Explanatory Remarks:

1. Editorial notes or additions are enclosed in ().
2. Structural elements are enclosed in <>.

Text:

<1>

śrīmahābhāratam
tasya khilabhāgo harivaṃśaḥ
tatra harivaṃśaparva

<1.1>

prathamo'dhyāyaḥ
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam |
devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet || 1 ||
dvaipāyanoṣṭhapuṭaniḥsṛtamaprameyaṃ
puṇyaṃpavitramatha pāpaharaṃ śivaṃ ca |
yo bhārataṃ samadhigacchati vācyamānaṃ
kiṃ tasya puṣkarajalairabhiṣecanena || 2 ||
jayati parāśarasūnuḥ
satyavatīhadayanandano vyāsaḥ |
yasyāsyakamalagalitaṃ
vāṅmayamamṛtaṃ jagat pibati || 3 ||
yo gośataṃ kanakaśṛṅgamayaṃ dadāti
viprāya vedaviduṣe bahuviśrutāya |
puṇyāṃ ca bhāratakathāṃ śṛṇuyācca tadvat
tulyaṃ phalaṃ bhavati tasya ca tasya caiva || 4 ||
śatāśvamedhasya yadatra puṇyaṃ
catuḥsahasrasya śatakratośca |
bhavedanantaṃ harivaṃśadānāt
prakīrtitaṃ vyāsamaharṣiṇā ca || 5 ||
yad vājapeyena tu rājasūyād
dṛṣṭaṃ phalaṃ hastirathena cānyat |
tallabhyate vyāsavacaḥ pramāṇaṃ
gītaṃ ca vālmīkimaharṣiṇā ca || 6 ||
yo harivaṃśaṃ lekhayati
yathāvidhinā mahātapāḥ sapadi |
ca jayati haripadakamalaṃ
madhupo hi yathā rasena lubdhaḥ || 7 ||
pitāmahādyaṃ pravadanti ṣaṣṭhaṃ
maharṣimakṣayyavibhūtiyuktam |
nārāyaṇasyāṃśajamekaputraṃ
dvaipāyanaṃ veda mahānidhānam || 8 ||
ādyaṃ puruṣamīśānaṃ puruhūtaṃ puruṣṭutam|
ṛtamekākṣaraṃ brahma vyaktāvyaktaṃ sanātanam || 9 ||
asacca sadasaccaiva yadviśvaṃ sadasatparam |
parāvarāṇāṃ sraṣṭāraṃ purāṇaṃ paramavyayam || 1.1.10 ||
maṅgalyaṃ maṅgalaṃ viṣṇuṃ vareṇyamanaghaṃ śucim |
namaskṛtya hṛṣīkeśaṃ carācaraguruṃ harim || 11 ||
naimiṣāraṇye kulapatiḥ śaunakastu mahāmuniḥ |
sautiṃ papraccha dharmātmā sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ || 12 ||
śaunaka uvāca
saute sumahadakhyānaṃ bhavatā parikīrtitam |
bhāratānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ pārthivānāṃ tathaiva ca || 13 ||
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca gandharvoragarakṣasām |
daityānāmatha siddhānāṃ guhyakānāṃ tathaiva ca || 14 ||
atyadbhutāni karmāṇi vikramā dharmaniścayāḥ |
vicitrāśca kathāyogā janma cāgryamanuttamam|| 15 ||
kathitaṃ bhavatā puṇyaṃ purāṇaṃ ślakṣṇayā girā |
manaḥkarṇasukhaṃ saute prīṇātyamṛtasammitam ||16 ||
tatra janma kurūṇāṃ vai tvayoktaṃ laumaharṣaṇe |
na tu vṛṣṇyandhakānāṃ ca tad bhavān vaktumarhati|| 17 ||
sautiruvāca
janamejayena yatpraṣṭaḥ śiṣyo vyāsasya dharmavit |
tat te'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi vṛṣṇīnāṃ vaṃśamāditaḥ || 18
śrutvetihāsaṃ kārtsnyena bhāratānāṃ sa bhārataḥ |
janamejayo mahāprājño vaiśampāyanamabravīt || 19 ||
janamejaya uvāca
mahābhāratamākhyānaṃ bahvarthaṃ śrutivistaram |
kathitaṃ bhavatā pūrvaṃ vistareṇa mayā śrutam || 1.1.20||
tatra śūrāḥ samākhyātā bahavaḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ |
nāmabhiḥ karmabhiścaiva vṛṣṇyandhakamahārathāḥ || 21 ||
teṣāṃ karmāvadātāni tvayoktāni dvijottama |
tatra tatra samāsena vistareṇaiva me prabho || 22 ||
na ca me taptirastīha kathyamāne purātane |
ekaścaiva mato rāśirvṛṣṇayaḥ pāṇḍavāstathā || 23 ||
bhavāṃśca vaṃśakuśalasteṣāṃ pratyakṣadarśivān |
kathayasva kulaṃ teṣāṃ vistareṇa tapodhana || 24 ||
yasya yasyānvaye ye ye tāṃstānicchāmi veditum |
sa tvaṃ sarvamaśeṣeṇa kathayasva mahāmune |
teṣāṃ pūrvavisṛṣṭiṃ ca vicintyemāṃ prajāpateḥ || 25 ||
sautiruvāca
satkṛtya paripṛṣṭastu sa mahātmā mahātapāḥ| |
vistareṇānupūrvyā ca kathayāmāsa tāṃ kathām || 26 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śṛṇu rājan kathāṃ divyāṃ puṇyāṃ pāpapramocanīm |
kathyamānāṃ mayā citrāṃ bahvarthāṃ śrutisammitām|| 27 ||
yaścemāṃ dhārayed vāpi śṛṇuyād vā'pyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ |
svavaṃśadhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā svargaloke mahīyate || 28 ||
avyaktaṃ kāraṇaṃ yat tannityaṃ sadasadātmakam|
pradhānaṃ puruṣaṃ tasmānnirmame viśvamīśvaram || 29 ||
taṃ vai viddhi mahārāja brahmāṇamamitaujasam |
sraṣṭāraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇam || 1.1.30 ||
ahaṅkārastu mahatastasmād bhūtāni jajñire |
bhūtabhedāśca bhūtebhya iti sargaḥ sanātanaḥ || 31||
vistarāvayavaṃ caiva yathāprajñaṃ yathāśruti |
kīrtyamānaṃ śṛṇu mayā pūrveṣāṃ kīrtivardhanam || 32 ||
dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ śatrughnaṃ svargyamāyuḥpravardhanam |
kīrtanaṃ sthirakīrtīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām || 33 ||
tasmātkalpāya te kalpaḥ samagraṃ śucaye śuciḥ |
ā vṛṣṇivaṃśād vakṣyāmi bhūtasargamanuttamam || 34 ||
tataḥ svayambhūrbhagavān sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ |
apa eva sasarjādau tāsu vīryamavāsṛjat || 35 ||
āpo nārā iti proktā āpo vai narasūnavaḥ |
ayanaṃ tasya tāḥ pūrvaṃ tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || 36 ||
hiraṇyavarṇamabhavat tadaṇḍamudakeśayam |
tatra jajñe svayaṃ brahmā svayambhūriti naḥ śrutam || 37 ||
hiraṇyagarbho bhagavānuṣitvā parivatsaram |
tadaṇḍamakarod dvaidhaṃ divaṃ bhuvamathāpi ca || 38 ||
tayoḥ śakalayormadhye ākāśamasṛjat prabhuḥ |
apsu pāriplavāṃ pṛthvīṃ diśaśca daśadhā dadhe || 39 ||
tatra kālaṃ mano vācaṃ kāmaṃ krodhamatho ratim |
sasarja sṛṣṭiṃ tadrūpāṃ sraṣṭumicchan prajāpatīn || 1.1.40 ||
marīcimatryaṅgirasaṃ pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum |
vasiṣṭhaṃ ca mahātejāḥ so'sṛjatsapta mānasān|| 41 ||
sapta brahmāṇa ityete purāṇe niścayaṃ gatāḥ |
nārāyaṇātmakānāṃ vai saptānāṃ brahmajanmanām || 42 ||
tato'sṛjatpunarbrahmā rudraṃ roṣātmasambhavam|
sanatkumāraṃ ca vibhuṃ pūrveṣāmapi pūrvajam || 43 ||
saptaite janayanti sma prajā rudraśca bhārata |
skandaḥ sanatkumāraśca tejaḥ saṃkṣipya tiṣṭhataḥ || 44 ||
teṣāṃ sapta mahāvaṃśā divyā devagaṇānvitāḥ |
kriyāvantaḥ prajāvanto maharṣibhiralaṃkṛtāḥ || 45 ||
vidyuto'śanimeghāṃśca rohitendradhanūṃṣi ca |
vayāṃsi ca sasarjādau parjanyaṃ ca sasarja ha || 46 ||
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni nirmame yajñasiddhaye |
mukhād devānajanayatpitṝṃśceśo'pi vakṣasaḥ|| 47 ||
prajanācca manuṣyān vai jaghanānnirmame'surān |
sādhyānajanayad devānityevamanuśuśruma || 48 ||
uccāvacāni bhūtāni gātrebhyastasya jajñire |
āpavasya prajāsargaṃ sṛjato hi prajāpateḥ || 49 ||
sṛjyamānāḥ prajā naiva vivardhante yadā tadā |
dvidhā kṛtvā''tmano dehamardhena puruṣo'bhavat|| 1.1.50 ||
ardhena nārī tasyāṃ sa sasṛje vividhāḥ prajāḥ |
divaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ caiva mahimnā vyāpya tiṣṭhataḥ || 51 ||
virājamasṛjadviṣṇuḥ so'sṛjatpuruṣaṃ virāṭ|
puruṣaṃ taṃ manuṃ viddhi tad vai manvantaraṃ smṛtam ||52 ||
dvitīyamāpavasyaitanmanorantaramucyate |
sa vairājaḥ prajāsarge sasarja puruṣaḥ prabhuḥ |
nārāyaṇavisargaḥ sa prajāstasyāpyayonijāḥ || 53 ||
āyuṣmān kīrtimān dhanyaḥ prajāvāñchrutavāṃstathā |
ādisargaṃ viditvemaṃ yatheṣṭāṃ gatimāpnuyāt || 54 |
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi ādisargakathane prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1||

<1.2>

dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
sa sṛṣṭāsu prajāsvevamāpavo vai prajāpatiḥ |
lebhe vai puruṣaḥ patnīṃ śatarūpāmayonijām || 1 ||
āpavasya mahimnā tu divamāvṛtya tiṣṭhataḥ |
dharmeṇaiva mahārāja śatarūpā vyajāyata || 2 ||
sā tu varṣāyutaṃ taptvā tapaḥ paramaduścaram |
bhartāraṃ dīptatapasaṃ puruṣaṃ pratyapadyata || 3 ||
sa vai svāyambhuvastāta puruṣo manurucyate |
tasyaikasaptatiyugaṃ manvantaramihocyate || 4 ||
vairājāt puruṣād vīraṃ śatarūpā vyajāyata |
priyavratottānapādau vīrāt kāmyā vyajāyata || 5 ||
kāmyā nāma mahābāho kardamasya prajāpateḥ |
kāmyāputrāstu cattvāraḥ samrāṭkukṣirvirāṭ prabhuḥ |
priyavrataṃ samāsādya patiṃ sā suṣuve sutān || 6 ||
uttānapādaṃ jagrāha putramatriḥ prajāpatiḥ |
uttānapādāccaturaḥ sūnṛtājanayat sutān || 7 ||
dharmasya kanyā suśroṇī sūnṛtā nāma viśrutā |
utpannā vājimedhena dhruvasya jananī śubhā || 8 ||
dhruvaṃ va kīrtimantaṃ ca śivaṃ śāntamayaspatim|
uttānapādo'janavaॉyt sūnṛtāyāṃ prajāpatiḥ || 9 |
dhruvo varṣasahastrāṇi trīṇi divyāni bhārata |
tapastepe mahārāja prārthayan sumahad yaśaḥ || 1.2.10 ||
tasmai brahmā dadau prītaḥ sthānamapratimaṃ bhuvi |
acalaṃ caiva purataḥ saptarṣīṇāṃ prajāpatiḥ || 11 ||
tasyātimātrāmṛddhiṃ ca mahimānaṃ nirīkṣya ca |
devāsurāṇāmācāryaḥ ślokamapyuśanā jagau ||12 ||
aho'sya tapaso vīryamaho śrutamaho balam |
yadenaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā bhuvaṃ saptarṣayaḥ sthitāḥ || 13||
tasmācchliṣṭiṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca dhruvācchambhurvyajāyata|
śliṣṭerādhatta succhāyā pañca putrānakalmaṣān || 14 ||
ripuṃ ripuñjayaṃ puṇyaṃ vṛkalaṃ vṛkatejasam|
riporādhatta bṛhatī cākṣuṣaṃ sarvatejasam ||15||
ajījanat puṣkariṇyāṃ vīraṇyāṃ cākṣuṣo manum|
prajāpaterātmajāyāmaraṇyasya mahātmanaḥ || 16||
manorajāyanta daśa naḍvalāyāṃ mahaujasaḥ |
kanyāyāmabhavañchreṣṭhā vairājasya prajāpateḥ || 17 ||
ūruḥ puruḥ śatadyumnastastapasvī satyavān kaviḥ |
agniṣṭudatirātraśca sudyumnaśceti te nava || 18 ||
abhimanyuśca daśamo naḍvalāyāḥ sutāḥ smṛtāḥ|
ūrorajanayat putrān ṣaḍāgneyī mahāprabhān |
aṅgaṃ sumanasaṃ khyātiṃ kratumaṅgirasaṃ gayam || 19 ||
aṅgāt sunīthāpatyaṃ vai venamekamajāyata |
apacārāttu venasya prakopaḥ sumahānabhūt || 1.2.20 ||
prajārthamṛṣayo yasya mamanthurdakṣiṇaṃ karam|
venasya pāṇau mathite babhūva munibhiḥ pṛthuḥ || 21 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā ṛṣayaḥ prāhureṣa vai muditāḥ prajāḥ |
kariṣyati mahātejā yaśaśca prāpsyate mahat || 22 ||
sa dhanvī kavacī khaḍgī tejasā nirdahanniva |
pṛthurvainyastadā cemāṃ rarakṣa kṣatrapūrvajaḥ || 23||
rājasūyābhiṣiktānāmādyaḥ sa vasudhādhipaḥ |
tasmāccaiva samutpannau nipuṇau sutamāgadhau || 24 ||
teneyaṃ gaurmahārāja dugdhā sasyāni bhārata |
prajānāṃ vṛttikāmena devaiḥ sarṣigaṇaiḥ saha || 25 ||
pitṛbhirdānavaiścaiva gandharvaiḥ sāpsarogaṇaiḥ |
sarpaiḥ puṇyajanaiścaiva vīrudbhiḥ parvataistathā || 26
teṣu teṣu ca pāśeṣu duhyamānā vasundharā |
prādād yathepsitaṃ kṣīraṃ tena prāṇānadhārayan || 27 ||
pṛthuputrau tu dharmajñau jajñāte'ntarddhipālitau |
śikhaṇḍinī havirdhānamantardhānāda vyajāyata ||28 ||
havirdhānātṣaḍāgneyī dhiṣaṇājanayatsutān |
prācīnabarhiṣaṃ śuklaṃ gayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vrajājinau || 29 ||
prācīnabarhirbhagavān mahānāsītprajāpatiḥ |
havirdhānānmahārāja yena saṃvarddhitā prajāḥ | 1.2.30 ||
prācīnāgrāḥ kuśāstasya pṛthivyāṃ janamejaya |
prācīnabarhirbhagavān pṛthivītalacāriṇaḥ|| 31 ||
samudratanayāyāṃ tu kṛtadāro'bhavatprabhuḥ |
mahatastapasaḥ pāre savarṇāyāṃ mahīpatiḥ || 32 ||
savarṇā''dhatta sāmudrī daśa prācīnabarhiṣaḥ |
sarve pracetaso nāma dhanurvedasya pāragāḥ || 33 ||
apṛthagdharmacaraṇāste'tapyanta mahattapaḥ |
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi samudrasalileśayāḥ || 34||
tapaścaratsu pṛthivīṃ pracetassu mahīruhāḥ |
arakṣyamāṇāmāvavrurbabhūvātha prajākṣayaḥ || 35 ||
nāśakanmāruto vātuṃ vṛtaṃ khamabhavad drumaiḥ |
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi na śekuśceṣṭituṃ prajāḥ || 36 ||
tadupaśrutya tapasā yuktāḥ sarve pracetasaḥ |
mukhebhyo vāyumagniṃ ca te'sṛjañjātamanyavaḥ || 37 ||
unmūlānatha tānkṛtvā vṛkṣānvāyuraśoṣayat|
tānagniradahadghoraṃ evamāsīd drumakṣayaḥ || 38 ||
drumakṣayamatho buddhvā kiṃcicchiṣṭeṣu śākhiṣu |
upagamyābravīdetān rājā somaḥ prajāpatīn || 39 ||
kopaṃ yacchata rājānaḥ sarve prācīnabarhiṣaḥ |
vṛkṣaśūnyā kṛtā pṛthvī śāmyetāmagnimārutau || 1.2.40 ||
ratnabhūtā ca kanyeyaṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ varavarṇinī |
bhaviṣyaṃ jānatā tattvaṃ dhṛtā garbheṇa vai mayā || 41 ||
māriṣā nāma kanyeyaṃ vṛkṣāṇāmiti nirmitā |
bhāryā vo'stu mahābhāgāḥ somavaṃśavivarddhinī || 42 ||
yuṣmākaṃ tejaso'rddhena mama cārddhena tejasaḥ |
asyāmutpatsyate putro dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ || 43 ||
ya imāṃ dagdhabhūyiṣṭhāṃ yuṣmattejomayena vai |
agnināgnisamo bhūyaḥ prajāḥ saṃvardhayiṣyati||44||
tataḥ somasya vacanājjagṛhuste pracetasaḥ |
saṃhṛtya kopaṃ vṛkṣebhyaḥ patnīṃ dharmeṇa māriṣām || 45 ||
māriṣāyāṃ tataste vai manasā garbhamādadhuḥ |
daśabhyastu pracetobhyo māriṣāyāṃ prajāpatiḥ |
dakṣo jajñe mahātejāḥ somasyāṃśena bhārata || 46 ||
putrānutpādayāmāsa somavaṃśavivardhanān |
acarāṃśca carāṃścaiva dvipado'tha catuṣpadaḥ |
sa dṛṣṭvā manasā dakṣaḥ paścādapyasṛjat striyaḥ || 47 ||
dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa |
śiṣṭāḥ somāya rājñe'tha nakṣatrākhyā dadau prabhuḥ||48||
tāsu devāḥ khagā nāgā gāvo ditijadānavāḥ |
gandharvāpsarasaścaiva jajñire'nyāśca jātayaḥ || 49 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti rājendra prajā maithunasambhavāḥ |
saṃkalpāddarśanātsparśātpūrveṣāṃ sṛṣṭirucyate|| 1.2.50 ||
janamejaya uvāca
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca gandharvoragarakṣasām |
sambhavaḥ kathitaḥ pūrvaṃ dakṣasya ca mahātmanaḥ || 51 ||
aṅguṣṭhād brahmaṇo jāto dakṣaḥ proktastvayānagha |
vāmāṅguṣṭhāt tathā caiva tasya patnī vyajāyata || 52 ||
kathaṃ prācetasatvaṃ sa punarlebhe mahātapāḥ |
etanme saṃśayaṃ vipra samyagākhyātumarhasi |
dauhitraścaiva somasya kathaṃ śvaśuratāṃ gataḥ || 53 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
utpattiśca nirodhaśca nityau bhūteṣu pārthiva |
ṛṣayo'tra na muhyanti vidvāṃsaścaiva ye janāḥ || 54 ||
yuge yuge bhavantyete sarve dakṣādayo nṛpa |
punaścaiva nirudhyante vidvāṃstatra na muhyati || 55 |
jyaiṣṭhyaṃ kāniṣṭhyamapyeṣāṃ pūrve nāsījjanādhipa |
tapa eva garīyo'bhūtprabhāvaścaiva kāraṇam || 56 ||
imāṃ visṛṣṭiṃ dakṣasya yo vidyātsacarācarām |
prajāvānāpaduttīrṇaḥ svargaloke mahīyate || 57 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi prajāsarge dakṣotpattikathane dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||

<1.3>

tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca gandharvoragarakṣasām |
utpattiṃ vistareṇemāṃ vaiśampāyana kīrtaya || 1 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
prajāḥ sṛjeti vyādiṣṭaḥ pūrvaṃ dakṣaḥ svayambhuvā|
yathā sasarja bhūtāni tathā śṛṇu mahīpate || 2 ||
mānasānyeva bhūtāni pūrvamevāsṛjatprabhuḥ |
ṛṣīndevān sagandharvānasurānatha rākṣasān|
yakṣabhūtapiśācāṃśca vayaḥpaśusarīsṛpān || 3 ||
yadāsya tāstu mānasyo na vyavarddhanta vai prajāḥ |
apadhyātā bhagavatā mahādevena dhīmatā || 4 ||
tataḥ saṃcintya tu punaḥ prajāhetoḥ prajāpatiḥ |
sa maithunena dharmeṇa sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ || 5 ||
asiknīmāvahat patnīṃ vīraṇasya prajāpateḥ |
sutāṃ sutapasā yuktāṃ mahatīṃ lokadhāriṇīm || 6 ||
atha putrasahasrāṇi vīraṇyāṃ pañca vīryavān |
asiknyāṃ janayāmāsa dakṣa eva prajāpatiḥ ||7 ||
tāṃstu dṛṣṭvā mahābhāgān saṃvivardhayiṣūn prajāḥ|
devarṣiḥ priyasaṃvādo nāradaḥ prābravīdidam |
nāśāya vacanaṃ teṣāṃ śāpāyaivātmanastathā || 8 ||
yaṃ kaśyapaḥ sutavaraṃ parameṣṭhī vyajījanat |
dakṣasya vai duhitari dakṣaśāpabhayānmuniḥ || 9 ||
pūrvaṃ sa hi samutpanno nāradaḥ parameṣṭhinā |
asiknyāmatha vīraṇyāṃ bhūyo devarṣisattamaḥ |
taṃ bhūyo janayāmāsa piteva munipuṅgavam || 1.3.10 ||
tena dakṣasya putrā vai haryaśvā iti viśrutāḥ |
nirmathya nāśitāḥ sarve vidhinā ca na saṃśayaḥ || 11 ||
tasyodyatastadā dakṣo nāśāyāmitavikramaḥ |
maharṣīn purataḥ kṛtvā yācitaḥ parameṣṭhinā || 12 ||
tato'bhisaṃdhiṃ cakruste dakṣastu parameṣṭhinā |
kanyāyāṃ nārado mahyaṃ tava putro bhavediti || 13 ||
tato dakṣastu tāṃ prādātkanyāṃ vai parameṣṭhine |
sa tasyāṃ nārado jajñe dakṣaśāpabhayādṛṣiḥ || 14 ||
janamejaya uvāca
kathaṃ vināśitāḥ putrā nāradena maharṣiṇā |
prajāpaterdvijaśreṣṭha śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || 15 |
vaiśampāyana uvāca
dakṣasya putrā haryaśvā vivardhayiṣavaḥ prajāḥ |
samāgatā mahāvīryā nāradastānuvāca ha || 16 ||
bāliśā bata yūyaṃ vai nāsyā jānītha vai bhuvaḥ |
pramāṇaṃ sraṣṭukāmāḥ stha prajāḥ prācetasātmajāḥ|
antarūrdhvamadhaścaiva kathaṃ srakṣyatha vai prajāḥ || 17 ||
te tu tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prayātāḥ sarvatodiśam |
pramāṇaṃ draṣṭukāmaste gatāḥ prācetasātmajāḥ || 18||
vāyoranaśanaṃ prāpya gatāste vai parābhavam |
adyāpi na nivartante samudrebhya ivāpagāḥ || 19 ||
haryaśveṣvatha naṣṭeṣu dakṣaḥ prācetasaḥ punaḥ |
vairaṇyāmeva putrāṇāṃ sahasramasṛjat prabhuḥ || 1.3.20 ||
vivardhayiṣavaste tu śabalāśvāḥ prajāstadā |
pūrvoktaṃ vacanaṃ tāta nāradenaiva noditāḥ || 21 ||
anyonyamūcuste sarve samyagāha mahāmuniḥ |
bhrātṝṇāṃ padavīṃ jñātuṃ gantavyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 22 ||
jñātvā pramāṇaṃ pṛthvyāśca sukhaṃ srakṣyāmahe prajāḥ |
ekāgrāḥ svasthamanasā yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || 23 ||
te'pi tenaiva mārgeṇa prayātāḥ sarvatodiśam |
adyāpi na nivartante samudrebhya ivāpagāḥ || 24 ||
naṣṭeṣu śabalāśveṣu dakṣaḥ kruddho'vadad vacaḥ |
nāradaṃ nāśamehīti garbhavāsaṃ vaseti ca || 25 ||
tadāprabhṛti vai bhrātā bhrāturanveṣaṇaṃ nṛpa |
prayāto naśyati kṣipraṃ tanna kāryaṃ vipaścitā || 26 ||
tāṃścāpi naṣṭān vijñāya putrān dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
ṣaṣṭiṃ bhūyo'sṛjat kanyā vīraṇyāmiti naḥ śrutam ||
tāstadā pratijagrāha bhāryārthe kaśyapaḥ prabhuḥ|
somo dharmaśca kauravya tathaivānye maharṣayaḥ || 28 ||
dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa |
saptaviṃśatiṃ somāya catasro'riṣṭanemine || 29 ||
dve caiva bhṛguputrāya dve caivāṅgirase tathā |
dve kṛśāśvāya viduṣe tāsāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu || 1.3.30 ||
arundhatī vasuryāmī labhyā bhānurmarutvatī |
saṃkalpā ca muhūrtā ca sādhyā viśvā ca bhārata |
dharmapatnyo daśa tvetāstāsvapatyāni me śṛṇu || 31 ||
viśvedevāśca viśvāyāḥ sādhyān sādhyā vyajāyata |
marutvatyāṃ marutvanto vasostu vasavastathā || 32 ||
bhānostu bhānavastāta muhūrtāyā muhūrtajāḥ || 33 ||
lambāyāścaiva ghoṣo'tha nāgavīthī ca yāmijā |
pṛthivīviṣayaṃ sarvamarundhatyāṃ vyajāyata || 34 ||
saṃkalpāyāstu sarvātmā jajñe saṃkalpa eva hi |
gavīthyāśca yāminyā vṛṣalambā vyajāyata || 35 ||
rājan somapatnyastu dakṣaḥ prācetaso dadau|
sarvā nakṣatranāmnyastā jyautiṣe parikīrtitāḥ || 36||
ye' tvanye khyātimanto vai devā jyotiḥpurogamāḥ |
vasavo'ṣṭau samākhyātāsteṣāṃ vakṣyāmi vistaram || 37 ||
āpo dhruvaśca somaśca dharaścaivānilānalau |
pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavo nāmabhiḥ smṛtāḥ || 38 ||
āpasya putro vaitaṇḍyaḥ śramaḥ śānto munistathā |
dhruvasya putro bhagavān kālo lokaprakālanaḥ || 39 ||
somasya bhagavān varcā varcasvī yena jāyate |
dharasya putro draviṇo hutahavyavahastathā |
manoharāyāḥ śiśiraḥ prāṇo'tha ramaṇastathā || 1.3.40 ||
anilasya śivā bhāryā yasyāḥ putro manojavaḥ |
avijñātagatiścaiva dvau putrāvanilasya tu || 41 ||
agniputraḥ kumārastu śarastambe śriyānvitaḥ |
tasya śākho viśākhaśca naigameyaśca pṛṣṭhajāḥ || 42 ||
apatyaṃ kṛttikānāṃ tu kārtikeya iti smṛtaḥ |
skandaḥ sanatkumāraśca sṛṣṭaḥ pādena tejasaḥ || 43 ||
pratyūṣasya viduḥ putramṛṣṭiṃ nāmnā ca devalam |
dvau putrau devalasyāpi kṣamāvantau tapasvinau || 44 ||
bṛhaspatestu bhaginī varastrī brahmacāriṇī |
yogasiddhā jagat kṛtsnamasaktā vicacāra ha || 45 ||
prabhāsasya ca sā bhāryā vasūnāmaṣṭamasya ca |
viśvakarmā mahābhāgastasyāṃ jajñe prajāpatiḥ || 46 ||
kartā śilpasahasrāṇāṃ tridaśānāṃ ca vardhakiḥ |
bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ kartā śilpavatāṃ varaḥ || 47 ||
yaḥ sarvāsāṃ vimānāni devatānāṃ cakāra ha |
manuṣyāścopajīvanti yasya śilpaṃ mahātmanaḥ || 48 ||
surabhī kaśyapād rudrānekādaśa vinirmame |
mahādevaprasādena tapasā bhāvitā satī || 49 ||
ajaikapādahirbudhnyastvaṣṭā rudrāśca bhārata |
tvaṣṭuścaivātmajaḥ śrīmān viśvarūpo mahāyaśāḥ || 1.3.50 ||
haraśca bahurūpaśca tryambakaścāparājitaḥ |
vṛṣākapiśca śambhuśca kapardī raivatastathā || 51 ||
mṛgavyādhaśca sarpaśca kapālī ca viśāmpate |
ekādaśaite kathitā rudrāstribhuvaneśvarāḥ || 52 ||
śataṃ tvevaṃ samākhyātaṃ rudrāṇāmamitaujasām |
purāṇe bharataśreṣṭha yairvyāptāḥ sacarācarāḥ || 53 ||
lokā bharataśārdūla kaśyapasya nibodha me |
aditirditirdanuścaiva ariṣṭā surasā khaśā || 54 ||
surabhirvinatā caiva tāmrā krodhavaśā irā |
kadrurmuniśca rājendra tāsvapatyāni me śṛṇu || 55||
pūrvamanvantare śreṣṭhā dvādaśāsan surottamāḥ |
tuṣitā nāma te'nyonyamūcurvaivasvate'ntare || 56 ||
upasthite'tiyaśasi cākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ |
hitārthaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ samāgamya parasparam || 57 ||
āgacchata drutaṃ devā aditiṃ sampraviśya vai |
manvantare prasūyāmastannaḥ śreyo bhaviṣyati || 58 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evamuktvā tu te sarve cākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ |
mārīcāt kaśyapājjātāste'dityā dakṣakanyayā || 59 ||
tatra viṣṇuśca śakraśca jajñāte punareva hi |
aryamā caiva dhātā ca tvaṣṭā pūṣā ca bhārata || 1.3.60 ||
vivasvān savitā caiva mitro varuṇa eva ca |
aṃśo bhagaścātitejā ādityā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ || 61 ||
cākṣuṣasyāntare pūrvamāsan ye tuṣitāḥ surāḥ |
vaivasvate'ntare te vai ādityā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ || 62||
saptaviṃśatiryāḥ proktāḥ somapatnyo'tha suvratāḥ|
tāsāmapatyābhyabhavan dīptānyamitatejasām || 63 ||
ariṣṭanemipantīnāmapatyānīha ṣoḍaśa |
bahuputrasya viduṣaścatasro vidyutaḥ smṛtāḥ || 64 ||
pratyaṅgirasajāḥ śreṣṭhā ṛco brahmarṣisatkṛtāḥ|
kṛśāśvasya tu rājarṣerdevapraharaṇāni ca || 65 ||
ete yugasahasrānte jāyante punareva hi |
sarvadevagaṇāstāta trayastriṃśat tu kāmajāḥ || 66 ||
teṣāmapi ca rājendra nirodhotpattirucyate || 67||
yathā sūryasya gagane udayāstamane iha |
evaṃ devanikāyaste sambhavanti yuge yuge || 68 ||
dityāḥ putradvayaṃ jajñe kaśyapāditi naḥ śrutam |
hiraṇyakaśipuścaiva hiraṇyākṣaśca vīryavān || 69 ||
siṃhikā cābhavat kanyā vipracitteḥ parigrahaḥ|
saiṃhikeyā iti khyātāstasyāḥ putrā mahābalāḥ |
gaṇaiśca saha rājendra daśasāhasramucyate || 1.3.70 ||
teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ |
asaṃkhyātā mahābāho hiraṇyakaśipoḥ śṛṇu || 71 ||
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putrāścatvāraḥ prathitaujasaḥ |
anuhrādaśca hrādaśca prahrādaścaiva vīryavān || 72||
saṃhrādaśca caturtho'bhūddhrādaputro hradastathā |
saṃhrādaputraḥ sundaśca nisundastāvubhau smṛtau || 73 ||
anuhrādasutau hyāyuḥ śibikālastathaiva ha |
virocanaśca prāhrādirbalirjajñe virocanāt || 74 ||
bale putraśataṃ tvāsīd bāṇajyeṣṭhaṃ narādhipa |
dhṛtarāṣṭraśca sūryaśca candramāścendratāpanaḥ || 75 ||
kumbhanābho gardabhākṣaḥ kukṣirityevamādayaḥ |
bāṇasteṣāmatibalo jyeṣṭhaḥ paśupateḥ priyaḥ || 76 ||
purākalpe hi bāṇena prasādyomāpatiṃ prabhum |
pārśvato vihariṣyāmi ityevaṃ yācito varaḥ || 77 ||
bāṇasya cendradamano lohityāmupapadyata |
gaṇāstathāsurā rājañchatasāhasrasammitāḥ || 78 ||
hiraṇyākṣasutāḥ pañca vidvāṃsaḥ sumahābalāḥ |
jharjharaḥ śakuniścaiva bhūtasaṃtāpanastathā |
mahānābhaśca vikrāntaḥ kālanābhastathaiva ca || 79 ||
abhavan danuputrāśca śataṃ tīvraparākramāḥ |
tapasvino mahāvīryāḥ prādhānyena nibodha tān || 1.3.80||
dvimūrdhā śakuniścaiva tathā śaṅkuśirā vibhuḥ|
śaṅkukarṇo virādhaśca gaveṣṭhī dundubhistathā |
ayomukhaḥ śambaraśca kapilo vāmanastathā || 81 ||
marīcirmaghavāṃścaiva irā śaṅkuśirā vṛkaḥ |
vikṣobhaṇaśca ketuśca ketuvīryaśatahradau || 82 ||
indrajit satyajiccaiva vajranābhastathaiva ca |
mahānābhaśca vikrāntaḥ kālanābhastathaiva ca || 83 ||
ekacakro mahābāhustārakaśca mahābalaḥ |
vaiśvānaraḥ pulomā ca vidrāvaṇamahāsurau || 84 ||
svarbhānurvṛṣaparvā ca tuhuṇḍaśca mahāsuraḥ |
sūkṣmaścaivāticandraśca ūrṇanābho mahāgiriḥ || 85||
asilomā ca keśī ca śaṭhaśca balako madaḥ |
tathā gaganamūrdhā ca kumbhanābho mahāsuraḥ || 86 ||
pramado mayaśca kupatho hayagrīvaśca vīryavān |
vaisṛpaḥ savirūpākṣaḥ supatho'tha harāharau || 87 ||
hiraṇyakaśipuścaiva śatamāyaśca śambaraḥ |
śarabhaḥ śalabhaścaiva vipracittiśca vīryavān || 88 ||
ete sarve danoḥ putrāḥ kaśyapādabhijajñire |
vipracittipradhānāste dānavāḥ sumahābalāḥ || 89 ||
eteṣāṃ yadapatyaṃ tu tanna śakyaṃ narādhipa |
prasaṃkhyātuṃ mahīpāla putrapautrādyanantakam || 1.3.90 ||
svarbhānostu prabhā kanyā pulomnaśca sutātrayam |
upadānavī hayaśirāḥ śarmiṣṭhā vārṣaparvaṇī || 91 ||
pulomā kālikā caiva vaiśvānarasute ubhe |
bahvapatye mahāvīrye mārīcestu parigrahaḥ || 92 ||
tayoḥ putrasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭiṃ dānavanandanān |
caturdaśaśatānanyān hiraṇyapuravāsinaḥ || 933
mārīcirjanayāmāsa mahatā tapasānvitaḥ |
paulomāḥ kālakeyāśca dānavāste mahābalāḥ || 94 ||
avadhyā devatānāṃ ca hiraṇyapuravāsinaḥ |
kṛtāḥ pitāmahenājau nihatāḥ savyasācinā || 95 ||
prabhāyā nahuṣaḥ putraḥ sṛṃjayaśca śacīsutaḥ |
pūruṃ jajñe'tha śarmiṣṭhā duṣyantamupadānavī || 96 ||
tato'pare mahāvīryā dānavāstvatidāruṇāḥ |
siṃhikāyāmathotpannā vipracitteḥ sutāstadā|| 97||
daityadānavasaṃyogājjātāstīvraparākramāḥ |
saiṃhikeyā iti khyātāstrayodaśa mahābalāḥ||98||
vyaṃśaḥ śalyaśca balinau nabhaścaiva mahābalaḥ |
vātāpirnamuciścaiva ilvalaḥ khasṛmastathā || 99 ||
āñjiko narakaścaiva kālanābhastathaiva ca |
śukaḥ potaraṇaścaiva vajranābhaśca vīryavān ||1.3.100||
rāhurjyeṣṭhastu teṣāṃ vai sūryacandravimardanaḥ |
mūkaścaiva tuhuṇḍaśca hrādaputrau babhūvatuḥ |101|
mārīcaḥ sundaputraśca tāḍakāyāṃ vyajāyata |
śivamāṇastathā caiva surakalpaśca vīryavān |102|
ete vai dānavāḥ śreṣṭhā danuvaṃśavivarddhanāḥ |
teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 103||
saṃhrādasya tu daityasya nivātakavacāḥ kule |
samutpannāḥ sutapasā mahānto bhāvitātmanaḥ ||104||
tisraḥ koṭyaḥ sutāsteṣāṃ maṇimatyāṃ nivāsinām|
te'pyavadhyāstu devānāmarjunena nipātitāḥ ||105||
ṣaṭ sutāḥ sumahāsattvāstāmrāyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
kākī śyenī ca bhāsī ca sugrīvī śuci gṛdhrikā || 106 ||
kākī kākānajanayadulūkī pratyulūkakān |
śyenī śyenāṃstathā bhāsī bhāsān gṛdhrāṃśca gṛdhryapi ||107||
śuciraudakān pakṣigaṇān sugrīvī tu paraṃtapa|
aśvānuṣṭrān gardabhāṃśca tāmrāvaṃśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 108 ||
vinatāyāstu putrau dvāvaruṇo garuḍastathā |
suparṇaḥ patatāṃ śreṣṭho dāruṇaḥ svena karmaṇā || 109||
surasāyāḥ sahasraṃ tu sarpāṇāmamitaujasām|
anekaśirasāṃ tāta khecarāṇāṃ mahātmanām ||1.3.110|
kādraveyāśca balinaḥ sahasramamitaujasaḥ |
suparṇavaśagā nāgā jaṅire'nekamastakāḥ || 111||
teṣāṃ pradhānāḥ satataṃ śeṣavāsukitakṣakāḥ |
airāvato mahāpadmaḥ kambalāśvatarāvubhau ||112||
elāpatrastathā śaṃkhaḥ karkoṭakadhanaṃjayau |
mahānīlamahākarṇau dhṛtarāṣṭrabalāhakau ||113||
kuharaḥ puṣpadaṣṭraśca durmukhaḥ sumukhastathā |
śaṅkhaśca śaṅkhapālaśca kapilo vāmanastathā |114|
nahuṣaḥ śaṅkharomā ca maṇirityevamādayaḥ |
teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca garuḍena nipātitāḥ ||115||
caturdaśa sahasrāṇi krūrāṇāṃ pavanāśinām |
gaṇaṃ krodhavaśaṃ viddhi tasya sarve ca daṃṣṭriṇaḥ 116||
sthalajāḥ pakṣiṇo'bjāśca dharāyāḥ prasavāḥ smṛtāḥ|
gāstu vai janayāmāsa surabhirmahiṣāṃstathā ||117|
irā vṛkṣalatāvallīstṛṇajātīśca sarvaśaḥ |
kaśā tu yakṣarakṣāṃsi munirapsarasastathā|| 118||
ariṣṭā tu mahāsattvān gandharvānamitaujasaḥ |
ete kaśyapadāyādāḥ kīrtitāḥ sthāṇujaṃgamāḥ ||119|
teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ |
eṣa manvantare tāta sargaḥ svārociṣe smṛtaḥ || 1.3.120||
vaivasvate tu mahati vāruṇe vitate kratau |
juhvānasya brahmaṇo vai prajāsargaṃ ihocyate || 121||
pūrvaṃ yatra tu brahmarṣīnutpannān sapta mānasān |
putratve kalpayāmāsa svayameva pitāmahaḥ || 122||
tato virodhe devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca bhārata |
ditirvinaṣṭaputrā vai toṣayāmāsa kaśyapam || 123 ||
tāṃ kaśyapaḥ prasannātmā samyagārādhitastayā |
vareṇa cchandayāmāsa sā ca vavre varaṃ tataḥ ||124||
putramindravadhārthāya samarthamamitaujasam |
sa ca tasyai varaṃ prādāt prārthitaṃ sumahātapāḥ || 125||
dattvā ca varamavyagro mārīcastāmabhāṣata |
bhaviṣyati sutaste'yaṃ yadyevaṃ dhārayiṣyasi ||126||
indraṃ suto nihantā te garbhaṃ vai śaradāṃ śatam |
yadi dhārayase śaucaṃ tatparā vratamāsthitā ||127||
tathetyabhihito bhartā tayā devyā mahātapāḥ |
dhārayāmāsa garbhaṃ tu śuciḥ sā vasudhādhipa ||128||
tato'bhyupāgamad dityāṃ garbhamādhāya kaśyapaḥ |
rocayan vai gaṇaśreṣṭhaṃ devānāmamitaujasām ||129||
tejaḥ sambhṛtya durdharṣamavadhyamamarairapi |
jagāma parvatāyaiva tapase śaṃsitavrataḥ || 1.3.130||
tasyāścaivāntaraprepsurabhavat pākaśāsanaḥ |
ūne varṣaśate cāsyā dadarśāntaramacyutaḥ || 131||
akṛtvā pādayoḥ śaucaṃ ditiḥ śayanamāviśat |
nidrāṃ ca kārayāmāsa tasyāḥ kukṣiṃ praviśya saḥ || 132||
vajrapāṇistato garbhaṃ saptadhā taṃ nyakṛntata |
sa pāṭyamāno vajreṇa garbhastu praruroda ha || 133||
mā rodīriti taṃ śakraḥ punaḥ punarathābravīt|
so'bhavat saptadhā garbhastamindro ruṣitaḥ punaḥ||134||
ekaikaṃ saptadhā cakre vajreṇaivārikarśanaḥ |
maruto nāma devāste babhūvurbharatarṣabha || 135||
yathaivoktaṃ maghavatā tathaiva maruto'bhavan |
devā ekonapañcāśat sahāyā vajrapāṇinaḥ ||136||
teṣāmevaṃ pravṛddhānāṃ bhūtānāṃ janamejaya |
rocayan vai gaṇaśreṣṭhaṃ devānāmamitaujasām ||137||
nikāyeṣu nikāyeṣu hariḥ prādāt prajāpatīn |
kramaśastāni rājyāni pṛthupūrvāṇi bhārata ||138||
sa hariḥ puruṣo vīraḥ kṛṣṇo jiṣṇuḥ prajāpatiḥ |
parjanyastapano'vyaktastasya sarvamidaṃ jagat ||139||
bhūtasargamimaṃ samyagjānato bharatarṣabha |
marutāṃ ca śubhaṃ janma śṛṇvataḥ paṭhato'pi vā |
nāvṛttibhayamastīha paralokabhayaṃ kutaḥ || 1.3.140||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi marudutpattikathane tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||

<1.4>

caturtho'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
abhiṣicyādhirājye tu pṛthuṃ vainyaṃ pitāmahaḥ|
tataḥ krameṇa rājyāni vyādeṣṭumupacakrame||1||
dvijānāṃ vīrudhāṃ caiva nakṣatragrahayostathā |
yajñānāṃ tapasāṃ caiva somaṃ rājye'bhyaṣecayat || 2 ||
apāṃ tu varuṇaṃ rājye rājñāṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ prabhum|
bṛhaspatiṃ tu viśveṣāṃ dadāvāṅgirasaṃ patim || 3 ||
bhṛgūṇāmadhipaṃ caiva kāvyaṃ rājye'bhyaṣecayat |
ādityānāṃ tathā viṣṇuṃ vasūnāmatha pāvakam | 4 ||
prajāpatīnāṃ dakṣaṃ tu marutāmatha vāsavam |
daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca prahlādamamitaujasam || 5 ||
vaivasvataṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ yamaṃ rājye'bhyaṣecayat |
mātṝṇāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca mantrāṇāṃ ca tathā gavām|| 6||
yakṣāṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca pārthivānāṃ tathaiva ca |
nārāyaṇaṃ tu sādhyānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam || 7 ||
vipracittiṃ tu rājānaṃ dānavānāmathādiśat|
sarvabhūtapiśācānāṃ giriśaṃ śūlapāṇinam || 8 |
śailānāṃ himavantaṃ ca nadīnāmatha sāgaram |
gandhānāṃ marutāṃ caiva bhūtānāmaśarīriṇām |
śabdākāśavatāṃ caiva vāyuṃ ca balināṃ varam || 9 ||
gandharvāṇāmadhipatiṃ cakre citrarathaṃ prabhum |
nāgānāṃ vāsukiṃ cakre sarpāṇāmatha takṣakam || 1.4.10 ||
kāraṇānāṃ ca rājānamairāvatamathādiśat |
uccaiḥśravasamaśvānāṃ garuḍaṃ caiva pakṣiṇām || 1 1||
mṛgāṇāmatha śārdūlaṃ govṛṣaṃ ca gavāṃ patim |
vanaspatīnāṃ rājānaṃ plakṣamevādiśat prabhum || 12 ||
sāgarāṇāṃ nadīnāṃ ca meghānāṃ varṣaṇasya ca |
ādityānāmadhipatiṃ parjanyamabhiṣiktavān || 13 ||
sarveṣāṃ daṃṣṭriṇāṃ śeṣaṃ rājānamabhyaṣecayat |
sarīsṛpāṇāṃ sarpāṇāṃ rājānaṃ caiva takṣakam || 14 ||
gandharvāpsarasāṃ caiva kāmadevaṃ tathā prabhum |
ṛtūnāmatha māsānāṃ divasānāṃ tathaiva ca || 15 ||
pakṣāṇāṃ ca kṣapāṇāṃ ca muhūrtatithiparvaṇām |
kalākāṣṭhāpramāṇānāṃ gaterayanayostathā || 16 ||
gaṇitasyātha yogasya cakre saṃvatsaraṃ prabhum |
evaṃ vibhajya rājyāni krameṇa sa pitāmahaḥ || 17 ||
diśāpālānatha tataḥ sthāpayāmāsa bhārata |
pūrvasyāṃ diśi putraṃ tu vairājasya prajāpateḥ || 18 ||
diśāpālaṃ sudhanvānaṃ rājānaṃ cābhyaṣecayat |
dakṣiṇasyāṃ mahātmānaṃ kardamasya prajāpateḥ || 19 ||
putraṃ śaṅkhapadaṃ nāma rājānaṃ so'bhyaṣecayat |
paścimāyāṃ diśi tathā rajasaḥ putramacyutam || 1.4.20 ||
ketumantaṃ mahātmānaṃ rājānaṃ so'bhyaṣecayat |
tathā hiraṇyaromāṇaṃ parjanyasya prajāpateḥ || 21 ||
udīcyāṃ diśi durdharṣaṃ rājānaṃ so'bhyaṣecayat|
tairiyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā saptadvīpā saparvatā || 22
yathāpradeśamadyāpi dharmeṇa paripālyate |
rājasūyābhiṣiktastu pṛthurebhirnarādhipaiḥ |
vedadṛṣṭena vidhinā rājarājye narādhipa || 23 ||
tato manvantare'tīte cākṣuṣe'mitatejasi |
vaivasvatāya manave brahmā rājyamathādiśat|
tasya vistaramākhyāsye manorvaivasvatasya ha || 24||
tavānukūlyād rājendra yadi śuśrūṣase'nagha |
mahaddhyetadadhiṣṭhānaṃ purāṇaṃ parikīrtitam |
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ svargavāsakaraṃ śubham || 25 ||
janamejaya uvāca
vistareṇa pṛthorjanma vaiśampāyana kīrtaya|
yathā mahātmanā tena dugdhā ceyaṃ vasuṃdharā||26||
yathā ca pitṛbhirdugdhā yathā devairyatharṣibhiḥ |
yathā daityaiśca nāgaiśca yathā yakṣairyathā drumaiḥ || 27 ||
yathā śailaiḥ piśācaiśca gandharvaiśca dvijottamaiḥ |
rākṣasaiśca mahāsattvairyathā dugdhā vasuṃdharā || 28 ||
teṣāṃ pātraviśeṣāṃśca vaiśampāyana kīrtaya |
vatsān kṣīraviśeṣāṃśca dogdhāraṃ cānupūrvaśaḥ || 29 ||
yasmācca kāraṇāt pāṇirvenasya mathitaḥ purā |
kruddhairmaharṣibhistāta kāraṇaṃ tacca kīrtaya || 1.4.30 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi pṛthorvainyasya vistaram |
ekāgraḥ prayataścaiva śṛṇuṣva janamejaya || 31 ||
nāśuceḥ kṣudramanasaḥ kuśiṣyāyāvratāya ca |
kīrtanīyamidaṃ rājan kṛtaghnāyāhitāya vā || 32 ||
svaryaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ dharmya vedena sammitam |
rahasyamṛṣibhiḥ proktaṃ śṛṇu rājan yathātatham || 33 ||
yaścainaṃ kathayennityaṃ pṛthorvainyasya vistaram|
brāhmaṇebhyo namaskṛtya na sa śocet kṛtākṛtaiḥ|| 34 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi pṛthūpākhyāne caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||

<1.5>

pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
āsīd dharmasya goptā vai pūrvamatrisamaḥ prabhuḥ |
atrivaṃśasamutpannastvaṅgo nāma prajāpatiḥ || 1 ||
tasya putro'bhavad veno nātyarthaṃ dharmakovidaḥ |
jāto mṛtyusutāyāṃ vai sunīthāyāṃ prajāpatiḥ || 2 ||
sa mātāmahadoṣeṇa venaḥ kālātmajā''tmajaḥ |
svadharmaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā kāmāllobheṣvavartata || 3 ||
maryādāṃ sthāpayāmāsa dharmāpetāṃ sa pārthivaḥ |
vedadharmānatikramya so'dharmanirato'bhavat || 4 ||
niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkārāstasmin rājani śāsati|
pravṛttaṃ na papuḥ somaṃ hutaṃ yajñeṣu devatāḥ || 5 ||
na yaṣṭavyaṃ na hotavyamiti tasya prajāpateḥ |
āsīt pratijñā krūreyaṃ vināśe pratyupasthite || 6 ||
ahamijyaśca yaṣṭā ca yajñaśceti kurūdvaha |
mayi yaśo vidhātavyo mayi hotavyamityapi || 7 ||
tamatikrāntamaryādamādadānamasāmpratam |
ūcurmaharṣayaḥ sarve marīcipramukhāstadā || 8 ||
vayaṃ dīkṣāṃ pravekṣyāmaḥ saṃvatsaragaṇān bahūn |
adharmaṃ kuru mā vena naiṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || 9 ||
nidhane'tra prasūtastvaṃ prajāpatirasaṃśayam |
prajāśca pālayiṣye'hamiti te samayaḥ kṛtaḥ || 1.5.10 ||
tāṃstadā bruvataḥ sarvān maharṣīnabravīt tadā |
venaḥ prahasya durbuddhirimamarthamanarthavit || 11 ||
vena uvāca
sraṣṭā dharmasya kaścānyaḥ śrotavyaṃ kasya vai mayā |
śrutavīryatapaḥsatyairmayā vā kaḥ samo bhuvi || 12 ||
prabhavaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
sammūḍhā na vidurnūnaṃ bhavanto māmacetasaḥ || 13 ||
icchan daheyaṃ pṛthivīṃ plāvayeyaṃ tathā jalaiḥ |
khaṃ bhuvaṃ caiva rundheyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 14 ||
yadā na śakyate mohādavalepācca pārthivaḥ |
anunetuṃ tadā venastataḥ kruddhā maharṣayaḥ || 15 ||
nigṛhya taṃ mahātmāno visphurantaṃ mahābalam |
tato'sya savyamūruṃ te mamanthurjātamanyavaḥ || 16 ||
tasmiṃstu mathyamāne vai rājña ūrau prajajñivān |
hrasvā'timātraḥ puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇaścāti babhūva ha || 17 ||
sa bhītaḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā sthitavāñjanamejaya |
tamatrirvihvalaṃ dṛṣṭvā niṣīdetyabravīt tadā || 18 ||
niṣādavaṃśakartāsau babhūva vadatāṃ vara |
dhīvarānasṛjaccātha venakalmaṣasambhavān || 19 ||
ye cānye vindhyanilayāstuṣārāstumbarāstathā |
adharmarucayo ye ca viddhi tān venasambhavān || 1.5.20 ||
tataḥ punarmahātmānaḥ pāṇiṃ venasya dakṣiṇam |
araṇīmiva saṃrabdhā mamanthuste maharṣayaḥ || 21 ||
pṛthustasmātsamuttasthau karājjvalanasaṃnibhaḥ |
dīpyamānaḥ svavapuṣā sākṣādagniriva jvalan || 22 ||
sa dhanvī kavacī jātaḥ pṛthureva mahāyaśāḥ |
ādyamājagavaṃ nāma dhanurgṛhya mahāravam |
śarāṃśca divyān rakṣārthaṃ kavacaṃ ca mahāprabham || 23 ||
tasmiñjāte'tha bhūtāni samprahṛṣṭāni sarvaśaḥ |
samāpeturmahārāja venaśca tridivaṃ gataḥ || 24 |
samutpannena kauravya satputreṇa mahātmanā |
trātaḥ sa puruṣavyāghra punnāmno narakāttadā || 25 ||
taṃ samudrāśca nadyaśca ratnānyādāya sarvaśaḥ |
toyāni cābhiṣekārthaṃ sarva evopatasthire || 26 ||
pitāmahaśca bhagavān devairāṅgirasaiḥ saha |
sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni jaṅgamāni tathaiva ca || 27 ||
samāgamya tadā vainyamabhyaṣiñcannarādhipam |
mahatā rājarājyena prajāpālaṃ mahādyutim || 28||
so'bhiṣikto mahātejā vidhivaddharmakovidaiḥ |
ādirājye tadā rājñāṃ pṛthurvainyaḥ pratāpavān || 29 ||
pitrāparañjitāstasya prajāstenānurañjitāḥ |
anurāgāt tatastasya nāma rājetyajāyata || 1.5.30||
āpastastambhire cāsya samudramabhiyāsyataḥ |
parvatāśca dadurmārgaṃ dhvajabhaṅgaśca nābhavat || 31||
akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī sidhyantyannāni cintayā |
sarvakāmadughā gāvaḥ puṭake puṭake madhu || 32 ||
etasminneva kāle tu yajñe paitāmahe śubhe |
sūtaḥ sūtyāṃ samutpannaḥ sautye'hani mahāmatiḥ|| 33||
tasminneva mahāyajñe jajñe prājño'tha māgadhaḥ |
pṛthoḥ stavārthe tau tatra samāhūtau surarthibhiḥ || 34 ||
tāvūcurṛṣayaḥ sarve stūyatāmeṣa pārthivaḥ |
karmaitadanurūpaṃ vāṃ pātraṃ cāyaṃ narādhipaḥ || 35 ||
tānūcatustadā sarvāṃstānṛṣīn sūtamāgadhau |
āvāṃ devānṛṣīṃścaiva prīṇayāvaḥ svakarmabhiḥ ||36||
na cāsya vidvo vai karma na tathā lakṣaṇaṃ yaśaḥ |
stotraṃ yenāsya kuryāva rājñastejasvino dvijāḥ|| 37 ||
ṛṣibhistau niyuktau ca bhaviṣyaiḥ stūyatāmiti |
yāni karmāṇi kṛtavān pṛthuḥ paścānmahābalaḥ || 38 ||
satyavāg dānaśīlo'yaṃ satyasaṃdho nareśvaraḥ |
śrīmāñjaitraḥ kṣamāśīlo vikrānto duṣṭaśāsanaḥ || 39 ||
dharmajñaśca kṛtajñaśca dayāvān priyabhāṣaṇaḥ |
mānyo mānayitā yajvā brahmaṇyaḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ || 1.5.40 ||
śamaḥ śāntaśca nirato vyavahārasthito nṛpaḥ |
tataḥ prabhṛti lokeṣu staveṣu janamejaya |
āśīrvādāḥ prayujyante sūtamāgadhabandibhiḥ || 41 ||
tayoḥ stavaistaiḥ suprītaḥ pṛthuḥ prādāt prajeśvaraḥ|
anūpadeśaṃ sūtāya magadhān māgadhāya ca || 42 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaprītāḥ prajāḥ prāhurmaharṣayaḥ |
vṛttīnāmeṣa vo dātā bhaviṣyati janeśvaraḥ || 43 ||
tato vainyaṃ mahārāja prajāḥ samabhidudruvuḥ |
tvaṃ no vṛttividhatsveti maharṣivacanāt tadā || 44 ||
so'bhidrutaḥ prajābhistu prajāhitacikīrṣayā |
dhanurgṛhya pṛṣatkāṃśca pṛthivīmādravad balī || 45 ||
tato vainyabhayatrastā gaurbhūtvā prādravanmahī |
tāṃ pṛthurdhanurādāya dravantīmanvadhāvata || 46 ||
sā lokān brahmalokādīn gatvā vainyabhayāttadā|
pradadarśāgrato vainyaṃ pragṛhītaśarāsanam || 47 ||
jvaladbhirniśitairbāṇairdīptatejasamacyutam |
mahāyogaṃ mahātmānaṃ durdharṣamamarairapi || 48 ||
alabhantī tu sā trāṇaṃ vainyamevānvapadyata |
kṛtāñjalipuṭā bhūtvā pūjyā lokaistribhiḥ sadā || 49 ||
uvāca vainyaṃ nādharmyaṃ strīvadhaṃ kartumarhasi |
kathaṃ dhārayitā cāsi prajā rājan vinā mayā || 1.5.50||
mayi lokāḥ sthitā rājanmayedaṃ dhāryate jagat|
madvināśe vinaśyeyuḥ prajāḥ pārthiva viddhi tat|| 51 ||
na tvamarhasi māṃ hantuṃ śreyaścet tvaṃ cikīrṣasi |
prajānāṃ pṛthivīpāla śṛṇu cedaṃ vaco mama || 52 ||
upāyataḥ samārabdhāḥ sarve sidhyantyupakramāḥ |
upāyaṃ paśya yena tvaṃ dhārayethāḥ prajā nṛpa || 53 ||
hatvāpi māṃ na śaktastvaṃ prajā dhārayituṃ nṛpa |
anubhūtā bhaviṣyāmi yaccha kopaṃ mahādyute | 54 ||
avadhyāśca striyaḥ prāhustiryagyonigateṣvapi |
sattveṣu pṛthivīpāla na dharme tyaktumarhasi || 55 |
evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā rājā mahāmanāḥ |
kopaṃ nigṛhya dharmātmā vasudhāmidamavravīt || 56 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi pṛthūpākhyāne pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||

<1.6>

ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ
pṛthuruvāca
ekasyārthāya yo hanyādātmano vā parasya vā|
bahūn vai prāṇino loke bhavet tasyeha pātakam ||1||
sukhamedhanti bahavo yasmiṃstu nihate'śubhe |
tasminnāsti hate bhadre pātakaṃ copapātakam || 2 ||
ekasmin yatra nidhanaṃ prāpite duṣṭakāriṇi |
bahūnāṃ bhavati kṣema tatra puṇyaprado vadhaḥ || 3 ||
so'haṃ prajānimittaṃ tvāṃ haniṣyāmi vasuṃdhare |
yadi me vacanaṃ nādya kariṣyasi jagaddhitam || 4
tvāṃ nihatyādya bāṇena macchāsanaparāṅmukhīm|
ātmānaṃ prathayitvāhaṃ prajā dhārayitā ciram || 5 ||
sā tvaṃ śāsanamāsthāya mama dharmabhṛtāṃ vare |
saṃjīvaya prajāḥ sarvāḥ samarthā hyasi dhāraṇe || 6 ||
duhitṛtvaṃ ca me gaccha tata enamahaṃ śaram |
niyaccheyaṃ tvadvadhārthamudyataṃ ghoradarśanam || 7 ||
pṛthivyuvāca
sarvametadahaṃ vīra vidhāsyāmi na saṃśayaḥ |
ṇa samārabdhāḥ sarve dvi || 8 ||
upāyaṃ paśya yena tvaṃ dhārayethāḥ prajā imāḥ |
vatsaṃ tu mama sampaśya kṣareyaṃ yena vatsalā || 9 ||
samāṃ ca kuru sarvatra māṃ tvaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ vara |
yathā vispandamānṃ me kṣīraṃ sarvatra bhāvayet || 1.6.10 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tata utsārayāmāsa śailāñchatasahasraśaḥ |
dhanuṣkoṭyā tadā vainyastena śailā vivarddhitāḥ || 11||
itthaṃ vainyastadā rājā mahīṃ cakre samāṃ tataḥ |
manvantareṣvatīteṣu viṣamāsīd vasuṃdharā || 12||
svabhāvenābhavan hyasyāḥ samāni viṣamāṇi ca |
cākṣuṣasyāntare pūrvamāsīdeva tadā kila || 13 ||
na hi pūrvavisarge vai viṣame pṛthivītale |
pravibhāgaḥ purāṇāṃ ca grāmāṇāṃ vā tadābhavat || 14 ||
na sasyāni na gorakṣā na kṛṣirna vaṇikpathaḥ |
naiva satyānṛtaṃ tatra na lobho na ca matsaraḥ || 15 ||
vaivasvate'ntare cāsmin sāmprataṃ samupasthite |
vainyāt prabhṛti rājendra sarvasyaitasya sambhavaḥ || 16 ||
yatra yatra samaṃ tvasyā bhūmerāsīdihānagha |
tatra tatra prajāḥ sarvāḥ saṃvāsaṃ samarocayan || 17 ||
āhāraḥ phalamūlāni prajānāmabhavat tadā |
kṛcchreṇa mahatā yukta ityevamanuśuśruma|| 18 ||
saṃkalpayitvā vatsaṃ tu manuṃ svāyambhuvaṃ prabhum |
svapāṇau puruṣaśreṣṭha dudoha pṛthivīṃ tataḥ |
sasyajātāni sarvāṇi pṛthurvainyaḥ pratāpavān || 19 ||
tenānnena prajāstāta vartante'dyāpi nityaśaḥ |
ṛṣibhiḥ śrūyate cāpi punardugdhā vasuṃdharā || 1.6.20 ||
vatsaḥ somo'bhavatteṣāṃ dogdhā cāṅgirasaḥ sutaḥ|
bṛhaspatirmahātejāḥ pātraṃ chandāṃsi bhārata |
kṣīramāsīdanupamaṃ tapo brahma ca śāśvatam || 21 ||
punardevagaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ puraṃdarapurogamaiḥ |
kāñcanaṃ pātramādāya dugdheyaṃ śrūyate mahī || 22||
vatsastu maghavānāsīddogdhā ca savitā prabhuḥ |
kṣīramūrjaskaraṃ caiva vartante yena devatāḥ || 23 ||
pitṛbhiḥ śrūyate cāpi punardugdhā vasuṃdharā |
rājataṃ pātramādāya svadhāmamitavikramaiḥ ||24||
yamo vaivasvatasteṣāmāsīd vatsaḥ pratāpavān |
antakaścābhavad dogdhā kālo lokaprakālanaḥ || 25 ||
nāgaiśca śrūyate dugdhā vatsaṃ kṛtvā tu takṣakam |
alābuṃ pātramādāya viṣaṃ kṣīraṃ narottama || 26 ||
teṣāmairāvato dogdhā dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ pratāpavān |
nāgānāṃ bharataśreṣṭha sarpāṇāṃ ca mahīpate || 27 ||
tenaiva vartayantyugrā mahākāyā viṣolbaṇāḥ |
tadāhārāstadācārāstadvīryāstadupāśrayāḥ || 28 ||
asuraiḥ śrūyate cāpi punardugdhā vasuṃdharā |
āyasaṃ pātramādāya māyāṃ śatrunibarhiṇīm || 29 ||
virocanastu prāhrādirvatsasteṣāmabhūt tadā |
ṛtvigdvimūrddhā daityānāṃ madhurdogdhā mahābalaḥ || 1.6.30 ||
tathaite māyayādyāpi sarve māyāvino'surāḥ |
vartayantyamitaprajñāstadevāmamitaṃ balam|| 31 ||
yakṣaiśca śrūyate tāta punardugdhā vasuṃdharā |
āmapātre mahārāja purāntarddhānamakṣayam || 32 ||
vatsaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ kṛtvā yakṣaiḥ puṇyajanaistadā |
dogdhā rajatanābhastu pitā maṇivarasya yaḥ || 33 ||
yakṣānujo mahātejāstriśīrṣaḥ sumahātapāḥ |
tena te vartayantīti paramarṣiruvāca ha || 34 ||
rākṣasaiśca piśācaiśca punardugdhā vasuṃdharā |
śāvaṃ kapālamādāya prajā bhoktuṃ nararṣabha || 35 ||
dogdhā rajatanābhastu teṣāmāsīt kurūdvaha |
vatsaḥ sumālī kauravya kṣīraṃ rudhirameva ca || 36 ||
tena kṣīreṇa yakṣāśca rākṣasāścāmaropamāḥ |
vartayanti piśācāśca bhūtasaṃghāstathaiva ca || 37 ||
padmapatre punardugdhā gandharvaiḥ sāpsarogaṇaiḥ |
vatsaṃ citrarathaṃ kṛtvā śucīn gandhānnararṣabha || 38 ||
teṣāṃ ca surucistvāsīddogdhā bharatasattama |
gandharvarājo'tibalo mahātmā sūryasaṃnibhaḥ || 39 ||
śailaiśca śrūyate rājan punardugdhā vasuṃdharā |
auṣadhīrvai mūrtimatī ratnāni vividhāni ca || 1.6.40 ||
vatsastu himavānāsīnmerudoṃgdhā mahāgiriḥ |
pātraṃ tu śailamevāsīttena śailā vivardhitāḥ || 41 ||
vīrudbhiḥ śrūyate rājan punardugdhā vasuṃdharā |
pālāśaṃ pātramādāya dagdhacchinnaprarohaṇam| 42 ||
dudoha puṣpitaḥ sālo vatsaḥ plakṣora'bhavattadā |
seyaṃ dhātrī vidhātrī ca pāvanī ca vasuṃdharā || 43 ||
carācarasya sarvasya pratiṣṭhā yonireva ca |
sarvakāmadughā dogdhrī sarvasasyaprarohiṇī || 44 ||
āsīdiyaṃ samudrāntā medinīti pariśrutā |
madhukaiṭabhayoḥ kṛtsnā medasābhipariplutā |
teneyaṃ medinī devī procyate brahmavādibhiḥ ||45||
tato'bhyupagamād rājñaḥ pṛthorvainyasya bhārata |
duhitṛtvamanuprāptā devī pṛthvīti cocyate |
pṛthunā pravibhaktā ca śodhitā ca vasuṃdharā || 46 ||
sasyākaravatī sphītā purapattanamālinī |
evaṃprabhāvo vainyaḥ sa rājāsīd rājasattamaḥ || 47
namasyaścaiva pūjyaśca bhūtagrāmairna saṃśayaḥ |
brāhmaṇaiśca mahābhāgairvedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ || 48 ||
pṛthureva namaskāryo brahmayoniḥ sanātanaḥ|
pārthivaiśca mahābhāgaiḥ pārthivatvamabhīpsubhiḥ || 49|
ādirājo namaskāryaḥ pṛthurvainyaḥ pṛpravebhyaḥ pratāpavān |
yodhairapi ca vikrāntaiḥ prāptukāmairjayaṃ yudhi |
pṛthureva namaskāryo yodhānāṃ prathamo nṛpaḥ || 1.6.50||
yo hi yoddhā raṇaṃ yāti kīrtayitvā pṛthuṃ nṛpam |
sa ghorarūpān saṃgrāmān kṣemī tarati kīrtimān || 51 ||
vaiśyairapi ca vittākhyaiḥ paṇyavṛttimanuṣṭhitaiḥ |
pṛthureva namaskāryo vṛttidātā mahāyaśāḥ | 52||
tathaiva śūdraiḥ śucibhistrivarṇaparicāribhiḥ |
ādirājo namaskāryaḥ śreyaḥ paramabhīpsubhiḥ || 53 ||
ete vatsaviśeṣāśca dogdhāraḥ kṣīrameva ca |
pātrāṇi ca mayoktāni kiṃ bhūyo varṇayāmi te || 54 ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ pṛthoścaritamāditaḥ |
putrapautrasamāyukto modate suciraṃ bhuvi || 55 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi pṛthūpākhyāne ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 ||

<1.7>

saptamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
manvantarāṇi sarvāṇi vistareṇa tapodhana |
teṣāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ visṛṣṭiṃ ca vaiśampāyana kīrtaya || 1 ||
yāvanto manavaścaiva yāvantaṃ kālameva ca |
manvantaraṃ tathā brahmañchrotumicchami tattvataḥ || 2 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
na śakyo vistarastāta vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi |
manvantarāṇāṃ kauravya saṃkṣepaṃ tveva me śṛṇu || 3 ||
svāyambhuvo manustāta manuḥ svārociṣastathā |
uttamastāmasaścaiva raivataścākṣuṣastathā || 4 ||
vaivasvataśca kauravya sāmprato manurucyate |
sāvarṇiśca manustāta bhautyo raucyastathaiva ca || 5 ||
tathaiva merusāvarṇāścatvāro manavaḥ smṛtāḥ |
atītā vartamānāśca tathaivānāgatāśca ye || 6 ||
kīrtitā manavastāta mayaite tu yathāśrutam |
ṛṣīṃsteṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi putrān devagaṇāṃstathā || 7 ||
marīciratrirbhagavānaṅgirāḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ |
pulastyaśca vasiṣṭhaśca saptaite brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ || 8 ||
uttarasyāṃ diśi tathā rājan saptarṣayo'pare |
devāśca śāntarajasastathā prakṛtayaḥ pare |
yāmā nāma tathā devā āsansvāyambhuve'ntare || 9 ||
āgnīdhraścāgnibāhuśca medhā medhātithirvasuḥ |
jyotiṣmāndyutimānhavyaḥ savanaḥ putra eva ca || 1.7.10 ||
manoḥ svāyambhuvasyaite daśa putrā mahaujasaḥ |
etat te prathamaṃ rājan manvantaramudāhṛtam || 11 ||
aurvo vasiṣṭhaputraśca stambaḥ kāśyapa eva ca |
prāṇā bṛhaspatiścaiva datto niścyavanastathā || 12 ||
ete maharṣayastāta vāyuproktā mahāvratāḥ |
devāśca tuṣitā nāma smṛtāḥ svārociṣe'ntare || 13 ||
havirdhnaḥ sukṛtirjyotirāpomūrtirayasmayaḥ |
prathitaśca nabhasyaśca nabha ūrjastathaiva ca || 14 ||
svārociṣasya putrāste manostāta mahātmanaḥ |
kīrtitāḥ pṛthivīpāla mahāvīryaparākramāḥ || 15 ||
dvitīyametat kathitaṃ tava manvantaraṃ mayā |
idaṃ tṛtīyaṃ vakṣyāmi tannibodha narādhipa || 16 ||
vasiṣṭhaputrāḥ saptāsan vāsiṣṭhā iti viśrutāḥ |
hiraṇyagarbhasya sutā ūrjjā nāma sutejasaḥ || 17 ||
ṛṣayo'tra mayā proktāḥ kīrtyamānānnibodha me|
auttameyān mahārāja daśa putrān manoramān || 18 ||
iṣa ūrjastanūjaśca madhurmādhava eva ca |
śuciḥ śukraḥ sahaścaiva nabhasyo nabha eva ca || 19 ||
bhānavastatra devāśca manvantaramudāhṛtam |
manvantaraṃ caturthaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi tacchṛṇu || 1.7.20 ||
kāvyaḥ pṛthustathaivāgnirjanyurdhātā ca bhārata |
kapīvānakapīvāṃśca tatra saptarṣayo'pare || 21 ||
purāṇe kathitāstāta putrāḥ pautrāśca bhārata |
satyā devagaṇāścaiva tāmasasyāntare manoḥ || 22 ||
putrāṃścaiva pravakṣyāmi tāmasasya manornṛpa |
dyutistapasyaḥ sutapāstapomūlastapodhanaḥ || 23 ||
taporatirakalmāṣastanvī dhanvī paraṃtapaḥ |
tāmasasya manorete daśa putrā mahābalāḥ || 24 ||
vāyuproktā mahārāja pañcamaṃ tadanantaram |
vedabāhuryadudhraśca munirvedaśirāstathā || 25 ||
hiraṇyaromā parjanya ūrdhvabāhuśca somajaḥ |
satyanetrastathā''treya ete saptarṣayo'pare || 26 ||
devāścābhūtarajasastathā prakṛtayo'pare |
pāriplavaśca raibhyaśca manorantaramucyate || 27 ||
atha putrānimāṃstasya nibodha gadato mama |
dhṛtimānavyayo yuktastattvadarśī nirutsukaḥ || 28 ||
araṇyaśca prakāśaśca nirmohaḥ satyavākkaviḥ |
raivatasya manoḥ putrāḥ pañcamaṃ caitadantaram || 29 ||
ṣaṣṭhaṃ te sampravakṣyāmi tannibodha narādhipa |
bhṛgurnabho vivasvāṃśca sudhāmā virajāstathā || 1.7.30 ||
atināmā sahiṣṇuśca saptaite vai maharṣayaḥ |
cākṣuṣasyāntare tāta manordevānimāñchṛṇu || 31 ||
ādyāḥ prabhūtā ṛbhavaḥ pṛthagbhāvā divaukasaḥ |
lekhāśca nāma rājendra pañca devagaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ |
ṛceraṅgirasaḥ putrā mahātmāno mahaujasaḥ || 32 ||
nāḍavaleyā mahārāja daśa putrāśca viśrutāḥ |
ūruprebhṛtayo rājan ṣaṇḍaṃ manvantaraṃ smṛtam || 33 ||
atrirvasiṣṭho bhagavān kaśyapaśca mahānṛṣiḥ |
gautamo'tha bharadvājo viśvāmitrastathaiva ca || 34 ||
tathaiva putro bhagavānṛcīkasya mahātmanaḥ |
saptamo jamadagniśca ṛṣayaḥ sāmprataṃ divi || 35 ||
sādhyā rudrāśca viśve ca maruto vasavastathā |
ādityāścāśvinau caiva devau vaivasvatau smṛtau || 36 ||
manorvaivasvatasyaite vartante sāmprate'ntare |
ikṣvākupramukhāścaiva daśa putrā mahātmanaḥ || 37 ||
eteṣāṃ kīrtitānāṃ tu maharṣīṇāṃ mahaujasām |
rājan putrāśca pautrāśca dikṣu sarvāsu bhārata || 38 ||
manvantareṣu sarveṣu prāgdiśaḥ saptasaptakāḥ |
sthitā lokavyavasthārthaṃ lokasaṃrakṣaṇāya ca || 39 ||
manvantare vyatikrānte catvāraḥ saptakā gaṇāḥ |
kṛtvā karma divaṃ yānti brahmalokamanāmayam || 1.7.40 ||
tato'nye tapasā yuktāḥ sthānamāpūrayantyuta |
atītā vartamānāśca krameṇaitena bhārata || 41 ||
etānyuktāni kauravya saptātītāni bhārata |
manvantarāṇi ṣaṭ cāpi nibodhānāgatāni me || 42 ||
sāvarṇā manavastāta pañca tāṃśca nibodha me |
eko vaivasvatasteṣāṃ catvārastu prajāpateḥ || 43 ||
parameṣṭhisutāstāta merusāvarṇatāṃ gataḥ |
dakṣasyaite hi dauhitrāḥ priyāyāstanayā nṛpa |
mahāntastapasā yuktā merupṛṣṭhe mahaujasaḥ || 44 ||
ruceḥ prajāpateḥ putro raucyo nāma manuḥ smṛtaḥ |
bhūtyāṃ cotpādito devyāṃ bhautyo nāma ruceḥ sutaḥ || 45 ||
anāgatāśca saptaite smṛtā divi maharṣayaḥ |
manorantaramāsādya sāvarṇasya ha tāñchṛṇu || 46 ||
rāmo vyāsastathā''treyo dīptimāniti viśrutaḥ |
bhāradvājastathā drauṇiraśvatthāmā mahādyutiḥ || 47 ||
gautamasyātmajaścaiva śaradvān gautamaḥ kṛpaḥ |
kauśiko gālavaścaiva ruruḥ kāśyapa eva ca ||48 ||
ete sapta mahātmāno bhaviṣyā munisattamāḥ |
brahmaṇaḥ sadṛśāścaite dhanyāḥ saptarṣayaḥ smṛtāḥ|| 49 ||
abhijātyātha tapasā mantravyākaraṇaistathā |
brahmalokapratiṣṭhāstu smṛtāḥ saptarṣayo'malāḥ || 1.7.50 |
bhūtabhavyabhavajjñānaṃ buddhvā caiva tu ye svayam|
tapasā vai prasiddhā ye saṃgatāḥ pravicintakāḥ || 51 ||
mantravyākaraṇādyaiśca aiśvaryāt sarvaśaśca ye |
etān bhāryān dvijo jñātvā naiṣṭhikāni ca nāma ca ||52||
saptaite saptabhiścaiva guṇaiḥ saptarṣayaḥ smṛtāḥ |
dīrghāyuṣo mantrakṛta īśvarā dīrghacakṣuṣaḥ | 53 ||
buddhyā pratyakṣadharmāṇo gotraprāvartakāstathā |
kṛtādiṣu yugākhyeṣu sarveṣveva punaḥ punaḥ || 54 ||
prāvartayanti te varṇānāśramāṃścaiva sarvaśaḥ |
saptarṣayo mahābhāgā satyadharmaparāyaṇāḥ || 55 ||
teṣāṃ caivānvayotpannā jāyantīha punaḥ punaḥ |
mantrabrāhmaṇakartāro dharme praśithile tathā || 56
yasmācca varadāḥ sapta parebhya eva yācitāḥ |
tasmānna kālo na vayaḥ pramāṇamṛṣibhāvane || 57 ||
eṣa saptarṣikoddeśo vyākhyātaste mayā nṛpa |
sāvarṇasya manoḥ putrān bhaviṣyāñchṛṇu sattama || 58 ||
varīyāṃścāvarīyāṃśca sammato dhṛtimān vasuḥ |
cariṣṇvyadhṛṣṇuśca vājaḥ sumatireva ca |
sāvarṇasya manoḥ putrā bhaviṣyā daśa bhārata || 59 ||
prathame merusāvarṇe pravakṣyāmi munīñchṛṇu |
medhātithistu paulastyo vasuḥ kāśyapa eva ca|| 1.7.60 ||
jyotiṣmān bhārgavaścaiva dyutimānaṅgirāstathā |
sāvanaścaiva vāsiṣṭha ātreyo havyavāhanaḥ || 61||
paulahaḥ sapta ityete munayo rohite'ntare |
devātānāṃ gaṇāstatra traya eva narādhipa || 62 ||
dakṣaputrasya putrāste rohitasya prajāpateḥ |
manoḥ putro dhṛṣṭaketuḥ pañcahotro nirākṛtiḥ || 63 ||
pṛthuḥ śravā bhūridhāmā ṛcīko'ṣṭahato gayaḥ |
prathamasya tu sāvarṇernava putrā mahaujasaḥ || 64 ||
daśame tvatha paryāye dvitīyasyāntare manoḥ |
haviṣmān paulahaścaiva sukṛtiścaiva bhārgavaḥ || 65 ||
āpomūrtistathā''treyo vāsiṣṭhaścāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ |
paulastyaḥ pramitiścaiva nabhogaścaiva kāśyapaḥ|
aṅgirā nabhasaḥ satyaḥ saptaite paramarṣayaḥ || 66 ||
devatānāṃ gaṇau dvau tau ṛṣimantrāśca ye smṛtāḥ|
manoḥ sutottamaujāśca nikuṣañjaśca vīryavān || 67 ||
śatānīko nirāmitro vṛṣaseno jayadrathaḥ |
bhūridyumnaḥ suvarcāśca daśa tvete manoḥ sutāḥ || 68 ||
ekādaśe'tha paryāye tṛtīyasyāntare manoḥ |
tasya sapta ṛṣīṃścāpi kīrtyamānānnibodha me|| 69 ||
haviṣmān kāśyapaścāpi haviṣmān yaśca bhārgavaḥ |
taruṇaśca tathā''treyo vāsiṣṭhastvanaghastathā || 1.7.70 ||
aṅgirāścodadhiṣṇyaśca paulastyo niścarastathā|
pulahaścāgnitejāśca bhāvyāḥ sapta maharṣayaḥ || 71 ||
brahmaṇastu sutā devā gaṇāsteṣāṃ trayaḥ smṛtāḥ |
saṃvartakaḥ suśarmā ca devānīkaḥ purūdvahaḥ || 72 ||
kṣemadhanvā ṭṛḍhāyuśca ādarśaḥ paṇḍako manuḥ |
sāvarṇasya tu putrā vai tṛtīyasya nava smṛtāḥ || 73 ||
caturthasya tu sāvarṇerṛṣīn sapta nibodha me |
dyutirvasiṣṭhaputraśca ātreyaḥ sutapāstathā || 74 ||
aṅgirāstapaso mūrtistapasvī kāśyapastathā |
tapo'śanaśca paulastyaḥ paulahaśca tapo raviḥ || 75 ||
bhārgavaḥ saptamasteṣāṃ vijñeyastu tapodhṛtiḥ |
pañca devagaṇāḥ proktā mānasā brahmaṇaśca te || 73 ||
devavāyuradūraśca devaśreṣṭho vidūrathaḥ |
mitravān mitradevaśca mitrasenaśca mitrakṛt |
mitrabāhuḥ suvarcāśca dvādaśasya manoḥ sutāḥ || 77 ||
trayodaśe'tha paryāye bhāvye manvantare manoḥ |
aṅgirāścaiva dhṛtimānpaulastyo havyapastu yaḥ|| 78 ||
paulahastattvadarśī ca bhārgavaśca nirutsukaḥ |
niṣprakampastathā''treyo nirmohaḥ kāśyapastathā|| 79 ||
sutapāścaiva vāsiṣṭhaḥ saptaite tu maharṣayaḥ |
traya eva gaṇāḥ proktā devatānāṃ svayambhuvā || 1.7.80 ||
trayodaśasya putrāste vijñeyāstu ruceḥ sutāḥ |
citraseno vicitraśca nayo dharmabhṛto dhṛtaḥ || 81 ||
sunetraḥ kṣatravṛddhiśca sutapā nirbhayo dṛḍhaḥ |
raucyasyaite manoḥ putrā antare tu trayodaśe || 82 ||
caturdaśe'tha paryāye bhautyasyaivāntare manoḥ |
bhārgavo hyatibāhuśca śucirāṅgirasastathā || 83 ||
yuktaścaiva tathā''treyaḥ śukro vāsiṣṭha eva ca |
ajitaḥ paulahaścaiva antyāḥ saptarṣayaśca te || 84 ||
eteṣāṃ kalya utthāya kīrtanātsukhamedhate |
yaśaścāpnoti sumahadāyuṣmāṃśca bhavennaraḥ || 85 ||
atītānāgatānāṃ vai maharṣīṇāṃ sadā naraḥ |
devatānāṃ gaṇāḥ proktāḥ pañca vai bharatarṣabha || 86 ||
taraṅgabhīrurvapraśca tarasvānugra eva ca |
abhimānī pravīṇaśca jiṣṇuḥ saṃkrandanastathā || 87 ||
tejasvī sabalaścaiva bhautyasyaite manoḥ sutāḥ |
bhautyasyaivādhikāre tu pūrṇe kalpastu pūryate || 88 ||
ityete nāmato'tītā manavaḥ kīrtitā mayā |
tairiyaṃ pṛthivī tāta samudrāntā sapattanā || 89 ||
pūrṇaṃ yugasahasraṃ tu paripālyā narādhipa |
prajābhiścaiva tapasā saṃhārasteṣu bhāgaśaḥ || 1.7.90 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi manvantaravarṇanaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||

<1.8>

aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
manvantarasya saṃkhyānaṃ yugānāṃ ca mahāmate |
brahmaṇo'hnaḥ pramāṇaṃ ca vaktumarhasi me dvija || 1 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
ahorātraṃ bhajet sūryo mānavaṃ laukikaṃ param |
tāmupādāya gaṇanāṃ śṛṇu saṃkhyāmariṃdama || 2 ||
nimeṣaiḥ pañcadaśabhiḥ kāṣṭhā triṃśat tu tāḥ kalāḥ |
triṃśatkalo muhūrtastu triṃśatā tairmanīṣiṇaḥ || 3 ||
ahorātramiti prāhuścandrasūryagatiṃ nṛpa |
viśeṣeṇa tu sarveṣu ahorātre ca nityaśaḥ || 4 ||
ahorātrāḥ pañcadaśa pakṣa ityabhiśabditaḥ |
dvau pakṣau tu smṛto māso māsau dvāvṛturucyate || 5 ||
abdaṃ dvyayanamuktaṃ ca ayanaṃ tvṛtubhistribhiḥ |
dakṣiṇaṃ cottaraṃ caiva saṃkhyātattvaviśāradaiḥ || 6 ||
mānenānena yo māsaḥ pakṣadvayasamanvitaḥ |
pitṝṇāṃ tadahorātramiti kālavido viduḥ || 7 ||
kṛṣṇapakṣastvahasteṣāṃ śuklapakṣastu śarvarī |
kṛṣṇapakṣaṃ tvahaḥ śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ vartate nṛpa || 8 ||
mānuṣeṇa tu mānena yo vai saṃvatsaraḥ smṛtaḥ |
devānāṃ tadahorātraṃ divā caivottarāyaṇam|
dakṣiṇāyanaṃ smṛtā rātriḥ prājñaistattvārthakovidaiḥ|| 9 ||
divyamabdaṃ daśaguṇamahorātraṃ manoḥ smṛtam |
ahorātraṃ daśaguṇaṃ mānavaḥ pakṣa ucyate || 1.8.10 ||
pakṣo daśaguṇo māso māsairdvādaśabhirguṇaiḥ |
ṛturmanūnāṃ saṃproktaḥ prājñaistattvārthadarśibhiḥ |
ṛtutrayeṇa tvayanaṃ taddvayenaiva vatsaraḥ || 11 ||
catvāryeva sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ tu kṛtaṃ yugam |
tāvacchatī bhavet saṃdhyā saṃdhyāṃśaśca tathā nṛpa || 12||
trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi tretā syātparimāṇataḥ |
tasyāśca triśatī saṃdhyā saṃdhyāṃśaśca tathāvidhaḥ|| 13 ||
tathā varṣasahasre dve dvāparaṃ parikīrtitam |
tasyāpi dviśatī saṃdhyā saṃdhyāṃśaśca tathāvidhaḥ | 14 ||
kalirvarṣasahasraṃ ca saṃkhyāto'tra manīṣibhiḥ |
tasyāpi śatikā saṃdhyā saṃdhyāṃśaścaiva tadvidhaḥ || 15 ||
eṣā dvādaśasāhasrī yugasaṃkhyā prakīrtitā |
divyenānena mānena yugasaṃkhyāṃ nibodha me || 16 ||
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliścaiva caturyugī |
yugaṃ tadekasaptatyā gaṇitaṃ nṛpasattama || 17 ||
manvantaramiti proktaṃ saṃkhyānārthaviśāradaiḥ |
ayanaṃ cāpi tatproktaṃ dve'yane dakṣiṇottare || 18 ||
manuḥ pralīyate yatra samāpte cāyane prabhoḥ |
tato'paro manuḥ kālametāvantaṃ bhavatyuta || 19 ||
samatīteṣu rājendra proktaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ sa vai |
tadeva cāyutaṃ proktaṃ muninā tattvadarśinā || 1.8.20 ||
brahmaṇastadahaḥ proktaṃ kalpaśceti sa kathyate |
sahasrayugaparyantā yā niśā procyate budhaiḥ || 21 ||
nimajjatyapsu yatrorvī saśailavanakānanā |
tasmin yugasahasre tu pūrṇe bharatasattama || 22 ||
brāhme divasaparyante kalpo niḥśeṣa ucyate |
yugāni saptatistāni sāgrāṇi kathitāni te || 23 ||
kṛtatretānibaddhāni manorantaramucyate |
caturdaśaite manavaḥ kīrtitāḥ kīrtivarddhanāḥ || 24 ||
vedeṣu sapurāṇeṣu sarveṣu prabhaviṣṇavaḥ |
prajānāṃ patayo rājan dhanyameṣāṃ prakīrtanam ||25 ||
manvantareṣu saṃhārāḥ saṃhārānteṣu sambhavāḥ |
na śakyamantaraṃ teṣāṃ vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi || 26 ||
visargasya prajānāṃ vai saṃhārasya ca bhārata |
manvantareṣu saṃhārāḥ śrūyante bharatarṣabha || 27 ||
saśeṣāstatra tiṣṭhanti devāḥ saptarṣibhiḥ saha |
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa śrutena ca samāhitāḥ || 28 ||
pūrṇe yugasahasre tu kalpo niḥśeṣa ucyate |
tatra sarvāṇi bhūtāni dagdhānyādityatejasā || 29 ||
brahmāṇamagrataḥ kṛtvā sahādityagaṇairvibhum |
yogaṃ yogīśvaraṃ devamajaṃ kṣetrajñamacyutam |
praviśanti suraśreṣṭhaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 1.8.30 ||
yaḥ sraṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ kalpānteṣu punaḥ punaḥ |
avyaktaḥ śāśvato devastasya sarvamidaṃ jagat || 31 ||
tatra saṃvartate rātriḥ sakalaikārṇave tadā |
nārāyaṇo dadhe nidrāṃ brāhmaṃ varṣasahasrakam || 32 ||
tāvantamiti kālasya rātrirityabhiśabditā|
nidrāyogamanuprāpto yasyāṃ śete pitāmahaḥ || 33 ||
sā ca rātrirapakrāntā sahasrayugaparyayā |
tadā prabuddho bhagavān brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 34 ||
punaḥ sisṛkṣayā yuktaḥ sargāya vidadhe manaḥ |
saiva smṛtiḥ purāṇeyaṃ tadvṛttaṃ tadviceṣṭitam || 35 ||
devasthānāni tānyeva kevalaṃ ca viparyayaḥ |
tato dagdhāni bhūtāni sarvāṇyādityaraśmibhiḥ || 36 ||
devarṣiyakṣagandharvāḥ piśācoragarākṣasāḥ |
jāyante ca punastāta yuge bharatasattama || 37 ||
yathartāvṛtuliṅgāni nānārūpāṇi paryaye |
dṛśyante tāni tānyeva tathā brāhmīṣu rātriṣu || 38 ||
niṣkramitvā prajākāraḥ prajāpatirasaṃśayam |
ye ca vai mānavā devāḥ sarve caiva maharṣayaḥ || 39 ||
te saṅgatāḥ śuddhasaṅgāḥ śaśvaddharmavisargataḥ |
na bhavanti punastāta yugaṃ bharatasattama || 1.8.40 ||
tatsarvaṃ kramayogena kālasaṃkhyāvibhāgavit |
sahasrayugasaṃkhyānaṃ kṛtvā divasamīśvaraḥ || 41 ||
rātriṃ yugasahasrāntāṃ kṛtvā ca bhagavān vibhuḥ |
saṃharatyatha bhūtāni sṛjate ca punaḥ punaḥ || 42 ||
vyaktāvyakto mahādevo harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
tasya te kīrtayiṣyāmi manorvaivasvatasya ha || 43 ||
visargaṃ bharataśreṣṭha sāmpratasya mahādyute |
vṛṣṇivaṃśaprasaṅgena kathyamānaṃ purātanam || 44 ||
yatrotpanno mahātmā sa harirvṛṣṇikule prabhuḥ |
sarvāsuravināśāya sarvalokahitāya ca || 45 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi manvantaragaṇanāyāmaṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||

<1.9>

navamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
vivasvān kaśyapājjajñe dākṣāyaṇyāmariṃdama |
tasya bhāryābhavat saṃjñā tvāṣṭrī devī vivasvataḥ|| 1 ||
sureṇuriti vikhyātā triṣu lokeṣu bhāvinī |
sā vai bhāryā bhagavatī mārtaṇḍasya mahātmanaḥ || 2 ||
bhartṛrūpeṇa nātuṣyad rūpayauvanaśālinī |
saṃjñā nāma sutapasā dīpteneha samanvitā || 3 ||
ādityasya hi tadrūpaṃ maṇḍalasya sutejasā |
gātreṣu paridagdhaṃ vai nātikāntamivābhavat || 4 ||
na khalvayaṃ mṛto'ṇḍasya iti snehādabhāṣata |
ajñānāt kaśyapastasmānmārtaṇḍa iti cocyate|| 5 ||
tejastvabhyadhikaṃ tāta nityameva vivasvataḥ |
yenātitāpayāmāsa trīm̐llokānkaśyapātmajaḥ|| 6 ||
trīṇyapatyāni kauravya saṃjñāyāṃ tapatāṃ varaḥ |
ādityo janayāmāsa kanyāṃ dvau ca prajāpatī || 7 ||
manurvaivasvataḥ pūrvaṃ śrāddhadevaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
yamaśca yamunā caiva yamajau sambabhūvatuḥ || 8 ||
sā vivarṇaṃ tu tadrūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃjñā vivasvataḥ |
asahantī ca svāṃ chāyāṃ savarṇā nirmame tataḥ || 9 ||
māyāmayī tu sā saṃjñā tasyāśchāyā samutthitā |
prāñjaliḥ praṇatā bhūtvā chāyā saṃjñāṃ nareśvara || 1.9.10 ||
uvāca kiṃ mayā kāryaṃ kathayasva śucismite |
sthitāsmi tava nirdeśe śādhi māṃ varavarṇini|| 11 ||
saṃjñovāca
ahaṃ yāsyāmi bhadraṃ te svameva bhavanaṃ pituḥ |
tvayeha bhavane mahyaṃ vastavyaṃ nirvikārayā || 12 ||
imau ca bālakau mahyaṃ kanyā ceyaṃ sumadhyamā |
sambhāvyāste na cākhyeyamidaṃ bhagavate kvacit|| 13 ||
chāyovāca
ā kacagrahaṇād devi ā śāpānnaiva karhicit|
ākhyāsyāmi mataṃ tubhyaṃ gaccha devi yathāsukham|| 14 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
samādiśya savarṇāṃ tāṃ tathetyuktā ca sā tayā |
tvaṣṭuḥ samīpamagamad vrīḍiteva tapasvinī || 15 ||
pituḥ samīpagā sā tu pitrā nirbhartsitā tadā|
bhartuḥ samīpaṃ gaccheti niyuktā ca punaḥ punaḥ || 16 ||
agacchadvaḍavā bhūtvā ''cchādya rūpamaninditā|
kurūnathottarān gatvā tṛṇānyeva cacāra ha || 17 ||
dvitīyāyāṃ tu saṃjñāyāṃ saṃjñeyamiti cintayan |
ādityo janayāmāsa putramātmasamaṃ tadā || 18 ||
pūrvajasya manostāta sadṛśo'yamiti prabhuḥ |
savarṇatvānmanorbhūyaḥ sāvarṇa iti coktavān || 19 ||
manurevābhavannāmnā sāvarṇa iti cocyate |
dvitīyo yaḥ sutastasyāḥ sa vijñeyaḥ śanaiścaraḥ || 1.9.20 ||
saṃjñā tu pārthivī tāta svasya putrasya vai tadā |
cakārābhyadhikaṃ snehaṃ na tathā pūrvajeṣu vai || 21 ||
manustasyākṣamattattu yamastasyā na cakṣame |
tāṃ sa roṣācca bālyācca bhāvino'rthasya vai balāt |
padā saṃtarjayāmāsa saṃjñāṃ vaivasvato yamaḥ || 22 ||
taṃ śaśāpa tataḥ krodhāt sāvarṇajananī nṛpa |
caraṇaḥ patatāmeṣa taveti bhṛśaduḥkhitā || 23 ||
yamastu tat pituḥ sarvaṃ prāñjaliḥ pratyavedayat |
bhṛśaṃ śāpabhayodvignaḥ saṃjñāvākyapratoditaḥ || 24 ||
śāpo'yaṃ vinivarteta provāca pitaraṃ tadā |
mātrā snehena sarveṣu vartitavyaṃ suteṣu vai || 25 ||
seyamasmānapāhāya yavīyāṃsaṃ bubhūṣati |
tasyāṃ mayodyataḥ pādo na tu dehe nipātitaḥ || 26 ||
bālyādvā yadi vā mohāttadbhavānkṣantumarhati|
yasmātte pūjanīyāhaṃ laṅghitāsmi tvayā suta || 27 ||
tasmāt tavaiṣa caraṇaḥ patiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ |
apatyaṃ durapatyaṃ syānnāmbā kujananī bhavet || 28 ||
śapto'hamasmi lokeśa jananyā tapatāṃ vara |
tava prasādāccaraṇo na patenmama gopate || 29 ||
vivasvānuvāca
asaṃśayaṃ putra mahad bhaviṣyatyatra kāraṇam |
yena tvāmāviśat krodho dharmajñaṃ satyavādinam || 1.9.30
kṛmayo māṃsamādāya yāsyanti dharaṇītalam || 31 ||
tava pādānmahāprājña tatastvaṃ prāpsyase sukham |
kṛtamevaṃ vacastathyaṃ mātustava bhaviṣyati || 32 ||
śāpasya parihāreṇa tvaṃ ca trāto bhaviṣyasi |
ādityo'thābravīt saṃjñāṃ kimarthaṃ tanayeṣu vai || 33 ||
tulyeṣvabhyadhikaḥ snehaḥ kriyate'ti punaḥ punaḥ |
sā tatparihasantī tu nācacakṣe vivasvate || 34 ||
ātmānaṃ susamādhāya yogāt tathyamapaśyata |
tāṃ śaptukāmo bhagavān nāśāya kurunandana || 35 ||
mūrdhajeṣu ca jagrāha samaye'tigate'pi ca |
sā tat sarvaṃ yathāvṛttamācacakṣe vivasvate || 36 ||
vivasvānatha tacchrutvā kruddhastvaṣṭāramabhyagāt |
tvaṣṭā tu taṃ yathā nyāyamarcayitvā vibhāvasum |
nirdagdhukāmaṃ roṣeṇa sāntvayāmāsa vai tadā || 37 ||
tvaṣṭovāca
tavātitejasāviṣṭamidaṃ rūpaṃ na śobhate |
asahantī ca tat saṃjñā vane carati śādvale || 38 ||
draṣṭā hi tāṃ bhavānadya svāṃ bhāryāṃ śubhacāriṇīm|
nityaṃ tapasyabhiratāṃ vaḍavārūpadhāriṇīm || 39 ||
parṇāhārāṃ kṛśāṃ dīnāṃ jaṭilāṃ brahmacāriṇīm |
hastihastaparikliṣṭāṃ vyākulāṃ padminīmiva |
ślāghyāṃ yogabalopetāṃ yogamāsthāya gopate || 1.9.40 ||
anukūlaṃ tu deveśa yadi syānmama tanmatam|
rūpaṃ nirvartayāmyadya tava kāntamariṃdama || 41 ||
rūpaṃ vivasvataścāsīt tiryagūrdhvasamaṃ tu vai |
tenāsau sambhṛto devarūpeṇa tu vibhāvasuḥ || 42 ||
tasmāt tvaṣṭuḥ sa vai vākyaṃ vahu mene prajāpatiḥ |
samanujñātavāṃścaiva tvaṣṭāraṃ rūpasiddhaye || 43 ||
tato'bhyupagamāttvaṣṭā mārtaṇḍasya vivasvataḥ |
bhramimāropya tat tejaḥ śātayāmāsa bhārata || 44 ||
tato nirbhāsitaṃ rūpaṃ tejasā saṃhṛtena vai |
kāntāt kāntataraṃ draṣṭumadhikaṃ śuśubhe tadā || 45
mukhe nirvartitaṃ rūpaṃ tasya devasya gopateḥ |
tataḥ prabhṛti devasya mukhamāsīt tu lohitam |
mukharāgaṃ tu yatpūrvaṃ mārtaṇḍasya mukhacyutam || 46 ||
ādityā dvādaśaiveha sambhūtā mukhasambhavāḥ |
dhātāryamā ca mitraśca varuṇoṃ'śo bhagastathā || 47 ||
indro vivasvānpūṣā ca parjanyo daśamastathā |
tatastvaṣṭā tato viṣṇurajaghanyo jaghanyajaḥ || 48 ||
harṣaṃ lebhe tato devo dṛṣṭvā''dityān svadehajān |
gandhaiḥ puṣpairalaṃkārairbhāsvatā mukuṭena ca || 49 ||
evaṃ sampūjayāmāsa tvaṣṭā vākyamuvāca ha |
gaccha deva nijāṃ bhāryāṃ kurūṃścarati sottarān || 1.9.50 ||
vaḍavārūpamāsthāya vane carati śādvale |
sa tathā rūpamāsthāya svabhāryārūpalīlayā || 51 ||
dadarśa yogamāsthāya svāṃ bhāryāṃ vaḍavāṃ tataḥ |
adhṛṣyāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tejasā niyamena ca || 52 ||
vaḍavāvapuṣā rājaṃścarantīmakutobhayām |
so'śvarūpeṇa bhagavāṃstāṃ mukhe samabhāvayat || 53 ||
maithunāya viceṣṭantī parapuṃsopaśaṅkayā |
sā tanniravamacchukraṃ nāsikāyāṃ vivasvataḥ || 54 ||
devau tasyāmajāyetāmaśvinau bhiṣajāṃ varau |
nāsatyaścaiva dasraśca smṛtau dvāvaśvināviti || 55 ||
mārtaṇḍasyātmajāvetāvaṣṭamasya prajāpateḥ |
saṃjñāyāṃ janayāmāsa vaḍavāyāṃ sa bhārata |
tāṃ tu rūpeṇa kāntena darśayāmāsa bhāskaraḥ || 56 ||
sā ca dṛṣṭvaiva bhartāraṃ tutoṣa janamejaya |
yamastu karmaṇā tena bhṛśaṃ pīḍitamānasaḥ || 57 ||
dharmeṇa rañjayāmāsa dharmarāja iva prajāḥ |
sa lebhe karmaṇā tena parameṇa mahādyutiḥ || 58 ||
pitṝṇāmādhipatyaṃ ca lokapālatvameva ca |
manuḥ prajāpatistvāsīt sāvarṇaḥ sa tapodhanaḥ || 59 ||
bhāvyaḥ so'nāgate kāle manuḥ sāvarṇike'ntare |
merupṛṣṭhe tapo ghoramadyāpi carati prabhuḥ || 1.9.60 ||
bhrātā śanaiścaraścāsya grahatvamupalabdhavān |
nāsatyau yau samākhyātau svarvaidyau tau babhūvatuḥ || 61 ||
sevato'pi tathā rājannaśvānāṃ śāntido'bhavat|
tvaṣṭā tu tejasā tena viṣṇoścakramakalpayat || 62 ||
tadapratihataṃ yuddhe dānavāntacikīrṣayā |
yavīyasī tayoryā tu yamī kanyā yaśasvinī || 63 ||
abhavat sā saricchreṣṭhā yamunā lokabhāvinī |
manurityucyate loke sāvarṇa iti cocyate ||64 ||
dvitīyo yaḥ sutastasya manorbhrātā śanaiścaraḥ |
grahatvaṃ sa ca lebhe vai sarvalokābhipūjitam || 65 ||
ya idaṃ janma devānāṃ śṛṇuyād vāpi dhārayet |
āpadbhyaḥ sa vimucyeta prāpnuyācca mahadyaśaḥ || 66 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi vaivasvatotpattau navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 ||

<1.10>

daśamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
manorvaivasvatasyāsan putrā vai nava tatsamāḥ |
ikṣvākuścaiva nābhāgo dhṛṣṇuḥ śaryātireva ca || 1
nariṣyaṃśca tathā prāṃśurnābhāgāriṣṭasaptamāḥ |
karūṣaśca pṛṣadhraśca navaite bharatarṣabha || 2 ||
akarot putrakāmastu manuriṣṭiṃ prajāpatiḥ |
mitrāvaruṇayostāta pūrvameva viśāmpate || 3 ||
anutpanneṣu navasu putreṣveteṣu bhārata |
tasyāṃ tu vartamānāyāmiṣṭyāṃ bharatasattama || 4 ||
mitrāvaruṇayoraṃśe munirāhutimājuhot |
āhutyāṃ hūyamānāyāṃ devagandharvamānuṣāḥ || 5 ||
tuṣṭiṃ tu paramāṃ jagmurmunayaśca tapodhanāḥ |
aho'sya tapaso vīryamaho'sya śrutamadbhutam || 6 ||
tatra divyāmbaradharā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā |
divyasaṃhananā caiva ilā jajñe iti śrutiḥ || 7 ||
tāmiletyeva hovāca manurdaṇḍadharastadā |
anugacchasva māṃ bhadre tamilā pratyuvāca ha |
dharmayuktamidaṃ vākyaṃ putrakāmaṃ prajāpatim || 8 ||
ilovāca
mitrāvaruṇayoraṃśe jātāsmi vadatāṃ vara |
tayoḥ sakāśaṃ yāsyāmi na māṃ dharmo hato'vadhīt|| 9 ||
saivamuktvā manuṃ devaṃ mitrāvaruṇayorilā |
gatvāntikaṃ varārohā prāñjalirvākyamabravīt || 1.10.10 ||
aṃśe'smi yuvayorjātā devau kiṃ karavāṇi vām|
manunā cāhamuktā vai anugacchasva māmiti || 11 ||
tāṃ tathāvādinīṃ sādhvīmilāṃ dharmaparāyaṇām |
mitraśca varuṇaścobhāvūcaturyannibodha tat || 12 ||
anena tava dharmeṇa praśrayeṇa damena ca |
satyena caiva suśroṇi prītau svo varavarṇini || 13 ||
āvayostvaṃ mahābhāge khyātiṃ kanyeti yāsyasi |
manorvaṃśadharaḥ putrastvameva ca bhaviṣyasi || 14 ||
sudyumna iti vikhyātastriṣu lokeṣu śobhane |
jagatpriyo dharmaśīlo manorvaṃśavivardhanaḥ || 15 ||
nivṛttā sā tu tacchutvā gacchantī piturantikam|
budhenāntaramāsādya maithunāyopamantritā || 16 ||
somaputrād budhād rājaṃstasyāṃ jajñe purūravāḥ |
janayitvā sutaṃ sā tamilā sudyumnatāṃ gatā || 17 ||
sudyumnasya tu dāyādāstrayaḥ paramadhārmikāḥ |
utkalaśca gayaścaiva vinatāśvaśca bhārata || 18 ||
utkalasyotkalā rājan vinatāśvasya paścimā|
dik pūrvā bharataśreṣṭha gayasya tu gayā purī || 19 ||
praviṣṭe tuṃ manau tāta divākaramariṃdama |
daśadhā taddadhatkṣatramakarot pṛthivīmimām || 1.10.20 ||
yūpāṅkitā vasumatī yasyeyaṃ savanākarā |
ikṣvākurjyeṣṭhadāyādo madhyadeśamavāptavān || 21 ||
kanyābhāvācca sudyumno nainaṃ guṇamavāptavān |
vasiṣṭhavacanāccāsīt pratiṣṭhāne mahātmanaḥ || 22 ||
pratiṣṭhā dharmarājasya sudyumnasya kurūdvaha |
tatpurūravase prādād rājyaṃ prāpya mahāyaśāḥ || 23 ||
sudyumnaḥ kārayāmāsa pratiṣṭhāne nṛpakriyām |
utkalasya trayaḥ putrāstriṣu lokeṣu viśrutāḥ |
dhṛṣṭakaścāmbarīṣaśca daṇḍaśceti sutāstrayaḥ || 24 ||
yaścakāra mahātmā vai daṇḍakāraṇyamuttamam|
vanaṃ tallokavikhyātaṃ tāpasānāmanuttamam ||25 ||
tatra praviṣṭamātrastu naraḥ pāpāt pramucyate|
sudyumnaśca divaṃ yāta ailamutpādya bhārata || 26 ||
mānaveyo mahārāja strīpuṃsorlakṣaṇairyutaḥ |
dhṛtavān ya iletyeva sudyumnaścātiviśrutaḥ || 27 ||
nariṣyataḥ śakāḥ putrā nābhāgasya tu bhārata |
ambarīṣo'bhavat putraḥ pārthivarṣabhasattamaḥ || 28 ||
dhṛṣṇostu dhārṣṭakaṃ kṣatraṃ raṇadhṛṣṭaṃ babhūva ha |
karūṣasya tu kārūṣāḥ kṣatriyā yuddhadurmadāḥ || 29 ||
sahasraṃ kṣatriyagaṇo vikrāntaḥ sambabhūva ha |
nābhāgāriṣṭaputrāśca kṣatriyā vaiśyatāṃ gatāḥ || 1.10.30 ||
prāṃśoreko'bhavat putraḥ śaryātiriti viśrutaḥ |
nariṣyatasya dāyādo rājā daṇḍadharo damaḥ |
śaryātermithunaṃ cāsīdānarto nāma viśrutaḥ || 31 ||
putraḥ kanyā sukanyākhyā yā patnī cyavanasya ha|
ānartasya tu dāyādo revo nāma mahādyutiḥ || 32 ||
ānartaviṣayaścāsīt purī cāsya kuśasthalī |
revasya raivataḥ putraḥ kakudmī nāma dhārmikaḥ || 33 ||
jyeṣṭhaḥ putraśatasyāsīd rājyaṃ prāpya kuśasthalīm|
sa kanyāsahitaḥ śrutvā gāndharvaṃ brahmaṇo'ntike || 34 ||
muhūrtabhūtaṃ devasya gataṃ bahuyugaṃ prabho |
ājagāma yuvaivātha svāṃ purīṃ yādavairvṛtām|| 35 ||
kṛtāṃ dvāravatīṃ nāmnā bahudvārāṃ manoramām |
bhojavṛṣṇyandhakairguptāṃ vāsudevapurogamaiḥ || 36 ||
tataḥ sa raivato jñātvā yathātattvamariṃdama |
kanyāṃ tāṃ baladevāya suvratāṃ nāma revatīm || 37 ||
dattvā jagāma śikharaṃ merostapasi saṃsthitaḥ |
reme rāmo'pi dharmātmā revatyā sahitaḥ sukhī || 38 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi ailotpattivarṇanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 ||

<1.11>

ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
kathaṃ bahuyuge kāle samatīte dvijottama |
na jarā revatīṃ prāptā raivataṃ ca kakudminam || 1 ||
meruṃ gatasya vā tasya śāryāteḥ saṃtatiḥ katham|
sthitā pṛthivyāmadyāpi śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ|| 2 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
na jarā kṣutpipāse vā na mṛtyurbharatarṣabha |
ṛtucakraṃ na bhavati brahmaloke sadānagha || 3 ||
kakudminastu taṃ lokaṃ raivatasya gatasya ha |
hatā puṇyajanaistāta rākṣasaiḥ sā kuśasthalī || 4 ||
tasya bhrātṛśataṃ cāsīddhārmikasya mahātmanaḥ |
tad vadhyamānaṃ rakṣobhirdiśaḥ prādravadacyutam || 5 ||
vidrutasya tu rājendra tasya bhrātṛśatasya vai |
teṣāṃ tu te bhayākrāntāḥ kṣatriyāstatra tatra ha || 6 ||
anvavāyastu sumahāṃstatra tatra viśāmpate |
yeṣāmete mahārāja śāryātā iti viśrutāḥ || 7 ||
kṣatriyā bharataśreṣṭha dikṣu sarvāsu dhārmikāḥ |
sarvaśaḥ parvatagaṇān praviṣṭāḥ kurunandana || 8 ||
nābhāgāriṣṭaputrau dvau vaiśyau brāhmaṇatāṃ gatau |
karūṣasya ca kārūṣāḥ kṣatriyā yuddhadurmadāḥ || 9 ||
prāṃśoreko'bhavat putraḥ prajātiriti naḥ śrutam |
pṛṣadhro hiṃsayitvā tu gurorgāma janamejaya || 1.11.10 ||
śāpācchūdratvamāpanno navaite parikīrtitāḥ |
vaivasvatasya tanayā manorvai bharatarṣabha || 11 ||
kṣuvataśca manostāta ikṣvākurabhavat sutaḥ |
tasya putraśataṃ tvāsīdikṣvākorbhūridakṣiṇam || 12 ||
teṣāṃ vikukṣirjyeṣṭhastu vikukṣitvādayodhatām |
prāptaḥ paramadharmajñaḥ so'yodhyādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ || 13 ||
śakunipramukhāstasya putrāḥ pañcāśaduttamāḥ |
uttarāpathadeśasthā rakṣitāro mahīpate || 14 ||
catvāriṃśadathāṣṭau ca dakṣiṇasyāṃ tathā diśi |
śaśādapramukhāścānye rakṣitāro viśāmpate || 15 ||
ikṣvākustu vikukṣiṃ vai aṣṭakāyāmathādiśat|
māṃsamānaya śrāddhārthaṃ mṛgān hatvā mahābalaḥ || 16 ||
śrāddhakarmaṇi coddiṣṭamakṛte śrāddhakarmaṇi |
bhakṣayitvā śaśaṃ tāta śaśādo mṛgayāgataḥ || 17 ||
ikṣvākuṇā parityakto vasiṣṭhavacanātprabhuḥ |
ikṣvākau saṃsthite tāta śaśādaḥ puramāvasat || 18 ||
śaśādasya tu dāyādaḥ kakutstho nāma vīryavān |
indrasya vṛṣabhūtasya kakutstho'jayatāsurān || 19 ||
pūrvaṃ devāsure yuddhe kakutsthastena hi smṛtaḥ |
anenāstu kakutsthasya pṛthurānenasaḥ smṛtaḥ || 1.11.20 ||
viṣṭarāśvaḥ pṛthoḥ putrastasmādārdrastvajāyata |
ārdrasya yuvanāśvastu śrāvastasya tu cātmajaḥ || 21 ||
jajñe śrāvastako rājā śrāvastī yena nirmitā |
śrāvastasya tu dāyādo bṛhadaśvo mahāyaśāḥ || 22 ||
kuvalāśvaḥ sutastasya rājā paramadhārmikaḥ |
yaḥ sa dhundhuvadhād rājā dhundhumāratvamāgataḥ || 23 ||
janamejaya uvāca
dhundhorvadhamahaṃ brahmañchrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ |
yadarthaṃ kuvalāśvaḥ san dhundhumāratvamāgataḥ || 24 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
kuvalāśvasya putrāṇāṃ śatamuttamadhanvinām|
sarve vidyāsu niṣṇātā balavanto durāsadāḥ || 25 ||
babhūvurdhārmikāḥ sarve yajvāno bhūridakṣiṇāḥ |
kuvalāśvaṃ sutaṃ rājye bṛhadaśvo nyayojayat || 26 ||
putrasaṃkrāmitaśrīstu vanaṃ rājā samāviśat |
tamuttaṅko'tha viprarṣiḥ prayāntaṃ pratyavārayat || 27 ||
uttaṅka uvāca
bhavatā rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ tat tāvat kartumarhasi |
nirudvignastapaścartuṃ na hi śaknoṣi pārthiva || 28 ||
tvayā hi pṛthivī rājanrakṣyamāṇā mahātmanā |
bhaviṣyati nirudvignā nāraṇyaṃ gantumarhasi || 29 ||
pālane hi mahān dharmaḥ prajānāmiha dṛśyate |
na tathā dṛśyate'raṇye mā te bhūd buddhirīdṛśī || 1.11.30 ||
īdṛśo na hi rājendra dharmaḥ kvacana dṛśyate |
prajānāṃ pālane yo vai purā rājarṣibhiḥ kṛtaḥ |
rakṣitavyāḥ prajā rājñā tāstvaṃ rakṣitumarhasi || 31 ||
mamāśramasamīpe hi sameṣu marudhanvasu |
samudro vālukāpūrṇaṃ ujjānaka iti śrutaḥ |
devatānāmavadhyaśca mahākāyo mahābalaḥ || 32||
antarbhūmigatastatra vālukāntarhito mahān |
rākṣasasya madhoḥ putro dhundhunāmā mahāsuraḥ |
śete lokavināśāya tapa āsthāya dāruṇam || 33 ||
saṃvatsarasya paryante sa niḥśvāsaṃ pramuñcati |
yadā tadā bhūścalati saśailavanakānanā || 34 ||
tasya niḥśvāsavātena raja uddhūyate mahat |
ādityapathamāvṛtya saptāhaṃ bhūmikampanam || 35
savisphuliṅgaṃ sāṅgāraṃ sadhūmamatidāruṇam |
tena tāta na śaknomi tasmin sthātuṃ svakāśrame || 36 ||
taṃ māraya mahākāyaṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā |
lokāḥ svasthābhavantvadya tasminvinihate'sure|| 37 ||
tvaṃ hi tasya vadhāyaikaḥ samarthaḥ pṛthivīpate |
viṣṇunā ca varo datto mahyaṃ pūrvayuge'nagha || 38 ||
yastvaṃ mahāsuraṃ raudraṃ haniṣyasi mahābalam |
tasya tvaṃ varadānena teja āpyāyayiṣyasi || 39 ||
na hi dhundhurmahātejāstejasālpena śakyate |
nirdagdhuṃ pṛthivīpāla sa hi varṣaśatairapi |
vīryaṃ hi sumahattasya devairapi durāsadam || 1.11.40 ||
sa evamukto rājarṣiruttaṅkena mahātmanā |
kuvalāśvaṃ sutaṃ prādāt tasmai dhundhunivāraṇe || 41 ||
bṛhadaśva uvāca
bhagavan nyastaśastro'hamayaṃ tu tanayo mama |
bhaviṣyati dvijaśreṣṭha dhundhumāro na saṃśayaḥ || 42 ||
sa taṃ vyādiśya tanayaṃ rājarṣirdhundhumāraṇe |
jagāma parvatāyaiva tapase saṃśitavrataḥ || 43 ||
kuvalāśvastu putrāṇāṃ śatena saha pārthivaḥ |
prāyāduttaṅkasahito dhundhostasya vinigrahe || 44 ||
tamāviśat tadā viṣṇurbhagavāṃstejasā prabhuḥ |
uttaṅkasya niyogād vai lokasya hitakāmyayā || 45 ||
tasmin prayāte durdharṣe divi śabdo mahānabhūt |
eṣa śrīmānavadhyo'dya dhundhumāro bhaviṣyati || 46 ||
divyairmālyaiśca taṃ devāḥ samantāt samavākiran |
devadundubhayaścāpi praṇedurbharatarṣabha || 47 ||
sa gatvā jayatāṃ śreṣṭhastanayaiḥ saha vīryavān |
samudraṃ khānayāmāsa vālukārṇavamavyayam || 48 ||
nārāyaṇena kauravya tejasā''pyāyitaḥ sa vai |
babhūva sa mahātejā bhūyo balasamanvitaḥ || 49 ||
tasya putraiḥ khanadbhistu vālukāntarhitastadā |
dhundhurāsādito rājandiśamāvṛtya paścimām || 1.11.50 ||
mukhajenāgninā krodhāllokānudvartayanniva |
vāri susrāva vegena mahodadhirivodaye || 51 ||
somasya bharataśreṣṭha dhārormikalilaṃ mahat |
tasya putraśataṃ dagdhaṃ tribhirūnaṃ tu rakṣasā || 52 ||
tataḥ sa rājā kauravya rākṣasaṃ taṃ mahābalam |
āsasāda mahātejā dhundhuṃ dhundhunibarhaṇaḥ || 53 ||
tasya vārimayaṃ vegamāpīya sa narādhipaḥ |
yogī yogena vahniṃ ca śamayāmāsa vāriṇā || 54 ||
nihatya taṃ mahākāyaṃ balenodakarākṣasam |
uttaṅkaṃ darśayāmāsa kṛtakarmā narādhipaḥ || 55 ||
uttaṅkastu varaṃ prādāt tasmai rājñe mahātmane |
dadau tasyākṣayaṃ vittaṃ śatrubhiścāparājayam || 56 ||
dharme ratiṃ ca satataṃ svargavāsaṃ tathākṣayam |
putrāṇāṃ cākṣayām̐llokān svarge ye rakṣasāhatāḥ ||57 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi dhundhuvadhe ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 ||

<1.12>

dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tasya putrāstrayaḥ śiṣṭā dṛḍhāśvo jyeṣṭha ucyate |
candrāśvakapilāśvau tu kumārau dvau kanīyasau || 1 ||
dhaundhumārirdṛḍhā śvastu haryaśvastasya cātmajaḥ |
haryaśvasya nikumbho'bhūt kṣatradharmarataḥ sadā || 2 ||
saṃhatāśvo nikumbhasya putro raṇaviśāradaḥ |
akṛśāśvaḥ kṛśāśvaśca saṃhatāśvasutau nṛpa || 3 ||
tasya haimavatī kanyā satāṃ mātā dṛṣadvatī |
vikhyātā triṣu lokeṣu putraścāsyāḥ prasenajit|| 4 ||
lebhe prasenajid bhāryāṃ gaurīṃ nāma pativratām|
abhiśaptā tu sā bhartrā nadī vai bāhudābhavat|| 5 ||
tasyāḥ putro mahānāsīdyuvanāśvo mahīpatiḥ |
māndhātā yuvanāśvasya trilokavijayī sutaḥ || 6 ||
tasya caitrarathī bhāryā śaśabindoḥ sutābhavat|
sādhvī bindumatī nāma rūpeṇāsadṛśī bhuvi || 7 ||
pativratā ca jyeṣṭhā ca bhrātṝṇāmayutasya sā
tasyāmutpādayāmāsa māndhātā dvau sutau nṛpa
purukutsaṃ ca dharmajñaṃ mucukundaṃ ca dhārmikam
purukutsasutastvāsīt trasadasyurmahīpatiḥ||9||
narmadāyāmathotpannaḥ sambhūtastasya cātmajaḥ |
sambhūtasya tu dāyādaḥ sudhanvā nāma pārthivaḥ || 1.12.10 ||
sudhanvanaḥ sutaścāsīttridhanvā ripumardanaḥ |
rājñastridhanvanastvāsīd vidvāṃstrayyāruṇaḥ sutaḥ|| 11 ||
tasya satyavrato nāma kumāro'bhūnmahābalaḥ |
pāṇigrahaṇamantrāṇāṃ vighnaṃ cakre sudurmatiḥ || 12 ||
yena bhāryā hṛtā pūrva kṛtodvāhā parasya vai |
bālyāt kāmācca mohācca saṃharṣāccāpalena ca|| 13 ||
jahāra kanyāṃ kāmātsa kasyacitpuravāsinaḥ|
adharmaśaṅkunā tena rājñā trayyāruṇo'tyajat|| 14 ||
apadhvaṃseti bahuśo vadan krodhasamanvitaḥ |
pitaraṃso'bravīttyaktaḥ kva gacchāmīti vai muhuḥ|| 15 ||
pitā tvenamathovāca śvapākaiḥ saha vartaya |
nāhaṃ putreṇa putrārthī tvayādya kulapāṃsana || 16 |
ityuktaḥ sa nirākrāmannagarād vacanātpituḥ |
na ca taṃ vārayāmāsa vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ || 17 ||
sa tu satyavratastāta śvapākāvasathāntike |
pitrā tyakto'vasaddhīraḥ pitā tasya vanaṃ yayau || 18 ||
tatastasmiṃstu viṣaye nāvarṣat pākaśāsanaḥ |
samā dvādaśa rājendra tenādharmeṇa vai tadā || 19 ||
dārāṃstu tasya viṣaye viśvāmitro mahātapāḥ |
saṃnyasya sāgarānūpe cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ || 1.12.20 ||
tasya patnī gale baddhvā madhyamaṃ putramaurasam |
śeṣasya bharaṇārthāya vyakrīṇād gośatena vai || 21 ||
taṃ tu baddhaṃ gale dṛṣṭvā vikrīyantaṃ nṛpātmajaḥ |
maharṣiputraṃ dharmātmā mokṣayāmāsa bhārata || 22 ||
satyavrato mahābāhurbharaṇaṃ tasya cākarot |
viśvāmitrasya tuṣṭyarthamanukampārthameva ca || 23 ||
so'bhavad gālavo nāma galabandhānmahātapāḥ |
maharṣiḥ kauśikastāta tena vīreṇa mokṣitaḥ || 24||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi gālavotpattau dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||

<1.13>

trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
satyavratastu bhaktyā ca kṛpayā ca pratijñayā |
viśvāmitrakalatraṃ tad babhāra vinaye sthitaḥ || 1 ||
hatvā mṛgān varāhāṃśca mahiṣāṃśca vanecarān |
viśvāmitrāśramābhyāśe māṃsaṃ vṛkṣe babandha saḥ || 2 ||
upāṃśuvratamāsthāya dīkṣāṃ dvādaśavārṣikīm |
piturniyogādavasat tasmin vanagate nṛpe || 3 ||
ayodhyāṃ caiva rāṣṭraṃ ca tathaivāntaḥpuraṃ muniḥ |
yājyopādhyāyasambandhād vasiṣṭhaḥ paryarakṣata || 4 ||
satyavratastu bālyācca bhāvino'rthasya vā balāt |
vasiṣṭhe'bhyadhikaṃ manyuṃ dhārayāmāsa vai tadā || 5 ||
pitrā tu taṃ tadā rāṣṭrāt tyajyamānaṃ svamātmajam |
na vārayāmāsa munirvasiṣṭhaḥ kāraṇena ha || 6 ||
pāṇigrahaṇamantrāṇāṃ niṣṭhā syāt saptame pade |
na ca satyavratastasya tamupāṃśumabudhyata || 7 ||
jānan dharmaṃ vasiṣṭhastu na māṃ trātīti bhārata |
satyavratastadā roṣaṃ vasiṣṭhe manasākarot || 8 ||
guṇabuddhyā tu bhagavān vasiṣṭhaḥ kṛtavāṃstathā|
na ca satyavratastasya tamupāṃśumabudhyata || 9 ||
tasminnaparitoṣo yaḥ piturāsīnmahātmanaḥ |
tena dvādaśa varṣāṇi nāvarṣat pākaśāsanaḥ || 1.13.10 ||
tena tvidānīṃ vahatā dīkṣāṃ tāṃ durvahāṃ bhuvi |
kulasya niṣkṛtistāta kṛtā sā vai bhavediti || 11 ||
na taṃ vasiṣṭho bhagavān pitrā tyaktaṃ nyavārayat
abhiṣekṣyāmyahaṃ putramasyetyevaṃ matirmuneḥ || 12 ||
sa tu dvādaśavarṣāṇi dīkṣāṃ tāmudvahad balī |
upāṃśuvratamāsthāya mahat satyavrato nṛpa || 13 ||
avidyamāne māṃse tu vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ |
sarvakāmadughāṃ dogdhrīṃ dadarśa sa nṛpātmajaḥ || 14 ||
tāṃ vai krodhācca mohācca śramāccaiva kṣudhārditaḥ |
daśadharmān gato rājā jaghāna janamejaya || 15 ||
tacca māṃsaṃ svayaṃ caiva viśvāmitrasya cātmajān|
bhojayāmāsa tacchrutvā vasiṣṭho'pyasya cukrudhe |
kruddhastu bhagavān vākyamidamāha nṛpātmajam || 16 ||
vasiṣṭha uvāca
pātayeyamahaṃ krūra tava śaṅkumasaṃśayam |
yadi te dvāvimau śaṅakū na syātāṃ vai kṛtau punaḥ|| 17 ||
pituścāparitoṣeṇa gurordogdhrīvadhena ca |
aprokṣitopayogācca trividhaste vyatikramaḥ || 18 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evaṃ trīṇyasya śaṅkūni tāni dṛṣṭvā mahātapāḥ|
triśaṅkuriti hovāca triśaṅkuriti sa smṛtaḥ|| 19 ||
viśvāmitrastu dārāṇāmāgato bharaṇe kṛte |
sa tu tasmai varaṃ prādānmuniḥ prītastriśaṅkave || 1.13.20 ||
chandyamāno vareṇātha varaṃ vavre nṛpātmajaḥ |
