divodāsena tāṃ jñātvā niviṣṭāṃ nagarīṃ bhavaḥ || 44 ||
pārśve tiṣṭhantamāhūya nikumbhamidamabravīt |
gaṇeśvara purīṃ gatvā śūnyāṃ vārāṇasīṃ kuru || 45 ||
mṛdunaivābhyupāyena hyativīryaḥ sa pārthivaḥ |
tato gatvā nikumbhastu purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ tadā || 46 ||
svapne nidarśayāmāsa kaṇḍukaṃ nāma nāpitam |
śreyaste'haṃ kariṣyāmi sthānaṃ me rocayānagha || 47 ||
madrūpāṃ pratimāṃ kṛtyā nagaryante tathaiva ca |
tataḥ svapne yathoddiṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ kāritavān nṛpa || 48 ||
purīdvāre tu vijñāpya rājānaṃ ca yathāvidhi |
pūjāṃ tu mahatīṃ tasya nityameva prayojayat || 49 ||
gandhaiśca dhūpamālyaiśca prokṣaṇīyaistathaiva ca |
annapānaprayogaiśca atyadbhutamivābhavat || 1.29.50 ||
evaṃ sampūjyate tatra nityameva gaṇeśvaraḥ|
tato varasahasraṃ tu nāgarāṇāṃ prayacchati|
putrānhiraṇyamāyuśca sarvān kāmāṃstathaiva ca || 51 ||
rājñastu mahiṣī śreṣṭhā suyaśā nāma viśrutā |
putrārthamāgatā devī sādhvī rājñā pracoditā || 52 ||
pūjāṃ tu vipulāṃ kṛtvā devī putramayācata |
punaḥ punarathāgatya bahuśaḥ putrakāraṇāt||53||
na prayacchati putraṃ hi nikumbhaḥ kāraṇena hi |
rājā tu yadi naḥ kupyetkāryasiddhistato bhavet|| 54 ||
atha dīrgheṇa kālena krodho rājānamāviśat |
bhūta eṣa mahāndvāri nāgarāṇāṃ prayacchati || 55 ||
prīto varān vai śataśo mama kiṃ na prayacchati |
māmakaiḥ pūjyate nityaṃ nagaryāṃ me sadaiva hi || 56 ||
vijñāpito mayātyarthaṃ devyā me putrakāraṇāt |
na dadāti ca putraṃ me kṛtaghnaḥ kena hetunā || 57 ||
tato nārhati satkāraṃ matsakāśād viśeṣataḥ |
tasmāttu nāśayiṣyāmi sthānamasya durātmanaḥ || 58 ||
evaṃ sa tu viniścitya durātmā rājakilbiṣī |
sthānaṃ gaṇapatestasya nāśayāmāsa durmatiḥ || 59||
bhagnamāyatana dṛṣṭvā rājānamaśapat prabhuḥ |
yasmādanaparādhasya tvayā sthānaṃ vināśitam |
puryakasmādiyaṃ śūnyā tava nūnaṃ bhaviṣyati || 1.29.60 ||
tatastena tu śāpena śūnyā vārāṇasī tadā |
śaptvā purīṃ nikumbhastu mahādevamathāgamat|| 61 ||
akasmāttu purī sā tu vidrutā sarvatodiśam|
tasyāṃ puryāṃ tato devo nirmame padamātmanaḥ || 62 ||
ramate tatra vai devo ramamāṇo gireḥ sutām |
na ratiṃ tatra vai devī labhate gṛhavismayāt |
vasāmyatra na puryāṃ tu devī devamathābravīt || 63 ||
deva uvāca
nāhaṃ veśmani vatsyāmi avimuktaṃ hi me gṛham |
nāhaṃ tatra gamiṣyāmi gaccha devi gṛhaṃ prati || 64 ||
sannuvāca bhagavāṃstryantakastripurāntakaḥ |
tasmāt tadavimuktaṃ hi proktaṃ devena vai svayam || 65 ||
evaṃ vārāṇasī śaptā avimuktaṃ ca kīrtitam||66 ||
yasmin vasati vai devaḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ| |
yugeṣu triṣu dharmātmā saha devyā maheśvaraḥ || 67 ||
antardhānaṃ kalau yāti tatpuraṃ hi mahātmanaḥ |
antarhite pure tasmin purī sā vasate punaḥ |
evaṃ vārāṇasī śaptā niveśaṃ punarāgatā || 68 ||
bhadraśreṇyasya putro vai durdamo nāma viśrutaḥ |
divodāsena bāleti ghṛṇayā sa vivarjitaḥ || 69 ||
haihayasya tu dāyādyaṃ kṛtavān vai mahīpatiḥ |
ājahre pitṛdāyādyaṃ divodāsahṛtaṃ balāt||1.29.70||
bhadraśreṇyasya putreṇa durdamena mahātmanā |
vairasyāntaṃ mahārāja kṣatriyeṇa vidhitsatā || 71 |
divodāsād dṛṣadvatyāṃ vīro jajñe pratardanaḥ|
tena putreṇa bālena prahataṃ tasya vai punaḥ || 72 ||
pratardanasya putrau dvau vatsabhārgau babhūvatuḥ |
vatsaputro hyalarkastu saṃnatistasya cātmajaḥ || 73 ||
alarkaḥ kāśirājastu brahmaṇyaḥ satyasaṅgaraḥ |
alarkaṃ prati rājarṣi śloko gītaḥ purātanaiḥ || 74 ||
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣaśatāni ca |
yuvā rūpeṇa sampanna āsīt kāśikulodvahaḥ ||
lopāmudrāprasādena paramāyuravāpa saḥ |
tasyāsīt sumahadrājyaṃ rūpayauvanaśālinaḥ || 76 ||
śāpasyānte mahābāhurhatvā kṣemakarākṣasam |
ramyāṃ niveśayāmāsa purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ punaḥ || 77 ||
saṃnaterapi dāyādaḥ sunītho nāma dhārmikaḥ |
sunīthasya tu dāyādaḥ kṣemyo nāma mahāyaśāḥ || 78 ||
kṣemyasya ketumānputraḥ suketustasya cātmajaḥ |
suketostanayaścāpi dharmaketuriti smṛtaḥ || 79 ||
dharmaketostu dāyādaḥ satyaketurmahārathaḥ |
satyaketusutaścāpi vibhurnāma prajeśvaraḥ || 1.29.80 ||
ānartastu vibhoḥ putraḥ sukumārastu tatsutaḥ |
sukumārasya putrastu dhṛṣṭaketuḥ sudhārmikaḥ |
dhṛṣṭaketostu dāyādo veṇuhotraḥ prajeśvaraḥ || 81 ||
veṇuhotrasutaścāpi bhargo nāma prajeśvaraḥ |
vatsasya vatsabhūmistu bhṛgubhūmistu bhārgavāt|| 82 ||
ete tvaṅgirasaḥ putrā jātā vaṃśe'tha bhārgave |
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāstayoḥ putrāḥ sahasraśaḥ |
ityete kāśayaḥ proktā nahuṣasya nibodha me || 83 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 29 ||

<1.30>

triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
utpannāḥ pitṛkanyāyāṃ virajāyāṃ mahaujasaḥ |
nahuṣasya tu dāyādāḥ ṣaḍindropamatejasaḥ || 1 ||
yatiryayātiḥ saṃyātirāyātiḥ pāñciko bhavaḥ |
suyātiḥ ṣaṣṭhasteṣāṃ vai yayātiḥ pārthivo'bhavat |
yatirjyeṣṭhastu teṣāṃ vai yayātistu tataḥ param || 2 ||
kakutsthakanyāṃ gāṃ nāma lebhe paramadhārmikaḥ |
yatistu mokṣamāsthāya brahmabhūto'bhavanmuniḥ || 3 ||
teṣāṃ yayātiḥ pañcānāṃ vijitya vasudhāmimām |
devayānīmuśanasaḥ sutāṃ bhāryāmavāpa saḥ |
śarmiṣṭhāmāsurīṃ caiva tanayāṃ vṛṣaparvaṇaḥ || 4 ||
yaduṃ ca turvasuṃ caiva devayānī vyajāyata |
druhyuṃ cānuṃ ca pūruṃ ca śarmiṣṭhā vārṣaparvaṇī || 5||
tasmai śakro dadau prīto rathaṃ paramabhāsvaram |
asaṅgaṃ kāñcanaṃ divyaṃ divyaiḥ paramavājibhiḥ || 6 ||
yuktaṃ manojavaiḥ śubhrairyena bhāryāmuvāha saḥ |
sa tena rathamukhyena ṣaḍrātrenājayanmahīm|
yayātiryudhi durdharṣastathā devān sadānavān || 7 ||
sa rathaḥ pauravāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāmabhavat tadā |
yāvattu vasunāmno vai kauravājjanamejaya || 8
kuroḥ putrasya rājendra rājñaḥ pārīkṣitasya ha |
jagāma sa ratho nāśaṃ śāpād gārgyasya dhīmataḥ || 9 ||
gārgyasya hi sutaṃ bālaṃ sa rājā janamejayaḥ |
vākchūraṃ hiṃsayāmāsa brahmahatyāmavāpa saḥ || 1.30.10 ||
sa lohagandhī rājarṣiḥ paridhāvannitastataḥ |
paurajānapadaistyakto na lebhe śarma karhicit || 11 ||
tataḥ sa duḥkhasaṃtapto nālabhatsaṃvidaṃ kvacit|
indrotaḥ śaunakaṃ rājā śaraṇaṃ pratyapadyata || 12 ||
yājayāmāsa cendrotaṃ śaunako janamejayam |
aśvamedhena rājānaṃ pāvanārthaṃ dvijottamaḥ || 13 ||
sa lohagandho vyanaśat tasyāvabhṛthametya ha |
sa ca divyo ratho rājan vasoścedipatestadā |
dattaḥ śakreṇa tuṣṭena lebhe tasmād bṛhadrathaḥ || 14 ||
bṛhadrathātkrameṇaiva gato bārhadrathaṃ nṛpam |
tato hatvā jarāsaṃdhaṃ bhīmastaṃ rathamuttamam || 15 ||
pradadau vāsudevāya prītyā kauravanandanaḥ |
saptadvīpāṃ yayātistu jitvā pṛdhvī sasāgarām || 16 ||
vyabhajat pañcadhā rājan putrāṇāṃ nāhuṣastadā |
diśi dakṣiṇapūrvasyāṃ turvasuṃ matimān nṛpaḥ || 17 ||
pratīcyāmuttarasyāṃ ca druhyuṃ cānuṃ ca nāhuṣaḥ |
diśi pūrvottarasyāṃ vai yaduṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ nyayojayat || 18|
madhye pūruṃ ca rājānamabhyaṣiñcata nāhuṣaḥ |
tairiyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā saptadvīpā sapattanā || 19 ||
yathāpradeśamadyāpi dharmeṇa pratipālyate |
praṇāsteṣāṃ purastāttu vakṣyāmi nṛpasattama || 1.30.20 ||
dhanurnyasya pṛṣatkāṃśca pañcabhiḥ puruṣarṣabhaiḥ |
jarāvānabhavad rājā bhāramāveśya bandhuṣu || 21 ||
niḥkṣiptaśastraḥ pṛthivīṃ nirīkṣya pṛthivīpatiḥ |
prītimānabhavad rājā yayātiraparājitaḥ |
evaṃ vibhajya pṛthivīṃ yayātiryadumabravīt || 22 ||
jarāṃ me pratigṛhṇīṣva putra kṛtyāntareṇa vai |
taruṇastava rūpeṇa careyaṃ pṛthivīmimām |
jarāṃ tvayi samādhāya taṃ yaduḥ pratyuvāca ha || 23 ||
anirdiṣṭā mayā bhikṣā brāhmaṇasya pratiśrutā |
anapākṛtya tāṃ rājan na grahīṣyāmi te jarām || 24 ||
jarāyāṃ bahavo doṣāḥ pānabhojanakāritāḥ |
tasmājjarāṃ na te rājan grahītumahamutsahe ||25 ||
santi te bahavaḥ putrā mattaḥ priyatarā nṛpa |
pratigrahītuṃ dharmajña putramanyaṃ vṛṇīṣva vai || 26 ||
sa evamukto yadunā rājā kopasamanvitaḥ |
uvāca vadatāṃ śreṣṭho yayātirgarhayan sutam || 27 ||
ka āśrayastavānyo'sti ko vā dharmo vidhīyate |
māmanādṛtya durbuddhe yadahaṃ tava deśikaḥ || 28 ||
evamuktvā yaduṃ tāta śaśāpainaṃ sa manyumān |
arājñyā te prajā mūḍha bhavitrīti narādhama || 29 ||
sa turvasuṃ ca druhyuṃ cāpyanuṃ ca bharatarṣabha |
evamevābravīd rājā pratyākhyātaśca tairapi || 1.30.30 ||
śaśāpa tānatikruddho yayātiraparājitaḥ |
yathā te kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ mayā rājarṣisattamaḥ || 31 ||
evaṃ śaptvā sutān sarvāṃścaturaḥ pūrupūrvajān|
tadeva vacanaṃ rājā pūrumapyāha bhārata ||32||
taruṇastava rūpeṇa careyaṃ pṛthivīmimām |
jarāṃ tvayi samādhāya tvaṃ pūro yadi manyase || 33 ||
sa jarāṃ pratijagrāha pituḥ pūruḥ pratāpavān |
yayātirapi rūpeṇa pūroḥ paryacaranmahīm || 34 ||
sa mārgamāṇaḥ kāmānāmantaṃ bharatasattama |
viśvācyā sahito reme vane caitrarathe prabhuḥ || 35 ||
yadāvitṛṣṇaḥ kāmānāṃ bhogeṣu sa narādhipaḥ |
tadā pūroḥ sakāśādvai svāṃ jarāṃ pratyapadyata || 36 ||
tatra gāthā mahārāja śṛṇu gītā yayātinā |
yābhiḥ pratyāharetkāmān sarvato'ṅgāni kūrmavat||37||
na jātu kāmaḥ kāmānāmupabhogena śāmyati |
haviṣā kṛṣṇavartmeva bhūya evābhivardhate || 38 ||
yat pṛthivyāṃ vrīhiyavaṃ hiraṇyaṃ paśavaḥ striyaḥ |
nālamekasya tat sarvamiti paśyanna muhyati || 39 ||
yadā bhāvaṃ na kurute sarvabhūteṣu pāpakam |
karmaṇā manasā vācā brahma sampadyate tadā ||1.30.40 ||
yadānebhyo na bibhyeta yadācāsmānna bibhyati |
yadā necchati na dveṣṭi brahma sampadyate tadā || 41 ||
yā dustyajā durmatibhiryā na jīryati jīryataḥ |
yo'sau prāṇāntiko rogastāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ tyajataḥ sukham|42|
jīryanti jīryataḥ keśā dantā jīryanti jīryataḥ |
jīvitāśā dhanāśā ca jīryato'pi na jīryati || 43 ||
yacca kāmasukhaṃ loke yacca divyaṃ mahatsukham|
tṛṣṇākṣayasukhasyaite nārhataḥ ṣoḍaśīṃ kalām|| 44 ||
evamuktvā sa rājarṣiḥ sadāraḥ prāviśadvanam |
kālena mahatā vāpi cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ || 45 ||
bhṛgutuṅge tapastaptvā tapaso'nte mahātapāḥ |
anaśnan dehamutsṛjya sadāraḥ svargamāptavān || 46 ||
tasya vaṃśe mahārāja pañca rājarṣisattamāḥ |
yairvyāptā pṛthivī sarvā sūryasyeva gabhastibhiḥ || 47 ||
yadostu śṛṇu rājarṣervaṃśaṃ rājarṣisatkṛtam |
yatra nārāyaṇo jajñe harirvṛṣṇikulodvahaḥ || 48 ||
dhanyaḥ prajāvānāyuṣmān kīrtimāṃśca bhavennaraḥ |
yayāteścaritaṃ puṇyaṃ paṭhañchṛṇvan narādhipa || 49 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi yayāticarite triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 30 ||

<1.31>

ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
pūrorvaṃśamahaṃ brahmañchrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ |
druhyoścānoryadoścaiva turvasośca pṛthak pṛthak || 1 ||
vṛṣṇivaṃśaprasaṅgena svaṃ vaśaṃ pūrvameva tu |
vistareṇānupūrvyā ca tad bhavānvaktumarhati || 2 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śṛṇu pūrormahārāja vaṃśamuttamapauruṣam |
vistareṇānupūrvyā ca yatra jāto'si pārthiva || 3 ||
hanta te kīrtayiṣyāmi pūrorvaṃśamanuttamam |
druhyoścānoryadoścaiva turvasośca narādhipa || 4 ||
pūroḥ putro mahāvīryo rājā''sījjanamejayaḥ |
pracinvāṃstu sutastasya yaḥ prācīmajayad diśam || 5 ||
pracinvataḥ pravīro'bhūnmanasyustasya cātmajaḥ |
rājā cābhayado nāma manasyorabhavat sutaḥ || 6 ||
tathaivābhayadasyāsīt sudhanvā tu mahīpatiḥ |
sudhanvano bahugavaḥ śamyātistasya cātmajaḥ || 7 ||
śamyātestu rahasyātī raudrāśvastasya cātmajaḥ |
raudrāśvasya ghṛtācyāṃ vai daśāpsarasi sūnavaḥ || 8 ||
ṛceyuḥ prathamasteṣāṃ kṛkaṇeyustathaiva ca |
kakṣeyuḥ sthaṇḍileyuśca sannateyustathaiva ca || 9 ||
daśārṇeyurjaleyuśca sthaleyuśca mahāyaśāḥ |
dhaneyuśca vaneyuśca putrikāśca daśa striyaḥ || 1.31.10 ||
rudrā śūdrā ca bhadrā ca maladā malahā tathā |
khaladā caiva rājendra naladā surasāpi ca |
tathā gocapalā tu strīratnakūṭā ca tā daśa || 11 ||
ṛṣirjāto'trivaṃśe tu tāsāṃ bhartā prabhākaraḥ |
rudrāyāṃ janayāmāsa sutaṃ somaṃ yaśasvinam || 12 ||
svarbhānunā hate sūrye patamāne divo mahīm |
tamo'bhibhūte loke ca prabhā yena pravartitā || 13 ||
svasti te'stviti cokto vai patamāno divākaraḥ |
vacanāt tasya viprarṣerna papāta divo mahīm || 14 ||
atriśreṣṭhāni gotrāṇi yaścakāra mahātapāḥ |
yajñeṣvatrerdhanaṃ caiva surairyasya pravartitam || 15 ||
sa tāsu janayāmāsa putrikāsu sanāmakān |
daśa putrān mahātmā sa tapasyugre ratānsadā || 16
te tu gotrakarā rājannṛṣayo vedapāragāḥ |
svastyātreyā iti khyātāḥ kiṃ tvatridhanavarjitāḥ || 17||
kakṣeyostanayāścāsaṃstraya eva mahārathāḥ |
sabhānaraścākṣuṣaśca paramanyustathaiva ca || 18 ||
sabhānarasya putrastu vidvān kālānalo nṛpaḥ |
kālānalasya dharmajñaḥ sṛñjayo nāma vai sutaḥ || 19 ||
sṛñjayasyābhavat putro vīro rājā purañjayaḥ |
janamejayo mahārāja purañjayasuto'bhavat || 1.31.20 ||
janamejayasya rājarṣermahāśālo'bhavat sutaḥ |
deveṣu sa paritrātaḥ pratiṣṭhitayaśā bhuvi || 21 ||
mahāmanā nāma suto mahāśālasya dhārmikaḥ |
jajñe vīraḥ suragaṇaiḥ pūjitaḥ sumahāyaśāḥ || 22 ||
mahāmanāstu putrau dvau janayāmāsa bhārata |
uśīnaraṃ ca dharmajñaṃ titikṣuṃ ca mahābalam || 23 ||
uśīnarasya patnyastu pañca rājarṣivaṃśajāḥ |
nṛgā kṛmī navā darvā pañcamī ca dṛṣadvatī || 24 ||
uśīnarasya putrāstu pañca tāsu kulodvahāḥ |
tapasā vai sumahatā jātā vṛddhasya bhārata || 25 ||
nṛgāyāstu nṛgaḥ putraḥ kṛmyāṃ kṛmirajāyata |
navāyāstu navaḥ putro darvāyāḥ suvrato'bhavat || 26 ||
dṛṣadvatyāstu saṃjajñe śibirauśīnaro nṛpaḥ |
śibestu śibayastāta yaudheyāstu nṛgasya ha || 27 ||
navasya navarāṣṭraṃ tu kṛmestu kṛmilā purī |
suvratasya tathāmbaṣṭhā śibiputrānnibodha me || 28 ||
śibeśca putrāścatvāro vīrāstrailokyaviśrutāḥ |
vṛṣadarbhaḥ suvīraśca madrakaḥ kaikayastathā || 29 ||
teṣāṃ janapadāḥ sphītāḥ kekayā madrakāstathā |
vṛṣadarbhāḥ suvīrāśca titikṣostu prajāḥ śṛṇu || 1.31.30 ||
taitikṣavo'bhavad rājā pūrvasyāṃ diśi bhārata |
uṣadratho mahābāhustasya phenaḥ suto'bhavat || 31 ||
phenāt tu sutapā jajñe sutaḥ sutapaso baliḥ |
jāto mānuṣayonau tu sa rājā kāñcaneṣudhiḥ || 32 ||
mahāyogī sa tu balirbabhūva nṛpatiḥ purā |
putrānutpādayāmāsa pañca vaṃśakarān bhuvi || 33 ||
aṅgaḥ prathamato jajñe vaṅgaḥ suhyastathaiva ca |
puṇḍraḥ kaliṅgaśca tathā bāleyaṃ kṣatramucyate || 34 ||
bāleyā brāhmaṇāścaiva tasya vaṃśakarā bhuvi |
balestu brahmaṇā dattā varāḥ prītena bhārata || 35 ||
mahāyogitvamāyuśca kalpasya parimāṇataḥ |
saṃgrāme vāpyajeyatvaṃ dharme caiva pradhānatā || 36 ||
trailokyadarśanaṃ caiva prādhānyaṃ prasave tathā |
bale cāpratimatvaṃ vai dharmatattvārthadarśanam || 37 ||
caturo niyatān varṇostvaṃ ca sthāpayitā bhuvi |
ityukto vibhunā rājā baliḥ śāntiṃ parā yayau || 38 ||
tasya te tanayāḥ sarve kṣetrajā munipuṅgavāt |
sambhūtā dīrghatapaso sudeṣṇāyāṃ mahaujasaḥ || 39 ||
balistānabhiṣicyeha pañca putrānakalmaṣān |
kṛtārthaḥ so'pi yogātmā yogamāśritya sa prabhuḥ ||1.31.40||
adhṛṣyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ kālāpekṣī carannapi |
kālena mahatā rājan svaṃ ca sthānamupāgamat || 41 ||
teṣāṃ janapadāḥ pañca aṅgā vaṅgāḥ sasuhyakāḥ |
kaliṅgāḥ puṇḍrakāścaiva prajāstvaṅgasya me śṛṇu || 42 ||
aṅgaputro mahānāsīd rājendro dadhivāhanaḥ |
dadhivāhanaputrastu rājā diviratho'bhavat || 43 ||
putro divirathasyāsīcchakratulyaparākramaḥ |
vidvān dharmaratho nāma tasya citrarathaḥ sutaḥ || 44 ||
tena citrarathenātha tadā viṣṇupade girau |
yajatā saha śakreṇa somaḥ pīto mahātmanā || 45 ||
atha citrarathasyāpi putro daśaratho'bhavat |
lomapāda iti khyāto yasya śāntā sutābhavat|| 46 ||
tasya dāśarathirvīraścaturaṅgo mahāyaśāḥ |
ṛṣyaśṛṅgaprasādena jajñe kulavivardhanaḥ || 47 ||
caturaṅgasya putrastu pṛthulākṣa iti smṛtaḥ |
pṛthulākṣasuto rājā campo nāma mahāyaśāḥ || 48 ||
campasya tu purī campā yā mālinyabhavatpurā |
pūrṇabhadraprasādena haryaṅgo'sya suto'bhavat || 49 ||
tato vaibhāṇḍakistasya vāraṇaṃ śakravāraṇam |
avatārayāmāsa mahīṃ mantrairvāhanamuttamam || 1.31.50 ||
haryaṅgasya tu dāyādo rājā bhadrarathaḥ smṛtaḥ |
putro bhadrarathasyāsīd bṛhatkarmā prajeśvaraḥ || 51 ||
bṛhaddarbhaḥ sutastasya tasmājjajñe bṛhanmanā |
bṛhanmanāstu rājendra janayāmāsa vai sutam || 52||
nāmnā jayadrathaṃ nāma yasmād dṛḍharatho nṛpaḥ |
āsīd dṛḍharathasyāpi viśvajijjanamejaya || 53 ||
dāyādastasya karṇastu vikarṇastasya cātmajaḥ |
tasya putraśataṃ tvāsīdaṅgānāṃ kulavardhanam || 54 ||
bṛhaddarbhasuto yastu rājñā nāmnā bṛhanmanāḥ |
tasya patnīdvayaṃ cāsīccaidyasyaite sute śubhe |
yaśodevī ca satyā ca tābhyāṃ vaṃśastu bhidyate ||55||
jayadrathastu rājendra yaśodevyāṃ vyajāyata |
brahmakṣatrottaraḥ satyāṃ vijayo nāma viśrutaḥ || 56 ||
vijayasya dhṛtiḥ putrastasya putro dhṛtavrataḥ |
dhṛtavratasya putrastu satyakarmā mahāyaśāḥ || 57 ||
satyakarmasutaścāpi sūtastvadhirathastu vai |
yaḥ karṇaṃ pratijagrāha tataḥ karṇastu sūtajaḥ || 58||
etat te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ karṇaṃ prati mahābalam |
karṇasya vṛṣasenastu vṛṣastasyātmajaḥ smṛtaḥ || 59 ||
ete'ṅgavaṃśajāḥ sarve rājānaḥ kīrtitā mayā |
satyavratā mahātmānaḥ prajñāvanto mahārathāḥ || 1.31.60 ||
ṛceyostu mahārāja raudrāśvatanayasya ha |
śṛṇu vaṃśamanuproktaṃ yatra jāto'si pārthiva || 61 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi kukṣeyuvaṃśānukīrtanaṃ nāma ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 31 ||

<1.32>

dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
anādhṛṣyastu rājarṣirṛceyuścaikarāṭ smṛtaḥ |
ṛceyorjvalanā nāma bhāryā vai takṣakātmajā || 1 ||
tasyāṃ sa devyāṃ rājarṣirmatināro mahīpatiḥ |
matinārasutāścāsaṃstrayaḥ paramadhārmikāḥ || 2 ||

sarve kṛtāstrā balinaḥ sarve yuddhaviśāradāḥ || 4 ||

duṣyantaṃ prati rājānaṃ vāguvācāśarīriṇī |
mātā bhastrā pituḥ putro yena jātaḥ sa eva saḥ || 11 ||

mātṝṇāṃ tāta kopena mayā te kathitaṃ purā |

atraivodāharantīmaṃ bharadvājasya dhīmataḥ |

tato'tha vitatho nāma bharadvājasuto'bhavat |
tato'tha vitathe jāte bharatastu divaṃ yayau || 17 ||
vitathaṃ cābhiṣicyātha bharadvājo vanaṃ yayau |
sa rājā vitathaḥ putrāñjanayāmāsa pañca vai || 18 ||
suhotraṃ ca suhotāraṃ gayaṃ gargaṃ tathaiva ca |

kāśikaśca mahāsattvastathā gṛtsamatirnṛpaḥ |
tathā gṛtsamateḥ putrā brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā viśaḥ || 1.32.20 ||
kāśikasya tu kāśeyaḥ putro dīrghatapāstathā |
ājamīḍho'paro vaṃśaḥ śrūyatāṃ puruṣarṣabha || 21 ||

ajamīḍho dvimīḍhaśca purumīḍhaśca vīryavān || 22 ||

purujātiḥ suśāntestu vāhyāśvaḥ purujātitaḥ || 24 ||

yavīnaraśca vikrāntaḥ kṛmilāśvaśca pañcamaḥ || 26 ||
pañcaite rakṣaṇāyālaṃ deśānāmiti viśrutāḥ |
pañcānāṃ viddhi pañcālānsphītairjanapadairvṛtān || 27 ||

sarva ete mahātmānaḥ kṣatropetā dvijātayaḥ |

maudgalasya suto jyeṣṭho brahmarṣiḥ sumahāyaśāḥ |
indraseno yato garbhaṃ vadhryaśvaṃ pratyapadyata || 1.32.30 ||
vadhryaśvānmithunaṃ jajñe menakāyāmiti śrutiḥ |

trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
babhūvustu yadoḥ putrāḥ pañca devasutopamāḥ |
sahasradaḥ payodaśca kroṣṭā nīlo'ñjikastathā || 1 ||
sahasradasya dāyādāstrayaḥ paramadhārmikāḥ |
haihayaśca hayaścaiva rājan veṇuhayastathā || 2 ||
haihayasyābhavat putro dharmanetra iti smṛtaḥ |
dharmanetrasya kārtastu sāhañjastasya cātmajaḥ || 3 ||
sāhañjanī nāma purī yena rājñā niveśitā |
sāhañjasya tu dāyādo mahiṣmān nāma pārthivaḥ || 4 ||
māhiṣmatī nāma purī yena rājñā niveśitā |
āsīnmahiṣmataḥ putro bhadraśreṇyaḥ pratāpavān || 5 ||
vārāṇasyadhipo rājā kathitaḥ pūrvameva tu |
bhadraśreṇyasya putrastu durdamo nāma viśrutaḥ || 6 ||
durdamasya suto dhīmānkanako nāma vīryavān |
kanakasya tu dāyādāścatvāro lokaviśrutāḥ || 7 ||
kṛtavīryaḥ kṛtaujāśca kṛtavarmā tathaiva ca |
kṛtāgnistu caturtho'bhūtkṛtavīryāttathārjunaḥ || 8 ||
yastu bāhusahasreṇa saptadvīpeśvaro'bhavat |
jigāya pṛthivīmeko rathenādityavarcasā || 9 ||
sa hi varṣāyutaṃ taptvā tapaḥ paramaduścaram |
dattamārādhayāmāsa kārtavīryo'trisambhavam || 1.33.10 ||
tasmai datto varān prādāccaturo bhūritejasaḥ |
pūrvaṃ bāhusahasraṃ tu prārthitaṃ sumahadvaram || 11 ||
adharme vartamānasya sadbhistatra nivāraṇam |
ugreṇa pṛthivīṃ jitvā svadharmeṇānurañjanam || 19 ||
saṃgrāmān subahūnkṛtvā hatvā nārīnsahasraśaḥ|
saṃgrāme vartamānasya vadhaṃ cāpyadhikād raṇe || 13 ||
tasya bāhusahasraṃ tu yudhyataḥ kila bhārata |
yogād yogeśvarasyeva prādurbhavati māyayā || 14 ||
teneyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā saptadvīpā sapattanā |
sasamudrā sanagarā ugreṇa vidhinā jitā | 15 ||
tena saptasu dvīpeṣu sapta yajñaśatāni vai |
prāptāni vidhinā rājñā śrūyante janamejaya || 16 ||
sarve yajñā mahābāhostasyāsan bhūridakṣiṇāḥ |
sarve kāñcanayūpāśca sarve kāñcanavedayaḥ || 17 ||
sarvairdevairmahārāja vimānasthairalaṃkṛtāḥ |
gandharvairapsarobhiśca nityamevopaśobhitāḥ || 18 ||
yasya yajñe jagau gāthāṃ gandharvo nāradastathā |
varīdāsātmajo vidvān mahimnā tasya vismitaḥ || 19 ||
nārada uvāca
na nūnaṃ kārtavīryasya gatiṃ yāsyanti pārthivāḥ |
yajñairdānaistapobhirvā vikrameṇa śrutena ca || 1.33.20 ||
sa hi saptasu dvīpeṣu khaṅgī carmī śarāsanī |
rathī dvīpānanucaran yogī saṃdṛśyate nṛbhiḥ || 21 ||
anaṣṭadravyatā caiva na śoko na ca vibhramaḥ |
prabhāveṇa mahārājñaḥ prajā dharmeṇa rakṣataḥ || 22 ||
pañcāśītisahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ vai narādhipaḥ |
sa sarvaratnabhāk samrāṭ cakravartī babhūva ha || 22 ||
sa eva yajñapālo'bhūt kṣetrapālaḥ sa eva ca |
sa eva vṛṣṭyāṃ parjanyo yogitvādarjuno'bhavat|| 24 ||
sa vai bāhusahasreṇa jyāghātakaṭhinatvacā |
bhāti raśmisahasreṇa śaradīva divākaraḥ || 25 ||
sa hi nāgān manuṣyeṣu māhiṣmatyāṃ mahādyutiḥ |
karkoṭakasutāñjitvā puryāṃ tasyāṃ nyaveśayat || 26 ||
sa vai vegaṃ samudrasya prāvṛṭkāle'mbujekṣaṇaḥ |
krīḍanniva bhujodbhinnaṃ pratisrotaścakāra ha || 27 ||
luṇṭhitā krīḍitā tena phenasragdāmamālinī |
caladūrmisahasreṇa śaṅkitābhyeti narmadā || 28 ||
tasya bāhusahasreṇa kṣubhyamāṇe mahodadhau |
bhayānnilīnā niśceṣṭāḥ pātālasthā mahāsurāḥ || 29 ||
cūrṇīkṛtamahāvīciṃ calanmīnamahātimim |
mārutāviddhaphenaughamāvartakṣobhaduḥsaham || 1.33.30 ||
prāvartayat tadā rājā sahasreṇa ca bāhunā |
devāsurasamākṣiptaḥ kṣīrodamiva mandaraḥ || 31 ||
mandarakṣobhacakitā amṛtodbhavaśaṅkitāḥ |
sahasotpatitā bhītā bhīmaṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛpottamam || 32 ||
natā niścalamūrdhāno babhūvuste mahoragāḥ |
sāyāhne kadalīkhaṇḍāḥ kampitāstasya vāyunā || 339
sa vai baddhvā dhanurjyābhirutsiktaṃ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ |
laṅkeśaṃ mohayitvā tu sabalaṃ rāvaṇaṃ balāt |
nirjityaiva samānīya māhiṣmatyāṃ babandha tam || 34 ||
śrutvā tu baddhaṃ paulastyaṃ rāvaṇaṃ tvarjunena tu |
tato gatvā pulastyastamarjunaṃ dadṛśe svayam |
mumoca rakṣaḥ paulastyaṃ pulastyenānuyācitaḥ || 35 ||
yasya bāhusahasrasya babhūva jyātalasvanaḥ |
yugānte tvambudasyeva sphuṭato hyaśaneriva || 36 ||
aho bata mṛdhe vīryaṃ bhārgavasya yadacchinat |
rājño vāhusahasraṃ tu haimaṃ tālavanaṃ yathā || 37 ||
tṛṣitena kadācit sa bhikṣitaścitrabhānunā |
sa bhikṣāmadadād vīraḥ saptadvīpānvibhāvasoḥ || 38 ||
purāṇi grāmaghoṣāṃśca viṣayāṃścaiva sarvaśaḥ |
jajvāla tasya sarvāṇi citrabhānurdidhakṣayā || 39 ||
sa tasya puruṣendrasya prabhāveṇa mahātmanaḥ |
dadāha kārtavīryasya śailāṃścaiva vanāni ca || 1.33.40 ||
sa śūnyamāśramaṃ ramyaṃ varuṇasyātmajasya vai |
dadāha vanavad bhītaścitrabhānuḥ sahaihayaḥ || 41 ||
yaṃ lebhe varuṇaḥ putraṃ purā bhāsvantamuttamam |
vasiṣṭhaṃ nāma sa muniḥ khyāta māpava ityuta || 42 ||
yatrāpavastu taṃ krodhācchaptavānarjunaṃ vibhuḥ |
yasmānna varjitamidaṃ vanaṃ te mama haihaya || 43 ||
tasmāt te duṣkaraṃ karma kṛtamanyo haniṣyati |
rāmo nāma mahābāhurjāmadagnyaḥ pratāpavān || 44 ||
chittvā bāhusahasraṃ te pramathya tarasā valī |
tapasvī brāhmaṇaśca tvāṃ vadhiṣyati sa bhārgavaḥ || 45 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
anaṣṭadravyatā yasya babhūvāmitrakarśana |
prabhāveṇa narendrasya prajā dharmeṇa rakṣataḥ || 46 ||
rāmāttato'sya mṛtyurvai tasya śāpānmunernṛpa |
varaścaiva hi kauravya svayameva vṛtaḥ purā || 47 ||
tasya putraśatasyāsan pañca śeṣā mahātmanaḥ |
kṛtāstrā balinaḥ śūrā dharmātmāno yaśasvinaḥ || 48 ||
śūrasenaśca śūraśca dhṛṣṭoktaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca |
jayadhvajaśca nāmnā''sīdāvantyo nṛpatirmahān || 49 ||
kārtavīryasya tanayā vīryavanto mahārathāḥ |
jayadhvajasya putrastu tālajaṅgho mahābalaḥ || 1.33.50 ||
tasya putrāḥ śataṃ khyātāstālajaṅghā iti śrutāḥ ||
teṣāṃ kule mahārāja haihayānāṃ mahātmanām || 51 ||
vītihotrāḥ sujātāśca bhojāścāvantayaḥ smṛtāḥ |
tauṇḍikerā iti khyātāstālajaṅghāstathaiva ca || 52 ||
bharatāśca sutā jātā bahutvānnānukīrtitāḥ |
vṛṣaprabhṛtayo rājan yādavāḥ pūrṇakarmiṇaḥ || 53 ||
vṛṣo vaṃśadharastatra tasya putro'bhavanmadhuḥ |
madhoḥ putraśataṃ tvāsīd vṛṣaṇastasya vaṃśabhāk|| 54 ||
vṛṣaṇād vṛṣṇayaḥ sarve madhostu mādhavāḥ smṛtāḥ |
yādavā yadunā cāgre nirucyante ca haihayāḥ || 55 ||
na tasya vittanāśo'sti naṣṭaṃ pratilabhecca saḥ |
kārtavīryasya yo janma kīrtayediha nityaśaḥ || 56 ||
ete yayātiputrāṇāṃ pañca vaṃśā viśāmpate |
kīrtitā lokavīrāṇāṃ ye lokāndhārayanti vai|| 57 ||
bhūtānīva mahārāja pañca sthāvarajaṅgamān |
śrutvā pañcavisargaṃ tu rājā dharmārthakovidaḥ || 58 ||
vaśī bhavati pañcānāmātmajānāṃ tatheśvaraḥ |
labhet pañca varāṃścaiva durlabhāniha laukikān || 59 ||
āyuḥ kīrtiṃ tathā putrānaiśvaryaṃ bhūmimeva ca |
dhāraṇācchravaṇāccaiva pañcavargasya bhārata || 1.33.60 ||
kroṣṭostu śṛṇu rājendra vaṃśamuttamapauruṣam
yadorvaṃśadharasyātha yajvanaḥ puṇyakarmaṇaḥ || 61 ||
kroṣṭurhi vaṃśaṃ śrutvemaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
yasyānvavāyajo viṣṇurharirvṛṣṇikulodvahaḥ || 62 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 33 ||

<1.34>

catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
gāndhārī caiva mādrī ca kroṣṭorbhārye babhūvatuḥ |
gāndhārī janayāmāsa anamitraṃ mahābalam || 1 ||
mādrī yudhājitaṃ putraṃ tato'nyaṃ devamīḍhuṣam |
teṣāṃ vaṃśastridhā bhūto vṛṣṇīnāṃ kulavardhanaḥ || 2 ||
mādryāḥ putrasya jajñāte sutau vṛṣṇyandhakāvubhau |
jajñāte tanayau vṛṣṇeḥ śvaphalkaścitrakastathā || 3 ||
śvaphalkastu mahārāja dharmātmā yatra vartate |
nāsti vyādhibhayaṃ tatra nāvarṣabhayamapyuta || 4 ||
kadācit kāśirājasya vibhorbharatasattama |
trīṇi varṣāṇi viṣaye nāvarṣat pākaśāsanaḥ || 5 ||
sa tatra vāsayāmāsa śvaphalkaṃ paramārcitam |
śvaphalkaparivarte caṃ vavarṣa harivāhanaḥ || 6 ||
śvaphalkaḥ kāśirājasya sutāṃ bhāryāmavindata |
gāndinīṃ nāma sā gāṃ tu dadau vipreṣu nityaśaḥ || 7 ||
sā māturudarasthā tu bahūn varṣagaṇān kila |
nivasantī na vai jajñe garbhasthāṃ tāṃ pitābravīt || 8 ||
jāyasva śīghraṃ bhadraṃ te kimarthamiha tiṣṭhasi |
provāca cainaṃ garbhasthā kanyā gāṃ ca dine dine || 9 ||
yadi dadyāṃ tato'dyāhaṃ jāyayiṣyāmi tāṃ pitā |
tathetyuvāca taṃ cāsyāḥ pitā kāmamapūrayat || 1.34.10 ||
dātā yajvā ca dhīraśca śrutavānatithipriyaḥ |
akrūraḥ suṣuve tasmācchvaphalkādbhūridakṣiṇaḥ || 11 ||
upāsaṅgastathā madgurmṛduraścārimejayaḥ |
avikṣipastathopekṣaḥ śatrughno'thārimardanaḥ || 12 ||
dharmadhṛgyatidharmā ca gṛdhro bhojo'ndhakastathā |
āvāhaprativāhau ca sundarī ca varāṅganā || 13 ||
akrūreṇograsenāyāṃ sugātryāṃ kurunandana |
prasenaścopadevaśca jajñāte devavarcasau || 14 ||
citrakasyābhavan putrāḥ pṛthurvipṛthureva ca |
aśvagrīvo'śvabāhuśca supārśvakagaveṣaṇau || 15 ||
ariṣṭanemiraśvaśca sudharmā dharmabhṛttathā |
suvāhurbahubāhuśca śraviṣṭhāśravaṇe striyau || 16||
aśmakyāṃ janayāmāsa śūraṃ vai devamīḍhuṣaḥ |
mahiṣyāṃ jajñire śūrād bhojyāyāṃ puruṣā daśa || 17 ||
vasudevo mahābāhuḥ pūrvamānakadundubhiḥ |
jajñe yasya prasūtasya dundubhyaḥ prāṇadan divi || 18 ||
ākānāṃ ca saṃhrādaḥ sumahānabhavad divi |
papāta puṣpavarṣaṃ ca śūrasya bhavane mahat || 19 ||
manuṣyaloke kṛtsne'pi rūpe nāsti samo bhuvi |
yasyāsītpuruṣāgryasya kāntiścandramaso yathā || 1.34.20 ||
devabhāgastato jajñe tathā devaśravāḥ punaḥ |
anādhṛṣṭiḥ kanavako vatsāvānatha gṛñjimaḥ || 21 ||
śyāmaḥ śamīko gaṇḍūṣaḥ pañca cāsya varāṅganāḥ |
pṛthukīrtiḥ pṛthā caiva śrutadevā śrutaśravāḥ || 22 ||
rājādhidevī ca tathā pañcaitā vīramātaraḥ |
pṛthāṃ duhitaraṃ vavre kuntistāṃ kurunandana || 23 ||
śūraḥ pūjyāya vṛddhāya kuntibhojāya tāṃ dadau |
tasmātkuntīti vikhyātā kuntibhojātmajā pṛthā |24|
antyasya śrutadevāyāṃ jagṛhuḥ suṣuve sutaḥ |
śrutaśravāyāṃ caidyasya śiśupālo mahābalaḥ || 25 ||
hiraṇyakaśipuryo'sau daityarājo'bhavatpurā |
pṛthukīrtyāṃ tu tanayaḥ saṃjajñe vṛddhaśarmaṇaḥ || 26 ||
karūṣādhipatirvīro dantavakro mahābalaḥ |
pṛthāṃ duhitaraṃ cakre kuntistāṃ pāṇḍurāvahat ||27 ||
yasyāṃ sa dharmavid rājā dharmājjajñe yudhiṣṭhiraḥ |
bhīmasenastathā vātādindrāccaiva dhanaṃjayaḥ || 28 ||
loke'pratiratho vīraḥ śakratulyaparākramaḥ |
anamitrācchinirjajñe kaniṣṭhādvṛṣṇinandanāt || 29 ||
śaineyaḥ satyakastasmādyuyudhānaśca sātyakiḥ |
asaṅgo yuyudhānasya bhūmistasyābhavatsutaḥ || 1.34.30 ||
bhūmeryugadharaḥ putra iti vaṃśaḥ samāpyate |
uddhavo devabhāgasya mahābhāgaḥ suto'bhavat |
paṇḍitānāṃ paraṃ prāhurdevaśravasamuddhavam || 31 ||
aśmakyāṃ prāptavān putramanādhṛṣṭiryaśasvinam |
nivṛttaśatruṃ śatrughnaṃ devaśravā vyajāyata || 32 ||
devaśravāḥ prajātastu naiṣādiryaḥ pratiśrutaḥ |
ekalavyo mahārāja niṣādaiḥ parivardhitaḥ || 33 ||
vatsāvate tvaputrāya vasudevaḥ pratāpavān |
adbhirdadau sutaṃ vīraṃ śauriḥ kauśikamaurasam || 34 ||
gaṇḍūṣāya tvaputrāya viṣvakseno dadau sutān |
cārudeṣṇaṃ sucāruṃ ca pañcālaṃ kṛtalakṣaṇam || 35 ||
asaṃgrāmeṇa yo cīro nāvartata kadācana |
raukmiṇeyo mahābāhuḥ kanīyān puruṣarṣabha || 36 ||
vāyasānāṃ sahasrāṇi yaṃ yāntaṃ pṛṣṭhato'nvayuḥ |
cārumāṃsāni bhokṣyāmaścārudeṣṇahatāni tu || 37 ||
tandrijastandripālaśca sutau kanavakasya tu |
vīraścāśvahanaścaiva vīrau tāvatha gṛñjimau || 38 ||
śyāmaputraḥ śamīkastu śamīko rājyamāvahat |
jugupsamānau bhojatvād rājasūyamavāpa saḥ |
ajātaśatruḥ śatrūṇāṃ jajñe tasya vināśanaḥ || 39 ||
vasudevasutānvīrānkīrtayiṣyāmi tāñchṛṇu || 1.34.40 ||
vṛṣṇestrividhametat tu bahuśākhaṃ mahaujasam|
dhārayan vipulaṃ vaṃśaṃ nānarthairiha yujyate || 41 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi vṛṣṇivaṃśakīrtanaṃ nāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 34 ||

<1.35>

pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
yāḥ patnyo vasudevasya caturdaśa varāṅganāḥ |
pauravī rohiṇī nāma indirā ca tathā varā || 1 ||
vaiśākhī ca tathā bhadrā sunāmnī caiva pañcamī |
sahadevā śāntidevā śrīdevā devarakṣitā || 2 ||
vṛkadevyupadevī ca devakī caiva saptamī |
sutanurvaḍavā caiva dve ete paricārike || 3 ||
pauravī rohiṇī nāma bāhlikasyātmajābhavat |
jyeṣṭhā patnī mahārāja dayitā''nakadundubheḥ || 4 ||
lebhe jyeṣṭhaṃ sutaṃ rāmaṃ sāraṇaṃ śaṭhameva ca |
durdamaṃ damanaṃ śvabhraṃ piṇḍārakamuśīnaram || 5 ||
citrāṃ nāma kumārīṃ ca rohiṇītanayā daśa |
citrā subhadreti punarvikhyātā kurunandana || 6 ||
vasudevācca devakyāṃ jajñe śaurirmahāyaśāḥ |
rāmācca niśaṭho jajñe revatyāṃ dayitaḥ sutaḥ || 7 ||
subhadrāyāṃ rathī pārthādabhimanyurajāyata |
akrūrāt kāśikanyāyāṃ satyaketurajāyata || 8
vasudevasya bhāryāsu mahābhāgāsu saptasu |
ye putrā jajñire śūrā nāmatastān nibodha me || 9 ||
bhojaśca vijayaścaiva śāntidevāsutāvubhau |
vṛkadevaḥ sunāmāyāṃ gadaścāstā sutāvubhau || 1.35.10 ||
upāsaṅgavaraṃ lebhe tanayaṃ devarakṣitā |
agāvahaṃ mahātmānaṃ vṛkadevī vyajāyata || 11 ||
kanyā trigartarājasya bhartā vai śaiśirāyaṇaḥ |
jijñāsāṃ pauruṣe cakre na caskande'tha pauruṣam || 12 ||
kṛṣṇāyasasamaprakhyo varṣe dvādaśame tathā |
mithyābhiśapto gārgyastu manyunābhisamīritaḥ || 13 ||
gopakanyāmupādāya maithunāyopacakrame |
gopālī tvapsarāstasya gopastrīveṣadhāriṇī || 14 ||
dhārayāmāsa gārgyasya garbhaṃ durdharamacyutam |
mānuṣyāṃ gārgyabhāryāyāṃ niyogācchūlapāṇinaḥ || 15 ||
sa kālayavano nāma jajñe rājā mahābalaḥ |
vṛṣapūrvārdhakāyāstamavahan vājino raṇe || 16 ||
aputrasya sa rājñastu vavṛdhe'ntaḥpure śiśuḥ |
yavanasya mahārāja sa kālayavano'bhavat || 17||
sa yuddhakāmī nṛpatiḥ paryapṛcchad dvijottamān|
vṛṣṇyandhakakulaṃ tasya nārado'kathayad vibhuḥ || 18 ||
akṣauhiṇyā tu sainyasya mathurāmabhyayāttadā |
dūtaṃ sampreṣayāmāsa vṛṣṇyandhakaniveśanam || 19 ||
tato vṛṣṇyandhakāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ puraskṛtya mahāmatim|
sametā mantrayāmāsuryavanasya bhayāt tadā || 1.35.20||
kṛtvā ca niścayaṃ sarve palāyanaparāyaṇāḥ |
vihāya mathurāṃ ramyāṃ mānayantaḥ pinākinam || 21 ||
kuśasthalīṃ dvāravatīṃ niveśayitumīpsavaḥ |
iti kṛṣṇasya janmedaṃ yaḥ śucirniyatendriyaḥ |
parvasu śrāvayed vidvānanṛṇaḥ sa sukhī bhavet || 22 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇajanmānukīrtanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 35 ||

<1.36>

ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
kroṣṭorevābhavat putro vṛjinīvānmahāyaśāḥ |
vṛjinīvatsutaścāpi svāhiḥ svāhākṛtāṃ varaḥ || 1 ||
svāhiputro'bhavad rājā ruṣadgurvadatāṃ varaḥ |
mahākratubhirīje yo vividhaibhūridakṣiṇaiḥ || 2 ||
sutaprasūtimanvicchan ruṣadguḥ so'gryamātmajam|
jajñe citrarathastasya putraḥ karmabhiranvitaḥ || 3 ||
āsīccaitrarathirvīro yajvā vipuladakṣiṇaḥ |
śaśabinduḥ paraṃ vṛttaṃ rājarṣīṇāmanuṣṭhitaḥ || 4 ||
pṛthuśravāḥ pṛdhuyaśā rājā''sīcchaśabindujaḥ |
śaṃsanti ca purāṇajñāḥ pārthaśravasamuttaram || 5 ||
anantaraṃ suyajñastu suyajñatanayo'bhavat|
uśato yajñamakhilaṃ svadharmamuśatāṃ varaḥ || 6 ||
śineyurabhavat sūnuruśataḥ śatrutāpanaḥ |
maruttastasya tanayo rājarṣirabhavannṛpa || 7 ||
marutto'labhata jyeṣṭhaṃ sutaṃ kambalabarhiṣam |
cacāra vipulaṃ dharmamamarṣāt pretyabhāgapi || 8 ||
sutaprasūtimicchan vai sutaṃ kambalabarhiṣaḥ |
babhūva rukmakavacaḥ śataprasavataḥ sutaḥ || 9 ||
nihatya rukmakavacaḥ śataṃ kavacināṃ raṇe |
dhanvināṃ niśitairbāṇairavāpa śriyamuttamām || 1.36.10||
jajñe'tha rukmakavacāt parājit paravīrahā |
jajñire pañca putrāstu mahāvīryāḥ parājitaḥ || 11 ||
rukmeṣuḥ pṛthurukmaśca jyāmaghaḥ pālito hariḥ |
pālitaṃ ca hariṃ caiva videhebhyaḥ pitā dadau || 12||
rukmeṣurabhavad rājā pṛthurukmasya saṃśritaḥ |
tābhyāṃ pravrājito rājyājjyāmagho'vasadāśrame || 13 ||
praśāntaḥ sa vanasthastu brāhmaṇaiścāvabodhitaḥ |
jigāya rathamāsthāya deśamanyaṃ dhvajī rathī || 14 ||
narmadākūlamekākī nagarīṃ mṛttikāvatīm |
ṛkṣavantaṃ giriṃ jitvā śuktimatyāmuvāsa saḥ || 15 ||
jyāmaghasyābhavad bhāryā śaibyā balavatī satī |
aputro'pi ca rājā sa nānyāṃ bhāryāmavindata || 16 ||
tasyāsīd vijayo yuddhe tatra kanyāmavāpa saḥ |
bhāryāmuvāca saṃtrastaḥ snuṣeti sa nareśvaraḥ || 17 ||
etacchrutvābravīd devī kasya ceyaṃ snuṣeti vai |
abravīt tadupaśrutya jyāmagho rājasattamaḥ || 18||
yaste janiṣyate putrastasya bhāryopadānavī |
ugreṇa tapasā tasyāḥ kanyāyāḥ sā vyajāyata |
putraṃ vidarbhaṃ subhagā śaibyā pariṇatā satī || 19 ||
rājaputryāṃ tu vidvāṃsau stuṣāyāṃ krathakauśikau |
paścād vidarbho'janayacchūrau raṇaviśāradau || 1.36.20 ||
lomapādaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu putraṃ paramadhārmikam |
lomapādātmajo babhrurāhvatistasya cātmajaḥ || 21 ||
āhvateḥ kauśikaścaiva vidvān paramadhārmikaḥ |
cediḥ putraḥ kauśikasya tasmāccaidyā nṛpāḥ smṛtāḥ||22||
bhīmo vidarbhasya sutaḥ kuntistasyātmajo'bhavat
kunterdhṛṣṭasuto jajñe raṇadhṛṣṭaḥ pratāpavān |
dhṛṣṭasya jajñire śūrāstrayaḥ paramadhārmikāḥ || 23||
āvantaśca daśārhaśca balī viṣaharaśca yaḥ |
daśārhasya suto vyomā vyomno jīmūta ucyate|| 24 |
jīmūtaputro bṛhatistasya bhīmarathaḥ sutaḥ |
atha bhīmarathasyāsīt putro navarathastathā || 25 ||
tasya cāsīddaśarathaḥ śakunistasya cātmajaḥ |
tasmāt karambhaḥ kārambhirdevarāto'bhavannṛpaḥ|| 26 ||
devakṣatro'bhavat tasya daivakṣatrirmahāyaśāḥ |
devagarbhasamo jajñe devakṣatrasya nandanaḥ || 27 ||
madhūnāṃ vaṃśakṛd rājā madhurmadhuravāgapi |
madhorjajñe'tha vaidarbho putro maruvasāstathā || 28 ||
āsīnmaruvasaḥ putraḥ purudvān puruṣottamaḥ |
madhurjajñe'tha vaidarbhyāṃ bhadravatyāṃ kurūdvahaḥ || 29 ||
aikṣvākī cābhavadbhāryā sattvāṃstasyāmajāyata |
sattvān sarvaguṇopetaḥ sāttvatāṃ kīrtivardhanaḥ || 1.36.30 ||
imāṃ visṛṣṭiṃ vijñāya jyāmaghasya mahātmanaḥ |
yujyate parayā kīrtyā prajāvāṃśca bhavennaraḥ || 31 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 36 ||

<1.37>

saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
sattvatātsattvasampannān kauśalyā suṣuve sutān|
bhajinaṃ bhajamānaṃ ca divyaṃ devāvṛdhaṃ nṛpam || 1 ||
andhakaṃ ca mahāvāhu vṛṣṇiṃ ca yadunandanam |
teṣāṃ visargāścatvāro vistareṇeha tāñchṛṇu || 2 ||

āstāṃ bhārye tayostasmājjajñire bahavaḥ sutāḥ || 3 ||
kṛmiśca kramaṇaścaiva dhṛṣṭaḥ śūraḥ puraṃjayaḥ |
ete bāhyakasṛñjayyāṃ bhajamānād vijajñire || 4 ||
ayutājitsahasrājicchatājiccātha dāśakaḥ |
upabāhyakasṛñjayyāṃ bhajamānād vijajñire || 5 ||

putraḥ sarvaguṇopeto mama syāditi niścitaḥ || 6 ||
saṃyujyātmānamevaṃ tu parṇāśāyā jalaṃ spṛśan |
sadopaspṛśatastasya cakāra priyamāpagā || 7 ||
cintayābhiparītā sā jagāmaikābhiniścayam |
kalyāṇatvānnarapatestasya sā nimnagottamā 8 ||
nādhyagacchata tāṃ nārīṃ yasyāmevaṃvidhaḥ sutaḥ |
jāyettasmātsvayaṃ hanta bhavāmyasya sahavratā|| 9 ||
atha bhūtvā kumārī sā bibhratī paramaṃ vapuḥ |
varayāmāsa nṛpatiṃ tāmiyeṣa ca sa prabhuḥ || 1.37.10 ||
tasyāmādhatta garbhaṃ ca tejasvinamudāradhīḥ |

putraṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ babhruṃ devāvṛdhānnṛpāt|
atra vaṃśe purāṇajñā gāyantīti pariśrutam || 12 ||
guṇān devāvṛdhasyātha kīrtayanto mahātmanaḥ |
yathaivāgre samaṃ dūrāt paśyāma ca tathāntike ||13||
babhruḥ śreṣṭho manuṣyāṇāṃ devairdevāvṛdhaḥ samaḥ |
ṣaṣṭiśca ṣaṭ ca puruṣāḥ sahasrāṇi ca sapta ca || 14 ||
ete'mṛtatvaṃ samprāptā babhrurdevāvṛdhāvapi |
yajvā dānapatirvidvān brahmaṇyaḥ sudṛḍhāyudhaḥ || 15 ||
kīrtimāṃśca mahātejāḥ sāttvatānāṃ mahāvaraḥ |
tasyānvavāyaḥ sumahānbhojā ye mārtikāvatāḥ || 16 ||
andhakātkāśyaduhitā caturo'labhatātmajān|
kukuraṃ bhajamānaṃ ca śamiṃ kambalabarhiṣam || 17 ||
kukurasya suto dhṛṣṇurdhṛṣṇostu tanayastathā |
kapotaromā tasyātha taittiristanayo'bhavat || 18 ||
jajñe punarvasustasmādabhijit tu punarvasoḥ|
tasya vai putramithunaṃ babhūvābhijitaḥ kila || 19 ||
āhukaścāhukī caiva khyātau khyātimatāṃ varau |
imāṃ codāharantyatra gāthāṃ prati tamāhukam || 1.37.20 ||
śvetena parivāreṇa kiśorapratimo mahān |
aśīticarmaṇā yuktaḥ sa nṛpaḥ prathamaṃ vrajet || 21 |||
nāputravān nāśatado nāsahasraśatāyuṣaḥ |
nāśuddhakarmā nāyajvā yo bhojamabhito vrajet || 22 ||
pūrvasyāṃ diśi nāgānāṃ bhojasyetyanumodanam |
sopāsaṅgānukarṣāṇāṃ dhvajināṃ savarūthinām || 23 ||
rathānāṃ meghaghoṣāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi daśaiva tu |
rūpyakāñcanakakṣāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi daśāpi ca || 24 ||
tāvantyeva sahasrāṇi uttarasyāṃ tathā diśi |
ā bhūmipālānbhojāḥ svānupatiṣṭhankiṅkiṇīkiṇaḥ || 25 ||
āhukī cāpyavantibhyaḥ svasāraṃ dadurandhakāḥ |
āhukasya tu kāśyāyāṃ dvau putrau sambabhūvatuḥ || 26 ||
devakaścograsenaśca devaputrasamāvubhau |

devavānupadevaśca sudevo devarakṣitaḥ |

vṛkadevyupadevī ca sunāsī caiva saptamī || 29 ||
navograsenasya sutāsteṣāṃ kaṃsastu pūrvajaḥ |
nyagrodhaśca sunāmā ca kaṅkaḥ śaṅkuḥ subhūmipaḥ || 1.37.30 ||
rāṣṭrapālo'tha sutanuranādhṛṣṭiśca puṣṭimān |
teṣāṃ svasāraḥ pañcā''sankaṃsā kaṃsavatī tathā || 31 ||
sutanū rāṣṭrapālī ca kaṅkā caiva varāṅganā |
ugrasenaḥ sahāpatyo vyākhyātaḥ kukurodbhavaḥ || 32 ||
kukurāṇāmimaṃ vaṃśaṃ dhārayannamitaujasām |
ātmano vipulaṃ vaṃśaṃ prajāvānāpnuyānnaraḥ || 33 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 37 ||

<1.38>

aṣṭatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
bhajamānasya putro'tha rathamukhyo vidūrathaḥ |
rājādhidevaḥ śūrastu vidūrathasuto'bhavat || 1 ||

dattātidattabalinau śoṇāśvaḥ śvetavāhanaḥ || 2 ||
śamī ca daṇḍaśarmā ca daṇḍaśatruśca śatrujit |
śravaṇā ca śraviṣṭhā ca svasārau sambabhūvatuḥ || 3 ||
śamīputraḥ pratikṣatraḥ pratikṣatrasya cātmajaḥ |
svayaṃbhojaḥ svayaṃbhojāddhṛdīkaḥ sambabhūva ha || 4 ||
tasya putrā babhūvurhi sarve bhīmaparākramāḥ |
kṛtavarmāgrajasteṣāṃ śatadhanvātha madhyamaḥ || 5 ||
devarṣervacanāt tasya bhiṣag vaitaraṇaśca yaḥ |
sudāntaśca vidāntaśca kāmadā kāmadantikā || 6 ||
devavāṃścābhavat putro vidvān kambalabarhiṣaḥ |
asamaujāstathā vīro nāsamaujāśca tāvubhau || 7 ||
ajātaputrāya sutān pradadāvasamaujase |
sudaṃṣṭraṃ cārurūpaṃ ca kṛṣṇamityandhakāstrayaḥ || 8 ||
ete cānye ca bahavo andhakāḥ kathitāstava |
andhakānāmimaṃ vaṃśaṃ dhārayed yastu nityaśaḥ || 9 ||
ātmano vipulaṃ vaṃśaṃ labhate nātra saśayaḥ |
gāndhārī caiva mādrī ca kroṣṭurbhārye babhūvatuḥ || 1.38.10 ||
gāndhārī janayāmāsa anamitraṃ mahābalam |
mādrī yudhājitaṃ putraṃ tato vai devamīḍhuṣam || 11 ||
anamitramamitrāṇāṃ jetāramaparājitam |
anamitrasuto nighno nighnato dvau babhūvatuḥ || 12 ||
prasenaścātha satrājicchatrusenājitāvubhau |
praseno dvāravatyāṃ tu nivasantyāṃ mahāmaṇim||13 ||
divyaṃ syamantakaṃ nāma samudrādupalabdhavān |
tasya satrājitaḥ sūryaḥ sakhā prāṇasamo'bhavat || 14 ||
sa kadācinniśāpāye rathena rathināṃ varaḥ |
abdhikūlamupaspraṣṭumupasthātuṃ yayau ravim || 15 ||
tasyopatiṣṭhataḥ sūryaṃ vivasvānagrataḥ sthitaḥ |
aspaṣṭamūrtirbhagavāṃstejomaṇḍalavān prabhūḥ || 16 ||

yathaivaṃ vyomni paśyāmi sadā tvāṃ jyotiṣāmpate || 17 ||
tejomaṇḍalinaṃ devaṃ tathaiva purataḥ sthitam |
ko viśeṣo'sti me tvattaḥ sakhyenopāgatasya vai || 189
etacchrutvā tu bhagavān maṇiratnaṃ syamantakam |
svakaṇṭhādavamucyaiva ekānte nyastavān vibhuḥ || 19 ||

prītimānatha taṃ dṛṣṭvā muhūrtaṃ kṛtavān kathām || 1.38.20 ||
tamapi prasthitaṃ bhūyo vivasvantaṃ sa satrajit |
lokānudbhāsayasyetān yena tvaṃ satataṃ prabho |
tadetanmaṇiratnaṃ me bhagavan dātumarhasi || 21 ||
tataḥ syamantakamaṇiṃ dattavāṃstasya bhāskaraḥ |
sa tamābaddhya nagarīṃ praviveśa mahīpatiḥ || 22 ||
taṃ janāḥ paryadhāvanta sūryo'yaṃ gacchatīti ha |

tat prasenajitaṃ divyaṃ maṇiratnaṃ syamantakam |
dadau bhrātre narapatiḥ premṇā satrājiduttamam || 24||
sa maṇiḥ syandate rukmaṃ vṛṣṇyandhakaniveśane |
kālavarṣī ca parjanyo na ca vyādhibhayaṃ hyabhūt || 25 ||
lipsāṃ cakre prasenāttu maṇiratne syamantake |
govindo na ca tallebhe śakto'pi na jahāra saḥ ||26||
kadācinmṛgayāṃ yātaḥ prasenastena bhūṣitaḥ |
syamantakakṛte siṃhād vadhaṃ prāpa vanecarāta || 27 ||
atha siṃhaṃ pradhāvantamṛkṣarājo mahābalaḥ |
nihatya maṇiratnaṃ tadādāya bilamāviśat || 28 ||
tato vṛṣṇyandhakāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ prasenavadhakāraṇāt|
prārthanāṃ tāṃ maṇerbuddhyā sarva eva śaśaṅkire || 29|
sa śaṅkyamāno dharmātmā nakārī tasya karmaṇaḥ |
āhariṣye maṇimiti pratijñāya vanaṃ yayau || 1.38.30 ||
yatra praseno mṛgayāmācarat tatra cāpyatha |
prasenasya padaṃ gṛhya puruṣairāptakāribhiḥ || 31 ||

ṛkṣeṇa nihato dṛṣṭaḥ pādairṛkṣaśca sūcitaḥ |

dhātryā kumāramādāya sutaṃ jāmbavato nṛpa |

dhātryuvāca
siṃhaḥ prasenamavadhīt siṃho jāmbavatā hataḥ |
sukumāraka mā rodīstava hyeṣa syamantakaḥ || 36 ||
suvyaktīkṛtaśabdastu tūṣṇīṃ bilamathāviśat |
praviśya cāpi bhagavāṃstamṛkṣabilamañjasā || 37 ||
sthāpayitvā biladvāri yadūṃllām̐ṅgalinā saha |

yuyudhe vāsudevastu bile jāmbavatā saha |
bāhubhyāmeva govindo divasānekaviṃśatim | 39 ||
praviṣṭe tu bilaṃ kṛṣṇe baladevapuraḥsarāḥ |
purīṃ dvāravatīmetya hataṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nyavedayan || 1.38.40 ||
vāsudevastu nirjitya jāmbavantaṃ mahābalam |
bheje jāmbavatīṃ kanyāmṛkṣarājasya sammatām |
maṇiṃ syamantakaṃ caiva jagrāhātmaviśuddhaye || 41 ||
anunīyarkṣarājānaṃ niryayau ca tadā bilāt |
dvārakāmagamat kṛṣṇaḥ śriyā paramayā yutaḥ || 42 ||
evaṃ sa maṇimāhṛtya viśodhyātmānamacyutaḥ |
dadau satrājite taṃ vai sarvasāttvatasaṃsadi || 43 ||
evaṃ mithyābhiśaptena kṛṣṇenāmitraghātinā |
ātmā viśodhitaḥ pāpād vinirjitya syamantakam ||
satrājito daśa tvātsanbhāryāstāsāṃ śataṃ sutāḥ |
khyātimantastrayasteṣāṃ bhaṅgakārastu pūrvajaḥ ||45||
vīro vātapatiścaiva upasvāvāṃśca te trayaḥ |
kumāryaścāpi tisro vai dikṣu khyātā narādhipa || 46 ||

tathā prasvāpinī caiva bhāryāṃ kṛṣṇāya tāṃ dadau || 47 ||
samākṣo bhaṅgakārasya nāreyaśca narottamau |

śvaphalkaḥ kāśirājasya sutāṃ bhāryāmavindata |

<1.39>

ekonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
yattat satrājite kṛṣṇo maṇiratnaṃ syamantakam |
adāt taddhārayāmāsa babhrurvai śatadhanvanā || 1 ||
sadā hi prārthayāmāsa satyabhāmāmaninditām |

rātrau taṃ maṇimādāya tato'krūrāya dattavān || 3 ||
akrūrastu tato ratnamādāya bharatarṣabha |

tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ tumulaṃ bhojakṛṣṇayoḥ |
śatadhanvā tato'krūramavaikṣat sarvato diśam || 12 ||
saṃrabdhau tāvubhau dṛṣṭvā tatra bhojajanārdanau |
śakto'pi śāṭhyāddhārdikyamakrūro nābhyapadyata || 13 ||

yojanānāṃ śataṃ sāgraṃ hayayā pratyapadyata || 14 ||
vikhyātā hṛdayā 'nāma śatayojanagāminī |

khamutpeturatha prāṇāḥ kṛṣṇo rāmamathābravīt || 17 ||
tiṣṭhasveha mahābāho dṛṣṭadoṣā hayā mayā |

atha ratnāni cāgryāṇi dravyāṇi vividhāni ca |
ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣāṇi dharmātmā yajñeṣu viniyojayat || 26 ||
akrūrayajñā iti te khyātāstasya mahātmanaḥ |
bahvannadakṣiṇāḥ sarve sarvakāmapradāyinaḥ || 27 ||
atha duryodhano rājā gatvā tu mithilāṃ prabhuḥ |
gadāśikṣāṃ tato divyāṃ balabhadrādavāptavān || 28 ||
prasādya tu tato rāmo vṛṣṇyandhakamahārathaiḥ |
ānīto dvārakāmeva kṛṣṇena ca mahātmanā || 29 ||
akrūrastvandhakaiḥ sārdhamapāyād bharatarṣabha |
hatvā satrājitaṃ suptaṃ sahabandhuṃ mahābalam || 1.39.30 ||
jñātibhedabhayāt kṛṣṇastamupekṣitavānatha |
apayāte tathākrūre nāvarṣat pākaśāsanaḥ || 31 ||
anāvṛṣṭyā yadā rājyamabhavad bahudhā kṛśam |
tataḥ prasādayāmāsurakrūraṃ kukurāndhakāḥ || 32 ||
punardvāravatīṃ prāpte tasmin dānapatau tataḥ |
pravavarṣa sahasrākṣaḥ kacche jalanidhestadā || 33 ||
kanyāṃ ca vāsudevāya svasāraṃ śīlasammatām |
akrūraḥ pradadau dhīmān prītyarthaṃ kurunandana || 34 ||
atha vijñāya yogena kṛṣṇo babhrūgataṃ maṇim |
sabhāmadhye gataṃ prāha tamakrūraṃ janārdanaḥ || 35 ||
yat tad ratnaṃ maṇivaraṃ tava hastagataṃ vibho |
tat prayacchasva mānārha mayi mānāryakaṃ kṛthāḥ || 36 ||
ṣaṣṭivarṣe gate kāle yadroṣo'bhūnmamānagha |
sa saṃrūḍho'sakṛtprāptastataḥ kālātyayo mahān|| 37 ||
tataḥ kṛṣṇasya vacanāt sarvasāttvatasaṃsadi |
pradadau taṃ maṇiṃ babhrurakleśena mahāmatiḥ || 38 ||
tatastamārjavaprāptaṃ babhrorhastādariṃdamaḥ |
dadau hṛṣṭamanāḥ kṛṣṇastaṃ maṇiṃ babhrave punaḥ || 39 ||
sa kṛṣṇahastātsamprāptaṃ maṇirantaṃ syamantakam |
ābaddhya gāndinīputro virarājāṃśumāniva || 1.39.40 ||
yastvevaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ |
sukhānāṃ sakalānāṃ ca phalabhāgīha jāyate || 41 ||
ā brahmabhuvanāścāpi yaśaḥkhyātirna saṃśayaḥ |
bhaviṣyati nṛpaśreṣṭha satyametad bravīmi te || 42||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇyekonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ | | 39 | |

<1.40>

catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
prādurbhāvān purāṇeṣu viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ |
satāṃ kathayatāmeva vārāha iti naḥ śrutam || 1 ||
na jāne tasya caritaṃ na vidhiṃ naiva vistaram |
na karmaguṇasaṃtānaṃ na hetuṃ na manīṣitam ||2 ||
kimātmako varāhaḥ sa kā mūrtiḥ kā ca devatā |
kimācāraḥ prabhāvo vā kiṃ vā tena purā kṛtam || 3 ||
yajñārthaṃ samavetānāṃ miṣatāṃ ca dvijanmanām |
mahāvarāhacaritaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyaneritam || 4 ||
yathā nārāyaṇo brahman vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ |
daṃṣṭrayā gāṃ samudrasthāmujjahārārisūdanaḥ || 5 ||
vistareṇaiva karmāṇi sarvāṇi ripughātinaḥ |
śrotumicchāmyaśeṣeṇa hareḥ kṛṣṇasya dhīmataḥ || 6 ||
karmaṇāmānupūrvyācca prādurbhāvāśca ye vibhoḥ |
yā cāsya prakṛtirbrahmaṃstāṃ me vyākhyātumarhasi || 7 ||
kathaṃ ca bhagavān viṣṇuḥ suraśatruniṣūdanaḥ |
vasudevakule dhīmān vāsudevatvamāgataḥ || 8 |
amarairāvṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyakṛdbhirniṣevitam|
devalokaṃ samutsṛjya martyalokamihāgataḥ || 9 ||
devamānuṣayornetā yo bhuvaḥ prabhavo vibhuḥ |
kimarthaṃ divyamātmānaṃ mānuṣye saṃnyayojayat || 1.40.10 ||
yaścakraṃ vartayatyeko mānuṣāṇāmanāmayam|
mānuṣye sa kathaṃ buddhiṃ cakre cakrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ || 11 ||
gopāyanaṃ yaḥ kurute jagataḥ sārvalaukikam |
sa kathaṃ gāṃ gato devo viṣṇurgopatvamāgataḥ || 12 ||
mahābhūtāni bhūtātmā yo dadhāra cakāra ca |
śrīgarbhaḥ sa kathaṃ garbhe striyā bhūcarayā dhṛtaḥ || 13 ||
yena lokān kramairjitvā tribhistrīṃstridaśepsayā |
sthāpitā jagato mārgāstrivargaprabhavāstrayaḥ || 14||
yo'ntakāle jagatpītvā kṛtvā toyamayaṃ vapuḥ |
lokamekārṇavaṃ cakre dṛśyādṛśyena vartmanā ||15 ||
yaḥ purāṇe purāṇātmā vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ |
viṣāṇāgreṇa vasudhāmujjahārārisūdanaḥ || 16 ||
yaḥ purā puruhūtārthe trailokyamidamavyayaḥ |
dadau jitvāsuragaṇān surāṇāṃ surasattamaḥ || 17 ||
yena saiṃhaṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā dvidhā kṛtvā ca tat punaḥ |
pūrvaṃ daityo mahāvīryo hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ || 18 ||
yaḥ purā hyanalo bhūtvā aurvaḥ saṃvartako vibhuḥ |
pātālastho'rṇavagataṃ papau toyamayaṃ haviḥ || 19 ||
sahasraśirasaṃ brahman sahasrākṣaṃ sahasradam|
sahasracaraṇaṃ devaṃ yamāhurvai yuge yuge || 1.40.20 ||
nābhyāraṇyāṃ samutpannaṃ yasya paitāmahaṃ gṛham |
ekārṇavajalasthasya naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame || 21 ||
yena te nihatā daityāḥ saṃgrāme tārakāmaye |
sarvadevamayaṃ kṛtvā sarvāyudhadharaṃ vapuḥ || 22 ||
garuḍasthena cotsiktaḥ kālanemirnipātitaḥ |
nirjitaśca mayo daityastārakaśca mahāsuraḥ || 23 ||
uttarānte samudrasya kṣīrodasyāmṛtodadheḥ |
yaḥ śete śāśvataṃ yogamāsthāya timiraṃ mahat || 24 ||
surāraṇirgarbhamadhatta divyaṃ tapaḥprakarṣādaditiḥ purāṇam |
śakraṃ ca yo daityagaṇāvaruddhaṃ garbhāvasāne nibhṛtaṃ cakāra || 25 ||
padāni yo lokamayāni kṛtvā cakāra daityān salileśayāṃstān |
kṛtvā ca devāṃstridivasya devāṃścakre sureśaṃ tridaśādhipatye || 26 ||
pātrāṇi dakṣiṇā dīkṣā camasolūkhalāni ca |
gārhapatyena vidhinā anvāhāryeṇa karmaṇā || 27 ||
agnimāhavanīyaṃ ca vedīṃ caiva kuśaṃ sruvam |
prokṣaṇīyaṃ dhruvāṃ caiva āvabhṛthyaṃ tathaiva ca || 28 ||
sudhātrīṇi ca yaścakre havyakavyapradān dvijān |
havyādāṃśca surān yajñe kravyādāṃstu pitṝnapi || 29 ||
bhāgārthe mantravidhinā yaścakre yajñakarmaṇi |
yūpānsamitsrucaṃ somaṃ pavitrān paridhīnapi || 1.40.30 ||
yajñiyāni ca dravyāṇi yajñāṃśca sacayānalān |
sadasyān yajamānāṃśca medhyādīṃśca kratūttamān || 31 ||
vibabhāja purā sarvaṃ pārameṣṭhyena karmaṇā |
yugānurūpān yaḥ kṛtvā lokānanuparākramat || 32 ||
kṣaṇā lavāśca kāṣṭhāśca kalāstraikālyameva ca |
muhūrtāstithayo māsāḥ pakṣāḥ saṃvatsarāstathā 33 ||
ṛtavaḥ kālayogāśca pramāṇaṃ trividhaṃ triṣu |
āyuḥ kṣetrāṇyupacayo lakṣaṇaṃ rūpasauṣṭhavam || 34 ||
trayo varṇāstrayo lokāstraividyaṃ pāvakāstrayaḥ |
traikālyaṃ trīṇi karmāṇi trayo'pāyāstrayo guṇāḥ ||35||
trayo lokāḥ purā sṛṣṭā yenānantyena karmaṇā |
sarvabhūtagaṇasraṣṭā sarvabhūtaguṇātmakaḥ || 36 ||
nṛṇāmindriyapūrveṇa yāgena ramate ca yaḥ |
gatāgatābhyāṃ yo netā sarvatra jagadīśvaraḥ || 37 ||
yo gatirdharmayuktānāmagatiḥ pāpakarmaṇām |
cāturvarṇyasya prabhavaścāturhotrasya rakṣitā || 38 ||
cāturvidyasya yo vettā cāturāśramyasaṃśrayaḥ |
digantaro nabhobhūto vāyurāpo vibhāvasuḥ || 39 ||
yaścandrasūryayorjyotiryogīśaḥ kṣaṇadāntakaḥ |
yatparaṃ śrūyate jyotiryatparaṃ śrūyate tapaḥ || 1.40.40 ||
yaṃ paraṃ prāhuraparaṃ yaḥ paraḥ paramātmavān |
nārāyaṇaparā vedā nārāyaṇaparāḥ kriyāḥ || 41 ||
nārāyaṇaparo dharmo nārāyaṇaparā gatiḥ |
nārāyaṇaparaṃ satyaṃ nārāyaṇaparaṃ tapaḥ || 42 ||
nārāyaṇaparo mokṣo nārāyaṇaparāyaṇam |
ādityādistu yo divyo yaśca daityāntako vibhuḥ|| 43 ||
yugānteṣvantako yaśca yaśca lokāntakāntakaḥ |
seturyo lokasetūnāṃ medhyo yo medhyakarmaṇām || 44 ||
vedyo yo vedaviduṣāṃ prabhuryaḥ prabhavātmanām |
somabhūtastu saumyānāmagnibhūto'gnivarcasām || 45 ||
manuṣyāṇāṃ manobhūtastapobhūtastapasvinām |
vinayo nayavṛttīnāṃ tejastejasvināmapi |
sargāṇāṃ sargakāraśca lokaheturanuttamaḥ || 46 ||
vigraho vigrahārhāṇāṃ gatirgatimatāmapi |
ākāśaprabhavo vāyurvāyuprāṇo hutāśanaḥ ||47 ||
devā hutāśanaprāṇāḥ prāṇo'gnermadhusūdanaḥ |
rasād vai śoṇitaṃ jātaṃ śoṇitānmāṃsamucyate|| 48 ||
māṃsāttu medaso janma medaso'sthīni caiva hi |
asthno majjā samabhavanmajjātaḥ śukrameva ca || 49||
śukrād garbhaḥ samabhavad rasamūlena karmaṇā |
tatrāpāṃ prathamo bhāgaḥ sa saumyo rāśirucyate || 1.40.50 ||
garbhoṣmasambhavo'gniryo dvitīyo rāśirucyate |
śukraṃ somātmakaṃ vidyādārtavaṃ viddhi pāvakam || 51 ||
bhāgau rasātmakau hyeṣāṃ vīryaṃ ca śaśipāvakau |
kaphavarge bhavecchukraṃ pittavarge ca śoṇitam || 52 ||
kaphasya hadayaṃ sthānaṃ nābhyāṃ pittaṃ pratiṣṭhitam |
dehasya madhye hṛdayaṃ sthānaṃ tanmanasaḥ smṛtam |
nābhikoṣṭhāntaraṃ yat tu tatra devo hutāśanaḥ || 53 ||
manaḥ prajāpatirjñeyaḥ kaphaḥ somo vibhāvyate |
pittamagniḥ smṛtaṃ hyetadagnīṣomātmakaṃ jagat || 54 ||
evaṃ pravartite garbhe varddhite'mbudasaṃnibhe |
vāyuḥ praveśaṃ saṃcakre saṅgataḥ paramātmanā || 55||
tato'ṅgāni visṛjati bibharti parivarddhayan |
sa pañcadhā śarīrastho bhidyate varddhate punaḥ || 56 ||
prāṇo'pānaḥ samānaśca udāno vyāna eva ca |
prāṇaḥ sa prathamaṃ sthānaṃ varddhayan parivartate || 57 ||
apānaḥ paścimaṃ kāyamudānordhvaṃ śarīriṇaḥ |
vyāno vyāyacchate yena samānaḥ saṃnivartayet |
bhūtāvāptistatastasya jāyatendriyagocarāt || 58 |
pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam |
tasyendriyāṇi viṣṭāni svaṃ svaṃ yogaṃ pracakrire ||59 ||
pārthivaṃ dehamāhustaṃ prāṇātmānaṃ ca mārutam |
chidrāṇyākāśayonīni jalāt srāvaḥ pravartate || 1.40.60 ||
jyotiścakṣuśca tejātmā teṣāṃ yantā manaḥ smṛtaḥ |
grāmāśca viṣayāścaiva yasya vīryāt pravartitāḥ || 61 ||
ityevaṃ puruṣaḥ sarvānsṛjam̐llokān sanātanān |
kathaṃ loke naidhane'smin naratvaṃ viṣṇurāgataḥ || 62 ||
eṣa me saṃśayo brahmannevaṃ me vismayo mahān |
kathaṃ gatirgatimatāmāpanno mānuṣīṃ tanum || 63 ||
śruto me svasya vaṃśasya pūrveṣāṃ caiva sambhavaḥ |
śrotumicchāmi viṣṇostu vṛṣṇīnāṃ ca yathākramam||
āścarya paramaṃ viṣṇurdevairdaityaiśca kathyate |
viṣṇorutpattimāścaryaṃ mamācakṣya mahāmune || 65 ||
etadāścaryamākhyānaṃ kathayasva sukhāvaham |
prakhyātabalavīryasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ |
karma cāścaryabhūtasya viṣṇostattvamihocyatām ||66||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi varāhotpattivarṇane catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 40 ||

<1.41>

ekacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
praśnabhāro mahāṃstāta tvayoktaḥ śārṅgadhanvani |
yathāśakti tu vakṣyāmi śrūyatāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yaśaḥ || 1 ||
viṣṇoḥ prabhāvaśravaṇe diṣṭyā te matirutthitā |
hanta viṣṇoḥ pravṛttiṃ ca śṛṇu divyā mayeritām ||2||
sahasrākṣaṃ sahasrāsyaṃ sahasracaraṇaṃ ca yam |
sahasraśirasaṃ devaṃ sahasrakaramavyayam || 3 ||
sahasrajihvaṃ bhāsvantaṃ sahasramukuṭaṃ prabhum |
sahasradaṃ sahasrādiṃ sahasrabhujamavyayam || 4 ||
savanaṃ havanaṃ caiva havyaṃ hotārameva ca |
pātrāṇi ca pavitrāṇi vediṃ dīkṣāṃ caruṃ sruvam || 5 ||
sruksomaṃ śūrpamusalaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ dakṣiṇāyanam |
adhvaryuṃ sāmagaṃ vipraṃ sadasyaṃ sadanaṃ sadaḥ || 6 ||
yūpaṃ samitkuśaṃ darvīṃ camasolūkhalāni ca |
prāgvaṃśaṃ yajñabhūmiṃ ca hotāraṃ cayanaṃ ca yat || 7 ||
hrasvānyatipramāṇāni carāṇi sthāvarāṇi ca |
prāyaścittāni cārthaṃ ca sthaṇḍilāni kuśāṃstathā || 8||
mantraṃ yajñavahaṃ vahniṃ bhāgaṃ bhāgavahaṃ ca yat |
agrebhujaṃ somabhujaṃ ghṛtārciṣamudāyudham || 9 ||
āhurvedavido viprā yaṃ yajñe śāśvataṃ vibhum |
tasya viṣṇoḥ sureśasya śrīvatsāṅkasya dhīmataḥ || 1.41.10 ||
prādurbhāvasahasrāṇi atītāni na saṃśayaḥ |
bhūyaścaiva bhaviṣyantītyevamāha prajāpatiḥ || 11 ||
yatpṛcchasi mahārāja puṇyāṃ divyāṃ kathāṃ śubhām |
yadarthaṃ bhagavān viṣṇuḥ sureśo ripusūdanaḥ |
devalokaṃ samutsṛjya vasudevakule'bhavat || 12 ||
tatte'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi śṛṇu sarvamaśeṣataḥ |
vāsudevasya māhātmyaṃ caritaṃ ca mahādyuteḥ || 13 ||
hitārthaṃ suramartyānāṃ lokānāṃ prabhavāya ca |
bahuśaḥ sarvabhūtātmā prādurbhavati kāryataḥ || 14 ||
prādurbhāvāṃśca vakṣyāmi puṇyān divyaguṇairyutān |
chāndasībhirudārābhiḥ śrutibhiḥ samalaṃkṛtān || 15||
śuciḥ prayatavāg bhūtvā nibodha janamejaya |
idaṃ purāṇaṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ vedaiśca sammitam || 16||
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi viṣṇordivyāṃ kathāṃ śṛṇu |
yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati bhārata |
dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya tadā sambhavati prabhuḥ||17||
tasya hyekā mahārāja mūrtirbhavati sattamā |
nityaṃ diviṣṭhā yā rājaṃstapaścarati duścaram || 18 ||
dvitīyā cāsya śayane nidrāyogamupāyayau |
prajāsaṃhārasargārthaṃ kimadhyātmavicintakam || 19 ||
suptvā yugasahasraṃ sa prādurbhavati kāryavān |
pūrṇe yugasahasre tu devadevo jagatpatiḥ || 1.41.20 ||
pitāmaho lokapālāścandrādityau hutāśanaḥ |
brahmā ca kapilaścaiva parameṣṭhī tathaiva ca || 21 ||
devāḥ saptarṣayaścaiva tryambakaśca mahāyaśāḥ |
vāyuḥ samudrāḥ śailāśca tasya dehaṃ samāśritāḥ || 22 ||
sanatkumāraśca mahānubhāvo manurmahātmā bhagavān prajākaraḥ |
purāṇadevo'tha purāṇi cakre pradīptavaiśvānaratulyatejāḥ || 23 ||
yena cārṇavamadhyasthau naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame |
naṣṭe devāsuragaṇe praṇaṣṭoragarākṣase || 24 ||
yoddhukāmau sudurdharṣau dānavau madhukaiṭabhau |
hatau prabhavatā tena tayordattvāmitaṃ varam || 25 ||
purā kamalanābhasya svapataḥ sāgarāmbhasi |
puṣkare yatra sambhūtā devāḥ sarṣigaṇāḥ purā || 26 ||
eṣa pauṣkarako nāma prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ |
purāṇe kathyate yatra vedaḥ śrutisamāhitaḥ || 27 ||
vārāhastu śrutimukhaḥ prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ |
yatra viṣṇuḥ suraśreṣṭho vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ |
mahīṃ sāgaraparyantāṃ saśailavanakānanām || 28 ||
vedapādo yūpadaṃṣṭraḥ kratudantaścitīmukhaḥ |
agnijihvo darbharomā brahmaśīrṣo mahātapāḥ || 29 ||
ahorātrekṣaṇo divyo vedāṅgaḥ śrutibhūṣaṇaḥ |
ājyanāsaḥ sruvatuṇḍaḥ sāmaghoṣasvano mahān |1.41.30||
dharmasatyamayaḥ śrīmān kramavikramasatkṛtaḥ |
prāyaścittanakho dhīraḥ paśujānurmahābhujaḥ || 31 ||
udgātrantro homaliṅgaḥ phalabījamahauṣadhiḥ |
vāyvantarātmā mantrasphigvikṛtaḥ somaśoṇitaḥ || 32 ||
vediskandho havirgandho havyakavyātivegavān |
prāgvaṃśakāyo dyutimān nānādīkṣābhirācitaḥ || 33 ||
dakṣiṇāhṛdayo yogī mahāsatramayo mahān |
upākarmoṣṭharucakaḥ pravargyāvartabhūṣaṇaḥ || 34 ||
nānāchandogatipatho guhyopaniṣadāsanaḥ |
chāyāpatnīsahāyo vai meruśṛṅga ivocchritaḥ || 35 ||
mahīṃ sāgaraparyantāṃ saśailavanakānanām|
ekārṇavajale bhraṣṭāmekārṇavagataḥ prabhuḥ || 36 ||
daṃṣṭrayā yaḥ samuddhṛtya lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā |
sahasraśīrṣo devādiścakāra pṛthivīṃ punaḥ || 37 ||
evaṃ yajñavarāheṇa bhūtvā bhūtahitārthinā |
uddhṛtā pṛthivī sarvā sāgarāmbudharā purā || 38 ||
vārāha eṣa kathito nārasiṃhamataḥ śṛṇu |
yatra bhūtvā mṛgendreṇa hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ || 39 ||
purā kṛtayuge rājan surārirbaladarpitaḥ |
daityānāmādipuruṣaścacāra tapa uttamam |1.41.40 ||
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi śatāni daśa pañca ca |
japopavāsanirataḥ sthānamaunadṛḍhavrataḥ || 41 ||
tataḥ śamadamābhyāṃ ca brahmacaryeṇa cānagha |
brahmā prīto'bhavat tasya tapasā niyamena ca || 42 ||
taṃ vai svayambhūrbhagavān svayamāgatya bhūpate |
vimānenārkavarṇena haṃsayuktena bhāsvatā || 43 ||
