kṣīṇe kaliyuge tasmiṃstataḥ kṛtayugaṃ punaḥ |
prapatsyate yathānyāyaṃ svabhāvādeva nānyathā ||169||
ete cānye ca bahavo divyā devaguṇairyutāḥ |
prādurbhāvāḥ purāṇeṣu gīyante brahmavādibhiḥ ||1.41.170||
yatra devāśca muhyanti prādurbhāvānukīrtane |
purāṇaṃ vartate yatra vedaśrutisamāhitam || 171||
etaduddeśamātreṇa prādurbhāvānukīrtanam |
kīrtitaṃ kīrtanīyasya sarvalokaguroḥ prabhoḥ ||172||
prīyante pitarastasya prādurbhāvānukīrtanāt |
viṣṇoratulavīryasya yaḥ śṛṇoti kṛtāñjaliḥ || 173||
etāstu yogeśvarayogamāyāḥ śrutvā naro mucyati sarvapāpaiḥ |
ṛddhiṃ samṛddhiṃ vipulāṃśca bhogān prāpnoti sarvaṃ bhagavatprasādāt || 174||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi prādurbhāvānusaṃgraho nāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 41 ||

<1.42>

dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
viśvatvaṃ śṛṇu me viṣṇorharitvaṃ ca kṛte yuge |
vaikuṇṭhatvaṃ ca deveṣu kṛpṇatvaṃ mānuṣeṣu ca || 1 ||
īśvaratvaṃ ca tasyedaṃ gahanāṃ karmaṇāṃ gatim |
avyakto vyaktaliṅgastho yatraiva bhagavān prabhuḥ |
nārāyaṇo hyanantātmā prabhavo'vyaya eva ca || 3 ||
eṣa nārāyaṇo bhūtvā harirāsītkṛte yuge |
brahmā śakraśca somaśca dharmaḥ śukro bṛhaspatiḥ || 4 ||
aditerapi putratvametya yādavanandanaḥ |
eṣa viṣṇuriti khyāta indrādavarajo'bhavat || 5 ||
prasādajaṃ hyasya vibhoradityāḥ putrajanma tat |
vadhārthaṃ suraśatrūṇāṃ daityadānavarakṣasām || 6||
pradhānātmā purā hyeṣa brahmāṇamasṛjat prabhuḥ |
so'sṛjat pūrvapuruṣaḥ purā kalpe prajāpatīn || 7 ||
te tanvānāstanūstatra brahmavaṃśānanuttamān |
tebhyo'bhavanmahātmabhyo bahudhā brahma śāśvatam || 8 ||
etadāścaryabhūtasya viṣṇornāmānukīrtanam |
kīrtanīyasya lokeṣu kīrtyamānaṃ nibodha me || 9 ||
vṛtte vṛtravadhe tāta vartamāne kṛte yuge |
āsīt trailokyavikhyātaḥ saṃgrāmastārakāmayaḥ || 1.42.10||
tatrāsan dānavā ghorāḥ sarve saṃgrāmadarpitāḥ |
ghnanti devagaṇānsarvān sayakṣoragarākṣasān || 11 ||
te vadhyamānā vimukhāḥ kṣīṇapraharaṇā raṇe |
trātāraṃ manasā jagmurdevaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim || 12 ||
etasminnantare meghā nirvāṇāṅgāravarṣiṇaḥ |
sārkacandragrahagaṇaṃ chādayanto nabhastalam || 13 ||
cañcadvidyudgaṇāviddhā ghorā nirhrādakāriṇaḥ |
anyonyavegābhihatāḥ pravavuḥ sapta mārutāḥ || 14 ||
dīptatoyāśanīpātairvajravegānilākulaiḥ |
rarāsa ghorairutpātairdahyamānamivāmbaram ||15 ||
peturulekaisahasrāṇi muhurākāśagānyapi |
nyubjāni ca vimānāni prapatantyutpatanti ca || 16 ||
caturyugāntaparyāye lokānāṃ yad bhayaṃ bhavet |
tādṛśānyeva rūpāṇi tasminnutpātalakṣaṇe || 17 ||
tamasā niṣprabhaṃ sarvaṃ na prājñāyata kiṃcana |
timiraughaparikṣiptā na rejuśca diśo daśa || 18 ||
niśeva rūpiṇī kālī kālameghāvaguṇṭhitā |
dyaurna bhātyabhibhūtārkā ghoreṇa tamasā vṛtā || 19 ||
tānghanaughānsatimirāndorbhyāmutkṣipya sa prabhuḥ |
vapuḥ saṃdarśayāmāsa divyaṃ kṛṣṇavapurhariḥ|| 1.42.20 ||
balāhakāñjananibhaṃ balāhakatanūruham |
tejasā vapuṣā caiva kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇamivācalam || 21||
dīptapītāmbaradharaṃ taptakāñcanabhūṣaṇam |
dhūmāndhakāravapuṣā yugāntāgnimivotthitam || 22 ||
caturdviguṇapīnāṃsaṃ balākāpaṅktibhūṣaṇam |
cāmīkarakarākārairāyudhairupaśobhitam || 23 ||
candrārkakiraṇoddyotaṃ girikūṭaṃ śiloccayam |
nandakānanditakaraṃ śarāśīviṣadhāriṇam || 24 ||
śakticitraṃ halodagraṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam |
viṣṇuśailaṃ kṣamāmūlaṃ śrīvṛkṣaṃ śārṅgadhanvinam || 25 ||
haryaśvarathasaṃyukte suparṇadhvajaśobhite |
candrārkacakrarucire mandarākṣadhṛtāntare ||26 ||
anantaraśmisaṃyukte dadṛśe merukūbare |
tārakācitrakusume grahanakṣatrabandhure || 27 ||
bhayeṣvabhayadaṃ vyomni devā daityaparājitāḥ |
dadṛśuste sthitaṃ devaṃ divyalokamaye rathe || 28 ||
te kṛtāñjalayaḥ sarve devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ |
jayaśabdaṃ puraskṛtya śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 29 ||
sa teṣāṃ tā giraḥ śrutvā viṣṇurdayitadevataḥ |
manaścakre vināśāya dānavānāṃ mahāmṛdhe || 1.42.30 ||
ākāśe tu sthito viṣṇuḥ sottame puruṣottamaḥ |
uvāca devatāḥ sarvāḥ sapratijñamidaṃ vacaḥ || 31 ||
śāntiṃ bhajata bhadraṃ vo mā bhaiṣṭa marutāṃ gaṇāḥ |
jitā me dānavāḥ sarve trailokyaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 32 ||
te tasya satyasaṃdhasya viṣṇorvākye na toṣitāḥ |
devāḥ prītiṃ parāṃ jagmuḥ prāpyevāmṛtamutthitam || 33 ||
tatastamaḥ saṃhriyate vineśuśca balāhakā |
pravavuśca śivā vātāḥ prasannāśca diśo daśa || 34 ||
suprabhāṇi ca jyotīṃṣi candraṃ cakruḥ pradakṣiṇam |
dīptimanti ca tejāṃsi cakrurarke pradakṣiṇam || 35 ||
na vigrahaṃ grahāścakruḥ prasannāścāpi sindhavaḥ |
nīrajaskā babhurmārgā nākamārgādayastrayaḥ || 36||
yathārthamūhuḥ sarito nāpi cukṣubhire'rṇavāḥ |
āsañchubhānīndriyāṇi narāṇāmantarātmasu | 37 ||
maharṣayo vītaśokā vedānuccairadhīyate |
yajñeṣu ca haviḥ svādu śivamaśnāti pāvakaḥ||38||
pravṛttadharmāḥ saṃvṛttā lokā muditamānasāḥ |
prītyā paramayā yuktā devadevasya bhūpate |
viṣṇoḥ satyapratijñasya śrutvārinidhane giram || 39 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 42 ||

<1.43>

tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tato bhayaṃ viṣṇumayaṃ śrutvā daiteyadānavāḥ |
udyogaṃ vipulaṃ cakruryuddhāya yudhi durjayāḥ || 1 ||
mayastu kāñcanamayaṃ trinalvāntaramavyayam |
catuścakraṃ vikramantaṃ sukalpitamahāyudham || 2 ||
kiṅkiṇījālanirghoṣaṃ dvīpicarmapariṣkṛtam |
khacitaṃ ratnajālaiśca hemajālaiśca bhūṣitam || 3 ||
svakṣaṃ rathavarodagraṃ sūpasthānamagopamam |
īhāmṛgagaṇākīrṇaṃ pakṣibhiśca virājitam |
divyāstratūṇīradharaṃ payodharanināditam || 4 ||
gadāparighasampūrṇaṃ mūrtimantamivārṇavam |
hemakeyūravalayaṃ svarṇamaṇḍalakūbaram || 5 ||
sapatākadhvajodagraṃ sādityamiva mandaram |
gajendrāmbhodasadṛśaṃ lambakesaravarcasam || 6 ||
yuktamṛkṣasahasreṇa sahasrāmbudanāditam |
dīptamākāśagaṃ divyaṃ rathaṃ pararathārujam || 7 ||
adhyatiṣṭhadraṇākāṅkṣī meruṃ dīptamivāṃśumān |
tārastu krośavistāramāyasaṃ vāyasadhvajam || 8 ||
śailotkarasamākīrṇaṃ nīlāñjanacayopamam |
kālalohāṣṭacaraṇaṃ loheṣāyugakūbaram |
timirāṅgārakiraṇaṃ garjantamiva toyadam || 9 ||
lohajālena mahatā sagavākṣeṇa daṃśitam |
āyasaiḥ parighaiḥ kīrṇaṃ kṣepaṇīyaistathāśmabhiḥ || 1.43.10 ||
prāsaiḥ pāśaiśca vitatairavasaktaiśca mudgaraiḥ |
śobhitaṃ trāsanīyaiśca tomaraiḥ saparaśvadhaiḥ || 11 ||
udyantaṃ dviṣatāṃ hetordvitīyamiva mandaram |
yuktaṃ kharasahasreṇa so'dhyārohadrathottamam || 12 ||
virocanastu saṃkruddho gadāpāṇiravasthitaḥ |
pramukhe tasya sainyasya dīptaśṛṅga ivācalaḥ || 13 ||
yuktaṃ hayasahasreṇa hayagrīvastu dānavaḥ |
syandanaṃ vāhayāmāsa sapatnānīkamardanaḥ || 14 ||
vyāyataṃ bahusāhasraṃ dhanurvisphārayanmahat|
varāhaḥ pramukhe tasthau sāvaroha ivācalaḥ || 15 ||
kharastu vikṣaran darpānnetrābhyāṃ roṣajaṃ jalam |
sphuraddantauṣṭhavadanaḥ saṃgrāmaṃ so'bhyakāṅkṣata || 16 ||
tvaṣṭā tvaṣṭādaśahayaṃ yānamāsthāya dānavaḥ |
vyūhito dānavairvyūhaiḥ paricakrāma vīryavān || 17 ||
vipracittisutaḥ śvetaḥ śvetakuṇḍalabhūṣaṇaḥ |
śvetaśailapratīkāśo yuddhāyābhimukhaḥ sthitaḥ || 18 ||
ariṣṭo baliputrastu variṣṭho'driśilāyudhaiḥ |
yuddhāyātiṣṭhadāyasto dharādhara ivāparaḥ || 19 ||
kiśorastvatisaṃharṣāt kiśora iva coditaḥ |
abhavad daityasainyasya madhye ravirivoditaḥ || 1.43.20 ||
lambastu lambameghābhaḥ pralambāmbarabhūṣaṇaḥ |
daityavyūhagato bhāti sanīhāra ivāṃśumān || 21 ||
svarbhānurvakrayodhī tu daśanauṣṭhekṣaṇāyudhaḥ |
hasaṃstiṣṭhati daityānāṃ pramukhe sa mahāgrahaḥ || 22 ||
anye hayagatā bhānti nāgaskandhagatāḥ pare |
siṃhavyāghragatāścānye varāharkṣagatāḥ pare || 23 ||
kecit kharoṣṭrayātāraḥ kecit toyadavāhanāḥ |
nānāpakṣigatāścānye kecit pavanavāhanāḥ || 24 ||
pattayaścāpare daityā bhīṣaṇā vikṛtānanāḥ |
ekapādā dvipādāśca nardanto yuddhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ || 25 ||
prakṣveḍamānā bahavaḥ sphoṭayantaśca te bhujān |
dṛptaśārdūlanirghoṣā nedurdānavapuṅgavāḥ || 26 ||
te gadāparighairugrairdhanurvyāyāmaśālinaḥ |
bāhubhiḥ parighākāraistarjayanti sma devatāḥ || 27 ||
prāsaiḥ pāśaiśca khaḍgaiśca tomarāṅkuśapaṭṭiśaiḥ |
cikrīḍuste śataghnībhiḥ śatadhāraiśca mudgaraiḥ || 28 ||
gaṇḍaśailaiśca śailaiśca parighaiścottamāyudhaiḥ |
cakraiśca daityapravarāścakrurānanditaṃ balam || 29 ||
evaṃ tad dānavaṃ sainyaṃ sarve yuddhabalotkaṭam |
devatābhimukhaṃ tasthau meghānīkamivotthitam || 1.43.30 ||
tadadbhutaṃ daityasahasragāḍhaṃ vāyvagnitoyāmbudaśailakalpam |
balaṃ raṇaughābhyudayāvakīrṇaṃ yuyutsayonmattamivāvabhāse || 31 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 43 ||

<1.44>

catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śrutaste daityasainyasya vistarastāta vigrahe |
surāṇāṃ sarvasainyasya vistaraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ śṛṇu || 1 ||
ādityā vasavo rudrā aśvinau ca mahābalau |
sabalāḥ sānugāścaiva saṃnahyanta yathābalam || 2 ||
puruhūtastu purato lokapālaḥ sahasradṛk |
grāmaṇīḥ sarvadevānāmāruroha suradvipam || 3 ||
savye cāsya rathaḥ pārśve pakṣipravaravegavān |
sucārucakracaraṇo hemavajrapariṣkṛtaḥ || 4 ||
devagandharvayakṣaughairanuyātaḥ sahasraśaḥ |
dīptimadbhiḥ sadasyaiśca brahmarṣibhirabhiṣṭutaḥ || 5 ||
vajravisphūrjitoddhūtairvidyudindrāyudhānvitaiḥ |
gupto balāhakagaṇaiḥ kāmagairiva parvataiḥ || 6 ||
samārūḍhaḥ sa bhagavān paryeti maghavā gajam |
havirdhāneṣu gāyanti viprāḥ somamakhe sthitāḥ || 7 ||
svarge śakrānuyāneṣu devatūryaninādiṣu |
indraṃ samupanṛtyanti śataśo hyapsarogaṇāḥ || 8 ||
ketunā vaṃśajātena rājamāno yathā raviḥ |
yukto harisahasreṇa manomārutaraṃhasā || 9 ||
sa syandanavaro bhāti yukto mātalinā tadā |
kṛtsnaḥ parivṛto merurbhāskarasyeva tejasā || 1.44.10 ||
yamastu daṇḍamudyamya kālayuktaṃ ca mudgaram |
tasthau suragaṇānīke daityān nādena bhīṣayan || 11 ||
caturbhiḥ sāgarairgupto lelihānaiśca pannagaiḥ |
śaṅkhamuktāṅgadadharo bibhrattoyamayaṃ vapuḥ || 12 ||
kālapāśaṃ samāvidhya hayaiḥ śaśikaropamaiḥ |
vāyvīritajalodgāraiḥ kurvaṃllīlāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 13 ||
pāṇḍuroddhūtavasanaḥ pravālarucirādharaḥ |
maṇiśyāmottamavapurhārabhārārpitodaraḥ || 14 ||
varuṇaḥ pāśabhṛnmadhye devānīkasya tasthivān |
yuddhavelāmabhilaṣat bhinnavela ivārṇavaḥ || 15 ||
yakṣarākṣasasainyena guhyakānāṃ gaṇairapi |
maṇiśyāmottamavapuḥ kubero naravāhanaḥ || 16 ||
yuktaśca śaṅkhapadmābhyāṃ nidhīnāmadhipaḥ prabhuḥ |
rājarājeśvaraḥ śrīmān gadāpāṇiradṛśyata || 17 ||
vimānayodhī dhanado vimāne puṣpake sthitaḥ |
sa rājarājaḥ śuśubhe yuddhārthī naravāhanaḥ |
prekṣyamāṇaḥ śivasakhaḥ sākṣādiva śivaḥ svayam || 18 ||
pūrvaṃ pakṣaṃ sahasrākṣaḥ pitṛrājastu dakṣiṇam |
varuṇaḥ paścimaṃ pakṣamuttaraṃ naravāhanaḥ || 19 ||
caturṣu yuktāścatvāro lokapālā balotkaṭāḥ |
svāsu dikṣvabhyarakṣan vai tasya devabalasya ha || 1.44.20 ||
sūryaḥ saptāśvayuktena rathenāmbaragāminā |
śriyā jājvalyamānena dīpyamānaiśca raśmibhiḥ || 21 ||
udayāstamayaṃ cakre meruparyantagāminā |
tridivadvāracakreṇa tapatā lokamavyayam || 22 ||
sahasraraśmiyuktena bhrājamānaḥ svatejasā |
cacāra madhye devānāṃ dvādaśātmā dineśvaraḥ || 23 ||
somaḥ śvetahayairbhāti syandane śītaraśmivān |
himatoyaprapūrṇābhirbhābhirāhlādayañjagat || 24 ||
tamṛkṣayogānugataṃ śiśirāṃśuṃ dvijeśvaram |
jagacchāyāṅkitatanuṃ naiśasya tamasaḥ kṣayam || 25 ||
jyotiṣāmīśvaraṃ vyomni rasānāṃ rasanaṃ prabhum |
oṣadhīnāṃ paritrāṇaṃ nidhānamamṛtasya ca || 26 ||
jagataḥ prathamaṃ bhāgaṃ saumyaṃ śītamayaṃ rasama |
dadṛśurdānavāḥ somaṃ himapraharaṇasthitam || 27
yaḥ prāṇaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ pañcadhā bhidyate nṛṣu |
saptaskandhagato lokāṃstrīndadhāra carācarān || 28 ||
yamāhuragneryantāraṃ sarvaprabhavamīśvaram |
saptasvaragatā yasya yonirgītirudīryate || 29||
yaṃ vadantyuttamaṃ bhūtaṃ yaṃ vadantyaśarīriṇam |
yamāhurākāśagamaṃ śīghragaṃ śabdayonijam || 1.44.30 ||
sa vāyuḥ sarvabhūtāyurudbhūtaḥ svena tejasā |
vavau pravyathayan daityān pratilomaḥ satoyadaḥ || 31 ||
maruto devagandharvā vidyādharagaṇaiḥ saha |
cikrīḍurasibhiḥ śubhrairnirmuktairiva pannagaiḥ || 32 ||
sṛjantaḥ sarpapatayastīvraṃ roṣamayaṃ viṣam |
śarabhūtāḥ surendrāṇāṃ cerurvyāttamukhā divi || 33 ||
parvatāstu śilāśṛṅgaiḥ śataśākhaiśca pādapaiḥ |
upatasthuḥ suragaṇān prahartuṃ dānavaṃ balam || 34 ||
yaḥ sa devo iṣīkeśaḥ padmanābhastrivikramaḥ |
kṛṣṇavartmā yugāntābho viśvasya jagataḥ prabhuḥ || 35 ||
samudrayonirmadhuhā havyabhukkratusatkṛtaḥ |
bhūrāpovyomabhūtātmā samaḥ śāntikaro'rihā || 36 ||
jagadyonirjagadbījo jagadgururudāradhīḥ |
so'rkamagnimivodyantamudyamyottamatejasam || 37 ||
arighnamamarānīke cakraṃ cakragadādharaḥ |
saparīveṣamudyantaṃ saviturmaṇḍalaṃ yathā || 38 ||
savyenālambya mahatīṃ sarvāsuravināśinīm |
kareṇa kālīṃ vapuṣā śatrukālapradāṃ gadām || 39 ||
śeṣairbhujaiḥ pradīptāni bhujagāridhvajaḥ prabhuḥ |
dadhārāyudhajālāni śārṅgādīni mahāyaśāḥ || 1.44.40 ||
sa kaśyapasyātmabhavaṃ dvijaṃ bhujagabhojanam |
pavanādhikasampātaṃ gaganakṣobhaṇaṃ khagam |
bhujagendreṇa vadane niviṣṭena virājitam || 41 ||
amṛtārambhanirmuktaṃ mandarādrimivocchritam |
devāsuravimardeṣu śataśo dṛṣṭavikramam || 42 ||
mahendreṇāmṛtasyārthe vajreṇa kṛtalakṣaṇam |
śikhinaṃ cūḍinaṃ caiva taptakuṇḍalabhūṣaṇam |
vicitrapakṣavasanaṃ dhātumantamivācalam || 43 ||
sphītakroḍāvalambena śītāṃśusamatejasā |
bhogibhogāvasaktena maṇiratnena bhāsvatā || 44 ||
pakṣābhyāṃ cārucitrābhyāmāvṛtya divi līlayā |
yugānte sendracāpābhyāṃ toyadābhyāmivāmbaram ||45||
nīlalohitapītābhiḥ patākābhiralaṃkṛtam |
ketuveṣapraticchannaṃ mahākāyaniketanam || 46 ||
aruṇāvarajaṃ śrīmānāruhya samare hariḥ |
suvarṇaṃ svena vapuṣā suparṇaṃ khecarottamam || 47 ||
tamanvayurdevagaṇā munayaśca tapodhanāḥ |
gīrbhiḥ paramamantrābhistuṣṭuvuśca gadādharam || 48 ||
tadvaiśravaṇasaṃśliṣṭaṃ vaivasvatapurassaram |
vārirājaparikṣiptaṃ devarājavirājitam || 49 ||
candraprabhābhirvimalaṃ yuddhāya samupasthitam |
pavanābaddhanirghoṣaṃ sampradīptahutāśanam || 1.44.50 ||
viṣṇorjiṣṇoḥ sahiṣṇośca bhrājiṣṇostejasā vṛtam |
balaṃ balavadudbhūtaṃ yuddhāya samavartata || 51 ||
svastyastu devebhya iti stutvā tatrāṅgirā'bravīt|
svastyastu daityebhya iti uśanā vākyamādade || 52 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi āścaryatārakāmaye catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 44 ||

<1.45>

pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tābhyāṃ balābhyāṃ saṃjajñe tumulo vigrahastadā |
surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca parasparajayaiṣiṇām || 1 ||
dānavā daivataiḥ sārddhaṃ nānāpraharaṇodyatāḥ |
samīyuryudhyamānā vai parvatāḥ parvatairiva || 2 ||
tat surāsurasaṃyuktaṃ yuddhamatyadbhutaṃ babhau |
dharmādharmasamāyuktaṃ darpeṇa vinayena ca || 3 ||
tato rathaiḥ prajavibhirvāhanaiśca pracoditaiḥ |
utpatadbhiśca gaganaṃ sāsihastaiḥ samantataḥ || 4 ||
vikṣipyamāṇairmusalaiḥ sampreṣyadbhiśca sāyakaiḥ |
cāpairvisphāryamāṇaiśca pātyamānaiśca mudgaraiḥ || 5 ||
tad yuddhamabhavad ghoraṃ devadānavasaṃkulam|
jagatastrāsajananaṃ yugasaṃvartakopamam || 6 ||
svahastamuktaiḥ parighaiḥ kṣipyamāṇaiśca parvataiḥ |
dānavāḥ samare jaghnurdevānindrapurogamān || 7 ||
te vadhyamānā balibhirdānavairjitakāśibhiḥ |
viṣaṇṇamanaso devā jagmurārtiṃ parāṃ mṛdhe || 8 ||
te'strajālaiḥ pramathitāḥ parighairbhinnamastakāḥ |
bhinnoraskā ditisutairvemū raktaṃ vraṇairbahu || 9 ||
spanditāḥ pāśajālaiśca niryatnāśca śaraiḥ kṛtāḥ |
praviṣṭā dānavī māyā na śekuste viceṣṭitum || 1.45.10 ||
saṃstambhitamivābhāti niṣprāṇasadṛśākṛti |
balaṃ surāṇāmasurairniṣprayatnāyudhaṃ kṛtam || 11 ||
māyāpāśān vikarṣaṃśca bhindan vajreṇa tāñśarān |
śakro daityabalaṃ ghoraṃ viveśa bahulocanaḥ || 12 ||
sa daityān pramukhe hatvā tad dānavabalaṃ mahat |
tāmasenāstrajālena tamobhūtamathākarot || 13 ||
te'nyonyaṃ nāvabudhyanta devān vā dānavānapi |
ghoreṇa tamasā''viṣṭāḥ puruhūtasya tejasā || 14 ||
māyāpāśairvimuktāśca yatnavantaḥ surottamāḥ |
vapūṃṣi daityasaṃghānāṃ tamobhūtānyapātayan || 15 ||
apadhvastā visaṃjñāśca tamasā nīlavarcasaḥ |
petuste dānavagaṇāśchinnapakṣā ivācalāḥ || 16 ||
daityānāṃ tadghanībhūtamandhakāramahārṇavam |
praviṣṭaṃ balamuttrastaṃ tamobhūtamivābabhau || 17 ||
tadāsṛjanmahāmāyāṃ mayastāṃ tāmasīṃ dahan |
yugāntāgnimivātyugrāṃ sṛṣṭāmaurveṇa vahninā || 18 ||
sā dadāha tamaḥ sarvaṃ māyā mayavikalpitā |
daityāśca dīptavapuṣaḥ sadya uttasthurāhave || 19 ||
māyāmaurvīṃ samāsādya dahyamānā divaukasaḥ |
bhejire candraviṣayaṃ śītāṃśusalile śayāt|| 1.45.20 ||
te dahyamānā hyaurveṇa tejasā bhraṣṭatejasaḥ |
śaśaṃsurvajriṇe devāḥ saṃtaptāḥ śaraṇaiṣiṇaḥ || 21 ||
saṃtapte māyayā sainye dahyamāne ca dānavaiḥ |
codito devarājena varuṇo vākyamabravīt|| 22 ||
varuṇa uvāca
purā brahmarṣijaḥ śakra tapastepe'tidāruṇam |
ūrvo muniḥ sa tejasvī sadṛśo brahmaṇo guṇaiḥ || 23 ||
taṃ tapantamivādityaṃ tapasā jagadavyayam|
upatasthurmunigaṇā devā brahmarṣibhiḥ saha || 24 ||
hiraṇyakaśipuścaiva dānavo dānaveśvaraḥ |
ṛṣiṃ vijñāpayāmāsa purā paramatejasam || 25 ||
tamūcurbrahmaṛṣayo vacanaṃ brahmasammitam|
ṛṣivaṃśeṣu bhagavañchinnamūlamidaṃ kulam || 26 ||
ekastvamanapatyaśca gotraṃ yannānuvartase |
kaumāraṃ vratamāsthāya kleśamevānuvartase || 27 ||
bahūni vipra gotrāṇi munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām |
ekadehāni tiṣṭhanti vibhaktāni vinā prajāḥ || 28 ||
kuleṣūcchinnamūleṣu teṣu no nāsti kāraṇam |
bhavāṃstu tapasā śreṣṭhaḥ prajāpatisamadyutiḥ || 29 ||
tat pravartasva vaṃśāya varddhayātmānamātmanā |
tvamādhatsvorjitaṃ tejo dvitīyāṃ vai tanuṃ kuru || 1.45.30 ||
sa evamukto munibhimunirmanasi tāḍitaḥ |
jagarhe tānṛṣigaṇān vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 31 ||
yathāyaṃ śāśvato dharmo munīnāṃ vihitaḥ purā |
sadā''rṣaṃ sevatāṃ karma vanyamūlaphalāśinām || 32 ||
brahmayonau prasūtasya brāhmaṇasyānuvartinaḥ |
brahmacaryaṃ sucaritaṃ brahmāṇamapi cālayet || 33 ||
dvijānāṃ vṛttayastisro ye gṛhāśramavāsinaḥ |
asmākaṃ tu vanaṃ vṛttirvanāśramanivāsinām || 34 ||
ambubhakṣā vāyubhakṣā dantolūkhalikāstathā |
aśmakuṭṭā daśanapāḥ pañcātapatapāśca ye || 35 ||
ete tapasi tiṣṭhanto vratairapi suduṣkaraiḥ |
brahmacaryaṃ puraskṛtya prārthayante parāṃ gatim || 36 ||
brahmacaryād brāhmaṇasya brāhmaṇatvaṃ vidhīyate |
evamāhuḥ pare loke brahma brahmavido janāḥ || 37 ||
brahmacarye sthitaṃ dhairyaṃ brahmacarye sthitaṃ tapaḥ |
ye sthitā brahmacaryeṣu brāhmaṇāste divi sthitāḥ || 38 ||
nāsti yogaṃ vinā siddhirnāsti siddhiṃ vinā yaśaḥ |
nāsti loke yaśomūlaṃ brahmacaryāt paraṃ tapaḥ || 39 ||
tannigṛhyendriyagrāmaṃ bhūtagrāmaṃ ca pañcamam |
brahmacaryeṇa varteta kimataḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ || 1.45.40 ||
ayoge keśaharaṇamasaṃkalpe vratakriyā |
abrahmacarye caryā ca trayaṃ syād dambhasaṃjñitam || 41 ||
kva dārāḥ kva ca saṃyogaḥ kva ca bhāvaviparyayaḥ |
yadeyaṃ brahmaṇā sṛṣṭā manasā mānasī prajā || 42 ||
yadyasti tapaso vīryaṃ yuṣmākamamitātmanām |
sṛjadhvaṃ mānasān putrān prājāpatyena karmaṇā || 43 |
manasā nirmitā yonirādhātavyā tapasvinā |
na dārayogaṃ bījaṃ vā vratamuktaṃ tapasvinām || 44 ||
yadidaṃ luptadharmārthaṃ yuṣmābhiriha nirbhayaiḥ |
vyāhṛtaṃ sadbhiratyarthamasadbhiriva me matiḥ || 45 ||
vapurdīptāntarātmānameṣa kṛtvā manomayam|
dārayogaṃ vinā srakṣye putramātmatanūruham|| 46 ||
evamātmānamātmā me dvitīyaṃ janayiṣyati |
vanyenānena vidhinā didhakṣantamiva prajāḥ || 47 ||
ūrvastu tapasā''viṣṭo niveśyoruṃ hutāśane |
mamanthaikena darbheṇa putrasya prabhavāraṇim || 48 ||
tasyoruṃ sahasā bhittvā jvālāmālī nirindhanaḥ |
jagato nidhanākāṅkṣī putro'gniḥ samapadyata || 49 ||
ūrvasyoruṃ vinirbhidya aurvo nāmāntako'nalaḥ |
didhakṣanniva lokāṃstrīñjajñe paramakopanaḥ || 1.45.50 ||
utpannamātraścovāca pitaraṃ dīptayā girā |
kṣudhā me bādhate tāta jagad bhakṣe tyajasva mām || 51 ||
tridivārohibhirjvālairjṛmbhamāṇo diśo daśa |
nirdahanniva bhūtāni vavṛdhe so'ntako'nalaḥ || 52 ||
etasminnantare brahmā sarvalokapatiḥ prabhuḥ |
ājagāma muniryatra vyasṛjat putramuttamam || 53 ||
sa dadarśorumūrvasya dīpyamānaṃ sutāgninā |
aurvakopāgnisaṃtaptām̐llokāṃśca ṛṣibhiḥ saha || 54 ||
tamuvāca tato brahmā munimūrvaṃ sabhājayan |
dhāryatāṃ putrajaṃ tejo lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā |
asyāpatyasya te vipra kariṣye sāhyamuttamam || 55 ||
vāsaṃ cāsya pradāsyāmi prāśanaṃ cāmṛtopamam |
tathyametanmama vacaḥ śṛṇu tvaṃ vadatāṃ vara || 56 ||
ūrva uvāca
dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi yanmamādya bhavāñchiśoḥ |
matimetāṃ dadātīha paramānugrahāya vai || 57 ||
prabhāvakāle samprāpte kāṅkṣitavye samāgame |
bhagavaṃstarpitaḥ putraḥ kairhavyaiḥ prāpsyate sukham || 58 ||
kutra cāsya nivāso vai bhojanaṃ ca kimātmakam |
vidhāsyati bhavānasya vīryatulyaṃ mahaujasaḥ || 59 ||
brahmovāca
vaḍavāmukhe'sya vasatiḥ samudrāsye bhaviṣyati |
mama yonirjalaṃ vipra tacca toyamayaṃ vapuḥ || 1.45.60 ||
taddhavistava putrasya visṛjāmyālayaṃ tu tat |
tatrāyamāstāṃ niyataḥ piban vārimayaṃ haviḥ || 61 ||
tato yugānte bhūtānāmeva cāhaṃ ca suvrata |
sahitau vicariṣyāvo lokāniti punaḥ punaḥ || 62 ||
eṣo'gnirantakāle tu salilāśī mayā kṛtaḥ |
dahanaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sadevāsurarakṣasām || 63 ||
evamastviti so'pyagniḥ saṃvṛtajvālamaṇḍalaḥ |
praviveśārṇavamukhaṃ nikṣipya pitari prabhām || 64 ||
pratiyātastato brahmā te ca sarve maharṣayaḥ |
aurvasyāgneḥ prabhāvajñāḥ svāṃ svāṃ gatimupāśritāḥ ||65||
hiraṇyakaśipurdṛṣṭvā tadadbhutamapūjayat |
ūrvaṃ praṇatasarvāṅgo vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha || 66 ||
bhagavannadbhutamidaṃ nirvṛttaṃ lokasākṣikam |
tapasā te muniśreṣṭha parituṣṭaḥ pitāmahaḥ || 67 ||
ahaṃ tu tava putrasya tava caiva mahāvrata |
bhṛtya ityavagantavyaḥ ślāghyo'smi yadi karmaṇā || 68||
tanmāṃ paśya samāpannaṃ tavaivārādhane ratam |
yadi sīde muniśreṣṭha tavaiva syāt parājayaḥ || 69 ||
ūrva uvāca
dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi yasya te'haṃ gururmataḥ |
nāsti te tapasānena bhayamadyeha suvrata || 1.45.70 ||
imāṃ ca māyāṃ gṛhṇīṣva mama putreṇa nirmitām |
nirindhanāmagnimayīṃ duḥsparśāṃ pāvakairapi || 71 ||
eṣā te svasya vaṃśasya vaśagārivinigrahe |
rakṣiṣyatyātmapakṣaṃ sā parāṃśca prahariṣyati || 72 ||
evamastviti tāṃ gṛhya praṇamya munipuṃgavam |
jagāma tridivaṃ hṛṣṭaḥ kṛtārtho dānaveśvaraḥ || 73 ||
varuṇa uvāca
saiṣā durviṣahā māyā devairapi durāsadā |
aurveṇa nirmitā pūrvaṃ pāvakenorvasūnunā || 74 ||
tasmiṃstu vyutthite daitye nirvīyaiṣā na saṃśayaḥ |
śāpo hyasyāḥ purā dattaḥ sṛṣṭā yenaiva tejasā || 75 ||
yadyeṣā pratihantavyā kartavyo bhagavān sukhī |
dīyatāṃ me sakhā śakra toyayonirniśākaraḥ || 76 ||
tenāhaṃ saha saṃgamya yādobhiśca samāvṛtaḥ |
māyāmetāṃ haniṣyāmi tvatprasādānna saṃśayaḥ || 77 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi aurvāgnisambhavo nāma pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 45 ||

<1.46>

vaiśampāyana uvāca
evamastviti saṃhṛṣṭaḥ śakrastridaśavarddhanaḥ |
saṃdideśāgrataḥ somaṃ yuddhāya śiśirāyudham || 1 ||
śakra uvāca
gaccha soma sahāyatvaṃ kuru pāśadharasya vai |
asurāṇāṃ vināśāya jayāya ca divaukasām 2 ||
tvamapratimavīryaśca jyotiṣāṃ ceśvareśvaraḥ |
tvanmayaṃ sarvalokānāṃ rasaṃ rasavido viduḥ || 3 ||
kṣayavṛddhī tavāvyakte sāgarasyeva maṇḍale |
parivartasyahorātraṃ kālaṃ jagati yojayan||4||
lokacchāyāmayaṃ lakṣma tavāṅke śaśasaṃśitam |
na viduḥ somadevā'pi ye ca nakṣatrayoginaḥ || 5 ||
tvamādityapathādūrdhvaṃ jyotiṣāṃ copari sthitaḥ |
tamaścotsārya vapuṣā bhāsayasyakhilaṃ jagat||6||
śvetabhānurhimatanurjyotiṣāmadhipaḥ śaśī |
abdakṛtkālayogātmā ījyo yajñraraso'vyayaḥ || 7 ||
oṣadhīśaḥ kriyāyonirambhoyoniranuṣṇabhāk |
śītāṃśuramṛtādhāraścapalaḥ śvetavāhanaḥ || 8||
tvaṃ kāntiḥ kāntavapuṣāṃ tvaṃ somaḥ somavṛttinām|
saumyastvaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ timiraghnastvamṛkṣarāṭ || 9 ||
tad gaccha tvaṃ sahānena varuṇena varūthinā |
śamayasvāsurīṃ māyāṃ yayā dahyāma saṃgare || 1.46.10 ||
soma uvāca
yanmāṃ vadasi yuddhārthe devarāja jagatpate |
eṣa varṣāmi śiśiraṃ daityamāyāpakarṣaṇam || 11 ||
etānmacchītanirdagdhānpaśya tvaṃ himaveṣṭitān|
vimāyān vimadāṃścaiva dānavāṃstvaṃ mahāmṛdhe || 12 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tato himakarotsṛṣṭāḥ sabāṣpā himavṛṣṭayaḥ |
veṣṭayanti sma tānghorāndaityān meghagaṇā iva|| 13 ||
tau pāśaśuklāṃśudharau varuṇendū mahāraṇe|
jaghnaturhimapātaiśca pāśaghātaiśca dānavān || 14 ||
dvāvambunāthau samare tau pāśahimayodhinau |
mṛdhe ceraturambhobhiḥ kṣubdhāviva mahārṇavau || 15 ||
tābhyāmāplāvitaṃ sainyaṃ tad dānavamadṛśyata |
jagat saṃvartakāmbhodaiḥ pravṛṣṭairiva saṃvṛtam || 16 ||
tāvudyatāṃśupāśau dvau śaśāṅkavaruṇau raṇe |
śamayāmāsaturmāyāṃ devau daiteyanirmitām || 17 ||
śītāṃśujayanirdagdhāḥ pāśaiśca prasitā raṇe |
na śekuścalituṃ daityā viśiraskā ivādrayaḥ || 18 ||
śītāṃśunihatāste tu peturdaityā himārditāḥ |
himaprāvṛtasarvāṅgā nirūṣmāṇa ivāgnayaḥ || 19 ||

mayo dadarśa māyāvī dānavān divi dānavaḥ || 21 ||

īhāmṛgagaṇākīrṇāṃ pavanāghūrṇitadrumām || 23 ||

sāśmasaṃghātaviṣamā drumaparvatasaṃkaṭā |
abhavad ghorasaṃcārā pṛthivī parvatairiva || 27||
nānāhato'śmabhiḥ kaścicchilābhiścāpyatāḍitaḥ |
nāniruddho drumagaṇairdevo'dṛśyata saṃyuge || 28 ||
tadapabhraṣṭadhanuṣaṃ bhagnapraharaṇāvilam |
niṣprayatnaṃ surānīkaṃ varjayitvā gadādharam || 29 ||
sa hi yuddhagataḥ śrīmānīśo na sma vyakampata |
sahiṣṇutvājjagatsvāmī na cukrodha gadādharaḥ || 1.46.30 ||
kālajñaḥ kālameghābhaḥ samaikṣat kālamāhave |
devāsuravimardaṃ sa draṣṭukāmo janārdanaḥ || 31 ||
tato bhagavatā''diṣṭau raṇe pāvakamārutau |

so'nilo'nalasaṃyuktaḥ so'nalaścānilākulaḥ |
daityasenāṃ dadahaturyugānteṣviva mūcchitau || 35 ||

śatapraharaṇodagraḥ śatabāhuḥ śatānanaḥ |

bāhubhistulayan vyoma kṣipanpadbhyāṃ mahīdharān |
īrayan mukhaniḥśvāsairvṛṣṭimanto balāhakān || 53 ||
tiryagāyataraktākṣaṃ mandarośgravarcasam |
didhakṣantamivāyāntaṃ sarvān devagaṇānmṛdhe || 554 ||
tarjayantaṃ suragaṇāṃśchādayantaṃ diśo daśa |
saṃvartakāle kṣudhitaṃ dṛptaṃ mṛtyumivotthitam || 55 ||
sutalenocchritavatā vipulāṅguliparvaṇā |
mālyābharaṇapūrṇena kiñciccalitavarmaṇā || 56 ||
ucchritenāgrahastena dakṣiṇena vapuṣmatā |
dānavān devanihatānuttiṣṭhadhvamiti bruvan || 57 ||
taṃ kālanemiṃ samare dviṣatāṃ kālasaṃnibham |
vīkṣanti sma surāḥ sarve bhayaviklavamānasāḥ || 58 ||
taṃ sma vīkṣanti bhūtāni kramantaṃ kālaneminam |
trivikramaṃ vikramantaṃ nārāyaṇamivāparam ||59 ||
socchrayan prathamaṃ pādaṃ mārutāghūrṇitāmbaraḥ |
prākrāmadasuro yuddhe trāsayan sarvadevatāḥ || 1.46.60 ||
sa mayenāsurendreṇa pariṣvaktaḥ kraman raṇe |
kālanemirbabhau daityaḥ viṣṇuneva puraṃdaraḥ || 61 ||
atha vivyathire devāḥ sarve śakrapurogamāḥ |
dṛṣṭvā kālamivāyāntaṃ kālanemiṃ bhayāvaham || 62 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi kālanemiprakramaṇe ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 46 ||

<1.47>

saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
dānavāṃścāpi piprīṣuḥ kālanemirmahāsuraḥ |
vyavardhata mahātejāstapānte jalado yathā || 1 ||
trailokyāntargataṃ taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā tai dānaveśvarāḥ |
uttasthurapariśrāntāḥ prāpyevāmṛtamuttamam || 2 ||
te vītabhayasaṃtrāsā mayatārapurogamāḥ |
tārakāmayasaṃgrāme satataṃ jayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ |
rejurāyodhanagatā dānavā yuddhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ || 3 ||
astramabhyasyatāṃ teṣāṃ vyūhaṃ ca .paridhāvatām |
prekṣatāṃ cābhavat prītirdānavaṃ kālaneminam || 4 ||
ye tu tatra mayasyāsan mukhyā yuddhapurassarāḥ |
te'pi sarve bhayaṃ tyaktvā hṛṣṭā yoddhumupasthitāḥ || 5 ||
mayastāro varāhaśca hayagrīvaśca vīryavān |
vipracittisutaḥ śvetaḥ kharalambāvubhāvapi || 6 ||
ariṣṭo baliputrastu kiśoroṣṭrau tathaiva ca |
svarbhānuścāmaraprakhyo vakrayodhī mahāsuraḥ || 7 ||
ete'straviduṣaḥ sarve sarve tapasi suvratāḥ |
dānavāḥ kṛtino jagmuḥ kālaneminamuttamam || 8 ||
te gadābhiśca gurvībhiñcakraiśca saparaśvadhaiḥ |
aśmabhiścādrisadṛśairgaṇḍaśailaiśca daṃśitaiḥ || 9 ||
paṭṭiśairbhindipālaiśca parighaiścottamāyudhaiḥ |
ghātanībhiśca gurvībhiḥ śataghnībhistathaiva ca || 1.47.10 ||
kālakalpaiśca musalaiḥ kṣepaṇīyaiśca mudgaraiḥ |
yugairyantraiśca nirmuktairargalaiścāgratāḍitaiḥ || 11 ||
dorbhiścāyatapīnāṃsaiḥ pāśaiḥ prāsaiśca mūrcchitaiḥ |
sarpairlelihyamānaiśca visarpadbhiśca sāyakaiḥ || 12 ||
vajraiḥ praharaṇīyaiśca dīpyamānaiśca tomaraiḥ |
vikośaiścāsibhistīkṣṇaiḥ śūlaiśca śitanirmalaiḥ || 13 ||
te vai saṃdīptamanasaḥ pragṛhītottamāyudhāḥ |
kālanemiṃ puraskṛtya tasthuḥ saṃgrāmamūrdhani || 14 ||
sā dīptaśastrapravarā daityānāṃ śuśubhe camūḥ |
dyaurnimīlitanakṣatrā saghanevāmbudāgame || 15 ||
devatānāmapi camū ruruce śakrapālitā |
dīptā śītoṣṇatejobhyāṃ candrabhāskaravarcasā || 16 ||
vāyuvegavatī saumyā tārāgaṇapatākinī |
toyadāviddhavasanā grahanakṣatrahāsinī || 17 ||
yamendradhanadairguptā varuṇena ca dhīmatā |
sampradīptāgnipavanā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā || 18 ||
sā samudraughasadṛśī divyā devamahācamūḥ |
rarājāstravatī bhīmā yakṣagandharvaśālinī || 19 ||
tayoścamvostadā tatra babhūva sa samāgamaḥ |
dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ saṃyogo yathā syād yugaparyaye || 1.47.20 ||
tad yuddhamabhavad ghoraṃ devadānavasaṃkulam |
kṣamāparākramamayaṃ darpasya vinayasya ca || 21 ||
niścakramurbalābhyāṃ tu tābhyāṃ bhīmāḥ surāsurāḥ |
pūrvāparābhyāṃ saṃrabdhāḥ sāgarābhyāmivāmbudāḥ || 22 ||
tābhyāṃ balābhyāṃ saṃhṛṣṭāśceruste devadānavāḥ |
vanābhyāṃ parvatīyābhyāṃ puṣpitābhyāṃ yathā gajāḥ || 23 ||
samājaghnustato bherīḥ śaṅkhān dadhmuśca naikaśaḥ |
sa śabdo dyāṃ bhuvaṃ caiva diśaśca samapūrayat || 24 ||
jyāghātatalanirghoṣo dhanuṣāṃ kūjitāni ca |
dundubhīnāṃ ninadatāṃ daityānāṃ nirdadhuḥ svanān || 25 ||
te'nyonyamabhisampetuḥ pātayantaḥ parasparam|
babhañjurbāhubhirbāhūn dvandvamanye yuyutsavaḥ || 26||
devatāstvaśanīrghorāḥ parighāṃścottamāyasān |
sasarjurājau nistriṃśān gadā gurvīśca dānavāḥ || 27 ||
gadānipātairbhagnāṅgā bāṇaiśca śakalīkṛtāḥ |
paripeturbhṛśaṃ kecindrabjāḥ kecit sasarjire || 28 ||
tato rathaiḥ saturagairvimānaiścāśugāmibhiḥ |
samīyuste nu saṃrabdhā roṣādanyonyamāhave || 29 ||
saṃvartamānāḥ samare vivartantastathāpare |
rathā rathairnirudhyante padātāśca padātibhiḥ || 1.47.30 ||
teṣāṃ rathānāṃ tumulaḥ sa śabdaḥ śabdavāhinām |
babhūvātha prasaktānāṃ nabhasīva payomucām || 31 ||
babhañjire rathān kecit kecit sammṛditā rathaiḥ |
sambādhameke samprāpya na śekuścalituṃ rathāḥ || 32 ||
anyonyasyābhisamare dorbhyāmutkṣipya darpitāḥ |
saṃhrādamānābharaṇā jaghnustatrāsicarmiṇaḥ || 33 ||
astrairanye vinirbhinnā raktaṃ vemurhatā yudhi |
kṣarajjalānāṃ sadṛśā jaladānāṃ samāgame || 34 ||
tadastraśastragrathitaṃ kṣiptotkṣiptagadāvilam |
devadānavasaṃkṣubdha sakulaṃ yuddhamābabhau || 35 ||
tad dānavamahāmeghaṃ devāyudhataḍitprabham |
anyonyabāṇavarṣa tad yuddhaṃ durdinamābabhau || 36 ||
etasminnantare kruddhaḥ kālanemirmahāsuraḥ |
vyavarddhata samudraughaiḥ pūryamāṇa ivāstudaḥ || 37 ||
tasya vidyucyalā pīḍāḥ pradīptāśanivarṣiṇaḥ |
gātre nagaśiraḥ prakhyā viniṣpeṣurbalāhakāḥ || 38 ||
krodhānniḥśvararatastasya bhrūbhedasvedavarṣiṇaḥ |
sāgniniṣpeṣapavanā mukhānniścerurarciṣaḥ || 39 ||
tiryagūrdhvaṃ ca gagane vavṛdhustasya bāhavaḥ |
pañcāsyāḥ kṛṣṇavapuṣo lelihānā ivoragāḥ || 1.47.40 ||
so'strajālairbahuvidhairdhanurbhiḥ parighairapi |
divyairākāśamāvavre parvatairucchritairiva || 41 ||
so'niloddhūtavasanastasthau saṃgrāmamūrdhani |
saṃdhyātapagrastaśikhaḥ sārcirmerurivāparaḥ || 42 ||
ūruvegapratikṣiptaiḥ śailaśṛṅgāgrapādapaiḥ |
apātayad devagaṇān vajreṇeva mahāgirīn || 43 ||
bāhubhiḥ śastranistriṃśaiśchinnabhinnaśirorasaḥ |
na śekuścalituṃ devāḥ kālanemihatā yudhi || 44 ||
muṣṭibhirnihatāḥ kecit kecicca vidalīkṛtāḥ |
yakṣagandharvapatayaḥ petuḥ saha mahoragaiḥ || 45 ||
tena vitrāsitā devāḥ samare kālaneminā |
na śekuryatnavanto'pi pratikartuṃ vicetasaḥ || 46 ||
tena śakraḥ sahasrākṣaḥ stambhitaḥ śarabandhanaiḥ |
airāvatagataḥ saṃkhye calituṃ na śaśāka ha || 47 ||
nirjalāmbhodasadṛśo nirjalārṇavasaprabhaḥ |
nirvyāpāraḥ kṛtastena vipāśo varuṇo mṛdhe || 48 ||
raṇe vaiśravaṇastena parighaiḥ kālarūpibhiḥ |
vyalapallokapāleśastyājito dhanadakriyām || 49 ||
yamaḥ sarvaharastena daṇḍapraharaṇo raṇe |
yāmyāmavasthāṃ samare nītaḥ svāṃ diśamāviśat||1.47.50||
sa lokapālānutsādya kṛtvā teṣāṃ ca karma tat |
dikṣu sarvāsu dehaṃ svaṃ caturdhā vidadhe tadā || 51 ||
sa nakṣatrapathe gatvā divyaṃ svarbhānudarśitam |
jahāra lakṣmīṃ somasya taṃ cāsya viṣayaṃ mahat || 52 ||
cālayāmāsadīptāṃśuṃ svargadvārātsa bhāskaram |
sāyanaṃ cāsya viṣayaṃ jahāra dinakarma ca || 53 ||
so'gniṃ devamukhe dṛṣṭvā cakārātmamukhe svayam|
vāyuṃ ca tarasā jitvā cakārātmavaśānugam || 54 ||
sasamudrāḥ samānīya sarvāśca sarito balāt |
cakārātmavaśe vīryād dehabhūtāśca sindhavaḥ || 55 ||
apaḥ svavaśagāḥ kṛtvā divijā yāśca bhūmijāḥ |
sthāpayāmāsa jagatīṃ suguptāṃ dharaṇīdharaiḥ || 56 ||
sa svayambhūrivābhāti mahābhūtapatirmahān |
sarvalokamayo daityaḥ sarvalokabhayāvahaḥ || 57 ||
sa lokapālaikavapuścandrasūryagrahātmavān |
pāvakānilasaṃghāto rarāja yudhi dānavaḥ || 58 ||
pārameṣṭhye sthitaḥ sthāne lokānāṃ prabhavāpyaye |
tuṣṭuvustaṃ daityagaṇā devā iva pitāmaham || 59 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi āścaryatārakāmaye saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||47||

<1.48>

aṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
pañca taṃ nābhyavartanta viparītena karmaṇā |
vedo dharmaḥ kṣamā satyaṃ śrīśca nārāyaṇāśrayā || 1 ||
sa teṣāmanupasthānāt sakrodho dānaveśvaraḥ |
vaiṣṇavaṃ padamanvicchan yayau nārāyaṇāntikam || 2 ||
sa dadarśa suparṇasthaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam |
dānavānāṃ vināśāya bhrāmayantaṃ gadāṃ śubhām || 3 ||
sajalāmbhodasadṛśaṃ vidyutsadṛśavāsasam |
svārūḍhaṃ svarṇapatrāḍhyaṃ śikhinaṃ kāśyapaṃ khagam || 4 ||
dṛṣṭvā daityavināśāya raṇe svasthamavasthitam |
dānavo viṣṇumakṣobhyaṃ babhāṣe kṣubdhamānasaḥ || 5 ||
ayaṃ sa ripurasmākaṃ pūrveṣāṃ dānavarṣiṇām |
arṇavāvāsinaścaiva madhorvai kaiṭabhasya ca || 6 ||
mayaṃ sa vigraho'smākamaśāmyaḥ kila kathyate |
yena naḥ saṃyugeṣvādyā bahavo dānavā hatāḥ || 7 ||
ayaṃ sa nirghṛṇo yuddhe'strī bālanirapatrapaḥ |
yena dānavanārīṇāṃ sīmantoddharaṇaṃ kṛtam || 8 ||
ayaṃ sa viṣṇurdevānāṃ vaikuṇṭhaśca divaukasām |
ananto bhogināmapsu svayambhūśca svayambhuvaḥ || 9 ||
ayaṃ sa nātho devānāmasmākaṃ vipriye sthitaḥ |
asya krodhena mahatā hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ || 1.48.10 ||
asyacchāyāṃ samāsādya devā makhamukhe sthitāḥ |
ājyaṃ maharṣibhirdattamaśnuvanti tridhā hutam || 11 ||
ayaṃ sa nidhane hetuḥ sarveṣāṃ devavidviṣām |
yasya tejaḥpraviṣṭāni kulānyasmākamāhave || 12 ||
ayaṃ sa kila yuddheṣu surārthe tyaktajīvitaḥ |
savitustejasā tulyaṃ cakraṃ kṣipati śatruṣu || 13 ||
ayaṃ sa kālo daityānāṃ kālabhūte mayi sthite |
atikrāntasya kālasya phalaṃ prāpsyati durmatiḥ || 14 ||
diṣṭyedānīṃ samakṣaṃ me viṣṇureva samāgataḥ |
adya madbāṇaniṣpiṣṭo māmeva praṇamiṣyati || 15 ||
yāsyāmyapacitiṃ diṣṭyā pūrveṣāmadya saṃyuge |
imaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ hatvā dānavānāṃ bhayāvaham || 16 ||
kṣiprameva vadhiṣyāmi raṇe nārāyaṇāśritān |
jātyantaragato'pyeṣa mṛdhe bādhati dānavān || 17 ||
eṣo'nantaḥ purā bhūtvā padmanābha iti smṛtaḥ |
jaghānaikārṇave ghore tāvubhau madhukaiṭabhau |
viniveśya svake ūrau nihatau dānaveśvarau || 18 ||
dvidhābhūtaṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā siṃhārdhaṃ narasaṃsthitam |
pitaraṃ me jaghānaiko hiraṇyakaśipuṃ purā || 19 ||
śubhaṃ garbhamadhattemamaditirdevatāraṇiḥ |
yajñakāle baleryo vai kṛtvā vāmanarūpatām |
trīm̐llokānājahāraikaḥ kramamāṇastribhiḥ kramaiḥ || 1.48.20 ||
bhūyastvidānīṃ samare samprāpte tārakāmaye |
mayā saha samāgamya saha devairvinaṅkṣyati || 21 ||
sa evamuktvā bahudhā kṣipannārāyaṇaṃ raṇe |
vāgbhirapratirūpābhiryuddhamevābhyarocayat || 22 ||
kṣipyamāṇo'surendreṇa na cukopa gadādharaḥ |
kṣamābalena mahatā sasmitaṃ vākyamabravīt || 23 ||
alpadarpabalo daitya sthitaḥ krodhādasadvadan |
hatastvamātmano doṣaiḥ kṣamāṃ yo'tītya bhāṣase || 24 ||
adhamastvaṃ mama mato dhigetat tava vāgbalam |
na tatra puruṣāḥ santi yatra garjanti yoṣitaḥ || 25 ||
ahaṃ tvāṃ daitya paśyāmi pūrveṣāṃ mārgagāminam |
prajāpatikṛtaṃ setuṃ ko bhittvā svastimānbhavet || 26 ||
adya tvāṃ nāśayiṣyāmi devavyāpārakārakam |
sveṣu sveṣu ca sthāneṣu sthāpayiṣyāmi devatāḥ || 27 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evaṃ bruvati yad vākyaṃ mṛdhe śrīvatsadhāriṇi |

krodhād dviguṇaraktākṣo viṣṇuṃ vakṣasyatāḍayat || 29 ||
dānavāścāpi samare mayatārapurogamāḥ |
udyatāyudhanistriṃśā dṛṣṭvā viṣṇumathādravan || 1.48.30 ||

krodhāt saṃraktanayano vaikuṇṭhaścakramādade || 35 ||

bhujāścāsya vyavardhanta vyāpnuvanto diśo daśa || 36 ||

vavṛdhe sa punarlokān krāntukāma ivaujasā || 37 ||

ṛṣayaḥ saha gandharvaistuṣṭuvurmadhusūdanam || 38 ||

padbhyāmākramya vasudhāṃ diśaḥ pracchādya bāhubhiḥ || 39|
sūryasya raśmitulyābhaṃ sahasrāramarikṣayam |
dīptāgnisadṛśaṃ ghoraṃ darśanīyaṃ sudarśanam || 1.48.40 ||
suvarṇanemiparyantaṃ vajranābhaṃ bhayāvaham |
medomajjāsthirudhirairdigdhaṃ dānavasambhavaiḥ || 41 ||
advitīyaṃ prahāreṣu kṣuraparyantamaṇḍalam |
sragdāmamālāvitataṃ kāmagaṃ kāmarūpiṇam 42 ||
svayaṃ svayambhuvā sṛṣṭaṃ bhayadaṃ sarvavidviṣām |
maharṣiroṣairāviṣṭaṃ nityamāhavadarpitam || 43 ||
kṣepaṇādyasya muhyanti lokāḥ sasthāṇujaṅgamāḥ |
kravyādāni ca bhūtāni tṛptiṃ yānti mahāhave || 44 ||
tamapratimakarmāṇaṃ samānaṃ sūryavarcasā |
cakramudyamya samare krodhadīpto gadādharaḥ || 45 ||
sammuṣṇan dānavaṃ tejaḥ samare svena tejasā |
ciccheda bāhuṃ cakreṇa śrīdharaḥ kālaneminaḥ 446 ||
tañca vaktraśataṃ ghoraṃ sāgnicūrṇāṭṭahāsinam |
tasya daityasya cakreṇa pramamātha balāddhariḥ || 47 ||
sa cchinnabāhurviśirā na prākampata dānavaḥ |
kabandho'vasthitaḥ saṃkhye viśākha iva pādapaḥ || 48 ||
taṃ vitatya mahāpakṣī vāyoḥ kṛtvā samaṃ javam |
urasā pātayāmāsa garuḍaḥ kālaneminam || 49 ||

nipapāta divaṃ tyaktvā kṣobhayandharaṇītalam || 1.48.50 ||
tasminnipatite daitye devāḥ sarṣigaṇāstadā |
sādhu sādhviti vaikuṇṭhaṃ sametāḥ pratyapūjayan || 51 ||

taṃ deśamājagāmāśu brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 56 ||
sarvairbrahmarṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ gaṃdharvaiḥ sāpsarogaṇaiḥ |
devadevo hariṃ devaṃ pūjayan vākyamabravīt || 57 ||
brahmovāca
kṛtaṃ deva mahatkarma surāṇāṃ śalyamuddhṛtam |
vadhenānena daityānāṃ vayaṃ hi paritoṣitāḥ || 58 ||
yo'yaṃ hatastvayā viṣṇo kālanemī mahāsuraḥ |
tvameko'sya mṛdhe hantā nānyaḥ kaścana vidyate || 59 ||
eṣa devān paribhavam̐llokāṃśca sacarācarān |
ṛṣīṇāṃ kadanaṃ kṛtvā māmapi pratigarjati || 1.48.60 ||
tadanena tavogreṇa parituṣṭo'smi karmaṇā |
yadayaṃ kālatulyābhaḥ kālanemī nipātitaḥ || 61 ||
tadāgacchasva bhadraṃ te gacchāma divamuttamam |
brahmarṣastvāṃ tatrasthāḥ pratīkṣante sadogatāḥ || 62 ||
ahaṃ maharṣayaścaiva tatra tvāṃ vadatāṃ vara |
vidhivaścārcayiṣyāmo gīrbhirdivyābhiracyuta || 63 ||
kiṃ cāhaṃ tava dāsyāmi varaṃ varabhṛtāṃ vara |
sureṣvapi sadaityeṣu varāṇāṃ varado bhavān || 64 ||
niryātayaitattrailokyaṃ sphītaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam |
asminneva mṛdhe viṣṇo śakrāya sumahātmane || 65 ||
evamukto bhagavatā brahmaṇā hariravyayaḥ |
devāñchakramukhān sarvānuvāca śubhayā girā || 66 ||
viṣṇuruvāca
śrūyatāṃ tridaśāḥ sarve yāvanto'tra samāgatāḥ |
śravaṇāvahitairdehaiḥ puraskṛtya puraṃdaram || 67 ||
asminnaḥ samare sarve kālanemimukhā hatāḥ |
dānavā vikramopetāḥ śakrādapi mahattarāḥ || 68 ||
tasmin mahati saṃkrande dvāveva tu vinissṛtau |
vairocanaśca daityendraḥ svarbhānuśca mahāgrahaḥ || 69 ||
tadiṣṭāṃ bhajatāṃ śakro diśaṃ varuṇa eva ca |
yāmyāṃ yamaḥ pālayatāmuttarāṃ ca dhanādhipaḥ || 1.48.70 ||
ṛkṣaiḥ saha yathāyogaṃ kāle caratu candramāḥ |
abdaṃ caturmukhaṃ sūryo bhajatāmayanaiḥ saha || 71 ||
ājyabhāgāḥ pravartantāṃ sadasyairabhipūjitāḥ |
hūyantāmagnayo viprairvedadṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 72 ||
devāśca balihomena svādhyāyena maharṣayaḥ |
śrāddhena pitaraścaiva tṛptiṃ yāntu yathā purā || 73 ||
vāyuścaratu mārgasthastridhā dīpyatu pāvakaḥ |
trayo varṇāśca lokāṃstrīn varddhayantyātmajairguṇaiḥ || 74 ||
kratavaḥ sampravartantāṃ dīkṣaṇīyairdvijātibhiḥ |
dakṣiṇāścopavartantāṃ yathārhaṃ sarvasatriṇām || 75 ||
gāśca sūryo rasānsomo vāyuḥ prāṇāṃśca prāṇiṣu |
tarpayantaḥ pravartantāṃ śivaiḥ saumyaiśca karmabhiḥ || 76 ||
yathāvadānupūrvyeṇa mahendrasalilodbhavāḥ |
trailokyaramātaraḥ sarvāḥ sāgaraṃ yāntu nimnagāḥ || 77 ||
daityebhyastyajyatāṃ bhīśca śāntiṃ vrajata devatāḥ |
svasti vo'stu gamiṣyāmi brahmalokaṃ sanātanam || 78 ||
svagṛhe sarvaloke vā saṃgrāme vā viśeṣataḥ |
viśrambho vo na mantavyo nityaṃ kṣudrā hi dānavāḥ|| 79 ||
apane gharame athavā samanta jagacca yā viśepataḥ
chidreṣu praharantyete na caiṣāṃ saṃsthitirdhruvāḥ |
saumyānāmṛjubhāvānāṃ bhavatāṃ cārjave matiḥ || 1.48.80 ||
ahaṃ tu duṣṭabhāvānāṃ yuṣmāsu sudurātmanām|
asamyagvartamānānāṃ mohaṃ dāsyāmi devatāḥ || 81 ||
yadā ca sudurādharṣaṃ dānavebhyo bhayaṃ bhavet |
tadā samupagamyāśu vidhāsye vastato'bhayam || 82 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evamuktvā suragaṇān viṣṇuḥ satyaparākramaḥ |
jagām brahmaṇā sārdhaṃ vrahmalokaṃ mahāyaśāḥ || 83 ||
etadāścaryamabhavat saṃgrāme tārakāmaye |
dānavānāṃ ca viṣṇośca yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi|| 84 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi kālanemivadhe'ṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 48 ||

<1.49>

ekonapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
brahmaṇā devadevena sārdhaṃ salilayoninā |
brahmalokagato brahman vaikuṇṭhaḥ kiṃ cakāra ha || 1 ||
kimarthe cādidevena nītaḥ kamalayoninā |
viṣṇurdaityavadhe vṛtte devaiśca kṛtasatkriyaḥ || 2 ||
brahmaloke ca kiṃ sthānaṃ kaṃ vā yogamupāsta saḥ |
kaṃ vā dadhāra niyamaṃ sa vibhurbhūtabhāvanaḥ || 3 ||
kathaṃ tasyā''satastatra viśvaṃ jagadidaṃ mahat |
śriyamāpnoti vipulāṃ surāsuranarārcitām || 4 ||
kathaṃ svapiti gharmānte budhyate cāmbudaplave |
kathaṃ ca brahmalokastho dhuraṃ vahati laukikīm || 5 ||
caritaṃ tasya viprendra divyaṃ bhagavato divi |
vistareṇa yathātattvaṃ sarvamicchāmi veditum || 6 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śṛṇu nārāyaṇasyādau vistareṇa pravṛttayaḥ |
brahmalokaṃ yathārūḍho brahmaṇā saha modate || 7 ||
kāmaṃ tasya gatiḥ sūkṣmā devairapi durāsadā |
yat tu vakṣyāmyahaṃ rājaṃstanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu || 8 ||
eṣa lokamayo devo lokāścaitanmayāstrayaḥ |
eṣa devamayaścaiva devāścaitanmayā divi || 9 ||
tasya pāraṃ na paśyanti bahavaḥ pāracintakāḥ |
eṣa pāraṃ paraṃ caiva lokānāṃ veda mādhavaḥ || 1.49.10 ||
asya devāndhakārasya mārgitavyasya daivataiḥ |
śṛṇu vai yattadā vṛttaṃ brahmaloke purātanam || 11 ||
sa gatvā brahmaṇo lokaṃ dṛṣṭvā paitāmahaṃ padam|
vavande tānṛṣīn sarvān viṣṇurārṣeṇa karmaṇā || 12 ||
so'gniṃ prāksavane dṛṣṭvā hūyamānaṃ maharṣibhiḥ |
avandata mahātejāḥ kṛtvā paurvāhṇikīṃ kriyām || 13 ||
sa dadarśa makheṣvājyairijyamānaṃ maharṣibhiḥ |
bhāgaṃ yajñiyamaśnānaṃ svadehamaparaṃ sthitam || 14 ||
abhivādyābhivādyānāmṛṣīṇāṃ brahmavarcasām |
paricakrāma so'cintyo brahmalokaṃ sanātanam || 15 ||
sa dadarśocchritān yūpāṃścaṣālāgravibhūṣitān |
makheṣu ca brahmarṣibhiḥ śataśaḥ kṛtalakṣaṇān || 16 ||
ājyadhūmaṃ samāghrāya śṛṇvanvedāndvijeritān|
yajñairijyantamātmānaṃ paśyaṃstatra cacāra ha || 17 ||
ūcustamṛṣayo devāḥ sadasyāḥ sadasi sthitāḥ |
arghyodyatabhujāḥ sarve pavitrāntarapāṇayaḥ || 18 ||
deveṣu vartate yad vai taddhi sarvaṃ janārdanāt |
yatpravṛttaṃ ca devebhyastadviddhi madhusūdanāt || 19 ||
agnīṣomamayaṃ lokaṃ yaṃ vidurviduṣo janāḥ |
taṃ somamagniṃ lokaṃ ca veda viṣṇuṃ sanātanam || 1.49.20 ||
kṣīrād yathā dadhi bhaveddadhnaḥ sarpirbhaved yathā |
mathyamāneṣu bhūteṣu tathā loko janārdanāt || 21 |
yathendriyaiśca bhūtaiśca paramātmā vidhīyate |
tathā devaiśca vedaiśca lokaiśca vihito hariḥ || 22 ||
yathā bhūtendriyāvāptirvihitā bhuvi dehinām |
tathā prāṇeśvarāvāptirdevānāṃ divi vaiṣṇavī || 22 ||
satriṇāṃ satraphaladaḥ pavitraṃ paramātmavān |
lokatantradharo hyeṣa mantraimantra ivocyate || 24 ||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
svāgataṃ te suraśreṣṭha padmanābha mahādyute |
idaṃ yajñiyamātithyaṃ mantrataḥ pratigṛhyatām || 25 ||
tvamasya yajñapūtasya pātraṃ pādyasya pāvanaḥ |
atithistvaṃ hi mantroktaḥ sa dṛṣṭaḥ satataṃ mataḥ || 26 ||
tvayi yoddhuṃ gate viṣṇau na prāvartanta naḥ kriyāḥ |
avaiṣṇavasya yajñasya na hi karma vidhīyate || 27 ||
sadakṣiṇasya yajñasya tvatprasūtiḥ phalaṃ labhet |
adyātmānamihāsmābhirijyamānaṃ nirīkṣase || 28 ||
evamastviti tānsarvānbhagavānpratyapūjayat|
mumude brahmalokastho brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 29 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi lokavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 49 ||

<1.50>

pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
ṛṣibhiḥ pūjitastaistu viveśa harirīśvaraḥ |
paurāṇaṃ brahmasadanaṃ divyaṃ nārāyaṇāśramam || 1 ||
sa tad viveśa hṛṣṭātmā tānāmantrya sadogatān |
praṇamya cādidevāya brahmaṇe padmayonaye || 2 ||
svena nāmnā parijñātaṃ sa taṃ nārāyaṇāśramam |
praviśanneva bhagavānāyudhāni vyasarjayat || 3 ||
sa tatrāmbupatiprakhyaṃ dadarśālayamātmanaḥ |
svadhiṣṭhitaṃ devagaṇaiḥ śāśvataiśca maharṣibhiḥ || 4 ||
saṃvartakāmbudopetaṃ nakṣatrasthānasaṃkulam |
timiraughaparikṣiptamapradhṛṣyaṃ surāsuraiḥ || 5 |
na tatra viṣayo vāyornendorna ca vivasvataḥ |
vapuṣaḥ padmanābhasya sa deśastejasā''vṛtaḥ || 6 ||
sa tatra praviśanneva jaṭābhāraṃ samudvahan |
sahasraśīrṣo bhūtvā tu śayanāyopacakrame || 7 ||
lokānāmantakālajñā kālī nayanaśālinī |
upatasthe mahātmānaṃ nidrā taṃ kālarūpiṇī || 8 ||
sa śiśye śayane divye samudrāmbhodaśītale |
harirekārṇavoktena vratena vratināṃ varaḥ || 9 ||
taṃ śayānaṃ mahātmānaṃ bhavāya jagataḥ prabhum |
upāsāñcakrire viṣṇuṃ devāḥ sarṣigaṇāstathā || 1.50.10 ||
tasya suptasya śuśubhe nābhimadhyātsamutthitam |
ādyaṃ tasyāsanaṃ padmaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sūryavarcasam |
sahasrapatraṃ varṇāḍhyaṃ sukumāraṃ supuṣpitam || 11
brahmasūtrodyatakaraḥ svapanneva mahāmuniḥ |
āvartayati lokānāṃ sarveṣāṃ kālaparyayam || 12 |
vivṛtāt tasya vadanānniḥśvāsapavaneritāḥ |
prajānāṃ paṅktayo hyuccairniṣpatantyutpatanti ca || 13||
te sṛṣṭāḥprāṇino medhyā vibhaktā brahmaṇā svayam |
caturdhā svāṃ gatiṃ jagmuḥ kṛtāntoktena karmaṇā || 14 ||
na taṃ veda svayaṃ brahmā nāpi brahmarṣayo'vyayāḥ |
viṣṇornidrāmayaṃ yogaṃ praviṣṭaṃ tamasāvṛtam || 15 ||
te tu brahmarṣayaḥ sarve pitāmahapurogamāḥ |
na vidustaṃ kvacit suptaṃ kvacidāsīnamāsane || 16 ||
jāgarti ko'tra kaḥ śete kaśca śaktaśca neṅgate |
ko bhogavānkodyutimānkṛṣṇātkṛṣṇataraśca kaḥ||17||
vimṛśanti sma taṃ devā divyābhirupapattibhiḥ |
na cainaṃ śekuranveṣṭuṃ karmato janmato'pi vā || 18 ||
gāthābhistatpradiṣṭābhirye tasya caritaṃ viduḥ |
purāṇāstaṃ purāṇeṣu ṛṣayaḥ sampracakṣate ||19 ||
śrūyate cāsya caritaṃ deveṣvapi purātanam |
mahāpurāṇāt prabhṛti paraṃ tasya na vidyate || 1.50.20||
yaccāsya devadevasya caritaṃ svaprabhāvajam |
tenemāḥ śrutayo vyāptā vaidikyo laukikāśca yāḥ || 21 ||
bhavakāle bhavatyeṣa lokānāṃ lokabhāvanaḥ |
dānavānāmabhāvāya jāgarti madhusūdanaḥ || 22 ||
yatrainaṃ vīkṣituṃ devā na śekuḥ suptamavyayam |
tataḥ svapiti gharmānte jāgarti jaladakṣaye || 23 ||
sa hi vedāśca yajñāśca yajñāṅgāni ca sarvaśaḥ |
yā tu yajñagatiḥ proktā sa eṣa puruṣottamaḥ || 24 ||
tasmin supte na vartante mantrapūtāḥ kratukriyāḥ |
śaratpravṛttayajño'yaṃ jāgarti madhusūdanaḥ || 25 ||
tadidaṃ vārṣikaṃ cakraṃ kārayatyambudeśvaraḥ |
vaiṣṇavaṃ karma kurvāṇaḥ supte viṣṇau puraṃdaraḥ || 26 ||
yā hyeṣā gahvarā māyā nidreti jagati sthitā |
sākasmād dveṣiṇī ghorā kālarātrirmahīkṣitām|| 27 ||
tasyāstanustamodvārā niśā divasanāśinī |
jīvitārdhaharā ghorā sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ bhuvi || 28 ||
naitayā kaścidāviṣṭo jṛmbhamāṇo muhurmuhuḥ |
śaktaḥ prasahituṃ vegaṃ majjanniva mahārṇave || 29 ||
annajā bhuvi martyānāṃ śramajā vā kathaṃcana |
saiṣā bhavati lokasya nidrā sarvasya laukikī || 1.50.30 ||
svapnānte kṣīyate hyeṣā prāyaśo bhuvi dehinām |
mṛtyukāle ca bhūtānāṃ prāṇān nāśayate bhṛśam || 31 ||
deveṣvapi dadhāraināṃ nānyo nārāyaṇādṛte |
sakhī sarvaharasyaiṣā māyā viṣṇuśarīrajā || 32 ||
saiṣā nārāyaṇamukhe dṛṣṭā kamalalocanā |
lokānalpena kālena grasate lokamohinī || 33 ||
evameṣā hitārthāya lokānāṃ kṛṣṇavartmanā |
dhriyate sevanīyā hi patyeva ca pativratā || 34 |
sa tayā nidrayā cchannastasmin nārāyaṇāśrame |
svapiti sma tadā viṣṇurmohayañjagadavyayaḥ || 35 ||
tasya varṣasahastrāṇi śayānasya mahātmanaḥ |
jagmuḥ kṛtayugaṃ caiva tretā caiva yugottamam || 36 ||
sa tu ddhāparaparyante jñātvā lokān suduḥkhitān |
prābudhyata mahātejāḥ stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ || 37 ||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
jahīhi nidrāṃ sahajāṃ bhuktapūrvāmiva srajam |
ime te brahmaṇā sārdhaṃ devā darśanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ || 38 ||
ime tvāṃ brahmavidvāṃso brahmasaṃstavavādinaḥ |
vardhayanti hṛṣīkeśa ṛṣayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ || 39 ||
eteṣāmātmabhūtānāṃ bhūtānāṃ bhūtabhāvana |
śṛṇu viṣṇo śubhā vāco bhūvyomāgnyanilāmbhasām|| 1.50.40 |
ime tvā sapta munayaḥ sahitā munimaṇḍalaiḥ |
stuvanti deva divyābhirgeyābhirgīrbhirañjasā || 41||
uttiṣṭha śatapatrākṣa padmanābha mahādyute |
kāraṇaṃ kiṃcidutpannaṃ devānāṃ kāryagauravāt || 42 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
sa saṃkṣipya jalaṃ sarvaṃ timiraughaṃ vidārayan |
udatiṣṭhaddhṛṣīkeśaḥ śriyā paramayā jvalan || 43 ||
sa dadarśa surānsarvānsametānsapitāmahān |
vivakṣataḥ prakṣubhitāñjagadarthe samāgatān || 44 ||
tānuvāca harirdevo nidrāviśrāntalocanaḥ |
tattvadṛṣṭārthayā vācā dharmahetvarthayuktayā || 45 ||
śrībhagavānuvāca
kuto vo vigraho devāḥ kuto vo bhayamāgatam |
kasya vā kena vā kāryaṃ kiṃ vā mayi na vartate || 46||
kiṃ khalvakuśalaṃ loke vartate dānavotthitam |
nṛṇāmāyāsajananaṃ śīghramicchāmi veditum || 47 ||
eṣa brahmavidāṃ madhye vihāya śayanottamam |
śivāya bhavatāmarthe sthitaḥ kiṃ karavāṇi vaḥ || 48 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi viṣṇoryogaśayanotthāne pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 50 ||

<1.51>

ekapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tacchrutvā viṣṇugaditaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
uvāca paramaṃ vākyaṃ hitaṃ sarvadivaukasām || 1 ||
nāsti kiṃcidbhayaṃ viṣṇo surāṇāmasurāntaka |
yeṣāṃ bhavānabhayadaḥ karṇadhāro raṇe raṇe || 2 ||
śakre jayati deveśe tvayi cāsurasūdane |
dharme prayatamānānāṃ mānavānāṃ kuto bhayam || 3 ||
satye dharme ca niratān mānavān vigatajvarān |
nākāle dharmiṇo mṛtyuḥ śaknoti prasamīkṣitum|| 4 ||
mānavānāṃ ca patayaḥ pārthivāśca parasparam |
ṣaḍbhāgamupabhuñjānā na bhayaṃ kurvate mithaḥ || 5 ||
te prajānāṃ śubhakarāḥ karadairavigarhitāḥ |
sukarairviprayuktārthāḥ kośamāpūrayantyuta || 6 ||
sphītāñjanapadān sarvān pālayantaḥ kṣamāparāḥ |
atīkṣṇadaṇḍāṃścaturo varṇāñjugupurañjasā || 7 ||
nodvejanīyā bhūtānāṃ sacivaiḥ sādhupūjitāḥ |
caturaṅgabalairguptāḥ ṣaḍguṇānupayuñjate || 8 ||
dhanurvedaparāḥ sarve sarve vedeṣu niṣṭhitāḥ |
yajante ca yathākālaṃ yajñairvipuladakṣiṇaiḥ || 9 ||
vedānadhītya dīkṣābhirmaharṣīn brahmacaryayā |
śrāddhaiśca medhyaiḥ śataśastarpayanti pitāmahān || 1.51.10 ||
naiṣāmaviditaṃ kiṃcittrividhaṃ bhuvi dṛśyate |
vaidikaṃ laukikaṃ caiva dharmaśāstroktameva ca || 11 ||
te parāvaradṛṣṭārthā maharṣisamatejasaḥ |
bhūyaḥ kṛtayugaṃ kartumutsahante narādhipāḥ || 12 ||
teṣāmeva prabhāveṇa śivaṃ varṣati vāsavaḥ |
yathārthaṃ ca vavurvātā virajaskā diśo daśa || 13 ||
nirutpātā ca vasudhā supracārāśca khe grahāḥ |
candramāśca sanakṣatraḥ saumyaṃ carati yogataḥ || 14 ||
anulomakaraḥ sūryastvayane dve cacāra ha |
havyaiśca vividhaistaptaḥ śubhagandho hutāśanaḥ || 15 ||
evaṃ samyak pravṛtteṣu vivṛddheṣu makhādiṣu |
tarpayatsu mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ nṛṇāṃ kālabhayaṃ kutaḥ || 16 ||
teṣāṃ jvalitakīrtīnāmanyonyavaśavartinām |
rājñāṃ balairbalavatā pīḍyate vasudhātalam || 17 ||
seyaṃ bhārapariśrāntā pīḍyamānā narādhipaiḥ |
pṛthivī samanuprāptā naurivāsannaviplavā || 18 ||
yugāntasadṛśai rūpaiḥ śailoccalitabandhanā |
jalotpīḍākulā svedaṃ dhārayantī muhurmuhuḥ || 19 ||
kṣatriyāṇāṃ vapurbhiśca tejasā ca balena ca |
nṛṇāṃ ca rāṣṭrairvistīrṇaiḥ śrāmyatīva vasundharā || 1.51.20 ||
pure pure narapatiḥ koṭisaṃkhyairbalairvṛtaḥ |
rāṣṭre rāṣṭre ca bahavo grāmāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ || 21 ||
bhūmipānāṃ sahasraiśca teṣāṃ ca balināṃ balaiḥ |
grāmāyutāḍhyai rāṣṭraiśca bhūmirnirvivarākṛtā || 22 ||
seyaṃ nirāmayaṃ kṛtvā niśceṣṭā kālamagrataḥ |
prāptā mamālayaṃ viṣṇo bhavāṃścāsyāḥ parā gatiḥ || 23 ||
karmabhūmirmanuṣyāṇāṃ bhūmireṣā vyathāṃ gatā |
yathā na sīdet tat kāryaṃ jagatyeṣā hi śāśvatī || 24 ||
asyā hi pīḍane doṣo mahān syānmadhusūdana |
kriyālopaśca lokānāṃ pīḍitaṃ ca jagad bhavet ||25 ||
śrāmyate vyaktameveyaṃ pārthivaughaprapīḍitā |
sahajāṃ yā kṣamāṃ tyaktvā calatvamacalā gatā || 26 ||
tadasyāḥ śrutavantaḥ sma taccāpi bhavatā śrutam |
bhārāvataraṇārthaṃ hi mantrayāma saha tvayā || 27 ||
satpathe hi sthitāḥ sarve rājāno rāṣṭravardhanāḥ |
narāṇāṃ ca trayo varṇā brāhmaṇānanuyāyinaḥ || 28 ||
sarvaṃ satyaparaṃ vākyaṃ varṇā dharmaparāstathā |
sarve vedaparā viprāḥ sarve vipraparā narāḥ || 29 ||
evaṃ jagati vartante manuṣyā dharmakāraṇāt |
yathā dharmavadho na syāt tathā mantraḥ pravartyatām| 1.51.30 ||
satāṃ gatiriyaṃ nānyā dharmaścāsyāḥ susādhanam |
rājñāṃ caiva vadhaḥ kāryo dharaṇyā bhāranirṇaye || 31 ||
tadāgaccha mahābhāga saha vai mantrakāraṇāt |
vrajāmo meruśikharaṃ puraskṛtya vasuṃdharām || 32 ||
etāvaduktvā rājendra brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi bhārāvataraṇe ekapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 51 ||

<1.52>

dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
bāḍhamityeva saha tairdurdināmbhodaniḥsvanaḥ |
pratasthe durdinākāraḥ sadurdina ivācalaḥ || 1 ||
samuktāmaṇividyotaṃ sacandrāmbhodavarcasam |
sajaṭāmaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ sa bibhracchrīdharo hariḥ|| 2 ||
sa cāsyorasi vistīrṇe romāñcodgatarājimān |
śrīvatso rājate śrīmāṃstanadvayamukhāñcitaḥ || 3 ||
pīte vasāno vasane lokānāṃ gururavyayaḥ |
hariḥ so'bhavadālakṣyaḥ sa saṃdhyābhra ivācalaḥ|| 4 ||
taṃ vrajantaṃ suparṇena padmayonigatānugam |
anujagmuḥ surāḥ sarve tadgatāsaktacakṣuṣaḥ || 5 ||
nātidīrgheṇa kālena samprāptā ratnaparvatam |
daḍaśurdevatāstatra tāṃ sabhāṃ kāmarūpiṇīm || 6 ||
meroḥ śikharavinyastāṃ saṃyuktāṃ sūryavarcasā |
kāñcanastambharacitāṃ vajrasaṃdhānatoraṇām || 7 ||
manonirmāṇacitrāḍhyāṃ vimānaśatamālinīm |
ratnajālāntaravatīṃ kāmagāṃ ratnabhūṣitām || 8 ||
klṛptaratnasamākīrṇāṃ sarvartukusumotkaṭām |
devamāyādharāṃ divyāṃ vihitāṃ viśvakarmaṇā || 9||
tāṃ hṛṣṭamanasaḥ sarve yathāsthānaṃ yathāvidhi |
yathānideśaṃ tridaśā viviśuste sabhāṃ śubhām || 1.52.10 ||
te niṣeduryathokteṣu vimāneṣvāsaneṣu ca |
bhadrāsaneṣu pīṭheṣu kuthāsvāstaraṇeṣu ca ||11 ||
tataḥ prabhañjano vāyurbrahmaṇā sādhu coditaḥ |
mā śabdamiti sarvatra pracakrāmātha tāṃ sabhām || 12 ||
niḥśabdastimite tasminsamāje tridivaukasām|
babhāṣe dharaṇī vākyaṃ khedāt karuṇabhāṣiṇī || 13 ||
dharaṇyuvāca
tvayā dhāryā tvahaṃ daiva tvayā vai dhāryate jagat |
tvaṃ dhārayasi bhūtāni bhuvanāni bibharṣi ca ||14 ||
yat tvayā dhāryate kiñcittejasā ca balena ca |
tatastava prasādena mayā yatnācca dhāryate || 15 ||
tvayā dhṛtaṃ dhārayāmi nādhṛtaṃ dhārayāmyaham |
na hi tad vidyate bhūtaṃ yat tvayā nānudhāryate || 16 ||
tvameva kuruṣe deva nārāyaṇa yuge yuge |
mama bhārāvataraṇaṃ jagato hitakāmyayā || 17 ||
tavaiva tejasā''krāntāṃ rasātalatalaṃ gatām |
trāyasva māṃ suraśreṣṭha tvāmeva śaraṇaṃ gatām || 18 ||
dānavaiḥ pīḍyamānāhaṃ rākṣasaiśca durātmabhiḥ |
tvāmeva śaraṇaṃ nityamupayāsye sanātanam || 19 ||
tāvanme'sti bhayaṃ bhūyo yāvanna tvāṃ kakudminam |
śaraṇaṃ yāmi manasā śataśo hyupalakṣaye || 1.52.20 ||
ahamādau purāṇasya saṃkṣiptā padmayoninā |
māṃ ca baddhvā kṛtau pūrvaṃ mṛnmayau dvau mahāsurau || 21 ||
karṇasrotodbhabau tau hi viṣṇorasya mahātmanaḥ |
mahārṇave prasvapataḥ kāṣṭhakuṇḍyasamau sthitau || 22 ||
tau viveśa svayaṃ vāyurbrahmaṇā sādhu coditaḥ |
divaṃ pracchādayantau tu vavṛdhāte mahāsurau || 23 ||
vāyuprāṇau tu tau gṛhya brahmā paryamṛśacchanaiḥ |
ekaṃ mṛdutaraṃ mene kaṭhinaṃ veda cāparam || 24 ||
nāmanī tu tayoścakre sa vibhuḥ salilodbhavaḥ |
mṛdustvayaṃ madhurnāma kaṭhinaḥ kaiṭabho'bhavat || 25 ||
tau daityau kṛtanāmānau ceraturbaladarpiṃtau |
sarvamekārṇavaṃ lokaṃ yoddhukāmau sudurjayau || 26 ||
tāvāgatau samālokya brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
ekārṇavāmbunicaye tatraivāntaradhīyata || 27 ||
sa padme padmanābhasya nābhimadhyāt samutthite |
rocayāmāsa vasatiṃ guhyāṃ brahmā caturmukhaḥ || 28 ||
tāvubhau jalagarbhasthau nārāyaṇapitāmahau |
bahūn varṣagaṇānapsu śayānau na cakampatuḥ || 29 ||
atha dīrghasya kālasya tāvubhau madhukaiṭabhau |
ājagmatustamuddeśaṃ yatra brahmā vyavasthitaḥ || 1.52.30 ||
dṛṣṭvā tāvasurau ghorau mahākāyau durāsadau |
brahmaṇā tāḍito viṣṇuḥ padmanālena vai tadā |
utpapātātha śayanāt padmanābho mahādyutiḥ || 31 ||
tad yuddhamabhavad ghoraṃ tayostasya ca vai tadā |
ekārṇave tadā loke trailokye jalatāṃ gate || 32 ||
tadābhūt tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ varṣasaṃkhyā sahasraśaḥ |
na ca tāvasurau yuddhe tadā śramamavāpatuḥ || 33 ||
athāto dīrghakālasya tau daityau yuddhadurmadau |
ūcatuḥ prītamanasau devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim || 34 ||
prītau svastava yuddhena ślāghyastvaṃ mṛtyurāvayoḥ |
āvāṃ jahi na yatrorvī salilena pariplutā || 35 ||
hatau ca tava putratvaṃ prāpnuyāvaḥ surottama |
yo hyāvāṃ yudhi nirjetā tasyāvāṃ vihitau sutau|| 36 ||
sa tu gṛhya mṛdhe dorbhyāṃ daityau tāvabhyapīḍayat |
jagmaturnidhanaṃ cāpi tāvubhau madhukaiṭabhau || 37 ||
tau hatau cāplutau toye vapurbhyāmekatāṃ gatau |
medo mumucaturdaityau mathyamānau jalormibhiḥ || 38 ||
medasā tajjalaṃ vyāptaṃ tābhyāmantardadhe tataḥ |
nārāyaṇaśca bhagavānasṛjat sa punaḥ prajāḥ || 39 ||
daityayormedasācchanā medinīti tataḥ smṛtā |
prabhāvātpadmanābhasya śāśvatī jagatī kṛtā || 1.52.40 ||
varāheṇa purā bhūtvā mārkaṇḍeyasya paśyataḥ |
viṣāṇenāhamekena toyamadhyāt samuddhṛtā || 41 ||
hṛtāhaṃ kramatā bhūyastadā yuṣmākamagrataḥ |
baleḥ sakāśāddaityasya viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || 42 ||
sāmprataṃ khidyamānāhamenameva gadādharam |
anāthā jagato nātha śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatā || 43 ||
agniḥ suvarṇasya gururgavāṃ sūryo guruḥ smṛtaḥ |
nakṣatrāṇāṃ guruḥ somo mama nārāyaṇo guruḥ || 44 ||
yadahaṃ dhārayāmyekā jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam |
mayā dhṛtaṃ dhārayate sarvametad gadādharaḥ || 45 ||
jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa bhārāvataraṇepsayā |
roṣāt triḥsaptakṛtvo'haṃ kṣatriyairviprayojitā || 46 ||
sāsmi vedyāṃ samāropya tarpitā nṛpaśoṇitaiḥ |
bhārgaveṇa pituḥ śrāddhe kaśyapāya niveditā || 47 ||
māṃsamedo'sthidurgandhā digdhā kṣatriyaśoṇitaiḥ |
rajasvaleva yuvatiḥ kaśyapaṃ samupasthitā || 48 ||
sa māṃ brahmarṣirapyāha kimurvi tvamavāṅmukhī|
vīrapatnīvratamidaṃ dhārayantī viṣīdasi || 49 ||
sāhaṃ vijñāpitavatī kaśyapaṃ lokabhāvanam |
patayo me hatā brahman bhārgaveṇa mahātmanā || 1.52.50 ||
sāhaṃ vihīnā vikrāntaiḥ kṣatriyaiḥ śastravṛttibhiḥ |
vidhavā śūnyanagarā na dhārayitumutsahe || 51 ||
tanmahyaṃ dīyatāṃ bhartā bhagavaṃstvatsamo nṛpaḥ |
rakṣet sagrāmanagarāṃ yo māṃ sāgaramālinīm || 52 ||
sa śrutvā bhagavānvākyaṃ bāḍhamityabravītprabhuḥ |
tato māṃ mānavendrāya manave sa pradattavān || 53 ||
sā manuprabhavaṃ divyaṃ prāpyekṣvākukulaṃ nṛpam |
vipulenāsmi kālena pārthivāt pārthivaṃ gatā || 54 ||
evaṃ dattāsmi manave mānavendrāya dhīmate |
bhuktā rājasahasraiśca maharṣikulasammitaiḥ || 55 ||
bahavaḥ kṣatriyāḥ śūrā māṃ jitvā divamāśritāḥ |
te ca kālavaśaṃ prāpya mayyeva pralayaṃ gatāḥ || 56 |'|
matkṛte vigrahā loke vṛttā vartanta eva ca |
kṣatriyāṇāṃ balavatāṃ saṃgrāmeṣvanivartinām || 57 ||
etad yuṣmatpravṛttena daivena paripālyate |
jagaddhitārthaṃ kuruta rājñāṃ hetuṃ raṇakṣaye || 58 ||
yadyasti mayi kāruṇyaṃ bhāraśaithilyakāraṇāt |
ekaścakradharaḥ śrīmānabhayaṃ me prayacchatu || 59 ||
yamahaṃ bhārasaṃtaptā samprāptā śaraṇārthinī |
bhāro yadyavaroptavyo viṣṇureṣa bravītu mām || 1.52.60 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi dharaṇīvākye dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 52 ||

<1.53>

tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
te śrutvā pṛthivīvākyaṃ sarva eva divaukasaḥ |
tadarthakṛtyaṃ saṃcintya pitāmahamathābruvan || 1 ||
bhagavan hriyatāmasyā dharaṇyā bhārasaṃtatiḥ |
śarīrakartā lokānāṃ tvaṃ hi lokasya ceśvaraḥ || 2 ||
yat kartavyaṃ mahendreṇa yamena varuṇena ca |
yad vā kāryaṃ dhaneśena svayaṃ nārāyaṇena vā || 3 ||
yad vā candramasā kāryaṃ bhāskareṇānilena vā |
ādityairvasubhirvāpi rudrairvā lokabhāvanaiḥ || 4 ||
aśvibhyāṃ devavaidyābhyāṃ sādhyairvā tridaśālayaiḥ |
bṛhaspatyuśanobhyāṃ vā kālena kalināpi vā || 5 ||
maheśvareṇa vā brahman viśākhena guhena vā |
yakṣarākṣasagandharvaiścāraṇairvā mahoragaiḥ || 6 ||
pataṅgaiḥ parvataiścāpi sāgarairvā mahormibhiḥ |
gaṅgāmukhābhirdivyābhiḥ saridbhirvā sureśvara || 7 ||
śīghramājñāpaya vibho kathamaṃśaḥ prayujyatām |
yadi te pārthivaṃ kāryaṃ kāryaṃ pārthivavigrahe || 8 ||
kathamaṃśāvataraṇaṃ kurmaḥ sarve pitāmaha |
antarikṣagatā ye ca pṛthivyāṃ pārthivāśca ye || 9 |
sadasyānāṃ ca viprāṇāṃ pārthivānāṃ kuleṣu ca |
ayonijāścaiva tanūḥ sṛjāmo jagatītale || 1.53.10 ||
surāṇāmekakāryāṇāṃ śrutvaitantiścitaṃ matam |
devaiḥ parivṛtaḥ prāha vākyaṃ lokapitāmahaḥ || 11 ||
rocate me suraśreṣṭhā yuṣmākamapi niścayaḥ |
sṛjadhvaṃ svaśarīrāṃśāṃstejasā''tmasamānbhuvi ||12||
sarva eva suraśreṣṭhāstejobhiravarohata |
bhāvayanto bhuvaṃ devīṃ labdhvā tribhuvanaśriyam || 13||
pārthive bhārate vaṃśe pūrvameva vijānatā |
pṛthivyāṃ sambhramamimaṃ śrūyatāṃ yanmayā kṛtam || 14 ||
samudre'haṃ purā pūrve velāmāsādya paścimām |
āsaṃ sārdhaṃ tanūjena kaśyapena mahātmanā || 15 ||
kathābhiḥ pūrvavṛttābhirlokavedānugāmibhiḥ |
itivṛttaiśca bahubhiḥ purāṇaprabhavairguṇaiḥ || 16 ||
kurvatastu kathāstāstāḥ samudraḥ saha gaṅgayā |
samīpamājagāmāśu yuktastoyadamārutaiḥ || 17 ||
sa vīciviṣamā kurvan gatiṃ vegataraṅgiṇīm |
yādogaṇavicitreṇa sacchannastoyavāsasā || 18 ||
śaṅkhamuktāmalatanuḥ pravālamaṇibhūṣaṇaḥ |
yuktaścandramasā pūrṇaḥ sābhragambhīraniḥsvanaḥ || 19 ||
sa māṃ paribhavanneva svāṃ velāṃ samatikraman |
kledayāmāsa capalairlāvaṇairambuvisravaiḥ || 1.53.20 ||
taṃ ca deśaṃ vyavasitaḥ samudro'dbhirvimarditum |
uktaḥ saṃrabdhayā vācā śānto'sīti mayā tadā || 21 ||
śānto'sītyuktamātrastu tanutvaṃ sāgaro gataḥ |
saṃhatormitaraṅgaughaḥ sthito rājaśriyā jvalan || 22 ||
bhūyaścaiva mayā śaptaḥ samudraḥ saha gaṅgayā |
sakāraṇāṃ matiṃ kṛtvā yuṣmākaṃ hitakāmyayā || 23 ||
yasmāt tvaṃ rājatulyena vapuṣā samupasthitaḥ |
gacchārṇava mahīpālo rājeva tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 24 ||
tatrāpi sahajāṃ līlāṃ dhārayan svena tejasā |
bhaviṣyasi nṛṇāṃ bhartā bhāratānāṃ kulodvahaḥ || 25 ||
śānto'sīti mayoktastvaṃ yaccāsi tanutāṃ gataḥ |
sutanuryaśasā loke śāntanustvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 26 ||
iyamapyāyatāpāṅgī gaṅgā sarvāṅgaśobhanā |
rūpiṇī ca saricchreṣṭhā tatra tvāmupayāsyati || 27 ||
evamuktastu māṃ kṣubdhaḥ so'bhivīkṣyārṇavo'bravīt |
māṃ prabho devadevānāṃ kimarthaṃ śaptavānasi || 28 ||
ahaṃ tava vidheyātmā tvatkṛtastvatparāyaṇaḥ |
aśapo'sadṛśairvākyairātmajaṃ māṃ kimātmanā || 29 ||
bhagavaṃstvatprasādena vegāt parvaṇi vardhitaḥ |
yadyahaṃ calito brahman ko'tra doṣo mamātmanaḥ || 1.53.30 ||
kṣiptābhiḥ pavanairadbhiḥ spṛṣṭo yadyasi parvaṇi |
atra me kiṃ nu bhagavan vidyate śāpakāraṇam || 31 ||
uddhataiśca mahāvātaiḥ pravṛddhaiśca balāhakaiḥ |
parvaṇā cenduyuktena tribhiḥ kṣubdho'smi kāraṇaiḥ|| 32 ||
evaṃ yadyaparāddho'haṃ kāraṇaistvatprakalpitaiḥ |
kṣantumarhasi me brahmañchāpo'yaṃ vinivartyatām || 33 ||
evaṃ mayi nirālambe śāpācchithilatāṃ gate |
kāruṇyaṃ kuru deveśa pramāṇaṃ yadyavekṣase || 34 ||
asyāstu devagaṅgāyā gāṃ gatāyāstvadājñayā |
mama doṣāt sadoṣāyāḥ prasādaṃ kartumarhasi ||35||
tamahaṃ ślakṣṇayā vācā mahārṇavamathābravam |
akāraṇajñaṃ devānāṃ trastaṃ śāpānalena tam || 36 ||
śāntiṃ vraja na bhetavyaṃ prasanno 'smi mahodadhe |
śāpe'smin saritāṃ nātha bhaviṣyaṃ śṛṇu kāraṇam || 37||
tvaṃ gaccha bhārate vaṃśe svaṃ dehaṃ svena tejasā |
ādhatsva saritāṃ nātha tyaktvemāṃ sāgarīṃ tanum|| 38 ||
mahodadhe mahīpālastatra rājaśriyā vṛtaḥ |
pālayaṃścaturo varṇān raṃsyase salileśvara || 39 ||
iyaṃ ca te saricchreṣṭhā bibhratī rūpamuttamam |
tatkālaṃ ramaṇīyāṅgī gaṅgā paricariṣyati || 1.53.40 ||
anayā saha jāhnavyā modamāno mamā''jñayā |
imaṃ salilasaṃklaṃdaṃ vismariṣyasi sāgara || 41 ||
tvaratā caiva kartavyaṃ tvayedaṃ mama śāsanam |
prājāpatyena vidhinā gaṅgayā saha sāgara || 42 ||
vasavaḥ pracyutāḥ svargāt praviṣṭāśca rasātalam |
teṣāmutpādanārthāya tvaṃ mayā viniyojitaḥ || 43 ||
aṣṭau tāñjāhnavī garbhānapatyārthaṃ dadhātviyam |
vibhāvasostulyaguṇānsurāṇāṃ prītivardhanān || 44 ||
utpādya tvaṃ vasūñchīghraṃ kṛtvā kurukulaṃ mahat |
praveṣṭāsi tanuṃ tyaktvā punaḥ sāgara sāgarīm || 45 ||
evametanmayā pūrvaṃ hitārthaṃ vaḥ surottamāḥ |
bhaviṣyaṃ paśyatā bhāraṃ pṛthivyāḥ pārthivātmakam|| 46 ||
tadeṣa śāntanorvaṃśaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ropito mayā |
vasavo ye ca gaṅgāyāmutpannāstridivaukasaḥ || 47 ||
adyāpi bhuvi gāṅgeyastatraiva vasuraṣṭamaḥ |
sapteme vasavaḥ prāptāḥ sa ekaḥ parilambate || 48 ||
dvitīyāyāṃ sa sṛṣṭāyāṃ dvitīyā śāntanostanuḥ |
vicitravīryo dyutimānāsīd rājā pratāpavān || 49 ||
vaicitravīryau dvāveva pārthivau bhuvi sāmpratam |
dhṛtarāṣṭraśca pāṇḍuśca vikhyātau puruṣarṣabhau || 1.53.50 ||
tatra pāṇḍoḥ śriyā juṣṭe dve bhārye sambabhūvatuḥ |
śubhe kuntī ca mādrī ca devayoṣopame tu te || 51 ||
dhṛtarāṣṭrasya rājñastu bhāryaikā tulyacāriṇī |

sabaleṣu narendreṣu śāntayatsvitaretaram |

śiṣyaṃ pravartate paścād yugaṃ dāruṇadarśanam || 59 ||
adharmaprāyapuruṣaṃ svalpadharmapratigraham |
utsannasatyasaṃyogaṃ vardhitānṛtasaṃcayam || 1.53.60 ||
maheśvaraṃ kumāraṃ ca dvau ca devau samāśritāḥ |
bhaviṣyanti narāḥ sarve loke na sthavirāyuṣaḥ || 61 ||
tadeṣa nirṇayaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ pārthivāntakaḥ |
aṃśāvataraṇaṃ sarve surāḥ kuruta mā ciram || 62 ||
dharmasyāṃśastu kuntyāṃ vai mādrayāṃ ca viniyujyatām |
vigrahasya kalirmūlaṃ gāndhāryāṃ viniyujyatām || 63 ||
etau pakṣau bhaviṣyanti rājānaḥ kālacoditāḥ |
jātarāgāḥ pṛthivyarthe sarve saṃgrāmalālasāḥ || 64 ||
gacchatviyaṃ vasumatī svāṃ yoniṃ lokadhāriṇī |

tatoṃ'śānavaniṃ devāḥ sarva evāvatārayan || 69 ||

ayonijā yonijāśca te devāḥ pṛthivītale || 1.53.70 ||
daityadānavahantāraḥ sambhūtāḥ puruṣeśvarāḥ |
kṣīrikāvṛkṣasaṃkāśā vajrasaṃhananāstathā || 71 ||
nāgāyutabalāḥ kecitkecidoghabalānvitāḥ |
gadāparighaśaktīnāṃ sahāḥ parighabāhavaḥ || 72 ||
giriśṛṅgaprahartāraḥ sarve parighayodhinaḥ |
vṛṣṇivaṃśasamutpannāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 73 ||
kuruvaṃśe ca te devāḥ pañcāleṣu ca pārthivāḥ |
yājñikānāṃ samṛddhānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca yoniṣu || 74 ||
sarvāstrajñā maheṣvāsā vedavrataparāyaṇāḥ |
sarvarddhiguṇasampannā yajvānaḥ puṇyakarmiṇaḥ || |75 ||
ācālayeyurye śailān kruddhā bhindyurmahītalam |
utpateyurathākāśaṃ kṣobhayeyurmahodadhim || 76 ||
evamādiśya tān sarvān bhūtabhavyabhavatprabhuḥ |
nārāyaṇe samāveśya lokāñchāntimupāgamat|| 77 ||
bhūyaḥ śṛṇu yathā viṣṇuravatīrṇo mahītale |
prajānāṃ vai hitārthāya prabhuḥ prāṇihiteśvaraḥ || 78 ||
yayātivaṃśajasyātha vasudevasya dhīmataḥ |
kule pūjye yaśaskarmā jajñe nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 79 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi devānāmaṃśāvataraṇe tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 53 ||

<1.54>

catuṣpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
kṛtakārye gate kāle jagatyāṃ ca yathānayam |

purī pṛthivyāṃ muditā mathurānāmataḥ śrutā |

pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāya
vaiśampāyana uvāca
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā sasmitaṃ madhusūdanaḥ |
pratyuvāca śubhaṃ vākyaṃ vareṇyaḥ prabhurīśvaraḥ || 1 ||
trailokyasya hitārthāya yanmāṃ vadasi nārada |
tasya samyakpravṛttasya śrūyatāmuttaraṃ vacaḥ || 2 ||
viditā dehino jātā mayaite bhuvi dānavāḥ |
yāṃ ca yastanumādāya daityaḥ puṣyati vigraham || 3 ||
jānāmi kaṃsaṃ sambhūtamugrasenasutaṃ bhuvi |
keśinaṃ cāpi jānāmi daityaṃ turagavigraham || 4 ||
nāgaṃ kuvalayāpīḍaṃ mallau cāṇūramuṣṭikau |
ariṣṭaṃ cāpi jānāmi daityaṃ vṛṣabharūpiṇam||5||

sā ca me viditā vipra pūtanā duhitā baleḥ || 6 ||
kāliyaṃ cāpi jānāmi yamunāhradagocaram |
vainateyabhayād yastu yamunāhradamāviśat || 7 ||
vidito me jarāsaṃdhaḥ sthito mūrdhni mahīkṣitām |
prāgjyotiṣapure vāpi narakaṃ sādhu tarkaye || 8 ||
mānuṣe pārthive loke mānuṣatvamupāgatam|
bāṇaṃ ca śoṇitapure guhapratimatejasam|| 9 ||
dṛptaṃ bāhusahasreṇa devairapi sudurjayama|
mayyāsaktāṃ ca jānāmi bhāratīṃ mahatīṃ dhuram||1.55.10||
sarvaṃ tacca vijānāmi yathā yotsyanti te nṛpāḥ |

eṣāṃ puruṣadehānāmaparāvṛttadehinām gaṃ 11 ||

tānahaṃ samare hanyāṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha || 17 ||
brahmovāca
nārāyaṇemaṃ siddhārthamupāyaṃ śṛṇu me vibho |

yatra tvaṃ ca mahābāho jātaḥ kulakaro bhuvi |
yādavānāṃ mahad vaṃśamakhilaṃ dhārayiṣyasi || 19 ||
tāṃścāsurānsamutpāṭya vaṃśaṃ kṛtvā''tmano mahat|
sthāpayiṣyasi maryādāṃ nṛṇāṃ tanme niśāmaya || 1.55.20 ||
purā hi kaśyapo viṣṇo varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ |
jahāra yajñiyā gā vai payodāstu mahāmakhe || 21 ||
aditiḥ surabhiścaite dve bhārye kaśyapasya tu |
pradīyamānā gāstāstu naicchatāṃ varuṇasya vai || 22 ||
tato māṃ varuṇo'bhyetya praṇamya śirasā tataḥ |
uvāca bhagavan gāvo guruṇā me hṛtā iti || 23 ||
kṛtakāryo hi gāstāstu nānujānāti me guruḥ |
anvavartata bhārye dve aditiṃ surabhiṃ tathā || 24 ||
mama tā hyakṣayā gāvo divyāḥ kāmaduhaḥ prabho |
caranti sāgarān sarvānrakṣitāḥ svena tejasā|| 25 ||
kastā dharṣayituṃ śakto mama gāḥ kaśyapādṛte |
akṣayaṃ vā kṣarantyagryaṃ payo devāmṛtopamam || 26 ||
prabhurvā vyutthito brahman gururvā yadi vetaraḥ |
