yadi prabhavatāṃ daṇḍo loke kāryamajānatām |
na vidyate lokaguro na syurvai lokasetavaḥ || 28 ||
yathā vāstu tathā vāstu kartavye bhagavān prabhuḥ |
mama gāvaḥ pradīyantāṃ tato gantāsmi sāgaram || 29 ||
yā ātmadevatā gāvo yā gāvaḥ sattvamavyayam |
lokānāṃ tvatpravṛttānāmekaṃ gobrāhmaṇaṃ smṛtam| 1.55.30 ||
trātavyāḥ prathamaṃ gāvastrātāstrāyanti tā dvijān |
gobrāhmaṇaparitrāṇe paritrātaṃ jagad bhavet || 31 ||
ityambupatinā prokto varuṇenāhamacyuta |
gavāṃ kāraṇatattvajñaḥ kaśyape śāpamutsṛjam || 32 ||
yenāṃśena hṛtā gāvaḥ kaśyapena maharṣiṇā |
sa tenāṃśena jagatīṃ gatvā gopatvameṣyati || 33 ||
yā ca sā surabhirnāma aditiśca surāraṇiḥ |
te'pyubhe tasya bhārye vai tenaiva saha yāsyataḥ || 34 ||
tābhyāṃ ca saha gopatve kaśyapo bhuvi raṃsyate |
sa tasya kaśyapasyāṃśastejasā kaśyapopamaḥ || 35 ||
vasudeva iti khyāto goṣu tiṣṭhati bhūtale |
girirgovardhano nāma mathurāyāstvadūrataḥ || 36 ||
tatrāsau goṣu nirataḥ kaṃsasya karadāyakaḥ |
tasya bhāryādvayaṃ jātamaditiḥ surabhiśca te || 37 ||
devakī rohiṇī ceme vasudevasya dhīmataḥ |
surabhī rohiṇī devī cāditirdevakī tvabhūt || 38 ||
tatra tvaṃ śiśurevāṅkau gopālakṛtalakṣaṇaḥ |
vardhayasva mūhābāho purā traivikrame yathā || 39 ||
chādayitvā''tmanā''tmānaṃ māyayā yogarūpayā |
tatrāvatara lokānāṃ bhavāya madhusūdana || 1.55.40 ||
jayāśīrvacanaistvete vardhayanti divaukasaḥ |
ātmānamātmanā hi tvamavatārya mahītale || 41 ||
devakīṃ rohiṇīṃ caiva garbhābhyāṃ paritoṣaya |
gopakanyāsahasrāṇi ramayaṃścara medinīm || 42 ||
gāśca te rakṣato viṣṇo vanāni paridhāvataḥ |
vanamālāparikṣiptaṃ dhanyā drakṣyanti te vapuḥ || 43 ||
viṣṇau padmapalāśākṣe gopālavasatiṃ gate |
bāle tvayi mahābāho loko bālatvameṣyati || 44 ||
tvadbhaktāḥ puṇḍarīkākṣa tava cittavaśānugāḥ|
goṣu gopā bhaviṣyanti sahāyāḥ satataṃ tava || 45 ||
vane cārayato gāśca goṣṭheṣu paridhāvataḥ |
majjato yamunāyāṃ ca ratiṃ prāpsyanti te tvayi || 46 ||
jīvitaṃ vasudevasya bhaviṣyati sujīvitam |
yastvayā tāta ityuktaḥ sa putra iti vakṣyati || 47 ||
athavā kasya putratvaṃ gacchethāḥ kaśyapādṛte |
kā ca dhārayituṃ śaktā tvāṃ viṣṇo aditiṃ vinā || 48 ||
yogenātmasamutthena gaccha tvaṃ vijayāya vai |
vayamapyālayānsvānsvāngacchāmo madhusūdana|| 49 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
sa devānabhyanujñāya vivikte tridivālaye |
jagāma viṣṇuḥ svaṃ deśaṃ kṣīrodasyottarāṃ diśam || 1.55.50 ||
tatra vai pārvatī nāma guhā meroḥ sudurgamā |
tribhistasyaiva vikrāntairnityaṃ parvasu pūjitā || 51 ||
purāṇaṃ tatra vinyasya dehaṃ harirudāradhīḥ |
ātmānaṃ yojayāmāsa vasudevagṛhe prabhuḥ || 52 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe harivaṃśaparvaṇi pitāmahavākye pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||55||
harivaṃśaparva sampūrṇa |

<2>

śrīparamātmane namaḥ
śrīmahābhāratam
tasya khilabhāgo harivaṃśaḥ
(tatra viṣṇuparva)

<2.1>

prathamo'dhyāyaḥ
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam |
devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
jñātvā viṣṇuṃ kṣitigataṃ bhāgāṃśca tridivaukasām |
vināśaśaṃsī kaṃsasya nārado mathurāṃ yayau || 1 ||
triviṣṭapādāpatito mathuropavane sthitaḥ |
preṣayāmāsa kaṃsasya dūtaṃ sa munipuṅgavaḥ || 2 |
sa dūtaḥ kathayāmāsa munerāgamanaṃ vane |
sa nāradasyāgamanaṃ śrutvā tvaritavikramaḥ || 3 ||
nirjagāmāsuraḥ kaṃsaḥ svapuryāḥ padmalocanaḥ |
sa dadarśātithiṃ ślāghyaṃ devarṣiṃ vītakalmaṣam || 4 ||
tejasā jvalanākāraṃ vapuṣā sūryavarcasam |
so'bhivādyarṣaye tasmai pūjāṃ cakre yathāvidhi || 5 ||
āsanaṃ cāgnivarṇābhaṃ visṛjyopajahāra saḥ |
niṣasādāsane tasmin sa vai śakrasakho muniḥ || 6 ||
uvāca cograsenasya sutaṃ paramakopanam |
pūjito'haṃ tvayā vīra vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 7 ||
yate tvevaṃ mama vacaḥ śrūyatāṃ gṛhyatāṃ tvayā |
anusṛtya divolokānahaṃ brahmapurogamān || 8 ||
gataḥ sūryasakhaṃ tāta vipulaṃ meruparvatam|
sanandanavanaṃ caiva dṛṣṭvā caitrarathaṃ vanam || 9 ||
āplutaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu saritsu saha daivataiḥ |
divyā tridhārā dṛṣṭā me puṇyā tripathagā nadī || 2.1.10 ||
smaraṇādeva sarveṣāmaṃhasā yā vibhedinī |
upaspṛṣṭaṃ ca tīrtheṣu divyeṣu ca yathākramam || 11
dṛṣṭaṃ me brahmasadanaṃ brahmarṣigaṇasevitam|
devagandharvanirghoṣairapsarobhiśca nāditam || 12 ||
so'haṃ kadācid devānāṃ samāje merumūrdhani |
saṃgṛhya vīṇāṃ saṃsaktāmagacchaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sabhām || 13 ||
so'haṃ tatra sitoṣṇīṣān nānāratnavibhūṣitān |
divyāsanagatān devānapaśyaṃ sapitāmahān || 14 ||
tatra mantrayatāmevaṃ devatānāṃ mayā śrutaḥ |
bhavataḥ sānugasyaiva vadhopāyaḥ sudāruṇaḥ || 15 ||
tatraiṣā devakī yā te mathurāyāṃ laghusvasā |
yo'syāṃ garbho'ṣṭamaḥ kaṃsa sa te mṛtyurbhaviṣyati || 16 ||
devānāṃ sa tu sarvasvaṃ tridivasya gatiśca saḥ |
paraṃ rahasyaṃ devānāṃ sa te mṛtyurbhaviṣyati || 17 ||
paraścaivāparasteṣāṃ svayambhūśca divaukasām|
tataste tanmahadbhūtaṃ divyaṃ ca kathayābhyaham || 18 ||
ślāghyaśca sa hi te mṛtyurbhūtapūrvaśca taṃ smara |
yatnaśca kriyatāṃ kaṃsa devakyā garbhakṛntane || 19 ||
eṣā me tvadgatā prītiryadarthaṃ cāhamāgataḥ |
bhujyantāṃ sarvakāmārthāḥ svasti te'stu vrajāmyaham|2.1.20|
ityuktvā nārade yāte tasya vākyaṃ vicintayan |
jahāsoccaistataḥ kaṃsaḥ prakāśadaśanaściram || 21 ||
provāca sasmitaṃ caiva bhṛtyānāmagrataḥ sthitaḥ |
hāsyaḥ khalu sa sarveṣu nārado na viśāradaḥ || 22 ||
nāhaṃ bhīṣayituṃ śakyo devairapi savāsavaiḥ |
āsanasthaḥ śayāno vā pramatto matta eva ca || 231
yo'haṃ dorbhyāmudārābhyāṃ kṣobhayeyaṃ dharāmimām |
ko'sti māṃ mānuṣe loke yaḥ kṣobhayitumutsahet || 24 ||
adyaprabhṛti devānāmevaṃ devānuvartinām |
nṛpakṣipaśusaṃghānāṃ karomi kadanaṃ mahat || 25 ||
ājñāpyatāṃ hayaḥ keśī pralambo dhenukastathā |
ariṣṭo vṛṣabhaścaiva pūtanā kāliyastathā || 26 ||
aṭadhvaṃ pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ yatheṣṭaṃ kāmarūpiṇaḥ |
praharadhvaṃ ca sarveṣu ye'smākaṃ pakṣadūṣakāḥ || 27 ||
garbhasthānāmapi gatirvijñeyā caiva dehinām |
nāradena hi garbhebhyo bhayaṃ naḥ samudāhṛtam || 28 ||
bhavanto hi yathākāmaṃ modantāṃ vigatajvarāḥ |
māṃ ca vo nāthamāśritya nāsti devakṛtaṃ bhayam || 29 ||
sa tu kelikilo vipro bhedaśīlaśca nāradaḥ |
suśliṣṭānapi loke'smin bhedayam̐llabhate ratim || 2.1.30 ||
kaṇḍūyamānaḥ satataṃ lokānaṭati cañcalaḥ |
ghaṭamāno narendrāṇāṃ tantraivarāṇi caiva hi || 31 ||
evaṃ sa vilapanneva vāṅmātreṇaiva kevalam |
viveśa kaṃso bhavanaṃ dahyamānena cetasā || 32 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi nāradāgamane kaṃsavākye prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||

<2.2>

dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
so'jñāpayatasaṃrabdhaḥ sacivānānmano hi tān |
yattā bhavata sarve vai devakyā garbhakṛntane || 1 ||
prathamādeva hantavyā garbhāste sapta eva hi |
mūlādeva tu hantavyaḥ so'nartho yatra saṃśayaḥ || 2 ||
devakī ca gṛhe guptā pracchannairabhirakṣitā |
svairaṃ caratu viśrabdhā garbhakāle tu rakṣyatām || 3 ||
māsān vai puṣpamāsādīngaṇayantu mama striyaḥ |
pariṇāme tu garbhasya śeṣaṃ jñāsyāmahe vayam || 4 ||
vasudevastu saṃrakṣyaḥ strīsanāthāsu bhūmiṣu |
apramattairmama hitai rātrāvahani caiva hi |
strībhirvarṣavaraiścaiva vaktavyaṃ na tu kāraṇam || 5 ||
eṣa mānuṣyako yatno mānuṣaireva sādhyate |
śrūyatāṃ yena daivaṃ hi madvidhaiḥ pratihanyate || 6 ||
mantragrāmaiḥ suvihitairauṣadhaiśca suyojitaiḥ |
yastena cānukūlena daivamapyanulomyate || 7 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evaṃ sa yatnavān kaṃso devakīgarbhakṛntane |
bhayena mantrayāmāsa śrutārtho nāradātsa vai || 8 ||
evaṃ śrutvā prayatnaṃ vai kaṃsasyāriṣṭasaṃjñitam |
antardhānaṃ gato viṣṇuścintayāmāsa vīryavān || 9 ||
saptemān devakīgarbhān bhojaputro vadhiṣyati |
aṣṭame ca mayā garbhe kāryamādhānamātmanaḥ || 2.2.10 ||
tasya cintayatastvevaṃ pātālamagamanmanaḥ |
yatra te garbhaśayanāḥ ṣaḍgarbhā nāma dānavāḥ || 11 ||
vikrāntavapuṣo dīptāste'mṛtaprāśanopamāḥ |
amarapratimā yuddhe putrā vai kālaneminaḥ || 12 ||
te tātatātaṃ saṃtyajya hiraṇyakaśipuṃ purā |
upāsāṃcakrire daityāḥ purā lokapitāmaham || 13 ||
tapyamānāstapastīvraṃ jaṭāmaṇḍaladhāriṇaḥ |
teṣāṃ prīto'bhavad brahmā ṣaḍgarbhāṇāṃ varaṃ dadau || 14 ||
brahmovāca
bho bho dānavaśārdūlāstapasāhaṃ sutoṣitaḥ |
brūta vo yasya yaḥ kāmastasya taṃ taṃ karomyaham || 15 ||
te tu sarve samānārthā daityā brahmāṇamabruvan |
yadi no bhagavān prīto dīyatāṃ no varo varaḥ || 16 ||
avadhyāḥ syāma bhagavan daivataiḥ samahoragaiḥ |
śāpapraharaṇaiścaiva svasti no'stu maharṣibhiḥ || 17 |
yakṣagandharvapatibhiḥ siddhacāraṇamānavaiḥ |
mā bhūd vadho no bhagavandadāsi yadi no varam|| 18
tānuvāca tato brahmā suprītenāntarātmanā |
bhavadbhiryadidaṃ proktaṃ sarvametad bhaviṣyati || 19 ||
ṣaḍgarbhāṇāṃ varaṃ dattvā svayambhūstridivaṃ gataḥ |
tato hiraṇyakaśiṣuḥ saroṣo vākyamabravīt || 2.2.20 ||
māmunmṛjya varo yasmāddhṛto vaḥ padmasambhavāt|
tasmād vastyājitaḥ snehaḥ śatrubhūtāṃstyajāmyaham|21||
ṣaṅgarbhā iti yo'yaṃ vaḥ śabdaḥ pitrābhivardhitaḥ |
sa eva vo garbhagatān pitā sarvānvadhiṣyati || 22 ||
ṣaḍeva devakīgarbhe ṣaḍgarbhā vai mahāsurāḥ |
bhaviṣyatha tataḥ kaṃso garbhasthānvo vadhiṣyati || 23 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
jagāmātha tato viṣṇuḥ pātālaṃ yatra te'surāḥ |
ṣaṅgarbhāḥ saṃyatāḥ santi jale garbhagṛheśayāḥ || 24 ||
saṃdadarśa jale suptān ṣaḍgarbhān garbhasaṃsthitān|
nidrayā kālarūpiṇyā sarvānantarhitānsa vai || 25 ||
svapnarūpeṇa teṣāṃ vai viṣṇurdehānathāviśat|
prāṇeśvarāṃśca niṣkṛṣya nidrāyai pradadau tadā || 26 ||
tāṃ covāca tato nidrāṃ viṣṇuḥ satyaparākramaḥ |
gaccha nidre mayotsṛṣṭā devakībhavanāntikam || 27 ||
imānprāṇeśvarān gṛhya ṣaḍgarbhān dānavottamān |
ṣaṅgarbhān devakogarbhe yojayasva yathākramam || 28 ||
jāteṣveteṣu garbheṣu nīteṣu ca yamakṣayam|
kaṃsasya viphale yatne devakyāḥ saphale śrame || 29 ||
prasādaṃ te kariṣyāmi matprabhāvasamaṃ bhuvi |
yena sarvasya lokasya devi devī bhaviṣyasi || 2.2.30 ||
saptamo devakīgarbho yoṃ'śaḥ saumyo mamāgrajaḥ |
sa saṃkrāmayitavyaste saptame māsi rohiṇīm || 31 ||
saṃkarṣaṇāttu garbhasya sa tu saṃkarṣaṇo yuvā |
bhaviṣyatyagrajo bhrātā mama śītāṃśudarśanaḥ||32
patito devakīgarbhaḥ saptamo'yaṃ bhayāditi |
aṣṭame mayi garbhasthe kaṃso yatnaṃ kariṣyati || 33 ||
yā tu sā nandagopasya dayitā bhuvi viśrutā |
yaśodā nāma bhadraṃ te bhāryā gopakulodvahā || 34 ||
tasyāstvaṃ navamo garbhaḥ kule'smākaṃ bhaviṣyasi |
navamyāmeva saṃjātā kṛṣṇapakṣasya vai tithau || 35 ||
ahaṃ tvabhijito yoge niśāyāṃ yauvane sthite |
ardharātre kariṣyāmi garbhamokṣaṃ yathāsukham || 36 ||
aṣṭamasya tu māsasya jātāvāvāṃ tataḥ samam |
prāpsyāvo garbhavyatyāsaṃ prāpte kaṃsasya nāśane || 37 ||
ahaṃ yaśodāṃ yāsyāmi tvaṃ devi bhaja devakīm |
āvayorgarbhasaṃyoge kaṃso gacchatu mūḍhatām || 38 ||
tatastvāṃ gṛhya caraṇe śilāyāṃ pātayiṣyati |
nirasyamānā gagane sthānaṃ prāpsyasi śāśvatam|| 39 ||
macchavīsadṛśī kṛṣṇā saṃkarṣaṇasamānanā |
bibhratī vipulau bāhūpamau divi || 2.2.40 ||
triśikhaṃ śūlamudyamya khaḍgaṃ ca kanakatsarum |
pātrīṃ ca pūrṇaṃ madhunā paṅkajaṃ ca sunirmalam || 41 ||
nīlakauśeyasaṃvītā pītenottaravāsasā |
śaśirasmiprakāśena hāreṇorasi rājatā || 42 ||
divyakuṇḍalapūrṇābhyāṃ śravaṇābhyāṃ vibhūṣitā |
candrasāpatnabhūtena mukhena tvaṃ virājitā || 43 ||
mukuṭena vicitreṇa keśabandhena śobhinā |
bhujaṅgābhairbhujairbhīmairbhūṣayantī diśo daśa || 44||
dhvajena śikhibarheṇa ucchritena virājatā |
aṅgajena mayūrāṇāmaṅgadena ca bhāsvatā || 45 ||
kīrṇā bhūtagaṇairghorairmanniyogānuvartinī |
kaumāraṃ vratamāsthāya tridivaṃ tvaṃ gamiṣyasi || 46 ||
tatra tvāṃ śatadṛkchakro matpradiṣṭena karmaṇā |
abhiṣekeṇa divyena daivataiḥ saha yokṣyase || 47 ||
tatraiva tvāṃ bhaginyarthe grahīṣyati sa vāsavaḥ |
kuśikasya tu gotreṇa kauśikī tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 48 ||
sa te vindhye nagaśreṣṭhe sthānaṃ dāsyati śāśvatam |
tataḥ sthānasahasraistvaṃ pṛthivīṃ śobhayiṣyasi || 49 ||
trailokyacāriṇī sā tvaṃ bhuvi satyopayācanā |
cariṣyasi mahābhāge varadā kāmarūpiṇī || 2.2.50 ||
tatra śumbhaniśumbhau dvau dānavau nagacāriṇau |
tau ca kṛtvā manasi māṃ sānugau nāśayiṣyasi || 51||
kṛtvānuyātrāṃ bhūtaistvaṃ surāmāṃsabalipriyā |
tithau navamyāṃ pūjāṃ tvaṃ prāpsyase sapaśukriyām || 52 ||
ye ca tvāṃ matprabhāvajñāḥ praṇamiṣyanti mānavāḥ |
teṣāṃ na durlabhaṃ kiñcit putrato dhanato'pi vā || 53 ||
kāntāreṣvavasannānāṃ magnānāṃ ca mahārṇave |
dasyubhirvā niruddhānāṃ tvaṃ gatiḥ paramā nṛṇām || 54||
tvāṃ tu stoṣyanti ye bhaktyā stavenānena vai śubhe |
tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati || 55 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi bhārāvataraṇe nidrāsaṃvijñāne dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||

<2.3>

tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
āryāstavaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathoktamṛṣibhiḥ purā |
nārāyaṇīṃ namasyāmi devīṃ tribhuvaneśvarīm || 1 ||
tvaṃ hi siddhirdhṛtiḥ kīrtiḥ śrīrvidyā saṃnatirmatiḥ |
saṃdhyā rātriḥ prabhā nidrā kālarātristathaiva ca || 2 ||
āryā kātyāyanī devī kauśikī brahmacāriṇī |
jananī siddhasenasya ugracārī mahābalā || 3 ||
jayā ca vijayā caiva puṣṭistuṣṭiḥ kṣamā dayā |
jyeṣṭhā yamasya bhaginī nīlakauśeyavāsinī || 4||
bahurūpā virūpā ca anekavidhicāriṇī |
virūpākṣī viśālākṣī bhaktānāṃ parirakṣiṇī || 5 ||
parvatāgreṣu ghoreṣu nadīṣu ca guhāsu ca |
vāsaste ca mahādevi vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca || 6 ||
śabarairbarbaraiścaiva pulindaiśca supūjitā |
mayūrapicchadhvajinī lokān kramasi sarvaśaḥ || 7 ||
kukuṭaiśchāgalairmeṣaiḥ siṃhairvyāghraiḥ samākulā |
ghaṇṭāninādabahulā vindhyavāsinyabhiśrutā || 8 ||
triśūlapaṭṭiśadharā sūryacandrapatākinī |
navamī kṛṣṇapakṣasya śuklasyaikādaśī tathā || 9 ||
bhaginī baladevasya rajanī kalahapriyā |
āvāsaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ niṣṭhā ca paramā gatiḥ || 2.3.10 ||
nandagopasutā caiva devānāṃ vijayāvahā |
cīravāsāḥ suvāsāśca raudrī saṃdhyācarī niśā || 11 ||
prakīrṇakeśī mṛtyuśca surāmāṃsabalipriyā |
lakṣmīralakṣmīrūpeṇa dānavānāṃ vadhāya ca ||12 ||
sāvitrī cāpi devānāṃ mātā bhūtagaṇasya ca |
kanyānāṃ brahmacaryaṃ tvaṃ saubhāgyaṃ pramadāsu ca || 13 ||
antarvedī ca yajñānāmṛtvijāṃ caiva dakṣiṇā |
karṣakāṇāṃ ca sīteti bhūtānāṃ dharaṇīti ca || 14 ||
siddhiḥ sāṃyātrikāṇāṃ tu velā tvaṃ sāgarasya ca|| |
yakṣāṇāṃ prathamā yakṣī nāgānāṃ suraseti ca || 15 ||
brahmavādinyatho dīkṣā śobhā ca paramā tathā |
jyotiṣāṃ tvaṃ prabhā devi nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca rohiṇī || 16 ||
rājadvāreṣu tīrtheṣu nadīnāṃ saṅgameṣu ca |
pūrṇā ca pūrṇimā candre kṛttivāsā iti smṛtā || 17 ||
sarasvatī ca vālmīke smṛtirdvaipāyane tathā |
ṛṣīṇāṃ dharmabuddhistu devānāṃ mānasī tathā || 18 ||
surā devī tu bhūteṣu stūyase tvaṃ svakarmabhiḥ |
indrasya cārudṛṣṭistvaṃ sahasranayaneti ca || 19 ||
tāpasānāṃ ca devī tvamaraṇī cāgnihotriṇām|
kṣudhā ca sarvabhūtānāṃ tṛptistvaṃ daivateṣu ca || 2.3.20||
svāhā tṛptirdhṛtirmedhā vasūnāṃ tvaṃ vasūmatī |
āśā tvaṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ ca puṣṭiśca kṛtakarmaṇām|| 21 ||
diśaśca vidiśaścaiva tathā hyagniśikhā prabhā |
śakunī pūtanā tvaṃ ca revatī ca sudāruṇā || 22 ||
nidrāpi sarvabhūtānāṃ mohinī kṣatriyā tathā |
vidyānāṃ brahmavidyā tvamoṅkāro'tha vaṣaṭ tathā || 23 ||
nārīṇāṃ pārvatīṃ ca tvāṃ paurāṇīmṛṣayo viduḥ |
arundhatī ca sādhvīnāṃ prajāpativaco yathā || 24 ||
paryāyanāmabhirdivyairindrāṇī ceti viśrutā |
tvayā vyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam || 25 ||
saṃgrāmeṣu ca sarveṣu agniprajvaliteṣu ca|
nadītīreṣu caureṣu kāntāreṣu bhayeṣu ca ||26||
pravāse rājabandhe ca śatrūṇāṃ ca pramardane|
praṇātyayeṣu sarveṣu tvaṃ hi rakṣā na saṃśayaḥ|| 27||
tvayi me hadayaṃ devi tvayi cittaṃ manastvayi |
rakṣa māṃ sarvapāpebhyaḥ prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || 28 ||
imaṃ yaḥ sustavaṃ divyamiti vyāsaprakalpitam |
yaḥ paṭhet prātarutthāya śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ || 29 ||
tribhirmāsaiḥ kāṅkṣitaṃ ca phalaṃ vai samprayacchasi |
ṣaḍbhirmāsairvariṣṭhaṃ tu varamekaṃ prayacchasi || 2.3.30 ||
arcitā tu tribhirmāsairdivyaṃ cakṣuḥ prayacchasi |
saṃvatsareṇa siddhiṃ tu yathākāmaṃ prayacchasi ||31 ||
satyaṃ brahma ca divyaṃ ca dvaipāyanavaco yathā |
nṛṇāṃ bandhaṃ vadhaṃ ghoraṃ putranāśaṃ dhanakṣayam || 32 ||
vyādhimṛtyubhayaṃ caiva pūjitā śamayiṣyasi |
bhaviṣyasi mahābhāge varadā kāmarūpiṇī || 33 ||
mohayitvā ca taṃ kaṃsamekā tvaṃ bhokṣyase jagat |
ahamapyātmano vṛttiṃ vidhāsye goṣu gopavat || 34 ||
samṛddhyarthamahaṃ caiva kariṣye kaṃsagopatām |
evaṃ tāṃ sa samādiśya gato'ntardhānamīśvaraḥ || 35 ||
sā cāpi taṃ namaskṛtya tathāstviti ca niścitā || 36 ||
yaścaitat paṭhate stotraṃ śṛṇuyād vāpyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ |
sarvārthasiddhiṃ labhate naro nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ || 37 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi svapnagarbhavidhāne āryāstutau tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||

<2.4>

caturtho'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
kṛte garbhavidhāne tu devakī devatopamā |
jagrāha sapta tāngarbhānyathāvat samudāhṛtān || 1 ||
ṣaṅgarbhān nissṛtān kaṃsastāñjaghāna śilātale|
āpantaṃ saptamaṃ garbhaṃ sā nināyātha rohiṇīm || 2 ||
ardharātre sthitaṃ garbhaṃ pātayantī rajasvalā |
nidrayā sahasā''viṣṭā papāta dharaṇītale || 3 ||
sā svapnamiva taṃ dṛṣṭvā garbhaṃ niḥsṛtamātmanaḥ |
apaśyantī ca taṃ garbhaṃ muhūrte vyathitābhavat || 4 ||
tāmāha nidrā saṃvignāṃ naiśe tamasi rohiṇīm|
rohiṇīmiva somasya vasudevasya dhīmataḥ || 5 ||
karṣaṇenāsya garbhasya svagarbhe cāhitasya vai |
saṃkarṣaṇo nāma sutaḥ śubhe tava bhaviṣyati || 6 ||
sā taṃ putramavāpyaivaṃ hṛṣṭā kiñcidavāṅmukhī |
viveśa rohiṇī veśma suprabhā rohiṇī yathā || 7 ||
tasya garbhasya mārgeṇa garbhamādhatta devakī |
yadarthaṃ sapta te garbhāḥ kaṃsena vinipātitāḥ || 8 ||
taṃ tu garbhaṃ prayatnena rarakṣustasya mantriṇaḥ |
so'pyatra garbhavasatau vasatvātmecchayā hariḥ || 9 ||
yaśodāpi samādhatta garbhaṃ tadahareva tu |
viṣṇoḥ śarīrajāṃ nidrāṃ viṣṇunirdeśakāriṇīm || 2.4.10 ||
garbhakāle tvasampūrṇe aṣṭame māsi te striyau |
devakī ca yaśodā ca suṣuvāte samaṃ tadā || 11 ||
yāmeva rajanīṃ kṛṣṇo jajñe vṛṣṇikulodvahaḥ |
tāmeva rajanīṃ kanyāṃ yaśodāpi vyajāyata || 12 ||
nandagopasya bhāryaikā vasudevasya cāparā |
tulyakālaṃ ca garbhiṇyau yaśodā devakī tathā || 13
devakyajanayadviṣṇuṃ yaśodā tāṃ tu dārikām |
muhūrte'bhijiti prāpte sārdharātre vibhūṣite || 14
sāgarāḥ samakampanta celuśca dharaṇīdharāḥ |
jajvaluścāgnayaḥ śāntā jāyamāne janārdane || 15 ||
śivāśca pravavurvātāḥ praśāntamabhavad rajaḥ |
jyotīṃṣyativyakāśanta jāyamāne janārdane || 16 ||
abhijinnāma nakṣatraṃ jayantī nāma śarvarī |
muhūrto vijayo nāma yatra jāto janārdanaḥ || 17 ||
avyaktaḥ śāśvataḥ sūkṣmo harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
jāyamāno hi bhagavānnayanairmohayan prabhuḥ || 18 ||
anāhatā dundubhayo devānāṃ prāṇadan divi |
ākāśāt puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ ca vavarṣa tridaśeśvaraḥ || 19 ||
gīrbhirmaṅgalayuktābhiḥ stuvanto madhusūdanam|
maharṣayaḥ sagandharvā upatasthuḥ sahāpsarāḥ || 2.4.20 |
jāyamāne hṛṣīkeśe prahṛṣṭamabhavajjagat|
indraśca tridaśaiḥ sārdhaṃ tuṣṭāva madhusūdanam || 21 ||
vasudevaśca taṃ rātrau jātaṃ putramadhokṣajam |
śrīvatsalakṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā yutaṃ divyaiśca lakṣaṇaiḥ |
uvāca vasudevastu rūpaṃ saṃhara vai prabho || 22 ||
bhīto'haṃ deva kaṃsasya tasmādevaṃ bravīmyaham |
mama putrā hatāstena tava jyeṣṭhāmbujekṣaṇa || 23 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
vasudevavacaḥ śrutvā rūpaṃ cāharadacyutaḥ |
anujñāpya pitṛtvena nandagopagṛhaṃ naya || 24 ||
vasudevastu saṃgṛhya dārakaṃ kṣiprameva ca |
yaśodāyā gṛhaṃ rātrau viveśa sutavatsalaḥ || 25
yaśodāyāstvavijñātastatra nikṣipya dārakam|
pragṛhya dārikāṃ caiva devakīśayane nyasat || 26 ||
parivarte kṛte tābhyāṃ garbhābhyāṃ bhayaviklavaḥ |
vasudevaḥ kṛtārtho vai nirjagāma niveśanāt || 27||
ugrasenasutāyātha kaṃsāyānakadundubhiḥ|
nivedayāmāsa tadā tāṃ kanyāṃ varavarṇinīm || 28||
tacchrutvā tvaritaḥ kaṃso rakṣibhiḥ saha vegibhiḥ |
ājagāma gṛhadvāraṃ vasudevasya vīryavān || 29 ||
sa tatra tvaritaṃ dvāri kiṃ jātamiti cābravīt |
dayitāṃ śīghramityevaṃ vāgbhiḥ samabhitarjayat ||2.4.30||
tato hāhākṛtāḥ sarvā devakībhavane striyaḥ |
uvāca devakī dīnā bāṣpagadgadayā girā || 31 ||
dārikā tu prajāteti kaṃsaṃ samabhiyācatī |
śrīmanto me hatāḥ sapta putragarbhāstvayā vibho || 32 ||
dārikeyaṃ hataivaiṣā paśyasva yadi manyase |
dṛṣṭvā kaṃsastu tāṃ kanyāmākṛṣyata mudā yutaḥ || 33 ||
hataivaiṣā yadā kanyā jātetyuktvā vṛthāmatiḥ |
sā garbhaśayane kliṣṭā garbhāmbuklinnamūrdhajā || 34 ||
kaṃsasya purato nyastā pṛthivyāṃ pṛthivīsamā |
sa caināṃ gṛhya puruṣaḥ khamāvidhyāvadhūya ca || 35 ||
udyacchanneva sahasā śilāyāṃ samapothayat |
sāvadhūtā śilāpṛṣṭhe'niṣpiṣṭā divamutpatat || 36 ||
hitvā garbhatanuṃ sā tu sahasā muktamūrdhajā |
jagāma kasamādiśya divyasraganulepanā || 37 ||
hāraśobhitasarvāṅgī mukuṭojjvalabhūṣitā |
kanyaiva sābhavannityaṃ divyā devairabhiṣṭutā || 38 ||
nīlapītāmbaradharā gajakumbhopamastanī |
rathavistīrṇajaghanā candravaktrā caturbhujā || 39
vidyudvispaṣṭavarṇābhā bālārkasadṛśekṣaṇā |
payodharastanavatī saṃdhyeva sapayo dharā || 2.4.40 ||
sā vai niśi tamograste babhau bhūtagaṇākule |
nṛtyatī hasatī caiva viparītena bhāsvatī || 41 ||
vihāyasi gatā raudrā papau pānamanuttamam |
jahāsa ca mahāhāsaṃ kaṃsaṃ ca ruṣitābravīt || 42||
kaṃsa kaṃsātmanāśāya yadahaṃ ghātitā tvayā |
sahasā ca samutkṣipya śilāyāmabhipothitā || 43 ||
tasmāttavāntakāle'haṃ kṛṣyamāṇasya śatruṇā |
pāṭayitvā karairdehamuṣṇaṃ pāsyāmi śoṇitam || 44 ||
evamuktvā vaco ghoraṃ sā yatheṣṭena vartmanā |
khaṃ sā devālayaṃ devī sagaṇā vicacāra ha || 45 ||
sā kanyā vavṛdhe tatra vṛṣṇisaṃghasupūjitā |
putravat pālyamānā sā vasudevājñayā tadā || 46 |
viddhi caināmathotpannāmaṃśād devīṃ prajāpateḥ |
ekānaṃśāṃ yogakanyāṃ rakṣārthaṃ keśavasya tu || 47 ||
tāṃ vai sarve sumanasaḥ pūjayanti sma yādavāḥ |
devavad divyavapuṣā kṛṣṇaḥ saṃrakṣito yayā || 48 ||
tasyāṃ gatāyāṃ kaṃsastu tāṃ mene mṛtyumātmanaḥ |
vivikte devakīṃ caiva vrīḍitaḥ samabhāṣata || 49 ||
kaṃsa uvāca
mṛtyoḥ svasaḥ kṛto yatnastava garbhā mayā hatāḥ |
anya evānyato devi mama mṛtyurupasthitaḥ || 2.4.50 |
nairāśyena kṛto yatnaḥ svajane prahṛtaṃ mayā |
daivaṃ puruṣakāreṇa na cātikrāntavānaham || 51 ||
tyaja garbhakṛtāṃ cintāṃ saṃtāpaṃ putrajaṃ tyaja |
hetubhūtastvahaṃ teṣāṃ sati kālaviparyaye || 52 ||
kāla eva nṛṇāṃ śatruḥ kālaśca pariṇāmakaḥ |
kālo nayati sarvaṃ vai hetubhūtastu madvidhaḥ || 53 ||
āgamiṣyanti vai devi yathābhāgamupadravāḥ |
idaṃ tu kaṣṭaṃ yajjantuḥ kartāhamiti manyate || 54 ||
mā kārṣīḥ putrajāṃ cintāṃ vilāpaṃ śokajaṃ tyaja |
evaṃ prāyo nṛṇāṃ yonirnāsti kālasya saṃsthitiḥ|| 55 ||
eṣa te pādayormūrdhnā putravat tava devaki |
madgatastyajyatāṃ roṣo jānāmyapakṛtaṃ tvayi || 56 ||
ityuktavantaṃ kaṃsaṃ sā devakī vākyamabravīt |
sāśrupūrṇamukhā dīnā bhartāramupavīkṣatī |
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha vatseti kaṃsaṃ māteva jalpatī || 57 ||
devakyuvāca
mamāgrato hatā garbhā ye tvayā kāmarūpiṇā |
kāraṇaṃ tvaṃ na vai putra kṛtānto'pyatra kāraṇam || 58 ||
garbhakartanametanme sahanīyaṃ tvayā kṛtam |
pādayoḥ patatā mūrdhnā svaṃ ca karma jugupsatā || 59 ||
garbhe ca niyato mṛtyurbālye'pi na nivartate |
yuvāpi mṛtyorvaśagaḥ sthaviro mṛta eva tu || 2.4.60 ||
kālapakvamidaṃ sarvaṃ hetubhūtastu tvadvidhaḥ |
ajñāte darśanaṃ nāsti yathā vāyustathaiva ca || 61 ||
jāto'pyajātatāṃ yāti vidhātrā yatra nīyate |
tad gaccha putra mā te bhūnmadgataṃ mṛtyukāraṇam || 62 ||
mṛtyunā prahṛte pūrvaṃ śeṣo hetuḥ pravartate |
vidhinā pūrvadṛṣṭena prajāsargeṇa tattvataḥ || 63 ||
mātāpitrostu kāryeṇa janmatastūpapadyate |
vaiśampāyana uvāca
niśamya devakīvākyaṃ sa kaṃsaḥ svaṃ niveśanam || 64 ||
praviveśa sasaṃrabdho dahyamānena cetasā |
kṛtye pratihate dīno jagāma vimanā bhṛśam || 69 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇajanmani caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||

<2.5>

pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
prāgeva vasudevastu vraje śuśrāva rohiṇīm |
prajñātāṃ putramevāgre candrāt kāntatarānanam|| 1 ||
sa nandagopaṃ tvaritaḥ provāca śubhayā girā|
gacchānayā sahaiva tvaṃ vrajameva yaśodayā||2||
tatra tau dārakau gatvā jātakarmādibhirguṇaiḥ |
yojayitvā vraje tāta saṃvardhaya yathāsukham || 3 ||
rauhiṇeyaṃ ca putraṃ me parirakṣa śiśuṃ vraje |
ahaṃ vācyo bhaviṣyāmi pitṛpakṣeṣu putriṇām || 4 ||
yo'hamekasya putrasya na paśyāmi śiśormukham |
hriyate hi balātprajñā prājñasyāpi sato mama || 5 ||
asmāddhi me bhayaṃ kaṃsānnirghṛṇād vai śiśorvadhe |
tadyathā rauhiṇeyaṃ tvaṃ nandagopa mamātmajam || 6 ||
gopāyasi yathā tāta tattvānveṣī tathā kuru |
vighnā hi bahavo loke bālānuttrāsayanti hi || 7||
sa ca putro mama jyāyān kanīyāṃśca tathāpyayam |
ubhāvapi samaṃ nāmnā nirīkṣasva yathāsukham || 8 ||
vardhamānāmubhāvetau samānavayasau yathā |
śobhetāṃ govraje tasmin nandagopa tathā kuru ||9 ||
bālye kelikilaḥ sarvo bālye muhyati mānavaḥ |
bālye caṇḍatamaḥ sarvastatra yatnaparo bhava || 2.5.10 ||
na ca vṛndāvane kāryo gavāṃ ghoṣaḥ kathaṃcana |
bhetavyaṃ tatra vasataḥ keśinaḥ pāpadarśinaḥ || 11 ||
sarīsṛpebhyaḥ kīṭebhyaḥ śakunibhyastathaiva ca |
goṣṭheṣu gobhyo vatsebhyo rakṣyau te dvāvimau śiśū|| 12||
nandagopa gatā rātriḥ śīghrayāno vrajāśugaḥ |
ime tvāṃ vyāharantīva pakṣiṇaḥ savyadakṣiṇāḥ || 13 ||
rahasyaṃ vasudevena so'nujñāto mahātmanā |
yānaṃ yaśodayā sārdhamāruroha mudānvitaḥ ||14 ||
kumāraskandhavāhyāyāṃ śibikāyāṃ samāhitaḥ |
saṃveśayāmāsa śiśuṃ śayanīyaṃ mahāmatiḥ || 15 ||
jagāma ca viviktena śītalānilasarpiṇā |
bahūdakena mārgeṇa yamunātīragāminā || 16 ||
sa dadarśa śubhe deśe govardhanasamīpage |
yamunātīrasambaddhaṃ śītamārutasevitam || 17 ||
virutaśvāpadai ramyaṃ latāvallīmahādrumam|
gobhistṛṇavilagnābhiḥ syandantībhiralaṃkṛtam || 18 ||
samapracāraṃ ca gavāṃ samatīrthajalāśayam |
vṛṣāṇāṃ skandhaghātaiśca viṣāṇodghṛṣṭapādapam || 19 ||
bhāsāmiṣādānusṛtaiḥ śyenaiścāmiṣagṛdhnubhiḥ |
sṛgālamṛgasiṃhaiśca vasāmedāśibhirvṛtam || 2.5.20 ||
śārdūlaśabdābhirutaṃ nānāpakṣisamākulam |
svāduvṛkṣaphalaṃ ramyaṃ paryāptatṛṇavīrudham || 21 ||
govrajaṃ gorutaṃ ramyaṃ gopanārībhirāvṛtam |
hambhāravaiśca vatsānāṃ sarvataḥ kṛtaniḥsvanam || 22 ||
śakaṭāvartavipulaṃ kaṇṭakīvāṭasaṃkulam |
paryanteṣvāvṛtaṃ vanyairbṛhadbhiḥ patitairdrumaiḥ || 23 ||
vatsānāṃ ropitaiḥ kīlairdāmabhiśca vibhūṣitam |
karīṣākīrṇavasudhaṃ kaṭacchannakuṭīmaṭham || 24 ||
kṣemyapracārabahulaṃ hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāvṛtam |
dāmanīpāśabahulaṃ gargarodgāraniḥsvunam || 25 ||
takraniḥsrāvabahulaṃ dadhimaṇḍārdramṛttikam |
manthānavalayodgārairgopīnāṃ janitasvanam || 26 ||
kākapakṣadharairbālairgopālakrīḍanākulam |
sārgaladvāragovāṭaṃ madhye gosthānasaṃkulam || 27 ||
sarpiṣā pacyamānena surabhīkṛtamārutam |
nīlapītāmbarābhiśca taruṇībhiralaṃkṛtam || 28 ||
vanyapuṣpāvataṃsābhirgopakanyābhirāvṛtam |
śirobhirdhṛtakumbhābhirbaddhairagrastanāmbaraiḥ || 29 ||
yamunātīramārgeṇa jalahārībhirāvṛtam |
sa tatra praviśan hṛṣṭo govrajaṃ gopanāditam || 2.5.30 ||
pratyudgato gopavṛddhaiḥ strībhirvṛddhābhireva ca |
niveśaṃ rocayāmāsa parivarte sukhāśraye || 31 ||
sā yatra rohiṇī devī vasudevasukhāvahā |
tatra taṃ bālasūryābhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gūḍhaṃ nyaveśayat || 32 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi govrajagamanaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||

<2.6>

ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tatra tasyāsataḥ kālaḥ sumahānatyavartata |
govraje nandagopasya ballavatvaṃ prakurvataḥ || 1 ||
dārakau kṛtanāmānau vavṛdhāte sukhaṃ ca tau |
jyeṣṭhaḥ saṃkarṣaṇo nāma kanīyān kṛṣṇa eva tu || 2 ||
meghakṛṣṇastu kṛṣṇo'bhūd dehāntaragato hariḥ |
vyavardhata gavāṃ madhye sāgarasya ivāmbudaḥ || 3 ||
śakaṭasya tvadhaḥ suptaṃ kadācit putragṛddhinī |
yaśodā taṃ samutsṛjya jagāma yamunāṃ nadīm || 4 ||
śiśulīlāṃ tataḥ kurvansa hastacaraṇau kṣipan |
ruroda madhuraṃ kṛṣṇaḥ pādāvūrdhvaṃ prasārayan || 5 ||
sa tatraikena pādena śakaṭaṃ paryavartayat |
nyubjaṃ payodharākāṅkṣī cakāra ca ruroda ca || 6 ||
etasminnantare prāptā yaśodā bhayaviklavā |
snātā prasravadigdhāṅgī baddhavatseva saurabhī || 7 ||
sā dadarśa viparyastaṃ śakaṭaṃ vāyunā vinā |
hāheti kṛtvā tvaritā dārakaṃ jagṛhe tadā || 8 ||
na sā bubodha tattvena śakaṭaṃ parivartitam |
svasti me dārakāyeti prītā bhītā ca sābhavat|| 9 ||
kiṃ tu vakṣyati te putra pitā paramakopanaḥ |
tvayyadhaḥśakaṭe supte akasmācca viloḍite || 2.6.10 ||
kiṃ me snānena duḥsnānaṃ kiṃ ca me gamane nadīm |
paryaste śakaṭe putra yā tvāṃ paśyāmyapāvṛtam || 11||
etasminnantare gobhirājagāma vanecaraḥ |
kāṣāyavāsasī bibhran nandagopo vrajāntikam || 12 ||
sa dadarśa viparyastaṃ bhinnabhāṇḍaghaṭīghaṭam|
apāstadhūrvibhinnākṣaṃ śakaṭaṃ cakramaulinam|| 13 ||
bhītastvaritamāgatya sahasā sādhulocanaḥ |
api me svastiputrāyetyasakṛd vacanaṃ vadan || 14 ||
pibantaṃ stanamālakṣya putraṃ svastho'bravītpunaḥ |
vṛṣayuddhaṃ vinā kena paryastaṃ śakaṭaṃ mama || 15 ||
pratyuvāca yaśodā taṃ bhītā gadgadabhāṣiṇī |
na vijānāmyahaṃ kena śakaṭaṃ parivartitam || 16 ||
ahaṃ nadī gatā saumya cailaprakṣālanārthinī |
āgatā ca viparyastamapaśyaṃ śakaṭaṃ bhuvi || 17 ||
tayoḥ kathayatorevamabruvaṃstatra dārakāḥ |
anena śiśunā yānametat pādena loḍitam|| 18 ||
asmābhiḥ sampatadbhiśca dṛṣṭametad yadṛcchayā |
nandagopastu tacchrutvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayau || 19 ||
prahṛṣṭaścaiva bhītaśca kimetaditi cintayan |
na ca te śraddadhurgopāḥ sarve mānuṣabuddhayaḥ || 2.6.20 ||
āścaryamiti te sarve vismayotphullalocanāḥ |
sve sthāne śakaṭaṃ sthāpya cakrabandhamakārayan || 21 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
kasyacittvatha kālasya śakunī veṣadhāriṇī |
dhātrī kaṃsasya bhojasya pūtaneti pariśrutā || 22||
pūtanā nāma śakunī ghorā prāṇibhayaṃkarī |
ājagāmārddharātre vai pakṣau krodhād vidhunvatī || 23 ||
tato'rdharātrasamaye pūtanā pratyadṛśyata |
vyāghragambhīranirghoṣaṃ vyāharantī punaḥ punaḥ || 24 ||
nililye śakaṭasyākṣe prasravotpīḍavarṣiṇī |
dadau stanaṃ ca kṛṣṇāya tasmin supte jane niśi|| 25 ||
tasyāḥ stanaṃ papau kṛṣṇaḥ prāṇaiḥ saha vinadya ca |
chinnastanī tu sahasā papāta śakunī bhuvi || 26 ||
tena śabdena vitrastāstato bubudhire bhayāt|
sa nandagopo gopā vai yaśodā ca suviklavā || 27 ||
te tāmapaśyan patitāṃ visaṃjñāṃ vipayodharām |
pūtanāṃ patitāṃ bhūmau vajreṇeva vidāritām || 28 ||
idaṃ kiṃ tviti saṃtrastāḥ kasyedaṃ karma cetyapi |
nandagopaṃ puraskṛtya gopāste paryavārayan || 29 ||
nādhyagacchanta ca tadā hetuṃ tatra kadācana |
āścaryamāścaryamiti bruvanto'nuyayurgṛhān || 2.6.30 ||
gateṣu teṣu gopeṣu vismiteṣu yathāgṛham |
yaśodāṃ nandagopastu papraccha gatasambhramaḥ || 31 ||
ko'yaṃ vidhirna jānāmi vismayo me mahānayam |
putrasya me bhayaṃ tīvraṃ bhīrutvaṃ samupāgatam || 32 ||
yaśodā tvabravīd bhītā nārya jānāmi kiṃ tvidam|
dārakeṇa sahānena suptā śabdena bodhitā || 33 ||
yaśodāyāmajānantyāṃ nandagopaḥ sabāndhavaḥ |
kaṃsād bhayaṃ cakārograṃ vismayaṃ ca jagāma ha || 34||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi śiśucaryāyāṃ śakaṭabhaṅgapūtanāvadhe ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 ||

<2.7>

saptamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
kāle gacchati tau saumyau dārakau kṛtanāmakau |
kṛṣṇasaṃkarṣaṇau cobhau riṅgiṇau samapadyatām || 1 ||
tāvanyonyagatau bālau bālyādevaikatāṃ gatau |
ekamūrtidharau kāntau bālacandrārkavarcasau || 2 ||
ekanirmāṇanirmuktāvekaśayyāsanāśanau |
ekaveṣadharāvekaṃ puṣyamāṇau śiśuvratam || 3 ||
ekakāryāntaragatāvekadehau dvidhākṛtau |
ekacaryau mahāvīryāvekasya śiśutāṃ gatau || 4 ||
ekapramāṇau lokānāṃ devavṛttāntamānuṣau |
kṛtsnasya jagato gopau saṃvṛttau gopadārakau || 5 ||
anyonyavyatiṣaktābhiḥ krīḍābhirabhiśobhitau |
anyonyakiraṇagrastau candrasūryāvivāmbare || 6 ||
visarpantau tu sarvatra sarpabhogabhujāvubhau |
rejatuḥ pāṃsudigdhāṅgau dṛptau kalabhakāviva || 7 ||
kvacid bhasmapradīptāṅgau karīṣaprokṣitau kvacit|
tau tatra paryadhāvetāṃ kumārāviva pāvakī || 8 ||
kvacijjānubhirudghṛṣṭaiḥ sarpamāṇau virejatuḥ |
krīḍantau vatsaśālāsu śakṛddigdhāṅgamūrdhajau || 9 ||
śuśubhāte śriyā juṣṭāvānandajananau pituḥ |
janaṃ ca viprakurvāṇau vihasantau kvacitkvacit|| 2.7.10 ||
tau tatra kautūhalinau mūrdhajavyākulekṣaṇau |
rejatuścandravadanau dārakau sukumārakau || 11 ||
atiprasaktau tau dṛṣṭvā sarvavrajavicāriṇau |
nāśakat tau vārayituṃ nandagopaḥ sudurmadau || 12 ||
tato yaśodā saṃkruddhā kṛṣṇaṃ kamalalocanam |
ānāyya śakaṭīmūle bhartsayantī punaḥ punaḥ || 13 ||
dāmnā caivodare baddhvā pratyabandhadulūkhale |
yadi śakto'si gaccheti tamuktvā karma sākarot||14||
vyagrāyāṃ tu yaśodāyāṃ nirjagāma tato'ṅgaṇāt |
śiśulīlāṃ tataḥ kurvankṛṣṇo vismāpayanvrajam|
so'ṅgaṇānniḥsṛtaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ karṣamāṇa ulūkhalam|| 15 ||
yamalābhyāṃ pravṛddhābhyāmarjunābhyāṃ caran vane |
madhyānniścakrāma tayoḥ karṣamāṇa ulūkhalam || 16 ||
tattasya karṣato baddhaṃ tiryaggatamulūkhalam |
lagnaṃ tābhyāṃ samūlābhyāmarjunābhyāṃ cakarṣa ca || 17 ||
tāvarjunau kṛṣyamāṇau tena bālena raṃhasā |
samūlaviṭapau bhagnau sa tu madhye jahāsa vai || 18 ||
nidarśanārthaṃ gopānāṃ divyaṃ svabalamāsthitaḥ |
taddāma tasya bālasya prabhāvādabhavad dṛḍham || 19 ||
yamunātīramārgasthā gopyastaṃ dadṛśuḥ śiśum |
krandantyo vismayantyaśca yaśodāṃ yayuraṅganāḥ || 2.7.20 ||
tāstu sambhrāntavadanā yaśodāmūcuraṅganāḥ |
ehyāgaccha yaśode tvaṃ sambhramāt kiṃ vilambase ||21||
yau tāvarjunavṛkṣau tu vraje satyopayācanau |
putrasyopari tāvetau patitau te mahīruhau || 22 ||
dṛḍhena dāmnā tatraiva baddho vatsa ivodare |
jahāsa vṛkṣayormadhye tava putraḥ sa bālakaḥ || 23 ||
uttiṣṭha gaccha durmedhe mūḍhe paṇḍitamānini |
putramānaya jīvantaṃ muktaṃ mṛtyumukhādiva || 24 ||
sā bhītā sahasotthāya hāhākāraṃ prakurvatī |
taṃ deśamagamad yatra pātitau tāvubhau drumau || 25 ||
sā dadarśa tayormadhye drumayorātmajaṃ śiśum|
dāmnā nibaddhamudare karṣamāṇamulūkhalam| 26 ||
sagopīgopavṛddhaśca samuvāca vrajastadā |
paryāgacchanta te draṣṭuṃ gopeṣu mahadadbhutam || 27 ||
jajalpuste yathākāmaṃ gopā vanavicāriṇaḥ |
kenemau pātitau vṛkṣau ghoṣasyāyatanopamau | 28 ||
vinā vātaṃ vinā varṣaṃ vidyatprapatanaṃ vinā |
vinā hastikṛtaṃ doṣa kenemau pātitau drumau || 29||
aho bata na śobhetāṃ vimūlāvarjunāvimau |
bhūmau nipatitau vṛkṣau vitoyau jaladāviva || 2.7.30 ||
yadīmau ghoṣaracitau ghoṣakalyāṇakāriṇau |
nandagopa prasannau te drumāvevaṃ gatāvapi |
yacca te dārako mukto vipulābhyāmapi kṣitau || 31 ||
autpātikamidaṃ ghoṣe tṛtīyaṃ vartate tviha |
pūtanāyā vināśaśca drumayoḥ śakaṭasya ca || 32 ||
asmin sthāne ca vāso'yaṃ ghoṣasyāsya na yujyate |
utpātā hyatra dṛśyante kathayanto na śobhanam || 33 ||
nandagopastu sahasā muktvā kṛṣṇamulūkhalāt |
niveśya cāṅke suciraṃ mṛtaṃ punarivāgatam || 34 ||
nātṛpyat prekṣamāṇo vai kṛṣṇaṃ kamalalocanam |
tato yaśodāṃ garhan vai nandagopo viveśa ha ||35 ||
sa ca gopajanaḥ sarvo vrajameva jagāma ha |
sa ca tenaiva nāmnā tu kṛṣṇo vai dāmabandhanāt |
goṣṭhe dāmodara iti gopībhiḥ parigīyate || 36 ||
etadāścaryabhūtaṃ hi bālasyāsīd viceṣṭitam |
kṛṣṇasya bharataśreṣṭha ghoṣe nivasatastadā || 37 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilamāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi śiśucaryāyāṃ yamalārjunabhaṅgo nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||

<2.8>

aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evaṃ tau bālyamuttīrṇau kṛṣṇasaṃkarṣaṇāvubhau |
tasminneva vrajasthāne saptavarṣau babhūvatuḥ || 1 ||
nīlapītāmbaradharau pītaśvetānulepanau |
babhūvaturvatsapālau kākapakṣadharāvubhau ||2 ||
parṇavādyaṃ śrutisukhaṃ vādayantau varānanau |
śuśubhāte vanagatau triśīrṣāviva pannagau || 3||
mayūrāṅgadakarṇau tu pallavāpīḍadhāriṇau |
vanamālākuloraskau drumapotāvivodgatau || 4 ||
aravindakṛtāpīḍau rajjuyajñopavītinau |
saśikyatumbakarakau gopaveṇupravādakau || 5 ||
kvaciddhasantāvanyonyaṃ krīḍamānau kvacitkvacit |
parṇaśayyāsu saṃsuptau kvacinnidrāntarekṣaṇau || 6 ||
evaṃ vatsān pālayantau śobhayantau mahāvanam |
cañcūryantau ramantau sma kiśorāviva cañcalau || 7||
atha dāmodaraḥ śrīmān saṃkarṣaṇamuvāca ha |
ārya nāsmin vane śakyaṃ gopālaiḥ saha krīḍitum ||8||
avagītamidaṃ sarvamāvābhyāṃ bhuktakānanam |
prakṣīṇatṛṇakāṣṭhaṃ ca gopairmathitapādapam ||9||
ghanībhūtāni yānyāsan kānanāni vanāni ca |
tānyākāśanikāśāni dṛśyante'dya yathā'sukham|| 2.8.10||
govāṭeṣvapi ye vṛkṣāḥ parivṛttārgaleṣu ca |
sarve goṣṭhāgniṣu gatāḥ kṣayamakṣayavarcasaḥ || 11 ||
saṃnikṛṣṭāni yānyāsankāṣṭhāni ca tṛṇāni ca |
tāni dūrāvakṛṣṭāsu mārgitavyāni bhūmiṣu || 12 ||
araṇyamidamalpodamalpakakṣaṃ nirāśrayam|
anveṣitavyaviśrāmaṃ dāruṇaṃ viraladrumam || 13 ||
akarmaṇyeṣu vṛkṣeṣu sthitaviprasthitadvijam |
saṃvāsasyāsya mahato janenotsāditadrumam || 14 ||
nirānandaṃ nirāsvādaṃ niṣprayojanamārutam|
nirvihaṅgamidaṃ śūnyaṃ nirvyañjanamivāśanam || 15 ||
vikrīyamāṇaiḥ kāṣṭhaiśca śākaiśca vanasambhavaiḥ |
ucchinnasaṃcayatṛṇairghoṣo'yaṃ nagarāyate || 16 ||
śailānāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ ghoṣo ghoṣāṇāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ vanam |
vanānāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ gāvastāścāsmākaṃ parā gatiḥ || 17 ||
tasmādanyad vanaṃ yāmaḥ pratyagrayavasendhanam |
icchantyanupabhuktāni gāvo bhoktuṃ tṛṇāni ca || 18 ||
tasmād vanaṃ navatṛṇaṃ gacchantu dhanino vrajāḥ |
na dvārabandhāvaraṇā na gṛhakṣetriṇastathā |
praśastā vai vrajā loke yathā vai cakracāriṇaḥ || 19 ||
śakṛnmūtreṣu teṣveva jātakṣārarasāyanam|
na tṛṇaṃ bhuñjate gāvo nāpi tat payase hitam || 2.8.20 ||
sthalīprāyāsu rathyāsu navāsu vanarājiṣu |
carāvaḥ sahitau gobhiḥ kṣipraṃ saṃvāhyatāṃ vrajaḥ || 21 ||
śrūyate hi vanaṃ ramyaṃ paryāptatṛṇasaṃstaram|
nāmnā vṛndāvanaṃ nāma svāduvṛkṣaphalodakam|| 22 ||
ajhillikaṇṭakavanaṃ sarvairvanaguṇairyutam|
kadambapādapaprāyaṃ yamunātīrasaṃśritam|| 23 ||
snigdhaśītānilavanaṃ sarvartunilayaṃ śubham |
gopīnāṃ sukhasaṃcāraṃ cārucitravanāntaram || 24 ||
tatra govardhano nāma nātidūre girirmahān |
bhrājate dīrghaśikharo nandanasyeva mandaraḥ || 25 ||
madhye cāsya mahāśākho nyagrodho yojanocchritaḥ |
bhāṇḍīro nāma śuśubhe nīlamegha ivāmbare || 26 ||
madhyena cāsya kālindī sīmantamiva kurvatī |
prayātā nandanasyeva nalinī saritāṃ varā || 27 ||
tatra govardhanaṃ caiva bhāṇḍīraṃ ca vanaspatim |
kālindīṃ ca nadīṃ ramyāṃ drakṣyāvaścarataḥ sukham || 28 ||
tatrāyaṃ kalpyatāṃ ghoṣastyajyatāṃ nirguṇaṃ vanam |
saṃtrāsayāvo bhadraṃ te kiñcidutpādya kāraṇam || 29
evaṃ kathayatastasya vāsudevasya dhīmataḥ |
prādurbabhūvuḥ śataśo raktamāṃsavasāśanāḥ || 2.8.30 ||
ghorāścintayatastasya svatanūruhajāstadā |
viniṣpeturbhayakarāḥ sarvaśaḥ śataśo vṛkāḥ || 31||
niṣpatanti sma bahavo vrajasyotsādanāya vai |
vṛkān niṣpatitāndṛṣṭvā goṣu vatseṣvatho nṛṣu || 32 ||
gopīṣu ca yathākāmaṃ vraje trāso'bhavanmahān |
te vṛkāḥ pañcabaddhāśca daśabaddhāstathā pare || 33 ||
triṃśadviṃśatibaddhāśca śatabaddhāstathā pare |
niścerustasya gātrebhyaḥ śrīvatsakṛtalakṣaṇāḥ||34||
kṛṣṇasya kṛṣṇavadanā gopānāṃ bhayavardhanāḥ |
bhakṣayadbhiśca tairvatsāṃstrāsayadbhiśca govrajān || 35 ||
niśi bālān haradbhiśca vṛkairutsādyate vrajaḥ |
na vane śakyate gantuṃ na gāśca parirakṣitum || 36 ||
na vanātkiṃcidāhartuṃ na ca vā tarituṃ nadīm|
trastā hyudvignamanaso'gatāstasminvane'vasan|| 37 ||
evaṃ vṛkairudīrṇaistu vyāghratulyaparākramaiḥ |
vrajo niṣpandaceṣṭaḥ sa ekasthānacaraḥ kṛtaḥ || 38 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi śiśucaryāyāṃ vṛkadarśane'ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||

<2.9>

navamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evaṃ vṛkāṃśca tān dṛṣṭvā vardhamānāndurāsadān |
sastrīpumānsa ghoṣo vai samasto'mantrayattadā|| 1 ||
sthāneneha na naḥ kāryaṃ vrajāmo'nyanmahadvanam |
yacchivaṃ ca sukhoṣyaṃ ca gavāṃ caiva sukhāvaham||2||
adyaiva kiṃ cireṇa sma vrajāmaḥ saha godhanaiḥ |
yāvad vṛkairvadhaṃ ghoraṃ na naḥ sarvo vrajo vrajet || 3 ||
eṣāṃ dhūmrāruṇāṅgānāṃ daṃṣṭriṇāṃ nakhakarṣiṇām|
vṛkāṇāṃ kṛṣṇavaktrāṇāṃ bibhīmo niśi garjatām|| 4 ||
mama putro mama bhrātā mama vatso'tha gaurmama |
vṛkairvyāpāditā hyevaṃ krandanti sma gṛhe gṛhe || 5 ||
tāsāṃ ruditaśabdena gavāṃ haṃbhāraveṇa ca |
vrajasyotthāpanaṃ cakrurghoṣavṛddhāḥ samāgatāḥ || 6 ||
teṣāṃ matamathājñāya gantuṃ vṛndāvanaṃ prati |
vrajasya viniveśāya gavāṃ caiva hitāya ca || 7 ||
vṛndāvananivāsāya tāñjñātvā kṛtaniścayān |
nandagopo bṛhadvākyaṃ bṛhaspatirivādade || 8 ||
adyaiva niścayaprāptiryadi gantavyameva naḥ |
śīghramājñāpyatāṃ ghoṣaḥ sajjībhavata mā ciram || 9 ||
tato'vaghuṣyata tadā ghoṣe tat prākṛtairjanaiḥ |
śīghraṃ gāvaḥ prakalpyantāṃ bhāṇḍaṃ samabhiropyatāma|| 2.9.10 ||
vatsayūthāni kālyantāṃ yujyantāṃ śakaṭāni ca |
vṛndāvanamitaḥ sthānānniveśāya ca gamyatām || 11||
tacchrutvā nandagopasya vacanaṃ sādhu bhāṣitam|
udatiṣṭhad vrajaḥ sarvaḥ śīghraṃ gamanalālasaḥ || 12 ||
prayāhyuttiṣṭha gacchāmaḥ kiṃ śeṣe yāhi yojaya |
uttiṣṭhati vraje tasmin gopakolāhalo hyabhūt || 13 ||
uttiṣṭhamānaḥ śuśubhe śakaṭīśakaṭastu saḥ |
vyāghraghoṣamahāghoṣo ghoṣaḥ sāgaraghoṣavān || 14 ||
gopīnāṃ gargarībhiśca mūrdhni cottambhitairghaṭaiḥ |
niṣpapāta vrajātpaṃktistārāpaṃktirivāmbarāt|| 15 ||
nīlapītāruṇaistāsāṃ vastrairagrastanocchritaiḥ |
śakracāpāyate paṃktirgopīnāṃ mārgagāminī || 16 ||
dāmanīdāmabhāraiśca kecit kāyāvalambibhiḥ |
gopā mārgagatā bhānti sāvarohā iva drumāḥ || 17 ||
sa vrajo vrajatā bhāti śakaṭaughena bhāsvatā |
potaiḥ pavanavikṣiptairniṣpatadbhirivārṇavaḥ || 18 ||
kṣaṇena tad vrajasthānamīriṇaṃ samapadyata |
dravyāvayavanirdhūtaṃ kīrṇaṃ vāyasamaṇḍalaiḥ || 19 ||
tataḥ krameṇa ghoṣaḥ sa prāpto vṛndāvanaṃ vanam |
niveśaṃ vipulaṃ cakre gavāṃ caiva hitāya ca || 2.9.20 ||
śakaṭāvartaparyantaṃ candrārddhākārasaṃsthitam|
madhye yojanavistīrṇaṃ tāvaddviguṇamāyatam|| 21 ||
kaṇṭakībhiḥ pravṛddhābhistathā kaṇṭakitadrumaiḥ |
nikhātocchritaśākhāgrairabhiguptaṃ samantataḥ || 22 ||
manthairāropyamāṇaiśca manthabandhānukarṣaṇaiḥ |
adbhiḥ prakṣālyamānābhirgargarībhiritastataḥ || 23 ||
kīlairāropyamāṇaiśca dāmanīpāśapāśitaiḥ |
stambhanībhirdhṛtābhiśca śakaṭaiḥ parivartitaiḥ || 24 ||
niyogapāśairāsaktairgargarīstambhamūrdhasu |
chādanārthaṃ prakīrṇaiśca kaṭakaistṛṇasaṃkaṭaiḥ || 25 ||
śākhāviṭaṅkairvṛkṣāṇāṃ kriyamāṇairitastataḥ |
śodhyamānairgavāṃ sthānaiḥ sthāpyamānairulūkhalaiḥ || 26 ||
prāṅamukhaiḥ sicyamānaiśca saṃdīpyadbhiśca pāvakaiḥ |
savatsacarmāstaraṇaiḥ paryaṅkaiścāvaropitaiḥ || 27 ||
toyamuttārayantībhiḥ prekṣantībhiśca tad vanam |
śākhāścākarṣamāṇābhirgopībhiśca samantataḥ || 28||
yuvabhiḥ sthaviraiścaiva gopairvyagrakarairbhṛśam |
viśasadbhiḥ kuṭhāraiśca kāṣṭhānyapi tarūnapi|| 29 ||
tad vrajasthānamadhikaṃ śuśubhe kānanāvṛtam |
ramyaṃ vananiveśaṃ vai svādumūlaphalodakam || 2.9.30 ||
tāstu kāmadughā gāvaḥ sarvapakṣirutaṃ vanam|
vṛndāvanamanuprāptā nandanopamakānanam || 31||
pūrvameva tu kṛṣṇena gavāṃ vai hitakāriṇā |
śivena manasā dṛṣṭaṃ tad vanaṃ vanacāriṇā || 32 ||
paścime tu tato rūkṣe gharme māse nirāmaye |
varṣatīvāmṛtaṃ deve tṛṇaṃ tatra vyavardhata || 33 ||
na tatra vatsāḥ sīdanti na gāvo netare janāḥ |
yatra tiṣṭhati lokānāṃ bhavāya madhusūdanaḥ || 34 ||
tāśca gāvaḥ sa ghoṣastu sa ca saṃkarṣaṇo yuvā |
kṛṣṇena vihitaṃ vāsaṃ tamadhyāsata nirvṛtāḥ || 35 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi vṛndāvanapraveśe navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9

<2.10>

daśamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tau tu vṛndāvanaṃ prāptau vasudevasutāvubhau |
ceraturvatsayūthāni cārayantau surūpiṇau || 1 ||

naṣṭadāvāgnidhūmāni vanāni pracakāśire || 6 ||

hāsitaṃ kuṭajairvṛkṣaiḥ kadambairvāsitaṃ vanam |

sampradīptamivābhāti phullanīpadrumaṃ vanam || 12 ||
aindreṇa payasā siktaṃ mārutena ca vismṛtam |
pārthivaṃ gandhamāghrāya lokaḥ kṣubhitamānasaḥ || 13 ||
dṛptasāraṅganādena darduravyāhṛtena ca |
navaiśca śikhivikruṣṭairavakīrṇā vasundharā || 14 ||
bhramattūrṇamahāvartā varṣaprāptamahārayāḥ |
harantyastīrajān vṛkṣānvistāraṃ yānti nimnagāḥ||15||
saṃtatāsāraniryatnāḥ klinnayatnottaracchadāḥ |
na tyajanti nagāgrāṇi śrāntā iva patattriṇaḥ || 16 ||
toyagambhīralambeṣu sravatsu ca nadatsu ca |
udareṣu navābhrāṇāṃ majjatīva divākaraḥ || 17 ||
mahīruhairutpatitaiḥ salilotpīḍasaṃkulā |
anviṣyamārgā vasudhā bhāti śādvalamālinī || 18 ||
vajreṇevāvarugṇānāṃ nagānāṃ nagaśālinām |
srotobhiḥ parikṛttāni patanti śikharāṇyadhaḥ || 19 ||
patatā meghavarṣeṇa yathā nimnānusāriṇā |
palvalotkīrṇamuktena pūryante vanarājayaḥ || 2.10.20||
hastocchritamukhā vanyā meghanādānusāriṇaḥ |
bhrāntātivṛṣṭyā mātaṅgā gāṃ gatā iva toyadāḥ|| 21||
prāvṛṭpravṛttiṃ saṃdṛśya dṛṣṭvā cāmbudharān ghanān|
rauhiṇeyo mithaḥ kāle kṛṣṇaṃ vacanamabravīt || 22 ||
paśya kṛṣṇa ghanān kṛṣṇān balākojjvalabhūṣaṇān |
gagane tava gātrasya varṇacorān samucchritān || 23 ||
tava nidrākaraḥ kālastava gātropamaṃ nabhaḥ |
tvamivājñātavasatiṃ candro vasati vārṣikīm || 24 ||
etannīlāmbudaśyāmaṃ nīlotpadalaprabham |
samprāpte durdine kāle durdinaṃ bhāti vai nabhaḥ || 25 ||
paśya kṛṣṇa jalodagraiḥ kṛṣṇairudgrathitairghanaiḥ |
govardhano yathā ramyo bhāti govardhano giriḥ || 26||
patitenāmbhasā hyete samantānmadadarpitāḥ |
bhrājante kṛṣṇasāraṅgāḥ kānaneṣu mudānvitāḥ ||27 ||
etānyambuprahṛṣṭāni haritāni mṛdūni ca |
tṛṇāni śatapatrākṣa patrairgūhanti medinīm || 28 ||
kṣarajjalānāṃ śailānāṃ vanānāṃ jaladāgame |
sasasyānāṃ ca sīmānāṃ na lakṣmīrvyatiricyate ||29||
śīghravātasamudbhūtāḥ proṣitautsukyakāriṇaḥ |
dāmodaroddāmaravāḥ prāgalbhyaṃ yānti toyadāḥ || 2.10.30 ||
hare haryaśvacāpena trivarṇena trivikrama |
vibāṇajyena racitaṃ tavedaṃ madhyamaṃ padam || 31 ||
nabhasyeṣa nabhaścakṣurna bhātyeva carannabhaḥ |
meghaiḥ śītātapakaro viraśmiriva raśmivān || 32 ||
dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ saṃsargaḥ satataṃ vitataiḥ kṛtaḥ |
avyavacchinnadhāraughaiḥ samudraughasamairghanaiḥ || 33 ||
nīpārjunakadambānāṃ pṛthivyāṃ cātivṛṣṭibhiḥ |
gandhaiḥ kolāhalā vānti vātā madanadīpanāḥ || 34 ||
sampravṛttamahāvarṣaṃ lambamānamahāmbudam |
bhātyagādhamaparyantaṃ sasāgaramivāmbaram || 35 ||
dhārānirmalanārācaṃ vidyutkavacavarmiṇam |
śakracāpāyudhadharaṃ yuddhasajjamivāmbaram || 36 ||
śailānāṃ ca vanānāṃ ca drumāṇāṃ ca varānana |
praticchannāni bhāsante śikharāṇi ghanairghanaiḥ || 37 ||
gajānīkairivākīrṇaṃ salilodgāribhirghanaiḥ |
varṇasārūpyatāṃ yāti gaganaṃ sāgarasya ca || 38 ||
samudroddhūtajanitā lolaśādvalakampinaḥ |
śītāḥ sapṛṣatoddāmāḥ karkaśā vānti mārutāḥ || 39 ||
niśāsu suptacandrāsu muktatoyāsu toyadaiḥ |
magnasūryasya nabhaso na vibhānti diśo daśa || 2.10.40 ||
cetanaṃ puṣkaraṃ kośaiḥ kṣudhādhmātaiḥ samantataḥ |
na ghṛṇīnāṃ na ramyāṇāṃ vivekaṃ yānti kṛṣṭayaḥ || 41 ||
gharmadoṣaparityaktaṃ meghatoyavibhūṣitam |
paśya vṛndāvanaṃ kṛṣṇa vanaṃ caitrarathaṃ yathā || 42 ||
evaṃ prāvṛḍguṇān sarvāñchrīmān kṛṣṇasya pūrvajaḥ |
kathayanneva balavān vrajameva jagāma ha || 43 ||
anyonyaṃ ramamāṇau tu kṛṣṇasaṃkarṣaṇāvubhau |
tatkālajñātibhiḥ sārddhaṃ ceratustad vanaṃ mahat || 44 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi prāvṛḍvarṇane daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 ||

<2.11>

ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
kadācit tu tadā kṛṣṇo vinā saṃkarṣaṇena vai |
cacāra tad vanaṃ ramyaṃ kāmarūpī varānanaḥ ||1||
kākapakṣadharaḥ śrīmāñchyāmaḥ padmadalekṣaṇaḥ |
śrīvatsenorasā yuktaḥ śaśāṅka iva lakṣmaṇā || 2 ||
sāṅgadenāgrahastena paṅkajodbhinnavarcasā |
sukumārābhitāmreṇa krāntavikrāntagāminā || 3 ||

sūkṣme vasāno vasane sasaṃdhya iva toyadaḥ || 4 ||
vatsavyāpārayuktābhyāṃ vyagrābhyāṃ gaṇḍarajjubhiḥ |
bhujābhyāṃ sādhuvṛttābhyāṃ pūjitābhyāṃ divaukasaiḥ || 5 ||
sadṛśaṃ puṇḍarīkasya gandhena kamalasya ca |
rarāja cāsya tad bālye rucirauṣṭhapuṭaṃ mukham || 6 ||
śikhābhistasya muktābhī rarāja mukhapaṅkajam |
vṛtaṃ ṣaṭpadapaṃktībhiryathā syāt padmamaṇḍalam || 7 ||
tasyārjunakadambākhyā nīpakandalamālinī |
rarāja mālā śirasi nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathā divi || 8 ||
sa tayā mālayā vīraḥ śuśubhe kaṇṭhasaktayā |
meghamālāmbudaśyāmo nabhasya iva mūrtimān || 9 ||
ekenāmalapatreṇa kaṇṭhasūtrāvalambinā |
rarāja barhipatreṇa mandamārutakampinā || 2.11.10 ||
kvacidgāyankvacitkrīḍaṃścañcūryaṃśca kvacitkvacit|
parṇavādyaṃ śrutisukhaṃ vādayaṃśca kvacid vane || 11 ||

gokule'mbudharaśyāmaścacāra dyutimān prabhuḥ |
reme ca tatra ramyāsu citrāsu vanarājiṣu || 13 ||

kesarāṇāṃ navairgandhairmadaniḥśvasitopamaiḥ |
abhīkṣṇaṃ niḥśvasantīṣu kāminīṣviva nityaśaḥ || 16 ||

sa kadācid vane tasmingobhiḥ saha paribhraman |
dadarśa vipulodagraṃ śākhinaṃ śākhināṃ varam || 18 ||
sthitaṃ dharaṇyāṃ meghābhaṃ nibiḍaṃ patrasaṃcayaiḥ |
gaganārdhocchritākāraṃ parvatābhogadhāriṇam || 19 ||
nīlacitrāṅgavarṇaiśca sevitaṃ bahubhiḥ khagaiḥ |
phalaiḥ pravālaiśca ghanaiḥ sendracāpaghanopamam || 2.11.20 ||
bhavanākāraviṭapaṃ latāpuṣpasumaṇḍitam |
viśālamūlāvanataṃ pavanāmbhodadhāriṇam || 21 ||
ādhipatyamivānyeṣāṃ tasya deśasya śākhinām|
kurvāṇaṃ śubhakarmāṇaṃ nirāvarṣamanātapam || 22 ||

dṛṣṭvā tatra matiṃ cakre nivāsāya tataḥ prabhuḥ || 23 ||
sa tatra vayasā tulyairvatsapālaiḥ sahānagha |
reme vai vāsaraṃ kṛṣṇaḥ purā svargagato yathā || 24 ||

parṇavādyāntare veṇuṃ tumbīṃ vīṇāṃ ca tatra ha || 27 ||

jagāma yamunātīraṃ latālaṃkṛtapādapam || 28 ||
taraṅgāpāṅgakuṭilāṃ vārisparśasukhānilām|
tāṃ ca padmotpalavatīṃ dadarśa yamunāṃ nadīm || 29 ||
sutīrthāṃ svādusalilāṃ hradinīṃ vegagāminīm |
toyavātodyatairvegairavanāmitapādapām || 2.11.30 ||
haṃsakāraṇḍavodghuṣṭā sārasaiśca nināditām |

cacāra ruciraṃ kṛṣṇo yamunāmupaśobhayan |

gambhīramakṣobhyajalaṃ niṣkampamiva sāgaram || 42 ||
toyajaiḥ śvāpadaistyaktaṃ śūnyaṃ toyacaraiḥ khagaiḥ |
agādhenāmbhasā pūrṇaṃ meghapūrṇamivāmbaram || 43 ||
duḥkhopasarpyaṃ tīreṣu sasarpairvipulairbilaiḥ |
viṣāraṇibhavasyāgnerdhūmena pariveṣṭitam || 44 ||
abhogyaṃ tat paśūnāṃ hi apeyaṃ ca jalārthinām |
