<2.12>

dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
sopasṛtya nadītīraṃ baddhvā parikaraṃ dṛḍham |
ārohaccapalaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kadambaśikharaṃ mudā || 1 ||
kṛṣṇaḥ kadambaśikharāllambamāno ghanākṛtiḥ |
hradamadhye'karocchabdaṃ nipatannambujekṣaṇaḥ || 2 ||
kṛṣṇena tatra patatā kṣubhito yamunāhradaḥ |
samprāsicyata vegena bhidyamāna ivāmbudaḥ || 3 ||
tena śabdena saṃkṣubdhaṃ sarpasya bhavanaṃ mahat |
udatiṣṭhajjalāt sarpo roṣaparyākulekṣaṇaḥ || 4 ||
sa coragapatiḥ kruddho megharāśisamaprabhaḥ |
tato raktāntanayanaḥ kāliyaḥ samadṛśyata || 5 ||
pañcāsyaḥ pāvakocchvāsaścalajjihvo'nalānanaḥ |
pṛthubhiḥ pañcabhirghoraiḥ śirobhiḥ parivāritaḥ || 6 ||
pūrayitvā hradaṃ sarvaṃ bhogenānalavarcasā |
sphuranniva ca roṣeṇa jvalanniva ca tejasā || 7 ||
krodhena jvalatastasya jalaṃ śṛtamivābhavat |
pratisrotāśca bhīteva jagāma yamunā nadī || 8 ||
tasya krodhāgnipūrṇebhyo vaktrebhyo'bhūcca mārutaḥ|
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ hradagataṃ krīḍantaṃ śiśulīlayā || 9 ||
sadhūmāḥ pannagendrasya mukhānniścerurarciṣaḥ |
sṛjatā tena roṣāgniṃ samīpe tīrajā drumāḥ || 2.12.10 ||
kṣaṇena bhasmasānnītā yugāntapratimena vai |
tasya putrāśca dārāśca bhṛtyāścānye mahoragāḥ || 11 ||
vamantaḥ pāvakaṃ ghoraṃ vaktrebhyo viṣasambhavam |
sadhūmaṃ pannagendrāste nipeturamitaujasaḥ || 12 ||
praveśitaśca taiḥ sarpaiḥ sa kṛṣṇo bhogabandhanam |
niryatnacaraṇākārastasthau giririvācalaḥ || 13 ||
adaśan daśanaistīkṣṇairviṣotpīḍajalāvilaiḥ |
te kṛṣṇaṃ sarpapatayo na mamāra ca vīryavān || 14 ||
etasminnantare bhītā gopālāḥ sarva eva te |
krandamānā vrajaṃ jagmurvāṣpagadgadayā girā || 15 ||
gopā ūcuḥ
eṣa mohaṃ gataḥ kṛṣṇo magno vai kāliye hrade |
bhakṣyate sarparājena tadāgacchata mā ciram || 16 ||
nandagopāya vai kṣipraṃ sabalāya nivedyatām |
eṣa te kṛṣyate kṛṣṇaḥ sarpeṇeti mahāhrade || 17 ||
nandagopastu tacchrutvā vajrapātopamaṃ vacaḥ |
ārtaḥ skhalitavikrāntastaṃ jagāma hradottamam || 18 ||
sabālayuvatīvṛddhaḥ sa ca saṃkarṣaṇo yuvā |
ākrīḍaṃ pannagendrasya jalasthaṃ samupāgamat || 19 ||
nandagopamukhā gopāste sarve sāśrulocanāḥ |
hāhākāraṃ prakurvantastasthustīre hradasya vai || 2.12.20 ||
vrīḍitā vismitāścaiva śokārtāśca punaḥ punaḥ |
kecittu putra hā heti hā dhigityapare punaḥ || 21 ||
apare hā hatāḥ smeti rurudurbhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ |
striyaścaiva yaśodāṃ tāṃ hā hatāsīti cukruśuḥ || 22 ||
yā paśyasi priyaṃ putraṃ sarparājavaśaṃ gatam |
spanditaṃ sarpabhogena kṛṣyamāṇaṃ yathā mṛtam || 23 ||
aśmasāramayaṃ nūnaṃ hṛdayaṃ te vilakṣyate |
putraṃ kathamimaṃ dṛṣṭvā yaśode nāvadīryase || 24 ||
duḥkhitaṃ bata paśyāmo nandagopaṃ hradāntike |
nyasya putramukhe dṛṣṭiṃ niścetanamavasthitam || 25 ||
yaśodāmanugacchantyaḥ sarpāvāsamimaṃ hradam|
praviśāmo na yāsyāmo vinā dāmodaraṃ vrajam || 26 ||
divasaḥ ko vinā sūryaṃ vinā candreṇa kā niśā |
vinā vṛṣeṇa kā gāvo vinā kṛṣṇena ko vrajaḥ |
vinā kṛṣṇaṃ na yāsyāmo vivatsā iva dhenavaḥ || 27 ||
tāsāṃ vilapitaṃ śrutvā teṣāṃ ca vrajavāsinām |
vilāpaṃ nandagopasya yaśodāruditaṃ tathā || 28 ||
ekabhāvaśarīrajña ekadeho dvidhā kṛtaḥ |
saṃkarṣaṇastu saṃkruddho babhāṣe kṛṣṇamavyayam || 29 ||
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho gopānāṃ nandavarddhana |
damyatāmeṣa vai kṣipraṃ sarparājo viṣāyudhaḥ || 2.12.30 ||
ime no bāndhavāstāta tvāṃ matvā mānuṣaṃ vibho |
paridevanti karuṇaṃ sarve mānuṣabuddhayaḥ || 31 ||
tacchrutvā rauhiṇeyasya vākyaṃ saṃjñāsamīritam |
vikramyāsphoṭayad bāhū bhittvā tannāgabandhanam || 32 ||
tasya padbhyāmathākramya bhogarāśiṃ jalotthitam |
śirastu kṛṣṇo jagrāha svahastenāvanāmya ca || 33 ||
tasyāruroha sahasā madhyamaṃ tanmahacchiraḥ |
so'sya mūrdhni sthitaḥ kṛṣṇo nanarta rucirāṅgadaḥ || 34 ||
mṛdyamānaḥ sa kṛṣṇena śāntamūrdhā bhujaṅgamaḥ |
āsyaiḥ sarudhirodgāraiḥ kātaro vākyamabravīt || 315 ||
avijñānānmayā kṛṣṇa roṣo'yaṃ sampradarśitaḥ |
damito'haṃ hataviṣo vaśagaste varānana || 36 ||
tadājñāpaya kiṃ kuryāṃ sadā sāpatyabāndhavaḥ |
kasya vā vaśatāṃ yāmi jīvitaṃ me pradīyatām || 37 ||
pañcamūrddhānataṃ dṛṣṭvā sarpaṃ sarpāriketanaḥ |
akruddha eva bhagavān pratyuvācorageśvaram || 38 ||
tavāsmin yamunātoye naiva sthānaṃ dadāmyaham |
gacchārṇavajalaṃ sarpa sabhāryaḥ sahabāndhavaḥ || 39 ||
yaśceha bhūyo dṛśyeta sthāne vā yadi vā jale |
tava bhṛtyastanūjo vā kṣipraṃ vadhyaḥ sa me bhavet|| 2.12.40 ||
śivaṃ cāsya jalasyāstu tvaṃ ca gaccha mahārṇavam|
sthāne tviha bhaved doṣastavāntakaraṇo mahān || 41 ||
matpadāni ca te sarpa dṛṣṭvā mūrdhasu sāgare |
garuḍaḥ pannagaripustvayi na prahariṣyati || 42 ||
gṛhya mūrdhnā tu caraṇau kṛṣṇasyoragapuṅgavaḥ |
paśyatāmeva gopānāṃ jagāmādarśanaṃ hradāt || 43 ||
nirjite tu gate sarpe kṛṣṇamuttīrya dhiṣṭhitam |
vismitāstuṣṭuvurgopāścakruścaiva pradakṣiṇam || 44 ||
ūcuḥ sarve ca samprītā nandagopaṃ vanecarāḥ |
dhanyo'syanugṛhīto'si yasya te putra īdṛśaḥ || 45 ||
adyaprabhṛti gopānāṃ gavāṃ goṣṭhasya cānagha |
āpatsu śaraṇaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prabhuścāyatalocanaḥ || 46 ||
jātā śivajalā sarvā yamunā munisevitā |
tīre cāsyāḥ sukhaṃ gāvo vicariṣyanti naḥ sadā || 47 ||
vyaktameva vayaṃ gopā vane yat kṛṣṇamīdṛśam |
mahadbhūtaṃ na jānīmaśchannamagnimiva vraje || 48 ||
evaṃ te vismitāḥ sarve stuvantaḥ kṛṣṇamavyayam |
jagmurgopagaṇā ghoṣaṃ devāścaitrarathaṃ yathā || 49 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi śiśucaryāyāṃ kāliyadamane dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||

<2.13>

trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
damite sarparāje tu kṛṣṇena yamunāhrade |
tameva ceraturdeśaṃ sahitau rāmakeśavau||1||
ājagmatustau sahitau godhanaiḥ saha gāminau |
giriṃ govarddhanaṃ ramyaṃ vasudevasutāvubhau || 2 ||
govarddhanasyottarato yamunātīramāśritam |
dadṛśāte ca tau vīrau ramyaṃ tālavanaṃ mahat || 3 ||
tau tālaparṇapratate ramyai tālavane ratau |
ceratuḥ paramaprītau vṛṣapotāvivoddhatau || 4 ||
sa tu deśaḥ sadā snigdho loṣṭapāṣāṇavarjitaḥ |
darbhaprāyasthalībhūtaḥ sumahān kṛṣṇamṛttikaḥ || 5 ||
tālaistairvipulaskandhairucchritaiḥ śyāmaparvabhiḥ |
phalāgraśākhibhirbhāti nāgahastairivocchritaiḥ || 6 ||
tatra dāmodaro vākyamuvāca vadatāṃ varaḥ |
aho tālaphalaiḥ pakvairvāsiteyaṃ vanasthalī || 7 ||
svādūnyārya sugandhīni śyāmāni rasavanti ca |
pakvatālāni sahitau pātayāvo laghukramau || 8 ||
yadyeṣāmīdṛśo gandho mādhuryaghrāṇatarpaṇaḥ |
rasenāmṛtakalpena bhavitavyaṃ ca me matiḥ || 9 ||
dāmodaravacaḥ śrutvā rauhiṇeyo hasanniva |
pātayan pakvatālāni cālayāmāsa tāṃstarūn || 2.13.10 ||
tattu tālavanaṃ nṛṇāmasevyaṃ duratikramam |
nirmāṇabhūtamiriṇaṃ puruṣādālayopamam || 11 ||
dāruṇo dhenuko nāma daityo gardabharūpadhṛk |
kharayūthena mahatā vṛtaḥ samanusevate || 12 ||
sa tu tālavanaṃ ghoraṃ gardabhaḥ parirakṣati |
nṛpakṣiśvāpadagaṇāṃstrāsayānaḥ sudurmatiḥ || 13 ||
tālaśabdaṃ sa taṃ śrutvā saṃghuṣṭaṃ phalapātanāt |
nāmarṣayat sa saṃkruddhastālasvanamiva dvipaḥ || 14 ||
śabdānusārī saṃkruddho darpāviddhasaṭānanaḥ |
stabdhākṣo hreṣitapaṭuḥ khurairnirdārayanmahīm || 15 ||
āviddhapuccho hṛṣito vyāttānana ivāntakaḥ |
āpatanneva dadṛśe rauhiṇeyamupasthitam || 16 ||
tālānāṃ tamadho dṛṣṭvā sa dhvajākāramavyayam |
rauhiṇeyaṃ kharo duṣṭaḥ so'daśad daśanāyudhaḥ || 17 ||
padbhyāmubhābhyāṃ ca punaḥ paścimābhyāṃ parāṅmukhaḥ |
jaghānorasi daityendro rauhiṇeyaṃ nirāyudham || 18 ||
tābhyāmeva ca jagrāha padbhyāṃ taṃ daityagardabham |
āvarjitamukhaskandhaṃ prerayaṃstālamūrdhani || 19 ||
sambhagnorukaṭigrīvo bhagnapṛṣṭho durākṛtiḥ |
kharastālaphalaiḥ sārdhaṃ papāta dharaṇītale || 2.13.20 ||
ta' gatāsuṃ gataśrīkaṃ patitaṃ vīkṣya gardabham |
jñātīṃstathāparāṃstasya tṛṇarājani so'kṣipat || 21 ||
sā bhūrgardabhadehaiśca tālaiḥ pakvaiśca pātitaiḥ |
babhāse channajaladā dyaurivāvyaktaśāradī || 22 ||
tasmin gardabhadaitye tu sānuge vinipātite |
ramyaṃ tālavanaṃ taddhi bhūyo ramyataraṃ babhau || 23 ||
vipramuktabhayaṃ śubhraṃ viviktākāradarśanam |
caranti sma sukhaṃ gāvastat tālavanamuttamam|| 24 ||
tataḥ praviṣṭāste sarve gopā vanavicāriṇaḥ |
vītaśokabhayāyāsāścañcūryante samantataḥ || 25 ||
tataḥ sukhaṃ prakīrṇāsu goṣu nāgendravikramau |
drumaparṇāsanaṃ kṛtvā tau yathārhaṃ niṣīdatuḥ || 26 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi śiśucaryāyāṃ dhenukavadhe trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 ||

<2.14>

caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
atha tau jātaharṣau tu vasudevasutāvubhau |
tat tālavanamutsṛjya bhūyo bhāṇḍīramāgatau || 1 ||
cārayantau vivṛddhāni godhanāni śubhāni ca |
sphītasasyaprarūḍhāni vīkṣamāṇau vanāni ca || 2 ||
kṣveḍayantau pragāyantau pracinvantau ca pādapān |
nāmabhirvyāharantau ca savatsā gāḥ paraṃtapau || 3 ||
niryogapāśairāsaktaiḥ skandhābhyāṃ śubhalakṣaṇau |
vanamālākuloraskau bālaśṛṅgāvivarṣabhau || 4 ||
suvarṇāñjanacūrṇābhāvanyonyasadṛśāmbarau |
mahendrāyudhasaṃsaktau śuklakṛṣṇāvivāmbudau || 5 ||
kuśāgrakusumānāṃ ca karṇapūrau manoramau |
vanamārgeṣu kurvāṇau vanyaveṣadharāvubhau || 6 ||
govardhanasyānu carau vane sānucarau tu tau |
ceraturlokasiddhābhiḥ krīḍābhiraparājitau || 7 ||
tāvevaṃ mānuṣīṃ dīkṣāṃ vahantau surapūjitau |
tajjātiguṇayuktābhiḥ krīḍābhiśceraturvanam || 8 ||
tau tu bhāṇḍīramāśritya bālakrīḍānuvartinau |
prāptau paramaśākhāḍhyaṃ nyagrodhaṃ śākhināṃ varam || 9 ||
tatra tvāndolikābhiśca yuddhamārgaviśāradau |
aśmabhiḥ kṣepaṇīyaiśca tau vyāyāmamakurvatām || 2.14.10 ||
yuddhamārgaiśca vividhairgopālaiḥ sahitāvubhau |
muditau siṃhavikrāntau yathākāmaṃ viceratuḥ || 11 ||
tayo ramayatoreva tallipsurasurottamaḥ |
pralambo'bhyāgamattatra cchidrānveṣī tayostadā || 12 ||
gopālaveṣamāsthāya vanyapuṣpavibhūṣitaḥ |
lobhayānaḥ sa tau vīrau hāsyaiḥ krīḍanakaistathā || 13 ||
so'vagāhata niśśaṅkasteṣāṃ madhyamamānuṣaḥ|
mānuṣaṃ vapurāsthāya pralambo dānavottamaḥ || 14 ||
prakrīḍitāśca te sarve saha tenāmarāriṇā |
gopālavapuṣaṃ gopā manyamānāḥ svabāndhavam|| 15 ||
sa tu cchidrāntaraprepsuḥ pralambo gopatāṃ gataḥ |
dṛṣṭiṃ praṇidadhe kṛṣṇe rauhiṇeye ca dāruṇām || 16 ||
aviṣahyaṃ tato matvā kṛṣṇamadbhutavikramam |
rauhiṇeyavadhe yatnamakarod dānavottamaḥ || 17 ||
hariṇākrīḍanaṃ nāma bālakrīḍanakaṃ tataḥ |
prakrīḍitāstu te sarve dvau dvau yugapadutpatan || 18 ||
kṛṣṇaḥ śrīdāmasahitaḥ pupluve gopasūnunā |
saṃkarṣaṇastu plutavān pralambena sahānagha || 19 ||
gopālāstvapare dvandvaṃ gopālairaparaiḥ saha |
pradrutā laṅghayanto vai te'nyonyaṃ laghuvikramāḥ || 2.14.20 ||
śrīdāmamajayat kṛṣṇaḥ pralambaṃ rohiṇīsutaḥ |
gopālaiḥ kṛṣṇapakṣīyairgopālāstvapare jitāḥ || 21 ||
te vāhayantastvanyonyaṃ saṃharṣāt sahasā drutāḥ |
bhāṇḍīraskandhamuddiśya maryādāṃ punarāgaman || 22 ||
saṃkarṣaṇaṃ tu skandhena śīghramutkṣipya dānavaḥ |
drutaṃ jagāma vimukhaḥ sacandra iva toyadaḥ || 23 ||
sa bhāramasahaṃstasya rauhiṇeyasya dhīmataḥ |
vavṛdhe sumahākāyaḥ śakrākrānta ivāmbudaḥ || 24 ||
sa bhāṇḍīravaṭaprakhyaṃ dagdhāñjanagiriprabham |
svaṃ vapurdarśayāmāsa pralambo dānavottamaḥ || 25 ||
pañcastabakayuktena mukuṭenārkavarcasā |
dīpyamānānano daityaḥ sūryākrānta ivāmbudaḥ || 26 ||
mahānano mahāgrīvaḥ sumahānantakopamaḥ |
raudraḥ śakaṭacakrākṣo namayaṃścaraṇairmahīm || 27 ||
sragdāmalambābharaṇaḥ pralambāmbarabhūṣaṇaḥ |
vīraḥ pralambaḥ prayayau lambatoya ivāmbudaḥ ||28 ||
sa jahārātha vegena rauhiṇeyaṃ mahāsuraḥ |
sāgaropaplavagataṃ kṛtsnaṃ lokamivāntakaḥ || 29 ||
hriyamāṇaḥ pralambena sa tu saṃkarṣaṇo babhau |
uhyamāna ivākāśe kālameghena candramāḥ || 2.14.30 ||
sa saṃdigdhamivātmānaṃ mene saṃkarṣaṇastadā |
daityaskandhagataḥ śrīmān kṛṣṇaṃ cedamuvāca ha || 31 ||
hriye'haṃ kṛṣṇa daityena parvatodagravarṣmaṇā |
pradarśayitvā mahatīṃ māyāṃ mānuṣarūpiṇīm|| 32 ||
kathamasya mayā kāryaṃ śāsanaṃ duṣṭacetasaḥ |
pralambasya pravṛddhasya darpād dviguṇavarcasaḥ || 33 ||
tamāha sasmitaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sāmnā harṣākulena vai |
abhijño rauhiṇeyasya vṛttasya ca balasya ca || 34 ||
aho'yaṃ mānuṣo bhāvo vyaktamevānupālyate |
yastvaṃ jaganmayaṃ devaṃ guhyād guhyataraṃ gataḥ || 35 ||
smara nārāyaṇātmānaṃ lokānāṃ tvaṃ viparyaye |
avagacchātmanā''tmānaṃ samudrāṇāṃ samāgame || 36 ||
purātanānāṃ devānāṃ brahmaṇaḥ salilasya ca |
ātmavṛttaprabhāvāṇāṃ saṃsmarādyaṃ ca vai vapuḥ || 37 ||
śiraḥ khaṃ te jalaṃ mūrttiḥ pādau bhūrdahano mukham|
vāyurlokāyuruchvāso manaḥ somo hyabhūttava || 38 ||
sahasrāsyaḥ sahasrāṅgaḥ sahasracaraṇekṣaṇaḥ |
sahasrapadmanābhastvaṃ sahasrāṃśudharo'rihā || 39 ||
yattvayā darśitaṃ loke tat paśyanti divaukasaḥ |
yat tvayā noktapūrvaṃ hi kastadanveṣṭumarhati || 2.14.40 ||
yad veditavyaṃ loke'smiṃstattvayā samudāhṛtam |
viditaṃ yat tavaikasya devā api na tad viduḥ || 41 ||
ātmajaṃ te vapurvyomni na paśyantyātmasambhavam |
yat tu te kṛtrimaṃ rūpaṃ tadarcanti divaukasaḥ || 42 ||
devairna dṛṣṭaścāntaste tenānanta iti smṛtaḥ |
tvaṃ hi sūkṣmo mahānekaḥ sūkṣmairapi durāsadaḥ || 43 ||
tvayyeva jagataḥ stambhe śāśvatī jagatī sthitā |
acalā prāṇināṃ yonirdhārayatyakhilaṃ jagat || 44 ||
catuḥsāgarabhogastvaṃ cāturvarṇyavibhāgavit |
caturyugeṣu lokānāṃ cāturhotraphalāśanaḥ ||45 ||
yathāhamapi lokānāṃ tathā tvaṃ tacca me matam |
ubhāvekaśarīrau svo jagadarthe dvidhākṛtau || 46 ||
ahaṃ vā śāśvataḥ kṛṣṇastvaṃ vā śeṣaḥ purātanaḥ |
lokānāṃ śāśvato devastvaṃ hi śeṣaḥ sanātanaḥ |
āvayordehamātreṇa dvidhedaṃ dhāryate jagat || 47 ||
ahaṃ yaḥ sa bhavāneva yastvaṃ so'haṃ sanātanaḥ |
dvāveva vihitau hyāvāmekadehau mahābalau || 48 ||
tadāsse mūḍhavat tvaṃ kiṃ prāṇena jahi dānavam |
mūrdhni devaripuṃ deva vajrakalpena muṣṭinā || 49 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
saṃsmāritastu kṛṣṇena rauhiṇeyaḥ purātanam |
balenāpūryata tadā trailokyāntaracāriṇā || 2.14.50 ||
tataḥ pralambaṃ durvṛttaṃ sa baddhena mahābhujaḥ |
muṣṭinā vajrakalpena mūrdhni cainaṃ samāhanat || 51 ||
tasyottamāṅgaṃ sve kāye vikapālaṃ viveśa ha |
jānubhyāṃ cāhataḥ śete gatāsurdānavottamaḥ || 52 ||
jagatyāṃ viprakīrṇasya tasya rūpamabhūt tadā |
pralambasyāmbarasthasya meghasyeva vidīryataḥ || 53 ||
tasya bhagnottamāṅgasya dehāt susrāva śoṇitam |
bahugairikasaṃyuktaṃ śailaśṛṅgādivodakam || 54 ||
taṃ nihatya pralambaṃ tu saṃhṛtya balamātmanaḥ |
paryaṣvajata vai kṛṣṇaṃ rauhiṇeyaḥ pratāpavān || 55 ||
taṃ tu kṛṣṇaśca gopāśca divisthāśca divaukasaḥ |
tuṣṭuvurnihate daitye jayāśīrbhirmahābalam || 56 ||
balenāyaṃ hato daityo bālenākliṣṭakarmaṇā|
vivadantyaśarīriṇyo vācaḥ surasamīritāḥ || 57 ||
baladeveti nāmāsya devairuktaṃ divi sthitaiḥ |
balaṃ tu baladevasya tadā bhuvi janā viduḥ || 58 ||
karmajaṃ nihate daitye devairapi durāsade || 59 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi śiśucaryāyāṃ pralambavadhe caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 ||

<2.15>

pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tayoḥ pravṛttayorevaṃ kṛṣṇasya ca balasya ca |
vane vicaratormāsau vyatiyātau sma vārṣikau || 1 ||
vrajamājagmatustau tu vraje śuśruvatustadā |
prāptaṃ śakramahaṃ vīrau gopāṃścotsavalālasān || 2 ||
kautūhalādidaṃ vākyaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ provāca tatra tān |
ko'yaṃ śakramaho nāma yena vo harṣa āgataḥ || 3 ||
tatra vṛddhatamastveko gopo vākyamuvāca ha |
śrūyatāṃ tāta śakrasya yadarthaṃ dhvaja ijyate || 4 ||
devānāmīśvaraḥ śakro meghānāṃ cārisūdana |
tasya cāyaṃ mahaḥ kṛṣṇa lokanāthasya śāśvataḥ || 5 ||
tena saṃcoditā meghāstasya cāyudhabhūṣitāḥ |
tasyaivājñākarāḥ sasyaṃ janayanti navāmbubhiḥ || 6 ||
meghasya payaso dātā puruhūtaḥ puraṃdaraḥ |
samprahṛṣṭaḥ sa bhagavān prīṇayatyakhilaṃ jagat || 7 ||
tena sampāditaṃ sasyaṃ vayamanye ca mānavāḥ |
vartayāmopayuñjānāstarpayāmaśca devatāḥ || 8 ||
deve varṣati loke'smiṃstataḥ sasyaṃ pravardhate |
pṛthivyāṃ tarpitāyāṃ tu sāmṛtaṃ lakṣyate jagat || 9 ||
kṣīravatyastvimā gāvo vatsavatyaśca nirvṛtāḥ |
tena saṃvardhitaistāta tṛṇaiḥ puṣṭāḥ sapuṅgavāḥ || 2.15.10 ||
nāsasyā nātṛṇā bhūmirna bubhukṣārdito janaḥ |
dṛśyate yatra dṛśyante vṛṣṭimanto balāhakāḥ || 11 ||
dudoha saviturgā vai śakro divyāḥ payasvinīḥ |
tāḥ kṣaranti navaṃ kṣīraṃ medhyaṃ meghaughadhāritam || 12 ||
vāyvīritaṃ tu megheṣu karoti ninadaṃ mahat |
javenāvartitaṃ caiva garjatīti janā viduḥ || 13 ||
tasya caivohyamānasya vāyuyuktairbalāhakaiḥ |
vajrāśanisamāḥ śabdāḥ śrūyante nagabhedinaḥ || 14 ||
tajjalaṃ vajraniṣpeṣairvimuñcati nabhogataiḥ |
bahubhiḥ kāmagairmeghaiḥ śakro bhṛtyairiveśvaraḥ || 15 ||
kvacid durdinasaṃkāśaiḥ kvacicchinnābhrasaṃnibhaiḥ |
kvacid bhinnāñjanākāraiḥ kvacicchīkaravarṣibhiḥ || 16 ||
maṇḍayatīva devendro viśvamevaṃ nabho ghanaiḥ |
kvacicchīkaramuktābhaṃ kurute gaganaṃ ghanaḥ || 17 ||
evametatpayo dugdhaṃ gobhiḥ sūryasya vāridaiḥ |
parjanyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhavāya bhuvi varṣati || 18 ||
yasmātprāvṛḍiyaṃ kṛṣṇa śakrasya bhuvi bhāvinī |
tasmātprāvṛṣi rājānaḥ sarve śakraṃ mudā yutāḥ |
mahaiḥ sureśamarcanti vayamanye ca mānavāḥ || 19 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi śiśucaryāyāṃ gopavākye pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 ||

<2.16>

ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
gopavṛddhasya vacanaṃ śrutvā śakraparigrahe |
prabhāvajño'pi śakrasya vākyaṃ dāmodaro'bravīt || 1 ||
vayaṃ vanacarā gopāḥ sadā godhanajīvinaḥ |
gāvo'smaddaivataṃ viddhi girayaśca vanāni ca || 2 ||
karṣukāṇāṃ kṛṣirvṛttiḥ paṇyaṃ vipaṇijīvinām|
gāvo'smākaṃ parā vṛttiretat traividyamucyate || 3 ||
vidyayā yo yayā yuktastasya sā daivataṃ param|
saiva pūjyārcanīyā ca saiva tasyopakāriṇī || 4 ||
yo'nyasya phalamaśnānaḥ karotyanyasya satkriyām|
dvāvanarthau sa labhate pretya ceha ca mānavaḥ ||5||
kṛṣyantā prathitā sīmā sīmāntaṃ śrūyate vanam|
vanāntā girayaḥ sarve te cāsmākaṃ gatirdhruvā || 6 ||
śrūyante girayaścāpi vane'smin kāmarūpiṇaḥ |
praviśya tāstāstanavo ramante sveṣu sānuṣu || 7 ||
bhūtvā kesariṇaḥ siṃhā vyāghrāśca nakhināṃ varāḥ |
vanāni svāni rakṣanti trāsayanto vanacchidaḥ || 8 ||
yadā caiṣāṃ vikurvanti te vanālayajīvinaḥ |
ghnanti tāneva durvṛttān pauruṣādena karmaṇā || 9 ||
mantrayajñaparā viprāḥ sītāyajñāśca karṣukāḥ |
giriyajñāstathā gopā ijyo'smābhirgirirvane || 2.16.10 ||
tanmahyaṃ rocate gopā giriyajñaḥ pravartatām |
karma kṛtvā sukhasthāne pādapeṣvathavā girau || 11 ||
tatra hatvā paśūn medhyān vitatyāyatane śubhe |
sarvaghoṣasya saṃdohaḥ kriyatāṃ kiṃ vicāryate || 12 ||
taṃ śaratkusumāpīḍāḥ parivārya pradakṣiṇam |
gāvo girivaraṃ sarvāstato yāntu punarvrajam || 13||
prāptā kileyaṃ hi gavāṃ svādutoyatṛṇā guṇaiḥ |
śarat pramuditā ramyā gatameghajalāśayā || 14 ||
priyakaiḥ puṣpitairgauraṃ śyāma bāṇāsanaiḥ kvacit |
kaṭhoratṛṇamābhāti nirmayūrarutaṃ vanam || 15 ||
vijalā vimalā vyomni vibalākā vividyutaḥ |
vivardhante jaladharā vidantā iva kuñjarāḥ || 16 ||
paṭunā meghavātena navatoyānukarṣiṇā |
parṇotkaraghanāḥ sarve prasādaṃ yānti pādapāḥ || 17 ||
sitavarṇāmbudoṣṇīṣaṃ haṃsacāmaravījitam |
pūrṇacandrāmalacchatraṃ sābhiṣekamivāmbaram || 18 ||
haṃsaiḥ prahasitānīva samutkṛṣṭāni sārasaiḥ |
sarvāṇi tanutāṃ yānti jalāni jaladakṣaye || 19 ||
cakravākastanataṭāḥ pulinaśroṇimaṇḍalāḥ |
haṃsalakṣaṇahāsinyaḥ patiṃ yānti samudragāḥ || 2.16.20 ||
kumudotphullamudakaṃ tārābhiścitramambaram |
samamabhyutsmayantīva śarvarīṣvitaretaram || 21 ||
mattakrauñcāvaghuṣṭeṣu kalamāpakvapāṇḍuṣu |
nirviṣṭaramaṇīyeṣu vaneṣu ramate manaḥ || 22 ||
puṣkariṇyastaḍāgāni vāpyaśca vikacotpalāḥ |
kedārāḥ saritaścaiva sarāṃsi ca śriyājvalan || 23 ||
paṅkajāni ca tāmrāṇi tathānyāni sitānyapi |
utpalāni ca nīlāni bhejire vārijāṃ śriyam||24||
madaṃ jahuḥ sitāpāṅgā mandaṃ vavṛdhire'nilāḥ |
abhavad vyabhramākāśamabhūcca nibhṛto'rṇavaḥ || 25 ||
ṛtuparyāyaśithilairvṛttanṛtyasamujjhitaiḥ |
mayūrāṅgaruhairbhūmirbahunetreva lakṣyate 26||
svapaṅkamalinaistīraiḥ kāśapuṣpalatākulaiḥ |
haṃsasārasavinyāsairyamunā bhāti śobhanā || 27 ||
kalamāpākaramyeṣu kedāreṣu jaleṣu ca |
sasyādā jalajādāśca mattā viruruvuḥ khagāḥ || 28 ||
siṣicuryāni jaladā jalena jaladāgame |
tāni sasyāni bālāni kaṭhinatvaṃ gatāni vai || 29 ||
tyaktvā meghamayaṃ vāsaḥ śaradguṇavidīpitaḥ |
eṣa vai vimale vyomni hṛṣṭo vasati candramāḥ || 2.16.30 ||
kṣīriṇyo dviguṇaṃ gāvaḥ pramattā dviguṇaṃ vṛṣāḥ |
vanānāṃ dviguṇā lakṣmīḥ sasyairguṇavatī mahī || 31 ||
jyotīṃṣi ghanamuktāni padmavanti jalāni ca |
manāṃsi ca manuṣyāṇāṃ prasādamupayānti vai || 32 ||
asṛjatsavitā vyomni nirmukto jaladairbhṛśam |
śaratprajvalitaṃ tejastīkṣṇaraśmirviśoṣayan || 33 ||
nīrājayitvā sainyāni prayānti vijigīṣavaḥ |
anyonyarāṣṭrābhimukhāḥ pārthivāḥ pṛthivīkṣitaḥ || 34 ||
bandhujīvābhitāmrāsu baddhapaṅkavatīṣu ca |
manastiṣṭhati kāntāsu citrāsu vanarājiṣu || 35 ||
vaneṣu ca virājante pādapā vanaśobhinaḥ |
asanāḥ saptaparṇāśca kovidārāśca puṣpitāḥ || 36 ||
iṣusāhvā nikumbhāśca priyakāḥ svarṇakāstathā |
sṛmarāḥ pecakāścaiva ketakyaśca samantataḥ || 37 ||
vrajeṣu ca viśeṣeṇa gargarodgārahāsiṣu |
śaratprakāśayoṣeva goṣṭheṣvaṭati rūpiṇī || 38 ||
nūnaṃ tridaśabhūyiṣṭhaṃ meghakālasukhoṣitam |
patattriketanaṃ devaṃ bodhayanti divaukasaḥ || 39 ||
śaradyevaṃ susasyāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ prāvṛṣaḥ kṣaye |
nīlacandrārkavarṇaiśca racitaṃ bahubhirdvijaiḥ || 2.16.40 ||
phalaiḥ pravālaiśca ghanamindracāpaghanopamam |
bhavanākāraviṭapaṃ latāparamamaṇḍitam || 41 ||
viśālamūlāvanataṃ pavanābhogamaṇḍitam |
arcayāmo giriṃ devaṃ gāścaiva ca viśeṣataḥ || 42 ||
sāvataṃsairviṣāṇaiśca barhāpīḍaiśca daṃśitaiḥ |
ghaṇṭābhiśca pralambābhiḥ puṣpaiḥ śāradikaistathā || 43 ||
śivāya gāvaḥ pūjyantāṃ giriyajñaḥ pravartyatām |
pūjyatāṃ tridaśaiḥ śakro girirasmābhirijyatām || 44 ||
kārayiṣyāmi goyajñaṃ balādapi na saṃśayaḥ |
yadyasti mayi vaḥ prītiryadi vā suhṛdo vayam |
gāvo hi pūjyāḥ satataṃ sarveṣāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 45 ||
yadi sāmnā bhavet prītirbhavatāṃ vaibhavāya ca |
etanmama vacastathyaṃ kriyatāmavicāritam || 46 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi śaradvarṇane ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 ||

<2.17>

saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
dāmodaravacaḥ śrutvā hṛṣṭāste goṣu jīvinaḥ |
tadvāgamṛtamāsādya pratyūcuraviśaṅkayā || 1 ||
tavaiṣā bāla mahatī gopānāṃ hitavarddhinī |
prīṇayatyeva naḥ sarvān buddhirvṛddhikarī gavām || 2 ||
tvaṃ gatistvaṃ ratiścaiva tvaṃ vettā tvaṃ parāyaṇam |
bhayeṣvabhayadastvaṃ nastvameva suhṛdāṃ suhṛt || 3 ||
tvatkṛte kṛṣṇa ghoṣo'yaṃ kṣemī muditagokulaḥ |
kṛtsno vasati śāntāriryathā svargaṃ gatastathā || 4 ||
janmaprabhṛti karmaitad devairasukaraṃ bhuvi |
boddhavyāścābhimānācca vismitāni manāṃsi naḥ || 5 ||
balena ca parārdhyena yaśasā vikrameṇa ca |
uttamastvaṃ manuṣyeṣu deveṣviva puraṃdaraḥ || 6 ||
pratāpena ca tīkṣṇena dīptyā pūrṇatayāpi ca |
uttamastvaṃ ca martyeṣu deveṣviva divākaraḥ || 7 ||
kāntyā lakṣmyā prasādena vadanena smitena ca |
uttamastvaṃ ca martyeṣu deveṣviva niśākaraḥ || 8 ||
balena vapuṣā caiva bālyena caritena ca |
syātte śaktidharastulyo na tu kaścana mānuṣaḥ || 9 ||
yat tvayābhihitaṃ vākyaṃ giriyajñaṃ prati prabho |
kastallaṅghayituṃ śakto velāmiva mahodadhiḥ || 2.17.10 ||
sthitaḥ śakramahastāta śrīmān girimahastvayam |
tvatpraṇīto'dya gopānāṃ gavāṃ hetoḥ pravartyatām || 11 ||
bhājanānyupakalpyantāṃ payasaḥ peśalāni ca |
kumbhāśca viniveśyantāmudapāneṣu śobhanāḥ || 12 ||
pūryantāṃ payasā nadyo droṇyaśca vipulāyatāḥ |
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca peyaṃ ca tatsarvamupanīyatām || 13 ||
bhājanāni ca māṃsasya nyasyantāmodanasya ca |
trirātraṃ caiva saṃdohaḥ sarvaghoṣasya gṛhyatām || 14 ||
viśasyantāṃ ca paśavo bhojyā ye mahiṣādayaḥ |
pravartyatāṃ ca yajño'yaṃ sarvagopasusaṃkulaḥ || 15 ||
ānandajanano ghoṣo mahān muditagokulaḥ |
tūryapraṇādaghoṣaiśca vṛṣabhāṇāṃ ca garjitaiḥ || 16 ||
hambhāravaiśca vatsānāṃ gopānāṃ harṣavardhanaḥ |
dadhno hrado ghṛtāvartaḥ payaḥkulyāsamākulaḥ || 17 ||
māṃsarāśiḥ prabhūtāḍhyaḥ prakāśaudanaparvataḥ |
samprāvartata yajño'sya girergobhiḥ samākulaḥ |
tuṣṭagopajanākīrṇo gopanārīmanoharaḥ || 18 ||
bhakṣyāṇāṃ rāśayastatra śataśaścopakalpitāḥ |
gandhamālyaiśca vividhairdhūpairuccāvacaistathā || 19 ||
athādhiśṛtaparyante samprāpte yajñasaṃvidhau |
yajñaṃ girestithau saumye cakrurgopā dvijaiḥ saha || 2.17.20 ||
yajanānte tadannaṃ tu tat payo dadhi cottamam |
māṃsaṃ ca māyayā kṛṣṇo girirbhūtvā samaśnute || 21 ||
tarpitāścāpi viprāgryāstuṣṭāḥ sampūrṇamānasāḥ |
uttasthuḥ prītamanasaḥ svasti vācyaṃ yathāsukham || 22 ||
bhuktvā cāvabhṛthe kṛṣṇaḥ payaḥ pītvā ca kāmataḥ|
saṃtṛpto'smīti divyena rūpeṇa prajahāsa vai || 23 ||
taṃ gopāḥ parvatākāraṃ divyasraganulepanam |
girimūrdhni sthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ jagmuḥ pradhānataḥ || 24 ||
bhagavānapi tenaiva rūpeṇācchāditaḥ prabhuḥ |
sahitaiḥ praṇato gopairvavandātmānamātmanā || 25 ||
tamūcurvismitā gopā devaṃ girivare sthitam |
bhagavaṃstvadvaśe yuktā dāsāḥ kiṃ kurma kiṅkarāḥ || 26 ||
sa uvāca tato gopān giriprabhavayā girā |
adyaprabhṛti cejyo'haṃ goṣu yadyastu vo dayā || 27 ||
ahaṃ vaḥ prathamo devaḥ sarvakāmakaraḥ śubhaḥ |
mama prabhāvāśca gavāmayutānyeva bhokṣyatha || 28 ||
śivaśca vo bhaviṣyāmi madbhaktānāṃ vane vane |
raṃsye ca saha yuṣmābhiryathā divigatastathā || 29 ||
ye ceme prathitā gopā nandagopapurogamāḥ |
eṣāṃ prītaḥ prayacchāmi gopānāṃ vipulaṃ dhanam || 2.17.30 ||
paryāpnuvantu kṣipraṃ māṃ gāvo vatsasamākulāḥ |
evaṃ mama parā prītirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 31 ||
kto nīrājanārthaṃ hi vṛndaśo gokulāni tam |
parivavrurgirivaraṃ savṛṣāṇi samantataḥ || 32 ||
tā gāvaḥ pradrutā hṛṣṭāḥ sāpīḍastabakāṅgadāḥ |
sasrajāpīḍaśṛṅgāgrāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 33 ||
anujagmuśca gopālāḥ kālayanto dhanāni ca |
bhakticchedānuliptāṅgā raktapītasitāmbarāḥ || 34 ||
mayūracitrāṅgadino bhujaiḥ praharaṇāvṛtaiḥ |
mayūrapatravṛntānāṃ keśabandhaiḥ suyojitaiḥ || 35 ||
babhrājuradhikaṃ gopāḥ samavāye tadādbhute |
anye vṛṣānāruruhurnṛtyanti sma pare mudā || 36 ||
gopālāstvapare gāśca jagṛhurvegagāminaḥ |
tasmin paryāyanirvṛtte gavāṃ nīrājanotsave ||37||
antardhānaṃ jagāmāśu tena dehena so'calaḥ |
kṛṣṇo'pi gopasahito viveśa vrajameva ha || 38 ||
giriyajñapravṛttena tenāścaryeṇa vismitāḥ |
gopāḥ sabālavṛddhā vai tuṣṭuvurmadhusūdanam || 39 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi giriyajñapravartane saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 17 ||

<2.18>

aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
mahe pratihate śakraḥ sakrodhastridaśeśvaraḥ |
saṃvartakaṃ nāma gaṇaṃ toyadānāmathābravīt || 1 ||
bho balāhakamātaṅgāḥ śrūyatāṃ mama bhāṣitam |
yadi vo matpriyaṃ kāryaṃ rājabhaktipuraskṛtam || 2 ||
ete vṛndāvanagatā dāmodaraparāyaṇāḥ |
nandagopādayo gopā vidviṣanti mamotsavam || 3 ||
ājīvo yaḥ parasteṣāṃ gopatyaṃ ca yataḥ smṛtam |
tā gāvaḥ saptarātreṇa pīḍyantāṃ varṣamārutaiḥ || 4 ||
airāvatagataścāhaṃ svayamevāmbu dāruṇam |
srakṣyāmi vṛṣṭiṃ vātaṃ ca vajrāśanisamaprabham || 5 ||
bhavadbhiścaṇḍavarṣeṇa caratā mārutena ca |
hatāstāḥ savrajā gāvastyakṣyanti bhuvi jīvitam|| 6 ||
evamājñāpayāmāsa sarvāñjaladharān prabhuḥ |
pratyāhate vai kṛṣṇena śāsane pākaśāsanaḥ || 7 ||
tataste jaladāḥ kṛṣṇā ghoranādā bhayāvahāḥ |
ākāśaṃ chādayāmāsuḥ sarvataḥ parvatopamāḥ || 8 ||
vidyutsampātajananāḥ śakracāpavibhūṣitāḥ |
timirāvṛtamākāśaṃ cakruste jaladāstadā || 9 ||
gajā ivānyasaṃyuktāḥ kecinmakaravarcasaḥ |
nāgā ivānye gagane cerurjaladapuṅgavāḥ || 2.18.10 ||
te'nyonyaṃ vapuṣā baddhā nāgayūthāyutopamāḥ |
durdinaṃ vipulaṃ cakruśchādayanto nabhastalam || 11 ||
nṛhastanāgahastābhyāṃ veṇūnāṃ caiva sarvataḥ |
dhārābhistulyarūpābhirvavṛṣuste balāhakāḥ || 12 ||
samudraṃ menire taṃ hi khamārūḍhaṃ nṛcakṣuṣaḥ |
durvigāhyamaparyantamagādhaṃ durdinaṃ mahat ||13 ||
naivāpatan vai khagamā dudruvurmṛgajātayaḥ |
parvatābheṣu megheṣu khe nandantu samantataḥ | 14 ||
naṣṭasūryendusadṛśairmeghairnabhasi dāruṇaiḥ |
ativṛṣṭena lokasya virūpamabhavad vapuḥ || 15 ||
meghaughairniṣprabhākāramadṛśyagrahatārakam |
candrasūryāṃśurahitaṃ khaṃ babhūvātiniṣprabham|| 16 ||
vāriṇā meghamuktena mucyamānena cāsakṛt |
ābabhau sarvatastatra bhūmistoyamayī yathā || 17 ||
vinedurbarhiṇastatra tokakalparutāḥ khagāḥ |
vivṛddhiṃ nimnagā yātāḥ plavagāḥ samplavaṃ gatāḥ || 1 ||
garjitena ca meghānāṃ parjanyaninadena ca |
tarjitānīva kampante tṛṇāni tarubhiḥ saha || 19 ||
prāpto'ntakālo lokānāṃ vyaktamekārṇavā mahī |
iti gopagaṇā vākyaṃ vyāharanti bhayārditāḥ || 2.18.20 ||
tenotpātāmbuvarṣeṇa gāvo viprahatā bhṛśam |
hambhāravaiḥ krandamānā na celuḥ stambhitopamāḥ || 21 ||
niṣkampasakthicaraṇā niṣprayatnakhurānanāḥ |
hṛṣṭaromārdratanavaḥ kṣāmakukṣipayodharāḥ || 22 ||
kāścit prāṇāñjahuḥ śrāntā nipetuḥ kāścidāturāḥ |
kāścitsavatsāḥ patitā gāvaḥ śīkaravejitāḥ || 23 ||
kāścidākramya kroḍena vatsāṃstiṣṭhanti mātaraḥ |
vimukhāḥ śrāntasakthyaśca nirāhārāḥ kṛśodarāḥ |
peturārtā vepamānā gāvo varṣaparājitāḥ || 24 ||
vatsāśconmukhakā bālā dāmodaramukhāḥ sthitāḥ |
trāhīti vadanairdīnaiḥ kṛṣṇamūcurivārditāḥ || 25 ||
gavāṃ tat kadanaṃ dṛṣṭvā durdināgamajaṃ mahat |
gopāṃścāsannanidhanān kṛṣṇaḥ kopaṃ samādadhe || 26 ||
sa cintayitvā saṃrabdho dṛṣṭo yogo mayeti ca |
ātmānamātmanā vākyamidamūce priyaṃvadaḥ || 27 ||
adyāhamimamutpāṭya sakānanavanaṃ girim |
kalpayeyaṃ gavāṃ sthānaṃ varṣatrāṇāya durdharam || 28 ||
ayaṃ dhṛto mayā śailaḥ pṛthvīgṛhanibhopamaḥ |
trāsyate savrajā gā vai madvaśyaśca bhaviṣyati || 29 ||
evaṃ sa cintayitvā tu kṛṣṇaḥ satyaparākramaḥ |
bāhvorbalaṃ darśayiṣyan samīpaṃ taṃ mahīdharam |
dorbhyāmutpāṭayāmāsa kṛṣṇo giririvāparaḥ || 2.18.30 ||
sa dhṛtaḥ saṃgato meghairgiriḥ savyena pāṇinā |
gṛhabhāvaṃ gatastatra gṛhākāreṇa varcasā || 31 ||
bhūmerutpāṭyamānasya tasya śailasya sānuṣu |
śilāḥ praśithilāścelurviniṣpetuśca pādapāḥ || 32 ||
śikharairghūrṇamānaiśca sīdamānaiśca pādapaiḥ |
vidhūtaiścocchritaiḥ śṛṅgairagamaḥ khagamo'bhavat || 33 ||
calatprasravaṇaiḥ pārśvairmeghoghairekatāṃ gataiḥ |
bhidyamānāśmanicayaścacāla dharaṇīdharaḥ || 34 ||
na meghānāṃ pravṛṣṭānāṃ na śailasyāśmavarṣiṇaḥ |
vividuste janā rūpaṃ vāyostasya ca garjataḥ || 35 ||
meghaiḥ saśailasaṃsthānairnīlaiḥ prasravaṇārpitaiḥ |
miśrīkṛta ivābhāti giriruddāmabarhavān ||36 ||
āpluto'yaṃ giriḥ pakṣairiti vidyādharoragāḥ |
gandharvāpsarasaścaiva vāco muñcanti sarvaśaḥ ||37||
sahastatalavinyasto muktamūlaḥ kṣitestalāt|
rītīrnirvartayāmāsa kāñcanāñjanarājatīḥ ||38 ||
kānicicchithilānīva saṃcchinnārddhāni kānicit|
girermeghapraviṣṭāni tasya śṛṅgāṇi cābhavan ||39 ||
giriṇā kampamānena kampitānāṃ tu śākhinām |
puṣpamuccāvacaṃ bhūmau vyaśīryata samantataḥ || 2.18.40||
niḥsṛtāḥ pṛthumūrdhānaḥ svastikārdhavibhūṣitāḥ |
dvijihvapatataḥ kruddhāḥ khecarāḥ khe samantataḥ || 41 ||
ārtiṃ jagmuḥ khagagaṇā varṣeṇa ca bhayena ca |
utpattyotpasya gaganāt punaḥ peturavāṅmukhāḥ ||42 ||
resurāroṣitāḥ siṃhāḥ sajalā iva toyadāḥ |
gargarā iva mathyanto neduḥ śārdūlapuṅgavāḥ || 43 ||
viṣamaiśca samībhūtaiḥ samaiścātyantadurgamaiḥ |
vyāvṛttadehaḥ ca giriranya evopalakṣyate || 44 ||
ativṛṣṭasya tairmeghaistasya rūpaṃ babhūva ha |
stambhitasyeva rudreṇa tripurasya vihāyasi || 45 ||
bāhudaṇḍena kṛṣṇasya vidhṛtaṃ sumahattadā |
nīlābhrapaṭalacchannaṃ tadgiricchatramābabhau || 46 ||
svapnāyamāno jaladairnimīlitaguhāmukhaḥ |
bāhūpadhāne kṛṣṇasya prasupta iva khe giriḥ || 47 ||
nirvihaṅgarutairvṛkṣairnirmayūrarutairvanaiḥ |
nirālamba ivābhāti giriḥ svaśikharairvṛtaḥ || 48 ||
paryastairghūrṇamānaiśca pracaladbhiśca sānubhiḥ |
sajvarāṇīva śailasya vanāni śikharāṇi ca || 49 ||
uttamāṅgagatāstasya meghāḥ pavanavāhanāḥ |
tvaryamāṇā mahendreṇa toyaṃ mumucurakṣayam || 2.18.50 ||
sa lambamānaḥ kṛṣṇasya bhujāgre saghano giriḥ |
cakrārūḍha ivābhāti deśo nṛpatipīḍitaḥ || 51 ||
sa meghanicayastasthau giriṃ taṃ parivārya ha |
puraṃ puraskṛtya yathā sphīto janapado mahān || 52 ||
niveśya taṃ kare śailaṃ tolayitvā ca sasmitam |
provāca goptā gopānāṃ prajāpatiriva sthitaḥ || 53 ||
etad daivairasambhāvyaṃ divyena vidhinā mayā |
kṛtaṃ girigṛhaṃ gopā nirvātaṃ śaraṇaṃ gavām || 54 ||
kṣipraṃ viśantu yūthāni gavāmiha hi śāntaye |
nirvāteṣu ca deśeṣu nivasantu yathāsukham || 55 ||
yathāśreṣṭhaṃ yathāyūthaṃ yathāsāraṃ yathāsukham |
vibhajyatāmayaṃ deśaḥ kṛtaṃ varṣanivāraṇam || 56 ||
śailotpāṭanabhūreṣā mahatī nirmitā mayā |
pañcakrośapramāṇena krośaikavistaro mahān |
trailokyamapyutsahate rakṣituṃ kiṃ punarvrajam || 57 ||
tataḥ kilakilāśabdo gavāṃ hambhāravaiḥ saha |
gopānāṃ tumulo jajñe meghanādaśca bāhyataḥ ||58 ||
prāviśanta tato gāvo gopairyūthaprakalpitāḥ |
tasya śailasya vipulaṃ pradaraṃ gahvarodaram || 59 ||
kṛṣṇo'pi mūle śailasya śailastambha ivocchritaḥ|
dadhāraikena hastena śailaṃ priyamivātithim || 2.18.60 ||
tato vrajasya bhāṇḍāni yuktāni śakaṭāni ca |
viviśurvarṣabhītāste tad gṛhaṃ girinirmitam || 61 ||
atidaivaṃ tu kṛṣṇasya dṛṣṭvā tat karma vajrabhṛt |
mithyāpratijño jaladān vārayāmāsa vai vibhuḥ || 62||
saptarātre tu nirvṛtte dharaṇyāṃ vigatotsavaḥ |
jagāma saṃvṛto meghairvṛtrahā svargamuttamam || 63 ||
nivṛtte saptarātraṃ tu niṣprayatne śatakratau |
gatābhre vimale vyomni divase dīptabhāskare || 64 ||
gāvastenaiva mārgeṇa parijagmuryathāgatam |
svaṃ ca sthānaṃ tato ghoṣaḥ pratyayāt punareva saḥ || 65 ||
kṛṣṇo'pi taṃ giriśreṣṭhaṃ svasthāne sthāvarātmavān |
prīto niveśayāmāsa śivāya varado vibhuḥ || 66 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi govardhanadhāraṇe'ṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 ||

<2.19>

ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
dhṛtaṃ govarddhanaṃ dṛṣṭvā paritrātaṃ ca gokulam |
kṛṣṇasya darśanaṃ śakro rocayāmāsa vismitaḥ || 1 ||
sa nirjalāmbudākāraṃ mattaṃ madajalokṣitam|
āruhyairāvataṃ nāgamājagāma mahītalam || 2 ||
sa dadarśopaviṣṭaṃ vai govarddhanaśilātale |
kṛṣṇamakliṣṭakarmāṇaṃ puruhūtaḥ puraṃdaraḥ || 3 ||
taṃ vīkṣya bālaṃ mahatā tejasā dīptamavyayam |
gopaveṣadharaṃ viṣṇuṃ prītiṃ lebhe puraṃdaraḥ || 4 ||
taṃ so'mbujadalaśyāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śrīvatsalakṣaṇam |
paryāptanayanaḥ śakraḥ sarvairnetrairudaikṣata || 5 ||
dṛṣṭvā cainaṃ śriyā juṣṭaṃ martyaloke'maropamam |
sūpaviṣṭaṃ śilāpṛṣṭhe śakraḥ sa vrīḍito'bhavat|| 6 ||
tasyopaviṣṭasya mukhaṃ pakṣābhyāṃ pakṣipuṅgavaḥ |
antarddhānaṃ gataśchāyāṃ cakāroragabhojanaḥ || 7 ||
taṃ vivikte vanagataṃ lokavṛttāntatatparam |
upatasthe gajaṃ hitvā kṛṣṇaṃ balaniṣūdanaḥ || 8 ||
sa samīpagatastasya divyasraganulepanaḥ |
rarāja devarājo vai vajrapūrṇakaraḥ prabhuḥ || 9 ||
kirīṭenārkatulyena vidyududadyotakāriṇā |
kuṇḍalābhyāṃ sa divyābhyāṃ satataṃ śobhitānanaḥ || 2.19.10 ||
pañcastabakalambena hāreṇorasi bhūṣitaḥ |
sahasrapatrakāntena dehabhūṣaṇakāriṇā |
īkṣamāṇaḥ sahasreṇa netrāṇāṃ kāmarūpiṇām || 11 ||
tridaśājñāpanārthena meghanirghoṣakāriṇā |
atha divyena madhuraṃ vyājahāra svareṇa tam || 12 ||
indra uvāca
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho jñātīnāṃ nandivarddhana |
atidivyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma tvayā prītimatā gavām ||13 ||
mayotsṛṣṭeṣu megheṣu yugāntāvartakāriṣu |
yattvayā rakṣitā gāvastenāsmi paritoṣitaḥ || 14 ||
svāyambhuvena yogena yaścāyaṃ parvatottamaḥ |
dhṛto veśmavadākāśe ko hyetena na vismayet || 15 ||
pratiṣiddhe mama mahe mayeyaṃ ruṣitena vai |
ativṛṣṭiḥ kṛtā kṛṣṇa gavāṃ vai sāptarātrikī || 16 ||
sā tvayā pratiṣiddheyaṃ meghavṛṣṭirdurāsadā |
devaiḥ sadānavagaṇairdurnivāryā mayi sthite || 17 ||
aho me supriyaṃ kṛṣṇa yat tvaṃ mānuṣadehavān |
samagraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tejo vinigūhasi roṣitaḥ || 18 ||
sādhitaṃ devatānāṃ hi manye'haṃ kāryamavyayam 11
tvayi mānuṣyamāpanne yukte caiva svatejasā || 19 ||
setsyate sarvakāryārtho na kiṃcit parihāsyate |
devānāṃ yad bhavān netā sarvakāryapurogamaḥ || 2.19.20 ||
ekastvamasi devānāṃ lokānāṃ ca sanātanaḥ |
dvitīyaṃ nātra paśyāmi yasteṣāṃ ca dhuraṃ vahet || 21 ||
yathā hi puṅgavaḥ śreṣṭho hyagre dhuri niyojyate |
evaṃ tvamasi devānāṃ magnānāṃ dvijavāhanaḥ || 22 ||
tvaccharīragataṃ kṛṣṇa jagatprakaraṇaṃ tvidam |
brahmaṇā sādhu nirdiṣṭaṃ dhātubhya iva kāñcanam || 23 ||
svayaṃ svayambhūrbhagavān buddhyātha vayasāpi vā |
na tvānugantuṃ śaknoti paṅgurdrutagatiṃ yathā || 24 ||
sthāṇubhyo himavāñchreṣṭho hradānāṃ varuṇālayaḥ |
garutmān pakṣiṇāṃ śreṣṭho devānāṃ ca bhavān varaḥ || 25 ||
apāmadhastālloko vai tasyopari mahīdharāḥ |
nāgānāmupariṣṭād bhūḥ pṛthivyupari mānuṣāḥ || 26 ||
manuṣyalokādūrdhvaṃ tu khagānāṃ gatirucyate |
ākāśasyopari ravirdvāraṃ svargasya bhānumān || 27 ||
devalokaḥ parastasmād vimānagamano mahān |
yatrāhaṃ kṛṣṇa devānāmaindre vinihitaḥ padaṃ || 28 ||
svargādūrdhvaṃ brahmaloko brahmarṣigaṇasevitaḥ |
tatra somagatiścaiva jyotiṣāṃ ca mahātmanām || 29 ||
tasyopari gavāṃ lokaḥ sādhyāstaṃ pālayanti hi |
sa hi sarvagataḥ kṛṣṇa mahākāśagato mahān || 2.19.30 ||
uparyupari tatrāpi gatistava tapomayī |
yāṃ na vidmo vayaṃ sarve pṛcchanto'pi pitāmaham || 31 ||
lokastvadho duṣkṛtināṃ nāgalokastu dāruṇaḥ |
pṛthivī karmaśīlānāṃ kṣetraṃ sarvasya karmaṇaḥ || 32 ||
khamasthirāṇāṃ viṣayo vāyunā tulyavṛttinām |
gatiḥ śamadamākhyānāṃ svargaḥ sukṛtakarmaṇām || 33 ||
brāhme tapasi yuktānāṃ brahmalokaḥ parā gatiḥ |
gavāmeva tu goloko durārohā hi sā gatiḥ || 34 ||
sa tu lokastvayā kṛṣṇa sīdamānaḥ kṛtātmanā |
dhṛto dhṛtimatā vīra nighnatopadravān gavām || 35 ||
tadahaṃ samanuprāpto gavāṃ vākyena coditaḥ |
brahmaṇaśca mahābhāga gauravāt tava cāgataḥ || 36 ||
ahaṃ bhūtapatiḥ kṛṣṇa devarājaḥ puraṃdaraḥ |
aditergarbhaparyāye pūrvajaste purākṛtaḥ ||37 ||
svatejastejasā caiva yat te darśitavānaham |
devarūpeṇa tat sarvaṃ kṣantumarhasi me vibho || 38 ||
evaṃ kṣāntamanāḥ kṛṣṇa svena saumyena tejasā |
brahmaṇaḥ śṛṇu me vākyaṃ gavāṃ ca gajavikrama || 39 ||
āha tvāṃ bhagavān brahmā gāvaścākāśagā divi |
karmabhistoṣitā divyaistava saṃrakṣaṇādibhiḥ || 2.19.40 ||
bhavatā rakṣitā gāvo golokaśca mahānayam |
yad vayaṃ puṅgavaiḥ sārddhaṃ varddhāmaḥ prasavaistathā || 41 ||
karṣakān puṅgavairbāhyairmedhyena haviṣā surān |
śriyaṃ śakṛtpravṛttena tarpayiṣyāma kāmadāḥ || 42 ||
tadasmākaṃ gurustvaṃ hi prāṇadaśca mahābalaḥ |
adyaprabhṛti no rājā tvamindro vai bhava prabho || 43 ||
tasmāttvaṃ kāñcanaiḥ pūrṇairdivyasya payaso ghaṭaiḥ |
ebhiradyābhiṣiñcasva mayā hastāvanāmitaiḥ || 44 ||
ahaṃ kilendro devānāṃ tvaṃ gavāmindratāṃ gataḥ |
govinda iti lokāstvāṃ stoṣyanti bhuvi śāśvatam||45||
mamopari yathendrastvaṃ sthāpito gobhirīśvaraḥ |
upendra iti kṛṣṇa tvāṃ gāsyanti divi devatāḥ || 46 ||
ye ceme vārṣikā māsāścatvāro vihitā mama |
eṣāmarddhaṃ prayacchāmi śaratkālaṃ tu paścimam || 47 ||
adyaprabhṛti māsau dvau jñāsyanti mama mānavāḥ |
varṣārddhe ca dhvajo mahyaṃ tataḥ pūjāmavāpsyasi |
mamāmbuprabhavaṃ darpaṃ tadā tyakṣyanti barhiṇaḥ || 48 ||
alpavāco gatamadā ye cānye meghanādinaḥ |
śāntiṃ sarve gamiṣyanti mama kālavicāriṇaḥ || 49 ||
triśaṅkvagastyacaritāmāśāṃ ca pracariṣyati |
sahasraraśmirādityastāpayan svena tejasā || 2.19.50||
tataḥ śaradi yuktāyāṃ maunakāmeṣu barhiṣu |
yācamāne khage toyaṃ vipluteṣu plaveṣu ca||51||
haṃsasārasapūrṇeṣu nadīnāṃ pulineṣu ca|
mattakrauñcapraṇādeṣu pramattavṛṣabheṣu ca||52||
goṣu caiva prahṛṣṭāsu kṣarantīṣu payo bahu|
nivṛtteṣu ca megheṣu niryātya jagato jalam|| 53||
ākāśe śastrasaṃkāśe haṃseṣu ca caratsu ca |
jātapadmeṣu toyeṣu vāpīṣu ca sarassu ca || 54||
taḍāgeṣu ca kānteṣu toyeṣu vimaleṣu ca|
kalamāvanatāgrāsu kṛṣṇakedārapaṅktiṣu||55||
madhyasthaṃ salilārambhaṃ kurvantīṣu nadīṣu ca|
susasyāyāṃ ca sīmāyāṃ manoharyāṃ munerapi|| 56 ||
pṛthivyāṃ pṛthurāṣṭrāyāṃ ramyāyāṃ varṣasaṃkṣaye|
śrīmatsu paṃktimārgeṣu phalavatsu tṛṇeṣu ca |
ikṣumatsu ca deśeṣu pravṛtteṣu makheṣu ca || 57 ||
tataḥ pravartyate puṇyā śarat suptotthite tvayi |
loke'smin kṛṣṇa nikhile yathaiva tridive tathā || 58 ||
narāstvāṃ caiva māṃ caiva dhvajākārāsu yaṣṭiṣu |
mahendraṃ cāpyupendraṃ ca mahayanti mahītale || 59 ||
ye cāvayoḥ sthire vṛtte mahendropendrasaṃjñite |
mānavāḥ praṇamiṣyanti teṣāṃ nāstyanayāgamaḥ || 2.19.60 ||
tataḥ śakrastu tān gṛhya ghaṭān divyapayodharān|
abhiṣekeṇa govindaṃ yojayāmāsa yogavit || 61 ||
dṛṣṭvā tamabhiṣiktaṃ tu gāvastāḥ saha yūthapaiḥ |
stanaiḥ prasravayuktaiśca siṣicuḥ kṛṣṇamavyayam || 62 ||

divyamālyāmbaradharaṃ devadevo'bravīdidam || 2.19.70 ||

śakrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇo govindatāṃ gataḥ |
prītena manasā yuktaḥ prativākyaṃ jagāda ha || 92 ||
prīto'smi darśanād deva tava śakra śacīpate |
yat tvayābhihitaṃ cedaṃ na kiṃcitparihāsyate || 93 ||
jānāmi bhavato bhāvaṃ jānāmyarjunasambhavam |
jāne pitṛṣvasāraṃ ca pāṇḍordattāṃ mahātmanaḥ || 94 ||
yudhiṣṭhiraṃ ca jānāmi kumāraṃ dharmanirmitam |
bhīmasenaṃ ca jānāmi vāyoḥ saṃtānajaṃ sutam || 95 ||
aśvibhyāṃ sādhu jānāmi sṛṣṭaṃ putradvayaṃ śubham|
nakulaṃ sahadevaṃ ca mādrīkukṣigatāvubhau || 96 ||
kānīnaṃ cāpi jānāmi savituḥ prathamaṃ sutam |
pitṛṣvasari karṇaṃ vai prasūtaṃ sūtatāṃ gatam || 97 ||
dhārtarāṣṭrāśca me sarve viditā yuddhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ |
pāṇḍoruparamaṃ caiva śāpāśaninipātajam || 98 ||
tadgaccha tridivaṃ śakra sukhāya tridivaukasām |
nājunasya ripuḥ kaścinmamāgre prabhaviṣyati || 99 ||
arjunārthe ca tānsarvānpāṇḍavānakṣatānyudhi |
kuntyā niryātayiṣyāmi nivṛtte bhārate mṛdhe || 2.19.100||
yacca vakṣyati māṃ śakra tanūjastava so'rjunaḥ |
bhṛtyavattat kariṣyāmi tava snehena yantritaḥ || 101 ||
satyasaṃdhasya tacchrutvā priyaṃ prītasya bhāṣitam |
kṛṣṇasya sākṣāt tridivaṃ jagāma tridaśeśvaraḥ ||102||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi govindābhiṣeke ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 ||

<2.20>

viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
gate śakre tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pūjyamāno vrajālayaiḥ |
govardhanaparaḥ śrīmān viveśa vrajameva ha || 1 ||
tasya vṛddhābhinandanti jñātayaśca sahoṣitāḥ |
dhanyāḥ smo'nugṛhītāḥ smastvadvṛttena nayena ca || 2 ||
gāvo varṣabhayāt tīrṇā vayaṃ tīrṇā mahābhayāt |
tava prasādād govinda devatulyaparākrama || 3 ||
amānuṣāṇi karmāṇi tava paśyāma gopate |
dhāraṇenāsya śailasya vidmastvāṃ kṛṣṇa daivatam || 4 ||
kastvaṃ bhavasi rudrāṇāṃ marutāṃ ca mahābalaḥ |
vasūnāṃ vā kimarthe ca vasudevaḥ pitā tava || 5 ||
balaṃ ca bālye krīḍā ca janma cāsmāsu garhitam|
kṛṣṇa divyā ca te ceṣṭā śaṅkitāni manāṃsi naḥ || 6 ||
kimarthaṃ gopaveṣeṇa ramase'smāsu garhitam |
lokapālopamaścaiva gāstvaṃ kiṃ parirakṣasi || 7 ||
devo vā dānavo vā tvaṃ yakṣo gandharva eva vā |
asmākaṃ bāndhavo jāto yo'si so'si namo'stu te ||8||
kenacid yadi kāryeṇa vasasīha yadṛcchayā |
vayaṃ tavānugāḥ sarve bhavantaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 9 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
gopānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇaḥ padmadalekṣaṇaḥ |
pratyuvāca smitaṃ kṛtvā jñātīnsarvānsamāgatān||2.20.10||
manyante māṃ yathā sarve bhavanto bhīmavikramam|
tathāhaṃ nāvamantavyaḥ svajātīyo'smi bāndhavaḥ||11||
yadi tvavaśyaṃ śrotavyaṃ kālaḥ sampratipālyatām |
tato bhavantaḥ śroṣyanti māṃ ca drakṣyanti tattvataḥ || 12 ||
yadyayaṃ bhavatāṃ ślāghyo bāndhavo devasaprabhaḥ |
parijñānena kiṃ kāryaṃ yadyeṣo'nugraho mama || 13 ||
evamuktāstu te gopā vasudevasutena vai |
baddhamaunā diśaḥ sarve bhejire pihitānanāḥ || 14 ||
kṛṣṇastu yauvanaṃ dṛṣṭvā niśi candramaso vanam|
śāradīṃ ca niśāṃ ramyāṃ manaścakre ratiṃ prati||15||
sa karīṣāṅgarāgāsu vrajarathyāsu vīryavān |
vṛṣāṇāṃ jātadarpāṇāṃ yuddhāni samayojayat || 16 ||
gopālāṃśca balodagrānyodhayāmāsa vīryavān |
vane sa vīro gāścaiva jagrāha grāhavad vibhuḥ || 17 ||
yuvatīrgopakanyāśca rātrau saṃkālya kālavit|
kaiśorakaṃ mānayan vai saha tābhirmumoda ha || 18 ||
tāstasya vadanaṃ kāntaṃ kāntā gopastriyo niśi |
pibanti nayanākṣepairgāṃ gataṃ śaśinaṃ yathā || 19 ||
haritālārdrapītena sa kauśeyena vāsasā |
vasāno bhadravasanaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kāntataro'bhavat || 2.20.20 ||
sa baddhāṅgadanirvyūhaścitrayā vanamālayā |
śobhamāno hi govindaḥ śobhayāmāsa tadvrajam||21||
nāma dāmodaretyevaṃ gopakanyāstadābruvan |
vicitraṃ caritaṃ ghoṣe dṛṣṭvā tattasya bhāsvataḥ || 22 ||
tāstaṃ payodharottuṅgairurobhiḥ samapīḍayan|
bhrāmitākṣaiśca vadanairnirīkṣante varāṅganāḥ || 23 ||
tā vāryamāṇāḥ patibhirmātṛbhirbhrātṛbhistathā |
kṛṣṇaṃ gopāṅganā rātrau mṛgayante ratipriyāḥ || 24 ||
tāstu paṅktīkṛtāḥ sarvā ramayanti manoramam |
gāyantyaḥ kṛṣṇacaritaṃ dvandvaśo gopakanyakāḥ || 25 ||
kṛṣṇalīlānukāriṇyaḥ kṛṣṇapraṇihitekṣaṇāḥ |
kṛṣṇasya gatigāminyastaruṇyastā varāṅganāḥ || 26 ||
vaneṣu tālahastāgraiḥ kūjayantyastathāparāḥ |
cerurvai caritaṃ tasya kṛṣṇasya vrajayoṣitaḥ | 27 ||
tāstasya nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ ca vilāsasmitavīkṣitam |
muditāścānukurvantyaḥ krīḍanti vrajayoṣitaḥ || 28 ||
bhāvanispandamadhuraṃ gāyantyastā varāṅganāḥ |
vrajaṃ gatāḥ sukhaṃ cerurdāmodaraparāyaṇāḥ || 29 ||
karīṣapāṃsudigdhāṅgyastāḥ kṛṣṇamanuvavrire |
ramayantyo yathā nāgaṃ sampramattaṃ kareṇavaḥ || 2.20.30 ||
tamanyā bhāvavikacairnetraiḥ prahasitānanāḥ |
pibantyatṛptavanitāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇamṛgekṣaṇāḥ|| 31 ||
mukhamasyābjasaṃkāśaṃ tṛṣitā gopakanyakāḥ |
ratyantaragatā rātrau pibanti rasalālasāḥ || 32 ||
hā heti kurvatastasya prahṛṣṭāstā varāṅganāḥ |
jagṛhurnissṛtāṃ vāṇīṃ nāmnā dāmodareritām || 33||
tāsāṃ grathitasīmantā ratiṃ nītvā''kulīkṛtāḥ |
cāru visraṃsire keśāḥ kucāgre gopayoṣitām || 34 ||
evaṃ sa kṛṣṇo gopīnāṃ cakravālairalaṃkṛtaḥ |
śāradīṣu sacandrāsu niśāsu mumude sukhī ||35||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi rāsakrīḍāyāṃ viṃśodhyāyaḥ||20||

<2.21>

ekaviṃśodhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
pradoṣārddhe kadācit tu kṛṣṇe ratiparāyaṇe|
trāsayan samado goṣṭhamariṣṭaḥ pratyadṛśyata||1||
nirvāṇāṅgārameghābhastīkṣṇaśṛṅgo'rkalocanaḥ |
kṣuratīkṣṇāgracaraṇaḥ kālaḥ kāla ivāparaḥ||2||
lelihānaḥ saniṣpeṣaṃ jihvayoṣṭhau punaḥ punaḥ |
garvitāviddhalāṅgūlaḥ kaṭhinaskandhabandhanaḥ || 3 ||
kakudodagranirmāṇaḥ pramāṇād duratikramaḥ ||
śakṛnmūtropaliptāṅgo gavāmudvejano bhṛśam||4||
mahākaṭiḥ sthūlamukho dṛḍhajānurmahodaraḥ |
viṣāṇāvalgitagatirlambatā kaṇṭhacarmaṇā ||5||
gavāroheṣu capalastarughātāṅkitānanaḥ ||
yuddhasañjāviṣāṇāgro dviṣadvṛṣabhasūdanaḥ || 6 ||
ariṣṭo nāma hi gavāmariṣṭo dāruṇākṛtiḥ |
daityo vṛṣabharūpeṇa goṣṭhān viparidhāvati || 7 ||
pātayāno gavāṃ garbhān dṛpto gacchatyanārtavam |
bhajamānaśca capalo gṛṣṭīḥ sampracacāra ha || 8 ||
śṛṅgapraharaṇo raudraḥ praharan goṣu durmadaḥ |
goṣṭheṣu na ratiṃ lebhe vinā yuddhena govṛṣaḥ || 9 ||
kasyacit tvatha kālasya sa vṛṣaḥ keśavāgrataḥ |
ājagāma balodagro vaivasvatavaśe sthitaḥ || 2.21.10 ||
sa tatra gāstu prasabhaṃ bādhamāno madotkaṭaḥ |
cakāra nirvṛṣaṃ goṣṭhaṃ nirvatsaśiśupuṅgavam || 11 ||
etasminneva kāle tu gāvaḥ kṛṣṇasamīpagāḥ |
trāsayāmāsa duṣṭātmā vaivasvatavaśe sthitaḥ || 12 ||
sendrāśanirivāmbhodo nardamāno mahāsuraḥ |
tālaśabdena taṃ kṛṣṇaḥ siṃhanādaiśca mohayan || 13 ||
abhyadhāvata govindo daityaṃ vṛṣabharūpiṇam |
sa kṛṣṇaṃ govṛṣo dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭalāṅgūlalocanaḥ || 14 ||
roṣitastālaśabdena yuddhākāṅkṣī nanarda ha |
tamāpatantaṃ durvṛttaṃ dṛṣṭvā vṛṣabharūpiṇam |
tasmāt sthānānna vyacalat kṛṣṇo giririvācalaḥ || 15 ||
sa kukṣau vṛṣabho dṛṣṭiṃ praṇidhāya dhṛtānanaḥ |
kṛṣṇasya nidhanākāṅkṣī tūrṇamabhyutpapāta ha || 16 ||
tamāpatantaṃ vegena pratijagrāha durddharam|
kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇāñjananibho vṛṣaṃ prati vṛṣopamaḥ || 17 ||
sa saṃsaktastu kṛṣṇo vai vṛṣeṇeva mahāvṛṣaḥ |
mumoca vaktrajaṃ phenaṃ nastaścātha saśabdavat || 18 ||
tāvanyonyāvaruddhāṅgau yuddhe kṛṣṇavṛṣāvubhau |
rejaturmeghasamaye saṃsaktāviva toyadau || 19 ||
tasya darpabalaṃ hatvā kṛtvā śṛṅgāntare padam |
āpīḍayadariṣṭasya kaṇṭhaṃ klinnamivāmbaram || 2.21.20 ||
śṛṅgaṃ cāsya punaḥ savyamutpāṭya yamadaṇḍavat |
tenaiva prāharad vaktre sa mamāra bhṛśaṃ hataḥ || 21 ||
sa bhinnaśṛṅgo bhagnāsyo bhagnaskandhaśca dānavaḥ |
papāta rudhirodgārī sāmbudhāra ivāmbudaḥ || 22 ||
govindena hataṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛptaṃ vṛṣabhadānavam |
sādhu sādhviti bhūtāni tatkarmāsyābhituṣṭuvuḥ || 23
sa copendro vṛṣaṃ hatvā kāntacandre niśāmukhe |
aravindābhanayanaḥ punareva rarāsa ha || 24 ||
te'pi govṛttayaḥ sarve kṛṣṇaṃ kamalalocanam|
upāsāṃcakrire hṛṣṭāḥ sarve śakramivāmarāḥ || 25 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi vṛṣabhāsuravadhe ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 ||

<2.22>

dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
kṛṣṇaṃ vrajagataṃ śrutvā vardhamānamivānalam |
udvegamagamat kaṃsaḥ śaṅkamānastato bhayam || 1 ||
pūtanāyāṃ hatāyāṃ ca kāliye ca parājite |
dhenuke pralayaṃ nīte pralambe ca nipātite || 2 ||
dhṛte govardhane śaile viphale śakraśāsane |
goṣu trātāsu ca tathā spṛhaṇīyena karmaṇā || 3 ||
kakudmini hate'riṣṭe gopeṣu muditeṣu ca |
dṛśyamāne vināśe ca saṃnikṛṣṭe mahābhaye || 4 ||
karṣaṇe vṛkṣayoścaiva śakaṭasya tathaiva ca |
acintyaṃ karmma tacchrutvā vardhamāneṣu śatruṣu || 5||
prāptāriṣṭamivātmānaṃ mene sa mathureśvaraḥ |
visaṃjñendriyabhūtātmā gatāsupratimo babhau || 6 ||
tato jñātīn samānāyya pitaraṃ cograśāsanaḥ |
niśi stimitamūkāyāṃ mathurāyāṃ janādhipaḥ || 7 ||
vasudevaṃ ca devābhaṃ kaṅkaṃ cāhūya yādavam|
satyakaṃ dārukaṃ caiva kaṅkāvarajameva ca || 8 ||
bhojaṃ vaitaraṇaṃ caiva vikadruṃ ca mahābalam |
bhayaśaṅkhaṃ ca dharmajñaṃ vipṛthuṃ ca pṛthuśriyam || 9 ||
babhruṃ dānapatiṃ caiva kṛtavarmāṇameva ca |
bhūritejasamakṣobhyaṃ bhūriśravasameva ca || 2.22.10 ||
etānsa yādavān sarvānābhāṣya śṛṇuteti ca |
ugrasenasuto rājā provāca mathureśvaraḥ || 11 ||
bhavantaḥ sarvakāryajñā vedeṣu pariniṣṭhitāḥ |
nyāyavṛttāntakuśalāstrivargasya pravartakāḥ || 12 ||
kartavyānāṃ ca kartāro lokasya vibudhopamāḥ |
tasthivāṃso mahāvṛtte niṣkampā iva parvatāḥ || 13 ||
adambhavṛttayaḥ sarve sarve gurukuloṣitāḥ |
rājamantradharāḥ sarve sarve dhanuṣi pāragāḥ || 14 ||
yaśaḥpradīpā lokānāṃ vedārthānāṃ vivakṣavaḥ |
āśramāṇāṃ nisargajñā varṇānāṃ kramapāragāḥ || 15 ||
pravaktāraḥ suniyatāṃ netāro nayadarśinām |
bhettāraḥ pararāṣṭrāṇāṃ trātāraḥ śaraṇārthinām || 16 ||
evamakṣatacāritraiḥ śrīmadbhiruditoditaiḥ |
dyaurapyanugṛhītā syādbhavadbhiḥ kiṃ punarmahī || 17 ||
ṛṣīṇāmiva vo vṛttaṃ prabhāvo marutāmiva |
rudrāṇāmiva vaḥ krodho dīptiraṅgirasāramiva || 18 ||
vyāvartamānaṃ sumahad bhavadbhiḥ khyāta kīrtibhiḥ |
dhṛtaṃ yadukulaṃ vīrairbhūtalaṃ parvatairiva || 19 ||
evaṃ bhavatsu yukteṣu mama cittānuvartiṣu |
vardhamāno mamānartho bhavadbhiḥ kimupekṣitaḥ || 2.22.20 ||
eṣa kṛṣṇa iti khyāto nandagopasuto vraje |
vardhamāna ivāmbhobhirmūlaṃ naḥ parikṛntati || 21 ||
anamātyasya śūnyasya cārāndhasya mamaiva tu |
kāraṇānnandagopasya sa suto gopito gṛhe || 22 ||
upekṣita iva vyādhiḥ pūryamāṇa ivāmbudaḥ |
nadanmegha ivoṣṇānte sa durātmā vivardhate || 23 ||
tasya nāhaṃ gatiṃ jāne na yogaṃ na parākramam |
nandagopasya bhavane jātasyādbhutakarmaṇaḥ || 24 ||
kiṃ tadbhūtaṃ samudbhūtaṃ devāpatyaṃ na vidmahe |
atidevairamānuṣyaiḥ karmabhiḥ so'numīyate || 25 ||
pūtanā śakunī bālye śiśunottānaśāyinā |
stanapānepsunā pītā prāṇaiḥ saha durāsadā || 26 ||
yamunāyā hrade nāgaḥ kāliyo damitastathā |
rasātalacaro nītaḥ kṣaṇenādarśanaṃ hradāt || 27 ||
nandagopasuto yogaṃ kṛtvā sa punarutthitaḥ |
cenukastālaśikharāt pātito jīvitaṃ vinā || 28 ||
pralambaṃ yaṃ mṛdhe devā na śekurativartitum |
bālena muṣṭinaikena sa hataḥ prākṛto yathā || 29 ||
vāsavasyotsavaṃ bhaṅaktvā varṣaṃ vāsavaroṣajam |
nirjitya gogṛhārthāya dhṛto govardhano giriḥ||2.22.30||
hatastvariṣṭo balavān niḥśṛṅgaśca kṛto vraje |
abālo bālyamāsthāya ramate śiśulīlayā || 31 ||
prabandhaḥ karmaṇāmeva tasya govrajavāsinaḥ |
saṃnikṛṣṭaṃ bhayaṃ caiva keśino mama ca dhuvam || 32 ||
bhūtapūrvaśca me mṛtyuḥ satataṃ pūrvadaihikaḥ |
yuddhākāṅkṣī ca sa yathā tiṣṭhatīha mamāgrataḥ || 33 ||
kva ca gopatvamaśubhaṃ mānuṣyaṃ mṛtyudurbalam |
kva ca devaprabhāveṇa krīḍitavyaṃ vraje mama || 34 ||
aho nīcena vapuṣācchādayitvā''tmano vapuḥ |
ko'pyeṣa ramate devaḥ śmaśānasya ivānalaḥ || 35 ||
śrūyate hi purā viṣṇuḥ surāṇāṃ kāraṇāntare |
vāmanena tu rūpeṇa jahāra pṛthivīmimām || 36 ||
kṛtvā kesariṇo rūpaṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā |
hato hiraṇyakaśipurdānavānāṃ pitāmahaḥ ||37||
acintyarūpamāsthāya śvetaśailasya mūrdhani |
bhavena cyāvitā daityāḥ purā tattripuraṃ ghnatā || 38 ||
cālito guruputreṇa bhārgavo'ṅgirasena vai |
praviśya dārdurīṃ māyāmanāvṛṣṭiṃ cakāra ha || 39 ||
anantaḥ śāśvato devaḥ sahasraśiraso'vyayaḥ |
vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāya projjahārārṇavānmahī m || 2.22.40 ||
amṛte nirmite pūrvaṃ viṣṇuḥ strīrūpamāsthitaḥ |
surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca yuddhaṃ cakre sudāruṇam || 41 ||
amṛtārthe purā cāpi devadaityasamāgame |
dadhāra mandaraṃ viṣṇurakūpāra iti śrutiḥ || 42 ||
vapurvāmanamāsthāya nandanīyaṃ purā baleḥ |
tribhiḥ kramaistu trīṃllokāñjahāra tridivālayam || 43 |
caturdhā tejaso bhāgaṃ kṛtvā dāśarathe gṛhe |
sa eva rāmasaṃjño vai rāvaṇaṃ vyanaśat tadā || 44 ||
evameva nikṛtyā vai tattadrūpamupāgataḥ |
sādhayatyātmanaḥ kāryaṃ surāṇāmarthasiddhaye||45||
tadeva nūnaṃ viṣṇurvā śakro vā marutāṃ patiḥ |
matsādhanecchayā prāpto nārado māṃ yaduktavān || 46 ||
atra me śaṅkate buddhirvasudevaṃ prati dhruvā |
asya buddhiviśeṣeṇa vayaṃ kātaratāṃ gatāḥ || 47 ||
ahaṃ hi khaṭvāṅgavane nāradena samāgataḥ |
dvitīyaṃ sa hi māṃ vipraḥ punarevābravīd vacaḥ || 48 ||
yastvayā hi kṛto yatnaḥ kaṃsa garbhakṛte mahān |
vasudevena te rātrau tatkarma viphalīkṛtam || 49 ||
dārikā yā tvayā rātrau śilāyāṃ kaṃsa pātitā |
tāṃ yaśodāsutāṃ viddhi kṛṣṇaṃ ca vasudevajam || 2.22.50 ||
rātrau vyāvartitāvetau garbhau tava vadhāya vai |
vasudevena saṃdhāya mitrarūpeṇa śatruṇā || 51 ||
sā tu kanyā yaśodāyā vindhye parvatasattame |
hatvā śumbhaniśumbhau dvau dānavau nagacāriṇau || 52 ||
kṛtābhiṣekā varadā bhūtasaṃghaniṣevitā |
arcyate dasyubhirghorairmahābalipaśupriyā || 53
surāpiśitapūrṇābhyāṃ kumbhābhyāmupaśobhitā |
mayūrāṅgadacitraiśca barhabhārairvibhūṣitā || 54 ||
hṛṣṭakukkuṭasaṃnādaṃ vanaṃ vāyasanāditam |
mṛgasaṃghaiśca sampūrṇamaviruddhaiśca pakṣibhiḥ || 55 ||
siṃhavyāghravarāhāṇāṃ nādena pratināditam |
vṛkṣagambhīranibiḍaṃ kāntāraiḥ sarvato vṛtam || 56 ||
divyabhṛṅgārucamarairādarśairupaśobhitam |
devatūryaninādaiśca śataśaḥ pratināditam || 57 ||
sthānaṃ tasyā nage vindhye nirmitaṃ svena tejasā |
ripūṇāṃ trāsajananī nityaṃ tatra manorame || 58 ||
vasate paramaprītā devatairapi pūjitā|
yastvayaṃ nandagopasya kṛṣṇa ityucyate sutaḥ || 59 ||
atra me nāradaḥ prāha sumahatkarmakāraṇam |
dvitīyo vasudevād vai vāsudevo bhaviṣyati || 2.22.60 ||
sa hi te sahajo mṛtyurbāndhavaśca bhaviṣyati |
sa eva vāsudevo vai vasudevasuto balī |
bāndhavo dharmato mahyaṃ hṛdayenāntako ripuḥ ||61 ||
netre tudati tasyaiva vaktreṇāmiṣagṛddhinā || 62 ||
vasudevastathaivāyaṃ saputrajñātibāndhavaḥ |
chinatti mama mūlāni bhuṅkte ca mama pārśvataḥ||63||
bhrūṇahatyāpi saṃtāryā govadhaḥ strīvadho'pi vā |
na kṛtaghnasya loko'sti bāndhavasya viśeṣataḥ || 64 ||
patitānugataṃ mārgaṃ niṣevatyacireṇa saḥ |
yaḥ kṛtaghno'nubandhena prītiṃ vahati dāruṇām || 65 |
narakādhyuṣitaḥ panthā gantavyastena dāruṇaḥ |
apāpe pāpahṛdayo yaḥ pāpamanutiṣṭhati || 66 ||
ahaṃ vā svajanaḥ ślāghyaḥ sa vā ślāghyataraḥ sutaḥ |
niyamairguṇavṛttena tvayā bāndhavakāmyayā || 67 ||
hastināṃ kalahe ghore vadhamṛcchanti vīrudhaḥ |
yuddhavyuparame te tu sahāśnanti mahāvane || 68 ||
bāndhavānāmapi tathā bhedakāle samutthite |
vadhyate yo'ntaraprepsuḥ svajano yadi vetaraḥ || 69 ||
kālastvaṃ hi vināśāya mayā puṣṭo vijānatā |
vasudeva kulasyāsya yad virodhayase bhṛśam || 2.22.70 ||
amarṣī vairaśīlaśca sadā pāpamatiḥ śaṭhaḥ |
sthāne yadukulaṃ mūḍha śocanīyaṃ tvayā kṛtam || 71 ||
vasudeva vṛthā vṛddha yanmayā tvaṃ puraskṛtaḥ |
śvetena śirasā vṛddho naiva varṣaśatairbhavet || 72 ||
yasya buddhiḥ pariṇatā sa vai vṛddhataro nṛṇām || 73 ||
tvaṃ ca karkaśaśīlaśca buddhyā ca na bahuśrutaḥ |
kevalaṃ vayasā vṛddho yathā śaradi toyadaḥ || 74 ||
kiṃ ca tvaṃ sādhu jānīṣe vasudeva vṛthāmate |
mṛte kaṃse mama suto mathurāṃ pālayiṣyati || 75 ||
chinnāśastvaṃ vṛthāvṛddho mithyātvevaṃ vicāritam |
jijīviṣurna so'pyasti yo'vatiṣṭhenmamāgrataḥ || 76 ||
prahartukāmo viśvaste yastvaṃ duṣṭena cetasā |
tat te pratikariṣye'haṃ putrayostava paśyataḥ || 77 ||
na me vṛddhavadhaḥ kaścid dvijastrīvadha eva ca |
kṛtapūrvaḥ kariṣye vā viśeṣeṇa tu bāndhave || 78 ||
iha tvaṃ jātasaṃvṛddho mama pitrā vivardhitaḥ |
pitṛṣvasuśca me bhartā yadūnāṃ prathamo guruḥ || 79 ||
kule mahati vikhyātaḥ prathite cakravartinām |
gurvarthaṃ pūjitaḥ sadbhirmahadbhirdharmabuddhibhiḥ || 2.22.80 ||
kiṃ kariṣyāmahe sarve satsu vaktavyatāṃ gatāḥ |
yadūnāṃ yūthamukhyasya yasya te vṛttamīdṛśam || 81 ||
madvadho vā jayo vātha vasudevasya durnayaiḥ |
satsu yāsyanti puruṣā yadūnāmavaguṇṭhitāḥ || 82 ||
tvayā hi madvadhopāyaṃ tarkamāṇena vai mṛdhe |
aviśvāsyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma vācyāśca yadavaḥ kṛtāḥ || 83 ||
aśāmyaṃ vairamutpannaṃ mama kṛṣṇasya cobhayoḥ |
śāntimekatare śāntiṃ gate yāsyanti yādavāḥ || 84 ||
gaccha dānapate kṣipraṃ tāvihānayituṃ vrajāt |
nandagopaṃ ca gopāṃśca karadān mama śāsanāt || 85 ||
vācyaśca nandagopo vai karamādāya vārṣikam |
śīghramāgaccha nagaraṃ gopaiḥ saha samanvitaḥ || 89 ||
kṛṣṇasaṃkarṣaṇau caiva vasudevasutāvubhau |
draṣṭumicchati vai kaṃsaḥ sabhṛtyaḥ sapurohitaḥ || 87 ||
etau yuddhavidau raṅge kālanirmāṇayodhinau |
dṛḍhau ca kṛtinau caiva śṛṇomi vyāyatodyamau || 88 ||
asmākamapi mallau dvau sajjau yuddhakṛtotsavau |
tābhyāṃ saha niyotsyete tau yuddhakuśalāvubhau || 89 ||
draṣṭavyau ca mayāvaśyaṃ bālau tāvamaropamau |
pitṛṣvasuḥ sutau mukhyau vrajavāsau vanecarau || 2.22.90 ||
vaktavyaṃ ca vraje tasmin samīpe vrajavāsinām |
rājā dhanurmakhaṃ nāma kārayiṣyati vai sukhī || 91 ||
saṃnikṛṣṭe vane te tu nivasantu yathāsukham |
janasyāmantritasyārthe yathā syāt sarvamavyayam ||92 ||
payasaḥ sarpiṣaścaiva dadhno dadhyuttarasya ca |
yathākāmapradānāya bhojyādhiśrayaṇāya ca || 93 ||
akrūra gaccha śīghraṃ tvaṃ tāvānaya mamājñayā |
saṃkarṣaṇaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca draṣṭuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 94 ||
tayorāgamane prītiḥ paramā matkṛtā bhavet|
dṛṣṭvā tu tau mahāvīryau tadvidhāsyāmi yaddhitam || 95 ||
śāsanaṃ yadi vā śrutvā mama tau paribhāṣitam |
nāgacchetāṃ yathākālaṃ nigrāhyāvapi tau mama || 96 ||
sāntvameva tu bāleṣu pradhānaṃ prathamo nayaḥ |
madhureṇaiva tau mandau svayamevānayāśu vai || 97 ||
akrūra kuru me prītimetāṃ paramadurlabhām |
yadi vā nopajapto'si vasudevena suvrata |
tathā kartavyametaddhi yathā tāvāgamiṣyataḥ || 98 ||
evamākṣipyamāṇo'pi vasudevo vasūpamaḥ |
sāgarākāramātmānaṃ niṣprakampamadhārayat ||99||
vākchalyaistāḍyamānastu kaṃsenādīrghadarśinā |
kṣamāṃ manasi saṃdhāya nottaraṃ pratyabhāṣata ||2.22.100|
ye tu taṃ dadṛśustatra kṣipyamāṇamanekadhā |
dhigdhigityasakṛtte vai śanairūcuravāṅmukhāḥ ||101||
akrūrastu mahātejā jānan divyena cakṣuṣā |
jalaṃ dṛṣṭveva tṛṣitaḥ preṣitaḥ prītimānabhūt ||102||
tasminneva muhūrte tu mathurāyāḥ sa niryayau |
prītimānpuṇḍarīkākṣaṃ draṣṭuṃ dānapatiḥ svayam ||103||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi akrūraprasthāne dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||22||

<2.23>

trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
kṣiptaṃ yaduvṛṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve te yadupuṅgavāḥ |
nipīḍya śravaṇān hastairmenire taṃ gatāyuṣam || 1 ||
andhako'nudvignamanā dhairyādavikṛtaṃ vacaḥ |
provāca vadatāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ samāje kaṃsamojasā || 2 ||
aślāghyo me mataḥ putra tavāyaṃ vākpariśramaḥ |
ayukto garhitaḥ sadbhirbāndhaveṣu viśeṣataḥ || 3 ||
ayādavo yadi bhavāñchṛṇu tāvad yaducyate |
na hi tvāṃ yādavaṃ vīra balātkurvanti yādavāḥ || 4 ||
aślāghyā vṛṣṇayaḥ putra yeṣāṃ tvamanuśāsitā |
ikṣvākuvaṃśajo rājā vinivṛttaḥ svayaṃ sakṛt || 5 ||
bhojo vā yādavo vāsi kaṃso vāsi yathā tathā |
sahajaṃ te śirastāta jaṭī muṇḍo'pi vā bhava || 6 ||
ugrasenastvayaṃ śocyo yo'smākaṃ kulapāṃsanaḥ |
durjātīyena yena tvamīdṛśo janitaḥ sutaḥ || 7 ||
na cātmano guṇāṃstāta pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ |
pareṇoktā guṇā gauṇyaṃ yānti vedārthasammitāḥ || 8 ||
pṛthivyāṃ yaduvaṃśo'yaṃ nindanīyo mahīkṣitām |
bālaḥ kulāntakṛnmūḍho yeṣāṃ tvamanuśāsitā || 9 ||
asādhumadbhirvākyaiśca tvayā sādhviti bhāṣitaiḥ |
na cāpyāsāditaṃ kāryamātmā ca vivṛtaḥ kṛtaḥ || 2.23.10 ||
guroranavaliptasya mānyasya mahatāmapi |
kṣepaṇaṃ kaḥ śubhaṃ manthe dvijasyeva vadhe kṛte || 11 ||
mānyāścaivābhigamyāśca ghṛddhāstāta yathāgnayaḥ |
krodho hi teṣāṃ pradahellokānantargatānapi || 12 ||
budhena tāta dāntena nityamabhyucchritātmanā |
dharmasya gatiranveṣyā matsyasya gatirapsviva || 13 ||
kevalaṃ tvaṃ tu darpeṇa vṛddhānagnisamāniha |
vacā tudasi marmaghnyā amantroktā yathā''hutiḥ| 14|
vasudevaṃ ca putrārthe yadimaṃ parigarhasi |
tatra mithyā pralāpaṃ te nindāmi kṛpaṇaṃ vacaḥ || 15 ||
dāruṇe ca pitā putre naiva dāruṇatāṃ vrajet |
putrārthaṃ hyāpadaḥ kaṣṭāḥ pitaraḥ prāpnuvanti hi || 16 ||
chādito vasudevena yadi putraḥ śiśustadā |
manyase yadyakartavyaṃ tat pṛccha pitaraṃ svakam || 17 ||
garhatā vasudevaṃ ca yaduvaṃśaṃ ca nindatā |
tvayā yādavaputrāṇāṃ vairajaṃ viṣamarjitam || 18 ||
akartavyaṃ yadi kṛtaṃ vasudevena putrajam |
kimarthamugrasenena śiśustvaṃ na vināśitaḥ || 19 ||
punnāmno narakātputro yasmāttrātā pitṝṃstadā |
tasmād bruvanti putreti putraṃ dharmavido janāḥ || 2.23.20 ||
jātyāṃ hi yādavaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sa ca saṃkarṣaṇo yuvā|
tvaṃ cāpi vidhṛtastābhyāṃ jātavaireṇa cetasā || 21 ||
uddhṛtānīha sarveṣāṃ yadūnāṃ hṛdayāni vai |
vasudeve tvayā''kṣipte vāsudeve ca kopite || 22 ||
kṛṣṇe ca bhavato dveṣye vasudevavigarhaṇāt |
śaṃsanti cemāni bhayaṃ nimittānyaśubhāni te || 23 ||
sarpāṇāṃ darśanaṃ tīvraṃ duḥsvapnānāṃ niśākṣaye |
puryā vaidhavyaśaṃsīni kāraṇairanumīmahe || 24 ||
eṣa ghorograhaḥ svātīmullikhan khe gabhastibhiḥ |
vakramaṅgārakaścakre citrāyāṃ ghoradarśanaḥ || 25 ||
budhena paścimā saṃdhyā vyāptā ghoreṇa tejasā |
vaiśvānarapathe śukro hyaticāraṃ cacāra ha || 26 ||
ketunā dhūmaketostu nakṣatrāṇi trayodaśa |
bharaṇyādīni bhinnāni nānuyānti niśākaram || 27 ||
prāksaṃdhyā parighagrastā bhābhirbādhati bhāskaram|
pratilomaṃ ca yāntyeva vyāharanto mṛgadvijāḥ || 28 ||
śivā smaśānānniṣkramya niḥśvāsāṅgāravarṣiṇī|
ubhe saṃdhye purīṃ ghorā paryeti bahu vāśatī || 29 ||
ulkā nirghātanādena papāta dharaṇītale |
calatyaparvaṇi mahī girīṇāṃ śikharāṇi ca || 2.23.30 ||
trastaḥ svarbhānunā sūryo divā naktamajāyata |
dhūmotpātairdiśo vyāptāḥ śuṣkāśanisamāhatāḥ || 31 ||
prasravanti ghanā raktaṃ sāśanistanayitnavaḥ |
calitā devatāḥ sthānāttyajanti vihagā nagān ||32||
yāni rājavināśāya daivajñāḥ kathayanti ha |
tāni sarvāṇi paśyāmo nimittānyaśubhāni vai || 33 ||
tvaṃ cāpi svajanadveṣī rājadharmaparāṅmukhaḥ |
animittāgatakrodhaḥ saṃnikṛṣṭabhayo hyasi || 34 ||
yastvaṃ devopamaṃ vṛddhaṃ vasudevaṃ vasūpamam |
mohāt kṣipasi durbuddhe kutaste śāntirātmanaḥ || 35 ||
tvadgato yo hi naḥ snehastaṃ tyajāmo'dya vai vayam |
ahitaṃ svasya vaṃśasya na tvāṃ kṣaṇamupāsmahe || 36 ||
sa hi dānapatirdhanyo yo drakṣyati vane gatam |
puṇḍarīkaviśālākṣaṃ kṛṣṇamakliṣṭakāriṇam || 37 ||
chinnamūlo hyayaṃ vaṃśo yadūnāṃ tvatkṛte kṛtaḥ |
kṛṣṇo jñātīn samānāyya sa saṃdhānaṃ kariṣyati || 38 ||
kṣāntameva tavānena vasudevena dhīmatā |
kālasamyakparijñāno brūhi tvaṃ yadyadicchasi || 39 ||
mahyaṃ tu rocate kaṃsa vasudevasahāyavān |
gaccha kṛṣṇasya nilayaṃ saṃdhistena ca rocatām ||2.23.40||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi andhakavacane trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 23 ||

<2.24>

caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
andhakasya vacaḥ śrutvā kaṃsaḥ saṃraktalocanaḥ |
na kiṃcidabravīt krodhād viveśa svaṃ niketanam || 1 ||
te ca sarve yathāveśma yādavāḥ śrutavistarāḥ |
jagmurvigatasaṃkalpāḥ kaṃsavaikṛtaśaṃsinaḥ || 2 ||
akrūro'pi yathā''jñaptaḥ kṛṣṇadarśanalālasaḥ |
jagāma rathamukhyena manasā tulyagāminā || 3 ||
kṛṣṇasyāpi nimittāni śubhānyaṅgagatāni vai |
pitṛtulyena śaṃsanti bāndhavena samāgamam || 4 ||
prāgeva ca narendreṇa māthureṇaugraseninā |
keśinaḥ preṣito dūto vadhāyopendrakāraṇāt || 5 ||
sa ca dūtavacaḥ śrutvā keśī kleśakaro nṛṇām |
vṛndāvanagato gopān bādhate sma durāsadaḥ || 6 ||
mānuṣaṃ māṃsamaśnānaḥ kruddho duṣṭaparākramaḥ |
durdānto vājidaityo'sāvakarot kadanaṃ mahat || 7 ||
nighnan gā vai sagopālān gavāṃ piśitabhojanaḥ |
durmadaḥ kāmacārī ca sa keśī niravagrahaḥ || 8 ||
tadaraṇyaṃ kṣmaśānābhaṃ nṛṇāṃ māṃsāsthibhirvṛtam |
yatrāste sa hi duṣṭātmā keśī turagadānavaḥ || 9 ||
khurairdārayate bhūmiṃ vegenārujate drumān |
heṣitaiḥ sparddhate vāyuṃ plutairlaṅghayate nabhaḥ || 2.24.10 ||
atipravṛddho mattaśca duṣṭo'śvo vanagocaraḥ |
ākampitasaṭo raudraḥ kaṃsasya caritānugaḥ || 11 ||
īriṇaṃ tad vanaṃ sarvaṃ tenāsīt pāpakarmaṇā |
kṛtaṃ turagadaityena sarvān gopāñjighāṃsatā || 12 ||
tena duṣṭapracāreṇa dūṣitaṃ tad vanaṃ mahat |
na nṛbhirgodhanaivāpi sevyate vanavṛttibhiḥ ||13 ||
niḥsampātaḥ kṛtaḥ panthāstena tadviṣayāśrayaḥ |
madāccalitavṛttena nṛmāṃsānyaśnatā bhṛśam || 14 ||
nṛśabdānusaraḥ kruddhaḥ sa kadācid vanāgame |
jagāma ghoṣasaṃvāsaṃ coditaḥ kāladharmaṇā || 15 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā dudruvurgopāḥ striyaśca śiśubhiḥ saha |
krandamānā jagannāthaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nāthamupāśritāḥ || 16 ||
tāsāṃ ruditaśavdena gopānāṃ kranditena ca |
dattvābhayaṃ tu kṛṣṇo vai keśinaṃ so'bhidudruve || 17 ||
keśī cāpyunnatagrīvaḥ prakāśadaśanekṣaṇaḥ |
heṣamāṇo javodagro govindābhimukho yayau || 18 ||
tamāpatantaṃ samprekṣya keśinaṃ hayadānavam |
pratyujjagāma govindastoyadaḥ śaśinaṃ yathā || 19 ||
keśinastu tamabhyāśe dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇamavasthitam |
manuṣyabuddhayo gopāḥ kṛṣṇamūcurhitaiṣiṇaḥ || 2.24.20 ||
kṛṣṇa tāta na khalveṣa sahasā te hayādhamaḥ |
upasarpyo bhavān bālaḥ pāpaścaiṣa durāsadaḥ || 21 ||
eṣa kaṃsasya sahajaḥ prāṇastāta bahiścaraḥ |
uttamaśca hayendrāṇāṃ dānavo'pratimo yudhi || 22 ||
trāsanaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ turagāṇāṃ mahābalaḥ |
avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ prathamaḥ pāpakarmaṇām || 23 ||
gopānāṃ tad vacaḥ śrutvā vadatāṃ madhusūdanaḥ |
keśinā saha yuddhāya matiṃ cakre'risūdanaḥ || 24 ||
tataḥ savyaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ ca maṇḍalaṃ sa paribhraman |
padbhyāmubhābhyāṃ sa hayaḥ krodhenārujate drumān || 25 ||
mukhe lambasaṭe cāsya skandhe keśaghanāvṛte |
valayo'bhrataraṅgābhāḥ susruvuḥ krodhajaṃ jalam || 26 ||
sa phenaṃ vaktrajaṃ caiva vavarṣa rajasāvṛtam |
himakāle yathā vyomni nīhāramiva candramāḥ || 27 ||
govindamaravindākṣaṃ heṣitodgāraśīkaraiḥ |
sa phenairvaktranirgīrṇaiḥ prokṣayāmāsa bhārata || 28 ||
khuroddhūtāvasiktena madhukakṣodapāṇḍunā |
rajasā sa hayaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ cakārāruṇamūrdhajam ||29 ||
plutavalgitapādastu takṣamāṇo dharāṃ khuraiḥ |
dantān nirdaśamānastu keśī kṛṣṇamupādravat || 2.24.30 ||
sa saṃsaktastu kṛṣṇena keśī turagasattamaḥ |
pūrvābhyāṃ caraṇābhyāṃ vai kṛṣṇaṃ vakṣasyatāḍayat || 31||
punaḥ punaḥ sa ca balī prāhiṇotpārśvataḥ khurān |
kṛṣṇasya dānavo ghoraṃ prahāramamitaujasaḥ ||32||
vaktreṇa cāsya ghoreṇa tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāyudhena vai |
adaśad bāhuśikharaṃ kṛṣṇasya ruṣito hayaḥ | 33 ||
sa lambakesarasaṭaḥ kṛṣṇena saha saṅgataḥ |
rarāja keśī meghena saṃsaktaḥ kha ivāṃśumān || 34 ||
urastasyorasā hantumiyeṣa valavān hayaḥ |
vegena vāsudevasya krodhād dviguṇavikramaḥ || 35 ||
tasyotsiktasya balavān kṛṣṇo'pyamitavikramaḥ |
bāhumābhoginaṃ kṛtvā mukhe kruddhaḥ samādadhat || 36 ||
sa taṃ bāhumaśakto vai khādituṃ bhettumeva ca |
daśanairmūlanirmuktaiḥ saphenaṃ rudhiraṃ vaman || 37 ||
vipāṭitābhyāmoṣṭhābhyāṃ kaṭābhyāṃ vidalīkṛtaḥ |
akṣiṇī vivṛte cakre visṛte muktabandhane || 38 ||
nirastahanurāviṣṭaḥ śoṇitāktavilocanaḥ |
utkarṇo naṣṭacetāstu sa keśī bahvaceṣṭata ||39||
utpatannasakṛtpādaiḥ śakṛnmūtraṃ samutsṛjan |
khinnāṅgaromā śrāntastu niryatnacaraṇo'bhavat || 2.24.40 ||
keśivaktravilagnastu kṛṣṇabāhuraśobhata |
vyābhugna iva gharmānte candrārdhakiraṇairghanaḥ || 41 ||
keśī ca kṛṣṇasaṃsaktaḥ śāntagātro vyarocata |
prabhātāvanataścandraḥ śrānto merumivāśritaḥ || 42 ||
tasya kṛṣṇabhujoddhūtāḥ keśino daśanā mukhāt|
petuḥ śaradi nistoyāḥ sitābhrāvayavā iva || 43 ||
sa tu keśī bhṛśaṃ śāntaḥ kṛṣṇenākliṣṭakarmaṇā |
svabhujaṃ svāyataṃ kṛtvā pāṭito balavattadā || 44 ||
sa pāṭito bhujenājau kṛṣṇena vikṛtānanaḥ |
keśī nadanmahānādaṃ dānavo vyathitastadā || 45 ||
vighūrṇamānastrastāṅgo mukhād rudhiramudvaman |
bhṛśaṃ vyaṅgīkṛtavapurnikṛttārddha ivācalaḥ || 46 ||
vyāditāsyo mahāraudraḥ so'suraḥ kṛṣṇabāhunā |
nipapāta yathā kṛtto nāgo hi dvidalīkṛtaḥ || 47 ||
bāhunā kṛttadehasya keśino rūpamābabhau |
paśoriva mahāghoraṃ nihatasya pinākinā || 48 ||
dvipādapṛṣṭhapucchārddhe śravaṇaikākṣināsike |
keśinastadvidhābhūte dve cārdhe rejatuḥ kṣitau || 49 ||
keśidantakṣatasyāpi kṛṣṇasya śuśubhe bhujaḥ |
vṛddhaḥ sāla ivāraṇye gajendradaśanāṅkitaḥ || 2.24.50 ||
taṃ hatvā keśinaṃ yuddhe kalpayitvā ca bhāgaśaḥ |
kṛṣṇaḥ padmapalāśākṣo hasaṃstatraiva tasthivān || 51 ||
taṃ hataṃ keśinaṃ dṛṣṭvā gopā gopastriyastathā |
babhūvurmuditāḥ sarve hatavighnā gataklamāḥ || 52 ||
dāmodaraṃ tu śrīmantaṃ yathāsthānaṃ yathāvayaḥ |
abhyanandan priyairvākyaiḥ pūjayantaḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 53 ||
gopā ūcuḥ
aho tāta kṛtaṃ karma hato'yaṃ lokakaṇṭakaḥ |
daityaḥ kṣiticaraḥ kṛṣṇa hayarūpaṃ samāsthitaḥ || 54 ||
kṛtaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ kṣemaṃ sevyaṃ nṛmṛgapakṣiṇām |
ghnatā pāpamimaṃ tāta keśinaṃ hayadānavam || 55 ||
hatā no bahavo gopā gāvo vatseṣu vatsalāḥ |
naike cānye janapadā hatānena durātmanā || 56 ||
eṣa saṃvartakaṃ kartumudyataḥ khalu pāpakṛt |
nṛlokaṃ nirnaraṃ kṛtvā cartukāmo yathāsukham || 57 ||
naitasya pramukhe sthātuṃ kaścicchakto jijīviṣuḥ |
api devasamūheṣu kiṃ punaḥ pṛthivītale || 58 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
athāhāntarhito vipro nāradaḥ khagamo muniḥ |
prīto'smi viṣṇo deveśa kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti cābravīt ||59||
nārada uvāca
yadidaṃ duṣkaraṃ karma kṛtaṃ keśijighāṃsayā |
tvayyeva kevalaṃ yuktaṃ tridive tryambakasya vā || 2.24.60 ||
ahaṃ yuddhotsukastāta tvadgatenāntarātmanā |
idaṃ narahayaṃ yuddhaṃ draṣṭuṃ svargādihāgataḥ || 61 ||
pūtanānidhanādīni karmāṇi tava dṛṣṭavān |
ahaṃ tvanena govinda karmaṇā paritoṣitaḥ || 62 ||
hayādasmānmahendro'pi bibheti balasūdanaḥ |
kurvāṇācca vapurghoraṃ keśino duṣṭacetasaḥ || 63 ||
yattvayā pāṭito deho bhujenāyataparvaṇā |
eṣo'sya mṛtyurantāya vihito viśvayoninā || 64 ||
yasmāt tvayā hataḥ keśī tasmānmacchāsanaṃ śṛṇu |
keśavo nāma nāmnā tvaṃ khyāto loke bhaviṣyasi ||65||
svastyastu bhavato loke sādhu yāmyahamāśugaḥ |
kṛtyaśeṣaṃ ca te kāryaṃ śaktastvamasi mā ciram || 66 ||
tvayi kāryāntaragate narā iva divaukasaḥ |
viḍambayantaḥ krīḍanti līlāṃ tvadbalamāśritāḥ || 67 ||
abhyāśe vartate kālo bhāratasyāhavodadheḥ |
hastaprāptāni yuddhāni rāgaṃ tridivagāminām || 68 ||
panthānaḥ śodhitā vyomni vimānārohaṇordhvagāḥ |
avakāśā vibhajyante śakraloke mahīkṣitām || 69 ||
ugrasenasute śānte padasthe tvayi keśava |
abhitastanmahad yuddhaṃ bhaviṣyati mahīkṣitām || 2.24.70 ||
tvāṃ cāpratimakarmāṇaṃ saṃśrayiṣyanti pāṇḍavāḥ |
bhedakāle narendrāṇāṃ pakṣagrāho bhaviṣyasi || 71 ||
tvayi rājāsanasthe hi rājaśriyamanuttamām |
śubhāṃ tyakṣyanti rājānastvatprabhāvānna saṃśayaḥ || 72 ||
eṣa me kṛṣṇa saṃdeśaḥ śrutibhiḥ khyātimeṣyati |
devatānāṃ divisthānāṃ jagataśca jagatpate || 73 ||
dṛṣṭaṃ me bhavataḥ karma dṛṣṭaścāsi mayā prabho |
kaṃse bhūyaḥ sameṣyāmi sādhite sādhu yāmyaham || 74 ||
evamuktvā tu sa tadā nāradaḥ khaṃ jagāma ha |
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā devasaṃgītayoninaḥ || 75 ||
tatheti sa samābhāṣya punargopān samāsadat |
gopāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ samāsādya viviśurvrajameva ha || 76 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi keśivadhe caturviśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 ||

<2.25>

pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
athāstaṃ gacchati tadā mandaraśmau divākare |
saṃdhyāraktatale vyomni śaśāṅke pāṇḍumaṇḍale || 1 ||
nīḍastheṣu vihaṅgeṣu satsu prāduṣkṛtāgniṣu |
īṣattamaḥsaṃvṛtāsu dikṣu sarvāsu sarvaśaḥ || 2 ||
ghoṣavāsiṣu supteṣu vāśantīṣu śivāsu ca |
naktaṃcareṣu hṛṣṭeṣu piśitāśanakāṅkṣiṣu || 3 ||
śakragopāhvayāmode pradoṣe'bhyāsataskare |
saṃdhyamayīmiva guhāṃ sampratiṣṭhe divākare || 4 ||
adhiśrayaṇavelāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ gṛhamedhinām |
vanyairvaikhānasairmantrairhūyamāne hutāśane || 5 ||
upāvṛttāsu vai goṣu duhyamānāsu ca vraje |
asakṛdvyāharantīṣu baddhavatsāsu dhenuṣu || 6 ||
prakīrṇadāmanīkeṣu gāstathaivāhvayatsu ca |
saninādeṣu gopeṣu kālyamāne ca godhane || 7 ||
karīṣeṣu praklṛpteṣu dīpyamāneṣu sarvaśaḥ |
kāṣṭhabhārānataskandhaigoṃpairabhyāgataistathā || 8 ||
kiṃcidabhyudyate some mandaraśmau virājati |
īṣadvigāhamānāyāṃ rajanyāṃ divase gate || 9 ||
prāpte dinavyuparame pravṛtte kṣaṇadāmukhe |
bhāskare tejasi gate saumye tejasyupasthite || 10 ||
agnihotrākule kāle saumyendau samupasthite |
agnīṣomātmake saṃdhau vartamāne jaganmaye || 11 ||
paścimenāgnidīptena pūrveṇotpalavarcasā |
dagdhādrisadṛśe vyomni kiṃcittārāgaṇākule || 12 ||
vayobhirvāsamuśatāṃ bandhubhiśca samāgamam |
śaṃsadbhiḥ syandanenāśu prāpto dānapatirvrajam || 13 ||
praviśanneva papraccha sāṃnidhyaṃ keśavasya saḥ |
rauhiṇeyasya cākrūro nandagopasya cāsakṛt || 14 ||
sa nandagopasya gṛhaṃ vāsāya vibudhopamaḥ |
avatīrya tato yānāt praviveśa mahābalaḥ || 15 ||
harṣapūrṇena vaktreṇa sāśrunetreṇa caiva hi |
praviśanneva ca dvāri dadarśādohane gavām || 16 ||
vatsamadhye sthitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ savatsamiva govṛṣam |
sa taṃ harṣaparītena vacasā gadgadena vai || 17 ||
ehi keśava tāteti pravyāharata dharmavit |
uttānaśāyinaṃ dṛṣṭvā punardṛṣṭvā śriyā vṛtam || 18 ||
avyaktayauvanaṃ kṛṣṇamakrūraḥ praśaśaṃsa ha |
ayaṃ sa puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ siṃhaśārdūlavikramaḥ |
sampūrṇajalameghābhaḥ parvatapravarākṛtiḥ || 19 ||
mṛdheṣvadharṣaṇīyena saśrīvatsena vakṣasā |
dviṣannidhanadakṣābhyāṃ bhujābhyāṃ sādhu bhūṣitaḥ || 20 ||
mūrtimān sarahasyātmā jagato'gryayasya bhājanam |
gopaveṣadharo viṣṇurudagrāgryatanūruhaḥ ||21||
kirīṭalāñchanenāpi śirasā chatravarcasā| |
kuṇḍalottamayogyābhyāṃ śravaṇābhyāṃ vibhūṣitaḥ || 22 ||
hārārheṇa ca pīnena suvistīrṇena vakṣasā |
dvābhyāṃ bhujābhyāṃ vṛttābhyāṃ dīrghābhyāmupaśobhitaḥ ||23||
strīsahasropacaryeṇa vapuṣā manmathādhinā |
pīte vasāno vasane so'yaṃ viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ || 24 ||
dharaṇyāśrayabhūtābhyāṃ caraṇābhyāmariṃdamaḥ |
trailokyākrāntibhūtābhyāṃ bhuvi padbhyāṃ vyavasthitaḥ ||25||
rucirāgrakaraścāsya cakrāṅkita ivekṣate |
dvitīya udyataścāpi gadāsaṃyogamicchati || 26 ||
avatīrṇo bhavāyeha prathamaṃ padamātmanaḥ |
śobhate'dya bhuvi śreṣṭhastridaśānāṃ dhuraṃdharaḥ || 27 ||
ayaṃ bhaviṣye kathito bhaviṣyakuśalairnaraiḥ |
gopālo yādavaṃ vaṃśaṃ kṣīṇaṃ vistārayiṣyati || 28 ||
tejasā yādavāścāsya śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ |
vaṃśamāpūrayiṣyanti hyoghā iva mahārṇavam || 29 ||
asyedaṃ śāsane sarvaṃ jagatsthāsyati śāśvatam |
nihatāmitrasāmantaṃ sphītaṃ kṛtayuge tathā || 30 ||
ayamāsthāya vasudhāṃ sthāpayitvā jagad vaśe |
rājñāṃ bhaviṣyatyupari na ca rājā bhaviṣyati || 31 ||
nūnaṃ tribhiḥ kramairjitvā yathānena prabhuḥ kṛtaḥ |
purā puraṃdaro rājā devatānāṃ triviṣṭape || 32 ||
tathaiva vasudhāṃ jitvā jitapūrvāṃ tribhiḥ kramaiḥ |
sthāpayiṣyati rājānamugrasenaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 33 ||
prasṛṣṭavairagādho'yaṃ praśnaiśca bahubhiḥ śrutaḥ |
brāhmaṇairbrahmavādaiśca purāṇo'yaṃ hi gīyate || 34 ||
spṛhaṇīyo hi lokasya bhaviṣyati ca keśavaḥ |
tathā hyasyotthitā buddhirmānuṣyamupajīvitum || 35 ||
ahaṃ tvasyādya vasatiṃ pūjayiṣye yathāvidhi |
viṣṇutvaṃ manasā caiva pūjayiṣyāmi mantravat || 36 ||
yacca jñātiparijñānaṃ prādurbhāvaśca vai nṛṣu |
amānuṣaṃ vedmi cainaṃ ye cānye divyacakṣuṣaḥ || 37 ||
so'haṃ kṛṣṇena vai rātrau sammantrya viditātmanā |
sahānena gamiṣyāmi savrajo yadi maṃsyate || 38 ||
evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā hetvarthakāraṇaiḥ |
viveśa nandagopasya kṛṣṇena saha saṃsadam || 39 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi akrūrāgamane pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 25 ||

<2.26>

ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
sa nandagopasya gṛhaṃ praviṣṭaḥ saha keśavaḥ |
gopavṛddhān samānīya provācāmitadakṣiṇaḥ || 1 ||
kṛṣṇaṃ caivābravīt prītyā rauhiṇeyena saṅgatam |
śvaḥ purīṃ mathurāṃ tāta gamiṣyāmaḥ sukhāya vai || 2 ||
yāsyanti ca vrajāḥ sarve gopālāḥ saparigrahāḥ |
kaṃsājñayā samucitaṃ karamādāya vārṣikam || 3 ||
samṛddhastatra kaṃsasya bhaviṣyati dhanurmahaḥ |
taṃ drakṣyatha samṛddhaṃ ca svajanaiśca sameṣyatha || 4||
pitaraṃ vasudevaṃ ca satataṃ duḥkhabhājanam |
dīnaṃ putravadhaśrāntaṃ yuvāmadya sameṣyathaḥ || 5 ||
satataṃ pīḍyamānaṃ ca kaṃsenāśubhabuddhinā |
daśānte śoṣitaṃ vṛddhaṃ duḥkhaiḥ śithilatāṃ gatam 6 ||
kaṃsasya bhayasaṃtrastaṃ bhavadbhyāṃ ca vinā kṛtam |
dahyamānaṃ divā rātrau sotkaṇṭhenāntarātmanā || 7 ||
tāṃ ca drakṣyasi govinda putrairamṛditastanīm |
devakīṃ devasaṃkāśāṃ sīdantīṃ vihataprabhām || 8 ||
putraśokena śuṣyantīṃ tbaddarśanaparāyaṇām |
viyogaśokasaṃtaptāṃ vivatsāmiva saurabhīm || 9 ||
upaplutekṣaṇāṃ dīnāṃ nityaṃ malinavāsasam |
svarbhānuvadanagrastāṃ śaśāṅkasya prabhāmiva || 2.26.10 ||
tvaddarśanaparāṃ nityaṃ tavāgamanakāṅkṣiṇīm |
tyatpravṛttena śokena sīdantīṃ vai tapasvinīm| 11 ||
tvatpralāpeṣvakuśalā tvayā bālye viyojitām |
arūpajñāṃ tava vibho vaktrasyāsyenduvarcasaḥ || 12 ||
yadi tvāṃ janayitvā sā devakī tāta tapyate |
apatyārtho nu kastasyā varaṃ hyevānapatyatā ||13 ||
aputrāṇāṃ hi nārīṇāmekaḥ śoko vidhīyate |
saputrā tvaphale putre dhikprajātena tapyate || 14 ||
tvaṃ tu śakrasamaḥ putro yasyāttavatsadṛśo guṇaiḥ |
pareṣāmapyabhayado na sā śocitumarhati || 15 ||
vṛddhau tavāmbāpitarau parabhṛtyatvamāgatau |
bhartsitau tvatkṛte nityaṃ kaṃsenāśubhabuddhinā || 16 ||
yadi te devakī mānyā pṛthivīvātmadhāriṇī |
tāṃ śokasalile magnāmuttārayitumarhasi || 17 ||
taṃ ca vṛddhaṃ priyasutaṃ vasudevaṃ sukhocitam |
putrayogena saṃyojya kṛṣṇa dharmamavāpsyasi || 18 ||
yathā nāgaḥ sudurvṛtto damito yamunāhrade |
vimūlaḥ sa kṛtaḥ śailo yathā vai bhūdharastvayā || 19 ||
darpotsiktaśca balavānariṣṭo vinipātitaḥ |
paraprāṇaharaḥ keśī duṣṭātmā ca hayo hataḥ || 2.26.20 ||
etenaiva prayatnena vṛddhāvuddhṛtya duḥkhitau |
yathā dharmamavāpnoṣi tatkṛṣṇa paricintyatām || 21 ||
nirbhartsyamāno yairdṛṣṭaḥ pitā te kaṃsasaṃsadi |
te sarve cakruraśrūṇi netrairduḥkhānvitā bhṛśam || 22 ||
garbhāvakartanādīni duḥkhāni subahūnyapi |
mātā te devakī kṛṣṇa kaṃsasya sahate'vaśā || 23 ||
mātāpitṛbhyāṃ sarveṇa jātena tanayena vai |
ṛṇaṃ vai pratikartavyaṃ yathāyogamudāhṛtam || 24 ||
evaṃ te kurvataḥ kṛṣṇa mātāpitroranugraham |
parityajetāṃ tau śokaṃ syācca dharmastavānagha || 25 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
kṛṣṇaḥ suviditārtho vai tamāhāmitavikramam |
bāḍhamityeva tejasvī na ca krodhavaśaṃ gataḥ || 26 ||
te ca gopāḥ samāgamya nandagopapuraḥsarāḥ |
akrūravacanaṃ śrutvā celuḥ kaṃsasya śāsanāt || 27 ||
gamanāya ca te sajjā babhūvurvrajavāsinaḥ |
sajjaṃ copāyanaṃ kṛtvā gopavṛddhāḥ pratasthire || 28 ||
karaṃ cānaḍuhaḥ sarpirmahiṣāṃścaupanāyikān |
yathāsāraṃ yathāyūthamupānīya payo dadhi || 29 ||
taṃ sajjayityā kaṃsasya karaṃ copāyanāni ca |
te sarve gopapatayo gamanāyopatasthire || 2.26.30 ||
akrūrasya kathābhiśca saha kṛṣṇena jāgrataḥ |
rauhiṇeyatṛtīyasya sā niśā vyatyavartata || 31 ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale pakṣivyāhārasaṃkule |
naiśākare raśmijāle kṣaṇadākṣayasaṃhṛte || 32 ||
nabhasyaruṇasaṃstīrṇe paryaste jyotiṣāṃ gaṇe |
pratyūṣapavanāsāraiḥ kledite dharaṇītale || 33 ||
kṣīṇākārāsu tārāsu suptaniṣpratibhāsu ca |
naiśamantardadhe rūpamudgacchati divākare || 34 ||
śītāṃśuḥ śāntakiraṇo niṣprabhaḥ samapadyata |
eko nāśayate rūpameko vardhayate vapuḥ || 35||
gobhiśca samakīrṇāsu vrajaniryāṇabhūmiṣu |
manthanāvartapūrṇeṣu gargareṣu nadatsu ca || 36 ||
dāmabhirdamyamāneṣu vatseṣu taruṇeṣu ca |
gopairāpūryamāṇāsu ghoṣarathyāsu sarvaśaḥ || 37 ||
tatraiva gurukaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ śakaṭāropitaṃ bahu |
tvaritāḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā jagmuḥ syandanavāhanāḥ || 38 ||
kṛṣṇo'tha rauhiṇeyaśca sa caivāmitadakṣiṇaḥ |
trayo rathagatā jagmustrilokapatayo yathā || 39 ||
athāha kṛṣṇamakrūro yamunātīramāśritaḥ |
syandanaṃ cātra rakṣasva yatnaṃ ca kuru vājiṣu || 2.26.40 ||
hayebhyo yavasaṃ dattvā hayabhāṇḍe rathe tathā |
pragāḍhaṃ yatnamāsthāya kṣaṇaṃ tāta pratīkṣyatām || 41 ||
yamunāyā hrade hyasmin stoṣyāmi bhujageśvaram |
divyairbhāgavatairmantraiḥ sarvalokaprabhuṃ yataḥ || 42 ||
guhyaṃ bhāgavataṃ devaṃ sarvalokasya bhāvanam |
śrīmatsvastikamūrddhānaṃ praṇamiṣyāmi bhoginam |
sahasraśirasaṃ devamanantaṃ nīlavāsasam || 43 ||
dharmadevasya tasyātha yad viṣaṃ prabhaviṣyati |
sarvaṃ tadamṛtaprakhyamaśiṣyāmyamaro yathā || 44 ||
svastikāyatanaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvijihvaṃ śrīvibhūṣitam |
samājastatra sarpāṇāṃ śāntyarthaṃ vai bhaviṣyati || 45 ||
āstāṃ māṃ samudīkṣantau bhavantau saṅgatāvubhau |
nivṛtto bhujagendrasya yāvadasmi hradottamāt || 46 ||
tamāha kṛṣṇaḥ saṃhṛṣṭo gaccha dharmiṣṭha mā ciram |
āvāṃ khalu na śaktau svastvayā hīnāvupāsitam ||47||
sa hṛde yamunāyāstu mamajjāmitadakṣiṇaḥ |
rasātale sa dadṛśe nāgalokamimaṃ yathā || 48 ||
tasya madhye sahasrāsyaṃ hematālocchritadhvajam |
lāṅgalāsaktahastāgraṃ musalopāśritodaram || 49 ||
asitāmbarasaṃvītaṃ pāṇḍuraṃ pāṇḍurāsanam |
kuṇḍalaikadharaṃ mattaṃ suptamamburuhekṣaṇam || 2.26.50 ||
bhogotkarāsane śubhre svena dehena kalpite |
svāsīnaṃ svastikābhyāṃ ca varāhābhyāṃ mahīdharam || 51 ||
kiṃcit savyāpavṛttena maulinā hemacūlinā |
jātarūpamayaiḥ padmairmālayācchannavakṣasam || 52 ||
raktacandanadigdhāṅgaṃ dīrghabāhumariṃdamam |
padmanābhasitābhrābhaṃ bhābhirjvalitatejasam || 53 ||
dadarśa bhogināṃ nāthaṃ sthitamekārṇaveśvaram |
pūjyamānaṃ dvijihvendrairvāsukipramukhaiḥ prabhum || 54 ||
kambalāśvatarau nāgau tau cāmarakarāvubhau |
avījayetāṃ taṃ devaṃ dharmāsanagataṃ prabhum || 55 ||
tasyābhyāśagato bhāti vāsukiḥ pannageśvaraḥ |
vṛto'nyaiḥ sacivaiḥ sarpaiḥ karkoṭakapuraḥsaraiḥ || 56 ||
taṃ ghaṭaiḥ kāñcanairdivyaiḥ paṅkajacchannamastakaiḥ |
rājānaṃ snāpayāmāsuḥ snātamekārṇavāmbubhiḥ || 57 ||
tasyotsaṅge ghanaśyāmaṃ śrīvatsācchāditorasam |
pītāmbaradharaṃ viṣṇuṃ sūpaviṣṭaṃ dadarśa ha || 58 ||
aparaṃ caiva somena tulyasaṃhananaṃ prabhum |
saṃkarṣaṇamivāsīnaṃ taṃ divyaṃ viṣṭaraṃ vinā || 59 ||
sa kṛṣṇaṃ tatra sahasā vyāhartumupacakrame |
tasya saṃstambhayāmāsa vākyaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ svatejasā || 2.26.60 ||
so'nubhūya bhujaṅgānāṃ taṃ bhāgavatamavyayam |
udatiṣṭhatpunastoyād vismito'mitadakṣiṇaḥ || 61 ||
sa tau rathasthāvāsīnau tatraiva balakeśavau |
nirīkṣyamāṇāvanyonyaṃ dadarśādbhutarūpiṇau || 62 ||
athāmajjat punastatra tadākrūraḥ kutūhalāt|
ijyate yatra devo'sau nīlavāsāḥ sitānanaḥ || 63||
tathaivāsīnamutsaṅge sahasrāsyadharasya vai |
dadarśa kṛṣṇamakrūraḥ pūjyamānaṃ tadā prabhum || 64 ||
bhūyaśca sahasotthāya taṃ mantraṃ manasā japan |
