rathaṃ tenaiva mārgeṇa jagāmāmitadakṣiṇaḥ || 65 ||
tamāha keśavo hṛṣṭaḥ sthitamakrūramāgamat |
kīdṛśaṃ nāgalokasya vṛttaṃ bhāgavate hrade || 66 ||
ciraṃ ca bhavatā kālo vyākṣepeṇa vilambitaḥ |
manye dṛṣṭaṃ tvayāścaryaṃ hṛdayaṃ te yathācalam || 67 ||
pratyuvāca sa taṃ kṛṣṇamāścaryaṃ bhavatā vinā |
kiṃ bhaviṣyati lokeṣu sthāvareṣu careṣu ca || 68 ||
tatrāścaryaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇa yad bhuvi durlabham|
tadihāpi yathā tatra paśyāmi ca ramāmi ca || 69 ||
saṃgataścāpi lokānāmāścaryeṇeha rūpiṇā |
ataḥ parataraṃ kṛṣṇa nāścaryaṃ draṣṭumutsahe || 2.26.70 ||
tadāgaccha gamiṣyāmaḥ kaṃsarājapurīṃ prabho |
yāvannāstaṃ vrajatyeṣa divasānte divākaraḥ || 71 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi akrūrakṛtanāgalokakathane ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 26 ||

<2.27>

saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
te tu yuṅktvā rathavaraṃ sarva evāmitaujasaḥ |
kṛṣṇena sahitāḥ prāyaṃstathā saṃkarṣaṇena ca || 1 ||
āseduste purīṃ ramyāṃ mathurāṃ kaṃsapālitām |
viviśuste purīṃ ramyāṃ kāle raktadivākare || 2 ||
tau tu svabhavanaṃ vīrau kṛṣṇasaṃkarṣaṇāvubhau |
praveśitau buddhimatā hyakrūreṇārkavarcasau || 3 ||
tāvāha varavarṇābhau bhīto dānapatistadā |
tyaktavyā tāta gamane vasudevagṛhe spṛhā || 4 ||
yuvayorhi kṛte vṛddhaḥ kaṃsena sa nirasyate |
bhartsyate ca divā rātrau neha sthātavyamityapi || 5 ||
tad yuvābhyāṃ hi kartavyaṃ pitrarthaṃ sukhamuttamam |
yathā sukhamavāpnoti tad vai kāryaṃ hitānvitam || 6 ||
tamuvāca tataḥ kṛṣṇo yāsyāvāvāmatarkitau |
prekṣantau mathurāṃ vīra rājamārgaṃ ca dhārmika |
tasyaiva tu gṛhaṃ sādho gacchāvo yadi manyase || 7 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
akrūro'pi namaskṛtya manasā kṛṣṇamavyayam |
jagāma kaṃsapārśvaṃ tu prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā || 8 ||
anuśiṣṭau ca tau vīrau prasthitau prekṣakāvubhau |
ālānābhyāmivonmuktau kuñjarau yuddhakāṅkṣiṇau || 9 ||
tau tu mārgagataṃ dṛṣṭvā rajakaṃ raṅgakārakam |
ayācetāṃ tatastau tu vāsāṃsi rucirāṇi vai || 2.27.10 ||
rajakaḥ sa tu tau prāha yuvāṃ kasya vanecarau |
rājavāsāṃsi yau mauḍhyād yācethāṃ nirbhayāvubhau || 11||
ahaṃ kaṃsasya vāsāṃsi nānādeśodbhavāni vai |
kāmarāgāṇi śataśo rañjayāmi viśeṣataḥ || 12 ||
yuvāṃ kasya vane jātau mṛgaiḥ saha vivarddhitau |
jātarāgāvidaṃ dṛṣṭvā raktamācchādanaṃ bahu || 13||
aho vāṃ jīvitaṃ tyaktaṃ yau bhavantāvihāgatau |
mūrkhau prākṛtavijñānau vāso yācitumicchataḥ || 14 ||
tasmai cukopa vai kṛṣṇo rajakāyālpamedhase |
prāptāriṣṭāya mūrkhāya sṛjate vāṅmayaṃ viṣam || 15 ||
talenāśanikalpena sa taṃ mūrddhanyatāḍayat |
sa gatāsuḥ papātorvyāṃ rajako vyastamastakaḥ || 16 ||
taṃ hataṃ paridevantyo bhāryāstasya vicukruśuḥ |
tvaritaṃ muktakeśaśca jagmuḥ kaṃsaniveśanam || 17 ||
tāvapyubhau suvasanau jagmaturmālyakāraṇāt |
vīthīmālyāpaṇānāṃ vai gandhāghrātau dvipāviva || 18 ||
guṇako nāma tatrāsīnmālyavṛttiḥ priyaṃvadaḥ |
prabhūtamālyāpaṇavām̐llakṣmīvān priyadarśanaḥ || 19 ||
taṃ kṛṣṇaḥ ślakṣṇayā vācā mālyārthamabhisṛṣṭayā |
dehītyuvāca tatkāle mālākāramakātaram || 2.27.20 ||
tābhyāṃ prīto dadau mālyaṃ prabhūtaṃ mālyajīvanaḥ |
bhavatoḥ svamidaṃ ceti provāca priyadarśanau || 21 ||
prītaḥ sumanasā kṛṣṇo guṇakāya varaṃ dadau |
śrīstvāṃ matsambhavā saumya ghanaughairabhipatsyate || 22 ||
sa labdhvā varamavyagro mālyavṛttiradhomukhaḥ |
kṛṣṇasya patito mūrdhnā pratijagrāha taṃ varam || 23 ||
yakṣāvimāviti tadā sa mene mālyajīvakaḥ |
sa bhṛśaṃ bhayasaṃvigno nottaraṃ pratyapadyata || 24 ||
vasudevasutau tau ca rājamārgagatāvubhau |
kubjāṃ dadṛśaturbhūyaḥ sānulepanabhājanām || 25 ||
tāmāha kṛṣṇaḥ kubjeti kasyedamanulepanam |
nayasyambujapatrākṣi kṣipramākhyātumarhasi || 26 ||
sasmitā sammukhī bhūtvā pratyuvācāmbujekṣaṇam|
kṛṣṇaṃ jaladagambhīraṃ vidyutkuṭilagāminī || 27 ||
rājñaḥ snānagṛhaṃ yāmi tad gṛhāṇānulepanam ||
dṛṣṭvaiva tvāravindākṣa vismitāsmi varānana || 28 ||
yattvamicchasi me vīra tvaṃ gṛhāṇānulepanam |
sthitāsmyāgaccha bhadraṃ te hṛdayasyāsi me priyaḥ ||29||
kutaścāgamyate saumya yanmāṃ tvaṃ nāvabudhyase |
mahārājasya dayitāṃ niyuktāmanulepane || 2.27.30 ||
tāmuvāca hasantīṃ tu kṛṣṇaḥ kubjāmavasthitām|
āvayorgātrasadṛśaṃ dīyatāmanulepanam ||31||
vayaṃ hi deśātithayo mallāḥ prāptā varānane |
draṣṭuṃ dhanurmahad divyaṃ rāṣṭre caiva maharddhimat || 32 ||
pratyuvācātha sā kṛṣṇaṃ priyo'si mama darśane |
rājārhamidamavyagraṃ tad gṛhāṇānulepanam || 33 ||
tāvubhāvanuliptāṅgau cārugātrau virejatuḥ |
tīrthagau paṅkadigdhāṅgau yamunāyāṃ yathā vṛṣau || 34 ||
tāṃ ca kubjāṃ sthagormadhye dvyaṅgulenāgrapāṇinā |
śanaiḥ sampīḍayāmāsa kṛṣṇo līlāvidhānavit ||35||
sā ca magnaṃ sthaguṃ matvā svāyatāṅgī śucismitā |
jahāsoccaiḥ stanataṭī ṛjuyaṣṭirlatā yathā ||36|
praṇayāccāpi kṛṣṇaṃ sā babhāṣe mattakāśinī |
kva yāsyasi mayā ruddhaḥ kānta tiṣṭha gṛhāṇa mām ||37||
tau jātahāsāvanyonyaṃ satalākṣepamavyayau |
vīkṣamāṇau prahasitau kubjāyāḥ śrutavistarau || 38 |
kṛṣṇastu kubjāṃ kāmārtāṃ sasmitaṃ visasarja ha |
tatastau kubjayā muktau praviṣṭau rājasaṃsadam ||39|
tāvubhau vrajasaṃvṛddhau gopaveṣavibhūṣitau |
gūḍhaceṣṭānanau bhūtvā praviṣṭau nṛpaveśma tat || 2.27.40 ||
dhanuḥśālāṃ gatau tatra bālāvaparitarkitau |
himavadvanasambhūtau siṃhāviva madotkaṭau || 41 ||
didṛkṣantau mahattatra dhanurāyogabhūṣitam |
papracchatuśca tau vīrāvāyudhāgārikaṃ tadā || 42||
bhoḥ kaṃsadhanuṣāṃ pāla śrūyatāmāvayorvacaḥ |
katarattad dhanuḥ saumya maho'yaṃ yasya vartate || 43||
āyogabhūtaṃ kaṃsasya darśayasva yadīcchasi |
sa tayordarśayāmāsa tad dhanuḥ stambhasaṃnibham || 44 ||
anāropyamasambhedyaṃ devairapi savāsavaiḥ |
tad gṛhītvā tadā kṛṣṇastolayāmāsa vīryavān ||45||
dorbhyo kamalapatrākṣaḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā |
tolayitvā yathākāmaṃ tad dhanurdaityapūjitam || 46 ||
āropayāmāsa balī nāmayāmāsa cāsakṛt |
ānāmyamānaṃ kṛṣṇena prakarṣāduragopamam || 47
dvidhābhūtamabhūnmadhye dhanurāyogabhūṣitam |
bhaṅktyā tu tad dhanuḥśreṣṭhaṃ kṛṣṇastvaritavikramaḥ |
niścakrāma mahāvegaḥ sa ca saṃkarṣaṇo yuvā ||48||
dhanuṣo bhaṅganādena vāyunirghoṣakāriṇā |
cacālāntaḥpuraṃ sarvaṃ diśaścaiva pupūrire || 49 ||
nirgamya tvāyudhāgārājjagmaturgopasaṃnidhau |
vegenāyudhapālastu gacchan sambhrāntamānasaḥ || 2.27.50 ||
samīpaṃ nṛpatergatvā kākocchvāso'bhyabhāṣata |
śrūyatāṃ mama vijñāpyamāścaryaṃ dhanuṣo gṛhe || 51 ||
nirvṛttamasmin kāle yajjagataḥ sambhramopamam |
narau kasyāpyasadṛśau śikhāvitatamūrddhajau || 52 ||
nīlapītāmbaradharau pītaśvetānulepanau |
tāvantaḥpuramajñātau praviṣṭau kāmaveṣiṇau || 53 ||
devaputropamau vīrau bālāviva hutāśanau |
sthitau dhanurgṛhe saumyau sahasā khādivāgatau |
mayā dṛṣṭau parivyaktaṃ rucirācchādanasrajau || 54 ||
tayorekastu padmākṣaḥ śyāmaḥ pītāmbarasrajaḥ |
jagrāha tad dhanūratnaṃ durgrāhyaṃ daivatairapi || 55 ||
tat sa bālo mahaccāpaṃ balād yantramivāyasam |
āropayitvā vegena nāmayāmāsa līlayā || 56 |
ākṛṣyamāṇaṃ tat tena vibāṇaṃ bāhuśālinā |
muṣṭideśe vikūjitvā dvidhābhūtamabhajyata || 57 ||
tataḥ pracalitā bhūmirnaiva bhāti ca bhāskaraḥ |
dhanuṣo bhaṅganādena bhramatīva nabhastalam || 58 ||
tadadbhutaṃ mahad dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ |
bhayād bhayadaśatrubhyastadihākhyātumāgataḥ || 59 ||
na jānāmi mahārāja kau tāvamitavikramau |
ekaḥ kailāsasaṃkāśa eko'ñjanagiriprabhaḥ || 2.27.60 ||
sa tu tañcāparatnaṃ vai bhaṅktvā stambhamiva dvipaḥ |
niṣpapātānilagatiḥ sānugo'mitavikramaḥ |
agamattaṃ dvidhā kṛtvā na jāne ko'pyasau nṛpa || 61||
śrutvaiva dhanuṣo bhaṅgaṃ kaṃso viditavistaraḥ |
visṛjyāyudhapālaṃ vai praviveśa gṛhottamam || 62 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi kaṃsadhanurbhaṅge saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 27 ||

<2.28>

aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
sa cintayitvā dhanuṣo bhaṅgaṃ bhojavivardhanaḥ |
babhūva vimanā rājā cintayan bhṛśaduḥkhitaḥ || 1 ||
kathaṃ bālo vigatabhīravamatya mahābalam |
prekṣyamāṇastu puruṣairdhanurbhaṅktvā vinirgataḥ || 2 ||
yasyārthe dāruṇaṃ karma kṛtaṃ lokavigarhitam |
pitṛṣvasrātmajān vīrānṣaḍevāhaṃ nyapothayam || 3 ||
daivaṃ puruṣakāreṇa na śakyamativartitum |
nāradoktaṃ ca vacanaṃ nūnaṃ mahyamupasthitam || 4 ||
evaṃ rājā vicintyātha niṣkramya svagṛhottamāt|
prekṣāgāraṃ jagāmāśu mañcānāmavalokakaḥ || 5 ||
sa dṛṣṭvā sarvaniryuktaṃ prekṣāgāraṃ nṛpottamaḥ |
śreṇīnāṃ dṛḍhaniryuktairmañcavāṭairnirantaram || 6 ||
sottamāgārayuktābhirvalabhībhirvibhūṣitam |
chadībhiḥ sampravṛddhābhirekastambhairvibhūṣitam || 7 ||
sarvataḥ sāranirvyūhaṃ svāyataṃ supratiṣṭhitam |
udagrākliṣṭasukliṣṭamañcārohaṇamuttamam || 8 ||
nṛpāsanaparikṣiptaṃ saṃcārapathasaṃkulam|
channaṃ tad vedikābhiśca mānuṣaughabharakṣamam || 9 ||
sa ṭaṣṭvā bhūṣitaṃ raṅgamājñāpayata buddhimān |
śvaḥ sacitrāḥ samālyāśca sapatākāstathaiva ca || 2.28.10 ||
suvāsitā vapuṣmanta upanītottaracchadāḥ |
kriyantāṃ mañcavāṭāśca valabhyo vīthayastathā || 11 ||
raṅgavāṭe karīṣasya kalpyantāṃ rāśayo'vyayāḥ |
paṭāstaraṇaśobhāśca valayaścānurūpataḥ || 12
sthāpyantāṃ sunikhātāśca pānakumbhā yathākramam |
udabhārasahāḥ sarve sakāñcanaghaṭottamāḥ || 13 ||
valayaścopakalpyantāṃ kaṣāyāścaiva kumbhaśaḥ |
prāśnikāśca nimantryantāṃ śreṇyaśca sapurogamāḥ || 14 ||
ājñā ca deyā mallānāṃ prekṣakāṇāṃ tathaiva ca |
samāje mañcaśobhāśca kalpyantāṃ sūpakalpitāḥ || 15 ||
evamājñāpya rājā sa samājavidhimuttamam |
samājavāṭānniṣkramya viveśa svaṃ niveśanam || 16 ||
āhvānaṃ tatra saṃcakre tasya malladvayasya vai |
cāṇūrasyāprameyasya muṣṭikasya tathaiva ca || 17 ||
tau tu mallau mahāvīryau balinau bāhuśālinau |
kaṃsasyājñāṃ puraskṛtya hṛṣṭau viviśatustadā || 18||
tau samīpagatau dṛṣṭvā mallau jagati viśrutau |
uvāca kaṃso nṛpatiḥ sopanyāsamidaṃ vacaḥ || 19 ||
bhavantau mama vikhyātau mallau vīradhvajocchritau |
pūjitau ca yathānyāyaṃ satkārārhau viśeṣataḥ || 2.28.20 ||
tanmatto yadi satkāraḥ smaryate sukṛtāni ca |
kartavyaṃ me mahat karma bhavadbhyāṃ svena tejasā || 21 |||
yāvetau mama saṃvṛddhau vraje gopālakāvubhau |
saṃkarṣaṇaśca kṛṣṇaśca bālāvapi jitaśramau || 22 ||
etau raṅgagatau yuddhe yuddhyamānau vanecarau |
nipātānantaraṃ śīghraṃ hantavyau nātra saṃśayaḥ || 23 ||
bālāvimau sucapalāvakriyāviti sarvathā |
nāvajñā tatra kartavyā kartavyo yatna eva hi || 24 ||
tābhyāṃ yudhi nirastābhyāṃ gopābhyāṃ raṅgasaṃnidhau |
āyatyāṃ ca tadātve ca śreyo mama bhaviṣyati ||25|
nṛpateḥ snehasaṃyuktairvacobhirhṛṣṭamānasau |
ūcaturyuddhasammattau mallau cāṇūramuṣṭikau || 26 ||
yadyāvayostau pramukhe sthāsyete gopakilbiṣau |
hatāvityeva mantavyau pretarūpau tapasvinau || 27 ||
yadyāvāṃ pratiyotsyete tāvariṣṭapariplutau |
āvābhyāṃ roṣayuktābhyāṃ pramukhe tau vanecarau || 28 ||
evaṃ vāgviṣamutsṛjya tāvubhau mallapuṅgavau |
anujñātau narendreṇa sve gṛhe tau prajagmatuḥ || 29 ||
mahāmātraṃ tataḥ kaṃso babhāṣe hastijīvinam |
hastī kuvalayāpīḍaḥ samājadvāri tiṣṭhatu || 2.28.30 ||
balavān madalolākṣaścapalaḥ krodhano nṛṣu |
dānotkaṭakaṭaścaṇḍaḥ prativāraṇaroṣaṇaḥ || 31 ||
sa saṃnodayitavyaste tāvuddiśya vanaukasau |
vasudevasutau vīrau yathā syātāṃ gatāyuṣau 32 ||
tvayā caiva gajendreṇa yadi tau goṣṭhajīvinau |
bhavetāṃ patitau raṅge paśyeyamahamutkaṭau || 33 ||
tatastau patitau dṛṣṭvā vasudevaḥ sabāndhavaḥ |
chinnamūlo nirālambaḥ sabhāryo vinaśiṣyati || 34 ||
ye ceme yādavā mūrkhāḥ sarve kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ |
vinaśiṣyanti cchinnāśā dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ nipātitam ||35||
etau hatvā gajendreṇa mallairvā svayameva vā |
purīṃ niryādavīṃ kṛtvā vicariṣyāmyahaṃ sukhī || 36 ||
karake maiṃ sukhapūrvaka vicarūm̐gā || 36 ||
pitā hi me parityakto yādavānāṃ kulodvahaḥ |
śeṣāśca me parityaktā yādavāḥ kṛṣṇapakṣiṇaḥ || 37 ||
na cāhamugrasenena jātaḥ kila sutārthinā |
mānuṣeṇālpavīryeṇa yathā māmāha nāradaḥ || 38 ||
mahāmātra uvāca
kathamuktaṃ nāradena rājan devarṣiṇā purā |
āścaryametat kathitaṃ tvattaḥ śrutamariṃdama || 39 ||
kathamanyena jātastvamugrasenāt piturvinā |
tava mātrā kathaṃ rājan kṛtaṃ karmedamīdṛśam || 2.28.40 ||
anyāpi prākṛtā nārī na kuryācca jugupsitam |
vistaraṃ śrotumicchāmi hyetat kautūhalaṃ hi me || 41 ||
kaṃsa uvāca
yathā kathitavān vipro maharṣirnāradaḥ prabhuḥ |
tathāhaṃ sampravakṣyāmi yadi tai śravaṇe matiḥ || 42||
āgataḥ śakrasadanāt sa vai śakrasakho muniḥ |
candrāṃśuśuklavasano jaṭāmaṇḍalamudvahan || 43 ||
kṛṣṇājinottarīyeṇa rukmayajñopavītavān |
daṇḍī kamaṇḍaludharaḥ prajāpatirivāparaḥ || 44 ||
gātā caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ vidvān gāndharvavedavit |
sa nārado'tha devarṣirbrahmalokacaro'vyayaḥ || 45 ||
tamāgatamṛṣiṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā yathāvidhi |
pādyārghyamāsanaṃ dattvā sampraveśyopaviśya ha || 46 ||
sukhopaviṣṭo'tha muniḥ pṛṣṭvā ca kuśalaṃ mama |
uvāca ca prītamanā devarṣirbhāvitātmavān || 47 ||
nārada uvāca
pūjito'haṃ tvayā vīra vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā |
idamekaṃ mama vacaḥ śrūyatāṃ pratigṛhyatām || 48 ||
gato'haṃ devasadanaṃ sauvarṇaṃ meruparvatam |
so'haṃ kadācid devānāṃ samāje merumūrdhani || 49 ||
tatra mantrayatāmevaṃ devatānāṃ mayā śrutaḥ |
bhavataḥ sānugamyaiva vadhopāyaḥ sudāruṇaḥ || 2.28.50 ||
tatra yo devakīgarbho viṣṇurlokanamaskṛtaḥ |
yo'syā garbho'ṣṭamaḥ kaṃsa sa te mṛtyurbhaviṣyati ||51||
devānāṃ sa tu sarvasvaṃ tridivasya gatiśca saḥ |
paraṃ rahasyaṃ devānāṃ sa te mṛtyurbhaviṣyati || 52 ||
yatnaśca kriyatāṃ kaṃsa garbhāṇāṃ pātanaṃ prati |
nāvajñā ripave kāryā durbale svajane'pi vā || 53 |
na cāyamugrasenaḥ sa pitā tava mahābalaḥ |
drumilo nāma tejasvī saubhasya patirūrjitaḥ || 54 ||
śrutvāhaṃ tad vacastasya kiṃcid roṣasamanvitaḥ |
bhūyo'pṛcchaṃ kathaṃ brahman drumilo nāma dānavaḥ || 55 ||
mama mātrā kathaṃ tasya brūhi vipra samāgamaḥ |
etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ vistareṇa tapodhana || 56 ||
nārada uvāca
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇu rājan yathārthataḥ |
dramilasya ca mātrā te saṃvādaṃ ca samāgamam || 57 ||
suyāmunaṃ nāma nagaṃ tava mātā rajasvalā |
prekṣituṃ sahitā strībhirgatā vai sā kutūhalāt || 58 ||
sā tatra ramaṇīyeṣu ruciradrumasānuṣu |
cacāra nagaśṛṅgeṣu kandareṣu nadīṣu ca || 59 ||
kinnarodgītamadhurāḥ pratiśrutyabhināditāḥ |
śṛṇvantī kājananīrvācaḥ śrotrasukhāvahāḥ || 2.28.60 ||
barhiṇāṃ caiva virutaṃ khagānāṃ ca vikūjitam |
abhīkṣṇamabhiśṛṇvantī strīdharmamabhirocayat || 61 ||
etasminnantare vāyurvanarājiviniḥsṛtaḥ |
hṛdyaḥ kusumagandhāḍhyo vavau manmathabodhanaḥ || 62 ||
dvirephābharaṇāścaiva kadambā vāyughaṭṭitāḥ |
mumucurgandhamadhikaṃ saṃtatāsāramūrchitāḥ || 63 ||
kesarāḥ puṣpavarṣaiśca vavṛṣurmadabodhanāḥ |
nīpā dīpā ivābhānti puṣpakaṇṭakadhāriṇaḥ || 64 ||
mahī navatṛṇacchannā śakragopavibhūṣitā |
yauvanastheva vanitā svaṃ dadhārārtavaṃ vapuḥ || 65 ||
atha saubhapatiḥ śrīmān drumilo nāma dānavaḥ |
bhaviṣyaddaivayogena vidhātrā tatra nīyate || 66 ||
kāmagena rathenāśu taruṇādityavarcasā |
yadṛcchayā gatastatra suyāmunadidṛkṣayā || 67 ||
vihāyasā kāmagamo manaso'pyāśugāminā |
sa taṃ prāpya parvatendramavatīrya rathottamāt || 68 ||
parvatopavane nyasya rathaṃ pararathārujam |
athāsau sūtasahitaścacāra nagamūrdhani || 69 ||
tato bahūnyapaśyetāṃ kānanāni vanāni ca |
sarvartuguṇasampannaṃ nandanasyeva kānanam || 2.28.70 ||
ceraturnagaśṛṅgeṣu kandareṣu nadīṣu ca |
nānādhātupinaddhaiśca śṛṅgairbahubhirucchritaiḥ || 71 ||
nānāratnavicitraiśca kāñcanāñjanarājatān |
nānākusumagandhāḍhyān nānāsattvagaṇairyutān || 72 ||
nānādvijagaṇairghuṣṭān nānāpuṣpaphaladrumān |
nānauṣadhisamāyuktānṛṣisiddhānusevitān || 73 ||
vidyādharān kimpuruṣānṛkṣavānararākṣasān |
siṃhān vyāghrān varāhāṃśca mahiṣāñcharabhāñchaśāna ||74
sṛmarāṃścamarānnyaṅkūn mātaṅgān yakṣarākṣasān |
evaṃ bahuvidhān paśyaṃścaramāṇo nagottamam || 75 ||
dūrād dadarśa nṛpatirdevīṃ devasutopamām |
krīḍamānāṃ sakhībhiśca puṣpaṃ caiva vicinvatīm || 76 ||
tataścarantīṃ suśroṇīṃ sastrībhiḥ saha saṃvṛtām |
dṛpta saubhapatirdūrād vismayan sūtamabravīt || 77 ||
kasyeyaṃ mṛgaśāvākṣī vanāntaravicāriṇī |
rūpaudāryaguṇopetā manmathasya ratiryathā || 78 ||
śacīva puruhūtasya utāho vā tilottamā |
nārāyaṇoruṃ nirbhidya sambhūtā varavarṇinī |
ailasya dayitā devī yoṣidratnaṃ kimurvaśī || 79 ||
kṣīrārṇave mathyamāne surāsuragaṇaiḥ saha |
manthānaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvāmṛtārthamiti naḥ śrutam || 2.28.80 ||
tato'mṛtātsamuttasthau devī śrīrlokabhāvinī |
nārāyaṇāṅkalulitā kiṃ śrīreṣā varāṅganā || 81 ||
nīlameghāntaragatā dyotayantyaciraprabhā |
tathā yoṣidgaṇān madhye rūpaṃ pradyotayad vanam ||82 ||
atīva sukumārāṅgī suprabhendunibhānanā |
dṛṣṭvā rūpamanindyāṅgyā vibhrānto vyākulendriyaḥ ||83||
kāmasya vaśamāpanno mano vihvalatīva me |
bhṛśaṃ kṛntati me'ṅgāni sāyakaiḥ kusumāyudhaḥ |
bhittvā hṛdi śarān pañca nirdayaṃ hanti me manaḥ || 84 ||
hadayāgnirvardhayati ājyasikta ivānalaḥ |
kathamadya bhavet kāryaṃ śamārthaṃ manmathāgninā || 85 ||
kenopāyena kiṃ kurmo bhajenmāṃ mattagāminī |
evaṃ bahu cintayāno nopalabhya ca dānavaḥ || 86 ||
sūtamāha muhūrtaṃ tu tiṣṭhasva tvamihānagha |
ahaṃ yāsyāmi tāṃ draṣṭuṃ kasyeyamiti yoṣitam || 87 ||
pratīkṣamāṇastiṣṭhasva yāvadāgamanaṃ mama |
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tasya tathāstviti vaco'bravīt ||88||
evamuktvā dānavendro gamanāya mano dadhe |
vāryupaspṛśya balavān dhyānamevānvacintayat || 89 ||
muhūrtaṃ dhyānamātreṇa dṛṣṭaṃ jñānabalāt tataḥ |
ugrasenasya patnīti jñātvā harṣamupāgataḥ || 2.28.90 ||
ugrasenasya rūpaṃ vai kṛtvā svaṃ parivartya saḥ |
upāsarpanmahābāhuḥ prahasan dānaveśvaraḥ || 91 ||
smayamānaśca śanakairjagrāhāmitavīryavān |
ugrasenasya rūpeṇa mātaraṃ te vyadharṣayat || 92 ||
sā patisnigdhahṛdayā taṃ bhāvenopasarpatī |
śaṅkitā cābhavatpaścāttasya gauravadarśanāt || 93 ||
sā tamāhotthitā bhītā na tvaṃ mama patirdhuvam |
kasya tvaṃ vikṛtācāro yenāsmi malinīkṛtā || 94 ||
ekabhartṛvratamidaṃ mama saṃdūṣitaṃ tvayā |
patyurme rūpamāsthāya nīca nīcena karmaṇā || 95 ||
kiṃ māṃ vakṣyanti ruṣitā bāndhavāḥ kulapāṃsanīm |
jugupsitā ca vatsyāmi patipakṣairnirākṛtā || 96 ||
dhiktvāmīdṛśamakṣāntaṃ duṣkulaṃ vyutthitendriyam |
aviśvāsyamanāryaṃ ca paradārābhimarśanam ||97||
sa tāmāha prasajjantīṃ kṣiptaḥ krodhena dānavaḥ |
ahaṃ vai drumilo nāma saubhasya patirūrjitaḥ || 98 ||
kiṃ māṃ kṣipasi roṣeṇa mūḍhe paṇḍitamānini |
mānuṣaṃ patimāśritya nīcaṃ mṛtyuvaśe sthitam || 99 ||
vyabhicārānna duṣyanti striyaḥ strīmānagarvite |
na hyāsāṃ niyatā buddhirmānuṣīṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 2.28.100||
śrūyante hi striyo bahvyo vyabhicāravyatikramaiḥ |
prasūtā devasaṃkāśān putrān niścalavikramān || 101||
atīva hi tvaṃ strīloke patidharmavatī satī |
śuddhā keśānvidhunvantī bhāṣase yadyadicchasi|| 102||
kasya tvamiti yaccāhaṃ tvayokto mattakāśini |
kaṃsastasmād ripudhvaṃsī tava putro bhaviṣyati || 103||
sā saroṣā punarbhūtvā nindantī tasya taṃ varam |
uvāca vyathitā devī dānavaṃ dhṛṣṭavādinam || 104||
dhika te vṛttaṃ sudurvṛtta yaḥ sarvā nindasi striyaḥ|
santi striyo nīcavṛttāḥ santi caiva pativratāḥ || 105||
yāstvekapatnyaḥ śrūyante'rundhatīpramukhāḥ striyaḥ |
dhṛtā yābhiḥ prajāḥ sarvā lokāścaiva kulādhama || 106||
yastvayā mama putro vai datto vṛttavināśanaḥ |
na me bahumatastveṣa śṛṇu cāpi yaducyate || 107||
utpatsyati pumān nīca pativaṃśe mamādya yaḥ |
bhaviṣyati sa te mṛtyuryaśca dattastvayā sutaḥ || 108||
drumilastvevamuktastu jagāmākāśameva tu |
tenaiva rathamukhyena divyenāpratigāminā || 109||
jagāma ca purīṃ dīnā mātā tadahareva te |
māmevamuktvā bhagavān nārado munisattamaḥ || 2.28.110||
dīpyamānastapovīryāt sākṣādagniriva jvalan |
vallakīṃ vādyamāno hi saptasvaravimūrcchitām || 111 ||
gāyano lakṣyavīthīṃ sa jagāma brahmaṇo'ntikam |
śṛṇuṣvedaṃ mahāmātra nibodha vacanaṃ mama || 112|
tathyaṃ coktaṃ nāradena trailokyajñena dhīmatā |
alaṃ balena vīryeṇa nayena vinayena ca || 113||
pramāṇairvāpi vīryeṇa tejasā vikrameṇa ca |
satyena caiva dānena nānyo'sti sadṛśaḥ pumān || 114||
viditvā sarvamātmānaṃ vacanaṃ śraddadhāmyaham |
kṣretrajo'haṃ sutastasya ugrasenasya hastipa || 115||
mātāpitṛbhyāṃ saṃtyaktaḥ sthāpitaḥ svena tejasā |
ubhābhyāmapi vidviṣṭo bāndhavaiśca viśeṣataḥ || 116||
etānapi haniṣyāmi yādavān kṛṣṇapakṣiṇaḥ |
tadimau ghātayitvā tu hastinā gopakilbiṣau || 1 17||
tad gaccha gajamāruhya sāṃkuśaprāsatomaraḥ |
sthiro bhava mahāmātra samājadvāri mā ciram || 1 18||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi
kaṃsavākye'ṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 28 ||

<2.29>

ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tasminnahani nirvṛtte dvitīye samupasthite |
āpūryata mahāraṅgaḥ paurairyuddhadidṛkṣubhiḥ || 1 ||
sacitrāṣṭāstricaraṇāḥ sārgaladvāravedikāḥ |
sagavākṣārdhacandrāśca sutalpottamabhūṣitāḥ || 2 ||
prāṅmukhaiścārunirmuktairmālyadāmāvataṃsitaiḥ |
alaṃkṛtairvirājadbhiḥ śāradairiva toyadaiḥ || 3 ||
mañcāgāraiḥ suniryuktairyuddhāya suvibhūṣitaiḥ |
samājavāṭaḥ śuśubhe sameghaugha ivārṇavaḥ || 4 ||
svakarmadravyayuktābhiḥ patākābhirnirantaram |
śreṇīnāṃ ca gaṇānāṃ ca mañcā bhāntyacalopamāḥ|| 5 ||
antaḥpuracarāṇāṃ ca prekṣāgārāṇyanekaśaḥ |
rejuḥ kāñcanacitrāṇi ratnajvālākulāni ca || 6 ||
tāni ratnaughaklṛptāni sasānupragrahāṇi ca |
rejurjavanikākṣepaiḥ sapakṣā iva khe nagāḥ || 7 ||
tatra cāmarahāraiśca bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca siñjitaiḥ |
maṇīnāṃ ca vicitrāṇāṃ vicitrāścerurarciṣaḥ || 8 ||
gaṇikānāṃ pṛthaṅmañcāḥ śubhairāstaraṇāmbaraiḥ |
śobhitā vāramukhyābhirvimānapratimaujasaḥ || 9 ||
tatrāsanāni khyātāni paryaṅkāśca hiraṇmayāḥ |
prakīrṇāśca kuthāścitrāḥ sapuṣpastabakairvṛtāḥ || 2.29.10 |
sauvarṇāḥ pānakumbhāśca pānabhūmyaśca śobhitāḥ |
phalāvadaṃśapūrṇāśca cāṅgeryaḥ pānayojitāḥ || 11||
anye ca mañcā bahavaḥ kāṣṭhasaṃcayabandhanāḥ |
rejuḥ prastaraṇāstatra śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 12 |
uttamāgārikāścaiva sūkṣmajālāvalokinaḥ |
strīṇāṃ prekṣāgṛhā bhānti rājahaṃsā ivāmbare || 13 ||
prāṅmukhaścārunirmukto meruśṛṅgasamaprabhaḥ |
rukmapatranibhastambhaścitraniryogaśobhitaḥ || 14 ||
prekṣāgāraḥ sa kaṃsasya pracakāśe'dhikaṃ śriyā |
śobhito mālyadāmaiśca nivāsakṛtalakṣaṇaḥ || 15 ||
tasmin nānājanākīrṇe janaughapratinādite |
samājavāṭe saṃstabdhe kampamānārṇavaprabhe || 16 ||
rājā kuvalayāpīḍaḥ samājadvāri kuñjaraḥ |
tiṣṭhatviti samājñāpya prekṣāgāramupāyayau || 17 ||
sa śukle vāsasī bibhracchavetavyajanacāmaraḥ |
śuśubhe śvetamukuṭaḥ śvetābhra iva candramāḥ || 18 ||
tasya siṃhāsanasthasya sukhāsīnasya dhīmataḥ |
rūpamapratimaṃ dṛṣṭvā paurāḥ procurjayāśiṣaḥ || 19 ||
tataḥ praviviśurmallā raṅgamāvalitāmbarāḥ |
tisraśca bhāgaśaḥ kakṣāḥ prāviśan balaśālinaḥ || 2.29.20 ||
tatastūryaninādena kṣveḍitāsphoṭitena ca |
vasudevasutau hṛṣṭau raṅgadvāramupasthitau || 21 ||
ballavau vastrasaṃvītau suracandanabhūṣitau |
ūrdhvapīḍau sragāpīḍau bāhuśastrakṛtau yamau || 22 ||
āsphoṭayantāvanyonyaṃ bāhū caivārgalopamau |
tāvāpatantau tvaritau pratiṣiddhau varānanau |
tena mattena nāgena codyamānena vai bhṛśam || 23 ||
sa mattahastī duṣṭātmā kṛtvā kuṇḍalinaṃ karam |
cakāra codito yatnaṃ nihantuṃ balakeśavau || 24 ||
tataḥ prahasitaḥ kṛṣṇastrāsyamāno gajena vai |
kaṃsasya tanmataṃ caiva jagarhe sa durātmanaḥ || 25 ||
tvarate khalu kaṃso'ya gantuṃ vaivasvatakṣayam |
yo māmanena nāgena pradharṣayitumicchati || 26 ||
saṃnikṛṣṭe tato nāge garjamāne yathā ghane |
sahasotpatya govindaścakre tālasvanaṃ prabhuḥ || 27 ||
kṣveḍitāsphoṭitaravaṃ kṛtvā nāgasya cāgrataḥ |
karaṃ sasīkaraṃ tasya pratijagrāha vakṣasā || 28 ||
viṣāṇāntarago bhūtvā punaścaraṇamadhyagaḥ |
babādhe taṃ gajaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ pavanastoyadaṃ yathā || 29 ||
sa hastāgrād viniṣkrānto viṣāṇāgrācca dantinaḥ |
vimuktaḥ padamadhyācca kṛṣṇo dvipamapothayat || 2.29.30 ||
so'tikāyastu sammūḍho hantuṃ kṛṣṇamaśaknuvan |
gajaḥ sveṣveva gātreṣu mathyamāno rarāsa ha || 31||
papāta bhūmau jānubhyāṃ daśanābhyāṃ tutoda ca |
madaṃ susrāva roṣācca gharmāpāye yathā ghanaḥ || 32 ||
kṛṣṇastu tena nāgena krīḍitvā śiśulīlayā |
nidhanāya matiṃ cakre kaṃsadviṣṭena cetasā || 33 ||
sa tasya pramukhe pādaṃ kṛtvā kumbhādanantaram |
dorbhyāṃ viṣāṇamutpāṭya tainaiva prāharat tadā || 34 ||
sa tena vajrakalpena svena dantena kuñjaraḥ |
hanyamānaḥ śakṛnmūtraṃ mumocārto rarāsa ha || 35 ||
kṛṣṇajarjaritāṅgasya kuñjarasyārtacetasaḥ |
kaṭābhyāmati susrāva vegavad bhūri śoṇitam || 36 ||
lāṅgūlaṃ cāsya vegena niścakarṣa halāyudhaḥ |
śailapṛṣṭhārdhasaṃlīnaṃ vainateya ivoragam || 37 ||
tenaiva gajadantena kṛṣṇo hatvā tu dantinam |
jaghānaikaprahāreṇa gajārohaṇamulbaṇam || 38 ||
so''rtanādaṃ mahat kṛtvā vidanto dantināṃ varaḥ |
papāta samahāmātro vajrabhinna ivācalaḥ || 35 ||
tatastau toraṇāṅgāni pragṛhya raṇakarkaśau |
gajasya pādarakṣāṃśca jaghnatuḥ puruṣarṣabhau || 2.29.40 ||
tāṃśca hatvā viviśaturmadhyaṃ raṅgasya tāvubhau |
nāsatyāvaśvinau svargādavatīrṇāvivecchayā || 41 ||
vṛṣṇyandhakāśca bhojāśca dadṛśurvanamālinau |
kṣveḍitotkruṣṭanādena bāhvorāsphoṭitena ca |
siṃhanādaiśca tālaiśca harṣayāmāsaturjanam || 42 ||
tau dṛṣṭvā bhojarājastu viṣasāda vṛthāmatiḥ |
paurāṇāmanurāgaṃ ca harṣa cālakṣya bhārata || 43 ||
taṃ hatvā puṇḍarīkākṣo nadantaṃ dantināṃ varam |
avatīrṇo'rṇavākāraṃ samājaṃ sahapūrvajaḥ || 44 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi kuvalayāpīḍavadhe ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||29||

<2.30>

triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
praviśantaṃ tu vegena mārutāvalgitāmbaram |
pūrvajaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā kṛṣṇaṃ kamalalocanam || 1 ||
gajadantakṛtollekhaṃ subhujaṃ devakīsutam |
līlākṛtāṅgadaṃ vīraṃ madena rudhireṇa ca || 2 ||
valgamānaṃ yathā siṃhaṃ vyūhamānaṃ yathā ghanam |
bahuśabdaprahāreṇa cālayantaṃ vasuṃdharām || 3 ||
augraseniḥ samālokya dantidantodyatāyudham |
kṛṣṇaṃ bhṛśāyastamukhaḥ saroṣaṃ samudaikṣata || 4 ||
bhujāsaktena śuśubhe gajadantena keśavaḥ |
candrārdhabimbasaṃsakto yathaikaśikharo giriḥ || 5 ||
valgamāne tu govinde sa kṛtsno raṅgasāgaraḥ |
janaughapratinādena pūryamāṇa ivābabhau || 6 ||
tataḥ krodhābhitāmrākṣaḥ kaṃsaḥ paramakopanaḥ |
cāṇūramādiśad yuddhe kṛṣṇasya sumahābalam || 7 ||
andhraṃ mallaṃ ca nikṛtiṃ muṣṭikaṃ ca mahābalam |
baladevāya sakrodho dideśādricayopamam || 8 ||
kaṃsenāpi samājñaptaścāṇūraḥ pūrvameva tu |
yoddhavyaṃ saha kṛṣṇena tvayā yatnavateti vai || 9 ||
sa roṣeṇa tu cāṇūraḥ kaṣāyīkṛtalocanaḥ |
abhyāvartata yuddhārthamapāṃ pūrṇo yathā ghanaḥ || 2.30.10 ||
avaghuṣṭe samāje, tu niśśabdastimite jane |
yādavāḥ sahitāstatra idaṃ vacanamabruvan || 11 ||
bāhuyuddhamidaṃ raṃge saprāśnikamakātaram |
kriyābalasamājñātamaśastraṃ nirmitaṃ purā || 12 ||
adbhiścātiśramo nityaṃ vineyaḥ kāladarśibhiḥ |
karīṣeṇa ca mallasya satataṃ satkriyā smṛtā || 13 ||
sthito bhūmigatenaiva yo yathā mārgataḥ sthitaḥ |
saṃyujyataśca paryāyaḥ prāśnikaiḥ samudāhṛtaḥ || 14 ||
bālo vā yadi vā vṛddho madhyo vāpi kṛśo'pi vā |
balastho vā sthito raṃge jñeyaḥ kakṣāntareṇa vai || 15||
balataśca kriyāśca bāhuyuddhavidhiryudhi |
nipātānantaraṃ kiṃcinna kartavyaṃ vijānatā || 16 ||
tadidaṃ prastutaṃ raṃge yuddhaṃ kṛṣṇāndhramallayoḥ |
bālaḥ kṛṣṇo mahānandhraḥ kathaṃ na syād vicāraṇā|| 17 ||
tataḥ kilakilāśabdaḥ samāje samavartata |
prāvalgata ca govindo vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha || 18 ||
ahaṃ bālo mahānandhro vapuṣā parvatopamaḥ |
yuddhaṃ mamānena saha rocate bāhuśālinā || 19 ||
yuddhavyatikramaḥ kaścinna bhaviṣyati matkṛtaḥ |
na hyahaṃ bāhuyodhānāṃ dūṣayiṣyāmi yanmatam || 2.30.20 ||
yo'yaṃ karīṣadharmaśca toyadharmaśca raṃgajaḥ |
kaṣāyasya ca saṃsargaḥ samayo hyeṣa kalpitaḥ || 21 ||
saṃyamaḥ sthiratā śauryaṃ vyāyāmaḥ satkriyā balam |
raṃge ca niyatā siddhiretad yuddhavidāṃ matam ||22||
avairamevaṃ yadayaṃ savairaṃ kartumudyataḥ |
atra vai nigrahaḥ kāryastoṣayiṣyāmyahaṃ jagat || 23 ||
karūṣeṣu prasūto'yaṃ cāṇūro nāma nāmataḥ |
bāhuyodhī śarīreṇa karmabhiścātra cintyatām || 24 ||
etena bahavo mallā nipātānantaraṃ hatāḥ |
raṅgapratāpakāmena mallamārgaśca dūṣitaḥ || 25 ||
śastrasiddhistu yodhānāṃ saṃgrāme śastrayodhinām |
raṅgasiddhistu mallānāṃ pratimallanipātajā || 26 ||
raṇe vi jayamānasya kīrtirbhavati śāśvatī |
hatasyāpi raṇe śastrairnākapṛṣṭhaṃ vidhīyate || 27 ||
raṇe ubhayataḥ siddhirhatasyeha ghnato'pi vā |
sā hi prāṇāntikīyātrā mahadbhiḥ sādhupūjitā || 28 ||
ayaṃ tu mārgo balataḥ kriyātaśca viniḥsṛtaḥ |
mṛtasya raṅge kva svargo jayate vā kuto ratiḥ || 29 ||
ye tu kecit svadoṣeṇa rājñaḥ paṇḍitamāninaḥ |
pratāpārthe hatā mallā mallahanturvadho hi saḥ || 2.30.30 ||
evaṃ saṃjalpatastasya tābhyāṃ yuddhaṃ sudāruṇam |
ubhābhyāmabhavad ghoraṃ vāraṇābhyāṃ yathā vane || 31 ||
kṛtapratikṛtaiścitrairbāhubhiśca sakaṇṭakaiḥ |
sannipātāvadhūtaiśca pramāthonmathanaistathā || 32 ||
tāvubhāvapi saṃśliṣṭau yathā śailamayau tathā |
kṣepaṇairmuṣṭibhiścaiva varāhoddhūtaniḥsvanaiḥ || 33 ||
kīlairvajranipātaiśca prasṛṣṭābhistathaiva ca |
śalākānakhapātaiśca pādoddhūtaiśca dāruṇaiḥ || 34 ||
jānubhiścāśmanirghoṣaiḥ śirobhyāṃ cāvaghaṭṭitaiḥ |
tad yuddhamabhavad ghoramaśastraṃ bāhutejasā || 35 ||
balaprāṇena śūrāṇāṃ samājotsavasaṃnidhau |
arajyata janaḥ sarvaḥ sotkṛṣṭaninadotthitaḥ || 36 ||
sādhuvādāṃśca mañceṣu ghoṣayantyapare janāḥ |
tataḥ prasvinnavadanaḥ kṛṣṇapraṇihitekṣaṇaḥ |
nyavārayata tūryāṇi kaṃsaḥ savyena pāṇinā ||37 ||
pratiṣiddheṣu tūryeṣu mṛdaṅgādiṣu teṣu vai |
khe saṃgatānyavādyanta devatūryāṇyanekaśaḥ || 38 ||
yuddhyamāne hṛṣīkeśe puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇe |
svayameva pravādyanta tūryaghoṣāstu sarvaśaḥ || 39 ||
antardhānagatā devā vimānaiḥ kāmarūpibhiḥ |
cerurvidyādharaiḥ sārddhaṃ kṛṣṇasya jayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ || 2.30.40 ||
jayasva kṛṣṇa cāṇūraṃ dānavaṃ mallarūpiṇam |
iti saptarṣayaḥ sarve ūcuścaiva nabhogatāḥ || 41 ||
cāṇūreṇa ciraṃ kālaṃ krīḍitvā devakīsutaḥ |
balamāhārayāmāsa kaṃsasyābhāvadarśivān || 42 ||
tataścacāla vasudhā mañcāścaiva jughūrṇire |
mukuṭāccāpi kaṃsasya papāta maṇiruttamaḥ || 43 ||
dorbhyāmānamya kṛṣṇastu cāṇūraṃ śīrṇajīvitam |
prāharanmuṣṭinā mūrdhni vakṣasyāhatya jānunā || 44 ||
niḥsṛte sāśrurudhire tasya netre sabandhane |
tāpanīye yathā ghaṇṭe kakṣopari vilambite || 45 ||
papāta sa tu raṅgasya madhye niḥsṛtalocanaḥ |
cāṇūro vigataprāṇo jīvitānte mahītale || 46 ||
dehena tasya mallasya cāṇūrasya gatāyuṣaḥ |
saṃniruddho mahāraṅgaḥ sa śaileneva lakṣyate || 47 ||
rauhiṇeyo hate tasmiṃścāṇūre baladarpite |
jagrāha muṣṭikaṃ raṃge kṛṣṇastośalakaṃ punaḥ || 48 |
sannipāte tu tau mallau prathame krodhamūrcchitau |
sameyātāṃ rāmakṛṣṇau kālasya vaśavartinau |
nirghātāvanatau bhūtvā raṅgamadhye vavalgatuḥ || 49 |
kṛṣṇastośalamudyamya giriśṛṅgopamaṃ balī |
bhrāmayitvā śataguṇaṃ niṣpipeṣa mahītale || 2.30.50 ||
tasya kṛṣṇābhipannasya pīḍitasya balīyasaḥ |
mukhād rudhiramatyarthamujjagāma mumūrṣataḥ || 51 ||
saṃkarṣaṇastu suciraṃ yodhayitvā mahābalaḥ |
andhramallaṃ mahāmallo maṇḍalāni vyadarśayat || 52 ||
muṣṭinaikena tejasvī sāśanistanayitnunā |
śirasyabhyahanad vīro vajreṇeva mahāgirim || 53 ||
sa niṣpatitamastiṣko visrastanayano bhuvi |
papāta nihatastena tato nādo mahānabhūt || 54 ||
andhratośalakau hatvā kṛṣṇasaṃkarṣaṇāvubhau |
krodhasaṃraktanayanau raṃgamadhye vavalgatuḥ || 55 ||
samājavāṭo nirmallaḥ so'bhavad bhīmadarśanaḥ |
andhre tadā mahāmalle muṣṭike ca nipātite || 56 ||
ye ca samprekṣakā gopā nandagopapurogamāḥ |
bhayakṣobhitasarvāṅgāḥ sarve tatrāvatasthire || 57 ||
harṣajaṃ vāri netrābhyāṃ varṣamāṇā pravepatī |
prasravotpīḍitā kṛṣṇaṃ devakī samudaikṣata || 58 ||
kṛṣṇadarśanajātena bāṣpeṇākulitekṣaṇaḥ |
vasudevo jarāṃ tyaktvā snehena taruṇāyate || 59 ||
vāramukhyāśca tāḥ sarvāḥ kṛṣṇasya mukhapaṅkajam |
papurhi netrabhramarairnimeṣāntaragāmibhiḥ || 2.30.60 ||
kaṃsasyātha mukhe svedo bhrūbhedāntaragocaraḥ |
abhavad roṣaniryāsaḥ kṛṣṇasaṃdarśaneritaḥ || 61 ||
keśavāya sadhūmena roṣaniśvāsavāyunā |
dīptamantargataṃ tasya hṛdayaṃ mānasāgninā || 62 ||
tasya prasphuritauṣṭhasya svinnālikatalasya vai |
kaṃsavaktrasya roṣeṇa raktasūryāyate vapuḥ || 63 ||
krodharaktānmukhāttasya niḥsṛtāḥ svedabindavaḥ |
yathā ravikaraspṛṣṭā vṛkṣāvaśyāyabindavaḥ || 64 ||
so'jñāpayata saṃkruddhaḥ puruṣānvyāyatānbahūn|
gopāvetau samājaughānniṣkrāmyetāṃ vanecarau || 65 ||
na caitau draṣṭumicchāmi vikṛtau pāpadarśanau |
gopānāmapi me rājye na kaścitsthātumarhati || 66 ||
nandagopaśca durmedhāḥ pāpeṣvabhirato mama |
āyasairnigaḍākārairlohapāśainigṛhyatām || 67 ||
vasudevaśca durvṛtto nityaṃ dveṣakaro mama |
avṛddhārheṇa daṇḍena kṣipramadyaiva śāsyatām ||68 ||
ye ceme prākṛtā gopā dāmodaraparāyaṇāḥ |
hriyantāṃ gāva eteṣāṃ yaccāsti vasu kiṃcana || 69 ||
evamājñāpayānaṃ taṃ kaṃsaṃ paruṣabhāṣiṇam |
dadarśāyastanayanaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ satyaparākramaḥ || 2.30.70 ||
kṣipte pitari cukrodha nandagope ca keśavaḥ |
jñātīnāṃ ca vyathāṃ dṛṣṭvā visaṃjñāṃ caiva devakīm || 71 ||
sa siṃha iva vegena keśavo jātavikramaḥ |
ārurukṣurmahābāhuḥ kaṃsanāśārthamacputaḥ || 72 ||
raṅgamadhyādutpapāta kṛṣṇaḥ kaṃsāsanāntikam |
asajjadvāyunā''kṣipto yathā khastho ghanāghanaḥ|| 73 ||
dadṛśurna hi taṃ sarve raṅgamadhyādavaplutam |
kevalaṃ kaṃsapārśvasthaṃ dadṛśuḥ puravāsinaḥ || 74 ||
so'pi kaṃsastathā''yastaḥ parītaḥ kāladharmaṇā |
ākāśādiva govindaṃ mene tatrāgataṃ prabhum || 75 ||
sa kṛṣṇenāyataṃ kṛtvā bāhuṃ parighasaṃnibham |
mūrdhajeṣu parāmṛṣṭaḥ kaṃso vai raṅgasaṃsadi || 76 ||
mukuṭaścāpatat tasya kāñcano vajrabhūṣitaḥ |
śirasastasya kṛṣṇena parāmṛṣṭasya pāṇinā || 77 ||
sa grahagrastakeśaśca kaṃso niryatnatāṃ gataḥ |
tathaiva ca visammūḍho vaikalyaṃ samapadyata || 78 ||
nigṛhītaśca keśeṣu gatāsuriva niḥśvasan |
na śaśāka mukhaṃ draṣṭuṃ kaṃsaḥ kṛṣṇasya vai tadā || 79 |
vikuṇḍalābhyāṃ karṇābhyāṃ chinnahāreṇa vakṣasā |
pralambābhyāṃ ca bāhubhyāṃ gātraivisṛtabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 2.30.80 ||
bhraṃśitenottarīyeṇa sahasāvalitānanaḥ |
ceṣṭamānaḥ samākṣiptaḥ kaṃsaḥ kārṣṇena tejasā || 81 ||
cakarṣa ca mahāraṅge mañcānniṣkramya keśavaḥ |
keśeṣu taṃ balād gṛhya kaṃsaṃ kleśārhatāṃ gatama || 82||
kṛṣyamāṇaḥ sa kṛṣṇena bhojarājo mahādyutiḥ |
samājavāṭe parikhāṃ dehakṛṣṭāṃ cakāra ha || 83 ||
samājavāṭe krīḍitvā vikṛṣya ca gatāyuṣam |
kṛṣṇo visarjayāmāsa kaṃsadehamadūrataḥ || 84 ||
dharaṇyāṃ mṛditaḥ śiśye tava dehaḥ sukhocitaḥ |
krameṇa viparītena pāṃsubhiḥ paruṣīkṛtaḥ || 85 ||
tasya tad vadanaṃ śyāmaṃ suptākṣaṃ mukuṭaṃ vinā |
na vibhāti viparyastaṃ vipalāśaṃ yathāmbujam || 86 ||
asaṃgrāmahataḥ kaṃsaḥ sa bāṇairaparikṣataḥ|
keśagrāhānnirastāsurvīramārgānnirākṛtaḥ || 87 ||
tasya dehe prakāśante sahasā keśavārpitāḥ |
māṃsacchedaghanāḥ sarve nakhāgrā jīvitacchidaḥ || 88 ||
taṃ hatvā puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ praharṣād dviguṇaprabhaḥ |
vavande vasudevasya pādau nihatakaṇṭakaḥ || 89 ||
mātuśca śirasā pādau nipīḍya yadunandanaḥ |
sāsiñcat prasravotpīḍaiḥ kṛṣṇamānandaniḥsṛtaiḥ || 2.30.90 ||
yādavāṃścaiva tān sarvān yathāsthānaṃ yathāvayaḥ |
papraccha kuśalaṃ kṛṣṇo dīpyamānaḥ svatejasā || 91 ||
baladevo'pi dharmātmā kaṃsabhrātaramūrjitam |
bāhubhyāmeva tarasā sunāmānamapothayat || 92 ||
tau jitārī jitakrodhau ciraviproṣitau vraje |
sthapiturbhavanaṃ vīrau jagmaturhṛṣṭamānasau || 93 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi kaṃsavadhe triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||

<2.31>

ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
bhartāraṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣīṇapuṇyamiva graham |
kaṃsapatnyo hataṃ kaṃsaṃ samantāt paryavārayan || 1 ||
taṃ mahīśayane suptaṃ kṣitināthaṃ gatāyuṣam |
bhāryāḥ sma dṛṣṭvā śocanti mṛgyo mṛgapatiṃ yathā || 2 ||
hā hatāḥ sma mahābāho hatāśā hatabāndhavāḥ |
vīrapatnyo hate vīre tvayi vīravratapriye || 3 ||
imāmavasthāṃ paśyantyaḥ paścimāṃ tava naiṣṭhikīm |
kṛpaṇaṃ rājaśārdūla vilapāmaḥ sabāndhavāḥ || 4 ||
chinnamūlāḥ sma saṃvṛttāḥ parityaktāstvayā vibho |
tvayi pañcatvamāpanne nāthe'smākaṃ mahābale || 5 ||
ko naḥ kopaparītāṅgī ratisaṃsargalālasāḥ |
latā iva viceṣṭantīḥ śayanīyāni neṣyati || 6 ||
idaṃ te'sadṛśaṃ saumya hṛdyaniḥśvāsamārutam |
dahatyarko mukhaṃ kāntaṃ nistoyamiva paṅkajam || 7 ||
ime te śravaṇe śūnye na śobhete vikuṇḍale |
śirodharāyāṃ saṃlīne satataṃ kuṇḍalapriye || 8 ||
kva te sa mukuṭo vīra sarvaratnavibhūṣitaḥ |
atyarthaṃ śiraso lakṣmīṃ yo dadhārārkasaprabhām || 9 ||
anena hi kalatreṇa tavāntaḥpuraśobhinā |
kathaṃ dīnena kartavyaṃ tvayi lokāntaraṃ gate || 2.31.10 ||
nanu nāma striyaḥ sādhvyaḥ priyabhogeṣvavañcitāḥ |
patīnāmaparityājyāḥ sa tvaṃ nastyajya gacchasi || 11 ||
aho kālo mahāvīryo yena paryayakarmaṇā |
kālatulyaḥ sapatnānāṃ tvaṃ kṣipramapanīyase || 12 ||
vayaṃ duḥkheṣvanucitāḥ sukheṣveva tvayaidhitāḥ |
kathaṃ vatsyāma vidhavā nātha kārpaṇyamāśritāḥ || 13 ||
strīṇāṃ cāritralubdhānāṃ patirekaḥ parā gatiḥ |
tvaṃ hi naḥ sā gatiśchinnā kṛtāntena balīyasā || 14||
vaidhavyenābhibhūtāḥ smaḥ śokasaṃtaptamānasāḥ |
roditavyahrade magnāḥ kva gacchāmastvayā vinā || 15 ||
saha tvayā gataḥ kālastvadaṅke krīḍitaṃ kṛtam |
kṣaṇena tadvihīnāḥ sma anityā hi nṛṇāṃ gatiḥ || 16 ||
aho balavihīnāḥ sma vipanne tvayi mānada |
ekaduṣkṛtakāriṇyaḥ sarvā vaidhavyalakṣaṇāḥ || 17 ||
tvayā svargapraticchandairlālitāḥ sma ratipriyāḥ |
tvayi kāmavaśāḥ sarvāḥ sa nastyajya kva gacchasi || 18|
asmākaṃ tvamanāthānāṃ nātho hyasi suropama |
āsāṃ vilapamānānāṃ kurarīṇāmiva prabho |
prativākyaṃ jagannātha dātumarhasi mānada || 19 ||
evamārtakalatrasya śāmyamāneṣu bandhuṣu |
gamanaṃ te mahābhāga dāruṇaṃ pratibhāti naḥ || 2.31.20 ||
nūnaṃ kāntatarāḥ kānta paraloke varastriyaḥ |
yatastvaṃ prasthito vīra vihāyemaṃ gṛhe janam || 21 ||
kiṃ nu te kāraṇaṃ vīra bhāryāsvetāsu bhūrida |
ārtanādaṃ rudantīṣu yanmohānnāvabudhyase || 22 ||
aho niṣkaruṇā yātrā narāṇāmaurdhvadehikī |
yat parityajya dārānsvānnirapekṣā vrajanti hi||23||
apatitvaṃ striyāḥ śreyo na tu śūraḥ patiḥ striyāḥ |
svargastrīṇāṃ priyāḥ śūrāsteṣāmapi ca tāḥ priyāḥ ||24||
aho kṣipramadṛśyena nayatā tvāṃ raṇapriyam|
prahṛtaṃ naḥ kṛtāntena sarvāsāmantarātmasu || 25 ||
hatvā jarāsaṃdhabalaṃ jitvā yakṣāṃśca saṃyuge |
kathaṃ mānuṣamātreṇa hatastvaṃ jagatītale || 26 ||
indreṇa saha saṃgrāmaṃ kṛtvā sāyakavigraham |
amartyairajito yuddhe martyenāsi kathaṃ hataḥ || 27 ||
tvayā sāgaramakṣobhyaṃ vikṣobhya śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ |
ratnasarvasvaharaṇaṃ jitvā pāśadharaṃ kṛtam || 28 ||
tvayā paurajanasyārthe mandaṃ varṣati vāsave|
sāyakairjaladāñjitvā balād varṣaṃ pravartitam || 29 ||
pratāpāvanatāḥ sarve tava tiṣṭhanti pārthivāḥ |
preṣayanto varārhāṇi ratnānyācchādanāni ca || 2.31.30 ||
tavaiva devakalpasya dṛṣṭavīryasya śatrubhiḥ |
kathaṃ prāṇāntakaṃ ghoramīdṛśaṃ bhayamāgatam || 31 ||
prāptāḥ smo vidhavāśabdaṃ tvayi nāthe nipātite |
apramattāḥ pramattena kṛtāntena nirākṛtāḥ || 32 ||
yadyevaṃ nātha gantavyaṃ yadi vā vismṛtā vayam |
vāṅmātreṇāpi yāmīti vaktavye kaḥ pariśramaḥ || 33 ||
prasīda nātha bhītāḥ sma pādau te yāma mūrddhabhiḥ |
alaṃ dūrapravāsena nivartasva narādhipa || 34 ||
aho vīra kathaṃ śeṣe niṣaṇṇastṛṇapāṃsuṣu |
śayānasya hi te bhūmau kasmānnodvijate vapuḥ || 35 ||
kena suptaprahāro'yaṃ datto'smākamatarkitaḥ |
prahṛtaṃ kena sarvāsu nārīṣvevaṃ sudāruṇam || 36 ||
ruditānuśayo nāryā jīvantyāḥ paridevanam |
kiṃ vayaṃ sati gantavye saha bhartrā rudāmahe || 37 ||
etasminnantare dīnā kaṃsamātā pravepatī |
kva me vatsaḥ kva me putra iti rorūyatī bhṛśam || 38 ||
sāpaśyannihataṃ putraṃ niṣprabhaṃ śaśinaṃ yathā |
hṛdayena vidīrṇena bhrāmyamāṇā punaḥ punaḥ|| 39 ||
putraṃ samabhivīkṣantī hā hatāsmīti vāśatī |
snuṣāṇāmārtanādena vilalāpa ruroda ca || 2.31.40 ||
sā tasya vadanaṃ dīnamutsaṃge putragṛddhinī |
kṛtvā putreti kāruṇyaṃ vilalāpārtayā girā || 41 ||
putra śūravrate yukta jñātīnāṃ nandivarddhana |
kimidaṃ tvaritaṃ vatsa prasthānaṃ kṛtavānasi || 42 ||
prasuptaścātivivṛte kiṃ putra niyamaṃ vinā |
vatsa naivaṃvidhā bhūmau śerate kṛtalakṣaṇāḥ || 43 ||
rāvaṇena purā gītaḥ śloko'yaṃ sādhusammataḥ |
balajyeṣṭhena lokeṣu rākṣasānāṃ samāgame || 44 ||
evamūrjitavīryasya mama devanighātinaḥ |
bāndhavebhyo bhayaṃ ghoraṃ durnivāryaṃ bhaviṣyati || 45 |
tathaiva jñātilubdhasya mama putrasya dhīmataḥ |
jñātibhyo bhayamutpannaṃ śarīrāntakaraṃ mahat || 46 ||
sā patiṃ bhūpatiṃ vṛddhamugrasenaṃ vicetasam |
uvāca rudatī vākyaṃ vivatsā hariṇī yathā || 47 ||
ehyehi rājañchuddhātmana paśya putraṃ janeśvaram |
śayānaṃ vīraśayane vajrāhatamivācalam || 48 ||
anya kurmo mahārāja niryāṇasadṛśīṃ kriyām |
pretatvamupapannasya gatasya yamasādanam || 49 ||
vīrabhogyāni rājyāni vayaṃ cāpi parājitāḥ |
gaccha vijñāpyatāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kaṃsasatkārakāraṇāt || 2.31.50 ||
maraṇāntāni vairāṇi śānte śāntirbhaviṣyati |
pretakāryāṇi kāryāṇi mṛtaḥ kimaparādhyate || 51 ||
evamuktvā patiṃ bhojaṃ keśānārujya duḥkhitā |
putrasya mukhamīkṣantī vilalāpaiva sā bhṛśam || 52 ||
imāste kiṃ kariṣyanti bhāryā rājan sukhoṣitāḥ |
tvāṃ patiṃ supatiṃ prāpya yā vipannamanorathāḥ ||53||
imaṃ te pitaraṃ vṛddhaṃ kṛṣṇasya vaśavartinam |
kathaṃ drakṣyāmi śuṣyantaṃ kāsārasalilaṃ yathā || 54 ||
ahaṃ te jananī putra kimarthaṃ nābhibhāṣase |
prasthito dīrghamadhvānaṃ parityajya priyaṃ janam || 55 ||
aho vīrālpabhāgyāyāḥ kṛtāntenābhivartinā |
ācchidya mama saṃdāyo nīyase nayakovidaḥ || 56 ||
dānamānagṛhītāni tṛptānyetāni tairguṇaiḥ |
rudanti tava bhṛtyānāṃ kulāni kulayūthapa || 57 ||
uttiṣṭha naraśārdūla dīrghabāho mahābala |
trāhi dīnaṃ janaṃ sarvaṃ puramantaḥpuraṃ yathā || 58 ||
rudatīnāṃ bhṛśārtānāṃ kaṃsastrīṇāṃ suvistaram |
jagāmāstaṃ dinakaraḥ saṃdhyārāgeṇa rañjitaḥ || 59 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi kaṃsastrīvilāpe ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 31 ||

<2.32>

dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
ugrasenastu kṛṣṇasya samīpaṃ duḥkhito yayau |
putraśokābhisaṃtapto viṣapīta iva śvasan || 1 ||
sa dadarśa gṛhe kṛṣṇaṃ yādavaiḥ parivāritam |
paścānutāpād dhyāyantaṃ kaṃsasya nidhanāvilam || 2 ||
kaṃsanārīvilāpāṃśca śrutvā sa karuṇān bahūn |
garhamāṇastathā''tmānaṃ tasmin yādavasaṃsadi || 3 ||
aho mayātibālyena roṣād doṣānuvartinā |
vaidhavyaṃ strīsahasrāṇāṃ kaṃsasyāsya vadhe kṛtam || 4 ||
kāruṇyaṃ khalu nārīṣu prākṛtasyāpi jāyate |
evamārtaṃ rudantīṣu mayā bhartari pātite || 5 ||
paridevitamātreṇa śokaḥ khalu vidhīyate |
kṛtāntasyānabhijñānāṃ strīṇāṃ kāruṇyasambhavaḥ ||6 ||
kaṃsasya hi vadhaḥ śreyān prāgevābhimato mama |
satāmudvejanīyasya pāpeṣvabhiratasya ca || 7 ||
loke patitavṛttasya paruṣasyālalpamedhasaḥ |
akliṣṭaṃ maraṇaṃ śreyo na vidviṣṭasya jīvitam || 8 ||
kaṃsaḥ pāpaparaścaiva sādhūnāmapyasammataḥ |
dhikchabdapatitaścaiva jīvite cāsya kā dayā || 9 ||
svarge tapobhṛtāṃ vāsa phalaṃ puṇyasya karmaṇaḥ |
ihāpi yaśasā yuktaḥ svargasthairavadhāryate || 2.32.10 ||
yadi syurnirvṛtā lokāḥ syuśca dharmaparāḥ prajāḥ |
narā dharmapravṛttāśca na rājñāmanayaḥ spṛśet || 11 ||
nigrahe duṣṭavṛttīnāṃ kṛtāntaḥ kṛrute phalam |
iṣṭadharmeṣu lokeṣu kartavyaṃ pāralaukikam || 12 ||
atīva devā rakṣanti naraṃ dharmaparāyaṇam |
kartāraḥ sulabhā loke duṣkṛtasya hi karmaṇaḥ || 13 ||
hataḥ so'yaṃ mayā kaṃsaḥ sādhvetadavagamyatām |
mūlacchedaḥ kṛtastasya viparītasya karmaṇaḥ || 14 ||
tadeṣa sāntvyatāṃ sarvaḥ śokārtaḥ pramadājanaḥ |
paurāśca puryāṃ śreṇyaśca sāntvyantāṃ sarva eva hi || 15 ||
evaṃ bruvati govinde viveśāvanatānanaḥ |
ugraseno yadūn gṛhya putrakilbiṣaśaṅkitaḥ || 16 ||
sa kṛṣṇaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣamuvāca yadusaṃsadi |
vāṣpasaṃdigdhayā vācā dīnayā sajjamānayā || 17 ||
putro niryātitaḥ krodhānnīto yāmyāṃ diśaṃ ripuḥ |
svadharmādhigatā kīrtirnāma viśrāvitaṃ bhuvi || 18 ||
sthāpitaṃ satsu māhātmyaṃ śaṅkitā ripavaḥ kṛtāḥ |
sthāpito yādavo vaṃśo garvitāḥ suhṛdaḥ kṛtāḥ || 19||
sāmanteṣu narendreṣu pratāpaste prakāśitaḥ |
mitrāṇi tvāṃ bhajiṣyanti saṃśrayiṣyanti pārthivāḥ ||2.32.20||
prakṛtayo'nuyāsyanti stoṣyanti tvāṃ dvijātayaḥ |
saṃdhivigrahamukhyāstvāṃ praṇamiṣyanti mantriṇaḥ || 21 ||
hastyaśvarathasampūrṇaṃ padātigaṇasaṃkulam |
pratigṛhāṇa kṛṣṇedaṃ kaṃsasya balamavyayam || 28 ||
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ ca yat kiṃcid ratnānyācchādanāni ca |
pratīcchantu niyuktā vai tvadīyāḥ kṛṣṇa pūruṣāḥ ||23||
striyo hiraṇyaṃ yānāni yadanyad vasu kiṃcana |
evaṃ hi vihite yoge paryāpte kṛṣṇa vigrahe || 24 ||
pratiṣṭhitāyāṃ medinyāṃ yadūnāṃ śatrusūdana |
tvaṃ gatiścāgatiścaiva yadūnāṃ yadunandana || 25 ||
śṛṇuṣva vadatāṃ vīra kṛpaṇānāmidaṃ vacaḥ |
asya tvatkopadagdhasya kaṃsasyāśubhakarmaṇaḥ || 26 ||
tava prasādād govinda pretakāryaṃ kriyeta ha |
tasya kṛtvā narendrasya vipannasyaurdhvadehikam || 27 ||
sasnuṣo'haṃ sabhāryaśca cariṣyāmi mṛgaiḥ saha |
pretasatkāramātreṇa kṛte bāndhavakarmaṇi |
ānṛṇyaṃ laukikaṃ kṛṣṇa gatāḥ kila bhavanti hi || 28 ||
tasyāgniṃ paścimaṃ kṛtvā citisthāne vidhānataḥ |
toyapradānamātreṇa kaṃsasyānṛṇyamāpnuyām || 29 ||
etatte kṛṣṇa vijñāpyaṃ sneho'tra mayi yujyatām |
prāpnoti sugatiṃ tatra kṛpaṇaḥ paścimāṃ kriyām || 2.32.30 ||
etacchrutvā vacastasya kṛṣṇaḥ paramavismitaḥ |
pratyuvācograsenaṃ vai sāntvapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ || 31 ||
kālayuktamidaṃ tāta tavaitad yat prabhāṣitam |
sadṛśaṃ rājaśārdūla vṛttasya ca kulasya ca || 32 ||
yat tvamevaṃvidhaṃ brūṣe gate'rthe duratikramaṃ |
prāpsyate nṛpasatkāraṃ kaṃsaḥ pretagato''pi san || 33 ||
kule mahati te janma vedān viditavānasi |
kathaṃ na jñāyate tāta niyatirduratikramā || 34 ||
sthāvarāṇāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ jaṅgamānāṃ ca pārthiva |
pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ karma kālena paripacyate || 35 ||
śrutavanto'rthavantaśca dātāraḥ priyadarśanāḥ |
brahmaṇyā nayasampannā dīnānugrahakāriṇaḥ || 36 ||
lokapālasamāstāta mahendrasamavikramāḥ |
kṣitipālāḥ kṛtāntena nīyante nṛpasattama || 37 ||
dhārmikāḥ sarvabhāvajñāḥ prajāpālanatatparāḥ |
kṣatradharmaparā dāntāḥ kālena nidhanaṃ gatāḥ || 38 ||
svayamātmakṛtaṃ karma śubhaṃ yā yadi vāśubham |
prāpte kāle tu tatkarma dṛśyate sarvadehinām || 39 ||
eṣā hyantarhitā māyā durvijñeyā surairapi |
yathāyaṃ muhyate loko hyatra karmaiva kāraṇam || 2.32.40 ||
kālenābhihataḥ kaṃsaḥ pūrvakarmapracoditaḥ |
na hyahaṃ kāraṇaṃ tatra kālaḥ karma ca kāraṇam || 41 ||
sūryasomamayaṃ tāta kṛtsnaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam |
kālena nidhanaṃ gatvā kālenaiva ca jāyate || 42 ||
sa kālaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ nigrahānugrahe rataḥ |
tasmātsarvāṇi bhūtāni kālasya vaśagāni vai || 43 ||
svadoṣeṇaiva dagdhasya sūnostava narādhipa |
nāhaṃ vai kāraṇaṃ tatra kālastatra ca kāraṇam || 44 ||
athavāhaṃ bhaviṣyāmi kāraṇaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ |
parāyaṇaparaḥ kālaḥ kiṃ kariṣyatyakāraṇaḥ || 45 ||
kālastu balavān rājan durvijñeyā hi sā gatiḥ|
parāvaraviśeṣajñā yāṃ yānti samadarśinaḥ || 46 ||
gatiḥ kālasya sā yena sarvaṃ kālasya gocaram |
bravīmi yadahaṃ tāta tadanuṣṭhīyatāṃ vacaḥ || 47 ||
na hi rājyena me kāryaṃ nāpyahaṃ nṛpa kāṅkṣitaḥ |
na cāpi rājyalubdhena mayā kaṃso nipātitaḥ || 48 ||
kiṃ tu lokahitārthāya kīrtyarthaṃ ca sutastava |
vyaṅgabhūtaḥ kulasyāsya sānujo vinipātitaḥ || 49 ||
ahaṃ sa eva gomadhye gopaiḥ saha vanecaraḥ |
prītimān vicariṣyāmi kāmacārī yathā gajaḥ || 2.32.50 ||
etāvacchataśo'pyevaṃ satyenaitad bravīmi te |
na me kāryaṃ nṛpatvena vijñāpyaṃ kriyatāmidam || 51 ||
bhavāna rājāstu mānyo me yadūnāmagraṇīḥ prabhuḥ |
vijayāyābhiṣicyasva svarājye nṛpasattama || 52 ||
yadi te matpriyaṃ kāryaṃ yadi vā nāsti te vyathā |
mayā nisṛṣṭaṃ rājyaṃ svaṃ cirāya pratigṛhyatām || 53 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ nottaraṃ pratyabhāṣata |
vrīḍitādhomukhaṃ taṃ tu rājānaṃ yadusaṃsadi |
abhiṣekena govindo yojayāmāsa dharmavit || 54 ||
sa baddhamukuṭaḥ śrīmānugraseno mahādyutiḥ |
cakāra saha kṛṣṇena kaṃsasya nidhanakriyām || 55 ||
taṃ sarve yādavā mukhyā rājānaṃ kṛṣṇaśāsanāt |
anujagmuḥ purīmārge devā iva śatakratum || 56 ||
rajanyāṃ tu nivṛttāyāṃ tataḥ sūrye virājite |
paścimaṃ kaṃsasaṃskāraṃ cakruste yadupuṅgavāḥ || 57 ||
śibikāyāmathāropya kaṃsadehaṃ yathākramam |
naiṣṭikena vidhānena cakruste kaṃsasatkriyām || 58 ||
sa nīto yamunātīramuttamaṃ nṛpateḥ sutaḥ |
satkṛtaśca yathānyāyaṃ naidhanena citāgninā || 59 ||
tathaiva bhrātaraṃ cāsya sunāmānaṃ mahābhujam |
saṃskāraṃ lambhayāmāsuḥ saha kṛṣṇena yādavāḥ || 2.32.60 ||
tābhyāṃ te salilaṃ cakrurvṛṣṇyandhakapurogamāḥ |
akṣayaṃ cāstu pretebhyo bhāṣamāṇāḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 61 ||
hiraṇyasya suvarṇasya daśa koṭīstathā hariḥ |
gāvo ratnāni vāsāṃsi grāmān nagarasammatān || 62 ||
dadau kaṃsaṃ samuddiśya brāhmaṇebhyo nṛpottamaḥ |
akṣayaṃ cāpi viprebhyo bhāṣamāṇāḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 63 ||
tayoste salilaṃ dattvā yādavā dīnamānasāḥ |
puraskṛtyograsenaṃ vai viviśurmathurāṃ purīm || 64 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi ugrasenābhiṣekakaṃsasaṃskārakathane dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 32 ||

<2.33>

trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
sa kṛṣṇastatra balavān rauhiṇeyena saṃgataḥ |
mathurāṃ yādavākīrṇāṃ purīṃ tāṃ sukhamāvasat || 1 ||
prāptayauvanadehastu yukto rājaśriyā jvalan |
kasyacit tvatha kālasya sahitau rāmakeśavau |
guruṃ sāndīpaniṃ kāśyamavantipuravāsinam || 3 ||
dhanurvedacikīrṣārthamubhau tāvabhijagmatuḥ |
nivedya gotraṃ svādhyāyamācāreṇābhyalaṃkṛtau || 4 ||
śuśrūṣū nirahaṃkārāvubhau rāmajanārdanau |
pratijagrāha tau kāśyo vidyāḥ prādācca kevalāḥ|| 5 ||
tau ca śrutidharau vīrau yathāvat pratipadyatām |
ahorātraiścatuṣṣaṣṭyā sāṅgavedamadhīyatām || 6 ||
catuṣpādaṃ dhanurvedaṃ śastragrāmaṃ sasaṃgraham |
acireṇaiva kālena gurustāvabhyaśikṣayat || 7 ||
atīvāmānuṣīṃ medhāṃ cintayitvā tayorguruḥ |
mene tāvāgatau vīrau devau candradivākarau || 8
dadarśa ca mahātmānāvubhau tāvapi parvasu |
pūjayantau mahādevaṃ sākṣād viṣṇuṃ vyavasthitam || 9 ||
guruṃ sāndīpaniṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛtakṛtyo'bhyabhāṣata |
gurvarthaṃ kiṃ dadānīti rāmeṇa saha bhārata || 2.33.10 ||
tayoḥ prabhāvaṃ sa jñātvā guruḥ provāca hṛṣṭavān |
putramicchāmyahaṃ dattaṃ yo mṛto lavaṇāmbhasi || 11 ||
putra eko'pi me jātaḥ sa cāpi timinā hataḥ |
prabhāse tīrthayātrāyāṃ taṃ me tvaṃ punarānaya || 12 ||
tathetyevābravīt kṛṣṇo rāmasyānumate sthitaḥ |
gatvā samudraṃ tejasvī viveśāntarjalaṃ hariḥ || 13 ||
samudraḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā darśayāmāsa svaṃ tadā |
tamāha kṛṣṇaḥ kvāsau bhoḥ putraḥ sāndīpaneriti || 14 ||
samudraḥ pratyuvācedaṃ daityaḥ pañcajano mahān |
timirūpeṇa taṃ bālaṃ grastavāniti mādhava || 15 ||
sa pañcajanamāsādya jaghāna puruṣottamaḥ |
na cāsasāda taṃ bālaṃ guruputraṃ tadācyutaḥ || 16 ||
sa tu pañcajanaṃ hatvā śaṅkhaṃ lebhe janārdanaḥ |
yastu devamanuṣyeṣu pāñcajanya iti śrutaḥ || 17 ||
tato vaivasvatapuraṃ jagāma puruṣottamaḥ |
tato yamo'bhyupāgamya vavande taṃ gadādharam || 18 ||
tamuvācātha vai kṛṣṇo guruputraḥ pradīyatām |
tayostatra tadā yuddhamāsīd ghorataraṃ mahat || 19 ||
tato vaivasvataṃ ghoraṃ nirjitya puruṣottamaḥ |
āsasāda ca taṃ bālaṃ guruputraṃ tadācyutaḥ || 2.33.20 ||
ānināya guroḥ putraṃ ciraṃ naṣṭaṃ yamakṣayāt |
tataḥ sāndīpaneḥ putraḥ prabhāvādamitaujasaḥ || 21 ||
dīrghakālagataḥ pretaḥ punarāsīccharīravān |
tadaśakyamacintyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā sumahadadbhutam || 22 ||
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ vismayaḥ samajāyata |
sa guroḥ putramādāya pāñcajanyaṃ ca mādhavaḥ |
ratnāni ca mahārhāṇi punarāyājjagatprabhuḥ || 23 ||
rākṣasaistasya ratnāni mahārhāṇi bahūni ca |
ānāyyāvedayāmāsa gurave vāsavānujaḥ || 24 ||
gadāparighayuddheṣu sarvāstreṣu ca tāvubhau |
acirānmukhyatāṃ prāptau sarvaloke dhanurbhṛtām || 25 ||
tataḥ sāndīpaneḥ putraṃ tadrūpavayasaṃ tadā |
prādāt kṛṣṇaḥ pratītātmā saha ratnairudāradhīḥ || .1 ||
ciranaṣṭena putreṇa kāśyaḥ sāndīpanistadā |
sametya mumude rājan pūjayan rāmakeśavau || 27 ||
kṛtāstrau tābubhau vīrau gurumāmantrya suvratau |
āyātau mathurāṃ bhūyo vasudevasutāvubhau || 28 ||
tataḥ pratyudyayuḥ sarve yādavā yadunandanau |
sabalā hṛṣṭamanasa ugrasenapurogamāḥ || 29 ||
śreṇyaḥ prakṛtayaścaiva mantriṇaḥ sapurohitāḥ |
sabālavṛddhā sā caiva purī samabhivartata || 2.33.30 ||
nanditūryāṇyavādyanta tuṣṭuvuśca janārdanam |
rathyāḥ patākāmālinyo bhrājante sma samantataḥ || 31 ||
prahṛṣṭamuditaṃ sarvamantaḥpuramaśobhata |
govindāgamane'tyarthaṃ yathaivendramahe tathā || 32 ||
muditāścātha gāyanti rājamārgeṣu gāyakāḥ |
tatrāsīt prathitā gāthā yādavānāṃ priyaṅkarā || 33 ||
govindarāmau samprāptau bhrātarau lokaviśrutau |
sve pure nirbhayāḥ sarve krīḍadhvaṃ saha bāndhavaiḥ || 34 ||
na tatra kaścid dīno vā malino vā vicetanaḥ |
mathurāyāmabhūd rājan govinde samupasthite ||35||
vayāṃsi sādhuvākyāni prahṛṣṭā gohayadvipāḥ |
naranārīgaṇāḥ sarve bhejire manasaḥ sukham || 36 ||
śivāśca vātāḥ pravavurvirajaskā diśo daśa |
daivatāni ca hṛṣṭāni sarveṣvāyataneṣu ca || 37 ||
yāni liṅgāni lokasya cāsan kṛtayuge purā |
tāni sarvāṇyadṛśyanta purīṃ prāpte janārdane || 38||
tataḥ kāle śive puṇye syandanenārimardanaḥ |
hariyuktena govindo viveśa mathurāṃ purīm || 39 ||
viśantaṃ mathurāṃ ramyāṃ tamupendramariṃdamam |
anujagmuryadugaṇāḥ śakraṃ devagaṇā iva || 2.33.40 ||
vasudevasya bhavanaṃ tatastau yadunandanau |
praviṣṭau hṛṣṭavadanau candrādityāvivācalam || 41 ||
pareṇa tejasopetau surendrāviva rūpiṇau |
tāvāyudhāni vinyasya gṛhe svaṃ svairacāriṇau || 42 ||
mumudāte yaduvarau vasudevasutāvubhau |
udyāneṣu vicitreṣu phalapuṣpāvanāmiṣu || 43 ||
ceratuḥ sumahātmānau yādavaiḥ parivāritau |
raivatasya samīpeṣu saritsu vimalāsu ca || 44 ||
padmapatravivṛddhāsu kāraṇḍavayutāsu ca
evaṃ tāvekanirmāṇau mathurāyāṃ śubhānanau |
ugrasenānugau bhūtvā kaṃcit kālaṃ mumodatuḥ || 45 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi rāmakṛṣṇapratyāgamane trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 33 |||

<2.34>

catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
sa kṛṣṇastatra sahito rauhiṇeyena saṃgataḥ |
mathurāṃ yādavākīrṇāṃ purīṃ tāṃ sukhamāvasat || 1 ||
prāptayauvanadehastu yukto rājaśriyā vibhuḥ |
cacāra mathurāṃ prītaḥ sa vanākarabhūṣaṇām || 2 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya rājā rājagṛheśvaraḥ |
śuśrāva nihataṃ kaṃsaṃ duhitṛbhyāṃ mahīpatiḥ || 3 ||
tato nāticirāt kālājjarāsaṃdhaḥ pratāpavān |
ājagāma ṣaḍaṅgena balena mahatā vṛtaḥ || 4 ||
jighāṃsurhi yadūn kruddhaḥ kaṃsasyāpacitiṃ smaran |
astiḥ prāptiśca nāmnā te māgadhasya sute nṛpa || 5 ||
jarāsaṃdhasya kalyāṇyau pīnaśroṇipayodhare |
ubhe kaṃsasya te bhārye prādād bārhadratho nṛpaḥ || 6 ||
sa tābhyāṃ mumude rājā baddhvā pitaramāhukam |
samāśritya jarāsaṃdhamanādṛtya ca yādavān |
śūraseneśvaro rājā yathā te bahuśaḥ śrutaḥ || 7 ||
jñātikāryārthasiddhyarthamugrasenahite rataḥ |
vasudevo'bhavannityaṃ kaṃso na mamṛṣe ca tam || 8 ||
rāmakṛṣṇau samāśritya hate kaṃse durātmani |
ugraseno'bhavad rājā bhojavṛṣṇyandhakairvṛtaḥ || 9 ||
duhitṛbhyāṃ jarāsaṃdhaḥ priyābhyāṃ balavān nṛpaḥ |
nodito vīrapatnībhyāmupāyānmathurāṃ tataḥ || 2.34.10 ||
kṛtvā sarvaṃ samudyogaṃ krodhādagnisamo jvalan |
pratāpāvanatā ye ca jarāsaṃdhasya pārthivāḥ || 11 ||
mitrāṇi jñātayaścaiva saṃyuktāḥ suhṛdastathā |
tamevānuyayuḥ sarve sainyaiḥ samuditairvṛtāḥ||12||
maheṣvāsā mahāvīryā jarāsaṃdhapriyaiṣiṇaḥ |
kārūṣo dantavaktraśca cedirājaśca vīryavān || 13 ||
kaliṅgādhipatiścaiva pauṇḍraśca balināṃ varaḥ |
sākṛtiḥ keśikaścaiva bhīṣmakaśca narādhipaḥ || 14 ||
putraśca bhīmakasyāpi rukmī mukhyo dhanurbhṛtām |
vāsudevārjunābhyāṃ yaḥ spardhate sa mahāhave || 15 ||
veṇudāriḥ śrutarvā ca krathaścaivāṃśumānapi|
aṅgarājaśca balavān vaṅgānāmadhipastathā || 16 ||
kausalyaḥ kāśirājaśca daśārṇādhipatistathā |
sukheśvaraśca vikrānto videhādhipatistathā || 17 ||
madrarājaśca balavāṃstrigartānāmatheśvaraḥ |
śālvarājaśca vikrānto daradaśca mahābalaḥ || 18 ||
yavanādhipatiścaiva bhagadattaśca vīryavān |
sauvīrarājaḥ śaibyaśca pāṇḍyaśca balināṃ varaḥ || 19 ||
gāndhārarājaḥ subalo nagnajicca mahābalaḥ |
kāśmīrarājo gonardo daradādhipatirnṛpaḥ |
duryodhanādayaścaiva dhārtarāṣṭrā mahābalāḥ || 2.34.20 ||
ete cānye ca rājāno balavanto mahārathāḥ |
tamanvayurjarāsaṃdhaṃ vidviṣanto janārdanam || 21 ||
te śūrasenānāviśya prabhūtayavasendhanān |
ūṣuḥ saṃrudhya mathurāṃ puraskṛtya balaṃ tadā || 22 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi mathuroparodhe catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 34 ||

<2.35>

pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
mathuropavane gatvā niviṣṭāṃstān narādhipān |
apaśyan vṛṣṇayaḥ sarve puraskṛtya janārdanam || 1 ||
tato hṛṣṭamanāḥ kṛṣṇo rāmaṃ vacanamabravīt |
tvarate khalu kāryārtho devatānāṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 2 ||
yathāyaṃ saṃnikṛṣṭo hi jarāsaṃdho narādhipaḥ |
lakṣyante hi dhvajāgrāṇi rathānāṃ vātaraṃhasām || 3 ||
etāni śaśikalpāni nṛpāṇāṃ vijigīṣatām |
chatrāṇyārya virājante procchritāni sitāni ca || 4 ||
aho nṛparathodagrā vimalāśchatrapaṅktayaḥ |
abhivartanti naḥ śubhrā yathā khe haṃsapaṅktayaḥ||5||
nṛpaḥ prāpto jarāsaṃdho mahīpatiḥ |
āvayoryuddhanikaṣaḥ prathamaḥ samarātithiḥ || 6 ||
ārya tiṣṭhāva sahitāvanuprāpte mahīpatau |
yuddhārambhaḥ prayoktavyo balaṃ tāvadvimṛśyatām || 7 ||
evamuktvā tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svasthaḥ saṃgrāmalālasaḥ |
jarāsaṃdhabalaṃ prepsuścakāra baladarśanam || 8 ||
vīkṣamāṇaśca tān sarvān nṛpān yaduvaro'vyayaḥ|
ātmanaivātmano vākyamuvāca hṛdi mantravit || 9 ||
ime te pṛthivīpālāḥ pārthive vartmani sthitāḥ |
ye vināśaṃ gamiṣyanti śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 2.35.10 ||
prokṣitān khalvimānmanye mṛtyunā nṛpapuṅgavān |
svargagāmīni cāpyeṣāṃ vapūṃṣi pracakāśire || 11||
sthāne bhārapariśrāntā vasudheyaṃ divaṃ gatā |
eṣāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ mukhyānāṃ balaughairabhipīḍitā || 12 ||
mahī nirantarā ceyaṃ balarāṣṭrābhisaṃvṛtā |
svalpena khalu kālena viviktaṃ pṛthivītalam || 13 ||
bhaviṣyati narendraughaiḥ śataśo vinipātitaiḥ |
vaiśampāyana uvāca
jarāsaṃdhastataḥ kruddhaḥ prabhuḥ sarvamahīkṣitām || 14 ||
narādhipasahasraughairanuyāto mahādyutiḥ |
vyāyatodagraturagaiḥ suyānaiḥ susamāhitaiḥ || 15 ||
rathaiḥ sāṃgrāmikairyuktairasaṅgagatibhiḥ kvacit|
hemakakṣairmahāghaṇṭairvāraṇairvāridopamaiḥ || 16 ||
mahāmātrottamārūḍhaiḥ kalpitai raṇakovidaiḥ |
svārūḍhaiḥ sādibhiryuktaiḥ preṅkhamāṇaiḥ pravalgitaiḥ|| 17 ||
vājibhirvāyusaṃkāśaiḥ plavadbhiriva patribhiḥ |
khaḍgacarmadharodagraiḥ pattibhirbalināṃ varaiḥ || 18 ||
sahasrasaṃkhyāsaṃyuktairutpatadbhirivoragaiḥ |
evaṃ caturvidhaiḥ sainyaiḥ kampamānairivāmbudaiḥ || 19 ||
nṛpaḥ prayāto balavāñjarāsaṃdho dhṛtavrataḥ |
sa rathairmeghanirghoṣairgajaiśca madasaṃyutaiḥ || 2.35.20 ||
hreṣamāṇaiśca turagaiḥ kṣveḍamānaiśca pattibhiḥ |
nādayāno diśaḥ sarvāstasyāḥ puryā vanāni ca || 21 ||
sa rājā sāgarākāraḥ sasainyaḥ pratyadṛśyata |
tadbalaṃ pṛthivīśānāṃ hṛṣṭayodhajanākulam || 22 ||
kṣveḍitāsphoṭitaravaṃ meghasainyamivābabhau |
rathaiḥ pavanasampātairgajaiśca jaladopamaiḥ |
turagaiśca javopetaiḥ pattibhiḥ khagamopamaiḥ || 23 ||
vimiśraṃ sarvato bhāti mattadvipasamākulam |
gharmānte sāgaragataṃ yathābhrapaṭalaṃ tathā || 24 ||
sabalāste mahīpālā jarāsaṃdhapurogamāḥ |
parivārya purīṃ sarve niveśāyopacakrire || 25 ||
babhau tasya niviṣṭasya balaśrīḥśibirasya vai |
śuklaparyantapūrṇasya yathā rūpaṃ mahodadheḥ || 26 ||
vītarātre tataḥ kāle samuttasthumahīkṣitaḥ |
ārohaṇārthaṃ puryāste samīyuryuddhalālasāḥ || 27 ||
samavāyīkṛtāḥ sarve yamunāmanu te nṛpāḥ |
niviṣṭā mantrayāmāsuryuddhakālakutūhalāḥ || 28 ||
teṣāṃ sutumulaḥ śabdaḥ śuśruve pṛthivīkṣitām |
yugānte bhidyamānānāṃ sāgarāṇāmiva svanaḥ || 29 ||
teṣāṃ sakañcukoṣṇīṣāḥ sthavirā vetrapāṇayaḥ |
cerurmā śabda ityevaṃ vadanto rājaśāsanāt || 2.35.30 ||
tasya rūpaṃ balasyāsīnniḥśabdastimitasya vai |
līnamīnagrahasyeva niḥśabdasya yathodadheḥ || 31 ||
niḥśabdastimite tasmin yogādiva mahārṇave |
jarāsaṃdho bṛhad vākyaṃ bṛhspatirivādade || 32||
śīghraṃ samabhivartantāṃ balāni pṛthivīkṣitām |
sarvato nagarī ceyaṃ janaughaiḥ parivāryatām || 33 ||
aśmayantrāṇi yujyantāṃ kṣepaṇīyāśca mudgarāḥ |
kāryā bhūmiḥ samā sarvā jalaughaiśca pariplutā |
ūrdhvaṃ cāpā nivāhyantāṃ prāsā vai tomarāstathā || 34 ||
dayitāṃ caiva ṭaṅkādyaiḥ khanitraiśca purī drutam |
nṛpāśca yuddhamārgajñā vinyasyantābhadūrataḥ || 35 ||
adyaprabhṛti sainyairme purīrodhaḥ pravartyatām |
yāvadetau raṇe gopau vasudevasutāvubhau || 36 ||
saṃkarṣaṇaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca ghātayāmi śitaiḥ śaraiḥ |
ākāśamapi pāṇaughairniḥsampātaṃ yathā bhavet || 37 ||
mayānuśiṣṭāstiṣṭhantu purībhūmiṣu bhūmipāḥ |
teṣu teṣvavakāśeṣu śīghramāruhyatāṃ purī || 38 ||
madraḥ kaliṅgādhipatiścekitānaḥ sabāhlikaḥ |
kāśmīrarājo gonardaḥ karūṣādhipatistathā || 39 ||
punaḥ kimpuruṣaścaiva parvatīyo hyanāmayaḥ |
nagaryāḥ paścimaṃ dvāraṃ śīghramārodhayantviti || 2.35.40 ||
pauravo veṇudāriśca vaidarbhaḥ somakastathā |
rukmī ca bhojādhipatiḥ sūryākṣaścaiva mālavaḥ || 41 ||
vindānuvindāvāvantyau dantavaktraśca vīryavān |
chāgaliḥ puramitraśca virāṭaśca mahīpatiḥ || 42 ||
kauravyo mālavaścaiva śatadhanvā vidūrathaḥ |
bhūriśravāstrigartaśca bāṇaḥ pañcanadastathā || 41 ||
uttaraṃ nagaradvāramete durgasahā nṛpāḥ |
āruhya cābhimardantāṃ vajrapratimagauravāḥ || 44 ||
ulūkaḥ kaitavaścaiva vīraścāṃśumataḥ sutaḥ |
ekalavyo bṛhatkṣatraḥ kṣatradharmā jayadrathaḥ || 45 ||
uttamaujāśca śalyaśca kauravāḥ kaikayāstathā |
vaidiśo vāmadevaśca sāṃkṛtiśca sinīpatiḥ || 46 ||
pūrvaṃ nagaranirvyūhamaiteṣvāyattamastu naḥ |
dārayanto vidhāvantu vātā iva balāhakān || 47 ||
ahaṃ ca daradaścaiva cedirājaśca vīryavān |
dakṣiṇaṃ nagaradvāraṃ pālayāmaḥ sudaṃśitāḥ || 48 ||
evameṣā purī kṣipraṃ samantād veṣṭitā balaiḥ |
vajrāvapātaviṣamaṃ prāpnotu tumulaṃ bhayam || 49 ||
gadino ye gadābhiste parighaiḥ parighāyudhāḥ |
apare vividhaiḥ śastrairdārayantu purīmimām || 2.35.50 ||
adyaiva nagarī hyeṣā viṣamoccayasaṃkaṭā |
kāryā bhūmisamā sarvā bhavadbhirvasudhāradhipaiḥ || 51 ||
caturaṅgabalairvyūhya jarāsaṃdho vyavasthitaḥ |
athābhyayād yadūn kruddhaiḥ saha sarvairnarādhipaiḥ || 52 ||
pratijagmurdaśārhāstaṃ vyūḍhānīkāḥ prahāriṇaḥ |
tad yuddhamabhavad ghoraṃ teṣāṃ devāsuropamam |
alpānāṃ bahubhiḥ sārdhaṃ vyatiṣaktarathadvipam || 53 ||
nagarānnissṛtau dṛṣṭvā vasudevasutāvubhau |
kṣubhitaṃ nṛvarānīkaṃ trastasammūḍhavāhanam || 54||
rathasthau daṃśitau caiva ceratustatra yādavau |
makarāviva saṃrabdhau samudrakṣobhaṇāvubhau || 55 ||
tayoḥ prayudhyatoḥ saṃkhye matirāsīnmahātmanoḥ |
āyudhānāṃ purāṇānāmādānakṛtalakṣaṇā || 56 ||
tataḥ khānnipatanti sma divyānyāhavasamplave |
lelihānāni dīptāni mahānti sudṛḍhāni ca || 57 ||
kravyādairanuyātāni mūrtimanti bṛhanti ca |
tṛṣitānyāhave bhoktuṃ nṛpamāṃsāni vai bhṛśam || 58 ||
divyasragdāmadhārīṇi trāsayanti ca khecarān |
prabhayā bhāsamānāni patamānāni cāmbarāt || 59 ||
halaṃ saṃvartakaṃ nāmaṃ saunandaṃ musalaṃ tathā |
dhanuṣāṃ pravaraṃ śārṅgaṃ gadā kaumodakī tathā || 2.35.60 ||
catvāryetāni tejāṃsi viṣṇupraharaṇāni ca |
tābhyāṃ samavatīrṇāni yādavābhyāṃ mahāmṛdhe || 61 ||
jagrāha prathamaṃ rāmo lalāmapratimaṃ halam |
sarpantamiva sarpendraṃ divyamālākulaṃ mṛdhe || 62 ||
saunandaṃ ca tataḥ śrīmān nirānandakaraṃ dviṣām |
savyena sātvatāṃ śreṣṭho jagrāha musalottamam || 63 ||
darśanīyaṃ ca lokeṣu dhanurjaladaniḥsvanam |
nāmnā śārṅgamiti khyātaṃ kṛpṇo jagrāha vīryavān || 64 ||
devairnigaditārthasya gadā tasyāpare kare |
nikṣiptā kumudākṣasya nāmnā kaumodakīti sā || 65 ||
tau sapraharaṇau vīrau sākṣāt viṣṇutanūpamau |
samare rāmagovindau ripūṃstān pratyayuddhyatām || 66 ||
sāyudhapragrahau vīrau tāvanyāśrayāvubhau |
pūrvajānujasaṃjñau tau rāmagovindalakṣaṇau || 67 ||
dviṣatsu pratikurvāṇau parākrāntau yatheśvarau |
viceraturyathā devau vasudevasutāvubhau || 68 ||
halamudyamya rāmastu sarpendramiva kopitaḥ |
cacāra samare vīro vidviṣāmantako yathā || 69 ||
vikarṣan rathavṛndāni kṣatriyāṇāṃ mahātmanām |
cakāra roṣaṃ saphalaṃ nāgeṣu ca hayeṣu ca || 2.35.70 ||
kuñjarāllām̐ṅgalakṣiptān musalākṣepatāḍitān |
rāmo virājan samare nirmamantha yathācalān ||71||
te vadhyamānā rāmeṇa raṇe kṣatriyapuṅgavāḥ |
jarāsaṃdhāntikaṃ bhītāḥ samarāt pratijagmire || 72 ||
tānuvāca jarāsaṃdhaḥ kṣatradharme vyavasthitaḥ |
dhigetāṃ kṣatravṛttiṃ vaḥ samare kātarānmanām || 73 ||
parāvṛttasya samare virathasya palāyataḥ |
bhrūṇahatyāmivāsahyāṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ || 74 ||
bhītāḥ kasmānnivartadhvaṃ dhigenāṃ kṣatravṛttitām |
kṣipraṃ sarve nivartadhvaṃ mama vākyena coditāḥ || 75| ||
athavā tiṣṭhata rathaiḥ prekṣakāḥ samavasthitāḥ |
yāvadetau raṇe gopau preṣayāmi yamakṣayam || 76 ||
tataste kṣatriyāḥ sarve jarāsaṃdhena noditāḥ |
sṛjantaḥ śarajālāni hṛṣṭā yoddhuṃ vyavasthitāḥ || 77 ||
te hayaiḥ kāñcanāpīḍai rathaiścāmbudanādibhiḥ |
nāgaiścāmbudasaṃkāśairmahāmātrapracoditaiḥ || 78 ||
satanutrāḥ sanistriṃśāḥ sapatākāyudhadhvajāḥ |
svāropitadhanuṣmantaḥ satūṇīrāḥ satomarāḥ || 79 ||
sacchatrāḥ sādinaścaiva cārucāmaravījitāḥ |
raṇe te'dhigatā rejuḥ syandanasthā mahīkṣitaḥ || 2.35.80 ||
tai yuddharāgā rathino vyagāhanta yudhāṃ varāḥ |
gadābhiścaiva gurvībhiḥ kṣepaṇīyaiśca mudgaraiḥ || 81 ||
etasminnantare tatra devānāṃ nandivardhanaḥ |
suparṇadhvajamāsthāya kṛṣṇastu rathamuttamam || 82 ||
samabhyayājjarāsradhaṃ śarraurvevyādha cāṣṭabhiḥ |
sārathiṃ cāsya vivyādha pañcabhirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ || 83 ||
jaghāna turagāṃścājau yatamānasya vīryavān |
taṃ kṛcchragatamājñāya citraseno mahārathaḥ || 84 ||
senānīḥ kaiśikaścaiva kṛṣṇaṃ vividhatuḥ śaraiḥ |
tribhirvivyādha saṃsaktaṃ baladevaṃ ca kaiśikaḥ || 85 ||
baladevo dhanuścāsya bhallenājau dvidhākarot |
javenābhyardayaccāpi tānarīñcharavṛṣṭibhiḥ || 86 ||
bahubhirbahudhā vīrān samantāt svarṇabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
taṃ citrasenaḥ saṃrabdho vivyādha navabhiḥ śaraiḥ || 87 ||
kaiśikaḥ pañcabhiścāpi jarāsaṃdhaśca saptabhiḥ |
tribhistribhiśca nārācaistān bibheda janārdanaḥ || 88 ||
pañcabhiḥ pañcabhiścaiva baladevaḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ |
rathaṃ caivāsya ciccheda citrasenasya vīryavān || 89 ||
baladevo dhanuścāsya bhallenājau dvidhākarot |
sa cchinnadhanvā viratho gadāmādāya vīryavān || 2.35.90 ||
abhyadhāvat susaṃrabdho jighāṃsurmusalāyudham |
sisṛkṣatastu nārācāścitrasenavadhaiṣiṇaḥ |
dhanuściccheda rāmasya jarāsaṃdho mahābalaḥ || 91 ||
gadayā ca jaghānāśvān krodhāt sa magadheśvaraḥ |
rāmaṃ cābhyadravad vīro jarāsaṃdho mahābalaḥ || 92 ||
ādāya musalaṃ rāmo jarāsaṃdhamupādravat |
tayostad yuddhamabhavat parasparavadhaiṣiṇoḥ || 93 ||
citrasenastu saṃsaktaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmeṇa māgadham |
rathamanyaṃ samāruhya jarāsaṃdhamavārayat || 94 ||
tato balena mahatā gajānīkena cāpyatha |
ubhayorantare tābhyāṃ svakulaṃ samapadyata || 95 ||
tataḥ sainyena mahatā jarāsaṃdho'bhisaṃvṛtaḥ |
rāmakṛṣṇāgragān bhojānāsasāda mahābalaḥ || 96 ||
tatra prakṣubhitasyeva sāgarasya mahāsvanaḥ |
prādurbabhūva tumulaḥ senayorubhayorapi || 97 ||
veṇubherīmṛdaṅgānāṃ śaṅkhānāṃ ca sahasraśaḥ |
ubhayoḥ senayo rājan prādurāsīnmahāsvanaḥ || 98 ||
kṣveḍitāsphoṭitotkruṣṭaistumulaḥ sarvato'bhavat|
utpapāta rajaścāpi khuranemisamuddhatam || 99 ||
samudyatamahāśastrāḥ pragṛhītaśarāsanāḥ |
anyonyamabhigarjantaḥ śūrāstatrāvatasthire || 2.35.100||
rathinaḥ sādinaścaiva pattayaśca sahasraśaḥ |
gajāścātibalāstatra samutpetuḥ samantataḥ || 101||
sa saṃnipātastumulastyaktvā prāṇānavartata |
vṛṣṇibhiḥ saha yodhānāṃ jarāsaṃdhasya dāruṇaḥ || 102||
tataḥ śiniranādhṛṣṭirbabhrurvipṛthurāhukaḥ |
baladevaṃ puraskatya sainyasyāddheṃna daṃśitāḥ ||103||
dakṣiṇaṃ pakṣamāseduḥ śatrusainyasya bhārata |
pālitaṃ cedirājena jarāsaṃdhena vā vibho || 104||
udīcyaiśca mahāvīryaiḥ śalyaśālvādibhirnṛpaiḥ |
sṛjantaḥ śaravarṣāṇi samabhityaktajīvitāḥ || 105||
avagāhaḥ pṛthuḥ kaṅkaḥ śatadyumno vidūrathaḥ |
hṛṣīkeśaṃ puraskṛtya sainyasyārddhena daṃśitāḥ || 106||
bhīṣmakeṇābhiguptaśca rukmiṇā ca mahātmanā |
devakenāpi rājendra tathā madreśvareṇa ca ||107||
prācyaiśca dākṣiṇānyaiśca guptavīryabalānvitaiḥ |
teṣāṃ ca yuddhamabhavat samabhityaktajīvitam || 108||
śaktyṛṣṭiprāsabāṇaughān sṛjatāmaśanisvanān |
sātyakiścitrakaḥ śyāmo yuyudhānaśca vīryavān |
rājādhidevo mṛduraḥ śvaphalkaśca mahārathaḥ || 109||
satrājicca prasenaśca balena mahatā vṛtāḥ|
vyūhasya pucchaṃ te sarve pratīyurdviṣatāṃ mṛdhe ||2.35.110||
vyūhasyārddhaṃ samāsedurmṛdureṇābhirakṣitāḥ |
rājabhiścāpi bahubhirvaiṇudārimukhaiḥ saha || 111||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi mathuroparodhe yuddhavarṇane pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 35 ||

<2.36>

ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tato yuddhāni vṛṣṇīnāṃ babhūvuḥ sumahāntyatha |
māgadhasya mahāmātrairnṛpaiścaivānuyāyibhiḥ || 1 ||
rukmiṇā vāsudevasya bhīṣmakeṇāhukasya ca|
krathena vasudevasya kaiśikasya tu babhruṇā || 2 ||
gadena cedirājasya dantavaktrasya śaṅkunā |
tathānyairvṛṣṇivīrāṇāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca mahātmanām || 3 ||
yuddhamāsīddhi sainyānāṃ sainikairbharatarṣabha |
ahāni pañca caikaṃ ca ṣaṭ saptāṣṭau ca dāruṇam || 4 ||
gajairgajā hayairaśvāḥ padātāśca padātibhiḥ |
rathai rathā vimiśrāśca yodhā yuyudhire nṛpa || 5 ||
jarāsaṃdhasya nṛpate rāmeṇāsīt samāgamaḥ |
mahendrasyeva vṛtreṇa dāruṇo romaharṣaṇaḥ || 6 ||
avekṣya rukmiṇīṃ kṛṣṇo rukmiṇaṃ na vyapothayat |
jvalanārkāṃśusaṃkāśānāśīviṣaviṣopamān || 7 ||
vārayāmāsa kṛṣṇo vai śarāṃstasya tu śikṣayā |
ityeṣāṃ sumahānāsīd balaughānāṃ parikṣayaḥ || 8 ||
ubhayoḥ senayo rājan māṃsaśoṇitakardamaḥ |
kabandhāni samuttasthuḥ subahūni samantataḥ || 9 ||
tasmin vimarde yodhānāṃ saṃkhyāvṛttikarāṇi ca |
rathī rāmo jarāsaṃdhaṃ śarairāśīviṣopamaiḥ || 2.36.10 ||
āvṛṇvannabhyayād vīrastaṃ ca rājā sa māgadhaḥ |
abhyavartata vegena syandanenāśugāminā ||11 ||
anyonyaṃ vividhairastraividdhvā viddhvā vinedatuḥ |
tau kṣīṇaśastrau virathau hatāśvau hatasārathī ||12||
gade gṛhītvā vikrāntāvanyonyamabhidhāvatām |
kampayantau bhuvaṃ vīrau tāvudyatagadāvubhau || 13 ||
dadṛśāte mahātmānau girī saśikharāviva |
vyupāramanta yuddhāni paśyatā tau mahābhujau |
saṃrabdhāvabhidhāvantau gadāyuddheṣu viśrutau || 14 ||
ubhau tau paramācāryau loke khyātau mahābalau |
mattāviva gajau yuddhe tāvanyonyamayudhyatām || 15 ||
tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca samaharṣayaḥ |
samantataścāpsarasaḥ samājagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ || 16 ||
tad devayakṣagandharvamaharṣibhiralaṃkṛtam |
śuśubhe'bhyadhikaṃ rājan divaṃ jyotirgaṇairiva || 17 ||
abhidudrāva rāmaṃ tu jarāsaṃdho mahābalaḥ |
savyaṃ maṇḍalamāśritya baladevastu dakṣiṇam || 18 ||
praharantau tato'nyonyaṃ gadāyuddhaviśāradau|
dantābhyāmiva mātaṅgau nādayantau diśo daśa || 19 ||
gadānipāto rāmasya śuśruve'śaniniḥsvanaḥ |
jarāsaṃdhasya ca raṇe parvatasyeva dīryataḥ || 2.36.20 ||
na sma kampayate rāmaṃ jarāsaṃdhakaracyutā |
gadā gadābhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vindhyaṃ girimivānilaḥ || 21 ||
rāmasya tu gadāvegaṃ vīryāt sa magadheśvaraḥ |
sehe dhairyeṇa mahatā śikṣayā ca vyapohayat || 22 ||
evaṃ tau tatra saṃgrāme vicarantau mahābalau |
maṇḍalāni vicitrāṇi viceraturariṃdamau || 23 ||
vyāyacchantau ciraṃ kālaṃ pariśrāntau ca tasthatuḥ |
samāśvasya muhūrtaṃ tu punaranyonyamāhatām || 24 ||
evaṃ tau yodhamukhyau tu samaṃ yuyudhatuściram|
na ca tau yuddhavaimukhyamubhāveva prajagmatuḥ||25||
athāpaśyad gadāyuddhe viśeṣaṃ tasya vīryavān |
rāmaḥ kruddho gadāṃ tyaktvā jagrāha musalottamam||26||
tamudyantaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā musalaṃ ghoradarśanam |
amoghaṃ baladevena kruddhena tu mahāraṇe || 27 ||
tato'ntarikṣe vāgāsīt susvarā lokasākṣiṇī|
uvāca baladevaṃ taṃ samudyatahalāyudham || 28 ||
na tvayā rāma vadhyo'yamalaṃ sedena mānada |
vidito'sya mayā mṛtyustasmātsādhu vyupārama |
acireṇaiva kālena prāṇāṃstyakṣyati māgadhaḥ || 29 ||
jarāsaṃdhastu tacchrutvā vimanāḥ samapadyata |
na prajahre tatastasmai punareva halāyudhaḥ || 2.36.30 ||
tau vyupāramatāṃ yuddhe vṛṣṇayaste ca pārthivāḥ |
asaktamabhavad yuddhaṃ teṣāmevaṃ sudāruṇam || 31 ||
dīrghakālaṃ mahārāja nighnatāmitaretaram |
parājite tvapakrānte jarāsaṃdhe mahīpatau || 32 ||
astaṃ yāte dinakare nānusasrustadā niśi |
samānīya svakaṃ sainyaṃ labdhalakṣyā mahābalāḥ || 33 ||
purīṃ praviviśurhṛṣṭāḥ keśavenābhipālitāḥ |
khāccyutānyāyudhānyevaṃ tānyevāntardadhustadā || 34 ||
jarāsaṃdho'pi nṛpatirbimanāḥ svapurīṃ yayau |
rājānaścānugā ye'sya svarāṣṭrāṇyeva te yayuḥ || 35 ||
jarāsaṃdhaṃ tu te jitvā menire naiva nirjitam |
vṛṣṇayaḥ kuruśārdūla rājā hyatibalaḥ sa vai || 36 ||
daśa cāṣṭau ca saṃgrāmāñjarāsandhasya yādavāḥ |
dadurna cainaṃ samare hantuṃ śekurmahābalāḥ || 37 ||
akṣauhiṇyaśca tasyāsan viṃśatiśca mahāmate |
jarāsandhasya nṛpatestadarthaṃ yāḥ samāgatāḥ || 38 ||
alpatvādabhibhūtāstu vṛṣṇayo bharatarṣabha |
bārhadrathena rājendra rājabhiḥ sahitena vai || 39 ||
jitvā tu māgadhaṃ saṃkhye jarāsandhaṃ mahīpatim |
viharanti sma sukhino bṛṣṇisiṃhā mahārathāḥ || 2.36.40 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi jarāsaṃdhāpayānaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 36 ||

<2.37>

saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
sa kṛṣṇastatra balavān rauhiṇeyena saṃgataḥ |
mathurāṃ yādavākīrṇāṃ purīṃ tāṃ sukhamāvasat || 1 ||
prāptayauvanadehastu yukto rājaśriyā vibhuḥ |
cacāra mathurāṃ prītaḥ savanākarabhūṣaṇām || 2 ||
kasyacit tvatha kālasya rājā rājagṛheśvaraḥ |
sasmāra nihataṃ kaṃsaṃ jarāsaṃdhaḥ pratāpavān || 3 ||
yuddhāya yojito bhūyo duhitṛbhyāṃ mahīpatiḥ |
daśa sapta ca saṃgrāmāñjarāsaṃdhasya yādavāḥ |
dadurna cainaṃ samare hantuṃ śekurmahārathāḥ || 4 ||
tato māgadharāṭ śrīmāṃścaturaṅgavalānvitaḥ |
bhūyo'pyaṣṭādaśaṃ kartuṃ saṃgrāmaṃ sa samārabhat || 5 ||
vailakṣyāt punarevāsau rājā rājagṛheśvaraḥ |
jarāsaṃdho balī śrīmān pākaśāsanavikramaḥ || 6 ||
sa sādhanena mahatā bṛhadrathasuto balī |
kṛṣṇasya vadhamanvicchan bhūyo vai saṃnyavartata || 7 |
taṃ śrutvā sahitāḥ sarve nivṛttaṃ magadheśvaram |
yādavā mantrayāmāsurjarāsaṃdhabhayārditāḥ || 8 ||
tataḥ prāha mahātejā vikadrurnayakovidaḥ |
kṛṣṇaṃ kamalapatrākṣamugrasenasya śṛṇvataḥ || 9 ||
śrūyatāṃ tāta govinda kulasyāsya samudbhavaḥ |
śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi prāptakālamahaṃ tataḥ |
yuktaṃ cenmanyase sādho kariṣyasi vaco mama || 2.37.10 ||
yādavasyāsya vaṃśasya samudbhavamaśeṣataḥ |
yathā me kathitaḥ pūrvaṃ vyāsena viditātmanā || 11 ||
āsīd rājā manorvaṃśe śrīmānikṣvākusambhavaḥ |
haryaśva iti vikhyāto mahendrasamavikramaḥ || 12 ||
tasyāsīd dayitā bhāryā madhordaityasya vai sutā |
devī madhumatī nāma yathendrasya śacī tathā || 13 ||
sā yauvanaguṇopetā rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi |
manorathakarī rājñaḥ prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī || 14 |'|
dānavendrakule jātā suśroṇī kāmarūpiṇī |
ekapatnīvratadharā khecarā rohiṇī yathā || 15 ||
sā tamikṣvākuśārdūlaṃ kāmayāmāsa kāminī |
sa kadācinnaraśraṣṭho bhrātrā jyeṣṭhena mādhava || 16 ||
rājyānnirasto viśvastaḥ so'yodhyāṃ samparityajat |
sa tadālpaparīvāraḥ priyayā sahito vane || 17 ||
reme sametya kālajñaḥ priyayā kamalekṣaṇaḥ |
bhrātrā viniṣkṛtaṃ rājyāt provāca kamalekṣaṇā || 18 ||
ehyāgaccha naraśreṣṭha tyaja rājyakṛtāṃ spṛhām |
gacchāvaḥ sahitau vīra madhormama piturgṛham || 19 ||
ramyaṃ madhuvanaṃ nāma kāmapuṣpaphaladrumam |
sahitau tatra raṃsyāvo yathā divi gatau tathā || 2.37.20 ||
piturme dayitastvaṃ hi māturmama ca pārthiva |
matpriyārthaṃ priyataro bhrātuśca lavaṇasya vai || 21 ||
raṃsyāvastatra sahitau rājyasthāviva kāmagau |
tatra gatvā naraśreṣṭha hyamarāviva nandane |
bhadraṃ te vihariṣyāvo yathā devapure tathā || 22 ||
taṃ tyajāva mahārāja bhrātaraṃ te'bhimāninam |
āvayordveṣiṇaṃ nityaṃ mattaṃ rājyamadena vai || 23 ||
dhigimaṃ garhitaṃ vāsaṃ bhṛtyavacca parāśrayam |
gacchāvaḥ sahitau vīra piturme bhavanāntikam || 24 ||
tasya samyakpravṛttasya pūrvajaṃ bhrātaraṃ prati |
kāmārtasya narendrasya patnyāstad ruruce vacaḥ || 25 ||
tato madhupuraṃ rājā haryaśvaḥ sa jagāma ca |
bhāryayā saha kāminyā kāmī puruṣapuṅgavaḥ || 26 ||
madhunā dānavendreṇa sa sāmnā samudāhṛtaḥ |
svāgataṃ vatsa haryaśva prīto'smi tava darśanāt || 27 ||
yadetanmama rājyaṃ vai sarvaṃ madhuvanaṃ vinā |
dadāmi tava rājendra vāsaśca pratigṛhyatām || 28 ||
vane'smim̐llavaṇaścāyaṃ sahāyaste bhaviṣyati |
amitranigrahe caiva karṇadhāratvameṣyati || 29 ||
pālayainaṃ śubhaṃ rāṣṭraṃ samudrānūpabhūṣitam |
gosamṛddhaṃ śriyā juṣṭamābhīraprāyamānuṣam || 2.37.30 ||
atra te vasatastāta durgaṃ giripuraṃ mahat |
bhavitā pārthivāvāsaḥ surāṣṭraviṣayo mahān || 31 ||
anūpaviṣayaścaiva samudrānte nirāmayaḥ |
ānartaṃ nāma te rāṣṭraṃ bhaviṣyatyāyataṃ mahat || 32 ||
tad bhaviṣyamahaṃ manye kālayogena pārthiva |
adhyāsyatāṃ yathākālaṃ pārthivaṃ vṛttamuttamam || 33 ||
yāyātamapi vaṃśaste sameṣyati ca yādavam |
anu vaṃśaṃ ca vaṃśaste somasya bhavitā kila || 34 ||
eṣa me vibhavastāta tavemaṃ viṣayottamam |
dattvā yāsyāmi tapase sāgaraṃ lavaṇālayam || 35 ||
lavaṇena samāyuktastvamimaṃ viṣayottamam |
pālayasvākhilaṃ tāta svasya vaṃśasya vṛddhaye || 36 ||
bāḍhamityeva haryaśvaḥ pratijagrāha tat puram |
sa ca daityastapovāsaṃ jagāma varuṇālayam || 37 ||
haryaśvaśca mahātejā divye girivarottame |
niveśayāmāsa puraṃ vāsārthamamaropamaḥ || 38 ||
ānartaṃ nāma tad rāṣṭraṃ surāṣṭraṃ godhanāyutam |
acireṇaiva kālena samṛddhaṃ pratyapadyata || 39 ||
anūpaviṣaye caiva velāvanavibhūṣitam |
vicitraṃ kṣetrasasyāḍhyaṃ prākāragrāmasaṃkulam || 2.37.40 ||
śaśāsa nṛpatiḥ sphītaṃ tad rāṣṭraṃ rāṣṭravarddhanaḥ |
rājadharmeṇa yaśasā prajānāṃ nandivarddhanaḥ || 41 ||
tasya samyaka pracāreṇa haryaśvasya mahātmanaḥ |
vyavardhata tadakṣobhya rāṣṭraṃ rāṣṭraguṇairyutam || 42 ||
sa hi rājā sthito rājye rājavṛttena śobhitaḥ |
prāptaḥ kulocitāṃ lakṣmīṃ vṛttena ca nayena ca || 43 ||
tasyaiva ca suvṛttasya putrakāmasya dhīmataḥ |
madhumatyāṃ suto jajñe yadurnāma mahāyaśāḥ || 44 ||
so'vardhata mahātejā yadurdundubhiniḥsvanaḥ |
rājalakṣaṇasampannaḥ sapatnairduratikramaḥ || 4 5||
yadurnāmābhavat putro rājalakṣaṇapūjitaḥ |
yathāsya pūrvajo rājā pūruḥ sa sumahāyaśāḥ ||46 ||
sa eka eva tasyāsīt putraḥ paramaśobhanaḥ |
ūrjitaḥ pṛthivībhartā haryaśvasya mahātmanaḥ || 47 ||
dasa varṣasahasrāṇi sa kṛtvā rājyamavyayam |
jagāma tridivaṃ rājā dharmeṇāpratimo bhuvi || 48 ||
tato yaduradīnātmā prajābhistvabhyaṣicyata |
pitaryuparate śrīmān krameṇārka ivoditaḥ || 49 ||
śaśāsa cemāṃ vasudhāṃ praśāntabhayataskarām |
yadurindrapratīkāśo nṛpo yenāsya yādavāḥ || 2.37.50 ||
sa kadācinnṛpaścakre jalakrīḍāṃ mahodadhau |
dāraiḥ saha guṇodāraiḥ satāra iva candramāḥ || 51 ||
sa tatra sahasā kṣiptastitīrṣuḥ sāgarāmbhasi |
dhūmravarṇena nṛpatiḥ sarparājena vīryavān || 52 ||
so'pākṛṣyata vegena jale sarpapuraṃ mahat |
maṇistambhagṛhadvāraṃ muktādāmavibhūṣitam || 53 ||
kīrṇaṃ śaṅkhakulaiḥ śubhrai ratnarāśivibhūṣitam |
pravālāṅkurapatrāḍhyaiḥ pādapairupaśobhitam || 54 ||
kīrṇaṃ pannaganāryoghaiḥ samudrodaravāsibhiḥ |
svarṇavarṇena bhāsvantaṃ svastikenenduvarcasā || 55 ||
sa taṃ dadarśa rājendro vimale sāgarāmbhasi |
pannagendrapuraṃ toye jagatyāmiva nirmitam || 56 ||
svacchaṃ caiva puraṃ tatra praviveśa nṛpo yaduḥ |
agādhaṃ toyadākāraṃ pūrṇaṃ sarpavadhūgaṇaiḥ || 57 ||
tasya dattaṃ maṇimayaṃ jalajaṃ paramāsanam |
svāstīrṇaṃ padmapatraiśca padmasūtrottaracchadam || 58 ||
tamāsīnaṃ nṛpaṃ tatra parame pannagāsane |
dvijihvapatiravyagro dhūmravarṇo'bhyabhāṣata || 59 ||
pitā te svargatiṃ prāptaḥ kṛtvā vaṃśamimaṃ mahat |
bhavantaṃ tejasā yuktamutpādya vasudhādhipam || 2.37.60 ||
yādavānāmayaṃ vaṃśastvannāmnā yadupuṅgava |
pitrā te maṅgalārthāya sthāpitaḥ pārthivākaraḥ || 61 ||
vaṃśe cāsmiṃstava vibho devānāṃ tanayāvyayāḥ |
ṛṣīṇāmuragāṇāṃ ca utpatsyante nṛyonijāḥ || 62 ||
tanmamemāḥ sutāḥ pañca kumāryo vṛttasammatāḥ |
utpannā yauvanāśvasya bhaginyāṃ nṛpasattama || 63 ||
pratīcchemāḥ svadharmeṇa prājāpatyena karmaṇā |
varaṃ ca te pradāsyāmi varārhastvaṃ mato mama || 64 ||
bhaimāśca kukurāścaiva bhojāścāndhakayādavāḥ |
dāśārhā vṛṣṇayaśceti khyātiṃ yāsyanti sapta te|| 65 ||
sa tasmai dhūmravarṇo vai kanyāḥ kanyāvrate sthitāḥ |
jalapūrṇena yogena dadāvindrasamāya vai || 66 ||
varaṃ cāsmai dadau prītaḥ sa vai pannagapuṅgavaḥ |
śrāvayan kanyakāḥ sarvā yathākramamadīnavat || 67 ||
etāsu te sutāḥ pañca sutāsu mama mānada |
utpatsyante pitustejo mātuścaiva samāśritāḥ || 68 ||
asmatsamayabaddhāśca salilābhyantarecarāḥ |
tava vaṃśe bhaviṣyanti pārthivāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ || 69 ||
sa varaṃ kanyakāścaiva labdhvā yaduvarastadā |
udatiṣṭhat vegena salilāccandramā iva || 2.37.70 ||
sa pañcakanyāmadhyastho dadṛśe tatra pārthivaḥ |
pañcatāreṇa saṃyukto nakṣatreṇeva candramāḥ || 71 ||
sa tadantaḥpuraṃ sarvaṃ dadarśa nṛpasattamaḥ |
vaivāhikena veṣeṇa divyasraganulepanaḥ || 72 ||
samāśvāsya ca tāḥ sarvāḥ sa patnīḥ pāvakopamāḥ|
jagāma svapuraṃ rājā prītyā paramayā yutaḥ || 73 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi vikadruvākyaṃ nāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 37 ||

<2.38>

aṣṭātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
sa tāsu nāgakanyāsu kālena mahatā nṛpaḥ |
janayāmāsa vikrāntān pañca putrān kulodvahān||1||
mucukundaṃ mahābāhuṃ padmavarṇaṃ tathaiva ca |
mādhavaṃ sārasaṃ caiva haritaṃ caiva pārthivam || 2 ||
etān pañcasutānrājā pañcabhūtopamān bhuvi |
īkṣamāṇo nṛpaḥ prītiṃ jagāmātulavikramaḥ || 3 ||
te prāptavayasaḥ sarve sthitāḥ pañca yathādrayaḥ |
tejitā baladarpābhyāmūcuḥ pitaramagrataḥ || 4 ||
tāta yuktāḥ sma vayasā bale mahati saṃsthitāḥ |
kṣipramājñaptumicchāmaḥ kiṃ kurmastava śāsanāt || 5 ||
sa tān nṛpatiśārdūlaḥ śārdūlāniva vaigitān |
prītyā paramayā prāha sutān vīryakutūhalāt || 6 ||
vindhyarkṣavantāvabhito dve puryau parvatāśraye |
niveśayatu yatnena mucukundaḥ suto mama || 7 ||
sahyasya copariṣṭāttu dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritaḥ |
padmavarṇo'pi me putro niveśayatu mā ciram || 8 ||
tatraiva parataḥ kānte deśe campakabhūṣite |
sāraso me puraṃ ramyaṃ niveśayatu putrakaḥ || 9 ||
harito'yaṃ mahābāhuḥ sāgare haritodake |
dīpaṃ pannagarājasya suto me pālayiṣyati || 2.38.10 ||
mādhavo me mahābāhurjyeṣṭhaputraśca dharmavit |
yauvarājyena saṃyuktaḥ svapuraṃ pālayiṣyati || 11 ||
sarve nṛpaśriyaṃ prāptā abhiṣiktāḥ sacāmarāḥ |
pitrānuśiṣṭāścatvāro lokapālopamā nṛpāḥ || 12 ||
svaṃ svaṃ niveśanaṃ sarve bhejire nṛpasattamāḥ |
purasthānāni ramyāṇi mṛgayanto yathākramam || 13 ||
mucukundaśca rājarṣirvindhyamadhyamarocayat |
svasthānaṃ narmadātīre dāruṇopalasaṃkaṭe || 14 ||
sa ca taṃ śodhayāmāsa viviktaṃ ca cakāra ha |
setuṃ caiva samaṃ cakre parikhāścāmitodakāḥ || 15 ||
sthāpayāmāsa bhāgeṣu devatāyatanānyapi |
rathyā vīthīrnṛṇāṃ mārgāścatvarāṇi vanāni ca || 16 ||
sa tāṃ purīṃ dhanavatīṃ puruhūtapurīprabhām |
nātidīrgheṇa kālena cakāra nṛpasattamaḥ || 17 ||
nāma cāsyāḥ śubhaṃ cakre nirmitaṃ svena tejasā |
tasyāḥ puryā nṛpaśreṣṭho devaśreṣṭhaparākramaḥ || 18 ||
mahāśmasaṃghātavatī yatheyaṃ vindhyasānugā |
māhiṣmatī nāma purī prakāśamupayāsyati || 19 ||
