ubhayorvindhyayoḥ pāde nagayostāṃ mahāpurīm |
madhye niveśayāmāsa śriyā paramayā vṛtām || 2.38.20 ||
purikāṃ nāma dharmātmā purīṃ devapurīprabhām |
udyānaśatasambādhāṃ samṛddhāpaṇacatvarām || 21 ||
ṛkṣavantaṃ samabhitastīre tatra nirāmaye |
nirmitā sā purī rājñā purikā nāma nāmataḥ || 22 ||
sa te dve vipule puryau devabhogyopame śubhe |
pālayāmāsa dharmātmā rājā dharme vyavasthitaḥ || 23 ||
padmavarṇo'pi rājarṣiḥ sahyapṛṣṭhe purottamam |
cakāra nadyā veṇāyāstīre tarulatākule || 24 ||
viṣayasyālpatāṃ jñātvā sampūrṇaṃ rāṣṭrameva ca |
niveśayāmāsa nṛpaḥ sa vapraprāyamuttamam || 25 ||
padmāvataṃ janapadaṃ karavīraṃ ca tatpuram |
nirmitaṃ padmavarṇena prājāpatyena karmaṇā || 26 ||
sārasenāpi vihitaṃ ramyaṃ krauñcapuraṃ mahat |
campakāśokabahulaṃ vipulaṃ tāmramṛttikam || 27 ||
vanavāsīti vikhyātaḥ sphīto janapado mahān |
purasya tasya tu śrīmān drumaiḥ sārvartukairvṛtaḥ || 28 ||
harito'pi samudrasya dvīpaṃ samabhipālayat |
ratnasaṃcayasampūrṇaṃ nārījanamanoharam || 29 ||
tasya dāśā jale magnā madgurā nāma viśrutāḥ |
ye haranti sadā śaṅkhān samudrodaracāriṇaḥ || 2.38.30 ||
tasyāpare dāśajanāḥ pravālāñjalasambhavān |
saṃcinvanti sadā yuktā jātarūpaṃ ca mauktikam|| 31 ||
jalajāni ca ratnāni niṣādāstasya mānavāḥ |
pracinvanto'rṇave yuktā naubhiḥ saṃyānagāminaḥ||32||
matsyamāṃsena tai sarve vartante sma sadā narāḥ |
gṛhaṇantaḥ sarvaratnāni ratnadvīpanivāsinaḥ || 33 ||
taiḥ saṃyānagatairdravyairvaṇijo dūragāminaḥ |
haritaṃ tarpayantyekaṃ yathaiva dhanadaṃ tathā || 34 ||
evamikṣvākuvaṃśāt tu yaduvaṃśo viniḥsṛtaḥ |
caturdhā yaduputraistu caturbhibhidyate punaḥ || 35 ||
sa yadurmādhave rājyaṃ visṛjya yadupuṅgave |
triviṣṭapaṃ gato rājā dehaṃ tyaktvā mahītale || 36 ||
babhūva mādhavasutaḥ sattvato nāma vīryavān |
sattvavṛttirguṇopeto rājā rājaguṇe sthitaḥ || 37 ||
sattvatasya suto rājā bhīmo nāma mahānabhūt |
yena bhaimāḥ susaṃvṛttāḥ sattvatāt sāttvatāḥ smṛtāḥ||38||
rājye sthite nṛpe tasmin rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati |
śatrughno lavaṇaṃ hatvā ciccheda sa madhorvanam || 39 ||
tasmin madhuvane sthāne purīṃ ca mathurāmimām |
niveśayāmāsa vibhuḥ sumitrānandavardhanaḥ || 2.38.40 ||
paryaye caiva rāmasya bharatasya tathaiva ca |
sumitrāsutayoścaiva sthānaṃ prāptaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam || 41 ||
bhīmeneyaṃ purī tena rājyasambandhakāraṇāt |
svavaśe sthāpitā pūrvaṃ svayamadhyāsitā tathā || 42 ||
tataḥ kuśe sthite rājye lave tu yuvarājani |
andhako nāma bhīmasya suto rājyamakārayat || 43 ||
andhakasya suto jajñe revato nāma pārthivaḥ |
ṛkṣo'pi revatājjajñe ramye parvatamūrdhani || 44 ||
tato raivata utpannaḥ parvataḥ sāgarāntike |
nāmnā raivatako nāma bhūmau bhūmidharaḥ smṛtaḥ || 45 ||
raivatasyātmajo rājā viśvagarbho mahāyaśāḥ |
babhūva pṛthivīpālaḥ pṛthivyāṃ prathitaḥ prabhuḥ || 46 ||
tasya tisṛṣu bhāryāsu divyarūpāsu keśava |
catvāro jajñire putrā lokapālopamāḥ śubhāḥ || 47 ||
vasurbabhruḥ suṣeṇaśca sabhākṣaścaiva vīryavān |
yadupravīrāḥ prakhyātā lokapālā ivāpare || 48 ||
tairayaṃ yādavo vaṃśaḥ pārthivairbahulīkṛtaḥ |
yaiḥ sākaṃ kṛṣṇaloke'smin prajāvantaḥ prajeśvarāḥ||49||
vasostu kuntiviṣaye vasudevaḥ suto vibhuḥ |
tataḥ sa janayāmāsa suprabhe dve ca dārike || 2.38.50 ||
kuntīṃ ca pāṇḍormahiṣīṃ devatāmiva bhūcarīm |
bhāryāṃ ca damaghoṣasya cedirājasya suprabhām || 51 ||
eṣa te svasya vaṃśasya prabhavaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ |
śruto mayā purā kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇadvaipāyanāntikāt || 52 ||
tvaṃ tvidānīṃ praṇaṣṭe'smin vaṃśe vaṃśabhṛtāṃ vara |
svayambhūriva samprāpto bhavāyāsmajjayāya ca || 53 ||
na tu tvāṃ pauramātreṇa śaktā gūhayituṃ vayam |
devaguhyeṣvapi bhavān sarvajñaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ || 54 ||
śaktaścāpi jarāsaṃdhaṃ nṛpaṃ yodhayituṃ vibho |
tvadbuddhivaśagāḥ sarve vayaṃ yodhavrate sthitāḥ || 55 ||
jarāsaṃdhastu balavān nṛpāṇāṃ mūrdhni tiṣṭhati |
aprameyabalaścaiva vayaṃ ca kṛśasādhanāḥ || 56 |
na ceyamekāhamapi purī rodhaṃ sahiṣyati |
kṛśabhaktendhanakṣāmā durgairapariveṣṭitā || 57 ||
asaṃskṛtāmbuparikhā dvārayantravivarjitā |
vapraprākāranicayā kartavyā bahuvistarā || 58 ||
saṃskartavyāyudhāgārā yoktavyā ceṣṭikācayaiḥ |
kaṃsasya balabhogyatvānnātiguptā purā janaiḥ || 59 ||
sadyo nipatite kaṃse rājye'smākaṃ navodaye |
purī pratyagrarodheva na rodhaṃ visahiṣyati || 2.38.60 ||
balaṃ sammardabhagnaṃ ca kṛṣyamāṇaṃ pareṇa ha |
asaṃśayamidaṃ rāṣṭraṃ janaiḥ saha vinaṅkṣyati || 61 ||
yādavānāṃ virodhena ye jitā rājyakāmukaiḥ |
te sarve dvaidhamicchanti yatkṣamaṃ tadvidhīyatām || 62 ||
vañcanīyā bhaviṣyāmo nṛpāṇāṃ nṛpakāraṇāt|
jarāsaṃdhabhayārtānāṃ dravatāṃ rājyasambhrame || 63 ||
ārtā vakṣyanti naḥ sarve rudhyamānāḥ pure janāḥ |
yādavānāṃ virodhena vinaṣṭāḥ smeti keśava || 64 ||
etanmama mataṃ kṛṣṇa visrambhātsamudāhṛtam|
tvaṃ tu vijñāpitaḥ pūrvaṃ na punaḥ samprabodhitaḥ || 65 ||
yadatra vaḥ kṣamaṃ kṛṣṇa tacca vai saṃvidhīyatām |
tvamasya netā sainyasya vayaṃ tvacchāsane sthitāḥ |
tvanmūlaśca virodho'yaṃ rakṣāsmānātmanā saha || 66 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi vikadruvākyaṃ nāmāṣṭātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||38 ||

<2.39>

ekonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
vikadrostu vacaḥ śrutvā vasudavo mahāyaśāḥ |
parituṣṭena manasā vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 1 ||
rājā ṣāḍguṇyavaktā vai rājā mantrārthatattvavit|
satattvaṃ ca hitaṃ caiva kṛṣṇoktaṃ kila dhīmatā || 2 ||
bhāṣitā rājadharmāśca satyāśca jagato hitāḥ |
vikradruṇā yaduśreṣṭha yaddhitaṃ tad vidhīyatām || 3 ||
etacchrutvā piturvākyaṃ vikradrośca mahātmanaḥ |
vākyamuttamamekāgro babhāṣe puruṣottamaḥ || 4 ||
bruvatāṃ vaḥ śrutaṃ vākyaṃ hetutaḥ kramatastathā |
nyāyataḥ śāstrataścaiva daivaṃ caivānupaśyatām || 5 ||
śrūyatāmuttaraṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā ca parigṛhyatām |
nayena vyavahartavyaṃ pārthivena yathākramam || 6 ||
saṃdhiṃ ca vigrahaṃ caiva yānamāsanameva ca |
dvaidhībhāvaṃ saṃśrayaṃ ca ṣāḍguṇyaṃ cintayet sadā || 7 ||
balinaḥ saṃnikṛṣṭe tu na stheyaṃ paṇḍitena vai |
apakrameddhi kālajñaḥ samartho yuddhamudvahet || 8 ||
ahaṃ tāvat sahāryeṇa muhūrte'smin prakāśite |
jīvitārthe gamiṣyāmi śaktimānapyaśaktavat || 9 ||
tataḥ sahyācalayutaṃ sahāryeṇāhamakṣayam |
ātmadvitīyaḥ śrīmantaṃ pravekṣye dakṣiṇāpatham || 2.39.10 ||
karavīrapuraṃ caiva ramyaṃ krauñcapuraṃ tathā |
drakṣyāvastatra sahitau gomantaṃ ca nagottamam || 11 ||
āvayorgamanaṃ śrutvā jitakāśī sa pārthivaḥ |
apraviśya purīṃ darpādanusāraṃ kariṣyati || 12 ||
tataḥ sahyavaneṣveva rājā yāti sa sānugaḥ |
āvayorgrahaṇe caiva nṛpatiḥ prayatiṣyati || 13 ||
eṣā naḥ śreyasī yātrā bhaviṣyati kulasya vai |
paurāṇāmatha puryāśca deśasya ca sukhāvahā || 14 ||
na ca śatroḥ paribhraṣṭā rājāno vijigīṣavaḥ |
pararāṣṭreṣu mṛṣyanti mṛdhe śatroḥ kṣayaṃ vinā || 15 ||
evamuktvā tu tau vīrau kṛṣṇasaṃkarṣaṇāvubhau |
prapedaturasambhrāntau dakṣiṇau dakṣiṇāpatham || 16 ||
tau tu rāṣṭrāṇi śataśaścarantau kāmarūpiṇau |
dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāsthāya ceraturmārgagau sukham || 17 ||
sahyapṛṣṭheṣu ramyeṣu modamānāvubhau tathā |
dakṣiṇāpathagau vīrāvadhvānaṃ samprapedatuḥ || 18 ||
tau ca svalpena kālena sahyācalavibhūṣitam |
karavīrapuraṃ prāptau svavaṃśena vibhūṣitam ||19||
tau tatra gatvā veṇāyā nadyāstīrāntamāśritam |
āsedatuḥ prarohāḍhyaṃ nyagrodhaṃ tarupuṅgavam || 2.39.20 ||
adhastāt tasya vṛkṣasya muniṃ dīptatapodhanam |
aṃsāvasaktaparaśuṃ jaṭāvalkaladhāriṇam || 21 ||
gauramagniśikhākāraṃ tejasā bhāskaropamam |
kṣatrāntakaramakṣobhyaṃ vapuṣmantamivārṇavam || 22 ||
nyastasaṃkucitādhānaṃ kāle hutahutāśanam |
klinnaṃ triṣavaṇāmbhobhirādyaṃ devaguruṃ yathā || 23 ||
savatsāṃ dhenukāṃ śvetāṃ homadhuk kāmadohanām|
kṣīrāraṇiṃ karṣamāṇaṃ mahendragirigocaram || 24 ||
dadṛśatustau sahitāvapariśrāntamavyayam |
bhārgavaṃ rāmamāsīnaṃ mandarasthaṃ yathā ravim || 25 ||
nyāyatastau tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā pādamūle kṛtāñjalī |
vasudevasutau vīrau sadhiṣṇyāviva pāvakau || 26 ||
kṛṣṇastamṛṣiśārdūlamuvāca vadatāṃ varaḥ |
ślakṣṇaṃ madhurayā vācā lokavṛttāntakovidaḥ || || 27 ||
bhagavan jāmadagnyaṃ tvāmavagacchāmi bhārgavam|
rāmaṃ munīnāmṛṣabhaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ kulāntakam || 28 ||
tvayā sāyakavegena kṣipto bhārgava sāgaraḥ |
iṣupātena nagaraṃ kṛtaṃ śūrpārakaṃ tvayā||29||
dhanuḥpañcaśatāyāmamiṣupañcaśatocchrayam |
sahyasya ca nikuñjeṣu sphīto janapado mahān||2.39.30 ||
atikramyodadhervelāmaparānte niveśitaḥ |
tvayā tat kārtavīryasya sahasrabhujakānanam || 31 ||
chinnaṃ paraśunaikena smaratā nidhanaṃ pituḥ |
iyamadyāpi rudhiraiḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ hatadviṣām || 32 ||
snigdhaistvatparaśūtsṛṣṭai raktapaṅkā vasuṃdharā |
raiṇukeyaṃ vijāne tvāṃ kṣitau kṣitiparoṣaṇam || 33 ||
paraśupragrahe yuktaṃ yathaiveha raṇe tathā |
tadicchāvastvayā vipra kaṃcidarthamupaśrutam || 34 ||
uttaraṃ ca śrutārthena pratyuktamaviśaṅkayā |
āvayormathurā rāma yamunātīraśobhinī || 35 ||
yādavau svo muniśreṣṭha yadi te śrutimāgatau |
vasudevo yaduśreṣṭhaḥ pitā nau hi dhṛtavrataḥ || 36 ||
janmaprabhṛti caivāvāṃ vrajeṣveva niyojitau |
tau svaḥ kaṃsabhayāt tatra śaṅkitau parivarddhitau || 37 ||
vayañca prathamaṃ prāptau mathurāyāṃ praveśitau |
tāvāvāṃ vyutthitaṃ hatvā samāje kaṃsamojasā || 38 ||
pitaraṃ tasya tatraiva sthāpayitvā janeśvaram |
svameva karma cārabdhau gavāṃ vyāpārakārakau || 30 ||
athāvayoḥ puraṃ roddhuṃ jarāsaṃdho vyavasthitaḥ |
saṃgrāmānsubahūnkṛtvā labdhalakṣāvapi svayam|| 2.39.40 ||
tataḥ svapurarakṣārthaṃ prajānāṃ ca dhṛtavrata |
akṛtārthāvanudyogau kartavyabalasādhanau || 41 ||
arathau pattinau yuddhe nistanutrau nirāyudhau |
jarāsaṃdhodyamabhayāt purād dvāveva niḥsṛtau || 42 ||
evamāvāmanuprāptau muniśreṣṭha tavāntikam|
āvayormantramātreṇa kartumarhasi satkriyām || 43 ||
śrutvaitad bhārgavo rāmastayorvākyamaninditam |
reṇukeyaḥ prativaco dharmasaṃhitamabravīt || 44 ||
aparāntādahaṃ kṛṣṇa sampratīhāgataḥ prabho |
eka eva vinā śiṣyairyuvayormantrakāraṇāt || 45 ||
vidito me vraje vāsastava padmanibhekṣaṇa |
dānavānāṃ vadhaścāpi kaṃsasyāpi durātmanaḥ || 46 ||
vigrahaṃ ca jarāsaṃdhe viditvā puruṣottama |
tava sabhrātṛkasyeha samprāpto'smi varānana || 47 ||
jāne tvāṃ kṛṣṇa goptāraṃ jagataḥ prabhumavyayam |
devakāryārthasiddhyarthamabālaṃ bālatāṃ gatam || 48 ||
na tvayāviditaṃ kiṃcit triṣu lokeṣu vidyate |
tathāpi bhaktimātreṇa śṛṇu vakṣyāmi te vacaḥ || 49 ||
pūrvajaistava govinda pūrvaṃ puramidaṃ kṛtam|
karavīrapuraṃ nāma rāṣṭraṃ caiva niveśitam || 2.39.50 ||
pure'smin nṛpatiḥ kṛṣṇa vāsudevo mahāyaśāḥ |
śṛgāla iti vikhyāto nityaṃ paramakopanaḥ || 51 ||
nṛpeṇa tena govinda tava vaṃśabhavā nṛpāḥ |
dāyādā nihatāḥ sarve vīra dveṣānuśāyinā || 52 ||
ahaṃkāraparo nityamajitātmātimatsarī |
rājyaiśvaryamadāviṣṭaḥ putreṣvapi ca dāruṇaḥ || 53 ||
tanneha bhavataḥ sthānaṃ rocate me narottama |
karavīrapure ghore nityaṃ pārthivadūṣite || 54 ||
śrūyatāṃ kathayiṣyāmi yatrobhau śatrubādhanau |

nivāsaṃ māṃsabhakṣāṇāṃ caurāṇāṃ ghorakarmaṇām || 57 ||
nānādrumalatāyuktaṃ citraṃ puṣpitapādapam|

upabhujya tvimānkāmāngatvā tāndharaṇīdharān||2.39.60||

mahākapiriti khyāto vanavāsyajanādhipaḥ || 62 ||
tamadṛṣṭvaiva rājānaṃ nivāsāya gate'hani |
tīrthamānaḍuhaṃ nāma tatrasthāḥ syāma saṃgatāḥ || 63 ||
tataścyutā gamiṣyāmaḥ sahyasya vivare girim |
gomantamiti vikhyātaṃ naikaśṛṅgavibhūṣitam || 64 ||
svargataikamahāśṛṅgaṃ durārohaṃ khagairapi |
viśrāmabhūtaṃ devānāṃ jyotirbhirabhisaṃvṛtam || 65 ||

taṃ vimānāvataraṇaṃ giriṃ merurivāparam || 66 ||

ūrmimantaṃ samudraṃ ca apāradvīpabhūṣaṇam |
prekṣamāṇau sukhaṃ tatra nagāgre vicariṣyathaḥ || 68 ||
śṛṅgasthau tasya śailasya gomantasya vanecarau |
durgayuddhena dhāvantau jarāsaṃdhaṃ vijeṣyatha || 69 ||
tatra śailagatau dṛṣṭvā bhavantau yuddhadurmadau |
āsaktaḥ śailayuddhe ca jarāsaṃdho bhaviṣyati || 2.39.70 ||
bhavatorapi yuddhe tu pravṛtte tatra dāruṇe |
āyudhaiḥ saha saṃyogaṃ paśyāmi nacirādiva || 71 ||
saṃgrāmaśca mahān kṛṣṇa nirdiṣṭastatra daivataiḥ |
yadūnāṃ pārthivānāṃ ca māṃsaśoṇitakardamaḥ || 72 ||

saunandaṃ musalaṃ caiva vaiṣṇavānyāyudhāni ca || 73 ||
darśayiṣyanti saṃgrāme pāsyanti ca mahīkṣitām |
rudhiraṃ kālayuktānāṃ vapurbhiḥ kālasaṃnibhaiḥ || 74 ||
sa cakramusalo nāma saṃgrāmaḥ kṛṣṇa viśrutaḥ |
daivatairiha nirdiṣṭaḥ kālasyādeśasaṃjñitaḥ || 75 ||
tatra te kṛṣṇa saṃgrāme suvyaktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vapuḥ |
drakṣyanti ripavaḥ sarve surāśca surabhāvana || 76 ||
tāṃ bhajasva gadāṃ kṛṣṇa cakraṃ ca ciravismṛtam |
bhajasva svena rūpeṇa surāṇāṃ vijayāya vai || 77 ||
balaścāyaṃ halaṃ ghoraṃ musalaṃ cāribhedanam |
vadhāya suraśatrūṇāṃ bhajatāllokabhāvanaḥ || 78 ||
eṣa te prathamaḥ kṛṣṇa saṃgrāmo bhuvi pārthivaiḥ |
pṛthivyarthe samākhyāto bhārāvataraṇe suraiḥ || 79 ||
āyudhāvāptiratraiva vapuṣo vaiṣṇavasya ca |
lakṣmyāśca tejasaścaiva vyūhānāṃ ca vidāraṇam || 2.39.80 ||
ataḥprabhṛti saṃgrāmo dharaṇyāṃ śastramūrcchitaḥ |
bhaviṣyati mahān kṛṣṇa bhārataṃ nāma vaiśasam || 81 ||
tad gaccha kṛṣṇa śailendraṃ gomantaṃ ca nagottamam |
jarāsaṃdhamṛdhe cāpi vijayastvāmupasthitaḥ || 82 ||
idaṃ caivāmṛtaprakhyaṃ homadhenoḥ payo'mṛtam |

catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tattu dhenvāḥ payaḥ pītvā balardpasamanvitau |
tatastau rāmasahitau prasthitau yadupuṅgavau || 1 ||
gomantaṃ parvataṃ draṣṭuṃ mattanāgendragāminau |
jāmadagnyapradiṣṭena mārgeṇa vadatāṃ varau || 2 ||
jāmadagnyatṛtīyāste trayastraya ivāgnayaḥ |
śobhayanti sma panthānaṃ tridivaṃ tridaśā iva || 3 ||
te cādhvavidhinā sarve tato vai divasakramāt |
gomantamacalaṃ prāptā mandaraṃ tridaśā iva || 4 ||
latācāruvicitraṃ ca nānādrumavibhūṣitam |
nānāgurupinaddhāṅgaṃ citraṃ citrairmanoharaiḥ || 5 ||
dvirephagaṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ śilāsaṃkaṭapādapam |
mattabarhiṇanirghoṣairnāditaṃ meghanādibhiḥ || 6 ||
gaganālagnaśikharaṃ jaladāsaktapādapam |
mattadvipaviṣāṇāgraiḥ parighṛṣṭopalāṅkitam || 7 ||
kūjadbhiścāṇḍajagaṇaiḥ samantāt pratināditam |
darīprapātāmburavaiśchannaṃ śārdūlatallajaiḥ || 8 ||
nīlāśmacayasaṃghātairbahuvarṇaṃ yathā ghanam |
dhātuvisrāvadigdhāṅgaṃ sānuprasravabhūṣitam || 9 ||
kīrṇaṃ suragaṇaiḥ kāntairmainākamiva kāmagam |
ucchritaṃ suviśālāgraṃ samūlāmbuparisravam || 2.40.10 ||
sakānanadarīprasthaṃ śvetābhragaṇabhūṣitam |
panasāmrātakāmraughairvetrasyandanacandanaiḥ || 11 ||
tamālailāvanayutaṃ marīcakṣupasaṃkulam |
pippalīvallikalilaṃ citramiṅgudipādapaiḥ || 12 ||
drumaiḥ sarjarasānāṃ ca sarvataḥ pariśobhitam |
prāṃśuśālavanairyuktaṃ bahucitravanairyutam || 13 ||
sarjanimbārjunavanaṃ pāṭalīkulasaṃkulam |
hintālaiśca tamālaiśca punnāgaiścopaśobhitam || 14 ||
jaleṣu jalajaiśchannaṃ sthaleṣu sthalajairapi |
paṅkajairdrumakhaṇḍaiśca sarvataḥ pratibhūṣitam || 15 ||
jambūjambūlavṛkṣāḍhyaṃ kadrukandalabhūṣitam |
campakāśokabakulaṃ bilvatindukaśobhitam || 16 ||
kuñjaiśca nāgapuṣpaiśca samantādupaśobhitam |
nāgayūthasamākīrṇaṃ mṛgasaṃghātaśobhitam || 17 ||
siddhacāraṇarakṣobhiḥ sevitaprastarāntaram |
gandharvaiśca samāyuktaṃ guhyakaiḥ pakṣibhistathā || 18 ||
vidyādharagaṇairnityamanukīrṇaśilātalam |
siṃhaśārdūlasaṃnādaiḥ satataṃ pratināditam |
sevitaṃ vāridhārābhiścandrapādaiśca śobhitam || 19 ||
stutaṃ tridaśagandharvairapsarobhiralaṃkṛtam |
vanaspatīnāṃ divyānāṃ puṣpairuccāvacaiḥ śritam || 2.40.20 ||
śakravajraprahārāṇāmanabhijñaṃ kadācana |
dāvāgnibhayanirmuktaṃ mahāvātabhayojjhitam || 21 ||
prapātaprabhavābhiśca saridbhirupaśobhitam |
kānanairānanākārairviśeṣadbhiriva śriyam || 22 ||
jalaśaivalaśṛṅgāgrairunmiṣantamiva śriyā |
sthalībhirmṛgajuṣṭābhiḥ kāntābhirupaśobhitam || 23 ||
pārśvairupalakalmāṣairmeghairiva vibhūṣitam |
pādapacchannabhūmībhiḥ sapuṣpābhiḥ samantataḥ || 24 ||
maṇḍitaṃ vanarājībhiḥ pramadābhiḥ patiryathā |
sundarībhirdarībhiśca kandarābhistathaiva ca || 25 ||
teṣu teṣvavakāśeṣu sadārāmiva śobhitam |
auṣadhīdīptaśikharaṃ vānaprasthaniṣevitam |
jātarūpairvanoddeśaiḥ kṛtrimairiva bhūṣitam || 26 ||
mūlena suviśālena śirasāpyucchritena ca |
pṛthivīmantarikṣaṃ ca grāhayantamiva sthitam || 27 ||
te samāsādya gomantaṃ ramyaṃ bhūmidharottamam |
ruciraṃ rurucuḥ sarve vāsāyāmarasaṃnibhāḥ || 28 ||
ruruhuste girivaraṃ khamūrdhvamiva pakṣiṇaḥ |
asajjamānā vegena vainateyaparākramāḥ || 29 ||
te tu tasyottaraṃ śṛṅgamārūḍhāstridaśā iva |
agāraṃ sahasā cakrurmanasā nirmitopamam || 2.40.30 ||
niviṣṭau yādavau dṛṣṭā jāmadagnyo mahāmatiḥ |
rāmo'bhimatamakliṣṭamāpraṣṭumupacakrame || 31 ||
kṛṣṇa yāsyāmyahaṃ tāta puraṃ śūrpārakaṃ vibho |
yuvayornāsti vaimukhyaṃ saṃgrāme daivatairapi || 32 ||
prāptavānasmi yāṃ prītiṃ mārgānugamanādapi |
sā me kṛṣṇānugṛhṇāti śarīramidamavyayam || 33 ||
idaṃ tat sthānamuddiṣṭaṃ yatrāyudhasamāgamaḥ |
yuvayorvihito devaiḥ samayaḥ sāmparāyikaḥ || 34 ||
daivānāṃ mukhya vaikuṇṭha viṣṇo devairabhiṣṭuta |
kṛṣṇa sarvasya lokasya śṛṇu me naiṣṭhikaṃ vacaḥ || 35 ||
yadidaṃ prastutaṃ karma tvayā govinda laukikam |
mānuṣāṇāṃ hitārthāya loke mānuṣadehinā || 36 ||
tasyāyaṃ prathamaḥ kalpaḥ kālena tu niyojitaḥ |
jarāsaṃdhena vai sārdhaṃ saṃgrāme samupasthite || 37 ||
tatrāyudhabalaṃ caiva rūpaṃ ca raṇakarkaśam |
svayamevātmanā kṛṣṇa tvamātmānaṃ vidhatsva ha || 38 ||
cakrodyatakaraṃ dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ gadāpāṇimāhave |
caturdviguṇapīnāṃsaṃ bibhyedapi śatakratuḥ || 39 ||
adyaprabhṛti te yātrā svargoktā samupasthitā |
pṛthivyāṃ pārthivendrāṇāṃ kṛtāstre tvayi mānada || 2.40.40 ||
vainateyasya cāhvānaṃ vāhanaṃ dhvajakarmaṇi |
kuru śīghraṃ mahābāho govinda vadatāṃ vara || 41 ||
yuddhakāmā nṛpatayastridivābhimukhodyatāḥ |
dhārtarāṣṭrasya vaśagāstiṣṭhanti raṇavṛttayaḥ || 42 ||
rājñāṃ nidhanadṛṣṭārthā vaidhavyenādhivāsitā |
ekaveṇīdharā ceyaṃ vasudhā tvāṃ pratīkṣate || 43 ||
sagrahaṃ kṛṣṇa nakṣatraṃ saṃkṣipyārivimardana |
tvayi mānuṣyamāpanne yuddhe ca samupasthite || 44 ||
tvarasva kṛṣṇa yuddhāya dānavānāṃ vadhāya ca |
svargāya ca narendrāṇāṃ devatānāṃ sukhāya ca || 45 ||
satkṛto'haṃ tvayā kṛṣṇa lokaiśca sacarācaraiḥ |
tvayā satkṛtarūpeṇa yena satkṛtavānaham || 46 ||
sādhayāmi mahābāho bhavataḥ kāryasiddhaye |
smartavyaścāsmi yuddheṣu kāntāreṣu mahīkṣitām || 47 ||
ityuktvā jāmadagnyastu kṛṣṇamakliṣṭakāriṇam |
jayāśiṣā varddhayitvā jagāmābhīpsitāṃ diśam ||||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi gomantārohaṇaṃ nāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 40 ||

<2.41>

ekacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
jāmadagnye gate rāme tau yādavakulodvahau |
gomantaśikhare ramye ceratuḥ kāmarūpiṇau || 1 ||
vanamālākuloraskau nīlapītāmbarāvubhau |
nīlaśvetavapuṣmantau gaganasthāvivāmbudau || 2 ||
tau śailadhātudigdhāṅgau yuvānau śikhare sthitau |
ceratustatra kānteṣu vaneṣu ratilālasau || 3 ||
udayantaṃ nirīkṣantau śaśinaṃ jyotiṣāṃ varam |
udayāstamane caiva grahāṇāṃ dharaṇīdhare || 4 ||
atha saṃkarṣaṇaḥ śrīmān vinā kṛṣṇena vīryavān |
cacāra tasya śikhare nagasya nagasaṃnibhaḥ || 5 ||
praphullasya kadambasya succhāye niṣasāda ha |
vāyunā mandagandhena vījyamānaḥ sukhena vai || 6 ||
tasya tenānilaughena sevyamānasya tatra vai |
madyasaṃsparjo gandhaḥ saṃspṛśan ghrāṇamāgataḥ||7||
tṛṣṇā cainaṃ viveśāśu vāruṇīprabhavā tadā |
śuśoṣa ca mukhaṃ tasya mattasyevāpare'hani || 8 ||
smāritaḥ sa purāvṛttamamṛtaprāśanaṃ vibhuḥ |
tṛṣito madirānveṣī tatastaṃ tarumaikṣata||9||
tasya prāvṛṣi phullasya yadambho jalajojjhitam|
tatkoṭarasthaṃ madirā saṃjāyata manoharā || 2.41.10 ||
tāṃ tu tṛṣṇābhibhūtātmā pibannārta ivāsakṛt |
mohācca calitākāraḥ samajāyata sa prabhuḥ || 11 ||
tasya mattasya vadanaṃ kiṃciccalitalocanam |
ghūrṇitākāramabhavaccharatkālendusaprabham || 12 ||
kadambakoṭare jātā nāmnā kādambarīti sā |
rūpiṇī vāruṇī tatra devānāmamṛtāraṇī || 13 ||
kādambarīmadakalaṃ viditvā kṛṣṇapūrvajam |
tisrastridaśanāryastamupatasthuḥ priyaṃvadāḥ || 14 ||
madirā rūpiṇī bhūtvā kāntiśca śaśinaḥ priyā |
śrīśca devī variṣṭhā strī svayamevāmbujadhvajā || 15 ||
sāñjalipragrahā devī rauhiṇeyamupasthitā |
vāruṇyā sahitaṃ vākyamuvāca madaviklavam || 16 ||
balaṃ jayasva daityānāṃ baladeva divīśvara |
ahaṃ te dayitā kāntā vāruṇī samupasthitā || 17 ||
tvāmevāntarhitaṃ śrutvā śāśvataṃ vaḍavāmukhe |
kṣīṇapuṇyeva vasudhāṃ paryemi vimalānana || 18 ||
puṣpacakrānulipteṣu kesareṣūṣitaṃ mayā |
atimukteṣu cākṣobhya puṣpastabakavatsu ca || 19 ||
ahaṃ kadambamālīnā meghakāle mukhapriyā |
tṛṣitaṃ mārgamāṇā tvāṃ svena rūpeṇa chāditā || 2.41.20 ||
sāsmi pūrṇena yogena yathaivāmṛtamanthane |
samīpaṃ preṣitā pitrā varuṇena tavānagha || 21 ||
sā yathaivārṇavagatā tathaiva vaḍavāmukhe |
tvayopabhoktumicchāmi sammatastvaṃ hi me guruḥ || 22 ||
na tvānantaṃ parityakṣye bhartsitāpi tvayānagha |
nāhaṃ tvayā vinā lokānutsahe deva sevitum || 23 ||
ādipadmaṃ ca padmāṅkaṃ divyaṃ śravaṇabhūṣaṇam |
kauśeyāni ca nīlāni samudrārhāṇi bibhratī || 24 ||
madirānantaraṃ kāntiḥ saṃkarṣaṇamupasthitā |
madenāgalitaśroṇī kiṃcidāghūṇitekṣaṇā || 25 ||
provāca praṇayāt kāntirbaddhāñjalipuṭā satī |
jayapūrveṇa yogena sasmitaṃ vākyamarthavat || 26 ||
ahaṃ candrādapi guruṃ sahasraśirasaṃ prabhum |
svairguṇairanuraktā tvāṃ yathaiva madirā tathā || 27 ||
śrīśca padmālayā devī nidheyā vaiṣṇavorasi |
rauhiṇeyorasi śubhā mālevāmalatāṃ gatā || 28 ||
sā mālāmamalāṃ gṛhya balasyorasi daṃśitā |
padmāsyā padmahastā vai saṃkarṣaṇamathābravīt || 29 ||
rāma rāmābhirāmastvaṃ vāruṇyā samalaṃkṛtaḥ |
kāntyā mayā ca deveśa saṃgataścandramā yathā || 2.41.30 ||
iyaṃ ca sā mayā mauliḥ proddhatā varuṇālayāt |
mūrdhni śīrṣasahasrasya yā te bhānurivābabhau || 31 ||
jātarūpamayaṃ caikaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ vajrabhūṣitam |
ādipadmaṃ ca padmākṣaṃ divyaśravaṇabhūṣaṇam || 32 ||
kauśeyāni ca nīlāni samudrārhāṇi bhāvataḥ |
hāraṃ ca pīnataralaṃ samudrābhyantaro'ṣitam || 33 ||
devemāṃ pratigṛhṇīṣva paurāṇī bhūṣaṇakriyām |
samayaste mahābāho bhūṣaṇānāmalaṃkriyā || 34 ||
saṃgṛhya tamalaṃkāraṃ tāśca tisraḥ surastriyaḥ |
śuśubhe baladevo hi śāradendusamaprabhaḥ || 35 ||
sa samāgamya kṛṣṇena jalajāmbhodavarcasā |
mudaṃ paramikāṃ lebhe grahayuktaḥ śaśī yathā || 36 ||
tābhyāmubhābhyāṃ saṃlāpe vartamāne gṛhe yathā |
vainateyastato'dhvānamaticakrāma vegataḥ || 37 ||
saṃgrāmamuktastejasvī daityapraharaṇāṅkitaḥ |
devatānāṃ jayaślāghī divyasraganulepanaḥ || 38 ||
suptasya śayane divye kṣīrode varuṇālaye |
viṣṇoḥ kirīṭaṃ daityena hṛtaṃ vairocanena vai || 39 ||
tadarthastena saṃgrāmaḥ kṛto gurvarthamojasā |
kirīṭārthe samudrasya madhye daityagaṇaiḥ saha || 2.41.40 ||
mokṣayitvā kirīṭaṃ tu vaiṣṇavaṃ patatāṃ varaḥ |
vyatyakramata vegena gaganaṃ devatālayam || 41 ||
sa dadarśa guruṃ śaile viṣṇuṃ kāryāntarāgatam |
tena krīḍāvalambena kirīṭena virājatā || 42 ||
sa dṛṣṭvā mānuṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ śailarājaśirogatam |
prakāśaceṣṭānirmuktaṃ vimaulimiva mānuṣam || 43 ||
abhijñastasya bhāvānāṃ garutmān patatāṃ varaḥ|
cikṣepa khaṃ gato mauliṃ viṣṇoḥ śirasi hṛṣṭavat || 44 ||
upendramūrdhni sā maulirapinaddhā ivāpatat |
śirasaḥ sthānaniryuktā kṛṣṇaṃ caivānvaśobhayat |
yathaiva meruśikhare bhānurmadhyaṃdine yathā || 45 ||
vainateyaprayogeṇa viditvā maulimāgatām |
kṛṣṇaḥ prahṛṣṭavadano rāmaṃ vacanamabravīt || 46 ||
tvarate khalu kāryārtho devatānāṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
yatheyamāvayoḥ śaile saṃgrāmaracanā kṛtā || 47 ||
vairocanena 'suptasya' mama maulirmahodadhau |
śakrasya sadṛśaṃ rūpaṃ divyamāsthāya sāgarāt || 48 ||
grāharūpeṇa yo nīta ānīto'sau garutmatā |
mamāhiśayanānmaulirhṛtvā kṣipto garutmatā || 49 ||
suvyaktaṃ saṃnikṛṣṭaḥ sa jarāsaṃdho narādhipaḥ |
lakṣyante hi dhvajāgrāṇi rathānāṃ vātaraṃhasām || 2.41.50 ||
etāni vijigīṣūṇāṃ śaśikalpāni bhūbhṛtām |
chatrāṇyārya virājante daṃśitāni mitāni ca || 51 ||
aho nṛparathodagrā vimalāśchatrapaṅktayaḥ |
abhivartanti naḥ śubhrā yathā khe haṃsapaṅktayaḥ || 52 ||
aho dyaurvimalābhānāṃ śastrāṇāṃ vimalānanā |
prabhā bhāskarabhāmiśrā carantīva diśo dṛśa || 53 ||
etāni nūnaṃ samare pārthivairāyudhāni ca |
kṣiptāni vinaśiṣyanti mayi sarvāṇi saṃyuge || 54 ||
kāle khalu nṛpaḥ prāpto jarāsaṃdho mahīpatiḥ |
āvayoryuddhanikaṣaḥ prathamaḥ samarātithiḥ || 55 ||
ārya tiṣṭhāva sahitau na khalvānāgate nṛpe |
yuddhārambhaḥ prayoktavyo balaṃ tāvad vimṛśyatām|| 56 ||
evamuktvā tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svasthaḥ saṃgrāmalālasaḥ |
jarāsaṃdhavadhaṃ prepsuścakāra baladarśanam || 57 ||
vīkṣamāṇaśca tānsarvān nṛpān yaduvaro'vyayaḥ |
ātmānamātmanovāca yatpūrvaṃ divi mantritam || 58 ||
ime te pṛthivīpālāḥ pārthive vartmani sthitāḥ |
ye vināśaṃ gamiṣyanti śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 59 ||
prokṣitānkhalvimān manye mṛtyunā nṛpasattamān |
svargagāmīni cāpyeṣāṃ vapuṃṣi pracakāśire || 2.41.60 ||
sthāne bhārapariśrāntā vasudheyaṃ divaṃ gatā |
eṣāṃ nṛpatisiṃhānāṃ balaughairabhipīḍitā || 61 ||
alpena khalu kālena viviktaṃ pṛthivītalam |
bhaviṣyati narendraughairākīrṇaṃ ca nabhastalam || 62 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi jarāsaṃdhābhigamanaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 41 ||

<2.42>

dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
jarāsaṃdhastataḥ prāpto nṛpaḥ sarvamahīkṣitām |
narādhipairbalayutairanuyāto mahādyutiḥ || 1 ||
vyāyatodagraturagairvispaṣṭārthasamāhitaiḥ |
rathaiḥ sāṅgrāmikairyuktairasaṅgagatibhiḥ kvacit || 2 ||
hemakakṣairmahāghaṇṭairvāraṇairvāridopamaiḥ |
mahāmātrottamārūḍhaiḥ kalpitai raṇagarvitaiḥ || 3 ||
svārūḍhaiḥ sādibhiryuktaiḥ preṅkhamāṇaiḥ pravalgitaiḥ |
vājibhirvāyusaṃkāśaiḥ plravadbhiriva patribhiḥ || 4 ||
khaṅgacarmabalodagraiḥ pattibhirbalināṃ varaiḥ |
sahastrasaṃkhyairnirmuktairutpatadbhirivoragaiḥ || 5 ||
evaṃ caturvidhaiḥ sainyaiḥ pracaladbhirivāmbudaiḥ |
nṛpo'bhiyāto balavāñjarāsaṃdho dhṛtavrataḥ || 6 ||
sa rathainemighoṣaiśca gajaiśca madasaṃyutaiḥ |
heṣadbhiścāpi turagaiḥ kṣveḍitograiśca pattibhiḥ || 7 ||
saṃnādayan diśaḥ sarvāḥ sarvāścāpi guhāśayān |
sa rājā sāgarākāraḥ sasainyaḥ pratyadṛśyata || 8 ||
tadbalaṃ pṛthivīśānāṃ hṛṣṭayodhajanākulam |
kṣveḍitāsphoṭitaravaṃ meghasainyamivābabhau || 9 ||
rathaiḥ pavanasaṃpātairgajaiśca jaladopamaiḥ |
turagaiśca sitābhrābhaiḥ pattibhiścāpi daṃśitaiḥ || 2.42.10 ||
vyāmiśraṃ tadbalaṃ bhāti mattadvipasamākulam |
gharmānte sāgaragataṃ yathābhrapaṭalaṃ tathā || 11 ||
sabalāste mahīpālā jarāsaṃdhapurogamāḥ |
parivārya giriṃ sarve niveśāyopacakramuḥ || 12 ||
babhau tasya niviṣṭasya balaśrīḥ śivirasya vai |
śukle parvaṇi pūrṇasya yathā rūpaṃ mahodadheḥ || 13 ||
vītarātre tataḥ kāle nṛpāste kṛtakautukāḥ |
ārohaṇārthaṃ śailasya sametā yuddhalālasāḥ || 14 ||
samavāyīkṛtāḥ sarve giriprastheṣu te nṛpāḥ |
niviṣṭā mantrayāmāsuryuddhakālakutūhalāḥ || 15 ||
eṣāṃ tu tumulaḥ śabdaḥ śuśruve pṛthivīkṣitām |
yugānte bhidyamānānāṃ sāgarāṇāṃ yathā svanaḥ || 16 ||
teṣāṃ sakañcukoṣṇīṣāḥ sthavirā vetrapāṇayaḥ |
cerurmā śabda ityevaṃ bruvanto rājaśāsanāt || 17 ||
tasya rūpaṃ balasyāsīnniḥśabdastimitasya vai |
līnamīnabhujaṅgasya niḥśabdasya payodadheḥ || 18 ||
tasmin stimitanidaśabde yogādiva mahārṇave |
jarāsandho bṛhadvākyaṃ bṛhaspatirivādade || 19 ||
śīghraṃ samabhivartantāṃ balānīha mahīkṣitām |

pāñcālādhipatiścaiva drupadaśca narādhipaḥ |

ahaṃ ca daradaścaiva cedirājaśca vīryavān |

eṣa bhūmidharo'dyaiva viṣamoccaśilānvitaḥ |

jarāsaṃdhavacaḥ śrutvā pārthivā rājaśāsanāt |

durārohaśca śikhare prāṃśupādapakaṇṭake |

sa vāyudīpito vahnirutpapāta samantataḥ |
sadhūmajvālamālābhirbhābhiḥ khamiva śobhayan || 55 ||
so'nalaḥ pavanāyastaḥ kāṣṭhasaṃcayamūlavān |

rītīrnirvartayāmāsa kāñcanāñjanarājatīḥ || 2.42.60 ||
vahninā cāpi dīptāṅgo girirnātivirājate |
dhūmāndhakārordhvatanurmajjamāna ivāmbudaḥ || 61 ||
viśliṣṭopalasaṃghātaḥ karkaśāṅgāravarṣaṇaḥ |

utpatyotpatya gaganāt punaḥ punaravāṅmukhāḥ |
resuścodvejitāḥ siṃhāḥ śārdūlāścānalāvilāḥ || 65 ||
mumucuḥ pādapāścaiva dāhaniryāsajaṃ jalam || 66 ||
vahatyūrdhvagatirvāto bhasmāṅgārātipiṅgalaḥ |
dhūmacchāyā ca gagane darpitāmbhodadarśanā || 67 ||

vajreṇa puruhūtasya yathā syād dāritastathā || 69 ||
ādīpya taṃ tu śailendraṃ kṣatriyā vyūhadaṃśitāḥ |
ardhakrośamapakrāntāḥ pāvakenābhitāpitāḥ || 2.42.70 ||
dahyamāne nagaśreṣṭhe sīdamānairmahādrumaiḥ |

dahyate'yaṃ giristāta sasānuśikharadrumaḥ |
āvayoḥ kṛṣṇa vaireṇa balibhirvasudhādhipaiḥ || 73 ||
paśya kṛṣṇānalauṣṇānāṃ sadhūmānāṃ samantataḥ |
vanānāṃ virasantīva nagābhyāśe dvipottamāḥ || 74 ||
ayaṃ yadyāvayorarthe gomantastāta dahyate |

tadasyānṛṇyahetorhi nagasya nagasaṃnibha |
kṣatriyānnihaniṣyāmo dorbhyāmeva yudhāṃ vara || 76 ||

kādambarīmadakṣībo nīlavāsāḥ sitānanaḥ |
sa śāradendusaṃkāśo vanamālāñcitodaraḥ || 79 ||
kāntaikakuṇḍaladharaścārumauliravāṅamukhaḥ |
nipapāta narendrāṇāṃ madhye keśavapūrvajaḥ || 2.42.80 ||
avaplute tato rāme kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇāmbudopamaḥ |
gomantaśikharācchrīmānāpluto'mitavikramaḥ || 81 ||

jalākulopalastatra prasruto dvirado yathā |

śrīvatsavakṣāḥ sumukhaḥ sahasrākṣasamadyutiḥ || 85 ||
rāmādanantaraṃ kṛṣṇaḥ pluto vai vīryavāṃstataḥ |

iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi gomantadāhe dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||42 ||

<2.43>

trayaścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tau nagādāplutau dṛṣṭvā vasudevasutāvubhau |
kṣubdhaṃ naravarānīkaṃ sarvaṃ sammūḍhavāhanam || 1 ||
bāhupraharaṇau tau tu ceratustatra yādavau |
makarāviva saṃrabdhau samudrakṣobhaṇāvubhau || 2 ||
tābhyāṃ mṛdhe praviṣṭābhyāṃ yādavābhyāṃ matistvabhūt |
āyudhānāṃ purāṇānāmādānakṛtalakṣaṇā || 3 ||
tato'mbaratalād bhūyaḥ patanti sma mahātmanoḥ |
madhye rājasahasrasya samaraṃ pratikāṅkṣiṇoḥ || 4 ||
yāni vai māthure yuddhe prāptānyāhavaśobhinoḥ |
tānyambarāt patanti sma divyānyāhavasamplave || 5 ||
lelihānāni dīptāni dīptāgnisadṛśāni vai |
nikṣipya yāni tatraiva tāni prāptau sma yādavau || 6 ||
kravyādairanuyātāni mūrtimanti bṛhanti ca |
tṛṣitānyāhave bhoktuṃ nṛpamāṃsāni sarvaśaḥ || 7 ||
divyasragdāmadhārīṇi trāsayanti ca khecarān |
prabhayā bhāsamānāni daṃśitāni diśo daśa || 8 ||
halaṃ sāṃvartakaṃ nāma saunandaṃ musalaṃ tathā |
cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ nāma gadāṃ kaumodakīṃ tathā || 9 ||
catvāryetāni tejāṃsi viṣṇupraharaṇāni vai |
tābhyāṃ samavatīrṇāni yādavābhyāṃ mahāmṛdhe || 2.43.10 ||
jagrāha prathamaṃ rāmo lalāmapratimaṃ raṇe |
sarpantamiva sarpendraṃ divyamālākulaṃ halam || 11 ||
savyena sātvatāṃ śreṣṭho jagrāha musalottamam |
saunandaṃ nāma balavān nirānandakaraṃ dviṣām || 12 ||
darśanīyaṃ ca lokeṣu cakramādityavarcasam |
nāmnā sudarśanaṃ nāma prīto jagrāha keśavaḥ || 13 ||
darśanīyaṃ ca lokeṣu dhanurjaladaniḥsvanam | |
nāmnā śārṅgamiti khyātaṃ prīto jagrāha vīryavān || 14 ||
devairnigaditārthasya gadā tasyāpare kare |
niṣaktā kumudākṣasya nāmnā kaumodakīti sā || 15 ||
tau sapraharaṇau vīrau sākṣādviṣṇutanūpamau |
samare rāmagovindau ripūṃstān pratyayuddhyatām|| 16 ||
āyudhapragrahau vīrau tāvanyonyamayāvubhau |
pūrvajānujasaṃjñau tu rāmagovindalakṣaṇau || 17 ||
samare'pratirūpau tau viṣṇureko dvidhā kṛtaḥ |
dviṣatsu pratikurvāṇau parākrāntau yatheśvarau || 18 ||
halamudyamya rāmastu sarpendramiva kopanam|
cacāra samare vīro dviṣatāmantakopamaḥ || 19 ||
vikarṣan rathavṛndāni kṣatriyāṇāṃ mahātmanām |
cakāra roṣaṃ saphalaṃ nāgeṣu ca hayeṣu ca || 2.43.20 ||
kuñjarām̐llāṅgalotkṣiptān musalākṣepatāḍitān |
rāmo'bhirāmaḥ samare nirmamantha yathācalān || 21 ||
te vadhyamānā rāmeṇa samare kṣatriyarṣabhāḥ |
jarāsaṃdhāntikaṃ bhītā virathāḥ pratijagmire || 22 ||
tānuvāca jarāsaṃdhaḥ kṣatradharme vyavasthitaḥ |
dhigetāṃ kṣatravṛttiṃ vaḥ samare kātarātmanām || 23 ||
parākrāntasya samare virathasya palāyataḥ |
bhrūṇahatyāmivāsahyāṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ || 24 ||
pattino bhuvi caikasya gopasyālpabalīyasaḥ |
bhītāḥ kiṃ vinivartadhvaṃ dhigetāṃ kṣatravṛttitām || 25 ||
kṣipraṃ samabhivartantāṃ mama vākyena noditāḥ |
yāvadetau raṇe gopau preṣayāmi yamakṣayam || 26 ||
tataste kṣatriyāḥ sarve jarāsaṃdhena noditāḥ |
kṣipantaḥ śarajālāni hṛṣṭā yoddhumupasthitāḥ || 27 ||
te hayaiḥ kāñcanāpīḍai rathaiścendusamaprabhaiḥ |
nāgaiścāmbhodasaṃkāśairmahāmātrapraṇoditaiḥ || 28 ||
satanutrāṇanistriṃśāḥ sāyudhābharaṇāmbarāḥ |
svāropitadhanuṣmantaḥ satūṇīrāḥ sasāyakāḥ || 29 ||
sacchatrotsedhinaḥ sarve cārucāmaravījitāḥ |
raṇāvanigatā rejuḥ syandanasthā mahīkṣitaḥ || 2.43.30 ||
tau yuddharaṅgāpatitau vidhāvantau mahābhujau |
vasudevasutau vīrau yuyutsū pratyadṛśyatām || 31 ||
tad yuddhamabhavattatra tayosteṣāṃ tu saṃyugaṃ |
sāyakotsargabahulaṃ gadānirghātadāruṇam || 32 ||
tataḥ śarasahasrāṇi pratīcchantau raṇeṣiṇau |
tasthaturyodhamukhyau tāvabhivṛṣṭau yathācalau || 33 ||
gadābhiścaiva gurvībhiḥ kṣepaṇīyaiśca mudgaraiḥ |
ardyamānau maheṣvāsau yādavau na cakampatuḥ || 34 ||
tataḥ kṛṣṇo'mbudākāraḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ
vyavardhata mahātejā vātayukta ivānalaḥ || 35 ||
sa cakreṇārkatulyena dīpyamānena tejasā |
ciccheda samare vīro nṛgajāśvamahārathān || 36 ||
gadānipātavihatā lāṅgalena ca karṣitāḥ |
na śekuste raṇe sthātuṃ pārthivā naṣṭacetasaḥ || 37 ||
cakrakṣuranikṛttāni vicitrāṇi mahīkṣitām |
rathayūthāni bhagnāni na śekuścalituṃ raṇe || 38 ||
musalākṣepabhagnāśca kuñjarāḥ ṣaṣṭihāyanāḥ |
ghanā iva ghanāpāye bhagnadantā vicukruśuḥ || 39 ||
cakrānalajvālahatāḥ sādinaḥ sapadātayaḥ |
petuḥ parāsavastatra yathā vajrahatāstathā || 2.43.40 ||
cakralāṅgalanirdagdhaṃ tatsainyaṃ vidalīkṛtam |
yugāntopahataprakhyaṃ sarvaṃ patitamābabhau || 41 ||
ākrīḍabhūmiṃ divyānāmāyudhānāṃ vapuṣmatām |
vaiṣṇavānāṃ nṛpāste tu draṣṭumapyabalīyasaḥ || 42 ||
kecidrathā sammṛditāḥ kecinnihatapārthivāḥ |
bhagnaikacakrāstvapare vikīrṇā dharaṇītale || 43 ||
tasmin viśasane ghore cakralāṅgalasamplave |
dāruṇāni pravṛttāni rakṣāṃsyautpātikāni ca || 44 ||
ārtānāṃ kūjamānānāṃ pāṭitānāṃ ca veṇuvat |
anto na śakyate'nveṣṭuṃ nṛnāgarathavājinām || 45 ||
sā pātitanarendrāṇāṃ rudhirā''rdrā raṇakṣitiḥ |
yoṣeva candanārdrāṅgī bhairavā pratibhāti vai || 46 ||
narakeśāsthimajjāntraiḥ śātitānāṃ ca dantinām |
rudhiraughaplavastatra cchādayāmāsa medinīm || 47 ||
tasmin mahābhīṣaṇake naravāhanasaṃkṣaye |
śivānāmaśivaiḥ śabdairnādite ghoradarśane || 48 ||
ārtastanitasaṃnāde rudhirāmbuhradākule |
antakākrīḍasadṛśe nāgadehaiḥ samāvṛte || 49 ||
apāstairbāhubhiryodhaisturagaiśca vidāritaiḥ |
kaṅkaiśca balagṛdhraiśca nāditaiḥ pratinādite || 2.43.50 ||
nipāte pṛthivīśānāṃ mṛtyusādhāraṇe raṇe |
kṛṣṇaḥ śatruvadhaṃ kartuṃ cacārāntakadarśanaḥ || 51 ||
yugāntārkaprabhaṃ cakraṃ kālīṃ caivāyasīṃ gadām |

ahaṃ sapūrvajaḥ saṃkhye padātiḥ pramukhe sthitaḥ || 53 ||

mṛdhe lokavariṣṭhābhyāṃ kuñjarābhyāmivaujasā || 57 ||
yojayitvā tataḥ skandhe rāmo daradamāhave |

rāmeṇa nihate tasmin darade rājasattame |
jarāsaṃdhasya rājñastu rāmeṇāsītsamāgamaḥ || 2.43.60 ||
mahendrasyeva vṛtreṇa dāruṇo lomaharṣaṇaḥ |
gade gṛhītvā vikrāntāvanyonyamabhidhāvataḥ || 61 ||
kampayantau bhuvaṃ vīrau tāvudyatamahāgadau |
dadṛśāte mahātmānau girī saśikharāviva || 62 ||
vyupāramanta yuddhāni prekṣya tau puruṣarṣabhau |
saṃrabdhāviva dhāvantau gadāyuddheṣu viśrutau || 63 ||
tāvubhau paramācāryau loke khyātau mahābalau |
mattāviva mahānāgāvanyonyaṃ samadhāvatām || 64 ||
tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ |
yakṣāścāpsarasaścaiva samājagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ || 65 ||
taddevayakṣagandharvamaharṣibhiralaṃkṛtam |
śuśubhe'bhyadhikaṃ rājan nabho jyotirgaṇairiva || 66 ||
abhidudrāva rāmaṃ tu jarāsaṃdho narādhipaḥ |
savyaṃ maṇḍalamāśritya baladevastu dakṣiṇam || 67 ||
tāvanyonyaṃ prajahrāte gadāyuddhaviśāradau |
dantābhyāmiva mātaṅgau nādayantau diśo daśa || 68 ||
gadānipāto rāmasya śuśruve'śaniniḥsvanaḥ |
jarāsaṃdhasya ca raṇe parvatasyeva dīryataḥ || 69 ||
na sma kampayate rāmaṃ jarāsaṃdhakaracyutā |
gadā gadābhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vindhyaṃ girimivānilaḥ || 2.43.70 ||
rāmasya tu gadāvegaṃ rājā sa magadheśvaraḥ |
sehe dhairyeṇa mahatā śikṣayā ca vyapothayat || 71 ||
tato'ntarikṣe vāgāsīt susvarā lokasākṣiṇī |
na tvayā rāma vadhyo'yamalaṃ khedena mānada ||72||
vihito'sya mayā mṛtyustasmātsādhu vyupārama |
acireṇaiva kālena prāṇāṃstyakṣyati māgadhaḥ ||73|||
jarāsaṃdhastu tacchrutvā vimanāḥ samapadyata |
na prāharat tatastasmai punareva halāyudhaḥ |
tau vyupāramatāṃ yuddhādvṛṣṇayaste ca pārthivāḥ || 74 ||
dīrghakālaṃ mahārāja nijaghnuritaretaram |
parājite tvapakrānte jarāsaṃdhe mahīpatau |
viviktamabhavat sainyaṃ parāvṛttamahāratham || 75 ||
te nṛpāścoditairnāgaiḥ syandanaisturagaistathā |
dudruvurbhītamanaso vyāghrāghrātā mṛgā iva || 76 |
tannarendraiḥ parityaktaṃ bhagnadarpairmahārathaiḥ |
ghoraṃ kravyādabahulaṃ raudramāyodhanaṃ babhau || 77 ||
dravatsu rathamukhyeṣu cedirājo mahādyutiḥ |
smṛtvā yādavasambandhaṃ kṛṣṇamevānvavartata || 78 ||
vṛtaḥ kārūṣasainyena cedisainyena cānagha |
sambandhakāmo govindamidamāha sa cedirāṭ || 79 ||
ahaṃ pitṛṣvasurbhartā tava yādavanandana |
sabalastvāmupāvṛttastvaṃ hi me dayitaḥ prabho || 2.43.80 ||
uktaścaiṣa mayā rājā jarāsaṃdho'lpacetanaḥ |
kṛṣṇād virama durbuddhe vigrahād raṇakarmaṇi || 81 ||
tadeṣo'dya mayā tyakto mama vākyasya dūṣakaḥ |
bhagno yuddhe jarāsaṃdhastvayā dravati sānugaḥ || 82 ||
nirvairo naiṣa saṃyāti svapuraṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ |
tvayyeva bhūyo'pyaparaṃ darśayiṣyati kilbiṣam || 83 ||
tadimāṃ saṃtyajāśu tvaṃ mahīṃ hatanarākulām |
kravyādagaṇasaṃkīrṇāṃ sevitavyāmamānuṣaiḥ || 84 ||
karavīrapuraṃ kṛṣṇa gacchāmaḥ sabalānugāḥ |
śṛgālaṃ vāsudevaṃ vai drakṣyāmastatra pārthivam || 85 ||
imau rathavarodagrau yuvayoḥ kāritau mayā |
yojitau śīghraturagaiḥ svaṅgacakrākṣakūbarau || 86 ||
śīghramāruha bhadraṃ te baladevasahāyavān |
tvarāmaḥ karavīrasthaṃ draṣṭuṃ taṃ vasudhādhipam || 87 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
pitṛṣvasṛpatervākyaṃ śrutvā cedipatestadā |
vākyaṃ hṛṣṭamanāḥ kṛṣṇo jagāda jagato guruḥ || 88 ||
aho yuddhābhisaṃtaptau deśakālocitaṃ tvayā |
bāndhavapratirūpeṇa saṃsiktau vacanāmbunā || 89 ||
deśakālaviśiṣṭasya hitasya madhurasya ca |
vākyasya durlabhā loke vaktāraścedisattama || 2.43.90 ||
cedinātha sanāthau svaḥ saṃvṛttau tava darśanāt |
nāvayoḥ kiṃcidaprāpyaṃ yayostvaṃ bandhurīdṛśaḥ || 91 ||
jarāsaṃdhasya nidhanaṃ ye cānye tatsamā nṛpāḥ |
paryāptau tvatsanāthau svaḥ kartuṃ cedikulodvaha || 92 ||
yadūnāṃ prathamo bandhustvaṃ hi sarvamahīkṣitām |
ataḥ prabhṛti saṃgrāmān drakṣyase cedisattama || 93 ||
cākraṃ mausalamityevaṃ saṃgrāmaṃ raṇavṛttayaḥ |
kathayiṣyanti loke'sminye dhariṣyanti pārthivāḥ||94||
rājñāṃ parājayaṃ yuddhe gomante'calasattame |
śravaṇād dhāraṇād vāpi svargalokaṃ vrajanti hi || 95||
tadgacchāma mahārāja karavīraṃ purottamam |
tvayoddiṣṭena mārgeṇa cedirāja śivāya vai || 96 ||
te syandanagatāḥ sarve pavanotpātibhirhayaiḥ |
bhejire dīrghamadhvānaṃ mūrtimanta ivāgnayaḥ || 97 ||
te trirātroṣitāḥ prāptāḥ karavīraṃ purottamam |
śivāya ca śive deśe niviṣṭāstridaśopamāḥ || 98 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi karavīrapurābhigamane tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 43 ||

<2.44>

catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tānāgatān viditvātha śṛgālo yuddhadurmadaḥ |
purasya dharṣaṇaṃ matvā nirjagāmendravikramaḥ || 1 ||
rathenādityavarṇena bhāsvatā raṇagāminā |
āyudhapratipūrṇena neminirghoṣahāsinā || 2 ||
mandarācalakalpena citrābharaṇabhūṣiṇā |
akṣayyasāyakaistūṇaiḥ pūrṇenārṇavaghoṣiṇā || 3 ||
haryaśvenāśugatināsaktena śikhareṣvapi |
hemakūbaragarbheṇa dṛḍhākṣeṇātiśobhinā || 4 ||
subandhureṇa dīptena patattrivaragāminā |
svagateneva śakrasya haryaśvena rathādriṇā || 5 ||
sāvitre niyame pūrṇe yaṃ dadau savitā svayam |
ādityaraśmibhiriva raśmibhiryo nigṛhyate || 6 ||
tena syandanamukhyena dviṣatsyandanaghātinā |
sa śṛgālo'bhyayātkṛṣṇaṃ śalabhaḥ pāvakaṃ yathā || 7 ||
cāpapāṇiḥ sutīkṣṇeṣuḥ kavacī hemamālikaḥ |
sitaprāvaraṇoṣṇīṣaḥ pāvakākāralocanaḥ || 8 ||
muhurmuhurjyācapalaṃ vikṣipan duḥsahaṃ dhanuḥ |
nirvaman roṣajaṃ vāyuṃ sānalajvālamaṇḍalam || 9 ||
bhābhirbhūṣaṇapaṃktīnāṃ dīpto merurivācalaḥ |
rathastha iva śailendraḥ śṛgālaḥ pratyadṛśyata || 2.44.10 ||
tasyārasitaśabdena rathanemisvanena ca |
gurutvena ca nāmyantī cacālorvī bhayāturā || 11 ||
tamāpatantaṃ śrīmantaṃ mūrtimantamivācalam |
śṛgālaṃ lokapālābhaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇo na vivyathe || 12 ||
śṛgālaścāpi saṃrabdhaḥ syandanenāśugāminā |
samīpe vāsudevasya yuyutsuḥ pratyadṛśyata || 13 ||
vāsudevaṃ sthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā śṛgālo yuddhalālasaḥ |
abhidudrāva vegena megharāśirivācalam || 14 ||
vāsudevaḥ smitaṃ kṛtvā pratiyuddhāya tasthivān |
tad yuddhamabhavat tābhyāṃ samare ghoradarśanam |
ubhābhyāmiva mattābhyāṃ kuṃjarābhyāṃ yathā vane || 15 ||
śṛgālastvabravītkṛṣṇaṃ samare samupasthitam |
yuddharāgeṇa tejasvī mohāccalitagauravaḥ || 16 ||
gomante yuddhamārgeṇa yat tvayā kṛṣṇa ceṣṭitam |
anāyakānāṃ mūrkhāṇāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ durbale bale || 17 ||
sa me suviditaḥ kṛṣṇa kṣatriyāṇāṃ parājayaḥ |
kṛpaṇānāmasattvānāmayuddhānāṃ raṇotsave || 18 ||
tiṣṭhedānīṃ yathākāmaṃ sthito'haṃ pārthive pade |
kva yāsyasi mayā ruddho raṇeṣvapariniṣṭhitaḥ ||
na cāhamekaṃ sabalo yuktastvāṃ yoddhumāhave |
ahamekastvamapyeko dvau yudhyāva raṇe sthitau || 2.44.20 ||
kiṃ janena nirastena tvaṃ vāhaṃ ca raṇe sthitaḥ |
dharmayuddhena nidhanaṃ vrajatvekataro raṇe || 21 ||
loke'sminvāsudevo'haṃ bhaviṣyāmi hate tvayi |
hate mayi tvamapyeko vāsudevo bhaviṣyasi || 22 ||
śṛgālasya vacaḥ śrutvā vāsudevaḥ kṣamāparaḥ |
īrṣyantaṃ praharasveti tamuktvā cakramādade || 23 ||
tataḥ sāyakajālāni śṛgālaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ |
cikṣepa kṛṣṇe ghorāṇi yuddhāya laghuvikramaḥ || 24||
śastrāṇi yāni cānyāni musalādyāni saṃyuge |
pātayāmāsa govinde sa śṛgālaḥ pratāpavān || 25 ||
śṛgālaprahitairastraiḥ pāvakajvālamālibhiḥ |
nirdayābhihataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sthito giririvācalaḥ || 26 ||
so'straprahārābhihataḥ kiṃcid roṣasamanvitaḥ |
cakramudyamya govindaḥ śṛgālasya parikṣipat || 27 ||
taṃ rathasthaṃ pramāṇasthaṃ śṛgālaṃ yuddhadurmadam |
jaghāna samare cakraṃ jātadarpaṃ mahābalam || 28 ||
tataḥ sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ punarāyād guroḥ kare |
cakreṇorasi nirbhinnaḥ sa gatāsurgatotsavaḥ |
papāta kṣatajasrāvī śṛgālo'dririvāhataḥ || 29 ||
niśamya taṃ nipatitaṃ vajrapātādivācalam |
tasya sainyānyapayayurvimanāṃsi hate nṛpe || 2.44.30 ||
kecit praviśya nagaraṃ kaśmalābhihatā bhṛśam |
rurudurduḥkhasaṃtaptā bhartṛśokābhipīḍitāḥ || 31 ||
kecittatraiva śocantaḥ smarantaḥ sukṛtāni ca |
patitaṃ bhūpatiṃ bhūmau na tyajanti sma duḥkhitāḥ || 32 ||
tato meghaninādena svareṇārivimardanaḥ |
kṛṣṇaḥ kamalapatrākṣo janānāmabhayaṃ dadau || 33 |
cakrocitena hastena rājatāguṅliparvaṇā |
na bhetavyaṃ na bhetavyamiti tānabhyabhāṣata || 34 ||
nāsya pāpasya doṣeṇa nirāvādhakaraṃ janam |
ghātayiṣyāmi samare nedaṃ śūravrataṃ matam||35||
aśrupūrṇamukhā dīnāḥ krandamānā bhṛśaṃ tadā |
te sma paśyanti patitaṃ dharaṇyāṃ dharaṇīpatim || 36 ||
cakranirdāritoraskaṃ bhinnaśṛṅgamivācalam || 37 ||
vilapanti sma te sarve sacivāḥ saprajā bhṛśam |
sāśrupātekṣaṇā dīnāḥ śokasya vaśamāgatāḥ || 38 ||
teṣāṃ ruditaśabdena paurāṇāṃ visvaraiḥ svaraiḥ |
mahiṣyastasya niṣpetuḥ saputrā ruditānanāḥ || 39 |
tāstaṃ nipatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā ślāghyaṃ bhūmipatiṃ patim |
stanānārujya karajairbhṛśārtāḥ paryadevayan || 2.44.40 ||
urāṃsyurasijāṃścaiva śirojānyākulānyapi |
nirdayaṃ tāḍayantyastā visvaraṃ ruruduḥ striyaḥ || 41 ||
tasyorasi suduḥkhārtā mṛditāḥ klinnalocanāḥ |
peturūrdhvabhujāḥ sarvāśchinnamūlā latā iva || 42 ||
tāsāṃ bāṣpāmbupūrṇāni netrāṇi nṛpayoṣitām |
vāriviprahatānīva paṅkajāni cakāśire || 43 ||
putraṃ cāsya puraskṛtya bālaṃ prasnutalocanam |
śakradevaṃ pituḥ pārśve dviguṇaṃ ruruduḥ striyaḥ || 45 ||
ayaṃ te vīra vikrānto bālaḥ putro na paṇḍitaḥ ||
tvaddhihīnaḥ kathamayaṃ pade sthāsyāta paitṛke || 46 ||
kathamekapade tyaktvā gato'syantaḥpuraṃ param |
atṛptāstava saukhyānāṃ kiṃ kurmo vidhavā vayam || 47 ||
tasya padmāvatī nāma mahiṣī pramadottamā |
rudatī putramādāya vāsudevamupasthitā || 48 ||
yastvayā pātito vīra raṇaproktena karmaṇā |
tasya pretagatasyāyaṃ putrastvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 49 ||
yadi tvāṃ praṇametāsau kuryāda vā śāsanaṃ tava |
nāyamekaprahāreṇa janastapyeta dāruṇam || 2.44.50 ||
yadi kuryādayaṃ mūḍhastvayi bāndhavakaṃ vidhim |
naivaṃ parītaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ seveta dharaṇītalam || 514
ayamasya vipannasya bāndhavasya tavānagha |
santatī rakṣyatāṃ vīra putraḥ putra ivātmajaḥ || 52 ||
tasyāstad vacanaṃ śrutvā mahiṣyā yadunandanaḥ |
mṛduparvamidaṃ vākyamuvāca vadatāṃ varaḥ || 53 ||
rājapatni gato roṣaḥ sahānena durātmanā |
prakṛtisthā vayaṃ jātā devi saiṣo'smi bāndhavaḥ || 54 ||
roṣo me vigataḥ sādhvi tava vākyairakalmaṣaiḥ |
yo'yaṃ putraḥ śṛgālasya mamāpyeṣa na saṃśayaḥ || 55 ||
abhayaṃ cābhiṣekaṃ ca dadāmyasmai sukhāya vai |
āhūyantāṃ prakṛtayaḥ purodhā mantriṇastathā || 56 ||
pitṛpaitāmahe rājye tava putro'bhiṣicyatām |
tataḥ prakṛtayaḥ sarvāḥ purodhā mantriṇastathā || 57 ||
abhiṣekārthamājagmuryato vai rāmakeśavau |
tataḥ siṃhāsanasthaṃ tu rājaputraṃ janārdanaḥ || 58 ||
abhiṣekeṇa divyena yojayāmāsa vīryavān |
abhiṣicya śṛgālasya karavīrapure sutam|
kṛṣṇastadaharevāśu prasthānamabhyarocayat || 59 ||
rathena hariyuktena tena yuddhārjitena vai |
keśavaḥ prasthito'dhvānaṃ vṛtrahā tridivaṃ yathā || 2.44.60 ||
śakradevo'pi dharmātmā saha mātrā paraṃtapaḥ |
sabālavṛddhayuvatīmukhyāḥ prakṛtayastathā || 61 ||
śibikāyāmathāropya śṛgālaṃ yuddhadurmadam|
saṃhatā dūramārgeṇa paścimābhimukhā yayuḥ || 62 ||
naidhanasya vidhānena cakruste tasya satkriyām |
satkāraṃ kārayāmāsuḥ pitṝṇāṃ pāralaukikam || 63 ||
uddiśyoddiśya rājānaṃ śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā sahasraśaḥ |
tataste salilaṃ dattvā nāmagotrādikīrtanaiḥ || 64 ||
pitaryuparate ghore śokasaṃvignamānasaḥ |
kṛtvodakaṃ tadā rājā praviveśa purottamam || 65 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi śṛgālavadho nāma catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 44 ||

<2.45>

pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tau tu svalpena kālena damaghoṣeṇa saṃgatau |
athādhvavidhinā tau tu pañcarātroṣitau pathi || 1 ||
damaghoṣeṇa saṃgamya ekarātroṣitāviva |
jagmatuḥ sahitau vīrau mudā paramayā yutau |
nagarīṃ mathurāṃ prāptau vasudevasutāvubhau || 2 ||
tataḥ pratyudgatāḥ sarve yādavā yadunandanau |
sabalā hṛṣṭamanasa ugrasenapurogamāḥ || 3 ||
śreṇyaḥ prakṛtayaścaiva mantriṇaśca yathocitāḥ |
sabālavṛddhā sā caiva purī samabhivartata || 4 ||
nanditūryāṇyavādyanta stūyetāṃ puruṣarṣabhau |
rathyāṃ patākāmālinyo bhāsanti sma samantataḥ || 5 ||
hṛṣṭā pramuditā sarvā purī paramaśobhitā |
bhrātrostayorāgamane yathaivendramahe tathā || 6 ||
muditāstatra gāyanti rājamārgeṣu gāyakāḥ |
stavāśīrbahulā gāthā yādavānāṃ priyaṃkarāḥ || 7 ||
govindarāmau samprāptau bhrātarau lokaviśrutau |
sve pure nirbhayāḥ sarve krīḍadhvaṃ yādavāḥ sukham || 8 ||
na tatra kaścid dīno vā malino vā vicetanaḥ |
mathurāyāmabhūt kaścid rāmakṛṣṇasamāgame || 9 ||
vayāṃsi sādhuvākyāni prahṛṣṭā gohayadvipāḥ |
naranārīgaṇāścaiva bhejire mānasaṃ sukham || 2.45.10 ||
śivāśca pravavurvātā virajaskā diśo daśa |
daivatānyapi sarvāṇi hṛṣyantyāyataneṣvatha || 11 ||
yāni liṅgāni lokasya vṛttānīha kṛte yuge |
tāni sarvāṇyadṛśyanta tayorāgamane tadā || 12 ||
tataḥ kāle śive puṇye syandanenārimardanau |
hariyuktena tau vīrau praviṣṭau mathurāṃ purīm || 13 ||
praviśantaṃ purīṃ ramyāṃ govindaṃ rāmameva ca |
anujagmuryadugaṇāḥ śakraṃ devagaṇā iva || 14 ||
vasudevasya bhavanaṃ pitustau yadunandanau |
praviṣṭau hṛṣṭavadanau candrādityāvivācalam || 15 ||
tatrāyudhāni saṃnyasya gṛhe sve svairacāriṇau |
mumudāte yaduvarau vasudevasutāvubhau || 16 ||
tatastu vasudevasya pādau samabhipīḍya ca |
tatrograsenaṃ rājānamanyāṃśca yadupuṅgavān || 17 ||
yathānyāyaṃ pūjayitvā tau sarvaiścābhinanditau |
jagmaturhṛṣṭamanasau mātureva niveśanam || 18 ||
evaṃ tāvekanirmāṇau mathurāyāṃ śubhānanau |
ugrasenānugau bhūtvā kaṃcitkālaṃ mumodatuḥ || 19 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi rāmakṛṣṇayormathurāṃ pratyāgamane pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāya || 45 ||

<2.46>

ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
kasyacit tvatha kālasya smṛtvā gopeṣu sauhṛdam|
jagāmaiko vrajaṃ rāmaḥ kṛṣṇasyānumate sthitaḥ || 1 ||
sa gatastatra ramyāṇi dadarśa vipulāni vai |
bhuktapūrvāṇyaraṇyāni sarāṃsi surabhīṇi ca || 2 ||
sa praviṣṭastu vegena taṃ vrajaṃ kṛṣṇapūrvajaḥ |
vanyena ramaṇīyena veṣeṇālaṃkṛtaḥ prabhuḥ || 3 ||
sa tānabhāṣata prītyā yathāpūrvamariṃdamaḥ |
gopāṃstenaiva vidhinā yathānyāyaṃ yathāvayaḥ || 4 ||
tathaiva prāha tāna sarvāṃstathaiva pariharṣayan |
tathaiva saha gopībhiryojayanmadhurāḥ kathāḥ || 5 ||
tamūcuḥ sthavirā gopāḥ priyaṃ madhurabhāṣiṇaḥ |
rāmaṃ ramayatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pravāsāt punarāgatam || 6 ||
svāgataṃ te mahābāho yadūnāṃ kulanandana |
adya sma nirvṛtāstāta yat tvāṃ paśyāmahe vayam|| 7 ||
prītāścaiva vayaṃ vīra yat tvaṃ punarihāgataḥ |
vikhyātastriṣu lokeṣu rāmaḥ śatrubhayaṃkaraḥ || 8 ||
vardhanīyā vayaṃ vīra tvayā yādavanandana |
athavā prāṇinastāta ramante janmabhūmiṣu || 9 ||
tridaśānāṃ vayaṃ mānyā dhruvamadyāmalānana |
ye sma dṛṣṭāstvayā tāta kāṅkṣamāṇāstavāgamam || 2.46.10||
diṣṭyā te nihatā mallāḥ kaṃsaśca vinipātitaḥ |
ugraseno'bhiṣiktaśca māhātmyena janena vai || 11 ||
samudre ca śruto'smābhistiminā saha vigrahaḥ |
vadhaḥ pañcajanasyaiva jarāsaṃdhena vigrahaḥ |
gomante ca śruto'smābhiḥ kṣatriyaiḥ saha vigrahaḥ| || 12 ||
daradasya vadhaścaiva jarāsaṃdhaparājayaḥ |
tatrāyudhāvataraṇaṃ śruta naḥ paramāhave || 13 ||
vadhaścaiva śṛgālasya karavīrapurottame |
tatsutasyābhiṣekaśca nāgarāṇāṃ ca sāntvanam || 14 ||
mathurāyāṃ praveśaśca kīrtanīyaḥ surottamaiḥ |
pratiṣṭhitā ca vasudhā pārthivāśca vaśīkṛtāḥ || 15 ||
tava cāgamanaṃ dṛṣṭvā sabhāgyāḥ sma yathā purā |
tena sma parituṣṭā vai hṛṣitāśca sabāndhavāḥ || 16 ||
pratyuvāca tato rāmaḥ sarvāṃstānabhitaḥ sthitān |
yādaveṣvapi sarveṣu bhavanto mama bāndhavāḥ || 17 ||
ihāvayorgataṃ bālyamiha caivāvayo ratam |
bhavadbhirvarddhitāścaiva yāsyāmo vikriyāṃ katham || 18 ||
gṛheṣu bhavatāṃ bhuktaṃ gāvaśca parirakṣitāḥ |
asmākaṃ bāndhavāḥ sarve bhavanto baddhasauhṛdāḥ || 19 ||
bruvatyevaṃ yathātattvaṃ gopamadhye halāyudhe |
saṃhṛṣṭavadanā bhūyo babhūburvrajayoṣitaḥ || 2.46.20 ||
tato vanāntaragato reme rāmo mahābalaḥ |
etasminnantare prāpte rāmāya viditātmane || 21 ||
gopālairdeśakālajñairupānīyata vāruṇī |
so'pibat pāṇḍurābhrābhastatkālaṃ jñātibhirvṛtaḥ||22||
vanāntaragato rāmaḥ pānaṃ madasamīraṇam |
upaninyustatastasmai vanyāni vividhāni ca || 23 ||
pratyagraramaṇīyāni puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca |
medhyāṃśca vividhān gandhān bhakṣyāṃśca hṛdayaṃgamān |
sadyo hṛtāni padmāni vikacānyutpalāni ca || 24 ||
śirasā cārukeśaina kiṃcidāvṛtamaulinā |
śravaṇaikāvalambena kuṇḍalena virājatā || 25 ||
candanārdreṇa pītena vanamālāvalambinā |
vibabhāvurasā rāmaḥ kailāseneva mandaraḥ || 26 ||
nīle vasāno vasane pratyagrajaladaprabhe |
rarāja vapuṣā śubhrastimiraughe yathā śaśī || 27 ||
lāṅgalenāvasiktena bhujagābhogavartinā |
tathā bhujāgraśliṣṭena musalena ca bhāsvatā || 28 ||
sa matto balināṃ śreṣṭho rarājāghūrṇitānanaḥ |
śaiśirīṣu triyāmāsu yathā svedālasaḥ śaśī || 29 ||
rāmastu yamunāmāha snātumicche mahānadi |
ehi māmabhigaccha tvaṃ rūpiṇī sāgaraṃgame || 2.46.30 ||
saṃkarṣaṇasya mattoktāṃ bhāratīṃ paribhūya sā |
nābhyavartata taṃ deśaṃ strīsvabhāvena mohitā || 31 ||
tataścukrodha balavān rāmo madasamīritaḥ |
cakāra sa halaṃ haste karṣaṇādhomukhaṃ balī || 32 ||
tasyāmupari medinyāṃ petustāmarasasrajaḥ |
mumucuḥ puṣpakośaiśca vāsareṇvaruṇaṃ jalam || 33 ||
sa halenānatāgreṇa kūle gṛhya mahānadīm |
cakarṣa yamunāṃ rāmo nyutthitāṃ vanitāmiva || 34 ||
sā vihvalajalasrotā hradaprasthitasaṃcayā |
vyāvartata nadī bhītā halamārgānusāriṇī || 35 ||
lāṅgalādiṣṭavartmā sā vegagā vakragāminī |
saṃkarṣaṇabhayatrastā yoṣevākulatāṃ gatā || 36 ||
pulinaśroṇibimbauṣṭhī mṛditaistoyatāḍitaiḥ |
phenamekhalasūtraiśca cchinnairambudagāminī || 37 ||
taraṅgaviṣamāpīḍā cakravākonmukhastanī |
vegagambhīravakrāṅgī trastamīnavibhūṣaṇā || 38 ||
sitahaṃsekṣaṇāpāṅgī kāśakṣaumocchritāmbarā |
tīrajodbhūtakeśāntā jalaskhalitagāminī || 39 ||
lāṅgalollikhitāpāṅgī kṣubhitā sāgaraṃgamā |
matteva kuṭilā nārī rājamārgeṇa gacchatī || 2.46.40 ||
kṛṣyate sātivegena srotaḥskhalitagāminī |
unmārgānītamārgā sā yena vṛndāvanaṃ vanam || 41 ||
vṛndāvanasya madhyena sā nītā yamunā nadī |
rorūyamāṇeva khagairanvitā toyavāsibhiḥ || 42 ||
sā yadā samatikrāntā nadī vṛndāvanaṃ vanam |
tadā strīrūpiṇī bhūtvā yamunā rāmamabravīt || 43 ||
prasīda nātha bhītāsmi pratilomena karmaṇā |
viparītamidaṃ rūpaṃ toyaṃ ca mama jāyate || 44 ||
asatyahaṃ nadīmadhye rauhiṇeya tvayā kṛtā |
karṣaṇena mahābāho svamārgavyabhicāriṇī || 45 ||
prāptāṃ māṃ sāgare pūrvaṃ sapatnyo vegagarvitāḥ |
phenahāsairhasiṣyanti toyavyāvṛttagāminīm || 46 ||
prasādaṃ kuru me vīra yāce tvāṃ kṛṣṇapūrvaja |
suprasannamanā nityaṃ bhava tvaṃ surasattama || 47 ||
karṣaṇāyudhakṛṣṭāsmi roṣo'yaṃ vinivartyatām |
mūrdhnā gacchāmi caraṇau tavaiṣā lāṅgalāyudha |
mārgamādiṣṭamicchāmi kva gacchāmi mahābhuja || 48 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
praṇayāvanatāṃ dṛṣṭvā yamunāṃ lāṅgalāyudhaḥ |
pratyuvācārṇavavadhūṃ madaklānta ida vacaḥ || 49 ||
lāṅgalādiṣṭamārgā tvamimaṃ me priyadarśane |
deśamambupradānena plāvayasvākhilaṃ śubhe || 2.46.50 ||
eṣa te subhru saṃdeśaḥ kathitaḥ sāgaraṃgame |
śāntiṃ vraja mahābhāge gamyatāṃ ca yathāsukham || 51 ||
yāvatsthāsyati loko'yaṃ tāvattiṣṭhatu me yaśaḥ|
yamunākarṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve te vrajavāsinaḥ || 52 ||
sādhu sādhviti rāmāya praṇāmaṃ cakrire tadā |
tāṃ visṛjya mahābhāgā tāṃśca sarvān vrajaukasaḥ|| 53 ||
tataḥ saṃcintya manasā rāmaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ |
punaḥ pratijagāmāśu mathurāṃ rohiṇīsutaḥ || 54 ||
sa gatvā mathurāṃ rāmo bhavanaṃ madhusūdanam |
parivartamānaṃ dadṛśe pṛthivyāḥ sāramavyayam || 55 ||
tathaivādhvanyaveṣeṇa sopaśliṣṭo janārdanam |
pratyagravanamālena vakṣasābhivirājatā || 56 ||
sa dṛṣṭvā tūrṇamāyāntaṃ rāmaṃ lāṅgaladhāriṇam |
sahasotthāya govindo dadāvāsanamuttamam || 57 ||
upaviṣṭaṃ tadā rāmaṃ papraccha kuśalaṃ vraje |
bāndhaveṣu ca sarveṣu goṣu caiva janārdanaḥ || |58 ||
pratyuvāca tato rāmo bhrātaraṃ sādhubhāṣiṇam |
sarvatra kuśalaṃ kṛṣṇa yeṣāṃ kuśalamicchasi || 59 ||
tatastayorvicitrārthāḥ paurāṇyaścābhavan kathāḥ |
vasudevāgrataḥ puṇyā rāmakeśavayostadā || 2.46.60 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi yamunākarṣaṇe ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 46 ||

<2.47>

saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
etasminnantare prāptā lokaprāvṛttikā narāḥ |
cakrāyudhagṛhaṃ sarve lokapālagṛhopamam || 1 ||
teṣvātyayikaśaṃsīṣu lokaprāvṛttikeṣviha |
kṛtasaṃjñā yaduśreṣṭhāḥ sametāḥ kṛṣṇasaṃsadi || 2 ||
samāgateṣu sarveṣu yadumukhyeṣu saṃsadi |
prāvṛttikā narāḥ prāhuḥ pārthivātyayikaṃ vacaḥ || 3 ||
janārdana narendrāṇāṃ pārthivānāṃ samāgamaḥ |
bhaviṣyati kṣitīśānāṃ samūḍhānāmanekaśaḥ || 4 ||
tvaritāstatra gacchanti nānājanapadeśvarāḥ |
kuṇḍine puṇḍarīkākṣa bhojaputrasya śāsanāt|| 5 ||
prakāśaṃ sma kathāstatra śrūyante manujeritāḥ |
rukmiṇī kila nāmāsti rukmiṇaḥ prathamā svasā|| 6 ||
bhāvī svayaṃvarastatra tasyāḥ kila janārdana |
ityarthamete sabalā gacchanti manujādhipāḥ || 7 ||
tasyāstrailokyasundaryāstṛtīye'hani yādava |
rukmabhūṣaṇabhūṣiṇyā bhaviṣyati svayaṃvaraḥ || 8 ||
rājñāṃ tatra sametānāṃ hastyaśvarathagāminām |
drakṣyāmaḥ śataśastatra śibirāṇi mahātmanām || 9 ||
siṃhaśārdūladṛptānāṃ mattadviradagāmināma |
sadā yuddhapriyāṇāṃ hi parasparamamarṣiṇām || 2.47.10 ||
jayāya śīghraṃ sahitā balaughena samanvitāḥ |
niruddhāḥ pṛthivīpālāḥ kimekāntacarā vayam |
nirutsāhā bhaviṣyāmo gacchāmo yadunandana || 11 ||
śrutvaitatkeśavo vākyaṃ hṛdi śalyamivārpitam |
nirjagāma yaduśreṣṭho yadūnāṃ sahito balaiḥ || 12 ||
yādavāste balodagrāḥ sarve saṃgrāmalālasāḥ |
niryayuḥ syandanavarairgarvitāstridaśā iva || 13 ||
balāgreṇa niyuktena harirīśānasammataḥ |
cakrodyatakaraḥ kṛṣṇo gadāpāṇirvyarocata || 14 ||
yādavāścāpare tatra vāsudevānuyāyinaḥ |
rathairādityasaṃkāśaiḥ kiṅkiṇīpratināditaiḥ || 15 ||
ugrasenaṃ tu govindaḥ prāha niścitadarśanaḥ |
tiṣṭha tvaṃ nṛpaśārdūla bhrātrā me sahito'nagha || 16 ||
kṣattriyā vikṛtiprajñāḥ śāstraniścitadarśanāḥ |
purīṃ śūnyāmimāṃ vīra jaghanye'bhipatanti ha || 17 ||
asmākaṃ śaṅkitāḥ sarve jarāsaṃdhavaśānugāḥ |
modante sukhinastatra devaloke yathāmarāḥ || 18 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā bhojarājo mahāyaśāḥ |
kṛṣṇasnehena vikṛtaṃ babhāṣe vacanāmṛtam || 19 ||
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho yadūnāṃ nandivarddhana |
śrūyatāṃ yadahaṃ tvadya vakṣyāmi ripusūdana || 2.47.20 ||
tvayā vihīnāḥ sarve sma na śaktāḥ sukhamāsitum |
pure'sminviṣayānte vā patihīnā iva striyaḥ || 21 ||
tvatsanāthā vayaṃ tāta tvadbāhubalamāśritāḥ |
bibhīmo | narendrāṇāṃ sendrāṇāmapi mānada || 22 ||
vijayāya yaduśreṣṭha yatra yatra gamiṣyasi |
tatra tvaṃ sahito'smābhirgacchethā yādavarṣabha || 23 ||
tasya rājño vacaḥ śrutvā sasmitaṃ devakīsutaḥ |
yatheṣṭaṃ bhavatāmadya tathā kartāsmyasaṃśayam || 24 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evamuktvā tu vai kṛṣṇo jagāmāśu rathena vai |
bhīṣmakasya gṛhaṃ prāpto lohitāyati bhāskare || 25 ||
prāpte rājasamāje tu śibirākīrṇabhūtale |
raṅgaṃ suvipulaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājasīṃ tanumāviśat || 26 ||
vitrāsanārthaṃ bhūpānāṃ prakāśārthaṃ purātanam |
manasā cintayāmāsa vainateyaṃ mahābalam || 27 ||
tataścintitamātrastu viditvā vinatātmajaḥ |
sukhalakṣyam̐ vapuḥ kṛtvā nililye keśavāntike || 28 ||
tasya pakṣanipātena pavanodbhrāntakāriṇā |
kampitā manujāḥ sarve nyubjāśca patitā bhuvi || 29 ||
garuḍābhihatāḥ sarve praceṣṭanto yathoragāḥ |
tān saṃnipatitān dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇo giririvācalaḥ ||2.47.30 ||
sa tadā pakṣavātena mene patagasattamam |
dadarśa garuḍaṃ prāptaṃ divyasraganulepanam || 31 ||
pakṣavātena pṛthivīṃ cālayantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ |
pṛṣṭhāsaktaiḥ praharaṇairlelihyantamivoragaiḥ || 32 ||
vaiṣṇavaṃ hastasaṃśleṣaṃ manyamānamavāṅmukham |
caraṇābhyāṃ prakarṣantaṃ pāṇḍuraṃ bhogināṃ varam || 33 ||
hemapatrairupacitaṃ dhātumantamivācalam |
amṛtārambhahartāraṃ dvijihvendravināśanam || 34 ||
trāsanaṃ daityasaṃghānāṃ vāhanaṃ dhvajalakṣaṇam |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sa dhvajaṃ prāptaṃ sacivaṃ sāmparāyikam || 35 ||
dhṛtimantaṃ garutmantaṃ jagāda madhusūdanaḥ |
dṛṣṭvā paramasaṃhṛṣṭaḥ sthitaṃ devamivāparam |
tulyasāmarthyayā vācā garutmantamavasthitam || 36 ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
svāgataṃ khecaraśreṣṭha surasenārimardana |
vinatāhṛdayānanda svāgataṃ keśavapriya || 37 ||
vraja patrarathaśreṣṭha kaiśikasya niveśanam |
vayaṃ tatraiva gatvādya pratīkṣāma svayaṃvaram || 38 ||
rājñāṃ tatra sametānāṃ hastyaśvarathagāminām |
drakṣyāmaḥ śataśastatra sametānāṃ mahātmanām || 39 ||
evamuktvā mahābāhurvainateyaṃ mahābalam |
jagāmātha purīṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kaiśikasya mahātmanaḥ || 2.47.40 ||
vainateyasakhaḥ śrīmān yādavaiśca mahārathaiḥ |
vidarbhanagarīṃ prāpte kṛṣṇe devakinandane || 41 ||
hṛṣṭāḥ pramuditāḥ sarve nivāsāyopacakramuḥ |
sarve śastrāyudhadharā rājāno balaśālinaḥ || 42 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
etasminneva kāle tu rājā nayaviśāradaḥ |
kaiśikastata utthāya prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā || 43 ||
arghyamācamanaṃ dattvā sa rājā kaiśikaḥ svayam |
satkṛtya vidhivat kṛṣṇaṃ svapuraṃ sampraveśayat || 44 ||
pūrvameva tu kṛṣṇāya kāritaṃ divyamandiram |
viveśa sabalaḥ śrīmān kailāsaṃ śaṃkaro yathā || 45 ||
khādyapānādiratnaughairarcito vāsavānujaḥ |
sukhena uṣitaḥ kṛṣṇastasya rājño niveśane |
pūjitau bahumānena snehapūrṇena cetasā || 46 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi rukmiṇīsvayaṃvare saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 47 ||

<2.48>

aṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
te kṛṣṇamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā vainateyasahācyutam |
babhūvuścintayāviṣṭāḥ sarve nṛpatisattamāḥ || 1 ||
te sametya sabhāṃ rājan rājāno bhīmavikramāḥ |
mantrāya mantrakuśalā nītiśāstrārthavittamāḥ || 2 ||
bhīṣmakasya sabhāṃ gatvā ramyāṃ hemapariṣkṛtām |
siṃhāsaneṣu citreṣu vicitrāstaraṇeṣu ca |
niṣeduste nṛpavarā devā devasabhāmiva || 3 ||
teṣāṃ madhye mahābāhurjarāsaṃdho mahābalaḥ |
vabhāṣe sa mahātejā devān deveśvaro yathā || 4 ||
jarāsaṃdha uvāca
śrūyatāṃ bho nṛpaśreṣṭhā bhīṣmakaśca mahāmatiḥ |
kathyamānaṃ mayā buddhyā vacanaṃ vadatāṃ varāḥ || 5 ||
yo'sau kṛṣṇa iti khyāto vasudevasuto balī |
vainateyasahāyena samprāptaḥ kuṇḍinaṃ tviha || 6 ||
kanyāhetormahātejā yādavairabhisaṃvṛtaḥ |
avaśyaṃ kurute yatnaṃ kanyāvāptiryathā bhavet || 7 ||
yadatra kāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ sunayopetamṛddhitam |
kurudhvaṃ nṛpaśārdūlā viniścitya balābalam || 8 ||
padātinau mahāvīryau vasudevasutāvubhau |
vainateyaṃ vinā tasmin gomante parvatottame |
kṛtavantau mahāghoraṃ bhavadbhirviditaṃ hi tat || 9 ||
vṛṣṇibhiryādavaiścaiva bhojāndhakamahārathaiḥ |
sametya yuddhamānasya kīdṛśo vigraho bhavet || 2.48.10 ||
kanyārthe yatatānena garuḍasthena viṣṇunā |
kaḥ sthāsyati raṇe tasminnapi śakraḥ suraiḥ saha || 11 ||
yadā cāsmai nāpi sutā kadācit sampradīyate |
tato hyayaṃ balādenāṃ netuṃ śaktaḥ suraiḥ saha || 12 ||
purā ekārṇave ghore śrūyate medinī tviyam |
pātālatalasammagnā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || 13 ||
vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāya uddhṛtā jagadādinā |
hiraṇyākṣaśca daityendro varāheṇa nipātitaḥ || 14 ||
hiraṇyakaśipuścaiva mahābalaparākramaḥ |
avadhyo'maradaityānāmṛṣigandharvakinnaraiḥ || 15 ||
yakṣarākṣasanāgānāṃ nākāśe nāvanisthale |
na cābhyantararātryahnorna śuṣkeṇārdrakeṇa ca || 16 ||
avadhyastriṣu lokeṣu daityendrastvaparājitaḥ |
narasiṃhena rūpeṇa nihato viṣṇunā purā || 17 ||
vāmanena tu rūpeṇa kaśyapasyātmajo balī |
adityā garbhasambhūto balirbaddho'surottamaḥ || 18 ||
satyarajjumayaiḥ pāśaiḥ kṛtaḥ pātālasaṃśrayaḥ |
kārtavīryo mahāvīryaḥ sahasrabhujavigrahaḥ || 19 ||
dattātreyaprasādena matto rājyamadena ca |
jāmadagnyo mahātejā reṇukāgarbhasaṃbhavaḥ || 2.48.20 ||
tretādvāparayoḥ saṃdhau rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ |
parśunā(paśunā?) vajrakalpena saptadvīpeśvaro nṛpaḥ |
viṣṇunā nihato bhūyaḥ chadmarūpeṇa haihayaḥ || 21 ||
ikṣvākukulasambhūto rāmo dāśarathiḥ purā |
trilokavijayaṃ vīraṃ rāvaṇaṃ saṃnyapātayat || 22 ||
purā kṛtūyuge viṣṇuḥ saṃgrāme tārakāmaye |
ṣoḍaśārddhabhujo bhūtvā garuḍastho hi vīryavān || 23 ||
nijaghānāsurān yuddhe varadānena garvitān |
kālanemiśca daiteyo devānāṃ ca bhayapradaḥ || 24 ||
sahasrakiraṇābhena cakreṇa nihato yudhi |
mahāyogabalenājau viśvarūpeṇa viṣṇunā || 25 ||
anena prāptakālāste nihatā bahavo'surāḥ |
vane vanacarā daityā mahābalaparākramāḥ || 26 ||
nihatā bālabhāvena pralambāriṣṭadhenukāḥ |
śakunīṃ keśinaṃ caiva yamalārjunakāvapi || 27 ||
nāgaṃ kuvalayāpīḍaṃ cāṇūraṃ muṣṭikaṃ tathā |
kaṃsaṃ ca balināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sagaṇaṃ devakīsutaḥ || 28 ||
nyahanad gopaveṣeṇa krīḍamāno hi keśavaḥ |
evamādīni divyāni chadmarūpāṇi cakriṇā || 29 ||
kṛtāni divyarūpāṇi viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā |
tenāhaṃ vaḥ pravakṣyāmi bhavatāṃ hitakāmyayā || 2.48.30 ||
taṃ manye keśavaṃ viṣṇuṃ surādyamasurāntakam |
nārāyaṇaṃ jagadyoniṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ dhruvam || 31 ||

gajāśvarathasambādhā pattidhvajasamākulā |
nirdagdhā mahatī senā cakralāṅgalavahninā || 41 ||
tenāyaṃ māgadhaḥ śrīmānanāgatamacintayat |

padātyoryudhyatostatra balakeśavayoryudhi |
durnivāryataro ghoro hyabhavad vāhinīkṣayaḥ || 43 ||

kṛṣṇasyāgamanaṃ caiva nṛpāṇāmatigarhitam |
kanyāhetornarendrāṇāṃ yathā vadati māgadhaḥ || 51 ||

ekonapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca

pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca

viśuddhabhāvaḥ kṛṣṇastu āvayordṛṣṭatattvataḥ || 2.50.40 ||
māgadhasya viśeṣeṇa na vairaṃ hṛdi dṛśyate |

<2.51>

ekapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
bhīṣmaka uvāca
putro me bāla bhāvena bhaginīṃ dātumicchati |
svayaṃvare narendrāṇāṃ na cāhaṃ dātumutsahe || 1 ||
atīva bālabhāvatvād dātumicchenmatirmama |
ekā hyekaṃ samālokya varayiṣyati me matiḥ || 2 ||
ataḥ prasādayiṣye tvāṃ putradurnayahetunā |
prasādaṃ kuru deveśa kṣantumarhasi me prabho || 3 ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
bālabhāvena putreṇa cālitaṃ nṛpamaṇḍalam |
yadā bhavati vai prauḍhaḥ kīdṛśo'vinayo bhavet || 4 ||
sūryendusadṛśām̐llokāṃstapasopārjitaśriyaḥ |

yathārheṇa tu sampūjya ātithyaṃ kṛtavānasi || 2.51.10 ||

hriyābhibhūto rājendra pārthivo'haṃ narādhipa |

ślakṣṇavācāmbunā''sicya śamito'gniriva jvalan ||19||
bhīṣmaka uvāca
prasīda devalokeśa pāhi māṃ lokaśāsana |
ajñānatamasāviṣṭaṃ jñānacakṣuḥprado bhava || 2.51.20 ||

phaladāṃ hi prakurvanti mahāsenāpatiryathā || 23 ||

yanmayā cintitaṃ kārya tad bhavāñchrotumarhati || 24 ||

śrutvā svayaṃ viniścitya yadyuktaṃ tatkariṣyati || 2.51.30 ||
rukmiṇī nāma te kanyā na sā prākṛtamānuṣī |

<2.52>

dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ prayāte vasudevaputre narādhipā bhūṣaṇabhūṣitāṅgāḥ |
sabhāṃ samājagmuḥ surendrakalpāḥ prabodhanārthaṃ gamanotsavāste || 1 ||
sabhāgatān somaraviprakāśān sukhopaviṣṭān rucirāsaneṣu |
samīkṣya rājā sunayārthavādī jagāda vākyaṃ nararājasiṃhaḥ || 2 ||
svayaṃvarakṛtaṃ doṣaṃ viditvā vo narādhipāḥ |
kṣantavyo mama vṛddhasya durdagdhasya phalodayam || 3 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evamābhāṣya tān sarvān satkṛtya ca yathāvidhi |
tato visarjayāmāsa nṛpāṃstān madhyadeśajān || 4 ||
pūrvapaścimajāṃścaiva uttarāpathikānapi |
ye'pi sarve maheṣvāsāḥ prahṛṣṭamanaso narāḥ || 5 ||
yathārheṇa ca sampūjya jagmuste narapuṅgavāḥ |
jarāsaṃdhaḥ sunīthaśca dantavaktraśca vīryavān || 6 ||
śālvaḥ saubhapatiścaiva mahākūrmaśca pārthivaḥ |
krathakaiśikamukhyāśca nṛpāḥ pravaravaṃśajāḥ || 7 ||
veṇudāriśca rājarṣiḥ kāśmīrādhipatistathā |
ete cānye ca bahavo dakṣiṇāpathikā nṛpāḥ || 8 ||
śrotukāmā raho vākyaṃ sthitā vai bhīṣmakāntike |
tān vai samīkṣya rājendraḥ sa rājā bhīṣmako balī ||9||
snehapūrṇena manasā sthitāṃstānavanīśvarān |
trivargasahitaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ ṣaḍguṇālaṃkṛtaṃ śubham || 2.52.10 ||
uvāca nayasampannaṃ snigdhagambhīrayā girā |
bhīṣmaka uvāca
bhavatāmavanīśānāṃ samālokya nayānvitama || 11 ||
vacanaṃ vyāhṛtaṃ śrutvā kṛtavān kāryamīdṛśam |
sadbhirbhavadbhiḥ kṣantavyaṃ vayaṃ nityāparādhinaḥ || 12 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evamuktvā tu rājā sa bhīṣmako nayakovidaḥ |
uvāca sutamuddiśya vacanaṃ rājasaṃsadi || 13 ||
bhīṣmaka uvāca
putrasya ceṣṭāmālokya trāsākulitalocanaḥ |
manye bālānimām̐llokān sa eṣa puruṣaḥ paraḥ || 14 ||
kīrtiḥ kīrtimatāṃ śreṣṭho yaśaśca vipulaṃ tathā |
sthāpitaṃ bhuvi martye'smin svabāhubalamūrjitam || 15||
dhanyā khalu mahābhāgā devakī yoṣitāṃ varā |
putraṃ tribhuvanaśreṣṭhaṃ kṛtvā garbheṇa keśavam || 16 ||
kṛṣṇaṃ kamalapatrākṣaṃ śrīpuñjamamarārcitam |
netrābhyāṃ snehapūrṇābhyāṃ vīkṣate mukhapaṅkajam || 17 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evaṃ lālapyamānaṃ tu rājānaṃ rājasaṃsadi |
uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā śālvarājo mahādyutiḥ || 18 ||
śālva uvāca
alaṃ khedena rājendra sutāya ripumardine |
kṣatriyasya raṇe rājan dhruvaṃ jayaparājayau || 19 ||
niyatā gati martyānāmeṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ |
balakeśavayoranyastṛtīyaḥ kaḥ pumāniha || 2.52.20 ||
raṇe yodhayituṃ śaktastava putraṃ mahābalam |
rathātirathavṛndānāmeka eva raṇājire || 21 ||
ripūn bādhayituṃ śakto dhanurgṛhya mahābhujaḥ |
bhārgavāstraṃ mahāraudraṃ devairapi durāsadam || 22 ||
sṛjato bāhuvīryeṇa kaḥ pumān prasahiṣyati |
ayaṃ tu puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇo hyanādinidhano'vyayaḥ || 23||
taṃ vijetā nṛloke'smin nāpi śūladharaḥ svayam |
tava putro mahārāja sarvaśāstrārthatattvavit || 24 ||
viditvā devamīśānaṃ na yodhayati keśavam |
adya tasya raṇe jetā yavanādhipatirnṛpa || 25||
sa kālayavano nāma avadhyaḥ keśavasya ha |
taptvā sudāruṇaṃ ghoraṃ tapaḥ paramaduścaram || 26 ||
rudramārādhayāmāsa dvādaśābdānayo'śanaḥ |
putrakāmena muninā toṣya rudrātsuto vṛtaḥ || 27 ||
māthurāṇāmavadhyo'yaṃ bhavediti ca śaṅkarāt |
evamastviti rudro'pi pradadau munaye sutam || 28 ||
evaṃ gārgyasya tanayaḥ śrīmān rudravarodbhavaḥ |
māthurāṇāmavadhyo'yaṃ mathurāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 29 ||
kṛṣṇo'pi balavāneṣa māthuro jātavānayam |
sa jeṣyati raṇe kṛṣṇaṃ mathurāyāṃ samāgataḥ || 2.52.30 ||
manyadhvaṃ yadi vā yuktāṃ nṛpā vācaṃ mayeritām |
tatra dūtaṃ visṛjadhvaṃ yavanendrapuraṃ prati || 31 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śrutvā saubhapatervākyaṃ sarve te nṛpasattamāḥ |
kurma ityabruvan hṛṣṭā jarāsaṃdhaṃ mahābalam || 32 ||
sa teṣāṃ vacanaṃ kṣutvā jarāsaṃdho mahīpatiḥ |
babhūva vimanā rājan brahmaṇo vacanaṃ smaran || 33 ||
jarāsaṃdha uvāca
māṃ samāśritya pūrvasmin nṛpā nṛpabhayārditāḥ |
prāpnuvanti hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sabhṛtyabalavāhanam || 34 ||
iha saṃcodyate bhūpaiḥ parasaṃśrayahetunā |
kanyeva svapatidveṣādanyaṃ ratiparāyaṇā || 35 ||
aho subalavad daivamaśakyaṃ vinivartitum |
yadahaṃ kṛṣṇabhīto'nyaṃ saṃśrayāmi balādhikam || 36 ||
nūnaṃ yogavihīno'haṃ kārayiṣye parāśrayam |
śreyo hi maraṇaṃ mahyaṃ na cānyaṃ saṃśraye nṛpāḥ || 37 ||
kṛṣṇo vā baladevo vā yovāsau vā narādhipaḥ |
hantāraṃ pratiyotsyāmi yathā brāhmapracoditaḥ || 38 ||
eṣā me niścitā buddhiretatsat puruṣavratam |
ato'nyathā na śakto'haṃ kartuṃ parasamāśrayam || 39 ||
bhavatāṃ sādhuvṛttānāmābādhaṃ na karoti saḥ |
tena dūtaṃ pradāsyāmi nṛpāṇāṃ rakṣaṇāya vai || 2.52.40 ||
vyomamārgeṇa yātavyaṃ yathā kṛṣṇo na bādhate |
gacchantamanucintyaivaṃ preṣayadhvaṃ nṛpottamāḥ || 41 ||
ayaṃ saubhapatiḥ śrīmānanalārkenduvikramaḥ |
rathenādityavarṇena prayāti svapuraṃ balī || 42 ||
yavanendro yathābhyeti narendrāṇāṃ samāgamam |
vacanaṃ ca tathāsmābhirdūtye naḥ kṛṣṇavigrahe || 43 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
punarevābravīd rājā saubhasya patimūrjitama |
gaccha sarvanarendrāṇāṃ sāhāyyaṃ kuru mānada || 44 ||
yavanendro yathā yāti yathā kṛṣṇaṃ vijeṣyati |
yathā vayaṃ ca tuṣyāmastathā nītirvidhīyatām || 45 ||
evaṃ saṃdiśya sarvāṃstān bhīṣmakaṃ pūjya dharmataḥ |
prayayau svapuraṃ rājā svena sainyena saṃvṛtaḥ || 46 ||
śālvo'pi nṛpatiśreṣṭhastāṃśca sampūjya dharmataḥ |
jagāmākāśamārgeṇa rathenānilaraṃhasā || 47 ||
te'pi sarve mahīpālā dakṣiṇāpathavāsinaḥ |
anuvrajya jarāsaṃdhaṃ gatāḥ svanagaraṃ prati || 48 ||
bhīṣmakaḥ saha putreṇa tāvubhau cintya durnayama |
sve gṛhe nyavasad dīnaḥ kṛṣṇamevānucintayan|| 49 ||
viditā rukmiṇī sādhvī svayaṃvaranivartanam |
kṛpṇasyāgamanāddhetornṛpāṇāṃ doṣadarśanam ||2.52.50 ||
gatvā tu sā sakhīmadhye uvāca vrīḍitānanā |
na cānyeṣāṃ narendrāṇāṃ patnī bhavitumutsahe |
kṛṣṇāt kamalapatrākṣātsatyametad vaco mama || 51 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi rukmiṇīsvayaṃvare dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 52 ||

<2.53>

tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
yavanānāṃ balodagraḥ sa kālayavano nṛpaḥ |
babhūva rājā dharmeṇa rakṣitā puravāsinām || 1 ||
trivargaviditaḥ prājñaḥ ṣaḍguṇānupajīvakaḥ |
saptavyasanasammūḍho guṇeṣvabhirataḥ sadā || 2 ||
śrutimān dharmaśīlaśca satyavādī jitendriyaḥ |
sāṃgrāmikavidhijñaśca durgalābhānusāraṇaḥ || 3 ||
śūro'pratibalaścaiva mantripravarasevakaḥ |
sukhāsīnaḥ sabhāṃ ramyāṃ sacivaiḥ parivāritaḥ || 4 ||
upāsyamāno yavanairātmavidbhirvipaścitaiḥ |
vividhāśca kathā divyāḥ kathyamānāḥ parasparam || 5 ||
etasminneva kāle tu divyagandhavaho'nilaḥ |
pravavau madanābodhaṃ cakāra sukhaśītalaḥ || 6 ||
kiṃsvidityekamanasaḥ sabhāyāṃ ye samāgatāḥ |
utphullanayanāḥ sarve rājā caivāvalokya saḥ || 7 ||
apaśyanta rathaṃ divyamāyāntaṃ bhāskaropamam |
śātakumbhamayaiḥ śubhraṃ rathāṅgairupaśobhitam || 8 ||
divyaratnaprabhākīrṇaṃ divyadhvajapatākinam |
vāhitaṃ divyaturagairmanomārutaraṃhasaiḥ || 9 ||
candrabhāskarabimbāni kṛtvā jāmbūnadena tam |
racitaṃ vai viśvakṛtā vaiyāghravarabhūṣitam || 2.53.10 ||
ripūṇāṃ trāsajananaṃ mitrāṇāṃ harṣavarddhanam |
dakṣiṇādigupāyantaṃ rathaṃ pararathārujam || 11 ||
tatropaviṣṭaṃ śrīmantaṃ saubhasya patimūrjitam |
dṛṣṭvā paramasaṃhṛṣṭaścārghyaṃ pādyeti cāsakṛt || 12 ||
uvāca yavanendrasya mantrī mantravidāṃ varaḥ |
tatrotthāya mahābāhuḥ svayameva nṛpāsanāt || 13 ||
pratyudgamyārghyamādāya rathāvataraṇe sthitaḥ |
śālvo'pi ca mahātejā dṛṣṭvā rājānamāgatam || 14 ||
mudā paramayā yuktaṃ śakrapratimatejasam |
avatīrya suviśrabdha eka eva rathottamāt || 15 ||
viveśa paramaṃ prīto mitradarśanalālasaḥ |
dṛṣṭvārghamudyataṃ rājā śālvo rājarṣisattamaḥ || 16 ||
uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā nārghārho'smi mahādyute |
dūto'haṃ manujendrāṇāṃ sakāśād bhavato'ntikam || 17 ||
preṣito bahubhiḥ sārddha jarāsaṃdhena dhīmatā |
tena manye mahārāja nārghārho'smīti rājasu || 18 ||
kālayavana uvāca
jānāmyahaṃ mahābāho dautyena tvāmihāgatam |
sāhitye naradevānāṃ preṣito māgadhena vai || 19 ||
tena tvāmarcaye rājan viśeṣeṇa mahāmate |
arghyapādyādisatkārairāsanena yathāvidhi || 2.53.20 ||
bhavatyabhyarcite rājñāṃ sarveṣāmarcitaṃ bhavet |
āsyatāmāsane śubhre mayā sārddhaṃ janeśvara || 21 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
sa hastāliṅganaṃ kṛtvā pṛṣṭvā ca kuśalāmayam |
sukhopaviṣṭau sahitau śubhe siṃhāsane sthitau || 22 ||
kālayavana uvāca
yadbāhubalamāśritya vayaṃ sarve narādhipāḥ |
vasāmo vigatodvignā devā iva śacīpatim || 23 ||
kimasādhyaṃ bhavedasya yenāsi preṣito mayi |
vada satyaṃ vacastasya kimājñāpayati prabhuḥ |
kariṣye vacanaṃ tasya api karma suduṣkaram || 24 ||
śālva uvāca
yathā vadati rājendra magadhādhipatistava |
tathāhaṃ sampravakṣyāmi śrūyatāṃ yavanādhipa || 25 ||
jarāsaṃdha uvāca
jāto'yaṃ jagatāṃ bādhī kṛṣṇaḥ paramadurjayaḥ |
viditvā tasya durvṛttamahaṃ hantuṃ samudyataḥ || 26 ||
pārthivairbahubhiḥ sārddhaṃ samagrabalavāhanaiḥ |
uparudhya mahāsainyairgomantamacalottamam || 27 ||
cedirājasya vacanaṃ mahārthaṃ śrutavānaham |
tadā tayorvināśāya hutāśanamayojayam || 28 ||
jvālāśatasahasrāḍhyaṃ yugāntāgnisamaprabham |
dṛṣṭvā rāmo gireḥ kūṭādāpluto hematāladhṛk || 29 ||
viniṣpatya mahāsenāṃ madhye sāgarasaṃnibhām |
ājaghāna durādharṣo narāśvarathadantinām || 2.53.30 ||
sarpantamiva sarpendraṃ vikṛṣyākṛṣya lāṅgalam |
naranāgāśvavṛndāni musalena vyapothayat || 31 ||
gajena gajamāsphālya rathena rathayodhinam |
hayena ca hayārohaṃ padātena padātinam || 32 ||
samare sa mahātejā nṛpārkaśatasaṃkule |
vicaranvividhān mārgānnidāghe bhāskaro yathā||33||
rāmādanantaraṃ kṛṣṇaḥ pragṛhyārkasamaprabham |
cakraṃ cakrabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ siṃhaḥ kṣudramṛgaṃ yathā || 34 ||
pravicālya mahāvīryaḥ pādavegena taṃ girim |
śatrusainye papātoccairyaduvīraḥ pratāpavān || 35 ||
pranṛtyanniva śailendrastoyadhārābhiṣecitaḥ |
ghūrṇamāno viveśorvīṃ vinirvāpya hutāśanam || 36 ||
ādīpyamānaśikharādavaplutya janārdanaḥ |
jaghāna vāhinīṃ rājaṃścakravyagreṇa pāṇinā || 37 ||
vikṣipya vipulaṃ cakraṃ gadāpātādanantaram |
naranāgāśvavṛndāni musalena vyacūrṇayat || 38 ||
krodhānilasamuddhūtacakralāṅgalavahninā |
nirdagdhā mahatī senā narendrārkābhipālitā || 39 ||
naranāgāśvakalilaṃ pattidhvajasamākulam |
rathānīkaṃ padātābhyāṃ kṣaṇena vidalīkṛtam || 2.53.40 ||
senāṃ prabhagnāmālokya cakrānalabhayārditām |
mahatā rathavṛndena parivārya samantataḥ || 41 ||
tatrāhaṃ yuddhyamānastu bhrātāsya balavān balī |
sthito mamāgrataḥ śūro gadāpāṇirhalāyudhaḥ || 42 ||
dvādaśākṣauhiṇīrhatvā prabhinna iva kesarī |
halaṃ saunandamutsṛjya gadayā māmatāḍayat || 43 ||
vajrapātanibhaṃ vegaṃ pātayitvā mamopari |
bhūyaḥ prahartukāmo māṃ vaiśākhenāsthito mahīm || 44 ||
vaiśākhaṃ sthānamāsthāya guhaḥ krauñcaṃ yathā purā |
tathā māṃ dīrghanetrābhyāmīkṣate nirdahanniva || 45 ||
tādṛgrūpaṃ samālokya baladevaṃ raṇājire |
jīvitārthī nṛloke'smin kaḥ pumān sthātumarhati ||46||
gṛhītvā sa gadāṃ bhīmāṃ kāladaṇḍamivodyatām |
kālāṅkuśena nirdhūtāṃ sthita evāgrato mama || 47 ||
tato jaladagambhīrasvareṇāpūrayan nabhaḥ |
vāguvācāśarīreṇa svayaṃ lokapitāmahaḥ || 48 ||
prahartavyo na rājñāyamavadhyo'yaṃ tavānagha |
kalpito'sya vadho'nyasmād viramasva halāyudha|| 49 ||
śrutvāhaṃ tena vākyena cintāviṣṭo nivartitaḥ |
sarvaprāṇaharaṃ ghoraṃ brahmaṇā svayamīritam || 2.53.50 ||
tenāhaṃ vaḥ pravakṣyāmi nṛpāṇāṃ hitakāmyayā |
śrutvā tvameva rājendra kartumarhasi tad vacaḥ || 51 ||
tapasogreṇa mahatā putrārthī toṣya śaṅkaram |
prāptavān devadeva tvāmavadhyaṃ māthurairjanaiḥ || 52 ||
mahāmuniścāyasacūrṇamaśnannupasthito dvādaśavārṣikaṃ vratam |
surāsuraiḥ saṃstutapādapaṅkajaḥ sa labdhavānīpsitakāmasampadam || 53 ||
tapobalād gārgyamunermahātmano varaprabhāvācchakalaindumaulinaḥ |
bhavantamāsādya janārdano himaṃ vilīyate bhāskararaśminā yathā || 54 ||
yatasva rājñāṃ vacanapracodito vrajasva yātrāṃ vijayāya keśavam |
praviśya rāṣṭraṃ mathurāṃ ca senayā nihatya kṛṣṇaṃ prathayan svakaṃ yaśaḥ || 55 ||
māthuro vāsudevo'yaṃ baladevaḥ sabāndhavaḥ |
tau vijeṣyasi saṃgrāme gatvā tāṃ mathurāṃ purīm || 56 ||
śālva uvāca
ityevaṃ narapatibhāskarapragītaṃ vākyaṃ te kathitamidaṃ hitaṃ nṛpāṇām |
tatsarvaṃ saha sacivairvimṛśya buddhyā yadyuktaṃ kuru manujendra cātmaniṣṭham || 57 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi śālvavākye tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 53 ||

<2.54>

catuṣpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evaṃ kathayamānaṃ taṃ śālvarājaṃ nṛpājñayā |
uvāca paramaprīto yavanādhipatirnṛpaḥ || 1 ||
kālayavana uvāca
dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ mama |
kṛṣṇanigrahahetoryanniyukto bahubhirnṛpaiḥ || 2 ||
durjayastriṣu lokeṣu surāsuragaṇairapi |
tasya nigrahahetormāmavadhārya jayāśiṣam || 3 ||
prahṛṣṭai rājasiṃhaistairavadhāryo jayo mama |
teṣāṃ vācāmbuvarṣeṇa vijayo me bhaviṣyati || 4 ||
kariṣye vacanaṃ teṣāṃ nṛpasattamacoditam |
parājayo'pi rājendra jayena sadṛśo mama || 5 ||
adyaiva tithinakṣatraṃ muhūrtaṃ karaṇaṃ śubham |
yāsyāmi mathurāṃ rājan vijetuṃ keśavaṃ raṇe || 6 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evamābhāṣya rājānaṃ saubhasya patimūrjitam |
satkṛtya ca yathānyāyaṃ mahārhamaṇibhūṣaṇaiḥ || 7 |
brāhmaṇebhyo dadau vittaṃ siddhādeśāya vai nṛpaḥ |
purohitāya rājendra pradadau bahuśo dhanam || 8 ||
hutvāgniṃ vidhivad rājā kṛtakautukamaṅgalaḥ |
prasthānaṃ kṛtavān samyag jetukāmo janārdanam || 9 ||
śālvo'pi bharataśreṣṭha kṛtārtho hṛṣṭamānasaḥ |
yavanendraṃ pariṣvajya jagāma svapuraṃ nṛpaḥ || 2.54.10 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi kālayavanavākye catuṣpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 54 ||

<2.55>

pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
vidarbhanagarād yāte śakratulyaparākrame |
kimarthaṃ garuḍo nītaḥ kiṃ ca karma cakāra saḥ || 1 ||
na cāruroha bhagavān vainateyaṃ mahābalam |
etanme saṃśayaṃ brahman brūhi tattvaṃ mahāmune || 2 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śṛṇu rājan suparṇena kṛtaṃ karmātimānuṣam |
vidarbhanagarīṃ gatvā vainateyo mahādyutiḥ || 3 ||
asamprāpte ca nagarīṃ mathurāṃ madhusūdane |
manasā cintayāmāsa vainateyo mahādyutiḥ || 4 |
yaduktaṃ devadevena nṛpāṇāmagrataḥ prabho |
yāsyāmi mathurāṃ ramyāṃ bhojarājena pālitām || 5 ||
iti tadvacanasyānte gamiṣyeti vicintayan |
kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ śrīmān praṇipatyābravīdidam || 6 ||
garuḍa uvāca
deva yāsyāmi nagarīṃ raivatasya kuśasthalīm |
raivataṃ ca giriṃ ramyaṃ nandanapratimaṃ vanam || 7 ||
rukmiṇodvāsitāṃ ramyāṃ śailodadhitaṭāśrayām |
vṛkṣagulmalatākīrṇāṃ puṣpareṇuvibhūṣitām || 8 ||
gajendrabhujagākīrṇāmṛkṣavānarasevitām |
varāhamānuṣākrāntāṃ mṛgayūthairanekaśaḥ || 9 ||
tāṃ samantāt samālokya vāsārthaṃ te kṣamāṃ kṣamā |
yadi syād bhavato ramyā praśastā nagarīti ca || 2.55.10 ||
kaṇṭakoddharaṇaṃ kṛtvā āgamiṣye tavāntikam |
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evaṃ vijñāpya deveśaṃ praṇipatya janārdanam || 11 ||
jagāma patagendro'pi paścimābhimukho balī |
kṛṣṇo'pi yadubhiḥ sārddhaṃ viveśa mathurāṃ purīm || 12 |
svairiṇya ugrasenaśca nāgarāścaiva sarvaśaḥ |
pratyudgamyārcayan kṛṣṇaṃ prahṛṣṭajanasaṃkulam || 13 ||
janamejaya uvāca
śrutvābhiṣiktaṃ rājendraṃ bahubhirvasudhādhipaiḥ |
kiṃ cakāra mahābāhurugraseno mahīpatiḥ || 14 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
