kīrṇaṃ nāgabalaiḥ kāntaṃ ketakīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitam || 21 ||
tālapunnāgabakuladrākṣāvanaghanaṃ kvacit |
anūpaṃ sindhurājasya prapeturyadupuṅgavāḥ || 22 ||
te tatra ramaṇīyeṣu viṣayeṣu sukhapriyāḥ |
mumuduryādavāḥ sarve devāḥ svargagatā iva || 23 ||
puravāstu vicinvan sa kṛṣṇastu paravīrahā |
dadarśa vipulaṃ deśaṃ sāgareṇopaśobhitam || 24 ||
vāhanānāṃ hitaṃ caiva sikatātāmramṛttikam |
puralakṣaṇasampannaṃ kṛtāspadamiva śriyā || 25 ||
sāgarānilasaṃvītaṃ sāgarāmbuniṣevitam |
viṣayaṃ sindhurājasya śobhitaṃ puralakṣaṇaiḥ || 26 ||
tatra raivatako nāma parvato nātidūrataḥ |
mandarodāraśikharaḥ sarvato'bhivirājate || 27 ||
tatraikalavyasaṃvāso droṇenādhyuṣitaściram |
prabhūtapuruṣopetaḥ sarvaratnasamākulaḥ || 28 ||
vihārabhūmistatraiva tasya rājñaḥ sunirmitā |
nāmnā dvāravatī nāma svāyatāṣṭāpadopamā || 29 ||
keśavena matistatra puryarthe viniveśitā |
niveśaṃ tatra sainyānāṃ rocayanti sma yādavāḥ || 2.56.30 ||
te raktasūryadivase tatra yādavapuṅgavāḥ |
senāpālāṃśca saṃcakruḥ skandhāvāraniveśanam || 31 ||
dhruvāya tatra nyavasat keśavaḥ saha yādavaiḥ |
deśe puraniveśāya sa yadupravaro vibhuḥ || 32 ||
tasyāstu vidhivannāma vāstūni ca gadāgrajaḥ |
nirmame puruṣaśreṣṭho manasā yādavottamaḥ || 33 ||
evaṃ dvāravatīṃ caiva purīṃ prāpya sabāndhavāḥ |
sukhino nyavasan rājan svarge devagaṇā iva || 34 ||
kṛṣṇo'pi kālayavanaṃ jñātvā keśiniṣūdanaḥ |
jarāsaṃdhabhayāccaiva purīṃ dvāravatīṃ yayau || 35 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi dvāravatīprayāṇe ṣaṭpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 56 ||

<2.57>

saptapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
bhagavañchrotumicchāmi vistareṇa mahātmanaḥ |
caritaṃ vāsudevasya yaduśreṣṭhasya dhīmataḥ || 1 ||
kimarthaṃ ca parityajya mathurāṃ madhusūdanaḥ |
madhyadeśasya kakudaṃ dhāma lakṣmyāśca kevalam || 2 ||
śṛṅgaṃ pṛthivyāḥ svālakṣyaṃ prabhūtadhanadhānyavat |
āryāḍhyajalabhūyiṣṭhamadhiṣṭhānavarottamam || 3 ||
ayuddhenaiva dāśārhastyaktavān dvijasattama |
sa kālayavanaścāpi kṛṣṇe kiṃ pratyapadyata || 4 ||
dvārakāṃ ca samāsādya vāridurgāṃ janārdanaḥ |
kiṃ cakāra mahābāhurmahāyogī mahātapāḥ || 5 ||
kiṃ vīryaḥ kālayavanaḥ kena jātaśca vīryavān |
yamasahyaṃ samālakṣya vyapayāto janārdanaḥ || 6 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
vṛṣṇīnāmandhakānāṃ ca gururgārgyo mahāmanāḥ |
brahmacārī purā bhūtvā na sma dārānsa vindati|| 7 ||
tathā hi vartamānaṃ tamūrdhvaretasamavyayam |
śyālo'bhiśastavān gārgyamapumānitirājani || 8 ||
so'bhiśastastadā rājan nagare tvajitaṃ jaye |
alipsaṃstu striyaṃ caiva tapastepe sudāruṇam || 9 ||
tato dvādaśavarṣāṇi so'yaścūrṇamabhakṣayat |
ārādhayan mahādevamacintyaṃ śūlapāṇinam || 2.57.10 ||
rudrastasmai varaṃ prādāt samarthaṃ yudhi nigrahe |
vṛṣṇīnāmandhakānāṃ ca sarvatejomayaṃ sutam || 11 ||
tataḥ śuśrāva taṃ rājā yavanādhipatirvaram |
putraprasavajaṃ daivādaputraḥ putrakāmitā || 12 ||
sa nṛpastamupānāyya sāntvayitvā dvijottamam |
taṃ ghoṣamadhye yavano gopastrīṣu samāsṛjat || 13 ||
gopālī tvapsarāstatra gopastrīveṣadhāriṇī |
dhārayāmāsa gārgyasya garbhaṃ durdharamacyutam || 14 ||
mānuṣyāṃ gārgyabhāryāyāṃ niyogācchūlapāṇinaḥ |
sa kālayavano nāma jajñe śūro mahābalaḥ || 15 ||
aputrasyātha rājñastu vavṛdhe'ntaḥpure śiśuḥ |
tasminnuparate rājan sa kālayavano nṛpaḥ || 16 ||
yuddhābhikāmo nṛpatiḥ paryapṛcchaddvijottamān |
vṛṣṇyandhakakulaṃ tasya nāradena niveditam || 17 ||
jñātvā tu varadānaṃ tannāradānmadhusūdanaḥ |
upapraikṣata tejasvī varddhantaṃ yavaneṣu tam || 18 ||
samṛddho hi yadā rājā yavanānāṃ mahābalaḥ |
tata evaṃ nṛpā mlecchāḥ saṃśrityānuyayustadā || 19 ||
śakāstuṣārā daradāḥ pāradāḥ śṛṅgalāḥ khasāḥ |
pahlavāḥ śataśaścānye mlecchā haimavatāstathā || 2.57.20 ||
sa taiḥ parivṛto rājā dasyubhiḥ śalabhairiva |
nānāveṣāyudhairbhīmairmathurāmabhyavartata || 21 ||
gajavājikharoṣṭrāṇāmayutairarbudairapi |
pṛthivīṃ kampayāmāsa sainyena mahatā vṛtaḥ || 22 ||
reṇunā sūryamārgaṃ tu samavacchādya pārthivaḥ |
mūtreṇa śakṛtā caiva sainyena sasṛje nadīm || 23 ||
aśvoṣṭraśakṛtāṃ rāśernissṛteti janādhipa|
tato'śvaśakṛdityevaṃ nāma nadyā babhūva ha || 24 ||
tatsainyaṃ mahadāyād vai śrutvā vṛṣṇyandhakāgraṇīḥ |
vasudevaḥ samānāyya jñātīnidamuvāca ha || 25 ||
idaṃ samutthitaṃ ghoraṃ vṛṣṇyandhakabhayaṃ mahat |
avadhyaścāpi naḥ śatrurvaradānāt pinākinaḥ || 26 ||
sāmādayo'bhyupāyāśca vihitāstasya sarvaśaḥ |
matto madabalābhyāṃ tu yuddhameva cikīrṣati || 27 ||
etāvāniha vāsaśca kathito nāradena me |
etāvati ca vaktavyaṃ sāmaiva paramaṃ matama || 28 ||
jarāsaṃdhaśca no rājā nityameva na mṛṣyate |
tathānye pṛthivīpālā vṛṣṇicakrapratāpitāḥ || 29 ||
kecit kaṃsavadhāccāpi viraktāstadgatā nṛpāḥ |
samāśritya jarāsaṃdhamasmānicchanti bādhitum || 2.57.30 ||
bahavo jñātayaścaiva yadūnāṃ nihatā nṛpaiḥ |
varddhituṃ naiva śakṣyāma pure'sminniti keśavaḥ || 31 ||
apayāne matiṃ kṛtvā dūtaṃ tasmai sasarja ha |
tataḥ kumbhe mahāsarpaṃ bhinnāñjanacayopamam || 32 ||
ghoramāśīviṣaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prākṣepayat tadā |
tatastaṃ mudrayitvā tu svena dūtena hārayat || 33 ||
nidarśanārthaṃ govindo bhīṣayāmāsa taṃ nṛpam |
sa dūtaḥ kālayavane darśayāmāsa taṃ ghaṭam || 34 ||
kālasarpopamaḥ kṛṣṇa ityuktvā bharatarṣabha ||
tatkālayavano buddhvā trāsanaṃ yādavaiḥ kṛtam || 35 ||
pipīlikānāṃ caṇḍānāṃ pūrayāmāsa taṃ ghaṭam |
sa sarpo bahubhistīkṣṇaiḥ sarvatastaiḥ pipīlikaiḥ |
bhakṣyamāṇaḥkilāṅgeṣu bhasmībhūto'bhavattadā || 36 ||
taṃ mudrayitvā tu ghaṭaṃ tathaiva yavanādhipaḥ |
preṣayāmāsa kṛṣṇāya bāhulyamupavarṇayan || 37 ||
vāsudevastu taṃ dṛṣṭvā yogaṃ vihatamātmanaḥ |
utsṛjya mathurāmāśu dvārakāmabhijagmivān || 38 ||
vairasyāntaṃ vidhitsaṃstu vāsudevo mahāyaśāḥ |
niveśya dvārakāṃ rājanvṛṣṇīnāśvāsya caiva ha || 39 ||
padātiḥ puruṣavyāghro bāhupraharaṇastadā |
ājagāma mahāvīryo mathurāṃ madhusūdanaḥ || 2.57.40 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā niryayau hṛṣṭaḥ sa kālayavano ruṣā |
prekṣāpūrvaṃ ca kṛṣṇo'pi niścakarṣa mahābalaḥ || 41 ||
athābhyagacchad govindaṃ jighṛkṣuryavaneśvaraḥ |
na cainamaśakad rājā grahītuṃ yogadharmiṇam.|| 42 ||
māndhātustu suto rājā mucukundo mahāyaśāḥ |
purā devāsure yuddhe kṛtakarmā mahābalaḥ || 43 ||
vareṇa cchandito devairnidrāmeva gṛhītavān |
śrāntasya tasya vāgevaṃ tadā prādurabhūt kila || 44 ||
prasuptaṃ bodhayed yo māṃ taṃ daheyamahaṃ surāḥ |
cakṣuṣā krodhadīptena evamāha punaḥ punaḥ || 45 ||
evamastviti taṃ śakra uvāca tridaśaiḥ saha |
sa surairabhyanujñāto hyadrirājamupāgamat || 46 ||
sa parvataguhāṃ kāṃcit praviśya śramakarśitaḥ |
suṣvāpa kālametaṃ vai yāvatkṛṣṇasya darśanam || 47 ||
tatsarvaṃ vāsudevāya nāradena niveditam |
varadānaṃ ca devebhyastejastasya ca bhūpateḥ || 48 ||
kṛṣṇo'nugamyamānaśca tena mlecchena śatruṇā |
tāṃ guhāṃ mucukundasya praviveśa vinītavat || 49 ||
śiraḥsthāne tu rājarṣermucukundasya keśavaḥ |
saṃdarśanapathaṃ tyaktvā tasthau buddhimatāṃ varaḥ || 2.57.50 ||
anupraviśya yavano dadarśa pṛthivīpatim |
sa taṃ suptaṃ kṛtāntābhamāsasāda sudurmatiḥ || 51 ||

pādenātmavināśāya śalabhaḥ pāvakaṃ yathā || 52 ||

nidrācchedena cukrodha pādasparśena tena ca || 53 ||
saṃsmṛtya sa varaṃ śakrādavaikṣata tamagrataḥ |
sa dṛṣṭamātraḥ krodhena samprajajvāla sarvaśaḥ || 54 ||
dadāha pāvakastaṃ tu śuṣkaṃ vṛkṣamivāśaniḥ |
kṣaṇena kālayavanaṃ netratejovinirgataḥ || 55 ||
taṃ vāsudevaḥ śrīmantaṃ cirasuptaṃ narādhipam |
kṛtakāryo'bravīd dhīmānidaṃ vacanamuttamam || 56 ||
rājaṃściraprasupto'si kathito nāradena me |
kṛtaṃ me sumahatkāryaṃ svasti te'stu vrajāmyaham || 57 ||
vāsudevamupālakṣya rājā hrasvaṃ pramāṇataḥ |
pariṣkṛtaṃ yugaṃ mene kālena mahatā tadā || 58 ||

kaśca kālaḥ prasuptasya yadi jānāsi kathyatām || 59 ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
somavaṃśodbhavo rājā yayātirnāma nāhuṣaḥ |
tasya putro yadurjyeṣṭhaścatvāro'nye yavīyasaḥ || 2.57.60 ||

vāsudevaṃ vijānīhi nṛpate māmihāgatam || 61 ||

idaṃ kaliyugaṃ viddhi kimanyat karavāṇi te || 62 ||
mama śatrustvayā dagdho devadattavaro nṛpa |

vaiśampāyana uvāca
ityuktaḥ sa tu kṛṣṇena nirjagāma guhāmukhāt |
anvīyamānaḥ kṛṣṇena kṛtakāryeṇa dhīmatā || 64 ||
tato dadarśa pṛthivīmāvṛtāṃ hrasvakairnaraiḥ |
svalpotsāhairalpabalairalpavīryaparākramaiḥ |

janārdano dvāravatīṃ ca tāṃ purīmaśobhayat tena dhanena bhūriṇā || 2.57.70 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi kālayavanavadhe saptapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 57 ||

<2.58>

aṣṭapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ prabhāte vimale bhāskare udite tadā |
kṛtajāpyo hṛṣīkeśo vanānte niṣasāda ha || 1 ||
paricakrāma taṃ deśaṃ durgasthānadidṛkṣayā |
upatasthuḥ kulaprāgryā yādavā yadunandanam || 2 ||
rohiṇyāmahani śreṣṭhe svasti vācya dvijottamān |
puṇyāhaghoṣairvipulairdurgasyārabdhavān kriyām || 3 ||
tataḥ paṅkajapatrākṣo yādavān keśisūdanaḥ |
provāca vadatāṃ śreṣṭho devān vṛtraripuryathā || 4 ||
kalpiteyaṃ mayā bhūmiḥ paśyadhvaṃ devasadmavat |
nāma cāsyāḥ kṛtaṃ puryāḥ khyātiṃ yadupayāsyati || 5 ||
iyaṃ dvāravatī nāma pṛthivyāṃ nirmitā mayā |
bhaviṣyati purī ramyā śakrasyevāmarāvatī || 6 ||
tānyevāsyāḥ kārayiṣye cihnānyāyatanāni ca |
catvarān rājamārgāṃśca samyagantaḥpurāṇi ca || 7 ||
devā ivātra modantu bhavanto vigatajvarāḥ |
bādhamānā ripūnugrānugrasenapurogamāḥ || 8 ||
gṛhyantāṃ veśmavāstūni kalpyantāṃ trikacatvarāḥ |
mīyantāṃ rājamārgāśca prāsādasya ca yā gatiḥ || 9 ||
preṣyantāṃ śilpimukhyā vai niyuktā veśmakarmasu |
niyujyantāṃ ca deśeṣu preṣyakarmakarā janāḥ || 2.58.10 ||

teṣu veśmasu yukteṣu yādaveṣu mahātmasu || 18 ||
puryāḥ kṣiptaṃ niveśārthaṃ cintayāmāsa mādhavaḥ |
tasya daivotthitā buddhirvimalā kṣiprakāriṇī || 19 ||
puryāḥ priyakarī sā vai yadūnāmabhivarddhinī |
śilpimukhyastu devānāṃ prajāpatisutaḥ prabhuḥ || 2.58.20 ||
viśvakarmā svamatyā vai purīṃ saṃsthāpayiṣyati |
manasā samanudhyāya tasyāgamanakāraṇāt |
tridaśābhimukhaḥ kṛṣṇo vivikte samapadyata || 21 ||
tasminneva tataḥ kāle śilpācāryo mahāmatiḥ |
viśvakarmā suraśreṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇasya pramukhe sthitaḥ || 22 ||
viśvakarmovāca
śakreṇa preṣitaḥ kṣipraṃ tava viṣṇo dhṛtavrata |
kiṅkaraḥ samanuprāptaḥ śādhi māṃ kiṃ karomi te || 23 ||

trailokyajñāpikāṃ vācamutsṛjasva mahābhuja |
eṣo'smi paridṛṣṭārthaḥ kiṃ karomi praśādhi mām || 25 ||
śrutvā vinītaṃ vacanaṃ keśavo viśvakarmaṇaḥ |
pratyuvāca yaduśreṣṭhaḥ kaṃsāriratulaṃ vacaḥ || 26 ||
śrutārtho devaguhyasya bhavān yatra vayaṃ sthitāḥ |

tadiyaṃ pūḥ prakāśārthaṃ niveśyā mayi suvrata |
matprabhāvānurūpaiśca gṛhaiśceyaṃ samantataḥ || 28 ||
uttamā ca pṛthivyāṃ vai yathā svarge'marāvatī |
tatheyaṃ hi tvayā kāryā śakto hyasi mahāmate || 29 ||
mama sthānamidaṃ kāryaṃ yathā vai tridive tathā |
martyāḥ paśyantu me lakṣmīṃ puryā yadukulasya ca || 2.58.30 ||
evamuktastataḥ prāha viśvakarmā matīśvaraḥ |
kṛṣṇamakliṣṭakarmāṇaṃ devāmitravināśanam || 31 ||
sarvametat kariṣyāmi yat tvayābhihitaṃ prabho |
purī tviyaṃ janasyāsya na paryāptā bhaviṣyati || 32 ||
bhaviṣyati ca vistīrṇā vṛddhirasyāstu śobhanā |
catvāraḥ sāgarāhyasyāṃ vicariṣyanti rūpiṇaḥ || 33 ||
yadīcchetsāgaraḥ kiṃcidutsraṣṭumapi toyarāṭ |
tataḥ svāyatalakṣaṇyā purī syātpuruṣottama || 34 ||
evamuktastataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prāgeva kṛtaniścayaḥ |
sāgaraṃ saritāṃ nāthamuvāca vadatāṃ varaḥ || 35 ||
samudra daśa ca dve ca yojanāni jalāśaye |
pratisaṃhriyatāmātmā yadyasti mayi mānyatā || 36 ||
avakāśe tvayā datte purīyaṃ māmakaṃ balam |
paryāptaviṣayā ramyā samagraṃ visahiṣyati || 37 ||
tataḥ kṛṣṇasya vacanaṃ śrutvā nadanadīpatiḥ |
sa mārutena yogena utsasarja jalāśayam || 38 ||
viśvakarmā tataḥ prītaḥ puryāḥ saṃlakṣya vāstu tat |
govinde caiva sammānaṃ kṛtavān sāgarastadā || 39 ||
viśvakarmā tataḥ kṛṣṇamuvāca yadunandanam |
adyaprabhṛti govinda sarve samadhirohata || 2.58.40 ||
manasā nirmitā ceyaṃ mayā pūḥ pravarā vibho |
acireṇaiva kālena gṛhasambādhamālinī || 41 ||
bhaviṣyati purī ramyā sudvārā prāgryatoraṇā |
cayāṭṭālakakeyūrā pṛthivyāṃ kakudopamā || 42 ||
antaḥpuraṃ ca kṛṣṇasya paricaryākṣayaṃ mahat |
cakāra tasyāṃ puryāṃ vai deśe tridaśapūjite || 43 ||
tataḥ sā nirmitā kāntā purī dvārāvatī tadā |
vidhānavihitadvārā prākāravaraśobhitā |
parikhācayasaṃguptā sāṭṭaprākāratoraṇā || 45 ||
kāntanārīnaragaṇā vaṇigbhirupaśobhitā |
nānāpaṇyagaṇākīrṇā khecarīva ca gāṃ gatā || 46 ||
prapāvāpīprasannodā udyānairupaśobhitā |
samantataḥ saṃvṛtāṅgī vanitevāyatekṣaṇā || 47 ||
samṛddhacatvaravatī veśmottamaghanācitā |
rathyākoṭisahasrāḍhyā śubhrarājapathottarā || 48 ||
bhūṣayantī samudraṃ sā svargamindrapurī yathā |
pṛthivyāṃ sarvaratnānāmekā nicayaśālinī || 49 ||
surāṇāmapi sukṣetrā sāmantakṣobhakāriṇī |
aprakāśaṃ tadākāśaṃ prāsādairupakurvatī || 2.58.50 ||
pṛthivyāṃ pṛthurāṣṭrāyāṃ janaughapratināditā |
oghaiśca vārirājasya śiśirīkṛtamārutā || 51 ||
anūpopavanaiḥ kāntaiḥ kāntyā janamanoharā |
satārakā dyauriva sā dvārakā pratyarājata || 52 ||
prākāreṇārkavarṇena śātakaumbhena saṃvṛtā |
hiraṇyaprativarṇaiśca gṛhairgambhīraniḥsvanaiḥ || 53 ||
śubhrameghapratīkāśairdvāraiḥ saudhaiśca śobhitā |
kvacit kvacidudagrāgrairupāvṛtamahāpathā || 54 ||
tāmāvasat purīṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sarve yādavanandanāḥ |
abhipretajanākīrṇā somaḥ khamiva bhāsayan || 55 ||
viśvakarmā ca tāṃ kṛtvā purīṃ śakrapurīmiva |
jagāma tridivaṃ devo govindenābhipūjitaḥ || 56 ||
bhūyaśca buddhirabhavat kṛṣṇasya viditātmanaḥ |
janānimān dhanaughaiśca tarpayeyamahaṃ yadi || 57 ||
sa vaiśravaṇasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ nidhīnāmuttamaṃ nidhim |
śaṅkhamāhvayatopendro niśi svaṃ bhavane prabhuḥ || 58 ||
sa śaṅkhaḥ keśavāhvānaṃ jñātvā hi nidhirāṭ svayam|
ājagāma samīpaṃ vai tasya dvāravatīpateḥ || 59 ||
sa śaṅkhaḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā vinayādavaniṃ gataḥ |
kṛṣṇaṃ vijñāpayāmāsa yathā vaiśravaṇaṃ tathā || 2.58.60 ||
bhagavan kiṃ mayā kāryaṃ surāṇāṃ vittarakṣiṇā |
niyojaya mahābāho yat kāryaṃ yadunandana || 61 ||
tamuvāca hṛṣīkeśaḥ śaṅkhaṃ guhyakamuttamam |
janāḥ kṛśadhanā ye'smiṃstān dhanenābhipūraya || 62 ||
necchāmyanaśitaṃ draṣṭuṃ kṛśaṃ malinameva ca |
dehīti caiva yācantaṃ nagaryāṃ nirdhanaṃ naram || 63 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
gṛhītvā śāsanaṃ mūrdhnā nidhirāṭ keśavasya ha |
nidhīnājñāpayāmāsa dvāravatyāṃ gṛhe gṛhe || 64 ||
dhanaughairabhivarṣadhvaṃ cakruḥ sarvaṃ tathā ca te |
nādhano vidyate tatra kṣīṇabhāgyo'pi vā naraḥ || 65 ||
kṛśo vā malino vāpi dvāravatyāṃ kathaṃcana |
dvāravatyāṃ puri purā keśavasya mahātmanaḥ || 66 ||
cakāra vāyorāhvānaṃ bhūyaśca puruṣottamaḥ |
tatrastha eva bhagavān yādavānāṃ priyaṃkaraḥ || 67 ||
prāṇayonistu bhūtānāmupatasthe gadādharam |
ekamāsīnamekānte devaguhyadharaṃ prabhum || 68 ||
kiṃ mayā deva kartavyaṃ sarvagenāśugāminā |
yathaiva dūto devānāṃ tathaivāsmi tavānagha || 69 ||
tamuvāca tataḥ kṛṣṇo rahasyaṃ puruṣo hariḥ |
mārutaṃ jagataḥ prāṇaṃ rūpiṇaṃ samupasthitam || 2.58.70 ||
gaccha māruta deveśamanumānya sahāmaraiḥ |
sabhāṃ sudharmāmādāya devebhyastvamihānaya || 71 ||
yādavā dhārmikā hyete vikrāntāśca sahasraśaḥ |
tasyāṃ viśeyurete vai na tu yā kṛtrimā bhavet || 72 ||
yā hyakṣayā sabhā ramyā kāmagā kāmarūpiṇī |
sā yadūn dhārayetsarvānyathaiva tridaśāstathā || 73 ||
saṃgṛhya vacanaṃ tasya kṛṣṇasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ |
vāyurātmopagatirjagāma tridivālayam ||74||
so'numānya surānsarvān kṛṣṇavākyaṃ nivedya ca |
sabhāṃ sudharmāmādāya punarāyānmahītalam || 75 ||
sudharmāya sudharmāṃ tāṃ kṛṣṇāyākliṣṭakāriṇe |
devo devasabhāṃ dattvā vāyurantaradhīyata || 76 ||
dvāravatyāstu sā madhye keśavena niveśitā |
sudharmā yadumukhyānāṃ devānāṃ tridive yathā || 77 ||
evaṃ divyaiśca bhogaiśca jalajaiścāvyayo hariḥ |
dravyairalaṃkaroti sma purīṃ svāṃ pramadāmiva || 78 ||
maryādāścaiva saṃcakre śreṇīśca prakṛtīstathā |
balādhyakṣāṃśca yuktāṃśca prakṛtīśāṃstathaiva ca || 79 ||
ugrasenaṃ narapatiṃ kāśyaṃ cāpi purohitam |
senāpatimanādhṛṣṭiṃ vikadruṃ mantripuṅgavam || 2.58.80 ||
yādavānāṃ kulakarān sthavirān daśa tatra vai |
matimān sthāpayāmāsa sarvakāryeṣvanantarān || 81 ||
ratheṣvatiratho yantā dārukaḥ keśavasya vai |
yodhamukhyaśca yodhānāṃ pravaraḥ sātyakiḥ kṛtaḥ || 82 ||
vidhānamevaṃ kṛtvātha kṛṣṇaḥ puryāmaninditaḥ |
mumude yadubhiḥ sārddhaṃ lokasraṣṭā mahītale || 83 ||
revatasyātha kanyāṃ ca revatīṃ śīlasammatām |
prāptavān baladevastu kṛṣṇasyānumate tadā || 84 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi dvārāvatīnirmāṇe'ṣṭapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 58 ||

<2.59>

ekonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
etasminneva kāle tu jarāsaṃdhaḥ pratāpavān |
nṛpānudyojayāmāsa cedirājapriyepsayā || 1 ||
sutāyā bhīṣmakasyātha rukmiṇyā rukmabhūṣaṇaḥ |
śiśupālasya nṛpatervivāho bhavitā kila || 2 ||
dantavaktrasya tanayaṃ suvaktramamitaujasam |
sahasrākṣasamaṃ yuddhe māyāśataviśāradam || 3 ||
pauṇḍrasya vāsudevasya tathā putraṃ mahābalam |
sudevaṃ vīryasampannaṃ pṛthagakṣauhiṇīpatim || 4 ||
ekalavyasya putraṃ ca vīryavantaṃ mahābalam |
putraṃ ca pāṇḍyarājasya kaliṅgādhipatiṃ tathā || 5 ||
kṛtāpriyaṃ ca kṛṣṇena veṇudāriṃ narādhipam |
aṃśumantaṃ tathā krāthaṃ śrutadharmāṇameva ca || 6 ||
nivṛttaśatruṃ kāliṅgaṃ gāndhārādhipatiṃ tathā |
prasahya ca mahāvīryaṃ kauśāmbyadhipameva ca || 7 ||
bhagadatto mahāsenaḥ śalaḥ śālvo mahābalaḥ |
bhūriśravā mahāsenaḥ kuntivīryaśca vīryavān |
svayaṃ varārthaṃ samprāptā bhojarājaniveśane || 8 ||
janamejaya uvāca—
kasmin deśe nṛpo jajñe rukmī vedavidāṃ varaḥ |
kasyānvavāye dyutimān sambhūto dvijasattama || 9 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
rājarṣeryādavasyāsīd vidarbho nāma vai sutaḥ |
vindhyasya dakṣiṇe pārśve vidarbhāyāṃ nyaveśayat || 2.59.10 ||
krathakaiśikamukhyāstu putrāstasya mahābalāḥ |
babhūvurvīryasampannāḥ pṛthagvaṃśakarā nṛpāḥ || 11 ||
tasyānvavāye bhīmasya jajñire vṛṣṇayo nṛpāḥ |
krathasya tvaṃśumān vaṃśe bhīṣmakaḥ kaiśikasya tu || 12 ||
hiraṇyarometyāhuryaṃ dākṣiṇātyeśvaraṃ nṛpāḥ |
agastyaguptāmāśāṃ yaḥ kuṇḍinastho'nvaśānnṛpaḥ|| 13||
rukmī tasyābhavatputro rukmiṇī ca viśāmpate |
rukmī cāstrāṇi divyāni drumātprāpa mahābalaḥ || 14||
jāmadagnyāttathā rāmādbrāhmamastramavāptavān |
prāsparddhata sa kṛṣṇena nityamadbhutakarmaṇā || 15 ||
rukmiṇī tvabhavadrājan rūpeṇāsadṛśī bhuvi |
cakame vāsudevastāṃ śravādeva mahādyutiḥ || 16 ||
sa tayā cābhilaṣitaḥ śravādeva janārdanaḥ |
tejovīryabalopetaḥ sa me bhartā bhavediti || 17 ||
tāṃ dadau na ca kṛṣṇāya dveṣādrukmī mahābalaḥ |
kaṃsasya vadhasaṃtāpāt kṛṣṇāyāmitatejase || 18 ||
yācamānāya kaṃsasya dveṣyo'yamiti cintayan |
caidyasyārthe sunīthasya jarāsaṃdhastu bhūmipaḥ |
varayāmāsa tāṃ rājā bhīṣmakaṃ bhīmavikramam || 19 ||
cedirājasya tu vasorāsītputro bṛhadrathaḥ |
magadheṣu purā yena nirmito'sau girivrajaḥ || 2.59.20 ||
tasyānvavāye jajñe'sau jarāsaṃdho mahābalaḥ |
vasoreva tadā vaṃśe damaghoṣo'pi cedirāṭ || 21 ||
damaghoṣasya putrāstu pañca bhīmaparākramāḥ |
bhaginyāṃ vasudevasya śrutaśravasi jajñire || 22 ||
śiśupālo daśagrīvo raibhyo'thopadiśo balī |
sarvāstrakuśalā vīrā vīryavanto mahābalāḥ || 23 ||
jñāteḥ samānavaṃśastha sunīthaḥ pradadau sutam |
jarāsaṃdhastu sutavad dadarśainaṃ jugopa ca || 24 ||
jarāsaṃdhaṃ puraskṛtya vṛṣṇiśatruṃ mahābalam |
kṛtānyāgāṃsi caidyena vṛṣṇīnāṃ cāpriyaiṣiṇā || 25 ||
jāmātā tvabhavattasya kaṃsastasmin hate yudhi |
kṛṣṇārthaṃ vairamabhavajjarāsaṃdhasya vṛṣṇibhiḥ || 26 ||
bhīṣmakaṃ varayāmāsa sunīthārthe ca rukmiṇīm |
tāṃ dadau bhīṣmakaścāpi śiśupālāya vīryavān || 27 ||
tataścaidyamupādāya jarāsaṃdho narādhipaḥ |
yayau vidarbhān sahito dantavaktreṇa yāyinā || 28 ||
anujñātaśca pauṇḍreṇa vāsudevena dhīmatā |
aṅgavaṅgakaliṅgānāmīśvaraḥ sa mahābalaḥ || 29 ||
mānayiṣyaṃśca tānrukmī pratyudgamya narādhipān |
parayā pūjayopetāṃstān nināya purīṃ prati || 2.59.30 ||
pitṛṣvasuḥ priyārthaṃ ca rāmakṛṣṇāvubhāvapi |
prayayurvṛṣṇayaścānye rathaistatra balānvitāḥ || 31 ||
krathakaiśikabhartā tān pratigṛhya yathāvidhi |
pūjayāmāsa pūjārhān bahiścaiva nyaveśayat || 32 ||
śvobhāvini vivāhe ca rukmiṇī niryayau bahiḥ |
caturyujā rathenaindre devatāyatane śubhe || 33 ||
indrāṇīmarcayiṣyantī kṛtakautukamaṅgalā |
dīpyamānena vapuṣā balena mahatā vṛtā || 34 ||
tāṃ dadarśa tadā kṛṣṇo lakṣmīṃ sākṣādiva sthitām|
rūpeṇāgryeṇa sampannāṃ devatāyatanāntike || 35 ||
vahneriva śikhāṃ dīptāṃ māyāṃ bhūmigatāmiva |
pṛthivīmiva gambhīrāmutthitāṃ pṛthivītalāt || 36 ||
marīcimiva somasya saumyāṃ strīvigrahāṃ bhuvi |
śrīmivāgryāṃ vinā padmaṃ bhaviṣyāṃ śrīsahāyinīm |
kṛṣṇena manasā dṛṣṭāṃ durnirīkṣyāṃ surairapi || 37 ||
śyāmāvadātā sā hyāsītpṛthucārvāyatekṣaṇā |
tāmrauṣṭhanayanāpāṅgī pīnorujaghanastanī || 38 ||
bṛhatī cārusarvāṅgī tanvī śaśisitānanā |
tāmratuṅganakhī subhrūrnīlakuñcitamūrdhajā || 39 ||
atyarthaṃ rūpataḥ kāntā pīnaśroṇipayodharā |
tīkṣṇaśuklaiḥ samairdantaiḥ prabhāsadbhiralaṃkṛtā || 2.59.40 ||
ananyā pramadā loke rūpeṇa yaśasā śriyā |
rukmiṇī rūpiṇī devī pāṇḍurakṣaumavāsinī || 41 ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vavṛdhe kāmaḥ kṛṣṇasya priyadarśanām |
haviṣevānalasyārcirmanastasyāṃ samādadhat || 42 ||
rāmeṇa saha niścitya keśavastu mahābalaḥ |
tatpramāthe'karodbuddhiṃ vṛṣṇibhiḥ praṇidhāya ca || 43 ||
kṛte tu devatākārye niṣkrāmantīṃ surālayāt |
unmathya sahasā kṛṣṇaḥ svaṃ nināya rathottamam || 44 ||
vṛkṣamutpāṭya rāmo'pi jaghānāpatataḥ parān |
samanahyanta dāśārhāstadājñaptāśca sarvaśaḥ || 45 ||
te rathairvividhākāraiḥ samucchritamahādhvajaiḥ |
vājibhirvāraṇaiścaiva parivavrurhalāyudham || 46 ||
ādāya rukmiṇīṃ kṛṣṇo jagāmāśu purīṃ prati |
rāme bhāraṃ tamāsajya yuyudhāne ca vīryavān || 47 ||
akrūre vipṛthau caiva gade ca kṛtavarmaṇi |
cakradeve sudeve ca sāraṇe ca mahābale || 48 ||
nivṛttaśatrau vikrānte bhaṅgakāre vidūrathe |
ugrasenātmaje kaṅke śatadyumne ca keśavaḥ || 49||
rājādhideve mṛdure prasene citrake tathā |
atidānte bṛhaddurge śvaphalke satyake pṛthau || 2.59.50 ||
vṛṣṇyandhakeṣu cānyeṣu mukhyeṣu madhusūdanaḥ |
gurumāsajya taṃ bhāraṃ yayau dvāravatīṃ prati || 51 ||
dantavaktro jarāsaṃdhaḥ śiśupālaśca vīryavān |
saṃnaddhā niryayuḥ kruddhā jighāṃsanto janārdanam || 52 ||
aṅgavaṅgakaliṅgaiśca sārddhaṃ pauṇḍraiśca vīryavān |
niryayau cedirājastu bhrātṛbhiḥ sa mahārathaiḥ || 53 ||
tān pratyagṛhṇan saṃrabdhā vṛṣṇivīrā mahārathāḥ |
saṃkarṣaṇaṃ puraskṛtya vāsavaṃ maruto yathā || 54 ||
āpatantaṃ hiṃ vegena jarāsaṃdhaṃ mahābalam |
ṣaḍbhirvivyādha nārācairyuyudhāno mahāmṛdhe || 55 ||
akrūro dantavaktraṃ tu vivyādha navabhiḥ śaraiḥ |
taṃ pratyaviddhyat kārūṣo bāṇairdaśabhirāśugaiḥ || 56 ||
vipṛthuḥ śiśupālaṃ tu śarairvivyādha saptabhiḥ |
aṣṭabhiḥ pratyaviddhyat taṃ śiśupālaḥ pratāpavān|| 57 ||
gaveṣaṇastu caidyaṃ tu ṣaḍabhirvivyādha mārgaṇaiḥ |
atidāntastathāṣṭābhirbṛhaddurgaśca pañcabhiḥ || 58 ||
prativivyādha tāṃścaidyaḥ pañcabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ |
jaghānāśvāṃśca caturaścaturbhirvipṛthoḥ śaraiḥ || 59 ||
bṛhaddurgasya bhallena śiraściccheda cārihā |
gaveṣaṇasya sūtaṃ tu prāhiṇod yamasādanam || 2.59.60 ||
hatāśvaṃ tu rathaṃ tyaktvā vipṛthustu mahābalaḥ |
āruroha rathaṃ śīghraṃ bṛhaddurgasya vīryavān || 61 ||
vipṛthoḥ sārathiścāpi gaveṣaṇarathaṃ drutam |
āruhya javanānaśvān niyantumupacakrame || 62 ||
te kruddhāḥ śaravarṣeṇa sunīthaṃ samavākiran |
nṛtyantaṃ rathamārgeṣu cāpahastāḥ kalāpinaḥ || 63 ||
cakradevo dantavaktraṃ bibhedorasi patriṇā |
ṣaḍrathaṃ pañcabhiścaiva vivyādha yudhi mārgaṇaiḥ || 64 ||
tābhyāṃ sa viddho daśabhirbāṇairmarmātigaiḥ śitaiḥ |
tato balī cakradevaṃ bibheda daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ || 65 ||
pañcabhiścāpi vivyādha so'pi dūrādvidūratham |
vidūratho'pi taṃ ṣaḍbhirvivyādhājau śitaiḥ śaraiḥ || 66 ||
triṃśatā pratyavidhyat taṃ balī bāṇairmahābalam |
kṛtavarmā bibhedājau rājaputraṃ tribhiḥ śaraiḥ || 67 ||
nyahanat sārathiṃ cāsya dhvajaṃ ciccheda socchritam |
prativivyādha taṃ kruddhaḥ pauṇḍraḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ śilīmukhaiḥ ||68||
dhanuściccheda cāpyasya bhallena kṛtavarmaṇaḥ |
nivṛttaśatruḥ kāliṅgaṃ bibheda niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ |
tomareṇāṃsadeśe taṃ nirbibheda kaliṅgarāṭ || 69 ||
gajenāsādya kaṅkastu gajamaṅgasya vīryavān |
tomareṇa bibhedāṅgaṃ bibhedāṅgaśca taṃ śaraiḥ || 2.59.70 ||
citrakaśca śvaphalkaśca satyakaśca mahārathaḥ |
kaliṅgasya tathānīkaṃ nārācairbibhiduḥ śataiḥ || 71 ||
taṃ nisṛṣṭadrumeṇājau vaṅgarājasya kuñjaram |
jaghāna rāmaḥ saṃkruddho vaṅgarājaṃ ca saṃyuge || 72 ||
taṃ hatvā rathamāruhya dhanurādāya vīryavān |
saṃkarṣaṇo jaghānograirnārācaiḥ kaiśikān bahūn || 73 ||
ṣaḍbhirnihatya kārūṣān maheṣvāsān sa vīryavān |
śataṃ jaghāna saṃkruddho māgadhānāṃ mahābale || 74 ||
nihatya tān mahābāhurjarāsaṃdhaṃ tato'bhyayāt |
tamāpatantaṃ vivyādha nārācairmāgadhastribhiḥ || 75 ||
taṃ bibhedāṣṭabhiḥ kruddho nārācairmusalāyudhaḥ |
ciccheda cāsya bhallena dhvajaṃ hemapariṣkṛtam || 76 ||
tad yuddhamabhavad ghoraṃ teṣāṃ devāsuropamam |
sṛjatāṃ śaravarṣāṇi nighnatāmitaretaram || 77 ||
gajairgajā hi saṃkruddhāḥ saṃnipetuḥ sahasraśaḥ |
rathai rathāśca saṃrabdhāḥ sādinaścāpi sādibhiḥ || 78 ||
padātayaḥ padātīṃśca śakticarmāsipāṇayaḥ |
chindantaścottamāṅgāni viceruryudhi te pṛthak || 79 ||
asīnāṃ pātyamānānāṃ kavaceṣu mahāsvanaḥ |
śarāṇāṃ patatāṃ śabdaḥ pakṣiṇāmiva śuśruve || 2.59.80 ||
bherīśaṅkhamṛdaṅgānāṃ veṇūnāṃ ca mṛdhe dhvanim |
jugūha ghoṣaḥ śastrāṇāṃ jyāghoṣaśca mahātmanām || 81 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi rukmiṇīharaṇe ekonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 59 ||

<2.60>

ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
kṛṣṇena hriyamāṇāṃ tāṃ rukmī śrutvā tu rukmiṇīm |
pratijñāmakarota kruddhaḥ samakṣaṃ bhīṣmakasya ha ||1 ||
rukmyuvāca
ahatvā yudhi govindamanānīya ca rukmiṇīm |
kuṇḍinaṃ na pravekṣyāmi satyametad bravīmyaham || 2 ||
āsthāya sa rathaṃ vīraḥ samudagrāyudhadhvajam |
javena prayayau kruddho balena mahatā vṛtaḥ || 3 ||
tamanvayurnṛpāścaiva dakṣiṇāpathavartinaḥ |
krāthoṃ'śumāñchrutarvā ca veṇudāriśca vīryavān || 4 ||
bhīṣmakasya sutāścānye rathena rathināṃ varāḥ |
krathakaiśikamukhyāśca sarva eva mahārathāḥ || 5 ||
te gatvā dūramadhvānaṃ saritaṃ narmadāmanu |
govindaṃ dadṛśuḥ kruddhāḥ sahaiva priyayā sthitam || 6 ||
avasthāpya ca tatsainyaṃ rukmī madabalānvitaḥ |
cikīrṣurdvairathaṃ yuddhamabhyayānmadhusūdanam || 7 ||
sa vivyādha catuḥṣaṣṭyā govindaṃ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ |
taṃ pratyavidhyat saptatyā bāṇairyudhi janārdanaḥ || 8 ||
yatamānasya ciccheda dhvajaṃ cāsya mahābalaḥ |
jahāra ca śiraḥ kāyātsārathestasya vīryavān || 9 ||
taṃ kṛcchragatamājñāya parivavrurjanārdanam |
dākṣiṇātyā jighāṃsanto rājānaḥ sarva eva hi || 2.60.10 ||
tamaṃśumān mahābāhurvivyādha daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ |
śrutarvā pañcabhiḥ kruddho veṇudāriśca saptabhiḥ || 11 ||
tato'śumantaṃ govindo bibhedorasi vīryavān |
niṣasāda rathopasthe vyathitaḥ sa narādhipaḥ || 12 ||
śrutarvaṇo jaghānāśvāṃścaturbhiścaturaḥ śaraiḥ |
veṇudārerdhvajaṃ chittvā bhujaṃ vivyādha dakṣiṇam || 13 ||
tathaiva ca śrutarvāṇaṃ śarairvivyādha pañcabhiḥ |
śiśriye sa dhvajaṃ śānto nyaṣīdacca vyathānvitaḥ || 14 ||
muñcantaḥ śaravarṣāṇi vāsudevaṃ tato'bhyayuḥ |
krathakaiśikamukhyāśca sarva eva mahārathāḥ || 15 ||
bāṇairbāṇāṃśca ciccheda teṣāṃ yudhi janārdanaḥ |
jaghāna caiṣāṃ saṃrabdhaḥ patamānāṃśca tāñcharān || 16 ||
punaranyāṃścatuḥṣaṣṭyā jaghāna niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ |
kruddhānāpatato vīrānadrivat sa mahābalaḥ || 17 ||
vidrutaṃ svabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā rukmī krodhavaśaṃgataḥ |
pañcabhirniśitairbāṇairvivyādhorasi keśavam || 18 ||
sārathiṃ cāsya vivyādha sāyakairniśitaistribhiḥ |
ājaghāna śareṇāsya dhvajaṃ ca nataparvaṇā || 19 ||
keśavastvaritaṃ dṛṣṭvā kruddho vivyādha mārgaṇaiḥ |
dhanuściccheda cāpyasya yatamānasya rukmiṇaḥ || 2.60.20 ||
athānyad dhanurādāya rukmī kṛṣṇajighāṃsayā |
prāduścakāra cānyāni divyānyastrāṇi vīryavān|| 21 ||
astrairastrāṇi saṃvārya tasya kṛṣṇo mahābalaḥ |
punaściccheda taccāpaṃ ratheṣāṃ ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ || 22||
sa cchinnadhanvā virathaḥ khaḍgamādāya carma ca |
utpapāta rathād vīro garutmāniva vīryavān || 23 ||
tasyābhipatataḥ khaḍgaṃ ciccheda yudhi keśavaḥ |
nārācaiśca tribhiḥ kruddho bibhedainamathorasi || 24 ||
sa papāta mahābāhurvasudhāmanunādayan |
visaṃjño mūrcchito rājā vajreṇeva mahāsuraḥ || 25 ||
tāṃśca rājñaḥ śaraiḥ sarvān punarvivyādha mādhavaḥ |
rukmiṇaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā vyadravanta narādhipāḥ || 26 ||
viceṣṭamānaṃ taṃ bhūmau bhrātaraṃ vīkṣya rukmiṇī |
pādayornyapatad viṣṇorbhrāturjīvitakāṅkṣiṇī || 27 ||
tāmutthāpya pariṣvajya sāntvayāmāsa keśavaḥ |
abhayaṃ rukmiṇe dattvā prayayau svapurīṃ tataḥ || 28 ||
vṛṣṇayo'pi jarāsaṃdhaṃ bhaṅktvā tāṃścaiva pārthivān |
prayayurdvārakāṃ hṛṣṭāḥ puraskṛtya halāyudham || 29 ||
prayāte puṇḍarīkākṣe śrutarvābhyetya saṃgare |
rukmiṇaṃ rathamāropya prayayau svāṃ purīṃ prati || 2.60.30 ||
anānīya svasāraṃ tu rukmī mānamadānvitaḥ |
hīnapratijño naicchat sa praveṣṭuṃ kuṇḍinaṃ puram || 31 ||
vidarbheṣu nivāsārthaṃ nirmame'nyat puraṃ mahat |
tad bhojakaṭamityeva babhūva bhuvi viśrutam || 32 ||
tatraujasā mahātejā dakṣiṇāṃ diśamanvagāt |
bhīṣmakaḥ kuṇḍine caiva rājovāsa mahābhujaḥ || 33 ||
dvārakāṃ cāpi samprāpte rāme vṛṣṇibalānvite |
rukmiṇyāḥ keśavaḥ pāṇiṃ jagrāha vidhivatprabhuḥ|| 34 ||
tataḥ saha tayā reme priyayā prīyamāṇayā |
sītayeva purā rāmaḥ paulomyeva puraṃdaraḥ || 35 ||
sā hi tasyābhavajjyeṣṭhā patnī kṛṣṇasya bhāminī |
pativratā guṇopetā rūpaśīlaguṇānvitā || 36 ||
tasyāmutpādayāmāsa putrān daśa mahārathān |
cārudeṣṇaṃ sudeṣṇaṃ ca pradyumnaṃ ca mahābalam || 37 ||
suṣeṇaṃ cāruguptaṃ ca cārubāhuṃ ca vīryavān |
cāruvindaṃ sucāruṃ ca bhadracāruṃ tathaiva ca || 38 ||
cāruṃ ca balināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sutāṃ cārumatīṃ tathā |
dharmārthakuśalāste tu kṛtāstrā yuddhadurmadāḥ || 39 ||
mahiṣīraṣṭa kalyāṇīstato'nyā madhusūdanaḥ |
upayeme mahābāhurguṇopetāḥ kulodbhavāḥ || 2.60.40 ||
kālindīṃ mitravindāṃ ca satyāṃ nāgnajinīmapi |
sutāṃ jāmbavataścāpi rohiṇīṃ kāmarūpiṇīm || 41 ||
madrarājasutāṃ cāpi suśīlāṃ śubhalocanām |
sātrājitīṃ satyabhāmāṃ lakṣmaṇāṃ cāruhāsinīm |42||
śaibyasya ca sutāṃ tanvīṃ rūpeṇāpsarasopamām |
strīsahasrāṇi cānyāni ṣoḍaśātulavikramaḥ || 43 ||
upayeme hṛṣīkeśaḥ sarvā bheje sa tāḥ samam |
parārdhyavastrābharaṇāḥ kāmaiḥ sarvaiḥ sukhocitāḥ |
jajñire tāsu putrāśca tasya vīrāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 44 ||
śāstrārthakuśalāḥ sarve balavanto mahārathāḥ |
yajvānaḥ puṇyakarmāṇo mahābhāgā mahābalāḥ || 45 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi rukmiṇīharaṇaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 60 ||

<2.61>

ekaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ kāle vyatīte tu rukmī mahati vīryavān |
duhituḥ kārayāmāsa svayaṃvaramariṃdamaḥ || 1 ||
tatrāhūtā hi rājāno rājaputrāśca rukmiṇā |
samājagmurmahāvīryā nānādigbhyaḥ śriyānvitāḥ ||2||
tatrājagāma pradyumnaḥ kumārairaparairvṛtaḥ |
sā hi taṃ cakame kanyā sa ca tāṃ śubhalocanām || 3 ||
śubhāṅgī nāma vaidarbhī kāntidyutisamanvitā |
pṛthivyāmabhavat khyātā rukmiṇastanayā tadā || 4 ||
upaviṣṭeṣu sarveṣu pārthiveṣu mahātmasu |
vaidarbhī varayāmāsa pradyumnamarisūdanam || 5 ||
sa hi sarvāstrakuśalaḥ siṃhasaṃhanano yuvā |
rūpeṇāpratimo loke keśavasyātmajo'bhavat || 6 ||
vayorūpaguṇopetā rājaputrī ca sābhavat |
nārāyaṇīvendrasenā jātakāmā ca taṃ prati || 7 ||
vṛtte svayaṃvare jagmū rājānaḥ svapurāṇi te |
upādāya ca vaidarbhī pradyumno dvārakāṃ yayau || 8 ||
reme saha tayā vīro damayantyā nalo yathā |
sa tasyāṃ janayāmāsa devagarbhopamaṃ sutam || 9 ||
aniruddhamiti khyātaṃ karmaṇāpratimaṃ bhuvi |
dhanurvede ca vede ca nītiśāstre ca pāragam || 2.61.10 ||
abhavat sa yadā rājannaniruddho vayo'nvitaḥ |
tadāsya rukmiṇaḥ pautrīṃ rukmiṇī rukmasaṃnibhām |
patnyarthe varayāmāsa nāmnā rukmavatīti sā || 11 ||
aniruddhaguṇairdātuṃ kṛtabuddhirnṛpastataḥ |
prītyā hi raukmiṇeyasya rukmiṇyāścāpyupagrahāt|| 12||
visparddhannapi kṛṣṇena vairaṃ tyajya mahāyaśāḥ |
dadāmītyabravīd rājā prītimāñjanamejaya || 13 ||
keśavaḥ saha rukmiṇyā putraiḥ saṃkarṣaṇena ca |
anyaiśca vṛṣṇibhiḥ sārddha vidarbhān sabalo yayau|| 14 ||
saṃyuktā jñātayaścaiva rukmiṇaḥ suhṛdaśca ye |
āhūtā rukmiṇā te'pi tatrājagmurnarādhipāḥ || 15 ||
śubhe tithau mahārāja nakṣatre cābhipūjite |
vivāhaḥ so'niruddhasya babhūva paramotsavaḥ || 16 ||
pāṇau gṛhīte vaidarbhyāstvaniruddhena tatra vai |
vaidarbhayādavānāṃ ca babhūva paramotsavaḥ || 17 ||
remire vṛṣṇayastatra pūjyamānā yathāmarāḥ |
athāśmakānāmadhipo veṇudārirudāradhīḥ || 18 ||
akṣaḥ śrutarvā cāṇūraḥ krāthaścaivāṃśumānapi |
jayatsenaḥ kaliṅgānāmadhipaśca mahābalaḥ || 19 ||
pāṇḍyaśca nṛpatiḥ śrīmānṛṣīkādhipatistathā |
ete sammantrya rājāno dākṣiṇātyā maharddhayaḥ || 2.61.20 ||
abhigamyābruvan sarve rukmiṇaṃ rahasi prabhum |
bhavānakṣeṣu kuśalo vayaṃ cāpi riraṃsavaḥ || 21 ||
priyadyūtaśca rāmo'sāvakṣeṣvanipuṇo'pi ca |
te bhavantaṃ puraskṛtya jetumicchāma taṃ vayam |
ityukto rocayāmāsa rukmī dyūtaṃ mahārathaḥ || 22 ||
te śubhāṃ kāñcanastambhāṃ kusumairbhūṣitājirām |
sabhāmāviviśurhṛṣṭāḥ siktāṃ candanavāriṇā || 23 ||
tāṃ praviśya tataḥ sarve śubhrasraganulepanāḥ |
sauvarṇeṣvāsaneṣvāsāṃcakrire vijigīṣavaḥ || 24 ||
āhūto baladevastu kitavairakṣakovidaiḥ |
bāḍhamityabravīddhṛṣṭaḥ saha dīvyāma paṇyatām || 25 ||
nikṛtyā vijigīṣanto dākṣiṇātyā narādhipāḥ |
maṇimuktāḥ suvarṇaṃ ca tatrāninyuḥ sahasraśaḥ || 26 ||
tataḥ prāvartata dyūtaṃ teṣāṃ rativināśanam |
kalahasyāspadaṃ ghoraṃ durmatīnāṃ kṣayāvaham || 27 ||
niṣkāṇāṃ ca sahasrāṇi suvarṇasya daśāditaḥ |
rukmiṇā saha sampāte baladevo glahaṃ dadau 28 ||
taṃ jigāya tato rukmī yatamānaṃ mahābalam |
tāvadevāparaṃ bhūyo baladevaṃ jigāya saḥ || 29 ||
asakṛjjīyamānastu rukmiṇā keśavāgrajaḥ |
suvarṇakoṭīrjagrāha glahaṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ || 2.61.30 ||
jitamityeva hṛṣṭo'tha tamāhvṛtirabhāṣata |
ślāghyamānaśca cikṣepa prahasan musalāyudham || 31 ||
avidyo durbalaḥ śrīmān hiraṇyamamitaṃ mayā |
ajeyo baladevo'yamakṣadyūte parājitaḥ || 32 ||
kaliṅgarājastacchrutvā prajahāsa bhṛśaṃ tadā |
dantān saṃdarśayan hṛṣṭastatrākruddhyaddhalāyudhaḥ || 33 ||
rukmiṇastad vacaḥ śrutvā parājayanimittajam |
nigṛhyamāṇastīkṣṇābhirvāgbhirbhīṣmakasūnunā || 34 ||
roṣamāhārayāmāsa jitaroṣo'pi dharmavit |
saṃkuddho dharṣaṇāṃ prāpya rauhiṇeyo mahābalaḥ || 35 ||
dhairyātmanaḥ saṃnidhāya tato vacanamabravīt |
daśakoṭisahasrāṇi glaha eko mamāparaḥ || 36 ||
enaṃ samparigṛhṇīṣva pātayākṣān narādhipa |
kṛṣṇākṣām̐llohitākṣāṃśca deśe'smiṃstvadhipāṃsule|| 37||
ityevamāhvayāmāsa rukmiṇaṃ rohiṇīsutaḥ |
anuktvā vacanaṃ kiṃcid bāḍhamityabravītpunaḥ|| 38 ||
akṣān rukmī tato hṛṣṭaḥ pātayāmāsa pārthivaḥ |
cāturakṣe tu nirvṛtte nirjitasya narādhipaḥ || 39 ||
baladevena dharmeṇa netyuvāca tato balam |
dhairyānmanaḥ samādhāya sa na kiṃciduvāca ha || 2.61.40 ||
baladevaṃ tato rukmī mayā jitamiti smayan |
baladevastu tacchutvā jihmaṃ vākyaṃ narādhipa || 41 ||
bhūyaḥ krodhasamāviṣṭo nottaraṃ vyājahāra ha |
tato gambhīranirghoṣā vāguvācāśarīriṇī || 42 ||
baladevasya taṃ krodhaṃ vardhayantī mahātmanaḥ |
satyamāha balaḥ śrīmān dharmeṇaiva parājitaḥ || 43 ||
anuktvā vacanaṃ kiṃcit prāpto bhavati karmaṇā |
manasā samanujñātaṃ tatsyādityavagamyatām || 44 ||
iti śrutvā vacastathyamantarikṣātsubhāṣitam |
saṃkarṣaṇastathotthāya sauvarṇenoruṇā balī || 45 ||
rukmiṇyā bhrātaraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ nijaghāna mahītale |
vivāde kupito rāmaḥ kṣeptāraṃ kila rukmiṇama |
jaghānāṣṭāpadenaiva pramathya yadunandanaḥ || 46 ||
tato'pasṛtya saṃkruddhaḥ kaliṅgādhipaterapi |
dantān babhañja saṃrambhādunnanāda ca siṃhavat || 47 ||
svaḍgamudyamya tānsarvāṃstrāsayāmāsa pārthivān |
stambhaṃ sabhāyāḥ sauvarṇamutpāṭya balināṃ varaḥ || 48 ||
gajendra iva taṃ stambhaṃ karṣan saṃkarṣaṇastataḥ |
nirjagāma sabhādvārāttrāsayāmāsa kaiśikān|| 49 ||
rukmiṇaṃ nikṛtiprajñaṃ sa hatvā yādavarṣabhaḥ |
vitrāsya vidviṣaḥ sarvān siṃhaḥ kṣudramṛgāniva || 2.61.50 ||
jagāma śibiraṃ rāmaḥ svayameva janāvṛtaḥ |
nyavedayatsa kṛṣṇāya tatra sarvaṃ yathābhavat || 51 ||
novāca sa tadā kṛṣṇaḥ kiṃcidrāmaṃ mahādyutiḥ |
nigṛhya ca tadā''tmānaṃ kṛcchrādaśrūṇyavartayat || 52 ||
na hato vāsudevena yaḥ pūrvaṃ paravīrahā |
jyeṣṭho bhrātātha rukmiṇyā rukmiṇīsnehakāraṇāt||53||
sa rāmakaramuktena nihato dyūtamaṇḍale |
aṣṭāpadena balavān rājā vajradharopamaḥ || 54 ||
tasmin hate mahāvīrye nṛpatau bhīṣmakātmaje |
drumabhārgavatulye vai drumabhārgavaśikṣite || 55 ||
kṛtau ca yuddhakuśale nityayājini pātite |
vṛṣṇayaścāndhakāścaiva sarve vimanaso'bhavan || 56 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
rukmiṇī ca mahābhāgā vilapantyārtayā girā |
vilapantīṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā sāntvayāmāsa keśavaḥ || 57 ||
etat te sarvamākhyātaṃ rukmiṇo nidhanaṃ yathā |
vairasya ca samutthānaṃ vṛṣṇibhirbharatarṣabha || 58 ||
vṛṣṇayo'pi mahārāja dhanānyādāya sarvaśaḥ |
rāmakṛṣṇau samāśritya yayurdvāravatīṃ prati || 59 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi rūkmivadho nāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 61 ||

<2.62>

dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
rājovāca
bhūya eva tu viprarṣe baladevasya dhīmataḥ |
māhātmyaṃ śrotumicchāmi śeṣasya dharaṇībhṛtaḥ || 1 ||
atīva baladevaṃ taṃ tejorāśimanirjitam |
kathayanti mahātmānaṃ ye purāṇavido janāḥ || 2 ||
tasya karmāṇyahaṃ vipra śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ |
anantaṃ yaṃ vidurnāgamādidevaṃ mahaujasam || 3 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
purāṇe nāgarājo'sau paṭhyate dharaṇīdharaḥ |
śeṣastejonidhiḥ śrīmānakampyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 4 ||
yogācāryo mahāvīryo devamantramukho balī |
jarāsaṃdhaṃ gadāyuddhe jitavān yo na cāvadhīt || 5 ||
bahavaścaiva rājānaḥ prathitāḥ pṛthivītale |
anvayurmāgadhaṃ sarve te cāpi vijitā raṇe || 6 ||
nāgāyutabalaprāṇo bhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ |
asakṛd baladevena bāhuyuddhe parājitaḥ || 7 ||
duryodhanasya kanyāṃ tu haramāṇo nyagṛhyata |
sāmbo jāmbavatīputro nagare nāgasāhvaye || 8 ||
rājabhiḥ sarvato ruddhe haramāṇo balāt kila |
tadupaśrutya saṃruddhamājagāma mahābalaḥ || 9 ||
rāmastasya tu mokṣārthamāgato nālabhacca tam |
tataścukrodha balavānadbhutaṃ cākaronmahat || 2.62.10 ||
anivāryamabhedyaṃ ca divyamapratimaṃ bale |
lāṅgalāstraṃ samudyamya brahmamantrābhimantritam || 11 ||
prākāravapre vinyasya purasya ca mahādyutiḥ |
prakṣeptumaicchad gaṅgāyāṃ nagaraṃ kauravasya tat || 12 ||
tad vighūrṇitamālakṣya puraṃ duryodhano nṛpaḥ |
sāmbaṃ niryātayāmāsa sabhāryaṃ tasya dhīmataḥ || 13 ||
dadau śiṣyaṃ tadā''tmānaṃ rāmasya sumahātmanaḥ |
gadāyuddhe kurupatiṃ śiṣyaṃ jagrāha taṃ ca saḥ || 14 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti rājendra purametad vighūrṇitam |
āvarjitamivābhāti gaṅgāmabhimukhaṃ nṛpa || 15 ||
idamatyadbhutaṃ karma rāmasya kathitaṃ bhuvi |
bhāṇḍīre kathitaṃ rājan yat kṛtaṃ śauriṇā purā || 16 ||
pralambaṃ muṣṭinaikena yajjaghāna halāyudhaḥ |
dhenukaṃ tu mahāvīryaṃ cikṣepa nagamūrddhani |
sa gatāyuḥ papātorvyāṃ daityo gardabharūpadhṛk || 17 ||
lavaṇajalagamā mahānadī drutajalavegataraṅgamālinī |
nagaramabhimukhaṃ yadā hṛtā halavidhṛtā yamunā yamasvasā || 18 ||
baladevasya māhātmyametat te kathitaṃ mayā |
anantasyāprameyasya śeṣasya dharaṇībhṛtaḥ || 19 ||
iti puruṣavarasya lāṅgalerbahuvidhamuttamamanyadeva ca |
yadakathitamihādya karma te tadupalabhasva purāṇavistarāt || 2.62.20 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi baladevamāhātmye dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 62 ||

<2.63>

triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
pratyetya dvārakāṃ viṣṇurhate rukmiṇi vīryavān |
akarod yanmahābāhustanme vada mahāmune || 1 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
sa taiḥ parivṛtaḥ śrīmān purī yādavanandanaḥ |
dvārakāṃ bhagavān viṣṇuḥ pratyavaikṣata vīryavān || 2 ||
pratyapadyata ratnāni vividhāni vasūni ca |
yathāhaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣo nairṛtān pratyavārayat || 3 ||
tatra vighnaṃ caranti sma daiteyāḥ saha dānavaiḥ |
tāñjaghāna mahābāhurvaradṛptān mahāsurān || 4 ||
vighnaṃ cāsyākarot tatra narako nāma dānavaḥ |
trāsanaḥ sarvadevānāṃ devarājaripurmahān || 5 ||
sa bhūmau mūrtiliṅgasthaḥ sarvadevādhibādhitā |
devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca pratīpamakarot tadā || 6 ||
tvaṣṭurduhitaraṃ bhaumaḥ kaśerumagamat tadā |
gajarūpeṇa jagrāha rucirāṅgīṃ caturdaśīm || 7 ||
pramathya tāṃ varārohāṃ narako vākyamabravīt |
naṣṭaśokabhayo mohāt prāgjyotiṣapatistadā || 8 ||
yāni devamanuṣyeṣu ratnāni vividhāni ca |
bibharti ca mahī kṛtsnā sāgareṣu ca yad vasu || 9 ||
adyaprabhṛti tānīha sahitāḥ sarvanairṛtāḥ |
tavaivopāhariṣyanti daityāśca saha dānavaiḥ || 2.63.10 ||
evamuttamaratnāni vastrāṇi vividhāni ca |
sa jahāra tadā bhaumastacca nādhicakāra saḥ || 11 ||
gandharvāṇāṃ ca yāḥ kanyā jahāra narako balī |
yāśca devamanuṣyāṇāṃ sapta cāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || 12 ||
caturdaśa sahasrāṇi ekaviṃśacchatāni ca |
ekaveṇīdharāḥ sarvāḥ satīmārgamanuvratāḥ || 13 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tāsāṃ puravaraṃ bhaumo'kārayanmaṇiparvatam |
alakāyāmadīnātmā muro svaviṣayaṃ prati || 14 ||
tāśca prāgjyotiṣapatiṃ muroścaiva daśātmajāḥ |
nairṛtāśca yathā mukhyāḥ pālayanta upāsate |
sa eṣa tapasaḥ pāre varadṛpto mahāsuraḥ || 15 ||
na cāsuragaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ sahitaiḥ karma tat purā |
kṛtapūrvaṃ tadā ghoraṃ yadakārṣīnmahāsuraḥ || 16 ||
aditiṃ dharṣayāmāsa kuṇḍalārthe mahāsuraḥ |
yaṃ mahī suṣuve devī yasya prāgjyotiṣaṃ puram || 17 ||
dvārapālāśca catvārastasyāsan yuddhadurmadāḥ |
hayagrīvo nisundaśca vīraḥ pañcanadastathā || 18 ||
muruḥ putrasahasraiśca varadatto'suro mahān |
ādevayānamāvṛtya panthānaṃ samupasthitaḥ |
vitrāsanaḥ sukṛtināṃ virūpai rākṣasaiḥ saha || 19 ||
tadvadhārthaṃ mahābāhuḥ śaṅkhacakragadāsibhṛt |
jāto vṛṣṇiṣu devakyāṃ vasudevājjanārdanaḥ || 2.63.20 ||
tasyātha puruṣendrasya lokaprathitatejasaḥ |
nivāso dvārakā devairupāyādupapāditā || 21 ||
atīva hi purī ramyā dvārakā vāsavakṣayāt |
mahārṇavaparikṣiptā pañcaparvataśobhitā || 22 ||
tasyāṃ devapurābhāyāṃ sabhā kāñcanatoraṇā |
sā dāśārhīti vikhyātā yojanāyāmavistṛtā || 23 ||
tatra vṛṣṇyandhakāḥ sarve rāmakṛṣṇapurogamāḥ |
lokayātrāmimāṃ kṛtsnāṃ parirakṣanta āsate || 24 ||
tatrāsīneṣu sarveṣu kadācid bharatarṣabha |
divyagandho vavau vāyuḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ papāta ha || 25 ||
tataḥ kilakilāśabdaḥ prabhājālābhisaṃvṛtaḥ |
muhūrtamantarikṣe'bhūt tato bhūmau pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 26 ||
madhye tu tejasastasya pāṇḍuraṃ gajamāsthitaḥ |
vṛto devagaṇaiḥ sarvairvāsavaḥ samadṛśyata || 27 ||
rāmakṛṣṇau ca rājā sa vṛṣṇyandhakagaṇaiḥ saha |
pratyudyayurmahātmānaṃ pūjayantaḥ sureśvaram || 28 ||
so'vartārya gajāt tūrṇaṃ pariṣvajya janārdanam |
sasvaje baladevaṃ ca taṃ ca rājānamāhukam || 29 ||
vṛṣṇīnanyān sasvaje ca yathākālaṃ yathāvayaḥ |
pūjito rāmakṛṣṇābhyāmāviveśa sa tāṃ sabhām || 2.63.30 ||
tatrāsīno'bhyalaṃkṛtvā sabhāṃ tāmamareśvaraḥ |
arghyādisamudācāraṃ pratyagṛhṇād yathāvidhi || 31 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
athovāca mahātejā vāsavo vāsavānujam|
sāntvapūrvaṃ kareṇāsya saṃspṛśya vadanaṃ śubham || 32 ||
devakīnandana vacaḥ śṛṇu me madhusūdana |
yena tvābhigato'smyadya kāryeṇāmitrakarśana || 33 ||
nairṛto narako nāma brahmaṇo varadarpitaḥ |
adityāḥ kuṇḍale mohājjahāra ditinandanaḥ || 34 ||
devānāṃ vipriye nityamṛṣīṇāṃ ca sa vartate |
taṃ ca devāntaraṃ prekṣya jahi tvaṃ pāpapūruṣam || 35 ||
ayaṃ tvāṃ garuḍastatra prāpayiṣyati kāmagaḥ |
kāmavīryo'titejasvī vainateyo'ntarikṣagaḥ || 36 ||
avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhaumaḥ sa narako'suraḥ |
niṣūdayitvā taṃ pāpaṃ kṣipramāgantumarhasi || 37 ||
ityuktaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣo devarājena keśavaḥ |
pratijajñe mahābāhurnarakasya nibarhaṇe || 38 ||
tataḥ sahaiva śakreṇa śaṅkhacakragadāsibhṛt|
pratasthe garuḍenātha satyabhābhāsahāyavān || 39 ||
krameṇa saptaskandhān sa marutāṃ sahavāsavaḥ |
paśyatāṃ yadusiṃhānāmūrdhvamācakrame balī || 2.63.40 ||
vāraṇendragataḥ śakro garuḍastho janārdanaḥ |
vidūratvāt prakāśete sūryācandramasāviva || 41 ||
antarikṣe ca gandharvairapsarobhiśca keśavaḥ |
stūyamāno'tha śakraśca krameṇāntaradhīyata || 42 ||
samādhāyetikartavyaṃ vāsavo vibudhādhipaḥ |
svameva bhavanaṃ prāyāt kṛṣṇaḥ prāgjyotiṣaṃ prati || 43 ||
pakṣānilahato vāyuḥ pratilomaṃ vavau tadā |
tato bhīmaravā meghā babhramurgaganecarāḥ || 44 ||
kṣaṇena samanuprāpto dvijenākāśagena vai |
dūrādeva ca tān dṛṣṭvā prayayau yatra te sthitāḥ || 45 ||
apaśyad dvāri tatrasthāṃ hastyaśvarathavāhinīm |
kṣurāntān mauravānpāśān ṣaṭsahasrāndadarśa ha||46||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
garuḍasyopari śrīmāñchaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ |
bibhrannīlāmbudākāraṃ pītavāsāścaturbhujaḥ || 47 ||
vanamālākuloraskaḥ śrīvatsāṅkitabhūṣaṇaḥ |
kirīṭamūrddhā sūryābhaḥ savidyudiva candramāḥ || 48 ||
jyāṃ vikūjanmahāśabdaḥ śrūyate'śaniniḥsvanaḥ |
jñātvā ca dānavaḥ sarvaṃ svayaṃ viṣṇurihāgataḥ || 49 ||
krodhād dviguṇaraktākṣo muruḥ kālāntakopamaḥ |
abhyadhāvata vegena śaktiṃ gṛhya mahāsuraḥ || 2.63.50 ||
cikṣepa sumahāśaktiṃ vajrakāñcanabhūṣitām |
tāmāpatantīṃ śaktiṃ tu maholkāṃ jvalitāmiva || 51 ||
samādhatta śaraṃ caikaṃ rukmapuṅkhaṃ janārdanaḥ |
dvidhācchinatkṣurapreṇa vāsudevaḥ sa vīryavān || 52 ||
śaktiṃ ciccheda tatrāsau vidyutpuñja iva jvalan |
punaśca krodharaktākṣo mururgṛhya mahāgadām || 53 ||
indrāśanirivendreṇa vikṛṣṭa iva niḥsvanaḥ |
ākarṇamuktaṃ cikṣepa ardhacandraṃ surottamaḥ || 54 ||
madhyadeśe tu ciccheda gadāṃ tāṃ rukmabhūṣitām |
punaściccheda bhallena dānavasya śiro raṇe || 55 ||
saṃchidya pāśān sarvāṃstān muruṃ hatvā sabāndhavam |
so'gryānrakṣogaṇān hatvā narakasya mahābalān ||56||
śilāsaṃghānatikramya bhagavān devakīsutaḥ |
apaśyad dānavaṃ sainyaṃ nisundaṃ ca mahābalam || 57 ||
hayagrīvaṃ ca ditijaṃ tathānyāṃścitrayodhinaḥ |
rodhayāmāsa tanmārgaṃ svasainyena mahābalaḥ || 58 ||
nisundo balināṃ śreṣṭho rathamāruhya satvaram |
jagrāha kārmukaṃ divyaṃ hemapṛṣṭhaṃ durāsadam || 59 ||
vivyādha daśabhirbāṇairnisundo madhusūdanam |
keśavaścāpi saptatyā vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ || 2.63.60 ||
aprāptāṃścāntarikṣe tāñcharāṃściccheda mādhavaḥ |
te sarve sainikāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ samantātparyavārayan || 61 ||
śarajālena mahatā chādyamānaḥ surottamaḥ |
dṛṣṭvā tāndānavānsarvānsakrodho madhusūdanaḥ || 62 ||
tato divyena cāstreṇa pārjanyena janārdanaḥ |
mahatā śaravarṣeṇa vārayāmāsa tadbalam || 63 ||
pañcapañcaśaraisteṣu ekaikena ca tān bahūn |
pārjanyasya prabhāveṇa sarvān marmasvatāḍayat || 64 ||
dudruvurbhayasaṃtrastā bhagnāste dānavā raṇe |
svasainyaṃ vidrutaṃ dṛṣṭvā niścakrāma punarmṛdhe || 65 ||
visṛjañcharavarṣāṇi chādayāmāsa keśavam |
na vibhāti raṇe sūryo nāpi vyoma diśo daśa || 66 ||
śaraiḥ saṃchādayāmāsa nisundo garuḍadhvajam |
sāvitraṃ nāma divyāstraṃ jagrāha puruṣottamaḥ || 67 ||
tena bāṇena tān bāṇāṃściccheda samare hariḥ |
bāṇairbāṇāṃśca saṃcchidya tasya kṛṣṇo mahābalaḥ || 68 ||
chatramekena bāṇena ratheṣāṃ ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ |
punaściccheda tānaśvāṃścaturbhiścaturaḥ śaraiḥ || 69 ||
sārathiṃ pañcabhirbāṇairdhvajamekena cicchide |
śaraikena vapuḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sutīkṣṇena śitena vai || 2.63.70 ||
śiraściccheda bhallena nisundasya surottamaḥ |
yaḥ sahasrasamāstvekaḥ sarvān devānayodhayat || 71 ||
nisundaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā hayagrīvaḥ pratāpavān |
śilāṃ pragṛhya mahatīṃ tolayāmāsa dānavaḥ || 72 ||
āvidhya sahasā muñcacchilāṃ śailasamāṃ prabhuḥ |
gṛhītvā divyapārjanyamastramastravidāṃ varaḥ || 73 |
divyāstreṇa śilāṃ viṣṇuḥ saptadhākṛta tejasā |
tad vidārya mahaccāśma pātayāmāsa bhūtale || 74 ||
tatastaiḥ śārṅganirmuktairnānāvarṇairmahāśaraiḥ |
yathā devāsuraṃ yuddhamabhavad bharatarṣabha |
nānāpraharaṇākīrṇaṃ tathā ghoramavartata || 75 ||
tataḥ śārṅgavinirmuktairnānāvarṇairmahāśarai |
garuḍastho mahābāhurnijaghāna mahāsurān || 76 ||
mahālāṅgalanirbhinnāḥ śaṅkhaśaktinipātitāḥ |
vineśurdānavāḥ sarve samāsādya janārdanam || 77 ||
keciccakrāgninirdagdhā dānavāḥ peturambarāt |
saṃnikarṣagatāḥ kecid gatāsuvikṛtānanāḥ || 78 ||
asṛjañcharavarṣāṇi vṛṣṭimanta ivāmbudāḥ |
vikṛtāṅgāsurāḥ sarve kṛṣṇabāṇaprapīḍitāḥ || 79 ||
śoṇitāktāḥ sma dṛśyante puṣpitā iva kiṃśukāḥ|
vyadravanta suvitrastā bhagnāstrāścitrayodhinaḥ || 2.63.80 ||
punaśca krodharaktākṣo vāyuvegena dānavaḥ |
daśavyāmocchritaṃ vṛkṣaṃ samāruhya vanaspatim || 81 ||
vṛkṣamutpāṭya vegena pratigṛhyābhyadhāvata |
cikṣepa sa mahāvṛkṣaṃ śikṣayā sughanākṛtiḥ || 82 ||
vṛkṣavegānilodbhūtaḥ śuśruve sumahāsvanaḥ |
tataḥ śarasahasreṇa yatamāno janārdanaḥ || 83 ||
naikadhā taṃ praciccheda citrabhānunibhākṛtim |
punaścaikena bāṇena hayagrīvasya corasi || 84 ||
vivyādha stanayormadhye sāyako jvalanaprabhaḥ |
viveśa so'pi vegena hṛdaṃ bhittvā vinirgataḥ || 85 ||
taṃ jaghāna mahāghoraṃ hayagrīvaṃ mahābalam |
apāratejā durddharṣaḥ sa vai yādavanandanaḥ || 86 ||
madhye lohitagaṅgasya bhagavān devakīsutaḥ |
audakāyāṃ virūpākṣaṃ pāpmānaṃ puruṣottamaḥ || 87 ||
aṣṭau śatasahasrāṇi dānavānāṃ paraṃtapaḥ |
nihatya puruṣavyāghraḥ prāgjyotiṣamupādravat || 88 ||
hatvā pañcanadaṃ nāma narakasya mahāsuram |
tataḥ prāgjyotiṣaṃ nāma dīpyamānamiva śriyā || 89 ||
puramāsādayāmāsa yuddhaṃ tatrābhavanmahat |
tataḥ prādhmāpayacchaṅkhaṃ pāñcajanyaṃ mahābalaḥ || 2.63.90 ||
śuśruve sumahāśabdaḥ saṃvartaninado yathā |
śrūyate triṣu lokeṣu bhīmagambhīraniḥsvanaḥ |
taṃ śrutvā narakaścāsīt krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ || 91 ||
lohacakrāṣṭasaṃyuktaṃ vinalvapratimaṃ ratham |
ratnakāñcanacitrāḍhyaṃ vedikābhogavistaram || 92 ||
vajradhvajena mahatā kāñcanena virājitam |
hemadaṇḍapatākāḍhyaṃ vaidūryamaṇikūbaram || 93 ||
yuktamaśvasahasreṇa rathaṃ pararathārujam|
lohajālaiśca saṃchannaṃ citrabhaktivirājitam || 94 ||
rathamadhyagato vīraḥ sasaṃdhya iva bhāskaraḥ |
nānāpraharaṇākīrṇaṃ rathaṃ hemapariṣkṛtam || 95 ||
vajraṃ tathoracchadaminduvarṇaṃ vyānaddhamuktānalatulyatejāḥ |
kirīṭamūrddhārkahutāśanābhaḥ karṇau tathā kuṇḍalayorjvalantau || 96 ||
dhūmravarṇā mahākāyā raktākṣā vikṛtānanāḥ |
nānākavacinaḥ sarve daityadānavarākṣasāḥ || 97 ||
khaḍgacarmadharāḥ kecit kecit tūṇadhanurbhṛtaḥ |
śaktihastāstathā kecicchūlahastāstathāpare || 98 ||
gajavājirathaughaiśca cālayantaśca medinīm |
niryayurnagarāt sarve susaṃnaddhāḥ prahāriṇaḥ || 99 ||
vṛto daityagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ narakaḥ kālasaṃnibhaḥ |
bherīśaṅkhamṛdaṅgānāṃ paṇavānāṃ sahasraśaḥ || 2.63.100||
śuśrāva vādyamānānāṃ jīmūtaninadopamam |
yataḥ kṛṣṇastato gatvā sarve te vikṛtānanāḥ || 101||
parivārya garutmantaṃ sarve'yudhyanta saṃgatāḥ |
mahatā chādayāmāsuḥ śaravarṣeṇa sainikāḥ || 102||
śaktiśūlagadāprāsāṃstomarānsāyakānbahūn |
ākāśaṃ chādayāmāsurvimuñcantaḥ sahasraśaḥ || 103||
kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇāmbudākāraḥ śārṅgaṃ gṛhya dhanustataḥ |
visphārya sumahaccāpaṃ dhanurjaladaniḥsvanam ||104 ||
vyasṛjaccharavarṣāṇi dānavānāṃ janārdanaḥ |
śaravarṣeṇa tatsainyaṃ vyadravat tu mahāhavāt || 105||
tad yuddhamabhavad ghoraṃ ghorarūpeṇa rakṣasā |
bhagnavyūhāśca te sarve kṛṣṇabāṇaprapīḍitāḥ ||106||
kecicchinnabhujāścaiva cchinnagrīvāśirānanāḥ |
keciccakradvidhācchinnāḥ kecid bāṇārditorasaḥ|| 107||
kecid dvidhākṛtāḥ śaktyā gajāśvarathavāhanāḥ |
kecitkaumodakībhinnāḥ keciccakravidāritāḥ || 108||
evaṃ vimathitā sarvā narāśvarathavāhinī |
tatrāsīnnarakeṇāsya yuddhaṃ paramadāruṇam || 109||
yat samāsena vakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu |
trāsanaḥ surasaṃghānāṃ narakaḥ puruṣottamam || 2.63.110||
yodhayāmāsa tejasvī madhuvanmadhusūdanam |
krodharaktāntanayano narako ghanasaṃnibhaḥ || 111||
jagrāha kārmukaṃ vīraḥ śakracāpamivocchritam |
tathārkakiraṇaprakhyaṃ bāṇaṃ jagrāha keśavaḥ || 112||
divyenāstreṇa samare pūrayāmāsa taṃ ratham |
uttamāstraṃ mahāpātaṃ mumoca narako balī || 113||
bajraviskūrjitākāramāyāntaṃ vīkṣya keśavaḥ |
cicchedāstraṃ mahābhāgaścakreṇa madhusūdanaḥ || 114||
vyahanat sārathiṃ cāsya śaraikeṇa janārdanaḥ |
sa rathaṃ sadhvajaṃ sāśvaṃ jaghāna daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ || 115||
tanutraṃ caiva ciccheda śareṇa madhusūdanaḥ |
tato vimuktakavacaḥ sarpasyeva tanuryathā || 116||
hatāśvo'pi raṇe vīro vitanutraśca dānavaḥ |
jagrāha vimalajvālaṃ lohabhārārpitaṃ dṛḍham || 117||
āvidhya sahasā muktaṃ śūlamindrāśaniprabham |
tadāpatat sa samprekṣya śūlaṃ hemapariṣkṛtam || 118||
dvidhā chinnaṃ kṣurapreṇa kṛṣṇenādbhutakarmaṇā |
tad yuddhamabhavad ghoraṃ ghorarūpeṇa rakṣasā ||119|
śastrapātamahāghātaṃ narakeṇa mahātmanā |
muhūrtaṃ yodhayāmāsa narakaṃ madhusūdanaḥ || 2.63.120||
athogracakraścakreṇa pradīptenākarod dvidhā |
cakradvidhākṛtaṃ tasya śarīramapatad bhuvi || 121||
vibhaktaṃ kuliśenaiva gireḥ śṛṅgaṃ dvidhākṛtam |
kṛṣṇamāsādya deveśaṃ jagāmāstamivāṃśumān || 122||
cakrotkṛntitagātro'sau dānavaḥ patito raṇe |
vajraprahāranirbhinnaṃ yathā gairikaparvatam ||123||
bhūmistu patitaṃ putraṃ nirīkṣyādāya kuṇḍale |
upātiṣṭhata govindaṃ vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 124||
dattastvayaiva govinda tvayaiva vinipātitaḥ |
yathecchasi tathā krīḍa bālaḥ krīḍanakairiva || 125||
ime te kuṇḍale deva prajāstasyānupālaya || 126||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi narakavadhe triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ||63||

<2.64>

catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
nihatya narakaṃ bhaumaṃ vāsavopamavikramam |
vāsavāvarajo viṣṇurdadarśa narakālayam || 1 ||
athārthagṛhamāsādya narakasya janārdanaḥ |
dadarśa dhanamakṣayyaṃ ratnāni vividhāni ca || 2 ||
maṇimuktāpravālāni vaidūryasya ca saṃcayān |
māsāragalvakūṭāni tathā vajrasya saṃcayān || 3 ||
jāmbūnadamayānyasya śātakumbhamayāni ca |
pradīptajvalanābhāni śītaraśminibhāni ca || 4 ||
śayanāni mahārhāṇi tathā siṃhāsanāni ca |
hiraṇyadaṇḍaruciraṃ śītaraśmisamaprabham || 5 ||
dadarśa tanmahacchatraṃ varṣamāṇamivāmbudam|
jātarūpasya śubhrasya dhārāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ || 6 ||
varuṇādāhṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ narakeṇeti naḥ śrutam|
yāvadratnaṃ gṛhe dṛṣṭaṃ narakasya dhanaṃ bahu || 7 ||
naiva rājñaḥ kuberasya na śakrasya yamasya ca |
ratnasaṃnicayastādṛg dṛṣṭapūrvo na ca śrutaḥ || 8 ||
hate bhaume nisunde ca hayagrīve ca dānave |
upāninyustatastāni ratnānyantaḥpurāṇi ca || 9 ||
dānavā hataśiṣṭā ye kośasaṃcayarakṣiṇaḥ |
keśavāya mahārhāṇi yānyarhati janārdanaḥ || 2.64.10 ||
daityā ūcuḥ
imāni maṇiratnāni vividhāni bahūni ca |
bhīmarūpāśca mātaṅgāḥ pravālavikṛtāḥ kuthāḥ || 11 ||
hemasūtrā mahākakṣāścāpatomaraśālinaḥ |
rucirābhiḥ patākābhiḥ śabalā rucirāṃkuśāḥ || 12 ||
te ca viṃśatisāhasrā dvistāvatyaḥ kareṇavaḥ |
aṣṭau śata sahasrāṇi deśajāścottamā hayāḥ || 13 ||
goṣu cāpi kṛto yāvān kāmastava janārdana |
tāvatīḥ prāpayiṣyāmo vṛṣṇyandhakaniveśanam || 14 ||
āvikāni ca sūkṣmāṇi śayanānyāsanāni ca |
kāmavyāhāriṇaścaiva pakṣiṇaḥ priyadarśanāḥ || 15 ||
nandanāgurukāṣṭhāni tathā kālīyakānyapi |
vasu yat triṣu lokeṣu dharmeṇādhigataṃ tava |
prāpayiṣyāma tat sarva vṛṣṇyandhakaniveśanam || 16 ||
devagandharvaratnāni pannagānāṃ ca yad vasu |
tāni sarvāṇi santīha narakasya niveśane || 17 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tacca sarvaṃ hṛṣīkeśaḥ parigṛhya parīkṣya ca |
sarvamāhārayāmāsa dānavairdvārakāṃ purīm || 18 ||
tatastad vāruṇaṃ chatraṃ svayamutkṣipya mādhavaḥ |
hiraṇyavarṣaṃ varṣantamāruroha vihaṅgamam || 19 ||
garuḍaṃ patagaśreṣṭhaṃ mūrtimantamivāmbudam |
tato'bhyayād giriśreṣṭhamabhito maṇiparvatam || 2.64.20 ||
tatra puṇyā vayurvātā hyabhavaṃścāmalāḥ prabhāḥ |
maṇīnāṃ hemavarṇānāmabhibhūya divākaram || 21 ||
tatra vaidūryavarṇāni dadarśa madhusūdanaḥ |
satoraṇapatākāni dvārāṇi śaraṇāni ca || 22 ||
vidyudgrathitameghābhaḥ prababhau maṇiparvataḥ |
hemacitravitānaiśca prāsādairupaśobhitaḥ || 23 ||
tatra tā varahemābhā dadarśa madhusūdanaḥ |
gandharvasuramukhyānāṃ priyā duhitarastathā || 24 ||
dadarśa pṛthulaśroṇīḥ saṃruddhā girikandare |
narakeṇa samānītā rakṣyamāṇāḥ samantataḥ || 25 ||
triviṣṭapasame deśe tiṣṭhantīraparājitāḥ |
nirviśantyo yathā devyaḥ sukhinyaḥ kāmavarjitāḥ || 26 ||
parivavrurmahābāhumekaveṇīdharāḥ striyaḥ |
sarvāḥ kāṣāyavāsinyaḥ sarvāśca niyatendriyāḥ || 27 ||
vratopavāsatanvaṅgyaḥ kāṅkṣantyaḥ kṛṣṇadarśanam|
sametya yadusiṃhasya sarvāścakruḥ striyo'ñjalīn|| 28 ||
narakaṃ nihataṃ jñātvā muraṃ caiva mahāsuram|
hayagrīvaṃ nisundaṃ ca tāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ paryavārayan || 29 ||
ye cāsāṃ rakṣiṇo vṛddhā dānavā yadunandanam |
kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve praṇipeturvayo'dhikāḥ || 2.64.30 ||
tāsāṃ paramanārīṇāmṛṣabhākṣaṃ nirīkṣya tam|
sarvāsāmeva saṃkalpaḥ patitvenābhavat tataḥ || 31 ||
tasya candropamaṃ vaktraṃ nirīkṣya muditendriyāḥ |
samprahaṣṭā mahābāhumidaṃ vacanamabruvan || 32 ||
satyaṃ ca yatpurā vāyurihāsmānvākyamabravīt |
sarvabhūtamatijñaśca devarṣirapi nāradaḥ || 33 ||
viṣṇurnārāyaṇo devaḥ śaṅkhacakragadāsibhṛt |
sa bhaumaṃ narakaṃ hatvā bhartā ca bhavitā sa vaḥ || 34 ||
supriyaṃ bata paśyāmaściraśrutamariṃdamam|
darśanena kṛtārthā hi vayamadya mahātmanaḥ || 35 ||
tatastāḥ sāntvayāmāsa pramadā vāsavānujaḥ |
sarvāḥ kamalapatrākṣīrdṛṣṭvā covāca mādhavaḥ || 36 ||
yathārhataḥ pūjayitvā samābhāṣya ca keśavaḥ |
yānaiḥ kiṅkarasaṃyuktairuvāha madhusūdanaḥ || 37 ||
kiṅkarāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi rakṣasāṃ vātaraṃhasām |
śibikāṃ vahatāṃ tatra nirghoṣaḥ sumahānabhūt || 38 ||
tasya parvatarājasya śṛṅgaṃ yat paramārcitam |
vimalārkendusaṃkāśaṃ maṇikāñcanatoraṇam || 39 ||
sapakṣigaṇamātaṅgaṃ samṛgavyālapādapam |
śākhāmṛgagaṇākīrṇaṃ suprastaraśilātalam || 2.64.40 ||
nyaṃkubhiśca varāhaiśca rurubhiśca niṣevitam |
saprapātaṃ mahāsānuṃ vicitraśikharadrumam || 41 ||
atyadbhutamacintyaṃ ca mṛgavṛndaviloḍitam |
jīvañjīvakasaṃghaiśca barhibhiśca nināditam || 42 ||
tadapyatibalo viṣṇurdorbhyāmutpāṭya bhāsuram |
āropayāmāsa balī garuḍe pakṣiṇāṃ vare || 43 ||
maṇiparvataśṛṅgaṃ ca sabhāryaṃ ca janārdanam |
uvāha līlayā pakṣī garuḍaḥ patatāṃ varaḥ || 44 ||
sa pakṣavalavikṣepairhimādriśikharopamaḥ |
dikṣu sarvāsu saṃhrādaṃ janayāmāsa pakṣirāṭ || 45 ||
ārujan parvatāgrāṇi pādapāṃśca samutkṣipan |
saṃjahāra mahābhrāṇi vijahāra ca kānicit || 46||
viṣayaṃ samatikramya devayoścandrasūryayoḥ |
yayau vātajavaḥ pakṣī janārdanavaśe sthitaḥ || 47 ||
sa merugirimāsādya devagandharvasevitam |
devasadmāni sarvāṇi dadarśa madhusūdanaḥ || 48 ||
viśveṣāṃ marutāṃ caiva sādhyānāṃ ca narādhipa |
bhrājamānānyatikrāmannaśvinośca paraṃtapa || 49 ||
prāpya puṇyatamāṃllokān devalokamariṃdamaḥ |
śakrasadma samāsādya praviveśa janārdanaḥ || 2.64.50 ||
avatīrya sa tārkṣyāt tu dadarśa vibudhādhipam |
prītaścaivābhyanandat taṃ devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ || 51 ||
prādāya kuṇḍale divye vavande taṃ tadācyutaḥ |
sabhāryo vibudhaśreṣṭhaṃ naraśreṣṭho janārdanaḥ || 52 ||
arcito devarājena ratnaiśca pratipūjitaḥ |
satyabhāmā ca paulomyā yathāvadabhinanditā || 53||
vāsavo vāsudevaśca jagmatuḥ sahitau tadā |
adityā bhavanaṃ divyaṃ devamāturmaharddhimat || 54 ||
tatrāditimupāsyantīmapsarobhiḥ samantataḥ |
dadṛśāte mahātmānau mahābhāgāṃ tapo'nvitām || 55 ||
tataste kuṇḍale divye prādādaditinandanaḥ |
vavande tāṃ śacībhartā mātaraṃ svāṃ puraṃdaraḥ || 56 ||
janārdanaṃ puraskṛtya karma caiva śaśaṃsa tat|
aditistau sutau prītyā pariṣvajyābhinandya ca || 57 ||
āśīrbhiranukūlābhirubhāvapyavadat tadā |
paulomī satyabhāmā ca prītyā paramayā yute || 58 ||
agṛhṇītāṃ varārhāyā devyāste caraṇau śubhau |
te cāpyabhyavadat premṇā devamātā yaśasvinī || 59 ||
yathāvadabravīccaiva janārdanamidaṃ vacaḥ |
adhṛṣyaḥ sarvabhūtānāmavadhyaśca bhaviṣyasi || 2.64.60 ||
yathaiva devarājo'yamajito lokapūjitaḥ |
bhavatviyaṃ varārohā nityaṃ ca priyadarśanā || 61 ||
sarvalokeṣu vikhyātā divyagandhā manoramā |
satyabhāmottamā strīṇāṃ subhagā sthirayauvanā || 62 ||
jarāṃ na yāsyati vadhūryāvattvaṃ kṛṣṇa mānuṣaḥ |
evamabhyarcitaḥ kṛṣṇo devamātrā mahābalaḥ || 63 ||
devarājābhyanujñāto ratnaiśca pratipūjitaḥ |
vainateyaṃ samāruhya sahitaḥ satyabhāmayā || 64 ||
devākrīḍaṃ parikrāman pūjyamānaṃ surarṣibhiḥ |
sa dadarśa mahābāhurākrīḍe vāsavasya ha || 65 ||
divyabhabhyarcitaṃ devaiḥ pārijātaṃ mahādrumam |
nityapuṣpadharaṃ divyaṃ puṇyagandhamanuttamam || 66 ||
yamāsādya janaḥ sarvo jātiṃ smarati paurvikīm |
saṃrakṣyamāṇaṃ devaistaṃ prasahyāmitavikramaḥ || 67 ||
utpāṭyāropayāmāsa viṣṇustaṃ garuḍopari |
so'paśyatsatyabhāmā ca divyamapsarasāṃ gaṇam ||68||
pṛṣṭhataḥ satyabhāmā ca divyā yoṣā ca vīkṣitā |
prāyāt tato dvāravatīṃ vāyujuṣṭena vai pathā || 69 ||
śrutvā taṃ devarājastu karma kṛṣṇasya tat tadā |
anumene mahābāhuḥ kṛtakarmeti cābravīt || 2.64.70 ||
sa pūjyamānastridaśaiḥ saptarṣigaṇasaṃstutaḥ |
pratasthe dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇo devalokādariṃdamaḥ || 71 ||
so'bhipatya mahābāhurdīrghamadhvānamalpavat|
pūjito devarājena dadṛśe yādavīṃ purīm || 72 ||
tathā karma mahatkṛtvā bhagavān vāsavānujaḥ |
upāyād dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ śrīmān garuḍavāhanaḥ || 73 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi pārijātaharaṇe dvārakāpraveśe catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 64 ||

<2.65>

pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
prādurbhāve muniśreṣṭha māthure caritaṃ śubham |
śṛṇvannaivādhigacchāmi tṛptiṃ kṛṣṇasya dhīmataḥ || 1 ||
dvārakāyāṃ nivasataḥ kṛtadārasya ṣaḍguṇam |
caritaṃ brūhi kṛṣṇasya sarvaṃ hi viditaṃ tava || 2 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
janamejaya kṛṣṇasya kṛtadārasya bhārata |
nibodha caritaṃ citraṃ tasyaiva sadṛśaṃ prabho || 3 ||
prāptadāro mahātejā vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān |
rukmiṇyā sahito devyā yayau raivatakaṃ nṛpa || 4 ||
ḍapavāsāvasānaṃ hi rukmiṇyāḥ pratipūjayan |
tarpayiṣyan svayaṃ viprāñjagāma madhusūdanaḥ || 5 ||
kumārāḥ prayayustatra putrabhrātara eva ca |
preṣitā vāsudevena nāradasyābhyanujñayā || 6 ||
ṣoḍaśa strīsahasrāṇi jagmureva ca dhīmataḥ |
ṛddhayā paramayā rājan viṣṇorevānurūpayā || 7 ||
tatastatra dvijātīnāṃ kāmān prādādadhokṣajaḥ |
arthināṃ dharmanityānāṃ bandināmiṣṭavādinām || 8 ||
kalyāṇanāmagotrāṇāṃ mahatāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām |
yaunaiḥ śrautaiśca mākhaiśca śuddhānāṃ kurunandana || 9 ||
tarpayitvā dvijān kāmairiṣṭairiṣṭaḥ satāṃ gatiḥ|
jñātīn saṃtarpayāmāsa yathārhaṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ || 2.65.10 ||
upavāsāvasāne'tha bhagavān sa viśeṣataḥ |
bahumene priyāṃ bhāryāṃ rukmiṇīṃ bhīṣmakātmajām || 11 ||
vasatastasya kṛṣṇasya sadārasyāmitaujasaḥ |
sahāsīnasya rukmiṇyā nārado'bhyāyayau muniḥ || 12 ||
āgataṃ cāprameyātmā munimindrānujastadā |
śāstradṛṣṭena vidhinā arcayāmāsa keśavaḥ || 13 ||
so'rcito vāsudevena munirarcyatamaḥ satām |
pārijātataroḥ puṣpaṃ dadau kṛṣṇāya bhārata || 14 ||
tadvṛkṣarājakusumaṃ rukyiṇyāḥ pradadau hariḥ |
pārśvasthā sā hi kṛṣṇasya bhojyā naravarābhavat || 15 ||
pratigṛhya tu tat puṣpaṃ kāmāraṇiraninditā |
śirasyamalapatrākṣī dadau kṛṣṇeṅgitānugā || 16 ||
trailokyanṛpasarvasvaṃ nārāyaṇamanoharā |
śuśubhe devapuṣpeṇa dviguṇaṃ bhaiṣmakī tadā || 17 ||
tāṃ nāradastathovāca munirbrahmasutastadā |
tavaivaupayikaṃ puṣpamekaṃ devi pativrate || 18 ||
alaṃkṛtaṃ puṣpametat saṃsargāt tava sarvathā |
atyarhā ca matā me tvametatpuṣpād dhṛtavrate || 19 ||
kalyāṇaguṇasampanne satataṃ bhartṛvatsale |
amlānametat satataṃ puṣpaṃ bhavati kāmini || 2.65.20 ||
saṃvatsaraparaṃ kālaṃ kālajñe guṇasammate |
īpsitānapi gandhāṃśca dadāti vadatāṃ vare || 21 ||
śītoṣṇe cecchite devi puṣpametat prayacchati |
sravatyapi rasāndevi manasā kāṅkṣitānvarān||22
sevyamānaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ dadāti varavarṇini |
sravatyapi tathā gandhānīpsitānprītivarddhanān || 23 ||
yāni yāni ca puṣpāṇi tvaṃ devyabhilaṣiṣyasi |
kusumaṃ vṛkṣarājasya tāni tāni pradāsyati || 24 ||
etadeva bhagādhānaṃ dharmiṣṭhe putradaṃ tathā |
matiṃ ca nāśubhe dhatte dhāryamāṇaṃ sadā śubhe || 25 ||
yad yadicchasi varṇaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ dhārayiṣyati |
svalpaṃ vā yadi vā sthūlaṃ chandataste bhaviṣyati || 26 |
aniṣṭagandhaharaṇametat sadgandhavarddhanam |
pradīpakarma rātrau ca karoti kamalekṣaṇe || 27 ||
saṃtānakasrajo mālāṃ puṣpavastrādi vācyutam |
puṣpamaṇḍapamukhyāni cintitena pradāsyati || 28 ||
bubhukṣā vā pipāsā vā glānirvāpyathavā jarā|
devavaddhārayantyāste svacchandena bhaviṣyati || 29 ||
anugītāni gītāni dāsyatyapi ca cintite |
suvāditrān sumadhurāṃstathaiva tava sammatān || 2.65.30 ||
pūrṇe saṃvatsare devi puṣpametat tavāntikāt|
nirvartsyate taruvaraṃ samayena prayāsyati || 31 ||
kṛtireṣā hi bhadraṃ te pārijātasya suprabhe |
nisargataḥ sargakṛtā satkārārthe'suradviṣām || 32 ||
umā devavarasyeṣṭā himālayasutā satī |
dhārayantīśvarī nityaṃ puṣpāṇyetāni suprabhe || 33 ||
aditiśca sapaulomī mahendrasuratāraṇī |
sāvitrī devamātā ca śrīśca sarvaguṇocitā || 34 ||
devapatnayastathaivānyā devāśca vasudevatāḥ |
saṃvatsaraparaḥ kālaḥ sarveṣāṃ na tu saṃśayaḥ || 35 ||
ṣoḍaśastrīsahasrāṇāṃ madhye tvaṃ khalu vartase |
adyeṣṭāṃ vāsudevasya vedmi tvāṃ bhojanandini || 36 ||
sapatnyaste guṇopete sarvāḥ sarveśvarapriye |
avamānāvasekena tvayā siktādya bhāmini || 37 |
prakāśamadya saubhāgyamanivāryaṃ yaśaśca te|
mandārakusumaṃ dattaṃ yat te madhunighātinā || 38 ||
adya sātrājitī devī jñāsyate varavarṇinī |
saubhāgyākhyaṃ sadā vetti yā''tmānaṃ subhagaṃ satī||39||
sāmbamātā ca gāndhārī bhāryāścānyā mahātmanaḥ |
saubhāgyārthodyatākāṅkṣāmadya mokṣyanti niḥspṛhāḥ ||2.65.40||
saubhāgyaikaratho jaitrastava devyadya niḥsṛtaḥ |
manoratharathānāṃ yaḥ sahasrairapi durjayaḥ || 41 ||
adyāhamavagacchāmi sarvathā sarvaśobhane |
ātmā dvitīyaḥ kṛṣṇasya bhoje tvamiti bhābhini || 42 ||
trailokyaratnasarvasvamadadād yat tavācyutaḥ |
jīvitātiśayastena tvayā prāpto haripriye || 43 ||
nāradenaivamuktaṃ tu tathyaṃ vākyaṃ narādhipa |
tatrasthāḥ śuśruvuḥ preṣyāḥ preṣitāḥ satyabhāmayā || 44 ||
devīnāṃ ca tathānyāsāṃ patnīnāṃ ca viśāmpate |
dṛṣṭvā tāḥ saviśeṣaṃ ca nāradenātyudāhṛtam || 45 ||
tacca śrutvā sunikhilaṃ preṣyābhiḥ strīsvabhāvataḥ |
prakāśīkṛtamevāsīd viṣṇorantaḥpure tadā || 46 ||
karṇākarṇi tato devyaḥ kaulīnamiva saṃghaśaḥ |
mantrayāñcakrire hṛṣṭā rukmiṇyatiguṇodayam || 47 ||
arheti putramāteti jyeṣṭheti ca samāgatāḥ |
prāyeṇa pravadanti sma hṛṣṭā dāmodarastriyaḥ || 48 ||
mamṛṣe na sapatnyāstu tatsaubhāgyaguṇodayam |
satyabhāmā priyā nityaṃ viṣṇoratulatejasaḥ || 49 ||
rūpayauvanasampannā svasaubhāgyena garvitā |
abhimānavatī devī śrutvaiverṣyāvaśaṃ gatā || 2.65.50 ||
samutsṛjantī vasanaṃ sakuṃkumaṃ śucismitā śuklatamaikamaṃśukam |
jagrāha roṣākulitena cetasā vahnestadā śrīriva varddhitendhanā ||51 ||
dandahyamānā jvalanena varddhatā īrṣyāsamutthena gataprabheva |
krodhānvitā krodhagṛhaṃ viviktaṃ viveśa tāreva ghanaṃ satoyam || 52 ||
baddhvā lalāṭe himacandraśuklaṃ dukūlapaṭṭaṃ priyaroṣacihnam|
paryantadeśaṃ sarasena devī vilipya sā lohitacandanena || 53 ||
saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya śiraḥ saroṣaṃ prakampamānā samupopaviṣṭā |
dīrghopadhāne śayane'panīya vibhūṣaṇānyeva nibaddhaveṇī || 54 ||
akāraṇārthena vikṛṣyamāṇā preṣyājanasyābhijanānvitāpi |
vicūrṇayāmāsa kuśeśayaṃ sā niḥśvasya niḥśvasya nakhairnatabhrūḥ || 55 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi pārijātaharaṇe pañcaṣaṣṭimo'dhyāyaḥ || 65 ||

<2.66>

ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
upaviṣṭaṃ muniṃ jñātvā rukmiṇyā saha keśavaḥ |
niścakrāmāprameyātmā vyapadeśena sarvavit || 1 ||
jagāma tvaritaścaiva satyabhāmāgṛhaṃ mahat |
ramye raivatakoddeśai nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā || 2 ||
abhimānavatīmiṣṭāṃ prāṇairapi garīyasīm |
jānan sātrājitīṃ viṣṇurviveśa śanakairiva || 3 ||
ruṣitāmiva tāṃ devīṃ snehāt saṃkalpayanniva |
bhītabhītaḥ sa śanakairviveśa madhusūdanaḥ || 4 ||
sevakaṃ dvāradeśe tu tiṣṭhetyuktvā viveśa ha |
nāradasyopacārārthaṃ pradyumnaṃ viniyujya saḥ || 5 ||
sa dadarśa priyāṃ dūrāt krodhāgāragatāṃ tadā |
preṣyāmiva sthitāṃ kopānniḥśvasantīṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 6 ||
karajāgrāvalīḍhaṃ tu paṅkajaṃ mukhapaṅkaje |
saṃśleṣayitvā niḥśvasya vihasantīṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 7 ||
kiṃcidākulitāgreṇa caraṇena vasundharām |
kṛtvā pṛṣṭhe'tha vadanaṃ viharantīṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 8 ||
karapadme punaḥ savye mukhapadmaṃ niveśya ca |
vanitāṃ cārusarvāṅgīṃ dhyāyantīṃ kamalekṣaṇām || 9 ||
sarasaṃ candanaṃ gṛhya preṣyāhastādaninditām |
prahlādayitvā hṛdayaṃ kṣipantīṃ nirdayaṃ punaḥ || 2.66.10 ||
punarutthāya śayanāt patantīṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ |
tāstāśceṣṭāḥ priyāyāśca tathānyā dadṛśe hariḥ || 11 ||
avaguṇṭhya yadā vaktramupadhāne nyaveśayat|
idamantaramityevaṃ tadā gatvā janārdanaḥ || 12 ||
preṣyājanaṃ sa saṃjñāya anākhyeyo'smi saṃjñayā |
sa śaṅkitapracāraśca vārito'nvagamatsa tām || 13 ||
grahāya vyajanaṃ caiva sthitvā sa paripārśvataḥ |
śanairivāsṛjad vātaṃ jahāsa śanakairiva || 14 ||
sa pārijātapuṣpasya saṃsargādanuvāsitaḥ |
babhāra bhagavān gandhaṃ divyaṃ mānuṣadurlabham || 15 ||
atyadbhutaṃ sugandhaṃ ca jighritvā vismayānvitā |
apāvṛṇonmukhaṃ satyā kimetaditi cābravīt || 16 ||
sotthitā pṛṣṭhato devamapaśyantī śucismitā |
paryapṛcchadatho preṣyā gandhasya prabhave tadā || 17 ||
tāḥ pṛṣṭāstvaprabhāṣantyo jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gatāḥ |
adhomukhyastatastasthuḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭāstadā || 18 ||
tadapūrvamadṛṣṭvaiva gandhaṃ muñcati medinī |
kathamekatarastasyā gandho'yamiti tat khalu || 19 ||
kiṃnvidaṃ syāditi ca sā vivekṣantī samantataḥ |
dadṛśe keśavaṃ devī sahasā lokabhāvanam || 2.66.20 ||
yujyatīti tatovāca sahasāsrāvilekṣaṇā |
avatikteva roṣeṇa babhūva praṇayānvitā || 21 ||
sā prasphuritacārvoṣṭhī niḥśvasyādhomukhī tadā |
muhūrtamasitāpāṅgī tasthāvanyamukhī śubhā || 22 ||
nibadhya bhrukuṭiṃ vāmāṃ samyagvikṣipya locane |
niveśya vadanaṃ haste śobhasītyabravīddharim || 23 ||
tasyāḥ susrāva netrābhyāṃ vāri praṇayakopajam |
kuśeśayapalāśābhyāmavaśyāyajalaṃ yathā || 24 ||
samutpatya jalaṃ tatra patitaṃ vadanāmbujāt |
pratijagrāha padmākṣaḥ karābhyāmatisatvaraḥ || 25 ||
athorasi patattoyaṃ śrīvatsāṅko'mbujekṣaṇaḥ |
priyānayanajaṃ devaḥ parimṛjyedamabravīt || 26 ||
sravatyasitapatrākṣi kimarthaṃ tava bhāmini |
toyaṃ sundari netrābhyāṃ puṣkarābhyāmivodakam || 27 ||
prabhāte pūrṇacandrasya madhyāhne paṅkajasya ca |
bibharti tava kiṃ vaktraṃ vapustava manohare || 28 ||
kimarthaṃ kauṅkumaṃ vāso mahārājatameva ca |
nānugṛhṇāsi suśroṇi śuklaṃ vāso'nugṛhyate || 29 ||
vāsasyete tavābhīṣṭe mahārajatakauṃkume |
devābhigamanādūrdhvaṃ śuklaṃ neṣṭaṃ hi tatstriyāḥ || 2.66.30 ||
kiñcānābharaṇaṃ gātraṃ sugātri tava kathyatām |
citrakasthānamākrāntaṃ kasmādavaravarṇini || 31 ||
śvetena tava paṭṭena vāsasā priyadarśane |
lalāṭaṃ sevyate kasmāccandanena sugandhinā || 32 ||
sarasenāyatāpāṅgi kāntena hṛdayapriye |
prabhopamardaṃ kenāpi kāraṇenānanasya ca |
karoṣi mama vātyarthaṃ mano glāpayasi priye || 33 ||
prasṛtaścandanarasaḥ kapolapraṇayī tava |
patralekhāsapatnatvaṃ prāpto nātivirājate || 34 ||
ratnaiścābharaṇairmuktā tava grīvā na śobhate |
grahanakṣatrarahitā dyaurivāvyaktaśāradī || 35 ||
pūrṇacandrasapatnena smereṇābahubhāṣiṇā |
kimu no bhāṣase mādya mukhenotpalagandhinā || 36 ||
arddhākṣṇāpi hi tāvanmāṃ kimarthaṃ na nirīkṣase |
muñcasyeva saniśvāsaṃ toyamañjanadurdinam || 37 ||
alamindīvaraśyāme ruditena manasvini |
jalamañjanakalmāṣaṃ mā mokṣīrānanadviṣam || 38 ||
tvadīyo'haṃ yadā devi khyāto jagati kiṅkaraḥ |
nājñāpayasi kiṃ māṃ tvaṃ pureva varavarṇini || 39 ||
kimakārṣamahaṃ devi vipriyaṃ tava bhāmini |
yenātimātramātmānamāyāsayasi sundari || 2.66.40 ||
manasā karmaṇā vācā na tvāmaticarāmyaham |
sarvathā sarvacārvaṅgi satyametad bravīmyaham || 41 ||
bahumānopamānyāsu strīṣu sarvāsu śobhane |
snehaśca bahumānaśca tvāmṛte'nyāsu nāsti me || 42 ||
naiva tvāṃ madano jahyānmṛte'pi mayi māmakaḥ |
iti me niścitaṃ viddhi cetaḥ surasutopame || 43 ||
kṣamādayaśca medinyāṃ śabdādyāścāmbare guṇāḥ |
dhruvaṃ paṅkajagarbhābhe tvayi snehastathā mama || 44 ||
ruciragnau yathā divyā prabhā caiva divākare |
kāntiśca śāśvatī candre snehastvayi tathā mama|| 45 ||
evaṃvādinamātmeṣṭaṃ satyabhāmā janārdanam|
śanairuvāca netrābhyāṃ pramṛjya subhagā jalam || 46 ||
madīyastvamiti hyāsīnmama nityaṃ manaḥ prabho |
adya sādhāraṇaṃ snehaṃ tvayi tāvadgatāsmyaham|| 47 ||
nājñāsiṣamahaṃ pūrvamanityaṃ kālaparyayam |
adya lokagatiṃ kṛtsnāmavagacchāmi na dhruvām || 48 ||
amṛtāyā dvitīyo'pi janmauhi mama sarvathā |
kimatra bahunoktena hṛdayaṃ vedmi te'cyuta || 49 ||
vāṅmātrameva paśyāmi mādhuryaṃ samprayujyate |
mayi snehaśca kṛtakastavānyatra na kṛtrimaḥ || 2.66.50 ||
ṛjusvabhāvāṃ bhaktāṃ ca sarvathā puruṣottama |
avajānāsi jānan māṃ kaitavīṃ vṛttimāsthitaḥ || 51 ||
etāvadastu paryāptaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ draṣṭavyamavyayam |
śrutaṃ cāpyadya yacchrāvyaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ snehaphalodayaḥ || 52 ||
yadi tvahamanugrāhyā māmanujñātumarhasi |
tapasye'haṃ paraṃ kṛtvā niścayaṃ puruṣottama || 53 ||
bhartuśchandena nārīṇāṃ tapo vā vratakāni vā |
niṣphalaṃ khalu yad bharturacchandena kriyeta hi || 54 ||
itīdamuktvā punareva śobhanā mumoca toyaṃ nayanodbhavaṃ satī |
grahāya pītaṃ harivāsasaḥ śubhā paṭāntamādhāya mukhe śucismitā |55||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi pārijātaharaṇe ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 66 ||

<2.67>

saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
nārāyaṇaḥ satyabhāmāṃ punarevaiṣa bhārata |
provāca praṇayāt kruddhāmabhimānavatīṃ satīm || 1 ||
śrībhagavānuvāca
dahatīva mamāṅgāni śokaḥ kamalalocane |
kimu tat kāraṇaṃ yena tvamevamativiklavā || 2 ||
śāpitāsi mama prāṇairācakṣvānatyayo yadi |
śrotavyaṃ yadi bhaktena bhartrā sarvāṅgaśobhane || 3 ||
tataḥ provāca bhartāraṃ satyā satyavrate sthitam |
bāṣpagadgadayā vācā tathainaidhomukhī sthitā || 4 ||
tvayaiva sthāpitaṃ pūrvaṃ saubhāgyaṃ mama mānada |
jagatyamalapatrākṣa yat khyātaṃ keśināśana || 5 ||
śiro vahāmi ceṣṭatvāt tavāhaṃ deva garvitā |
sarvasīmantinīmadhye spṛhaṇīyāsmi sarvathā || 6 ||
sāhamadyāvahāsyāsmi sapatnīnāṃ janasya ca |
iti preṣyābhirākhyātaṃ śrutvā tathyaṃ tatastataḥ || 7 ||
yat pārijātakusumaṃ dattavān nāradastava |
tat kileṣṭajane dattaṃ tvayāhaṃ parivarjitā || 8 ||
ratnātiśayadānena tasyāmabhyadhikaḥ kila |
snehaśca bahumānaśca prakāśaṃ gamitastvayā || 9 ||
tāmastauṣīt samakṣaṃ te priyāṃ sa kila nāradaḥ |
tamaśrauṣīśca dṛṣṭastvaṃ priyāyāḥ saṃstavaṃ kila || 2.67.10 ||
stotavyo yadi tāvat sa nāradena tavāgrataḥ |
durbhago'yaṃ janastatra kimarthamanuśabditaḥ || 11 ||
praṇayasya rasaṃ dattvā paścāttāpaḥ prabho yadi |
anujñāṃ me prayacchasva tapaḥ kartuṃ prasīda me || 12 ||
svapnenāpi na dṛṣṭvāhaṃ śraddadhyāṃ puṣkarekṣaṇa |
yadanyadeva nirvṛttamaśrauṣaṃ paśyatastava || 13 ||
kāmaṃ kāmo'stu tasyaiva muneratulatejasaḥ |
atra manyustu me deva sāṃnidhyaṃ tava tatra yat || 14 ||
mānārthaṃ jīvyate loke sadbhirityuktavānasi |
tadevaṃ sati necchāmi jīvituṃ mānavarjitā || 15 ||
mamābhavad yato rakṣā bhayamadya tato mama |
sarvato rakṣate yo māṃ sa māṃ nādyābhirakṣati || 16 ||
hā gatiṃ kāṃ gamipyāmi tyaktā deva tvayā vibho |
kumudvatīgatāṃ nūnaṃ gatiṃ yāsyāmyasaṃgatā || 17 ||
kimakārṣamahaṃ mohādīśvarāṇāṃ priyāpriyam |
priyā bhūtvā priyā bhūtā yadyahaṃ tava mānada || 18 ||
vasantakusumaiścitraṃ tadā raivatakaṃ girim |
priyā bhūtvāpriyā bhūtā kathaṃ drakṣyāmyahaṃ punaḥ || 19 ||
parapuṣṭasvanonmiśraṃ puṣpagandhavahaṃ śucim |
kathaṃ nāmānilaṃ dveṣyā sesreyaṃ durbhagā satī || 2.67.20 ||
jalakrīḍāṃ tavāṅkasthā deva kṛtvā mahodadhau |
kathaṃ daurbhāgyamāpannā paśyeyamapi sāgaram || 21 ||
sātrājiti priyā nānyā tvatto me'stīti viddhi mām|
yadavocaḥ kva tad yātamatha vā kaḥ smariṣyati ||22||
yadadrākṣīddhi māṃ śvaśrūrbahumānena nandinī |
avajñātāṃ tvayā rājñīṃ nūnaṃ daurbhāgyakarśitām || 23 ||
kiṃ nu gūḍhena me premṇā susnigdhaināpi mānada |
yatsamānāṃ janairdevo māṃ na paśyati nityadā || 24 ||
nāhaṃ tvāṃ kitavaṃ dhūrtamajñāsiṣamariṃdama |
adya jñāto'si tatpakṣacañcalo janavañcakaḥ || 25 ||
svaravarṇeṅgitākārairnigūḍho deva yatnataḥ |
caura jñāto'si tatpakṣavāṅmātramadhuraḥ śaṭhaḥ || 26||
evamīrṣyāvaśaṃ prāptāṃ devīṃ sātrājitīṃ hariḥ |
abhimānavatīṃ devaḥ sāntvapūrvamathābravīt || 27 ||
maivaṃ padmapalāśākṣi prāṇeśvari vada priye |
kimatra bahunoktena tvadīyamavagaccha mām || 28 ||
tat pārijātakusumaṃ tasyā devi mamāgrataḥ |
nārado matpriyaṃ kurvan munirakliṣṭakarmakṛt || 29 ||
dākṣiṇyādānurodhācca dattavān nātra saṃśayaḥ |
prasīdaikāparādhaṃ me marṣayasya śucismite || 2.67.30 ||
pārijātakapuṣpāṇi yadīcchasyatikopane |
tadā dātāsmi suśroṇi satyametadbravīmi tam || 31 ||
svargāspadādānayitvā pārijātaṃ drumeśvaram |
gṛhe te sthāpayiṣyāmi yāvatkālaṃ tvamicchasi || 32 ||
evamuktā tu hariṇā provāca harivallabhā |
yadyevaṃ sa drumaḥ śakyastvihānayitumacyuta || 33 ||
manyureva pramṛṣṭo hi bhaved bahuguṇaṃ mama |
sīmantinīnāṃ sarvāsāmadhikā syāmadhokṣaja || 34 ||
tathāstu prathamaḥ kalpa iti tāṃ madhusūdanaḥ |
provācāpratimo devo jagataḥ prabhavāpyayaḥ || 35 ||
tathetyukteti kṛṣṇena tutoṣa samitiṃjaya |
satyabhāmā satāmiṣṭā kaṃsanāśanavallabhā || 36||
tataḥ snāto jagannāthaḥ sarveśaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ |
cakārāvaśyakaṃ sarvaṃ sarvakāmapradaḥ satām || 37 ||
dadhyau ca nāradaṃ devaḥ snāto devamunirnṛpa |
abhyājagāma snānānte muniśreṣṭho mahodadhau || 38 ||
tamāgataṃ narapate satāṃ gatiradhokṣajaḥ |
satyayā saha dharmātmā yathāvidhi apūjayat || 39 ||
pādau prakṣālayāñcakre muneḥ sātrājitī svayam |
jalaṃ devaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo bhṛṅgāreṇa dadau tadā || 2.67.40 ||
athopakalpayāmāsa sukhāsīnāya keśavaḥ |
paramānnaṃ sa munaye prayatātmā jagadguruḥ || 41 ||
tallokakartrā satkṛtya dattaṃ munirudāradhīḥ |
bubhuje vadatāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ || 42 ||
upaspṛśya tatastṛptaḥ pradadau cāśiṣaḥ prabho |
tāśca prītena manasā pratijagrāha keśavaḥ || 43 ||
tataḥ sātrājitīṃ devīṃ praṇatāṃ nārado'bravīt |
prasārya dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ sajalaṃ jalajekṣaṇām|| 44 ||
yathedānīṃ tathaiva tvaṃ bhava devi pativratā |
saviśeṣaṃ ca subhagā bhava mattapaso balāt || 45 ||
ityuktā munimukhyena satyabhāmā haripriyā |
uttasthau mahatā yuktā harṣeṇa tu narādhipa || 46 ||
sa kṛṣṇo'pyabhyanujñāṃ tu labdhvā munivarāttadā|
bubhuje vighasaṃ dhīmānaprameyaparākramaḥ || 47 ||
tatastvāvaśyakaṃ kṛtvā satyabhāmāpi bhārata |
anujñayā tadā bharturviveśāntargṛhaṃ mudā || 48 ||
tato vinirgatā devī kṛṣṇasyaivābhyanujñayā |
sthitā pārśve ca kṛṣṇasya namaskṛtvā mahātmane || 49||
tato muhūrtamāsitvā nāradaḥ kṛṣṇamabravīt |
āpṛcche tvāṃ gamiṣyāmi śakralokamadhokṣaja || 2.67.50 ||
tatrādyaṃ devamīśānaṃ namaskṛtya maheśvaram |
gāsyanti devagandharvāstathaivāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || 51 ||
māsi māsyucitaṃ hyetanmahendrasadane prabho |
pūjārthaṃ devadevasya gāndharvaṃ nṛtyameva ca || 52 ||
antarhito devadevaḥ somaḥ sapravaro vibhuḥ |
paśyatyamaramukhyena kṛtaṃ bhaktyādrighātinā || 53 ||
nimantrito'haṃ pūrvedyuḥ puṣpaṃ dattvā mahādyute |
pārijātasya bhadraṃ te tarurājño mahātmanaḥ || 54 ||
ktvaie nimantrita kiyā yā || 54 ||
yadetadāhṛtaṃ svargāt tvadarthaṃ tu mayā vibho |
devopabhogyametaddhi tarurājasamudbhavam || 55 ||
iṣṭaḥ sa vṛkṣaḥ satataṃ śacyāḥ puṣkaralocana |
saubhāgyamāvahatyeva pūjyamāno'pi nityaśaḥ || 56 ||
puṇyaṃ kartuṃ tadā sṛṣṭaḥ pārijāto mahādrumaḥ |
adityā dharmanityena kaśyapena mahātmanā || 57 ||
purādityā mahātejāstoṣitaḥ kila kaśyapaḥ |
vareṇa cchandayāmāsa mārīcastapaso nidhiḥ || 58 ||
sovāca subhagā yena bhaveyaṃ munisattama |
svalaṃkṛtā kāmataśca sarvaireva vibhūṣaṇaiḥ || 59 ||
īpsitaṃ gītanṛtyaṃ ca bhavenmama tapodhana |
kumārī nityadā caiva bhaveyaṃ tapaso nidhe || 2.67.60 ||
virajā śokarahitā bhaveyamiti nityadā |
patibhaktimatī caiva dharmaśīlā tathaiva ca || 61 ||
pārijātaṃ tato'srākṣīdadityāḥ priyakāmyayā |
sarvakāmapradaiḥ puṣpairāvṛtaṃ nityagandhadaiḥ || 62 ||
triśākhaṃ sarvadā dṛśyaṃ sarvabhūtamanoharam |
sarvapuṣpāṇi dṛśyante tasminneva mahādrume || 63 ||
īdṛśānyapi puṣpāṇi bibhartyekāpi rūpiṇī |
bahurūpāṇi cāpyanyā padmāni ca tato'parā || 64 ||
mandārādapi vṛkṣācca sāramuddhatya kaśyapaḥ |
tasmādeṣa taruśreṣṭhaḥ sarveṣāṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ gataḥ || 65 ||
tatastatra nibadhyātha kaśyapaṃ pradadau śubhā |
aditirmama puṇyārthaṃ saubhāgyārthaṃ tathaiva ca || 66 ||
adityā kaśyapo dattaḥ puṇyārthaṃ ca tathā mama |
puṣpadāmnā veṣṭayitvā kaṇṭhe puṇyārthamātmavān || 67 ||
niṣkrayeṇa mayā muktaḥ kaśyapastu tapodhanaḥ |
indro dattastathendrāṇyā saubhāgyārthaṃ tato mama || 68 ||
somaścāpyatha rohiṇyā ṛddhyā ca dhanadastathā |
evaṃ saubhāgyado vṛkṣaḥ pārijāto na saṃśayaḥ || 69 ||
pari jāto viṣṇupadyāḥ pārijātetiśabditaḥ |
mandārapuṣpairyadyukto mandārastena kathyate || 2.67.70 ||
ko'pyayaṃ dārurityāhurajānanto yato janāḥ |
kovidāra iti khyātastataḥ sa sumahātaruḥ || 71 ||
mandāraḥ kovidāraśca pārijātaśca nāmabhiḥ |
sa vṛkṣo jñāyate divyo yasyaitatkusumottamam || 72 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi pārijātaharaṇe saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 67 ||

<2.68>

aṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tato jigamiṣuṃ tatra nāradaṃ munisattamam |
provāca bhagavān viṣṇuraprameyaparākramaḥ || 1 ||
maharṣe dharmatattvajña svargaṃ gatvā tvayānagha |
dṛṣṭvā sadasyān devasya tripuraghnasya dhīmataḥ || 2 ||
anājñayā madvacanād vijñāpyaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ |
sambhāvayitvā bhrātṛtvaṃ paurāṇaṃ vetsi yanmune || 3 ||
yamasrākṣīnmuniśreṣṭho bhagavān kaśyapastarum |
pārijātaṃ purādityāḥ sukhārthaṃ dharmasattamaḥ || 4 ||
sa puṇyamatisaubhāgyaṃ dadāti tarusattamaḥ |
tava dattaṃ purā dānaṃ vratena tarumuttamam || 5 ||
devībhirdharmanityābhirdharmārthamamarottama |
dattaṃ śrutvābhikāṅkṣanti dātuṃ patnyo mama prabho || 6 ||
puṇyārthaṃ dānadharmārthaṃ mama prītyarthameva ca |
ānāyayad dvāravatīṃ pārijātaṃ mahādrumam || 7 ||
datte dāne punaḥ svargaṃ taruṃ tvaṃ netumarhasi |
sa vācya evaṃ bhagavān balabhid bhagavaṃstvayā || 8 ||
tathā tathā prayatnaśca kāryo'sminmunisattama |
yathā taruvaraṃ dadyāt pārijātaṃ sureśvaraḥ || 9 ||
tatra dūtaguṇaṃ tāvat paśyāmaste tapodhana |
sambhāvyā sarvakṛtyānāṃ sampaddhi tvayi me matā || 2.68.10 ||
evaṃ nārāyaṇenokto nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ |
prahasyovāca keśighnamidaṃ vākyaṃ tapodhanaḥ || 11 ||
bāḍhamevaṃ pravakṣyāmi yadumukhya sureśvaram |
na tu dāsyati devendraḥ pārijātaṃ kathaṃcana || 12 ||
mandaraṃ parvataśreṣṭhaṃ dānavaistridaśaistathā |
nikṣipya toyadhau pūrvaṃ pārijātaḥ samāhṛtaḥ || 13 ||
mandarāt parvataśreṣṭhānnayituṃ preṣitaḥ purā |
pārijātaṃ hareṇāpi lokakartrā janārdana || 14 ||
svayaṃ vijñāpito gatvā tataḥ śakreṇa śaṅkaraḥ |
ākrīḍadruma udyāne śacyāḥ syāditi yācitaḥ || 15||
tathāstviti varo datto mahādevena cānagha |
na ca nītaḥ pārijāto mandaraṃ citrakandaram || 16 ||
krīḍāvṛkṣaḥ sa śacyeti vyapadeśena mokṣitaḥ |
mahendreṇa mahābāho pārijātastataḥ purā || 17 ||
priyārthamumayā sākṣāt pārijātavanaṃ haraḥ |
gavyūtiśatavistīrṇaṃ mandarasyaiva kandaram || 18 ||
na tatra sūryabhāḥ kṛṣṇa praviśanti nagottame |
na ca candraprabhā śītā naiva kṛṣṇa sadāgatiḥ || 19 ||
śītoṣṇe kṛtastatra śailaputryā bhavanti hi |
svayaṃprabhaṃ vanaṃ taddhi mahādevasya tejasā || 2.68.20 ||
