varjayitvā mahādevau sagaṇau yadunandana |
māṃ cānyastadvanaṃ divyaṃ na prayāti kathaṃcana || 21 ||
sravanti tatra vārṣṇeya pārijātāḥ samantataḥ |
sarvaratnāni mukhyāni manasā kāṅkṣitāni vai || 22 ||
gaṇāstānyupabhuñjanti pravarāṇāṃ mahātmanām |
ājñayā devadevasya lokanāthasya keśava || 23 ||
pārijātād bahuguṇaṃ phalaṃ teṣāṃ tathā vanam |
abhimānaṃ prabhāścaiva guṇā bhūriguṇāstathā || 24 ||
mūrtimantaśca te vṛkṣāḥ somaṃ devaṃ vṛṣadhvajam |
upatiṣṭhanti satataṃ pravaraiḥ saha keśava || 25 ||
raudreṇa tejasā juṣṭā duḥkhairhīnāḥ sukhānvitāḥ |
taravo mandare te hi dayitāḥ śailakanyayā || 26 ||
praviveśāndhako nāma ghorastatra mahābalaḥ |
daiteyo varadānena darpitaḥ pāpaniścayaḥ ||27 ||
sa hato devadevena hareṇāmitraghātinā |
avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ vṛtrād daśaguṇaṃ balī || 28 ||
evaṃ duḥkhaṃ na te deva pārijātaṃ pradāsyati |
puṣkarākṣa sahasrākṣaḥ satyametad bravīmi te || 29 ||
satataṃ sahito devyā śacyā sa hi varadrumaḥ |
sarvakāmapradaḥ kṛṣṇa tathendrāya mahaujase || 2.68.30 ||
śrībhagavānuvāca
mune tad yujyate sādhu mahādevena dhīmatā |
yacchacīkāraṇaṃ kṛtvā na nītaḥ sa taruḥ purā || 31 ||
sa jyeṣṭhaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ lokakṛt prabhavo'vyayaḥ |
pārāvaryasya sadṛśaṃ kṛtavāniti me matiḥ || 32 ||
ahaṃ yavīyān devasya sarvathā balaghātinaḥ |
lālanīyaśca bhagavañjayanta iva sattama || 33 ||
sarvathā bhagavāṃstāvadupāyairbahuvistaraiḥ |
karotu yatnaṃ prītyarthaṃ śakto hyasi tapodhana || 34 ||
mayā mune pratijñātaṃ puṇyārthaṃ satyabhāmayā |
svargādihānayiṣyāmi pārijātamiti prabho || 35 ||
mayā tadanṛtaṃ kartuṃ kathaṃ śakyaṃ tapodhana |
nānṛtaṃ hi vaco vipra proktaṃ pūrvaṃ mayānagha || 36 ||
mayi bhagnapratijñe vai lokānāṃ viplavo bhavet |
yanmayā hi muniśreṣṭha lokadharmā guṇānvitāḥ |
paridhāryāḥ sthitau sarve sa kathaṃ hyanṛtaṃ vadet || 37||
na devagandharvagaṇā na rākṣasā
na cāsurā naiva ca yakṣapannagāḥ |
mama pratijñāmapahantumudyatā
mune samarthāḥ khalu bhadramastu te || 38 ||
sa pārijātaṃ yadi na pradāsyati
prayācyamāno bhavatāmareśvaraḥ |
tataḥ śacīvyāmṛditānulepane
gadāṃ vimokṣyāmi puraṃdarorasi || 39 ||
iti pravācyo yadi sāmapūrvakaṃ
prayācyamāno na taruṃ prayacchati |
suniścayaṃ madgamanāya sarvathā
tvayāpi kāryaḥ khalu tatra niścayaḥ || 2.68.40 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi pārijātaharaṇe nāradakṛṣṇabhāṣaṇe aṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 68 ||

<2.69>

ekonasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
nārado'tha munirgatvā mahendrasadanaṃ prati |
tāṃ rātrimavasat tatra dadṛśe ca mahotsavam || 1 ||
tatrādityā mahātmāno vasavaśca surottamāḥ |
rājarṣayaśca vidvāṃsaḥ svargatāḥ karmabhiḥ śubhaiḥ || 2 ||
nāgā yakṣāśca siddhāśca cāraṇāśca tapodhanāḥ |
brahmarṣayaśca śataśo devarṣimanavastathā || 3 ||
suparṇāśca mahātmāno marutaśca mahābalāḥ |
divaukasāṃ nikāyāśca śataśo'nye samāgatāḥ || 4 ||
uparyupari sarveṣāṃ somo devo maheśvaraḥ |
tasthāvamitavikrāntaḥ svairgaṇaiḥ parivāritaḥ || 5 ||
devarṣim̐bhirmuniśreṣṭhaiḥ saṃvṛtaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ |
kalpāntarasahasreṣu kṣayo yeṣāṃ na vidyate || 6 ||
yānarcayanti satataṃ devā deveśvaropamāḥ |
ātmanā nāvalepāndhā ye ca dharmapathi sthitāḥ || 7 ||
rudrāśca kāśyapā devamadhyupāsanta bhārata |
skandaśca bhagavānagnirgaṅgā ca saritāṃ varā || 8 ||
arciṣmāṃstumburuścaiva bhāriśca vadatāṃ varaḥ |
netāro devadevānāmete hi tapasānvitāḥ || 9 ||
etānanuvidhīyante sarvadevagaṇā nṛpa |
dharmanityāstaponityāḥ satāṃ mārgamupāśritāḥ || 2.69.10 ||
ye tvime mānuṣā devānarcayanti śubhārthinaḥ |
tānarcayanti hyamarāstathā rājañchubhārthinaḥ || 11 ||
pitṛkṛtyeṣu devānāṃ saṃnyāsaṃ ye tvanuṣṭhitāḥ |
svādhyāyavantaḥ kauravya sadā niyamacāriṇaḥ || 12 ||
gandharvādhipatiḥ śrīmāṃstatra citraratho nṛpa |
saputro vādayāmāsa devavādyāni hṛṣṭavat || 13 ||
ūrṇāyuścitrasenaśca hāhā hūhūstathaiva ca |
ḍumbarastumburuścaiva jaguranye ca ṣaḍguṇān || 14 ||
urvaśī vipracittiśca hemā rambhā ca bhārata |
hemadantā ghṛtācī ca sahajanyā tathaiva ca || 15 ||
jujoṣa bhagavān devastadupasthānamātmavān |
vṛttena tuṣṭaḥ śakrasya jagāma jagato gatiḥ || 16 ||
gate bhūtapatau sarve nṛpā jagmuryathāgatam |
mahendreṇārcitā devāḥ svāneva nilayāngatāḥ || 17 ||
tataḥ sarveṣu yāteṣu sukhāsīnaṃ puraṃdaram |
sadasyaiḥ svaiḥ sahāsīnaṃ nārado'bhiyayau muniḥ || 18 ||
tamindraḥ pūjayāmāsa samutthāya tapodhanam |
dideśa kuśagarbhe ca pīṭhamātmāsanopamam || 19 ||
nārado'tha mahātejā mahendramidamabravīt |
dūto'hamamaraśreṣṭha viṣṇoratulatejasaḥ || 2.69.20 ||
kiñcitkāryaṃ puraskṛtya preṣito'smi mahātmanā |
ānartādārtiharaṇaṃ tasyaivānaghatejasaḥ || 21 ||
prītivākyāni hṛdyāni prayujya munaye tadā |
tataḥ prahṛṣṭo bhagavānabravīt pākaśāsanaḥ || 22 ||
kimāha puruṣaśreṣṭhaḥ śīghramācakṣva me mune |
cirasya khalu kṛṣṇena saṃsmṛto'smi mahātmanā || 23 ||
nārada uvāca
mahendrendrānujaṃ draṣṭuṃ gato'haṃ bhrātaraṃ tava |
kathañciddvārakāṃ tatra kāśyapānāṃ yaśaskaram|| 24 ||
taṃ tu raivatake'drākṣaṃ tadāsīnamariṃdamam |
rukmiṇyā sahitaṃ vīramumayeva vṛṣadhvajam || 25 ||
pārijātataroḥ puṣpaṃ tasya dattaṃ mayānagha |
vismāpanārthaṃ deveśa patnīnāmurutejasaḥ || 26 ||
tad dṛṣṭvā tasya patnyastu vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ |
bahukāmapradaṃ puṣpaṃ vṛkṣarājasamudbhavam || 27 ||
guṇāstāsāṃ mayā khyātāstasya puṣpasya mānada |
sṛṣṭiśca pārijātasya kaśyapena mahātmanā || 28 ||
adityā kaśyapo dattaḥ puṇyārthaṃ ca yathā mama |
puṣpadāmnā veṣṭayitvā kaṇṭhe puṇyārthamātmavān || 29 ||
tvaṃ ca datto yathā śacyā devāścānye sureśvara |
niṣkrayaśca yathā dattaḥ kaśyapādyairmaharṣibhiḥ || 2.69.30 ||
tacchrutvā tasya patnyekā satyabhāmeti viśrutā |
puṇyakāryaṃ manaścakre dayitā te yavīyasaḥ || 31 ||
tayā cābhyarthito bhartā deva devyā gaṇeśvaraḥ |
pratijajñe sa dharmārthaṃ yavīyāṃstava mānada || 32 ||
tato māmuktavān vīro viṣṇurbalavatāṃ varaḥ |
yathāvatsuramukhyeśa bruvataḥ śṛṇu bhāvataḥ || 33 ||
lālanīyo yavīyāṃstu praṇipatyācyuto'bravīt|
ānayeyaṃ suraśreṣṭha pārijātaṃ varadrumam || 34 ||
manoratho'stu saphalo vadhvāste'surasūdana |
dharmakṛtye viśeṣeṇa vadhvāste surasattama || 35 ||
ayaṃ darśitakalyāṇo loko lokagaṇeśvara|
paśyantyamarakalyāṇaṃ matprabhāvācca mānavāḥ || 36 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
vāsudevavacaḥ śrutvā mahendraḥ kurunandana|
nāradaṃ vadatāṃ śreṣṭhamidaṃ vākyamathābravīt || 37 ||
bhajāsanaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha yuktamuktaṃ tvayā dvija |
saṃdeśaṃ pratidāsyāmi viṣṇoratulatejasaḥ || 38 ||
āsīne nārade śakro labdhānujño'tha nāradāt|
svamāsanaṃ tato bheje tasyaiva sadṛśaṃ prabho || 39 ||
upaviṣṭaḥ surapatirathobāca tapodhanam |
nirīkṣya svabalaṃ vīryaṃ harṣadaṃ vṛtranāśanaḥ || 2.69.40||
maharṣe kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭvā vaktavyaste janārdanaḥ |
vacanānmama dharmajña sarvabhūtasukhāvahaḥ || 41 ||
madanantaramīśastvaṃ jagato nātra saṃśayaḥ |
tvadīyaḥ pārijātaśca ratnānyanyāni cācyuta || 42 ||
tvaṃ tu bhārāvataraṇaṃ kartuṃ deva mahīṃ gataḥ |
mānuṣyaṃ sarvavṛttānāṃ sthitaḥ kāryasya siddhaye || 43 ||
tvayi tīrṇapratijñe hi punaḥ prāpte triviṣṭapam |
pūrayiṣyāmi vadhvāste iṣṭān kāmānadhokṣaja || 44 ||
svargīyāni ca ratnāni na netavyāni keśava |
svalpārthe mānuṣaṃ lokamiti pūrvakṛtā sthitiḥ || 45 ||
utkramya hi sthitiṃ daivīṃ pravartāmi mahābala |
yadyahaṃ kiṃ pravakṣyanti prajāpatigaṇāḥ prabho || 46 ||
brahmaṇā saha putreṇa sapautreṇa mahātmanā |
niyamāḥ sarvakṛtyānāṃ sthāpitā jagato dhruvāḥ || 47 ||
prajāpatikṛtaṃ mārgamapāsya vrajato mama |
śrutvā prajāpatirdhīmāñcchāpamapyutsṛjet prabhuḥ || 48 ||
asmābhirbhidyamānaṃ hi maryādāsetubandhanam |
bhetsyantyaśaṅkitā daityā daityapakṣāstathāpare || 49 ||
strīnimittamito nīte pārijāte drumeśvare |
svargaukaso bhaviṣyanti vimanaskāśca mānada || 2.69.50 ||
upabhogā manuṣyāṇāṃ vihitā ye svayaṃbhuvā |
taistu tuṣyatu me bhrātā sampaśyankālaparyayam|| 51 ||
ihāpi tāta tridive mama yaḥ syātparigrahaḥ |
tridivastho'pi taṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sarvaṃ bhoktumihārhati || 52 ||
hṛṣṭo hyāmiṣabhojyānāmabhimānājjanārdanaḥ |
tato dharmaṃ samutsṛjya pāpamevānuvartate || 53 ||
strīvaśyatā khyāpyamānā kṛṣṇasya hi mahātmanaḥ |
jagatyathaśasā yogaṃ janayediti me matiḥ || 54 ||
mānuṣyaṃ mānuṣe prāpto yadetanmadhusūdanaḥ |
kuryānnirbandhanīyaṃ yad bhrātrā jyeṣṭhena nārada || 55 ||
svargyaratnavilopena dharṣaṇā syānmamānagha |
jñātito dharṣaṇā caiva viśeṣeṇaiva garhitā || 56 ||
dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca krameṇa madhusūdanaḥ |
sevatveṣa satāṃ dharmānsthāpitān padmayoninā || 57 ||
mahītalaṃ pārijātamarpayiṣyāmyahaṃ yadi |
paulomīmāditaḥ kṛtvā ko nu māṃ bahu maṃsyate || 58 ||
pārijātaṃ mahīpṛṣṭhe dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā ca mānuṣāḥ |
svargārthe nodyamiṣyanti dṛṣṭvā svargaphalaṃ kṣitau || 59 ||
pārijātaguṇān martyā juṣanti yadi nārada |
devatānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ na viśeṣo bhaviṣyati || 2.69.60 ||
tatra yat kriyate karma iha tad bhujyate naraiḥ |
svargārthaṃ na yatiṣyanti pārijātaguṇānvitāḥ ||61 ||
sarvaratnavaraḥ svarge pārijātastapodhana |
tulyaṃ devasamairmartyaiḥ sarvadaiva jagad bhavet || 62 ||
yajñairmartyā na yakṣyanti labdhasvargaphalā bhuvi |
na pūrtāni pradāsyanti tulyatvamamarairgatāḥ || 63 ||
yajñairjapyāhnikaiścaiva nityamāpyāyayanti naḥ |
mānuṣāḥ svargamicchantaḥ śraddadhānāstapodhana || 64 ||
tat sarvaṃ na kariṣyanti pārijātaguṇānvitāḥ |
nistejaso bhaviṣyāma te gatāstadvihīnatām || 65 ||
itaḥ suvṛṣṭyā sasyaiste jīvanti puruṣā bhuvi |
āpyāyayantaste'pyasmān dānairyajñaistathaiva ca || 66 ||
na bubhukṣā pipāsā vā bādhate yadi mānuṣān |
rogo jarā vā mṛtyurvā dharmajñāratireva ca || 67 ||
daurgandhyaṃ vā sughorā vā ītayaḥ karmasambhavāḥ |
kimudyogaṃ kariṣyanti pārijātaguṇānvitāḥ || 68 ||
sarvathā nayanaṃ tatra pārijātasya na kṣamam |
iti vācyastvayā vipra viṣṇurakliṣṭakarmakṛt || 69 ||
yathā yathā ca me bhrātā tuṣyatyetad vicārayan |
tathā tathā tvayā kāryaṃ kāryaṃ matprītimicchatā || 2.69.70 ||
hārāśca maṇayaścaiva candanānyagurūṇi ca |
vastrāṇi ca vicitrāṇi vadhvāstvaṃ dvārakāṃ naya || 71 ||
yogyāni yāni martyānāṃ yāvadicchati keśavaḥ |
na svargaparimoṣaṃ tu kartumarhati sāmpratam || 72 ||
dadāmi ratnāni yathepsitānyahaṃ bahūni citrāṇi vibhūṣaṇāni ca |
na pārijātaṃ ca kathaṃcana drumaṃ mune pradāsyāmi divaukasāṃ priyam|| 73 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi pārijātaharaṇe indravākye ekonasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 69 ||

<2.70>

saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
devarājavacaḥ śrutvā nāradaḥ kurunandana |
provāca vākyaṃ vākyajño dharmātmā dharmavittamaḥ || 1 ||
avaśyameva vaktavyaṃ hitaṃ balaniṣūdana |
mayā tava mahābāho bahumāno'sti me tvayi || 2 ||
ukto mayā vāsudevo jānatā bhavato matam |
na dattaḥ pārijāto'yaṃ harasyāpi tvayā purā || 3 ||
hetavaśca mayā tasya darśitāste samāsataḥ |
na cāvagatavān devaḥ satyametad bravīmi te || 4 ||
upendro'haṃ mahendreṇa lālanīyaḥ sadeti mām |
uvāca puṇḍarīkākṣo dattamuttarameva ca || 5 ||
punaḥ punarmayā vāsya hetavo deva darśitāḥ |
tato na buddhirvyāvṛttā vṛtranāśana tasya vai || 6 ||
api cāpyuktavān devo vākyānte madhusūdanaḥ |
pratyāha puruṣaśreṣṭhaḥ saroṣamiva vāsava || 7 ||
na devagandharvagaṇā na rākṣasā na cāsurā naiva ca yakṣapannagāḥ |
mama pratijñāmapahantumudyatā mune samarthāḥ khalu bhadramastu te || 8 ||
sa pārijātaṃ yadi na pradāsyati prayācyamāno bhavatāmareśvaraḥ |
tataḥ śacīvyāmṛditānulepane gadāṃ vimokṣyāmi puraṃdarorasi || 9 ||
upendrasya mahendrāyaṃ bhrātuste niścayaḥ paraḥ |
yadatra manyase nyāyyaṃ sampradhārya kuruṣva tat || 2.70.10 ||
tattvaṃ hitaṃ ca deveśa śrūyatāṃ vadato mama |
nayanaṃ pārijātasya dvārakāṃ mama rocate || 11 ||
nāradenaivamuktastu suvyaktaṃ baladehabhit |
roṣāviṣṭaḥ sahasrākṣo'bravīdetantarādhipa || 12 ||
anāgasi mayi jyeṣṭhe sodare yadi keśavaḥ |
evaṃ pravṛttaḥ kiṃ śakyaṃ kartumadya tapodhana || 13 ||
bahūni pratilomāni purā sa kṛtavān mayi |
kṛṣṇo nārada soḍhāni bhrāteti sma mayā sadā || 14 ||
khāṇḍave cārjunarathaṃ purā vāhayatā satā |
madīyā vāritā meghāḥ śamayanto'gnimuddhatam|| 15 ||
govardhanaṃ dhārayatā vipriyaṃ ca kṛtaṃ mama |
tathā vṛtravadhe prāpte sāhāyyārthaṃ vṛto mayā || 16 ||
samo'hamiti sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāmiti coktavān |
svabāhubalamāśritya vṛtraśca nihato mayā || 17 ||
devāsureṣu prāpteṣu saṃgrāmeṣu ca nārada |
yudhyatyātmecchayā kṛṣṇo mune suviditaṃ tava || 18 ||
bahunātra kimuktena tasmād diṣṭyā pravartatām |
jñātibhedo na naḥ kāryaḥ sākṣī tvaṃ mama nārada || 19 ||
mamorasi gadāṃ moktumudyato yadi keśavaḥ |
anuśabdyātha paulomīṃ guṇaḥ ka iha dṛśyate || 2.70.20 ||
udavāsagato dhīmān pitā naḥ kaśyapaḥ prabhuḥ |
adityā saha me mātrā tayorvākyamidaṃ bhavet || 21 ||
ajitātmā mama bhrātā rajasā tamasā vṛtaḥ |
kāmena ca striyo bākyādevaṃ māmuktavāngurum|| 22 ||
dhikstriyaḥ sarvathā vipra dhig rājasamitiṃ tathā |
yatrādhikṣiptavān viṣṇurevaṃ māṃ strījito dvija || 23 ||
na dṛṣṭaṃ kaśyapakule vyapadeśyaṃ mahāmune |
naiva dakṣakule dṛṣṭaṃ māturme yatra sambhavaḥ || 24 ||
na jyeṣṭhatā na rājatvaṃ devānāṃ pratimānitam |
kāmarāgābhibhūtena kṛṣṇena khalu nārada || 25 ||
putradārasahasrairhi bhrātānagha viśiṣyate |
sadvṛtto jñānasampanna iti brahmā purābravīt || 26 ||
nāsti bhrātṛsamo vandhurāhārya itaro janaḥ |
iti māmavravīnmātā pitā caiva prajāpatiḥ || 27 ||
sodare tu viśeṣaṃ tu pitā me kaśyapo'bravīt |
dṛptā mayā viruddhayante dānavāḥ pāpaniścayāḥ || 28 ||
kāmametanna vaktavyaṃ svayamātmastavānvitam |
prāptastvavasaro vipra yadihādyocyate mayā || 29 ||
dhanurjyāyāṃ muniśreṣṭha chinnāyāṃ hi purānagha |
dhanvībhiramarāṇāṃ ca varadānānmahāmate || 2.70.30 ||
utkṛttaśiraso viṣṇoḥ purā deho dhṛto mayā |
sandhitaṃ ca śiro yatnācchinnaṃ raudreṇa tejasā|| 31 ||
ahaṃ viśiṣṭo devānāmityuktyā punaracyutaḥ |
dhanurāropya darpeṇa sthito nārada keśavaḥ || 32 ||
kiṃ māṃ pitā vā mātā vā vakṣyatīti mayā mune |
snehena ca sthitaṃ viṣṇoḥ śarīraṃ munisattama || 33 ||
aindraṃ vaiṣṇavamasyaiva mune bhāgamahaṃ dadau |
yavīyāṃsamahaṃ premṇā kṛṣṇaṃ paśyāmi nārada || 34 ||
saṃgrāmeṣu prahartavyaṃ tena pūrvaṃ tapodhana |
rājā kilāhaṃ samare praharāmyagrato dhuvam || 35 ||
prādurbhāveṣu sarveṣu svaśarīramivānagha |
yatnād rakṣāmi dharmajña keśavaṃ bhaktimāśritam || 36 ||
idaṃ bhaṅktvā madīyaṃ ca bhuvanaṃ viṣṇunā kṛtam |
uparyupari lokānāmadhikaṃ bhuvanaṃ mune || 37 ||
avamānaḥ sa ca mayā pṛṣṭhataḥ kriyate mune |
lālanīyo mayā bāla ityevaṃ bhrātṛgauravāt || 38 ||
bālo'yaṃ mama putreti yavīyāniti nārada |
pitrā mātrā ca govindo mānī ca paribhāṣitaḥ || 39 ||
iṣṭastatra janānāṃ ca keśavaḥ suviśeṣataḥ |
vayaṃ dveṣyā na saṃdehastatra sneho'tiricyate || 2.70.40 ||
sarvajño balavāñchraraḥ pātraṃ mānayitā tathā |
keśavetyeva ca dhyānaṃ yattadvitathatāṃ gatam || 41 ||
gaccha nārada vaktavyaḥ keśavo vacanānmama |
āhūto na nivarteyaṃ samaraṃ prati śatrubhiḥ || 42 ||
yadīcchasi tadāgaccha sahyaṃ te yattvamicchasi |
praharasva ca pūrvaṃ tvaṃ bhāryājita yathecchasi || 43 ||
rathāṅgenātha śārṅgeṇa gadayā nandakena ca |
praharāruhya garuḍaṃ dṛḍho bhūtvā janārdana | 44 ||
prahṛte prahariṣyāmi yathāśaktyā ca keśava |
aho dhig yadi māṃ sneho viklavaṃ na kariṣyati || 45 ||
yāvanna saṃgrāmagato jito'haṃ cakrapāṇinā |
pārijātaṃ na dāsyāmi tāvad bho munisattama || 46 ||
māṃ samāhvayate jyeṣṭhaṃ yavīyān sa tapodhana |
aho taṃ marṣayiṣyāmi kimarthaṃ strījitaṃ harim || 47 ||
adyaiva gaccha bhagavan dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇapālitām |
vivāde saṃsthitaḥ so'jña iti vācyastvayācyutaḥ ||48||
palāśapatrārddhamapi tvayājito na pārijātasya tava pradāsyati |
iti pravācyo madhusūdanastvayā vaco madīyaṃ smaratā tapodhana || 49 ||
punaḥ pravācyo bhagavaṃstvayācyuto mama priyārthaṃ khalu nirviśaṅkitam |
na māyayā hartumihārhasi drumaṃ suyuddhamevāstu dhigastu jihmatām || 2.70.50 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi pārijātaharaṇe indravākye saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 70 ||

<2.71>

ekasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
mahendravacanaṃ śrutvā nārado vadatāṃ varaḥ |
vivikte devarājānamidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 1 ||
kāmaṃ priyāṇi rājāno vaktavyā nātra saṃśayaḥ |
prāptakālaṃ tu vaktavyaṃ hitamapriyamapyuta || 2 ||
aniyuktapurobhāgo na syāditi vadanti hi |
sulokagatitattvajño nayavijñānakovidaḥ || 3 ||
kāryākārye samutpanne paripṛcchati māṃ bhavān |
yatastataḥ pravakṣyāmi gṛhyatāṃ yadi rocate || 4 ||
anuktenāpi suhṛdā vaktavyaṃ jānatā hitam |
nyāyyaṃ ca prāptakālaṃ ca parābhavamanicchatā || 5 ||
vaktavyaṃ sarvathā sadbhirapriyaṃ cāpi yaddhitam |
ānṛṇyametat snehasya sadbhirevādṛtaṃ purā || 6 ||
anṛte dharmabhagne ca na śuśrūṣati cāpriye |
na priyaṃ ca hitaṃ vācyaṃ sadbhireveti ninditāḥ || 7 ||
sarvathā deva vaktavyaṃ śrūyatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ vara |
śrutvā ca kuru sarvajña mama śreyaskaraṃ vacaḥ || 8 ||
anyonyabhedo bhrātṝṇāṃ suhṛdāṃ vā balāntaka |
bhavatyānandakṛd deva dviṣatāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 9 ||
hitānubandhasahitaṃ kāryaṃ jñeyaṃ sureśvara |
viparītaṃ ca tadbuddhyā nityaṃ buddhimatāṃ vara || 2.71.10 |
yatsyāttāpakaraṃ paścādārabdhaṃ kāryamīdṛśam|
ārabhennaiva tad vidvāneṣa buddhimatāṃ nayaḥ || 11 ||
vipākamasya kāryasya nānupaśyāmi śobhanam |
yadatra kāraṇaṃ deva nibodha vibudhādhipa || 12 ||
ya eko viśvamadhyāste pradhānaṃ jagato hariḥ |
prakṛtyā yaṃ paraṃ sarve kṣetrajñaṃ vai vidurbudhāḥ || 13 ||
tasyāvyaktasya yo vyakto bhāgaḥ sarvabhavodbhavaḥ |
tasyātmā paramo devo viṣṇuḥ sarvasya dhīmataḥ || 14 ||
prakṛtyāḥ prathamo bhāga umā devī yaśasvinī |
vyaktaḥ sarvamayo viśvaḥ strīsaṃjño lokabhāvanaḥ || 15 ||
rukmiṇyādyāḥ striyastasyā vyaktatvaṃ prathamo guṇaḥ |
avyayā prakṛtirdevī guṇī devo maheśvaraḥ || 16 ||
na viśeṣo'sya rudrasya viṣṇoścāmarasattama |
guṇinaścāvyayaḥ śāstā sadā ca prathamo'guṇaḥ || 17 ||
nārāyaṇo mahātejāḥ sarvakṛtyayekabhāvanaḥ |
bhoktā maheśvaro devaḥ kartā viṣṇuradhokṣajaḥ || 18 |
brahmā devagaṇāścānye paścātsṛṣṭā mahātmanā |
mahādevena deveśa prajāpatigaṇāstathā || 19 ||
evaṃ purāṇapuruṣo viṣṇurdeveṣu paṭhyate |
acintyaścāprameyaśca guṇebhyaśca parastathā || 2.71.20 ||
adityā tapasā viṣṇurmahātmā''rādhitaḥ purā |
vareṇa cchanditā tena parituṣṭena cāditiḥ || 21 ||
tayoktastvatsamaṃ putramicchāmīti surottama |
praṇipatya ca vijñāya nārāyaṇamadhokṣajam || 22 ||
tenoktaṃ bhuvane nāsti matsamaḥ puruṣo'paraḥ |
aṃśena tu bhaviṣyāmi putraḥ khalvahameva te || 23 ||
sa jātaḥ sarvakṛd devo bhrātā tava sureśvara |
nārāyaṇo mahātejā yamupendraṃ pracakṣate || 24 ||
icchanneva harirdeva kāśyapatvamupāgataḥ |
taistairbhāvairvikurute bhūtabhavyabhavāpyayaḥ || 25 ||
prādurbhāvaṃ gato devo jagato hitakāmyayā |
māthuraṃ jagato nāthaḥ kartā hartā ca keśavaḥ || 26||
yathā palalapiṇḍaḥ syād vyāptaḥ snehena mānada |
tathā jagadidaṃ vyāptaṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || 27 ||
brahmaṇyadevaḥ sarvātmā taistairbhāvairvikurvati |
jagatyatiguṇo devo vaikuṇṭhaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ || 28 ||
ataḥ samastadevānāṃ pūjya eva ca keśavaḥ |
padmanābhaśca bhagavān prajāsargakaro vibhuḥ || 29 ||
ananto dhāraṇārthaṃ ca bibharti ca mahadyaśaḥ |
yajña ityapi sadbhiśca kathyate vedavādibhiḥ || 2.71.30 ||
śvetaḥ kṛtayuge devo raktastretāyuge tathā |
dvāpare ca tathā pītaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kaliyuge vibhuḥ || 31 ||
avadhītsa hiraṇyākṣaṃ divyarūpadharo hariḥ |
dadhārāpsu nimajjantīmeṣa devo vasundharām || 32 ||
vārāhaṃ vapurāśritya jagato hitakāmyayā |
jaghne hiraṇyakaśipuṃ nārasiṃhavapurhariḥ || 33 ||
jigāya jagatīṃ caiva viṣṇurvāmanarūpadhṛk |
babandha ca baliṃ devaḥ śrīmān pannagabandhanaiḥ || 34 ||
devadānavasambhūtānākrāmayadapi śriyam |
tvayyanantaḥ purā viṣṇurudāro'mitavikramaḥ || 35 ||
sāvaśeṣaṃ tapo yasya tannihanti janārdanaḥ |
alīkeṣvapi vartantaṃ vratametanmahātmanaḥ || 36 ||
jaghne ca dānavān mukhyān devānāṃ ye ca śatravaḥ|
tava priyārthaṃ govindo dharmanityaḥ satāṃ gatiḥ || 37 ||
rāmatvamapi cāvāpya jaghne rāvaṇamātmavān |
bhūtvā kāmaguṇāṃścaiva jaghāna dviradaṃ hariḥ || 38 ||
hitāya jagato'dyāpi loke vasati mānuṣe |
upendro jagatāṃ nāthaḥ sarvabhūtottamottamaḥ || 39 ||
jaṭī kṛṣṇājinī daṇḍī dṛṣṭapūrvo mayā hariḥ |
daiteyeṣu caran devastṛṇeṣvagnirivoddhataḥ || 2.71.40 ||
adrākṣamapi govindaṃ dānavaikārṇavaṃ jagat |
kurvāṇaṃ dānavairhīnaṃ jagato hitakāmyayā || 41 ||
avaśyaṃ pārijātaṃ te nayiṣyati janārdanaḥ |
dvārakāmamaraśreṣṭha nānṛtaṃ ca bravīmyaham || 42 ||
bhrātṛsnehābhibhūtastvaṃ na kṛṣṇe prahariṣyasi |
nāpi kṛṣṇastvayi jyeṣṭhe prahariṣyati vāsava || 43 ||
naiva cecchroṣyati proktaṃ mayā deva kathañcana |
pṛccha tvaṃ nayadharmajñān ye hitāstava mantriṇaḥ || 44 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
nāradenaivamuktastu mahendro janamejaya |
idamuttaramīśo'tha pratyuvāca jagadgurum || 45 ||
evaṃvidhaprabhāvaṃ tvaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vadasi yad dvija |
evametat subahuśaḥ śrutaṃ khalu mayā mune || 46 ||
yataścaivaṃvidhaḥ kṛṣṇastato'haṃ tasya vai tarum |
na pradāsyāmi dātavyaṃ satāṃ dharmamanusmaran || 47 ||
mahāprabhāvo nālpārthe ruṣyediti vicintayan |
vyavasthito'haṃ bhadraṃ te mune sarvaguṇāditi || 48 ||
mahāprabhāvāḥ satataṃ bhavanti hi sahiṣṇavaḥ |
śrotāraścaiva satataṃ vṛddhānāṃ jñānacakṣuṣām || 49 ||
mahātmā kāraṇe nālpe kṛṣṇo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ |
bhrātrā jyeṣṭhena sarvajño virodhaṃ gantumarhati || 2.71.50 ||
yathaivaṃ mama mātuḥ sa varaṃ prādādadhokṣajaḥ |
tathaiva tasyāḥ putrāṇāṃ jyeṣṭhānāṃ soḍhumarhati || 51 ||
yathaivopendratāṃ yātaḥ svayamicchañjanārdanaḥ |
tathaiva bhrāturindrasya sammānaṃ kartumarhati || 52 ||
jyaiṣṭhyametena devena nārabdhaṃ kiṃ purātane |
athedānīmapīcchet sa jyeṣṭho'stu madhusūdanaḥ || 53 ||
suniścitaṃ balaripumīkṣya nārado visarjitastridaśavareṇa dharmabhṛt |
yayau purīṃ yaduvṛṣabhābhirakṣitāṃ kuśasthalīṃ dhṛtimatimāṃstapodhanaḥ || 54 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi pārijātaharaṇe nāradasya svargātpunarāgamane ekasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 71 ||

<2.72>

dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
athetya dvārakāṃ ramyāṃ nārado munisattamaḥ |
dadarśa puruṣaśreṣṭhaṃ nārāyaṇamariṃdamam || 1 ||
svaveśmani sukhāsīnaṃ sahitaṃ satyabhāmayā |
virājamānaṃ vapuṣā sarvatejo'tigāminā || 2 ||
tamevārthaṃ mahātmānaṃ cintayantaṃ dṛḍhavratam |
kevalaṃ yojayantaṃ ca vākyamātreṇa bhāvinīm || 3 ||
dṛṣṭvaiva nāradaṃ devaḥ pratyutthāya adhokṣajaḥ |
pūjayāmāsa ca tathā vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 4 ||
sukhopaviṣṭaṃ viśrāntaṃ prahasya madhusūdanaḥ |
vṛttāntaṃ paripapraccha pārijātataruṃ prati || 5 ||
athācaṣṭa muniḥ sarvaṃ vistareṇa tapodhanaḥ |
indrānujāyendravākyaṃ nikhilaṃ janamejaya || 6 ||
śrutvā kṛṣṇastu tatsarvaṃ nāradaṃ vākyamabravīt|
amarāvatīṃ purīṃ yāsye śvo'haṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ vara || 7 ||
ityuktvā nāradenaiva sahitaḥ sāgaraṃ yayau |
saṃdideśa tatastatra vivikte nāradaṃ hariḥ || 8 ||
mahendrabhavanaṃ gatvā adya brūhi tapodhana |
abhivādya mahātmānaṃ madvākyamamarottamam || 9 ||
na yuddhe pramukhe śakra sthātumarhasi me prabho |
pārijātasya nayane niścitaṃ tvamavehi mām || 2.72.10 ||
evamuktastu kṛṣṇena nāradastridivaṃ gataḥ |
ācacakṣe'tha kṛṣṇoktaṃ devendrasyāmitaujasaḥ || 11 ||
tato bṛhaspateḥ śakraḥ śaśaṃsa balanāśanaḥ |
śrutvā bṛhaspatirdevamuvāca kurunandana || 12 ||
aho dhig brahmasadanaṃ mayi yāte śatakrato |
durnītamidamārabdhamatra bhedo hi dāruṇaḥ 13 ||
anākhyātvā kathaṃ nāma bhavatā bhuvaneśvara |
mamaitat kṛtyamārabdhaṃ deva kenāpi hetunā || 14 ||
athavā bhavitavyena karmajena prayujyate |
jagad vṛtraghna na vidhiḥ śakyaḥ samativartitum || 15 ||
sahasaiva tu kāryāṇāmārambho na praśasyate |
tadetatsahasā''rabdhaṃ kāryaṃ dāsyati lāghavam || 16 ||
bṛhaspatiṃ mahātmānaṃ mahendrastvabravīd vacaḥ |
evaṃ gate'dya yat kāryaṃ tad bhavān vaktumarhati || 17 ||
tamuvācātha dharmātmā gatānāgatatattvavit |
adhomukhaścintayitvā bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ || 18 ||
yatasva saha putreṇa yodhayasva janārdanam |
tathā śakra kariṣyāmi yathā nyāyyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 19 ||
bṛhaspatistvevamuktvā kṣīrodaṃ sāgaraṃ gataḥ |
ācaṣṭa munaye sarvaṃ kaśyapāya mahātmane || 2.72.20 ||
tacchrutvā kaśyapaḥ kruddho bṛhaspatimabhāṣata |
avaśyaṃ bhāvyametad bhoḥ sarvathā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 21 ||
icchataḥ sadṛśīṃ bhāryāṃ maharṣerdevaśarmaṇaḥ |
apadhyānakṛto doṣaḥ patatyeṣa śatakratoḥ || 22 ||
tasya doṣasya śāntyarthamārabdhaśca mune mayā |
udavāsaḥ sa doṣaśca prāpta eva sudāruṇaḥ || 23 ||
tad gamiṣyāmi madhye'sya sahādityā tapodhana |
ubhau tau vārayiṣyāmi daivaṃ saṃvadate yadi || 24 ||
bṛhaspatistu dharmātmā mārīcamidamabravīt |
prāptakālaṃ tvayā tatra bhavitavyaṃ tapodhana || 25 ||
tatheti kaśyapaścoktvā samprasthāpya bṛhaspatim |
jagāmārcayituṃ devaṃ rudraṃ bhūtagaṇeśvaram || 26 ||
tatra saumyaṃ mahātmānamānarca vṛṣabhadhvajam |
varārthī kaśyapo dhīmānadityā sahitaḥ prabhuḥ || 27 ||
tuṣṭāva ca tamīśānaṃ mārīcaḥ kaśyapastadā |
vedoktaiḥ svakṛtaiścaiva stavaiḥ stutyaṃ jagadgurum || 28 ||
kaśyapa uvāca
urukramaṃ viśvakarmāṇamīśaṃ jagatsraṣṭāraṃ dharmadṛśyaṃ vareśam |
saṃ sarvaṃ tvāṃ dhṛtimaddhāma divyaṃ viśveśvaraṃ bhagavantaṃ namasye || 29 ||
yo devānāmadhipaḥ pāpahartā tataṃ viśvaṃ yena jaganmayatvāt |
āpo garbhaṃ yasya śubhā dharitryo viśveśvaraṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye || 2.72.30 ||
śālāvṛkānyo yatirūpo nijaghne dattānindreṇa praṇudo hitānām |
virūpākṣaṃ sudarśanaṃ puṇyayoniṃ viśveśvaraṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi mūrdhnā || 31 ||
bhuṅkte ya eko vibhurjagato viśvamagryaṃ dhāmnāṃ dhāma sukṛtitvānna dhṛṣyaḥ |
puṣyāt sa māṃ mahasā śāśvatena somapānāṃ marīcipānāṃ variṣṭhaḥ || 32 ||
atharvāṇaṃ suśirasaṃ bhūtayoniṃ kṛtinaṃ vīraṃ dānavānāṃ ca bādham |
yajñe hutiṃ yajñiyaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ vai viśveśvaraṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi devam || 33 ||
jagajjālaṃ vitataṃ yatra viśvaṃ viśvātmānaṃ prītidevaṃ gatānām |
ya ūrdhvagaṃ rathamāsthāya yāti viśveśvaraḥ sa sumanā me'stu nityam || 34 ||
antaścaraṃ rocanaṃ cāruśākhaṃ mahābalaṃ dharmanetāramīḍyam |
sahasranetraṃ śatavartmānamugraṃ mahādevaṃ viśvasṛjaṃ namasye || 35 ||
śuciṃ yogaṃ śaṃsanaṃ śāntapāpaṃ śarvaṃ śambhuṃ śaṃkaraṃ bhūtanātham|
dhuraṃdharaṃ gopatiṃ candracihnaṃ hṛṣīkāṇāmayanaṃ yāmi mūrdhnā || 36 ||
āśuḥśiśānaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ roruvāṇaṃ kṛtaṃ dharmaṃ vitathaṃ cāśuśeṣam |
vasuṃdharaṃ samṛjīkaṃ samaṃ tvāṃ dhṛtavrataṃ śūladharaṃ prapadye || 37 ||
anantavīryaṃ dhṛtakarmāṇamādyaṃ yajñāśeṣaṃ yajatāṃ cābhiyājyam |
havirbhujaṃ bhuvanānāṃ sadaiva jyeṣṭhaṃ dvijaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ prapadye || 38 ||
paraṃ guṇebhyaḥ pṛśnigarbhasvarūpaṃ yaśaḥ śṛṅgaṃ vyūhanaṃ kāntarūpam |
śuddhātmānaṃ puruṣaṃ satyadhāmaṃ sammohanaṃ duṣkṛtināṃ namasye || 39 ||
yuktoṅkāraṃ svaśirasaṃ cārukarma dṛḍhavrataṃ dṛdadhanvānamājam|
śūraṃ vettāraṃ dhanuṣo'strātirekaṃ patiṃ paśūnāṃ śamanaṃ namasye || 2.72.40 ||
eko rātiścaiva bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ sarvātithiryo hi juṣatyarighnaḥ |
ariṃtudo'nuttamaḥ saṃvibhāgī vibhājako māṃ bhagavānpātu devaḥ|| 41 ||
ya eko yāti jagatāṃ viśvamīśo ya eko'dānmarutāṃ prāṇamagryam |
yenānṛśaṃsyācchāśvataṃ sāma juṣṭaṃ sa māṃ juṣyātsukṛtiśreyase'dya || 42 ||
brahmāsṛjad yo bhuvanottamottamaṃ tṛpto vidvānbrāhmaṇaḥ ṣaḍguṇasya |
sṛṣṭvā rasaṃ vyāhṛtisthaṃ samagraṃ sa māṃ pāyādiha bahurūpo'rihāṅgaiḥ|| 43 ||
vyañjano'jano'tha vidvān samagraḥ spṛśiḥ śambhuḥ prāṇadaḥ kṛttivāsāḥ |
raso dhruvaḥ pavamānasya bhartā sapatnīśaḥ śaṅkaraḥ sāradhātā ||44 ||
tryambakaṃ puṣṭidaṃ vibruvāṇaṃ dharmaṃ viprāṇāṃ varadaṃ yajvanāṃ ca |
varād varaṃ raṇajetāramīśaṃ devaṃ devānāṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi rudram || 45 ||
āsyaṃ devānāmantakaṃ duṣkṛtīnāṃ trivṛtstomaṃ vṛkṣahaṃ karmasākṣyam |
bhūtāyanaṃ bhūtapatiṃ guṇajñaṃ guṇākāraṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi rudram || 46 ||
anuddhṛtaṃ yajñakartāramantaṃ madhyaṃ cādyaṃ yajñakṛtāṃ sāmyarūpam|
vedavrateṣu bahudhā gītamīśamabhitriviṣṭapaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi rudram|| 47 ||
mahājinaṃ vratinaṃ mekhalālaṃ sutoṣaṇaṃ krodhadhavaṃ vipāpam |
bhūtaṃ kṣetrajñaṃ guṇinaṃ vā kapardinaṃ nato'smīśaṃ vandanaṃ vandanānām || 48 ||
devaṃ devānāṃ pāvanaṃ pāvanānāṃ kṛtiṃ kṛtīnāṃ mahato mahāntam|
śatātmānaṃ saṃstutaṃ gopatīnāṃ patiṃ devaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi rudram || 49 ||
antaścaraṃ puruṣaṃ guhyasaṃjñaṃ prabhāsvantaṃ praṇavaṃ vipradīpam |
hetuṃ paraṃ paramasyākṣarasya śubhaṃ devaṃ guṇinaṃ saṃnato'smi || 2.72.50 ||
prasūtirubhayorna prasūtaśca sūkṣmaḥ pṛthagbhūtebhyo na pṛthakyaikabhūtaḥ |
svayaṃ bhūtaḥ pātu māṃ sarvasādaḥ pradaḥ svādaḥ sampadaḥ pātu ratnam|| 51 ||
āsannaḥ saṃnataraḥ sādhanānāṃ śraddhāvatāṃ śrāddhavṛttipraṇetā |
patirgaṇānāṃ mahatāṃ satkṛtīnāṃ pāyānmeṣaḥ pūraṇaḥ ṣaḍguṇānām|| 52 ||
antarbahirvṛjinānāṃ nihantā svayaṃ kartā bhūtabhāvī vikurvan |
dhṛtāyudhaḥ sukṛtināmuttamaujāḥ praṇudyānme vṛjinaṃ devadevaḥ || 53 ||
yenoddhatāstraiḥ purā māyino vai dagdhā ghoreṇa vitathāntāḥ śareṇa |
mahatkurvanto vṛjinaṃ devatānāṃ jyāyānīśaḥ pātu viśvodadhātā|| 54 ||
bhāgīyasāṃ bhāgamato'ntamicchan makho dākṣo yena kṛtto'nvadhāvat|
vidvānyajñasyādirathāntaḥ sa devaḥ pāyādīśo māṃ dakṣayajñāntahetuḥ || 55||
anyo dhanyaḥ saṃskṛtaścottamaśca jagatsṛṣṭvā yo'tti sarvātiguhyaḥ |
sa māṃ mukhapramukhe pātu nityaṃ vicinvānaḥ prathamaḥ ṣaḍguṇānām|| 56|
guṇatraikālyaṃ yasya devasya nityaṃ sattvodreko yasya bhāvātprasūtaḥ |
goptā goptṝṇāṃ sannado duṣkṛtīnāmādyo viśvasya bādhamānasya kruddhaḥ|| 57 ||
dhāmno yasya hariragro'tha viśvo brahmā putraiḥ sahitaśca dvijāśca |
parābhūtā bhavane yasya somo juṣatveṣa śreyase sādhugoptā || 58 ||
yasmādbhūtānāṃ bhūtiranto'tha madhyaṃ dhṛtirbhūtiryaśca guhāśrutiśca |
guhābhibhūtasya puruṣeśvarasya mahātmanaḥ sammṛḍavedyasya tasya || 59 ||
yalliṅgāṅkaṃ tryambakaḥ sarvamīśo bhagaliṅgāṅkaṃ yaddhyumā sarvadhātrī |
nānyat tṛtīyaṃ jagatīhāsti kiṃcinmahādevāt sarvasarveśvaro'sau || 2.72.60 ||
iti saṃstūyamānastu bhagavān vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ |
darśayāmāsa dharmātmā kaśyapaṃ dharmadhṛgvaram || 61 ||
uvāca cainaṃ deveśaḥ prasannenāntarātmanā |
yena saṃstauṣi kāryeṇa tvaṃ tajjāne prajāpate || 62 ||
indropendrau mahātmānau devau prakṛtimeṣyataḥ |
pārijātaṃ tu dharmātmā nayiṣyati janārdanaḥ || 63 ||
apadhyāto mahendro hi muninā devaśarmaṇā |
asyākāṅkṣatpurā bhāryā tapodīptasya kaśyapa || 64 ||
gamyatāṃ tatra dharmajña dākṣāyaṇyā saha tvayā |
adityā śakrasadanaṃ śreyaste putrayordhuvam || 65 ||
iti haravacanaṃ niśamya vidvān kamalabhavātmajasūnuraprameyaḥ |
tridaśagaṇaguruṃ praṇamya rudraṃ muditamanāḥ sumanaukasaṃ jagāma || 66 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi pārijātaharaṇe kaśyapakṛtarudrastotre dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||72||

<2.73>

trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
atha viṣṇurmahātejā muhūrtābhyudite ravau |
mṛgayāvyapadeśena yayau raivatakaṃ girim || 1 ||
āropyaikarathe devaḥ sātyakiṃ narapuṅgavam |
pradyumnamanugaccheti proktvā kurukulodvaha || 2 ||
raivataṃ ca giriṃ devo gatvā dārukamabravīt |
madīyaṃ rathamenaṃ tvaṃ grahāyehaiva dāruka || 3 ||
pratipālaya māṃ saumya dinārddhe vārayan harīn |
rathenaiva praveṣṭāhaṃ dvārakāṃ sūtasattama || 4 ||
iti saṃdiśya bhagavānāruroha jayodyataḥ |
tārkṣyaṃ sasātyako dhīmānaprameyaparākramaḥ || 5 ||
pṛthag rathena kauravya pradyumnaḥ śatrusūdanaḥ |
ākāśagāminā rājanpṛṣṭhataḥ kṛṣṇamanvayāt || 6 ||
nimeṣāntaramātreṇa nandanaṃ kānanaṃ hariḥ |
devodyānaṃ yayau dhīmān pārijātajihīrṣayā || 7 ||
dadarśa tatra bhagavān devayodhān durāsadān |
nānāyudhadharān vīrān nandanasthānadhokṣajaḥ || 8 ||
teṣāṃ sampaśyatāmeva pārijātaṃ mahābalaḥ |
utpāṭyāropayāmāsa pārijātaṃ satāṃ gatiḥ || 9 ||
garuḍaṃ pakṣirājānamayatnenaiva bhārata |
upasthito vigrahavān pārijātaḥ sa keśavam || 2.73.10 ||
sāntvito vāsudevena pārijātaśca bhārata |
uktaśca vṛkṣa mā bhaistvaṃ keśavena mahātmanā || 11 ||
taṃ prasthitaṃ taruṃ dṛṣṭvā pārijātamadhokṣajaḥ |
amarāvatīṃ purīṃ śreṣṭhāṃ tataścakre pradakṣiṇām || 12 ||
te tu nandanagoptāraḥ pārijāto drumottamaḥ |
hriyatīti mahendrāya gatvā nṛpa śaśaṃsire || 13 ||
athairāvatamāruhya niryayau pākaśāsanaḥ |
jayantena rathasthena pṛṣṭhato'nugataḥ prabhuḥ || 14 ||
pūrvamabhyāgataṃ dvāraṃ keśavaṃ śatrunāśanam |
dṛṣṭvovāca pravṛttaṃ bhoḥ kimidaṃ madhusūdana || 15 ||
praṇamya garuḍastho'tha keśavaḥ śakramabravīt |
vadhvāste puṇyakāryāya nīyate'yaṃ varadrumaḥ || 16 ||
tamuvāca tataḥ śakro mā maivaṃ puṣkarekṣaṇa |
ayodhayitvā na tarurnayitavyastvayācyuta || 17 ||
praharasva mahābāho prathamaṃ mayi keśava |
pratijñā saphalā te'stu muktvā kaumodakī mayi || 18||
tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śaraistīkṣṇairdevarājagajottamam |
bibhedāśanisaṃkāśaiḥ prahasanniva bhārata || 19 ||
vivyādha garuḍaṃ vajrī divyaiḥ śaravaraistathā |
bāṇāṃściccheda sahasā keśavasya tarasvinaḥ || 2.73.20 ||
yān yān mumoca devendrastāṃstāṃściccheda mādhavaḥ |
mādhavena prayuktāṃśca ciccheda balavṛtrahā || 21 ||
mahendrasya ca śabdena dhanuṣaḥ kurunandana |
śārṅgasya ca ninādena mumuhuḥ svargavāsinaḥ || 22 ||
tayorvartati saṃgrāme garuḍasthaṃ mahābalaḥ |
pārijātaṃ jayanto'tha hartumabhyudyato balī || 23 ||
pradyumnamatha kaṃsaghno vārayeti tadābravīt |
tatastaṃ vārayāmāsa raukmiṇeyaḥ pratāpavān || 24 ||
jayanto jayatāṃ śreṣṭho raukmiṇeyamatheṣubhiḥ |
sarvagātreṣu vihasannājaghāna rathe sthitaḥ || 25 ||
rathastha eva rathinaṃ kāmastu kamalekṣaṇaḥ |
aindrimabhyardayāmāsa bāṇairāśīviṣopamaiḥ || 26
sa saṃnipātastumulo babhūva kurunandana |
jayantasya ca vīrasya raukmiṇeyasya cobhayoḥ || 27 ||
kṛtapratikṛtaṃ yuddhe cakratustau mahābalau |
mahendropendratanayau jagatyastrabhṛtāṃ varau || 28 ||
devāśca munayaścaiva dadṛśurvismayānvitāḥ |
taṃ saṃgrāmaṃ mahāghoraṃ siddhāścaiva sacāraṇāḥ || 29 ||
tatastu pravaro nāma devadūto mahābalaḥ |
pārijātaṃ punarhartumiyeṣa kurunandana || 2.73.30 ||
sakhā sa devarājasya mahāstravidariṃdamaḥ |
avadhyo varadānena brahmaṇaḥ kurunandana || 31 ||
brāhmaṇastapasā siddhau jambūdvīpād divaṃ gataḥ |
svaśaktyā nṛpa saṃyātaḥ sakhitvaṃ balaghātinā || 32 ||
tamāpatantaṃ samprekṣya kṛṣṇaḥ sātyakimabravīt |
atrastha eva pravaraṃ śarairvāraya sātyake || 33 ||
tataḥ ṣaṣṭyā ratheṣūṇāṃ garuḍasthaṃ dvijastadā |
ājaghāna mahābāho sātyakiṃ pravaro bhṛśam || 35 ||
śinernaptā dhanustasya kṣipataḥ sāyakān nṛpa |
ciccheda puruṣavyāghro vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 36 ||
brāhmaṇo nābhihantavyastiṣṭha tiṣṭha svavartmani |
avadhyā yādavānāṃ hi svāparādhe'pi hi dvijāḥ || 37 ||
pravarastu prahasyainamuvāca kurunandana |
alaṃ kṣāntyā nṛṇāṃ śūra yuddhya sarvātmanā raṇe || 38 ||
jāmadagnyasya rāmasya śiṣyo'hamapi yādava |
nāmataḥ pravaro nāma sakhā śakrasya dhīmataḥ || 39 ||
na devā yoddhumicchanti manyanto madhusūdanam |
ānṛṇyaṃ sauhṛdasyāhamadhigantāsmi mādhava || 2.73.40 ||
tatastayostadā raudraḥ saṃgrāmo vavṛdhe nṛpa |
astrairdivyairnaravyāghra śaineyadvijamukhyayoḥ || 41 ||
dyauścacāla tadā rājan dyucarāśca sahasraśaḥ |
tasmin vartati saṃgrāme teṣāmatimahātmanām || 42 ||
nātiśiṣye raṇe kārṣṇiraindrimastrabhṛtāṃ varam |
aindriḥ kārṣṇi mahātmānaṃ māyinaṃ śūrasattamam|| 43 ||
hanta gṛhṇa pratīccheti tāvubhau yodhasattamau |
yuyudhāte naraśreṣṭha parasparajayaiṣiṇau || 44 ||
atha śārṅgāyudhasutaṃ śacīputraḥ pratāpavān |
vibhāṣyābhyahanadrājan divyenāstreṇa satvaraḥ || 45 ||
so'straṃ tadabhidīpyantamāpatantaṃ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ |
tastambhe bāṇajālena tadadbhutamivābhavat || 46 ||
tatastad dīpyamānaṃ tu papāta raṇamūrddhani |
raukmiṇeyasya kauravya ghoraṃ dānavamardanam || 47 ||
tenāstreṇa ratho dagdhaḥ pradyumnasya mahātmanaḥ |
nādahat tat sughoraṃ taṃ raukmiṇeyaṃ narādhipa || 48 ||
dahatyagniṃ na khalvagniruddhato'pi viśāmpate |
dagdhād rathānmahābāhu raukmiṇeyaḥ pracakrame || 49 ||
atha nārāyaṇasuto viratho rathināṃ varaḥ |
sthito dhanuṣmānākāśe jayantamidamabravīt || 2.73.50 ||
mahendraputra divyaṃ tvaṃ yadastraṃ muktavānasi |
nāhamīdṛśarūpāṇāṃ śakyo hantuṃ śatairapi || 51 ||
prayatnaṃ kuru śikṣāṇāṃ yatnaṃ me'dya pradarśaya |
nāsti me'tiśayaṃ kartā saṃgrāme'maranandana || 52 ||
āsīnme sādhvasaṃ dṛṣṭvā rathasthaṃ tvāṃ dhṛtāyudham|
bibhemi tava nedānīṃ yuddhe dṛṣṭabalo'balam || 53 ||
manasā smaryatāṃ saiṣa pārijātastvayā taruḥ |
śakyaṃ na khalu hastābhyāṃ spraṣṭavyo yastvayā hyasau ||54||
ratho māyāmayo dagdhastvayā yo hyastratejasā |
īdṛśānāṃ sahasrāṇi sraṣṭuṃ śakto'smi māyayā || 55 ||
evamukto jayantaśca mumocāstraṃ mahābalaḥ |
tapasopacitaṃ tena svayamevātitejasā || 56 ||
tat pradyumno mahāvegaṃ śarajālairavārayat |
catvāryastrāṇi divyāni mumuce cāparāṇi saḥ || 57 ||
dikṣu sarvāsu rurudhustānyastrāṇyatha bhārata |
raukmiṇeyaṃ mahātmānamantarikṣe ca pañcamam || 58 ||
maholkāsadṛśān bāṇānastrāṇyamarasattamaḥ |
mumoca yāni ghorāṇi pradyumnaṃ prati sarvataḥ || 59 ||
tāni sarvāṇi bāṇaughaiḥ kārṣṇirastrāṇyavārayat |
jayantaṃ cāparairbāṇairvidhyādha niśitaistadā || 2.73.60 ||
tato nādaḥ samutsṛṣṭo hyamaraiḥ puṇyakarmabhiḥ |
dṛṣṭvā sthairyaṃ ca śaighryaṃ ca pradyumnasya mahātmanaḥ || 61 ||
pravarasyāpi bāṇena śitena śinipuṅgavaḥ |
cicchedeṣvāsanaṃ vīro hastāvāpaṃ ca bhārata || 62 ||
tatau'nyatsa tu jagrāha mahat taddhanuruttamam |
mahendradattaṃ pravaro mahāśanisamasvanam || 63 ||
sa tena vīro mahatā dhanuṣā viprasattamaḥ |
śarān mumoca vividhānarkaraśminibhāṃstadā || 64 ||
cakarta ca dhanuścitraṃ śaineyasyāmitaujasaḥ |
vivyādha sarvagātreṣu bāṇairapi ca sātyakim || 65 ||
dhanurādāya śaineyastato'nyat kurunandana |
dṛḍhaṃ bhārasahaṃ dhīmān vivyādha pravaraṃ raṇe || 66 ||
uccakartaturanyonyavarmaṇī tau śitaiḥ śaraiḥ |
gātrebhyaścaiva māṃsāni marmabhidbhiḥ śarodyamaiḥ || 67 ||
athāṣṭadhārabāṇena punariṣvāsanaṃ dvidhā |
ciccheda pravaro vīrastribhiścainamatāḍayat || 68 ||
anyadiṣvāsanaṃ taṃ tu grahītumanasaṃ dvijaḥ |
gadayā tāḍayāmāsa kṣepyayā laghuhastavān || 69 ||
so'siṃ carma ca jagrāha sātyakiḥ prahasanniva |
na jagrāha dhanurdhīmān gadayābhihato bhṛśam || 2.73.70 ||
tataḥ śaraśatānyeva mumoca pravarastadā |
vihastamiva vijñāya sātyakiṃ yadunandanam || 71 ||
pradyumno'sya dadau khaḍgaṃ nirmalākāśasaṃnibham |
tasya ciccheda bhallena nistriṃśaṃ pravarastadā || 72 ||
tsarudeśe'pātayacca pravaraḥ prahasanniva |
vyadhamacca tathā carma śitairbāṇairajihmagaiḥ || 73 ||
ājaghāna ca śaktyainaṃ hṛdi vipro nanāda ca |
taṃ viklavamiva jñātvā pārijātajihīrṣayā |
tārkṣyābhyāśe rathenaiva sa tasthau pravarastadā || 74 ||
taṃ pakṣapuṭavegena cikṣepa garuḍastathā |
gavyūtimekāṃ sarathaḥ sa papāta mumoha ca || 75 ||
taṃ jayanto nipatyātha patitaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ nṛpa |
samāśvāsya rathaṃ śīghraṃ samāropitavāṃstadā || 76 ||
śaineyamapi muhyantaṃ patantaṃ ca muhurmuhuḥ |
āśvāsayānaḥ pradyumnaḥ pitṛvyaṃ pariṣasvaje || 77 ||
taṃ hi pasparśa hastena savyena madhusūdanaḥ |
virujaḥ sparśamātreṇa sātyakiḥ samapadyata || 78 ||
pradyumno dakṣiṇe pārśve vāme tu śinipuṅgavaḥ |
tasthatuḥ pārijātasya yuddhaśauṇḍatarāvubhau || 79 ||
jayantaḥ pravaraścaiva rathenaikena bhārata |
sampatantau mahendreṇa prahasyoktau mahātmanā || 2.73.80 ||
nāsannamabhigantavyaṃ garuḍasya kathaṃcana |
balavāneṣa patatāṃ rājā ca vinatāsutaḥ || 81 ||
dakṣiṇe caiva savye ca pārśve mama dhṛtāyudhau |
ubhau sthitau yuddhyamānaṃ māmeva hi prapaśyatam || 82 ||
evamuktau sthitau vīrau tataḥ śakrasya pārśvayoḥ |
dadṛśāte yuddhadyamānau devarājajanārdanau || 83 ||
athendro garuḍaṃ bāṇairmahāśanisamasvanaiḥ |
vivyādha sarvagātreṣu mahāstrapravaraistathā || 84 ||
sa tān bāṇānagaṇayan vainateyaḥ pratāpavān |
sasārābhimukho vīraḥ śakranāgamariṃdamaḥ || 85 ||
ubhau tau sahasā rājan balinau gajapakṣiṇau |
prayuddhau vīryasampannau mahāprāṇau durāsadau || 86 ||
radanaiḥ pannagaripuṃ kareṇa śirasā tadā |
airāvato gajapatirājaghāna nadaṃstathā || 87 ||
tathā nakhāṅkuśaistīkṣṇairvainateyo balotkaṭaḥ |
tathā pakṣanipātaiśca śakranāgaṃ jaghāna ha || 88 ||
muhūrtaṃ sumahānāsīt sampāto gajapakṣiṇoḥ |
vismāpanīyo jagataḥ prekṣitṝṇāṃ bhayāvahaḥ || 89 ||
mūrdhnyathairāvataṃ tārkṣyastāḍayāmāsa bhārata |
nakhāṅkuśakarālena caraṇena mahābalaḥ || 2.73.90 ||
samprahārābhisaṃtapto nipapāta triviṣṭapāt |
pāriyātre giriśreṣṭhe dvīpe'smiñjanamejaya || 91 ||
patantamapi taṃ śakro na mumoca mahābalaḥ |
kāruṇyādatha sauhārdāt pūrvābhyupagamādapi || 92||
kṛṣṇo'pyanvagamaccainaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ prabhavo'vyayaḥ |
pārijātavatā dhīmān garuḍena mahābalaḥ || 93 ||
sa tasthau parvataśreṣṭhe pāriyātre tu vṛtrahā |
airāvate samāśvaste saṃgrāmo vavṛdhe punaḥ || 94 ||
śarairāśīviṣaprakhyai ratnayuktaiḥ sutejitaiḥ |
anyonyaṃ kuruśārdūla śakrakeśavayormahān || 95 ||
tato vajrāyudho vajramaśaniṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ |
mumoca garuḍe rājannairāvataripau nṛpa || 96 ||
vajrāśaninipātāṃstān sehe śakrasya pakṣirāṭ |
avadhyo balināṃ śreṣṭho nisargeṇa tapobalāt || 97 ||
mumoca pakṣamekaikaṃ mānayannaśaniṃ sadā |
vajraṃ ca devarājño'tha bhrātuḥ kaśyapasambhavaḥ || 98 ||
ākramyamāṇastārkṣyeṇa nyamajjannṛpate giriḥ |
viveśa dharaṇīṃ rājañcchīryamāṇaḥ samantataḥ || 99 ||
cukūja bahumānena kṛṣṇasya sa tu parvataḥ |
taṃ cādrākṣīttataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kiṃciccheṣamadhokṣajaḥ ||2.73.100||
taṃ muktvā garuḍenātha tasthau devo vihāyasi |
pradyumnaṃ ca tadovāca sarvakṛllokabhāvanaḥ || 101||
ito dvāravatīṃ gatvā rathamānaya mā ciram |
sadārukaṃ mahābāho mattejobalamāśritaḥ || 102||
vaktavyo balabhadraśca rājā ca kukurādhipaḥ |
śvo jitvendraṃ tvāgamiṣye dvārakāmiti mānada || 103||
tathetyuktvā tu dharmātmā pradyumnaḥ pitaraṃ vibhuḥ |
gatvā yathoktamuktvā ca yādavendrabalāvubhau || 104||
nāḍikāntaramātreṇa punastaṃ deśamāyayau |
dārukeṇa samāyuktaṃ rathamāsthāya bhārata || 105 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi pārijātaharaṇe śrīkṛṣṇendrayuddhe trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 73 ||

<2.74>

catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tamāruhya rathaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ pāriyātraṃ giriṃ yayau |
yatrairāvatamāsthāya sthitaḥ surapatiḥ prabhuḥ || 1 ||
pāriyātro giriśreṣṭho dṛṣṭvā yāntaṃ janārdanam|
śāṇapādasamo bhūtvā praviveśa vasuṃdharām || 2 ||
priyārthaṃ vāsudevasya prabhāvajño mahātmanaḥ |
tasya prīto hṛṣīkeśaḥ parvatasya janādhipa || 3 ||
tataḥ prayātaṃ yuddhārthamacyutaṃ kurunandana |
sapārijāto garuḍaḥ pṛṣṭhato'nuyayau tadā || 4 ||
prayumnaḥ sātyakiścāpi garuḍasthau mahābalau |
gatāvubhau rakṣaṇārthaṃ pārijātamariṃdamau || 5 ||
tatastvastaṃ gataḥ sūryaḥ pravṛttā rajanī nṛpa |
upasthitaṃ punaryuddhaṃ śakrakeśavayoriha || 6 ||
suprahārāhataṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇurairāvataṃ gajam |
nātikalpaṃ mahātejā devarājānamabravīt || 7 ||
garuḍābhihataḥ pūrvaṃ nātikalpo gajottamaḥ |
airāvato mahābāho rātriśca samupohyate || 8 ||
śvaḥ prabhāte yathākāmaṃ pravartasva yathecchasi |
evamastviti kṛṣṇaṃ tu devarājo'bravīt prabhuḥ || 9 ||
uvāsa puṣkarābhyāśe devarājaḥ puraṃdaraḥ |
vrajaṃ girimayaṃ kṛtvā dharmātmā nṛpasattama || 2.74.10 ||
brahmā tato jagāmātha kaśyapaśca mahānṛṣiḥ |
aditiścaiva sarve ca devā munaya eva ca || 11 ||
sādhyā viśve ca kauravya nāsatyāvaśvinau tathā |
ādityāścaiva rudrāśca vasavaśca janeśvara || 12 ||
nārāyaṇaśca putreṇa sātyakena ca bhārata |
sahovāsa girau ramye pāriyātre prahṛṣṭavat || 13 ||
yat sa śāṇapramāṇo'sya bhaktyā samabhavannṛpa |
varaṃ prādāt tatastasya parvatasya mahādyutiḥ || 14 ||
śāṇapāda iti khyāto bhaviṣyasi mahāgire |
puṇyenārddhena tulyo hi puṇyo himavataḥ śubhaḥ || 15 ||
evameva ca bhūyiṣṭho bhava parvatasattama |
meruṇā spardhamāno hi bahucitramṛgairyutaḥ |
rame tvāṃ paśyamāno'haṃ bahucitranagāyutam || 16 ||
tathā dattvā varaṃ tasya parvatasya tu keśavaḥ |
dadhyau gaṅgāṃ saricchreṣṭhāṃ namaskṛtvā vṛṣadhvajam || 17 ||
athāyayau viṣṇupadī smṛtā kṛṣṇena bhārata |
sampūjyatāṃ tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛtvā snānamadhokṣajaḥ || 18 ||
udakaṃ ca gṛhāyātha bilvaṃ ca hariravyayaḥ |
devamāvāhayāmāsa rudraṃ sarveśvareśvaram || 19 ||
tataḥ prāpto mahādevaḥ somaḥ sapravaro vibhuḥ |
tasthāvupari bilvasya tathā gaṅgodakasya ca || 2.74.20 ||
taṃ pārijātakusumairarcayāmāsa keśavaḥ |
tuṣṭāva vāgbhirīśeśaṃ sarvakartāramīśvaram || 21 ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
rudro deva tvaṃ rudanād rāvaṇācca rorūyamāṇo drāvaṇāccātidevaḥ |
bhaktaṃ bhaktānāṃ vatsalaṃ vatsalānāṃ kīrtyā yuṅkṣveśādya prapadye śaraṇyam|| 22 ||
grāmyāraṇyānāṃ tvaṃ patistvaṃ paśūnāṃ khyāto devaḥ paśupatiḥ sarvakarmā |
nānyastvattaḥ paramo devadeva jagatpatiḥ suravīrārihantā || 23 ||
yasmīdīśo mahatāmīśvarāṇāṃ bhavānādyaḥ prītidaḥ prāṇadaśca |
tasmāddhi tvāmīśvaraṃ prāhurīśaṃ saṃto vidvāṃsaḥ sarvaśāstrārthatajjñāḥ || 24 ||
bhūtaṃ yasmājjagadatyanta dhīra tvatto'vyaktādakṣarādakṣareśa |
tasmāt tvāmāhurbhava ityeva bhūtaṃ sarveśvarāṇāṃ mahatāmapyudāram || 25 ||
yasmājjitairabhiṣikto'si sarvairdevāsuraiḥ sarvabhūtaiśca deva |
maheśvaraṃ viśvakarmāṇamāhustvāṃ vai sarve tena devātidevam || 26 ||
pūjyo daivaiḥ pūjyase nityadā vai śaśvacchreyaḥ kāṅkṣibhirvaradāmeyavīrya |
tasmād vikhyāto bhagavān devadevaḥ satāmiṣṭaḥ sarvabhūtātmabhāvī || 27 ||
bhūmitrayāṇāṃ deva yasmāt pratiṣṭhā punarlokānāṃ bhāvanāmeyakīrtiḥ |
tryambaketi prathamaṃ tena nāma tavāprameya tridaśeśanātha || 28 ||
śarvaḥ śatrūṇāṃ śāsanādaprameyastathā bhūyaḥ śāsanācceśvareṇa |
sarvavyāpitvācchaṅkaratvācca sadbhiḥ śabdasyeśānaḥ śrīkarārkāgryatejāḥ || 29 ||
saṃsaktānāṃ nityadā yat karoṣi śamaṃ bhrātṛvyān yadyanaiṣīḥ samastān |
tasmād devaḥ śaṅkaro'syaprameyaḥ sadbhirddharmajñaiḥ kathyase sarvanātha || 2.74.30 ||
dattaḥ prahāraḥ kuliśena pūrvaṃ taveśāna surarājñātivīrya |
kaṇṭhe nailyaṃ tena te yat pravṛttaṃ tasmāt khyātastvaṃ nīlakaṇṭheti kalpaḥ ||31||
yalliṅgāṅkaṃ yacca loke bhagāṅkaṃ sarvaṃ soma tvaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca |
prāhurviprāstvāṃ guṇinaṃ tattvavijñāstathā dhyeyāmambikāṃ lokadhātrīm || 32 ||
vaidairgītā sā hi tat tvaṃ prasūtā yajño dīkṣāṇāṃ yogināṃ cātirūpaḥ |
nātyadbhutaṃ tvatsamaṃ deva bhūtaṃ bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavadevātha nāsti || 33 ||
ahaṃ brahmā kapilo yo'pyanantaḥ putrāḥ sarve brahmaṇaścātivīrāḥ |
tvattaḥ sarve devadeva prasūtā evaṃ sarveśaḥ kāraṇātmā tvamīḍya ||34 ||
iti saṃstūyamānastu bhagavān govṛṣadhvajaḥ |
prasārya dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ nārāyaṇamathābravīt || 35 ||
manīṣitānāmarthānāṃ prāptiste surasattama |
pārijātaṃ ca hartāsi mā bhūt te manaso vyathā || 36||
yathā mainākamāśritya tapastvamakaroḥ prabho |
tathā mama varaṃ kṛṣṇa saṃsmṛtya sthairyamāpnuhi || 37 ||
avadhyastvamajeyaśca mattaḥ śūratarastathā |
bhavitāsītyavocaṃ yat tat tathā na tadanyathā || 38 ||
yaśca stavena māṃ bhaktyā stoṣyate'marasattama |
tvayā kṛtena dharmajña dharmabhāk sambhaviṣyati |
samare ca jayaṃ viṣṇo prāpya pūjāṃ tathottamām || 39 ||
bilvodakeśvaro nāma bhavitāhamihānagha |
deveśvara tvayāsthāpi deva siddhopayācanaḥ || 2.74.40 ||
ihasthopauṣito vidvān bhaktimān mama keśava |
trirātramīpsitām̐llokān gamiṣyati janārdana || 41 ||
avindhyā nāma deśe'smingaṅgācaiva bhaviṣyati |
gaṅgāsnānasamaṃ snānaṃ mantrato bhavitā tathā || 42 ||
ṣaṭapuraṃ nāma nagaraṃ dānavānāṃ janārdana |
atrāntarddharaṇīdeśe parākramya mahābalāḥ || 43 ||
ete daityā durātmāno jagato deva kaṇṭakāḥ |
channā vasanti govinda sānāvasya mahāgireḥ || 44 ||
avadhyā devadevānāṃ vareṇa brahmaṇo'nagha |
mānuṣāntaritastasmāt tvametāñjahi keśava || 45 ||
evamuktvā mahādevastatraivāntaradhīyata |
pariṣvajya mahātmānaṃ vāsudevaṃ janādhipa || 46 ||
tato yāte mahādeve prabhātāyāṃ narādhipa |
tasyāṃ niśāyāṃ govindo bhūyaḥ parvatamabravīt || 47 ||
tavādhaḥ parvataśreṣṭha nivasanti mahāsurāḥ |
avadhyā devadevānāṃ vareṇa brahmaṇaḥ purā || 48 ||
nirgamiṣyanti te naiva mayā ruddhā mahābalāḥ |
dvāre niruddhe tatraiva vinaṅkṣyanti mamājñayā || 49 ||
tvayi saṃnihitaścāhaṃ bhaviṣyāmi mahāgire |
adhiṣṭhāya mahāghorān nivatsyāmi ca parvata || 2.74.50 ||
āruhya mūrdhni madrūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā parvatasattama |
gosahasrapradānasya phalaṃ prāpsyati śāśvatam || 51 ||
tvatto'śmabhiśca pratimāṃ kārayitvā hi bhaktitaḥ |
śuśrūṣayanti ye nityaṃ mama yāsyanti te gatim || 52 ||
iti taṃ parvataṃ kṛṣṇo varado'nugṛhītavān |
tadāprabhṛti deveśastatra saṃnihito'cyutaḥ || 53 ||
pāṣāṇaiḥ pratimāṃ tāta kārayitvā ca kaurava |
śuśrūṣanti kṛtātmāno viṣṇulokābhikāṅkṣiṇaḥ ||54||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi pārijātaharaṇe śrīkṛṣṇakṛtaśivastutirnāma catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 74 ||

<2.75>

pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tato rathavaraṃ kṛṣṇaḥ samāruhya mahāmanāḥ |
bilvodakeśvaraṃ devaṃ namaskṛtya yayau nṛpa || 1 ||
mahendramāhvayāmāsa rathastho madhusūdanaḥ |
satkṛtaṃ puṣkarābhyāśe sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ saha || 2 ||
tataḥ śakro jayanto'tha haribhiryuktamuttamam |
āruroha rathaṃ devaḥ sarvakāmapradaḥ satām || 3 ||
tato rathasthayoryuddhamabhavat kurunandana |
devayordaivayogena pārijātakṛte tadā || 4 ||
tato'hanad raṇe viṣṇurbāṇaiḥ śatrubalārdanaḥ |
sainyāni devarājasya bāṇajālairajihmagaiḥ || 5 ||
upendraṃ na mahendro'tha naiva viṣṇuḥ sureśvaram |
tāḍayāmāsaturvīrau śastraiḥ śaktāvapi prabho || 6 ||
ekaikamaśvaṃ daśabhirmahendrasya janārdanaḥ |
vivyādha viśikhaistīkṣṇairastrayuktairjaneśvara || 7 ||
śaibyādyānapi devendraḥ śarairamarasattamaḥ |
chādayāmāsa rājendra ghorairastrābhimantritaiḥ || 8 ||
sa ca bāṇasahasraiśca kṛṣṇo gajamavākirat |
garuḍaṃ ca mahātejā balabhiddharivāhanam || 9 ||
bhūyiṣṭhābhyāṃ rathābhyāṃ tau tadahaḥ śatrudāraṇau |
yuyudhāte mahātmānau nārāyaṇasurādhipau || 2.75.10 ||
cakampe vasudhā kṛtsnā naurjalastheva bhārata |
diśāṃ dāhena digdeśāḥ saṃvṛtāśca samantataḥ || 11 ||
celurgirivarāścaiva petuśca śataśo drumāḥ |
petuśca dharaṇīpṛṣṭhe martyā dharmaguṇānvitāḥ || 12 ||
nirghātāḥ śataśaścaiva petustatra narādhipa |
ūhuśca saritaḥ sarvāḥ pratisroto viśāmpate || 13 ||
viṣvagvātā vavuścaiva peturulkāśca niṣprabhāḥ |
muhurmuhurbhūtasaṃghā rathanādena mohitāḥ || 14 ||
prajajvāla jale caiva vahnirjanapadeśvara |
yuyudhuśca grahaiḥ sārddhaṃ grahā nabhasi sarvataḥ || 15 ||
jyotīṃṣi śataśaḥ petuḥ svargācca dharaṇītale |
diśāṃ gajāḥ prakupitā nāgāśca dharaṇītale || 16 ||
gardabhāruṇasaṃsthānaiśchinnābhraiścāvṛtaṃ nabhaḥ |
vinadadbhirmahārāvairulkāśoṇitavarṣibhiḥ || 17 ||
na bhūrna dyaurna gaganaṃ narendravṛṣabhābhavan |
svasthāni suravīrau tu dṛṣṭvā yuddhagatau tadā || 18 ||
jepurmunigaṇā mantrāñjagato hitakāmyayā |
brāhmaṇāśca mahātmāno hyatiṣṭhaṃsteṣu satvarāḥ || 19 ||
tato brahmā mahātejāḥ kaśyapaṃ vākyamabravīt |
gaccha badhvā sahādityā putrau vāraya suvrata || 2.75.20||
sa tatheti tadā devamuktvā padmabhavaṃ muniḥ |
jagāma rathamāsthāya tasthau naravarāntike || 21 ||
sthitaṃ tu kaśyapaṃ dṛṣṭvā sahādityā tadantarā |
ubhau rathābhyāṃ dharaṇīmavatīrṇau mahābalau || 22 ||
nyastaśastrau ca tau vīrau vavandaturariṃdamau |
pitarau dharmatattvajñau sarvabhūtahite ratau || 23 ||
ubhau gṛhītvā hastābhyāmaditistvabravīd vacaḥ |
asodarāvivaivaṃ kimanyonyaṃ hantumicchataḥ || 24 ||
svalpamarthaṃ puraskṛtya pravṛttamatidāruṇam |
sadṛśaṃ neti paśyāmi sarvathā mama putrayoḥ || 25 ||
śrotavyaṃ yadi mātuśca pituścaiva prajāpateḥ |
nyastaśastrau sthitau bhūtvā kurutaṃ vacanaṃ mama || 26 ||
tathetyuktvā ca tau devau snātukāmau mahābalau |
gaṅgāṃ jagmaturevātha prajalpantau parasparam || 27 ||
śakra uvāca
tvaṃ prabhurlokakṛt kṛtsnarājye'haṃ sthāpitastvayā |
sthāpayitvā kathaṃ nāma punarmāmavamanyase ||28||
bhrātṛtvamupagamyaiva jyeṣṭhatvaṃ cāpyapohya ca |
kathaṃ kamalapatrākṣa nirvāṇaṃ kartumicchasi || 29 ||
snātau tu jāhnavītoye punarabhyāgatau nṛpa |
yatrāditiḥ kaśyapaśca mahātmānau dṛḍhavratau || 2.75.30 ||
priyasaṃgamanaṃ nāma taṃ deśaṃ munayo'vadan |
yatra tau saṃgatau cobhau pitṛbhyāṃ kamalekṣaṇau || 31 ||
tataḥ śakrasya kauravya dattvā vācābhayaṃ tadā |
yatra devagaṇāḥ sarve sametā dharmacāriṇaḥ || 32 ||
tato yayurvimānaistu devāḥ sarve triviṣṭapam |
ṛddhyā paramayā yuktāsteṣāmevānurūpayā || 33 ||
kaśyapaścāditiścaiva tathā śakrajanārdanau |
vimānamekamāruhya gatā rājaṃstriviṣṭapam || 34 ||
te śakrasadanaṃ prāptā ramyaṃ sarvaguṇānvitam |
ūṣurekatra kauravya muditā dharmacāriṇaḥ || 35 ||
śacī tu kaśyapaṃ patnyā sahitaṃ dharmavatsalā |
upācaranmahātmānaṃ sarvabhūtahite ratam || 36 ||
tatastasyāṃ prabhātāyāṃ rajanyāmabravīddharim |
aditirdharmatattvajñā sarvabhūtahitaṃ vacaḥ || 37 ||
upendra dvārakāṃ gaccha pārijātaṃ nayasva ca |
vadhvā samprāpayasveśa puṇyakaṃ hṛdaye sthitam || 38 ||
puṇyake satyayā prāpte punareṣa tvayā taruḥ |
nandane puruṣaśreṣṭha sthāpyaḥ sthāne yathocite || 39 ||
evamastviti kṛṣṇena devamātā yaśasvinī |
uktā dharmaguṇairyuktā nāradena mahātmanā || 2.75.40 ||
tato'bhivādya pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca janārdanaḥ |
mahendraṃ saha śacyātha pratasthe dvārakāṃ prati || 41 ||
dadau kṛṣṇāya paulomī niyogān kurunandana |
sarvāsāmeva kṛṣṇasya bhāryāṇāṃ dharmacāriṇī || 42 ||
divyānāṃ sarvaratnānāṃ vāsasāṃ ca manasvinī |
nānārāgaviraktānāṃ sadaivārajasāmapi || 43 ||
bhāryāṇāṃ ca sahasrāṇi yāni ṣoḍaśa mādhave |
pratigṛhya mahātejāḥ prayayau dvārakāṃ prati || 44 ||
sampūjyamāno dyutimān khecaraiḥ puṇyakarmabhiḥ |
sasātyakiḥ saputraśca prāpto raivatakaṃ girim || 45||
sa tatra sthāpayitvā ca pārijātaṃ varadrumam |
sātyakaṃ preṣayāmāsa dvārakāṃ dvāraśālinīm || 46||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
pārijātamihānītaṃ mahendrasadanānmayā |
nivedaya mahābāho bhaimānāṃ bhaimavarddhana || 47 ||
adya dvāravatīṃ caiva pārijātamahaṃ drumam |
praveśayiṣye nagare śobhā prakriyatāṃ śubhā || 48 ||
ityuktaḥ sātyako gatvā tathoktvā punarāgataḥ |
kumārairnāgaraiḥ sārddhaṃ sāmbaprabhṛtibhiḥ prabho || 49 ||
tato'grataḥ pārijātamāropya garuḍe tadā |
pradyumno dvārakāṃ ramyāṃ viveśa rathināṃ varaḥ || 2.75.50 ||
śaibyādihayayuktena rathenānuyayau hariḥ |
tasyātha rathamukhyena sātyakaḥ sāmba eva ca || 51 ||
ye tvanye nṛpa vārṣṇeyā yānairbahuvidhaistathā |
yayuḥ prahṛṣṭāstat karma pūjayanto mahātmanaḥ || 52 ||
sātyakād vistaraṃ śrutvā yādavā nāgarāstathā |
vismayaṃ paramaṃ jagmuraprameyasya karmaṇā || 53 ||
taṃ divyakusumaṃ vṛkṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā''nartanivāsinaḥ |
rājan na tatṛpurhṛṣṭāḥ paśyamānā mahodayam || 54 ||
tamadbhutamacintyaṃ ca madakelikalāṇḍajam |
vṛkṣottamaṃ paśyatāṃ vai vṛddhānāmagamajjarā || 55 ||
ye tvandhacakṣuṣaḥ sarve te'bhavan divyacakṣuṣaḥ |
virogā rogiṇaścāsan ghrātvā gandhaṃ vanaspateḥ || 56 |
lapantaḥ kaukilāñchvetāñchrutvā''nartanivāsinaḥ |
babhūvurhṛṣṭamanaso vavanduśca janārdanam || 57 |
nānāvidhāni tūryāṇi geyāni madhurāṇi ca |
śuśruvustasya vṛkṣasya nātidūraṃ gatā narāḥ || 58 |
yo'yaṃ saṃkalpayāmāsa gandhaṃ hṛdyaṃ narastathā |
sa tadaiva tamājaghre pārijātasamudbhavam || 59 ||
tataḥ praviśya ramyāṃ tu dvārakāṃ yadunandanaḥ |
vasudevaṃ mahātmānaṃ dadṛśe devakīṃ tathā || 2.75.60 ||
kukurādhipatiṃ caiva balaṃ bhrātarameva ca |
vṛddhāśca yādavānāṃ ye mānārhānamaropamān || 61 ||
visṛjya tān vai bhagavānanādinidhano'cyutaḥ |
sampūjya ca yathānyāyaṃ svameva bhavanaṃ gataḥ || 62 ||
sa satyabhāmayā vāsaṃ viveśa madhusūdanaḥ |
pārijātaṃ taruśreṣṭhaṃ grahāya gadapūrvajaḥ || 63 ||
sā devī pūjayāmāsa prahṛṣṭā vāsavānujam|
pratijagrāha taṃ cāpi pārijātaṃ mahādrumam || 64 ||
manīṣitena sa taruralpo bhavati bhārata |
mahāṃśca vāsudevasya tadadbhutamabhūnmahat || 65 ||
kadācid dvārakāṃ sarvāṃ pracchādayati bhārata |
kadāciddhastadhāryastu bhavatyaṅguṣṭhasaṃnibhaḥ || 66 ||
nananda satyā kauravya devī prāpya manoratham |
puṇyakārthaṃ tu sambhārān sambhartumupacakrame || 67 ||
yāni dravyāṇi kauravya jambūdvīpe tu kānicit|
yogyāni tāni kṛṣṇena sambhṛtāni mahātmanā || 68 ||
muniṃ tadāsasmṛtavān sa nāradaṃ
janārdanaḥ sarvaguṇocitaṃ vaśī |
pratigrahārthaṃ vratakasya satyayā
yathopadiṣṭasya puraṃdarānujaḥ || 69||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi
pārijātānayane pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 75 ||

<2.76>

ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
atha kṛṣṇasya kauravya dhyātamātrastapodhanaḥ |
ājagāma muniśreṣṭho nārado vadatāṃ varaḥ || 1 ||
sampūjayitvā vidhivad vāsudevo viśāmpate |
pratigrahārthaṃ vidhivacchrīmān bhaktyā nyamantrayat|| 2 ||
tataḥ kāle ca samprāpte snātaṃ devo mahāmunim |
sampūjya mālyairgandhaiśca bhojayāmāsa bhārata || 3 ||
sārvakāmikamannādyaṃ sarvabhūtakṛdanvayaḥ |
satyayā priyayā sārddhaṃ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā || 4 ||
puṣpadāmāvasṛjyātha kaṇṭhe kṛṣṇasya bhāvinī |
babandha kṛṣṇaṃ subhagā pārijāte vanaspatau || 5 ||
adbhirdadau nāradāya tato'nujñāpya keśavam |
devī dhenusahasraṃ ca kāñcanasya ca parvatam || 6 ||
hiraṇyarūpyamiśraṃ ca maṇiratnaprabhasya ca |
tilamiśrasya ca tathā dhānyairanyairyutasya ca || 7 ||
pratigṛhya tu tat sarvaṃ nārado munisattamaḥ |
sa samprahṛṣṭo bhuktvātha bhūyaḥ keśavamabravīt || 8 ||
bhoḥ keśava madīyastvamadbhirdatto'si satyayā |
sa tvaṃ māmanugacchasva kuru yadyad bravīmyaham || 9 ||
prathamaḥ pakṣa ityevamabravīnmadhusūdanaḥ |
vrajantamanuvavrāja nāradaṃ ca janārdanaḥ || 2.76.10 ||
parihāsaṃ bahuvidhaṃ kṛtvā munivarastadā |
tiṣṭhasva gacchāmītyuktvā parihāsavicakṣaṇaḥ || 11 ||
apanīya tataḥ kaṇṭhāt puṣpadāmainamabravīt |
kapilāṃ gāṃ savatsāṃ bho niṣkrayārthaṃ prayaccha me || 12 ||
kṛṣṇājinaṃ tilaiḥ pūrṇaṃ prayaccha ca sakāñcanam |
eṣo'tra niṣkrayaḥ kṛṣṇa vihito vṛṣaketunā || 13 ||
tathetyuktvā hṛṣīkeśastathā cakre janādhipa |
sa uvāca muniśreṣṭhaṃ hasitvā madhusūdanaḥ || 14 ||
varaṃ varaya dharmajña yaste nārada kāṅkṣitaḥ |
tatte dātāsmi dharmajña parā prītirhi me tvayi || 15 ||
nārada uvāca
nityamevāstu me prīto bhavān viṣṇo sanātana |
tvatprasādāttu sālokyaṃ vrajeyaṃ te mahāmate || 16 ||
ayonijo bhaveyaṃ te nārāyaṇa satāṃ gate |
bhaveyaṃ brāhmaṇaścaiva punarjātyantareṣvapi || 17 ||
evamastviti taṃ devo viṣṇuḥ provāca bhārata |
tutoṣa ca tato dhīmān nārado munisattamaḥ || 18 ||
ṣoḍaśa strīsahasrāṇi viṣṇoratulatejasaḥ |
nimantritāni kauravya satyayā harikrāntayā || 19 ||
tāsāṃ dadau saṃniyogamekaikaṃ harivallabhā |
śacyā yo vāsudevasya purā datto narādhipa || 2.76.20 ||
pārijāto vasaṃstatra tataḥ pravavṛte tadā |
ājñayā vāsudevasya nāradena mahātmanā || 21 ||
nimantritā gaṇāḥ sarve keśavena mahātmanā |
vibhūtiṃ pārijātasya dadṛśuḥ kurunandana || 22 ||
pāṇḍavāṃścānayāmāsa sahaiva pṛthayā hariḥ |
draupadyā ca mahātejāstathaiva ca subhadrayā || 23 ||
śrutaśravāṃ ca sasutāṃ bhīṣmakaṃ sasutaṃ tadā |
anyānapi ca kauravya mitrasambandhibāndhavān || 24 ||
reme ca saha pārthena phālgunena janārdanaḥ |
sāntaḥpuro mahātejāḥ paramarddhyāvasannṛpa || 25 ||
saṃvatsare tato yāte keśihāmarasattamaḥ |
pārijātaṃ punaḥ svargamānayat sarvabhāvanaḥ || 26 ||
tatrāditiṃ kaśyapaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā svajananīṃ prabhuḥ |
śakreṇa sahito dhīmānaprameyaparākramaḥ || 27 ||
tamuvācāditirmātā praṇataṃ madhusūdanam |
saubhrātramastu vāmevaṃ nityaṃ cāmarasattama || 28 ||
manorathaṃ mama tvaṃ ca pūrayasva janārdana |
tathetyevābravītkṛṣṇastato mātaramātmavān || 29 ||
āmantrayitvā pitarau devarājānamabravīt|
vāsudevo mahātejāḥ kālaprāptamidaṃ vacaḥ || 2.76.30 ||
mahādevena deveśa saṃdiṣṭo'smi mahātmanā |
bhantarbhūmitale'vadhyānasurān prati mānada || 31 ||
tadito daśarātreṇa hantāhamasurottamān |
tatropaviṣṭān sthātavyaṃ pravareṇa mahātmanā || 32 ||
jayantena ca vīreṇa dānavānāṃ jighāṃsayā |
eko'tra mānuṣo devo devaputrastathā paraḥ || 33 ||
avadhyāḥ kila te devairbrahmaṇo varadarpitāḥ |
asmābhiḥ kila hantavyā mānuṣatvamupāgataiḥ || 34 ||
tatheti kṛṣṇaṃ sa hariḥ prītarūpastathāvravīt|
sasvajāte tato devāvanyonyaṃ janamejaya || 35 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi pārijātaharaṇe svarge pārijātasthāpane ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 76 ||

<2.77>

saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
puṇyakānāṃ mamotpattiṃ kathayasva dvijottama |
dvaipāyanaprasādena sarvaṃ hi viditaṃ tava || 1 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
umayā puṇyakavidhirnarendrotpāditaḥ purā |
śṛṇu yena vidhānena loke dharmabhṛtāṃ vara || 2 ||
svargānnīte pārijāte kṛṣṇenākliṣṭakarmaṇā |
yayau dvāravatīṃ dhīmān nārado munisattamaḥ || 3 ||
devāsure nṛpaśreṣṭha saṃgrāme samupasthite |
ṣaṭ purasya vadhe ghore mahādevājñayānagha || 4 ||
kṛṣṇena sahitaṃ vipraṃ nāradaṃ dharmavittamam |
āsīnaṃ paripapraccha rukmiṇī bhaiṣmikī nṛpa || 5 ||
tatra jāmbavatī devī satyabhāmā ca bhāminī |
gāndhārarājaputrī ca yogayuktā narādhipa || 6 ||
devyaśca nṛpa kṛṣṇasya bahvyo'nyā vai samāgatāḥ |
kulaśīlaguṇopetā dharmaśīlāḥ pativratāḥ || 7 ||
rukmiṇyuvāca
mune dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha dharmajñānabhṛtāṃ vara |
utpattiṃ puṇyakānāṃ tvaṃ vaktumarhasyaśeṣataḥ || 8 ||
vidhiṃ ca phalayogaṃ ca dānakālaṃ tathaiva ca |
kautūhalaṃ nastatsiddhiṃ vadasva vadatāṃ vara || 9 ||
nārada uvāca
śṛṇu vaidarbhi dharmajñe sapatnībhiḥ sahānaghe |
puṇyakānāṃ vidhiḥ prokto yathā devi puromayā || 2.77.10 ||
cacāromā vrataṃ devī puṇyakānāṃ śucivratā |
vratāvasāne'tha tayā sakhyo devi nimantritāḥ || 11 ||
adityādyāḥ sutāḥ sarvā dakṣasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ |
paulomī ca śacī devī khyātā loke pativratā || 12 ||
rohiṇī ca mahābhāgā somasya dayitā satī |
phālgunī ca tathā pūrvā revatī ca viśāmpate || 13 ||
tathā śatabhiṣā caiva maghā ca kurunandana |
etābhirhi mahādevī pūrvamārādhitā satī || 14 ||
gaṅgā sarasvatī caiva veṇī godā ca nimnagā |
tathā vaitaraṇī caiva gaṇḍakī yā ca bhārata || 15 ||
anyāśca sarito ramyā lopāmudrā ca bhārata |
satyaścānyā jagaddevyo dhārayanti hi tā śubhāḥ|| 16 ||
śubhāśca girinandinyo vahnikanyāśca suvratāḥ |
svāhā vahnipriyā devī sāvitrī ca yaśasvinī || 17 ||
ṛddhiḥ kuberakāntā ca jaleśamahiṣī tathā |
bhāryā pitṛpateścaiva vasupatnyastathā ca yāḥ || 18 ||
hrīḥ śrīrdhṛtistathā kīrtirāśā medhā ca suvratāḥ |
prītirmatiśca khyātiśca sannītiśca tapodhanāḥ || 19 ||
devyaḥ satyastathaivānyāḥ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ |
tāsāṃ vratāvasāne ca pūjāṃ cakre'mbikā tadā || 2.77.20 ||
tilaratnamayaṃ dattvā parvataṃ sarvadhānyavat |
vāsobhirbhūṣaṇairmukhyairnānārāgaiḥ sumadhyame || 21 ||
pratigahya tu tāṃ pūjāṃ dattāṃ devyā tapodhanāḥ |
upaviṣṭāḥ kathāścitrāḥ kurvantyo bhartṛdevatāḥ || 22 ||
puṇyakārthaṃ kathāstāsāmāsan devī śaśaṃsa yāḥ|
vidhiṃ ca puṇyakasyātha satīnāṃ bhartṛdevate || 23 ||
tāsāṃ matena sādhvīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ somanandinī |
paryapṛcchadumā devī puṇyakānāṃ vidhiṃ varā || 24 ||
umā tāsāṃ priyārthaṃ tu puṇyakānyabravīt tadā |
samakṣaṃ mama vaidarbhi sarvabhūtahite ratā || 25 ||
mamaiva comayā dattaḥ sa tadā ratnaparvataḥ |
pratigṛhya mayā caiva kṛto brāhmaṇasācchubhe || 26 ||
umā tvarundhatīṃ sādhvīmāmantrya yadabhāṣata |
śṛṇu kalyāṇi vakṣyāmi sarvābhiḥ sahitā śubhe || 27||
puṇyakānāṃ vidhiṃ kṛtsnaṃ yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ |
yathā caiva mayā dṛṣṭastata eṣa vidhiḥ śubhe || 28 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi puṇyakavidhikathane saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 77 ||

<2.78>

aṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
umovāca
sarvajñāhaṃ yadā bhartuḥ prasādena śucismite |
tadā purā mamādiṣṭo dṛṣṭaḥ puṇyavidhiḥ śubhaḥ || 1 ||
sanātanaḥ puṇyavidhiriti buddhyāvagamyatām |
mahādevaprasādena mayā dṛṣṭastvarundhati || 2 ||
puṇyakāni ca sarvāṇi cīrṇavatyasmyanindite |
anujñayā bhagavato bhartuḥ śarvasya dhīmataḥ || 3 ||
satītvaṃ dharmacaraṇaṃ yasyā nityamakhaṇḍitam |
puṇyakānāṃ vidhistasyāḥ purāṇaiḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 4 ||
dānopavāsapuṇyāni sukṛtānyapyarundhati |
niṣphalānyasatīnāṃ hi puṇyakāni tathā śubhe || 5 ||
yā vañcayanti bhartāraṃ yoniduṣṭāśca yāḥ striyaḥ |
yonidoṣātpuṇyaphalaṃ nāśnanti nirayaṅgamāḥ || 6 ||
sādhvyo jagad dhārayanti suśīlāḥ patidevatāḥ |
ananyā dharmanityāśca satīpanthānamāśritāḥ || 7 ||
avāgduṣṭā śaucayuktā dhṛtimatyaḥ śubhavratāḥ |
satataṃ sādhuvādinyo dhārayanti jagat khalu || 8 ||
vyādhitaḥ patito vāpi dīno vāpi kathañcana |
akāryakāriṇaṃ vāpi patitaṃ vāpi nirguṇam|
strī patiṃ tārayatyeva tathā''tmānaṃ śubhānane || 2.78.10 ||
yoniduṣṭastriyo nāsti prāyaścittaṃ hataiva sā |
vāgduṣṭe vihitaṃ sadbhiḥ prāyaścittaṃ purātane || 11 ||
bhartuśchandena kartavyaṃ vratakaṃ sarvadā striyā |
upavāso'pi vā satye kāṅkṣantyā sukṛtāṃ gatim|| 12||
kalpāntarasahasreṣu na strī sā labhate gatim |
tiryagyonisahasreṣu pacyate yoniviplavāt || 13 ||
yadi sā nāma mānuṣyaṃ strī labhedasatī satī |
caṇḍālayonau durmedhā jāyate kukkurāśanā || 14 ||
bhartā devaḥ sadā strīṇāṃ sadbhirdṛṣṭastapodhane |
yasyā hi tuṣyate bhartā sā satī dharmacāriṇī || 15 ||
kautūhalahatānāṃ tu strīṇāṃ loko na śobhanaḥ |
bhartaryeva mano yāsāṃ sadbhāvena vyavasthitam || 16 ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā patiṃ nāticaranti yāḥ |
tāsāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ saumye puṇyakaiḥ samudāhṛtam|| 17 ||
puṇyakānāṃ vidhiṃ kṛtsnaṃ svarlokapratiśobhane |
nibodha saha sarvābhirdṛṣṭo yastapasā mayā || 18 ||
snātvā strī prātarutthāya patiṃ vijñāpayet satī | |
upavāsārthamatha vā vratakārthaṃ dhṛtavrate || 19 ||
śvaśurābhyāṃ ca caraṇau satataṃ sattamasya ca |
grahāyaudumbaraṃ pātraṃ sakuśaṃ sākṣataṃ tathā || 2.78.20 ||
gośṛṅgaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ sicya pratigṛhṇīta tajjalam |
tato bhartuḥ satī dadyāt snātasya prayatasya ca || 21 ||
ātmano'pi niṣektavyaṃ tataḥ śirasi tajjalam |
trailokyasarvatīrtheṣu snānametadudāhṛtam || 22 ||
upavāseṣu kartavyametaddhi vratakeṣu ca |
snānametaddhi sāmānyaṃ strīṇāṃ puṃsāṃ ca bhāmini || 23 ||
arundhati mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tapasā haratejasā |
aśalyaviddhaṃ śayanamāsanaṃ ca tathāvidham || 24 ||
svayaṃ prakṣālanaṃ cāpi pādayoranuśabditam |
aśruprapāto roṣaśca kalahaśca kṛtaḥ sati |
upavāsād vratād vāpi sadyo bhraṃśayati striyaḥ ||25||
śuklameva sadā vāsaḥ praśastaṃ candrasambhave |
antarvāso'paraṃ caiva upavāse vrate tathā || 26 ||
pādukārthaṃ tṛṇaiḥ kāryaṃ sarvadā vratake sati |
upavāse'pi ca vidhireṣa eva pravartitaḥ || 27 ||
añjanaṃ rocanaṃ cāpi gandhān sumanasastathā |
vratake copavāse ca nityameva vivarjayet || 28 ||
dantakāṣṭhaṃ śiraḥsnānamudvartanamathāpi vā |
vivarjitaṃ mṛdā sarvaṃ śaucārthaṃ tu vidhīyate || 29 ||
bilvāmṛtaphalairnityaṃ śrīphalaiśca samācaret |
prakṣālanaṃ vai śirasaḥ sadāmṛnmiśritairjalaiḥ || 2.78.30 ||
śiraso'bhyañjanaṃ saumye naiva tāvat praśasyate |
na pādayorna gātrasya sneheneti sthitiḥ smṛtā || 31 ||
goyānamuṣṭrayānaṃ ca kharayānaṃ ca varjitam |
nagnasnānaṃ ca satataṃ vrate cāpyupavāsake || 32 ||
nadījalaṃ prasravajaṃ praśastaṃ somanandini |
śubhe taḍāge vāpyādau vistīrṇe jalajāyute || 33 ||
gatvā snānaṃ praśastaṃ tu sadaiva khalu sarvathā |
alābhe tvavaruddhā strī ghaṭasnānaṃ samācaret || 34 ||
navaiśca kumbhaiḥ snātavyaṃ vidhireṣa purātanaḥ |
snānaṃ ca kāryaṃ śirasā tapaḥphalamavāpnuyāt || 35||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi pārijātaharaṇe puṇyakavidhau aṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 78 ||

<2.79>

ekonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
umovāca
vidhinaitena kṛtsnena strī sadā bhartṛdevatā |
caret saṃvatsaraṃ dāntā ṣaṇmāsān māsameva ca ||1||
striyo hyāvāhayet sādhvīrekādaśa samādhinā |
svayaṃ caiva vidhirdṛṣṭo vratakānāṃ mayā śubhaḥ || 2 ||
adbhirdadyāt satīḥ sarvā yā mūlavratinī bhavet |
tāsāṃ tu niṣkrayo deyaḥ kāladeśānurūpataḥ || 3 ||
tato māsāntaśuklasya tithau ca navamī tathā |
ārādhayitvā kartavyaṃ vratakasyāpavarjanam || 4 ||
upavāsamahorātraṃ vratakaṃ cāpi niścitam |
ādau cānte ca kurvīta vratakasyāpi siddhaye || |5 ||
kṣurakarma tato bharturātmanaścaiva kārayet |
utsādanaṃ ca snānaṃ ca tasminnahani saṃsmṛtam || 6 ||
tato vivāhavatsnānaṃ vihitaṃ puṇyake śubhe |
maṇḍanaṃ caiva vihitaṃ mālyadhāraṇameva ca || 7 ||
kumbhaistu snāpyamānemaṃ sādhvī mantramudīrayet|
bhartuḥ pādau namaskṛtya manasā vātha vā girā || 8 ||
āpo devya ṛṣīṇāṃ hi viśvadhātryo divyā madantyo yāḥ śaṅkarā dharmadhātryaḥ|
hiraṇyavarṇāḥ pāvakāḥ śivatamena rasena śreyaso māṃ juṣantu || 9 ||
apāmeva smṛto mantraḥ sarvatrānyatra me śṛṇu |
mantrāḥ purāṇavihitāḥ strīṇāṃ sarvāṅgaśobhane || 2.79.10 ||
śubhāvyayā guṇinī yuktadharmā bhartrā sākaṃ mama dāsyā vareṇa |

sapatnīnāmadhi nityaṃ bhaveyaṃ saputrā syāṃ subhagā cārurūpā |

bhūmirvāyurjalamākāśamagnirantaḥ kṣetrajñaḥ prakṛtiryo mahāṃśca |
ahaṃkāraśca mama sākṣye niyuktāḥ smareyurme niścayaṃ ca vrataṃ ca || 15 ||
yairārabdho dehināṃ bhautiko'yaṃ vidhiḥ sattvādyairbhūtayuktaiḥ sabījaiḥ |
bhavantyete me sākṣiṇaḥ sarvasaṃsthā vrate cāsmin niścaye cāpi nityam || 16 ||
candrādityau puṇyasākṣī yamaśca diśaḥ sarvā daśa cātmā ca me'yam|
santvete vai sākṣiṇaḥ sarvasaṃsthā vrate cāsminniścaye cāpi nityam || 17 ||
mantrairetaiḥ purāṇoktaiḥ sarvadravyābhimantraṇam |
vratacaryāt prabhṛti vai purāṇe samudāhṛtam || 18 ||
snātvātha vāsasī dadyādbhartuḥ kartya svayaṃ śubhe |
athātmakartitaṃ na syācchubhe vighnena kenacit || 19 ||
vāso'nyadeva dadyācca śvetaṃ mukhyaṃ navaṃ śuci |
svakartitaṃ ca sūtraṃ tu vāsasā tena miśrayet || 2.79.20 ||
tato dvijaṃ śuciṃ dāntaṃ jñānavijñānakovidam |

sarvathānyasamunmiśrastilaiśca saviśeṣataḥ || 23 ||

lavaṇapratimāṃ dadyānnavanītasya cāparām |
guḍasya madhunaścaiva suvarṇasya ca śobhanām || 25 ||
