tathā sumanasāṃ dadyād raupyasyaudumbarasya ca || 26 ||
phalānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ vāsasāmapi nandini |
citrapratikṛtiṃ caiva kāṣṭhasya pratimāṃ tathā || 27 ||
śilāṃ pratikṛtiṃ caiva dadhno'tha payasastathā |
sarpiṣā dūrvayā caiva yā cānyāmapyabhīpsati || 28 ||
kāladeśānurūpaṃ ca deyaṃ vibhavataḥ sati |
alpaṃ vā bahulaṃ vāpi bhartuśchandena sarvadā || 29 ||
tilapātraṃ pradātavyaṃ na deyaṃ nanu śobhane |
gaustvavaśyaṃ pradātavyā kapilā kāṃsyameva ca || 2.79.30 ||
kṛṣṇājinaṃ ca subhage satilaṃ vāsasānvitam |
ādarśaścaiva kūrcaśca tathājinamanindite || 31 ||
etad dattvā sarvakāmānāpnoti varavarṇini |
puro'dhikā putravatī subhagā rūpabhāginī || 32 ||
mṛṣṭahastā dhanāḍhyā ca strī bhavatyamalekṣaṇā |
icchayā labhate caiva kanyā rūpaguṇānvitāḥ || 33 ||
bhavanti subhagāścaryāstathaiva ca puro'dhikāḥ |
putravatyo dhanāḍhyāśca śīlavatyaśca nityadā || 34 ||
arundhati kṛtaṃ hyetanmayaiva prathamaṃ yataḥ |
umāvratakamityeva khyātamatra mahītale || 35 ||
etadevottamaṃ strīṇāṃ vrataṃ tasmān samācaret |
sarvakāmānavāpnoti dattvaivaitadanindite || 36 ||
etadvratakaro hyeva devadevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ |
purābhiṣiktavān saumye priyārthaṃ mama sarvakṛt || 37 ||
vratakasyāvasāne'tha deyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca nityadā |
strīṇāṃ kāmāḥ pradeyāśca sadṛśāḥ kāladeśayoḥ || 38 ||
ekaikasya pradātavyaṃ vratakaṃ varavarṇini |
chandato brāhmaṇānāṃ tu deyamannaṃ sadakṣiṇam || 39 ||
pāyasaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ vratake nānyadiṣyate |
nātra prāṇivadhaḥ kāryaḥ purāṇe niyatā śrutiḥ || 2.79.40 ||
atha dvitīyaṃ vakṣyāmi vrataṃ somasamudbhave |
mahādevaprasādena dṛṣṭavatyasmi yacchubhe || 41 ||
sarvāḥ putraphalā nāryaḥ sadbhiretadudāhṛtam |
tasmādanviṣyatī dadyāt saputrakarakāñchubhe || 42 ||
jyeṣṭhāṣāḍhau śubhau māsau puroktaṃ vidhimācaret |
athavā jyeṣṭhamevaikamāṣāḍhaṃ vā samācaret || 43 ||
tato māsadvaye pūrṇe māse vā varavarṇini |
saputrakarakān dadyāt phāṇitapratipūritān || 44 ||
sarpiṣaḥ payasaścaiva dadhno'tha madhuno'naghe |
jalasya ca tathā dadyāt pūrayitvā śaśiprabhe || 45 ||
ekasmai jñānavṛddhāya suvratāya jitātmane |
saputrakarakān dadyād yāvanto manasaḥ priyāḥ || 46 ||
iccheta strī duhitaraṃ strīṇāṃ kāmakaraṃ tataḥ |
kiṃciddravyaṃ sutākāmāt sutāṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ|| 47||
gaurvātha kāñcanaṃ vāpi dakṣiṇārthaṃ praśasyate |
viprasyācchādanaṃ deyamavaśyaṃ tu śucismite || 48 ||
yajñopavītaṃ vratake dadyānnārī śucivratā |
saputrakarakāṇāṃ tu vidhirukto vipaścitā || 49 ||
apatyākhyānayogena brāhmaṇebhyaḥ śucivratā |
saṃvatsaraṃ susampūrṇaṃ vratadharmānupālinī || 2.79.50 ||
karakānapi dadyācca pūrṇe saṃvatsare śubhe |
anujñayā sadā bhartuḥ satyavādinyarundhati || 51 ||
suvarṇasūtraṃ viprāya kaumudyāṃ dātumarhati |
yajñopavītaṃ viprasya vrataṃ saṃsthāpya kāmikam || 52 ||
yajñopavītaṃ karakaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ ca svaśaktitaḥ |
prayacchatī satī strībhyaḥ sarvānkāmānsamaśnute||53||
navaṃ na bhakṣayet kiṃcinnārī dhānyamatho phalam |
puṣpāṇi nopayuñjīta yāvadevaṃ samācaret || 54 ||
ekabhaktena dharmajñe puṇyakaṃ kartumarhati |
brāhmaṇāya tathā deyaṃ bhartuśca tadanantaram || 55 ||
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā subhagā rūpaśālinī |
bhavatyavidhavā caiva strī dhanasya tatheśvarī || 56 ||
vārtākāni na khāded yā strī pūrṇaṃ parivatsaram |
na sā putravināśaṃ hi paśyatītyavagamyatām || 57 ||
śaśakaṃ mṛgamāṃsaṃ vā nityameva vivarjayet |
nāpnoti maraṇaṃ nārī prāpnoti patidevatām || 58 ||
alābuṃ varjayennārī tathaivotpādikāmapi |
kalambīṃ kāñcanaṃ nādyādyā bhartuḥ sukhamicchati|| 59 ||
pūrṇe saṃvatsare dadyādekaikaṃ śākamādṛtā |
sadakṣiṇaṃ putravatī bhavatyekā puro'dhikā || 2.79.60 ||
ayaṃ prakṣālayānā strī svapādāvevamāditaḥ |
pratiṣṭhāṃ labhate nityamudvegaṃ nādhigacchati || 61 ||
divā yā sūryapūtena vartayet strī pativratā |
ekaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ rātrāvannaṃ vivarjayet || 62 ||
sā jīvaputrā subhagā bhavatyamaravarṇini |
adhitiṣṭhati sarvāśca sapatnyo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 63 ||
pūrṇe saṃvatsare dadyāt sauvarṇaṃ sūryamuttamam |
brāhmaṇāyābhirūpāya daridrāya yaśasvine || 64 ||
phalāni vātha puṣpāṇi bhakṣyāṇyapi ca suvratā |
dadyādanastamitake caritavratakā tathā || 65 ||
yā tathāstamite sūrye bhuṅkte strī niyatā satī |
candranakṣatrapūtāni bhojyāni varavarṇini || 66 ||
sā dadyāt kāñcanaṃ candraṃ nakṣatrāṇi grahānapi |
abhirūpāya viprāya vāsaśca lavaṇānvitam || 67 ||
candraśītalagātrī sā bhavatyamaravarṇinī |
subhagā darśanīyā ca putravatyapi bhāvinī || 68 ||
paurṇamāsyāṃ tu satataṃ prāpte somodaye'ṅganā |
arghyaṃ dadyāt sumanasāṃ sākṣataṃ sakuśaṃ tathā || 69 ||
yāvakaṃ ca baliṃ dadyād dadhnā ca saha saṃyutam |
evaṃ yā kurute nityaṃ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 2.79.70 ||
adṛṣṭvā yā tu nāśnāti sūryaṃ nārī pativratā|
durdine vāthavā vyabhre seṣṭān kāmānavāpnuyāt|| 71||
kāñcanaṃ śaktito dadyātsā viprāya manasvinī |
subhagā darśanīyā ca bhavatyamaravarṇinī || 72 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi pārijātaharaṇe vratakathane ekonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 79 ||

<2.80>

bhagavatyuvāca
nirveṣṭavyaṃ śarīraṃ yairvratakaiḥ puṇyakairapi |
arundhati pravakṣyāmi sahaitābhirvareṇa tu || 1 ||
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīṃ yā kṣipati syādvā mūlaphalāśinī |
brāhmaṇāyaikamaśanaṃ svaṃ dattvā bhartṛdevatā || 2 ||
śuklavastrā śubhācārā gurudaivatapūjakā |
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā tato dadyād dvijātaye || 3 ||
govālarajjusukṛtaṃ cāmaraṃ ca dhvajaṃ tathā |
dakṣiṇāpūrṇamiṣṭānnaṃ śaktyā vāpi śucivrate || 4 ||
ūrmimantaḥ svarālāgrāḥ śroṇideśāvalambinaḥ |
tasyā bhavanti keśāstu bhaktimatyā hi bhartari || 5
śiro nirveṣṭukāmā tu gomayena śiraḥ śatī|
prakṣālayenmalaṃ dhātryā bilvena śrīphalena ca || 6 ||
gomūtraṃ ca sadā prāśyecchiraḥsnānaṃ ca miśrayet|
kṛṣṇāṃ caturdaśīṃ tvetat kartavyaṃ varavarṇini || 7 ||
bhavatyavidhavā caiva subhagā vijvarā tathā |
śirorogairnaiva cāsyāḥ śarīramabhitapyate||8||
darśanīyaṃ lalāṭaṃ yā kāṅkṣati strī śucismite |
tithiṃ pratipadaṃ nityaṃ sā kṣipedekabhojanā || 9 ||
payasā ca tathāśnīyād yāvatsaṃvatsaro gataḥ |
brāhmaṇāya tato dadyāt paṭaṃ rūpyamayaṃ śubham || 2.80.10 ||
lalāṭaṃ rūpasampannamāpnoti strī sumadhyamā |
satataṃ strī dvitīyāyāṃ bhruvoricchetsurūpatām|| 11||
anantaropavāsena śākabhaktāśanā satī |
tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe brāhmaṇaṃ svasti vācayet || 12
phalaiḥ pariṇataiḥ saumyairmāṣāṇāṃ dakṣiṇānvitaiḥ |
lavaṇena ca bhadraṃ te ghṛtapātreṇa cānaghe||13||
ātmanaḥ śobhanau karṇāvicchatī strī sumadhyamā |
nakṣatre śravaṇe prāpte dhruvaṃ bhuñjīta yāvakam || 14||
tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe karṇau dadyāddhiraṇmayau |
ghṛte prakṣipya viprāya payasā sahite śubhe || 15 ||
nāsāmicchellāṭāntāmavyaṅgāṃ vyādhivarjitām|
tilagulmaṃ sadā siñced yāvat puṣpyeddhi rakṣita||16|
anantaropavāsena sektavyaḥ salilaiḥ sadā
tasmādavāpya puṣpāṇi ghṛte prakṣipya dāpayet ||17||
svakṣī bhaveyamiti yā strī kāṅkṣatyamṛtodbhave |
anantaraṃ vai bhuñjānā payasātha ghṛtena vā || 18 ||
tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe padmapatrāṇi maṇḍitā |
tathaivotpalapatrāṇi nyaset kṣīre śucismite || 19 ||
plavamānāni viprāya tato dadyātsatī sati |
kṛṣṇasārasamānākṣī tad dattvā bhavati sma vai || 2.80.20 ||
icchedoṣṭhau cārurūpau yā strī dharmaguṇānvitā |
sā mṛnmayena tu pibedudakaṃ vatsaraṃ satī || 21 ||
ayācitena bhuñjīta navamyāṃ dharmabhāginī |
tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe vidrumaṃ dātumarhati || 22 ||
tena bimbaphalābhauṣṭhī strī bhavatyeva śobhane |
subhagātha vapuḥputradhanāḍhyā gomatī tathā || 23 ||
yā cārurūpāniccheta dantānamaravarṇini |
śuklāṣṭamīṃ na sāśnīyād bhaktadvayamaninditā || 24 ||
tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe dadyād raupyamayān satī |
dantān prākṣipya dharmajñe payasyatiguṇodite || 25 ||
tena sā jātipuṣpābhāndantānprāpnoti sā satī |
saubhāgyamapi cāpnoti saputratvaṃ tathānaghe || 26 ||
sarvameva mukhaṃ kāntamicched yā rucirānane |
sā pūrṇamāsyāṃ snātvā tu prāpya candrodaye śubhe ||27||
yāvakaṃ payasā siddhaṃ dattvā viprāya bhāminī |
tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe candraṃ rūpyamayaṃ śubham || 28 ||
padme phulle tu vinyasya brāhmaṇān svasti vācayet|
pūrṇacandramukhī tena dānena strī śubhā bhavet || 29||
stanāvicchati yā nārī tṛṇarājaphalopamau |
ayācitaṃ daśamyāṃ sā nityamaśnīta vāgyatā || 2.80.30 ||
saṃvatsare tataḥ pūrṇe dve bilve kāñcane śubhe |
sadakṣiṇe brāhmaṇāya prayacchati dhṛtātmane || 31 ||
saubhāgyaṃ paramāpnoti bahuputrāṃstathaiva ca |
sadonnatau stanau sā strī bibhartyamaravarṇini || 32 ||
śātodaratvamicchantī kṣipedekāntabhojinī |
pañcamyāṃ tatra bhoktavyamannaṃ toyena nityadā || 33 ||
tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe dadyājjātilatāṃ śubhe |
phullāṃ sadakṣiṇāṃ dhanye brāhmaṇāya dhṛtātmane || 34 ||
hastāvicchati yā nārī rūpayuktau sumadhyame |
dvādaśīṃ sā kṣipatvevaṃ śākaiḥ sarvairaninditaiḥ || 35 ||
saṃvatsare tataḥ prāpte raukme padme dadātu sā |
brāhmaṇāyābhirūpāya tathā padmadvayaṃ śubham || 36 ||
śroṇīṃ viśālāmanvicchet strī kṣipatveva suvrate |
trayodaśīmekabhaktamaśnātvevamayācitam || 37 ||
tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe lavaṇaṃ samprayacchatu |
prajāpatimukhākāraṃ kṛtvā tatra varānane || 38 ||
kāñcanaṃ caiva dātavyaṃ tadākārasya sarvadā |
añjanena ca dharmajñā śanakairavacūrṇayet || 39 ||
ratnāni caiva pūrṇāni vāso raktaṃ ca dāpayet|
tena śroṇīmabhimatāṃ strī saumye pratipadyate || 2.80.40 ||
madhurāṃ vācamicchantī varjayellavaṇaṃ satī |
saṃvatsaraṃ vā māsaṃ vā prayacchellavaṇaṃ tataḥ || 41 ||
sadakṣiṇaṃ brāhmaṇāya paraṃ mādhuryamicchatī |
śukavākyācchataguṇaṃ bhavatyamaravarṇini || 42 ||
gūḍhagulphaśirau pādāvicchantyā somanandini |
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhayāṃ varārohe bhoktavyaṃ salilaudanam || 43 ||
agnirvā brāhmaṇo vāpi na spraṣṭavyaḥ padā sadā |
yadā padā spṛśet taṃ ca vandeta tapasānvite || 44 ||
pādena na ca vai pādaṃ prakṣālayitumarhati|
etairnityavratairyuktā dharmajñā patidevatā || 45 ||
kūrmau rūpyamayau dadyād brāhmaṇāya pativrate |
tau varāya brāhmaṇāya sthāpayitvā ghṛte'naghe || 46||
padme cādhomukhe kṛtvā dadyād viprāya nandini |
raktairdravyairmiśrayitvā kāñcanenābhyalaṃkṛte || 47 ||
sarvameva tu yā gātramicchatyatimanoharam |
trirātraṃ puṣpakāle sā karotu patidevatā || 48 ||
kaumudyāmathavāṣāḍhyāṃ māghyāṃ cāśvayuje tathā|
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ caiva manyate'tithidaivatam || 49 ||
ghṛtaṃ ca nityaṃ viprebhyo dadātu lavaṇaṃ tathā |
sammārjanaṃ gṛhe caiva karotu patidevatā || 2.80.50 ||
upalepanaṃ ca dharmajñe balikarma ca mānini |
vāgduṣṭā caiva mā śubhre bhaktvātmārthapaṇḍitā || 51 ||
paryaśnātu ca sā kañcidapi śākaṃ yaśasvini |
baliṃ sṛjatvatathyaṃ ca parityajatu bhāmini || 52 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi pārijātaharaṇe vratakavidhāne'śītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 80 ||

<2.81>

ekāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
umovāca
bāndhavān saguṇānicchedekabhaktena nityadā |
saptamīṃ saptamīṃ nityaṃ kṣapet strī patidevatā || 1 ||
tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe vṛkṣaṃ dadyāddhiraṇmayam |
sadakṣiṇaṃ brāhmaṇāya śubhabandhumatī bhavet || 2 ||
karañje dīpakaṃ dadyāt sadā yā pramadā vare |
pūrṇe saṃvatsare dadyāt sauvarṇaṃ dīpakaṃ tataḥ || 3 ||
rucyā sā strī bhaved bharturiṣṭā putravatī tathā |
sapatnīnāmadhi tathā dīpavajjvalate śubhe || 4 ||
yā śeṣabhojinī nityaṃ naiva ca syādaruntudā |
na ca syādvyaśanā saumye nityaṃ ca patidevatā || 5 ||
śaucānvitā ca satataṃ na ca rūkṣābhibhāṣiṇī |
śvaśrūśvaśurayorniṃtyaṃ śuśrūṣābhiratā satī || 6 ||
kiṃ tasyā vratakaiḥ kāryaṃ kiṃ vā syādupavāsakaiḥ |
yā bhartṛdevatā nityaṃ satyadharmaguṇānvitā || 7 ||
vidhavā strī tu yā hi syāddaivayogātsatī sati |
tasyā vakṣyāmi yo dharmaḥ purāṇoktaḥ sumadhyame || 8 ||
patiṃ saṃkalpayitvā sā citrasthaṃ vātha mṛnmayam |
tasya pūjāṃ sadā kuryāt satāṃ dharmamanusmaret || 9 ||
tata evābhyanujñāṃ sā nityaṃ yāceta suvratā |
vratake copavāse ca bhojane ca viśeṣataḥ ||2.81.10 ||
bhartṛlokān vrajatyeva na ced vyuccarate patim |
śāṇḍilī sūryavad bhāti satataṃ patidevatā || 11 ||
adyaprabhṛti sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ caiva yoṣitaḥ |
drakṣyanti puṇyakavidhiṃ paurāṇo yaḥ sanātanaḥ || 12 ||
muniśca nāradaḥ kṛtsnaṃ paurāṇaṃ jñāsyate vidhim |
upavāsasya dharmātmā vratakānāṃ tathaiva ca || 13 ||
aditistapasendrāṇī tvaṃ ca somasute vare |
pravartane puṇyakānāṃ vratakānāṃ ca sarvadā || 14 ||
kīrtanīyāḥ satīnāṃ hi bhaviṣyatha guṇānvitāḥ |
upavāsavratavidhiṃ yathāvadiha kṛtsnaśaḥ || 15 ||
prādurbhāveṣu sarveṣu bhāryā viṣṇormahātmanaḥ |
jñāsyanti puṇyakavidhiṃ nityameva sanātanam || 16 ||
saviśeṣaṃ ca dharmāṇāṃ strīdharmeṣu praśasyate |
patibhaktiraduṣṭatvamavāgduṣṭatvameva ca || 17 ||
nārada uvāca
evamuktāstu tāḥ sādhvyo mahādevyā tapodhanāḥ |
jagmurhṛṣṭā mahādevīṃ praṇipatya harapriyām || 18 ||
aditirvratakaṃ cakre śṛṇu yad dharmacāriṇī |
umāvratavidhiḥ sarvaḥ pūrvoddiṣṭastayā kṛtaḥ || 19 ||
pārijāte nibadhyātha mama dattastu kaśyapaḥ |
aditivratakaṃ nāma tad dattaṃ satyabhāmayā || 2.81.20 ||
tadeva vratakaṃ dattaṃ sāvitryā dharmanityayā |
taireva yuktaiḥ saṃyuktamidaṃ tvabhyadhikaṃ kṛtam || 21 ||
saṃdhyākāle tu samprāpte sthāne sthāne tathaiva ca |
pūjanaṃ vā namaskāro japaśca dviguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || 22 ||
sāvitrīvratakaṃ kṛtvā tathādityā vrataṃ satī |
bhartuḥ kulaṃ pitṛkulamātmānaṃ caiva tārayet || 23 ||
indrāṇī vratakaṃ cakre tadevaumaṃ yathāvidhi |
raktamabhyadhikaṃ vāso bhojanaṃ caiva sāmiṣam || 24 ||
caturthe divase vāpi puṇyakārthaṃ vidhiḥ punaḥ |
ahorātropavāsaśca deyaṃ kumbhaśataṃ tathā || 25 ||
gaṅgayā vratakaṃ dattaṃ tadevaumaṃ yaśaskari |
snānamabhyadhikaṃ tvatra pratyūṣasyātmano jale || 26 ||
anyasmin vā jale māghaśuklapakṣe haripriye |
etad gaṅgāvrataṃ nāma sarvakāmapradaṃ smṛtam || 27 ||
sapta sapta ca saptātha kulāni harivallabhe |
strī tārayati dharmajñā gaṅgāvratakacāriṇī || 28 ||
deyaṃ kumbhasahasraṃ tu gaṅgāyā vratake śubhe |
tāraṇaṃ pāraṇaṃ caiva tad vrataṃ sārvakāmikam || 29 ||
yamabhāryā cakārātha vrataṃ yāmarathaṃ śubham |
hemante tat tu kartavyamākāśe harivallabhe || 2.81.30 ||
imāni caiva vākyāni brūyādākāśamāsthitā |
snātvā śucisamācārā namaskṛtya patiṃ śubhe || 31 ||
carāmyahaṃ yāmarathaṃ himaṃ pṛṣṭhena dhāraye |
pativratā jīvaputrā bhaveyaṃ ca puro'dhikā || 32 ||
sapatnīradhitiṣṭheyaṃ paśyeyaṃ caiva mā yamam |
sabhartṛputrā jīveyaṃ ciraṃ ca sukhameva ca || 33 ||
patilokaṃ ca gaccheyaṃ bhaveyaṃ nandinī tathā |
sucailā mṛṣṭahastā ca svajaneṣṭā guṇānvitā || 34 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā tato vipraṃ madhunā svasti vācayet |
tilairapi tathā kṛṣṇaiḥ pāyasena tu bhojayet || 35 ||
evaṃ vratāni devībhiḥ kṛtānyamaravarṇini |
mahādevyā puroktāni rudrapatnyā haripriye || 36 ||
ahaṃ bravīmi tapasā madīyena samanvitāḥ |
sarvā drakṣyatha guṇyāni vratakāni tathaiva ca || 37 ||
paurāṇānyumayā devyā yāni dṛṣṭāni vai purā |
kalyāṇaguṇayuktāni pāvanāni śubhāni ca || 38 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
rukmiṇī vratakaṃ cakre dṛṣṭvā vratakavistaram |
umāyā varadānena dṛṣṭvā divyena cakṣuṣā || 39 ||
umāvratakavat sarvaṃ vṛṣadānaṃ tathādhikam |
ratnamālāpradānaṃ ca tathānnaṃ sārvakāmikam || 2.81.40 ||
tathā jāmbavatī cakre puromāvratakaṃ tathā |
dadāvabhyadhikaṃ sā tu ratnavṛkṣaṃ manoharam || 41 ||
satyā dadau tathaivātha puromāvratakaṃ tathā |
pītamabhyadhikaṃ vāsastayā dattamumāvrate || 42 ||
rohiṇyātha ca phālgunyā maghayā ca purātane |
vratāni khalu dattāni bahūni kulavardhana ||43 ||
dadau śatabhiṣā caiva vratakaṃ puṇyalakṣaṇam |
yena nakṣatramukhyatvaṃ jagāma kurunandana || 44 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi pārijātaharaṇe umāvratakathanasamāptau
pārijātaharaṇakathanasamāptau caikāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 81 ||

<2.82>

dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
vaiśampāyana dharmajña vyāsaśiṣya tapodhana |
pārijātasya haraṇe ṣaṭpuraṃ parikīrtitam || 1 ||
nivāso'suramukhyānāṃ dāruṇānāṃ tapodhana |
teṣāṃ vadhaṃ muniśreṣṭha kīrtayasvāndhakasya ca || 2 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tripure nihate vīra rudreṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā |
tatra pradhānā bahavo babhūvurasurottamāḥ || 3 ||
śarāgninā na dagdhāste rudreṇa tripurālayāḥ |
ṣaṣṭiḥ śatasahasrāṇi na nyūnānyadhikāni ca || 4 ||
te jñātivadhasaṃtaptāścakrurvīrāḥ purā tapaḥ |
jambūmārge satāmiṣṭe maharṣigaṇasevite || 5 ||
ādityābhimukhā vīrāḥ sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ samāḥ |
vāyubhakṣā nṛpaśreṣṭha stuvantaḥ padmasambhavam || 6 ||
teṣāmudumbaraṃ rājan gaṇa ekaḥ samāśritaḥ |
vṛkṣaṃ tatrāvasan vīrāste kurvanto mahattapaḥ || 7 ||
kapitthavṛkṣamāśritya kecittatroṣitāḥ purā |
sṛgālavāṭīstvapare cerurugraṃ tathā tapaḥ || 8 ||
vaṭamūle tathā cerustapaḥ kauravanandana |
adhīyanto paraṃ brahma vaṭaṃ gatvāsurātmajāḥ || 9 ||
teṣāṃ tuṣṭaḥ prajākartā naradeva pitāmahaḥ |
varaṃ dātuṃ suraśreṣṭhaḥ prāpto dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ || 2.82.10 ||
varaṃ varayatetyuktāste rājan padmayoninā |
neṣustadvaradānaṃ tu dviṣantastryambakaṃ vibhum || 11 ||
icchanto'pacitiṃ gantuṃ jñātīnāṃ kurunandana |
tānuvāca tato brahmā sarvaśaḥ kurunandana || 12 ||
viśvasya jagataḥ kartuḥ saṃhartuśca mahātmanaḥ |
kaḥ śakto'pacitiṃ gantuṃ māstu vo'tra vṛthā śramaḥ||13||
anādimadhyanidhanaḥ somo devo maheśvaraḥ |
tamāsūya sukhaṃ svarge vastumicchanti ye'surāḥ|| 14 ||
te neṣustatra kecit tu durātmāno mahāsurāḥ |
atheṣurapare rājannasurā bhavyabhāvanāḥ || 15 ||
neṣurye sudurātmānastānuvāca pitāmahaḥ |
varayadhvaṃ varaṃ vīrā rudrakrodhamṛte'surāḥ || 16 ||
te ūcuḥ sarvadevānāmavadhyāḥ syāma he vibho |
purāṇi ṣaṭ ca no deva bhavantyantarmahītale || 17 ||
sarvakāmasamṛddhārthaṃ ṣaṭapuraṃ cāstu naḥ prabho |
vayaṃ ca ṣaṭpuraṃ gatvā vasema ca sukhaṃ vibho || 18 ||
rudrādugraṃ bhayaṃ na syād yena no jñātayo hatāḥ |
nihataṃ tripuraṃ dṛṣṭvā bhītāḥ sma tapasāṃ nidhe || 19 ||
pitāmaha uvāca
asurā bhavatāvadhyā devānāṃ śaṅkarasya ca |
na bādhiṣyatha cedviprān satpathasthānsatāṃ priyān||2.82.20||
vipropaghātaṃ mohāccet kariṣyatha kathaṃcana |
nāśaṃ yāsyatha viprā hi jagataḥ paramā gatiḥ || 21 ||
nārāyaṇād bibhetavyaṃ kurvadbhirbrāhmaṇāhitam |
sarvabhūteṣu bhagavān hitaṃ dhatte janārdanaḥ || 22 ||
te gatā asurā rājan brahmaṇātha visarjitāḥ |
ye'pi bhaktā mahādevamasurā dharmacāriṇaḥ || 23 ||
svayaṃ hi darśanaṃ teṣāṃ dadau tripuranāśanaḥ |
śvetaṃ vṛṣabhamāruhya somaḥ sapravaraḥ prabhuḥ |
uvācedaṃ ca bhagavānasurān sa satāṃ gatiḥ || 24 ||
vairamutsṛjya dambhaṃ ca hiṃsāṃ cāsurasattamāḥ |
māmeva cāśritāstasmād varaṃ sādhu dadāmi vaḥ || 25 ||
yairdīkṣitāḥ stha munibhiḥ satkriyāparamairdvijaiḥ |
saha tairgamyatāṃ svargaḥ prīto'haṃ vaḥ sukarmaṇā || 26 ||
iha ye caiva vatsyanti tāpasā brahmavādinaḥ |
api kāpitthikā vṛkṣe teṣāṃ loko yathā mama||27||
iha māsāntapakṣāntau yaḥ kariṣyati mānavaḥ |
vānaprasthena vidhinā pūjayan māṃ tapodhanāḥ || 28 ||
varṣāṇāṃ sa sahasraṃ tu tapasāṃ prāpsyate phalam |
kṛtvā trirātraṃ vidhivallapsyate cepsitāṃ gatim|| 29 ||
arkadvīpe nivasato dviguṇaṃ tad bhaviṣyati |
na videśe ca bhadraṃ vo varametad dadāmyaham || 2.82.30 ||
śvetavāhananāmānaṃ yaśca māṃ pūjayiṣyati |
sarvato bhayacitto'pi gatiṃ sa mama yāsyati || 31 ||
audumbarān vāṭamūlān dvijān kāpitthikānapi|
tathā sṛgālavāṭīyān dharmātmāno dṛḍhavratān || 32 ||
munīṃśca brahmavādīyān saviśeṣeṇa ye narāḥ |
pūjayiṣyanti satataṃ te yāsyantīpsitāṃ gatim ||33||
ityuktvātha mahādevo bhagavāñchvetavāhanaḥ |
taireva sahitaḥ sarvai rudralokaṃ jagāma vai || 34 ||
jambūmārgaṃ gamiṣyāmi jambūmārge vasāmyaham |
evaṃ saṃkalpamāno'pi rudraloke mahīyate || 35 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi ṣaṭpuravadhe dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 82 ||

<2.83>

tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
etasminneva kāle tu caturvedaṣaḍaṅgavit |
brāhmaṇo yājñavalkyasya śiṣyo dharmaguṇānvitaḥ || 1 ||
brahmadatteti vikhyāto vipro vājasaneyivān |
aśvamedhaḥ kṛtastena vasudevasya dhīmataḥ || 2 ||
sa saṃvatsaradīkṣāyāṃ dīkṣitaḥ ṣaṭpurālayaḥ |
āvartāyāḥ śubhe tīre sunadyā munijuṣṭyā || 3 ||
sakhā ca vasudevasya sahādhyāyī dvijottamaḥ |
upādhyāyaśca kauravya kṣīrahotā mahātmanaḥ || 4 ||
vasudevastatra yāto devakyā sahitaḥ prabho |
yajamānaṃ ṣaṭpurasthaṃ yathā śakro bṛhaspatim || 5 ||
tat satraṃ brahmadattasya bahvannaṃ bahudakṣiṇam |
upāsanti muniśreṣṭhā mahātmāno dṛḍhavratāḥ || 6 ||
vyāso'haṃ yājñavalkyaśca sumanturjaiministathā |
dhṛtimāñjābaliścaiva devalādyāśca bhārata || 7 ||
ṛddhyānurūpayā yuktaṃ vasudevasya dhīmataḥ |
yatrepsitāndadau kāmāndevakī dharmacāriṇī || 8 ||
vāsudevaprabhāveṇa jagatsraṣṭurmahītale |
tasmin satre vartamāne daityāḥ ṣaṭpuravāsinaḥ || 9 ||
nikumbhādyāḥ samāgamya tamūcurvaradarpitāḥ |
kāryatāṃ yajñabhāgo naḥ somaṃ pāsyāmahe vayam |
kanyāśca brahmadatto no yajamānaḥ prayacchatu || 2.83.10 ||
bahvyaḥ santyasya kanyāśca rūpavatyo mahātmanaḥ |
āhūya tāḥ pradātavyāḥ sarvathaiva hi naḥ śrutam || 11 ||
ratnāni ca brahmadatto viśiṣṭāni dadātu naḥ |
anyathā tu na yaṣṭavyaṃ vayamājñāpayāmahe || 12 ||
etacchrutvā brahmadattastānuvāca mahāsurān |
yajñabhāgo na vihitaḥ purāṇe'surasattamāḥ || 13 ||
kathaṃ satre somapānaṃ śakyaṃ dātuṃ mayā hi vaḥ |
pṛcchateha muniśreṣṭhān vedabhāṣyārthakovidān || 14 ||
kanyā hi mama yā deyāstāśca saṃkalpitā mayā |
antarvedyāṃ pradātavyāḥ sadṛśānāmasaṃśayam || 15 ||
ratnāni tu prayacchāmi sāntvenāhaṃ vicintyatām |
balānnaiva pradāsyāmi devakīputramāśritaḥ || 16 ||
nikumbhādyāstu ruṣitāḥ pāpāḥ ṣaṭpuravāsinaḥ |
yakṣavāṭaṃ viluluṭhurjahruḥ kanyāśca tāstathā | 17 ||
taddṛṣṭvā sampravṛttaṃ tu dadhyāvānakadundubhiḥ |
vāsudevaṃ mahātmānaṃ balabhadraṃ gadaṃ tathā || 18 ||
viditārthastataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pradyumnamidamabravīt |
gaccha kanyāparitrāṇaṃ kuru putrāśu māyayā || 19 ||
yāvad yādavasainyena ṣaṭpuraṃ yāmyahaṃ prabho |
sa yayau ṣaṭpuraṃ vīraḥ piturāśākarastadā || 2.83.20 ||
nimeṣāntaramātreṇa gatvā kāmo mahābalaḥ |
kanyāstā māyayā dhīmānapajahre mahābalaḥ || 21 ||
māyāmayīśca kṛtvā'nyā nyastavānrukmiṇīsutaḥ |
mā bhairiti ca dharmātmā devakīmuktavāṃstadā || 22 ||
māyāmayīstato hṛtvā sutā hyasya durāsadāḥ |
ṣaṭpuraṃ viviśurdaityāḥ parituṣṭā narādhipa || 23 ||
karma cāsārya te tatra vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā |
yad viśiṣṭaṃ bahuguṇaṃ tadabhūcca narādhipa || 24 ||
etasminnantare prāptā rājānastatra bhārata |
satre nimantritāḥ pūrvaṃ brahmadattena dhīmatā || 25 ||
jarāsaṃdho dantavaktraḥ śiśupālastathaiva ca |
pāṇḍavā dhārtarāṣṭrāśca mālavāḥ sagaṇāstathā || 26 ||
rukmī caivāhvṛtiścaiva nīlo vā dharma eva ca |
vindānuvindāvāvantyau śalyaḥ śakunireva ca || 27 ||
rājānaścāpare vīrā mahātmāno dṛḍhāyudhāḥ |
āvāsitā nātidūre ṣaṭpurasya ca bhārata || 28 ||
tān dṛṣṭvā nāradaḥ śrīmānacintayadaninditaḥ |
kṣattrasya yādavānāṃ ca bhaviṣyati samāgamaḥ || 29 ||
atra heturahaṃ yuddhe tasmāt tat prayatāmyaham |
evaṃ saṃcintayitvātha nikumbhabhavanaṃ gataḥ || 2.83.30 ||
pūjitaḥ sa nikumbhena dānavaiśca tathāparaiḥ |
upaviṣṭaḥ sa dharmātmā nikumbhamidamabravīt || 31 ||
kathaṃ virodhaṃ yadubhiḥ kṛtvā svasthairihāsyate |
yo brahmadattaḥ sa hariḥ sa hi tasya pituḥ sakhā || 32 ||
śatāni pañca bhāryāṇāṃ brahmadattasya dhīmataḥ |
ānītā vasudevasya sutasya priyakāmyayā || 33||
śatadvayaṃ brāhmaṇīnāṃ rājanyānāṃ śataṃ tathā |
vaiśyānāṃ śatamekaṃ ca śūdrāṇāṃ śatameva ca || 34 ||
tābhiḥ śuśrūṣito dhīmān durvāsā dharmavittamaḥ |
tena tāsāṃ varo datto muninā puṇyakarmaṇā || 35 ||
ekaikastanayo rājannekaikā duhitā tathā |
rūpeṇānupamāḥ sarvā varadānena dhīmataḥ || 36 ||
kanyā bhavanti tanayāstasyāsura punaḥ punaḥ |
saṅgame saṅgame vīra bhartṛbhiḥ śayane saha || 37 ||
sarvapuṣpamayaṃ gandhaṃ prasravanti varāṅganāḥ |
sarvadā yauvane nyastāḥ sarvāścaiva pativratāḥ || 38 ||
sarvā guṇairapsarasāṃ gītanṛtyaguṇodayam |
jānanti sarvā daiteya varadānena dhīmataḥ || 39 ||
putrāśca rūpasampannāḥ śāstrārthakuśalāstathā |
sve sve sthitā varṇadharme yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || 2.83.40 ||
tāḥ kanyā bhaimamukhyānāṃ dattāḥ prāyeṇa dhīmatā |
avaśeṣaṃ śataṃ tvekaṃ yadānītaṃ kila tvayā || 41 ||
tadarthe yādavān vīra yodhayiṣyasi sarvathā |
sahāyārthaṃ tu rājāno dhriyantāṃ hetupūrvakam || 42 ||
brahmadattasutārthaṃ ca ratnāni vividhāni ca |
dīyantāṃ bhūmipālānāṃ sahāyārthe mahātmanām || 43 ||
ātithyaṃ kriyatāṃ caiva yai sameṣyanti vai nṛpāḥ |
evamukte tathā cakrurasurāste'tihṛṣṭavat || 44 ||
labdhvā pañcaśataṃ kanyā ratnāni vividhāni ca |
yathārheṇa narendraistā vibhaktā bhaktavatsalaiḥ || 45 ||
ṛte pāṇḍusutān vīrān vāritā nāradena te |
nimeṣāntaramātreṇa tatra gatvā mahātmanā || 46 ||
tuṣṭaistairasurā hyuktā rājan bhūmipasattamaiḥ |
sarvakāmasamṛddhārthairbhavadbhiḥ khagamaiḥ svayam || 47 ||
arcitāḥ sma yathānyāyaṃ kṣatraṃ kiṃ vaḥ prayacchatu |
kṣatraṃ cārcitapūrvaṃ hi divyairvīrairbhavadvidhaiḥ || 48 ||
nikumbho'thābravīd dhṛṣṭaḥ kṣatraṃ suraripustadā |
anuvarṇayitvā kṣatrasya māhātmyaṃ satyameva ca || 49 ||
yuddhaṃ no ripubhiḥ sārddhaṃ bhaviṣyati nṛpottamāḥ |
sāhāyyaṃ dātumicchāmo bhavadbhistatra sarvathā || 2.83.50 ||
evamastviti tānūcuḥ kṣattriyāḥ kṣīṇakilbiṣāḥ |
pāṇḍaveyānṛte dhīrāñchrutārthānnāradād vibho || 51 ||
kṣatriyāḥ saṃniviṣṭāste yuddhārthaṃ kurunandana |
patnyastu brahmadattasya yajñavāṭaṃ gatā api || 52 ||
kṛṣṇo'pi senayā sārddhaṃ prayayau ṣaṭ puraṃ vibhuḥ |
mahādevasya vacanamudvahan manasā nṛpa || 53 ||
sthāpayitvā dvāravatyāmāhukaṃ pārthivaṃ tadā |
sa tayā senayā sārddhaṃ paurāṇāṃ hitakāmyayā || 54 ||
yajñavāṭasyāvidūre devo niviviśe vibhuḥ |
deśe pravarakalyāṇe vasudevapracoditaḥ || 55 ||
dattagulmāpratisaraṃ kṛtvā taṃ vidhivatprabhuḥ |
pradyumnamaṭane śrīmān rakṣārthaṃ viniyujya ca || 56 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi ṣaṭpuravadhe kṛṣṇasya ṣaṭpuragamane tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 83 ||

<2.84>

caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
muhūrtābhyudite sūrye janacakṣuṣi nirmale |
balaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sātyakiśca tārkṣyamāruruhustadā || 1 ||
baddhagodhāṅgulitrāṇā daṃśitā yuddhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ |
bilvodakeśvaraṃ devaṃ namaskṛtya surottamam || 2 ||
āvartayā jale snātvā rudreṇa varadattayā |
gaṅgāyāḥ kuruśārdūla rudravākyena puṇyayā || 3 ||
pradyumnamagre sainyasya viyati sthāpya mānadaḥ |
rakṣārthaṃ yajñavāṭasya pāṇḍavān viniyujya ca || 4 ||
śeṣāṃ senāṃ guhādvāri bhagavān viniyujya ca |
jayantamatha sasmāra pravaraṃ ca satāṃ gatiḥ || 5 ||
tāvāpeturevātha svayaṃ cāpaśyatāṃ tathā |
viyatyeva niyuktau tau pradyumna iva bhārata || 6 ||
tataḥ kṛṣṇasya vacanādāhato raṇadundubhiḥ |
jalajā murajāścaiva vādyānyevāparāṇi ca || 7 ||
makaro racito vyūhaḥ sāmbena ca gadena ca |
sāraṇaścoddhavaścaiva bhojo vaitaraṇastathā || 8 ||
anādhṛṣṭiśca dharmātmā pṛthurvipṛthureva ca |
kṛtavarmā ca daṃṣṭraśca nicakṣurarimardanaḥ || 9 ||
sanatkumāro dharmātmā cārudeṣṇaśca bhārata |
aniruddhasahāyau tau pṛṣṭhānīkaṃ rarakṣatuḥ || 2.84.10 ||
śeṣā yādavasenā tu vyūhamadhye vyavasthitā |
rathairaśvairnarairnāgairākulā kulavardhana || 11 ||
ṣaṭpurādapi niṣkrāntā dānavā yuddhadurmadāḥ |
āruhya meghanādāṃśca gardabhānapi hastinaḥ || 12 ||
makarāñchiśumārāṃśca drutānapi ca bhārata |
mahiṣānapi khaḍgāṃśca uṣṭrānapi ca kacchapān || 13 ||
etaireva rathairyuktā vividhāyudhapāṇayaḥ |
kirīṭāpīḍamukuṭairaṅgadairapi maṇḍitāḥ || 14 ||
nānardamānairvividhaistūryairnemisvanākulaiḥ |
pradhmāyamānaiḥ śaṅkhaiśca mahāmbudasamasvanaiḥ || 15 ||
tāsāmasurasenānāmudyatānāṃ janeśvara |
nikumbho niryayāvagre devānāmiva vāsavaḥ || 16 ||
bhūmiṃ dyāṃ ca vavṛdhire dānavāste balotkaṭāḥ |
nadanto vividhānnādān kṣveḍantaśca punaḥ punaḥ || 17 ||
rājasenāpi saṃyattā cedirājapurogamā |
asurāṇāṃ sahāyārthe niścitā janamejaya || 18 ||
duryodhanabhrātṛśataṃ cedirājānujāgragam |
sthitaṃ rathairnaravyāghra gandharvanagaropamaiḥ || 19 ||
kaṭhinānādino vīra drupadasyandanāstathā |
rukmī caivāhvṛtiścaiva tasthaturniścitau raṇe |
tālavṛkṣapratīkāśe dhunvānau dhanuṣī śubhe || 2.84.20 ||
śalyaśca śakuniścobhau bhagadattaśca pārthivaḥ |
jarāsaṃdhastrigartaśca virāṭaśca sahottaraḥ || 21 ||
yuddhārthamudyatā vīrā nikumbhādyā jayaiṣiṇaḥ |
yuyutsamānā yadubhirdevairiva mahāsurāḥ || 22 ||
tato nikumbhaḥ samare śarairāśīviṣopamaiḥ |
mamarda samare senāṃ bhaimānāṃ bhīmadarśanām || 23 ||
senāpatiranādhṛṣṭirmamṛṣe tanna yādavaḥ |
mamarda ghorairbāṇoghaiścitrapuṅkhaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ || 24 ||
na ratho'suramukhyasya dadṛśe na ca vājinaḥ |
na dhvajo na nikumbhastu sarve bāṇābhisaṃvṛtāḥ || 25 ||
sa parītya tato vīro nikumbho māyināṃ varaḥ |
astambhayadanādhṛṣṭiṃ māyayā bhaimasattamam || 26 ||
stambhayitvānayad vīraṃ guhāṃ ṣaṭpurasaṃjñitām |
ruddhvā cābhyagamadvīro māyābalamupāśritaḥ || 27 ||
punareva nikumbhastu kṛtavarmāṇamāhave |
anayaccārudeṣṇaṃ ca bhojaṃ vaitaraṇaṃ tathā || 28 ||
sanatkumāramṛkṣaṃ ca tathaiva niśaṭholmukau |
bahūṃścaivāparān bhojān māyābalasamāśritaḥ || 29 ||
na tasya dadṛśe deho māyācchanno janeśvara |
nayato yādavānghorān guhāṃ ṣaṭpurasaṃśitām || 2.84.30||
tad dṛṣṭvā kadanaṃ ghoraṃ bhaimānāṃ bhayavardhanaḥ |
cukopa bhagavānkṛṣṇo balaḥ satyaka eva ca || 31 ||
saviśeṣaṃ tathā kāmaḥ sāmbaśca paravīrahā |
aniruddhaśca durdharṣo bhaimāśca bahavo'pare || 32 ||
tataḥ śārṅgāyudhaḥ śārṅgaṃ kṛtvā sajyaṃ nareśvara |
dānaveṣu pravṛtteṣu tṛṇeṣviva hutāśanaḥ || 33 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā dānavā devamabhidudruvurīśvaram |
śalabhāḥ kālapāśārtāḥ pradīptamiva pāvakam || 34 ||
samutsṛjya śataghnīśca parighāṃśca sahasraśaḥ |
śūlāni cāgnitulyāni pradīptāṃśca paraśvadhān || 35 ||
parvatāgrāṇi vṛkṣāṃśca ghorāśca vipulāḥ śilāḥ |
utkṣipya ca gajānmattān rathānapi hayānapi ||36 ||
nārāyaṇāgnistān sarvān dadāha prahasanniva |
bāṇārciṣā mahātejā jagaddhitakaro hariḥ ||37 ||
śāradaṃ varṣaṇaṃ yadvat sehe dhīro gavāṃ patiḥ |
tadvad yaduvṛṣaḥ sehe bāṇavarṣamariṃdamaḥ || 38 ||
na sehire 'surā bāṇānnārāyaṇadhanuścyutān |
varṣaṃ parjanyavihitaṃ vālukāsetavo yathā || 39||
na śekuḥ pramukhe sthātuṃ kṛṣṇasyāsurasattamāḥ |
vyāditāsyasya siṃhasya vṛṣabhā iva bhārata || 2.84.40 ||
te vadhyamānāḥ kṛṣṇena divamācakramustadā |
jīvitāśāṃ vahantastu nārāyaṇabhayārditāḥ || 41 ||
tānākāśagatānaindrirjayantaḥ pravarastathā |
nijaghnatuḥ śarairghorairjvalitārcisamaiḥ prabho || 42 ||
nipeturasurāṇāṃ tu śirāṃsi dharaṇītale |
tṛṇarājaphalānīva muktāni śikharāt taroḥ || 43 ||
nipeturbāhavaśchinnā dainyānāṃ vasudhātale |
kālenopahatā vīra pañcavaktrā ivoragāḥ || 44 ||
raukmiṇeyastataḥ sṛṣṭvā ghorāṃ māyāmayīṃ guhām |
adṛśyaniṣkramaṃ vīraḥ kṣatraṃ prakṣeptumudyataḥ | 45 ||
gadena saha dharmātmā sāraṇena sutena ca |
sāmbena cāparaiścāpi pūrvaṃ ye na praveśitāḥ || 46 ||
pramathya tarasā karṇe yatantaṃ raṇamūrdhani |
jagrāha balavān kārṣṇiḥ prasphurantaṃ tatastataḥ || 47 ||
vinadya ca guhāṃ vīro ghorāṃ māyāmayīṃ nṛpa |
duryodhanaṃ ca rājānaṃ virāṭadrupadāvapi || 48 |
śakuniṃ caiva śalyaṃ ca nīlaṃ cāpi nadīsutam |
vindānuvindau rājānau jarāsaṃdhaṃ ca bhārata || 49 ||
trigartānmālavāṃścaiva vāsantyāṃśca mahābalān |
dhṛṣṭadyusnādikāṃścaiva pañcālānastrakovidān || 2.84.50 ||
tathāhvṛtimuvācedaṃ mātulaṃ rukmimeva ca |
śiśupālaṃ ca rājānaṃ bhagadattaṃ ca bhārata || 51 ||
sambandhaṃ ca gurutvaṃ ca mānayāmi narādhipāḥ |
guhāmimāṃ ghorarūpāṃ yatra prakṣepayāmi vaḥ || 52 ||
bilvodakeśvareṇāhamājñaptaḥ śūlapāṇinā |
prakṣeptavyā narendrāste guhāyāmiti dhīmatā || 53 ||
āśritya śāmbarīṃ māyāṃ nikumbhena mahātmanā |
prakṣiptān yādavāṃścaiva mokṣayiṣyāmi sarvathā || 54 ||
ityukto śiśupālastu rājā senāpatistathā |
śaraistatarda tān bhaimān pradyumnaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 55 ||
bilvodakeśvaraṃ devaṃ raukmiṇeyo namasya ca |
ārabhannṛpatiṃ baddhuṃ śiśupālaṃ mahābalam || 56 |
tataḥ pāśasahastrāṇi grahāya pravarottamaḥ |
śailādirabravīd vīraṃ raukmiṇeyaṃ mahābalam || 57 ||
bilvodakeśvaro devaḥ prāha tvāṃ yadunandana |
sarvaṃ kuru tathā rātryāṃ coktastvaṃ bho yathā mayā|| 58 ||
kanyārthaṃ ratnalubdhāṃstu baddhvā cemān narādhipān|
pāśaistvameva bhoktuṃ ca pramāṇaṃ yadunandana || 59 ||
asurāṃstu mahābāho niḥśeṣān kartumarhasi |
evameva ca vaktavyastvayā vīra janārdanaḥ || 2.84.60 ||
tataḥ sa bhagadattaṃ ca śiśupālaṃ ca bhūmipa |
āhvṛtiṃ caiva rukmiṃ ca śeṣāṃścānyānnarādhipān ||61||
babandha haradattaistaiḥ pāśairuttamavīryadhṛk |
māyāmayīṃ guhāṃ caivamānayat kurunandana || 62 ||
baddhvā ca raukmiṇeyo'tha niḥśvasanta ivoragān |
aniruddhaṃ cakārātha rakṣitāraṃ svamātmajam || 63 ||
teṣāṃ niravaśeṣeṇa babandha yadunandanaḥ |
senāpatīn kṣatriyāṃśca kośādhyakṣāṃśca bhārata || 64 ||
avyagrastu tato hantumasurānudyataḥ prabho || 65 ||
saṃnaddha eva covāca brahmadattaṃ dvijottamam |
visrabdhaṃ vartatāṃ karma mā bhaiḥ paśya dhanaṃjayam || 66 ||
na devebhyo nāsurebhyo nāgebhyo dvijasattama |
bhayaṃ hi vidyate tasya goptāro yasya pāṇḍavāḥ || 67 ||
na cāsuraistava sutāḥ spṛṣṭāḥ khalvapi cetasā |
yajñavāṭe nirīkṣyantāṃ māyayā nihitā mayā || 68 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi ṣaṭpuravadhe caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 84 ||

<2.85>

pañcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
ruddheṣu bhūmipāleṣu sānugeṣu viśāmpate |
āviveśāsurāṃścātha kaśmalaṃ janamejaya || 1 ||
diśaḥ pratasthuste vīrā vadhyamānāḥ samantataḥ |
kṛṣṇānantaprabhṛtibhiryadubhiryuddhadurmadaiḥ || 2 ||
nikumbhastānathovāca ruṣito dānavottamaḥ |
bhittvā pratijñāṃ kiṃ mohādbhayārtā yāta vihvalāḥ || 3 ||
hīnapratijñāḥ kām̐llokān prayāsyatha palāyitāḥ |
agatvāpacitiṃ yuddhe jñātīnāṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ || 4 ||
phalaṃ jitveha bhoktavyaṃ ripūn samarakarkaśān |
hatena cāpi śūreṇa vastavyaṃ tridive sukham || 5 ||
palāyitvā gṛhaṃ gatvā kasya drakṣyatha he mukham |
dārānvakṣyatha kiṃ cāpi dhigdhik kiṃ kiṃ na lajjatha ||6||
evamuktā nivṛttāste lajjamānā nṛpāsurāḥ |
dviguṇena ca vegena yuyudhuryadubhiḥ saha || 7 ||
utsave yuddhaśauṇḍānāṃ nānāpraharaṇairnṛpa |
ye yānti yajñavāṭaṃ taṃ tān nihanti dhanaṃjayaḥ || 8 ||
yamau bhīmaśca rājā ca dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ |
dyāṃ prayātāñjaghānaindriḥ pravaraśca dvijottamaḥ || 9 ||
athāsurāsṛktoyāḍhyā keśaśaivalaśādvalā |
cakrakūrmarathāvartā gajaśailānuśobhinī || 2.85.10 ||
dhvajakuntatarucchannā stanitotkruṣṭanādinī |
govindaśailaprabhavā bhīrucittapramāthinī || 11 ||
asṛgbudbudaphenāḍhyā asimatsyataraṅgiṇī |
susrāva śoṇitanadī nadīva jaladāgame || 12 ||
tān dṛṣṭvaiva nikumbhastu varddhamānāṃśca śātravān |
hatān sarvān sahāyāṃśca vīryādevātpapāta ha || 13 ||
sa vārito jayantena pravareṇa ca bhārata |
śaraiḥ kuliśasaṃkāśairnikumbho raṇakarkaśaḥ || 14 ||
saṃnivṛtyātha daṣṭoṣṭhaḥ parigheṇa durāsadaḥ |
pravaraṃ tāḍayāmāsa sa papāta mahītale || 15 ||
aindristaṃ patitaṃ bhūmau bāhubhyāṃ pariṣasvaje |
viditvā caiva saprāṇaṃ hitvāsuramabhidrutaḥ || 16 ||
abhidrutya nikumbhaṃ ca nistriṃśena jaghāna ha |
parigheṇāpi daiteyo jayantaṃ samatāḍayat || 17 ||
tatakṣa bahulaṃ gātraṃ nikumbhasyaindrirāhave |
sa cintayāmāsa tadā vadhyamāno mahāsuraḥ || 18 ||
kṛṣṇena saha yoddhavyaṃ vairiṇā jñātighātinā |
śrāvayāmi kimātmānamāhave śakrasūnunā || 19 ||
evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā tatraivāntaradhīyata |
jagāma caiva yuddhārthaṃ yatra kṛṣṇo mahābalaḥ || 2.85.20 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvairāvataskandhamāsthito balanāśanaḥ |
draṣṭumabhyāgato yuddhaṃ jahṛṣe saha daivataiḥ || 21 ||
sādhu sādhviti putraṃ ca parituṣṭaḥ sa sasvaje |
pravaraṃ cāpi dharmātmā sasvaje mohavarjitam || 22 ||
devadundubhayaścāpi praṇedurvāsavājñayā |
jayamānaṃ raṇe dṛṣṭvā jayantaṃ raṇadurjayam || 23 ||
dadarśātha nikumbhastu keśavaṃ raṇadurjayam |
arjunena sthitaṃ sārdhaṃ yajñavāṭāvidūrataḥ || 24 ||
sa nādaṃ sumahān kṛtvā pakṣirājamatāḍayat |
parigheṇa sughoreṇa balaṃ satyakameva ca || 25 ||
nārāyaṇaṃ cārjunaṃ ca bhīmaṃ cātha yudhiṣṭhiram |
yamau ca vāsudevaṃ ca sāmbaṃ kāmaṃ ca vīryavān || 26 ||
yuyudhe māyayā daityaḥ śīghrakārī ca bhārata |
na cainaṃ dadṛśuḥ sarve sarvaśastraviśāradāḥ || 27 ||
yadā tu naivāpaśyastaṃ tadā bilvodakeśvaram |
dadhyau devaṃ hṛṣīkeśaḥ pramathānāṃ gaṇeśvaram || 28||
tataste dadṛśuḥ sarve prabhāvādatitejasaḥ |
bilvodakeśvarasyāśu nikumbhaṃ māyināṃ varam || 29||
kailāsaśikharākāraṃ grasantamiva dhiṣṭhitam |
āhvayantaṃ raṇe kṛṣṇaṃ vairiṇaṃ jñātināśanam || 2.85.30||
satyagāṇḍīva evādya pārthastasya ratheṣubhiḥ |
parighaṃ caiva gātreṣu vivyādhainamathāsakṛt || 31 ||
te bāṇāstasya gātreṣu parighe ca janādhipa |
bhaṅgāḥ śilāśitāḥ sarve nipetuḥ kuñcitāḥ kṣitau ||32||
viphalānastrayuktāṃstān dṛṣṭvā bāṇāndhanaṃjayaḥ |
papraccha keśavaṃ vīraḥ kimetaditi bhārata || 33 ||
parvatānapi bhindanti mama vajropamāḥ śarāḥ |
kimidaṃ devakīputra vismayo'tra mahān mama || 34 ||
tamuvāca tataḥ kṛpṇaḥ prahasanniva bhārata |
mahadbhūtaṃ nikumbho'yaṃ kaunteya śṛṇu vistarāt|| 35 ||
purā gatvottarakurūṃstapaścakre mahāsuraḥ |
śataṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ devaśatrurdurāsadaḥ || 36 ||
athainaṃ chandayāmāsa vareṇa bhagavān haraḥ |
sa vavre trīṇi rūpāṇi na vadhyāni surāsuraiḥ || 37 ||
tamuvāca mahādevo bhagavān vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ |
mama vā brāhmaṇānāṃ vā viṣṇorvā priyamācaran || 38 ||
bhaviṣyasi harervadhyo na tvanyasya mahāsura |
brahmaṇyo'haṃ ca viṣṇuśca viprāṇāṃ paramā gatiḥ || 39 ||
sa eṣa sarvaśastrāṇāmavadhyaḥ pāṇḍunandana|
trideho'tipramāthī ca varamattaśca dānavaḥ || 2.85.40 ||
bhānumatyāpaharaṇe deho'syaiko hato mayā |
avadhyaṃ ṣaṭpuraṃ dehamidamasya durātmanaḥ ||41 ||
ditiṃ śuśrūṣati nyeko deho'sya tapasānvitaḥ |
anyastu deho ghoro'sya yenāvasati ṣaṭpuram ||42 |
etat tu sarvamākhyātaṃ nikumbhacaritaṃ mayā |
tvarayāsya vadhe vīra kathā paścād bhaviṣyati || 43 ||
tayoḥ kathayatorevaṃ kṛṣṇayorasurastadā |
guhāṃ ṣaṭpurasaṃjñāṃ tāṃ viveśa raṇadurjayaḥ || 44 ||
anviṣya tasya bhagavān viveśa madhusūdanaḥ |
tāṃ ṣaṭpuraguhāṃ ghorāṃ durdharṣāṃ kurunandana || 45 ||
candrasūryaprabhāhīnāṃ jvalantīṃ svena tejasā |
sukhaduḥkhoṣṇaśītāni prayacchantīṃ yathepsitam || 46 ||
tatra praviśya bhagavānapaśyata janādhipān |
yuyudhe saha ghoreṇa nikumbhena janādhipa || 47 ||
kṛṣṇasyānupraviṣṭāstu balādyā yādavāstadā |
praviṣṭāśca tathā sarve pāṇḍavāste mahātmanaḥ || 48 ||
sametāstu praviṣṭāste kṛṣṇasyānumatena vai |
yuyudhe sa tu kṛṣṇena raukmiṇeyaḥ pracoditaḥ |
mānayad yādavānsarvānyānayaṃ baddhavānpurā || 49 ||
te muktā raukmiṇeyena prāptā yatra janārdanaḥ |
prahṛṣṭamanasaḥ sarve nikumbhavadhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ || 2.85.50 ||
rājāno vīra muñceti punaḥ kāmaṃ yathābruvan |
mumoca cātha tānvīro raukmiṇeyaḥ pratāpavān || 51 ||
adhomukhamukhāḥ sarve baddhamaunā narādhipāḥ |
lajjayābhiplutā vīrāstasthurnaṣṭaśriyastadā || 52 ||
nikumbhamapi govindaḥ prayatantaṃ jayaṃ prati |
yodhayāmāsa bhagavān ghoramātmaripuṃ hariḥ || 53 ||
parighenāhataḥ kṛṣṇo nikumbhena bhṛśaṃ vibho |
gadayā cāpi kṛṣṇena nikumbhastāḍito bhṛśam || 54 ||
tāvubhau mohamāpannau suprahārahatau tadā |
tataḥ pravyathitāndṛṣṭvā pāṇḍavāṃścātha yādavān|| 55 ||
jepurmunigaṇāstatra kṛṣṇasya hitakāmyayā |
tuṣṭuvuśca mahātmānaṃ vedaproktaistathā stavaiḥ || 56 ||
tataḥ pratyāgataprāṇo bhagavān keśavastadā |
dānavaśca punarvīrāvudyatau samaraṃ prati || 57 ||
vṛṣabhāviva nardantau gajāviva ca bhārata |
śālāvṛkāviva kruddhau praharantau raṇotkaṭau || 58 ||
atha kṛṣṇaṃ tadovāca nṛpa vāgaśarīriṇī |
cakreṇa śamayasyainaṃ devabrāhmaṇakaṇṭakam || 59 ||
iti hovāca bhagavān devo bilvodakeśvaraḥ |
dharmaṃ yaśaśca vipulaṃ prāpnuhi tvaṃ mahābala || 2.85.60 ||
tathetyuktvā namaskṛtvā lokanāthaḥ satāṃ gatiḥ |
sudarśanaṃ mumocātha cakraṃ daityakulāntakam|| 61 ||
tannikumbhasya ciccheda śiraḥ pravarakuṇḍalam |
nārāyaṇabhujotsṛṣṭaṃ sūryamaṇḍalavarcasam || 62 ||
utpapāta śirastasya bhūmau jvalitakuṇḍalam |
meghamatto gireḥ śṛṅgānmayūra iva bhūtale || 63 ||
nikumbhe nihate tasmin devo bilvodakeśvaraḥ |
tutoṣa ca naravyāghra jagattrāsakare vibhuḥ || 64 ||
papāta puṣpavṛṣṭiśca śakrasṛṣṭā nabhastalāt |
devadundubhayaścaiva praṇedurarināśane 65 ||
nananda ca jagatkṛtsnaṃ munayaśca viśeṣataḥ |
daityakanyāśca bhagavān yadubhyaḥ śataśo dadau || 66 ||
kṣattriyāṇāṃ ca bhagavānsāntvayitvā punaḥ punaḥ |
ratnāni ca vicitrāṇi vāsāṃsi pravarāṇi ca || 67 ||
rathānāṃ vājiyuktānāṃ ṣaṭ sahasrāṇi keśavaḥ |
adadāt pāṇḍavebhyaśca prītātmā gadapūrvajaḥ || 68 ||
tadeva cātha pravaraṃ ṣaṭpuraṃ puravarddhanaḥ |
dvijāya brahmadattāya dadau tārkṣyavaradhvajaḥ || 69 ||
satre samāpte ca tadā śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ |
visarjayitvā tat kṣatraṃ pāṇḍavāṃśca mahābalaḥ || 2.85.70 ||
bilvodakeśvarasyātha samājamakarot prabhuḥ |
māṃsasūpasamākīrṇaṃ bahvannaṃ vyañjanākulam || 71 ||
niyuddhakuśalān mallān devo mallapriyastadā |
yodhayitvā dadau bhūri vittaṃ vastrāṇi cātmavān ||72||
mātāpitṛbhyāṃ sahito yadubhiśca mahābalaḥ |
abhivādya brahmadattaṃ yayau dvāravatīṃ purīm || 73 ||
sa viveśa purīṃ ramyāṃ hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākulām |
puṣpacitrapathāṃ vīro vandyamāno naraiḥ pathi || 74 ||
imaṃ yaḥ ṣaṭapuravadhaṃ vijayaṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ |
śṛṇuyād vā paṭhed vāpi yuddhe jayamavāpnuyāt|| 75||
aputro labhate putramadhano labhate dhanam |
vyādhito mucyate rogī baddhaścāpyatha bandhanāt || 76 ||
idaṃ puṃsavanaṃ proktaṃ garbhādhānaṃ ca bhārata |
śrāddheṣu paṭhitaṃ samyagakṣayyakaraṇaṃ smṛtam || 77 ||
idamamaravarasya bhārate prathitabalasya jayaṃ mahātmanaḥ |
satatamiha hi yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ sugatimito vrajate gatajvaraḥ || 78 ||
maṇikanakavicitrapāṇipādo niratiśayārkaguṇo'rihādināthaḥ |
caturudadhiśayaścaturvidhātmā jayati jagatpuruṣaḥ sahasranāmā ||79 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi ṣaṭpuravadhe pañcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 85 ||

<2.86>

ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
śruto'yaṃ ṣaṭpuravadho ramyo munivarottama |
puroktamandhakavadhaṃ vaiśampāyana kīrtaya || 1 ||
bhānumatyāśca haraṇaṃ nikumbhasya vadhaṃ tathā |
prabrūhi vadatāṃ śreṣṭha paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 2 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
ditirhateṣu putreṣu viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā |
tapasā''rādhayāmāsa mārīcaṃ kaśyapaṃ purā || 3 ||
tapasā kālayuktena tathā śuśrūṣayā muneḥ |
ānukūlyena ca tathā mādhuryeṇa ca bhārata || 4 ||
parituṣṭaḥ kaśyapastu tāmuvāca tapodhanaḥ |
parituṣṭo'smi te bhadre varaṃ varaya suvrate || 5 ||
ditiruvāca
hataputrāsmi bhagavan devairdharmabhṛtāṃ vara |
avadhyaṃ putramicchāmi devairamitavikramam || 6||
kaśyapa uvāca
avadhyaste suto devi dākṣāyaṇi bhavediti |
devānāṃ saṃśayo nātra kaścitkamalalocane || 7 ||
devadevamṛte rudraṃ tasya na prabhavāmyaham |
ātmā tataste putreṇa rakṣitavyo hi sarvathā || 8 ||
anvālabhata tāṃ devīṃ kaśyapaḥ satyavāgatha |
aṅgulyodaradeśe tu sā putraṃ suṣuve tataḥ || 9 ||
sahastrabāhuṃ kauravya sahasraśirasaṃ tathā |
dvisahasrekṣaṇaṃ caiva tāvaccaraṇameva ca || 2.86.10 ||
sa vrajatyandhavad yasmādanandho'pi hi bhārata |
tamandhako'yaṃ nāmneti procustatra nivāsinaḥ || 11 ||
avadhyo'smīti lokān sa sarvān bādhati bhārata |
haratyapi ca ratnāni sarvāṇyātmabalāśrayāt || 12 ||
vāsayatyātmavīryeṇa nigṛhyāpsarasāṃ gaṇān |
sa veśmanyūrjito'tyarthaṃ sarvalokabhayaṃkaraḥ || 13 ||
paradārāpaharaṇaṃ pararatnavilopanam |
cakāra satataṃ mohādandhakaḥ pāpaniścayaḥ || 14 ||
trailokyavijayaṃ kartumudyataḥ sa tu bhārata |
sahāyairasuraiḥ sārdhaṃ bahubhiḥ sarvadharṣibhiḥ || 15 ||
tacchrutvā bhagavāñchakraḥ kaśyapaṃ pitaraṃ bravīt |
andhakenedamārabdhamīdṛśaṃ munisattama || 16 ||
ājñāpaya vibho kāryamasmākaṃ samanantaram |
yavīyasaḥ kathaṃ nāma soḍhavyaṃ syānmune mayā || 17 ||
iṣṭaputre prahartavyaṃ kathaṃ nāma mayā vibho |
ihātrabhavatī kuryānmanyuṃ mayi hate sute || 18 ||
devendravacanaṃ śrutvā kaśyapo'thābravīnmuniḥ |
vārayiṣyāmi devendra sarvathā bhadramastu te || 19 ||
andhakaṃ vārayāmāsa dityā saha tu kaśyapaḥ |
trailokyavijayād vīraṃ kṛcchrakṛcchreṇa bhārata || 2.86.20 ||
vārito'pi sa duṣṭātmā bādhatyeva divaukasaḥ |
taistairupāyairduṣṭātmā pramathya ca tathāmarān || 21 ||
babhañja kānane vṛkṣānudyānāni ca durmatiḥ |
uccaiḥśravaḥsutānaśvān balādapyānayad divaḥ || 22 ||
nāgān diśāgajasutān divyānapi ca bhārata |
balāddharati devānāṃ paśyatāṃ varadarpitaḥ || 23 ||
devānāpyāyante tu ye yaśaistapasā tathā |
teṣāṃ cakāra vighnaṃ sa duṣṭātmā devakaṇṭakaḥ || 24 ||
nejuryajñaistrayo varṇāstepuśca na tapāṃsyapi |
andhakasya bhayād rājan yajñavighnāni kurvataḥ ||25 ||
tasyecchayā vāti vāyurādityaśca tapatyuta |
candramā vā sanakṣatro dṛśyate naiva vā punaḥ || 26||
na vrajanti vimānāni vihāyasi bhayāt prabho |

manoharataraṃ caiva bhaimānāmatitejasām || 68 ||

nanṛturmadhurārāvāḥ śikhaṇḍigaṇasaṃvṛtāḥ || 2.88.70 ||

bhramarairupagītāśca sragdāmāsaktavāsibhiḥ || 71 ||
nārāyaṇājñayā vṛkṣāḥ puṣpāṇi mumucurbhṛśam |
ṛtavaścārurūpāṇi vihāyasi gatāstathā || 72 ||
vavau manoharo vāto ratikhedaharaḥ sukhaḥ |
rajobhiḥ sarvapuṣpāṇāṃ pṛktaścandanaśaityabhṛt || 73 ||
śītoṣṇamicchatāṃ tatra babhūva vasudhāpate |
vāsudevaprasādena bhaimānāṃ krīḍatāṃ tadā || 74 ||
na kṣutpipāsā na glānirna cintā śoka eva ca|
āviveśa tadā bhaimān prabhāvāccakrapāṇinaḥ || 75 ||
apraśāntamahātūryā gītanṛtyopaśobhitāḥ |
babhūvuḥ sāgarakrīḍā bhaimānāmatitejasām || 76 ||
bahuyojanavistīrṇaṃ samudraṃ salilāśayam |
ruddhā cikrīḍurindrābhā bhaimāḥ kṛṣṇābhirakṣitāḥ || 77 ||
paricchadasyānurūpaṃ yānapātraṃ mahātmanaḥ |
nārāyaṇasya devasya vihitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā || 78 ||

kṛṣṇasya tāni sarvāṇi yānapātre'titejasaḥ || 79 ||

maṇivaiḍūryacitrāstāḥ kārtasvaravibhūṣitāḥ || 2.88.80 ||

ekonanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
reme balaścandanapaṅkadigdhaḥ kādambarīpānakalaḥ pṛthuśrīḥ |
raktekṣaṇo revatimāśrayitvā pralambabāhurlalitaprayātaḥ || 1 ||

rarāja rāmo'mbudamadhyametya sampūrṇabimbo bhagavānivenduḥ || 2 ||

athājñayā kaṃsanikumbhaśatrorudārarūpo'psarasāṃ gaṇaḥ saḥ |

cakrurhasantyaśca tathaiva rāsaṃ taddeśabhāṣākṛtiveṣayuktāḥ |
sahastatālaṃ lalitaṃ salīlaṃ varāṅganā maṅgalasambhṛtāṅgyaḥ || 7 ||

yaśodayā ca prathitaṃ yaśo'tha dāmodaratvaṃ ca janārdanasya |
vadhaṃ tathāriṣṭakadhenukābhyāṃ vraje ca vāsaṃ śakunīvadhaṃ ca || 9

sa kāliyo nāgapatirhrade ca kṛṣṇena dāntaśca yathā durātmā || 2.89.10 ||

caturyugānāṃ nṛpa revato'tha tataḥ pravṛttā ca kumārajātiḥ 78 ||
gāndharvajātiśca tathāparāpi dīpād yathā dīpaśatāni rājan |
viveda kṛṣṇaśca sa nāradaśca pradyumnamukhyairnṛpa bhaimamukhyaiḥ || 79 ||
vijñānametaddhi pare yathāvaduddeśamātrācca janāstu loke |
jānanti chālikyaguṇodayānāṃ toyaṃ nadīnāmathavā samudraḥ || 2.89.80 ||
jñātuṃ samartho hi mahāgirirvā phalāgrato vā guṇato'tha vāpi |
śakyaṃ na chālikyamṛte tapobhiḥ sthāne vidhānānyatha mūrcchanāsu || 81 ||
ṣaḍgrāmarāgepu ca tattu kāryaṃ tasyaikadeśāvayavena rājan |
leśābhidhānāṃ sukumārajātiṃ niṣṭhāṃ suduḥkhena narāḥ prayānti || 82 ||
chālikyagāndharvaguṇodayeṣu ye devagandharvamaharṣisaṃghāḥ |
niṣṭhāṃ prayāntītyavagaccha buddhyā chālikyamevaṃ madhusūdanena || 83 ||
bhaimottamānāṃ naradeva dattaṃ lokasya cānugrahakāmyayaiva |
gataṃ pratiṣṭhāmamaropageyaṃ bālā yuvānaśca tathaiva vṛddhāḥ || 84.||
krīḍanti bhaimāḥ prasavotsaveṣu pūrvaṃ tu bālāḥ samudāvahanti |
vṛddhāśca paścātpratimānayanti sthāneṣu nityaṃ pratimānayanti || 85 ||
martyeṣu martyān yadavo'tivīrāḥ svavaṃśadharme samanusmarantaḥ |
purātanaṃ dharmavidhānatajjñāḥ prītiḥ pramāṇaṃ na vayaḥ pramāṇam || 86 ||
prītipramāṇāni hi sauhṛdāni prītiṃ puraskṛtya hi te daśārhāḥ |
vṛṣṇyandhakāḥ putrasakhā babhūvurvisarjitāḥ keśivināśanena || 87 ||
svarge gatāścāpsarasāṃ samūhāḥ kṛtvā praṇāmaṃ madhukaṃsaśatroḥ |
prahṛṣṭarūpasya suhṛṣṭarūpā babhūva hṛṣṭaḥ suralokasaṅghaḥ || 88 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi bhānumatīharaṇe chālikyakrīḍāvarṇane ekonanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||89||

<2.90>

navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
nikumbhasya vadham vaiśampāyana uvāca
teṣāṃ krīḍāvasaktānāṃ yadūnāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām |
chidramāsādya durbuddhirdevaśatrurdurāsadaḥ || 1 ||
kanyāṃ bhānumatīṃ nāma bhānorduhitaraṃ nṛpa |
jahārātmavadhākāṅkṣī nikumbho nāma dānavaḥ || 2 ||
antarhito mohayitvā yadūnāṃ pramadājanam |
māyāvī māyayā rājan pūrvavairamanusmaran || 3 ||
bhrāturhiṃ vajranābhasya tasya kanyā prabhāvatī |
pradyumnena hṛtā vīra vajranābhastathā hataḥ || 4 ||
bhānoreva tathāraṇye vasatyavasareṇa hi |
asvādhīne durādharṣe chidrajño dānavādhamaḥ || 5 ||
kanyāpure mahānādaḥ sahasā samupasthitaḥ |
tasyāṃ hriyantyāṃ kanyāyāṃ rudantyāṃ samitiṃjaya || 6 ||
vasudebāhukau vīrau daṃśitau nirgatāvubhau |
ārtanādamupaśrutya bhānoḥ kanyāpure tadā || 7 ||
na dṛṣṭigocare tau tu dadṛśāte'pakāriṇam|
tathaiva daṃśitau yātau yatra kṛṣṇo mahābalaḥ || 8 ||
śrutārthaḥ svaṃ vimānaṃ tadāruroha janārdanaḥ |
pārthena sahitastārkṣyaṃ nāgaśatrumariṃdamaḥ || 9 ||
rathī tvamanugaccheti saṃdiśya makaradhvajam |
tvareti garuḍaṃ vīraḥ saṃdideśa ca kāśyapam || 2.90.10 ||
vajraṃ nagaramāyāntaṃ nikumbhaṃ raṇadurjayam |
pārthakṛṣṇau mahātmānāvāsedaturariṃdamau || 11 ||
pradyumnaśca mahātejā māyināṃ pravaro nṛpa |
nikumbhaścātha tān dṛṣṭvā tridhā''tmānamathākarot||12||
tān sarvān yodhayāmāsa nikumbhaḥ prahasanniva |
bahukaṇṭakagurvībhirgadābhiramaropamaḥ || 13 ||
savyenālambya hastena kanyāṃ bhānumatīṃ nṛpa |
dakṣiṇenātha hastena gadayā prāharat punaḥ || 14 ||
kanyārthaṃ na ca kṛṣṇau vā kāmo vā nṛpasattama |
nirdayaṃ praharanti sma nikumbhe ca mahāsure || 15 ||
samarthāste mahātmānaḥ śatruṃ hantuṃ durāsadāḥ |
niśaśvasurnarapate dayābhārāvapīḍitāḥ || 16 ||
śreṣṭho dhanuṣmatāṃ pārthaḥ sarvathā kuśalo yudhi |
nāgoṣṭravidhinā daityaṃ śarapaṅktyā jaghāna ha || 17 ||
te tu vaitastikairbāṇairvividhān dānavān yudhi |
na kanyāṃ kalayā yuktyā śikṣayā ca mahīpate || 18 ||
tataḥ sa kanyayā sārddha tatraivāntaradhīyata |
āsurīmāśrito māyāṃ na ca tāṃ vetti kaścana || 19 ||
taṃ kṛṣṇau raukmiṇeyaśca pṛṣṭhato'nuyayustadā |
hāritaḥ śakuno bhūtvā tasthāvatha mahāsuraḥ || 2.90.20 ||
taṃ bāṇaiḥ punarevātha vīro bhūyo dhanaṃjayaḥ |
vaitastikairmarmabhidbhiḥ kanyāṃ rakṣannatāḍayat || 21 ||
sa imāṃ pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ saptadvīpāṃ mahāsuraḥ |
babhrāmānugataścaiva tairvīrairarimardanaḥ || 22 ||
gokarṇasyopariṣṭāttu parvatasya mahāsuraḥ |
papāta velāṃ gaṅgāyāḥ puline saha kanyayā || 23 ||
na devā nāsurāścāpi laṅghayanti tapodhanāḥ |
gokarṇaṃ tejasā guptaṃ mahādevasya bhārata || 24 ||
etadantaramāsādya pradyumnaḥ śīghravikramaḥ |
kanyāṃ bhānumatīṃ bhaimo jagrāha raṇadurjayaḥ || 25 ||
asuraḥ so'rdito rājan kṛṣṇābhyāṃ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ |
tyaktvāthottaragokarṇaṃ nikumbho dakṣiṇāṃ diśam |
jagāma pṛṣṭhato yātau kṛṣṇau tārkṣyagatau tadā || 26 ||
viveśa ṣaṭpuraṃ caiva jñātīnāmālayaṃ tadā |
tatra vīrau guhādvāri kṛṣṇau rātrai tadoṣatuḥ || 27 ||
raukmiṇeyo'pi kṛṣṇena saṃdiṣṭo dvārakāṃ purīm|
anayad bhānutanayā prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā || 28 ||
nayitvā cāyayau vīraḥ ṣaṭpuraṃ dānavākulam |
dadarśa ca guhādvāri kṛṣṇau bhīmaparākramau || 29 ||
ūṣaturdvāramākramya ṣaṭapurasya mahābalau |
kṛṣṇau pradyumnasahitau nikumbhavadhakāṅkṣakṣiṇau || 2.90.30 ||
tato'nantarametasmād bilādatibalastadā |
nirjagāma balī yoddhuṃ nikumbho bhīmavikramaḥ || 31 ||
tasya nirgacchatastasmād bilātpārtho viśāmpate |
rurodha sarvato mārgaṃ śarairgāṇḍīvaniḥsṛtaiḥ || 32 ||
so'bhisṛtya gadāṃ ghorāmudyamya bahukaṇṭakām |
śirasyatāḍayat pārthaṃ nikumbho balināṃ varaḥ || 33 ||
adṛṣṭenāhato vīraḥ śirasyatha mumoha saḥ |
gadayābhihate pārthe raktaṃ vamati muhyati || 34 ||
hasitvā so'suro dṛpto raukmiṇeyamatāḍayat |
taṃ prāṅmukhamukhaṃ vīraṃ māyāvī māyināṃ varam |
adṛṣṭenāhato vīraḥ śirasyatha mumoha saḥ || 35 ||
tayāgatau tu dṛṣṭvā tau muhyamānau sutāḍitau |
abhidudrāva govindo nikumbhaṃ krodhamūrchitaḥ || 36 ||
kaumodakīṃ samudyamya gadapūrvodbhavo gadām |
tāvanyonyaṃ durādharṣau garjantāvabhipetatuḥ || 37 ||
airāvatagataḥ śakraḥ sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ saha |
dadarśa tanmahāyuddhaṃ ghoraṃ devāsuraṃ tadā || 38 ||
dṛṣṭvā devān hṛṣīkeśaścitrairyuddhairariṃdamaḥ |
iyeṣa dānavaṃ hantuṃ devānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 39 ||
sa maṇḍalāni citrāṇi darśayāmāsa keśavaḥ |
kaumodakīṃ mahābāhurlālayan yuddhakovidaḥ || 2.90.40 ||
tathaivāsuramukhyo'pi gadāṃ tāṃ bahukaṇṭakām |
śikṣayā bhrāmayāṇo'tha maṇḍalāni cacāra ha || 41 ||
vṛṣabhāviva garjantau bṛhantāviva kuñjarau |
iṣitāntaramāsādya kruddhau śālāvṛkāviva || 42 |
ājaghāna nikumbhastu gadayā gadapūrvajam |
spaṣṭāṣṭaghaṃṭayā vīra nādaṃ muktvātidāruṇam || 43 ||
tatkālameva kṛṣṇo'pi bhrāmayitvā mahāgadām |
nikumbhamūrddhani tadā pātayāmāsa bhārata || 44 ||
avaṣṭabhya muhūrtaṃ tu hariḥ kaumodakīṃ gadām |
tasthau jagadgururdhīmān mumoha patitaḥ kṣitau || 45 ||
hāhābhūtaṃ jagat sarvaṃ tatkālamabhavat tadā |
tathāgate vāsudeve naradeva mahātmani || 46 ||
ākāśagaṅgātoyena śītena ca sugandhinā |
siṣecāmṛtamiśreṇa kṛṣṇaṃ deveśvaraḥ svayam || 47 ||
nūnamātmecchayā kṛṣṇastathā cakre surottamaḥ |
ko hi śakto mahātmānaṃ yuddhe mohayituṃ harim || 48 ||
kṛṣṇaḥ pratyāgataprāṇaścakramudyamya bhārata |
pratīccheti durātmānamuvāca ripunāśanaḥ || 49 ||
nikumbho'pyatimāyāvī utpapāta durāsadaḥ |
śarīraṃ tat parityajya na tu taṃ vetti keśavaḥ || 2.90.50 ||
mumūrṣati mṛto vāyamiti matvā janārdanaḥ |
rarakṣa smaramāṇo'tha vīro vīravrataṃ vibho || 51 ||
atha pradyumnakaunteyāvāgatau labdhacetanau |
sthitau nārāyaṇābhyāśe nikumbhavadhaniścitau || 52 ||
pradyumno'pyatha māyāvī viditaḥ kṛṣṇamabravīt |
nikumbhastāta nāstyatra gataḥ kvāpi sudurmatiḥ || 53 ||
pradyumnenaivamukte tu tannanāśa kalevaram |
prajahāsātha bhagavānarjunena saha prabhuḥ || 54 ||
tadāyutasahasrāṇi nikumbhānāṃ janādhipa |
dadṛśuste tato vīrāḥ kṣitau divi ca sarvataḥ || 55 ||
sahasrāṇyeva kṛṣṇaṃ tu tathā pārthamariṃdama |
raukmiṇeyaṃ tathā vīraṃ tadadbhutamivābhavat || 56 ||
pāṇḍavasya dhanuḥ kecitkecidasya mahāśarān |
anye'sya jagṛhurhastāvanye pādau mahāsurāḥ || 57 ||
evaṃ grahāya taṃ vīramagamaṃste vihāyasi |
pārthānāmapi koṭyastu gṛhītānāṃ tadābhavan || 58 ||
nāntaṃ dadarśa kṛṣṇaśca kārṣṇiśca ripunāśanau |
vicchidya tau śarairvīrau nikumbhaṃ pārthavarjitau || 59 ||
ekaikastu dvidhā cchinno dvedhā bhavati bhārata |
divyajñānastadā kṛṣṇo bhagavānanudṛṣṭavān || 2.90.60 ||
nikumbhaṃ tattvataścāpi dadarśa madhusūdanaḥ |
sraṣṭāraṃ sarvamāyānāṃ hartāraṃ phālgunasya ca || 61 |
sa cakreṇa śirastasya cakartāsurasūdanaḥ |
paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhūtabhavyabhavo hariḥ || 62 ||
sa muktvā phālgunaṃ rājañchinne śirasi bhārata |
papātāsuramukhyo'tha cchinnamūla iva drumaḥ || 63 ||
athākāśagataṃ pārthaṃ patamānaṃ vihāyasaḥ |
kṛṣṇavākyena jagrāha kārṣṇirviyati mānada || 64 ||
nikumbhe patite bhūmau samāśvāsya dhanaṃjayam |
jagāma dvārakāṃ devaḥ pārthakāmasamanvitaḥ || 65 ||
samiyāya daśārho'tha dvārakāṃ mudito vibhuḥ |
nāradaṃ ca mahātmānaṃ vavande yadunandanaḥ || 66 ||
nārado'tha mahātejā bhānuṃ yādavamabravīt |
bhāno mā kārṣīrmanyuṃ tvaṃ śrūyatāṃ bhaimanandana || 67 ||
krīḍantyā raivatodyāne durvāsāḥ kopito'nayā |
sa śaśāpa tato roṣānmunirduhitaraṃ tava || 68 ||
atidurlalitaiḥ kanyā śatruhastaṃ gamiṣyati |
sutārthe te mayā sārddhaṃ munibhiḥ sa prasāditaḥ || 69 ||
bālāṃ vratavatīṃ kanyāmanāgasamimāṃ mune |
śaptavānasi dharmajña kathaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ vara |
anugrahaṃ vidhatsvātra vayaṃ vijñāpayāmahe || 2.90.70 ||
asmābhirevamuktastu durvāsā bhaimanandana |
uvācādhomukho bhūtvā muhūrtaṃ kṛpayānvitaḥ || 71 ||
yadavocamahaṃ vākyaṃ tat tathā na tadanyathā |
ripuhastamavaśyaṃ hi gamiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 72 ||
adūṣitā nu dharmeṇa bhartāramupalapsyati |
bahuputrā bahudhanā subhagā ca bhaviṣyati || 73 ||
sugandhagandhā ca sadā kumārī ca punaḥ punaḥ |
na ca śokamimaṃ ghoraṃ tanvaṅgī dhārayiṣyati || 74 ||
evaṃ bhānumatī vīra sahadevāya dīyatām |
śraddadhānaḥ sa śūraśca dharmaśīlaśca pāṇḍavaḥ || 75 ||
tato bhānumatīṃ bhānurdadau mādrīsutāya vai |
sahadevāya dharmātmā nāradasya vacaḥ smaran || 76 ||
ānītaḥ sahadevaśca preṣitaścakrapāṇinā |
vivāhe ca tadā vṛtte sabhāryaḥ sa purīṃ gataḥ || 77 ||
imaṃ kṛṣṇasya vijayaṃ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādatha |
vijayaṃ sarvakṛtyeṣu śraddadhāno labhennaraḥ || 78 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi bhānumatīharaṇe nikumbhavadho nāma navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 90 ||

<2.91>

ekanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
bhānumatyāpaharaṇaṃ vijayaṃ keśavasya ca |
chālikyanayanaṃ caiva devalokānmahāmune || 1 ||
krīḍāṃ ca sāgare divyāṃ vṛṣṇīnāmatitejasām |
aśrauṣaṃ paramāścaryaṃ mune dharmabhṛtāṃ vara || 2 ||
vajranābhavadho hyukto nikumbhavadhakīrtane |
tanme kautūhalaṃ śrotuṃ prasādād bhavato mune || 3 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
hanta te vartayiṣyāmi vajranābhavadhaṃ nṛpa |
vijayaṃ caiva kāmasya sāmbasyaiva ca bhārata || 4 ||
meroḥ sānau narapate tapaścakre mahāsuraḥ |
vajranābha iti khyāto niścitaḥ samitiṃjayaḥ || 5 ||
tasya tuṣṭo mahātejā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
vareṇa cchandayāmāsa tapasā paritoṣitaḥ || 6 ||
avadhyatvaṃ sa devebhyo vavre dānavasattamaḥ |
puraṃ vajrapuraṃ cāpi sarvaratnamayaṃ śubham || 7 ||
svacchandena praveśaśca na vāyorapi bhārata |
acintitena kāmānāmupapattirnarādhipa || 8 ||
śākhānagaramukhyānāṃ saṃvāhānāṃ śatāni ca |
nagarasyāprameyasya samantājjanamejaya || 9 ||
tathā tadabhavat tasya varadānena bhārata |
uvāsa vajranagare vajranābho mahāsuraḥ || 2.91.10 ||
koṭiśo varalabdhaṃ tamasurāḥ parivārya te |
ūṣurvajrapure rājan saṃvāheṣu tathaiva ca || 11 ||
śākhānagaramukhyeṣu ramyeṣu ca narādhipa |
hṛṣṭapuṣṭapramuditā nṛpa devasya śatravaḥ || 12 |
vajranābho'tha duṣṭātmā varadānena darpitaḥ |
purasya cātmanaścaiva jagad bādhitumudyataḥ || 13 ||
mahendramabravīd gatvā devalokaṃ viśāmpate |
ahamīśitumicchāmi trailokyaṃ pākaśāsana || 14 ||
athavā me prayacchasva yuddhaṃ devagaṇeśvara |
sāmānyaṃ hi jagatkṛtsnaṃ kāśyapānāṃ mahātmanām || 15||
sa bṛhaspatinā sārddhaṃ mantrayitvā maheśvaraḥ |
vajranābhaṃ suraśreṣṭhaḥ provāca kuruvaṃśaja || 16 ||
satreṣu dīkṣitaḥ saumya kaśyapo naḥ pitā muniḥ |
tasmin vṛtte yathānyāyyaṃ tathā sa hi kariṣyati || 17 ||
tataḥ sa pitaraṃ gatvā kaśyapaṃ dānavo'bravīt |
yathoktaṃ devarājena tamuvācātha kaśyapaḥ || 18 ||
satre vṛtte kariṣyāmi yathā nyāyyaṃ bhaviṣyati |
tvaṃ tu vajrapure putra vasa gaccha samāhitaḥ || 19 ||
evamukte vajranābhaḥ svameva nagaraṃ gataḥ |
mahendro'pi yayau devo dvārakāṃ dvāraśālinīm || 2.91.20 ||
gatvā cāntarhito devo vāsudevamathābravīt |
vajranābhasya vṛttāntaṃ tamuvāca janārdanaḥ || 21 ||
śaurerupasthito deva vājimedho mahākratuḥ |
tasmin vṛtte vajranābhaṃ pātayiṣyāmi vāsava || 22 ||
tatropāyaṃ praveśe tu cintayāvaḥ satāṃ gate |
nānicchayā praveśo'sti tatra vāyorapi prabho || 23 ||
tato gato devarājo vāsudevena satkṛtaḥ |
vājimedhe ca samprāpte vasudevasya bhārata || 24 ||
tasmin yajñe vartamāne praveśārthaṃ surottamau |
cintayāmāsaturvīrau devarājācyutāvubhau || 25 ||
tatra yajñe vartamāne sunāṭyena naṭastadā |
maharṣīstoṣayāmāsa bhadranāmeti nāmataḥ || 26 ||
taṃ vareṇa muniśreṣṭhāśchandayāmāsurātmavat |
sa vavre tu naṭo bhadro varaṃ deveśvaropamaḥ || 27 ||
devendrakṛṣṇacchandena sarasvatyā pracoditaḥ |
praṇipatya muniśreṣṭhānaśvamedhe samāgatān || 28 ||
naṭa uvāca
bhojyo dvijānāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhaveyaṃ munisattamāḥ |
saptadvīpāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ vicareyamimāmaham || 29 ||
prasiddhākāśagamanaḥ śaknuvaṃśca viśeṣataḥ |
avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sthāvarā ye ca jaṅgamāḥ || 2.91.30 |
yasya yasya ca veṣeṇa praviśeyamahaṃ khalu |
mṛtasya jīvato vāpi bhāvyenotpāditasya vā || 31 ||
satūryastādṛśaḥ syāṃ vai jarārogavivarjitaḥ |
tuṣyeyurmunayo nityamanye ca mama sarvadā || 32 ||
evamastviti samprokto brāhmaṇairnṛpate naṭaḥ |
saptadvīpāṃ vasumatīṃ paryaṭatyamaropamaḥ || 33 ||
purāṇi dānavendrāṇāmuttarāṃśca kurūṃstathā |
bhadrāśvān ketumālāṃśca kālāmradvīpameva ca || 34 ||
parvaṇīṣu tu sarvāsu dvārakāṃ yadumaṇḍitām |
āyāti varadattaḥ sa lokavīro mahānaṭaḥ || 35 ||
tato haṃsān dhārtarāṣṭrān devalokanivāsinaḥ |
uvāca bhagavāñchakraḥ sāntvayitvā sureśvaraḥ || 36 ||
bhavanto bhrātaro'smākaṃ kāśyapā devapakṣiṇaḥ |
vimānavāhā devānāṃ sukṛtīnāṃ tathaiva ca || 37 ||
devānāmasti kartavyaṃ kāryaṃ śatruvadhānvitam |
tatkartavyaṃ na mantraśca bhettavyo vaḥ kathaṃcana || 38 ||
na kurvatāṃ devatājñāmugro daṇḍaḥ patedapi |
sarvatrāpratiṣiddhaṃ vo gamanaṃ haṃsasattamāḥ || 39 ||
gatvā praveśyamanyeṣāṃ vajranābhapurottamam |
ito'ntaḥpuravāpīṣu caradhvamucitaṃ hi vaḥ || 2.91.40 ||
tasyāsti kanyāratnaṃ hi trailokyātiśayaṃ śubham |
nāmnā prabhāvatī nāma candrābheva prabhāvatī || 41 ||
varadānena sā labdhā mātrā kila varānanā |
haimavatyā mahādevyāḥ sakāśāditi naḥ śrutam || 42||
svayaṃvarā ca sā kanyā bandhubhiḥ sthāpitā satī |
ātmecchayā patiṃ haṃsā varayiṣyati śobhanā || 43 ||
tadbhavadbhirguṇā vācyāḥ pradyumnasya mahātmanaḥ |
sadbhūtāḥ kularūpasya śīlasya vayasastathā || 44 ||
yadā sā raktabhāvā ca vajranābhasutā satī |
tasyāḥ sakāśāt saṃdeśo nayitavyaḥ samādhinā ||45||
pradyumnasya punastasmādānayadhvaṃ tathaiva ca |
svabuddhyā prāptakālaṃ ca saṃvidheyaṃ hitaṃ mama || 46
netravaktraprasādaśca kartavyastatra sarvathā || 47 ||
tathā tathā guṇā vācyāḥ pradyumnasya mahātmanaḥ |
yathā yathā prabhāvatyā manastatra bhavet sthitam || 48 ||
vṛttāntaścānudivasaṃ pradeyo mama sarvathā |
dvāravatyāṃ ca kṛṣṇasya bhrāturmama yavīyasaḥ || 49 ||
tāvadyatnaśca kartavyaḥ pradyumno yāvadātmavit |
paryāvarted varārohāṃ vajranābhasutāṃ vibhuḥ || 2.91.50 ||
avadhyāste tu devānāṃ brahmaṇo varadarpitāḥ |
devaputrairhi hantavyāḥ pradyumnapramukhairyudhi || 51 ||
naṭo dattavarastasya veṣamāsthāya yādavāḥ |
pradyumnādyā gamiṣyanti vajranābhavināśanāḥ || 52 ||
etacca sarvaṃ kartavyamanyacca sarvameva hi |
prāptakālaṃ vidhātavyamasmākaṃ priyakāmyayā || 53 ||
praveśastatra devānāṃ nāsti haṃsāḥ kathaṃcana |
vajranābhepsite tatra pradeśe khalu sarvathā || 54 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi vajranābhavadhe ekanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 91 ||

<2.92>

dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
te vāsavavacaḥ śrutvā haṃsā vajrapuraṃ yayuḥ |
pūrvocitaṃ hi gamanaṃ teṣāṃ tatra janādhipa || 1 ||
te dīrghikā su ramyāsu nipeturvīra pakṣiṇaḥ |
padmotpalairāvṛtāsu kāñcanaiḥ sparśanakṣamaiḥ || 2 ||
te vai nadanto madhuraṃ saṃskṛtāpūrvabhāṣiṇaḥ |
pūrvamapyāgatāste tu vismayaṃ janayanti hi || 3 ||
antaḥpuropabhogyāsu cerurvāpīṣu te nṛpa |
dṛṣṭāste vajranābhasya triviṣṭapanivāsinaḥ || 4 ||
ālapantaḥ sumadhuraṃ dhārtarāṣṭrā janeśvara |
sa tānuvāca daiteyo dhārtarāṣṭrānidaṃ vacaḥ || 5 ||
triviṣṭape nityaratā bhavantaścārubhāṣiṇaḥ |
yadaivehonsavo'smākaṃ bhavadbhiravagamyate || 6 ||
āgantavyaṃ jālapādāḥ svamidaṃ bhavatāṃ gṛham |
visrabdhaṃ ca praveṣṭavyaṃ triviṣṭapanivāsibhiḥ || 7 ||
te tathoktāḥ śakunayo vajranābhena bhārata |
tathetyuktvā hi viviśurdānavendraniveśanam || 8 ||
cakruḥ paricayaṃ te ca devakāryavyapekṣayā |
mānuṣālāpinaste tu kathāścakruḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ || 9 ||
vaṃśabaddhāḥ kāśyapānāṃ sarvakalyāṇabhāginām |
striyo remurviśeṣeṇa śṛṇvantyaḥ saṅgatāḥ kathāḥ || 2.92.10 ||
vicarantastato haṃsā dadṛśuścāruhāsinīm |
prabhāvatīṃ varārohāṃ vajranābhasutāṃ tadā || 11 ||
haṃsāḥ paricitāṃ cakrustāṃ tataścāruhāsinīm |
sakhīṃ śucimukhīṃ cakre haṃsīṃ rājasutā tadā || 12 ||
sā tāṃ kacitpapraccha vajranābhasutāṃ sakhīm |
viśrambhitāṃ pṛthaksūktairākhyānakaśatairvarām || 13 ||
trailokyasundarīṃ vedmi tvāmahaṃ hi prabhāvati |
rūpaśīlaguṇairdevi kiṃcit tvāṃ vaktumutsahe || 14||
vyatikrāmati te bhīru yauvanaṃ cāruhāsini |
yadatītaṃ punarnaiti gataṃ srota ivāmbhasaḥ || 15 ||
kāmopabhogatulyā hi ratirdevi na vidyate |
strīṇāṃ jagati kalyāṇi satyametad bravīmi te || 16 ||
svayaṃvare ca nyastā tvaṃ pitrā sarvāṅgaśobhane |
na ca kāṃścid varayase devāsurakulodbhavān || 17 ||
vrīḍitā yānti suśroṇi pratyākhyātāstvayā śubhe |
rūpaśauryaguṇairyuktān sadṛśāṃstvaṃ kulasya hi || 18 ||
ihaiṣyati kimarthaṃ tvāṃ pradyumno rukmiṇīsutaḥ || 19 ||
trailokye yasya rūpeṇa sadṛśo na kulena vā |
guṇairvā cārusarvāṅgi śauryeṇāpyati vā śubhe || 2.92.20 ||
deveṣu devaḥ suśroṇi dānaveṣu ca dānavaḥ |
mānuṣeṣvapi dharmātmā manuṣyaḥ sa mahābalaḥ || 21 ||
yaṃ sadā devi dṛṣṭvā hi sravanti jaghanāni hi |
āpīnānīva dhenūnāṃ srotāṃsi saritāmiva || 22 ||
na pūrṇacandreṇa mukhaṃ nayane vā kuśeśayaiḥ |
utsahe nopamātuṃ hi mṛgendreṇātha vā gatim || 23 ||
jagataḥ sāramuddhṛtya putraḥ sa vihitaḥ śubhe |
kṛtyānaṅgaṃ vare sāṅgaṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || 24 ||
hṛtena śambaro bālye yena pāpo nibarhitaḥ |
māyāśca sarvāḥ samprāptā na ca śīlaṃ vināśitam ||25 ||
yānyānguṇānpṛthuśroṇi manasā kalpayiṣyasi |
eṣṭavyāstriṣu lokeṣu pradyumne sarva eva te || 26 ||
rucyā vahnipratīkāśaḥ kṣamayā pṛthivīsamaḥ |
tejasā sūryasadṛśo gāmbhīryeṇa hradopamaḥ |
prabhāvatīṃ śucimukhīṃ tvitīhovāca bhāminī || 27 ||
prabhāvatyuvāca
viṣṇurmānuṣalokasthaḥ śrutaḥ subahuśo mayā |
pituḥ kathayataḥ saumye nāradasya ca dhīmataḥ || 28 ||
śatruḥ kila sa daityānāṃ varjanīyaḥ sadānaghe |
kulāni kila daityānāṃ tena dagdhāni mānini || 29 ||
pradīptena rathāṅgena śārṅgeṇa gadayā tathā |
śākhānagaradeśeṣu vasanti kila ye'surāḥ || 2.92.30 ||
ityete dānavendreṇa saṃdiśyante hi taṃ prati |
manoratho hi sarvāsāṃ strīṇāmeva śucismite || 31 ||
bhaveddhi me patikulaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pitṛkulāditi |
yadi nāmābhyupāyaḥ syāt tasyehāgamanaṃ prati || 32 ||
mahānanugraho me syātkulaṃ syātpāvitaṃ ca me |
samarthanāṃ me pṛṣṭā tvaṃ prayaccha śucilāpini || 33 ||
pradyumnaḥ syādyathā bhartā sa me vṛṣṇikulodbhavaḥ |
atyantavairī daityānāmudvejanakaro hariḥ || 34 ||
asurāṇāṃ striyo vṛddhāḥ kathayantyo mayā śrutāḥ |
pradyumnasya tathā janma purastādapi me śrutam || 35 |
yathā ca tena nihato balavān kālaśambaraḥ |
hṛdi me vartate nityaṃ pradyumnaḥ khalu sattame || 36 ||
hetuḥ sa nāsti syāt tena yathā mama samāgamaḥ |
dāsī tavāhaṃ sakhyārhe dūtye tvāṃ ca visarjaye || 37 ||
paṇḍitāsi vadopāyaṃ mama tasya ca saṃgame |
tatastāṃ sāntvayitvā sā prahasantīdamabravīt || 38 ||
śucimukhyuvāca
tatra dūtī gamiṣyāmi tavāhaṃ cāruhāsini |
imāṃ bhaktiṃ tavodārāṃ pravakṣyāmi śucismite || 39 ||
tathā caiva kariṣyāmi yathaiṣyati tavāntikam |
sākṣātkāmena suśroṇi bhaviṣyati sakāminī || 2.92.40||
iti me bhāṣitaṃ nityaṃ smarethāḥ śucilocane |
kathākuśalatāṃ pitre kathayasvāyatekṣaṇe || 41||
mama tvaṃ tatra me devi hitaṃ samyak prapatsyase |
ityuktā sā tathā cakre yattat sā tāmathābravīt||42||
dānavendraśca tāṃ haṃsīṃ papracchāntaḥpure tadā |
prabhāvatyā samākhyātā kathākuśalatā tava || 43 ||
tattvaṃ śucimukhi brūhi kathāṃ yogyatayā vare |
kiṃ tvayā dṛṣṭamāścaryaṃ jagatyuttamapakṣiṇi || 44 ||
adṛṣṭapūrvamanyairvā yogyāyogyamanindite |
sovāca vajranābhaṃ tu haṃsī naravarottama || 45 ||
śrūyatāmityathāmantrya dānavendraṃ mahādyutim |
dṛṣṭā me śāṇḍilī nāma sādhvī dānavasattama |
āścaryaṃ karma kurvantī merupārśve manasvinī || 46 ||
sumanāścaiva kauśalyā sarvabhūtahite ratā |
kathaṃcid varaśāṇḍilyāḥ śailaputryāḥ śubhā sakhī||47||
naṭaścaiva mayā dṛṣṭo munidattavaraḥ śubhaḥ |
kāmarūpī ca bhojyaśca trailokye nityasammataḥ || 48 ||
kurūn yātyuttarān vīra kālāmradvīpameva ca |
bhadrāśvān ketumālāṃśca dvīpānanyāṃstathānagha || 49 ||
devagandharvageyāni nṛtyāni vividhāni ca |
sa vetti devān nṛtyena vismāpayati sarvathā || 2.92.50 ||
vajranābha uvāca
śrutametanmayā haṃsi na cirādiva vistaram |
cāraṇānāṃ kathayatāṃ siddhānāṃ ca mahātmanām || 51 ||
kutūhalaṃ mamāpyasti sarvathā pakṣinandini |
naṭe dattavare tasmin saṃstavastu na vidyate || 52 ||
haṃsyuvāca
saptadvīpān vicarati naṭaḥ sa ditijottama |
guṇavantaṃ janaṃ śrutvā guṇakāryaḥ sa sarvathā || 53 ||
tava cecchṛṇuyād vīra sadbhūtaṃ guṇavistaram |
naṭaṃ tadāgataṃ viddhi puraṃ tava mahāsura || 54 ||
vajranābha uvāca
upāyaḥ sṛjatāṃ haṃsi yeneha sa naṭaḥ śubhe |
āgacchenmama bhadraṃ te viṣayaṃ pakṣinandini || 55 ||
te haṃsā vajranābhena kāryahetorvisarjitāḥ |
devendrāyātha kṛṣṇāya śaśaṃsuḥ sarvameva tat || 56 ||
adhokṣajena pradyumno niyuktastatra karmaṇi |
prabhāvatyāśca saṃsarge vajranābhavadhe tathā || 57 ||
daivīṃ māyāṃ samāśritya saṃvidhāya harirnaṭam |
naṭaveṣeṇa bhaimānāṃ preṣayāmāsa bhārata || 58 ||
pradyumnaṃ nāyakaṃ kṛtvā sāmbaṃ kṛtvā vidūṣakam |
pāripārśve gadaṃ vīramanyān bhaimāṃstathaiva ca || 59 ||
vāramukhyā naṭīḥ kṛtvā tattūryasadṛśāstadā |
tathaiva bhadraṃ bhadrasya sahāyāṃśca tathāvidhān || 2.92.60 ||
pradyumnavihitaṃ ramyaṃ vimānaṃ te mahārathāḥ |
jagmurāruhya kāryārthaṃ devānāmamitaujasām || 61 ||
ekaikasya samā rūpe puruṣāḥ puruṣasya te |
strīṇāṃ ca sadṛśāḥ sarve te svarūpairnarādhipāḥ || 62 ||
te vajranagarasyātha śākhānagaramuttamam |
jagmurdānavasaṃkīrṇaṃ supuraṃ nāma nāmataḥ || 63 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi vajranābha
pradyumnādigamane dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 92 ||

<2.93>

vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ supuravāsīnāmasurāṇāṃ narādhipa |
dadāvājñāṃ vajranābho dīyatāṃ gṛhamuttamam || 1 ||
ātithyaṃ kriyatāmeṣāṃ bahuratnamupāyanam |
vāsāṃsi suvicitrāṇi sukhāya janarañjanam || 2 ||
bharturājñāṃ samālabhya tathā cakruśca sarvaśaḥ |
pūrvaśruto naṭaḥ prāptaḥ kautūhalamajījanat || 3 ||
naṭasyātha dadurdaityāḥ satkāraṃ parayā mudā |
paryāyārthe daduścāpi ratnāni subahūnyatha || 4 ||
tataḥ sa nanṛte tatra varadatto naṭastathā |
supure puravāsīnāṃ paraṃ harṣaṃ samādadhat || 5 ||
rāmāyaṇaṃ mahākāvyamuddiśya nāṭakaṃ kṛtam |
janma viṣṇorameyasya rākṣasendravadhepsayā || 6 ||
lomapādo daśaratha ṛṣyaśṛṅgaṃ mahāmunim |
śāntāmapyānayāmāsa gaṇikābhiḥ sahānagha || 7 ||
rāmalakṣyaṇaśatrughnā bharataścaiva bhārata |
ṛṣyaśṛṅgaśca śāntā ca tathārūpairnaṭaiḥ kṛtāḥ || 8 ||
tatkālajīvino vṛddhā dānavā vismaye gatāḥ |
ācacakṣuśca teṣāṃ vai rūpatulyatvamacyuta || 9 ||
saṃsphārābhinayau teṣāṃ prastāvānāṃ ca dhāraṇam |
dṛṣṭvā sarve praveśaṃ ca dānavā vismayaṃ gatāḥ || 2.93.10 ||
te raktā vismayaṃ nedurasurāḥ parayā mudā |
utthāyotthāya nāṭyasya viṣayeṣu punaḥ punaḥ || 11 ||
dadurvastrāṇi tuṣṭāśca graiveyavalayāni ca |
hārān manoharāṃścaiva hemavaiḍūryabhūṣitān || 12 ||
pṛthagartheṣu datteṣu lokaiste tuṣṭuvurnaṭāḥ |
asurāṃśca munīṃścaiva gotrairabhijanairapi || 13 ||
preṣitaṃ vajranābhasya śākhānagaravāsibhiḥ |
naṭasya divyarūpasya narendrāgamanaṃ tadā || 14 |||
purā śrutārtho daityendraḥ preṣayāmāsa bhārata |
ānīyatāṃ vajrapuraṃ naṭo'sāviti harṣitaḥ || 15 ||
dānavendravacaḥ śrutvā śākhānagaravāsibhiḥ |
nītā vajrapuraṃ ramyaṃ naṭaveṣeṇa yādavāḥ || 16 ||
āvāsaśca tato dattaḥ sukṛto viśvakarmaṇā |
eṣṭavyaṃ yaśca tat sarvaṃ dattaṃ śataguṇottaram || 17 ||
atha kālotsavaṃ cakre vajranābho mahāsuraḥ |
kārayāmāsa ramyaṃ ca camūvāṭaṃ prahṛṣṭavān || 18 ||
tatastān pariviśrāntān prekṣārthāya pracodayat |
dattvā ratnāni bhūrīṇi vajranābho mahābalaḥ || 19 ||
upaviṣṭaśca tān draṣṭuṃ saha jñātibhirātmavān |
channe cāntaḥpuraṃ sthāpya cakṣurdṛśye narādhipa || 2.93.20 ||
bhaimāpi baddhanepathyā naṭaveṣadharāstathā |
kāryārthe bhīmakarmāṇo nṛtyārthamupacakramuḥ || 21 ||
tato ghanaṃ sasuṣiraṃ murajānakabhūṣitam |
tantrīsvaragaṇairviddhānātodyānanvavādayan || 22 ||
tatastu devagāndhāraṃ chālikyaṃ śravaṇāmṛtam |
bhaimastriyaḥ prajagire manaḥśrotrasukhāvaham || 23 ||
āgāndhāragrāmarāgaṃ gaṅgāvataraṇaṃ tathā |
viddhamāsāritaṃ ramyaṃ jagire svarasampadā || 24 ||
layatālasamaṃ śrutvā gaṅgāvataraṇaṃ śubham |
asurāṃstoṣayāmāsurutthāyotthāya bhārata || 25 ||
nāndiṃ ca vādayāmāsuḥ pradyumno gada eva ca |
sāmbaśca vīryasampannaḥ kāryārthaṃ naṭatāṃ gataḥ || 26 ||
nāndyante ca tadā ślokaṃ gaṅgāvataraṇāśritam |
raukmiṇeyastadovāca samyak svabhinayānvitam || 27||
rambhābhisāraṃ kauberaṃ nāṭakaṃ nanṛtustataḥ |
śūro rāvaṇarūpeṇa rambhāveṣā manovatī || 28 ||
nalakūbarastu pradyumnaḥ sāmbastasya vidūṣakaḥ |
kailāso rūpitaścāpi māyayā yadunandanaiḥ || 29 |
śāpaśca dattaḥ kruddhena rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ |
nalakūbareṇa ca yathā rambhā cāpyatha sāntvitā || 2.93.30 ||
etat prakaraṇaṃ vīrā nanṛturyadunandanāḥ |
nāradasya muneḥ kīrtiṃ sarvajñasya mahātmanaḥ || 31 ||
pādoddhāreṇa nṛtyena tathaivābhinayena ca |
tuṣḍhuvurdānavā vīrā bhaimānāmatitejasām || 32 ||
te dadurvastramukhyāni ratnānyābharaṇāni ca |
hārāṃstaralaviddhāṃśca vaiḍūryamaṇibhūṣitān || 33 ||
vimānāni vicitrāṇi rathāṃścākāśagāminaḥ |
gajānākāśagāṃścaiva divyanāgakulodbhavān || 34 ||
candanāni ca divyāni śītāni rasavanti ca |
gurūṇyagurumukhyāni gandhāḍhyāni ca bhārata || 35 ||
cintāmaṇīnudārāṃśca cintite sarvakāmadān |
prekṣāsu tāsu bahvīṣu dadanto dānavāstathā || 36 ||
dhanaratnairvirahitāḥ kṛtāḥ puruṣasattama |
striyo dānavamukhyānāṃ tathaiva ca janeśvara || 37 ||
tato haṃsī prabhāvatyāḥ sakhī prāha prabhāvatīm |
gatāsmi dvārakāṃ ramyāṃ bhaimaguptāmanindite || 38 ||
pradyumnaśca mayā dṛṣṭo vivikte cārulocane |
bhaktiśca kathitā tasya mayā tava śucismite || 39 ||
tena hṛṣṭena kālaśca kṛtaḥ kamalalocane |
adya pradoṣasamaye tvayā saha samāgame || 2.93.40||
tadadya ruciraśroṇi tava priyasamāgamaḥ |
na hyātmavati bhāṣanti mithyā bhaimakulodbhavāḥ || 41 ||
tataḥ prabhāvatī hṛṣṭā haṃsīṃ tāmidamabravīt |
uṣitāsi mamāvāse svaptumarhasi sundari || 42 ||
tvayāhaṃ sahitā''vāse draṣṭumicchāmi kaiśavim |
niḥsādhvasā bhaviṣyāmi tvayā saha vihaṅgame || 43 ||
haṃsī tatheti covāca sakhīṃ kamalalocanām |
āruroha ca taddharmyaṃ prabhāvatyā vihaṅgamā || 44 ||
viśvakarmakṛte tatra harmyapṛṣṭhe prabhāvatī |
saṃvidhānaṃ cakārāśu pradyumnāgamanakṣamam || 45 ||
tasmin kṛte saṃvidhāne kāmamānayituṃ yayau |
prabhāvatīmanujñāpya haṃsī vāyusamā gatau || 46 ||
naṭaveṣadharaṃ kāmaṃ gatvovāca śucismitā |
adya bhūtaḥ sa bhagavan samayo vartate niśi || 47 ||
tatheti prāha tāṃ kāmaḥ sā nivṛttātha pakṣiṇī |
abhyāgatā ca sā haṃsī prabhāvatimathābravīt |
abhyeti raukmiṇeyo'sāvāśvasāyatalocane || 48 ||
pradyumno nīyamānaṃ tu dadṛśe mālyamātmavān |
bhramarairāvṛtaṃ vīraḥ sugandhamarimardanaḥ || 49 ||
nililye tatra mālye tu bhūtvā madhukarastadā |
prabhāvatyā nīyamāne viditārthaḥ pratāpavān || 2.93.50 ||
praveśitaṃ ca tanmālyaṃ strībhirmadhukarāyutam |
upanītaṃ prabhāvatyai strībhistad bhramarāvṛtam || 51 ||
avidūre ca vinyastaṃ prabhāvatyā janādhipa |
bhramarāste yayuḥ saumya saṃdhyākāle hyupasthite || 52 ||
sa bhaimapravaro vīrastaiḥ sahāyairvihīnataḥ |
karṇotpale prabhāvatyā nililye śanakairiva || 53 ||
tataḥ prabhāvatī haṃsīmuvāca vadatāṃ varā |
udyataṃ pūrṇacandraṃ sā samīkṣyātimanoharam || 54 ||
sakhi dahyanti me'ṅgāni mukhaṃ ca pariśuṣyati |
autsukyaṃ hṛdi cātīva ko'yaṃ vyādhiranauṣadhaḥ || 55 ||
dadhad dviguṇamautsukyamasau pūrṇaniśākaraḥ |
navoditaḥ śītaraśmiḥ sakhyaṃ harati ca priyaḥ || 56 ||
na dṛṣṭapūrvo hi mayā śrutamātreṇa kāṅkṣitaḥ |
aho dhūmayate'ṅgāni strīsvabhāvasya dhik khalu || 57 ||
kalpayāmi yathābuddhyā yadi nābhyeti me priyaḥ |
kumudvatīgataṃ mārgaṃ hā gamiṣyāmyakiṃcanā || 58 ||
madanāśīviṣeṇāsmi hā hā daṣṭā manasvinī |
śītavīryāḥ prakṛtyaiva jagato hrādanāḥ sukhāḥ |
dahanti mama gātrāṇi kiṃ nu candragabhastayaḥ || 59 ||
prakṛtyā śītalo vāyurnānāpuṣparajovahaḥ |
dāvāgnisadṛśo me'dya dandahīti śubhāṃ tanum || 2.93.60 ||
tataḥ saṃkalpaye eva sthairyaṃ kāryamivātmanaḥ |
nāvatiṣṭhati nirvīryaṃ manaḥ sakalpadharṣitam || 61 ||
vimanaskāsmi muhyāmi vepathurme mahān hṛdi |
bambhramīti ca me dṛṣṭirhā hā yāmi dhruvaṃ kṣayam || 62 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi pradyumnagamane trinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||93||

<2.94>

caturnavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
āviṣṭeyaṃ mayā bālā sarvathetyavagamya tu |
kārṣṇirhṛṣṭena manasā haṃsīmidamuvāca ha || 1 ||
daityendratanayāṃ prāptamavagacchasva māmiha |
ṣaṭpadaiḥ saha ṣaṭpādo bhūtvā mālye nilīya hi || 2 ||
vidheyo'smi prabhāvatyā yatheṣṭaṃ mayi vartatām |
ityuktvā darśayāmāsa surūpo rūpamātmanaḥ || 3 ||
taddharmyapṛṣṭhaṃ prabhayā dyotitaṃ tasya dhīmataḥ |
abhibhūtā prabhā caiva rājaṃścandrodbhavā śubhā || 4 ||
prabhāvatyāstu taṃ dṛṣṭvā vavṛdhe kāmasāgaraḥ |
candrasyevodaye prāpte parvaṇyāṃ saritāṃ patiḥ || 5 ||
salajjādhomukhī kiñcitkiñcittiryagavekṣiṇī|
prabhāvatī tadā tasthau niścalaṃ kamalekṣaṇā || 6 ||
kareṇādhaḥpradeśe tāṃ cārubhūṣaṇabhūṣitām |
spṛṣṭvovāca varārohāṃ romāñcitatanustataḥ || 7 ||
manorathaśatairlabdhaṃ kiṃ pūrṇendusamaprabham |
adhomukhaṃ mukhaṃ kṛtvā na māṃ kiñcitprabhāṣase || 8 ||
prabhopamardaṃ mā kārṣīrvadanasya varānane |
sādhvasaṃ tyajyatāṃ bhīru dāsaḥ sādhvanugṛhyatām || 9 ||
na kālamiva paśyāmi bhīru bhīrutvamutsṛja |
yācāmyeṣo'ñjaliṃ kṛtvā prāptakālaṃ nibodha me || 2.94.10 ||
gāndharveṇa vivāhena kuruṣvānugrahaṃ mama |
deśakālānurūpeṇa rūpeṇāpratimā satī || 11 ||
upaspṛśya tato bhaimo maṇisthaṃ jātavedasam |
juhāva samaye vīraḥ puṣpairmantrānudīrayan || 12 ||
jagrāhātha karaṃ tasyā varābharaṇabhūṣitam |
cakre pradakṣiṇaṃ caivaṃ taṃ maṇisthaṃ hutāśanam || 13 ||
prajajvāla sa tejasvī mānayannacyutātmajam|
bhagavāñjagataḥ sākṣī śubhasyāthāśubhasya ca || 14
uddiśya dakṣiṇāṃ vīro viprāṇāṃ yadunandanaḥ |
uvāca haṃsīṃ dvārasthāṃ tiṣṭhāvāṃ rakṣa pakṣiṇi || 15 ||
tasyāṃ praṇamya yātāyāṃ kāmastāṃ cārulocanām |
prahāya dakṣiṇe haste nināya śayanottamam || 16 ||
ūrāvevopaveśyaināṃ sāntvayitvā punaḥ punaḥ |
cucumba śanakairgaṇḍaṃ vāsayan mukhamārutaiḥ || 17 ||
tato'syāśca papau vaktrapadmaṃ madhukaro yathā |
āliliṅge ca suśroṇīṃ krameṇa ratikovidaḥ || 18 ||
arīramad rahasyenāṃ na codvejitavāṃstadā |
apakṛṣṭaṃ caratyarthaṃ ratikāryaviśāradaḥ |
uvāsa sa tayā sārddhaṃ raman kṛṣṇasutaḥ prabhuḥ || 19 ||
aruṇodayakāle ca yayau yatra naṭālayam |
akāmayā prabhāvatyā kathañcitsa visarjitaḥ || 2.94.20 ||
tāmeva manasā kāntāṃ kāntarūpāṃ samudvahan |
ta ūṣurnaṭaveṣeṇa kāryārthaṃ bhaimavaṃśajāḥ || 21 ||
pratīkṣantastadā vākyamindrakeśavayostadā |
udyogaṃ vajranābhasya trailokyavijayaṃ prati || 22 ||
pratīkṣanto mahātmāno guhyasaṃrakṣaṇe ratāḥ |
kaśyapasya muneḥ satraṃ yāvat tāvannarādhipa || 23 ||
devāsurāṇāṃ sarveṣāmavirodho mahātmanām |
trailokyavijayārthāya yatatāṃ dharmacāriṇām || 24 ||
evaṃ kālaṃ pratīkṣāṇāṃ vasatāṃ tatra dhīmatām |
samprāptaḥ prāvṛṣo ramyaḥ sarvabhūtamanoharaḥ || 25 ||
aharniśaṃ ca vṛttāntaṃ prayacchanti manojavāḥ |
śakrakeśavayorhaṃsāḥ kumārāṇāṃ mahātmanām || 26 ||
reme saha prabhāvatyā pradyumnaścānurūpayā |
rātrau rātrau mahātejā dhārtarāṣṭrābhirakṣitaḥ || 27 ||
tairhi vajrapuraṃ haṃsairvasadbhirvāsavājñayā |
vyāptaṃ nṛpa naṭāṃstāṃśca na viduḥ kālamohitāḥ || 28 ||
divāpi raukmiṇeyastu prabhāvatyā nṛpālaye |
tiṣṭhatyantarhito vīro haṃsasaṃghābhirakṣitaḥ || 29 ||
māyayāsya praticchāyā dṛśyate hi naṭālaye |
dehārdhena tu kauravya siṣeve'sau prabhāvatīm || 2.94.30 ||
saṃnatiṃ vinayaṃ śīlaṃ līlāṃ dākṣyamathārjavam |
spṛhayantyasurā dṛṣṭvā vidvattāṃ ca mahātmanām || 31 ||
rūpaṃ vilāsaṃ gandhaṃ ca mañjubhāṣāmathāryatām |
tāsāṃ yādavanārīṇāṃ spṛhayantyasurastriyaḥ || 32 ||
vajranābhasya tu bhrātā sunābho nāma viśrutaḥ |
duhitṛdvayaṃ ca nṛpate tasya rūpaguṇānvitam || 33 ||
ekā candravatī nāmnā guṇavatyatha cāparā |
prabhāvatyālayaṃ te tu vrajataḥ khalu nityadā || 34 ||
dadṛśāte tu te tatra ratisaktāṃ prabhāvatīm |
paripapracchatuścaiva visrambhopagatāṃ satīm || 35 ||
sovāca mama vidyāsti yādhītā kāṅkṣitaṃ patim |
ratyarthaṃ sā''nayatyāśu saubhāgyaṃ ca prayacchati ||36 ||
devaṃ vā dānavaṃ vāpi vivaśaṃ sadya eva hi |
sāhaṃ ramāmi kāntena devaputreṇa dhīmatā || 37 ||
dṛśyatāṃ matprabhāveṇa pradyumnaḥ supriyo mama |
te dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ yāte rūpayauvanasampadam || 38 ||
punarevābravīt te tu bhaginyau cāruhāsinī |
prabhāvatī varārohā kālaprāptamidaṃ vacaḥ || 39 ||
devā dharmaratā nityaṃ dambhaśīlā mahāsurāḥ |
devāstapasi raktā hi sukhe raktā mahāsurāḥ || 2.94.40 ||
devāḥ satye ratā nityamanṛte tu mahāsurāḥ |
dharmastapaśca satyaṃ ca yatra tatra jayo dhuvam || 41 ||
devaputrau varayatāṃ patividyāṃ dadāmyaham |
ucitau matprabhāveṇa sadya evopalapsyathaḥ || 42 ||
tāṃ tathetyūcaturhṛṣṭe bhaginyau cārulocanām |
paripapraccha bhaimaṃ ca kāryaṃ tat patimāninī || 43 ||
sa pitṛvyaṃ gadaṃ vīraṃ sāmbaṃ cāthābravīt tadā |
rūpānvitau suśīlau ca śūrau ca raṇakarmaṇi || 44 ||
prabhāvatyuvāca
parituṣṭena dattā me vidyā durvāsasā purā |
parituṣṭena saubhāgyaṃ sadā kanyātvameva ca || 45 ||
devadānavayakṣāṇāṃ yaṃ dhyāsyati sa te patiḥ |
bhaviteti mayā caiva vīro'yamabhikāṅkṣitaḥ || 46 ||
gṛhṇītaṃ tadimāṃ vidyāṃ sadyo vāṃ priyasaṅgamaḥ |
tato jagṛhaturhṛṣṭe tāṃ vidyāṃ bhaginīmukhāt || 47 ||
dadhyaturgadasāmbau ca vidyāmabhyasya te śubhe |
tau pradyumnena sahitau praviṣṭau bhaimanandanau || 48 ||
pracchannau māyayā vīrau kārṣṇinā māyinā nṛpa |
gāndharveṇa vivāhena tāvapyaribalārdanau || 49 ||
pāṇiṃ jagṛhaturvīrau mantrapūrvaṃ satāṃ priyau |
candravatyā gadaḥ sāmbo guṇavatyā ca kaiśaviḥ || 2.94.50 ||
remire'surakanyābhirvīrāste yadupuṅgavāḥ |
mārgamāṇāstvanujñāṃ te śakrakeśavayostadā || 51 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi prabhāvatīpāṇigrahaṇe caturnavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 94 ||

<2.95>

pañcanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
nabho nabhasye'tha nirīkṣya māsi kāmastadā toyadavṛndakīrṇam |
prabhāvatīṃ cāruviśālanetrāmuvāca pūrṇendunikāśavaktraḥ || 1 |
tavānanābho varagātri candro na dṛśyate sundari cārubimbaḥ |
tvatkeśapāśapratimairniruddho balāhakaiścārunirantaroru || 2 ||
saṃdṛśyate subhru taḍid ghanasthā tvaṃ hemacārvābharaṇānviteva |
muñcanti dhārāśca ghanā nadantastvaddhārayaṣṭeḥ sadṛśā varāṅgi || 3 ||
ghanapradeśeṣu balākapaṅaktayastvaddantapaṅktipratimāvibhānti |
nimagnapadmāni saritsu subhru na bhānti toyāni rayākulāni || 4 ||
amī ghanā vāyuvaśopayātā balākamālāmalacārudantāḥ |
anyonyamabhyāhanituṃ pravṛttā vaneṣu nāgā iva śukladantāḥ || 5 ||
dhanustrivarṇaṃ varagātri paśya kṛtaṃ tavāpāṅgamivānanastham |
vibhūṣayantaṃ gaganaṃ ghanāśca praharṣaṇaṃ kāmijanasya kānte || 6 ||
ghanān nadantaḥ pratinardamānān nirīkṣyasuśroṇi śikhīnprahṛṣṭān |
samādṛtānuddhatapicchabhārān priyābhirāmānupanṛtyamānān|| 7 ||
harmyeṣu cānye śaśipāṇḍureṣu yajanti suśroṇi mayūrasaṃghāḥ |
muhūrtaśobhāmaticārurūpāṃ dattvā patanto valabhīpuṭeṣu || 8 ||
praklinnapakṣāstarumastakeṣu muhūrtacūḍāmaṇitāṃ vidhāya |
prayānti bhūmiṃ navaśādvalānāmāśaṅkamānā dhṛtacārudehāḥ || 9 ||
pravāti dhārāntaraniḥsṛtaśca sukho'nilaścandanapaṅkaśītaḥ |
kadambasarjārjunapuṣpabhūtaṃ samāvahan gandhamanaṅgabandhum || 2.95.10 ||
ratiśramasvedavināśaheturnavodabhārānayane ca hetuḥ |
