na mārutaḥ syād yadi cārugātri na meghakālo mama vallabhaḥ syāt || 11 ||
evaṃvidheṣu priyasaṅgameṣu ratāvasāne yadupaiti vāyuḥ |
ratiśramasvedaharaḥ sugandhī tataḥ paraṃ kiṃ sukhamasti loke || 12 ||
jalāplutānīkṣya mahānadīnāṃ sugātri haṃsāḥ pulināni hṛṣṭāḥ |
gatāḥ bhramaṃ mānasavāsalubdhāḥ sasārasāḥ krauñcagaṇānuviddhāḥ ||| 13||
na bhānti nadyo na sarāṃsi caiva hatatviṣīvāyatacārunetre |
gateṣu haṃseṣvatha sāraseṣu rathāṅgatulyāhvayaneṣu caiva || 14
bhogaikadeśena śubhaṃ śayānaṃ dhruvaṃ jagannāthamupendramīśam |
nidrābhyupetā varakālatajjñā śriyaṃ praṇamyottaracārurūpām || 15 ||
nidrāyamāṇe bhagavatyupendre meghāmbarākrāntaniśākaro'dya |
padmāmalābhaḥ kamalāyatākṣi kṛṣṇasya vaktrānukṛtiṃ karoti || 16 ||
kadambanīpārjunaketakānāṃ srajo dhruvaṃ kṛṣṇamupānayanti |
puṣpāṇi cānyānyṛtavaḥ samastāḥ kṛṣṇāt prasādānabhikāṅkṣamāṇāḥ ||17||
nāgāścaranto viṣadigdhavaktrāḥ spṛśanti puṣpāṇyapi pādapānyān|
pepīyamānān bhramarairjanānāṃ kautūhalaṃ te janayantyatīva || 18 ||
toyātibhārāmbudavṛndanaddhaṃ nabhaḥ patiṣyantamivābhivīkṣya |
nipānagambhīramabhinnavṛṣṭaṃ manoharaṃ cārumukhastanoru || 19 ||
balākamālākulamālyadāmnā nirīkṣa ramyaṃ ghanavṛndametat |
sasyāni bhūmāvabhivarṣamāṇaṃ jagaddhitārthaṃ vimalāṅgayaṣṭe || 2.95.20 ||
jalāvalambāmbudavṛndakarṣī ghanairghanān yodhayatīva vāyuḥ |
pravṛttacakro nṛpatirvanasthān gajāngajaiḥ svairiva vīryadṛptān || 21 ||
abhaumamambho visṛjanti meghāḥ pūtaṃ pavitraṃ pavanaiḥ sugandhi |
harṣāvahaṃ cātakabarhiṇānāṃ varāṇḍajānāṃ jaladapriyāṇām || 22 ||
plavaṃgamaḥ poḍaśapakṣaśāyī virauti goṣṭhaḥ sahakāminībhiḥ |
ṛco dvijātiḥ priyasatyadharmā yathā suśiṣyaiḥ parivāryamāṇaḥ || 23 ||
guṇo mahāṃstoyadakālajo'yamabuddhameghasvanabhīṣitānām |
pariṣvajantaḥ parivarddhayanti vināpi śayyāsamayaṃ priyāṇām || 24 ||
doṣo'yamekaḥ salilāgamasya māṃ pratyudārānvayavarṇaśīle |
na dṛśyate yat tava vaktratulyo dhanagrahagrastatanuḥ śaśāṅkaḥ || 25 ||
pradṛśyate bhīru yadā śaśāṅko ghanāntarastho jagataḥ pradīpaḥ |
tadānupaśyanti janāḥ prahṛṣṭā bandhuṃ pravāsādiva saṃnivṛttam || 26 ||
vilāpasākṣī priyahīnitānāṃ saṃdṛśyate bhīru yadā śaśāṅkaḥ |
netrotsavaḥ proṣitakāmukānāṃ dṛṣṭvaiva kāntaṃ bhavatītyavaimi || 27 ||
netrotsavaḥ kāntasamāgatānāṃ dāvāgnitulyaḥ priyahīnitānām |
tenaiva dehena varāṅganānāṃ candro'pi tāvatpriyavipriyaśca || 28 ||
vināpi candreṇa pure pituste yataḥ prabhā candragabhastigaurī |
guṇāguṇāṃścandramasā na vedmi yatastato'haṃ praśaśaṃsayiṣye || 29||
avāpa yo brāhmaṇarājyamīḍyo durāpamanyaiḥ sukṛtaistapobhiḥ |
gāyanti viprāḥ pavamānasaṃjñaṃ samāgatāḥ parvaṇi cāpyudāram|| 2.95.30 ||
pitā budhasyottaravīryakarmā purūravā yasya suto nṛdevaḥ |
prāṇāgnirīḍyo'gnimajījanad yo naṣṭaṃ śamīgarbhabhavaṃ bhavātmā || 31||
tathaiva paścāccakame mahātmā purorvaśīmapsarasāṃ variṣṭhām|
pītaḥ purā yo'mṛtasarvadeho munipravīrairvaragātri ghoraiḥ || 32 ||
nṛpaḥ kuśāgraiḥ punareva yaśca dhīmānato'gnirdivi pūjyate ca |
āyuśca vaṃśe nahuṣaśca yasya yo devarājatvamavāpa vīraḥ || 33 ||
devātidevo bhagavān prasūto vaṃśe hariryatra jagatpraṇetā |
bhaimaḥ pravīraḥ surakāryahetoryaḥ subhrudakṣasya vṛtaḥ sutābhiḥ || 34 ||
babhūva rājātha vasuśca yasya vaṃśe mahātmā śaśivaṃśadīpaḥ |
yaścakravartitvamavāpa vīraḥ svaiḥ karmabhiḥ śakrasamaprabhāvaḥ || 35 ||
yaduśca rājā śaśivaṃśamukhyo yo'vāpa mahyāmadhirājabhāvam|
bhojāḥ kule yasya narādhipasya vīrāḥ prasūtāḥ surarājatulyāḥ || 36 ||
na kūṭakṛd yasya nṛpo'sti vaṃśe na nāstiko naiṣkṛtiko'pi vātha |
aśraddadhāno'pyathavā kadaryaḥ śauryeṇa vā vāriruhākṣi hīnaḥ || 37 ||
vaṃśe vadhūstvaṃ kamalāyatākṣi ślāghyā guṇānāmatipātrabhūtā |
kuru praṇāmaṃ śikharāgradanti tasya tvamīśasya satāṃ priyasya || 38 ||
nārāyaṇāyātmabhavāyanāya lokāyanāya tridaśāyanāya |
khagendraketoḥ puruṣottamāya kuru praṇāmaṃ śvaśurāya devi || 39 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi pradyumnabhāṣaṇe pañcanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 95 ||

<2.96>

ṣaṇṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
satrāvasāne ca muneḥ kaśyapasyātitejasaḥ |
jagmurdevāsurāḥ svāni sthānānyamitavikramāḥ || 1 ||
vajranābho'pi nirvṛtte satre kaśyapamabhyagāt |
trailokyavijayākāṅkṣī tamuvācātha kaśyapaḥ || 2 ||
vajranābha nibodha tvaṃ śrotavyaṃ yadi cenmama |
vasa vajrapure putra svajanena samāvṛtaḥ || 3 ||
tapasābhyadhikaḥ śakraḥ śaktaścaiva svabhāvataḥ |
brahmaṇyaśca kṛtajñaśca jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhatamo guṇaiḥ || 4 |
rājā kṛtsnasya jagataḥ pātrabhūtaḥ satāṃ gatiḥ |
samprāpto lokarājyaṃ sa sarvabhūtahite rataḥ || 5 ||
naiva śakyastvayā jetuṃ vajranābha vihanyase |
ahiṃ padā vyutkramanvai nacirād vinaśiṣyasi || 6 ||
vajranābhaśca tadvākyaṃ nābhinandati bhārata |
kālapāśaparītāṅgo martukāma ivauṣadham || 7 ||
abhivādya sa durbuddhiḥ kaśyapaṃ lokabhāvanam|
trailokyavijayārambhe matiṃ cakre durāsadaḥ || 8 ||
jñātiyodhān samānīya mitrāṇi subahūni ca |
pratasthe svargamevāgre vijigīṣan viśāmpate || 9 ||
etasminnantare devau kṛṣṇendrau ca mahābalau |
preṣayāmāsaturhaṃsān vajranābhavadhaṃ prati || 2.96.10 ||
samāgatāstu tacchrutvā yadumukhyā mahābalāḥ |
mantrayitvā mahātmānaścintāmāpedire tathā || 11 ||
vajranābho'dya hantavyaḥ pradyumnenetyasaṃśayam |
tayorduhitaro bhāryā bhaktyā tāḥ sarvabhāvanāḥ || 12 ||
sarvāḥ sagarbhāstāścaiva kiṃ nu kāryamanantaram |
prāptaḥ prasavakālaśca tāsāṃ nāticirādiva || 13 ||
sammantrayitvaitadarthaṃ haṃsānūcurmahābalāḥ |
ākhyeyamarthavat kṛtsnaṃ śakrakeśavayostadā || 14 ||
haṃsairgatvā tadākhyātaṃ devayostad yathātatham |
tābhyāṃ haṃsāstu saṃdiṣṭā na bhetavyamiti prabho || 15 ||
utpatsyanti guṇaiḥ ślāghyāḥ putrā vaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ |
garbhasthāḥ sarvavedāṃśca sāṅgānvetsyantyaninditāḥ|| 16 ||
tathā cānāgataṃ sarvamastrāṇi vividhāni ca |
sadya eva yuvānaśca bhaviṣyanti supaṇḍitāḥ || 17 ||
evamuktā gatā haṃsāḥ punarvajrapuraṃ vibho |
śaśaṃsuścaiva bhaimānāṃ śakrakeśavabhāṣitam || 18 ||
prabhāvatī tadā putraṃ suṣuve sadṛśaṃ pituḥ |
sadyo yauvanasamprāptaṃ sarvajñatvaṃ ca bhārata || 19 ||
māsamātreṇa suṣuve devī candravatī nṛpa |
candraprabhamiti khyātaṃ tanayaṃ sadṛśaṃ pituḥ || 2.96.20 ||
sadyaśca yauvanaṃ prāptaṃ sarvajñatvaṃ ca bhārata |
guṇavatyapi putraṃ ca guṇavantamaninditā || 21 ||
yuvānāvatha sadyastau sarvaśāstrārthakovidau |
indropendraprasādena saṃvṛttau yuddhavarddhanau || 22 ||
harmyapṛṣṭhe varddhamānā dṛṣṭāste yadunandanāḥ |
indropendrecchayā vīra nānyathetyavadhāryatām || 23 ||
niveditāśca sambhrāntairdaityairākāśarakṣibhiḥ |
vajranābhāya vīrāya triviṣṭapajayaiṣiṇe || 24 ||
vadhāya sarve gṛhyantāṃ mamaite gṛhadharṣakāḥ |
ityuvācāsurapatirvajranābho mahāsuraḥ ||25 ||
tataḥ sainyaṃ samājñaptamasurendreṇa dhīmatā |
āvārayāmāsa diśaḥ sarvāḥ kurukulodvaha || 26 ||
gṛhyantāmāśu vadhyantāmiti vācastatastataḥ |
uccerurasurendrasya śāsanādariśāsinaḥ || 27 ||
tacchrutvā vyathitāsteṣāṃ mātaraḥ putravatsalāḥ |
rurudustā rudantīśca pradyumnaḥ prahasan bravīt || 28 ||
mā bhaiṣṭa jīvamāneṣu sthiteṣvasmāsu sarvathā |
kiṃ no daityāḥ kariṣyanti sarvathā bhadramastu vaḥ || 29 ||
prabhāvatīmathovāca pradyumno viplavāṃ sthitām |
pitā tava gadāpāṇiḥ pitṛvyāśca sthitāstava || 2.96.30 ||
bhrātaraścaiva te devi jñātayaśca tathāpare |
ete pūjyāśca mānyāśca tavārthe khalu sarvathā || 31 ||
bhaginyau pṛccha bhadraṃ te kālo'yaṃ khalu dāruṇaḥ |
maraṇaṃ sahamānānāṃ yuddhyatāṃ vijayo dhruvam || 32 |
dānavendrādayo hyete yotsyante'smadvadhaiṣiṇaḥ |
kimatra kāryamasmābhiḥ sarvaiścakrāntarasthitaiḥ || 33 ||
prabhāvatī rudantī tu pradyumnamidamabravīt |
śirasyañjalimādhāya jānubhyāṃ patitā kṣitau || 34 ||
gṛhāṇa śastramātmānaṃ rakṣa śatrunibarhaṇa |
jīvan putrāṃśca dārāṃśca draṣṭāsi yadunandana || 35 ||
āryāṃ nṛvara vaidarbhīmaniruddhaṃ ca mānada |
smṛtvaitanmokṣayātmānaṃ vyasanādarimardana || 36 ||
durvāsasā varo datto muninā mama dhīmatā |
vaidhavyarahitā hṛṣṭā jīvaputrā bhaviṣyasi || 37 ||
eṣa me hṛdayāśvāso bhavitā na tadanyathā |
sūryāgnitejaso vākyaṃ munerindrānujātmaja || 38 ||
ityuktvāthāsimādāya sūpaspṛṣṭvā manasvinī |
pradadau raukmiṇeyāya jayasveti varaṃ varā || 39 ||
sa taṃ jagrāha dharmātmā prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā |
praṇamya śirasā dattaṃ priyayā bhaktiyuktayā ||2.96.40 ||
candravatyapi nistriṃśaṃ gadāya pradadau mudā |
tadā guṇavatī caiva sāmbāyāsiṃ mahātmane || 41 ||
haṃsaketumathovāca pradyumnaḥ praṇataṃ prabhuḥ |
ihaiva sāmbasahito yudhyasva saha yādavaiḥ || 42 ||
ākāśe dikṣu sarvāsu yotsyāmyahamariṃdama |
ityuktvātha rathaṃ cakre māyayā māyināṃ varaḥ || 43 ||
sahasraśirasaṃ nāgaṃ kṛtvā sārathimātmavān |
anantabhogaṃ kauravya sarvanāgottamottamam || 44 ||
sa tena rathamukhyena harṣayan vai prabhāvatīm |
cacārāsurasainyeṣu tṛṇeṣviva hutāśanaḥ || 45 ||
śarairāśīviṣaprakhyairarddhacandrānukāribhiḥ |
bhedanairgādhanaiścaiva tatarda ditisambhavān || 46 ||
asurāśca raṇe mattāḥ kārṣṇiṃ śastrairitastataḥ |
jaghnuḥ kamalapatrākṣaṃ paraṃ niścayamāsthitāḥ || 47 ||
ciccheda bāhūn keṣāṃcitkeyūravalayojjvalān |
sakuṇḍalāni keṣāṃcicchirāṃsyapi ca cicchide ||48||
kṣuracchinnaiḥ śirobhiśca kāyaiśca śakalairapi |
asurāṇāṃ mahī kīrṇā pradyumnenātitejasā || 49 ||
deveśvaro devagaṇaiḥ sahitaḥ samitiṃjayaḥ |
dadarśa mudito yuddhaṃ bhaimānāṃ ditijaiḥ saha || 2.96.50 ||
ye gadaṃ caiva sāmbaṃ ca daityāḥ samabhidudruvuḥ |
te yayurnidhanaṃ sarve yādāṃsīva mahodadhau || 51 ||
viṣamaṃ tu tadā yuddhaṃ dṛṣṭvā devapatirhariḥ |
gadāya preṣayāmāsa svaṃ rathaṃ harivāhanaḥ || 52 ||
dideśa mātalisutaṃ yantāraṃ ca suvarcasam |
sāmbāyairāvaṇaṃ nāgaṃ preṣayāmāsa ceśvaraḥ || 53 ||
jayantaṃ raukmiṇeyasya sahāyamadadād vibhuḥ |
airāvaṇamadhiṣṭhātuṃ pravaraṃ sa niyuktavān || 54 ||
devaputradvijau vīrāvaprameyaparākramau |
anujñāpya surādhyakṣaṃ brahmāṇaṃ lokabhāvanam || 55 ||
taṃ mātalisutaṃ caiva gajamairāvaṇaṃ tadā |
devaḥ preṣitavāñchakro vidhijño varakarmasu || 56 ||
kṣīṇamasya tapo vadhyo yadūnāmeṣa durmatiḥ |
pravadanti tu bhūtāni sarvatra tu yathepsitam || 57 ||
pradyumnaśca jayantaśca prāptau harmyaṃ mahābalau |
asurāñccharajālaughairvikrāmyantau praṇaśyatuḥ || 58 ||
gadaṃ kārṣṇistadovāca durvāryaraṇadurjayaḥ |
upendrānuja śakreṇa ratho'yaṃ preṣitastava || 59 ||
hariyuṅmātalisuto yantā cāyaṃ mahābalaḥ |
pravarādhiṣṭhitaścāyaṃ sāmbasyairāvaṇo gajaḥ || 2.96.60 ||
adyopahāro rudrasya dvārakāyāṃ mahābalaḥ |
śva eṣyati hṛṣīkeśastasmin vṛtte'cyutānuja|| 61 ||
tasyājñayā vadhiṣyāmo vajranābhaṃ sabāndhavam |
abhyutthānakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ triviṣṭapajayaṃ prati || 62 ||
kariṣyāmi vidhānaṃ tu naiṣa śakraṃ sutānvitam |
vijeṣyatyapramādastu kartavya iti me matiḥ || 63 ||
kalatrarakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ sarvopāyairnarairbudhaiḥ |
kalatradharṣaṇaṃ loke maraṇādatiricyate || 14 ||
evaṃ saṃdiśya bhaimaḥ sa gadasāmbau mahābalaḥ |
pradyumnakoṭyaḥ sasṛje māyayā divyarūpayā || 65 ||
tamaśca nāśayāmāsa daityasṛṣṭaṃ durāsadam |
jahṛṣe devarājaśca taṃ dṛṣṭvā ripumardanam || 66 ||
dadṛśuḥ sarvabhūtāni kārṣṇiṃ sarveṣu śatruṣu |
antarātmani vartantaṃ kṣetrajñamiva taṃ viduḥ || 67 ||
evaṃ vyatītā rajanī raukmiṇeyasya yudhyataḥ |
asurāṇāṃ tribhāgaśca nihataścātitejasā || 68 ||
yāvad viyodhayāmāsa kārṣṇirdaityān raṇājire |
saṃdhyopāstā jayantena tāvad viṣṇupadījale ||69 ||
ayodhayajjayantaśca yāvad daityān mahābalaḥ |
tāvadākāśagaṅgāyāṃ bhaimaḥ saṃdhyāmupāstavān || 2.96.70 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi pradyumnadaityayuddhe ṣaṇṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 96 ||

<2.97>

saptanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
jagataścakṣuṣi tato muhūrtābhyudite ravau |
prādurāsīddharirdevastārkṣyeṇoragaśatruṇā || 1 ||
haṃsatrāyumanobhiśca suśīghrataragaḥ khagaḥ |
tasthau viyati śakrasya samīpe kurunandana || 2 ||
sametya ca yathānyāyaṃ kṛṣṇo vāsavasaṃnidhau |
pāñcajanyaṃ harirdadhmau daityānāṃ bhayavarddhanam || 3 ||
taṃ śrutvābhyāgatastatra pradyumno paravīrahā |
vajranābhaṃ jahītyuktaḥ keśavena tvareti ca || 4 ||
tārkṣyamāruhya gaccheti punareva praṇoditaḥ |
cakāra sa tathā vīraḥ praṇipatya surottamau || 5 ||
sa manoraṃhasā vīra tārkṣyeṇāśu yayau nṛpa |
abhyāśaṃ vajranābhasya mahādvandvasya bhārata || 6 ||
tatastārkṣyagato vīrastatarda rāṇamūrddhani |
vajranābhaṃ sthiro bhūtvā sarvāstravidaninditaḥ || 7 ||
tena tārkṣyagatenaiva gadayā kṛṣṇasūnunā |
urasyabhyāhato vīro vajranābho mahātmanā || 8 ||
sa tenābhihato vīro daityo mohavaśaṃ gataḥ |
cakṣāra ca bhṛśaṃ raktaṃ babhrāmaiva gatāsuvat || 9 ||
āśvasetyatha taṃ kārṣṇiruvāca raṇadurjayaḥ |
labdhasaṃjñaḥ sa vīrastu pradyumnamidamabravīt || 2.97.10 ||
sādhu yādava vīryeṇa ślāghyo mama ripurbhavān |
pratiprahārakālo'yaṃ sthiro bhava mahābala || 11 ||
evamuktvā mahānādaṃ muktvā meghaśatopamam |
gadāṃ mumoca vegena saghaṇṭāṃ bahukaṇṭakām || 12 ||
tayā lalāṭe'bhihataḥ pradyumno gadayā nṛpa |
udvaman rudhiraṃ bhūri mumoha yadunandanaḥ || 13 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ pāñcajanyaṃ jalodbhavam |
dadhmāvāśvāsanakaraṃ putrasya ripunāśanaḥ || 14 ||
taṃ pāñcajanyaśabdena pratyāśvastaṃ mahābalam |
dṛṣṭvā pramuditā lokā viśeṣeṇendrakeśavau || 15 ||
tasya cakraṃ kare yātaṃ kṛṣṇacchandena bhārata |
kṣuranemisahasrāraṃ daityasaṃghakulāntakam || 16 ||
tanmumocācyutasutastasya nāśāya bhārata |
namaskṛtvā surendrāya kṛṣṇāya ca mahātmane || 17 ||
vajranābhasya tatkāyāduccakarta śirastadā |
nārāyaṇasutonmuktaṃ daityānāmanupaśyatām || 18 ||
gadaḥ sunābhamavadhīd yatamāna raṇājire |
harmyapṛṣṭhe jighāṃsantaṃ raṇadṛptaṃ bhayānakam || 19||
sāmbaḥ samaramadhyasthānasurānarimardanaḥ |
nināya niśitairbāṇaiḥ pretādhipaparigraham || 2.97.20 ||
nikumbho'pi hate vīre vajranābhe mahāsure |
jagāma ṣaṭpuraṃ vīro nārāyaṇabhayārditaḥ || 21 ||
nibarhite devaripau vajranābhe mahāsure |
avatīrṇau mahātmānau harī vajrapuraṃ tadā || 22 ||
labdhapraśamanaṃ caiva cakratuḥ surasattamau |
sāntvayāmāsatuścaiva bālavṛddhaṃ bhayārditam || 23 ||
indropendrau mahātmānau mantrayitvā mahābalau |
āyatyāṃ ca tadātve ca nṛhaspatimatānugau || 24 ||
vajranābhasya tad rājyaṃ caturdhā cakraturnṛpa |
vijayasya caturbhāgaṃ jayantatanayasya vai || 25 ||
pradyumnasya caturbhāgaṃ raukmiṇeyasutasya ca |
candraprabhasya dadatuścaturbhāgaṃ janeśvara || 26 ||
koṭyaścatasro grāmāṇāmadhikāstā viśāmpate |
śākhāpurasahasraṃ ca sphītaṃ vajrapuropamam |
caturdhā cakratustatra saṃhṛṣṭau śakrakeśavau || 27 ||
kambalājinavāsāṃsi ratnāni vividhāni ca |
caturddhā cakraturvīrau vīra vāsavakeśavau || 28 ||
tato'bhiṣiktāste vīrā rājāno vāsavājñayā |
devadundubhivādyena nṛpa viṣṇupadījalaiḥ || 29 ||
svayaṃ śakreṇa devena keśavena ca dhīmatā |
ṛṣivaṃśe mahātmānaḥ śakramādhavanandanāḥ || 2.97.30 ||
vijayasya prasiddheva gatirviyati dhīmataḥ |
mātṛjena guṇenāpi mādhavānāṃ mahātmanām || 31 ||
abhiṣicya jayantaṃ tu vāsavo bhagavān bravīt |
tvayaite vīra saṃrakṣyā rājānaḥ samitiṃjayāḥ || 32 ||
mama vaṃśakaro'traikaḥ keśavasya trayo'nagha |
avadhyāḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhaviṣyanti mamājñayā || 33 ||
gamanāgamanaṃ caiva divi siddhaṃ bhaviṣyati |
triviṣṭapaṃ dvārakāṃ ca ramyāṃ bhaimābhirakṣitām || 34 ||
diśāgajasutān nāgān hayāṃścoccaiḥśravo'nvayān |
icchayaiṣāṃ prayacchasva rathāṃstvaṣṭṛkṛtānapi || 35 ||
gajāvairāvaṇasutau śatruñjayaripuñjayau |
prayacchākāśagau vīra sāmbasya ca gadasya ca || 36 ||
ākāśena purīṃ yātu dvārakāṃ bhaimarakṣitām |
āyātu ca sutau draṣṭuṃ yatheṣṭaṃ bhaimanandanau || 37 ||
iti saṃdiśya bhagavān devarājaḥ purandaraḥ |
jagāma bhagavān svargaṃ dvārakāmapi keśavaḥ || 38 ||
ṣaṇmāsānuṣitastatra gadaḥ pradyumna eva ca |
sāmbaśca dvārakāṃ yātā rūḍhe rājye mahābalāḥ || 39 ||
adyāpi tāni rājyāni meroḥ pārśve tathottare |
tiṣṭhanti ca jagad yāvat sthāsyantyamarasaṃnibha || 2.97.40 ||
nivṛtte mausale yuddhe svargaṃ yāteṣu vṛṣṇiṣu |
gadapradyumnasāmbāste gatā vajrapuraṃ vibho || 41 ||
tataḥ proṣya punaryānti svarga svaiḥ karmabhiḥ śubhaiḥ |
prasādena ca kṛṣṇasya lokakarturjaneśvara || 42 ||
pradyumnottarametat te nṛdeva kathitaṃ mayā |
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ śatrunāśanameva ca || 43 ||
putrapautrā vivardhante ārogyadhanasampadaḥ |
yaśo vipulamāpnoti dvaipāyanavaco yathā || 44 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi vajranābhavadho nāma saptanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 97 ||

<2.98>

aṣṭanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
dadarśātha purīṃ kṛṣṇo dvārakāṃ garuḍe sthitaḥ |
devasadmapratīkāśāṃ samantāt pratināditām || 1 ||
maṇiparvatayantrāṇi tathā krīḍāgṛhāṇi ca |
udyānavanamukhyāni valabhīcatvarāṇi ca || 2 ||
samprāpte tu tadā kṛṣṇe purīṃ devakinandane |
viśvakarmāṇamāhūya devarājo'bravīdidam || 3 ||
priyamicchasi cet kartuṃ mahyaṃ śilpavatāṃ vara |
kṛṣṇapriyārthaṃ bhūyastvaṃ prakuruṣva manoharām || 4 ||
udyānaśatasambādhāṃ dvārakāṃ svargasammitām |
kuruṣva vibudhaśreṣṭha yathā mama purī tathā || 5 ||
yatkiṃcit triṣu lokeṣu ratnabhūtaṃ prapaśyasi |
tena saṃyujyatāṃ kṣipraṃ purīṃ dvāravatīṃ tvayā || 6 ||
kṛṣṇo hi surakāryeṣu sarveṣu satatotthitaḥ |
saṃgrāmān ghorarūpāṃśca vigāhati mahābalaḥ || 7 ||
tāmindravacanād gatvā viśvakarmā purīṃ tataḥ |
alaṃcakre samantād vai yathendrasyāmarāvatī || 8 ||
tāṃ dadarśa daśārhāṇāmīśvaraḥ pakṣivāhanaḥ |
viśvakarmakṛtairdivyairabhiprāyairalaṃkṛtām || 9 ||
tāṃ tadā dvārakāṃ dṛṣṭvā prabhurnārāyaṇo vibhuḥ |
hṛṣṭaḥ sarvārthasampannaḥ praveṣṭumupacakrame || 2.98.10 ||
so'paśyadvṛkṣakhaṇḍāṃśca ramyān dṛṣṭimanoharān|
dvārakāṃ prati dāśārhaścitritāṃ viśvakarmaṇā ||11 ||
padmakhaṇḍākulābhiśca haṃsasevitavāribhiḥ |
gaṅgāsindhuprakāśābhiḥ parikhābhirvṛtāṃ purīm || 12 ||
prākāreṇārkavarṇena śātakaumbhena rājatā |
cayamūrghni niviṣṭena dyāṃ yathaivābhramālayā || 13 ||
kānanairnandanaprakhyaistathā caitrarathopamaiḥ |
babhau cāruparikṣiptā dvārakā dyaurivāmbudaiḥ || 14 ||
vabhau raivatakaḥ śailo ramyasānuguhājiraḥ |
pūrvasyāṃ diśi lakṣmīvān maṇikāñcanatoraṇaḥ || 15 ||
dakṣiṇasyāṃ latāveṣṭaḥ pañcavarṇo virājate |
indraketupratīkāśaḥ paścimāṃ diśamāśritaḥ |
sukakṣo rājataḥ śailaścitrapuṣpamahāvanaḥ || 16 |
uttarāṃ diśamatyarthaṃ vibhūṣayati veṇumān |
mandarādripratīkāśaḥ pāṇḍuraḥ pārthivarṣabha || 17 ||
citrakaṃ pañcavarṇaṃ ca pāñcajanyaṃ vanaṃ mahat |
sarvartukavanaṃ caiva bhāti raivatakaṃ prati || 18 ||
latāveṣṭitaparyantaṃ meruprabhavanaṃ mahat |
bhāti bhānuvanaṃ caiva puṣpakaṃ ca mahad vanam || 19 ||
akṣakairbījakaiścaiva mandāraiścopaśobhitam |
śatāvartavanaṃ caiva karavīrākaraṃ tathā || 2.98.20 ||
bhāti caitrarathaṃ caiva nandanaṃ ca vanaṃ mahat |
ramaṇaṃ bhāvanaṃ caivaṃ veṇumantaṃ samantataḥ || 21 ||
vaiḍūryapatrairjalajaistadā mandākinī nadī |
bhāti puṣkariṇī ramyā pūrvasyāṃ diśi bhārata || 22 ||
sānavo bhūṣitāstatra keśavasya priyaiṣibhiḥ |
bahubhirdevagandharvaiścoditairviśvakarmaṇā || 23 ||
mahānadī dvāravatīṃ pañcāśadbhirmahāmukhaiḥ |
praviṣṭā puṇyasalilā bhāvayantī samantataḥ || 24 ||
aprameyāṃ mahotsedhāmagādhaparikhāyutām|
prākāravarasampannāṃ sudhāpāṇḍuralepanām || 25 ||
tīkṣṇayantraśataghnībhirhemajālaiśca bhūṣitā| |
āyasaiśca mahācakrairdadarśa dvārakāṃ purīm || 26 || ||
aṣṭau rathasahasrāṇi nagare kiṅkiṇīkinām |
samucchritapatākāni yathā devapure tathā || 27 ||
aṣṭayojanavistīrṇāmacalāṃ dvādaśāyatām |
dviguṇopaniveśāṃ ca dadarśa dvārakāṃ purīm || 28 ||
aṣṭamārgamahārathyāṃ mahāṣoḍaśacatvarām |
evaṃmārgaparikṣiptāṃ sākṣāduśanasā kṛtām || 29||
striyo'pi yasyāṃ yudhyeran kimu vṛṣṇimahārathāḥ |
vyūhānāmuttamā mārgāḥ sapta caiva mahāpathāḥ || 2.98.30 ||
tatra vai vihitāḥ sākṣād vividhā viśvakarmaṇā |
tasmin puravaraśreṣṭhe dāśārhāṇāṃ yaśasvinām || 31 |
veśmāni jahṛṣe dṛṣṭvā tato devakinandanaḥ |
kāñcanairmaṇisopānairupetāni nṛharṣaṇaiḥ || 32 |
bhīmaghoṣamahāghoṣaiḥ prāsādavaracatvaraiḥ |
samucchritapatākāni pāriplavavanāni ca || 33 ||
kāñcanāgrāṇi bhāsvanti prāsādaśikharāṇi ca |
gṛhāṇi ramaṇīyāni merukūṭanibhāni ca || 34 ||
pāṇḍupāṇḍuraśṛṅgaiśca śātakumbhapariṣkṛtaiḥ |
rannasānuguhāśṛṅgairvicitrairiva parvataiḥ || 35||
pañcavarṇaiḥ suvarṇaiśca puṣpavṛṣṭisamaprabhaiḥ |
parjanyatulyanirghoṣairnānārūpairivādribhiḥ ||36 ||
dāvāgnijvalitaprakhyairnirmitairviśvakarmaṇā |
ālikhadbhirivākāśamaticandrārkabhāsvaraiḥ || 37 ||
tairdāśārhairmahābhāgairbabhāse tadvanadrumaiḥ |
vāsudevendraparjanyairgṛhameghairalaṃkṛtā || 38 |
dadṛśe dvārakā cārumeghairdyauriva saṃvṛtā |
sākṣād bhagavato veśma vihitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā || 39 ||
dadṛśe vāsudevasya caturyojanamāyatam |
tāvadeva ca vistīrṇamaprameyamahādhanam || 2.98.40 ||
prāsādavarasampannaṃ yuktaṃ jagati parvataiḥ |
yaścakāra mahābhāgastvaṣṭā vāsavanoditaḥ || 41 ||
prāsādaṃ caiva hemābhaṃ sarvabhūtamanoharam || 42 ||
meroriva giraḥ śṛṅgamucchritaṃ kāñcanaṃ mahat |
rukmiṇyāḥ pravaraṃ vāsaṃ vihitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā || 43 ||
satyabhāmā punarveśma yadāvasata pāṇḍuram |
vicitramaṇisopānaṃ tad vidurbhogavāniti || 44||
vimalādityavarṇābhiḥ patākābhiralaṃkṛtam |
vyaktasaṃjavanoddeśo yaścaturdiṅmahādhvajaḥ || 45 ||
sa ca prāsādamukhyo'tha jāmbavatyā vibhūṣitaḥ |
prabhayābhyabhavat sarvāṃstānanyo bhāskaro yathā || 46 ||
udyadbhāskaravarṇābhastayorantaramāśritaḥ ||
viśvakarmakṛto divyaḥ kailāsaśikharopamaḥ || 47 ||
jāmbūnada ivādīptaḥ pradīptajvalano yathā |
sāgarapratimo'tiṣṭhanmerurityabhiviśrutaḥ || 48 ||
tasmin gāndhārarājasya duhitā kulaśālinī |
gāndhārī bharataśreṣṭha keśavena niveśitā || 49 ||
padmakūla iti khyātaṃ padmavarṇaṃ mahāprabham |
subhīmāyā mahākūṭaṃ veśmātiruciraprabham || 2.98.50 ||
sūryaprabhastu prāsādaḥ sarvakāmaguṇairyutaḥ |
lakṣmaṇāyā nṛpaśreṣṭha nirdiṣṭaḥ śārṅgadhanvanā || 51 ||
vaiḍūryamaṇivarṇābhaḥ prāsādo haritaprabhaḥ |
yaṃ viduḥ sarvabhūtāni paramityeva bhārata || 52 ||
vāsaṃ taṃ mitravindāyā devarṣigaṇapūjitam |
mahiṣyā vāsudevasya bhūṣaṇaṃ teṣu veśmasu || 53 ||
yastu prāsādamukhyo'tra vihito viśvakarmaṇā |
atīva ramyaramyo'sau dhiṣṭhitaḥ parvato yathā || 54 ||
suvārtāyā nivāsaḥ sa praśastaḥ sarvadaivataiḥ |
mahiṣyā vāsudevasya ketumāniti viśrutaḥ || 55 ||
yastu prāsādamukhyo vai yaṃ tvaṣṭā vidadhe svayam |
yojanāyatavipkambhaḥ sarvaratnamayaḥ śubhaḥ || 56 ||
sa śrīmān virajā nāma vyarājattatra suprabhaḥ |
upasthānagṛhaṃ yatra keśavasya mahātmanaḥ || 57 ||
tasmin suvihitāḥ sarve rukmadaṇḍāḥ patākinaḥ |
sadane vāsudevasya mārgasaṃjavanadhvajāḥ || 58 ||
ratnajālāni divyāni tatraiva ca niveśitāḥ |
āhṛtya yadusiṃhena vaijayanto'calo mahān || 59 ||
haṃsakūṭasya yacchṛṅgamindradyumnasaraḥ prati |
ṣaṣṭitālasamutsedhamardhayojanamāyatam || 2.98.60 ||
sakinnaramahānāgaṃ tadapyamitatejasā |
paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānāmānītaṃ lokaviśrutam || 61 ||
ādityapathagaṃ yat tu meroḥ śikharamuttamam |
jāmbūnadamayaṃ divyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam || 62 ||
tadapyutpāṭya kṛṣṇārthamānītaṃ viśvakarmaṇā |
bhrājamānamatīvāgryaṃ sarvauṣadhisamanvitam || 63 ||
tadindravacanāt tvaṣṭā kāryahetoḥ samānayat |
pārijātaśca tatraiva keśavenāhṛtaḥ svayam || 64 ||
nīyamāne tu tatrāsīd yuddhamadbhutakarmaṇaḥ |
kṛṣṇasya ye'bhyarakṣaṃstu devāḥ pādapamuttamam || 65||
puṇḍarīkaśatairjuṣṭaṃ vimānaiśca hiraṇmayaiḥ |
vihitā vāsudevārthaṃ ratnapuṣpaphaladrumāḥ || 66 ||
padmakhaṇḍajalopetā ratnasaugandhikotpalāḥ |
maṇihemaplavākīrṇāḥ puṣkariṇyaḥ sarāṃsi ca || 67|| ||
tāsāṃ paramakūlāni śobhayanti mahādrumāḥ |
śālāstālāḥ kadambāśca śataśākhāśca rauhiṇāḥ ||68||
ye ca haimavatā vṛkṣā ye ca meruruhāstathā |
āhṛtya yadusiṃhārthaṃ vihitā viśvakarmaṇā || 69 ||
raktapītāruṇaśyāmāḥ śvetapuṣpāśca pādapāḥ |
sarvartuphalasampannāsteṣu kānanasandhiṣu || 2.98.70||
samakūlajalopetāḥ śāntaśarkaravālukāḥ |
tasmin puravare nadyaḥ prasannasalilā hradāḥ || 71 ||
puṣpākulajalopetā nānādrumalatākulāḥ |
aparāścābhavan nadyo hemaśarkaravālukāḥ || 72
mattabarhiṇasaṃghaiśca kokilaiśca sadāmadaiḥ |
babhūvuḥ paramopetāstasyāṃ puryāṃ ca pādapāḥ || 73 ||
tatraiva gajayūthāni pure gomahiṣāstathā ||
nivāsaśca kṛtastatra varāhamṛgapakṣibhiḥ || 74 ||
puryāṃ tasyāṃ tu ramyāyāṃ prākāro vai hiraṇmayaḥ |
vyaktaḥ kiṣkuśatotsedho vihito viśvakarmaṇā|| 75 ||
atīva ramyaḥ so'thāsīd veṣṭitaḥ parvato yathā |
te ca te ca mahāśailāḥ saritaśca sarāṃsi ca |
parikṣiptāni bhaumena vanānyupavanāni ca || 76 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi dvārakā viśeṣanirmāṇaṃ nāmāṣṭanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 98 ||

<2.99>

navanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evamālokayānaḥ sa dvārakāṃ vṛṣabhekṣaṇaḥ |
apaśyatsvagṛhaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prāsādaśataśobhitam || 1 |
maṇistambhasahasrāṇāmayutairvivṛtaṃ śataiḥ |
toraṇairjvalanaprakhyairmaṇividrumarājataiḥ || 2 ||
tatra tatra prabhāsadbhiścitrakāñcanavedikaiḥ |
prāsādastatra sumahān kṛṣṇopasthāniko'bhavat|| 3 |
sphāṭikastambhavivṛto vistīrṇaḥ sarvakāñcanaḥ |
padmākulajalopetā raktasaugandhikotpalāḥ || 4 ||
maṇihemanibhāścitrā ratnasopānabhūṣitāḥ |
mattabarhiṇajuṣṭāśca kokilaiśca sadāmadaiḥ || 5 ||
babhūvuḥ paramopetā vāpyaśca vikacotpalāḥ |
viśvakarmakṛtaḥ śailaḥ prākārastasya veśmanaḥ || 6 ||
vyaktakiṣkuśatotsedhaḥ parikhāpariveṣṭitaḥ |
tad gṛhaṃ vṛṣṇisiṃhasya nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā || 7 |
mahendrasadṛśaṃ veśma samantādardhayojanam |
tatastaṃ pāṇḍuraṃ śaurirmūrdhni tiṣṭhan garutmataḥ || 8 ||
prītaḥ śaṅkhamupādhmāsīd dviṣatāṃ romaharṣaṇam |
tasya śaṅkhasya śabdena sāgaraścukṣubhe bhṛśam|
rarāsa ca nabhaḥ kṛtsnaṃ taccitramabhavat tadā || 9 ||
pāñcajanyasya nirghoṣaṃ saṃśrutya kukurāndhakāḥ |
viśokāḥ samapadyanta garuḍasya ca darśanāt || 2.99.10 ||
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ garuḍasyopari sthitam |
dṛṣṭvā jahṛṣire paurā bhāskaropamatejasam || 11 ||
tatastūryapraṇādaśca bherīṇāṃ ca mahāsvanāḥ |
jajñire siṃhanādāśca sarveṣāṃ puravāsinām || 12 ||
tataste sarvadāśārhāḥ sarve ca kukurāndhakāḥ |
prīyamāṇāḥ samājagmurālokya madhusūdanam || 13 ||
vāsudevaṃ puraskṛtya śaṅkhatūryaravaiḥ saha |
ugraseno yayau rājā vasudevaniveśanam || 14 ||
ānandinī paryacarat sveṣu veṣmasu devakī |
rohiṇī ca yaśodā ca āhukasya ca yāḥ striyaḥ || 15 ||
tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ suparṇena svaṃ niveśanamabhyagāt |
cacāra ca yathoddeśamīśvarānucaro hariḥ || 16 ||
avatīrya gṛhadvāri kṛṣṇastu yadunandanaḥ |
yathārhaṃ pūjayāmāsa yādavān yādavarṣabhaḥ || 17||
rāmāhukagadākrūrapradyumnādibhirarcitaḥ |
praviveśa gṛhaṃ śaurirādāya maṇiparvatam || 18||
taṃ ca śakrasya dayitaṃ pārijātaṃ mahādrumam |
praveśayāmāsa gṛhaṃ pradyumno rukmiṇīsutaḥ || 19 ||
te'nyonyaṃ dadṛśurvīrā dehabandhānamānuṣān |
pārijātaprabhāveṇa tato mumudire janāḥ || 2.99.20 ||
taiḥ stūyamāno govindaḥ prahṛṣṭairyādavarṣabhaiḥ |
praviveśa gṛhaṃ śrīmān vihitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā || 21 ||
tato'ntaḥpuramadhye taṃ saśṛṅgamaṇiparvatam |
nyaveśayadameyātmā vṛṣṇibhiḥ sahito'cyutaḥ || 22 ||
taṃ ca divyaṃ drumaśreṣṭhaṃ pārijātamamitrajit|
arcyamarcitamavyagramiṣṭe deśe nyaveśayat || 23 ||
anujñāpya tato jñātīn keśavaḥ paravīrahā |
tāḥ striyaḥ pūjayāmāsa saṃhṛtā narakeṇa yāḥ || 24 ||
vastrairābharaṇairdivyairdāsībhirdhanasaṃcayaiḥ |
hāraiścandrāśusaṃkāśairmaṇibhiśca mahāprabhaiḥ || 25 ||
pūrvamabhyarcitāścaiva vasudevena tāḥ striyaḥ |
devakyā saha rohiṇyāṃ revatyā cāhukena ca || 26 ||
satyabhāmottamā strīṇāṃ saubhāgyenābhavattadā |
kuṭumbasyeśvarī tvāsīdrukmiṇī bhīṣmakātmajā||27||
tāsāṃ yathārhaharmyāṇi prāsādaśikharāṇi ca |
ādideśa gṛhānkṛṣṇaḥ pāribarhāṃśca puṣkalān || 28 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi dvārakāpraveśanaṃ nāma navanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 99 ||

<2.100>

śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ sampūjya garuḍaṃ vāsudevo'numānya ca |
sakhivaccopagṛhyainamanujajñe gṛhaṃ prati || 1 ||
so'nujñāto hi satkṛtya praṇamya ca janārdanam |
ūrdhvamācakrame pakṣī yatheṣṭaṃ gaganecaraḥ || 2 ||
sa pakṣavātasaṃkṣubdhaṃ samudraṃ makarālayam |
kṛtvā vegena mahatā yayau pūrvamahodadhim || 3 ||
kṛtyakāle upasthāsya ityuktvā garuḍe gate |
kṛṣṇo dadarśa pitaraṃ vṛddhamānakadundubhim || 4 ||
ugrasenaṃ ca rājānaṃ baladevaṃ ca sātyakim |
kāśyaṃ sāndīpaniṃ caiva brahmagārgyaṃ tathaiva ca || 5||
anyāṃśca vṛddhānvṛṣṇīnāṃ tāṃśca bhojāndhakāṃstathā|
ratnapravekairdāśārhān vīryalabdhaistathārcayat || 6 ||
hatā brahmadviṣaḥ sarve jayantyandhakavṛṣṇayaḥ |
raṇāt pratinivṛtto'yamakṣato madhusūdanaḥ || 7 ||
iti catvararathyāsu dvāravatyāṃ supūjitaḥ |
cākriko ghoṣayāmāsa puruṣo mṛṣṭakuṇḍalaḥ || 8 ||
tataḥ sāndīpaniṃ pūrvamabhigamya janārdanaḥ |
vavande vṛṣṇinṛpatimāhukaṃ vinayānvitaḥ || 9 ||
tathāśruparipūrṇākṣamānandāgatacetasam |
vavande saha rāmeṇa pitaraṃ vāsavānujaḥ || 2.100.10 ||
upagamya tathā śeṣān satkṛtya ca yathārhataḥ |
sarveṣāṃ nāma jagrāha dāśārhāṇāmadhokṣajaḥ || 11 ||
tataḥ sarvāṇi divyāni sarvaratnamayāni ca |
āsanāgryāṇi viviśurupendrapramukhāstadā || 12 ||
tatastaddhanamakṣayyaṃ kiṅkarairyatsamāhṛtam |
tatsabhāmānayāmāsuḥ puruṣāḥ kṛṣṇaśāsanāt || 13||
tataḥ sammānayāmāsa dāśārhāṃśca yadūttamaḥ |
sarvān dundubhiśabdena pūjayiṣyañjanārdanaḥ || 14 ||
tāmāsanavatīṃ ramyāṃ maṇividrumatoraṇām |
sabhāṃ sarvadaśārhāste viviśuḥ kṛṣṇaśāsanāt || 15 ||
tataḥ puruṣasiṃhairyā yadubhiḥ sarvato vṛtā |
kharvārthaguṇasampannā sā sabhā bharatarṣabha |
śuśubhe'bhyadhikaṃ śubhrā siṃhairgiriguhā yathā || 16 ||
rāmeṇa saha govindaḥ kāñcanaṃ mahadāsanam |
ugrasenaṃ puraskṛtya bhojavṛṣṇipuraskataḥ || 17 ||
tatropaviṣṭāṃstān vīrān yathāprīti yathāvayaḥ |
samābhāṣya yaduśreṣṭhānuvāca puruṣottamaḥ || 18 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi sabhāpraveśanaṃ nāma śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 100 ||

<2.101>

ekādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
bhavatāṃ puṇyakīrtīnāṃ tapobalasamādhibhiḥ |
apadhyānācca pāpātmā bhaumaḥ sa narako hataḥ || 1 ||
mokṣitaṃ bandhanād guptaṃ kanyāntaḥpuramuttamam |
maṇiparvatamutpāṭya śikharaṃ caitadāhṛtam || 2 ||
ayaṃ dhanaughaḥ sumahān kiṅkarairāhṛto mama |
īśā bhavanto dravyasya tānuktvā virarāma ha || 3 ||
tacchrutvā vāsudevasya bhojavṛṣṇyandhakā vacaḥ |
jahṛṣurhṛṣṭaromāṇaḥ pūjayanto janārdanam || 4 ||
ūcuścainaṃ nṛvīrāste kṛtāñjalipuṭāstataḥ |
naitaccitraṃ mahābāho tvayi devakinandane || 5 ||
yatkṛtvā duṣkaraṃ karma devairapi durāsadam |
lālayeḥ svajanān bhogai ratnaiśca svayamarjitaiḥ || 6 ||
tataḥ sarvadaśārhāṇāmāhukasya ca yāḥ striyaḥ |
prīyamāṇāḥ samājagmurvāsudevadidṛkṣayā || 7 ||
devakīsaptamā devyo rohiṇī ca śubhānanā |
dadṛśuḥ kṛṣṇamāsīnaṃ rāmaṃ caiva mahābhujam || 8 ||
tau tu pūrvamatikramya rohiṇīmabhivādya ca |
abhivādayatāṃ devīṃ devakīṃ rāmakeśavau || 9 ||
sā tābhyāmṛṣabhākṣābhyāṃ putrābhyāṃ śuśubhe'mbikā |
aditirdevamāteva mitreṇa varuṇena ca || 2.101.10 ||
tataḥ prāptā narāgryau tu tasyāḥ sā duhitā tadā |
ekānaṃśeti yāmāhurnarā vai kāmarūpiṇīm || 11 ||
tathā kṣaṇamuhūrtābhyāṃ yathā jajñe sureśvaraḥ |
yatkṛte sagaṇaṃ kaṃsaṃ jaghāna puruṣottamaḥ || 12 ||
sā kanyā vavṛdhe tatra vṛṣṇisadmani pūjitā |
putravat pālyamānā vai vāsudevājñayā tadā || 13 |
ekānaṃśeti yāmāhurutpannā mānavā bhuvi |
yogakanyāṃ durādharṣāṃ rakṣārthaṃ keśavasya ha || 14 ||
yāṃ caṃ sarve sumanasaḥ pūjayanti sma yādavāḥ |
devavad divyapuruṣaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ saṃrakṣito yayā || 15 ||
tāṃ ca tatropasaṃgamya priyāmiva sakhīṃ svasām |
dakṣiṇena karāgreṇa parijagrāha mādhavaḥ || 16 ||
tathaiva rāmo'tibalaḥ sampariṣvajya bhāvinīm |
mūrdhnyupāghrāya savyena pratijagrāha pāṇinā || 17 ||
dadṛśustāḥ striyo madhye bhaginīṃ rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ |
rukmapadmavyagrakarāṃ striyaṃ padmālayāmiva || 18 ||
tathākṣatamahāvṛṣṭyā puṣpaiśca vividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
avakīrya ca lājaistāḥ striyo jagmuryathālayam || 19 ||
tataste yādavāḥ sarve pūjayanto janārdanam |
upopaviviśuḥ prītāḥ praśaṃsanto'dbhutaṃ kṛtam || 2.101.20 ||
pūjyamāno mahābāhuḥ paurāṇāṃ rativardhanaḥ |
virarāja mahākītirdevairiva sa taiḥ saha || 21 ||
samāsīneṣu sarveṣu yādaveṣu janārdanam |
niyogāttridaśendrasya nārado'bhyāgamat sabhām||22||
so'tha sampūjitaḥ pūjyaḥ śūraistairyadupuṅgavaiḥ |
karaṃ saṃspṛśya sa harerviveśa paramāsane || 23 ||
sukhopaviṣṭastān vṛṣṇīnupaviṣṭānuvāca ha |
samprāptaṃ śakravacanājjānīdhvaṃ māṃ nararṣabhāḥ || 24 ||
śṛṇudhvaṃ rājaśārdūlāḥ kṛṣṇasyāsya parākramam |
yāni karmāṇi kṛtavān bālyātprabhṛti keśavaḥ ||25||
ugrasenasutaḥ kaṃsaḥ sarvān nirmathya yādavān |
rājyaṃ jagrāha durbuddhirbaddhvā pitaramāhukam || 26 ||
samāśritya jarāsaṃdhaṃ śvaśuraṃ kulapāṃsanaḥ |
bhojavṛṣṇyandhakān sarvānavamanyata durmatiḥ || 27 ||
jñātikāryaṃ cikīrṣuśca vasudevaḥ pratāpavān |
ugrasenasya rakṣārthaṃ svaputraṃ paryarakṣata || 28 ||
sa gopaḥ saha dharmātmā mathuropavane sthitaḥ |
atyadbhutāni karmāṇi kṛtavān madhusūdanaḥ || 29 ||
pratyakṣaṃ śūrasenānāṃ śrūyate mahadadbhutam |
uttānena śayānena śakaṭāntaracāriṇā || 2.101.30 ||
rākṣasī nihatā raudrā śakunīveṣadhāriṇī |
pūtanā nāma ghorā sā mahākāyā mahābalā || 31 ||
viṣadigdhaṃ stanaṃ raudraṃ prayacchantī janārdane |
dadṛśurnihatāṃ tāṃ te rākṣasīṃ vanagocarāḥ || 32 ||
punarjāto'yamityāhuruktastasmādadhokṣajaḥ |
atyadbhutamidaṃ cāsīd yacchiśuḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 33 ||
pādāṅguṣṭhena śakaṭaṃ krīḍamāno vyaloḍayat|
dāmnā colūkhale baddho viprakurvan kumārakam || 34 ||
babhañjārjunavṛkṣau dvau khyāto dāmodarastadā |
kāliyaśca mahānāgo durādharṣo mahābalaḥ || 35 ||
krīḍatā vāsudevena nirjito yamunāhrade |
akrūrasya samakṣaṃ ca yannāgabhavane vibhuḥ || 36 ||
pūjyamānaṃ tadā nāgairdivyaṃ vapuradhārayat |
śītavātārditā gāśca dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇena dhīmatā || 37 ||
dhṛto govardhanaḥ śailaḥ saptarātraṃ mahātmanā |
śiśunā vāsudevena gavāṃ trāṇārthamicchatām || 38 ||
tathokṣaduṣṭo'tibalo mahākāyo narāntakṛt|
gopatirvāsudevena hato'riṣṭo mahāsuraḥ || 39 ||
dhenukaḥ sa mahākāyo dānavaḥ sumahābalaḥ |
nihato vāsudevena gavāṃ trāṇāya durmatiḥ || 2.101.40 ||
sunāmānamamitraghnaḥ sarvasainyapuraskṛtam |
vṛkaividrāvayāmāsa grahītuṃ samupasthitam 41 ||
rauhiṇeyena saṃgamya vane vicaratā punaḥ |
gopaveṣadhareṇaiva kaṃsasya bhayamāhitam || 42 ||
tathā vrajagataḥ śaurirdṛṣṭvā yuddhabalaṃ hayam |
pragrahaṃ bhojarājasya jaghāna puruṣottamaḥ || 43 ||
pralambaśca mahākāyo rauhiṇeyena dhīmatā |
dānavo muṣṭinaikena kaṃsāmātyo nipātitaḥ || 44 ||
etau hi vasudevasya putrau surasutopamau |
vavṛdhāte mahāvīryau brahmagārgyeṇa saṃskṛtau || 45 ||
janmaprabhṛti cāpyetau gārgyeṇa paramarṣiṇā |
yāthātathyena vijñāpya saṃskāraṃ pratipāditau || 46 ||
yadā tvimau naraśreṣṭhau sthitau yauvanasammukhe |
siṃhaśāvāvivodīrṇau mattau haimavatau yathā || 47 ||
tato manāṃsi gopīnāṃ haramāṇau mahābalau |
āstāṃ goṣṭhavarau vīrau devaputropamadyutī || 48 ||
etau jaye vā yuddhe vā krīḍāsu vividhāsu ca |
nandagopasya gopālā na śekuḥ prasamīkṣitum || 49 ||
vyūḍhoraskau mahābāhū śālaskandhāvivodgatau |
śrutvāsau vyathitaḥ kaṃso mantribhiḥ sahito'bhavat||2.101.50||
nāśakacca yadā kaṃso grahītuṃ balakeśavau |
nijagrāha tataḥ krodhād vasudevaṃ sabāndhavam || 51 ||
sahograsenena tadā coravad gāḍhabandhanam |
kālaṃ mahāntamanayat kṛcchramānakadundubhiḥ || 52 ||
kaṃsastu pitaraṃ baddhvā śūrasenāñśaśāsa ha |
jarāsaṃdhaṃ samāśritya tathaivāhvṛtibhīṣmakau || 53 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya mathurāyāṃ mahotsavam |
pinākinaṃ samuddiśya cakre kaṃso narādhipaḥ || 54 ||
tatra mallāḥ samājagmurnānādeśyā viśāmpate |
nartanā gāyanāścaiva kuśalā nṛtyakarmasu || 55 ||
tataḥ kaṃso mahātejā raṅgavāṭaṃ mahādhanam |
kuśalaiḥ kārayāmāsa śilpibhiḥ sādhuniṣṭhitaiḥ|| 56||
tatra mañcasahasrāṇi paurajānapadairjanaiḥ |
samākīrṇāni dṛśyante jyotīṃṣi gagane yathā || 57 ||
bhojarājaḥ śriyā juṣṭaṃ raṅgavāṭaṃ maharddhimat|
āruroha tataḥ kaṃso vimānaṃ sukṛtī yathā || 58 ||
raṅgavāṭe gajaṃ mattaṃ prabhūtāyudhakalpitam ||
śūrairadhiṣṭhitaṃ kaṃsaḥ sthāpayāmāsa vīryavān || 59 |
yadā hi sa mahātejā rāmakṛṣṇau samāgatau |
śuśrāva puruṣavyāghrau sūryācandramasāviva || 2.101.60 ||
tadāprabhṛti yatno'bhūd rakṣāṃ prati narādhipa |
na ca śiśye sukhaṃ rātrau rāmakṛṣṇau vicintayan ||61||
śrutvā tu rāmaḥ kṛṣṇaśca taṃ samājamanuttamam |
ubhau viviśaturvīrau śārdūlau govrajaṃ yathā || 62 ||
tataḥ praveśe saṃruddhau rakṣibhiḥ puruṣarṣabhau |
hatvā kuvalayāpīḍaṃ sasādinamariṃdamau |
avamṛdya durādharṣau raṅgaṃ viviśatustadā || 63 ||
cāṇūrāndhrau viniṣpiṣya keśavena balena ca |
augraseniḥ suduṣṭātmā sānujo vinipātitaḥ || 64 ||
yatkṛtaṃ yadusiṃhena devairapi suduṣkaram |
karma tatkeśavādanyaḥ kartumarhati kaḥ pumān || 65 ||
yaddhi nādhigataṃ pūrvaiḥ prahlādabaliśambaraiḥ |
tadidaṃ prāpitaṃ vittaṃ śauriṇā bhavatāṃ kṛte || 66 ||
etena murumākramya daityaṃ pañcajanaṃ tathā |
niṣkramya śailasaṃghātānnisundaḥ sagaṇo hataḥ || 67 ||
narakaśca hato bhaumaḥ kuṇḍale cāhṛte śubhe |
prāptaṃ ca divi deveṣu keśavena mahadyaśaḥ || 68 ||
vītaśokabhayābādhāḥ kṛṣṇabāhubalāśrayāḥ |
yajadhvaṃ vividhairyajñairyādavā vītamatsarāḥ || 69 ||
devānāṃ sumahatkāryaṃ kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇena dhīmatā |
priyamāvedayāmyeṣa bhavatāṃ bhadramastu vaḥ || 2.101.70 ||
yadiṣṭaṃ vo yaduśreṣṭhāḥ kartāsmi tadatandritaḥ |
bhavatāmasmi yūyaṃ ca mama yuṣmāsvahaṃ sthitaḥ || 71 ||
iti sambodhayan kṛṣṇamabravīt pākaśāsanaḥ |
sa māṃ praiṣītsuraśreṣṭhaḥ prītastuṣṭāstathā vayam || 72 ||
yatra dhīḥ śrīḥ sthitā tatra yatra śrīstatra saṃnatiḥ |
saṃnatirdhīstathā śrīśca nityaṃ kṛṣṇe mahātmani || 73 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi nāradavākyaṃ nāmaikādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 101 ||

<2.102>

dvyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
nārada uvāca
sāditā mauravāḥ pāśā nisundanarakau hatau |
kṛtaḥ kṣemyaḥ punaḥ panthāḥ puraṃ prāgjyotiṣaṃ prati || 1 ||
śauriṇā pṛthivīpālāstrāsitāḥ sparddhino raṇe |
dhanuṣaśca ninādena pāñcajanyasvanena ca || 2 ||
meghaprakhyai rathānīkairdākṣiṇātyaiḥ surakṣitam |
rukmiṇaṃ yudhi nirjitya mahābalaparākramam |
rukyiṇīmājahārāśu keśavo vṛṣṇipuṅgavaḥ || 3 ||
tataḥ parjanyaghoṣeṇa rathenādityavarcasā |
uvāha mahiṣīṃ bhojyāṃ śaṅkhacakragadāsibhṛt || 4 ||
jārūthyāmāhvṛtiḥ krāthaḥ śiśupālaśca nirjitaḥ |
vakraśca saha sainyena śatadhanvātha nirjitaḥ || 5 ||
indradyumno hataḥ kopād yavanaśca kaśerumān |
hataḥ saubhapatiḥ śrīmāñchālvaśca dṛḍhadhanvanā || 6 ||
parvatānāṃ sahasraṃ ca cakreṇa puruṣottamaḥ |
vikīrya puṇḍarīkākṣo dyumatsenaṃ vyapothayat || 7 ||
mahendraśikhare caiva nimeṣāntaracāriṇau |
jagrāha puruṣavyāghro varuṇasyābhitaścarau || 8 ||
irāvatyāṃ mahābhojāvagnisūryasamau yudhi |
gopatistālaketuśca nihatau śārṅgadhanvanā || 9 ||
akṣaprapatane caiva ḍimbho haṃsaśca dānavau |
ubhau tāvapi kṛṣṇena sānugau vinipātitau || 2.102.10 ||
dagdhā vārāṇasī caiva keśavena mahātmanā |
sarāṣṭraḥ sānubandhaśca kāśīnāmadhipo hataḥ || 11 ||
vijitya ca yamaṃ saṃkhye śaraiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ |
athaindrasenirānītaḥ kṛṣṇenādbhutakarmaṇā || 12 ||
sahitaḥ sarvayādobhiḥ sāgareṣu mahābalaḥ |
prāpya lohitakūṭaṃ ca kṛṣṇena varuṇo jitaḥ || 13 ||
mahendrabhavane jāto devairgupto mahātmabhiḥ |
acintayitvā devendraṃ pārijātadrumo hṛtaḥ || 14 ||
pāṇḍyaṃ pauṇḍraṃ kaliṅgaṃ ca mātsyaṃ caiva janārdanaḥ |
jaghāna sahitān sarvān vaṅgarājaṃ tathaiva ca || 15 ||
eṣa caikaśataṃ hatvā raṇe rājñāṃ mahātmanām |
gāndhārīmāvahad vīro mahiṣīṃ priyadarśanām || 16 ||
tathā gāṇḍīvadhanvānaṃ krīḍantaṃ madhusūdanaḥ |
jigāya bharataśreṣṭhaṃ kuntyāḥ pramukhato vibhuḥ || 17 ||
droṇaṃdrauṇiṃ kṛpaṃ karṇaṃ bhīṣmaṃ caiva suyodhanam |
cakrānuyānaiḥ prahṛvaṇe jigāya puruṣottamaḥ || 18 ||
babhrośca priyamanvicchañchaṅkhacakragadāsibhṛt |
sauvīrarājasya sutāṃ prasahya hṛtavān prabhuḥ || 19 ||
paryastāṃ pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ sāśvāṃ sarathakuñjarām |
vaiṇudārikṛte yatnājjigāya puruṣottamaḥ || 2.102.20||
avāpya tapaso vīryaṃ balamojaśca mādhavaḥ |
pūrvadehe jahārāyaṃ balestribhuvanaṃ hariḥ || 21||
vajrāśanigadākhaḍgaistrāsayadbhiśca dānavaiḥ |
yasya nādhigato mṛtyuḥ puraṃ prāgjyotiṣaṃ prati || 22 ||
abhibhūtaśca kṛṣṇena sagaṇaḥ sumahābalaḥ |
baleḥ putro mahāvīryo bāṇo draviṇavattaraḥ || 23 ||
pīṭhaṃ tathā mahābāhuḥ kaṃsāmātyaṃ janārdanaḥ |
paiṭhikaṃ cāsilomānaṃ nijaghāna mahābalaḥ || 24 ||
jṛmbhamairāvaṇaṃ cāpi virūpaṃ ca mahāyaśāḥ |
jaghāna puruṣavyāghro daityaṃ mānuṣarūpiṇam || 25 ||
tathā nāgapatiṃ toye kālīyaṃ ca mahaujasam |
nirjitya puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ preṣayāmāsa sāgaram || 26 ||
saṃjīvayāmāsa mṛtaṃ putraṃ sāndīpanestathā |
nirjitya puruṣavyāghro yamaṃ vaivasvataṃ hariḥ || 27 ||
evameṣa mahābāhuḥ śāstā teṣāṃ durātmanām |
devāṃśca brāhmaṇāṃścaiva ye dviṣanti sadā nṛpa || 28 ||
nihatya narakaṃ bhaumamāhṛtya maṇikuṇḍale |
devamāturdadau caiva prītyarthaṃ vajrapāṇinaḥ || 29 ||
evaṃ sadaiva daityānāṃ surāṇāṃ ca mahāyaśāḥ |
bhayābhayakaraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sarvalokakaro vibhuḥ || 2.102.30 ||
saṃsthāpya dharmān martyeṣu yajñairiṣṭvā''ptadakṣiṇaiḥ|
kṛtvā devārthamamitaṃ svasthānaṃ pratipatsyate ||31||
kṛṣṇo bhogavatīṃ ramyāmṛṣikāntāṃ mahāyaśāḥ |
dvārakāmātmasātkṛtvā samudraṃ gamayiṣyati || 32 ||
bahuratnasamākīrṇo caityayūpaśatāṅkitām |
dvārakāṃ varuṇāvāsaṃ pravekṣyati sakānanām || 33||
tāṃ sūryasadanaprakhyāṃ matajñaḥ śārṅgadhanvanaḥ |
visṛṣṭāṃ vāsudevena sāgaraḥ plāvayiṣyati || 34 ||
surāsuramanuṣyeṣu nāsīnna bhavitā kvacit |
ya imāmāvasetkaścidanyo vai madhusūdanāt || 35 ||
evameṣa daśārhāṇāṃ vidhāya vidhimuttamam |
viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ somaḥ sūryaśca bhavitā svayam 36 ||
aprameyastvacintyaśca yathā kāmacaro vaśī |
modatyeṣa sadā bhūtairbālaḥ krīḍanakairiva || 37 ||
na pramātuṃ mahābāhuḥ śakyo'yaṃ madhusūdanaḥ |
paraṃ hyaparametasmād viśvarūpānna vidyate || 38 ||
śruto'yameva śataśastathā śatasahasraśaḥ |
anto hi karmaṇāmasya dṛṣṭapūrvo na kenacit || 39 ||
evametāni karmāṇi śiśumadhyagatastadā |
kṛtavān puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ saṃkarṣaṇasahāyavān || 2.102.40 ||
ityuvāca purā vyāsastapovīryeṇa cakṣuṣā |
mahāyogī mahābuddhiḥ sarvapratyakṣadarśivān || 41 |
vaiśampāyana uvāca
iti saṃstūya govindaṃ mahendravacanānmuniḥ |
yadubhiḥ pūjitaḥ sarvairnāradastridivaṃ yayau || 42 ||
tatastad vasu govindo dideśāndhakavṛṣṇiṣu |
yathārhaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣo vidhivanmadhusūdanaḥ || 43||
yādavāśca dhanaṃ prāpya vidhivad bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ |
yajñairiṣṭvā mahātmāno dvārakāmāvasan purīm || 44 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi nāradavākyaṃ nāma
dvyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 102 ||

<2.103>

tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
bahūnāṃ strīsahasrāṇāmaṣṭau bhāryāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
tāsāmapatyānyaṣṭānāṃ bhagavān prabravītu me || 1 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
aṣṭau mahiṣyaḥ putriṇya iti prādhānyataḥ smṛtāḥ |
sarvā vīraprajāścaiva tāsvapatyāni me śṛṇu || 2 ||
rukmiṇī satyabhāmā ca devī nāgnajitī tathā |
sudattā ca tathā śaibyā lakṣmaṇā cāruhāsinī || 3 ||
mitravindā ca kālindī jāmbavatyatha pauravī |
subhīmā ca tathā mādrī rukmiṇītanayāñchṛṇu || 4 ||
dyumnaḥ prathamaṃ jajñe śambarāntakaraḥ śubhaḥ |
dvitīyaścārudeṣṇaśca vṛṣṇisiṃho mahārathaḥ || 5 ||
cārubhadraścārugarbhaḥ sudeṣṇo druma eva ca |
suṣeṇaścāruguptaśca cāruvindaśca vīryavān || 6 ||
cārubāhuḥ kanīyāṃśca kanyā cārumatī tathā |
jajñire satyabhāmāyāṃ bhānurbhīmarathaḥ kṣupaḥ || 7 ||
rohito dīptimāṃścaiva tāmrajākṣo jalāntakaḥ |
bhānurbhīmalikā caiva tāmraparṇī jalandhamā || 8 ||
catasro jajñire teṣāṃ svasāro garuḍadhvajāt |
jāmbavatyāḥ suto jajñe sāmbaḥ samitiśobhanaḥ || 9 ||
mitravānmitravindaśca mitravatyapi cāṅganā |
mitrabāhuḥ sunīthaśca nāgnajityāḥ prajāḥśṛṇu || 2.103.10 ||
bhadrakāro bhadravindaḥ kanyā bhadravatī tathā |
sudattāyāṃ tu śaibyāyāṃ saṃgrāmajidajāyata || 11 ||
satyajit senajiccaiva tathā śūraḥ sapatnajit |
subhīmāyāḥ suto mādryā vṛkāśvo vṛkanirvṛtiḥ || 12 ||
kumāro vṛkadīptiśca lakṣmaṇāyāḥ prajāḥ śṛṇu |
gātravān gātraguptaśca gātravindaśca vīryavān ||13||
jajñire gātravatyā ca bhaginyā'nujayā saha |
aśrutaśca suto jajñe kālindyāḥ śrutasammitaḥ || 14 ||
aśrutaṃ śrutasenāyai pradadau madhusūdanaḥ |
taṃ pradāya hṛṣīkeśastāṃ bhāryāṃ mudito'bravīt || 15 ||
eṣa vāmubhayorastu dāyādaḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ |
bṛhatyāṃ tu gadaṃ prāhuḥ śaibyāyāmaṅgadaṃ sutam || 16 ||
utpannaṃ kumudaṃ caiva śvetaṃ śvetā tathāṅganā |
agāvahaḥ sumitraśca śuciścitrarathastathā || 17 ||
citrasenaḥ sudevāyāścitrā citravatī tathā |
vanastambaśca jajñāte sutaḥ stambavanaśca ha || 18 ||
nivāsano'vanastambaḥ kanyā stambavatī tathā |
upasannaśca śaṅkuśca vajrāṃśuḥ kṣipra eva ca || 19 ||
kauśikyāṃ sutasomāyāṃ yaudhiṣṭhiryāṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ |
kapālī garuḍaścaiva jajñāte citrayodhinau || 2.103.20 ||
evamādīni putrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi nibodha me |
daśāyutaṃ samākhyātā vāsudevasya te sutāḥ || 21 ||
ayutāni tathā cāṣṭau śūrā raṇaviśāradāḥ |
janārdanasya prasavaḥ kīrtito'yaṃ tathā mayā || 22 ||
pradyumnasya suto jajñe vaidarbhyāṃ rājasattama |
aniruddho raṇe'ruddho jajñe sa mṛgaketanaḥ || 22 ||
revatyāṃ baladevasya jajñāte niśaṭholmukau |
bhrātarau devasaṃkāśāvubhau puruṣasattamau || 24 ||
sutanuśca sutārā ca śaurerāstāṃ parigrahaḥ |
pauṇḍrakaḥ kapilaścaiva vasudevasya tau sutau || 25 ||
tārāyāṃ kapilo jajñe pauṇḍraśca sutanoḥ sutaḥ |
tayornṛpo'bhavat pauṇḍraḥ kapilaśca vanaṃ yayau || 26 ||
turyāṃ samabhavad vīro vasudevānmahābalaḥ |
jarā nāma niṣādānāṃ prabhuḥ sarvadhanuṣmatām || 27 ||
kāśyā supārśvaṃ tanayaṃ lebhe sāmbāt tarasvinam|
sānurjajñe'niruddhasya vajraḥ sānorajāyata || 28 ||
vajrājjajñe pratirathaḥ sucārustasya cātmajaḥ |
anamitrācchinirjajñe kaniṣṭhādvṛṣṇinandanāt || 29 ||
śinestu satyavāg jajñe satyakaśca mahārathaḥ |
satyakasyātmajaḥ śūro yuyudhānastvajāyata || 2.103.30 ||
asaṅgo yuyudhānasya maṇistasyābhavatsutaḥ |
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi vṛṣṇivaṃśānukīrtane tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 103 ||

<2.104>

caturadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
ya eṣa bhavatā pūrvaṃ śambaraghnetyudāhṛtaḥ |
pradyumnaḥ ca kathaṃ jaghne śambaraṃ tad bravīhi me || 1 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
rukmiṇyāṃ vāsudevasya lakṣmyāṃ kāmo dhṛtavrataḥ |
śambarāntakaro jajñe pradyumnaḥ kāmadarśanaḥ |
sanatkumāra iti yaḥ purāṇe parigīyate || 2 ||
taṃ saptarātre sampūrṇe niśīthe sūtikāgṛhāt |
jahāra kṛṣṇasya sutaṃ śiśuṃ vai kālaśambaraḥ || 3 ||
viditaṃ tasya kṛṣṇasya devamāyānuvartinaḥ |
tato na nigṛhītaḥ sa dānavo yuddhadurmadaḥ || 4 ||
sa mṛtyunā parītāyurmāyayā saṃjahāra tam |
dorbhyāmutkṣipya nagaraṃ svaṃ nināya mahāsuraḥ || 5 ||
anapatyā tu tasyāsīd bhāryā rūpaguṇānvitā |
nāmnā māyāvatī nāma māyeva śubhadarśanā || 6 ||
dadau taṃ vāsudevasya putraṃ putramivātmajam |
tasyā mahiṣyā māninyā dānavaḥ kālacoditaḥ || 7 ||
māyāvatī tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā samprahṛṣṭatanūruhā |
harṣeṇa mahatā yuktā punaḥ punarudaikṣata || 8 ||
atha tasyā nirīkṣantyāḥ smṛtiḥ prādurbabhūva ha |
ayaṃ sa mama kānto'bhūt smṛtvaivaṃ cānvacintayat||9||
ayaṃ sa nātho bhartā me yasyārthe'haṃ divāniśam |
cintāśokārṇave magnā na vindāmi ratiṃ kvacit || 2.104.10 ||
ayaṃ bhagavatā pūrvaṃ devadevena śūlinā |
kheditena kṛto'naṅgo dṛṣṭo jātyantare mayā || 11 ||
kathamasya stanaṃ dāsye mātṛbhāvena jānatī |
bharturbhāryā tvahaṃ bhūtvā vakṣye vā putra ityuta || 12 ||
evaṃ saṃcintya manasā dhātryāstaṃ sā samarpayat |
rasāyanaprayogaiśca śīghrameva vyavardhayat || 13 ||
dhātryāḥ sakāśātsa ca tāṃ śṛṇvan rukmiṇinandanaḥ |
māyāvatīmavijñānānmene svāmeva mātaram || 14 ||
sā ca taṃ varddhayāmāsa kārṣṇiṃ kamalalocanam |
māyāścāsmai dadau sarvā dānavī kāmamohitā || 15 ||
sa yadā yauvanasthastu pradyumnaḥ kāmadarśanaḥ |
cikīrṣitajño nārīṇāṃ sarvāstravidhipāragaḥ || 16 ||
taṃ sā māyāvatī kāntaṃ kāmayāmāsa kāminī |
iṅgitaiścāpi vīkṣantī prālobhayata sasmitā |

pañcādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

ratisamaramaśaktā vīkṣituṃ socchvasantī
svagṛhagamanakāmā necchate sthātumatra || 84 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi śambarasainyabhaṅgo nāma pañcādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 105 ||

<2.106>

ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śambarastu tataḥ kruddhaḥ sūtamāha viśāmpate |
śatrupramukhato vīra rathaṃ me vāhaya drutam || 1 ||
yāvadenaṃ śarairhanmi mama vipriyakārakam |
tato bhartṛvacaḥ śrutvā sūtastatpriyakārakaḥ || 2 ||
rathaṃ saṃcodayāmāsa cāmīkaravibhūṣitam |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā rathamāyāntaṃ pradyumnaḥ phullalocanaḥ || 3 ||
saṃdadhe cāpamādāya śaraṃ kanakabhūṣitam |
tenāhanat susaṃkruddhaḥ kopayañśambaraṃ raṇe || 4 ||
hṛdaye tāḍitastena devaśatruḥ suviklavaḥ |
rathaśaktiṃ samāśritya tasthau so'tha vicetanaḥ || 5 ||
sa cetanāṃ punaḥ prāpya dhanurādāya śambaraḥ |
vivyādha kārṣṇiṃ kupitaḥ saptabhirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ || 6 ||
tānaprāptāñśarān so'tha saptabhiḥ saptadhācchinat|
śambaraṃ ca jaghānātha saptatyā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ || 7 ||
punaḥ śarasahasreṇa kaṅkabarhiṇavāsasā |
ahanacchambaraṃ krodhād dhārābhiriva parvatam || 8 ||
pradiśo vidiśaścaiva śaradhārāsamāvṛtāḥ || 9 ||
andhakārīkṛtaṃ vyoma dinakartā na dṛśyate |
tato'ndhakāramutsārya vaidyutāstreṇa śambaraḥ || 2.106.10 ||
pradyumnasya rathopasthe śaravarṣaṃ mumoca ha |
tadastrajālaṃ pradyumnaḥ śareṇānataparvaṇā || 11 ||
ciccheda bahudhā rājandarśayan pāṇilāghavam|
hate tasmin mahāvarṣe śarāṇāṃ kārṣṇinā tadā || 12 ||
drumavarṣaṃ mumocātha māyayā kālaśambaraḥ |
drumavarṣocchritaṃ dṛṣṭvā pradyumnaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ || 13 ||
āgneyāstraṃ mumocātha tena vṛkṣānanāśayat|
bhasmībhūte vṛkṣavarṣe śilāsaṃghātamutsṛjat || 14 ||
pradyumnastaṃ tu vāyavyaiḥ protsārayata saṃyuge |
tato māyāṃ parāṃ cakre devaśatruḥ pratāpavān || 15 ||
siṃhānvyāghrān varāhāṃśca tarakṣūnṛkṣavānarān |
vāraṇān vāridaprakhyānhayānuṣṭrānviśāmpate|| 16 ||
mumoca dhanurāyamya pradyumnasya rathopari |
gāndharvāstreṇa ciccheda sarvāṃstānkhaṇḍaśastadā ||17||
pradyumnena tu sā māyā hatā tāṃ vīkṣya śambaraḥ |
anyāṃ māyāṃ mumocātha śambaraḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ || 18 ||
gajendrān bhinnavadanān ṣaṣṭihāyanayauvanān |
mahāmātrottamārūḍhān kalpitān raṇakovidān| 19 ||
tāmāpatantīṃ māyāṃ tu kārṣṇiḥ kamalalocanaḥ |
saiṃhīṃ māyāṃ samutsraṣṭuṃ cakre buddhiṃ mahāmanāḥ || 2.106.20||
sā sṛṣṭā siṃhamāyā tu raukmiṇeyena dhīmatā |
māyā nāgavatī naṣṭā ādityeneva śarvarī || 21 ||
nihatāṃ hastimāyāṃ tu tāṃ samīkṣya mahāsuraḥ |
anyāṃ sammohinīṃ māyāṃ so'sṛjad dānavottamaḥ||22 ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā mohinīṃ nāma māyāṃ mayavinirmitām |
saṃjñāstreṇa tu pradyumno nāśayāmāsa vīryavān || 23 ||
śambarastu tataḥ kruddho hatayā māyayā tadā |
saiṃhīṃ māyāṃ mahātejāḥ so'sṛjad dānaveśvaraḥ|| 24||
siṃhānāpatato dṛṣṭvā raukmiṇeyaḥ pratāpavān |
astraṃ gāndharvamādāya śarabhānasṛjat tadā || 25 ||
te'ṣṭāpadā balodagrā nakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhā raṇe |
siṃhān vidrāvayāmāsurvāyurjaladharāniva || 26
siṃhān vidravato dṛṣṭvā māyayāṣṭāpadena vai |
śambaraścintayāmāsa kathamenaṃ nihanmi vai |
aho mūrkhasvabhāvo'haṃ yanmayā na hataḥ śiśuḥ || 27 ||
prāptayauvanadehastu kṛtāstraścāpi durmatiḥ |
tat kathaṃ nihaniṣyāmi śatruṃ raṇaśiraḥsthitam || 28 ||
māyā sā tiṣṭhate tīvrā pannagī nāma bhīṣaṇā |
dattā me devadevena hareṇāsuraghātinā || 29 ||
tāṃ sṛjāmi mahāmāyāmāśīviṣasamākulām |
tayā dahyeta duṣṭātmā hyeṣa māyāmayo balī || 2.106.30 ||
sā sṛṣṭā pannagī māyā viṣajvālāsamākulā |
tayā pannagamayyā tu sarathaṃ sahavājinam || 31 ||
sasūta sa hi pradyumnaṃ babandha śarabandhanaiḥ |
badhyamānaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā ātmānaṃ vṛṣṇivaṃśajaḥ | 32 ||
māyāṃ saṃcintayāmāsa sauparṇīṃ sarpanāśinīm |
sā cintitā mahāmāyā pradyumnena mahātmanā || 33 ||
suparṇā vicaranti sma sarpā naṣṭā mahāviṣāḥ |
bhagnāyāṃ sarpamāyāyāṃ praśaṃsanti surāsurāḥ || 34 ||
sādhu vīra mahābāho rukmiṇyānandavardhana |
yattvayā dharṣitā māyā tena sma paritoṣitāḥ || 35 ||
hatāyāṃ sarpamāyāyāṃ śambaro'cintayat punaḥ |
asti me kāladaṇḍābho mudgaro hemabhūṣitaḥ | 36||
tamapratihataṃ yuddhe devadānavamānavaiḥ |
purā yo mama pārvatyā dattaḥ paramatuṣṭayā || 37 ||
gṛhāṇa śambaremaṃ tvaṃ mudgaraṃ hemabhūṣitam |
mayā sṛṣṭaṃ svadehe vai tapaḥ paramaduścaram || 38 ||
māyāntakaraṇaṃ nāma sarvāsuravināśanam |
anena dānavau raudrau balinau kāmarūpiṇau || 39 ||
śumbhaścaiva niśumbhaśca sagaṇau sūditau mayā |
prāṇasaṃśayamāpanne tvayā mokṣyaḥ sa śatrave || 2.106.40||
ityuktvā pārvatī devī tatraivāntaradhīyata |
tadahaṃ mudgaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mocayiṣyāmi śatrave || 41||
tasya vijñāya cittaṃ tu devarājo'bhyabhāṣata |
gaccha nārada śīghraṃ tvaṃ pradyumnasya rathaṃ prati || 42 ||
sambodhaya mahābāhuṃ pūrvajātiṃ ca mokṣaya |
vaiṣṇavāstraṃ prayacchāsmai vadhārthaṃ śambarasya ca || 43||
abhedyaṃ kavacaṃ cāsya prayacchāsurasūdane |
evamukto maghavatā nāradaḥ prayayau tvaram || 44 ||
ākāśe'dhiṣṭhito'vocanmakaradhvajaketanam |
kumāra paśya māṃ prāptaṃ devagandharvanāradam |
preṣitaṃ devarājena tava sambodhanāya vai || 45 ||
smara tvaṃ pūrvakaṃ bhāvaṃ kāmadevo'si mānada |
harakopānalād dagdhastenānaṅga ihocyase || 46 ||
tvaṃ vṛṣṇivaṃśajāto'si rukmiṇyā garbhasambhavaḥ|
jāto'si keśavena tvaṃ pradyumna iti kīrtyase || 47||
āhṛtya śambareṇa tvamihānīto'si mānada |
saptarātre tvasampūrṇe sūtikāgāramadhyataḥ || 48 ||
vadhārthaṃ śambarasya tvaṃ hriyamāṇo hyupekṣitaḥ |
keśavena mahābāho devakāryārthasiddhaye || 49 ||
yaiṣā māyāvatī nāma bhāryā vai śambarasya tu |
ratiṃ tāṃ viddhi kalyāṇīṃ tava bhāryāṃ purātanīm || 2.106.50 ||
tava saṃrakṣaṇārthāya śambarasya gṛhe'vasat|
māyāṃ śarīrajāṃ tasya mohanārthaṃ durātmanaḥ || 51||
rateḥ sampādanārthāya preṣayatyaniśaṃ tadā |
evaṃ pradyumna buddhvā vai tatra bhāryā pratiṣṭhitā || 52 |
hatvā taṃ śambaraṃ vīra vaiṣṇavāstreṇa saṃyuge |
gṛhya māyāvatīṃ bhāryāṃ dvārakāṃ gantumarhasi || 53 ||
gṛhāṇa vaiṣṇavaṃ cāstraṃ kavacaṃ ca mahāprabham |
śakreṇa tava saṃgṛhya preṣitaṃ śatrusūdana || 54 ||
śṛṇu me hyaparaṃ vākyaṃ kriyatāmaviśaṅkayā |
asya devaripostāta mudgaro nityamūrjitaḥ || 55 ||
pārvatyāṃ parituṣṭāyāṃ dattaḥ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ |
amoghaścaiva saṃgrāme devadānavamānavaiḥ || 56 ||
tadastrapravighātārthaṃ devīṃ tvaṃ smartumarhasi |
stavyā caiva namasyā ca mahādevī raṇotsukaiḥ || 57||
tatra vai kriyatāṃ yatnaḥ saṃgrāme ripuṇā saha |
ityuktvā nārado vākyaṃ prayayau yatra vāsavaḥ || 58 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi śambaravadhe nāradavākye ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 106 ||

<2.107>

saptādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śambarastu tataḥ kruddho mudgaraṃ taṃ samādade |
mudgare gṛhyamāṇe tu dvādaśārkāḥ samutthitāḥ || 1 ||
parvatāścalitāḥ sarve tathaiva vasudhātalam |
unmārgāḥ sāgarā yātāḥ saṃkṣubdhāścāpi devatāḥ || 2 ||
gṛdhracakrākulaṃ vyoma ulkāpāto babhūva ha |
vavarṣa rudhiraṃ devaḥ paruṣaṃ pavano vavau || 3 ||
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahotpātān pradyumnaḥ sa tvarānvitaḥ |
avatīrya rathād vīraḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ || 4 ||
devīṃ sasmāra manasā pārvatīṃ śaṅkarapriyām|
praṇamya śirasā devīṃ stotuṃ samupacakrame || 5 ||
pradyumna uvāca
oṃ namaḥ kātyāyanyai girīśāyai namo namaḥ |
namastrailokyamāyāyai kātyāyanyai namo namaḥ || 6 |
namaḥ śatruvināśinyai namo gauryai śivapriye |
namasye śumbhamathanīṃ niśumbhamathanīmapi || 7 ||
kālarātri namastubhyaṃ kaumāryai ca namo namaḥ |
kāntāravāsinīṃ devīṃ namasyāmi kṛtāñjaliḥ || 8||
vindhyavāsinīṃ durgaghnāṃ raṇadurgāṃ raṇapriyām |
namasyāmi mahādevīṃ jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ tathā || 9||
aparājitāṃ namasye'hamajitāṃ śatrunāśinīm |
ghaṇṭāhastāṃ namasyāmi ghaṇṭāmālākulāṃ tathā || 2.107.10 ||
triśūlinīṃ namasyāmi mahiṣāsuraghātinīm |
siṃhavāhāṃ namasyāmi siṃhapravaraketanām || 11
ekānaṃśāṃ namasyāmi gāyatrīṃ yajñasatkṛtām |
sāvitrīṃ cāpi viprāṇāṃ namasye'haṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ ||12 |
rakṣa māṃ devi satataṃ saṃgrāme vijayaṃ kuru |
iti kāmavacastuṣṭā durgā samprītamānasā || 13 ||
uvāca vacanaṃ devī suprītenāntarātmanā |
paśya paśya mahābāho rukmiṇyānandavarddhana || 14||
varaṃ varaya vatsa tvamamoghaṃ darśanaṃ mama |
devyāstu vacanaṃ śrutvā romāñcodgatamānasaḥ || 15 ||
praṇamya śirasā devīṃ vijñaptumupacakrame |
yadi tvaṃ devi tuṣṭāsi dīyatāṃ me yadīpsitam || 16 ||
varaṃ ca varade yāce sarvāmitreṣu me jayaḥ |
yastvayā mudgaro dattaḥ śambarasyātmasambhavaḥ || 17 ||
eṣa me gātramāsādya mālā padmavatī bhavet|
tathāstviti ca sāpyuktvā tatraivāntaradhīyata || 18 ||
pradyumnastu mahātejāstuṣṭo rathamathāruhat |
mudgaraṃ taṃ gṛhītvā ca śambaraḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ || 19 ||
bhrāmayitvā sa cikṣepa pradyumnorasi vīryavān |
sa gatvā madanābhyāśaṃ mālā bhūtvā tu pauṣkarī || 2.107.20 ||
pradyumnasya ca kaṇṭhe tu samāsaktā vyarājata |
nakṣatrāṇāṃ tu mālāyāṃ yathā parivṛto vidhuḥ || 21 ||
tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ |
sādhusādhviti vācocuḥ pūjayankeśavātmajam||22 ||
mudgaraṃ puṣpabhūtaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā pradyumnasaṃnidhau |
vaiṣṇavaṃ paramāstraṃ tu nāradena yathāhṛtam || 23 ||
saṃdadhe cāpamānamya idaṃ vacanamabravīt |
yadyahaṃ rukmiṇīputraḥ keśavasyātmajo hyaham || 24 ||
tena satyena bāṇena jahi tvaṃ śambaraṃ raṇe |
ityuktvā cāpamākṛṣya saṃdhāya ca mahāmanāḥ || 25 ||
cikṣepa śambarasyātha daham̐llokatrayaṃ yathā |
sa kṣipto vṛṣṇisiṃhena śarā kravyādamohanaḥ || 26 ||
hadayaṃ śambarasyātha bhittvā dharaṇimāgataḥ |
na cāsya māṃsaṃ na snāyurnāsthi na tvaṅ na śoṇitam||27||
sarvaṃ tad bhasmasādbhūtaṃ vaiṣṇavāstrasya tejasā |
hate daitye mahākāye dānave śambare'dhame || 28||
jahṛṣurdevagandharvā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ |
urvaśī menakā rambhā vipracittistilottamā || 29 ||
nanṛturhṛṣṭamanaso jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam |
devarājastu suprītaḥ sarvadevagaṇaiḥ saha |
pradyumnaṃ puṣpavarṣeṇa tamabhyarcya prahṛṣṭavat || 2.107.30 ||
atha samarahate tu daityarāje madhumathanasya sutena vaiṣṇavāstraiḥ |
vigataripubhayāḥ surāśca jagmurmakaravibhūṣaṇaketanaṃ stuvantaḥ || 31||
sa ca samarapariśramaṃ vahan vai nagaramukhaṃ praviveśa raukmiṇeyaḥ |
priyatama iva kāntayā prahṛṣṭastvaritapadaṃ ratidarśanaṃ cakāra || 32 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi śambaravadhe saptādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 107 ||

<2.108>

aṣṭādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
samāptamāyo māyājño vikrāntaḥ samare'vyayaḥ |
aṣṭamyāṃ nihato yuddhe māyāvī kālaśambaraḥ || 1 ||
tamṛkṣavante nagare nihatyāsurasattamam |
gṛhya māyāvatīṃ devīmāgacchannagaraṃ pituḥ || 2||
so'ntarikṣagato bhūtvā māyāvī śīghravikramaḥ |
ājagāma purīṃ ramyāṃ rakṣitāṃ tejasā pituḥ || 3 ||
so'ntarikṣānnipatitaḥ keśavāntaḥpure śiśuḥ |
māyāvatyā saha tayā rūpavāniva manmathaḥ || 4 ||
tasmiṃstatrāvapatite mahiṣyaḥ keśavasya yāḥ |
vismitāścaiva hṛṣṭāśca bhītāścaivābhavaṃstataḥ || 5 ||
tatastaṃ kāmasaṃkāśaṃ kāntayā saha saṅgatam |
prekṣantyo hṛṣṭavadanāḥ pibantyo nayanotsavam || 6 ||
taṃ vinītamukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā lajjamānaṃ pade pade |
abhavan snigdhasaṃkalpāḥ sarvāstāḥ kṛṣṇayoṣitaḥ ||7||
rukmiṇī caiva taṃ dṛṣṭvā śokārtā putragarddhinī |
sapatnīśatasaṃkīrṇā sabāṣpā vākyamabravīt || 8 ||
yādṛk svapno mayā dṛṣṭo niśāyāṃ yauvane gate |
kaṃsāriṇā mamānīya dattaṃ sāhārapallavam || 9 ||
śaśiraśmipratīkāśaṃ muktādāma ca śobhanam |
keśavenāṅkamāropya mama kaṇṭhe nyabadhyata || 2.108.10 ||
śyāmā sucārukeśā strī śuklāmbaravibhūṣitā |
padmahastā nirīkṣantī praviṣṭā mama veśmani || 11 ||
tayā punarahaṃ gṛhya snāpitā rucirāmbunā |
kuśeśayamayīṃ mālāṃ strī saṃgṛhyātha pāṇinā || 12 ||
mama mūrdhanyupāghrāya dattā svacchā tayā mama |
evaṃ svapnān kīrtayantī rukmiṇī hṛṣṭamānasā || 13 ||
sakhījanavṛtā devī kumāraṃ vīkṣya taṃ muhuḥ |
dhanyāyāḥ khalvayaṃ putro dīrghāyuḥ priyadarśanaḥ || 14 ||
īdṛśaḥ kāmasaṃkāśo yauvane prathame sthitaḥ |
jīvaputrā tvayā putra kāsau bhāgyasamanvitā || 15 ||
kimarthaṃ cāmbudaśyāmaḥ sabhāryastvamihāgataḥ |
asmin vayasi suvyaktaṃ pradyumno mama putrakaḥ || 16 ||
bhaved yadi na nītaḥ syātkṛtāntena balīyasā |
vyaktaṃ kṛṣṇakumārastvaṃ na mithyā mama tarkitam || 17 ||
vijñāto'si mayā cihnairvinā cakraṃ janārdanaḥ |
mukhaṃ nārāyaṇasyeva keśāḥ keśānta eva ca || 18||
ūrū vakṣo bhujau tulyau halinaḥ śvaśurasya me |
kastvaṃ vṛṣṇikulaṃ sarvaṃ dyotayan vapuṣāsthitaḥ || 19 ||
aho nārāyaṇasyeva divyā te paramā tanuḥ |
etasminnantare kṛṣṇaḥ sahasā praviveśa ha |
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā śambarasya vadhaṃ prati || 2.108.20 ||
so'paśyat taṃ sutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ siddhaṃ manmathalakṣaṇaiḥ |
snuṣāṃ māyāvatīṃ caiva hṛṣṭacetā janārdanaḥ || 21 ||
so'bravītsahasā devīṃ rukmiṇīṃ devatāmiva |
ayaṃ sa devi samprāptaḥ sutaścāpadharastava || 22 ||
anena śambaraṃ hatvā māyāyuddhaviśāradam |
hṛtā māyāśca tāḥ sarvā yābhirdevānabādhayat || 23 ||
satī ceyaṃ śubhā sādhvī bhāryā vai tanayasya te |
māyāvatīti vikhyātā śambarasya gṛhoṣitā || 24 ||
mā ca te śambarasyeyaṃ patnīti bhavatu vyathā |
manmathe tu gate nāśaṃ gate cānaṅgatāṃ purā || 25 ||
kāmapatnīṃ na kāntaiṣā śambarasya ratiḥ priyā |
māyārūpeṇa taṃ daityaṃ mohayatyasakṛcchubhā || 26 ||
na caiṣā tasya kaumāre vaśe tiṣṭhati śobhanā |
ātmamāyāmayaṃ kṛtvā rūpaṃ śambaramāviśat || 27 ||
patnyeṣā mama putrasya snuṣā tava varāṅganā |
lokakāntasya sāhāyyaṃ kariṣyati manomayam || 28 ||
praveśayaināṃ bhavanaṃ pūjyāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ snuṣāṃ mama |
ciraṃ praṇaṣṭaṃ ca sutaṃ bhajasva punarāgatam || 29 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ devī kṛṣṇenodāhṛtaṃ tadā |
praharṣamatulaṃ labdhvā rukmiṇī vākyamabravīt || 2.108.30 ||
aho dhanyatarāsmīti vīraputrasamāgamāt|
adya me saphalaḥ kāmaḥ pūrṇo me'dya manorathaḥ || 31||
cirapraṇaṣṭaputrasya darśanaṃ priyayā saha |
āgaccha putra bhavanaṃ sabhāryaḥ praviśeha ca || 32||
tato'bhivādya caraṇau govindaṃ mātaraṃ ca tām|
pradyumnaḥ pūjayāmāsa halinaṃ ca mahābalam || 33 ||
utthāpya taṃ pariṣvajya mūrdhnyupāghrāya vīryavān |
pradyumnaṃ balināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ keśavaḥ paravīrahā || 34||
snuṣāṃ cotthāpya tāṃ devī rukmiṇī rukmabhūṣaṇā|
pariṣvajyopasaṃgṛhya snehād gadgadabhāṣiṇī || 35 ||
sametya bhavanaṃ patnyā śacīndramaditiryathā |
praveśayāmāsa tadā rukmiṇī sutamāgatam || 36 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi pradyumnāgamane aṣṭādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 108 ||

<2.109>

navādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
atrāścaryātmakaṃ stotramāhnikaṃ jayatāṃ vara |
pradyumne dvārakāṃ prāpte hatvā taṃ kālaśambaram || 1 ||
baladevena rakṣārthaṃ proktamāhnikamucyate |
yañjaptvā tu nṛpaśreṣṭha sāyaṃ pūtātmatāṃ vrajet || 2 ||
kīrtitaṃ baladevena viṣṇunā caiva kīrtitam |
dharmakāmaiśca munibhirṛṣibhiścāpi kīrtitam || 3 ||
karhicid rukmiṇīputro halinā saṃyuto gṛhe |
upaviṣṭaḥ praṇamyātha tamuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ || 4 ||
pradyumna uvāca
kṛṣṇānuja mahābhāga rohiṇītanaya prabho |
kiṃcitstotraṃ mama brūhi yajjaptvā nirbhayo'bhavam|| 5 ||
śrībaladeva uvāca
surāsuragururbrahmā pātu māṃ jagataḥ patiḥ |
athoṅkāravaṣaṭkārau sāvitrī vidhayastrayaḥ || 6 ||

sahyodayaśca malayo merumandaradardurāḥ |
krauñcakailāsamainākāḥ pāntu māṃ dharaṇīdharāḥ || 16 ||
śeṣaśca vāsukiścaiva viśālākṣaśca takṣakaḥ |
elāpatraḥ śuklavarṇaḥ kambalāśvatarāvubhau || 17 ||
hastibhadraḥ piṭarakaḥ karkoṭakadhanaṃjayau |
tathā pūraṇakaścaiva nāgaśca karavīrakaḥ || 18 ||
sumanāsyo dadhimukhastathā śṛṅgārapiṇḍakaḥ |
maṇināgaśca bhagavāṃstriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ || 19 ||
nāgarāḍadhikarṇaśca tathā hāridrako'paraḥ |
ete cānye ca bahavo ye cānye nānukīrtitāḥ || 2.109.20 ||
bhūdharāḥ satyadharmāṇaḥ pāntu māṃ bhujageśvarāḥ |
samudrāḥ pāntu catvāro gaṅgā ca saritāṃ varā || 21 ||
sarasvatī candrabhāgā śatadrurdevikā śivā |
dvārāvatī vipāśā ca sarayūryamunā tathā || 22 ||
kalmāṣī ca rathoṣmā ca bāhudā ca hiraṇyadā |
plakṣā cekṣumatī caiva sravantī ca bṛhadrathā || 23 ||
khyātā carmaṇvatī caiva puṇyā caiva vadhūsarā |
etāścānyāśca sarito yāścānyā nānukīrtitāḥ|| 24 ||
uttarāpathagāminyaḥ salilaiḥ snapayantu mām |
veṇī godāvarī sītā kāverī kauṅkaṇāvatī || 25 ||
kṛṣṇā veṇā śuktimatī tamasā puṣpavāhinī |
tāmraparṇī jyotirathā utphalodumbarāvatī || 26 ||

vitastā bhīmarathyā ca ailā caiva mahānadī || 27 ||
kālindī gomatī puṇyā nadaḥ śoṇaśca viśrutaḥ |
etāścānyāśca vai nadyo yāścānyā na tu kīrtitāḥ || 28 ||
dakṣiṇāpathavāhinyaḥ salilaiḥ snapayantu mām |

sindhurvetravatī caiva bhojāntā vanamālikā |
pūrvabhadrā parābhadrā ūrmilā ca paradrumā || 2.109.30 ||
