<2.110>

daśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
hṛto yadaiva pradyumnaḥ śāmbareṇātmaghātinā |
māse'sminneva sāmbastu jāmbavatyāmajāyata || 1 ||
bālyātprabhṛti rāmeṇa śastreṣu viniyojitaḥ |
rāmādanantaraścaiva mānitaḥ sarvavṛṣṇibhiḥ || 2 ||
jātamātre tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śubhāṃ tāmavasat purīm |
nihatāmitrasāmantaḥ śakrodyānaṃ yathāmaraḥ || 3 ||
yādavīṃ ca śriyaṃ dṛṣṭvā svāṃ śriyaṃ dveṣṭi vāsavaḥ |
janārdanabhayāccaiva na śāntiṃ lebhire nṛpāḥ || 4 ||
kasyacit tvatha kālasya pure vāraṇasāhraye |
duryodhanasya yajñe vai samīyuḥ sarvapārthivāḥ || 5 ||
tāṃ śrutvā mādharvīṃ lakṣmīṃ saputraṃ ca janārdanam |
purīṃ dvārāvatīṃ caiva niviṣṭāṃ sāgarāntare || 6 ||
dūtaistaiḥ kṛtasaṃghānāḥ pṛthivyāṃ sarvapārthivāḥ |
śriyaṃ draṣṭuṃ dṛṣīkeśamājagmuḥ kṛṣṇamandim || 7 ||
duryodhanamukhāḥ sarve dhṛtarāṣṭravaśānugāḥ |
pāṇḍavapramukhāścaiva dhṛṣṭadyumnādayo nṛpāḥ || 8 ||
pāṇḍyāścolakaliṅgeśā bāhrīkā drāviḍāḥ khaśāḥ |
akṣauhiṇīḥ prakarṣanto dṛśā cāṣṭau ca bhūmipāḥ || 9 ||
ājagmuryādavapurīṃ govindabhujapālitām |
te parvataṃ raivatakaṃ parivāryāvanīśvarāḥ || 2.110.10 ||
viviśuryojanākhyāsu svāsu svāsu ca bhūmiṣu |
tataḥ śrīmān hṛṣīkeśāḥ sah yādvapuṅgavaiḥ || 11 ||
samīpaṃ mānavendrāṇāṃ niryayau kamalekṣaṇaḥ |
sa teṣāṃ naradevānāṃ madhyastheo madhusūdanaḥ || 12 ||
vyarājata yaduśreṣṭhaḥ śaradīva divākaraḥ |
kṛtvā siṃhāsane kṛṣṇaḥ kāñcane niṣasād ha |
rājāno'pi yathāsthānaṃ niṣedurvividheṣvatha || 14 ||
siṃhāsaneṣu citreṣu pīṭheṣu ca narādhipāḥ |
sa yādavanarendrāṇāṃ samājaḥ śuśubhe tadā || 15 ||
surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca sadasi brahmaṇo yathā |
teṣāṃ citrāḥ kathāstatra pravṛttāstatsamāgame |
yadūnāṃ pārthivānāṃ ca keśavasyopaśrṛṇvataḥ || 16 ||
etasminnantare vāyurvavau megharavopamaḥ |
tumulaṃ durdinaṃ cāsīt savidyutstanayitnumat || 17 ||
tad durdinatalaṃ bhittvā nāradḥ pratyadṛśyata |
saṃceṣṭitajaṭābhāro vīṇāsaktena bāhunā || 18 ||
sa papāta narendrāṇāṃ madhye sāgarasaṃnibhaḥ |
nārad'gniśikhākāraḥ śrīmāñchakrasakho muniḥ || 19 ||
tasmin nipatite bhūmau nārade munipuṅgave |
tadadbhutaṃ mahāmedhaṃ vyapākṛṣyata durdinam || 2.110.20 ||
so'vagāhya narendrāṇāṃ madhye sāgarasaṃnibhaḥ |
āsanasthaṃ yaduśreṣṭhamuvāca muniravyayam || 21 ||
āścaryaṃ khalu devānāmekastvaṃ puruṣottamaḥ|
dhanyaścāsi mahābāho lokenānyo'sti kaścana || 22 ||
evamuktaḥ smitaṃ kṛtvā pratyuvāca muniṃ prabhuḥ |
āścaryaścaiva dhanyaśca dakṣiṇābhiḥ sahetyaham || 23 ||
evamukto muniśreṣṭhaḥ prāha madhye maddībhṛtām |
kṛṣṇa paryāptavākyo'smi gamiṣyāmi yathāgatam|| 24 ||
taṃ prasthitamabhiprekṣya pārthivāḥ prāhurīśvaram |
guhyaṃ mantramajānanto vacanaṃ nāraderitam || 25 ||
āścaryamityabhihitaṃ dhanyo'sīti ca mādhava |
dakṣiṇābhiḥ sahetyevaṃ pratyukte'pi ca nārade || 26 ||
kimetannābhijānīmo divyaṃ mantrapadaṃ mahat |
yadi śrāvyamidaṃ kṛṣṇa śrotumicchāma tattvataḥ || 27 ||
tānuvāca tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sarvān pārthivapuṅgavān |
śrotavyaṃ nāradastveṣa dvijo vaḥ kathayiṣyati || 28 ||
brūhi nārada tattvārthaṃ śrītukāmā mahībhujaḥ |
yat tvayābhihitaṃ vākyaṃ mayā nu pratibhāṣitam || 29 ||
sa pīṭhe kāñcane śubhre sūpaviṣṭaḥ svalaṃkṛtaḥ |
prabhāvaṃ tasya vandyasya pravaktumupacakrame || 2.110.30 ||
nārada uvāca|
śrūyatāṃ bho nṛpaśreṣṭhā yāvantaḥ stha samāgatāḥ |
asya kṛṣṇasya mahato yathā pāramahaṃ gataḥ || 31 ||
ahaṃ kadācid gaṅgāyāstīre triṣavaṇātithiḥ |
carāmyekaḥ kṣapāpāye dṛśyamāne divākare || 32 ||
apaśyaṃ girikūṭābhaṃ kapāladvayadehinam |
krośamaṇḍalavistāraṃ tāvad dviguṇamāyatam || 33 ||
catuścaraṇasuśliṣṭaṃ klinnaṃ caiva sapaṅkilam | |
mama vīṇākṛtiṃ kūrmaṃ gajacarmacayopamam || 34 ||
so'haṃ taṃ pāṇinā spṛṣṭvā proktavāñjalacāriṇam |
tvamāścaryaśarīro'si kūrma dhanyo'si me mataḥ || 35 ||
yastvamevamabhedyābhyāṃ kapālābhyāṃ samāvṛtaḥ |
toye carasi niḥśaṅkaḥ kaṃcidnyamacintayan || 36 ||
sa māmuvācāmbucaraḥ kūrmo mānuṣavatsvayam |
kimāścarye mayi mune dhanyaścāhaṃ kathaṃ vibho || 37 ||
gaṅgeyaṃ nimnagā dhanyā kimāścaryamataḥ param ||
yatrāhamiva sattvāni carantyayutaśo dvija || 38 ||
so'haṃ kutūhalāviṣṭo nardī gaṅgāmupasthitaḥ |
dhanyāsi tvaṃ saricchreṣṭhe nityamāścaryabhūṣitā || 39 ||
yā tvamevaṃ mahādehaiḥ śvāpadairupaśobhitā |
hradinī sāgaraṃ yāsi rakṣantī tāpasālayān || 2.110.40 ||
evamuktā tato gaṅgā rūpiṇī pratyabhāṣata |
nāradaṃ devagandharvaṃ śakrasya dayitaṃ dvijam || 45 ||
mā maivaṃ devagandharva saṃgrāmakalahapriya |
nāhaṃ dhanyā dvijaśreṣṭha naivāścaryopaśobhitā || 42 ||
tava satye niviṣṭasya vākyaṃ māṃ pratibādhate |
sarvāścaryakaro loke dhanyaścaivārṇavo dvija || 43 ||
yatrāhamiva vistīrṇāḥ śataśo yānti nimnagāḥ|
so'haṃ tripathagāvākyaṃ śrutvārṇavamupasthitaḥ || 44 ||
āścarya khalu lokāna dhanyaścāsi mahārṇava |
yena khalvasi yonistvamambhasāṃ salileśvaraḥ || 45 ||
sthāne tvāṃ vārivāhinyaḥ sarito lokapāvanāḥ |
imāḥ samabhigacchanti patnyo lokanamaskṛtāḥ|| 46 ||
samudrastvevamuktastu tato māmavadadvacaḥ |
svaṃ jalaughatalaṃ bhittvā vyutthitaḥ pavaneritaḥ || 47 ||
mā maivaṃ devagandharva nāsmyāścaryo dvijarṣabha |
vasudheyaṃ mune dhanyā yatrāhamupari sthitaḥ || 48 ||
ṛte tu pṛthivīṃ loke kimāścaryamataḥ param |
so'haṃ sāgaravākyena kṣitiṃ kṣititale sthitaḥ || 49 ||
kautūhalasamāviṣṭo hyabruvaṃ jagato gatim |
dharitri dehināṃ yone dhanyā khalvasi śobhane || 2.110.50 ||
āścaryaṃ cāpi bhūteṣu mahatyā kṣamayā yute |
tena khalvasi bhūtānāṃ dharaṇī manujāraṇiḥ || 51 ||
kṣamā tvattaḥ prabhūtā ca karma cāmbaragāminām |
tato bhūḥ stutivākyena sā mayoktena tejitā || 52 ||
vihāya sahajaṃ dhairyaṃ pratyakṣā māmabhāṣata |
devagandharva mā maivaṃ saṃgrāmakalahapriya || 53 ||
nāsmi dhanyā na cāścarye pārakyeyaṃ dhṛtirmama |
ete dhanyā dvijaśreṣṭha parvatā dhārayanti mām || 54 ||
āścaryāṇi ca dṛśyante ete lokasya hetavaḥ |
so'haṃ dharaṇivākyena parvatān samupasthitaḥ || 55 ||
dhanyā bhavanto dṛśyante bahvāścaryāśca bhūdharāḥ |
kāñcanasyāgraratnasya ghātūnāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 56 ||
tena khalvākarāḥ sarve bhavanto bhuvi śāśvatāḥ |
te mamaitad vacaḥ śrutvā parvatāstasthuṣāṃ varāḥ || 57 ||
ūcurmāṃ sāntvayuktāni vacāṃsi ghanaśobhitāḥ |
brahmarṣe na vayaṃ dhanyā nāpyāścaryāṇi santi naḥ |
brahmā prajāpatirdhanyaḥ sarvāścaryaḥ sureṣvapi || 58 ||
so'haṃ prajāpatiṃ gatvā sarvaprabhavamavyayam |
tasya vākyasya paryāyaparyāptamiva lakṣaye || 59 ||
so'haṃ pitāmahaṃ devaṃ lokayoniṃ caturmukham |
stotuṃ paścādupagataḥ praṇato'vanatānanaḥ || 2.110.60 ||
so'haṃ vākyasamāptyarthaṃ śrāvaye padmayonijam|
āścaryaṃ bhagavāneko dhanyo'si jagato guruḥ || 61 ||
na kiṃcidanyat paśyāmi bhūtaṃ yadbhavatā samam |
tvattaḥ sarvamidaṃ jātaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam || 62 ||
sadevadānavā martyā loke bhūtendriyātmakāḥ |
bhavanti sarvadeveśa dṛṣṭvā sarvamidaṃ jagat || 63||
tena khalvasi devānāṃ devadevaḥ sanātanaḥ |
teṣāmevāsi yatsraṣṭā lokānāmādisambhavaḥ || 64 ||
tato māṃ prāha bhagavān brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
dhanyāścaryāśritairvākyaiḥ kiṃ māṃ nārada bhāṣase || 65 ||
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ vedā dhanyā vedāśca nārada |
ye lokān dhārayanti sma vedāstattvārthadarśinaḥ|| 66 ||
ṛksāmayajuṣāṃ satyamatharvaṇi ca yanmatam |
tanmayaṃ viddhi māṃ vipraṃ dhṛto'haṃ tairmayā ca te || 67 ||
pārameṣṭhyena vākyena nodito'haṃ svayambhuvā |
vedopasthānikāṃ cakre matiṃ saṃsthānavistarāt || 68 ||
so'haṃ svayambhūvacanād vedān vai samupasthitaḥ |
avocaṃ tāṃśca caturo mantrapravacanānvitān || 69 ||
dhanyā bhavantaḥ puṇyāśca nityamāścaryabhūṣitāḥ |
ādhārāścaiva viprāṇāmevamāha prajāpatiḥ || 2.110.70 ||
svayambhuvo'pīha paraṃ bhavatsu praśnamāgatam |
yuṣmatparataraṃ nāsti śrutyā vā tapasāpi vā || 71 ||
pratyūcuste tato vākyaṃ vedā māmabhitaḥ sthitāḥ |
āścaryāścaiva dhanyāśca yajñāścātmaparāyaṇāḥ || 72 ||
yajñārthe ca vayaṃ sṛṣṭā dhātrā yena sma nārada ||
tadasmākaṃ paro yajño na vayaṃ svavaśe sthitāḥ || 73 ||
svayambhuvaḥ parā vedā vedānāṃ kratavaḥ parāḥ |
tato'hamabruvaṃ yajñān bṛhadvāgbhiḥ puraskṛtān ||74||
bho yajñāḥ paramaṃ tejo yuṣmāsu khalu lakṣyate |
brahmaṇābhihitaṃ vākyaṃ yacca vedairudīritam || 75 ||
āāścaryamanyalloke'smin bhavadbhyo nābhigamyate |
dhanyāḥ khalu bhavanto ye dvijātīnāṃ svavaṃśajāḥ || 76 ||
te'pi khalvagnayastṛptiṃ yuṣmābhiryānti tarpitāḥ |
bhāgaiśca tridaśāḥ sarve mantraiścaiva maharṣayaḥ || 77 ||
agniṣṭomādayo yajñā mama vākyādanantaram |
pratyūcurmāṃ tato vākyaṃ sarve yūpadhvajāḥ sthitāḥ || 78 ||
āścaryaśabdo nāsmāsu dhanyaśabdo'pi vā mune |
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ viṣṇuḥ sa hyasmākaṃ parā gatiḥ || 79 ||
yadājyaṃ vayamaśnīmo hutamagniṣu pāvanam |
tat sarvaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣo lokamūrtiḥ prayacchati || 2.110.80 ||
so'haṃ viṣṇorgatiṃ prepsuriha sampatito bhuvi |
dṛṣṭaścāyaṃ mayā kṛṣṇo bhavadbhiriha saṃvṛtaḥ || 81 ||
yanmayābhihito hyeṣa tvamāścaryaṃ janārdana |
dhanyaścāsīti bhavatāṃ madhyastho hyatra pārthivāḥ || 82 ||
pratyukto'hmanenādya vākyasyāsya yaduttaram |
dakṣiṇābhiḥ sahetyevaṃ paryāptaṃ vacanaṃ mama || 83 ||
yajñānāṃ hi gatirviṣṇuḥ sarveṣāṃ sahadakṣiṇaḥ |
dakṣiṇābhiḥ sahetyevaṃ praśno mama samāptavān || 84 ||
kūrmeṇābhihitaṃ pūrvaṃ pāramparyādihāgatam |
sadakṣiṇe'smin puruṣe tadvākyaṃ pratipāditam || 85 ||
yanmāṃ bhavantaḥ pṛcchanti vākyasyāsya vinirṇayam|
tadetat sarvamākhyātaṃ sādhayāmi yathāgatam || 86 ||
nārade tu gate svarge sarve te pṛthivībhujaḥ |
vismitāḥ svāni rāṣṭrāṇi jagmuḥ sabalavāhanāḥ || 87 ||
janārdano'pi sahito yadubhiḥ pāvakopamaiḥ |
svameva bhavanaṃ vīro viveśa yadunandanaḥ || 88 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi dhanyopākhyānaṃ nāma daśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 110 ||

<2.111>

ekādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
bhūya eva mahābāho kṛṣṇasya jagatāṃ pateḥ |
māhātmyaṃ śrotumicchāmi paramaṃ dvijasattama || 1 ||
na hi me tṛptirastīha śṛṇvatastasya dhīmataḥ |
karmaṇāmanusaṃtānaṃ purāṇasya mahātmanaḥ || 2 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
nāntaḥ śakyaḥ prabhāvasya vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi |
govindasya mahārāja śrūyatāmidamadbhutam || 3 ||
śaratalpe śayānena bhīṣmeṇa paricoditaḥ |
gāṇḍīvadhanvā bībhatsurmāhātmyaṃ keśavasya yat || 4 ||
rājñāṃ madhye mahārāja jyeṣṭhaṃ bhrātaramabravīt |
yudhiṣṭhiraṃ jitāmitramiti tacchrṛṇu kaurava || 5 ||
arjuna uvāca
purāhaṃ dvārakāṃ yātaḥ sambandhīnavalokakaḥ |
nyavasaṃ pūjitastatra bhojavṛṣṇyandhakottamaiḥ || 6 ||
tataḥ kadācid dharmātmā dīkṣito madhusūdanaḥ |
ekāhena mahābāhuḥ śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 7 ||
tato dīkṣitamāsīnamabhigamya dvijottamaḥ |
kṛṣṇaṃ vijñāpayāmāsa trāhi trāhīti cābravīt || 8 ||
brāhmaṇa uvāca
rakṣādhikāro bhavataḥ paritrāyasva māṃ vibho |
caturthāṃśaṃ hi dharmasya rakṣitā labhate phalam || 9 ||
vāsudeva uvāca
na bhetavyaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha rakṣāmi tvāṃ kuto bhayam |
brūhi tattvena bhadraṃ te yadyapi syātsuduṣkaram || 2.111.10 ||
brāhmaṇa uvāca
jāto jāto mahābāho putro me hriyate'nagha |
trayo hṛtāścaturthaṃ tvaṃ kṛṣṇa rakṣitumarhasi || 11 ||
brāhmaṇyāḥ sūtikālo'dya tatra rakṣā vidhīyatām|
yathā dhriyedapatyaṃ me tathā kuru janārdana || 12 ||
arjuna uvāca
tato māmāha govindo dīkṣito'haṃ kratāviti |
rakṣā ca brāhmaṇe kāryā sarvāvasthāgatairapi || 13 ||
śrutvāhamevaṃ kṛṣṇasya vaco'vocaṃ narādhipa |
māṃ niyojaya govinda rakṣiṣye'haṃ dvijaṃ bhayāt|| 14 ||
ityuktaḥ sa smitaṃ kṛtvā māmuvāca janārdanaḥ |
rakṣasītyevamuktastu vrīḍito'smi narādhipa || 15 ||
tato māṃ vrīḍitaṃ matvā punarāha janārdanaḥ |
gamyatāṃ kauravaśreṣṭha śakyate yadi rakṣitum || 16 ||
tvatpurogāśca rakṣantu vṛṣṇyandhakamahārathāḥ |
ṛte rāmaṃ mahābāhuṃ pradyumnaṃ ca mahābalam || 17 ||
tato'haṃ vṛṣṇisainyena mahatā parivāritaḥ |
tamagrato dvijaṃ kṛtvā prayātaḥ saha senayā || 18 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi vāsudevamāhātmye ekādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 111 ||

<2.112>

dvādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
arjuna uvāca
muhūrtena vayaṃ grāmaṃ taṃ prāpya bharatarṣabha |
viśrāntavāhanāḥ sarve nivāsāyopasaṃsthitāḥ || 1 ||
tato grāmasya madhye'haṃ niviṣṭaḥ kurunandana |
samantād vṛṣṇisainyena mahatā parivāritaḥ || 2||
tataḥ śakunayo dīptā mṛgāśca krūrabhāṣiṇaḥ |
dīptāyāṃ diśi vāśanto bhayamāvedayanti me || 3 ||
saṃdhyārāgo japāvarṇo bhānumāṃścaiva niṣprabhaḥ |
papāta mahatī colkā pṛthivī cāpyakampata || 4 ||
tānsamīkṣya mahotpātān dāruṇām̐llomaharṣaṇān |
yogamājñāpayaṃstatra janasyotsukacetasaḥ || 5 ||
yuyudhānapurogāśca vṛṣṇyandhakamahārathāḥ |
sarve yuktarathāḥ sajjāḥ svayaṃ cāhaṃ tathābhavam || 6 | |
gate'rdharātrasamaye brāhmaṇo bhayaviklavaḥ |
upāgamya bhayādasmānidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 7 ||
kālo'yaṃ samanuprāpto brāhmaṇyāḥ prasavasya me |
tathā bhavantastiṣṭhantu na bhaved vañcanaṃ yathā || 8 ||
muhūrtādeva cāśrauṣaṃ kṛpaṇaṃ ruditasvanam |
tasya viprasya bhavane hriyate'hriyateti ca || 9 ||
athākāśe punarvācamaśrauṣaṃ bālakasya vai |
ūm̐heti hriyamāṇasya na ca paśyāmi rākṣasam || 2.112.10 ||
tato'smābhistadā tāta śaravarṣaiḥ samantataḥ |
viṣṭambhitā diśaḥ sarvā hṛta eva sa bālakaḥ || 11 ||
brāhmaṇo''rtasvaraṃ kṛtvā hṛte tasmin kumārake |
vācaḥ sa paruṣāstīvrāḥ śrāvayāmāsa māṃ tadā || 12 ||
vṛṣṇayo hatasaṃkalpāstathāhaṃ naṣṭacetanaḥ |
māmevaṃ hi viśeṣeṇa brāhmaṇaḥ pratyabhāṣata || 13||
rakṣiṣyāmīti coktaṃ te na ca rakṣitavānasi |
śṛṇu vākyamidaṃ śeṣaṃ yat tvamarhasi durmate || 14 ||
vṛthā tvaṃ spardhase nityaṃ kṛṣṇenāmitabuddhinā |
yadi syādiha govindo naitadatyāhitaṃ bhavet || 15 ||
yathā caturthaṃ dharmasya rakṣitā labhate phalam|
pāpasyāpi tathā mūḍha bhāgaṃ prāpnotyarakṣitā || 16 ||
rakṣiṣyāmīti coktaṃ te na ca śakto'si rakṣitum |
moghaṃ gāṇḍīvametatte moghaṃ vīryaṃ yaśaśca te || 17 ||
akiñciduktvā taṃ vipraṃ tato'haṃ prasthitastathā |
saha vṛṣṇyandhakasutairyatra kṛṣṇo mahādyutiḥ || 18 ||
tato dvāravatīṃ gatvā dṛṣṭvā madhunighātinam |
vrīḍitaḥ śokasaṃtapto govindenopalakṣitaḥ || 19 ||
sa tu māṃ vrīḍitaṃ dṛṣṭvā vinindan kṛṣṇasaṃnidhau |
mauḍhyaṃ paśyata me yo'haṃ śraddadhe klībakatthanam || 2.112.20 ||
taṃ pradyumno nāniruddho na rāmo na ca keśavaḥ |
yatra śaktāḥ paritrātuṃ ko'nyastadavaneśvaraḥ || 21 ||
dhigarjunaṃ vṛthāvādaṃ dhigātmaślāghino dhanuḥ |
daivopasṛṣṭo yo maurkhyādāgacchati ca durmatiḥ || 22 ||
evaṃ śapati viprarṣau vidyāmāsthāya vaiṣṇavīm |
yayau saṃyaminīṃ vīro yatrāste bhagavān yamaḥ || 23 ||
viprāpatyamacakṣāṇastata aindrīmagāt purīm |
āgneyīṃ nairṛtīṃ saumyāmudīcīṃ vāruṇīṃ tathā || 24 |
rasātalaṃ nākapṛṣṭhaṃ dhiṣṇyānyanyānyudāyudhaḥ |
tato'labdhvā dvijasutamanistīrṇapratiśravaḥ || 25||
agniṃ vivikṣuḥ kṛṣṇena pradyumnena niṣedhitaḥ |
darśaye dvijasūnuṃ te māvajñātmānamātmanā || 26 ||
kīrtiṃ ta ete vipulāṃ sthāpayiṣyanti mānavāḥ |
iti sambhāṣya māṃ snehāt samāśvāsya ca mādhavaḥ || 27 ||
sāntyayitvā tu taṃ vipramidaṃ vacanamabravīt |
sugrīvaṃ caiva śaibyaṃ ca meghapuṣpabalāhakau | 28 ||
yojayāśvāniti tadā dārukaṃ pratyabhāṣata |
āropya brāhmaṇaṃ kṛṣṇo hyavaropya ca dārukam || 29 ||
māmuvāca tataḥ śauriḥ sārathyaṃ kriyatāmiti |
tataḥ samāsthāya rathaṃ kṛṣṇo'haṃ brāhmaṇaḥ sa ca|
prayātāḥ sma diśaṃ saumyāmudīcīṃ kauravarṣabha || 2.112.30 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi vāsudevamāhātmye śrīkṛṣṇasyodīcīgamane dvādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 112 ||

<2.113>

trayodaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
arjuna uvāca
tataḥ parvatajālāni saritaśca vanāni ca |
apaśyaṃ samatikramya sāgaraṃ varuṇālayam || 1 ||
tato'rghyamudadhiḥ sākṣādupanīya janārdanam |
sa prāñjaliḥ samutthāya kiṃkaromīti cābravīt || 2 ||
pratigṛhya sa tāṃ pūjāṃ tamuvāca janārdanaḥ |
rathapanthānamicchāmi tvayā dattaṃ nadīpate || 3 ||
athābravīt samudrastu prāñjalirgaruḍadhvajam |
prasīda bhagavan naivamanyo'pyevaṃ gamiṣyati || 4 ||
tvayaiva sthāpitaḥ pūrvamagādho'smi janārdana |
tvayā pravartite mārge yāsyāmi gamanāyatām || 5 ||
anye'pyevaṃ gamiṣyanti rājāno darpamohitāḥ |
evaṃ saṃcintya govinda yat kṣamaṃ tat samācara || 6 ||
vāsudeva uvāca
brāhmaṇārthaṃ madartha ca kuru sāgara madvacaḥ |
madṛte na pumān kaścidanyastvāṃ dharṣayiṣyati || 7 ||
athābravīt samudrastu punareva janārdanam |
abhiśāpabhayād bhīto bāḍhamevaṃ bhaviṣyati || 8 ||
śoṣayāmyeṣa mārgaṃ te yena tvaṃ kṛṣṇa yāsyasi |
rathena saha sūtena sadhvajena tu keśava || 9 ||
vāsudeva uvāca
mayā datto varaḥ pūrvaṃ na śoṣaṃ yāsyasīti ha |
mānuṣāste na jānīyurvividhān ratnasaṃcayāna || 10 ||
jalaṃ stambhaya sādho tvaṃ tato yāsyāmyahaṃ rathī|
na ca kaścit pramāṇaṃ te ratnānāṃ vetsyate naraḥ || 11 ||
sāgareṇa tathetyukte prasthitāḥ smo jalena vai |
stambhitena pathā bhūmau maṇivarṇena bhāsvatā || 12 ||
tato'rṇavaṃ samuttīrya kurūnapyuttarān vayam |
kṣaṇena samatikrāntā gandhamādanameva ca || 13 ||
tatastu parvatāḥ sapta keśavaṃ samupasthitāḥ |
jayanto vaijayantaśca nīlo rajataparvataḥ || 14 ||
mahāmeruḥ sakailāsa indrakūṭaśca nāmataḥ |
bibhrāṇā varṇarūpāṇi vividhānyadbhutāni ca || 15 ||
upasthāya ca govindaṃ kiṃ kurmetyabruvaṃstadā |
tāṃścaiva pratijagrāha vidhivanmadhusūdanaḥ || 16 ||
tānuvāca hṛṣīkeśaḥ praṇāmāvanatān sthitān |
vivaraṃ gacchato me'dya rathamārgaḥ pradīyatām || 17 ||
te kṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā pratigṛhya ca parvatāḥ |
pradaduḥ kāmato mārgaṃ gacchato bharatarṣabha || 18 ||
tatraivāntarhitāḥ sarve tadāścaryataraṃ mama |
asaktaṃ ca ratho yāti meghajñāleṣvivāṃśumān || 19 ||
sapta dvīpān sasindhuśca sapta sapta girīnatha |
lokālokaṃ tathātītya viveśa sumahattamaḥ || 20 ||
tataḥ kadācid duḥkhena rathamūhusturaṅgamāḥ |
paṅkabhūtaṃ hi timiraṃ sparśād vijñāyate nṛpa || 21 ||
atha parvatabhūtaṃ tat timiraṃ samapadyata |
tadāsādya mahārāja niṣprayatnā hayāḥ sthitāḥ || 22 ||
tataścakreṇa govindaḥ pāṭayitvā tamastadā |
ākāśaṃ darśayāmāsa rathapanthānamuttamam || 23 ||
niṣkramya tamasastasmādākāśe darśite tadā |
bhaviṣyāmīti saṃjñā me bhayaṃ ca vigataṃ mama || 24 ||
tatastejaḥ prajvalitamapaśyaṃ tat tadāmbare|
sarvalokaṃ samāviśya sthitaṃ puruṣavigraham||25||
taṃ praviṣṭo hṛṣīkeśo dīptaṃ tejonidhiṃ tadā |
ratha eva sthitaścāhaṃ sa ca brāhmaṇasattamaḥ || 26 ||
sa muhūrtāt tataḥ kṛṣṇo niścakrāma tadā prabhuḥ |
caturo bālakān gṛhya brāhmaṇasyātmajāṃstadā || 27 ||
pradadau brāhmaṇāyātha putrān sarvāñjanārdanaḥ |
trayaḥ pūrvaṃ hṛtā ye ca sadyojātaśca bālakaḥ || 28 ||
prahṛṣṭo brāhmaṇastatra putrān dṛṣṭvā punaḥ prabho |
ahaṃ ca paramaprīto vismitaścābhavaṃ tadā || 29 ||
tato vayaṃ punaḥ sarve brāhmaṇasya ca te sutāḥ|
yathā gatā nivṛttāḥ sma tathaiva bharatarṣabha||30||
tataḥ sma dvārakāṃ prāptāḥ kṣaṇena nṛpasattam
asamprāpte'rdhadivase vismito'haṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 31 ||
saputraṃ bhojayitvā tu dvijaṃ kṛṣṇo mahāyaśāḥ |
dhanena vardhayitvā ca gṛhaṃ prāsthāpayat tadā || 32 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi vāsudevamāhālaye brāhmaṇaputrānayane travodaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 113 ||

<2.114>

caturdaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
arjuna uvāca
tataḥ kṛṣṇo bhojayitvā śatāni subahūni ca |
viprāṇāmṛṣikalpānāṃ kṛtakṛtyo'bhavat tadā || 1 ||
tataḥ saha mayā bhuktvā vṛṣṇibhojaiśca sarvaśaḥ |
vicitrāśca kathā divyāḥ kathayāmāsa bhārata || 2 ||
tataḥ kathānte tatrāhamabhigamya janārdanam |
apṛcchaṃ tad yathāvṛttaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yad dṛṣṭavānaham || 3 ||
kathaṃ samudraḥ stabdhodaḥ kṛtastu kamalekṣaṇa |
parvatānāṃ ca vivaraṃ kṛtaṃ tat kathamacyuta || 4 ||
tamastacca kathaṃ ghoraṃ ghanaṃ cakreṇa pāṭitam |
tacca yatparamaṃ tejaḥ praviṣṭo'si kathaṃ ca tat || 5 ||
kimarthaṃ tena te bālāstadā cāpahṛtāḥ prabho |
yacca te dīrghamadhvānaṃ saṃkṣiptaṃ tat kathaṃ punaḥ || 6 ||
kathaṃ cālpena kālena nastadgatāgatam |
etat sarvaṃ yathāvṛttamācakṣva mama keśava || 7 ||
vāsudeva uvāca
maddarśanārthaṃ te bālā hṛtāstena mahātmanā |
viprārthameṣyate kṛṣṇo nāgacchedanyatheti ha || 8 ||
brahma tejomayaṃ divyaṃ mahad yad dṛṣṭavānasi |
ahaṃ sa bharataśreṣṭha mattejastat sanātanam || 9 ||
prakṛtiḥ sā mama parā vyaktāvyaktā sanātanī |
yāṃ praviśya bhavantīha muktā yogaviduttamāḥ || 2.114.10 ||
sā sāṃkhyānāṃ gatiḥ pārtha yogināṃ ca tapasvinām |
tat padaṃ paramaṃ brahma sarvaṃ vibhajate jagat || 11 ||
māmeva tad ghanaṃ tejo jñātumarhasi bhārata |
samudraḥ stabdhatoyo'hamahaṃ stambhayitā jalam || 12 ||
ahaṃ te parvatāḥ sapta ye dṛṣṭā vividhāstvayā |
paṅkabhūtaṃ hi timiraṃ dṛṣṭavānasi yaddhi tat || 13 ||
ahaṃ tamo ghanībhūtamahameva ca pāṭakaḥ |
ahaṃ ca kālo bhūtānāṃ dharmaścāhaṃ sanātanaḥ || 14 ||
candrādityau mahāśailāḥ saritaśca sarāṃsi ca |
catasraśca diśaḥ sarvā mamaivātmā caturvidhaḥ || 15 ||
cāturvarṇyaṃ matprasūtaṃ cāturāśramyameva ca |
cāturvidhyasya kartāhamiti budhyasva bhārata || 16 ||
arjuna uvāca
bhagavan sarvabhūteśa vettumicchāmi te prabho |
pṛcchāmi tvāṃ prapanno'haṃ namaste puruṣottama || 17 ||
vāsudeva uvāca
brahma ca brāhmaṇāścaiva tapaḥ satyaṃ ca bhārata |
ugraṃ bṛhattamaṃ caiva mattastad viddhi pāṇḍava || 18 ||
priyaste'haṃ mahābāho priyo me'si dhanaṃjaya |
tena te kathayiṣyāmi nānyathā vaktumutsahe || 19 ||
ahaṃ yajūṃṣi sāmāni ṛcaścātharvaṇāni ca |
ṛṣayo devatā yajñā mattejo bharatarṣabha || 2.114.20 ||
pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam |
candrādityāvahorātraṃ pakṣā māsāstathartavaḥ |
muhūrtāśca kalāścaiva kṣaṇāḥ saṃvatsarāstathā || 21 ||
mantrāśca vividhāḥ pārtha yāni śāstrāṇi kānicit |
vidyāśca veditavyaṃ ca mattaḥ prādurbhavanti hi || 22 ||
manmayaṃ viddhi kaunteya kṣayaṃ sṛṣṭiṃ ca bhārata |
saccāsacca mamaivātmā sadasaccaiva yatparam || 23 ||
arjuna uvāca
evamukto'smi kṛṣṇena prīyamāṇena vai tadā |
tathaiva ca mano nityamabhavanme janārdane || 24 ||
etacchrutaṃ ca dṛṣṭaṃ ca māhātmyaṃ keśavasya me |
yanmāṃ pṛcchasi rājendra bhūyāṃścāto janārdanaḥ || 25 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
etacchrutvā kuruśreṣṭho dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ |
pūjayāmāsa dharmātmā govindaṃ puruṣottamam || 26 ||
vismitaścābhavad rājā saha sarvaiḥ sahodaraiḥ |
rājabhiśca samāsīnairye tatrāsan samāgatāḥ || 27 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi vāsudevamāhātmye kṛṣṇārjunabhāṣaṇe caturdaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 114 ||

<2.115>

pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
bhūya eva dvijaśreṣṭha yadusiṃhasya dhīmataḥ |
karmāṇyaparimeyāṇi śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || 1 ||
śrūyante vividhāni sma adbhutāni mahādyuteḥ |
asaṃkhyeyāni divyāni prakṛtānyapi sarvaśaḥ || 2 ||
yānyahaṃ vividhānyasya śrutvā prīye mahāmune |
prabhūyāḥ sarvaśastāta tāni me śṛṇvato'nagha | 3 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
bahūnyāścaryabhūtali keśavasya mahātmanaḥ |
kathitāni mahābāho nāntaṃ śakyaṃ hi karmaṇām || 4 ||
gantuṃ hi bharataśreṣṭha vistareṇa samantataḥ |
avaśyaṃ hi mayā vācyaṃ leśamātreṇa bhārata || 5 ||
viṣṇoramitavīryasya prathitodārakarmaṇaḥ |
ānupūrvyāṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa || 6 ||
dvāravatyāṃ nivasatā yadusiṃhena dhīmatā |
rāṣṭrāṇi nṛpamukhyānāṃ kṣobhitāni mahātmanām || 7 ||
yadūnāmantaraprepsurvicakro dānavo hataḥ |
puraṃ prāgjyotiṣaṃ gatvā punastena mahātmanā || 8 ||
samudramadhye duṣṭātmā narako dānavo hataḥ |
vāsavaṃ ca raṇe jitvā pārijāto hṛto balāt || 9 ||
varuṇaścaiva bhagavān nirjito lohite hrade |
dantavaktraśca kārūṣo nihato dakṣiṇāpathe || 2.115.10 ||
śiśupālaśca sampūrṇe kilbiṣaikaśate hataḥ |
gatvā ca śoṇitapuraṃ śaṃkareṇābhirakṣitaḥ || 11 ||
baleḥ suto mahāvīryo bāṇo bāhusahasrabhṛt|
mahāmṛdhe mahārāja jitvā jīvan visarjitaḥ || 12 ||
nirjitaḥ pāvakaścaiva girimadhye mahātmanā |
śālvaśca vijitaḥ saṃkhye saubhaśca vinipātitaḥ|| 13 ||
vikṣobhya sāgaraṃ caiva pāñcajanyo vaśīkṛtaḥ |
hayagrīvaśca nihato nṛpāścānye mahābalāḥ || 14 ||
jarāsaṃdhasya nidhane mokṣitāḥ sarvapārthivāḥ |
rathena jitvā nṛpatīn gāndhāratanayā hṛtā || 15 ||
bhraṣṭarājyāśca śokārtāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ parirakṣitāḥ |
dāhitaṃ ca vanaṃ ghoraṃ puruhūtasya khāṇḍavam || 16 ||
gāṇḍīvaṃ cāgninā dattamarjunāyopapāditam |
dautyaṃ ca tatkṛtaṃ ghore vigrahe janamejaya || 17 ||
anena yadumukhyena yaduvaṃśo vivardhitaḥ |
kuntyāśca pramukhe proktā pratijñā pāṇḍavān prati|| 18 ||
nivṛtte bhārate yuddhe pratidāsyāmi tatsutān |
mokṣitaśca mahātejā nṛgaḥ śāpātsudāruṇāt || 19 ||
yavanaśca hataḥ saṃkhye kāla ityabhiviśrutaḥ |
vānarau ca mahāvīryau maindo dvivida eva ca || 2.115.20 ||
vijitau yudhi durdharṣau jāmbavāṃśca parājitaḥ |
sāndīpanestathā putrastava caiva pitā tathā || 21 ||
gatau vaivasvatavaśaṃ jīvitau tasya tejasā |
saṃgrāmā bahavaḥ prāptā ghorā naravarakṣayāḥ || 22
nihatāśca nṛpāḥ sarve kṛtvā tajjayamadbhutam |
janamejayāsya yuddheṣu yathā te varṇitā mayā || 23 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi vāsudevamāhātmye pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||115 ||

<2.116>

ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
bhūya eva mahābāhoryadusiṃhasya dhīmataḥ |
karmāṇyaparimeyāṇi śrutāni dvijasattama || 1 ||
tvattaḥ śrutavatāṃ śreṣṭha vāsudevasya dhīmataḥ |
yat tvayā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ bāṇaṃ prati mahāsuram || 2 ||
kathaṃ ca devadevasya putratvamasuro gataḥ || 3
yo'bhiguptaḥ svayaṃ brahmañchaṅkareṇa mahātmanā |
sahavāsaṃ gatenaiva sagaṇena guhena tu || 4 ||
balerbalavataḥ putro jyeṣṭho bhrātṛśatasya yaḥ |
vṛto bāhusahasreṇa divyāstraśatadhāriṇā || 5 ||
asaṃkhyaiśca mahākāyairmahābalaśatairvṛtaḥ |
vāsudevena sa kathaṃ bāṇaḥ saṃkhye parājitaḥ || 6 ||
saṃrabdhaścaiva yuddhārthī jīvanmuktaḥ kathaṃ ca saḥ |
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājan kṛṣṇasyāmitatejasaḥ || 7 ||
manuṣyaloke bāṇena yathābhūd vigraho mahān |
vāsudevena yatrāsau rudraskandasahāyavān || 8 ||
baliputro raṇaślāghī jitvā jīvanvisarjitaḥ |
yathā cāsya varo dattaḥ śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā || 9 ||
nityaṃ sāṃnidhyatāṃ caiva gāṇapatyaṃ tathākṣayam |
yathā bāṇasya tad yuddhaṃ jīvanmukto yathā ca saḥ || 2.116.10||
yathā ca devadevasya putratvaṃ so'suro gataḥ |
yadarthaṃ ca mahad yuddhaṃ tat sarvamakhilaṃ śṛṇu || 11 ||
dṛṣṭvā vapuḥ kumārasya krīḍataśca mahātmanaḥ |
baliputro mahāvīryo vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 12 ||
tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā tapaścartuṃ suduṣkaram |
rudrasyārādhanārthāya devasya syāṃ yathā sutaḥ || 13 ||
tato'glapayadātmānaṃ tapasā ślāghate ca saḥ |
devaśca paramaṃ toṣaṃ jagāma ca sahomayā || 14 ||
nīlakaṇṭhaḥ parāṃ prītiṃ gatvā cāsuramabravīt |
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yat te manasi vartate || 15 ||
atha bāṇo'bravīd vākyaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram |
devyāḥ putratvamicchāmi tvayā dattaṃ trilocana || 16 ||
śaṃkarastu tathetyuktvā rudrāṇīmidamabravīt|
kanīyān kārtikeyasya putro'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 17 ||
yatrotthito mahāsenaḥ so'gnijo rudhire pure |
tatroddeśe puraṃ cāsya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 18 ||
nāmnā tacchoṇitapuraṃ bhaviṣyati purottamam |
mayābhiguptaṃ śrīmantaṃ na kaścit prasahiṣyati || 19 ||
tataḥ sa nivasan bāṇaḥ pure śoṇitasāhvaye |
rājyaṃ praśāsate nityaṃ kṣobhayan sarvadevatāḥ || 2.116.20 ||
atha vīryamadotsikto bāṇo bāhusahasravān |
acintayan devagaṇān yuddhamākāṅkṣate sadā || 21 ||
dhvajaṃ cāsya dadau prītaḥ kumāro hyagnitejasam |
vāhanaṃ caiva bāṇasya mayūraṃ dīptatejasam || 22 ||
na devā na ca gandharvā na yakṣā nāpi pannagāḥ |
tasya yuddhe vyatiṣṭhanta devadevasya tejasā || 23 ||
tryambakeṇābhiguptaśca darpotsikto mahāsuraḥ |
bhūyo mṛgayate yuddhaṃ śūlinaṃ so'bhyagacchata || 24 ||
sa rudramabhigamyātha praṇipatyābhivādya ca |
balisūnuridaṃ vākyaṃ papraccha vṛṣabhadhvajam || 25 ||
asakṛnnirjitā devāḥ sasādhyāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ |
mayā madabalotsekāt sasainyena tavāśrayāt ||26||
imaṃ deśaṃ samāgamya vasanti sma pure sukham |
te parājayasaṃtrastā nirāśā matparājaye || 27 ||
nākapṛṣṭhamupāgamya nivasanti yathāsukham |
so'haṃ nirāśo yuddhasya jīvitaṃ nādya kāmaye || 28 ||
ayudhyato vṛthā hyeṣāṃ bāhūnāṃ dhāraṇaṃ mama |
tad brūhi mama yuddhasya kaccidāgamanaṃ bhavet |
na me yuddhaṃ vinā deva ratirasti prasīda me || 29 ||
tataḥ prahasya bhagavānabravīd vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ |
bhavitā bāṇa yuddhaṃ vai yathā tacchṛṇu dānava || 2.116.30 ||
dhvajasyāsya yadā bhaṅgastava tāta bhaviṣyati |
svasthāne sthāpitasyātha tadā yuddhaṃ bhaviṣyati || 31 ||
ityevamuktaḥ prahasan bāṇastu bahuśo mudā |
prasannavadano bhūtvā pādayoḥ patito'bravīt || 32 ||
diṣṭyā bāhusahasrasya na vṛthā dhāraṇaṃ mama |
diṣṭyā sahasrākṣamahaṃ vijetā punarāhave || 33 ||
ānandenāśrupūrṇābhyāṃ netrābhyāmarimardanaḥ |
pañcāñjaliśatairdevaṃ pūjayan patito bhuvi || 34 ||
īśvara uvāca
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bāhūnāmātmanaḥ svakulasya tu |
sadṛśaṃ prāpsyase vīra yuddhamapratimaṃ mahat || 35 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evamuktastato bāṇastryambakeṇa mahātmanā |
harṣeṇātyucchritaḥ śīghraṃ nanāma vṛṣabhadhvajam || 36 ||
śitikaṇṭhavisṛṣṭastu bāṇaḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ |
yayau svabhavanaṃ tatra yatra dhvajagṛhaṃ mahat || 37 ||
tatropaviṣṭaḥ prahasan kumbhāṇḍamidamabravīt |
priyamāvedayiṣyāmi bhavato yanmanogatam || 38 ||
ityevamuktaḥ prahasan bāṇamapratimaṃ raṇe |
provāca rājankiṃ tvetadvaktukāmo'si matpriyam||39||
vismayotphullanayanaḥ praharṣādiva bhāṣase |
tvattaḥ śrotumihecchāmi varaṃ kiṃ labdhavānasi || 2.116.40 |
devadevaprasādena skandasya ca mahātmanaḥ |
īpsitaṃ kiṃ tvayā prāptaṃ tanme brūhi mahāsura || 41 ||
śitikaṇṭhaprasādena skandagopāyanena ca |
kaccittrailokyarājyaṃ te vyādiṣṭaṃ śūlapāṇinā || 42 ||
kaccid viṣṇuparitrāsaṃ vimokṣyanti diteḥ sutāḥ|| 43 ||
pātālavāsamutsṛjya kaccittava balāśrayāt |
vibudhāvāsaniratā bhaviṣyanti mahāsurāḥ || 44 ||
balirviṣṇuparākrānto baddhastava pitā nṛpa |
salilaughād viniṣkramya kaccidrājyamavāpsyati||45||
divyamālyāmbaradharaṃ divyasraggandhalepanam |
kaccid vairocaniṃ tāta drakṣyāmaḥ pitaraṃ tava || 46 ||
kaccittribhiḥ kramaiḥ pūrvaṃ hṛtām̐llokānimānprabho |
punaḥ pratyānayiṣyāmo jitvā sarvāndivaukasaḥ || 47 ||
snigdhagambhīranirghoṣaṃ śaṅkhasvanapurojavam |
kaccinnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ jeṣyāmaḥ samitiṃjayam || 48 ||
kaccid vṛṣadhvajastāta prasādasumukhastava |
yathā te hṛdayotkampaḥ sāśrubinduḥ pravartate || 49 ||
kaścidīśvaratoṣeṇa kārtiṃkeyamatena ca |
prāptavānasi sarveṣāmasmākaṃ rājyasampadam ||2.116.50 ||
iti kumbhāṇḍavacanaiścoditaḥ so'surottamaḥ |
bāṇo vāṇīmasaṃsaktāṃ provāca vadatāṃ varaḥ || 51 ||
bāṇa uvāca
cirātprabhṛti kumbhāṇḍa na yuddhaṃ prāpyate mayā |
tato mayā mudā pṛṣṭaḥ śitikaṇṭhaḥ pratāpavān || 52 ||
yuddhābhilāṣaḥ sumahān deva saṃjāyate mama |
abhiprāpsyāmyahaṃ yuddhaṃ manasastuṣṭivardhanam || 53 ||
tato'haṃ devadevena hareṇāmitraghātinā |
prahasya suciraṃ kālamukto'smi vacanaṃ priyam |
prāpsyase sumahad yuddhaṃ tvaṃ bāṇāpratimaṃ mahat || 54 ||
mayūradhvajabhaṅgaste bhaviṣyati yadāsura |
tadā tvaṃ prāpsyase yuddhaṃ sumahad ditinandana || 55 ||
tato'haṃ paramaprīto bhagavantaṃ vṛṣadhvajam |
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ tavāntikamupāgataḥ || 56 ||
ityevamuktaḥ kumbhāṇḍaḥ provāca nṛpatiṃ tadā |
aho na śobhanaṃ rājana yadevaṃ bhāṣase vacaḥ || 57 ||
evaṃ kathayatostatra tayoranyonyamucchritaḥ |
dhvajaḥ papāta vegena śakrāśanisamāhataḥ || 58 ||
taṃ tathā patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā so'suro dhvajamuttamam |
praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe mene cāhavamāgatam || 59 ||
tataścakampe vasudhā śakrāśanisamāhatā |
nanādāntarhito bhūmau vṛṣadaṃśo jagarja ca || 2.116.60 ||
devānāmapi yo devaḥ so'pyavarṣata vāsavaḥ |
śoṇitaṃ śoṇitapure sarvataḥ paramaṃ tataḥ || 61 ||
sūrya bhittvā maholkā ca papāta dharaṇītale |
svapakṣe coditaḥ sūryo bharaṇīṃ samapīḍayat || 62 ||
caityavṛkṣeṣu sahasā dhārāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ |
śoṇitasya sravan ghorā nipetustārakā bhṛśam || 63 ||
rāhuragrasadādityamaparvaṇi viśāmpate |
lokakṣayakare kāle nirghātaścāpatanmahān || 64 ||
dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāsthāya dhūmaketuḥ sthito'bhavat|
aniśaṃ cāpyavicchinnā vavurvātāḥ sudāruṇāḥ || 65 ||
śvetalohitaparyantaḥ kṛṣṇagrīvastaḍiddyutiḥ |
trivarṇaparigho bhānuḥ saṃdhyārāgamathāvṛṇot || 66 ||
vakramaṅgārakaścakre kṛttikāsu bhayaṃkaraḥ |
bāṇasya janmanakṣatraṃ bhartsayanniva sarvaśaḥ || 67||
anekaśākhaścaityaśca nipapāta mahītale |
arcitaḥ sarvakanyābhirdānavānāṃ mahātmanām || 68 ||
evaṃ vividharūpāṇi nimittāni niśāmayan |
bāṇo balamadonmatto niścayaṃ nādhigacchati || 69 ||
vicetāstvabhavat prājñaḥ kumbhāṇḍastattvadarśivān|
bāṇasya sacivastatra kīrtayan bahukilbiṣam || 2.116.70 ||
utpātā hyatra dṛśyante kathayanto na śobhanam |
tava rājyavināśāya bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ || 71 ||
vayaṃ cānye ca sacivā bhṛtyāste ca tavānugāḥ |
kṣayaṃ yāsyanti nacirāt sarve pārthiva durnayāt || 72 ||
yathā śakradhvajataroḥ svadarpāt patanaṃ bhavet |
balamākāṅkṣato mohāt tathā bāṇasya nardataḥ || 73 ||
devadevaprasādāt tu trailokyavijayaṃ gataḥ |
utsekād dṛśyate nāśo yuddhākāṅkṣī nanarda ha || 74 ||
bāṇaḥ prītamanāstvevaṃ papau pānamanuttamam |
daityadānavanārībhiḥ sārdhamuttamavikramaḥ | 75 ||
kumbhāṇḍaścintayāviṣṭo rājaveśmābhyayāttadā |
acintayacca tattvārthaṃ taistairutpātadarśanaiḥ || 76 ||
rājā pramādī durbuddhirjitakāśī mahāsuraḥ |
yuddhamevābhilaṣate na doṣānmanyate madāt || 77 ||
mahotpātabhayaṃ caiva na tanmithyā bhaviṣyati |
apīdānīṃ bhavenmithyā sarvamutpātadarśanam || 78 ||
iha tvāste trinayanaḥ kārtikeyaśca vīryavān |
tenotpanno'pi doṣo naḥ kaccidgacchetparābhavam||79||
utpannadoṣaprabhavaḥ kṣayo'yaṃ bhavitā mahān |
doṣāṇāṃ na bhavennāśa iti me dhīyate matiḥ || 2.116.80||
niyato doṣa evāyaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ |
daurātmyānnṛpaterasya doṣabhūtā hi dānavāḥ || 81 ||
devadānavasaṃghānāṃ yaḥ kartā bhuvanaprabhuḥ |
bhagavān kātikeyaśca kṛtavām̐llohite pure || 82 ||
prāṇaiḥ priyataro nityaṃ bhaviṣyati guhaḥ sadā |
tadviśiṣṭaśca bāṇo'pi śivasya satataṃ priyaḥ || 83 ||
darpotsekāttu nāśāya varaṃ yācitavānbhavam|
yuddhahetoḥ sa lubdhastu sarvathā na bhaviṣyati || 84 ||
yadi viṣṇupurogānāmindrādīnāṃ divaukasām |
bhavitrī ghanavatprāptirbhavahastātkṛtā bhavet || 85||
etayośca hi ko yuddhaṃ kumārabhavayoriha |
śakto dātuṃ samāgamya bāṇasāhāyyakāṅkṣiṇoḥ || 86 ||
na ca devavaco mithyā bhaviṣyati kadācana |
bhaviṣyati mahad yuddhaṃ sarvadaityavināśanam ||
sa evaṃcintayāviṣṭaḥ kumbhāṇḍastattvadarśivān|
svastipraṇihitāṃ buddhiṃ cakāra sa mahāsuraḥ ||88 ||
ye hi devairvirudhyante puṇyakarmabhirāhave |
yathā balirniyamitastathā te yānti saṃkṣayam || 89||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi bāṇayuddhe ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 116 ||

<2.117>

saptadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
krīḍāvihāropagataḥ kadācidabhavad bhavaḥ |
devyā saha nadītīre ramye śrīmati sa prabhuḥ || 1 ||
śatāni tatrāpsarasāṃ cikrīḍuśca samantataḥ |
sarvartukavane ramye gandharvapatayastathā || 2 ||
kusumaiḥ pārijātasya puṣpaiḥ saṃtānakasya ca |
gandhoddāmamivākāśaṃ nadītīraṃ tu sarvaśaḥ || 3 ||
veṇuvīṇāmṛdaṅgaiśca paṇavaiśca sahasraśaḥ |
vādyamānaiḥ sa śuśrāva gītamapsarasāṃ tadā || 4 ||
sūtamāgadhakalpaiścāstuvannapsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ |
devadevaṃ suvapuṣaṃ sragviṇaṃ raktavāsasam || 5 ||
śrīmaheśaṃ devadevamarcayanti manoramam |
tatastu devyā rūpeṇa citralekhā varāpsarāḥ || 6 ||
bhavaṃ prasādayāmāsa devī ca prāhasat tadā |
prasādayantīmīśānaṃ prahasantyapsarogaṇāḥ || 7 ||
bhavasya pārṣadā divyā nānārūpā mahaujasaḥ |
devyā hyanujñayā sarve krīḍante tatra tatra ha || 8||
atha te pārṣadāstatra rahasye suvipaścitaḥ |
mahādevasya rūpeṇa taccihnaṃ rūpamāsthitāḥ || 9 ||
tato devyāḥ surūpeṇa līlayā vadanena ca |
devī prahāsaṃ mumuce tāścaivāpsarasastadā |
tataḥ kilakilāśabdaḥ prādurbhūtaḥ samantataḥ || 10 ||
praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe bhavaḥ prītamanāstadā |
bāṇasya duhitā kanyā tatroṣā nāma bhāminī || 11 ||
devaṃ saṃkrīḍitaṃ dṛṣṭvā devyā saha nadīgatam|
dīpyamānaṃ mahādevaṃ dvādaśādityatejasam ||12 ||
nānārūpaṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā devyāḥ priyacikīrṣayā |
uṣā manorathaṃ cakre pārvatyāḥ saṃnidhau tathā || 13 ||
dhanyā hi bhartṛsahitā ramatyevaṃ samāgatā |
manasā tvatha saṃkalpamuṣayā bhāṣitaṃ tathā | 14 ||
vijñāya tamabhiprāyamuṣāyāḥ parvatātmajā |
prāha devī tato vākyamuṣāṃ harṣayatī śanaiḥ ||15 ||
uṣe tvaṃ śīghramapyevaṃ bhartrā saha ramiṣyasi |
yathā devo mayā sārdhaṃ śaṅkaraḥ śatrunāśanaḥ || 16||
evamukte tadā devyā vākye cintāvilekṣaṇā |
uṣā bhāvaṃ tadā cakre bhartrā raṃsye kadā saha || 17 ||
tadā haimavatī vākyaṃ samprahasyedamabravīt|
uṣe śṛṇuṣva vākyaṃ me yadā saṃyogameṣyasi || 18 ||
vaiśākhe māsi harmyasthāṃ dvādaśyāṃ tvāṃ dinakṣaye |
ramayiṣyati yaḥ svapne sa te bhartā bhaviṣyati || 19 ||
evamuktā daityasutā kanyāgaṇasamāvṛtā |
apākrāmata harṣeṇa ramamāṇā yathāsukham || 20||
tataḥ sakhībhirhāsyantī harṣeṇotphullalocanā |
tālikāsaṃnipātaiśca hyanyonyaṃ jaghnurūrjitāḥ || 21 ||
kinnaryo yakṣakanyāśca nānādaiteyakanyakāḥ |
apsarogaṇakanyāśca uṣāyāḥ sakhitāṃ gatāḥ || 22 ||
uktā ca tatra tābhiśca bhartā tava varānane |
bhaviṣyatyacireṇeva devyā vacanakalpitaḥ || 23 ||
na hi devyā vaco mithyā bhaviṣyati kadācana |
rūpābhijanasampannaḥ patiste kalpitastayā || 24 ||
uṣā sakhīnāṃ tad vākyaṃ pratipūjya yathāvidhi |
dattaṃ manorathaṃ devyā bhāvayantī vyavasthitā || 25 ||
tataḥ krīḍāvihāraṃ tamanubhūya sahomayā |
gate'hani tataḥ sarvā nāryastāḥ paramādbhutāḥ || 26 ||
yayuḥ svānālayān sarvā devī cādarśanaṃ gatā |
kāścidaśvaistathā yānairgajairanyāstathā rathaiḥ || 27 ||
puraṃ praviviśurhṛṣṭāḥ kāścidākāśamāsthitāḥ |
tataḥ prabhṛti sā devī kāmamohaṃ gatā vibho || 28 ||
devyāstu vacanaṃ smṛtvā saṃsmarantī patiṃ tadā |
nidrāṃ na bhajate rātrau na divā bhojanaṃ tathā || 29||
smarantī patibhāvaṃ sā vilalāpa nṛpātmajā |
nindantī śaśinaṃ nāke sevatī na ca candanam || 30 ||
sā bālā mohitā rājan kāmena paripīḍitā |
upacaryanti tāṃ sakhyo vijvarāmapi sajvarām || 31 ||
tapyate hṛdayaṃ tasyā lepitaṃ candanena ca |
kapole pāṇḍimācihnaṃ netre jalasamanvite || 32 ||
jambhaṇaṃ ca tathā svāpo dehe tasyā vyavardhata |
padminīkandacūrṇāni śītalāni muhurmuhuḥ || 33 ||
kṣipanti sakhyo hṛdaye pīḍite manmathāgninā |
vyajanāni prakurvanti pṛcchanti ca punaḥ punaḥ || 34 ||
kā vyathā kiṃ śarīraṃ te kimidaṃ tava bhāmini |
kiṃ tubhyaṃ rocate devi tadākhyāhi varānane || 35 ||
kasmādidaṃ samutpannaṃ duḥkhasādhyaṃ manorame |
tvanmano'nugataṃ vākyaṃ vadantyetāstu sārikāḥ || 36 ||
śukā nīlatamāḥ subhru paṭhanti hi pumāniva |
prahlādajananaṃ vākyaṃ kimarthaṃ nādya bhāṣase || 37 ||
tava tāto mahāvīro devānāmapi durjayaḥ |
tasyāgre tiṣṭhate ko'pi na bhūmau varavarṇini || 38 ||
baleḥ putro mahāvīro bāṇo hi duratikramaḥ |
jitāmarāvatīkaṃ ca nagaraṃ śoṇitāhvayam |
yatra saṃtiṣṭhate daivaḥ śūlahasto maheśvaraḥ || 39 ||
putro'yamiti jānīhi girijāṃ yo'bravīddharaḥ |
bāṇaṃ prati mahādevastava tātamuṣe śṛṇu || 40 ||
kā vyathā te mukhe svedo nāsāgre ca virājate |
nīhārabindavaḥ padme rājante śaradāgame || 41 ||
sampūrṇacandrapratimaṃ mukhaṃ candro yathā ghane |
na śobhate tu vicchāyaṃ kimarthaṃ kāraṇaṃ vada || 42 ||
śvāsān muñcasi bāle tvaṃ na ratiṃ yāsi bhāvataḥ |
gṛhāṇa bhojanaṃ divyaṃ yat te manasi vartate || 43 ||
tāmbūlaṃ rocate pūrvaṃ tat kimarthaṃ na gṛhyate |
miṣṭāni yāni vastūni durlabhānītarairjanaiḥ || 44 ||
gṛhāṇa devi uttiṣṭha vada pīḍāṃ śarīrajām |
iti kolāhalaṃ śrutvā uṣāveśmasamudbhavam || 45 ||
dāsībhiḥ kīrtitaṃ tatra māturagre pṛthak pṛthak|
rājaputrī yadā devi samāyātā gṛhe satī || 46 ||
jalakrīḍāvihārācca mūkeva parilakṣyate |
ato dāsījanā devi vadāmastvāṃ vayaṃ janāḥ || 47 ||
ko mohaḥ kimidaṃ maunaṃ kaḥ svāpo mlānatā katham|
vicārya bhiṣajo devi diśyantāṃ kaṣṭaśāntaye || 48 ||
śirīṣapuṣpasadṛśaṃ yaccharīraṃ sukomalam |
tat kathaṃ sahate devi vyādhibhāraṃ varānane || 49 ||
iti śrutvā tadā devī satvarā haṃsagāminī |
prāpya deśamuṣā yatra kimidaṃ kaṣṭalakṣaṇam || 50 ||
pallavākṛtihastena komalaṃ tatkaraṃ tadā |
spṛṣṭvāṅgulīranāyāsaṃ sphoṭayāmāsa bhāvinī || 51 ||
kimasti tava kalyāṇi kā vyathā tava vartate |
ete vaidyāḥ samāgatya pṛcchanti bhavatīṃ hi tat || 52 ||
vaidyā ūcuḥ
jalakrīḍāṃ gatā tatra rājaputrī sakhīgaṇaiḥ |
pārvatyāḥ krīḍitaṃ tatra jānīmaḥ śramasambhavam || 53 ||
śramādglāniḥ samutpannā jṛmbhaṇaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ |
svāpaśca jāyate tena mā bhayaṃ kartumarhasi || 54||
devyuvāca
hadaye nihitaṃ vaidyāścandanaṃ himasaṃyutam |
amātyāḥ kimidaṃ śīghraṃ kimidaṃ budbudāyate || 55 ||
atidāho mahān svedaḥ pipāsā na bubhukṣate |
pralāpa eva kiṃ tasyāṃ śāstrato brūta niścitam || 56 ||
vaidyā ūcuḥ
krīḍāvihāre militāḥ strījanā devasaṃnidhau |
rūpeṇāpratimā devī rājaputrī ca bhāvinī || 57 ||
dṛṣṭipātaḥ kṛtastābhistena putryāṃ vyathābhavat|
rakṣāmantraistathā pītaiḥ sarṣapaistāṃ kumārikām || 58 ||
pānīyairabhiṣekeṇa parā śāntirbhaviṣyati |
ityuktvā bhiṣajaḥ sarve nivṛttā nṛpaveśmataḥ || 59 ||
sūcayantaḥ punaḥ sarve kāmābhiprāyajāṃ vyathām |
mātṛpṛṣṭā varārohā cirakālamuvāca sā || 60 ||
lajjāvatī mahābhāgā mātaraṃ rudatī bhṛśam |
mātarna rocate nityaṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ na ca bhojanam || 61 ||
na cāpyutsavakaṃ mātaḥ sadāhaṃ hṛdayaṃ śṛṇu |
ityuktvā virarāmātha hyuṣā nārī varānanā || 62 ||
sarvābhiḥ strībhirārabdhamanyonyaṃ mukhavīkṣaṇam|
lajjānukāri nārīṇāṃ yauvanaṃ hi bhavediti || 63 ||
iyaṃ ca rājakanyā hi bhartṛyogyā kimucyate |
pituḥ prasādānmātuśca prāpnuyāt sadṛśaṃ varam || 64 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi bāṇayuddhe uṣāvirahonāma saptadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||117 ||

<2.118>

aṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tatrasthāḥ paramā nāryaścitreṇa paramādbhutāḥ |
tato harmye śayānāṃ tu vaiśākhe māsi bhāminīm|| 1 ||
dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣasya sakhīgaṇavṛtāṃ tadā |
yathoktaḥ puruṣaḥ svapne ramayāmāsa tāṃ śubhām || 2 ||
viceṣṭamānā rudatī devyā vacanacoditā |
sā svapne ramitā tena strībhāvaṃ cāpi lambhitā || 3 ||
śoṇitāktā prarudatī sahasaivotthitā niśi |
tāṃ tathā rudatīṃ dṛṣṭvā sakhī bhayasamanvitā || 4 ||
citralekhā vacaḥ snigdhamuvāca paramādbhutam|
uṣe mā bhaiḥ kimevaṃ tvaṃ rudatī paritapyase |
baleḥ sutasutā ca tvaṃ prakhyātā kiṃ bhayānvitā|| 5 ||
na bhayaṃ vidyate loke tava subhru viśeṣataḥ |
abhayaṃ tava vāmoru pitā devāntako raṇe || 6 ||
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhadraṃ te viṣādaṃ mā kṛthāḥ śubhe |
naivaṃvidheṣu vāseṣu bhayamasti varānane || 7 ||
asakṛd devasahitaḥ śacībhartā sureśvaraḥ |
aprāpta eva nagaraṃ pitrā te mṛdito raṇe || 8 ||
ayaṃ devasamūhasya bhayadaśca pitā tava |
mahāsuravaraḥ śrīmān baleḥ putro mahābalaḥ || 9 ||
evaṃ sābhihitā sakhyā bāṇaputrī yaśasvinī|
svapne rūpaṃ yathā dṛṣṭaṃ nyavedayadaninditā || 10 ||
uṣovāca
evaṃ saṃdharṣitā sādhvī kathaṃ jīvitumutsahe |
pitaraṃ kiṃ nu vakṣyāmi devaśatrumariṃdamam || 11 ||
evaṃ saṃdūṣaṇakarī vaṃśasyāsya mahaujasaḥ |
śreyo hi maraṇaṃ mahyaṃ na me śreyo'dya jīvitam || 12 ||
īpsito vā yathā ko'pi puruṣo'dhigato hi me |
jāgratīva yathā cāhamavasthaivaṃ kṛtā mama || 13 ||
niśāyāṃ jāgratīvāhaṃ nītā kena daśāmimām |
kathamevaṃ kṛtā nāma kanyā jīvitumutsahe || 14 ||
kulopakrośanakarī kulāṅgārī nirāśrayā |
jīvituṃ na spṛhennārī sādhvīnāmagrataḥ sthitā || 15 ||
ityevaṃ bāṣpapūrṇākṣī sakhījanavṛtā tadā |
vilalāpa ciraṃ kālamuṣā kamalalocanā || 16 ||
anāthavat tāṃ rudatīṃ sakhyaḥ sarvā vicetasaḥ |
ūcuraśruparītākṣīmuṣāṃ sarvāḥ samāgatāḥ || 17 ||
duṣṭena manasā devi śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham |
kriyate na ca te subhru kiṃcid duṣṭaṃ manaḥ śubhe || 18 ||
prasabhaṃ daivasaṃyogād yadi bhuktāsi bhāmini |
svapnayogena kalyāṇi vratalopo na vidyate || 19 ||
vyabhicāreṇa te devi nāsti kaścid vyatikramaḥ |
na ca svapnakṛto doṣo martyaloke'sti sundari || 20 ||
evaṃ viprarṣayo devi dharmajñāḥ kathayanti vai |
manasā caiva vācā ca karmaṇā ca viśeṣataḥ |
duṣṭā yā tribhiretaistu pāpā sā procyate budhaiḥ || 21 ||
na ca te dṛśyate bhīru manaḥ pracalitaṃ sadā |
kathaṃ tvaṃ doṣasaṃduṣṭā niyatā brahmacāriṇī || 22 ||
yadi suptā satī sādhvī śuddhabhāvā manasvinī |
imāmavasthāṃ prāptā tvaṃ naiva dharmo vilupyate || 23 ||
yasyā duṣṭaṃ manaḥ pūrvaṃ karmaṇā copapāditam |
tāmāhurasatī nāma satī tvamasi bhāmini || 24 ||
kulajā rūpasampannā niyatā brahmacāriṇī |
imāmavasthāṃ nītāsi kālo hi duratikramaḥ || 25 ||
ityevamuktāṃ rudatīṃ bāṣpeṇāvṛtalocanām |
kumbhāṇḍaduhitā vākyaṃ paramaṃ tvidamabravīt || 26 ||
tyaja śokaṃviśālākṣi apāpā tvaṃ varānane |
śrutaṃ me yadidaṃ vākyaṃ yāthātathyena tacchṛṇu || 27 ||
uṣe yaduktā devyāsi bhartāraṃ dhyāyatī tadā |
samīpe devadevasya smara bhāmini tad vacaḥ || 28 ||
dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣasya vaiśākhe māsi yo niśi |
harmye śayānāṃ rudatīṃ strītvaṃ samupaneṣyati || 29 ||
bhavitā sa hi te bhartā śūraḥ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ |
ityuvāca vaco hṛṣṭā devī tava manogatam || 30 ||
na hi tad vacanaṃ mithyā pārvatyā yadudāhṛtam |
sā tvaṃ kimidamatyarthaṃ rodiṣīndunibhānane || 31 ||
evamuktā tayā bālā smṛtvā devīvacastataḥ |
abhavantaṣṭaśokā sā bāṇaputrī śubhekṣaṇā || 32 ||
uṣovāca
smarāmi bhāmini vaco devyāḥ krīḍāgate bhave |
yathoktaṃ sarvamakhilaṃ prāptaṃ harmyatale mayā || 33 ||
bhartā tu mama yadyeṣa lokanāthasya bhāryayā |
vyādiṣṭaḥ sa kathaṃ jñeyastatra kāryaṃ vidhīyatām || 34 ||
ityevamukte vacane kumbhāṇḍaduhitā punaḥ |
vyājahāra yathānyāyamarthatattvaviśāradā || 35||
na hi tasya kulaṃ deviṃ na kīrtiṃ nāpi pauruṣam |
kañcijjānāti tattvena kimidaṃ tvaṃ vimuhyase || 36 ||
adṛṣṭaścāśrutaścaiva dṛṣṭaḥ svapne ca yaḥ śubhe |
kathaṃ jñeyo bhaved bhīru so'smābhīratitaskaraḥ || 37 ||
yena tvamasitāpāṅgi mattakāśini vikramāt |
rudatī prasabhaṃ bhuktā praviśyāntaḥpuraṃ sakhi || 38 ||
na hyasau prākṛtaḥ kaścid yaḥ praviṣṭaḥ prasahya te |
nagaraṃ lokavikhyātamekaḥ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ || 39 ||
ādityā vasavo rudrā aśvinau ca mahaujasau |
na śaktāḥ śoṇitapuraṃ praveṣṭuṃ bhīmavikramāḥ || 40 ||
so'yametaiḥ śataguṇairviśiṣṭaścārisūdanaḥ |
praviṣṭaḥ śoṇitapuraṃ bāṇamākramya mūrdhani || 41 ||
yasyā naivaṃvidho bhartā bhaved yuddhaviśāradaḥ |
kastasyā jīvitenārtho bhogairvāstyambujekṣaṇe || 42 ||
dhanyāsyanugṛhītāsi yasyāste patirīdṛśaḥ |
prāpto devyāḥ prasādena kandarpasamavikramaḥ || 43 ||
idaṃ tu yat kāryatamaṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ tanmayeritam |
vijñeyo yasya putro vai yannāmā yatkulaśca saḥ || 44 ||
ityevamukte vacane tatroṣā kāmamohitā |
uvāca kumbhāṇḍasutāṃ kathaṃ jñāsyāmyahaṃ sakhi || 45 ||
tvameva cintaya sakhi nottaraṃ pratibhāti me |
svakārye muhyate loko yathā jīvaṃ labhāmyaham || 46 ||
uṣāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā rāmā vākyamidaṃ punaḥ |
uvāca rudatīṃ coṣāṃ kumbhāṇḍaduhitā sakhī || 47 ||
kuśalā te viśālākṣi sarvathā saṃdhivigrahe |
apsarā citralekhā vai kṣipraṃ vijñāpyatāṃ sakhi || 48 ||
asyāḥ sarvamaśeṣeṇa trailokyaṃ viditaṃ sadā |
evamuktā tadaivoṣā harṣeṇāgatavismayā ||49 ||
tāmapsarasamānāyya citralekhāṃ sakhīṃ priyām |
kṛtāñjalipuṭā dīnā uṣā vacanamabravīt || 50 ||
srā tacchrutvā tu vacanamuṣāyāḥ parikīrtitam|
āśvāsayāmāsa sakhī bāṇaputrīṃ yaśasvinīm || 51 ||
tataḥ sā vismayāviṣṭā vacanaṃ prāha durvacam |
citralekhāmapsarasaṃ praṇayāt tāṃ sakhīmidam || 52 ||
paramaṃ śṛṇu me vākyaṃ yat tvāṃ vakṣyāmi bhāmini|
bhartāraṃ yadi me'dya tvaṃ nānayiṣyasi matpriyam|| 53 ||
kāntaṃ padmapalāśākṣaṃ mattamātaṅgagāminam |
tyakṣyāmyahaṃ tataḥ prāṇānacirāt tanumadhyame || 54 ||
citralekhābravīd vākyamuṣāṃ harṣayatī śanaiḥ |
naiṣo'rthaḥ śakyate'smābhirvettuṃ bhāmini suvrate ||55 ||
na kulena na varṇena na śīlena na rūpataḥ |
na deśataśca vijñātaḥ sa hi cāro mayā sakhi || 56 ||
kiṃ tu kartuṃ yathā śakyaṃ buddhipūrvaṃ mayā sakhi |
prāptaṃ ca śṛṇu me vākyaṃ yathākāmamavāpsyasi || 57 ||
devadānavayakṣāṇāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām |
ye viśiṣṭāḥ prabhāveṇa rūpeṇābhijanena ca || 58 ||
yathāprabhāvaṃ tān sarvānālikhiṣyāmyahaṃ sakhi |
manuṣyaloke ye cāpi pravarā lokaviśrutāḥ || 59 ||
saptarātreṇa te bhīru darśayiṣyāmi tānaham |
tato vijñāya pādasthaṃ bhartāraṃ pratipatsyase || 60 ||
sā citralekhayā proktā uṣā hitacikīrṣayā |
kriyatāmevamityāha citralekhāṃ sakhīṃ priyām || 61 ||
tataḥ kuśalahastatvād yathālekhyaṃ samantataḥ |
ityuktvā saptarātreṇa kṛtvā lekhyagatāṃstu tān|| 62 ||
citrapaṭṭagatān mukhyānānayāmāsa śobhanā |
tataḥ prāstīrya paṭṭaṃ sā citralekhā svayaṃkṛtam || 63 ||
uṣāyai darśayāmāsa sakhīnāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ |
ete deveṣu ye mukhyāstathā dānavavaṃśajāḥ ||64 ||
kinnaroragayakṣāṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ samantataḥ |
gandharvāsuradaityānāṃ ye cānye bhoginaḥ smṛtāḥ ||65||
manuṣyāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ ye viśiṣṭatamā narāḥ |
tānetānpaśya sarvāṃstvaṃ yathaiva likhitān mayā ||66||
yaste bhartā yathārūpaḥ sa mayā likhitaḥ sakhi |
taṃ tvaṃ pratyabhijānīhi svapne yaṃ dṛṣṭavatyasi || 67 ||
tataḥ krameṇa sarvāṃstān dṛṣṭvā sā mattakāśinī |
devadānavagandharvavidyādharagaṇānatha |
atītya ca yadūn sarvān dadarśa yadunandanam || 68 ||
tatrāniruddhaṃ dṛṣṭvā sā vismayotphullalocanā |
uvāca citralekhāṃ tāmayaṃ cauraḥ sa vai sakhi || 69 ||
yenāhaṃ dūṣitā pūrvaṃ svapne harmyagatā satī |
so'ya vijñātarūpo me kuto'yaṃ ratitaskaraḥ || 70 ||
citralekhe vadasvainaṃ tattvato mama śobhane |
kulaśīlābhijanato nāma kiṃ cāsya bhāmini |
tataḥ paścād vidhāsyāmi kāryasyāsya viniścayam||71||
citralekhovāca
ayaṃ trailokyanāthasya naptā kṛṣṇasya dhīmataḥ |
bhartā tava viśālākṣi prādyumnirbhīmavikramaḥ || 72 ||
na hyasti triṣu lokeṣu sadṛśo'sya parākrame |
utpāṭya parvatāneva parvataireṣa śātayet || 73 ||
dhanyāsyanugṛhītāsi yasyāste yadupuṅgavaḥ |
tryakṣapatnyā samādiṣṭaḥ sadṛśaḥ sajjanaḥ patiḥ || 74 ||
uṣovāca
tvamevātra viśālākṣi yogyā bhava varānane |
na śakyā hi gatiścānyā agatyā me gatirbhava || 75 ||
antarikṣacarā ca tvaṃ yoginī kāmarūpiṇī |
upāyasyāsya kuśalā kṣipramānaya me priyam || 76 ||
upāyaścintyatāṃ bhīru sampratarkya priye sukham |
siddhārthā saṃnivartasva yenopāyena sundari || 77 ||
bhavedāpatsu yanmitraṃ tanmitraṃ śasyate budhaiḥ |
kāmārtā cāsmi suśroṇi bhava me prāṇadhāriṇī || 78 ||
yadyenaṃ me viśālākṣi bhartāramamaropamam |
adya nānayasi kṣipraṃ prāṇāṃstyakṣyāmyahaṃ śubhe || 79 ||
uṣāyāḥ vacanaṃ śrutvā citralekhābravīd vacaḥ |
śrotumarhasi kalyāṇi vacanaṃ me śucismite || 80 ||
yathā bāṇasya nagarī rakṣyate devi sarvaśaḥ |
dvārakāpi tathā bhīru durādharṣā surairapi || 81 ||
ayasmayapraticchannā guptadvārā ca sā purī |
guptā vṛṣṇikumāraiśca tathā dvārakavāsibhiḥ || 82 ||
prānte salilasaṃyuktā vihitā viśvakarmaṇā |
rakṣyate puruṣairghoraiḥ padmanābhasya śāsanāt || 83||
śailaprākāraparikhādurgamārgapraveśinī |
saptaprākāraracitā parvatairdhātumaṇḍitaiḥ || 84 ||
na ca śakyamavijñātaiḥ praveṣṭuṃ dvārakāṃ purīm |
ātmānaṃ māṃ ca rakṣasva pitaraṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 85 ||
uṣovāca
tava yogaprabhāveṇa śakyaṃ tatra praveśanam |
bahunā kiṃ pralāpena pratijñā śrūyatāṃ mama || 86 ||
aniruddhasya vadanaṃ pūrṇacandrasamaprabham |
yadyahaṃ tanna paśyāmi yāsyāmi yamasādanam || 87 ||
dūtamāsādya kāryāṇāṃ siddhirbhavati bhāmini |
tasmāddautyena me gaccha jīvantīṃ māṃ yadīcchasi || 88 ||
yadi tvaṃ me vijānāsi sakhyaṃ premṇā ca bhāṣitam|
kṣipramānaya me kāntaṃ tavāsmi śaraṇaṃ gatā || 89 ||
jīvitasya hi saṃdehaṃ kṣayaṃ caiva kulasya ca |
kāmārtā hi na paśyanti kāminyo madaviklavāḥ || 90 ||
prayatno yujyate kāryeṣviti śāstranidarśanam |
tvaṃ ca śaktā viśālākṣi dvārakāyāṃ praveśane || 91 ||
saṃstutāsi mayā bhīru kuru me priyadarśanam |
citralekhovāca
sarvathā saṃstutā te'haṃ vākyairamṛtasodaraiḥ || 92 ||
kāritā ca samudyogaṃ priyaiḥ kāntaiśca bhāṣitaiḥ |
eṣā gacchāmyahaṃ bhīru kṣipraṃ vai dvārakāṃ purīm || 93 ||
bhartāramānayāmyadya tava vṛṣṇikulodbhavam |
aniruddhaṃ mahābāhuṃ praviśya dvārakāṃ purīm || 94 ||
sā vacastathyamaśivaṃ dānavānāṃ bhayāvaham |
uktvā cāntarhitā kṣipraṃ citralekhā manojavā || 95 ||
sakhībhiḥ sahitā hyūṣā cintayantī tu sā sthitā|
tṛtīye tu muhūrte sā naṣṭā bāṇapurāt tadā || 96 ||
sakhīpriyaṃ cikīrṣantī pūjayantī tapodhanān |
kṣaṇena samanuprāptā dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇapālitām || 97 ||
kailāsaśikharākāraiḥ prāsādairupaśobhitām |
dadarśa dvārakāṃ ramyāṃ divi tārāmiva sthitām || 98 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi uṣāharaṇe citralekhāyā dvārakāgamane aṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 118 ||

<2.119>

ekonaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
adya dvāravatīṃ prāpya sthitā sā bhavanāntike |
pravṛttiharaṇārthāya citralekhā vyacintayat || 1 ||
atha cintayatī sā tu buddhibuddhyarthaniścayam|
apaśyannāradaṃ tatra dhyāyantamudake munim || 2 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā citralekhā tu harṣeṇotphullalocanā |
upasṛtyābhivādyātha tatraivādhomukhī sthitā || 3 ||
nāradastvāśiṣaṃ dattvā citralekhāmathābravīt |
kimarthamiha samprāptā śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || 4 ||
devarṣimatha taṃ divyaṃ nāradaṃ lokapūjitam |
kṛtāñjalapuṭā bhūtvā citralekhā tvathābravīt || 5 ||
bhagavañchrūyatāṃ vākyaṃ dautyenāhamihāgatā |
aniruddhaṃ mune netuṃ yadarthaṃ ca śṛṇuṣva me || 6 ||
nagare śoṇitapure bāṇo nāma mahāsuraḥ |
tasya kanyā varārohā nāmnoṣeti ca viśrutā || 7 ||
bhagavan sānuraktā ca prādyumniṃ puruṣottamam |
devyā varavisargeṇa tasyā bhartā vinirmitaḥ || 8 ||
taṃ ca netuṃ samāyātā tatra siddhiṃ vidhatsa me |
mayā nīte'niruddhe tu nagaraṃ śoṇitāhvayam || 9 ||
pravṛttiḥ puṇḍarīkākṣe tvayā''khyeyā mahāmune |
avaśyaṃ bhavitā caiva kṛṣṇena saha vigrahaḥ |
bāṇasya sumahān saṃkhye divyo hi sa mahāsuraḥ || 2.119.10 ||
na ca śakto'niruddhastaṃ yuddhe jetuṃ mahāsuram |
sahasrabāhumāyāntaṃ jayet kṛṣṇo mahābhujaḥ || 11 ||
bhagavan saṃnikarṣaṃ te yadarthamahamāgatā |
kathaṃ hi puṇḍarīkākṣo jñāpitastadidaṃ bhavet || 12 ||
tvatprasādācca bhagavanna me kṛṣṇādbhayaṃ bhavet|
sa hi tattvārthadṛṣṭistu aniruddhaḥ kathaṃ hriyet || 13 ||
kruddho hi sa mahābāhustrailokyamapi nirdahet|
pautraśokābhisaṃtaptaḥ śāpena sa daheta mām || 14 ||
tatropāyaṃ ca bhagavaṃścintituṃ vai tvamarhasi |
yathā hyuṣā labhet kāntaṃ mama caivābhayaṃ bhavet || 15 ||
ityevamukto bhagavāṃścitralekhāṃ sa nāradaḥ |
uvāca sa śubhaṃ vākyaṃ mā bhaistvamabhayaṃ śṛṇu || 16 ||
tvayā nīte'niruddhe tu kanyāveśmapraveśite |
yadi yuddhaṃ bhavettatra smartavyo'haṃ śucismite || 17 ||
mamaiṣa paramaḥ kāmo yuddhaṃ draṣṭuṃ manorame |
tad dṛṣṭvā ca mahāprītiḥ pravṛttiśca dṛḍhā bhavet|| 18 ||
gṛhyatāṃ tāmasī vidyā sarvalokapramohinī |
kṛtakṛtyastu te devi eṣa vidyāṃ dadāmyaham || 19 ||
evamukte tu vacane nāradena maharṣiṇā |
tatheti vacanaṃ prāha citralekhā manojavā || 2.119.20 ||
abhivādya mahāmānamṛṣīṇāṃ nāradaṃ varam |
sā jagāmāniruddhasya gṛhaṃ caivāntarikṣagā || 21 ||
tato dvāravatīmadhye kāmasya bhavanaṃ śubham |
tatsamīpe'niruddhasya bhavanaṃ sā viveśa ha || 22 ||
sauvarṇavedikāstambhaṃ rukmavaiḍūryatoraṇam |
mālyadāmāvasaktaṃ ca pūrṇakumbhopaśobhitam || 23 ||
barhikaṇṭhanibhagrīvaṃ prāsādairekasaṃcayaiḥ |
maṇipravālavistīrṇaṃ devagandharvanāditam || 24 ||
dadarśa bhavanaṃ yatra prādyumniravasat sukham |
tataḥ praviśya sahasā bhavanaṃ tasya tanmahat || 25 ||
tatrāniruddhaṃ sāpaśyaccitralekhā varāpsarāḥ |
madhye paramanārīṇāṃ tārāpatimivoditam || 26 ||
krīḍāvihāre nārībhiḥ sevyamānamitastataḥ |
pibantaṃ madhu mādhvīkaṃ śriyā paramayā yutam || 27 ||
varāsanagataṃ tatra yathā caiḍavilaṃ tathā |
vādyate samatālaṃ ca gīyate madhuraṃ tathā || 28 ||
na ca tasya manastatra tamevārthamacintayat |
striyaḥ sarvaguṇopetā nṛtyante tatra tatra vai || 29 ||
na cāsya manasastuṣṭiṃ citralekhā prapaśyati |
na cābhiramate bhogairna cāpi madhu sevate || 2.119.30 ||
vyaktamasya hi tatsvapno hṛdaye parivartate |
iti tatraiva buddhyā ca niścitā gatasādhvasā || 31 ||
sā dṛṣṭvā paramastrīṇāṃ madhye śakradhvajopamam |
cintayāviṣṭahṛdayā citralekhā manasvinī || 32 ||
kathaṃ kāryamidaṃ kāryaṃ kathaṃ svasti bhavediti |
sāntarhitā cintayitvā citralekhā yaśasvinī || 33 ||
tāmasyā cchādayāmāsa vidyayā śubhalocanā |
tato'ntarikṣādevāśu prāsādoparyadhiṣṭhitā || 34 ||
prādyumniṃ vacanaṃ prāha ślakṣṇaṃ madhurayā girā |
cakṣurdattvā tu sā tasmai kṛtvā cātmanidarśanam||35||
vivikte sā ca vai deśe taṃ vākyamidamabravīt |
api te kuśalaṃ vīra sarvatra yadunandana || 36 ||
ahastāvatpradoṣo vā kaccidgacchati te sukham |
śṛṇuṣva tvaṃ mahābāho vijñaptiṃ me ratīsuta || 37 ||
uṣāyā mama sakhyāstu vākyaṃ vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ |
svapne tu yā tvayā dṛṣṭā strībhāvaṃ cāpi bhāvitā || 38 ||
bibharti hṛdaye yā tvāmuṣayā preṣitā tvaham |
rudantī jṛmbhatī caiva niḥśvasantī muhurmuhuḥ || 39 ||
tvaddarśanaparā saumya kāminī paritapyate |
yadi tvaṃ yāsyase vīra dhārayiṣyati jīvitam || 2.119.40 ||
adarśanena maraṇaṃ tasyā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ |
yadi nārīsahasraṃ te hṛdisthaṃ yadunandana || 41 ||
striyāḥ kāmayamānāyāḥ kartavyā hastadhāraṇā |
tvaṃ ca tasyā varotsargaṃ datto devyā manorathaḥ || 42 ||
citrapaṭṭaṃ mayā dattaṃ tvaccihnaṃ dṛśya jīvati |
sānukrośo yaduśreṣṭha bhava tasyā manorathe || 43 ||
uṣā te patate mūrdhnā vayaṃ ca yadunandana |
śrūyatāṃ codbhavastasyāḥ kulaśīlaṃ ca yādṛśam || 44 ||
saṃsthānaṃ prakṛtiṃ cāsyāḥ pitaraṃ ca bravīmi te |
vairocanisuto vīro bāṇo nāma mahāsuraḥ || 45 ||
sa rājā śoṇitapure tasya tvāmicchate sutā |
tvadbhāvagatacittā sā tvanmayaṃ cāpi jīvitam || 46 ||
manorathakṛto bhartā devyā datto na saṃśayaḥ |
tvatsaṃgamāt sā suśroṇī prāṇān dhārayate śubhā||47||
citralekhāvacaḥ śrutvā so'niruddho'bravīdidam |
dṛṣṭā svapne mayā sā hi tanmattaḥ śṛṇu śobhana || 48 ||
rūpaṃ kāntiṃ matiṃ caiva saṃyogaṃ ruditaṃ tathā |
evaṃ sarvamahorātraṃ muhyāmi paricintayan || 49 ||
yadyahaṃ samanugrāhyo yadi sakhyaṃ tvamicchasi |
nayasva citralekhe māṃ draṣṭumicchāmyahaṃ priyām || 2.119.50 ||
kāmasaṃtāpasaṃtaptaḥ priyāsaṅgamakāmataḥ |
eṣo'ñjalirmayā baddhaḥ satyaṃ svapna kuruṣva me || 51 ||
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā citralekhā varāpsarāḥ |
saphalo'dya mama kleśaḥsakhyā me yatprayācitam||52||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
īpsitaṃ tasya vijñāya aniruddhasya bhāminī |
citralekhā tatastuṣṭā tatheti ca tamabravīt || 53 ||
harmye strīgaṇamadhyasthaṃ kṛtvā cāntarhitaṃ tadā |
utpapāta gṛhītvā sā prādyumniṃ yuddhadurmadam || 54 ||
sā tamadhvānamāgamya siddhacāraṇasevitam |
sahasā śoṇitapuraṃ praviveśa manojavā || 55 ||
adarśanaṃ tamānīya māyayā kāmarūpiṇī |
aniruddhaṃ mahābhāgā yatroṣā tatra gacchati || 56 ||
uṣāyā darśayaccainaṃ citrābharaṇabhūṣitam |
citrāmbaradharaṃ vīraṃ rahasyamararūpiṇam || 57 ||
tatroṣā vismitā dṛṣṭvā harmyasthā sakhisaṃnidhau|
praveśayāmāsa ca taṃ tadā sā svagṛhaṃ tataḥ || 58 ||
praharṣotphullanayanā priyaṃ dṛṣṭvārthakovidā |
sā harmyasthā tamarghyeṇa yādavaṃ samapūjayat || 59 ||
citralekhāṃ pariṣvajya priyākhyānairatoṣayat |
tvaritā kāminī prāha citralekhāṃ bhayāturā || 2.119.60 ||
sakhīdaṃ vai kathaṃ kāryaṃ guhyakāryaviśārade |
guhye kṛte bhavet svasti prakāśe jīvitakṣayaḥ || 61 ||
citralekhābravīdvākyaṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ niścayaṃ sakhi |
kṛtaṃ puruṣakāreṇa daivaṃ nāśayate kṣaṇāt || 62 ||
yadi devyāḥ prasādaste hyanukūlo bhaviṣyati |
adya māyākṛtaṃ guhyaṃ na kaścijjñāsyate naraḥ || 63 ||
sakhyā vai evamuktā sā paryavasthitacetanā |
evametaditi prāha sāniruddhamidaṃ vacaḥ || 64 ||
diṣṭyā svapnatagataścauro dṛśyate subhagaḥ patiḥ |
yatkṛte tu vayaṃ khinnā durlabhapriyakāṅkṣayā || 65 ||
kaccit tava mahābāho kuśalaṃ sarvatogatam |
hṛdayaṃ hi mṛdu strīṇāṃ tena pṛcchāmyahaṃ tava || 66 ||
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā uṣāyāḥ ślakṣṇamarthavat|
so'pyāha yaduśārdūlaḥ śubhākṣarataraṃ vacaḥ || 67 ||
harṣaviplutanetrāyāḥ pāṇināśru pramṛjya ca |
prahasya sasmitaṃ prāha hṛdayagrāhakaṃ vacaḥ || 68 ||
kuśalaṃ me varārohe sarvatra mitabhāṣiṇi |
tvatprasādena me devi priyamāvedayāmi te || 69 ||
adṛṣṭapūrvaśca mayā deśo'yaṃ śubhadarśane |
niśi svapne yathā dṛṣṭaḥ sakṛtkanyāpure tathā || 2.119.70 ||
evamevamahaṃ bhīru tvatprasādādihāgataḥ|
na ca tadrudrapatnyā vai mithyā vākyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 71 ||
devyāste prītimājñāya tvatpriyārthaṃ ca bhāmini |
anuprāpto'smi cādyaiva prasīda śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 72 ||
ityuktā tvaramāṇā sā guhyadeśe svalaṃkṛtā |
kāntena saha saṃyuktā sthitā vai bhītabhītavat|| 73 |
tataścodvāhadharmeṇa gāndharveṇa samīyatuḥ |
anyonyaṃ ramatustau tu cakravākau yathā divā || 74 ||
patinā sāniruddhena mumude tu varāṅganā |
kāntena saha saṃyuktā divyavastrānulepanā || 75 ||
ramamāṇāniruddhena avijñātā sutā tadā |
tasminneva kṣaṇe prāpte yadūnāmṛṣabho hi saḥ || 76 ||
divyamālyāmbaradharo divyasraganulepanaḥ |
uṣayā saha saṃyukto vijñāto bāṇarakṣibhiḥ || 77 ||
tatastaiścārapuruṣairbāṇasyāveditaṃ drutam |
yathā dṛṣṭamaśeṣeṇa kanyāyāstadatikramam || 78 ||
tataḥ kiṅkarasainyaṃ tu vyādiṣṭaṃ bhīmakarmaṇā |
baleḥ putreṇa vīreṇa bāṇenāmitraghātinā || 79 ||
gacchadhvaṃ sahitāḥ sarve hanyatāmeva durmatiḥ |
yena naḥ 'kulacāritraṃ dūṣitaṃ dūṣitātmanā || 2.119.80 ||
uṣāyāṃ dharṣitāyāṃ hi kulaṃ no dharṣitaṃ mahat |
asampradattāṃ yo'smābhiḥ svayaṃ grāhamadharṣayat || 81 ||
aho vīryamaho dhairyamaho dhārṣṭyaṃ ca durmateḥ |
yaḥ puraṃ bhavanaṃ cedaṃ praviṣṭo naḥ sa bāliśaḥ || 82 ||
evamuktvā punastāṃstu kiṅkarāṃścodayadbhṛśam |
te tasyājñāmatho gṛhya susaṃnaddhā viniryayuḥ || 83 ||
yatrāniruddho hyabhavat tatrāgacchan mahābalāḥ || 84 ||
nānāśastrodyatakarā nānārūpā bhayaṃkarāḥ |
dānavāḥ samabhikruddhāḥ prādyumnivadhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ || 85 ||
ruroda tadvalaṃ dṛṣṭvā bāṣpeṇāvṛtalocanā |
prādyumnivadhabhītā sā bāṇaputrī yaśasvinī || 86 ||
tatastu rudatīṃ dṛṣṭvā tāmūṣāṃ mṛgalocanām |
hā hā kānteti vepantīmaniruddho'bhyabhāṣata || 87 ||
abhayaṃ te'stu suśroṇi mā bhaistvaṃ hi mayi sthite |
samprāpto harṣakālaste nehāsti bhayakāraṇam || 88 ||
kṛtsno'yaṃ yadi bāṇasya bhṛtyavargo yaśasvini |
āgacchati na me cintā bhīru paśyādya vikramam || 89 ||
tasya sainyasya ninadaṃ śrutvābhyāgacchatastataḥ |
sahasaivotthitaḥ śrīmānprādyumniḥ kimiti bruvan ||2.119.90||
atha so'paśyata balaṃ nānāpraharaṇodyatam |
sthitaṃ samantatastatra parivārya gṛhaṃ mahat || 91 ||
tato'bhyagacchat tvarito yatra tadveṣṭitaṃ balam|
kruddhaḥ svabalamāsthāya adaśad daśanacchadam || 92 ||
tato yoddhumapoḍhānāṃ bāṇeyānāṃ niśamya tu |
sā citralekhāsmarata nāradaṃ devadarśanam || 93 ||
tato nimeṣamātreṇa samprāpto munipuṅgavaḥ |
smṛto'tha citralekhāyāḥ puraṃ śoṇitasāhvayam|| 94 ||
antarikṣe sthitastatra so'niruddhamathābravīt |
mā bhayaṃ svasti te vīra prāpto'smyadya puraṃ tava || 95 ||
tataśca nāradaṃ dṛṣṭvā so'bhivādya mahābalaḥ |
prahṛṣṭamānaso bhūtvā yuddhārthamabhivartata || 96 ||
tatasteṣāṃ svanaṃ śrutvā sarveṣāmeva garjatām |
sahasaivotthitaḥ śūrastotrārdita iva dvipaḥ || 97 ||
tamāpatantaṃ samprekṣya saṃdaṣṭauṣṭhaṃ mahābhujam |
prāsādāccāvarohantaṃ bhayārtā vipradudruvuḥ || 98 ||
antaḥpuradvāragataṃ parighaṃ gṛhya cātulam|
vadhāya teṣāṃ cikṣepa nānāyuddhaviśāradaḥ || 99 ||
te sarve bāṇavarṣaiśca gadābhirmuśalaistathā |
asibhiḥ śaktibhiḥ śūlainijaghnū raṇagocare || 2.119.100||
sa hanyamāno nārācaiḥ parighaiśca samantataḥ |
dānavaiḥ samabhikruddhaiḥ prādyumniḥ śastrakovidaiḥ || 101||
nākṣubhyat sarvabhūtātmā nadan megha ivoṣṇage |
āvidhya parighaṃ ghoraṃ teṣāṃ madhye vyatiṣṭhata |
sūryo divi caran madhye meghānāmiva sarvaśaḥ || 102||
daṇḍakṛṣṇājinadharo nārado hṛṣṭamānasaḥ |
sādhu sādhviti vai tatra so'niruddhamabhāṣata || 103||
te hanyamānā raudreṇa parigheṇāmitaujasā |
prādravanta bhayāt sarve meghā vāteritā yathā || 104||
vidrāvya dānavān vīraḥ parigheṇa suvikramaḥ |
aniruddho raṇe hṛṣṭaḥ siṃhanādaṃ nanāda ca || 105||
gharmānte toyado vyomni nadanniva mahāsvanaḥ |
tiṣṭhadhvamiti cukrośa dānavān yuddhadurmadān || 106||
prādyumnirvyahanaccāpi sarvāñchatrunibarhaṇaḥ |
tena te samare sarve hanyamānā mahātmanā || 107||
yato bāṇastato bhītā yayuryuddhaparāṅmukhāḥ |
tato bāṇasamīpasthāḥ śvasanto rudhirokṣitāḥ ||108||
na śarma lebhire daityā bhayaviklavacetasaḥ |
mā bhaiṣṭa mā bhaiṣṭa iti rājñā te tena coditāḥ|| 109 ||
trāsamutsṛjya caikasthā yudhyadhvaṃ dānavarṣabhāḥ |
tānuvāca punarbāṇo bhayaviklavalocanān || 2.119.110||
kimidaṃ lokavikhyātaṃ yaśa utsṛjya dūrataḥ |
bhavanto yānti vaiklavyaṃ klībā iva vicetasaḥ || 111||
ko'yaṃ yasya bhayatrastā bhavanto yāntyanekaśaḥ |
kulāpadeśinaḥ sarve nānāyuddhaviśāradāḥ || 1 12||
bhavadbhirna hi me kāryaṃ yuddhasāhāyyamadya vai |
abravīd dhvaṃsatetyevaṃ matsamīpācca naśyata ||113||
atha tān vāgbhirugrābhistrāsayana bahudhā balī |
vyādideśa raṇe śūrānanyānayutaśaḥ punaḥ || 114||
pramāthagaṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ vyādiṣṭaṃ tasya nigrahe |
anīkaṃ sumahāraudraṃ nānāpraharaṇodyatam || 115||
athāntarikṣaṃ bahudhā vidyutvadbhirivāmbudaiḥ |
bāṇānīkaiḥ samabhavad vyāptaṃ saṃdīptalocanaiḥ || 116 ||
kecit kṣitisthāḥ prākrośangajā iva samantataḥ |
antarikṣe vyarājanta gharmānta iva toyadāḥ || 117||
tatastat sumahat sainyaṃ sametamabhavat punaḥ |
tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti ca tadā vāco'śrūyanta sarvaśaḥ || 118||
aniruddho raṇe vīraḥ sa ca tānabhyavartata |
tadāścaryaṃ samabhavad yadekastu samāgataḥ || 119||
ayudhyata mahāvīryairdānavaiḥ saha saṃyuge |
teṣāmeva ca jagrāha parighāṃstomarānapi || 2.119.120||
taireva ca tadā yuddhe tāñjaghāna mahābalaḥ |
punaḥ parighamutsṛjya pragṛhya raṇamūrdhani || 121||
sa tena vicaran mārgānekaḥ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ |
bhrāntamudbhrāntamāviddhamāplutaṃ viplutaṃ plutam|| 122||
iti prakārād dvātriṃśad vicarannābhyadṛśyata |
ekaṃ sahasraśaścātra dadṛśū raṇamūrdhani ||123||
krīḍantaṃ bahudhā yuddhe vyāditāsyamivāntakam |
tatastenābhisaṃtaptā rudhiraughapariplutāḥ || 124||
punarbhagnāḥ prādravanta yatra bāṇo vyavasthitaḥ |
gajavājirathaughaiste cohyamānāḥ samantataḥ ||125||
kṛtvā cārtasvaraṃ ghoraṃ diśo jagmurhataujasaḥ |
ekaikasyopari tadā te'nyonyaṃ bhayapīḍitāḥ || 126||
vamantaḥ śoṇitaṃ jagmurviṣādād vimukhā raṇe |
na babhūva purā devairyudhyatāṃ tādṛśaṃ bhayam || 127||
yādṛśaṃ yudhyamānānāmaniruddhena saṃyuge |
kecid vamanto rudhiraṃ hyapatan vasudhātale ||128||
dānavā giriśṛṅgābhā gadāśūlāsipāṇayaḥ |
te bāṇamutsṛjya raṇe jagmurbhayasamākulāḥ || 129||
viśālamākāśatalaṃ dānavā nirjitāstadā |
niḥśeṣabhagnāṃ mahatīṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ vāhinīṃ tadā || 2.119.130||
bāṇaḥ krodhātprajajvāla samiddho'gnirivādhvare |
antarikṣacaro bhūtvā sādhuvādī samantataḥ || 131||
nārado nṛtyati prīto hyaniruddhasya saṃyuge |
etasminnantare caiva bāṇaḥ paramakopanaḥ ||132||
kumbhāṇḍasaṃgṛhītaṃ tu rathamāsthāya vīryavān |
yayau yatrāniruddho vai udyatāsī rathe sthitaḥ || 133||
paṭṭiśāsigadāśūlamudyamya ca paraśvadhān |
babhau bāhusahasreṇa śakro dhvajaśatairiva || 134||
baddhagodhāṅgulitraiśca bāhubhiḥ sa mahābhujaḥ |
nānāpraharaṇopetaḥ śuśubhe dānavottamaḥ ||135||
siṃhanādaṃ nadan kruddho visphāritamahādhanuḥ |
abravīt tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ || 136||
vacanaṃ tasya saṃśrutya prādyumniraparājitaḥ |
bāṇasya vadanaṃ saṃkhye samudvīkṣya tato'hasat || 137|
kiṅkiṇīśatanirghoṣaṃ raktadhvajapatākinam |
ṛṣyacarmāvanaddhāṅgaṃ daśanalvaṃ mahāratham || 138||
tasya vājisahasraṃ tu rathe yuktaṃ mahātmanaḥ |
purā devāsure yuddhe hiraṇyakaśiporiva ||139||
tamāpatantaṃ dadṛśe dānavaṃ yadupuṅgavaḥ |
samprahṛṣṭastato yuddhe tejasā cāpyapūryata ||2.119.140||
asicarmadharo vīraḥ svasthaḥ saṃgrāmalālasaḥ |
narasiṃho yathā pūrvamādidaityavadhodyataḥ ||141||
āpatantaṃ dadarśātha khaḍgacarmadharaṃ tadā |
khaḍgacarmadharaṃ taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā bāṇaḥ padātinam || 142||
praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe prādyumnivadhakāṅkṣayā |
tanutreṇa vihīnaśca khaḍgapāṇiśca yādavaḥ ||143|
ajeya iti taṃ matvā yuddhāyābhimukhaḥ sthitaḥ |
aniruddhaṃ raṇe bāṇo jitakāśī mahābalaḥ || 144||
vācaṃ covāca saṃkruddho gṛhyatāṃ hanyatāmiti |
vācaṃ ca bruvatastasya śrutvā prādyumnirāhave || 145||
bāṇasya bruvataḥ krodhāddhasamāno'bhyudaikṣata |
uṣāṃ bhayaparitrastāṃ rudatīṃ tatra bhāminīm || 146||
aniruddhaḥ prahasyātha samāśvāsya ca tāṃ sthitaḥ |
atha bāṇaḥ śaraughāṇāṃ kṣudrakāṇāṃ samantataḥ || 147|
cikṣepa samare kruddho hyaniruddhavadhepsayā |
aniruddhastu ciccheda kāṅkṣaṃstasyaparājayam|| 148||
vavarṣa śarajālāni kṣudrakāṇāṃ samantataḥ |
bāṇo'niruddhaśirasi kāṅkṣaṃstasya raṇe vadham||149||
tato bāṇasahasrāṇi carmaṇā vyavadhūya saḥ |
babhau pramukhatastasya sthitaḥ sūrya ivodaye || 2.119.150||
so'bhibhūya raṇe bāṇamāsthito yadunandanaḥ |
siṃhaḥ pramukhato dṛṣṭvā gajamekaṃ yathā vane || 151||
tato bāṇaḥ sa bāṇaughairmarmabhedibhirāśugaiḥ |
vivyādha niśitaistīkṣṇaiḥ prādyumnimaparājitam || 152||
samāhatastato bāṇaiḥ khaḍgacarmadharo'patat |
tamāpatantaṃ niśitairabhyahan sāyakaistathā || 153||
so'tividdho mahābāhurbāṇaiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ |
krodhenābhiprajajvāla cikīrṣuḥ karma duṣkaram || 154||
rudhiraughaplutairgātrairbāṇavarṣaiḥ samāhitaḥ |
abhibhūtaḥ susaṃkruddho yayau bāṇarathaṃ prati || 155||
asibhirmusalaiḥ śūlaiḥ paṭṭiśaistomaraistathā |
so'tividdhaḥ śaraughaiśca prādyumnirna vyakampata || 156||
āplutya sahasā kruddho ratheṣāṃ tasya so'cchinat|
jaghāna cāśvān khaḍgena bāṇasya raṇamūrdhani || 157||
taṃ punaḥ śaravarṣeṇa paṭṭiśaistomarairapi |
cakārāntarhitaṃ bāṇo yuddhamārgaviśāradaḥ || 158||
hato'yamiti vijñāya prāṇadan nairṛtā gaṇāḥ |
tato'vaplutya sahasā rathapārśve vyavasthitaḥ || 159||
śaktiṃ bāṇastataḥ kruddho ghorarūpāṃ bhayānakām|
jagrāha jvalitāṃ ghorāṃ ghaṇṭāmālākulāṃ raṇe ||2.119.160||
jvalanādityasaṃkāśāṃ yamadaṇḍogradarśanām |
prāhiṇot tāmasaṅgena maholkāṃ jvalitāmiva || 161||
tāmāpatantīṃ samprekṣya jīvitāntakarīṃ tadā |
so'bhiplutya tadā śaktiṃ jagrāha puruṣottamaḥ || 162||
nirbibheda tato bāṇaṃ tayā śaktyā mahābalaḥ |
sā bhittvā tasya dehaṃ vai prāviśaddharaṇītalam || 163||
sa gāḍhaviddho vyathito dhvajayaṣṭiṃ samāśritaḥ |
tato mūrcchābhibhūtaṃ taṃ kumbhāṇḍo vākyamabravīt|| 164||
upekṣase dānavendra kimevaṃ śatrumudyatam |
labdhalakṣo hyayaṃ vīro nirvikāro'dya dṛśyate || 165||
māyāmāśritya yudhyasva nāyaṃ vadhyo'nyathā bhavet|
ātmānaṃ māṃ ca rakṣasva pramādāt kimupekṣase || 166||
vadhyatāmayamadyaiva na naḥ sarvān vināśayet |
anyāṃśca śataśo hatvā uṣāṃ nītvā vrajiṣyati || 167|
kumbhāṇḍavacanairevaṃ dānavendraḥ praṇoditaḥ |
vācaṃ rūkṣāmabhikruddhaḥ provāca vadatāṃ varaḥ || 168||
eṣo'hamasya vidadhe mṛtyuṃ prāṇaharaṃ raṇe |
ādāsyāmyahametaṃ vai garutmāniva pannagam || 169||
ityevamuktvā sarathaḥ sadhvajaḥ sāśvasārathiḥ |
gandharvanagarākārastatraivāntaradhīyata || 2.119.170||
mumoca niśitānbāṇāṃśchanno māyādharo balī |
vijñāyāntarhitaṃ bāṇaṃ prādyumniraparājitaḥ || 171 ||
pauruṣeṇa samāyuktaḥ samaikṣata diśo daśa |
āsthāya tāmasīṃ vidyāṃ tadā kruddho baleḥ sutaḥ || 172||
mumoca viśikhāṃstīkṣṇāṃśchanno māyādharo balī |
prāyumniḥ viśikhairbaddhaḥ sarpabhūtaiḥ samantataḥ || 173 ||

niṣprayatnaḥ kṛtastasthau maināka iva parvataḥ |
jvālāvalīḍhavadanaiḥ sarpabhogairviceṣṭitaḥ || 175||
abhitaḥ parvatākāraḥ prādyumnirabhavad raṇe |

tatastaṃ vāgbhirugrābhiḥ saṃrabdhaḥ samatarjayat || 177||

kumbhāṇḍa vadhyatāṃ śīghramayaṃ vai kulapāṃsanaḥ || 178||

ityevamukte vacane kumbhāṇḍo vākyamavravīt || 179||
rājan vakṣyāmyahaṃ kiṃcit tanme śṛṇu yadicchasi |
ayaṃ vijñāyatāṃ kasya kuto vāyamihāgataḥ || 2.119.180||
kena vāyamihānītaḥ śakratulyaparākramaḥ |
mayāyaṃ bahuśo rājan dṛṣṭo yudhyan mahāraṇe || 181 ||
krīḍanniva ca yuddheṣu dṛśyate devasūnuvat |
balavān sattvasampannaḥ sarvaśastraviśāradaḥ || 182||
nāyaṃ vadhakṛtaṃ doṣamarhate daityasattama |
gāndharveṇa vivāhena kanyeyaṃ tava saṃgatā || 183||
adeyā hyapratigrāhyā ataścintya vadhaṃ kuru |
vijñāya ca vadhaṃ vāsya pūjāṃ vāsya kariṣyasi || 184||
vadhe hyasya mahān doṣo rakṣaṇe sumahān guṇaḥ |
ayaṃ hi puruṣotkṛṣṭaḥ sarvathā mānamarhati || 185||
sarvato veṣṭitatanurna vyathatyeṣa bhogibhiḥ |
kulaśauṇḍīryavīryaiśca sattvena ca samanvitaḥ ||186||
paśya rājan mahāvīryairanvitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
na no gaṇayate sarvān vadhaṃ prāpto'pyayaṃ balī || 187||
yadi māyāprabhāveṇa nātra baddho bhavedayam |
sarvānsuragaṇānsaṃkhye yodhayennātra saṃśayaḥ || 188||
sarvasaṃgrāmamārgajño bhaved vīryādhikastava |
śoṇitaughaplutairgātrairnāgabhogaiśca veṣṭitaḥ || 189||
triśikhāṃ bhrukuṭiṃ kṛtvā na cintayati naḥ sthitān|
imāmavasthāṃ nīto'pi svabāhubalamāśritaḥ || 2.119.190||
na cintayati rājaṃstvāṃ vīryavānko'pyasau yuvā |
sahasrabāhoḥ samare dvibāhuḥ samavasthitaḥ |
na cintayati te vīryamayaṃ vīryamadānvitaḥ || 191||
ucitaṃ yadi te rājan jñeyo vīryabalānvitaḥ |
kanyā ceyaṃ na cānyasya niryātye tena saṃgatā ||192||
yadi ceṣṭatamaḥ kaścidayaṃ vaṃśe mahātmanām|
tataḥ pūjāmayaṃ vīraḥ prāpsyate cāsurottama ||193||
rakṣyatāmiti coktvaiva tathāstviti ca tasthivān |
evamukte tu vacane kumbhāṇḍena mahātmanā || 194||
tathetyāha ca kumbhāṇḍaṃ bāṇaḥ śatruniṣūdanaḥ |
saṃrakṣiṇastato dattvā aniruddhasya dhīmataḥ || 195||
yayau svameva bhavanaṃ baleḥ putro mahāyaśāḥ |
saṃyataṃ māyayā dṛṣṭvā aniruddhaṃ mahābalam ||196||
ṛṣīṇāṃ nāradaḥ śreṣṭho'vrajad dvāravatīṃ prati |
tato hyākāśamārgeṇa munirdvāravatīṃ gataḥ || 197||
gate ṛṣīṇāṃ pravare so'niruddho vyacintayat|
naṣṭo'yaṃ dānavaḥ krūro yuddhameṣyatyasaṃśayaḥ ||198||
sa gatvā nāradastatra śaṅkhacakragadādharam |
jñāpayiṣyati tattvena imamarthaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 199||
nāgairviceṣṭitaṃ dṛṣṭvā uṣā prādyumnimāturā |
ruroda bāṣparuddhākṣī tāmāha rudatīṃ punaḥ ||2.119.200||
kimidaṃ rudyate bhīru mā bhaistvaṃ mṛgalocane |
paśya suśroṇi samprāptaṃ matkṛte madhusūdanam ||201||
yasya śaṅkhadhvaniṃ śrutvā bāhuśabdaṃ balasya ca |
dānavā nāśameṣyanti garbhāścāsurayoṣitām ||202|
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evamuktāniruddhena uṣā viśrambhamāgatā |
nṛśaṃsaṃ pitaraṃ caiva śocate sā sumadhyamā ||203||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi bāṇāniruddhayuddha ekonaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 119 ||

<2.120>

viṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
yadā bāṇapure vīraḥ so'niruddhaḥ sahoṣayā |
saṃniruddho narendreṇa bāṇena balisūnunā || 1 ||
tadā devīṃ koṭavatīṃ rakṣārthaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ |
yad gītamaniruddhena devyāḥ stotramidaṃ śṛṇu || 2 ||
anantamakṣayaṃ divyamādidevaṃ sanātanam |
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya pravaraṃ jagatāṃ prabhum || 3 ||
caṇḍīṃ kātyāyanīṃ devīmāryāṃ lokanamaskṛtām |
varadāṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi nāmabhirharisaṃstutaiḥ || 4 ||
ṛṣibhirdaivataiścaiva vākpuṣpairarcitāṃ śubhām |
tāṃ devīṃ sarvadehasthāṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtām || 5 ||
aniruddha uvāca
mahendraviṣṇubhaginīṃ namasyāmi hitāya vai |
manasā bhāvaśuddhena śuciḥ stoṣye kṛtāñjaliḥ|| 6||
gautamīṃ kaṃsabhayadāṃ yaśodānandavarddhinīm |
medhyāṃ gokulasambhūtāṃ nandagopasya nandinīm || 7 ||
prājñāṃ dakṣāṃ śivāṃ saumyāṃ danuputravimardinīm|
tāṃ devīṃ sarvadehasthāṃ sarvabhūtanamaskṛtām || 8 ||
darśanīṃ pūraṇīṃ māyāṃ vahnisūryaśaśiprabhām |
śāntiṃ dhruvāṃ ca jananīṃ mohanīṃ śoṣaṇīṃ tathā || 9 ||
sevyāṃ devaiḥ sarṣigaṇaiḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtām |
kālīṃ kātyāyanīṃ devīṃ bhayadāṃ bhayanāśinīm || 2.120.10 ||
kālarātriṃ kāmagamāṃ trinetrāṃ brahmacāriṇīm |
saudāminīṃ megharavāṃ vetālīṃ vipulānanām || 11 ||
yūthasyādyāṃ mahābhāgāṃ śakunīṃ revatīṃ tathā |
tithīnāṃ pañcamīṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ pūrṇamāsīṃ caturdaśīm || 12 ||
saptaviṃśatiṛkṣāṇi nadyaḥ sarvā diśo daśa |
nagaropavanodyānadvārāṭṭālakavāsinīm || 13 ||
hrīṃ śrīṃ gaṅgāṃ ca gandharvāṃ yoginīṃ yogadāṃ satām |
kīrtimāśāṃ diśaṃ sparśāṃ namasyāmi sarasvatīm || 14||
vedānāṃ mātaraṃ caiva sāvitrīṃ bhaktavatsalām |
tapasvinīṃ śāntikarīmekānaṃśāṃ sanātanām || 15 ||
kauṭīryāṃ madirāṃ caṇḍāmilāṃ malayavāsinīm |
bhūtadhātrīṃ bhayakarīṃ kūṣmāṇḍīṃ kusumapriyām || 16 ||
dāruṇīṃ madirāvāsāṃ vindhyakailāsavāsinīm |
varāṅganāṃ siṃharathīṃ bahurūpāṃ vṛṣadhvajām || 17 ||
durlabhāṃ durjayāṃ durgāṃ niśumbhabhayadarśinīm |
surapriyāṃ surāṃ devīṃ vajrapāṇyanujāṃ śivām || 18 ||
kirātīṃ cīravasanāṃ caurasenānamaskṛtām |
ājyapāṃ somapāṃ saumyāṃ sarvaparvatavāsinīm || 19 ||
niśumbhaśumbhamathanīṃ gajakumbhopamastanīm |
jananīṃ siddhasenasya siddhacāraṇasevitām || 2.120.20 ||
carāṃ kumāraprabhavāṃ pārvatīṃ parvatātmajām |
pañcāśaddevakanyānāṃ patnyo devagaṇasya ca || 21 ||
kadruputrasahasrasya putrapautravarastriyaḥ |
mātā pitā jaganmānyā divi devāpsarogaṇaiḥ || 22 ||
ṛṣipatnīgaṇānāṃ ca yajñagandharvayaṃ pitām |
vidyādharāṇāṃ nārīṣu sādhvīṣu manujāsu ca || 23||
evametāsu nārīṣu sarvabhūtāśrayā hyasi |
namaskṛtāsi trailokye kinnarodgītasevite || 24 ||
acintyā hyaprameyāsi yāsi sāsi namo'stu te |
ebhirnāmabhiranyaiśca kīrtitā hyasi gautami || 25 ||
tvatprasādādavighnena kṣipraṃ mucyeya bandhanāt |
avekṣasva viśālākṣi pādau te śaraṇaṃ vraje || 26 ||
sarveṣāmeva bandhānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kartumarhasi |
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca candrasūryāgnimārutāḥ || 27 ||
aśvinau vasavaścaiva viśvesādhyāstathaiva ca |
marutā saha parjanyo dhātā bhūmirdiśo daśa || 28 ||
gāvo nakṣatravaṃśāśca grahā nadyo hradāstathā |
saritaḥ sāgarāścaiva nānāvidyādharoragāḥ || 29 ||
tathā nāgāḥ suparvāṇo gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ |
kṛtsnaṃ jagadidaṃ proktaṃ devyā nāmānukīrtanāt || 2.120.30 ||
devyāḥ stavamimaṃ puṇyaṃ yaḥ paṭhet susamāhitaḥ |
sā tasmai saptame māsi varamagryaṃ prayacchati || 31 ||
aṣṭādaśabhujā devī divyābharaṇabhūṣitā |
hāraśobhitasarvāṅgī mukuṭojjvalabhūṣaṇā || 32 ||
kātyāyani stūyase tvaṃ varamagryaṃ prayacchasi |
ataḥ stavīmi tvāṃ devīṃ varade vāmalocane || 33 ||
namo'stu te mahādevi suprītā me sadā bhava |
prayaccha tvaṃ varaṃ hyāyuḥ puṣṭiṃ caiva kṣamāṃ dhṛtim || 34 ||
bandhanastho vimucyeyaṃ satyametad bhavediti |
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evaṃ stutā mahādevī durgā durgaparākramā || 35 ||
sāṃnidhyaṃ kalpayāmāsa aniruddhasya bandhane |
aniruddhahitārthāya devī śaraṇavatsalā || 36 ||
baddhaṃ bāṇapure vīramaniruddhaṃ vyamokṣayat |
sāntvayāmāsa taṃ vīramaniruddhamamarṣaṇam || 37 ||
pūjayāmāsa tāṃ vīraḥ so'niruddhaḥ pratāpavān |
prasādaṃ darśayāmāsa aniruddhasya bandhane || 38 ||
nāgapāśena baddhasya tasyoṣāhṛtacetasaḥ |
sphoṭayitvā karāgreṇa pañjaraṃ vajrasaṃnibham || 39 ||
ruddhaṃ bāṇapure vīraṃ sāniruddhamabhāṣata |
sāntvayantī vaco devī prasādābhimukhī tadā || 2.120.40 ||
śrīdevyuvāca
cakrāyudho mokṣayitāniruddha tvāṃ bandhanādāśu sahasva kālam |
chittvā sa bāṇasya sahasrabāhuṃ purīṃ nijāṃ neṣyati daityasūdanaḥ || 41 ||
tato'niruddhaḥ punareva devīṃ tuṣṭāva hṛṣṭaḥ śaśikāntavaktraḥ |
aniruddha uvāca
namo'stu te devi varaprade śive namo'stu te devi surārināśini || 42 ||
namo'stu te kāmacare sadāśive namo'stu te sarvahitaiṣiṇi priye |
namo'stu te bhītikari dviṣāṃ sadā namo'stu te bandhanamokṣakāriṇi || 43 ||
brahmāṇīndrāṇi rudrāṇi bhūtabhavyabhave śive |
trāhi māṃ sarvabhītibhyo nārāyaṇi namo'stu te || 44 ||
namo'stu te jagannāthe priye dānte mahāvrate |
bhaktipriye jaganmātaḥ śailaputri vasundhare || 45 ||
trāhi māṃ tvaṃ viśālākṣi nārāyaṇi namo'stu te |
trāyasva sarvaduḥkhebhyo dānavānāṃ bhayaṃkari || 46 ||
rudrapriye mahābhāge bhaktānāmārtināśini |
namāmi śirasā devīṃ bandhanastho vimokṣitaḥ || 47 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
āryāstavamidaṃ puṇyaṃ yaḥ paṭhet susamāhitaḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati |
bandhanastho vimucyeta satyaṃ vyāsavaco yathā || 48 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi aniruddhakṛta āryāstavo nāma viṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 120 ||

<2.121>

ekaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tato'niruddhasya gṛhe ruruduḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ |
priyaṃ nāthamapaśyantyaḥ kurarya iva saṃghaśaḥ || 1 ||
aho dhikkimidaṃ nāthanāthe kṛṣṇe vyavasthite |
anāthā iva saṃtrastā rudimo bhayapīḍitāḥ || 2 ||
yasyendrapramukhā devāḥ sādityāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ |
bāhucchāyāmupāśritya vasanti divi nirvṛtāḥ || 3 ||
tasyotpannamidaṃ loke bhayadasya mahābhayam |
tasyāniruddhaḥ pautrastu vīraḥ kenāpi no hṛtaḥ || 4 ||
aho nāsti bhayaṃ nūnaṃ tasya loke sudurmateḥ |
vāsudevasya yaḥ krodhamutpādayati duḥsaham || 5 ||
vyāditāmāsya yo mṛtyordaṃṣṭrāgre parivartate |
sa vāsudevaṃ samare mohādabhyudiyād ripuḥ || 6 ||
idamevaṃvidhaṃ kṛtvā vipriyaṃ yadupuṅgave |
kathaṃ jīvan vimucyeta sākṣādapi śacīpatiḥ || 7 ||
hatanāthāḥ sma śocyāḥ sma vayaṃ nāthaṃ vinā kṛtāḥ |
viprayogeṇa nāthasya kṛtāntavaśagāḥ kṛtāḥ || 8 ||
ityevaṃ tā vadantyaśca rudantyaśca punaḥ punaḥ |
netrajaṃ vāri mumucuraśivaṃ paramāṅganāḥ || 9 ||
tāsāṃ bāṣpāmbupūrṇāni nayanāni cakāśire |
salilenāplutānīva paṅkajāni jalāgame || 2.121.10 ||
tāsāmarālapakṣmāṇi rājayanti śubhāni ca |
rudhireṇāplutānīva nayanāni cakāśire || 11 ||
tāsāṃ harmyatalasthānāṃ pūrṇaṃ āsīnmahāsvanaḥ |
kurarīṇāmivākāśe rudatīnāṃ sahasraśaḥ || 12||
te śrutvā ninadaṃ ghoramapūrvaṃ bhayamāgatam |
utpetuḥ sahasā svebhyo gṛhebhyaḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ || 13 ||
kasmādeṣo'niruddhasya śrūyate sumahāsvanaḥ |
gṛhe kṛṣṇābhiguptānāṃ kuto no bhayamāgatam || 14 ||
ityevamūcuste'nyonyaṃ snehaviklavagadgadā |
adharṣitā yathā siṃhā guhābhya iva niḥsṛtāḥ || 15 ||
sannāhabherī kṛṣṇasya āhatā mahatī tadā |
yasyāḥ śabdena te sarve samāgamya ca dhiṣṭhitāḥ || 16 ||
kimetaditi te'nyonyaṃ samapṛcchanta yādavāḥ |
anyonyasya hi te sarve yathāvṛttamavedayan || 17 ||
tataste bāṣpapūrṇākṣāḥ krodhasaṃraktalocanāḥ |
niḥśvasanto vyatiṣṭhanta yādavā yuddhadurmadāḥ || 18 ||
tūṣṇīṃbhūteṣu sarveṣu vipṛthurvākyamabravīt|
kṛṣṇaṃ praharatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ niḥśvasantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 19 ||
kimidaṃ cintayāviṣṭaḥ puruṣendra bhavāniha |
tava bāhubalaprāṇāḥ svāsthitāḥ sarvayādavāḥ || 2.121.20 ||
bhavantamāśritāḥ kṛṣṇa saṃvibhaktāśca sarvaśaḥ |
tathaiva balavāñśakrastvayyāveśya jayājayau || 21 ||
sukhaṃ svapiti niḥśaṅkaḥ kathaṃ tvaṃ cintayānvitaḥ |
śokasāgaramakṣobhyaṃ sarve te jñātayo gatāḥ || 22 ||
tān majjamānānekastvaṃ samuddhara mahābhuja |
kimevaṃ cintayāviṣṭo na kiṃcidapi bhāṣase || 23 ||
cintāṃ kartuṃ vṛthā deva na tvamarhasi mādhava |
ityevamuktaḥ kṛṣṇastu niḥśvasya suciraṃ bahu || 24 ||
prāha vākyaṃ sa vākyajño bṛhaspatiriva svayam|
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
vipṛtho cintayāviṣṭo hyetatkāryamacintayam || 25 ||
vicintayaṃstvahaṃ cāsya kāryasya na labhe gatim|
tathāhaṃ bhavatāpyukto nottaraṃ vidadhe kvacit || 26 ||
dāśārhagaṇamadhye'haṃ vadāmyarthavatīṃ giram |
śṛṇudhvaṃ yādavāḥ sarve yathācintānvito hyaham|| 27 ||
aniruddhe hṛte vīre pṛthivyāṃ sarvapārthivāḥ |
aśaktā iti maṃsyante sarvānasmān sabāndhavān|| 28 ||
āhukaścaiva no rājā hṛtaḥ śālvena vai purā |
pratyānītaḥ sa cāsmābhiryuddhaṃ kṛtvā sudāruṇam|| 29 ||
pradyumnaścāpi no bālaḥ śambareṇa hṛto hyabhūt |
sa taṃ nihatya samare prāpto rukmiṇinandanaḥ || 2.121.30 ||
idaṃ tu sumahat kaṣṭaṃ prādyumniḥ kva pravāsitaḥ |
evaṃvidhamahaṃ doṣaṃ na smare manujarṣabhāḥ || 31 ||
bhasmanā guṇṭhitaḥ pādo yena me mūrdhni pātitaḥ |
tasyāhaṃ sānubandhasya hariṣye jīvitaṃ raṇe || 32 ||
ityevamukte kṛṣṇena sātyakirvākyamabravīt |
cārāḥ kṛṣṇa praṇīyantāmaniruddhasya mārgaṇe |
saparvatavanoddeśāṃ mārgantu vasudhāmimām || 33 ||
