āhukaṃ prāha kṛṣṇastu smitaṃ kṛtvā vacastadā |
ābhyantarāśca bāhyāśca vyādiśyantāṃ carā nṛpa|| 34 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
keśavasya vacaḥ śrutvā āhukastvarito'bhavat|
anveṣaṇe'niruddhasya sa cārān diṣṭavāṃstadā || 35 ||
tataścārāstu vyādiṣṭāḥ pārthivena yaśasvinā |
hayā rathāśca vyādiṣṭāḥ pārthivena mahātmanā |
abhyantaraṃ ca mārgadhvaṃ bāhyataśca samantataḥ || 36 ||
veṇumantaṃ latāviṣṭaṃ tathā raivatakaṃ girim |
ṛkṣavantaṃ giriṃ caiva mārgadhvaṃ tvaritā hayaiḥ || 37 ||
ekaikaṃ tatra codyānaṃ mārgadhvaṃ kānanāni ca |
yātavyaṃ cāpi niḥśaṅkamudyānāni samantataḥ || 38 ||
hayānāṃ ca sahasrāṇi rathānāṃ cāpyanekaśaḥ |
āruhya tvaritāḥ sarve mārgadhvaṃ yadunandanam || 39 ||
senāpatiranādhṛṣṭiridaṃ vacanamabravīt |
kṛṣṇamakliṣṭakarmāṇamacyutaṃ bhītabhītavat || 2.121.40 ||
śṛṇu kṛṣṇa vaco mahyaṃ rocate yadi te prabho |
cirāt prabhṛti me vaktuṃ bhavantaṃ jāyate matiḥ || 41 ||
asilomā pulomā ca nisundanarakau hatau |
saubhaḥ śālvaśca nihatau maindo dvivida eva ca || 42 ||
hayagrīvaśca sumahān sānubandhastvayā hataḥ |
tādṛśe vigrahe vṛtte devahetoḥ sudāruṇe ||43 ||
sarvāṇyetāni karmāṇi niḥśeṣāṇi raṇe raṇe |
kṛtavānasi govinda pārṣṇigrāhaśca nāsti te || 44 ||
idaṃ karma tvayā kṛṣṇa sānubandhaṃ mahat kṛtam |
pārijātasya haraṇe yat kṛtaṃ karma duṣkaram || 45 ||
tatra śakrastvayā kṛṣṇa airāvataśirogataḥ |
nirjito bāhuvīryeṇa tvayā yuddhaviśāradaḥ || 46 ||
tena vairaṃ tvayā sārdha kartavyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ |
vairānubandhaśca mahāṃstena kāryastvayā saha ||47 ||
tatrāniruddhaharaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ maghavatā svayam |
na hyanyasya bhavecchaktirvairaniryātanaṃ prati || 48 ||
ityevamukte vacane kṛṣṇo nāga iva śvasan |
uvāca vacanaṃ dhīmānanādhṛṣṭiṃ mahābalam || 49 ||
senānīstāta mā maivaṃ na devāḥ kṣudrakarmiṇaḥ |
nākṛtajñā na ca klībā nāvaliptā na bāliśāḥ ||| 2.121.50 ||
devatārthaṃ ca me yatno mahān dānavasaṃkṣaye |
teṣāṃ priyārthaṃ ca raṇe hanmi dṛptān mahābalān || 51||
tatparastanmanāścāsmi tadbhaktastatpriye rataḥ |
kathaṃ pāpaṃ kariṣyanti vijñāyaivaṃvidhaṃ hi mām || 52 ||
akṣudrāḥ satyavantaśca nityaṃ bhaktānukampinaḥ |
tebhyo na vidyate pāpaṃ bāliśatvāt prabhāṣase || 53||
kadācidiha puṃścalyā aniruddho hṛto bhavet |
deveṣu samahendreṣu naitat karma vidhīyate || 54 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evaṃ cintayamānasya kṛṣṇasyādbhutakarmaṇaḥ |
kṛṣṇasya vacanaṃ śrunvā tato'krūro'bravīd vacaḥ || 55 ||
madhuraṃ ślakṣṇayā vācā arthavākyaviśāradaḥ |
yacchakrasya prabho kāryaṃ tadasmākaṃ viniścitam || 56 ||
asmākaṃ cāpi yatkāryaṃ taddhi kāryaṃ śacīpateḥ |
saṃrakṣyāśca vayaṃ devairasmābhiścāpi devatāḥ |
devatārthaṃ vayaṃ cāpi mānuṣatvamupāgatāḥ || 57 ||
evamakrūravacanaiścodito madhusūdanaḥ |
snigdhagambhīrayā vācā punaḥ kṛṣṇo'bhyabhāṣata ||58||
nāyaṃ devairna gandharvairna yakṣairna ca rākṣasaiḥ |
pradyumnaputro'pahṛtaḥ puṃścalyā nu mahāyaśaḥ || 59 |||
māyāvidagdhāḥ puṃścalyo daityadānavayoṣitaḥ |
tābhirhṛto na saṃdeho nānyato vidyate bhayam || 2.121.60 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
ityevamukte vacane kṛṣṇena tu mahātmanā |
athāvagamya tattvena yad bhūtaṃ yadumaṇḍale |
udatiṣṭhanmahānādastadā kṛṣṇaṃ praśaṃsayan || 61 ||
harṣayan sa tu sarveṣāṃ sūtamāgadhabandinām |
madhuraḥ śrūyate ghoṣo yādavasya niveśane || 62 ||
te cārāḥ sarvataḥ sarve sabhādvāramupāgatāḥ |
śanairgadgadayā vācā idaṃ vacanamabruvan || 63 ||
udyānāni guhāḥ śailāḥ sabhā nadyaḥ sarāṃsi ca |
ekaikaṃ śataśo rājan mārgitaṃ na ca dṛśyate || 64 ||
anye kṛṣṇaṃ carā rājannupāgamya tadābruvan |
sarve no viditā deśāḥ prādyumnirna ca dṛśyate || 65 ||
yadanyat saṃvidhātavyaṃ vidhānaṃ yadunandana |
tadājñāpaya naḥ kṣipramaniruddhasya mārgaṇe || 66 ||
tataste dīnamanasaḥ sarve bāṣpākulekṣaṇāḥ |
anyonyamabhyabhāṣanta kimataḥ kāryamuttamam || 67 ||
saṃdaṣṭauṣṭhapuṭāḥ kecitkecid bāṣpākulekṣaṇāḥ |
kecid bhrakuṭimāsthāya cintayantyarthasiddhaye || 68 ||
evaṃ cintayatāṃ teṣāṃ bahvarthamabhibhāṣitam |
aniruddhaḥ kutaśceti sambhramaḥ sumahānabhūt || 69 ||
anyonyamabhivīkṣante yādavā jātamanyavaḥ |
tāṃ niśāṃ vimanaskāste gamayeyuḥ kathaṃcana |
aniruddho hṛtaśceti punaḥ punarariṃdama || 2.121.70||
evaṃ ca bruvatāṃ teṣāṃ prabhātā rajanī tadā |
tatastūryaninādaiśca śaṅkhānāṃ ca mahāsvanaiḥ |
prabodhanaṃ mahābāhoḥ kṛṣṇasyākriyatālaye || 71 ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale prādurbhūte divākare |
praviveśa sabhāmeko nāradaḥ prahasanniva || 72 ||
dṛṣṭvā tu yādavān sarvān kṛṣṇena saha saṃgatān |
tataḥ sa jayaśabdena mādhavaṃ pratyapūjayat ||73||
ugrasenādayaste ca tamṛṣiṃ pratyapūjayan |
athābhyutthāya vimanāḥ kṛṣṇaḥ samitidurjayaḥ |
madhuparkaṃ ca gāṃ caiva nāradāya dadau prabhuḥ || 74 ||
sopaviśyāsane śubhre sarvāstaraṇasaṃvṛte |
sukhāsīno yathānyāyamuvācedaṃ vaco'rthavat || 75 ||
nārada uvāca
kimevaṃ cintayāviṣṭā niḥsaṅgā gatamānasāḥ |
utsāhahīnāḥ sarve vai klībā iva samāsate || 76 ||
ityevamukte vacane nāradena mahātmanā |
vāsudevo'bravīd vākyaṃ śrūyatāṃ bhagavannidam || 77 ||
aniruddho hṛto brahman kenāpi niśi suvrata |
yasyārthe sarva evāsma cintayāviṣṭacetasaḥ ||78 ||
eṣa te yadi vṛttāntaḥ śruto dṛṣṭo'pi vā mune |
bhagavan kathyatāṃ sādhu priyametanmamānagha || 79 ||
ityevamukte vacane keśavena mahātmanā |
prahasyaitad vacaḥ prāha śrūyatāṃ madhusūdana || 2.121.80 ||
nirvṛttaṃ sumahad yuddhaṃ devāsurasamaṃ mahat|
aniruddhasya caikasya bāṇasyāpi mahāmṛdhe || 81 ||
uṣā nāma sutā tasya bāṇasyāpratimaujasaḥ |
tasyārthe citralekhā vai jahārāśu tamapsarāḥ || 82 ||
ubhayorapi tatrāsī mahāyuddhaṃ sudāruṇam |
prādyumnibāṇayoḥ saṃkhye valivāsavayoriva || 83 ||
asmābhiścāpi tad yuddhaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ sumahadadbhutam |
aniruddho bhayāt tena saṃyugeṣvanivartinā || 84 ||
bāṇena māyāmāsthāya baddho nāgairmahābalaḥ |
vyādiṣṭastu vadhastasya bāṇena garuḍadhvaja || 85 ||
taṃ nivāritavān mantrī kumbhāṇḍo nāma tasya ha |
kumārasyāniruddhasya tenāsaktena saṃyuge || 86 ||
bāṇena māyāmāsthāya sarpairniyamanaṃ kṛtam |
uttiṣṭhatu bhavāñchīghraṃ yaśase vijayāya ca || 87 ||
nāyaṃ saṃrakṣituṃ kālaḥ prāṇāṃstāta jayaiṣiṇām |
prāṇaiḥ kiṃcidgatairvīro dhairyamālambya tiṣṭhati || 88 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
ityevamukte vacane vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān |
prāyātrikān vai sambhārānājñāpayata vīryavān || 89 ||
tataścandanacūrṇaiśca lājaiścaiva samantataḥ |
niryayau sa mahābāhuḥ kīryamāṇo janārdanaḥ || 2.121.90||
nārada uvāca
smaraṇaṃ vainateyasya kartumarhasi mādhava |
na hyanyena tadadhvānaṃ śakyaṃ gantuṃ mahābhuja || 91 ||
ākarṇaya tamadhvānaṃ gantavyamatidurjayam |
ekādaśa sahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ janārdana || 92 ||
taditaḥ śoṇitapuraṃ prādyumniryatra sāmpratam |
manojavo mahāvīryo vainateyaḥ pratāpavān || 93 ||
samāhvayasva govinda sa hi tvāṃ tatra neṣyati |
ekena sumuhūrtena bāṇaṃ saṃdarśayiṣyati || 94 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā sasmāra garuḍaṃ tadā |
sa kṛṣṇapārśvamāgamya prāñjalirgaruḍaḥ sthitaḥ || 95 ||
praṇamyātha vacaḥ prāha vainateyo mahābalaḥ |
vāsudevaṃ mahātmānaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ madhurayā girā || 96 ||
garuḍa uvāca
padmanābha mahābāho kimarthaṃ saṃsmṛto hyaham |
kṛtyaṃ te yadihātrāsti śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ||97||
phasya pakṣaparikṣepairnāśayāmi purīṃ prabho |
prabhāvāttava govinda ko na vidyād balaṃ mama || 98 ||
gadāvegaṃ ca te vīra cakrāgniṃ ca mahābhuja |
nāvabudhyati mūḍhātmā ko darpānnāśameṣyati || 99 ||
halaṃ siṃhamukhaṃ kasya vanamālī niyokṣyati |
kasya dehastu nirbhinno medinīṃ yāsyati prabho || 2.121.100||
kasya śaṅkharavaiḥ prāṇān mohayiṣyasi mādhava |
ko'yaṃ saparivāro'dya yāsyate yamasādanam || 101||
evamukte tu vacane vainateyena dhīmatā |
vāsudevo vacaḥ prāha śṛṇu tvaṃ vadatāṃ vara ||102||
baleḥ putreṇa bāṇena prādyumniraparājitaḥ |
uṣāyāḥ kāraṇe baddho nagare śoṇitāhvaye |
aniruddhastu kāmārto baddho nāgairviṣolbaṇaiḥ ||103||
tasya mokṣārthamāhūto mayā tvaṃ patageśvara |
tava vegasamo nāsti pakṣiṇāṃ pravaro bhavān |
aśakyaṃ ca tadadhvānaṃ gantumanyena kāśyapa || 104||
tatra prāpaya māṃ śīghraṃ yatra prādyumnirāvasat |
vaidarbhī te snuṣā vīra rudatī putragṛddhinī || 105 ||
amṛtaṃ tu hṛtaṃ pūrva tvayā pannaganāśana || 106||
mayā saha samāgamya tasmin kāle mahābhuja |
abhavanme dhvajaścaiva tvadbhaktāḥ sarvavṛṣṇayaḥ |
sakhitvaṃ mānayasvādya bhaktiṃ ca patageśvara || 107||
tava vegasamo nāsti pakṣiṇo na ca te samāḥ |
suparṇa sukṛtena tvāṃ śape pannaganāśana || 108||
dāsībhāvaṃ gatā mātā mokṣitaikākinā purā |
pakṣavikṣepamātreṇa hatā yodhāstvayā purā || 109||
bhavān suragaṇān sarvān pṛṣṭhamāropya vikramāt |
gaccha me hyagamān deśān vijayaśca tavāśrayāt || 2.121.110||
gurutvānmerutulyastvaṃ laghutvāt pavanopamaḥ |
bhūte bhavye bhaviṣye ca na te tulyo'sti vikrame ||111 ||
satyasaṃdha mahābhāga vainateya mahādyute |
aniruddhekṣaṇenādya sāhāyyamupakalpyatām || 112||
garuḍa uvāca
atyadbhutamidaṃ vākyaṃ tava kṛṣṇa mahābhuja |
tvatprasādācca vijayaḥ sarvatraiva mahābhuja || 113||
dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi saṃstavānmadhusūdana |
stotavyastvaṃ mayā kṛṣṇa stauṣi māṃ tvaṃ mahābhuja ||114||
vedādhyakṣaḥ surādhyakṣaḥ sarvakāmaprado bhavān |
amoghadarśanastvaṃ hi varārthiṣu varapradaḥ || 115||
caturbhujaścaturmūrtiścāturhotrapravartakaḥ |
cāturāśramyahotā ca caturnetā mahākaviḥ || 116||
dhanurdharaścakradharo bhavāñchaṅkhadharo mahān |
bhavān pūrveṣu deheṣu khyāto bhūmidharaḥ prabho ||117||
lāṅgalī musalī cakrī devakītanayo bhavān |
cāṇūramathanaścaiva gopriyaḥ kaṃsahā bhavān || 118||
govardhanadharaścaiva mallārirmallabhāvanaḥ |
mallapriyo mahāmallo mahāpuruṣa ityapi || 119||
viprapriyo vipradito viprajño viprabhāvanaḥ |
brahmaṇyaśca vareṇyaśca bhavān dāmodaraḥ smṛtaḥ |
pralambamathanaścaiva keśihā dānavāntakaḥ || 2.121.120||
asilomnaśca hantā ca tathā rāvaṇanāśanaḥ |
vibhīṣaṇasya bhagavān rājyado vālināśanaḥ || 121||
sugrīvarājyadātā tvaṃ balirājyāpahārakaḥ |
ratnahartā mahāratnaṃ samudrodarasambhavam || 122||
varuṇaśca bhavān khyāto bhavāṃśca saridudbhavaḥ |
bhavān khaṅgadharo dhanvī dhanurdharavaro mahān || 123||
dāśārha iti vikhyāto mahādhanvā dhanuḥpriyaḥ |
govinda iti vikhyāta udadhistvaṃ ca suvrata || 124||
ākāśaśca tapaścaiva samudramathano bhavān |
bhavān svargo bahuphalo bhavānsvargacaro mahān || 125||
tvameva ca mahāmegho bījaniṣpattireva ca |
trailokyamathanastvaṃ ca krodhalobhamanorathaḥ || 126||
bhavān kāmapradaścaiva kāmaḥ sarvadhanurdharaḥ |
saṃvarto vartanaścaiva pralayo nilayo mahān || 127||
hiraṇyagarbho rūpajño rūpavān madhusūdanaḥ |
īśastvaṃ ca mahādeva asaṃkhyeyaguṇānvitaḥ || 198|
stotumicchasi māṃ deva stotavyastvaṃ yadūttama |
cakṣuṣā ye tvayā ghorāḥ prāṇino hi nirīkṣitāḥ || 129||
hatāste yamadaṇḍena tiryaṅnirayagāminaḥ |
ye tvayā paramaprītyā prāṇino vai nirīkṣitāḥ || 2.121.130||
iha ca pretya te sarve sarvathā svargagāminaḥ |
eṣa te'haṃ mahābāho vaśagaḥ śāsane sthitaḥ || 131||
jayasthānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā garuḍaḥ prāha keśavam |
ayamasmi sthito vīra āruhasva mahābala || 132||
tataḥ kaṇṭhe pariṣvajya mādhavo garuḍaṃ tataḥ |
sakhe śatruvināśāya arghyo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām ||133||
dattvārghyaṃ parayā prītyā śaṅkhacakragadāsibhṛt|
āruroha mahābāhuḥ suparṇaṃ puruṣottamaḥ || 134||
kṛṣṇasya pārśvamāgamya harṣādevāsthito'bhavat|
kṛṣṇakeśaḥ pravalayo viṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇaśca varṇataḥ || 135||
caturdaṃṣṭraścaturbāhuścaturveda ṣaḍaṅgavit |
śrīvatsāṅko'ravindākṣa ūrdhvaromā mṛdutvacaḥ || 136||
samāṅguliḥ samanasro raktāṅgulinakhāntaraḥ |
snigdhagambhīranirghoṣo vṛttabāhurmahābhujaḥ ||137||
ājānubāhustāmrāsyaḥ siṃhavispaṣṭavikramaḥ |
sahasramiva sūryāṇāṃ dīpyamānaḥ prakāśate || 138|
yaḥ prabhurbhāti viśvātmā bhūtānāṃ bhāvano vibhuḥ |
yasyāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryaṃ dadau prītaḥ prajāpatiḥ || 139||
prajāpatīnāṃ sādhyānāṃ tridaśānāṃ ca śāśvataḥ |
stūyamānaḥ stavairdivyaiḥ sūtamāgadhabandibhiḥ |
ṛṣibhiśca mahābhāgairvedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ || 2.121.140||
saṃvidhānamathājñāpya dvārakāyāṃ mahābalaḥ |
gamanāya matiṃ cakre vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān || 141||
āsthito garuḍaṃ devastasya cānu halāyudhaḥ |
pṛṣṭhato'nu balasyāpi pradyumnaḥ śatrukarṣaṇaḥ || 142||
jaya bāṇaṃ mahābāho ye cāsyānugatā raṇe |
na hi te pramukhe sthātuṃ kaścicchakto mahāmṛdhe || 143||
prasāde te dhruvā lakṣmīrvijayaśca parākrame |
vijeṣyasi raṇe śatruṃ daityendraṃ sahasainikam || 144||
siddhacāraṇasaṃghānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ |
śṛṇvanvāco'ntarikṣe vai prayayau keśavo raṇe || 145||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi kṛṣṇaprayāṇe ekaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 121 ||

<2.122>

dvāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tatastūryaninādaiśca śaṅkhānāṃ ca mahāsvanaiḥ |
bandimāgadhasūtānāṃ stavaiścāpi sahasraśaḥ || 1 ||
sa tūnmukhairjayāśīrbhiḥ stūyamāno hi mānavaiḥ |
babhāra rūpaṃ somārkaśukrāṇāṃ pratimaṃ tadā || 2 ||
atīva śuśubhe rūpaṃ vyomni tasyotpatiṣyataḥ |
vainateyasya bhadraṃ te bṛṃhitaṃ haritejasā | 3 ||
athāṣṭabāhuḥ kṛṣṇastu parvatākārasaṃnibhaḥ |
vibabhau puṇḍarīkākṣo vikāṅkṣan bāṇasaṃkṣayam || 4 ||
asicakragadābāṇā dakṣiṇaṃ pārśvamāsthitāḥ |
carma śārṅgaṃ tathā vajraṃ śaṅkhaṃ caivāsya vāmataḥ || 5 ||
śīrṣāṇāṃ vai sahasraṃ tu vihitaṃ śārṅgadhanvanā |
sahasraṃ caiva kāyānāṃ vahan saṃkarṣaṇastadā || 6 ||
śvetapraharaṇo'dhṛṣyaḥ kailāsa iva śṛṅgavān |
prasthito garuḍenātha udyanniva niśākaraḥ || 7 ||
sanatkumārasya vapuḥ prādurāsīnmahātmanaḥ|
pradyumnasya mahābāhoḥ saṃgrāme vikramiṣyataḥ||8||
sa pakṣabalavikṣepairvidhunvan parvatān bahūn |
jagāma mārge balavān vātasya pratiṣedhayan || 9 ||
atha vāyoratigatimāsthāya garuḍastadā |
siddhacāraṇasaṃghānāṃ śubhaṃ mārgamavātarat || 2.122.10 ||
atha rāmo'bravīd vākyaṃ kṛṣṇamapratimaṃ raṇe |
svābhiḥ prabhābhirhīnāḥ sma kṛṣṇa kasmādapūrvavat|| 11 ||
sarve kanakavarṇābhāḥ saṃvṛttāḥ sma na saṃśayaḥ |
kimidaṃ brūhi nastattvaṃ kiṃ meroḥ pārśvagā vayam || 12 ||
śrībhagavānuvāca
manye bāṇasya nagaramabhyāsasthamariṃdama |
rakṣārthaṃ tasya niryāto vahnireṣa sthito jvalan || 13 ||
agnerāhavanīyasya prabhayā sma samāhatāḥ |
tena no varṇavairūpyamidaṃ jātaṃ halāyudha || 14 ||
śrīrāma uvāca
yadi sma saṃnikarṣasthā yadi niṣprabhatāṃ gatāḥ |
tad vidhatsva svayaṃ buddhyā yadatrānantaraṃ hitam || 15 ||
śrībhagavānuvāca
kuruṣva vainateya tvaṃ yacca kāryamanantaram |
tvayā vidhāne vihite kariṣyāmyahamuttamam || 16 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
etacchrutvā tu garuḍo vāsudevasya bhāṣitam |
cakre mukhasahasraṃ hi kāmarūpī mahābalaḥ || 17 ||
gaṅgāmupāgamat tūrṇaṃ vainateyo mahābalaḥ |
āplutyākāśagaṅgāyāmāpīya salilaṃ bahu || 18 ||
pravavarṣopari gato vainateyaḥ pratāpavān |
tenāgniṃ śamayāmāsa buddhimān vinatātmajaḥ || 19 ||
agnirāhavanīyastu tataḥ śāntimupāgamat|
taṃ dṛṣṭvāhavanīyaṃ tu śāntamākāśagaṅgayā |
paramaṃ vismayaṃ gatvā suparṇo vākyamavravīt || 2.122.20 ||
aho vīryamathāgnestu yo dahed yugasaṃkṣaye |
yatheha varṇavairūpyaṃ cakre kṛṣṇasya dhīmataḥ || 21 ||
trayastrayāṇāṃ lokānāṃ paryāptā iti me matiḥ |
kṛṣṇaḥ saṃkarṣaṇaścaiva pradyumnaśca mahābalaḥ ||22 ||
tataḥ praśānte dahane sampratasthe sa pakṣirāṭ |
svapakṣabalavikṣepaṃ kurvan ghoraṃ mahāsvanam || 23 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ tatra rudrasyānucarāgnayaḥ |
āsthitā garuḍaṃ hyete nānārūpā bhayāvahāḥ || 24 ||
kimarthamiha samprāptāḥ ke vāpīme janāstrayaḥ |
niścayaṃ nādhigacchanti te girivrajavahnayaḥ || 25 ||
prāvartayaṃśca saṃgrāmaṃ taistribhiḥ saha yādavaiḥ |
teṣāṃ yuddhaprasaktānāṃ saṃnādaḥ sumahānabhūt|| 26 ||
taṃ ca śrutvā mahānādaṃ siṃhānāmiva garjatām|
athāṅgirāḥ svapuruṣaṃ preṣayāmāsa buddhimān||27||
yatra tad vartate yuddhaṃ tatra gacchasva mā ciram ||
dṛṣṭvā tat sarvamāgaccha ityuktaḥ prahitastvaran||28||
tathetyuktvā sa tad yuddhaṃ vartamānamavaikṣata |
agnīnāṃ vāsudevena saṃsaktānāṃ mahāmṛdhe || 29||
te jātavedasaḥ sarve kalmāṣaḥ kusumastathā |
dahanaḥ śoṣaṇaścaiva tapanaśca mahābalaḥ || 2.122.30||
svāhākārasya viṣaye prakhyātāḥ pañca vahnayaḥ |
athāpare mahābhāgāḥ svairanīkairvyavasthitāḥ||31||
piṭharaḥ patagaḥ svarṇaḥ śvāgādho bhrāja eva ca|
svadhākārāśrayāḥ pañca ayudhyaṃste'pi cāgnayaḥ || 32 ||
jyotiṣṭomavibhāgau ca vaṣaṭakārāśrayau punaḥ |
dvāvagnī samprayudhyete mahātmānau mahādyutī || 33 ||
āgneyaṃ rathamāsthāya śaramudyamya bhāsvaram|
tayormadhye'ṅgirāścaiva maharṣirvibabhau raṇe || 34 ||
sthitamaṅgirasaṃ dṛṣṭvā vimuñcantaṃ śitāñcharān |
kṛṣṇaḥ provāca saṃkruddhaḥ smayanniva punaḥ punaḥ || 35 ||
tiṣṭhadhvamagnayaḥ sarve eṣa vo vidadhe bhayam |
mamāstratejasā dagdhā diśo yāsyatha vidrutāḥ |
athāṅgirāstriśūlena dīptena samadhāvata || 36 ||
ādadāna iva krodhātkṛṣṇaprāṇān mahāmṛdhe |
triśūlaṃ tasya dīptaṃ tu ciccheda parameṣubhiḥ |
ardhacandraistathā tīkṣṇairyamāntakanibhopamaiḥ || 37 ||
sthūṇākarṇena bāṇena dīptena sa mahāmanāḥ |
vivyādhāntakatulyena vakṣasyaṅgirasaṃ tataḥ || 38 ||
rudhiraughaplutairgātrairaṅgirā vihvalanniva |
viṣṭabdhagātraḥ sahasā papāta dharaṇītale || 39 ||
śeṣāstato'gnayaḥ sarve catvāro brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ|
āvāhayaṃstadā śīghraṃ bāṇasya puramantikāt ||2.122.40||
athāgamat tataḥ kṛṣṇo yatra bāṇapuraṃ tataḥ |
atha bāṇapuraṃ dṛṣṭvā dūrāt provāca nāradaḥ || 41 ||
etat tacchoṇitapuraṃ kṛṣṇa paśya mahābhuja |
atra rudro mahātejā rudrāṇyā sahito'vasat || 42 ||
guhaśca bāṇaguptyarthaṃ satataṃ kṣemakāraṇāt |
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā kṛṣṇaḥ samprahasan bravīt|| 43 ||
kṣaṇaṃ cintayatāmatra śrūyatāṃ ca mahāmune |
yadi vāvatared rudro bāṇasaṃrakṣaṇaṃ prati || 44 ||
śaktito vayamapyatra saha yotsyāma tena vai |
evaṃ vivadatostatra kṛṣṇanāradayostadā || 45 ||
prāptā nimeṣamātreṇa śīghragā garuḍena te |
tataḥ śaṅkhaṃ samādhāya vadane puṣkarekṣaṇaḥ || 46 ||
vāyuvegasamudbhūto meghaścandramivodgiran |
tataḥ pradhmāpya taṃ śaṅkhaṃ bhayamutpādya vīryavān || 47 ||
praviveśa puraṃ kṛṣṇo bāṇasyādbhutakarmaṇaḥ |
tataḥ śaṅkhapraṇādaiśca bherīṇāṃ ca mahāsvanaiḥ || 48 ||
bāṇānīkāni sahasā saṃnahyanta samantataḥ |
tataḥ kiṃkarasainyaṃ tu vyādiṣṭaṃ samare bhayāt || 49 ||
koṭiśaścāpi bahuśo dīptapraharaṇāstadā |
tadasaṃruyeyamekasthaṃ mahābhraghanasaṃnibham || 2.122.50 ||
nīlāñjanacayaprakhyamaprameyamathākṣayam |
dīptapraharaṇāḥ sarve daityadānavarākṣasāḥ || 51 ||
pramāthagaṇamukhyāśca ayudhyan kṛṣṇamavyayam|
sarvatastaiḥ pradīptāstraiḥ sārciṣmadbhirivāgnibhiḥ || 52 |
abhyupetya tadātyugrairyakṣarākṣasakinnaraiḥ |
pīyate rudhiraṃ teṣāṃ caturṇāmapi saṃyuge ||53||
tad balaṃ tu samāsādya balabhadro mahābalaḥ |
provāca vacanaṃ tatra parasya balanāśanaḥ || 54 ||
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho vidhatsvaiṣāṃ mahad bhayam |
iti saṃcoditaḥ kṛṣṇo balabhadreṇa dhīmatā || 55 ||
teṣāṃ vadhārthamāgneyaṃ jagrāha puruṣottamaḥ |
astramastravidāṃ śreṣṭho yamāntakasamaprabhaḥ |
pravidhūyāsuragaṇān kravyādānastratejasā || 56 ||
prayayau tvarayā yukto yatra dṛśyeta tad balam |
śūlapaṭṭiśaśaktyṛṣṭipinākaparighāyudham || 57 ||
pramāthagaṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ balaṃ tadabhavat kṣitau |
śailameghapratīkāśairnānārūpairbhayānakaiḥ |
vāhanaiḥ saṃghaśaḥ sarve yodhāstatrāvatasthire || 58 ||
vātodbhūtairiva ghanairviprakīrṇairivācalaiḥ |
śuśubhe tatra bahulairanīkairdṛḍhadhanvibhiḥ || 59 ||
musalairasibhiḥ śūlairgadābhiḥ parighaistathā |
abādhaṃ tadasaṃkhyeyaṃ śuśubhe sarvato balam || 2.122.60 ||
tataḥ saṃkarṣaṇo devamuvāca madhusūdanam |
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho yadetad dṛśyate balam |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca mamāpyeṣaiva saṃjātā buddhirityabravīcca tam |
etaiḥ saha raṇe yoddhumicchāmi puruṣottama || 61 ||
mamāpyeṣaiva saṃjātā buddhirityabravīcca tam|
ebhiḥ saha raṇe yoddhumiccheyaṃ yodhasattamaiḥ||62||
yuddhyataḥ prāṅmukhasyāstu suparṇo vai mamāgrataḥ |
savyapārśve tu pradyumnastathā me dakṣiṇe bhavān |
rakṣitavyamathānyonyamasmin ghore mahāmṛdhe || 63 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evaṃ bruvantaste'nyonyamadhirūḍhāḥ khagottamam |
giriśṛm̐ṅganibhairghorairgadāmusalalāṅgalaiḥ ||64 ||
yudhyato rauhiṇeyasya raudraṃ rūpamabhūt tadā |
yugānte sarvabhūtānāṃ kālasyeva didhakṣataḥ || 65||
ākṛṣya lāṅgalāgreṇa musalenāvapothayat |
cacārātibalo rāmo yuddhamārgaviśāradaḥ || 66 ||
pradyumnaḥ śarajālaistān samantāt paryavārayat |
dānavānpuruṣavyāghro yuddhayamānānmahābalaḥ || 67 ||
snigdhāñjanacayaprakhyaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ |
pradhmāya bahuśaḥ śaṅkhamayudhyata janārdanaḥ || 68 |
pakṣaprahāranihatā nakhatuṇḍāgradāritāḥ |
nītā vaivasvatapuraṃ vainateyena dhīmatā || 69 ||
tairhanyamānaṃ daityānāmanīkaṃ bhīmavikramam |
abhajyata tadā saṃkhye bāṇavarṣasamāhatam || 2.122.70 ||
bhajyamāneṣvanīkeṣu trātukāmaḥ samabhyayāt|
jvarastripādastriśirāḥ ṣaḍbhujo navalocanaḥ || 71 ||
bhasmapraharaṇo raudraḥ kālāntakayamopamaḥ |
nadan meghasahasreṇa tulyo nirghātaniḥsvanaḥ || 72 ||
niḥśvasañjṛmbhamāṇaśca nidrānvitatanurbhṛśam |
netrābhyāmākulaṃ vaktraṃ muhuḥ kurvan bhraman muhuḥ ||73||
saṃhṛṣṭaromā glānākṣo bhagnacitta iva śvasan |
halāyudhamabhikruddhaḥ srākṣepamidamabravīt || 74 ||
kimevaṃ balamatto'si na māṃ paśyasi saṃyuge |
tiṣṭha tiṣṭha na me jīvana mokṣyase raṇamūrdhani | 75 ||
ityevamuktvā prahasan halāyudhamupādravat|
yugāntāgninibhairghorairmuṣṭibhirjanayan bhayam || 76 ||
caratastatra saṃgrāme maṇḍalāni sahasraśaḥ |
rauhiṇeyasya śīghreṇa nāvasthānamadṛśyata || 77 ||
tasya bhasma tadā kṣiptaṃ jvareṇāpratimaujasā |
śaighryād vakṣo nipatitaṃ śarīre parvatopame || 78 ||
tad bhasma vakṣasastasya meroḥ śikharamāgamat |
pradīptaṃ patitaṃ tatra giriśṛṅgaṃ vyadārayat || 79 ||
śeṣeṇa cāpi jajvāla bhasmanā kṛṣṇapūrvajaḥ |
niḥśvasañjambhamāṇaśca nidrānvitatanurbhṛśam || 2.122.80 ||
netrayorākulatvaṃ ca muhuḥ kurvan bhramaṃstathā |
saṃhṛṣṭaromā glānākṣaḥ kṣiptacitta iva śvasan || 81 ||
tato haladharo bhagnaḥ kṛṣṇamāha vicetanaḥ |
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho pradīpto'smyabhayaṃ kuru || 82 ||
dahyāmi sarvatastāta kathaṃ śāntirbhavenmama |
ityevamukte vacane balenāmitatejasā || 83 ||
prahasya vacanaṃ prāha kṛṣṇaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ |
na bhetavyamitītyuktvā pariṣvakto halāyudhaḥ || 84 ||
kṛṣṇena paramasnehāt tato dāhāt pramucyata |
mokṣayitvā balaṃ tatra dāhāt tu madhusūdanaḥ || 85 ||
provāca paramakruddho vāsudevo jvaraṃ tadā|
śrībhagavānuvāca
ehyehi jvara yudhyasva yā te śaktirmahāmṛdhe || 86 ||
yacca te pauruṣaṃ sarvaṃ tad darśayatu no bhavān |
savyetarābhyāṃ bāhubhyāmevamukto jvarastadā || 87 ||
cikṣepainaṃ bhasma jvālāgarbha mahābalaḥ |
tataḥ pradīptagātrastu muhūrtamabhavat prabhuḥ || 88 ||
kṛṣṇaḥ praharatāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ śamaṃ cāgnirgatastataḥ |
tatastairbhujagākārairbāhubhistu tribhistadā || 89 ||
jaghāna kṛṣṇaṃ grīvāyāṃ muṣṭinaikena corasi |
sa samprahārastumulastayoḥ puruṣasiṃhayoḥ || 2.122.90 ||
jvarasya tu mahāyuddhe kṛṣṇasya tu mahaujasaḥ |
parvateṣu patantīnāmaśanīnāmiva svanaḥ || 91 ||
kṛṣṇajvarabhujāghātairyuddhamāsīt sudāruṇam |
naivamevaṃ prahartavyamiti tatra mahāsvanaḥ |
muhūrtamabhavad yuddhamanyonyaṃ tu mahātmanoḥ || 92 ||
tato jvaraṃ kanakavicitrabhūṣaṇaṃ nyapīḍayad bhujayugalena saṃyuge |
jagatkṣayaṃ samupanayañjagatpatiḥ śarīradhṛg gaganacaraṃ mahāmṛdhe || 93 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi kṛṣṇajvarayuddhe dvāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 122 ||

<2.123>

trayoviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
mṛtamityabhivijñāya jvaraṃ śatruniṣūdanaḥ |
kṛṣṇo bhujabalābhyāṃ tu cikṣepātha mahītale || 1 ||
muktamātraḥ sa bāhubhyāṃ kṛṣṇadehaṃ viveśa ha |
amuktvā vigrahaṃ tasya kṛṣṇasyāpratimaujasaḥ || 2 ||
sa hyāviṣṭastathā tena jvareṇāpratimaujasā |
kṛṣṇaḥ skhalanniva muhuḥ kṣitau gāḍhaṃ vyavartata || 3 ||
jṛmbhate śvasate caiva valgate ca punaḥ punaḥ |
romāñcotthitagātraśca nidrayā cābhibhūyate || 4 ||
tataḥ sthairyaṃ samālambya kṛṣṇaḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ |
vikurvati mahāyogī jambhamāṇaḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 5 ||
jvarābhibhūtamātmānaṃ vijñāya puruṣottamaḥ |
so'sṛjajjvaramanyaṃ tu pūrvajvaravināśanam || 6 ||
ghoraṃ vaiṣṇavamatyugraṃ sarvaprāṇibhayaṃkaram |
saṃsṛṣṭavān sa tejasvī taṃ jvaraṃ bhīmavikramam || 7 ||
jvaraḥ kṛṣṇavisṛṣṭastu gṛhītvā taṃ jvaraṃ balāt |
kṛṣṇāya hṛṣṭaḥ prāyacchattaṃ jagrāha tato hariḥ || 8 ||
tatastaṃ paramakruddho vāsudevo mahābalaḥ |
svagātrāt svajvareṇaiva niṣkāsayata vīryavān || 9 ||
āvidhya bhūtale cainaṃ śatadhā kartumudyataḥ |
vyāghoṣata jvarastatra bhoḥ paritrātumarhasi || 2.123.10 ||
āvidhyamāne tasmiṃstu kṛṣṇenāmitatejasā |
aśarīrā tato vāṇī hyantarikṣādabhāṣata || 11 ||
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho yadūnāṃ nandivardhana |
mā vadhīrjvaramenaṃ tu rakṣaṇīyastvayānagha || 12 ||
ityevamukte vacane taṃ mumoca hariḥ svayam |
bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyasya jagataḥ paramo guruḥ || 13 ||
kṛṣṇasya pādayormūrdhnā śaraṇaṃ so'gamajjvaraḥ |
evaṃ mukto hṛṣīkeśaṃ jvaro vākyamathābravīt || 14 ||
śṛṇuṣva mama govinda vijñāpyaṃ yadunandana |
yo me manoratho deva taṃ tvaṃ kuru mahābhuja || 15 ||
ahameko jvarastāta nānyo loke jvaro bhavet|
tvatprasādāddhi deveśa varamenaṃ vṛṇomyaham || 16 ||
deva uvāca
evaṃ bhavatu bhadraṃ te yathā tvaṃ jvara kāṅkṣase |
varārthināṃ varo deyo bhavāṃśca śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 17 ||
eka eva jvaro loke bhavānastu yathā purā |
yo'yaṃ mayā jvaraḥ sṛṣṭo mayyevaiṣa pralīyatām || 18 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evamukte tu vacane jvaraṃ prati mahāyaśāḥ |
kṛṣṇaḥ praharatāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ punarvākyamuvāca ha || 19 ||
vāsudeva uvāca
śṛṇuṣva jvara saṃdeśaṃ yathā loke cariṣyasi |
sarvajātiṣu viśrabdhaṃ yathā sthāvarajaṅgame || 2.123.20 ||
tridhā vibhajya cātmānaṃ matpriyaṃ yadi kāṅkṣase |
catuṣpādān bhajaikena dvitīyena ca sthāvarān || 21 ||
tṛtīyo yaśca te bhāgo mānuṣeṣūpapatsyate |
tridhābhūtaṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā pakṣiṣu tvaṃ bhava jvara || 22 ||
caturtho yastṛtīyasya bhaviṣyati sa te dhuvam |
ekāntarastṛtīyastu sa vai cāturthiko jvaraḥ || 23 ||
mānuṣeṣvabhibhedena vasa tvaṃ pravibhajya vai |
jātiṣvathāvaśeṣāsu nivasa tvaṃ śṛṇuṣva me || 24 ||
vṛkṣeṣu kīṭarūpeṇa tathā saṃkocapatrakaḥ |
pāṇḍupatraśca vikhyātaḥ phaleṣvapturyameva ca || 25 ||
apāṃ tu nīlikāṃ vidyācchikhodbhedena barhiṇām|
padminyādau himo bhūtvā pṛthivyāmapi coṣaraḥ || 26 ||
gairikaḥ parvateṣveva matprasādād bhaviṣyasi |
goṣvapasmārako bhūtvā khorakaśca bhaviṣyasi ||27 ||
evaṃ tvaṃ bahurūpeṇa bhaviṣyasi mahītale |
darśanāt sparśanāccāpi prāṇināṃ vadhameṣyasi || 28 ||
ṛte devamanuṣyāṇāṃ nānyastvā visahiṣyati |
vaiśampāyana uvāca
kṛṣṇasya vacanaṃ śrutvā jvaro hṛṣṭamanā hyabhūt || 29 ||
provāca vacanaṃ kiṃcit praṇamitvā kṛtāñjaliḥ |
jvara uvāca
sarvajātiprabhutvena kṛto dhanyo'smi mādhava || 2.123.30 ||
bhūyaśca te balaḥ kartumicchāmi ṣuruṣarṣabha |
tadājñāpaya govinda kiṃ karomi mahābhuja || 31 ||
ahamasurakulapramāthinā tripurahareṇa hareṇa nirmitaḥ |
raṇaśirasi vinirjitastvayā prabhurasi deva tavāsmi kiṃkaraḥ || 32 ||
dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi yat tvayā matpriyaṃ kṛtam|
ājñāpaya priyaṃ kiṃ te cakrāyudha karomyaham || 33 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
jvarasya vacanaṃ śrutvā vāsudevo'bravīd vacaḥ |
abhisaṃdhiṃ śṛṇuṣvādya yat tvāṃ vakṣyāmi niścayāt||34||
śrībhagavānuvāca
mahāhave tava mama ca dvayorimaṃ parākramaṃ bhujabalakevalāstrayoḥ |
praṇamya māmekamanāḥ paṭhet tu yaḥ sa vai bhavejjvara vigatajjvaro naraḥ || 35 ||
tripād bhasmapraharaṇastriśirā navalocanaḥ |
sa me prītaḥ sukhaṃ dadyāt sarvāmayapatirjvaraḥ || 36 ||
ādyantavantaḥ kavayaḥ purāṇāḥ sūkṣmā bṛhanto'pyanuśāsitāraḥ |
sarvāñjvarān ghnantu mayāniruddhapradyumnasaṃkarṣaṇavāsudevāḥ || 37 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evamuktastu kṛṣṇena jvaraḥ sākṣānmahānmanā |
provāca yaduśārdūlamevametad bhaviṣyati || 38 ||
varaṃ labdhvā jvaro hṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇācca samayaṃ punaḥ |
praṇamya śirasā kṛṣṇamapakrāntastato raṇāt || 39 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi jvarakṛṣṇasaṃvāde
trayoviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 123 ||

<2.124>

caturviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataste tvaritāḥ sarve trayastraya ivāgnayaḥ |
vainateyamathāruhya yudhyamānā raṇe sthitāḥ || 1 ||
tataḥ sarvāṇyanīkāni bāṇavarṣairavākiran |
ardayan vainateyasthā nadanto'tibalād raṇe || 2 ||
cakralāṅgalapātaiśca bāṇavarṣaiśca pīḍitam |
saṃcukopa mahānīkaṃ dānavānāṃ durāsadam || 3 ||
kakṣe'gniriva saṃvṛddhaḥ śuṣkendhanasamīritaḥ |
kṛṣṇabāṇāgnirudbhūto vivṛddhiṃ paramāṃ gataḥ || 4 ||
dānavānāṃ sahasrāṇi tasmin samaramūrdhani |
yugāntāgnirivārciṣmān dahamāno vyarājata || 5 ||
tāṃ dīryamāṇāṃ mahatīṃ nānāpraharaṇārditām |
senāṃ bāṇaḥ samāsādya vārayan vākyamabravīt || 6 ||
lāghavaṃ samupāgamya kimarthaṃ bhayaviklavāḥ |
daityavaṃśasamunpannāḥ palāyadhvaṃ mahāhavāt || 7 ||
kavacāsigadāprāsakhaḍgacarmaparaśvadhān |
utsṛjyotsṛjya gacchanti kiṃ bhavanto'ntarikṣagāḥ||8||
svajātiṃ caiva bhāvaṃ ca harasaṃsargameva ca |
mānayadbhirna gantavyameṣo hyahamavasthitaḥ || 9 ||
evamuccaritaṃ vākyaṃ śṛṇvantastadacintayan |
apākrāmanta te sarve dānavā bhayamohitāḥ || 2.124.10 ||
pramāthagaṇaśeṣaṃ tu tadanīkamatiṣṭhata |
bhagnāvaśeṣaṃ yuddhāya punaścakre manastadā || 11 ||
kumbhāṇḍo nāma bāṇasya sasvāmātyaśca vīryavān |
bhagnaṃ svabalamālokya idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 12 ||
eṣa bāṇaḥ sthito yuddhe śaṃkaro'yaṃ guhastathā |
kimarthaṃ balamutsṛjya bhavanto yānti mohitāḥ || 13 ||
prāṇāṃstyaktvā palāyante sarve dānavapuṅgavāḥ |
evaṃ kumbhāṇḍavākyaṃ te śṛṇvanto bhayavihvalāḥ |
cakrāgnibhayavitrastāḥ sarve yānti diśo daśa || 14 ||
bhagnaṃ balaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇenāmitatejasā |
saṃraktanayanaḥ sthāṇuryuddhāya paryavartata || 15 ||
bāṇasaṃrakṣaṇaṃ kartuṃ rathamāsthāya suprabham |
devaḥ kumāraśca tathā rathenāgnisamena vai || 16 ||
nandīśvarasamāyuktaṃ rathamāsthāya vīryavān |
saṃdaṣṭauṣṭhapuṭo rudraḥ prādhāvata yato hariḥ || 17 ||
pibanniva tadākāśaṃ siṃhayukto mahāsvanaḥ |
ratho bhāti ghanonmuktaḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ yathā śaśī || 18||
tato gaṇasahasraistu nānārūpairbhayāvahaiḥ |
nadadbhirvividhān nādānratho devasya śobhayan || 19||
kecit siṃhamukhāstatra tathā vyāghramukhāḥ pare |
nāgāśvoṣṭramukhāstatra pravepuratipīḍitāḥ || 2.124.20 ||
vyālayajñopavītāśca kecit tatra mahābalāḥ |
kharoṣṭragajavaktrāśca aśvagrīvāśca saṃsthitāḥ || 21 ||
chāgamārjāravaktrāśca meṣavaktrāstathā pare |
cīriṇaḥ śikhinaścānye jaṭilordhvaśiroruhāḥ || 22 ||
bhagnāḥ paripatanti sma śaṅkhadundubhiniḥsvanaiḥ |
kecit saumyamukhāstatra divyaiḥ śastrairalaṃkṛtāḥ|| 23 ||
nānāpuṣpakṛtāpīḍā nānāpraharaṇāyudhāḥ |
vāmanā vikaṭāścaiva siṃhavyāghraparicchadāḥ || 24 ||
rudhirādrairmahāvaktrairmahādaṃṣṭrā balipriyāḥ |
devaṃ samparivāryātha mahāśatrupramardanam || 25 ||
līlāyamānāstiṣṭhanti saṃgrāmābhimukhonmukhāḥ |
tato divyaṃ rathaṃ dṛṣṭvā rudrasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ || 26 ||
kṛṣṇo garuḍamāsthāya yayau rudrāya saṃyuge |
vainateyasthamāsyantamāyāntamagraṇī harim || 27 ||
vivyādha kupito bāṇairnārācānāṃ śatena saḥ |
sa śarairarditastena hareṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā || 28 ||
harirjagrāha kupito hyastraṃ pārjanyamuttamam |
pracacāla tato bhūmirviṣṇurudraprapīḍitā || 29 ||
nāgāścordhvamukhāstatra vicelurabhipīḍitāḥ |
parvatāḥ patitāstatra jaladhārābhirāplutāḥ || 2.124.30 ||
kecinmumucire tatra śikharāṇi samantataḥ |
diśaśca pradiśaścaiva bhūmirākāśameva ca || 31 ||
pradīptānīva dṛśyante sthāṇukṛṣṇasamāgame |
samantataśca nirghātāḥ patanti dharaṇītale || 32 ||
śivāścaivāśivān nādānnadante bhīmadarśanāḥ |
vāsavaścānadan ghoraṃ rudhiraṃ cāpyavarṣata || 33 ||
ulkā ca bāṇasainyasya pucchenāvṛtya tiṣṭhati |
pravavau mārutaścāpi jyotīṃṣyākulatāṃ yayuḥ || 34 ||
prabhāhīnāstathauṣadhyo na carantyantarikṣagāḥ |
etasminnantare brahmā sarvadevagaṇairvṛtaḥ || 35 ||
tripurāntakamudyantaṃ jñātvā rudramupāgamat |
gandharvāpsarasaścaiva yakṣā vidyādharāstathā || 36 ||
siddhacāraṇasaṃghāśca paśyanto'tha divi sthitāḥ|
tataḥ pārjanyamastraṃ tat kṣiptaṃ rudrāya viṣṇunā || 37 ||
yayau jvalannatha tadā yato rudro rathasthitaḥ |
tataḥ śatasahasrāṇi śarāṇāṃ nataparvaṇām || 38 ||
nipetuḥ sarvato digbhyo yato hararathaḥ sthitaḥ |
athāgneyaṃ mahāraudramastramastravidāṃ varaḥ || 39 ||
mumoca ruṣito rudrastadadbhutamivābhavat |
tato viśīrṇadehāste catvāro'pi samantataḥ || 2.124.40 ||
nādṛśyanta śaraiśchannā dahyamānāśca vahninā |
siṃhanādaṃ tataścakruḥ sarva evāsurottamāḥ || 41 ||
hato'yamiti vijñāya āgneyāstreṇa vai tadā|
tatastad visahitvā''jau hyastramastravidāṃ varaḥ ||42 ||
jagrāha vāruṇaṃ so'straṃ vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān |
prayukte vāsudevena vāruṇāstre'titejasi ||43 ||
āgneyaṃ praśamaṃ yātamastraṃ vāruṇatejasā |
tasmin pratihate tvastre vāsudevena saṃyuge || 44 ||
paiśācaṃ rākṣasaṃ raudraṃ tathaivāṅgirasaṃ bhavaḥ |
mumocāstrāṇi catvāri yugāntāgninibhāni vai || 45||
vāyavyamatha sāvitraṃ vāsavaṃ mohanaṃ tathā |
astrāṇāṃ dhāraṇārthāya vāsudevo vyamuñcata ||46 ||
astraiścaturbhiścatvāri vārayitvāśu mādhavaḥ |
mumoca vaiṣṇavaṃ so'straṃ vyāditāsyāntakopamam ||47||
vaiṣṇavāstraṃ prayukte tu sarva evāsurottamāḥ |
bhūtayakṣagaṇaścaiva bāṇānīkaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ || 48 ||
diśaḥ sarvā prādravanta bhayamohena viklavāḥ |
pramāthagaṇabhūyiṣṭhe dīrṇe sainye mahāsuraḥ || 49 ||
nirjagāma tato bāṇo yuddhāyābhimukhastvaran |
bhīmapraharaṇairghorairdaityaiśca sumahābalaiḥ|
vṛto mahārathairvīrairvajrīva surasattamaiḥ || 2.124.50 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
japaiśca mantraiśca tathauṣadhībhirmahātmanaḥ svastyayanaṃ pracakruḥ |
sa tatra vastrāṇi śubhāśca gāvaḥ phalāni puṣpāṇi tathaiva niṣkān || 51 ||
baleḥ suto brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchan virājate tena yathā dhaneśaḥ |
sahasrasūryo bahukiṅkiṇīkaḥ parārghyajāmbūnadaratnacitraḥ || 52 ||
sahasracandrāyutatārakaśca ratho mahānagnirivāvabhāti |
tamāsthito dānavasaṃgṛhītaṃ mahādhvajaṃ kārmukadhṛk sa bāṇaḥ || 53 ||
udvartayiṣyan yadupuṅgavānāmatīva raudraṃ sa bibharti rūpam |
sa manyumān vīrarathaughasaṃkulo viniryayau tān prati daityasāgaraḥ || 54 ||
vātapravṛddhastu taraṅgasaṃkulo yathārṇavo lokavināśanāya |
bhīmāni saṃtrāsakarairvapurbhistānyagrato bhānti balāni tasya || 55 ||
mahārathānyucchritakārmukāṇi saparvatānīva vanāni rājan |
viniḥsṛtaḥ sāgaratoyavāsādatyadbhutaścāhavadraṣṭukāmaḥ || 56 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi rudrakṛṣṇayuddhe caturviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 124 ||

<2.125>

pañcaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
andhakārīkṛte loke pradīpte tryambake tathā |
na nandī nāpi ca ratho na rudraḥ pratyadṛśyata || 1 ||
dviguṇaṃ dīptadehastu roṣeṇa ca balena ca |
tripurāntakaro bāṇaṃ jagrāha sa caturmukham || 2 ||
saṃdadhat kārmukaṃ caiva kṣeptukāmastrilocanaḥ |
vijñāto vāsudevena cittajñena mahātmanā || 3 ||
jṛmbhaṇaṃ nāma so'pyastraṃ jagrāha puruṣottamaḥ |
haraṃ saṃjṛmbhayāmāsa kṣiprakārī mahābalaḥ || 4 ||
saśaraḥ sadhanuścaiva harastenāśu jṛmbhitaḥ |
saṃjñāṃ na lebhe bhagavān vijetāsurarakṣasām || 5 ||
saśaraṃ sadhanuṣkaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā''tmānaṃ vijṛmbhitam |
balonmatto'tha bāṇo'sau śarvaṃ codayate'sakṛt|| 6 ||
tato nanāda bhūtātmā snigdhagambhīrayā girā |
pradhmāpayāmāsa tadā kṛṣṇaḥ śaṅkhaṃ mahābalaḥ || 7||
pāñcajanyasya ghoṣeṇa śārṅgavisphūrjitena ca |
devaṃ vijṛmbhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvabhūtāni tatrasuḥ || 8 ||
etasminnantare tatra rudrasya pārṣadā raṇe |
māyāyuddhaṃ samāśritya pradyumnaṃ paryavārayan || 9 ||
sarvāṃstu nidrāvaśagānkṛtvā makaraketumān |
dānavān nāśayat tatra śarajālena vīryavān |
pramāthagaṇabhūyiṣṭhāṃstatra tatra mahābalān || 2.125.10 ||
tatastu jṛmbhamāṇasya devasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ |
jvālā prādurabhūdvaktrāddahantīva diśo daśa ||11||
tatastu dharaṇīdevī pīḍyamānā mahātmabhiḥ |
brahmāṇaṃ viśvadhātāraṃ vepamānābhyupāgamat || 12 ||
pṛthivyuvāca
devadeva mahābāho pīḍyāmi paramaujasā |
kṛṣṇarudrabharākrāntā bhaviṣyaikārṇavā punaḥ || 13 ||
aviṣahyamimaṃ bhāraṃ cintayasva pitāmaha |
laghvībhūtā yathā deva dhārayeyaṃ carācaram || 14 ||
tatastu kāśyapīṃ devīṃ pratyuvāca pitāmahaḥ |
muhūrtaṃ dhārayātmānamāśu laghvī bhaviṣyasi || 15 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
dṛṣṭvā tu bhagavān brahmā rudraṃ vacanamabravīt |
sṛṣṭo mahāsuravadhaḥ kiṃ bhūyaḥ parirakṣyate || 16 ||
na ca yuddhaṃ mahābāho tava kṛṣṇena rocate |
na ca budhyasi kṛṣṇaṃ tvamātmānaṃ tu dvidhā kṛtam|| 17 ||
tataḥ śarīrayogāddhi bhagavānavyayaḥ prabhuḥ |
praviśya paśyate kṛtsnāṃstrīṃllokānsacarācarān|| 18 ||
praviśya yogaṃ yogātmā varāṃstānanucintayan |
dvāravatyāṃ yaduktaṃ ca tadanusmṛtya sarvaśaḥ |
jagāda nottaraṃ kiṃcinnivṛtto hyabhavat tadā || 19 ||
ātmānaṃ kṛṣṇayonisthaṃ paśyata hyekayonijam |
tato niḥsṛtya rudrastu nyastavādo'bhavanmṛdhe || 2.125.20 ||
brahmāṇaṃ cābravīd rudro na yotsye bhagavanniti |
kṛṣṇena saha saṃgrāme laghvī bhavatu medinī || 21 ||
tataḥ kṛṣṇo'tha rudraśca pariṣvajya parasparam |
parāṃ prītimupāgamya saṃgrāmādapajagmatuḥ || 22 ||
na ca tau paśyate kañcidyoginau yogamāgatau |
eko brahmā tathā kṛtvā paśyam̐llokānpitāmahaḥ || 23 ||
uvācaitat samuddiśya mārkaṇḍeyaṃ sanāradam |
pārśvasthaṃ paripapraccha jñātvā vai dīrghadarśinam || 24 ||
pitāmaha uvāca
mandarasya gireḥ pārśve nalinyāṃ bhavakeśavau |
rātrau svapnāntare brahmanmayā dṛṣṭau harācyutau || 25 |
haraṃ ca harirūpeṇa hariṃ ca hararūpiṇam |
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ pītāmbaradharaṃ haram || 26||
triśūlapaṭṭiśadharaṃ vyāghracarmadharaṃ harim |
garuḍasthaṃ cāpi haraṃ hariṃ ca vṛṣabhadhvajam || 27||
vismayo me mahānbrahman dṛṣṭvā tatparamādbhutam |
etadācakṣva bhagavan yāthātathyena suvrata || 28 ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
śivāya viṣṇurūpāya viṣṇave śivarūpiṇe |
yathāntaraṃ na paśyāmi tena tau diśataḥ śivam || 29 ||
anādimadhyanidhanametadakṣaramavyayam |
tadeva te pravakṣyāmi rūpaṃ hariharātmakam || 2.125.30 ||
yo viṣṇuḥ sa tu vai rudro yo rudraḥ sa pitāmahaḥ |
ekā mūrtistrayo devā rudraviṣṇupitāmahāḥ || 31 ||
varadā lokakartāro lokanāthāḥ svayambhuvaḥ |
ardhanārīśvarāste tu vrataṃ tīvraṃ samāsthitāḥ || 32 ||
yathā jale jalaṃ kṣiptaṃ jalameva tu tad bhavet |
rudraṃ viṣṇuḥ praviṣṭastu tathā rudramayo bhavet || 33 ||
agnimagniḥ praviṣṭastu agnireva yathā bhavet |
tathā viṣṇuṃ praviṣṭastu rudro viṣṇumayo bhavet || 34 ||
rudramagnimayaṃ vidyādviṣṇuḥ somātmakaḥ smṛtaḥ|
agnīṣomātmakaṃ caiva jagat sthāvarajaṃgamam || 35 ||
kartārau cāpahartārau sthāvarasya carasya tu |
jagataḥ śubhakartārau prabhaviṣṇū maheśvarau || 36 ||
kartṛkāraṇakartārau kartṛkāraṇakārakau |
bhūtabhavyabhavau devau nārāyaṇamaheśvarau || 37 ||
jagataḥ pālakāvetāvetau sṛṣṭikarau smṛtau |
ete caiva pravarṣanti bhānti vānti sṛjanti ca |
etat parataraṃ guhyaṃ kathitaṃ te pitāmaha || 38 ||
yaścainaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ yaścainaṃ śṛṇuyānnaraḥ |
prāpnoti paramaṃ sthānaṃ viṣṇurudraprasādajam || 39 ||
devau hariharau stoṣye brahmaṇā saha saṃgatau |
etau ca paramau devau jagataḥ prabhavāpyayau || 2.125.40 ||
rudrasya paramo viṣṇurviṣṇośca paramaḥ śivaḥ |
eka eva dvidhābhūto loke carati nityaśaḥ || 41 ||
na vinā śaṃkaraṃ viṣṇurna vinā keśavaṃ śivaḥ |
tasmādekatvamāyātau rūdropendrau tu tau purā |
namo rudrāya kṛṣṇāya namaḥ saṃhatacāriṇe || 42 ||
namaḥ ṣaḍardhanetrāya sadvinetrāya vai namaḥ |
namaḥ piṅgalanetrāya padmanetrāya vai namaḥ || 43 ||
namaḥ kumāragurave pradyumnagurave namaḥ |
namo dharaṇīdharāya gaṅgādharāya vai namaḥ || 44 ||
namo mayūrapicchāya namaḥ keyūradhāriṇe |
namaḥ kapālamālāya vanamālāya vai namaḥ || 45 ||
namastriśūlahastāya cakrahastāya vai namaḥ |
namaḥ kanakadaṇḍāya namaste brahmadaṇḍine || 46 ||
namaścarmanivāsāya namaste pītavāsase |
namo'stu lakṣmīpataye umāyāḥ pataye namaḥ || 47 ||
namaḥ khaṭvāṅgadhārāya namo musaladhāriṇe |
namo bhasmāṅgarāgāya namaḥ kṛṣṇāṅgadhāriṇe|| 48 ||
namaḥ śmaśānavāsāya namaḥ sāgaravāsine |
namo vṛṣabhavāhāya namo garuḍavāhine || 49 ||
namastvanekarūpāya bahurūpāya vai namaḥ |
namaḥ pralayakartre ca namastrailokyadhāriṇe || 2.125.50 ||
namo'stu saumyarūpāya namo bhairavarūpiṇe |
virūpākṣāya devāya namaḥ saumyekṣaṇāya ca || 51 ||
dakṣayajñavināśāya balerniyamanāya ca |
namaḥ parvatavāsāya namaḥ sāgaravāsine || 52 ||
namaḥ suraripughnāya tripuraghnāya vai namaḥ |
namo'stu narakaghnāya namaḥ kāmāṅganāśine || 53 ||
namastvandhakanāśāya namaḥ kaiṭabhanāśine |
namaḥ sahasrahastāya namo'saṃkhyeyabāhave || 54 ||
namaḥ sahasraśīrṣāya bahuśīrṣāya vai namaḥ |
dāmodarāya devāya muñjamekhaline namaḥ || 55||
namaste bhagavan viṣṇo namaste bhagavañchiva |
namaste bhagavan deva namaste devapūjita || 56 ||
namaste sāmabhirgīta namaste yajubhiḥ saha |
namaste suraśatrughna namaste surapūjita || 57 ||
namaste karmiṇāṃ karma namo'mitaparākrama |
hṛṣīkeśa namaste'stu svarṇakeśa namo'stu te || 58 ||
imaṃ stavaṃ yo rudrasya viṣṇoścaiva mahātmanaḥ |
sametya ṛṣibhiḥ sarvaiḥ stutau stauti maharṣibhiḥ 59 ||
vyāsena vedaviduṣā nāradena ca dhīmatā |
bhāradvājena gargeṇa viśvāmitreṇa vai tathā || 2.125.60 ||
agastyena pulastyena dhaumyena tu mahātmanā |
ya idaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ stotraṃ hariharātmakam || 61 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi
arogo balavāṃścaiva jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
śriyaṃ ca labhate nityaṃ na ca svargānnivartate || 62
aputro labhate putraṃ kanyā vindati satpatim |
gurviṇī śṛṇute yā tu varaṃ putraṃ prasūyate || 63 ||
rākṣasāśca piśācāśca vighnāni ca vināyakaḥ |
bhayaṃ tatra na kurvanti yatrāyaṃ paṭhyate stavaḥ || 64 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi hariharātmakastavo nāma pañcaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||125||

<2.126>

ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
apayāte tato deve kṛṣṇe caiva mahātmani |
punaścāsīt kathaṃ yuddhaṃ pareṣāṃ lomaharṣaṇam || 1 |
vaiśampāyana uvāca
kumbhāṇḍasaṃgṛhīte tu rathe tiṣṭhan guhastadā |
abhidudrāva kṛṣṇaṃ ca balaṃ pradyumnameva ca || 2 ||
tataḥ śaraśatairugraistānvivyādha raṇe guhaḥ |
amarṣaroṣasaṃkruddhaḥ kumāraḥ pravaro nadan || 3 ||
śarasaṃvṛtagātrāste trayastraya ivāgnayaḥ |
śoṇitaughaplutairgātraiḥ prāyudhyanta guhaṃ tataḥ || 4 ||
tataste yuddhamārgajñāstrayastribhiranuttamaiḥ |
vāyavyāgneyapārjanyairbibhidurdīptatejasaḥ || 5
tānastrāṃstribhirevāstrairvinivārya sa pāvakiḥ |
śailavāruṇasāvitraistānsa vivyādha kopavān || 6 ||
tasya dīptaśaraughasya dīptacāpadharasya ca |
śaraughānastramāyābhirgrasanti sma mahātmanaḥ |
yadā tadā guhaḥ kruddhaḥ prajvalanniva tejasā || 7 ||
astraṃ brahmaśiro nāma kālakalpaṃ durāsadam |
saṃdaṣṭauṣṭhapuṭaḥ saṃkhye jagṛhe pāvakiḥ prabhuḥ || 8 ||
prayukte brahmaśirasi sahasrāṃśusamaprabhe |
ugre paramadurdharṣe lokakṣayakare tathā || 9 ||
hāhābhūteṣu sarveṣu pradhāvatsu samantataḥ |
astratejaḥpramūḍhe tu viṣaṇṇe jagati prabhuḥ |
keśavaḥ keśimathanaścakraṃ jagrāha vīryavān || 2.126.10 ||
sarveṣāmastravīryāṇāṃ vāraṇaṃ ghātanaṃ tathā |
cakramapraticakrasya loke khyātaṃ mahātmanaḥ || 11 ||
astraṃ brahmaśirastena niṣprabhaṃ kṛtamojasā |
ghanairivātapāpāye saviturmaṇḍalaṃ yathā || 12 ||
tato niṣprabhatāṃ yāte naṣṭavīrye mahaujasi |
tasmin brahmaśirasyastre krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ || 13 ||
guhaḥ prajajvāla raṇe haviṣevāgnirulbaṇaḥ |
śatrughnīṃ jvalitāṃ divyāṃ śaktiṃ jagrāha kāñcanīm ||14||
amoghāṃ dayitāṃ ghorāṃ sarvalokabhayāvahām |
tāṃ pradīptāṃ maholkābhāṃ yugāntāgnisamaprabhām |
ghaṇṭāmālākulāṃ divyāṃ cikṣepa ruṣito guhaḥ || 15 ||
nanāda balavaccāpi nādaṃ śatrubhayaṃkaram |
sā ca kṣiptā tadā tena brahmaṇyena mahātmanā || 16 ||
jṛmbhamāṇeva gagane sampradīptamukhī tadā |
ādhāvata mahāśaktiḥ kṛṣṇasya vadhakāṅkṣiṇī || 17 ||
bhṛśaṃ viṣaṇṇaḥ śakro'pi sarvāmaragaṇairvṛtaḥ |
śaktiṃ prajvalitāṃ dṛṣṭvā dagdhaḥ kṛṣṇeti cābravīt || 18 ||
tāṃ samīpamanuprāptāṃ mahāśaktiṃ mahāmṛdhe |
huṅkāreṇaiva nirbhartsya pātayāmāsa bhūtale || 19 ||
patitāyāṃ mahāśaktyāṃ sādhusādhviti sarvaśaḥ |
siṃhanādaṃ tataścakruḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ || 2.126.20 ||
tato deveṣu nardatsu vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān |
punaścakraṃ sa jagrāha daityāntakaraṇaṃ raṇe || 21 ||
vyāvidhyamāne cakre tu kṛṣṇenāpratimaujasā |
kumārarakṣaṇārthāya bibhratī sutanuṃ tadā || 22 ||
digvāsā devavacanāt praviṣṭā tatra koṭavī |
lambamānā mahābhāgā bhāgo devyāstathāṣṭamaḥ |
citrā kanakaśaktistu sā ca nagnā sthitāntare || 23 ||
athāntarāt kumārasya devīṃ dṛṣṭvā mahābhujaḥ |
parāṅmukhastato vākyamuvāca madhusūdanaḥ || 24 ||
śrībhagavānuvāca
apagacchāpagaccha tvaṃ dhik tvāmiti vaco'bravīt|
kimevaṃ kuruṣe vighnaṃ niścitasya vadhaṃ prati || 25 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ tasya koṭavī tu tadā vibhoḥ |
naiva vāsaḥ samādhatte kumāraparirakṣaṇāt | 26 ||
śrībhagavānuvāca
apavāhya guhaṃ śīghramapayāhi raṇājirāt |
svasti hyevaṃ bhavedadya yotsyato yotsyatā mayā||27||
tāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā sthitāṃ devo hariḥ saṃgrāmamūrdhani |
saṃjahāra tataścakraṃ bhagavān vāsavānujaḥ || 28 ||
evaṃ kṛte tu kṛṣṇena devadevena dhīmatā |
apavāhya guhaṃ devī harasāṃnidhyamāgatā || 29 ||
etasminnantare caiva vartamāne mahābhaye |
kumāre rakṣite devyā bāṇastaṃ deśamāyayau || 2.126.30 ||
apayāntaṃ guhaṃ dṛṣṭvā muktaṃ kṛṣṇena saṃyugāt |
bāṇaścintayate tatra svayaṃ yotsyāmi mādhavam || 31 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
bhūtayakṣagaṇāścaiva bāṇānīkaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ |
diśaṃ pradudruvuḥ sarve bhayamohitalocanāḥ || 32 ||
pramāthagaṇabhūyiṣṭhe sainye dīrṇe mahāsuraḥ |
nirjagāma tato bāṇo yuddhāyābhimukhastvaran || 33 ||
bhīmapraharaṇairghorairdaityendraiḥ sumahārathaiḥ |
mahābalairmahāvīrairvajrīva surasattamaiḥ || 34 ||
purohitāḥ śatruvadhaṃ vadantastathaiva cānye śrutaśīlavṛddhāḥ |
japaiśca mantraiśca tathauṣadhībhirmahātmanaḥ svastyayanaṃ pracakruḥ || 35 ||
tatastūryapraṇādaisa bherīṇāṃ tu mahāsvanaiḥ |
siṃhanādaiśca daityānāṃ bāṇaḥ kṛṣṇamabhidravat || 36 ||
dṛṣṭvā bāṇaṃ tu niryātaṃ yuddhāyaiva vyavasthitam |
āruhya garuḍaṃ kṛṣṇo bāṇāyābhimukho yayau || 37 ||
āyāntamatha taṃ dṛṣṭvā yadūnāmṛṣabhaṃ raṇe |
vainateyamathārūḍhaṃ kṛṣṇamapratimaujasam || 38 ||
atha bāṇastu taṃ dṛṣṭvā pramukhe pratyupasthitam |
uvāca vacanaṃ kruddho vāsudevaṃ tarasvinam ||39||
bāṇa uvāca
tiṣṭha tiṣṭha na me'dya tvaṃ jīvanpratigamiṣyasi |
dvārakāṃ dvārakāsthāṃśca suhṛdo drakṣyase na ca || 2.126.40 ||
suvarṇavarṇān vṛkṣāgrānadya drakṣyasi mādhava |
mayābhibhūtaḥ samare mumūrṣuḥ kālanoditaḥ || 41 ||
adya bāhusahasreṇa kathamaṣṭabhujo raṇe |
mayā saha samāgamya yotsyase garuḍadhvaja || 42 ||
adya tvaṃ vai mayā yuddhe nirjitaḥ sahabāndhavaḥ |
dvārakāṃ śoṇitapure nihataḥ saṃsmariṣyasi || 43||
nānāpraharaṇopetaṃ nānāṅgadavibhūṣitam |
adya bāhusahasraṃ me koṭibhūtaṃ niśāmaya || 44 ||
garjatastasya vākyaughā jalaughā iva sindhutaḥ |
niścaranti mahāghorā vātoddhūtā ivormayaḥ || 45 ||
roṣaparyākule caiva netre tasya babhūvatuḥ |
jagaddidhakṣanniva khe mahāsūrya ivoditaḥ || 46 ||
tacchrutvā nāradastasya bāṇasyātyūrjitaṃ vacaḥ |
jahāsa sumahāhāsaṃ bhindanniva nabhastalam || 47||
yogapaṭṭamupāśritya tasthau yuddhadidṛkṣayā |
kautūhalotphulladṛśaḥ kurvan paryaṭate muniḥ || 48 ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
bāṇa kiṃ garjase mohācchūrāṇāṃ nāsti garjitam |
ehyehi yudhyasva raṇe kiṃ vṛthā garjitena te || 49 ||
yadi yuddhāni vacanaiḥ siddhyeyurditinandana |
bhavāneva jayennityaṃ bahvabaddhaṃ prajalpati || 2.126.50 ||
ehyehi jaya māṃ bāṇa jito vā vasudhātale |
cirāyāvāṅmukho dīnaḥ patitaḥ śeṣyase 'suraiḥ || 51 ||
ityevamuktvā bāṇaṃ tu marmabhedibhirāśugaiḥ |
nirbibheda tadā kṛṣṇastamamoghairmahāśaraiḥ || 52 ||
vinirbhinnastu kṛṣṇena mārgaṇairmarmabhedibhiḥ |
smayan bāṇastataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ śaravarṣairavākirat || 53 ||
jvaladbhiriva saṃyuktaṃ tasmin yuddhe sudāruṇe |
tataḥ parighanistriṃśairgadātomaraśaktibhiḥ || 54 ||
musalaiḥ paṭṭiśaiścaiva cchādayāmāsa keśavam |
sa tu bāhusahasreṇa garvito daityasattamaḥ || 55 ||
yodhayāmāsa samare dvibāhumatha līlayā |
lāghavāt tasya kṛṣṇasya balisūnū ruṣānvitaḥ || 56 ||
tato'straṃ paramaṃ divyaṃ tapasā nirmitaṃ mahat |
yadapratihataṃ yuddhe sarvāmitravināśanam || 57 ||
brahmaṇā vihitaṃ divyaṃ tanmumoca diteḥ sutaḥ |
tasmin mukte diśaḥ sarvāstamaḥpihitamaṇḍalāḥ|| 58 ||
prādurāsan sahasrāṇi sughorāṇi ca sarvaśaḥ |
tamasā saṃvṛte loke na prājñāyata kiṃcana || 59 ||
sādhu sādhviti bāṇaṃ tu pūjayanti sma dānavāḥ |
hā hā dhigiti devānāṃ śrūyate vāgudīritā || 2.126.60 ||
tato'strabalavegena sārciṣmatyaḥ sudāruṇāḥ |
ghorarūpā mahāvegā nipeturbāṇavṛṣṭayaḥ || 61 ||
naiva vātāḥ pravāyanti na meghāḥ saṃcaranti ca |
astre visṛṣṭe bāṇena dahyamāne ca keśave || 62 ||
tato'straṃ sumahāvegaṃ jagrāha madhusūdanaḥ |
pārjanyaṃ nāma bhagavān kālāntakanibhaṃ raṇe || 63 ||
tato vitimire loke śarāgniḥ praśamaṃ gataḥ |
dānavā moghasaṃkalpāḥ sarve'bhūvaṃstadā bhṛśam || 64 ||
dānavāstraṃ praśāntaṃ tu parjanyāstre'bhimantrite |
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve nadanti ca hasanti ca || 65 ||
hate śastre mahārāja daiteyaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ |
bhūyaḥ sa chādayāmāsa keśavaṃ garuḍe sthitam || 66 ||
musalaiḥ paṭṭiśaiścaiva cchādayāmāsa keśavam |
tasya tāṃ tarasā sarvāṃ bāṇavṛṣṭiṃ samudyatām || 67 ||
prahasan vārayāmāsa keśavaḥ śatrusūdanaḥ |
keśavasya tu bāṇena vartamāne mahāhave || 68 ||
tasya śārṅgavinirmuktaiḥ śarairaśanisaṃnibhaiḥ |
tilaśastadrathaṃ cakre so'śvadhvajapatākinam || 69 ||
ciccheda kavacaṃ kāyānmukuṭaṃ ca mahāprabham |
kārmukaṃ ca mahātejā hastāvāpaṃ ca keśavaḥ || 2.126.70 ||
vivyādha cainamurasi nārācena smayanniva |
sa marmābhihataḥ saṃkhye pramumohālpacetanaḥ || 71 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mūrcchitaṃ bāṇaṃ prahāraparipīḍitam |
prāsādavaraśṛṃgastho nārado munipuṅgavaḥ || 72 ||
utthāyāpaśyata tadā kakṣyāsphoṭanatatparaḥ |
vādayāno nakhāṃścaiva diṣṭyā diṣṭyeti cābravīt || 73||
aho me saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam |
dṛṣṭaṃ me yadidaṃ citraṃ dāmodaraparākramam || 74 ||
jaya bāṇaṃ mahābāho daiteyaṃ devakilbiṣam |
yadarthamavatīrṇo'si tat karma saphalīkuru || 75 ||
evaṃ stutvā tadā devaṃ bāṇaiḥ khaṃ dyotayañchitaiḥ |
itastataḥ sampatadbhirnārado vyacarad raṇe || 76 ||
keśavasya tu bāṇena vartamāne mahābhaye |
prayudhyetāṃ dhvajau tatra tāvanyonyamabhidrutau |
yuddhaṃ tvabhūt vāhanayorubhayordevadaityayoḥ || 77 ||
garuḍasya ca saṃgrāmo mayūrasya ca dhīmataḥ |
pakṣatuṇḍaprahāraistu caraṇāsyanakhaistathā || 78 ||
anyonyaṃ jaghnatuḥ kruddhau mayūragaruḍāvubhau |
vainateyastataḥ kruddho mayūraṃ dīptatejasam || 79 ||
jagrāha śirasi kṣipraṃ tuṇḍenābhipataṃstadā |
utkṣipya caiva pakṣābhyāṃ nijaghāna mahābalaḥ || 2.126.80 ||
padbhyāṃ pārśvābhighātābhyāṃ kṛtvā ghātānyanekaśaḥ|
ākṛṣya cainaṃ tarasā vikṛṣya ca mahābalaḥ || 81
niḥsaṃjñaṃ pātayāmāsa gaganādiva bhāskaram |
mayūre patite tasmin papātātibalo bhuvi || 82 ||
bāṇaḥ samarasaṃvignaścintayan kāryamātmanaḥ |
mayātibalamattena na kṛtaṃ suhṛdāṃ vacaḥ || 83 ||
paśyatāṃ devadaityānāṃ prāpto'smyāpadamuttamām |
taṃ dīnamanasaṃ jñātvā raṇe bāṇaṃ suviklavam || 84 ||
cintayad bhagavān rudro bāṇarakṣaṇamāturaḥ |
tato nandīṃ mahādevaḥ prāha gambhīrayā girā || 85 ||
nandikeśvara yāhi tvaṃ yato bāṇo raṇe sthitaḥ |
rathenānena divyena siṃhayuktena bhāsvatā || 86 ||
bāṇaṃ saṃyojayāśu tvamalaṃ yuddhāya vānagha |
pramāthagaṇamadhye'haṃ sthāsyāmi na hi me manaḥ || 87 ||
yoddhuṃ prabhavate hyadya bāṇaṃ saṃrakṣa gamyatām |
tathetyuktvā tato nandī rathena rathināṃ varaḥ || 88 ||
yato bāṇastato gatvā bāṇamāha śanairidam |
daityāmu rathamātiṣṭha śīghramehi mahābala || 89||
tato yudhyasva kṛṣṇaṃ vai dānavāntakaraṃ raṇe |
āruroha rathaṃ bāṇo mahādevasya dhīmataḥ || 2.126.90 ||
ārūḍhaḥ sa tu bāṇaśca taṃ rathaṃ brahmanirmitam |
taṃ syandanamadhiṣṭhāya bhavasyāmitatejasaḥ || 91 ||
prāduścakre mahāraudramastraṃ sarvāstraghātanam |
dīptaṃ brahmaśironāma bāṇaḥ kruddho'tivīryavān|| 92 ||
pradīpte brahmaśirasi lokaḥ kṣobhamupāgamat |
lokasaṃrakṣaṇārthe vai tat sṛṣṭaṃ brahmayoninā || 93 ||
taccakreṇa nihatyāstraṃ prāha kṛṣṇastarasvinam |
loke prakhyātayaśasaṃ bāṇamapratimaṃ raṇe || 94 ||
katthitāni kva te tāta bāṇa kiṃ na vikatthase |
ayamasmi sthito yuddhe yuddhyasva puruṣo bhava || 95 ||
kārtavīryārjuno nāma pūrvaṃ bāhusahasravān |
mahābalaḥ sa rāmeṇa dvibāhuḥ samare kṛtaḥ || 96 ||
tathā tavāpi darpo'yaṃ bāhūnāṃ vīryasambhavaḥ |
eś te darpaśamanaṃ karomi raṇamūrddhani || 97 ||
yāvat te darpaśamanaṃ karomyadya svabāhunā |
tiṣṭhedānīṃ na me'dya tvaṃ mokṣyase raṇamūrddhani || 98 ||
atha tad durlabhaṃ dṛṣṭvā yuddhaṃ paramadāruṇam |.
tatra devāsurasame yuddhe nṛtyati nāradaḥ || 99 ||
nirjitāśca gaṇāḥ sarve pradyumnena mahātmanā |
nikṣiptavādā yuddhasya devadevaṃ gatāḥ punaḥ || 2.126.100||
sa taccakraṃ sahasrāraṃ nadan megha ivoṣṇage |
jagrāha kṛṣṇastvarito bāṇāntakaraṇaṃ raṇe ||101|
tejo yajjyotiṣāṃ caiva tejo vajrāśanestathā |
sureśasya ca yat tejastaccakre paryavasthitam || 102||
tretāgneścaiva yat tejo yacca vai brahmacāriṇām |
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca tato jñānaṃ taccakre samavasthitam ||103||
pativratānāṃ yattejaḥ prāṇāśca mṛgapakṣiṇām |
yaśca cakradhareṣvasti taccakre saṃniveśitam || 104||
nāgarākṣasayakṣāṇāṃ gandharvāpsarasāmapi |
trailokyasya ca yatprāṇaṃ sarvaṃ cakre vyavasthitam ||105||
tejasā tena saṃyuktaṃ jvalanniva ca bhāskaraḥ |
vapuṣā teja ādatte bāṇasya pramukhe sthitam || 106||
jñātvātitejasā cakraṃ kṛṣṇenābhyuditaṃ raṇe |
aprameyaṃ hyavihataṃ rudrāṇī cābravīcchivam || 107||
ajeyametat trailokye cakraṃ kṛṣṇena dhāryate |
bāṇaṃ trāyasva deva tvaṃ yāvaccakraṃ na muñcati ||108||
tatastryakṣo vacaḥ śrutvā devīṃ lambāmathābravīt|
gacchaihi lambe śīghraṃ tvaṃ bāṇasaṃrakṣaṇaṃ prati ||109||
tato yogaṃ samādhāya adṛśyā himavatsutā |
kṛṣṇasyaikasya tadrūpaṃ darśantī pārśvamāgatā || 2.126.110||
cakrodyatakaraṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavantaṃ raṇājire ||
antardhānamupāgamya tyajya sā bāsasī punaḥ ||111 ||
paritrāṇāya bāṇasya vijayādhiṣṭhitā tataḥ |
pramukhe vāsudevasya digvāsāḥ koṭavī sthitā || 1 12||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvātha punaḥ prāptāṃ devīṃ rudrasya sammatām |
lambādvitīyāṃ tiṣṭhantīṃ kṛṣṇo vacanamabravīt || 113||
bhūyaḥ sāmarṣatāmrākṣīṃ digvastrāvasthitāṃ raṇe |
bāṇasaṃrakṣaṇaparā hanmi bāṇaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||1 14||
evamuktā tu kṛṣṇena bhūyo devyabravīdidam |
jāne tvāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ sraṣṭāraṃ puruṣottamam |
mahābhāgaṃ mahādevamanantaṃ nīlamavyayam || 115||
padmanābhaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ lokānāmādisambhavam |
nārhase deva hantuṃ vai bāṇamapratimaṃ raṇe || 1 16||
prayaccha hyabhayaṃ bāṇe jīvaputrītvameva ca |
mayā dattavaro hyeṣa bhūyaśca parirakṣyate || 117||
na me mithyā samudyogaṃ kartumarhasi mādhava |
evamukte tu vacane devyā parapuraṃjayaḥ ||118||
kṛṣṇaḥ prabhāṣate vākyaṃ śṛṇu satyaṃ tu bhāmini |
bāṇo bāhusahasreṇa nardate darpamāśritaḥ || 119||
eteṣāṃ chedanaṃ tvadya kartavyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ |
dvibāhunā ca bāṇena jīvaputrī bhaviṣyasi || 2.126.120||
āsuraṃ darpamāśritya na ca māṃ saṃśrayiṣyati |
evamukte tu vacane kṛṣṇenākliṣṭakarmaṇā || 121||
provāca devī bāṇo'yaṃ devadatto bhavediti |
atha tāṃ kārtikeyasya mātaraṃ so'bhibhāṣya vai |
tataḥ kruddho mahābāhuḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pravadatāṃ varaḥ || 122||
provāca bāṇaṃ samare vadatāṃ pravaraḥ prabhuḥ |
yudhyatāṃ yudhyatāṃ saṃkhye bhavatāṃ koṭavī sthitā || 123||
aśaktānāmiva raṇe dhig bāṇa tava pauruṣam |
evamuktvā tataḥ kṛṣṇastaccakraṃ paramātmavān || 124||
nimīlitākṣo vyasṛjad bāṇaṃ prati mahābalaḥ |
kṣepaṇādyasya muhyanti lokāḥ sasthāṇujaṅgamāḥ || 125||
kravyādāni ca bhūtāni tṛptiṃ yānti mahāmṛdhe |
tamapratimakarmāṇaṃ samānaṃ sūryavarcasā ||126||
cakramudyamya samare kopadīpto gadādharaḥ |
sa muṣṇan dānavaṃ tejaḥ samare svena tejasā|| 127 ||
ciccheda bāhūṃścakreṇa śrīdharaḥ paramaujasā |
alātacakravat tūrṇaṃ bhrāmyamāṇaṃ raṇājire || 128||
kṣiptaṃ tu vāsudevena bāṇasya raṇamūrddhani |
viṣṇucakraṃ bhramatyāśu śaighryād rūpaṃ na dṛśyate || 129||
tasya bāhusahasrasya paryāyeṇa punaḥ punaḥ |
bāṇasya cchedanaṃ cakre taccakraṃ raṇamūrddhani || 2.126.130||
kṛtvā dvibāhuṃ taṃ bāṇaṃ chinnaśākhamiva drumam |
punaḥ karāgre kṛṣṇasya cakraṃ prāptaṃ sudarśanam || 131||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
kṛtakṛtye tu samprāpte cakre daityanipātane |
sravatā tena kāyena śoṇitaughapariplutaḥ || 132 ||
abhavat parvatākāraśchinnabāhurmahāsuraḥ |
asṛṅmattaśca vividhān nādān muñcan ghano yathā ||
tasya nādena mahatā keśavo ripusūdanaḥ |
cakraṃ bhūyaḥ kṣeptukāmo bāṇanāśārthamudyataḥ |
tamupetya mahādevaḥ kumārasahito'bravīt || 134||
īśvara uvāca
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho jāne tvāṃ puruṣottamam|
madhukaiṭabhahantāraṃ devadevaṃ sanātanam ||135||
lokānāṃ tvaṃ gatirdeva tvatprasūtamidaṃ jagat ||
ajeyastvaṃ tribhirlokaiḥ sasurāsurapannagaiḥ || 136||
tasmātsaṃhara divyaṃ tvamidaṃ cakraṃ samudyatam |
anivāryamasaṃhāryaṃ raṇe śatrubhayaṃkaram ||137||
bāṇasyāsyābhayaṃ dattaṃ mayā keśiniṣūdana |
tanme na syādvṛthā vākyamatastvāṃ kṣāmayāmyaham|| 138||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
jīvatāṃ deva bāṇo'yametaccakraṃ nivartitam |
mānyastvaṃ devadevānāmasurāṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ || 139||
namaste'stu gamiṣyāmi yatkāryaṃ tanmaheśvara |
na tāvat kriyate tasmānmāmanujñātumarhasi || 2.126.140||
evamuktvā mahādevaṃ kṛṣṇastūrṇa mahāmanāḥ |
jagāma tatra yatrāste prādyumniḥ sāyakaiścitaḥ || 141||
gate kṛṣṇe tato nandī bāṇamāha vacaḥ śubham |
gaccha vāṇa prasannasya devadevasya cāgrataḥ || 142||
tacchrutvā nandivākyaṃ tu bāṇo'gacchata śīghragaḥ |
chinnabāhuṃ tato bāṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā nandī pratāpavān || 143||
apavāhya rathenainaṃ yato devastato yayau |
tato nandī punarbāṇaṃ prāguvācottaraṃ vacaḥ || 144||
bāṇa bāṇa pranṛtyasva śreyastava bhaviṣyati |
eṣa devo mahādevaḥ prasādasumukhastava || 145||
śoṇitaughaplutairgātrairnandivākyapracoditaḥ |
jīvitārthī tato bāṇaḥ pramukhe śaṃkarasya vai ||146||
anṛtyat bhayasaṃvigno dānavaḥ sa vicetanaḥ |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā ca pranṛtyantaṃ bhayodvignaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 147|
nandivākyaprajavitaṃ bhaktānugrahakṛd bhavaḥ |
karuṇāvaśamāpanno mahādevo'bravīd vacaḥ || 148||
īśvara uvāca
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bāṇa tvaṃ manasā yadabhīpsasi |
prasāda sumukhaste'haṃ priyo'si mama dānava || 149||
bāṇa uvāca
ajaraścāmaraścaiva bhaveyaṃ satataṃ vibho |
eṣa me prathamo deva varo'stu yadi manyase || 2.126.150||
deva uvāca
tulyo'si daivatairbāṇa na mṛtyustava vidyate |
athāparaṃ vṛṇīṣvādya anugrāhyo'si me sadā || 151 ||
bāṇa uvāca
yathāhaṃ śoṇitairdigdho bhṛśārto vraṇapīḍitaḥ |
bhaktānāṃ nṛtyatāṃ deva putrajanma bhavedbhava || 152|
śrīhara uvāca
nirāhārāḥ kṣamāvantaḥ satyārjavasamāhitāḥ |
madbhaktā ye'pi nṛtyanti teṣāmevaṃ bhaviṣyati || 153||
tṛtīyaṃ tvamatho bāṇa varaṃ vara manogatam |
tad vidhāsyāmi te putra saphalo'stu bhavāniha|| 154||
bāṇa uvāca
cakratāḍanajā ghorā rujā tīvrā hi me'nagha |
vareṇāsau tṛtīyena śāntiṃ gacchatu me bhava || 155||
śrīrudra uvāca
evaṃ bhavatu bhadraṃ te na rujā prabhaviṣyati |
akṣataṃ tava gātraṃ tu svasthāvasthaṃ bhaviṣyati || 156||
caturthe te varaṃ dadmi vṛṇīṣva yadi kāṅkṣasi |
na te'haṃ vimukhastāta prasādasumukho hyaham || 157||
bāṇa uvāca
pramāthagaṇavaṃśyasya prathamaḥ syāmahaṃ vibho |
mahākāla iti khyātiṃ gaccheyaṃ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ || 158||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyāha bāṇaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ |
divyarūpo'kṣato gātrairnīrujastu mamāśrayāt || 159||
mamātisargād bāṇa tvaṃ bhava caivākutobhayaḥ |
bhūyaste pañcamaṃ dadmi prakhyātabalapauruṣa |
punarvaraya bhadraṃ te yatte manasi vartate || 2.126.160||
bāṇa uvāca
vairūpyamaṅgajaṃ yanme mā bhūd deva kadācana |
dvibāhurapi me deho na virūpo bhaved bhava ||161||
śrīhara uvāca
bhavitā sarvametat te yathecchasi mahāsura |
bhavatyevaṃ na cādeyaṃ bhaktānāṃ vidyate mama || 162||
tato'bravīnmahādevo bāṇaṃ sthitamathāntike |
evaṃ bhaviṣyate sarva yat tvayā samudāhṛtam || 163||
etāvaduktvā bhagavāṃstrinetro gaṇasaṃvṛtaḥ |
paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata ||164||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi uṣāharaṇe bāṇāsuravarapradāne ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||126||

<2.127>

saptaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evaṃ varān bahūn prāpya bāṇaḥ prītamanā'bhavat |
jagāma saha rudreṇa mahākālatvamāgataḥ || 1 ||
vāsudevo'pi bahudhā nāradaṃ paryapṛcchata |
kvāniruddho'sti bhagavansaṃyato nāgabandhanaiḥ || 2 ||
śrotumicchāmi tattvena snehaklinnaṃ hi me manaḥ |
aniruddhe hṛte vīre kṣubhitā dvārakā purī || 3 ||
śīghraṃ taṃ mokṣayiṣyāmo yadarthaṃ vayamāgatāḥ |
adya taṃ naṣṭaśatruṃ vai draṣṭumicchāmahe vayam || 4 ||
sa pradeśastu bhagavan viditastava suvrata |
evamuktastu kṛṣṇena nāradaḥ pratyabhāṣata || 5||
kanyāpure kumāro'sau baddho nāgaiśca mādhava |
etasminnantare śīghraṃ citralekhā hyupasthitā || 6 ||
bāṇasyottamaśarvasya daityendrasya mahātmanaḥ |
idamantaḥpuraṃ deva praviśasva yathāsukham || 7 ||
tataḥ praviṣṭāste sarve hyaniruddhasya mokṣaṇe |
balaḥ suparṇaḥ kṛṣṇastu pradyumno nāradastathā || 8 ||
tato dṛṣṭvaiva garuḍaṃ ye'niruddhaśarīragāḥ |
śararūpā mahāsarpā veṣṭayitvā tanuṃ sthitāḥ 9 ||
te sarve sahasā dehāt tasya niḥsṛtya bhoginaḥ |
kṣitiṃ samabhivartitvā prakṛtyāvasthitāḥ śarāḥ || 2.127.10 ||
dṛṣṭaḥ spṛṣṭaśca kṛṣṇena so'niruddho mahāyaśāḥ |
sthitaḥ prītamanā bhūtvā prāñjalirvākyamabravīt || 11 ||
aniruddha uvāca
devadeva sadā yuddhe jetā tvamasi keśava |
na śaktaḥ pramukhe sthātuṃ sākṣādapi śatakratuḥ || 12 ||
tato mahābalaṃ devaṃ balabhadraṃ yaśasvinam |
abhivādayate hṛṣṭaḥ so'niruddho mahāmanāḥ || 13 ||
mādhavaṃ ca mahātmānamabhivādya kṛtāñjaliḥ |
khagottamaṃ mahāvīryaṃ suparṇamabhivādya ca || 14 ||
tato makaraketuṃ ca citrabāṇadharaṃ prabhum |
pitaraṃ so'bhyupāgamya pradyumnamabhivādayat || 15 ||
sakhīgaṇadhṛtā caiva sā coṣā bhavane sthitā |
balaṃ cātibalaṃ caiva vāsudevaṃ sudurjayam || 16 ||
asaṃkhyātagatiṃ caiva suparṇamabhivādya ca |
puṣpabāṇadharaṃ caiva lajjamānābhyavādayat || 17 ||
tataḥ śakrasya vacanānnāradaḥ paramadyutiḥ |
vāsudevasamīpaṃ sa prahasan punarāgataḥ || 18 ||
varddhāpayati taṃ devaṃ govindaṃ śatrusūdanam |
diṣṭyā varddhasi govinda aniruddhasamāgamāt || 19 ||
tato'niruddhasahitā nāradaṃ praṇatāḥ sthitāḥ |
āśīrbhirvarddhayitvā ca devarṣiḥ kṛṣṇamabravīt || 2.127.20 ||
aniruddhasya vīryākhyo vivāhaḥ kriyatāṃ vibho |
jambūlamālikāṃ draṣṭuṃ śraddhā hi mama jāyate || 21 ||
tataḥ prahasitāḥ sarve nāradasya vacaḥśravāt |
kṛṣṇaḥ provāca bhagavankriyatāmāśu mā ciram || 22 ||
etasminnantare tāta kumbhāṇḍaḥ samupasthitaḥ |
vaivāhikāṃstu sambhārāngṛhya kṛṣṇaṃ namasya tu || 23 ||
kumbhāṇḍa uvāca
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho bhava tvamabhayapradaḥ |
śaraṇāgato'smi deveśa prasīdaiṣo'ñjalistava || 24 ||
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā sarvaṃ prāgeva cācyutaḥ |
abhayaṃ yacchate tasmai kumbhāṇḍāya mahātmane || 25 ||
kumbhāṇḍa mantriṇāṃ śreṣṭha prīto'smi tava suvrata |
sukṛtaṃ te vijānāmi rāṣṭriko'stu bhavāniha || 26 ||
sajñātipakṣaḥ susukhī nirvṛto'stu bhavāniha |
rājyaṃ ca te mayā dattaṃ ciraṃ jīva mamāśrayāt || 27 ||
evaṃ dattvā rājyamasmai kumbhāṇḍāya mahātmane |
vivāhamakarot tasyāniruddhasya janārdanaḥ |
tatastu bhagavān vahnistatra svayamupasthitaḥ || 28 ||
sa vivāho'niruddhasya nakṣatre ca śubhe'bhavat |
tato'psarogaṇaścaiva kautukaṃ kartumudyataḥ || 29 ||
snātastvalaṃkṛtastatra so'niruddhaḥ svabhāryayā |
tataḥ snigdhaiḥ śubhairvākyairgandharvāśca jagustadā || 2.127.30 ||
nṛtyantyapsarasaścaiva vivāhamupaśobhayan |
tato nirvartayitvā tu vivāhaṃ śatrusūdanaḥ || 31 ||
aniruddhasya suprajñaḥ sarvairdevagaṇairvṛtaḥ |
āmantrya varadaṃ tatra rudraṃ devanamaskṛtam || 32 ||
cakāra gamane buddhiṃ kṛṣṇaḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ |
dvārakābhimukhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ jñātvā śatruniṣūdanam || 33 ||
kumbhāṇḍo vacanaṃ prāha prāñjalirmadhusūdanam |
bāṇasya gāvastiṣṭhanti haste tu varuṇasya vai || 34 ||
yāsāmamṛtakalpaṃ vai kṣīraṃ kṣarati mādhava |
tat pītvātibalaścaiva naro bhavati durjayaḥ || 35 ||
kumbhāṇḍenaivamākhyāte hariḥ prītamanāstadā |
gamanāya matiṃ cakre gantavyamiti niścayam || 36 ||
tatastu bhagavānbrahmā vardhāpya sa tu keśavam |
jagāma brahmalokaṃ sa vṛtaḥ svabhavanālayaiḥ || 37 ||
indro marudgaṇayuto dvārakābhimukho yayau |
tataḥ kṛṣṇastataḥ sarve gacchanti jayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ || 38 ||
vāhanena mayūreṇa sakhībhiḥ parivāritā |
dvārakābhimukhī hyūṣā devyā prasthāpitā yayau || 39
tato balaśca kṛṣṇaśca pradyumnaśca mahābalaḥ |
ārūḍhavanto garuḍamaniruddhaśca vīryavān || 2.127.40 ||
prasthitaśca sa tejasvī garuḍaḥ patatāṃ varaḥ |
unmūlayaṃstarugaṇān kampayaṃścāpi medinīm || 41 ||
ākulāśca diśaḥ sarvā reṇudhvastamivāmbaram |
garuḍe samprayāte'bhūnmandaraśmirdivākaraḥ || 42 ||
tataste dīrghamadhvānaṃ prayayuḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ |
āruhya garuḍaṃ sarve jitvā bāṇaṃ mahaujasam || 43 ||
tato'mbaratalasthāste vāruṇīṃ diśamāsthitāḥ |
apaśyanta mahātmāno gāvo divyapayaḥpradāḥ |
velāvanavicāriṇyo nānāvarṇāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 44 ||
avajñāya tadā rūpaṃ kumbhāṇḍavacanāśrayāt |
kṛṣṇaḥ praharatāṃ śreṣṭhastattvato'rthaviśāradaḥ || 45 ||
niśamya bāṇagāvastu tāsu cakre manastadā |
āsthito garuḍaṃ prāha sa tu lokādiravyayaḥ || 46 ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
vainateya prayāhi tvaṃ yatra bāṇasya godhanam |
yāsāṃ pītvā kila kṣīramamṛtatvamavāpnuyāt || 47 ||
āha māṃ satyabhāmā ca bāṇagāvo mamānaya |
yāsāṃ pītvā kila kṣīraṃ na jīryanti mahāsurāḥ || 48 ||
vijarāśca jarāṃ tyaktvā bhavanti kila jantavaḥ |
tā ānayasva bhadraṃ te yadi dharmo na lupyate || 49 ||
athavā kāryalopo vai maiva tāsu manaḥ kṛthāḥ |
iti māmabravīt satyā tāścaitā viditā mama || 2.127.50 ||
garuḍa uvāca
dṛśyante gāva etāstā dṛṣṭvā māṃ varuṇālayam |
viśanti sahasā sarvāḥ kāryamatra vidhīyatām || 51 ||
ityuktvā caiva garuḍaḥ pakṣavātena sāgaram |
sahasā kṣobhayitvā ca viveśa varuṇālayam || 52 ||
dṛṣṭvā javena garuḍaṃ prāptaṃ vai varuṇālayam |
vāruṇāśca gaṇāḥ sarve vibhrāntāḥ prācalaṃstadā|| 53 ||
tatastu vāruṇaṃ sainyamabhiyātaṃ sudurjayam |
pramukhe vāsudevasya nānāpraharaṇodyatam |
tad yuddhamabhavad ghoraṃ vāruṇaiḥ pannagāriṇā || 54 ||
teṣāmāpatatāṃ saṃkhye vāruṇānāṃ sahasraśaḥ |
bhagnaṃ balamanādhṛṣyaṃ keśavena mahātmanā || 55 ||
tataste pradrutā yānti tameva varuṇālayam|
ṣaṣṭiṃ rathasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭiṃ rathaśatāni ca || 56 ||
vāruṇāni ca yuddhāni dīptaśastrāṇi saṃyuge |
tad balaṃ balibhiḥ śūrairbaladevajanārdanaiḥ || 57 ||
pradyumnenāniruddhena garuḍena ca sarvaśaḥ |
śaraughairvividhaistīkṣṇairvadhyamānaṃ samantataḥ || 58 ||
tato bhagnaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇenākliṣṭakarmaṇā |
varuṇastvatha saṃkuddho niryayau yatra keśavaḥ || 59 ||
ṛṣibhirdevagandharvaistathaivāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ |
saṃstūyamāno bahudhā varuṇaḥ pratyadṛśyata || 2.127.60 ||
chatreṇa dhriyamāṇena pāṇḍureṇa vapuṣmatā |
salilasrāviṇā śreṣṭhaṃ cāpamudyamya dhiṣṭhitaḥ || 61 ||
apāṃ patiratikruddhaḥ putrapautrabalānvitaḥ |
āhvayanniva yuddhāya visphāritamahādhanuḥ || 62 ||
sa tu prādhmāpayacchaṅkhaṃ varuṇaḥ samadhāvata |
hariṃ hara iva kruddho bāṇajālaiḥ samāvṛṇot || 63 ||
tataḥ pradhmāya jalajaṃ pāñcajanyaṃ janārdanaḥ |
bāṇajālairdiśaḥ sarvāstataścakre mahābalaḥ || 64 ||
tataḥ śaraughairvimalairvaruṇaḥ pīḍito raṇe |
smayanniva tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ varuṇaḥ pratyayudhyata || 65 ||
tato'straṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ghoramabhimantryāhave sthitaḥ |
vāsudevo'bravīd vākyaṃ pramukhe tasya dhīmataḥ || 66 ||
idamastraṃ mahāghoraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ śatrusūdanam |
mayodyataṃ vadhārthaṃ te tiṣṭhedānīṃ sthiro bhava || 67 ||
tato'straṃ varuṇo devo hyastraṃ vaiṣṇavamudyataḥ |
vāruṇāstreṇa saṃyojya vinanāda mahābalaḥ || 68 ||
tasyāstre vitatā hyāpo varuṇasya viniḥsṛtāḥ |
vaiṣṇavāstrasya śamane vartate samitiṃjayaḥ || 69||
āpastu vāruṇāstatra kṣiptāḥ kṣiptā jvalanti vai|
dahyante vāruṇāstatra tato'stre jvalite punaḥ || 2.127.70 |
vaiṣṇave tu mahāvīrye diśo bhītā vidudruvuḥ |
tad balaṃ jvalitaṃ dṛṣṭvā varuṇaḥ kṛṣṇamabravīt || 71 ||
smara svaprakṛtiṃ pūrvāmavyaktāṃ vyaktalakṣaṇām |
tamo jahi mahābhāga tamasā muhyase katham || 72 ||
sattvastho nityamāsīstvaṃ yogīśvara mahāmate |
pañcabhūtāśrayān doṣānahaṃkāraṃ ca varjaya || 73 ||
yā yā te vaiṣṇavī mūrtistasyā jyeṣṭho hyahaṃ tava |
jyeṣṭhabhāvena mānyaṃ tu kiṃ māṃ tvaṃ dagdhumicchasi || 74 ||
nāgnirvikramate hyagnau tyaja kopaṃ yudhāṃ vara |
tvayi na prabhaviṣyāmi jagataḥ prabhavo hyasi || 75 ||
pūrvaṃ hi yā tvayā sṛṣṭā prakṛtirvikṛtātmikā |
dharmiṇī bījabhāvena pūrva dharmaṃ samāśritā || 76 ||
āgneyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ saumyaṃ prakṛtyaivedamāditaḥ |
tvayā sṛṣṭaṃ jagadidaṃ sa kathaṃ mayi vartase || 77
ajeyaḥ śāśvato devaḥ svayambhūrbhūtabhāvanaḥ |
akṣaraṃ ca kṣaraṃ caiva bhāvābhāvau mahādyute || 78 ||
rakṣa māṃ rakṣaṇīyo'haṃ tvayānagha namo'stu te |
ādikartāsi lokānāṃ tvayaitad bahulīkṛtam|| 79 ||
vikrīḍasi mahādeva bālaḥ krīḍanakairiva |
na hyahaṃ prakṛtidveṣī nāhaṃ prakṛtidūṣakaḥ || 2.127.80 ||
prakṛtiryā vikāreṣu vartate puruṣarṣabha |
tasyā vikāraśamane vartase tvaṃ mahādyute || 81 ||
vikāro vā vikārāṇāṃ vikārāya na te'nagha |
tānadharmavido mandān bhavān vikurute sadā || 82 ||
idaṃ prakṛtijairdoṣaistamasā muhyate yadā |
rajasā vāpi saṃspṛṣṭaṃ tadā mohaḥ pravartate || 83 ||
parāvarajñaḥ sarvatra aiśvaryavidhimāsthitaḥ |
kiṃ mohayasi naḥ sarvānprajāpatiriva svayam || 84 ||
varuṇenaivamuktastu kṛṣṇo lokaparāyaṇaḥ |
bhāvajñaḥ sarvakṛd dhīrastataḥ prītamanā hyabhūt || 85 ||
ityevamuktaḥ kṛṣṇastu prahasan vākyamabravīt |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
gāvaḥ prayaccha me vīra śāntyarthaṃ bhīmavikrama || 86 ||
ityevamukte kṛṣṇena vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ |
varuṇo hyabravīd bhūyaḥ śṛṇu me madhusūdana || 87 ||
varuṇa uvāca
bāṇena sārdhaṃ samayo mayā deva kṛtaḥ purā |
kathaṃ ca samayaṃ kṛtvā kuryāṃ viphalamanyathā || 88 ||
tvameva veda sarvasya yathā samayabhedakaḥ |
cāritraṃ duṣyate tena na ca sadbhiḥ praśasyate || 89 ||
dharmabhāgbhirnaro nityaṃ varjyate madhusūdana |
na ca lokānavāpnoti pāpaḥ samayabhedakaḥ || 2.127.90 ||
prasīda dharmalopaśca mā bhūnme madhusūdana |
na māṃ samayabhedena yoktumarhasi mādhava || 91 ||
jīvannāhaṃ pradāsyāmi gāvo vai vṛṣabhekṣaṇa |
hatvā nayasva māṃ gāva eṣa me samayaḥ purā || 92 ||
etacca me samākhyātaṃ samayaṃ madhusūdana |
satyameva mahābāho na mithyā tu sureśvara || 93 ||
yadyevāhamanugrāhyo rakṣa māṃ madhusūdana |
athavā goṣu nirbandho hatvā naya mahābhuja || 94 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
varuṇenaivamuktastu yadūnāṃ vaṃśavardhanaḥ |
abhedyaṃ samayaṃ matvā nyastavādo gavāṃ prati || 95 ||
sa prahasya tato vākyaṃ vyājahārārthakovidaḥ |
tasmānmukto'si yadyevaṃ bāṇena samayaḥ kṛtaḥ || 96 ||
praśritairmadhurairvākyaistattvārthamadhubhāṣitaiḥ |
kathaṃ pāpaṃ kariṣyāmi varuṇa tvayyahaṃ prabho || 97 ||
gaccha mukto'si varuṇa satyasaṃdho'si no bhavān|
tvatpriyārthaṃ mayā muktā bāṇagāvo na saṃśayaḥ || 98 |
tatastūryaninādaiśca bherīṇāṃ ca mahāsvanaiḥ |
arghyamādāya varuṇaḥ keśavaṃ pratyapūjayat |
keśavo'rghyaṃ tadā gṛhya varuṇād yadunandanaḥ || 99 ||
balaṃ cāpūjayad devaḥ kuśalīva samāhitaḥ |
varuṇāyābhayaṃ dattvā vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān ||2.127.100 ||
dvārakāṃ prasthitaḥ śauriḥ śacīpatisahāyavān |
tatra devāḥ samarutaḥ sasādhyāḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ || 101||
gandharvāpsarasaścaiva kiṃnarāścāntarikṣagāḥ |
anugacchanti bhūteśaṃ sarvabhūtādimavyayam || 102||
ādityā vasavo rudrā aśvinau yakṣarākṣasāḥ |
vidyādharagaṇāścaiva ye cānye siddhacāraṇāḥ |
gacchantamanugacchanti yaśasā vijayena ca || 103||
nāradaśca mahābhāgaḥ prasthito dvārakāṃ prati |
tuṣṭo bāṇajayaṃ dṛṣṭvā varuṇaṃ ca kṛtapriyam || 104||
kailāsaśikharaprakhyaiḥ prāsādaiḥ kandaraiḥ śubhaiḥ |
dūrānniśamya madhuhā dvārakāṃ dvāramālinīm || 105||
pāñcajanyasya nirghoṣaṃ cakre cakragadādharaḥ |
saṃjñāṃ prayacchate devo dvārakāpuravāsinām || 106||
devānuyānanirghoṣaṃ pāñcajanyasya nisvanam |
śrutvā dvāravatī sarvā praharṣamatulaṃ gatā || 107||
pūrṇakumbhaiśca lājaiśca bahuvinyastavistaraiḥ |
dvāropaśobhitāṃ kṛtvā sarvāṃ dvāravatīṃ purīm || 108||
suśliṣṭarathyāṃ saśrīkāṃ bahuratnopaśobhitām|
viprāścārghyaṃ samādāya tathaiva kulanaigamāḥ || 109||
jayaśabdaiśca vividhaiḥ pūjayanti sma mādhavam |
vainateye tamāsīnaṃ nīlāñjanacayopamam ||2.127.110||
vavandire tadā kṛṣṇaṃ śriyā paramayā yutam |
tamānupūrvyā varṇāśca pūjayanti mahābalam || 111||
anantaṃ keśihantāraṃ śreṣṭhipūrvāśca śreṇayaḥ |
ṛṣibhirdevagandharvaiścāraṇaiśca samantataḥ || 112|
stūyate puṇḍarīkākṣo dvārakopavane sthitaḥ |
tadāścaryamapaśyanta dāśārhagaṇasattamāḥ || 113||
praharṣamatulaṃ prāptā dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ mahābhujam |
bāṇaṃ jitvā mahādevamāyāntaṃ puruṣottamam || 114||
dvārakāvāsināṃ vācaścaranti bahudhā tadā |
prāpte kṛṣṇe mahābhāge yādavānāṃ mahārathe || 115||
gatvā ca dūramadhvānaṃ suparṇo drutamāgataḥ |
dhanyāḥ smo'nugṛhītāḥsmo yeṣāṃ vai jagataḥ pitā || 116||
rakṣitā caiva goptā ca dīrghabāhurmahābhujaḥ |
vainateyaṃ samāruhya jitvā bāṇaṃ sudurjayam || 117||
prāpto'yaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣo manāṃsyāhlādayanniva |
evaṃ kathayatāmeva dvārakāvāsināṃ tadā || 118||
vāsudevagṛhaṃ devā viviśuste mahārathāḥ |
avatīrya suparṇāttu vāsudevo balastadā || 119||
pradyumnaścāniruddhaśca gṛhān praviviśustadā |
tato devavimānāni saṃcaranti tadā divam || 2.127.120||
avasthitāni dṛśyante nānārūpāṇi sarvaśaḥ |
haṃsarṣabhamṛgairnāgairvājisārasabarhiṇaiḥ || 121||
bhāsvanti tāni dṛśyante vimānāni sahasraśaḥ |
atha kṛṣṇo'bravīdvākyaṃ kumārāṃstānsahasraśaḥ|
pradyumnādīnsamastāṃstu ślakṣṇaṃ madhurayā girā|| 122||
ete rudrāstathā''dityā vasavo'thāśvināvapi |
sādhyā devāstathānye ca vandadhvaṃ ca yathākramam || 123||
sahasrākṣaṃ mahābhāgaṃ dānavānāṃ bhayaṃkaram |
vandadhvaṃ sahitāḥ śakraṃ sagaṇaṃ nāgavāhanam || 124||
saptarṣayo mahābhāgā bhṛgvāṅgirasamāśritāḥ |
ṛṣayaśca mahātmāno vandadhvaṃ ca yathākramam ||125||
ete cakradharāścaiva tān vandadhvaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ |
sāgarāśca hradāścaiva matpriyārthamihāgatāḥ |||126||
diśaśca vidiśaścaiva vandadhvaṃ ca yathākramam |
vāsukipramukhāścaiva nāgā vai sumahābalāḥ || 127||
gāvaśca matpriyārthaṃ vai vandadhvaṃ ca yathākramam |
jyotīṃṣi saha nakṣatrairyakṣarākṣasakiṃnaraiḥ || 128||
āgatā matpriyārthaṃ vai vandadhvaṃ ca yathākramam |
vāsudevavacaḥ śrutvā kumārāḥ praṇatāḥ sthitāḥ || 129||
yathākrameṇa sarveṣāṃ devatānāṃ mahātmanām |
sarvān divaukaso dṛṣṭvā paurā vismayamāgatāḥ || 2.127.130||
pūjārthamatha samarān pragṛhya drutamāgatāḥ |
aho sumahadāścaryaṃ vāsudevasya saṃśrayāt || 13 1|
prāpyate yadihāsmābhiriti vācaścarantyuta |
tataścandanacūrṇaiśca gandhapuṣpaiśca sarvaśaḥ ||132 ||
kiranti paurāḥ sarvāstān pūjayanto divaukasaḥ |
lājaiḥ praṇāmairdhūpaiśca vādyadhvaniyamaistathā || 133||
dvārakāvāsinaḥ sarve pūjayanti divaukasaḥ |
āhukaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca sāmbaṃ ca yadunandanam || 134||
sātyakiṃ colmukaṃ caiva vipṛthuṃ ca mahābalam |
akrūraṃ ca mahābhāga tathā niśaṭhameva ca || 135||
etān pariṣvajya tadā mūrdhni cāghrāya vāsavaḥ |
atha śakro mahābhāgaḥ samakṣa yadumaṇḍale || 136||
stuvantaṃ keśihantāraṃ tatrovācottaraṃ vacaḥ |
sātvataḥ sāttvatāmeṣa sarveṣāṃ yadunandanam || 137||
mokṣayitvā raṇe caiva yaśasā pauruṣeṇa ca |
mahādevasya miṣato guhasya ca mahātmanaḥ || 138||
eva bāṇaṃ raṇe jitvā dvārakāṃ punarāgataḥ |
sahasrabāhorbāhūnāṃ kṛtvā dvayamanuttamam || 139||
sthāpayitvā dvibāhutve prāpto'yaṃ svapuraṃ hariḥ |
yadarthaṃ janma kṛṣṇasya mānuṣeṣu mahātmanaḥ || 2.127.140||
tadapyavasitaṃ kāryaṃ naṣṭaśokā vayaṃ kṛtāḥ |
pibatāṃ madhu mādhvīkaṃ bhavatāṃ prītipūrvakam || 141||
kālo yāsyatyavirataṃ viṣayeṣveva sajjatām |
bāhūnāṃ saṃkṣayāt sarve vayamasya mahātmanaḥ || 142||
praṇaṣṭaśokā raṃsyāmaḥ sarvaṃ eva yathāsukham |
evaṃ stutvā sahasrākṣaḥ keśavaṃ dānavāntakam || 143|
āpṛcchya taṃ mahābhāgaḥ sarvadevagaṇairvṛtaḥ |
tataḥ punaḥ pariṣvajya kṛṣṇaṃ lokanamaskṛtam |
puraṃdaro divaṃ yātaḥ saha devamarudgaṇaiḥ || 144||
ṛṣayaśca mahātmāno jayāśīrbhirmahaujasam |
yathāgataṃ punaryātā yakṣarākṣasakiṃnarāḥ || 145||
puraṃdare divaṃ yāte padmanābho mahābalaḥ |
apṛcchata mahābhāgaḥ sarvān kuśalamavyayam || 146||
tataḥ kilakilāśabdaṃ nirvamantaḥ sahasraśaḥ |
gacchanti kaumudīṃ draṣṭuṃ so'naghaḥ prīyate sadā || 147||
dvārakāṃ prāpya kṛṣṇastu reme yadugaṇaiḥ saha |
vividhān sarvakāmārthāñchriyā paramayā yutaḥ || 148||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi dvārakāpratyāgamane
saptaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 127 ||

<2.128>

aṣṭāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
athāhuko mahābāhuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ prāha mahādyutiḥ |
harṣādutphullanayanaḥ śrūyatāṃ yadunandana || 1 ||
evaṃ gate'niruddhasya kriyatāṃ mahadutsavaḥ |
kṣemāt pratyāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā sevyamānā mahāmate || 2 ||
uṣāpi ca mahābhāgā sakhībhiḥ parivāritā |
ramate parayā prītyā cāniruddhena saṃgatā || 3 ||
kumbhāṇḍaduhitā rāmā uṣāyāḥ sakhimaṇḍale |
praveśyatāṃ mahābhāgā vaidarbhī varddhayet punaḥ || 4 ||
sāmbāya dīyatāṃ rāmā kumbhāṇḍaduhitā śubhā |
śeṣāśca kanyā nyasyantāṃ kumārāṇāṃ yathākramam || 5 ||
vartate sotsavastatra aniruddhasya veśmani |
gṛhe śrīdhanvanaścaiva śubhastatra pravartate || 6 ||
vādayanti pure tatra nāryo madavaśaṃ gatāḥ |
nṛtyante cāpsarāstatra gāyanti ca tathāparāḥ|| 7 ||
kāścit pramuditāstatra kāścidanyonyamabruvan |
nānāvarṇāmvaradharāḥ krīḍamānāstatastataḥ || 8 ||
abhiyānti tato'nyonyaṃ kāścinmadavaśāt svayam|
krīḍanti kāścidakṣaistu harṣādutphullalocanāḥ || 9 ||
māyūraṃ rathamāruhya sakhībhiḥ parivāritā |
uṣā sampreṣitā devyā rudrāṇyā pratigṛhyatām || 10 ||
iyaṃ caiva kulaślāghyā nāmnoṣā sundarī varā |
bāṇaputrī tava vadhūḥ pratigṛhṇīṣva bhāminīm || 11 ||
tataḥ pratigṛhītā sā strībhirācāramaṅgalaiḥ |
praveśitā ca sā veśma aniruddhasya śobhanā || 12 ||
devakī rohiṇī caiva rukmiṇyatha vidarbhajā |
dṛṣṭvāniruddhaṃ rodantyaḥ snehaharṣasamanvitāḥ || 13 ||
revatī rukmiṇī caiva gṛhamukhyaṃ praveśayat |
vadhūrvardhasi diṣṭyā tvamaniruddhasya darśanāt || 14 ||
tatastūryapraṇādaistā varanāryaḥ śubhānanāḥ |
kriyāmārebhire kartumuṣā ca gṛhasaṃsthitā || 15 |
tato harmyatalasthā sā vṛṣṇipuṅgavasaṃsthitā |
ramate sarvasadṛśairupabhogairvarānanā || 16 ||
citralekhā ca suśroṇī apsarārūpadhāriṇī |
āpṛcchya ca sakhīvargamuṣāṃ ca tridivaṃ gatā || 17 ||
gatāsu tāsu sarvāsu sakhīṣvasurasundarī |
māyāvatyā gṛhaṃ nītā prathamaṃ sā nimantritā || 18 ||
sā tu pradyumnagṛhiṇī snuṣā dṛṣṭvā sumadhyamā |
vāsobhirannapānaiśca pūjayāmāsa sundarīm || 19 ||
tataḥ krameṇa sarvāstā vadhūmūṣāṃ yadustriyaḥ |
ācāramanupaśyantyaḥ svadharmamupacakrire || 20 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
etat te sarvamākhyātaṃ mayā kurukulodvaha |
yathā bāṇo jitaḥ saṃkhye jīvanmuktaśca viṣṇunā|| 21 ||
dvārakāyāṃ tataḥ kṛṣṇo reme yadugaṇairvṛtaḥ |
anvaśāsanmahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ parayā saṃyuto mudā || 22 ||
evameṣo'vatīrṇo vai pṛthivīṃ pṛthivīpate |
viṣṇuryadukulaśreṣṭho vāsudeveti viśrutaḥ || 23 ||
etaiśca kāraṇaiḥ śrīmān vasudevakule prabhuḥ |
jāto vṛṣṇiṣu devakyāṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi || 24 ||
nivṛtte nāradapraśne yanmayoktaṃ samāsataḥ |
śrutāste vistarāḥ sarve ye pūrvaṃ janamejaya || 25 ||
viṣṇostu māthure kalpe yatra te saṃśayo mahān |
vāsudevagatiścaiva sā mayā samudāhṛtā || 26 ||
āścaryaṃ caiva nānyad vai kṛṣṇaścāścaryasaṃnidhiḥ |
sarveṣvāścaryakalpeṣu nāstyāścaryamavaiṣṇavam || 27 ||
eṣa dhanyo hi dhanyānāṃ dhanyakṛd dhanyabhāvanaḥ |
deveṣu tu sadaityeṣu nāsti dhanyataro'cyutāt || 28 ||
ādityā vasavo rudrā aśvinau marutastathā |
gaganaṃ bhūrdiśaścaiva salilaṃ jyotireva ca || 29 ||
eṣa dhātā vidhātā ca saṃhartā caiva nityaśaḥ |
satyaṃ dharmastapaścaiva brahmā caiva pitāmahaḥ || 30 ||
anantaścaiva nāgānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ śaṃkaraḥ smṛtaḥ |
jaṅgamājaṅgamaṃ caiva jagannārāyaṇodbhavam || 31 ||
etasmācca jagat sarvaṃ prasūyeta janārdanāt |
jagacca sarvaṃ deveśe taṃ namaskuru bhārata || 32 ||
pūjyaśca satataṃ sarvairdevaireṣa sanātanaḥ |
ityuktaṃ bāṇayuddhaṃ te māhātmyaṃ keśavasya tu || 33 ||
vaṃśapratiṣṭhāmatulāṃ śravaṇādeva lapsyase |
ye cedaṃ dhārayiṣyanti bāṇayuddhamanuttamam || 34 ||
keśavasya ca māhātmyaṃ nādharmastānbhajiṣyati |
eṣā tu vaiṣṇavī caryā mayā kārtsnyena kīrtitā || 35 ||
pṛcchatastāta yajñe'smin nivṛtte janamejaya |
āścaryaparva nikhilaṃ yo hīdaṃ dhārayennṛpa || 36 ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati |
kalya utthāya yo nityaṃ kīrtayet susamāhitaḥ || 37 ||
na tasya durlabhaṃ kiṃcidiha loke paratra ca |
brāhmaṇaḥ sarvavedī syāt kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet|| 38 ||
vaiśyo dhanasamṛddhaḥ syācchūdraḥ kāmānavāpnuyāt |
nāśubhaṃ prāpnuyātkiṃcid dīrghamāyurlabheta saḥ || 39 ||
sautiruvāca
iti pārīkṣito rājā vaiśampāyanabhāṣitam |
śrutavānacalo bhūtvā harivaṃśaṃ dvijottamāḥ || 40 ||
evaṃ śaunaka saṃkṣepād vistareṇa tathaiva ca |
proktā vai sarvavaṃśāste kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 41 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe viṣṇuparvaṇi uṣāharaṇasamāptau aṣṭāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 128 ||

<3>

śrīmahābhāratam
tasya khilabhāgo harivaṃśaḥ
(tatra bhaviṣyaparva)

<3.1>

prathamo'dhyāyaḥ
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam |
devīṃ sarasvatīṃ caiva tato jayamudīrayet ||
śaunaka uvāca
janamejayasya ke putrāḥ paṭhyante laumaharṣaṇe |
kasmin pratiṣṭhito vaṃśaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ mahātmanām|| 1 ||
etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me |
tvattaḥ kathayataḥ sarvaṃ vedmyahaṃ tat parisphuṭam || 2 ||
sautiruvāca
pārīkṣitasya kāśyāyāṃ dvau putrau sambabhūvatuḥ |
candrāpīḍaśca nṛpatiḥ sūryāpīḍaśca mokṣavat || 3 ||
candrāpīḍasya putrāṇāṃ śatamuttamadhanvinām |
janamejaya ityevaṃ kṣātraṃ bhuvi pariśrutam || 4 ||
teṣāṃ śreṣṭhastu rājāsīt pure vāraṇasāhvaye |
satyakarṇo mahābāhuryajvā vipuladakṣiṇaḥ || 5 ||
satyakarṇasya dāyādaḥ śvetakarṇaḥ pratāpavān |
aputraḥ sa tu dharmātmā praviveśa tapovanam || 6 ||
tasmād vanagatād garbhaṃ yādavī pratyapadyata |
sucārorduhitā subhrūrmāninī bhrātṛmālinī 7 ||
sa tu janmani garbhasya śvetakarṇaḥ prajeśvaraḥ |
anvagacchad gataṃ pūrvairmahāprasthānamacyutam || 8 ||
sā dṛṣṭvā samprayātaṃ taṃ māninī pṛṣṭhato'nvayāt |
pathi sā suṣuve subhrūrvane rājīvalocanam || 9 ||
kumāraṃ taṃ parityajya bhartāraṃ cānvagacchata |
pativratā mahābhāgā draupadīva purā patīn || 3.1.10 ||
sa tu rājakumāro'sau girikuñje ruroda ha |
chāyārthe tasya meghāstu prādurāsan samantataḥ || 11 ||
śraviṣṭhāyāśca putrau dvau pippalādaśca kauśikaḥ |
dṛṣṭvā kṛpānvitau gṛhya taṃ prākṣālayatāṃ jalaiḥ |
nighṛṣṭau tasya tau pārśvau śilāyāṃ rudhiraplutau || 12 ||
ajaśyāmau tu pārśvau tāvubhāvapi samāhitau |
tathaiva tu samārūḍhau ajapārśvastato'bhavat || 13 ||
tato'japārśva iti tau cakrāte tasya nāma ha |
sa tu vemakaśālāyāṃ dvijābhyāmabhivardhitaḥ || 14 ||
vemakasya tu bhāryā tamudvahat putrakāraṇāt |
vemakyāḥ sa tu putro'bhūd brāhmaṇau sacivau ca tau||15||
teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca yugapattulyajīvinaḥ |
sa eṣa pauravo vaṃśaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 16 ||
śloko'pi cātra gīto'yaṃ nāhuṣeṇa yayātinā |
