jarāsaṃkramaṇe pūrvaṃ bhṛśaṃ prītena dhīmatā || 17 ||
acandrārkagrahā bhūmirbhavedapi na saṃśayaḥ |
apauravā na tu mahī bhaviṣyati kadācana || 18 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pāṇḍavavaṃśapratiṣṭhākīrtane prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||

<3.2>

dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ
śaunaka uvāca
ukto'yaṃ harivaṃśaste parvāṇi nikhilāni ca |
yathā puroktāni tathā vyāsaśiṣyeṇa dhīmatā || 1 ||
tatkathyamānamamitamitihāsasamanvitam |
prīṇātyasmānamṛtavat sarvapāpavināśanam || 2 ||
sukhaśrāvyatayā dhīra mano hlādayatīva naḥ |
janamejayastu nṛpatiḥ śrutvā cākhyānamuttamam |
saute kimakarot paścāt sarpasatrādanantaram || 3 ||
sautiruvāca
janamejayastu sa nṛpaḥ śrutvā cākhyānamuttamam|
yadārabhat tadākhyāsye sarpasatrādanantaram || 4 ||
tasminsatre samāpte'tha rājā pārīkṣitastadā |
yaṣṭuṃ sa vājimedhena sambhārānupacakrame || 5 ||
ṛtvikpurohitācāryānāhūyedamuvāca ha |
yakṣye'haṃ vājimedhena haya utsṛjyatāmiti || 6 ||
tato'sya vijñāya cikīrṣitaṃ tadā kṛṣṇo mahātmā sahasā''jagāma |
pārīkṣitaṃ draṣṭumadīnasattvaṃ dvaipāyanaḥ sarvaparāvarajñaḥ || 7 ||
pārīkṣitastu nṛpatirdṛṣṭvā tamṛṣimāgatam |
arghyapādyāsanaṃ dattvā pūjayāmāsa śāstrataḥ || 8 ||
tau copaviṣṭāvabhitaḥ sadasyāstasya śaunaka |
kathā bahuvidhāścitrāścakrāte vedasaṃhitāḥ || 9 ||
tataḥ kathānte nṛpatirnodayāmāsa taṃ munim |
pitāmahaṃ pāṇḍavānāmātmanaḥ prapitāmaham || 3.2.10 ||
mahābhāratamākhyānaṃ bahvarthaṃ śrutivistaram |
nimeṣamātramapi me sukhaśrāvyatayā gatam || 11 ||
vibhūtivistārakaraṃ sarveṣāṃ vai yaśaskaram |
tvayā suvihitaṃ brahmañśaṅkhe kṣīramivāhitam || 12 ||
amṛtena tu tṛptiḥ syād yathā svargasukhena ca |
tathā tṛptiṃ na gacchāmi śrutvemāṃ bhāratīṃ kathām || 13 ||
anumānya tu sarvajñaṃ pṛcchāmi bhagavannaham |
hetuḥ kurūṇāṃ nāśasya rājasūyo mato mama || 14 ||
duḥsahānāṃ yathā dhvaṃso rājanyānāmupaplave |
rājasūyaṃ tathā manye yuddhārthamupakalpitam || 15 ||
rājasūyasya nu somena śrūyate pūrvamāhṛtaḥ |
tasyānte sumahad yuddhamabhavat tārakāmayam || 16 ||
āhṛto varuṇenātha tasyānte sumahākratoḥ |
devāsuraṃ mahāyuddhaṃ sarvabhūtakṣayāvaham || 17 ||
hariścandraśca rājarṣiḥ kratumenamupāharat|
tatrāpyāḍībakaṃ nāma yuddhaṃ kṣatriyanāśanam||18||
tato'nantaramāryeṇa pāṇḍavenātidustaraḥ |
mahābhārata ārambhaḥ sambhūto'gniriva kratuḥ || 19 ||
tadasya mūlaṃ yuddhasya lokakṣayakarasya tu |
rājasūyo mahāyajñaḥ kimarthaṃ na nivāritaḥ || 3.2.20 ||
rājasūyo hyasaṃhāryo yajñāṅgaiśca duratyayaiḥ |
mithyā praṇīte yajñāṅge prajānāṃ saṃkṣayo dhruvaḥ || 21 ||
bhavānapi ca sarveṣāṃ pūrveṣāṃ naḥ pitāmahaḥ |
atītānāgatajñaśca nāthaścādikaraśca naḥ || 22 ||
te kathaṃ bhavatā netrā buddhimantaścyutā nayāt |
anāthā hyaparādhyante kunetāraśca mānavāḥ || 23 ||
vyāsa uvāca
kālena viparītāste tava pūrvapitāmahāḥ |
na māṃ bhaviṣyaṃ pṛcchanti na cāpṛṣṭo bravīmyaham || 24 ||
sāmarthyaṃ ca na paśyāmi bhaviṣyasya nivartane |
parihartuṃ na śakyā hi kālena vihitā gatiḥ || 25 ||
tvayā tvidamahaṃ pṛṣṭo vakṣyāmyāgantu bhāvi yat|
ataśca balavān kālaḥ śrutvāpi na kariṣyasi|| 26 ||
na saṃrambhānna cārambhānna vai sthāsyasi pauruṣe |
lekhā hi kālalikhitāḥ sarvathā duratikramāḥ || 27 ||
aśvamedhaḥ kratuḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ pariśrutaḥ |
tena bhāvena te yajñaṃ vāsavo dharṣayiṣyati || 28 ||
yadi tacchakyate rājan parihartuṃ kathaṃcana |
daivaṃ puruṣakāreṇa mā yajethāśca taṃ kratum || 29 ||
na cāparādhaḥ śakrasya nopādhyāyagaṇasya te |
tava vā yajamānasya kālo'tra duratikramaḥ || 3.2.30 ||
tasya saṃsthākṛtamidaṃ kālasya parameṣṭhinaḥ |
yathā dṛṣṭaṃ prajāsarge gamiṣyati yugakṣaye || 31 ||
tathā yajñaphalānāṃ ca vikretāro dvijātayaḥ |
tatpraṇeyaṃ nibodhasva trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 32 ||
janamejaya uvāca
nivṛttāvaśvamedhasya kiṃ nimittaṃ bhaviṣyati |
śrutvā parihariṣyāmi bhagavan yadi manyase || 33 ||
vyāsa uvāca
nimittaṃ bhavitā tatra brahmakopakṛtaṃ prabho |
yatethāḥ parihartuṃ tvamityetad bhadramastu te || 34 ||
tvayā vṛttaṃ kratuṃ caiva vājimedhaṃ paraṃtapa |
kṣatriyā nāhariṣyanti yāvad bhūmirdhariṣyati || 35 ||
janamejaya uvāca
nivṛttāvaśvamedhasya brahmaśāpāgnitejasā |
ahaṃ nimittamiti me bhayaṃ tīvraṃ tu jāyate || 36 ||
kathaṃ hyakīrtyā yujyeta sukṛtī madvidho janaḥ |
lokānutsahate gantuṃ khaṃ sapāśa iva dvijaḥ || 37 ||
yathā hyanāgatamidaṃ dṛṣṭamatra praṇāśanam |
yadyasti punarāvṛttiryajñasyāśvāsayasva mām || 38 ||
vyāsa uvāca
upāttayajño deveṣu brāhmaṇeṣūpapatsyate |
tejasā vyāhataṃ tejastejasyevāvatiṣṭhate || 39 ||
audbhijjo bhavitā kaścitsenānīḥ kāśyapo dvijaḥ|
aśvamedhaṃ kaliyuge punaḥ pratyāhariṣyati || 3.2.40 ||
tadante tatkulīnaśca rājasūyamapi kratum |
āhariṣyati rājendra śvetagrahamivāntakaḥ || 41 ||
yathābalaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ kartṝṇāṃ dāsyate phalam |
yugāntadvāramṛṣibhiḥ saṃvṛtaṃ vicariṣyati || 42
tadā prabhṛti hāsyanti nṛṇāṃ prāṇāḥ purākṛtīḥ |
na nivartiṣyate loke vṛttāntāvartaneṣviha || 43 ||
tadā sūkṣmo mahodarko dustaro dānamūlavān |
cāturāśramyaśithilo dharmaḥ pravicaliṣyati || 44 ||
tadā hyalpena tapasā siddhiṃ prāpsyanti mānavāḥ |
dhanyā dharmaṃ cariṣyanti yugānte janamejaya || 45 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi janamejayapraśne dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||

<3.3>

tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
āsannaṃ viprakṛṣṭaṃ vā yadi kālaṃ na vidmahe |
tasmād dvāparasaṃviddhaṃ yugāntaṃ spṛhayāmyaham || 1 ||
prāptā vayaṃ tu tat kālamanayā dharmatṛṣṇayā |
ādadyāt paramaṃ dharmaṃ sukhamalpena karmaṇā || 2 ||
śaunaka uvāca
prajāsamudvegakaraṃ yugāntaṃ samupasthitam |
praṇaṣṭadharmaṃ dharmajña nimittairvaktumarhasi || 3 ||
sautiruvāca
pṛṣṭa evaṃ bhaviṣyasya gatiṃ tattvena cintayan |
yugānte sarvabhūtānāṃ bhagavānabravīt tadā || 4 ||
vyāsa uvāca
arakṣitāro hartāro balibhāgasya pārthivāḥ |
yugānte prabhaviṣyanti svarakṣaṇaparāyaṇāḥ || 5 ||
akṣatriyāśca rājāno viprāḥ śūdropajīvinaḥ |
śūdrāśca brāhmaṇācārā bhaviṣyanti yugakṣaye || 6 ||
kāṇḍe spṛṣṭāḥ śrotriyāśca niṣkriyāṇi havīṃṣyatha |
ekapaṅktyāmaśiṣyanti yugānte janamejaya || 7 ||
śilpavanto'nṛtaparā narā madyāmiṣapriyāḥ |
mitrabhāryā bhaviṣyanti yugānte janamejaya || 8 ||
rājavṛttisthitāścaurā rājānaścauraśīlinaḥ |
bhṛtyāścānirdiṣṭabhujo bhaviṣyanti yugakṣaye || 9 ||
dhanāni ślāghanīyāni satāṃ vṛttamapūjitam|
akutsanā ca patite bhaviṣyanti yugakṣaye || 3.3.10 ||
praṇaṣṭacetanā martyā muktakeśā vicūlinaḥ |
ūnaṣoḍaśavarṣāśca prajāsyanti narāḥ sadā || 11 ||
aṭṭaśūlā janapadāḥ śivaśūlāścatuṣpathāḥ |
pramadāḥ keśaśūlāśca bhaviṣyanti yugakṣaye || 12||
sarve brahma vadiṣyanti sarve vājasaneyinaḥ |
śūdrā bhovādinaścaiva bhaviṣyanti yugakṣaye || 13 |
tapoyajñaphalānāṃ ca vikretāro dvijātayaḥ |
ṛtavaśca bhaviṣyanti viparītā yugakṣaye || 14 ||
śukladantā'ñjitākṣāśca muṇḍāḥ kāṣāyavāsasaḥ|
śūdrā dharmaṃ cariṣyanti śākyabuddhopajīvinaḥ || 15 ||
śvāpadapracuratvaṃ ca gavāṃ caiva parikṣayaḥ |
svādūnāṃ vinivṛttiśca vidyādantagate yuge || 16 ||
antyā madhye nivatsyanti madhyāścāntanivāsinaḥ|
tathā nimnaṃ prajāḥ sarvā gamiṣyanti yugakṣaye || 17 ||
tathā dvihāyanā damyāstathā palvalakarṣakāḥ |
citravarṣī ca parjanyo yuge kṣīṇe bhaviṣyati || 18 ||
sarve caurakule jātāścorayānāḥ parasparam |
svalpenākhyā bhaviṣyanti yatkiṃcitprāpya durgatāḥ ||
na te dharmaṃ kariṣyanti mānavā nirgate yuge |
ūṣārkabahulā bhūmiḥ panthānastaskarāvṛtāḥ || 3.3.20 ||
sarve vāṇijyakāścaiva bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge |
pitṛdattāni deyāni vibhajante sutāstadā |
haraṇāya prapatsyante lobhānṛtavirodhitāḥ || 21 ||
saukumārye tathā rūpe ratne copakṣayaṃ gate |
bhaviṣyanti yugānte ca nāryaḥ keśairalaṃkṛtāḥ || 22 ||
nirvihārasya bhūtasya gṛhasthasya bhaviṣyati |
yugānte samanuprāpte nānyā bhāryā samā gatiḥ ||23 ||
kuśīlānāryabhūyiṣṭhaṃ vṛthārūpasamanvitam |
puruṣālpaṃ bahustrīkaṃ tad yugāntasya lakṣaṇam || 24 ||
bahuyācanako loko na dāsyati parasparam |
avicārya grahīṣyanti dānaṃ varṇāntarāt tathā || 25 ||
rājacaurāgnidaṇḍārto janaḥ kṣayamupaiṣyati |
sasyaniṣpattiraphalā taruṇā vṛddhaśīlinaḥ |
īhayāsukhino lokā bhaviṣyanti yugakṣaye || 26 ||
varṣāsu vātāḥ paruṣā nīcāḥ śarkaravarṣiṇaḥ |
saṃdigdhaḥ paralokaśca bhaviṣyati yugakṣaye || 27 ||
ātmanaśca durācārā brahmadūṣaṇatatparāḥ |
ātmānaṃ bahu manyante manyurevābhyayāddvijān|| 28 ||
vaiśyācārāśca rājanyā dhanadhānyopajīvinaḥ |
yugāpakramaṇe sarve bhaviṣyanti dvijātayaḥ || 29 ||
apravṛttāḥ prapatsyante samayāḥ śapathāstathā |
ṛṇaṃ savinayabhraṃśaṃ yuge kṣīṇe bhaviṣyati || 3.3.30 ||
bhaviṣyatyaphalo harṣaḥ krodhaśca saphalo nṛṇām |
ajāścaivoparotsyante payaso'rthe yugakṣaye || 31 ||
aśāstraviduṣāṃ puṃsāmevameva svabhāvataḥ |
apramāṇaṃ vadiṣyanti nītiṃ paṇḍitamāninaḥ || 32 ||
śāstroktasyāpravaktāro bhaviṣyanti yugakṣaye |
sarve sarvaṃ hi jānanti vṛddhānanupasevya vai || 33 ||
na kaścidakavirnāma yugānte samupasthite |
na kṣatrāṇi niyokṣyanti vikarmasthā dvijātayaḥ |
cauraprāyāśca rājāno yugānte paryupasthite || 34 ||
kuṇḍāvṛṣā naikṛtikāḥ surāpā brahmavādinaḥ |
aśvamedhena yakṣyanti yugānte janamejaya || 35 ||
ayājyān yājayiṣyanti tathābhakṣyasya bhakṣiṇaḥ |
brāhmaṇā dhanatṛṣṇārtā yugānte samupasthite || 36 ||
bhośabdamabhidhāsyanti na ca kaścitpaṭhiṣyati |
ekaśaṅkhāstadā nāryo gavedhukapinaddhakāḥ || 37 ||
nakṣatrāṇi viyogīni viparītā diśastathā |
saṃdhyārāgo'tha digdāho bhaviṣyatyavare yuge || 38 ||
pitṝnputrā niyokṣyanti vadhvaḥ śvaśrūśca karmasu |
viyoniṣu cariṣyanti pramadāsu narāstathā || 39 ||
vākcharaistarjayiṣyanti gurūñchiṣyāstathaiva ca |
mukheṣu ca prayokṣyanti pramattāśca narāstadā || 3.3.40 |
akṛtāgrāṇi bhokṣyanti narāścaivāgnihotriṇaḥ |
bhikṣāṃ balimadattvā ca bhokṣyanti puruṣāḥ svayam|| 41 ||
patīnsuptān vañcayitvā gamiṣyanti striyo'nyataḥ |
puruṣāśca prasuptāsu bhāryāsu ca parastriyam || 42 ||
nāvyādhito nāpyarujo janaḥ sarvo'bhyasūyakaḥ |
na kṛtipratikartā ca yuge kṣīṇe bhaviṣyati || 43 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kaliyugavarṇane tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||

<3.4>

caturtho'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
evaṃ vilulite loke manuṣyāḥ kena pālitāḥ |
nivatsyanti kimācārāḥ kimāhāravihāriṇaḥ || 1 ||
kiṃkarmāṇaḥ kimīhantaḥ kiṃpramāṇāḥ kimāyuṣaḥ |
kāṃ ca kāṣṭhāṃ samāsādya prapatsyanti kṛtaṃ yugam || 2 ||
vyāsa uvāca
ata ūrdhvaṃ cyute dharme guṇahīnāḥ prajāstataḥ |
śīlavyasanamāsādya prāpsyante hrāsamāyuṣaḥ || 3 ||
āyurhānyā balaglānirbalaglānyā vivarṇatā |
vaivarṇyādvyādhisampīḍā nirvedo vyādhipīḍanāt|| 4 ||
nirvedādātmasambodhaḥ sambodhād dharmaśīlatā |
evaṃ gatvā parāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ prapatsyanti kṛtaṃ yugam || 5 ||
uddeśato dharmaśīlāḥ kecinmadhyasthatāṃ gatāḥ |
vimarṣaśīlāḥ kecit tu hetuvādakutūhalāḥ || 6 ||
pratyakṣamanumānaṃ ca pramāṇaṃ ceti niścitāḥ |
pramāṇaikaṃ kariṣyanti neti paṇḍitamāninaḥ || 7 ||
apramāṇaṃ kariṣyanti vedoktamapare janāḥ |
tadā mukhabhagāścaiva bhaviṣyanti striyo'parāḥ || 8 ||
nāstikyaparamāścāpi kecid dharmavilopakāḥ |
bhaviṣyanti narā mūḍhā mandāḥ paṇḍitamāninaḥ || 9 ||
tadātvamātre śraddheyāḥ śāstrajñānabahiṣkṛtāḥ |
dāmbhikāste bhaviṣyanti vādaśīlakutūhalāḥ || 3.4.10 ||
tadā vicalite dharme janāḥ śeṣapuraskṛtāḥ |
śubhānyevācariṣyanti dānasatyasamanvitāḥ || 11 ||
sarvabhakṣo hyasaṃgupto nirguṇo nirapatrapaḥ |
bhaviṣyati tadā lokastatkaṣāyasya lakṣaṇam || 12 ||
viprāṇāṃ śāśvatīṃ vṛttiṃ yadā varṇāvarā janāḥ |
pratipatsyanti vṛtyarthaṃ tat kaṣāyasya lakṣaṇam || 13 ||
kaṣāyopaplave loke jñānavidyāpraṇāśane |
siddhiṃ svalpena kālena yāsyanti nirupaskṛtāḥ || 14 ||
mahāyuddhaṃ mahāvātaṃ mahāvarṣaṃ mahābhayam |
bhaviṣyati yuge kṣīṇe tatkaṣāyasya lakṣaṇam || 15 ||
viprarūpāṇi rakṣāṃsi rājānaḥ karṇavedinaḥ |
pṛthivīmupabhokṣyanti yugānte samupasthite || 16 ||
niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkārā anayāścābhimāninaḥ |
viprāḥ kravyādarūpeṇa sarvabhakṣā vṛthāvratāḥ || 17 ||
mūrkhāḥ svārthaparā lubdhāḥ kṣudrāḥ kṣudraparicchadā||
vyavahāropavṛttāśca cyutā dharmācca śāśvatāt || 18 ||
hartāraḥ pararatnānāṃ paradārāpahārakāḥ |
kāmātmāno durātmānaḥ sopadhāḥ priyasāhasāḥ|| 19 ||
teṣu prabhavamāṇeṣu tulyaśīleṣu sarvataḥ |
abhāvino bhaviṣyanti munayo bahurūpiṇaḥ || 3.4.20 ||
utpannā ye kṛtayuge pradhānapuruṣāśrayāḥ |
kathāyogena tānsarvānpūjayiṣyanti mānavāḥ || 21 ||
sasyacaurā bhaviṣyanti tathā cailāpahāriṇaḥ |
bhakṣyabhojyāpahārāśca karaṇḍānāṃ ca hāriṇaḥ || 22 ||
caurāścaurasya hartāro hantā hanturbhaviṣyati |
cauraiścaurakṣaye cāpi kṛte kṣemaṃ bhaviṣyati || 23 ||
niḥsāre kṣubhite loke niṣkriye vyantare sthite |
narāḥ śrayiṣyanti vanaṃ karabhāraprapīḍitāḥ || 24 ||
pitṝnājñāpayiṣyanti putrāḥ karmaṇi sarvaśaḥ |
snuṣā śvaśrūstathā caiva yugānte pratyupasthite || 25 ||
vākcharairardayiṣyanti gurūñchiṣyāḥ samantataḥ |
yajñakarmaṇyuparate rakṣāṃsi śvāpadāni ca |
kīṭamūṣakasarpāśca dharṣayiṣyanti mānavān || 26 ||
kṣemaṃ subhikṣamārogyaṃ sāmagryaṃ vāpi bandhuṣu |
uddeśato naraśreṣṭha bhaviṣyanti yugakṣaye || 27 ||
svayaṃpālāḥ svayaṃcaurā yugasambhārasambhṛtāḥ |
maṇḍalaiḥ pracaliṣyanti deśe deśe pṛthakpṛthak || 28 ||
svadeśebhyaḥ paribhraṣṭā niḥsārāḥ saha bandhubhiḥ |
narāḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti tadā kālaparikṣayāt || 29 ||
tadā skandhe samādhāya kumārānvidrutā bhayāt|
kauśikīṃ pratariṣyanti narāḥ kṣudbhayapīḍitāḥ || 3.4.30 ||
aṅgānvaṅgānkaliṅgāṃśca kāśmīrānatha mekalān |
ṛṣikāntagiridroṇīḥ saṃśrayiṣyanti mānavāḥ || 31 ||
kṛtsnaṃ vā himavatpārśvaṃ kūlaṃ ca lavaṇāmbhasaḥ|
araṇyeṣu ca vatsyanti narā mlecchagaṇaiḥ sahaḥ || 32 ||
naiva śūnyā na cāśūnyā bhaviṣyati vasuṃdharā |
goptāraścāpyagoptāraḥ prabhaviṣyanti śastriṇaḥ || 33 ||
mṛgairmatsyairvihaṃgaiśca śvāpadaiḥ sarpakīṭakaiḥ |
madhuśākaphalairmūlairvartayiṣyanti mānavāḥ || 34 ||
cīraṃ parṇaṃ ca bahulaṃ valkalānyajināni ca |
svayaṃkṛtāni vatsanti yathā munijanāstathā || 35 ||
bījānāmākṛtiṃ nimneṣvīhantaḥ kāṣṭhaśaṅkubhiḥ |
ajaiṣṭhakaṃ kharoṣṭraṃ ca pālayiṣyanti yatnataḥ || 36 ||
nadīsrotāṃsi rotsyanti toyārthaṃ kūlamāśritāḥ |
pakvānnavyavahāreṇa vipaṇantaḥ parasparam || 37 ||
tanūruhairyathā jātaiḥ samūlāntarasaṃvṛtaiḥ |
bahvapatyāḥ prajāhīnāḥ kulalakṣaṇavarjitāḥ || 38 ||
evaṃ bhaviṣyanti tadā manuṣyāḥ kālakāritāḥ |
hīnāddhīnaṃ tadā dharmaṃ prajāḥ samanuvartsyati || 39 ||
āyustatra ca martyānāṃ paraṃ triṃśad bhaviṣyati |
durbalā viṣayaglānā rajasā samabhiplutāḥ || 3.4.40 ||
bhaviṣyati tadā teṣāṃ rogairindriyasaṃkṣayaḥ |
āyuḥprakṣayasaṃrodhād viṣādaḥ prabhaviṣyati || 41 ||
śuśrūṣavo bhaviṣyanti sādhūnāṃ darśane ratāḥ |
satyaṃ ca pratipatsyanti vyavahāropasaṃkṣayāt || 42 ||
bhaviṣyanti ca kāmānāmalābhād dharmaśīlinaḥ |
kariṣyanti ca saṃkocaṃ svapakṣakṣayapīḍitāḥ || 43 ||
evaṃ śuśrūṣaṇe dāne satye prāṇābhirakṣaṇe |
catuṣpādaḥ pravṛttaśca dharmaḥ śreyo'bhipatsyate || 44 ||
teṣāṃ labdhānumānānāṃ guṇeṣu parivartatām |
svādu kiṃ nviti vijñāya dharma evaṃ vadiṣyati || 45 ||
yathā hāniḥ kramāt prāptā tathā vṛddhiḥ kramādgatā|
pragṛhīte yato dharme pravatsyanti kṛtaṃ yugam || 46 ||
sādhu vṛttaṃ kṛtayuge kaṣāye hānirucyate |
eka eva tu kālaḥ sa hīnavarṇo yathā śaśī || 47 ||
channo hi tamasā somo yathā kaliyuge tathā |
pūrṇaśca tamasā hīno yathā kṛtayuge tathā || 48 ||
arthavādaḥ paraṃ brahma vedārtha iti taṃ viduḥ |
anirṇiktamavijñātaṃ dāyādyamiva dhāryate || 49 ||
iṣṭavādastapo nāma tapo hi sthāvaraṃ kṛtam |
guṇaiḥ karmābhinirvṛttirguṇāstathyena karmaṇā || 3.4.50 ||
āśīstu puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā deśākālānuvartinī |
yuge yuge yathākālamṛṣibhiḥ samudāhṛtā || 51 ||
iha dharmārthakāmānāṃ devatānāṃ pratikriyā |
āśiṣaśca śubhāḥ puṇyāstathaivāyuryuge yuge || 52 ||
yathā yugānāṃ parivartanāni ciraṃ pravṛttāni vidhisvabhāvāt|
kṣaṇaṃ na saṃtiṣṭhati jīvalokaḥ kṣayodayābhyāṃ parivartamānaḥ || 53 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kaliyugavarṇane caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||

<3.5>

pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ
sūta uvāca
ityevamāśvāsayato rājānaṃ janamejayam |
atītānāgataṃ vākyamṛṣeḥ pariṣadā śrutam || 1 ||
amṛtasyeva saṃvāhaḥ prabhā candramaso yathā |
atarpayata tacchrotraṃ maharṣervākyayo rasaḥ || 2 ||
dharmakāmārthasaṃyuktaṃ karuṇaṃ vīraharṣaṇam |
ramaṇīyaṃ tadākhyānaṃ kṛtsnaṃ pariṣadā śrutam || 3 ||
kecidaśrūṇi mumucuḥ śrutvā dadhyustathāpare |
itihāsaṃ tamṛṣiṇā pāṇāviva nidarśitam || 4 ||
sadasyān so'bhthanujñāya kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇām|
punardrakṣyāma ityuktvā jagāma bhagavānṛṣiḥ || 5 ||
anujagmustadā sarve prayāntamṛṣisattamam |
loke pravadatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ye viśiṣṭāstapodhanāḥ || 6 ||
yāte bhagavati vyāse tadā brahmarṣibhiḥ saha |
ṛtvijaḥ pārthivāścaiva pratijagmuryathāgatam || 7 ||
pannagānāṃ sughorāṇāṃ kṛtvā tāṃ vairayātanām |
jagāma roṣamunmṛjya rājā viṣamivoragaḥ || 8 ||
hotrāgnidīptaśirasaṃ paritrāya ca takṣakam |
āstīko'thāśramapadaṃ jagāma sa mahāmuniḥ || 9 ||
rājāpi hāstinapuraṃ jagāma svajanāvṛtaḥ |
anvaśāsacca muditastadā pramuditāḥ prajāḥ || 3.5.10 ||
kasyacit tvatha kālasya sa rājā janamejayaḥ |
dīkṣito vājimedhena vidhivad bhūridakṣiṇaḥ || 11 ||
saṃjñaptamaśvaṃ tatrāsya devī kāśyā vapuṣṭamā |
saṃviveśopagamyātha vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 12 ||
tāṃ tu sarvānavadyāṅgīṃ cakame vāsavastadā |
saṃjñaptamaśvamāviśya tayā miśrībabhūva saḥ || 13 ||
tasmin vikāre janite viditvā tattvataśca tat |
asaṃjñapto'yamaśvaste dhvaṃsetyadhvaryumabravīt || 14 ||
adhvaryurjñānasampannastadindrasya viceṣṭitam |
kathayāmāsa rājarṣeḥ śaśāpa sa puraṃdaram || 15 ||
janamejaya uvāca
yadyasti me yajñaphalaṃ tapo vā rakṣataḥ prajāḥ |
phalenānena sarveṇa bravīmi śrūyatāmidam || 16 ||
adyaprabhṛti devendramajitendriyamasthiram |
kṣatriyā vājimedhena na yakṣyantīti śaunaka || 17 ||
ṛtvijaścābravīt kruddhaḥ sa rājā janamejayaḥ |
daurbalyaṃ bhavatāmetad yadaya dharṣitaḥ kratuḥ || 18 ||
viṣaye me na vastavyaṃ gacchadhvaṃ saha bāndhavaiḥ |
ityuktāstatyajurviprāstaṃ nṛpaṃ jātamanyavaḥ || 19 ||
amarṣādanvaśāsacca patnīśālāgatāḥ striyaḥ |
rājā paramadharmajñastāmasau janamejayaḥ || 3.5.20 ||
asatīṃ vapuṣṭamāmetāṃ niryātayata me gṛhāt |
yayā me caraṇau mūrdhni pātitau reṇuguṇṭhitau || 21 ||
śauṇḍīryaṃ me'nayā bhagnaṃ yaśo mānaśca dūṣitaḥ |
na caināṃ draṣṭumicchāmi parikliṣṭāmiva srajam || 22 ||
na svādu so'śnāti naraḥ sukhaṃ svapiti vā rahaḥ |
anvāste yaḥ priyāṃ bhāryāṃ pareṇa mṛditāmiha |
punarnaivopabhuñjīta śvāvalīḍhaṃ haviryathā || 23 ||
evamuccaiḥ prabhāṣantaṃ kruddhaṃ pārīkṣitaṃ nṛpam |
gandharvarājaḥ provāca viśvāvasuridaṃ vacaḥ || 24 ||
viśvāvasuruvāca
triyajñaśatayajvānaṃ vāsavastvāṃ na mṛṣyate |
apsarāstena patnī te vihiteyaṃ vapuṣṭamā || 25 ||
rambhānāmāpsarā devī kāśirājasutā matā |
saiṣā yoṣidvarā rājan ratnabhūtānubhūyatām || 26 ||
yajñe vivaramāsādya vighnamindreṇa te kṛtam |
yajvā hyasi kuruśreṣṭha samṛddhyā vāsavopamaḥ || 97 ||
bibhetyabhibhavācchakrastava kratuphalairnṛpa |
tasmādāvartitaścaiva kraturindreṇa te vibho || 28 ||
māyaiṣā vāsaveneha prayuktā vighnamicchatā |
kratorvivaramāsādya saṃjñaptaṃ dṛśya vājinam || 29 ||
ratimindreṇa rambhāyāṃ manyase yāṃ vapuṣṭamām |
atha te guravaḥ śaptāstriyajñaśatayājinaḥ || 3.5.30 ||
bhraṃśitastvaṃ ca viprāśca balādindrasamādiha |
tvattaścaiva sudurdharṣāt triyajñaśatayājinaḥ || 31 ||
bibheti hi sadā tvatto brāhmaṇebhyo'pi vāsavaḥ |
ekena vai tadubhayaṃ tīrṇe śakreṇa māyayā || 32 ||
sa eṣa sumahātejā vijigīṣuḥ puraṃdaraḥ |
kathamanyairanācīrṇaṃ napturdārānatikramet || 33 ||
yathaiva hi parā buddhiḥ paro dharmaḥ paro damaḥ |
yathaiva paramaiśvaryaṃ kīrtitaṃ harivāhane |
tathaiva tvayi durdharṣe triyajñaśatayājini || 34 ||
mā vāsavaṃ mā ca gurumātmānaṃ mā vapuṣṭamām |
gaccha doṣeṇa kālo hi sarvathā duratikramaḥ || 35 ||
aiśvaryeṇāśvamāviśya devendreṇāsi roṣitaḥ |
ānukūlyena devasya vartitavyaṃ sukhārthinā || 36 ||
dustaraṃ pratikūlaṃ hi pratisrota ivāmbhasaḥ |
strīratnamupabhuṅkṣvemāmapāpāṃ vigatajvaraḥ || 37 ||
apāpāstyajyamānā vai tyajeyurapi yoṣitaḥ |
aduṣṭāstu striyo rājandivyāstu saviśeṣataḥ|| 38 ||
bhānoḥ prabhā śikhā vahnervedī hotre tathāhutiḥ |
parāmṛṣṭāpyasaṃsaktā nopaduṣyanti yoṣitaḥ || 39 ||
grāhyā lālayitavyāśca pūjyāśca satataṃ budhaiḥ |
śīlavatyo namaskāryāḥ pūjyāḥ śriya iva striyaḥ|| 3.5.40 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi viśvāvasuvākye pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||

<3.6>

ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ
sautiruvāca
evaṃ sa viśvāvasunānunītaḥ prasādamāgamya vapuṣṭamāyāḥ |
cakāra mithyā vyatiśaṅkitātmā śāntiṃ parāṃ mānavadharmahṛṣṭām || 1 ||
śramamabhivinivartya mānasaṃ sa samabhilaṣajjanamejayo yaśaḥ svam |
viṣayamanuśaśāsa dharmabuddhirmuditamanā ramayan vapuṣṭamāṃ tām|| 2 ||
na hi viramati viprapūjanānna ca vinivartati yajñadānaśīlāt |
na viṣayaparirakṣaṇāccyuto'bhūnna ca parigarhati tāṃ vapuṣṭamāṃ ca || 3 ||
vidhivihitamaśakyamanyathā hi kartuṃ
yadṛṣiracintyatapāḥ purābravīt saḥ |
iti sa nṛpatirātmavāṃstadāsau
tadanuvicintya babhūva vītamanyuḥ|| 4 ||
idaṃ mahākāvyamṛṣermahātmanaḥ
paṭhannṛṇāṃ pūjyatamo bhavennaraḥ |
prakṛṣṭamāyuḥ samavāpya durlabhaṃ
labhecca sarvajñaphalaṃ ca keśavam || 5 ||
śatakratoḥ kalmaṣavipramokṣaṇaṃ
paṭhannidaṃ mucyati kalmaṣāntaraḥ |
tathaiva kāmān vividhān samaśnute
hyavāptakāmaśca cirāya nandati || 6 ||
yathā hi puṣpaprabhavaṃ phalaṃ drumāḥ
phalātprajāyanti punaśca pādapāḥ |
tathā maharṣiprabhavā imā giraḥ
pravardhayante tamṛṣiṃ pravardhitāḥ || 7 ||
putrānaputro labhate suvarcasaścyutaḥ punarvindati cātmanaḥ sthitim |
vyādhiṃ na cāpnoti ciraṃ sabandhanaṃ kriyāṃ ca puṇyāṃ labhate guṇānvitaḥ|| 8 ||
patimabhilabhate ca satsu kanyā
śravaṇamupetya śubhā munestu vācaḥ|
janayati ca sutān guṇairupetān
ripujanamardanavīryaśālinaśca || 9 ||
vijayati vasudhāṃ ca rājavṛtti
rdhanamatulaṃ labhate dviṣajjayaṃ ca |
vipulamapi dhanaṃ labhecca vaiśyaḥ
sugatimiyācchravaṇācca śūdrajātiḥ|| 3.6.10||
purāṇametaccaritaṃ mahātmanāmadhītyabuddhiṃ labhate ca naiṣṭhikīm|
vihāya duḥkhāni vimuktasaṅgaḥ sa vītarāgo vicared vasuṃdharām || 11 ||
ityetadākhyānamudāhṛtaṃ vai
pratismaranto dvijamaṇḍaleṣu |
sthairyeṇa dhairyeṇa punaḥ smarantaḥ
sukhaṃ bhavanto'nucarantu lokam || 12 ||
iti caritamidaṃ mahātmanāmṛṣikṛtamadbhutavīryakarmaṇām |
kathitamidaṃ hi samāsavistaraiḥ kimaparamicchasi kiṃ bravīmi te || 13 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi bhaviṣyāntagranthārthaprakāśo nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 ||

<3.7>

saptamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
prabhāvaṃ padmanābhasya svapataḥ sāgarāmbhasi |
puṣkare vai yathodbhūtā devāḥ sarṣigaṇāḥ purā || 1 ||
etadākhyāhi nikhilaṃ yogaṃ yogavidāṃ pate |
śṛṇvatastasya me kīrtiṃ na tṛptirabhijāyate || 2 ||
kiyantaṃ caiva kālaṃ vai śayitā puruṣottamaḥ |
kimarthaṃ ca tathā śete kaśca kālasya sambhavaḥ || 3 ||
kiyatā caiva kālena prabudhyati surādhipaḥ |
kathamutthāya bhagavānasṛjannikhilaṃ jagat || 4 ||
ke prajāpatayastāta āsan pūrvaṃ mahāmune |
kathaṃ nirmitavāṃścaiva citraṃ lokaṃ sanātanaḥ || 5 ||
kathamekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame |
naṣṭe devāsuragaṇe praṇaṣṭoragarākṣase || 6 ||
naṣṭānalānile loke naṣṭākāśamahītale |
kevalaṃ gahvarībhūte mahābhūtaviparyaye || 7 ||
prabhurmahābhūtapatirmahātejā mahākṛtiḥ |
āste suraguruśreṣṭho vidhimādāya kaṃ mune || 8 ||
tanme tvamupapannāya brahmannetadasaṃśayam |
vaktumarhasi dharmiṣṭha yaśo nārāyaṇātmakam || 9 ||
prādurbhāvaṃ puraskṛtya bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ mahātmanaḥ |
śraddhānāmupaviṣṭānāṃ bhagavan vaktumarhasi || 3.7.10 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
nārāyaṇayaśojñāne yā bhaved bhavataḥ spṛhā |
tvadvaṃśānagha pūtasya kāryaṃ kurukularṣabha || 11 ||
śṛṇuṣvādipurāṇebhyo devatābhyo yathāśruti |
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca vadatāṃ śruto'smābhirmahātmanām|| 12 ||
yathā ca tapasā dṛṣṭo bṛhaspatisamadyutiḥ |
pārāśaryastataḥ śrīmān gururdvaipāyano'bravīt || 13 ||
tat te'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi yathāprajñaṃ yathāśrutam |
na vijñātuṃ mayā śakyamṛṣimātreṇa bhārata || 14 ||
kaḥ samutsahate jñātuṃ paraṃ nārāyaṇātmakam |
viśvātmano yaṃ brahmāpi na vedayati tattvataḥ || 15 ||
śrutaṃ me viśvadevānāṃ yad rahasyaṃ maharṣiṇām |
tadidaṃ sarvadevānāṃ tattvatastattvavādinām || 16 ||
tadadhyātmavidāṃ cintyaṃ kāraṇaṃ caiva karmiṇām |
adhidaivaṃ ca yad daivaṃ tada daivamiti saṃjñitam || 17 ||
yad bhūtamadhibhūtaṃ ca yatparaṃ ca maharṣiṇām|
yat satyaṃ vedadṛṣṭaṃ ca yat tadvedavido viduḥ || 18 ||
yaḥ kartā kārako buddhirmanaḥ kṣetrajña eva ca |
pradhānaṃ puruṣaḥ śāstā ekastadabhiśabdyate || 19 ||
kālaḥ kālaṃ svapayati draṣṭā svādhīna eva ca |
prāṇaḥ pañcavidhaścaiva dhruvamakṣarameva ca || 3.7.20 ||
ucyate vividhairbhāvaistasyaivānagha tatparaiḥ |
sa eva bhagavān sarvaṃ karoti vikaroti ca || 21 ||
yo'smānkārayate karma tenāsya vyākulīkṛtāḥ |
yajāmahe tameveśaṃ tamevecchāma nirvṛtāḥ || 22 ||
yo vaktā yaśca vaktavyo yaścāhaṃ tadbravīmi vaḥ |
idaṃ śṛṇuta yacchreyo yaccānyat parijalpatha || 23 ||
yāḥ kathāścaiva vartante śrutayo vātha gahvarāḥ |
viśvaṃ viśvapatirdevāḥ sarvaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam || 24||
yat satyaṃ yadanṛtamādimakṣaraṃ vai
yadbhūtaṃ bhavati mithaśca yadbhaviṣyam |
yat kiṃciccaramacarāvyayaṃ triloke
tatsarvaṃ puruṣavaraḥ prabhurvariṣṭhaḥ || 25 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi puṣkaraprādurbhāve saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||

<3.8>

aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
catvāryāhuḥ sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ tu kṛtaṃ yugam |
tasya tāvacchatī saṃdhyā dviguṇā janamejaya || 1 ||
tatra dharmaścatuṣpādo hyadharmaḥ pādavigrahaḥ |
svadharmaniratāḥ santo yajante caiva mānavāḥ || 2 ||
sthitā dharmaparā viprā rājavṛttau sthitā nṛpāḥ |
kṛṣyāmabhiratā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāḥ śuśrūṣavastathā || 3 ||
sadā satyaṃ tapaścaiva dharmaścaiva vivardhate |
sadbhirācaritaṃ yacca kriyate khyāyate ca yat || 4 ||
etat kṛtayuge vṛttaṃ sarveṣāmeva bhārata |
prāṇināṃ dharmabuddhīnāmapi cennīcayoninām || 5 ||
trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi tretāyugamihocyate |
tasya tāvacchatī saṃdhyā dviguṇā parikīrtitā || 6 ||
dvābhyāmadharmaḥ pādābhyāṃ tribhirdharmo vyavasthitaḥ |
tatra satyaṃ ca sattvaṃ ca kṛte sarvaṃ pravartate || 7 ||
tretāyāṃ vikṛtiṃ yānti varṇā laulyena saṃyutāḥ |
cāturvarṇyasya vaikṛtyādyānti daurbalyamāśritāḥ|| 8 ||
eṣa tretāyugavidhirvihito devanirmitaḥ |
dvāparasyāpi yā ceṣṭā tāmapi śrotumarhasi || 9 ||
dvāparaṃ dve sahasre tu varṣāṇāṃ kurusattama |
tasya tāvacchatī saṃdhyā dviguṇā parikīrtitā || 3.8.10 ||
tatrāpyarthaparā viprā jñānino rajasā''vṛtāḥ |
śaṭhā naiṣkṛtikāḥ kṣudrā jāyante kurupuṅgava || 11 ||
dvābhyāṃ dharmaḥ sthitaḥ padbhyāmadharmastribhirutthitaḥ |
viparyayaṃ śanairyānti kṛte ye dharmasetavaḥ || 12 ||
brāhmaṇyabhāvā naśyanti tathāstikyaṃ viśīryate |
vratopavāsāstyajyante dvāpare yugaparyaye || 13 ||
tathā varṣasahasraṃ tu varṣāṇāṃ dve śate tathā |
saṃdhyayā saha saṃkhyātaṃ krūraṃ kaliyugaṃ smṛtam || 14 ||
tatrādharmaścatuṣpādaḥ syād dharmaḥ pādavigrahaḥ |
kāmaniṣṭhāstamaśchannā jāyante tatra mānavāḥ || 15 ||
naivopavāsakṛt kaścinna ca sādhurna satyavāk |
āstiko brahmavaktā vā naro bhavati vai tadā || 16 ||
ahaṃkāragṛhītāśca prakṣīṇasnehabandhanāḥ |
viprāḥ śūdrasamācārāḥ śūdrāstvācāralakṣaṇāḥ || 17 ||
dūṣakāstvāśramāṇāṃ ca varṇānāṃ caiva saṃkarāḥ |
agamyāsvabhiraṃsyante vartantyevaṃ kalau yuge || 18 ||
evaṃ dvādaśasāhasraṃ tadekaṃ yugamucyate |
tadekasaptatiguṇaṃ manvantaramihocyate || 19 ||
trayyāṃ caiva na saṃdeho yugānte janamejaya |
divyaṃ dvādaśasāhasraṃ yugaṃ tu kavayo viduḥ |
etatsahasraparyantaṃ tadaho brāhmamucyate || 3.8.20 ||
tato'hani gate tasmin sarveṣāmeva dehinām |
śarīranirvṛtiṃ dṛṣṭvā rudraḥ saṃhārabuddhimān || 21 ||
devatānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ mahīpate |
daityānāṃ mānavānāṃ ca yakṣagandharvarakṣasām || 22 ||
devarṣīṇāṃ brahmarṣīṇāṃ tathā rājarṣiṇāmapi |
kiṃnarāṇāmapsarasāṃ bhujaṅgānāṃ tathaiva ca || 23 ||
parvatānāṃ nadīnāṃ ca paśūnāṃ caiva bhārata |
tiryagyonigatānāṃ ca sattvānāṃ mṛgapakṣiṇām || 24 ||
mahābhūtapatirdevaḥ pañcabhūtāni bhūtakṛt |
jagatsaṃharaṇārthāya kurute vaiśasaṃ mahat || 25 ||
bhūtvā sūryaścakṣuṣī cādadāno
bhūtvā vāyuḥ saṃharan prāṇijātam|
bhūtvā vahnirdahyate sarvalokān
megho bhūtvā bhūya evābhyavarṣat || 26 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi puṣkaraprādurbhāve
kṛtādiyugaparimāṇavarṇane aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||8 ||

<3.9>

navamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
bhūtvā nārāyaṇo yogī saptamūrtirvibhāvasuḥ |
gabhastibhiḥ pradīptābhiḥ saṃśoṣayati sāgarān || 1 ||
pītvārṇavāṃśca sarvān sa nadīḥ kūpāṃśca sarvaśaḥ |
parvatānāṃ ca salilaṃ sarvaṃ pītvā ca raśmibhiḥ || 2 ||
bhittvā sahasraśaścaiva mahīṃ nītvā rasātalam|
rasātalagataṃ kṛtsnaṃ pibate rasamuttamam || 3 ||
apsu sṛjankledamanyad dadāti prāṇināṃ dhruvam |
tat sarvamaravindākṣa ādatte puruṣottamaḥ || 4 ||
vāyuśca balavānbhūtvā sa vidhūyākhilaṃ jagat|
prāṇodaye surāṇāṃ ca vāyunā kurute hariḥ || 5 ||
tato devagaṇānāṃ ca sarveṣāmeva dehinām |
ye cendriyagaṇāḥ sarve ye cānye ca yatodbhavāḥ |
pūyaṃ ghrāṇaṃ śarīraṃ ca pṛthivīmāśritā guṇāḥ || 6 ||
jihvā rasaśca kledaśca saṃśritāḥ salilaṃ guṇāḥ |
rūpaṃ cakṣurvipākaśca jyotirevāśritā guṇāḥ || 7 ||
sparśaḥ prāṇaśca ceṣṭā ca pavanaṃ saṃśritā guṇāḥ |
parameṣṭhinaṃ vareṇyaṃ ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ samāśritāḥ || 8 ||
tato bhagavatā tatra raśmibhiḥ parivāritāḥ |
vāyunā kṛṣyamāṇāśca rūpānyonyasamāśrayāt || 9 ||
teṣāṃ saṃgharṣajodbhūtaḥ pāvakaḥ śatadhā jvalan |
adahannikhilāṃllokānugraḥ saṃvartako'nalaḥ || 3.9.10 ||
saṃparvatāṃstarūn gulmām̐llatāvallīstṛṇāni ca |
vimānāni ca divyāni purāṇi vividhāni ca || 11||
āśramāṃśca tathā puṇyāndivyānyātanāni ca |
yāni cāśrayaṇīyāni tāni sarvāṇi so'dahat || 12 ||
bhasmībhūtāṃstataḥ sarvām̐llokām̐llokagururhariḥ |
bhūyo nirvāpayāmāsa jalayuktena karmaṇā || 13 ||
sahasradṛṅmahātejā bhūtvā kṛṣṇo mahāghanaḥ |
divyatoyena haviṣā tarpayāmāsa medinīm || 14 ||
tataḥ kṣīranikāśena svādunā paramāmbhasā |
śivena puṇyena mahīṃ nirvāṇamagamat param || 15 ||
te nagā jalasaṃchannāḥ payasaḥ sarvatodharāḥ |
ekārṇavajalā bhūtvā sarvasattvavivarjitāḥ || 16 ||
mahābhūtānyapi ca taṃ praviṣṭānyamitaujasam |
naṣṭārkapavanākāśe sūkṣme janavivarjite || 17 ||
saṃśoṣayitvā pītvā ca vasatyekaḥ sanātanaḥ |
paurāṇaṃ rūpamāsthāya kimapyamitabuddhimān || 18 ||
ekārṇavajale hyāsīd yogī yogamupāgataḥ |
ayutānāṃ sahasrāṇi gatānyekārṇave'mbhasi |
na cainaṃ kaścidavyaktaṃ vyaktaṃ veditumarhati || 19 ||
janamejaya uvāca
ekārṇavavidhiḥ ko'yaṃ yaścaiva parikīrtitaḥ |
ka eṣa puruṣo nāma kiṃ yogaḥ kaśca yogavān || 3.9.20||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
etāvantamasau kālamekārṇavavidhiṃ prati |
kariṣyatīmaṃ bhagavāniti kaścinna budhyate || 21 ||
na vai mātā na ca draṣṭā na jñātā naiva pārśvagaḥ |
na smāvagacchate kaścidṛte taṃ devamīśvaram || 22 ||
nabhaḥ kṣitiṃ pavanamatha prakāśayan prajāpatiṃ bhuvanacaraṃ sureśvaram |
pitāmahaṃ śrutinilayaṃ mahāmuniṃ śaśāsa bhūḥ śayanamarocayat prabhuḥ|| 23 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi puṣkaraprādurbhāve navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 ||

<3.10>

daśamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evamekārṇavībhūte śete loke mahādyutiḥ |
pracchādya salilaṃ sarvaṃ harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 ||
mahato rajaso madhye mahārṇavasamasya vai |
virajasko mahābāhurakṣaraṃ brahma yaṃ viduḥ || 2 ||
ātmarūpaprakāśena tapasā saṃvṛtaḥ prabhuḥ |
trikamāsthāya kālaṃ tu tataḥ suṣvāpa so'vyayaḥ|| 3 ||
puruṣo yajña ityevaṃ yatparaṃ parikīrtitam |
yathānyatpuruṣākhyaṃ syātsarvaṃ tatpuruṣottamaḥ|| 4 ||
ye ca yajñaparā viprā ṛtvijā iti saṃjñitāḥ |
ātmadehātpurā bhūtā yajñebhyaḥ śrūyatāṃ tadā || 5 ||
brahmāṇaṃ paramaṃ vaktrādudgātāraṃ ca sāmagam |
hotāramatha cādhvaryuṃ bāhubhyāmasṛjat prabhuḥ || 6 ||
brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇatvācca samprastāraṃ ca sarvaśaḥ |
tanmitraṃ varuṇaṃ sṛṣṭvā pratiṣṭhātārameva ca || 7 ||
udarāt pratihartāraṃ potāraṃ caiva bhārata |
acchāvākaṃ manorūbhyāṃ neṣṭāraṃ caiva bhārata || 8 ||
pāṇibhyāmatha cāgnīdhraṃ subrahmaṇyaṃ ca yajñiyam |
grāvāṇamatha bāhubhyāmunnetāraṃ ca yajñiyam || 9 ||
evamevaiṣa bhagavān poḍaśaitāñjagatpatiḥ |
pravaktṝn sarvayajñānāmṛtvijo'sṛjaduttamān || 3.10.10 ||
tadeṣa vai vedamayaḥ puruṣo yajñasammitaḥ |
vedāśca tanmayāḥ sarve sāṅgopaniṣadakriyāḥ || 11 ||
svapityekārṇave caiva yadāścaryamabhūttadā |
śrūyate tad yathāvṛttaṃ mārkaṇḍeyo yadanvabhūt ||12 ||
jīrṇo bhagavatastasya kukṣāveva mahāmuniḥ |
bahuvarṣasahasrāyustasyaiva varatejasā || 13 ||
iti tīrthaprasaṅgena pṛthvītīrthagocaraḥ |
āśramānapi puṇyāṃśca tīrthānyāyatanāni ca || 14 ||
deśānrāṣṭrāṇi citrāṇi purāṇi vividhāni ca |
japahomarataḥ kṣāntastapo ghoraṃ samāśritaḥ || 15 ||
mārkaṇḍeyastatastasya śanairvaktrād viniḥsṛtaḥ |
niṣkrāmantaṃ na cātmānaṃ jānīte devamāyayā || 16||
niṣkrāntastasya vadanādekārṇavamatho gataḥ |
sarvatastamasācchannaṃ mārkaṇḍeyo nirīkṣate || 17 ||
tasyotpannaṃ bhayaṃ tīvraṃ saṃśayaścātmajīvite |
devadarśanasaṃhṛṣṭo vismayaṃ cāgamat param || 18 ||
saṃcintayati madhyastho mārkaṇḍeyo'tiśaṅkitaḥ |
kiṃsvidbhavediyaṃ cintā mohaḥ svapno'nu'bhūyate || 19 ||
vyaktamanyatamo bhāvo hyeteṣāṃ bhavitā mama |
na hīdṛśamasaṃśliṣṭamayuktaṃ satyamarhati || 3.10.20 ||
naṣṭacandrārkapavane channaparvatabhūtale |
katamaḥ syādayaṃ loka iti cintāvyavasthitaḥ || 21 ||
apaśyaccāpi puruṣaṃ śayānaṃ parvatopamam |
toyāḍhyamiva jīmūtaṃ madhye magnaṃ mahārṇave || 22 ||
tapantamiva tejobhirbhāsvantamiva varcasā |
jāgrantamiva gāmbhīryācchvasantamiva pannagam || 23 ||
sa devaṃ praṣṭumāyāti kau bhavāniti vismayāt|
tathaiva ca śanairbhūyo muniḥ kukṣiṃ praveśitaḥ || 24 ||
sa praviṣṭaḥ punaḥ kukṣau mārkaṇḍeyaḥ suniścitaḥ |
tathaiva carate bhūyo vijānan svapnadarśanam || 25 ||
sa tathaiva yathāpūrvaṃ pṛthivīmaṭate punaḥ |
puṇyatīrthāni pūtāni niraikṣad divi bhūtale || 26 ||
kratubhiryajamānāṃśca samāptavaradakṣiṇaiḥ |
paśyate devakukṣisthānyajñiyāñchataśo dvijān|| 27 ||
sadvṛttamāśritāḥ sarve varṇā brāhmaṇapūrvakāḥ |
catvāraścāśramāḥ samyag yathoddiṣṭapadānugāḥ || 28 ||
varṣāṇāṃ śatasāhasraṃ mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ |
vicaran pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ na ca kukṣyantamaikṣata|| 29 ||
tataḥ kadācidatha vai punarvaktrād viniḥsṛtaḥ |
suptaṃ nyagrodhaśākhāyāṃ bālamekaṃ nirīkṣate || 3.10.30 ||
yathā caikārṇavajale nīhāreṇa vṛtāntare |
avyaktabhīṣaṇe loke sarvabhūtavivarjite || 31 ||
sa bhūyo vismayāviṣṭaḥ kautūhalasamanvitaḥ |
bālamādityasaṃkāśaṃ na śaknotyupasarpitum || 32 ||
so'cintayadathaikānte sthitvā salilasaṃnidhau |
pūrvadṛṣṭamidaṃ neti śaṅkito devamāyayā || 33 ||
agādhe salila stabdhe mārkaṇḍeyaḥ plavanmuniḥ |
na śāntiṃ labhate tatra śramāt saṃtrastaviklavaḥ || 34 ||
tathaiva bhagavān haṃso gato yogena bālatām |
babhāṣe meghatulyena svareṇa puruṣottamaḥ || 35 ||
śrībhagavānuvāca
mā bhairvatsa na bhetavyamihaivāyāhi cāntikam |
mārkaṇḍeya mune dhīra bālastvaṃ śramapīḍitaḥ || 36 ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
ko māṃ nāmnā kīrtayate tapaḥ paribhavan mama |
bahuvarṣasahasrāyurdharṣayaṃścaiva me vayaḥ || 37 ||
na hyeṣa samudācāro deveṣvapi samāhitaḥ |
māṃ brahmāpi sa viśveśo dīrghāyuriti bhāṣate || 38 ||
kastapo ghoraśiraso mamādya tyaktajīvitaḥ |
mārkaṇḍeyeti māṃ proktvā mṛtyumīkṣitumicchati|| 39 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evamābhāṣate krodhānmārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ |
athainaṃ bhagavān bhūyo babhāṣe tatparāyaṇam || 3.10.40 ||
śrībhagavānuvāca
ahaṃ te janako vatsa hṛpīkeśaḥ pitā guruḥ |
āyuḥpradātā paurāṇaḥ kimarthaṃ nopasarpati || 41 ||
māṃ putrakāmaḥ prathamaṃ pitā te hyaṅgirā muniḥ |
pūrvamārādhayāmāsa tapastīvramupāśritaḥ || 42 ||
tatastvāṃ ghoraśirasaṃ dahanopamatejasam |
dattavānahamātmeṣṭaṃ maharṣimamitāyuṣam || 43 ||
tatra notsahate cānyo yo na bhūto mamātmakaḥ |
draṣṭumekārṇavagataṃ krīḍantaṃ yogadharmiṇam || 44 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ prasannavadano vismayotphullalocanaḥ |
mūrghni baddhāñjalipuṭo mārkaṇḍeyo mahātapāḥ || 45 ||
nāmagotraṃ tataḥ śrutvā dīrghāyurlokapūjitaḥ |
athākaronnamaskāraṃ praṇataḥ śirasā prabhum || 46 ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
icche'haṃ tattvatto māyāmimāṃ jñātuṃ tavānagha |
yadekārṇavamadhyasthaḥ śeṣe tvaṃ bālarūpavān || 47 ||
kiṃsaṃjñaḥ kaśca bhagavām̐lloke vijñāyase'nagha |
tarkaye tvāṃ mahābhūtaṃ na bhūtamiha tiṣṭhati || 48 ||
śrībhagavānuvāca
ahaṃ nārāyaṇo brahmā sambhavaḥ sarvadehinām |
sarvabhūtodbhavakaraḥ sarvabhūtavināśanaḥ || 49 ||
ahamaindre pade śakra ṛtūnāmapi vatsaraḥ |
ahaṃ yuge yugākṣaśca yugasyāvarta eva ca || 3.10.50 ||
ahaṃ sarvāṇi sattvāni daivatānyakhilāni ca |
bhujagānāmahaṃ śeṣastārkṣyo'haṃ sarvapakṣiṇām || 51 ||
ahaṃ sahasraśīrṣā dyauryaḥ padairabhisaṃvṛtaḥ |
ādityo yajñapuruṣo devo yajñamayo makhaḥ |
ahamagnirhavyavāhe yādasāṃ patiravyayaḥ || 52 ||
yatpṛthivyāṃ dvijendrāṇāṃ tapasā bhāvitātmanām |
bahujanmaniruddhātmā brāhmaṇo yatirucyate || 53 ||
jñānavān dṛṣṭaviśvātmā yogināṃ yogavittamaḥ |
kṛtāntaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ viśveṣāṃ kālasaṃjñitaḥ || 54 ||
ahaṃ karma kriyā jīvaḥ sarveṣāṃ dharmadarśanaḥ |
niṣkriyaḥ sarvabhūteṣu svātmajyotiḥ sanātanaḥ || 55 ||
pradhānaṃ puruṣo devo'hamādyastvakṣayo'vyayaḥ |
ahaṃ dharmastapaścāhaṃ sarvāśramanivāsinām || 56 ||
ahaṃ hayaśiro devaḥ kṣīrode yo mahārṇave |
ṛtaṃ satyaṃ ca paramamahamekaḥ prajāpatiḥ || 57 ||
ahaṃ sāṃkhyamahaṃ yogamahaṃ tatparamaṃ padam |
ahamijyo bhavaścāhamahaṃ vidyādhipaḥ smṛtaḥ || 58 ||
ahaṃ jyotirahaṃ vāyurahaṃ bhūmirahaṃ nabhaḥ |
ahamāpaḥ samudrāśca nakṣatrāṇi diśo daśa |
ahaṃ varṣamahaṃ somaḥ parjanyo'hamahaṃ raviḥ || 59 ||
kṣīrodaḥ sāgaraścāhaṃ samudro vaḍavāmukhaḥ |
vahniḥ saṃvartako bhūtyā pibaṃstoyamayaṃ haviḥ || 3.10.60 ||
ahaṃ purāṇaṃ paramaṃ tathaiveha parāyaṇam |
ahaṃ bhūtasya bhavyasya vartamānasya sambhavaḥ || 61 ||
yatkiṃcitpaśyase caiva yacchṛṇoṣi ca kiṃcana |
yaccānubhavase loke tat sarvaṃ māmakaṃ smṛtam || 62 ||
viśvaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ sṛjeyaṃ cādya paśya mām| |
yuge yuge ca srakṣyāmi mārkaṇḍeyākhilaṃ jagat || 63 || |
tadetadakhilaṃ sarvaṃ mārkaṇḍeyāvadhāraya |
śuśrūṣurmama dharmepsuḥ kukṣau cara sukhī bhava || 64 ||
mama brahmā śarīrastho devāśca ṛṣibhiḥ saha |
byaktamavyaktayogaṃ māmavagacchāparājitam || 65 ||
ahamekākṣaro mantrastryakṣaraścaiva sarvaśaḥ |
tripadaścaiva paramastrivargārthanidarśanaḥ || 66 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evametat purāṇeṣu vedānte ca mahāmuniḥ |
vaktre vyāhṛtavānāśu mārkaṇḍeyaṃ mahāmunim|
praveśayāmāsa tato jaṭharaṃ viśvarūpadhṛk || 67 ||
tato bhagavataḥ kukṣiṃ praviṣṭo munisattamaḥ |
rarāma sukhamāsādya śuśrūṣurhaṃsamavyayam || 68 ||
tadakṣaraṃ vividhamathāśrito vapurmahārṇave vyapagatacandrabhāskare |
śanaiścaranprabhurapi haṃsasaṃjñito'sṛjajjagadvisṛjati kālaparyaye || 69 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṣkare mārkaṇḍeyakartṛkabhagavaddarśane daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 ||

<3.11>

ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
āpavaḥ sa vibhurbhūtvā kārayāmāsa vai tapaḥ |
chādayitvā''tmano dehamātmanā kumbhasambhavaḥ || 1 ||
tato mahātmātibalo matiṃ lokasya sarjane |
mahatā pañcabhūtānāṃ viśvasto vyacintayat || 2 ||
tasya cintayatastatra tapasā bhāvitātmanaḥ |
nirākāśe toyamaye sūkṣme jagati gahvare || 3 ||
īṣatsaṃkṣobhayāmāsa so'rṇavaṃ salile sthitaḥ |
so'nantarormiṇā sūkṣmamatha cchidramabhūttadā || 4||
tatra śabdagatirbhūtvā mārutadravasambhavaḥ |
sa labdhvā''ntaramakṣobhyo vyavardhata samīraṇaḥ || 5 ||
vivardhatā balavatā tena saṃśobhito'rṇavaḥ |
anyonyavegābhihatā mamanthuścormayo bhṛśam || 6 ||
mahārṇavasya kṣubdhasya tasmin nambhasi mathyati |
kṛṣṇavartmā samabhavatprabhurvaiśvānaro'rcimān || 7 ||
tatra saṃśoṣayāmāsa pāvakaḥ salilaṃ bahu |
kṣayājjalanidheśchidramabhavanniḥsṛtaṃ nabhaḥ || 8||
ātmatejodbhavāḥ puṇyā āpo'mṛtarasopamāḥ |
ākāśaṃ chidrasambhūtaṃ vāyurākāśasambhavaḥ || 9||
ājyasaṃgharṣaṇodbhūtaṃ pāvakaṃ cājyasambhavam|
dṛṣṭvā prītiyuto devo mahābhūtādibhāvanaḥ || 10 ||
dṛṣṭvā bhūtāni bhagavām̐llokasṛṣṭyarthatattvavit|
brahmaṇo janma sa hitaṃ bahurūpo vicinvati || 11 ||
caturyugādisaṃkhyānte sahasrayugaparyaye |
yatpṛthivyāṃ dvijendrāṇāṃ tapasā bhāvitātmanām || 12 ||
bahujanmaniruddhātmā brāhmaṇo yatiruttamaḥ |
jñānavān dṛṣṭaviśvātmā yogināṃ yogavittamaḥ || 13 ||
taṃ yogavantaṃ vijñeyaṃ sampūrṇaiśvaryavikramam |
devo brahmaṇi viśve ca niyojayati yogavit|| 14||
tatastasmin mahātoye haviṣo hariracyutaḥ |
svapan krīḍaṃśca vividhaṃ modate caiṣa pāvakiḥ | 15 ||
padmaṃ nābhyudbhavaṃ caikaṃ samutpāditavāṃstadā |
sahasrapatraṃ virajo bhāskarābhaṃ hiraṇmayam || 16 ||
hutāśanajvalitaśikhojjvalaprabhaṃ sugandhinaṃ śaradamalārkatejasam|
virājate kamalamudāravarcasaṃ mahātmanastanuruhacārudarśanam || 17||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṣkare mahāpadmotpattau ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ||

<3.12>

vaiśampāyana uvāca
atha yogavidāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvabhūtamanomayam ||
sraṣṭāraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ brahmāṇaṃ sarvatomukham || 1 ||
tasmin hiraṇmaye padme bahuyojanavistṛte |
sarvatejoguṇamaye pārthivailakṣaṇairyute || 2 ||
tacca padmaṃ purāṇajñāḥ pṛthivīruhamuttamam ||
nārāyaṇāṅgasambhūtaṃ pravadanti maharṣayaḥ || 3 ||
yā tu padmāsanā devī pṛthivīṃ tām̐ pracakṣate|
ye garbhasārāṅkuratastān divyān parvatān viduḥ || 4 ||
himavantaṃ ca meruṃ ca nīlaṃ niṣadhameva ca |
kailāsaṃ muñjavantaṃ ca tathādriṃ gandhamādanam || 5 ||
puṇyaṃ triśikharaṃ caiva kāntaṃ mandarameva ca | |
udayaṃ kandaraṃ caiva vindhyamastaṃ ca parvatam || 6 ||
ete devagaṇānāṃ ca siddhānāṃ ca mahātmanām |
āśramāḥ puṇyaśīlānāṃ sarvakāmayutādrayaḥ || 7 ||
eteṣāmantaro deśo jambūdvīpa iti smṛtaḥ |
jambūdvīpasya saṃkhyānaṃ yājñiyā yatra cakrire || 8 ||
garbhād yat sravate toyaṃ devāmṛtarasopamam |
divyatīrthaśatāpāṅgyastā divyāḥ saritaḥ smṛtāḥ||9||
yānyetāni tu padmasya kesarāṇi samantataḥ |
asaṃkhyātāḥ pṛthivyāṃ tu viśve te dhātuparvatāḥ || 10 ||
yāni padmasya patrāṇi bhūrīṇyūrdhvaṃ narādhipa |
te durgamāḥ śailacitā mlecchadeśā vikalpitāḥ || 11 ||
yānyadhaḥ padmapatrāṇi vāsārthe tāni bhāgaśaḥ |
daityānāmuragāṇāṃ ca pātālaṃ tanmahātmanām || 12 ||
teṣāmadhogataṃ yattadudaketyabhisaṃjñitam |
mahāpātakakarmāṇo majjante yatra mānavāḥ || 13 ||
padmasyānte kuśaṃ yattadekārṇavajalaṃ mahat |
proktāste dikṣu saṃghātāścatvāro jalasāgarāḥ || 14 ||
ṛṣernārāyaṇasyāyaṃ mahāpuṣkarasambhavaḥ ||
prādurbhāvo'pyayaṃ tasmānnāmnā puṣkarasambhavaḥ || 15 ||
etasmāt kāraṇāt tajjñaiḥ purāṇaiḥ paramarṣibhiḥ |
yajñiyairvedadṛṣṭārthairyajñe padmacitī kṛtaḥ || 16 ||
evaṃ bhagavatā padme viśvasya paramo vidhiḥ |
parvatānāṃ nadīnāṃ ca deśānāṃ ca vinirmitaḥ || 17 ||
vibhustathaivāpratimaprabhāvaḥ prabhākaro vai bhagavān mahātmā |
svayaṃ svayaṃbhūḥ śayane'sṛjat tadā jaganmayaṃ padmanidhiṃ mahārṇave || 18 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṣkare sarvabhūtotpattau dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||

<3.13>

trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
caturyugādisambhūtau sahasrayugaparyaye |
vighnastamasi sambhūto madhurnāma mahāsuraḥ || 1 ||
tasyaiva ca sahāyo'nyo bhūto rajasi kaiṭabhaḥ |
tau rajastamasāviṣṭau sambhūtau kāmarūpiṇau || 2 ||
ekārṇavajalaṃ sarvaṃ kṣobhayantau mahāsurau |
kṛṣṇaraktāmbaradharau śvetadīptogradaṃṣṭriṇau || 3 ||
ubhau madakaṭodagrau keyūravalayojjvalau |
mahāvikṛtatāmrākṣau pīnoraskau mahābhujau || 4 ||
mahacchiraḥsaṃhananau jaṅgamāviva parvatau |
nīlameghābhrasaṃkāśāvādityapratimānanau || 5 ||
vidyudambhodatāmrābhyāṃ karābhyāmatibhīṣaṇau |
pādasaṃcāravegābhyāmutkṣipantāvivārṇavam || 6||
kampayantāviva hariṃ śayānamarisūdanam |
tau tatra viharantau sma puṣkare viśvatomukham || 7 ||
paśyatāṃ dīptavapuṣaṃ yogināṃ śreṣṭhamuttamam |
nārāyaṇasamājñaptaṃ sṛjantamakhilāḥ prajāḥ |
daivatāni ca viśvāni mānasāṃśca sutānṛṣīn || 8 ||
tatastāvūcatustatra brahmāṇamasurottamau |
dṛptau yuyutsukau kruddhau roṣasaṃraktalocanau || 9||
kastvaṃ puṣkaramadhyasthaḥ sitoṣṇīṣaścaturmukhaḥ |
āvāmagaṇayan mohādāsse tvaṃ vigatajvaraḥ || 10 ||
ehyāvayorbāhuyuddhaṃ prayaccha kamalodbhava |
āvābhyāmativīrābhyāṃ na śakyaṃ sthātumāhave || 11 ||
kastvaṃ kaścodbhavastubhyaṃ kena vāsīha coditaḥ |
kaḥ sraṣṭā kaśca vai goptā kena nāmnābhidhīyase || 12 ||
brahmovāca
yaḥ ka ityucyate loke hyavijñātaḥ sahasraśaḥ |
tatsambhavaṃ yogavantaṃ kiṃ māṃ nābhyavagacchathaḥ || 13 ||
madhukaiṭabhāvūcatuḥ
nāvayoḥ paramaṃ loke kiṃcidasti mahāmate |
āvābhyāṃ chādyate viśvaṃ tamasā rajasā tathā || 14 ||
rajastamomayāvāvāṃ yatīnāṃ duḥkhalakṣaṇau |
chalakau dharmaśīlānāṃ dustarau sarvadehinām || 15 ||
āvābhyāṃ muhyate loka ucchritābhyāṃ yuge yuge |
āvāmarthaśca kāmaśca yajñāḥ sarvaparigrahāḥ || 16 ||
sukhaṃ yatra mudo yatra yatra śrīḥ sannatirnayaḥ |
eṣāṃ yatkāṅkṣitaṃ caiva tattadāvāṃ vicintaya || 17||
brahmovāca
yat tad yogavatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yacca pūrvaṃ mayārcitam|
tatsamādhāya guṇavānsattve cāsmi pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 18 ||
yatparaṃ yogayuktānāmakṣaraṃ sattvameva ca |
rajasastamasaścaiva yatsraṣṭā jīvasambhavaḥ || 19 ||
yato bhūtāni jāyante sāttvikānītarāṇi ca |
sa eva yuddhvā samare vaśī vāṃ śamayiṣyati || 20 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ śayānaṃ śrīmantaṃ bahuyojanavistṛtam |
padmanābhaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ praṇamyāvocatāmubhau || 21 ||
jānīvastvāṃ viśvayonimekaṃ puruṣasattamam|
tavopāsanahetvarthamidaṃ nau viddhi kāraṇam || 22 ||
amoghadarśanaṃ satyaṃ yatastvāṃ vidurīśvaram |
tatastvāmabhito deva kaṅkṣāvaḥ prativīkṣitum|| 23 ||
tadicchāvo varaṃ dattaṃ tvayā hyāvāmariṃdama |
amoghaṃ darśanaṃ deva namaste'stvajitaṃjaya || 24 ||
śrībhagavānuvāca
tānicchatho drutaṃ brūtaṃ varānasurasattamau |
dattāyuṣau mayā bhūyastvaho jīvitumicchathaḥ || 25 ||
tasmād yadeṣa vāṃ yatnastatprāpnutaṃ mahābalau |
vadhyau bhavantau tu syātāṃ tāvityevābravīddhariḥ |
ubhāvapi mahātmānāvūrjitau kṣatavarjitau || 26 ||
madhukaiṭabhāvūcatuḥ
yasminna kaścinmṛtavāṃstasmindeśe vibho vadham|
icchāvaḥ putratāṃ yātuṃ tava caiva surādhipa || 27
śrībhagavānuvāca
bāḍhaṃ sutau me pravarau bhaviṣye kalpasambhave |
bhaviṣyatho na saṃdehaḥ satyametad bravīmi vām||28||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
varaṃ pradāyātha mahāsurābhyāṃ sanātano viśvavarottamo vibhuḥ |
rajastamobhyāṃ bhavabhāvanopamau mamantha tāvūrutale surārihā || 29||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi madhukaiṭabhavarapradāne trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 ||

<3.14>

caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
sthitvā tasmiṃstu kamale brahmā brahmavidāṃ varaḥ |
ūrdhvabāhurmahābāhustapo ghoraṃ samāśritaḥ || 1 ||
jvalanniva ca tejasvī bhābhiḥ svābhistamonudaḥ |
babhāse sarvadharmajñaḥ sahasrāṃśurivāṃśumān || 2 ||
athānyadrūmāsthāya śambhurnārāyaṇo'vyayaḥ |
dvidhā kṛtvā''tmanā''tmānamacintyātmā sanātanaḥ|3|
ājagāma mahātejā yogācāryo mahāyaśāḥ |
sāṃkhyācāryaśca matimān kapilo brāhmaṇo varaḥ || 4 ||
devarṣibhistu tāvetau brahma brahmavidāṃ varau |
ubhāvapi mahātmānāvūrjitau kṣetratatparau || 5 ||
tau prāptāvūcatustatra brahmāṇamamitaujasam |
parāvaraviśeṣajñau pūjitau paramarṣibhiḥ || 6 ||
bahutvād dṛḍhapādaśca viśvātmā jagataḥ sthitiḥ |
grāmaṇīḥ sarvalokānāṃ brahmā lokagururvaraḥ || 7 ||
tayostad vacanaṃ śrutvā tisro vyāhṛtayo japan |
trīnimānkṛtavām̐llokānyathāha brāhmaṇī śrutiḥ|| 8 ||
putraṃ bhūsaṃjñakaṃ caiva samutpāditavān prabhuḥ |
tato'gre tadgatasneho brahmā mānasamavyayam || 9 ||
sotpannastvagre brahmāṇamuvāca mānasaḥ sutaḥ |
karomi kiṃ te sāhāyyaṃ bravītu bhagavāniti || 10 ||
brahmovāca
ya eṣa kapilo nāma brahmā nārāyaṇastathā |
vadate varadastvāṃ tu tatkuruṣva mahāmate || 11 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
brahmaṇoktastadā bhūyaḥ saṃśayaṃ samupasthitaḥ |
śuśrūṣurasmi yuvayoḥ kiṃ kurmīti kṛtāñjaliḥ || 12 ||
parameśvarāvūcatuḥ
yat satyamakṣaraṃ brahma hyaṣṭādaśanidhaṃ smṛtam |
yat satyamamṛtaṃ caiva paraṃ tat samanusmara || 13 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
etad vaco niśamyātha sa yayau diśamuttarām |
gatvā ca tatra brahmatvamagajjñānacakṣuṣā || 14 ||
tato brahmā bhuvarnāma dvitīyamasṛjat prabhuḥ |
saṃkalpayitvā ca punarmanasaiva mahāmanāḥ || 15 ||
tataḥ so'pyabravīd vākyaṃ kiṃ kurmīti pitāmaham |
pitāmahasamājñapto brahmāṇau samupasthitaḥ || 16 ||
brahmabhyāṃ sahitaḥ so'tha bhūyo bhāgavatīṃ gataḥ |
prāptaśca paramaṃ sthānaṃ sa tayoḥ pārśvamāgataḥ || 17 ||
tasminnapi gate putraṃ tṛtīyamasṛjat prabhuḥ |
mokṣopāyeti kuśalaṃ bhūrbhuvarnāma taṃ vibhuḥ || 18||
āsasāda sa taddharmaṃ tayorevāgamad gatim |
evaṃ putrāstrayo'pyete uktāḥ śambhormahātmanaḥ || 19 ||
tān gṛhītvā sutāṃstasya prayayau svāṃ gatiṃ tathā|
nārāyaṇo'tha bhagavān kapilaśca yatīśvaraḥ || 20 ||
yaṃ kālaṃ tau gatau muktau brahmā tatkālameva tu |
tepe ghorataraṃ bhūyaḥ sa tapaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ || 21 ||
na rarāma tato brahmā prabhurekastapaścaran |
śarīrārddhamatho bhāryāṃ samutpāditavāñchubhām || 22 ||
tapasā tejasā caiva varcasā niyamena ca |
sadṛśīmātmano bhāryāṃ samarthāṃ lokasarjane || 23 ||
tayā saha tatastatra reme brahmā tapomayaḥ |
sṛjan prajāpatīn sarvānsāgarān saritastathā ||24||
tato'sṛjad vai tripadāṃ gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram|
akaroccaiva catvāro vedān gāyatrisambhavān ||25||
ātmārthe cāsṛjat putrām̐llokakartṝn pitāmahaḥ |
viśve prajānāṃ patayo yebhyo lokā viniḥsṛtāḥ || 26 ||
viśveśaṃ prathamaṃ nāma mahātapasamātmajam |
sarvāśramatamaṃ puṇyaṃ nāmnā dharmaṃ sa sṛṣṭavān || 27||
dakṣaṃ marīcimatriṃ ca pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum |
vasiṣṭhaṃ gautamaṃ caiva bhṛgumaṅgirasaṃ manum || 28 ||
atharvabhūtā ityete khyātā brahmamaharṣayaḥ |
trayodaśasutānāṃ tu ye vaṃśā vai maharṣiṇām || 29 ||
aditirditirdanuḥ kālā danāyuḥ siṃhikā muniḥ |
prabodhā surasā krodhā vinatā kadrureva ca || 30 ||
dakṣasyaitā duhitaraḥ kanyā dvādaśa bhārata |
nakṣatrāṇi ca bhadraṃ te saptaviṃśatirūrjitāḥ || 31 ||
marīceḥ kaśyapaḥ putrastapasā nirmitaḥ prabhuḥ |
tasmai kanyā dvādaśemā dakṣastā anvamanyata || 32 ||
nakṣatrākhyāni somāya vasave dattavānṛṣiḥ |
rohiṇyādīni sarvāṇi puṇyāni janamejaya || 33 ||
lakṣmīḥ kīrtistathā sādhyā viśvā kāmānugā śubhā |
devī marutvatī caiva brahmaṇā nirmitā purā || 34 ||
etāḥ pañca variṣṭhā vai suraśreṣṭhāya bhārata |
dattā dharmāya bhadraṃ te brahmaṇā dṛṣṭadharmaṇā || 35 ||
yā rūpārddhamayī patnī brahmaṇaḥ kāmarūpiṇī |
surabhiḥ sā tu gaurbhūtvā brahmāṇaṃ samupasthitā || 36 ||
tatastāmagamad brahmā maithune lokapūjitaḥ |
lokasarjanahetujño gavāmarthāya bhārata || 37 ||
jajñe caikādaśa sutān vipulān dharmasaṃhitān |
raktasaṃdhyābhrasadṛśān dahanopamatejasaḥ || 38 ||
te rudanto dravantaśca bhagavantaṃ pitāmaham |
rodanād rāvaṇāccaiva tato rudrā iti smṛtāḥ || 39 ||
nirṛtiścaiva sarpaśca tṛtīyo hyaja ekapāt |
mṛgavyādhaḥ pinākī ca dahano'theśvaraśca vai || 40 ||
ahirbudhnyaśca bhagavān kapālī cāparājitaḥ |
senānīśca mahātejā rudrā ekādaśa smṛtāḥ 41 ||
tasyāmeva surabhyāṃ tu jajñe govṛṣabhastathā |
akṛṣṭāśca tathā māṣāḥ sikatāḥ praśrayo'kṣatāḥ ||42 ||
ajāścaiva tu vatsāśca tathaivāmṛtamuttamam |
oṣadhyaḥ pravarā yāśca surabhyāṃ tāḥ samutthitāḥ || 43 ||
dharmāllakṣmyudbhavaḥ kāmaḥ sādhyā sādhyān vyajāyata |
bhavaṃ ca prabhavaṃ caivamīśānaṃ surabhī tathā || 44 ||
arundhatyāruṇī caiva viśvāvasubaladhruvau |
mahiṣaśca tanūjaśca vijñātamanasāvapi || 45 ||
matsaraśca vibhūtiśca sarvāḥ surabhisūnavaḥ |
suparvataṃ viṣaṃ nāgaṃ sādhyā lokanamaskṛtā || 46 ||
vāsavānugatā devī janayāmāsa vai sutān |
dharaṃ vai prathamaṃ devaṃ dvitīyaṃ dhruvamavyayam || 47 ||
viśvāvasuṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca caturthaṃ somamīśvaram |
pañcamaṃ parvataṃ caiva yogendraṃ tadanantaram || 48 ||
saptamaṃ ca tato vāyumaṣṭamaṃ nirṛtiṃ vasum |
dharmasyāpatyamityevaṃ surabhyāṃ samajāyata || 49 ||
viśvedevāstu viśvāyāṃ dharmājjātā iti śrutiḥ |
sudharmā ca mahābāhuḥ śaṅkhapācca mahābalaḥ || 50 ||
dakṣaścaiva mahābāhurvapuṣmāṃśca tathaiva ca |
cākṣuṣasya manorete tathānantamahīraṇau || 51 ||
viśvāvasusuparvāṇau viṣṭaraśca mahāyaśāḥ |
ruruśca ṛṣiputro vai bhāskarapratimadyutiḥ || 52 ||
viśvedevāndevamātā viśveśāñjanayatsutān |
marutvatī marutvatto devānajanayacchubhān || 53 ||
agniṃ cakṣurhavirjyotiḥ sāvitraṃ mitrameva ca |
amaraṃ śaravṛṣṭiṃ ca saṃkṣayaṃ ca mahābhujam || 54 ||
virajaṃ caiva śukraṃ ca viśvāvasuvibhāvasū|
aśmantaṃ citraraśmiṃ ca tathā niṣkupitaṃ nṛpam || 55 ||
hūyamānaṃ ca hūtiṃ ca cāritraṃ bahupannagam |
bṛhantaṃ ca bṛhadrūpaṃ tathaiva paratāpanam || 56 ||
marutvatyāṃ purā dharmājjajñe putradvayaṃ śubham |
adityāṃ jajñire rājannādityāḥ kaśyapādatha |
indro viṣṇurbhagastvaṣṭā varuṇoṃ'śo'ryamā raviḥ|| 57 ||
pūṣā mitraśca varado manuḥ parjanya eva ca |
ityete dvādaśādityā variṣṭhāstridivaukasaḥ || 58 ||
ādityasya sarasvatyāṃ jajñe putradvayaṃ śubham |
rūpaśreṣṭhaṃ balaśreṣṭhaṃ tridive rūpiṇāṃ varam || 59 ||
danustu dānavāñjajñe ditirdaityān vyajāyata |
kālā nu kālakeyāṃśca hyasurānrākṣasāṃstathā || 60 ||
danāyuṣāyāstanayā vyādhayaścādhayastathā |
siṃhikā grahamātā ca gandharvajananī muniḥ || 61 ||
prabodhāpsarasāṃ mātā surasāyāṃ sarīsṛpāḥ |
krodhāyāḥ sarvabhūtāni piśācāścaiva bhārata || 62 ||
tathā yakṣagaṇāścaiva guhyakāśca viśāmpate |
catuṣpadāni sarvāṇi ṛte gāvastu saurabhāḥ || 63 ||
aruṇo garuḍaścaiva vinatāyāṃ vyajāyata |
mahīdharān sarpanāgān devī kadrūrvyajāyata || 64 ||
evaṃ vivṛddhimagaman viśvelokāḥ parasparam|
tadā pauṣkarake rājan prādurbhāve mahātmanaḥ || 65 ||
purāṇe pauṣkaraṃ caiva mayā dvaipāyanācchrutam |
kathitaṃ tena pūrveṇa yat kṛtaṃ paramarṣibhiḥ || 66 ||
yaścedamagryaṃ prathamaṃ purāṇaṃ sadāpramattaḥ paṭhate mahātmā |
avāpya kāmāniha vītaśokaḥ paratra sa svargaphalāni bhuṅkte || 67 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṣkare sarvabhūtotpattau caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 ||

<3.15>

pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
śrutaṃ naḥ paramaṃ brahman svavaṃśacaritaṃ mahat |
divyamanyonyasambhūtaṃ mānitaṃ bahubhirguṇaiḥ || 1 ||
chandobhirvṛttasaṃjātaiḥ samāsaiśca savistaraiḥ |
laghubhirmadhurābhāṣairgrathitaṃ padavigrahaiḥ || 2 ||
trivargeṇābhisampannaṃ dharmeṇārthena bhoginām |
kāmena bahurūpeṇa śarīrāntargatena ca || 3 ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ prabhāvaiśca yodhānāṃ ca parākramaiḥ |
vairaniryātanaiścaiva pratijñānāṃ ca pāragaiḥ || 4 ||
ripustavasusampannairnānubandhaḥ pracoditaḥ |
vaṃśayornirvināśāya nṛpeṇa dvija vigrahāt || 5 ||
ye ca tasmin mahāraudre saṃgrāme nihatā nṛpāḥ |
teṣāṃ sarvāṇi rāṣṭrāṇi putrāḥ sarve prapedire || 6 ||
kauravaḥ prathito rājā bhagavacchāsanānugaḥ |
dharmaśca bahudhā proktastrayāṇāṃ varṇasampadām |
śūrāṇāmapi vikhyātaḥ svargaheturdvijarṣabha || 7 ||
anugrahārthaṃ bhūtānāṃ notsekāya kathaṃcana |
caturṇāṃ varṇasaṃjñānāṃ pṛyakpṛthaganekadhā || 8 |
garbhavāsaṃ patantaśca bhūtānāṃ samprabodhitāḥ |
pṛcchanto devasaṃcāraṃ kṣīṇe puṇye ca karmaṇi || 9 ||
dāne yaścāpi saṃyogaḥ sa cāpi bahudhā kṛtaḥ |
dvayoḥ saṃyogavihitaṃ madhu vāgvacanaṃ tayoḥ || 10 ||
na tacchakyaṃ mayā''khyātuṃ bhāratādhyayanaṃ mahat|
ekāhena mahān brahmannapi divyena cakṣuṣā || 11 ||
brahmaṇo'hnastu vistāraṃ saṃkṣepaṃ ca susaṃgraham |
śrotumicchāmi bhagavanmahatkautūhalaṃ hi me || 12 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṣkare janamejayavākye pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 ||

<3.16>

ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā rājan pañcendriyasamāhitaḥ |
kathāṃ kathayato rājan nirvikāreṇa cetasā || 1 ||
brahmasambandhasambaddhamabaddhaṃ karmabhirnṛpa |
purastād brahma sampannaṃ brahmaṇo yadadakṣiṇam || 2 ||
avyaktaṃ kāraṇaṃ yattannityaṃ sadasadātmakam |
niṣkalaḥ puruṣastasmāt sambabhūvātmayonijaḥ || 3
divyo divyena vapuṣā sarvabhūtapatirvibhuḥ |
acintyaścāvyayaścaiva yugānāṃ prabhavo'vyayaḥ || 4 ||
abhūtaścāpyajātaśca sarvatra samatāṃ gataḥ |
avyaktāt paramaṃ yat tannārāyaṇavido viduḥ || 5 ||
sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ taṃ sarvato'kṣiśiromukham |
sarvataḥ śrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati || 6 ||
asataśca sataścaiva vijñeyaṃ tatra kāraṇam |
avyakto vyaktarūpasthaścarannapi na dṛśyate || 7 ||
vikārapuruṣo'byakto hyarūpī rūpamāśritaḥ |
caratyacintyaḥ sarveṣu gūḍho'gniriva dāruṣu || 8 ||
bhūtabhavyodbhavo nāthaḥ parameṣṭhī prajāpatiḥ |
prabhuḥ sarvasya lokasya nāma cāsyeti tattvataḥ || 9||
apadāttu pado jātastasmānnārāyaṇo'bhavat |
avyakto vyaktimāpanno brahmayogena kāmataḥ || 3.16.10 ||
brahmabhāve ca taṃ viddhi saśabdaṃ labdhavān prabhuḥ |
prabhuḥ sarvasya lokasya sthāvarasyetarasya ca || 11 ||
ahaṃ tviti sa hovāca prajā srakṣyāmi bhārata |
prabhavaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yasya tanturimāḥ prajāḥ || 12 ||
svabhāvājjāyate sarvaṃ svabhāvācca tathābhavat |
ahaṃkāraḥ svabhāvācca tathā sarvamidaṃ jagat || 13 ||
sarvavyāpī nirālambo hyagrāhyo'tha jayo dhruvaḥ |
eṣa brahmamayo jyotirbrahmaśabdena śabditaḥ || 14 ||
avyakto vyaktimāpannaḥ pañcabhiḥ kratulakṣaṇaiḥ |
dhārayanbrahmaṇo vyaktaṃ vividhaṃ cintitaṃ tvaran|| 15 ||
atha mūrtiṃ samādhāya svabhāvād brahmacoditaḥ |
sasarja salilaṃ brahma yena sarvamidaṃ tatam || 16 ||
vāyuṃ pūrvamatho dṛṣṭvā yo dhāturdhātṛsattamaḥ |
dharaṇāddhātṛśabdaṃ ca labhate lokasaṃjñitam || 17 ||
tadetad vāyusambhūtaṃ kṛtsnaṃ jagadabhūt purā |
etad devairatikrāntaṃ pūrvameva sarasvati || 18 ||
pṛthaktvaṃ gamitaṃ toyaṃ pṛthivīśabdamicchatā |
ghanatvācca dravatvācca nikhilenopalabhyate || 19 ||
phalatvātsīdamānā ca salile salilodbhavā |
vyājahāra śubhāṃ vāṇīṃ samantātpūrayanniva || 3.16.20 ||
ūrdhve'haṃ sthātumicchāmi saṃsīdāmyuddharasva mām|
gambhīre toyavivare mūrtivikṣobhitāntaram || 21||
tato mūrtidharā devī sarvabhūtaprarohiṇī |
yathāyogena sambhūtā sarvatra viṣayaiṣiṇī || 22 ||
śrutvā ca gaditaṃ tasyā giraṃ tāṃ ca subhāṣitām|
varāharūpamāsthāya nipapāta mahārṇave | 23 ||
uddhṛtya so'vaniṃ toyātkṛtvā karma suduṣkaram |
samādhau pralayaṃ gatvā pralīno na ca dṛśyate || 24 ||
yattad brahmamayaṃ jyotirākāśamiti saṃjñitam |
tatra brahmā samudbhūtaḥ sarvabhūtapitāmahaḥ || 25||
adyāpi manasā dhātrā dhāryate sarvayoninā |
jñānayogena sūkṣmeṇa prajānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 26 ||
bhittvā tu pṛthivīmadhyamupayāti samudbhavam |
tapanastūrdhvamātiṣṭhan raśmibhiḥ sa hasanniva|| 27 ||
tasya maṇḍalamadhyāt tu niḥsṛtaṃ somamaṇḍalam |
sa sanātanajo brahmā saumyaṃ somatvamanvagāt || 28 ||
somamaṇḍalaparyantāt pavanaḥ samajāyata |
tadakṣaramayaṃ jyotistejobhirabhivarddhayan || 29 ||
sa tu yogamayājjñānātsvabhāvādbrahmasambhavāt|
sṛjate puruṣaṃ divyaṃ brahmayoniṃ sanātanam || 3.16.30 ||
dravaṃ yatsalilaṃ tasya ghanaṃ yatpṛthivī bhavat|
chidraṃ yacca tadākāśaṃ jyotiryaccakṣureva tat || 31 ||
vāyunā spandate cainaṃ saṃghātājjyotisambhavaḥ |
puruṣātpuruṣo bhāvaḥ pañcabhūtamayo mahān || 32 ||
bhūtātmā vai same tasmiṃstasmin dehe sanātanaḥ |
guhāyāṃ nihitaṃ jñānaṃ yogād yajjñaḥ sanātanaḥ || 33 ||
tapanasyaiva tadrūpaṃ yo'gnirvasati dehinām |
śarīre nityaśo yuktaṃ dhātubhiḥ saha saṃgataḥ || 34 ||
svabhāvātkṣayamāyāti svabhāvād bhayameti ca |
svabhāvādvindate śāntiṃ svabhāvāccana vindati||35||
indriyairatimūḍhātmā mohito brahmaṇaḥ pade |
sambhavaṃ nidhanaṃ caiva karmabhiḥ pratipadyate || 36 ||
yāvat tad brahmaviṣayaṃ nopayāti ha tattvataḥ |
tāvat saṃsāramāpnoti sambhavāṃśca punaḥ punaḥ | 37 ||
indriyairvyatirikto vai yadā bhavati yogavit |
tadā brahmatvamāpannaḥ pralayāgre pratiṣṭhati || 38 ||
pratiṣiddhamamuṃ lokaṃ brahmavān sa bhavatyuta |
na ca rāgavyayairyāti na ca sajjati karhicit || 39 ||
āgatiṃ ca gatiṃ caiva nidhanaṃ sambhavaṃ tathā |
bhūtebhyo vetti sarvajñaḥ parāṃ siddhimupāgataḥ || 3.16.40 ||
ātmano gatayaścaiva tathā viṣayagocaram |
purastātkarmanirvṛtteḥ pade brahmā pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 41 ||
cittagranthīṃśca manasā rundhyātpūrvāśca yātanāḥ |
bhidyamānāḥ pralobhena vāyubhinnamivārṇavam || 42 ||
pacyate hṛdayaṃ nīlaṃ parebhyo jñānacakṣuṣā |
brahmaproktamivātmā vai vimukto dehabandhanāt || 43 ||
sṛjedapi paraṃ lokaṃ saṃharedapi vidyayā |
tejomūrtirivāviddhamiha lokaṃ ca saṃsṛjet ||44 ||
tiryagyonau gatāṃścaiva karmabhirniyamopamaiḥ |
tānyapi pratimucyeta brahmayuktena cetasā || 45 ||
akṣaraṃ ca kṣaraṃ caiva yogakarmābhividyate |
na kṣaraṃ vidyate tatra yad brahma karmabhirdhruvam || 46 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṣkare ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 ||

<3.17>

saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
pṛthivyāṃ yat kṛtaṃ chidraṃ tapanena vivardhatā |
tasminnyasto'tha mainākaḥ svabhāvavihito'calaḥ|| 1 ||
parvabhiḥ parvatatvaṃ ca labhate nāma saṃśitam |
acalādacalatvaṃ ca svabhāvānmerureva saḥ || 2 ||
tasya pṛṣṭhe suvistīrṇe nagasya sumaharddhimān |
tasmiṃstu puruṣo vyakto vasati jyotisambhavaḥ |
vihitaśca svabhāvena tenaiva paramātmanā || 3 ||
yattad brahmamayaṃ tejo nihitaṃ śiraso'ntare |
tasya jyotirmayaṃ rūpaṃ dāntaṃ puruṣavigraham || 4 ||
vadanādabhiniṣkrāntaṃ jvalantamiva tejasā |
caturbhirvadanairyuktaṃ caturbhiśca dvijottamaiḥ || 5 ||
vaktraṃ vrahma samudbhūtaṃ brahmā brāhmaṇapuṅgavaḥ |
tadevaṃ tanmahadbhūtaṃ punarbhāvatvamāgatam || 6 ||
uddhṛtā pṛthivī devī purastātsalilāśayāt|
brahmatvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sthānādaloko lokatāṃ gataḥ || 7 ||
padasaṃdhau brahmalokaṃ śṛṅgaṃ merostadābhavat |
ucchritaṃ yojanaśataṃ sahasraśatameva ca || 8 ||
evameva ca vistāraṃ caturbhirguṇitaṃ guṇaiḥ |
athavā naiva saṃkhyātuṃ śakyaṃ bhūtena kenacit |
samāḥ sahasrairbahubhirapi divyena tejasā || 9 ||
caturbhiḥ pārśvavistāraiḥ śilābhirabhisaṃvṛtaiḥ |
nagasya yasya rājendra vistāraiḥ śatayojanaiḥ || 3.17.10 ||
koṭikoṭīśataguṇairguṇitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ |
yogayuktaiḥ sadā siddhairnityaṃ brahmaparāyaṇaiḥ || 11 ||
marudbhiḥ saha devendrai rudrairvasubhireva ca |
ādityairviśvasahitai rarakṣa vasudhādhipān || 12 ||
rarakṣa pṛthivīṃ caiva bhagavān viṣṇunā saha |
vivasvadvaruṇābhyāṃ ca saṃghātaṃ gamitaṃ nṛpa || 13 ||
tena brāhmeṇa vapuṣā brahmaprāptena bhārata |
yattad viṣṇumayaṃ tejaḥ sarvatra samatāṃ gatam || 14 ||
yattad brahmeti vai proktaṃ brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ |
niyamairbahubhiḥ prāptaiḥ satyavrataparāyaṇaiḥ || 15 ||
evamete trayo lokā brāhme'hani samāhitāḥ |
ahani brahma cāvyaktaṃ vyaktaṃ prāṇe pratiṣṭhitam || 16 ||
brahmaṇo niyataṃ karma prabhāveṇa pracoditam |
pravartamānaṃ bhāvena śaśvadacchalavādinām || 17 ||
etaddhitamiti proktaṃ brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ |
yadekaṃ brahmaṇaḥ pādaṃ diṣṭatvaṃ gamitaṃ padam || 18 ||
bahutvād viprabhāvānāṃ viśvaśabdaḥ prayujyate |
brāhmaṇairbrahma bhūtātmā satyavrataparāyaṇaiḥ || 19 ||
viśvarūpaṃ manorūpaṃ buddhirūpaṃ ca mānayan |
evaṃ dvandvaṃ sa bhagavān prathamaṃ mithunaṃ sṛjat || 3.17.20 ||
sa eva bhagavān viśvo devyā saha sanātanaḥ |
vidhāya vipulānbhogānbrahmā carati sānugaḥ|| 21 ||
sa eṣa bhagavān brahmā nityaṃ brahmavidāṃ varaḥ |
nirvāṇapadagantṝṇāmakiṃcanapathaiṣiṇām || 22 ||
somātsomaḥ samutpanno dhārāsalilavigrahāt |
yayābhiṣikto bhūtānāmādhipatye maheśvaraḥ || 23 ||
abhiṣicya ca bhūteśaṃ kṛtvā karma svabhāvataḥ |
nadati sma tadā nādaṃ tena sā hyucyate nadī || 24 ||
sā brahmalokaṃ sambhāvya abhibhūya sahasradhā |
gāṃ gatā gaganād devī saptadhā prasasāra ca || 25 ||
sahasradhā ca rājendra bahudhā ca punaḥ punaḥ |
imaṃ lokamamuṃ caiva bhāvayan kṣarasambhavam || 26||
tato bhūtāni rohanti mahābhūtaphalāni ca |
tataḥ sarve kriyārambhāḥ pravartante manīṣiṇām || 27 ||
caturbhirvadanaistasya mukhapadmād viniḥsṛtā |
tadākṣaramayī siddhirdiśatvaṃ samupāgatā || 28 ||
tasya jñānamayaṃ puṇyaṃ catuṣpādaṃ sanātanam |
patitvenābhavad devo brahmā cātra pitāmahaḥ || 29 ||
pādā dharmasya catvāro yairidaṃ dhāryate jagat |
brahmacaryeṇa vyaktena gṛhasthena ca pāvane || 3.17.30 ||
gurubhāvena vākyena guhyagāminagāminā |
ityete dharmapādāḥ syuḥ svargahetoḥ pracoditāḥ || 31 ||
nyāyād dharmeṇa guhyena somo vardhati maṇḍale |
brahmaṇo brahmacaraṇād vedā vartanti śāśvatāḥ || 32 ||
gṛhasthāmabhi vākyena tṛpyanti pitarastathā |
ṛṣayo'pi ca dharmeṇa nagasya śirasi sthitāḥ || 33 ||
nagasya tasya sampaśya meroḥ śikharamuttamam |
padbhyāṃ sampīḍya vṛṣaṇāvṛṣibhistairvicāryate || 34 ||
grīvāṃ nigṛhya pṛṣṭhaṃ ca vināmya prahasanniva |
nābhideśe karau nyasya sarvaśo'ṅgāni saṃkṣipan || 35 ||
mūrdhni brahma samutkṣipya manasāpi pitāmahaḥ |
asṛjanmanasā viṣṇuṃ yogād yogeśvarasya ca || 36 ||
vyatiriktendriyo viṣṇurbimbādbimbamivoddhṛtaḥ|
tejomūrtidharo devo nabhasīndurivoditaḥ || 37 ||
rarāja brahmayogena sahasrāṃśurivāparaḥ |
virājannabhaso madhye prabhābhiratulaṃ prabhuḥ || 38 ||
nopalabhyati mūḍhātmā pratyakṣaṃ brahma śāśvatam |
lalāṭamadhye tiṣṭhantaṃ dvidhābhūtaṃ kriyāṃ pratiṃ || 39 ||
jyotiścakṣuṣi sambaddhaṃ bimbaṃ bhāskarasomayoḥ |
buddhyā pūrvaṃ tu paśyanti adhyātmaviṣaye ratāḥ || 3.17.40
brāhmaṇā vedavidvāṃsaḥ satyavrataparāyaṇāḥ |
netare jātu paśyanti adhyātmaṃ nāvabudhyate || 41 ||
hiṃsāyogairayogātmā sarvaprāṇacarairnṛpa |
bhūtayo bhuvi bhūteśo mohaprāptena cetasā || 42 ||
karmabhiḥ kutsitairanyaiḥ sarvaprāṇivadhaiṣiṇām |
narāṇāṃ yogamādhāya sveṣu mātreṣu bhārata || 43 ||
samāhitamanā brahman mokṣaprāptena hetunā |
candramaṇḍalasaṃsthānājjyotiścāndraṃ mahat tadā || 44 ||
praviśya hṛdayaṃ kṣipraṃ gāyatryā nayanāntare |
garbhasya sambhavo yaśca caturdhā puruṣātmakaḥ || 45 ||
brahmatejomayo'vyaktaḥ śāśvato'tha dhuvo'vyayaḥ|
na cendriyaguṇairyukto yuktastejoguṇena ca || 46 ||
candrāṃśuvimalaprakhyo bhrājiṣṇurvarṇasaṃsthitaḥ |
netrābhyāṃ janayad devo ṛgvedaṃ yajuṣā saha || 47 ||
sāmavedaṃ ca jihvāgrādatharvāṇaṃ ca mūrdhataḥ |
jātamātrāstu te vedāḥ kṣetraṃ vindanti tattvataḥ|| 48 ||
tena vedatvamāpannā yasmād vindanti tatpadam |
te sṛjanti tadā vedā brahma pūrvaṃ sanātanam || 49 ||
puruṣaṃ divyarūpābhaṃ svaiḥ svairbhāvairmanobhavaiḥ |
atharvaṇastu yo yogaḥ śīrṣaṃ yajñasya tat smṛtam || 3.17.50 ||
grīvābāhvantaraṃ caiva ṛgbhāgaḥ sa bhavet tataḥ |
hṛdayaṃ caiva pārśvaṃ ca sāmabhāgastu nirmitaḥ || 51 ||
bastiśīrṣaṃ kaṭīdeśaṃ jaṅghorucaraṇaiḥ saha |
evameṣa yajurbhāgaḥ saṃghāto yajñakalpitaḥ |
puruṣo divyarūpābhaḥ sambhūto hyamarātpadāt || 52 ||
sa hi vedamayo yajñaḥ sarvabhūtasukhāvahaḥ |
ubhayorlokayostāta hiṃsāvarjyaḥ sanātanaḥ || 53 ||
yogārambhaṃ karmasādhyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ sanātanam |
prabhavaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yo vindati sa vedavit || 54 ||
sa siddhaḥ procyate loke siddhireva na saṃśayaḥ |
nirmuktaiḥ sarvakarmabhyo munibhirvedapāragaiḥ || 55 ||
vaiṣṇavaṃ yajñamityevaṃ bruvate vedapāragāḥ |
brāhmaṇā niyamaśrāntā vedopaniṣade pade | 56 ||
janamejaya uvāca
cetasastūpalambhe hi manogrāhyasya kāmataḥ |
kāraṇaṃ śrotumicchāmi yathā tvaṃ manyase mune || 57 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
na hyasya kāraṇaṃ kiṃcid bāhyaṃ bhavati bhārata |
antargataṃ kāraṇaṃ tu śārīraṃ mānasaṃ nṛpa || 58 ||
yena vedyaṃ vidurmartyā brāhmaṇāḥ saṃśitavratāḥ |
avedyamapi vedyaṃ ca śakyaṃ vettuṃ na karmaṇā || 59 ||
brāhmaṇena vinītena sadā brahmaniṣeviṇā |
sadā viditatattvena siddhihetormahīpate || 3.17.60 ||
sadā caiva śucirbhūtvā niyato brahmakarmaṇā |
upatiṣṭheta sa guruṃ baddhāñjalipuṭo dvijaḥ || 61 ||
sāyaṃ prātaśca tattvajño mokṣakarmāṇi kārayet|
vinīto brahmabhāvena samāhitamatirmuniḥ || 62||
samprapadyeta manasā vaiṣṇavaṃ padamuttamam |
dhyāyanneva prasīdeta samāhitamatirdvijaḥ || 63 ||
gacchate paramaṃ brahma nirvikāreṇa cetasā |
apunarbhavabhāvajño nirmamo bhāvabandhanāt || 64 ||
tadevākṣaramityāhuryat tad brahma sanātanam |
tarhi tatkarmayogena vidyāyogena darśitam || 65 ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ vinītānāṃ vaiṣṇave padasaṃcaye |
sarvadravyātiriktānāṃ kāmayogavigarhiṇām || 66 ||
apunarbhāvināṃ lokāḥ karmayogapratiṣṭhitāḥ |
anādānena manasā rājan karmaṇi karmaṇi || 67 ||
ādānād badhyate janturnirādānāt pramucyate |
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ kriyāvāptirjantoḥ pūrvājjanādhipa || 68||
muktaścendriyabandhena prāptaśca paramaṃ padam|
na bhūyaḥ punarāyāti mānuṣaṃ dehavigraham || 69 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṣkare saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 ||

<3.18>

aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
upasargaṃ ca yogaṃ ca dhyātavyaṃ caiva yatpadam |
na bhūyaḥ punarāyāti mānuṣaṃ dehavigraham |
siddhiṃ siddhiguṇāṃścaiva śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ|| 1 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śṛṇu vistarataḥ sarvaṃ yathā pṛcchasi medhayā |
upapannena manasā brahmādīnāmanekadhā || 2 ||
pañcasiddhiguṇāṃstyaktvā paśyato brahmaṇo nṛpa |
yogayuktena manasā pañcendriyanivāsinaḥ || 3 ||
brahmaṇaścintayānasya brahmayajñaṃ sanātanam |
bahurūpamanaiśvaryāt pravartati nirodhanam || 4 ||
pañcendriyasya grāmasya navadvārasya bhārata |
kāmakrodhasya lobhasya saṃniruddhasya medhayā || 5 ||
tejasā mūrdhni cādhāya dhūmo dodhūyate mahān |
nīlalohitavarṇābhaiḥ pītaiḥ śvetaiśca dhātubhiḥ || 6 ||
māñjiṣṭharāgavarṇābhaiḥ kapotasadṛśaistathā |
śuddhavaidūryavarṇābhaiḥ padmarāgasamaprabhaiḥ || 7 ||
sphāṭikairmaṇivarṇābhaināgendrasadṛśaistathā |
indragopakavarṇābhaiścandrāṃśusalilaprabhaiḥ || 8 ||
bahuvarṇaiḥ sudhūmaughairindrāyudhasamaprabhaiḥ |
sampatadbhiśca yugapanmeghairiva samāgataḥ |
nirudhyata ivākāśaṃ pakṣavadbhirivādribhiḥ || 9 ||
te dhūmavarṇāḥ saṃghātā ghanāḥ saliladhāriṇaḥ |
nirvemuścaiva toyaughān viviśurvasudhātale || 3.18.10 ||
mūrdhni caiva mahānagnirmānaso dhūyate prabhuḥ |
yuktaḥ paramayogena śataśo'rcibhirāvṛtaḥ || 11 ||
tasyārcervisphuliṅgānāṃ sahastrāṇi śatāni ca |
visasruḥ sarvagātrebhyo jvalanniva yugāgnayaḥ || 12 ||
yāvatyo varṣadhārāstu tāvatyo 'rcyo 'nalasya ca |
srameyurvāridhārābhirvipule vasudhātale || 13 ||
varṇābhyāṃ yujyamānasya vāyurdodhūyate mahān |
divyasiddhaguṇodbhūtaḥ sūkṣmaprāṇavivardhanaḥ || 14 ||
vegavān bhīmanirghoṣo balavān prāṇagocaraḥ |
taireva cāgnisaṃghātairdhātubhiḥ saha saṃgataḥ || 15 ||
sahasraśo'tha śataśo mūrtiṃ kṛtvā pṛthagvidhām |
agnirvāyurjalaṃ bhūmirdhātavo brahmacoditāḥ || 16 ||
samavāyatvamāpannā bījabhūtā mahīpate |
saṃghātaṃ brahmavegena dhātavo gamitā nṛpa || 17 ||
yad brahma cakṣupormadhye sa sūkṣmaḥ puruṣo virāṭ |
tayoranyān bahūn sūkṣmān sasṛje puruṣottamaḥ|| 18 ||
sa eva bhagavānviṣṇurvyaktāvyaktaḥ sanātanaḥ |
ādhāraḥ sarvavidyānāṃ pralaye pralayāntakṛt || 19 ||
taṃ mūrdhni dhātubhirnaddhaṃ viśanti brahmacoditāḥ |
te'ntarāḥ puruṣāḥ sarve jñātāraḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ || 3.18.20 ||
atha ceṣṭitumārabdhā mūrtayo brahmasammitāḥ |
bhittvā ca dharaṇīṃ daivīṃ prāpadyanta diśo daśa || 21 ||
ityete pārthavāḥ sarve ṛṣayo brahmanirmitāḥ |
tatraiva pralayaṃ yātā bhūmitvamupayānti ca || 22 ||
karmakṣayād vimucyante dhātubhiḥ karmabandhanaiḥ |
karmakṣayād vimuktatvādindriyāṇāṃ ca bandhanāt|| 23 ||
tāmeva prakṛtiṃ yānti ajñātāṃ karmagocaraiḥ |
kṣarād dhūmakṣayaṃ caiva agnigarbhāstapomayāḥ || 24 ||
yena tanturivācchanno bhāvābhāvaḥ pravartate |
dhūmādabhrāstu sambhūtā abhrāttoyaṃ sunirmalam|| 25 ||
jagatī jalāttu sambhūtā jagatyeva ca yatphalam
phalādrasastu saṃjajñe rasātprāṇastu dehinām|| 26 ||
rasaśca tanmayo jajñe yattad brahma sanātanam |
pradhānaṃ brahma coddiṣṭaṃ bahubhiḥ kāraṇāntaraiḥ |
brāhmaṇaistapasi śrāntaiḥ satyavrataparāyaṇaiḥ || 27 ||
avyaktād vyaktimāpannaṃ svena bhāvena bhārata |
antaḥsthaṃ sarvabhūteṣu carantaṃ vidyayā saha || 28 ||
karma karteti rājendra viṣayasthamanekadhā |
nopalabhyeta cakṣurbhyāṃ tapasā dagdhakilbiṣaiḥ || 29 ||
upalabhyeta cakṣurbhyo jñānibhirbrahmavādibhiḥ |
niḥsṛtastu bhruvormadhyānmeghamukta ivāṃśumān || 3.18.30 ||
caradbhiḥ pakṣivalloke nirdvandvairniṣparigrahaiḥ |
yogadharmeṇa kauravya dhuvamāsādyate phalam || 31 ||
prādurbhāvaṃ kṣayaṃ caiva bhūtasya nidhanaṃ tathā |
vidhatte śataśo brahmā saṃkṣaye ca bhavet tadā || 32 ||
karmaṇaḥ karma yogajño bhūtebhyo nātra saṃśayaḥ |
avināśāya lokasya dharmasyāpyāyanena ca || 33 ||
yugaṃ dvādaśasāhasraṃ sahasrayugasaṃhitam |
etad brahmayugaṃ nāma yugānāṃ prathamaṃ yugam || 34 ||
sahasrayugayorante saṃhāraḥ pralayāntakṛt|
sūkṣmaṃ bhavati lokānāṃ nirvikāramacetanam || 35 ||
tathā pralayamāpannaṃ jagat sarvaṃ sanātanam |
brahma sampadyate sūkṣmaṃ nirmitaṃ kāraṇairguṇaiḥ || 36 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṣkare aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 ||

<3.19>

ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
prāgvaṃśaṃ śrotumicchāmi vistareṇa mahāmune |
ādyayoryugayorbrahman brahmaprāptasya sarvaśaḥ || 1 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śṛṇu vistaraśaḥ sarvaṃ yanmāṃ pṛcchasi medhayā |
upapannena manasā daivapratyayasādhinā || 2 ||
ṛddhi prāptastu bhagavān yogātmā brahmasambhavaḥ |
bhūtānāṃ bahulatvaṃ ca cakāreheśvaraḥ prabhuḥ || 3 ||
sthito brahmāsane brahmā vikṣiptaḥ sahasā prabhuḥ |
acalenaiva bhāvena sthāṇubhūtena bhārata || 4 ||
raktaśca mokṣaviṣaye sa ca jñānamaye pade |
yasmāt padasahasrāṇi prabhavanti bhavanti ca || 5 ||
brahmayajñaṃ tu yajate yogād vedātmakaṃ sadā |
brahmaṇo vipulaṃ jñānamaiśvaryaṃ ca pravartate || 6 ||
tataḥ prathamamaiśvaryaṃ yuñjānena pravartitam |
brahmaṇā brahmabhūtena bhūtānāṃ hitamicchatā || 7 ||
tadā tvākāśamaiśvaryaṃ yuñjānasya pravartate |
brahmaṇo brahmabhūtasya nirvikāreṇa karmaṇā || 8 ||
tadāntarikṣaṃ samprāptaṃ nirmalaṃ brahma cāvyayam |
saṃhāraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ narāṇāṃ brahmavādinām |
dhruvamaiśvaryayogānāṃ pratipadyanti dehinaḥ || 9 ||
ākāśaiśvaryabhūtena saṃyuge brahmavādinā |
pravartamānamaiśvaryaṃ vāyubhūtaṃ karoti ca |
vikārairbahubhiḥ prāptaiḥ sampatadbhirmahābalaiḥ || 3.19.10 ||
etairvikāraiḥ saṃvṛttairniruddhaiśca samantataḥ |
dhruvamaiśvaryamāpannaḥ siddho bhavati brāhmaṇaḥ || 11 ||
śarīrādabhiniṣkramya ākāśena pradhāvati |
nirālambo nirālambānnālambya manasā tataḥ || 12 ||
aiśvaryabhūto bhūtātmā caran divi na dṛśyate |
cakṣurbhirbahubhirlokaiḥ puraṃdarasamairapi || 13 ||
oṃkāraṃ ye tvadhīyante manasā brahmasattamāḥ |
vimuktāḥ sarvakarmabhyaste taṃ paśyanti sādhavaḥ || 14 ||
etaddhi paramaṃ brahma brāhmaṇānāṃ manīṣiṇām |
antaścarati bhūtānāṃ viddhi cetanayā saha || 15 ||
eṣa śabdo mahānādaḥ purāṇo brahmasambhavaḥ |
vāyubhūto'kṣaraṃ prāpto vadantyevaṃ dvijātayaḥ || 16 ||
arūpī rūpasampanno dhātubhiḥ saha saṃgataḥ |
antaścarati bhūteṣu kāmakārakaro vaśī ||17 ||
etat pūrvamanudhyāya manasā''pūrayanniva |
vedātmakaṃ tadā yajñaṃ cintayanto manīṣiṇaḥ ||18 ||
brāhmaṇāḥ śucayo dāntā yaśoyuñjastadanvayāḥ |
brahmalokaṃ kāṅkṣamāṇā vaiṣṇavaṃ padamuttamam || 19||
padahetoḥ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ kurvanti vigatajvarāḥ |
na hyete prasavādāne bhavamicchanti bhārata || 3.19.20
tribhirmālyopahāraiśca pratibhāvaiśca vai dvijāḥ |
yajanti paramātmānaṃ viṣṇuṃ satyaparākramam ||21 ||
yajanaṃ vikramaṃ caiva brahmapūrvāḥ pracakrire |
brahmāpi vaiṣṇavaṃ tejo vedoktairvacanairnṛpa || 22 ||
brāhmaṇairbrahmavidbhiśca brahmajñairbrahmavādibhiḥ |
śucibhiḥ karmanirmuktaiḥ satyavrataparāyaṇaiḥ || 23 ||
dhātubhirmokṣakāle ca mahātmā sampradṛśyate |
tadeva paramaṃ brahma vaiṣṇavaṃ paramādbhutam || 24 ||
rasātmakaṃ tadaiśvaryaṃ vikārānte pradṛśyate |
ghorarūpā vikārāste vyathayanti mahātmanaḥ ||25 ||
saṃchādyātīva toyena kṣubhyamāṇo vicetanaḥ |
ūrmibhiśchādyate caiva śītoṣṇābhirvikārataḥ || 26 ||
mahārṇavagataścaiva dahyate na ca majjate |
magnaścaiva mahānadyāḥ salile naiva sīdati || 27 ||
sīdamānaśca salile sa śīte pātyate balāt |
vyasanācchādanāccaiva mucyamāno vicetanaḥ || 28 ||
śvabhre prapadyamānaśca toyena pariṣicyate |
śuklavarṇena bahunā srotasā mūrdhni sarvaśaḥ || 29||
ūrdhvaṃ jyotiravekṣaṃśca śuklaiḥ pītaiśca bādhyate |
vāridapūrṇaiḥ sugambhīrairvidyudbhiriva bhāsitaiḥ || 3.19.30 ||
etairvikāraiḥ saṃvṛttainirruddhaiścaiva sarvaśaḥ |
dhruvamaiśvaryamāsādya siddho bhavati brāhmaṇaḥ || 31 ||
rasātmakaṃ tadaiśvaryaṃ jihvāgrādabhiniḥsṛtam |
sahasradhāraṃ vitataṃ meghatvaṃ samupāgatam || 32 ||
rasāṃśca vividhān yogāt saṃsiddhaḥ sṛjate prabhuḥ|
dhātvarthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yogaprāptena hetunā || 33 |
tejaso rūpamaiśvaryaṃ vikāraiḥ saha vardhate |
ātmano vighnajananaṃ svastho brāhmaṇakāraṇe || 34
uprarūpairvirūpaiśca hanyate daṇḍapāṇibhiḥ |
ghorarūpaiḥ sugambhīraiḥ piṅgākṣairnaravigrahaiḥ || 35 ||
netraṃ samuddharan bhīmo jihvāgraṃ cāsya vindati |
nadanti yugapannādaṃ jṛmbhamāṇāḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 36 ||
punareva tadā bhūtvā bahurūpāstadābhavan |
nṛtyamānāḥ pragāyanti tarpayanto viśeṣataḥ || 37 ||
strībhūtāśca tataḥ sarve yuñjānāścāvalambire |
kaṇṭhe'sya bahurūpatvād vighnaiścaiva pralobhayan || 38 ||
madhurairabhidhānaiśca vyāharanti na bhītavat |
patanti yugapat sarve pādayormūrdhabhiryutāḥ || 39 ||
prasādaṃ kāṅkṣamāṇāśca yogasyāntaravighnataḥ |
bahuprakāraṃ kathayan nṛtyanti ca taranti ca || 3.19.40 ||
etairvikāraiḥ saṃvṛttairniruddhaiścaiva sarvaśaḥ |
bhuvamaiśvaryamāsādya siddho bhavati brāhmaṇaḥ || 41 ||
tadarciṣa ivāgneyā ādityasyeva raśmayaḥ |
tejorūpakamaiśvaryaṃ janitāstejabindavaḥ || 42 ||
jyotīṃṣi caiva saṃvṛttā ākāśe guṇasaṃvṛtāḥ |
caranti loke satataṃ sūryācandramasorgatim || 43
candrasūryātmakaṃ divyaṃ jyotiḥ saghanamuttamam |
etad vibhrājate loke kālacakraṃ dhruvaṃ varam || 44||
ardhamāsāśca māsāśca ṛtusaṃvatsarāṇyatha |
kṣaṇā lavā muhūrtāśca kalāḥ kāṣṭhāstathaiva ca || 45 ||
ahorātrapramāṇaṃ ca nimiṣonmeṣaṇaṃ tathā |
tārāṇāṃ gatayaścaiva grahāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 46 ||
atha pārthivamaiśvaryaṃ vikāragrahasambhavam |
yogayuktāstvabhigrastāḥ pātyante hyacalāsanāt||47 ||
alobhācchidyate sadyo vepamāno'nukīrtyate |
sīdate vasudhāmadhye bhidyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 48||
bhūtānāṃ bahurūpaiśca anyaiśca talavāsibhiḥ |
viṣayairyujyate kṣipraṃ saṃkṣepāt samavaruddhyate || 49 ||
tataḥ pārthivamaiśvaryaṃ sevamānaśca sarvataḥ |
mūrtimadbhiśca bahudhā dhātubhiḥ sa ca hanyate || 3.19.50 ||
śaktitomaranistriṃśairgadābhiścāpyanekadhā |
asibhiḥ pātyate caiva kṣuradhāraiḥ sahasraśaḥ || 51 ||
bhidyate caiva bāṇāgraiḥ sutīkṣṇairmarmabhedibhiḥ |
ebhirvikārairnirvṛttairniruddhaiścaiva sarvaśaḥ || 52 ||
bhuvamaiśvaryamāpannaḥ siddho bhavati brāhmaṇaḥ |
tataḥ pārthivamaiśvaryaṃ nirmuktasya vikārataḥ || 53 ||
prādurbhavati saṃjāte samādhau pralayaṃ gate |
divyaṃ gandhaṃ samāghrāya divyārthāṃstāñchṛṇoti ca || 54 ||
divyarūpaiśca puruṣaiśchidyate na ca bhidyate |
gacchan sukṛtināṃ cāntaḥ pradhānātmā kṣaranniva|| 55 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṣkare ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 ||

<3.20>

viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tato'nyāṃ dhāraṇāṃ gatvā manasā sa pitāmahaḥ |
brahmakarmasamārambhaṃ nirmuktenāntarātmanā || 1 ||
sarvāṅgadhāraṇāṃ kṛtvā manasā prahasanniva |
brahmayogena ca brahmā sṛjate manasā prajāḥ || 2 ||
cakṣuṣo rūpasampannā hyapsarāḥ sṛjate prabhuḥ |
nāsikāgrācca gandharvān sucitrāmbaravāsasaḥ || 3 ||
tumburupramukhān sarvāñchataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ |
nṛtyavāditrakuśalān kuśalān sāmagītiṣu 4 ||
brahmayogena yogajñaḥ svayambhūrbhagavān prabhuḥ |
cārunetrāṃ sukeśāntāṃ subhrūṃ cārunibhānanām || 5 ||
padmena śatapatreṇa cāruṇā suvirājitām |
svakṣāṃ śucigiraṃ sevyāṃ brāhmīṃ mūrtimatīṃ śriyam|| 6 ||
sasṛje manasā brahmā samyakproktena cetasā |
bhāvayogena bhūtātmā sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ nṛpa || 7 ||
cakṣuṣo rūpasampannāḥ sṛjan so'psarasaḥ prabhuḥ|
nāsikāgrācca gandharvān suvāsaḥ supravāditān|| 8 ||
gānaprabhāṣaṃ saṃcakre gandharvāṇāmaśeṣataḥ |
anyeṣāṃ caiva viprāṇāṃ gānaṃ brahmaprabhāṣitam || 9 ||
padbhyāṃ sṛjati bhūtāni gatimanti dhruvāṇi ca |
narakinnarayakṣāṃśca piśācoragarākṣasān || 3.20.10 ||
gajān siṃhāṃśca vyāghrāṃśca mṛgāṃścaiva sahasraśaḥ |
tṛṇajātīśca bahudhā bhāvahetoścatuṣpadān || 11 ||
ye tu hastānnikhādanti karmaprāptena hetunā |
hastebhyaḥ karma sasṛje mantavyaṃ manasā tathā || 12 ||
vāyunā sa visargaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ sukhamicchatā |
upatasthe tadānandaṃ pañcendriyasamādhinā || 13 ||
hṛdayādasṛjad gāvo bāhubhyāṃ pakṣiṇastathā |
anyāni caiva sattvāni taistairveṣaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ || 14 ||
ṛṣiṃ tvaṅgirasaṃ caiva muniṃ jvalitatejasam |
brahmavaṃśakaraṃ divyaṃ vyatiṣiktaṣaḍindriyam || 15 ||
bhruvo'ntarādajanayad yogād yogeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ |
brahmavaṃśakaraṃ divyaṃ bhṛguṃ paramadhārmikam || 16 ||
lalāṭamadhyādasṛjannāradaṃ priyavigraham |
sanatkumāraṃ mūrdhnaśca mahāyogī pitāmahaḥ || 17 ||
abhiṣiktaṃ tu somaṃ ca yauvarājye pitāmahaḥ |
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca rājānaṃ śāśvataṃ rajanīśvaram || 18 ||
tapasā mahatā yukto grahaiḥ saha niśākaraḥ |
cacāra nabhaso madhye prabhābhirbhāsayan jagat || 19 ||
sa gātrairbhagavān yogānmanasā siddhimāgataḥ |
sasṛje sarvabhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca || 3.20.20 ||
tatra sthānāni bhūtānāṃ yogāṃścaiva pṛthagvidhān |
vyadhatta śataśo brahmā sarvabhūtapitāmahaḥ || 21 ||
eṣa brahmamayo yajño yogaḥ sāṃkhyaśca tattvataḥ |
vijñānaṃ ca svabhāvaśca kṣetraṃ kṣetrajña eva ca || 22 ||
ekatvaṃ ca pṛthaktvaṃ ca sambhavo nidhanaṃ tathā |
kālaḥ kālakṣayaścaiva jñeyo vijñānameva ca || 23 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṣkare viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 ||

<3.21>

ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
śrutaṃ brahmayugaṃ brahman yugānāṃ prathamaṃ yugama|
kṣatrasyāpi yugaṃ brahmañchrotumicchāmyahaṃ prabho || 1 ||
sasaṃkṣepaṃ savistāraṃ niyamairbahubhiścitam |
upāyajñaiśca kathitaṃ kratubhiścaiva śobhitam || 2||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
etatte kathayiṣyāmi yahyakarmabhirarcitam |
dānadharmaiśca vividhaiḥ prajābhirupaśobhitam || 3 |
te'ṅguṣṭhamātrā munaya ādattāḥ sūryaraśmibhiḥ |
mokṣaprāptena vidhinā nirābādhena karmaṇā || 4 ||
pravṛtte cāpravṛtte ca nityaṃ brahmaparāyaṇāḥ |
parāyaṇasya saṃgamya brahmaṇastu mahīpate || 5 |
śrīvṛtāḥ pāvanāścaiva brāhmaṇāśca mahīpate |
caritabrahmacaryāśca brahmajñānāvabodhitāḥ || 6 |
pūrṇe yugasahasrānte prabhāve pralayaṃ gatāḥ |
brāhmaṇā vṛtasampannā jñānasiddhāḥ samāhitāḥ || 7 |
vyatiriktendriyo viṣṇuryogātmā brahmasrambhavaḥ |
dakṣaḥ prajāpatirbhūtvā sṛjate vipulāḥ prajāḥ || 8 ||
akṣarādbrāhmaṇāḥ saumyāḥ kṣarātkṣatriyabāndhavāḥ|
vaiśyā vikārataścaiva śūdrā dhūmavikārataḥ || 9 ||
śvetalohitakairvarṇaiḥ pītairnīlaiśca brāhmaṇāḥ |
abhinirvartitā varṇāścintayānena viṣṇunā || 3.21.10 ||
tato varṇatvamāpannāḥ prajā loke caturvidhāḥ |
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścaiva mahīpate || 11 ||
ekaliṅgāḥ pṛthagdharmā dvipadāḥ paramādbhutāḥ |
yātanāyābhisampannā gatijñāḥ sarvakarmasu || 12 ||
trayāṇāṃ varṇajātānāṃ vedaproktāḥ kriyāḥ smṛtāḥ|
tena vo brahmayogena vaiṣṇavena mahīpate || 13 ||
prajñayā tejasā yogāttasmāt prācetasaḥ prabhuḥ |
viṣṇureva mahāyogī karmaṇāmantaraṃ gataḥ || 14 ||
tato nirmāṇasambhūtāḥ śūdrāḥ karmavivarjitāḥ |
tasmānnārhanti saṃskāraṃ na hyatra brahma vidyate || 15 ||
yathāgnau dhūmasaṃghāto hyaraṇyā mathyamānayā |
prādurbhūto visarpan vai nopayuñjanti karmaṇi || 16
