evaṃ śūdrā visarpanto bhuvi kārtsnyena janmanā |
nāsaṃskṛtena dharmeṇa vedaproktena karmaṇā || 17 ||
tato'nye dakṣaputrāśca sambhūtā brahmayonayaḥ |
balavanto mahotsāhā mahāvīryā mahaujasaḥ || 18 ||
pitrā proktā mahātmāno dakṣiṇā yajñakarmaṇā |
antamicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ dhātryāḥ putrā balo hyaham|| 19 ||
tato vidhāsye tattvajñāḥ prajānāṃ vipulaṃ balam |
vipulatvāddhi kṣetrāṇāṃ mamāpi vipulāḥ prajāḥ|| 3.21.20 ||
na teṣāṃ darśayad devī cakṣuṣā rūpamātmanaḥ |
prajāpatisutānāṃ vai vipulāsāramicchatām || 21 |
ātmano bhāvanirvṛtte bhāve kṛtayuge tadā |
janitrī sarvabhūtānāmaṇḍajānudbhijāṃstathā || 22 ||
saṃvedajananī dhātrī ceti mātrā pracoditā |
aṇutāṃ tanutāṃ caiva jantūnāṃ karmabhoginām || 23
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṣkare ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 ||

<3.22>

dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
sādhvahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tretāyāṃ brāhmaṇottama |
yajjñātvā sarvavidyānāṃ paraṃ paśyeyamavyayam || 1 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
dakṣastu punarālambya strībhāvaṃ puruṣottamaḥ |
yogād yogeśvarātmānaṃ niṣaṇṇo girimūrdhani || 2 ||
sujānuḥ pīnajaghanā subhrūraḥ padmanibhānanā |
raktāntanayanā kāntā sarvabhūtamanoramā ||3||
dakṣaḥ prācetasastasyāṃ kanyāyāṃ janayat prabhuḥ |
dehārdhayogavidhinā kanyāḥ padmanibhānanāḥ || 4 ||
dakṣaḥ puruṣarūpeṇa strīrūpamapahāya vai |
darśane sarvabhūtānāṃ kāntaḥ kāntataro'bhavat || 5 ||
tāḥ kanyāḥ pradadau dakṣaḥ svayaṃ prācetasaḥ prabhuḥ |
brahmadeyena vidhinā brahmaprāptena bhārata || 6 ||
pradadau daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa |
saptaviṃśati somāya patnīhetoḥ samāhitaḥ || 7 ||
dakṣo dattvātha tāḥ kanyā brahmakṣetraṃ prapadya ca |
brahmaṇādhyuṣitaṃ puṇyaṃ samāhitamanā muniḥ || 8 ||
tapyamāno mṛgaiḥ sārdhaṃ cacāra vasudhāṃ nṛpa |
tṛṇamūlaphalairvṛddho vṛddhaśca tapasāsakṛt || 9 ||
mṛgāstu tasya modanti phalaṃ modanti brāhmaṇāḥ |
dīkṣitāḥ puṇyakarmāṇastapasā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ || 3.22.10 ||
saṃgrāmakāle kālajñaḥ śarīrādipatirmuniḥ |
karmayajñakṛtāṃ tāta siddhiṃ paśyati lakṣaṇāt || 11 ||
dānamānapravīrāśca nirudvegā nirāmiṣāḥ |
mṛgaiḥ saha jarāṃ yānti sapatnīkāḥ suputriṇaḥ || 12 ||
brāhmaṇāḥ stotrasaṃsiddhā janitre prathame pade |
brahmaṇādhyuṣitatvācca brahmakṣetramihocyate || 13 ||
yatibhiḥ karmabhirmuktairjitakrodhairjitendriyaiḥ |
caradbhirvasudhāṃ viprairakiṃcanapathaiṣibhiḥ || 14 ||
yā prajā sarvamārūḍhā mānasī brahmacāriṇī |
saivaiṣā vyaktimāpannā svabhāvaduratikramā || 15 ||
avyaktā vyaktamāpantā svabhāvād duratikramā |
vyaktāvyaktagatiścaiṣā kāladharmānmahīpate || 16 ||
sthāvarā jaṅgamāścaiva sthūlasūkṣmāśca bhārata |
kālayogena yogajñā bhavanti na bhavanti ca || 17 ||
etāścaitāḥ prajāḥ sarvā dakṣakanyāsu jajñire |
kaśyapenāvyayeneha saṃyuktāḥ kāladharmaṇā || 18 ||
ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ |
nāgāścānekaśirasaḥ sādhyā vai pannagāstathā || 19 ||
gandharvāḥ kinnarā yakṣāḥ suparṇāśca tathāpare |
garutmān saha yakṣaiśca kinnarāśca suvāsasaḥ || 3.22.20 ||
gāvaḥ paśugaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ narāśca vasudhādhipa |
carācarāśca vasudhādhartāraśca dharādharāḥ || 21 ||
gajāḥ siṃhāśca vyāghrāśca hayāḥ pakṣadharāstathā |
khaḍgā viṣāṇinaścaiva vṛṣabhāśca mṛgāstathā || 22 ||
caturviṣāṇā nāgendrāḥ padmābhā varṇataḥ śubhāḥ |
sarvalakṣaṇasampannāḥ prāṇinaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ || 23 ||
teṣāṃ rūpaistathā gātraistaiḥ śīlaistaiḥ parākramaiḥ |
munayaḥ punarudbhūtā dharmakṣetre sanātane ||| 24 ||
kṣetrajñā mānase loke dharmiṇo vedagocarāḥ |
yatrodbhūtāḥ surāḥ sarve divi loke pratiṣṭhitāḥ || 25 ||
ye cānye tapasā siddhā gṛhasthā manujādhipa |
brahmacaryeṇa saṃsiddhāḥ paricaryāṃ gatā guroḥ || 26 ||
ye ca yogagatiṃ prāptāḥ siddhihetormahīpate |
kleśādhikaiḥ karmajanyairvṛttiṃ lapsyanti vai dvijāḥ|| 27 ||
śiloñchavṛttayaḥ khyātāḥ sapatnīkā dṛḍhavratāḥ |
sarve tvete divicarā bhavanti caritavratāḥ || 28 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṣkare dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 ||

<3.23>

trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
pitāmahaṃ puraskṛtya merupṛṣṭhe samāhitāḥ |
jaṭājinadharā viprāstyaktakrodhā jitendriyāḥ || 1 ||
parvatāntarasaṃsiddhe bahupādapasaṃvṛte |
dhātusaṃrañjitaśile same nistṛṇakaṇṭake || 2 ||
trayāṇāṃ brahmavedānāṃ pañcasvaravirājite |
mantrayajñaparā nityaṃ nityaṃ vratahite ratāḥ || 3 ||
ekamevāgnimādhāya sarve brāhmaṇapuṅgavāḥ |
bibhidurmantraviṣayaiḥ susamāhitamānasāḥ || 4 ||
tridhā praṇīto jvalano munibhirvedapāragaiḥ |
ataste tattvamāpannā yadekastrividhaḥ kṛtaḥ || 5 ||
eka eva mahānagnirhaviṣā sampravartate |
svadhākāreṇa dharmajña mantrāṇāṃ kāryasiddhaye || 6 ||
svayaṃ ca dakṣaḥ samprāpto bhagavān bhūtasatkṛtaḥ |
brahmā brāhmaṇanirmātā sarvabhūtapitāmahaḥ || 7 ||
daṇḍī carmī śarī khaḍgī śikhī padmanibhānanaḥ |
abhavannyastasaṃtāpo jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ || 8 ||
yajate puṣkare brahmā medhayā saha saṃgataḥ |
indraproktāni sāmāni gīyante brahmavādibhiḥ || 9 ||
ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ yavā vrīhiḥ sarvaṃ paramakaṃ haviḥ |
vedaproktaṃ makhe nyastaṃ kalpitaṃ brahmaṇaḥ pade || 3.23.10 ||
nirmathyāraṇimāgneyīṃ śamīgarbhasamutthitām |
sa brahmā prathamaṃ tasminnagnimayaṃ pravartayat || 11 ||
na hyalpaṃ vihitaṃ dravyaṃ yathāgniryajñakarmaṇi |
pravartayed vibhāgairvā hutadravyamayaṃ balam || 12 ||
phalāni taiḥ prayuktāni havīṃṣi vitate'dhvare |
prayuñjate prayogajñā munayo brahmavādinaḥ || 13 ||
ṣaṇmāsāṃścaturo vedān sambabhāṣe bṛhaspatiḥ |
brahmaṇo vitate yajñe parayā brahmasampadā || 14 ||
śikṣākṣarasametāyā madhurāyāḥ samantataḥ |
sānusvaritarāmāyāḥ sarasvatyāḥ prabhāṣate || 15 ||
tena brāhmaṇaśabdena brahmaproktena bhārata |
vibhāti sa makho vyaktaṃ brahmaloka ivāparaḥ || 16 ||
makho brahmamukhottīrṇo brahmaśabdairanāmayaiḥ |
prayogaiḥ samprayuktaḥ sa jalpanniva vivardhate || 17 ||
samidbhiḥ somakalaśaiḥ pātraiścaiva bahiścaraiḥ |
yavairvrīhibhirājyaiśca pūrṇaiśca jalabhājanaiḥ || 18 ||
karma prāptaiśca vasubhiḥ karmabhiśca parānvitaiḥ |
gobhiḥ payasvinībhiśca parivatsaiśca komalaiḥ || 19 ||
brahmavṛddho vayovṛddhastapovṛddhaśca bhārata |
brahmajñānamayo devo vidyayā saha saṃgataḥ || 3.23.20 ||
mānasaiśca kriyāmūrtirye ca bhūtāḥ svayaṃ nṛpa |
brahmā juhoti tāṃstasmānmarudbhiḥ sahitastadā || 21 ||
tejomūrtidharai rūpairna ca tatkarmaṇāspṛśat |
bedaproktena vidhinā sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ nṛpa || 22 ||
nirmathyāraṇimāgneyīṃ śamīgarbhasamutthitām |
kratunā yajate pūrṇamagniṣṭomena sa prabhuḥ || 23 ||
sadasyaistatsado vyaktaṃ śuśubhe yajñakarmaṇi |
jalpanti madhurā vācaḥsānusārāḥ kriyāstathā|| 24 ||
karmabhiśca tapoyuktairvedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ |
sūryendusadṛśai rājan virarāja mahākratuḥ || 25 ||
brahmaghoṣeṇa mahatā brahmāvāsa ivāparaḥ |
vasudhāmiva samprāptaiḥ sarvaireva divaukasaiḥ || 26 ||
vedavedāṅgavidbhiśca vinītairbrahmavādibhiḥ |
gatāgataistapaḥśrāntaiḥ svargaloke mahīyate ||27 ||
jvaladbhiriva vipraistaistribhirevādhvare'gnibhiḥ |
brahmaloka ivābhāti brahmaṇaḥ sa mahākratuḥ || 28 ||
indraproktāni sāmāni gāyanti brahmavādinaḥ |
vacanāni prayuktāni yajūṃṣi vitate'dhvare || 29 ||
tapaḥśāntā brahmaparāḥ satyavratasamāhitāḥ |
āyayurmunayaḥ sarve manobhiḥ śrotravādibhiḥ || 3.23.30 ||
hotā caivābhavadrājan brahmatve ca bṛhaspatiḥ |
sarvadharmavidāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ purāṇo brahmasambhavaḥ || 31 ||
yajamānaśca yajñānte viṣṇoḥ pūjāṃ prayujya ca |
adityāḥ paścime garbhe tapasā sambhṛte nṛpa || 32 ||
padaṃ viṣṇurajo brahmā nirdvandvaṃ niṣparigraham |
yataḥ padasahasrāṇi bhaviṣyantyudbhavanti ca || 33 ||
avandhyaṃ cāprameyaṃ ca vyatiriktaṃ ca karmabhiḥ |
ātmāpi yasya munayo bhavanti niṣparigrahāḥ || 34 ||
parigrahāśca viṣayā doṣaprāptā mahīyate |
doṣāśca yugapat sarve chādayanti mano balāt || 35||
indriyagrāmaviṣaye caranto niṣparigrahāḥ |
parigrahaṃ śubhaṃ dharmamavidyālakṣaṇaṃ viduḥ || 36 ||
vidyālakṣaṇasaṃyogānna manaśchādyate nṛpa |
yadi cenmuniśabdena gṛhyate brahmavādibhiḥ || 37 ||
vedavidyāvratasnātairniyataiḥ kurusattama |
divilokāḥ satāṃ sthānaṃ lokānāṃ loka ucyate|| 38 ||
yatra devā havyapuṣṭā na kṣayaṃ yānti bhārata |
yajamānaśca bhogaiḥ svaiḥ karmaprāptodite pade |
modate saha patnībhirvijvaro vasudhādhipa || 39 ||
yajñāvasāne śailendraṃ dvijebhyaḥ pradadau prabhu |
dayayā sarvabhūtānāṃ nirmalenāntarātmanā || 3.23.40 ||
taṃ śailaṃ sarvagātrāṇi parasparaviśeṣiṇaḥ |
na śekuḥ pravibhāgārthaṃ bhettuṃ sarvodyamairapi || 41 ||
tataste brāhmaṇagaṇā niṣedurvasudhātale |
śrameṇābhihatāḥ sarve vivarṇavadanā nṛpa || 42 ||
supārśvo girimukhyastu vāgbhirmadhurabhāṣatā |
abravītpraṇataḥ sarvāñchirasā tāndvijottamān ||43||
nahi śakyo balād bhettuṃ yuṣmābhirasusaṅgibhiḥ |
api varṣaśatairdivyaiḥ parasparavirodhibhiḥ || 44 |
ekībhūtā yadā sarve bhaviṣyatha samāhitāḥ |
avirodhena yugapad vibhajiṣyatha nirvṛtāḥ || 45 ||
balaṃ hi rāgadveṣābhyāṃ vardhate brahmasattamāḥ|
vimuktaṃ rāgadoṣābhyāṃ brahma vardhati śāśvatam || 46 ||
yadāhaṃ bhedayiṣyāmi svargabhinnaiḥ śilāśataiḥ |
dhātubhiśca visarpadbhiḥ śikharaiścānupātibhiḥ || 47 ||
viśīrṇaiḥ pārśvavivarairnāgaiśca galitairbhuvi |
bahubhirvyālarūpaiśca codyamāno guhāśayaiḥ || 48 ||
pratigṛhya ca tad vākyaṃ śailendrasya subhāṣitam |
tūṣṇīṃ babhūvuste sarve tadā brāhmaṇasattamāḥ || 49 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṣkare trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 23 ||

<3.24>

caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
balirhomāśca vardhante ahanyahani bhārata |
dvijānāṃ tapasāḍhyānāṃ gṛhadharmeṣu tiṣṭhatām || 1 ||
devatārcāśca pūjyante tadā prabhṛti bhārata |
teṣāṃ brahmavidāṃ rājan pṛthivyāṃ brahmavādibhiḥ || 2 ||
tatraiva brahmasadane same nistṛṇakaṇṭake |
prājyendhanatṛṇe deśe puṇye parvatarodhasi || 3 ||
vāsaṃ yatra prakurvanti dṛṣṭvā bhagavataḥ kriyām |
tapo'rthino mahābhāgā brahmacaryavrate sthitāḥ || 4 ||
gṛhasthadharmaniratā dānaprāptena cetasā |
yatayaścāpi kāṅkṣanti dharmeṇeha vikāṅkṣiṇaḥ || 5 ||
vanyaiḥ karmaphalaiścaiva ratā brāhmaṇapuṅgavāḥ |
agnihotravratasnātā jitakrodhāḥ samāhatāḥ || 6 ||
daivayuktena vā yuktāḥ karmaṇā brahmasattamāḥ |
cīravalkalasaṃvītā niyatā niyatendriyāḥ || 7 ||
caranto brahmacaryaṃ ca vratamāsthāya dāruṇam |
anena vidhinā rājan karmaprāptena sarvaśaḥ || 8 ||
kramādye vedasaṃskāraṃ puṇyaṃ prāptāḥ sanātanam |
pūrvairācaritaṃ rājan munibhirbrahmavādibhiḥ || 9 ||
nāvedavidvānāgacchennāpi raudraṃ vrataṃ caret|
na ca tyāgena gaccheta gṛhadharmaṃ na ca tyajet || 3.24.10 ||
naiva gaccheta duḥsthānamaprāpto vedasaṃcayam|
ṛcaśca saṃcayaḥ pūrvaḥ sāmagānāṃ ca bhārata || 11 ||
ye cāpi putriṇo na syuḥ śrutyāpi prāpnuyuḥ phalam|
brāhmaṇāstapasā śrāntā gurośca paricaryayā || 12 ||
yasya naiva śrutaṃ brahma na gṛhītaṃ viśāmpate |
kāma taṃ dhārmiko rājā śūdrakarmāṇi kārayet || 13 ||
athavā naiva vidyeta yad brahma nādriyed dvijaḥ |
dvābhyāṃ tu śrotraviṣaye manaḥ pūrvaṃ samāhitam || 14 ||
evaṃ sarvendriyārambhān vedapūrvān samācaret |
brāhmaṇo bhūtisampanno ya icched bhūtimātmanaḥ|| 15 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṣkare caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 ||

<3.25>

pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
te tu gobrāhmaṇā nāgāścandrādityapuraskṛtāḥ |
brāhmaṇān pūjayandevān vasubhirbrahmasambhavaiḥ || 1 ||
nāradapramukhāścaiva gandharvā ṛṣayo nṛpa |
kurvanti satataṃ yajñe kramaprāptaṃ pitāmaham || 2 ||
vacobhirmadhurābhāṣaiḥ pañcendriyanivāsibhiḥ |
sarvabhūtapriyakaraiḥ sarvabhūtahitaiṣibhiḥ || 3 ||
stūyamānaśca yajñānte pañcendrimasamāhitaiḥ |
provāca bhagavānbrahmā diṣṭyā diṣṭyeti bhārata || 4 ||
tataḥ kaśyapamābhāṣya provāca bhagavān prabhuḥ |
bhavānapi sutaiḥ sārdhaṃ yakṣyate vasudhātale || 5 ||
kratubhiḥ paramaprāptaiḥ sampūrṇavaradakṣiṇaiḥ |
yakṣāḥ surāśca te sarve yathā pratiguṇaiḥ prabho || 6 ||
vayaṃ yakṣyāmahe pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ yakṣyāmahe vayam|
evamanyonyasaṃrambhād vidyante baladarpitāḥ || 7 ||
daiteyāścāpyadaiteyāḥ parasparajayaiṣiṇaḥ |
yuddhāyaiva pratiṣṭhanti pragṛhya vipulau bhujau || 8 ||
nivāryamāṇā ṛṣibhistapasā dagdhakilbiṣaiḥ |
anyaiśca vividhairviprairvedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ || 9 ||
nivāryamāṇā yudhyante vṛṣabhā iva gokule |
prayuddhā yuddhasaṃkrāntāḥ sarve prāṇajayaiṣiṇaḥ || 3.25.10 ||
paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ mṛtyorviṣayamāgatāḥ |
tataḥ śabdena mahatā paraṃ kṛtvā mahābalāḥ || 11 ||
rundhanti bāhubhiḥ kruddhāḥ sapakṣā iva pakṣiṇaḥ |
cacāla vasudhā caiva pādākrāntā ca roṣibhiḥ || 12 ||
nauryathā puruṣākrāntā niṣīdati mahājale |
parvatāśca viśāryante nardamānā gajā iva || 13 ||
cukṣubhuśca mahānadyastāḍitā mātariśvanā |
tataḥ samabhavad yuddhaṃ madhorviṣṇośca bhārata || 14 ||
yugāntakaraṇaṃ ghoraṃ sarvaprāṇibhayaṃkaram |
pramamātha madhovirṣṇuḥ samagraṃ balapauruṣam || 15 ||
vahneriva balaṃ dīptaṃ śamayatyambunā yathā |
tathā praśamitaṃ tena prabhuṇā hyupakāriṇā || 16 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 25 ||

<3.26>

ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
balavān sa tu daiteyo madhurbhīmaparākramaḥ |
babandha pāśairniśitairmahendraṃ parvatāntare || 1 ||
taṃ vai prahlādavacanāllakṣaṇajñaśca bhārata |
aiśvaryamaindramākāṅkṣanbhaviṣyaṃ buddhisaṃkṣayāt|| 2 ||
baddhvendraṃ sahasā madhye pāśairmarmavivarjitaiḥ |
āyasairbahubhiścitrairbalavadbhirvidāraṇaiḥ || 3 ||
viṣṇumevāgraṇī rudramāhvayad yuddhakovidaḥ |
madhye gaṇānāṃ sarveṣāṃ kālasya vaśamāgataḥ || 4 ||
dvaidhībhūtāḥ kāśyapeyā madhorvaśamupāgatāḥ |
yuddhārthamabhyadhāvanta pragṛhya vipulā gadāḥ || 5 ||
gandharvāḥ kiṃnarāścaiva vādye gīte ca kovidāḥ |
pranṛtyanti pragāyanti prahasanti ca sarvaśaḥ || 6 ||
tantrībhiḥ suprayuktābhirmadhurābhiḥ svabhāvataḥ |
mano madhorvidhunvanti yudhyamānasya rāgiṇaḥ || 7 ||
madhorbalārthaṃ madhuno niyogāt padmayoninaḥ |
etānvikarānkurvanti gandharvāḥ satyavādinaḥ| 8 ||
tatra śakto hiṃ gāndharve tasmiñchabde madhurmanaḥ |
dānavāścāsurāścaiva pratyakṣaṃ yānti prāṇadan || 9 ||
madhośca mana ākṣipya paśyan yogena cakṣuṣā |
mandaraṃ prayate viṣṇurgūḍho'gniriva dāruṣu || 3.26.10 ||
ṛṣayo dīptamanasaṃ kiṃcid vyathitamānasāḥ |
pitāmahaṃ puraskṛtya kṣaṇenāntaradhīyata || 11 ||
viṣṇuṃ so'bhyahanat kruddho madhurmadhunibhekṣaṇaḥ |
bhujena śaṅkhadeśānte na cakampe padātpadam || 12 ||
viṣṇuścābhyahanad daityaṃ karāgreṇa stanāntare |
sa papāta mahīṃ tūrṇaṃ jānubhyāṃ rudhiraṃ vaman || 13 ||
na cainaṃ patitaṃ hanti viṣṇuryuddhaviśāradaḥ |
bāhuyuddhe hi samayaṃ matvācintyaparākramaḥ || 14 ||
indradhvaja ivottiṣṭhañjānubhyāṃ sa mahītalāt |
madhu roṣaparītātmā nirdahanniva cakṣuṣā || 15 ||
paruṣābhistato vāgbhiranyonyamabhigarjatuḥ |
samīyaturbāhuyuddhe parasparavadhaiṣiṇau || 16 ||
ubhau tau bāhubalināvubhau yuddhaviśāradau |
ubhau ca tapasā śāntāvubhau satyaparākramau || 17 ||
dṛḍhaprahāriṇau vīrāvanyonyaṃ vicakarṣatuḥ |
śailendrāviva yuddhyantau pakṣaiḥ pāṣāṇasaṃnibhaiḥ || 18 ||
vikarṣantau vamantau ca anyonyaṃ vasudhātale |
gajāviva viṣāṇāgrairnakhāgraiśca viceratuḥ || 19 ||
tato vraṇamukhaiścaiva susrāva rudhiraṃ bahu |
grīṣmānte dhātusaṃsṛṣṭaṃ śailebhya iva kāñcanam || 3.26.20 ||
saṃsiktau rudhiraughaiśca sravadbhiḥ samaraṃjitau |
athādyataiḥ padāgraiśca tau vyadārayatāṃ mahīm || 21 ||
abhihatya tu tau vīrau parasparamanaikadhā |
pataṅgāviva yudhyetāṃ pakṣābhyāṃ māṃsagṛddhinau || 22 ||
śuśruvuścāntarikṣe'tha sarvabhūtāni puṣkare |
siddhānāṃ vadanonmuktāḥ parayā varṇasampadā || 23 ||
stutayo viṣṇusaṃyuktāḥ satyāḥ satyaparākrame |
śarīraṃ dhātusaṃyuktaṃ saṃyuktaṃ cetanena ca || 24 ||
tad brahma indriyairyuktaṃ tejobhūtaṃ sanātanam |
dhruvaṃ tiṣṭhanti bhūtāste sūkṣme pralayatāṃ gate || 25 ||
punaścodbhavate sūkṣmaṃ bahurūpamanekadhā |
prabodhya bhāvaṃ bhūtānāṃ triṣu lokeṣu kāmadaḥ || 26 ||
surūpo bahurūpāṃstām̐llokān saṃcarate vaśī |
mānasīṃ tanumāsthāya bahubhiḥ kāraṇāntaraiḥ || 27 ||
yogātmā dhārayannurvīṃ nāgātmānaṃ divaṃdharaḥ |
brahma bhūtaṃ paraṃ caiva sūkṣmeṇātmānamīśvaraḥ || 28 ||
brāhmeṇa viprān vasati yuddhenaiva ca kṣatriyān |
pradānakarmaṇā vaiśyāñchūdrān paricareṇa ca || 29 ||
gāvaḥ kṣīrapradānena aśvān yajñeṣu prokṣaṇaiḥ |
pitaraścoṣmaṇaiveha havirbhāgena devatāḥ || 3.26.30 ||
caturbhirvyatiriktāṅgaistribhiranyaiśca dhātubhiḥ |
saptabhiḥ pitṛbhirnityaistrīm̐llokān parirakṣati || 31 ||
candrasūryātmakaṃ nityaṃ yathātmanihatātmakam |
prakāśa cāprakāśaṃ ca nigūḍhaṃ svena tejasā || 32 ||
trayastu pitaro nityaṃ vardhayanti divākaram |
caturbhiḥ pitṛbhiścaiva candro vardhati maṇḍale || 33 ||
trayaḥ pitṛgaṇā nityaṃ piṇḍān paścādadanti te |
catvāro'nye pitṛgaṇāḥ siddhāḥ pañca ka ādade || 34 ||
tvameva pañca tāndharmāṃstvamevāpañca tānvibho |
sanātanamayo divyaḥ śāśvato brahmasambhavaḥ || 35 ||
yasmāttvatteja ādatte agnirvāyuśca sarvaśaḥ |
atastvaṃ karmaṇā tena ādityaḥ samapadyata || 36 ||
yadādatsi jagat sarvaṃ raśmibhiḥ pradahanniva |
yugāntakāle samprāpte parāṃ siddhimupāgataḥ || 37 ||
pakṣasaṃdhāvamāvāsyāṃ lokaṃ carasi mānuṣam |
ṛṣibhiḥ saha gūḍhātmā sūryenduvasusambhavaiḥ || 38 ||
saphalaṃ karma kartṝṇāṃ yajatāṃ puṣṭivardhanaḥ |
hetūnāmavikārāya mā bhūt karmaviparyayaḥ || 39 ||
vanaspatyauṣadhīścaiva yugapat pratipadyase |
bālabhāvāya vasudhāṃ pakṣe pakṣe janistava || 3.26.40 ||
bhūtānāṃ bhuvi bhūteśa bhāvyarthe vasudhātale |
vasu yad bhuvi kiṃcicca sarvaṃ tattvanmayaṃ vibho || 41 ||
tvameva vividhaṃ dharmaṃ śāśvataṃ vasudhātale |
devayajñaṃ mantravākyamātmayajñaṃ samānuṣam || 42 ||
dvividhaḥ svargamārgaśca sūryaścandraśca nirmalaḥ |
candramāḥ pitṛyānaśca devayānaśca bhāskaraḥ || 43 ||
tvameva vasudhāyukto viśvaṃ carasi sīmayā |
ekīkṛtya gaṇānsarvān saṃkṣipyāmutra sambhavaḥ|| 48 ||
ekastvamasi sambhūtaḥ purāṇapuruṣo virāṭ |
akṣayaścāprameyaśca karmakārakaro vaśī || 45 ||
mūrtastejasi sambhūto vāyuḥ paryeti khecaraḥ |
saptabhī rūpasaṃsthānairnityamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati || 46 ||
sādhane cāpi nirvāṇe saṃhāre pralaye tathā |
dhātā dhāraṇakāle ca diśaścakṣuṣi dhāriṇi || 47 ||
sevyamāno munigaṇairnityaṃ vigatakilbiṣaiḥ |
karmabhiḥ satyamāpannaiḥ samarāgairjitendriyaiḥ || 48 ||
stūyamānaśca vibudhaiḥ siddhairmunivaraistathā |
sasmāra vipulaṃ dehaṃ harirhayaśiro mahān || 49 ||
kṛtvā vedamayaṃ rūpaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ vapuḥ |
śiromadhye mahādevo brahmā tu hṛdaye sthitaḥ || 3.26.50 ||
ādityaraśmayo bālāścakṣuṣī śaśibhāskarau |
jaṅghe tu vasavaḥ sādhyāḥ sarvasaṃdhiṣu devatāḥ || 51 ||
jihvā vaiśvānaro devaḥ satyā devī sarasvatī |
maruto varuṇaścaiva jānudeśe vyavasthitāḥ || 52 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā tathā rūpaṃ surāṇāmadbhutaṃ mahat |
asuraṃ pīḍayāmāsa krodhād raktāntalocanaḥ || 53 ||
madhormedo'mbupūrṇā ca pṛthivī samadṛśyata |
pramadeva ghanā caiva śuklāṃśukanivāsinī || 54 ||
medinītyeva śabdaśca labdhaḥ pṛṣṭyā narottama |
nāmāsurasahasreṇa dharaṇyāṃ sampratiṣṭhitam || 55 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṣkare ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 26 ||

<3.27>

saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
madhornipatanaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvabhūtāni puṣkare |
prahṛṣṭāni pragāyanti pranṛtyanti ca sarvaśaḥ || 1 ||
supārśvo girimukhyastu kāñcanaiḥ śikharottamaiḥ |
bahudhātuvicitraiśca khaṃ likhanniva cābabhau || 2 ||
girayaścābhiśobhante dhātubhiḥ samarañjitāḥ |
prāṃśubhiḥ śikharāgraiśca savidyuta ivāmbudāḥ || 3 ||
pakṣavātoddhato reṇuścūrṇaiḥ sāñjanavālukaiḥ |
chādayan parvatāgrāṇi mahāmegha ivābabhau || 4 ||
meghasaṃśliṣṭaśikharāḥ pakṣavikṣiptapādapāḥ |
kāñcanodbhedabahulāḥ khe tiṣṭhantīva parvatāḥ || 5 ||
pakṣavantaḥ saśikharā hemadhātubhirañjitāḥ |
pavanena samudbhūtāstrāsayanti vihaṅgamān || 6 ||
kāñcanāḥ parvatāḥ sarve sphāṭikairmaṇibhiścitāḥ |
sūryakāntaiśca bahubhiścandrakāntaiśca nirmalāḥ || 7 ||
himavāṃśca mahāśailaḥ śvetairdhātubhirācitaḥ |
kāñcanaiḥ śikharāgraiśca sūryapādaprakāśitaiḥ || 8 ||
maṇibhiśca prakāśadbhiḥ pakṣāntaraviniḥsṛtaiḥ |
tāmrapuṣpaiśca śikharairdīpyamānaiḥ svatejasā || 9 ||
mandaraścograśikharaḥ sphāṭikairmaṇibhiścitaḥ |
vajragarbho nirālambaiḥ svargopama ivābabhau || 3.27.10 ||
sahasraśṛṅgaḥ kailāsaḥ śilādhātuvibhūṣitaḥ |
toraṇaiścaiva nibiḍaiḥ prāṃśubhiścaiva pādapaiḥ || 11 ||
pravādayadbhirgandharvaiḥ kinnaraiśca pragāyibhiḥ |
devakanyāṅgarāgaiśca prakrīḍādririvābabhau || 12 ||
madhurairvādyagītaiśca nṛtyaiścābhinayodgataiḥ |
śṛṅgāraiḥ sāṅgahāraiśca kailāso madanāyate || 13 ||
ādityābhāsibhiḥ śṛṅgairbhinnāñjanacayopamaiḥ |
vindhyo nīlāmbudaśyāmo vibhinna iva toyadaḥ || 14 ||
dhātvarthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ merupṛṣṭhe mahābale |
nirvemurvimalaṃ toyaṃ meghajālairivottamaiḥ || 15 ||
śilābhirbahucitrābhirdhātubhirbahurūpibhiḥ |
prasravadbhirguhādvāraiḥ salilaṃ sphaṭikaprabham || 16 ||
grīṣmānte vāyusaṃgūḍhā ghanā iva savidyutaḥ |
citraiḥ puṣpaistarugaṇāḥ śobhanta iva bhūṣitāḥ || 17 ||
nāgāḥ kanakasambhūtairvicitrairiva bhūṣitāḥ |
vihaṃgamābhilīnāśca latāstarusamāśritāḥ || 18 ||
vilambantyaḥ sapuṣpāśca nṛtyante vāyughaṭṭitāḥ |
pavanena samudbhūtā mahatā mādhave'hani || 19 ||
mumucuḥ puṣpasaṃghātaṃ toyaṃ veleva varṣati |
phalavadbhiśca vipulaiḥ śāstrāskandhāvarohibhiḥ |
pādapairvarṇabahulairdhriyeta ca vasuṃdharā || 3.27.20 ||
madhupriyā madhukarā madhumattā vihaṃgamāḥ |
ghoṣayantīva gāyantaḥ kāmasyāgamasambhavam || 21 ||
viṣṇurmadhornihantā ca cakāra madhuvāhinīm |
nadīṃ prasravanirbhedāṃ sutīrthā bahulodakām || 22 ||
aṃgāravarṇasikatāṃ madhutīrthāṃ manoramām |
vimalairambubhiḥ pūrṇāṃ puṣpasaṃcayavāhinīm || 23 ||
viveśa puṣkaraṃ sā tu brahmaṇo vākyanoditā |
ṛṣibhiścānucaritā brahmatantraniṣevibhiḥ || 24 ||
dhātrī kapilarūpeṇa gaurbhūtvā kṣarate payaḥ |
madhuraṃ vitate yajñe brahmaṇo vākyacoditā || 25 ||
saraśca pṛthivībhūtaṃ saṃdhātuṃ prāptavanmahīm |
śuddhaṃ ca bhajate lokaṃ śāśvataṃ paramādbhutam || 26 ||
sarasvatyāḥ samudbhūtaṃ brahmakṣetre tamonudam|
marutīrthamatikramya puṣkareṣu visarpati || 27 ||
sucārurūpā dharmajñā ajā rūpeṇa chādayan |
rūpaṃ kanakavarṇābhaṃ tapoyuktena cetasā || 28
ajagandhakṛtonmuktaḥ sambhūtaḥ parvato mahān |
guruddhāraguṇaprāṇaḥ śāśvataḥ siddhasevitaḥ || 29 ||
vedikābhiḥ sucitrābhiḥ kāñcanābhirvirājitaḥ |
puṣkarāṇi parītāni tvaṣṭrā vipuladakṣiṇa || 3.27.30 ||
mahāmeroryathā rūpaṃ pañcabhirdhātubhirvṛtaḥ |
cetanā yābhisampanno rūpeṇādbhutadarśanaḥ || 31 ||
kariṣyāmyahamapyetanmanasā dharmacāriṇam |
rūpaṃ bahuvidhaṃ loke pārthivīṃ cetanāṃ tathā || 32 ||
trīṃśca lokān prapadyeyaṃ pañcabhirdhātulakṣaṇaiḥ |
ṣaṣṭhena ca sasarjeyaṃ manasā dharmacāriṇīm || 33 ||
saṅgeṣu bhāvamohābhyāṃ paśyanti ca samṛddhayaḥ |
vimuktāḥ sarvasaṅgebhyo dhārayanti parigrahān || 34 ||
na ca vindeta māṃ kaścinmanasā kāmarūpiṇam |
pañcadhātunibaddhaśca nānābhāṣitacodanaḥ || 35 ||
ye ca viṣṇumadhīyante bahudhā kāmavigrahaiḥ |
te māṃ paśyeyuravyaktaṃ tapasā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ || 36 ||
ye ca māmabhiroheyurnarā dharmapathe sthitāḥ |
te'pi svargajitaḥ santaḥ paśyeyurmāṃ gataklamāḥ || 37 ||
yaścaiva parvataḥ prāṃśurmerupṛṣṭhe vyavasthitaḥ |
etamāruhya yudhyeyuḥ prāṇatyāge sunirmalāḥ || 38 ||
apsarobhiḥ samāgamya vicareyurmanojavāḥ |
nandanaṃ vanamāruhya kāmyakaṃ ca mahadvanam || 39 ||
imāṃ vidyāṃ samāsthāya madbhaktāḥ puṣkareṣviha |
śarīraṃ kṣapayiṣyanti vratairbahuvidhaiḥ kṛtaiḥ || 3.27.40 ||
siddhiṃ prāpya krameyuste kāmairbahuvidhairnarāḥ |
imaṃ lokamamuṃ caiva sampateyuryathāsukham || 41 ||
gaurī siddhetivyākhyātā triṣu lokeṣu vidyayā |
prabhāvaṃ tapasā vṛttaṃ darśayantī samāhitāḥ || 42 ||
ṣaṇṇāṃ jñānābhisaṃdhīnāmabhijñānāt sasaṃgrahāḥ |
bhaveyuste nirārambhā dhātunirmuktabandhanāḥ || 43 ||
sahasraguṇamapyatra dattvā dānaphalādiva |
avimānena viprāṇāṃ manaḥśuddhena karmaṇā || 44 ||
sarvatraivāprameyeṇa atyantaṃ phalamāpnuyuḥ |
amuṣmim̐lloke dharmajñāḥ saha sarvakulodbhavaiḥ || 45 ||
yeṣāmiha ca sāṃnidhyaṃ yajñe brāhmaṇasaṃkule |
te bhūyo yajamānādyā abhiṣicya punaḥ punaḥ || 46 ||
tathā tāṃ manyase gaurīṃ manasā dharmacāriṇīm |
anugrahāya bhūtānāṃ tanmamāgre tapodhane || 47 ||
satya eṣa paro'vidye bhavitā nātra saṃśayaḥ |
nāphalo vidyate dharmaścarito dharmacāriṇā || 48 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṣkare saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 27 ||

<3.28>

aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
diśaṃ jigamiṣurdivyāmuttarāṃ satyasādhanaḥ |
tathā sa dhātunicaye puṇye parvatarodhasi || 1 ||
viṣṇuḥ paramadharmātmā ekapādena tiṣṭhati |
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi puṣkare puṣkarekṣaṇaḥ || 2 ||
ātmanyātmānamādhāya tapasā brahmasambhavaḥ |
ghaṭate karmaṇogreṇa lokamutthānakāraṇāt || 3 ||
bhāsuro bhasmanā''cchādya gātrāṇi svayamātmanaḥ |
aṣṭau varṣasahasrāṇi sahasraṃ ca tapodhanaḥ || 4 ||
tejasā tena jyotīṃṣi vibhāvya brāhmaṇarṣabhaḥ |
tiṣṭhate nabhaso madhye yogātmā bhāvayañjagat || 5 ||
somo viṣayamākṣipya manasā dhārayanmanaḥ |
yuktaḥ paramadharmātmā brāhmīṃ siddhimupāgataḥ || 6 ||
sampradṛśyata sarvatra divi bhuvyantare tathā |
jyotiṣṇu karma kurvāṇo bahurūpaḥ sa sampadā || 7 ||
maheśvaro'tigūḍhānmā vṛṣarūpeṇa tiṣṭhati |
uddhṛtya dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ vāyubhakṣaḥ samāhitaḥ || 8 ||
aṣṭau varṣasahasrāṇi srahasraṃ śatameva ca |
mahāyogī mahādevo niyamād brahmasambhavaḥ || 9 ||
atha vāyurghanībhūto ante carati gopateḥ |
phenībhūtaṃ samudgāraiḥ pavanaṃ nirgiranmukhāt || 3.28.10 ||
sa niṣkrāntastato vaktrātprāṇena paramāptavān |
niryāsabhūtaḥ patito naivārdro naiva pārthivaḥ || 11 ||
sa pheno vāriṇā''viśya cacāra vasudhātale |
naivārdro naiva śuṣkāṅgo vāyusaṃghātamāgataḥ || 12 ||
tatkāle phenamutkṣipya pavanaḥ saha vāriṇā |
nirālambe nirālambastvabhrāṇi samapadyata || 13 ||
te kṣipanti payo bhūmāvātmānaṃ svena ghaṭṭitāḥ |
nīlameghāruṇaprakhyā naivādrā naiva pārthivāḥ || 14 ||
brāhmīṃ mūrtiṃ samādhāya vāyuḥ sarvatrago vaśī |
samāḥ sahasraṃ sampūrṇaṃ cacāra vipula tapaḥ || 15 ||
vahnirbahujaṭī bhūtvā cīravalkalavāsabhṛt
tapastapyadanāhāro maunamāsthāya pauṣkare || 16 ||
varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasrāṇi trīṇi caikaṃ ca yatnataḥ |
tasyāgnestejaḥ sambhūto mahānagniḥ pravartate || 17 ||
svargaprakāśaṃ kṛtvā ca svargavāsī tamonudaḥ |
divi bhūtaprakāśākhyastapasā brahmasambhavaḥ || 18 ||
tattamo bhuvi rājendra mānuṣeṣu pratiṣṭhitam |
bhāskarastejasaṃhārastato bhavati sattamaḥ || 19 ||
martyānāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ teja ākṣipya vartate |
na tu yogabale rājan brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ |
tattamonāśayed rātrau nāpyahobhavitādvayam ||3.28.20 ||
puṣpamitro mahātejā yakṣaḥ sarvatrago vaśī |
tapaścarati dharmātmā puṣkareṣu samāhitaḥ || 21 ||
mahendraśikharāddhārā yāvantyo yānti medinīm |
tāvatsvarūpamāsthāya tiṣṭhate nikhilāḥ samāḥ || 22 ||
jānubhyāṃ patito bhūmau jyotirnabhasi paśyati |
samāḥ sahasraṃ nikhilaṃ netrairanimiṣairjagat || 23 ||
netrāṇi bahudhā tasya netrāntairabhiniḥsṛtāḥ |
madhyandinakare prāpte raśmivān saparigrahe || 24 ||
te raśmayaḥ prabhānetraiḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ |
rarāja tejaḥsaṃyogād vidvadbhiriva pāvakaḥ || 25 ||
sa visphuliṅgairnetrāntairādityamanuvartate |
karmaṇo'nte yugānte vā jagato bahurūpiṇaḥ || 26 ||
bahutāpaḥ punarbhūtvā niṣaṇṇo vasudhātale |
samāḥ sahasraṃ sampūrṇaṃ tapastepe sudāruṇam || 27 ||
nigṛhītendriyo bhūtvā apsarobhirlalāma ha |
meroḥ śikharamāsādya kāmaṃ kāmena nirvaman || 28 ||
tapaḥkāmaḥ sa yakṣastu kubero naravāhanaḥ |
viṣṇureva tapo'dhyakṣastejaso'nte vijṛmbhati || 29 ||
na hi kaścit pumānasti ya evaṃ tapa ācaret |
triṣu lokeṣu rājendra ṛte viṣṇuṃ sanātanam || 3.28.30 ||
vāsukirbahuśīrṣastu nāgendro maunamāsthitaḥ |
tapa ācarate samyaṅ nidhāya manasā manaḥ || 31 ||
śeṣaḥ satyadhṛtirnāgo balavān brahmasambhavaḥ |
vṛkṣamāruhya dharmātmā avākchīrṣo'valambate || 32 ||
jihvābhirlelihānābhirgātrajaṃ viṣamutsṛjan |

kālakūṭaṃ viṣaṃ taddhi sumahat samapadyata |
yena loko hyabhigrasto na sukhaṃ vindate nṛpa || 34 |
sarvatrānugataṃ tīkṣṇaṃ bhujaṅgeṣu mahīpate |
jaṅgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ caiva sarvatrānugataṃ viṣam || 35 ||
parasparavivṛddhena hiṃsāyuktena bhārata |
nāśayatyānmano'ṅgāni tena tīkṣṇena bhārata || 36 ||
atha brahmā mahābhāgo bhūtānāṃ hitakāmyayā |
mantraṃ visṛjate rājan brahmākṣaramahiṃsakam || 37 ||
garutmān vitataiḥ pakṣairnakhāgraiḥ salilaṃ mahīm|
samāḥ sahasraṃ sampūrṇaṃ cūlāgreṇāvalambinā || 38 ||
parṇabhāraiśca vikacairvistīrṇairvasudhātale |
rarāja vasudhā caiva parṇairbahuvicitritaiḥ || 39 ||
yena vṛttena jīveyuḥ sarvabhūtāni bhārata |
iha loke manuṣyendra devaloke ca bhārata |
dyaurivācitanakṣatrā mahī talavisarpibhiḥ || 3.28.40 ||
himavān himasampāte bhavatyekacaro vaśī |
puṣkarāmbhasi dharmātmā matsyollikhitamūrdhajaḥ || 41 ||
atha svabalamākramya pṛthivīṃ prāṃśudvāhinīm |
tapaścarati dharmātmā bāhumudyamya dakṣiṇam || 42 ||
sāgraṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca śatamekaṃ ca suvrata |
tapaścarati saṃyogād vāyubhakṣaḥ samāhitaḥ || 43 ||
samādhiyogāt saṅgād vā brahmayogasya bhārata |
yeneyaṃ pṛthivī rājan dhāryate brahmayoninā || 44 ||
anādyantena nityena sarvatra viṣayaiṣiṇā |
yo'sau viṣṇuragādhātmā paramātmā nirākṛtiḥ || 45 ||
dine niṣaṇṇo bhavati rātrau bhavati vai sthiraḥ |
satyasaṃdhaḥ sa dharmātmā kāmakārakaro bhavet || 46 ||
tasya yaḥ sodyataḥ pāṇiḥ pṛthivyāṃ pṛthivīsamaḥ |
rātrau sa tapano bhavati maṇḍalaṃ vipulaṃ nabhaḥ || 47 ||

grahāṇāṃ gatayaścaiva tārāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 48 ||
tāṃ chāyāmākṣipan somātsravadbhirmaṇḍalena vai|
pṛthivyāṃ dakṣiṇo hasto mahāyogī mahāmanāḥ || 49 ||
saiṣā chāyā śaśībhūtā śaśimaṇḍalamāviśat |
aliṅgā pṛthivīliṅgādadbhutādakṣayā divi || 3.28.50 ||
aṅgāṅgānyupagṛhyaiva tapaścarati niścayāt |

ākāśagaṅgā saṃvṛttā vipulairambuvigrahaiḥ || 55 ||

padmakhaṇḍaiśca vividhaiḥ śuśubhe divyagandhibhiḥ || 56 ||

pṛṣṭhāt prayātā śailendre mandare mandagāminī || 3.28.60 ||
ṛṅmayāṃścaturo vedān pādaiścaturbhirāvṛtān |
yajurbhiḥ sāmabhiścaiva grathitāñchikṣayā tadā || 61 ||
ṛṣibhirjvalanaprakhyaistapasā dagdhakilbiṣaiḥ |
supārśvasya gireḥ pāde paridāyaiḥ supāraṇaiḥ || 62 ||
niḥsvanaṃ sarvabhūtāni niyamaiśca na śṛṇvate |
mandarāgre visarpantaṃ jagatkṛtsnamatīndriyam || 63 ||

viṣṇurviṣṇutvamāpanno dehāntaravisṛṣṭavān |

saṃhṛtya manasā''tmānaṃ mahāyogī mahābalaḥ || 81 ||

<3.29>

ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
saṃyujya tapasā devāḥ kimakurvaṃstataḥ param |
na hi tad vidyate loke tapasā yanna labhyate || 1 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
atha dīkṣāṃ samāsthāya sarve viṣṇumayā gaṇāḥ |
puṣkarādagnimuddhṛtya praṇīya ca yathāvidhi || 2 ||
vahuvurmantravidhinā brāhmaṇā mantracoditāḥ |
haviṣā mantrapūtena yathā vai vidhireva ca || 3||
sa cāgnirvidhivattatra vardhate brahmatejasā |
tejobhirbahulībhūtaḥ prabhuḥ puruṣavigrahaḥ || 4
brahmadaṇḍa iti khyāto vapuṣā nirdahanniva |
divyarūpapraharaṇo hyasicarmadhanurdharaḥ | 5 ||
sagado lāṅgalī cakrī śarī carmī paraśvadhī |
śūlī vajrī svaṅgapāṇiḥ śaktimān varakārmukaḥ || 6 ||
viṣṇuścakradharaḥ khaḍgī musalī lāṅgalāyudhaḥ |
naro lāṅgalamālambya musalaṃ ca mahābalaḥ || 7 ||
vajramindrastapoyogācchataparyāṇamakṣipat |
rudraḥ śūlaṃ pinākaṃ ca manasādhārayad bhuvi || 8 ||
mṛtyurdaṇḍaṃ pāśamāpaḥ kālaḥ śaktimagṛhṇata |
jagrāha paraśuṃ tvaṣṭā kuberaśca paraśvadham || 9 ||
nirvikāraiḥ samāyuktāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ |
viśvakarmā ca tvaṣṭā ca cakrāte hyāyudhaṃ bahu || 3.29.10 ||
indrāyāgnirathaṃ prādāt sūryāya ca pratāpine |
paramātmā dadau kṛṣṇo rudrāya ca mahātmane || 11 ||
chandobhireva tvaṣṭā ca sa cakārātha vāhinīm
viśvakarmā vimānāni cakāra bahubhiḥ kramaiḥ || 12 ||
śarīrāṃśaṃ samuddhṛtya viṣṇuḥ satyaparākramaḥ |
puṣkarāt parvaṇi vanāt pṛtanārthaṃ pravartayan || 13 ||
dyāṃ caiva sūryaṛkṣāṇāṃ vācā vai samakalpayat |
yathā sa pūjyaḥ saṃgrāme śatrūn nirbibhide raṇe || 14 ||
sa taṃ daṇḍaṃ samucitaṃ nirvikāraṃ samāhitam |
brahmā jagrāha vidhinā antardhānagataḥ prabhuḥ ||15 ||
svaiḥ prabhāvaiśca vidhinā so'stragrāmaṃ caturvidham|
aindramāgneyavāyavye raudraṃ raudreṇa varcasā || 16||
ebhirvikāraiḥ saṃyuktā diteḥ putrā mahābalāḥ |
tapasā śikṣayā caiva svāstraiḥ praharaṇairapi || 17 ||
balena caturaṅgeṇa vīryeṇa susamāhitāḥ |
apradhṛṣyā raṇe sarve samapadyanta vai tadā || 18 ||
te vihāya guhāmadhyaṃ sabhāṇḍopaskare rathe |
mandarasya gireḥ pāde vicerurvasudhātale || 19 ||
caturaṅgaṃ balaṃ sarvaṃ saṃhṛtya tamasaḥ prabhuḥ |
viṣṇureva mahāyogāṃścacāra vasudhātale || 3.29.20 ||
bhūyo'nyattapa āseduścaranto brāhmaṇaiḥ saha |
taiśca sarvaiḥ suragaṇairdharmacīranivāsibhiḥ || 21 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṣkare ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 29 ||

<3.30>

triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
brahman khile vartamāne nirmaryāde mahāgrahe |
avināśe ca bhūtānāṃ kathamāsan prajāstadā || 1 |
vaiśampāyana uvāca
abhyaṣiñcatpṛthuṃ vainyaṃ purā rājye prajāpatiḥ |
rājyāya ṛṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ prajādharmaparāyaṇaḥ || 2 ||
eṣa naḥ paramo rājā sānurāgo vyajāyata |
tretāyāṃ sampravṛttāyāmanyonyamanujalpire || 3 ||
eṣa no vṛttidātā ca śilpānāṃ ca pravartitā |
nirmātā sarvabhūtānāṃ satyaprāptena karmaṇā || 4 ||
etasminnantare devā gandhamādanasānuṣu |
bahubhirniyamaiḥ śrāntā niṣaṇṇā girisānuṣu || 5 ||
atha gandhaṃ samāsādya samantād devadānavāḥ |
māthave samaye prāpte tena gandhena darpitāḥ || 6 ||
puṣpamātrasya yad vīryaṃ mārutena visarpitam |
manogrāhi sukhaṃ sarvaṃ pārthivaṃ gandhamuttamam || 7 ||
te daityāstena gandhena kiṃcid vismayamāgatāḥ |
prasannamanaso bhūtvā paraṃ saukhyamupāgatāḥ || 8 ||
ūcuśca sahitāḥ sarve tena gandhena darpitāḥ |
puṣpamātrasya yad vīryaṃ kiṃ tasya phalato bhavet || 9 ||
anumānena vijñeyā vividhāḥ karmabuddhayaḥ |
śubhāścaivāśubhāścaiva buddhiprāṇena dehinām || 3.30.10 ||
tasmād vayaṃ payomadhye oṣadhyo nirmathāmahe |
mandareṇa viśālena balinā kāmarūpiṇā || 11 ||
samudramabhisaṃrambhānmathnīmaḥ somajaṃ jalam |
pītvā ca sahitāḥ sarve prasthitāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ || 12|
viṣṇurevāgraṇīsteṣāṃ bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ |
divaṃ ca vasudhāṃ caiva bhokṣyāmaḥ saha śatrubhiḥ || 13 ||
samūlapatraśākhāśca sapuṣpāḥ phalaśālinaḥ |
sarve grahāṃśca gṛhṇīmaḥ sudhāṃ ca vasudhātale || 14 ||
uddhṛtya giripādebhyo gandhamādanasānujān |
prabhāṣya vacanaṃ daityā mandarasya prakampane || 15 ||
samuddhartuṃ pradhāvantaḥ kampayanti sma medinīm |
niścayena mahāvīryā bāhubhiḥ pariṇāhibhiḥ || 16 ||
na śaknuste sūmuddhartuṃ śailendraṃ danuvaṃśajāḥ |
nipeturjānubhirghṛṣṭā vipule parvatāntare || 17 ||
samādhāyātmanā''tmānaṃ tapasā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ |
pitāmahaṃ prapadyante śirobhiḥ kāmarūpibhiḥ || 18||
teṣāṃ mano'bhilaṣitaṃ brahmā sarvatrago vaśī |
jñātvā bahuvidhairvākyairvyājahāra sarasvatīm || 19 ||
aśarīrāṃ śarīrasthaḥ parayā varṇasampadā |
sarvalokamatirbrahmā lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 3.30.20 ||
ādityairvasubhiścaiva rudraiśca samarudgaṇaiḥ |
devairyakṣaiḥ sagandharvaiḥ kinnaraiśca pragāyibhiḥ || 21 ||
sametya sahitaiḥ sarvaiḥ śakya uddharituṃ giriḥ |
amṛtārthe mahātejā dhātubhiḥ samaraṃjitaḥ || 22 ||
surāsuragaṇāḥ sarve samutpāṭya mahāgirim |
hastārūḍhāḥ prapaśyanti vīrudho himavadrasam || 23 ||
etacchutvā ca vacanaṃ sarveṣāmantike tadā |
daiteyā bāhubalino manobhirvāgbhiraiva ca || 24 ||
vikrīḍabhūtā bahudhā babhūvurlavaṇāmbhasaḥ |
yatra puṣkaravinyastaḥ sahitairdevadānavaiḥ || 25 ||
surāsuragaṇāḥ sarve sahitā lavaṇāmbhasaḥ |
mandaraṃ puṣkaraṃ kṛtvā netraṃ vāsukimeva ca || 26 ||
samāḥ sahasraṃ mathitaṃ jalamoṣadhibhiḥ saha |
kṣīrabhūtaṃ samāyogādamṛtaṃ samapadyata || 27 ||
tajjahrurasurāḥ pūrvamākrāntā lobhamanyunā |
dhanvantaristathā madyaṃ śrīrdevī kaustubho maṇiḥ|| 28 ||
śaśāṅko vimalaścāpi samuttasthuḥ samantataḥ |
uccaiḥśravā hayo ramyaḥ pīyūṣaṃ tadanantaram || 29 ||
paścād devāstadātumudyatā rāhumabruvan |
na tu kecitpibanti sma daityā naiva ca dānavāḥ || 3.30.30 ||
cicchedātha hariḥ saṃkhye rāhoścakreṇa kaṃ tadā |
anirmuktaṃ pitṛgaṇairmunibhiśca sanātanaiḥ || 31 ||
tadindrahastādamṛtaṃ jahāra pṛthivī svayam |
jagāmāṅkagatā devī brahmavākyapracoditā || 32 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṣkare triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 30 ||

<3.31>

ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
nihate daityasaṃghāte viṣṇoścātiparākrame |
daiteyā dānaveyāśca kimicchanti parākramāt || 1 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
dānavā rājyamicchanti parākramya mahābalāḥ |
tapa icchanti sahitā devāḥ satyaparākramāḥ || 2 ||
janamejaya uvāca
kathaṃ kālasya mahato hiraṇyakaśipustadā |
yajate brahmaṇaḥ kṣetre prāptaiśvaryaḥ sa kāmadaḥ || 3 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
īje bahusuvarṇena rājasūyena pārthivaḥ |
kratunā dānavaśreṣṭho vasudhāyāṃ mahābalaḥ || 4 ||
gaṅgāyamunayormadhye yadabhūd vipulaṃ tapaḥ |
sameyustatra sahitā yajamāne mahāsure || 5 ||
brāhmaṇā vedavidvāṃso mahāvrataparāyaṇāḥ |
yatayaścāpare siddhā yogadharmeṇa bhārata || 6 ||
munayo vālakhilyāśca dhanyā dharmeṇa śobhitāḥ |
bahavo hi dvijā mukhyā nityadharmaparāyaṇāḥ || 7 ||
ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgā vipraiḥ pūjyāḥ sahasraśaḥ |
vipulairatra vibhavairhiyamāṇaistatastataḥ || 8 ||
śukrastu saha putreṇa daityaṃ yājayate prabhuḥ |
hiraṇyakaśipuṃ madhye gaṇānāṃ jvalanaprabhaḥ || 9 ||
hiraṇyakaśipuścaiva vyājahāra sarasvatīm |
kāmād varaṃ dadātīti tad vai sampratipadyatām || 3.31.10 ||
viṣṇurvāmanarūpeṇa bhikṣāṃ tāṃ pratigṛhṇati |
hiraṇyakaśiporhastād dve pade padameva ca || 11 ||
tataḥ kramitumārebhe viṣṇuḥ satyaparākramaḥ |
trīm̐llokān munibhiḥ krāntairdivyaṃ vapuradhārayat || 12 ||
hṛtarājyāśca daiteyāḥ pātālavivaraṃ yayuḥ |
sasainyagaṇasambaddhāḥ saprāsāḥ sāsitomarāḥ || 13 ||
sayantralaguḍāścaiva sapatākārathadhvajāḥ |
sacarmavarmakośāśca sāyudhāḥ saparaśvadhāḥ || 14 ||
tathendraviṣṇusahitāḥ sadyaste'bhyutthitā gaṇā|
abhyaṣiñcan pramuditā lokānāmadhipe surāḥ || 15 ||
sa tān svadhāmṛtenāśu pitṛtve samatarpayat |
brahmā tadamṛtaṃ divyaṃ mahendrāya prayacchati |
akṣayaṃ cāvyayaṃ caiva saṃvṛtastena karmaṇā || 16 ||
tataḥ śaṅkhamupādhmāsīd dviṣatāṃ lomaharṣaṇam |
pitāmahakarodbhūtaṃ janitṛ prathame pade || 17 ||
taṃ śrutvā śaṅkhaśabdaṃ tu trayo lokāḥ samāhitāḥ |
nirvṛtiṃ paramāṃ prāptā indraṃ nāthamavāpya ca || 18 ||
sarvaiḥ praharaṇaiścaiva saṃyuktā vahnisambhavaiḥ |
mandarāgreṣu vihitairjvaladbhiriva pāvakaiḥ || 19 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṣkare ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 31 ||

<3.32>

dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tato mahati vṛttānte sthite rājye mahodaye |
devatānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ sahavāso'bhavat tadā || 1 ||
ekataḥ samadhīyanti sahitāḥ prarudanti ca |
svayaṃ ca bhāgaṃ gṛhṇanti yajñakarmaṇi bhārata || 2 ||
prācetasaṃ tato dakṣaṃ dīkṣitvā vai bṛhaspatiḥ |
vājimedhāya bhagavānṛṣibhiḥ parivāritaḥ || 3 ||
tasmin mātāmahe yajñe dakṣasya viditātmanaḥ |
śāmitramakarod rudro bhāgārthe saha nandinā || 4 ||
rudrasyaiva hi tad rūpaṃ dvidhābhūtaṃ tadīpsayā |
jātaḥ paramadharmātmā nandī puruṣavigrahaḥ || 5 ||
tena yogena rājendra yattad brahma sanātanam |
vihitaṃ satyavacanaistenaiva paramātmanā || 6 ||
sarūpaiścāpyarūpaiśca virūpākṣairghaṭodaraiḥ |
ūrdhvanetrairmahākāyairvikaṭairvāmanaistathā || 7 ||
śikhibhirjaṭibhiścaiva tryakṣaiśca śaṅkukarṇibhiḥ |
cīribhiścarmibhiścaiva kūṭamudgarapāṇibhiḥ || 8 ||
saghaṇṭādhāribhiścaiva muñjamekhaladhāribhiḥ |
sahastakaṭakaiścaiva svarṇakuṇḍaladhāribhiḥ || 9 ||
saḍiṇḍimaiḥ sabherīyaiḥ samṛdaṅgaiḥ saveṇubhiḥ |
etaiḥ parivṛto devo makhaṃ taṃ samupārujat || 3.32.10 ||
saśaṅkhamurajaiścāpi satālaphalapāṇibhiḥ |
uprāyudhadharo devaḥ sapināka ivāntakaḥ || 11 ||
virarājārcibhirdīptairmakhe makhavatāṃ varaḥ |
kālāgniriva dīptārcirjagaddagdhumivodyataḥ || 12 ||
nandī pinākapāṇiśca jaghnaturmakhamuttamam |
yugānta iva kālāgniḥ kṣipraṃ dagdhumivodyataḥ || 13 ||
yūpamutkṣipya dhāvanti niśācaragaṇāstathā |
trāsayan munisaṃghāṃśca cīracarmanivāsinaḥ || 14 ||
havīṃṣyanye pibantyeva jihvābhistāmralocanāḥ |
bhakṣayanti paśūnanye rasanāntāvalambibhiḥ || 15 ||
mumucuścāpare yūpān paśavaḥ praharanti ca |
vahnimadhye prasiñcanti vāribhiḥ praśamāya ca || 16 ||
somamanye jahuḥ kecinnetraistāmrajapopamaiḥ |
darbhān kecid vilumpanti hastaiḥ padmadalaprabhaiḥ || 17 ||
babhañjire ca yūpāgrān kalaśāṃścāpi cikṣipuḥ |
cicchiduḥ kāñcanān vṛkṣāñchobhārthamupakalpitān || || 18 ||
bibhiduścaiva bāṇaiste mumucuśca hiraṇmayān |
lulupuścaiva pātrāṇi mamanthuścāraṇīmapi || 19 ||
arujaṃścaiva prāgvaṃśaṃ lulupuśca samāhitāḥ |
cakhādire puroḍāśān nakhāgraiśca cakartire || 3.32.20 ||
evaṃ divā ca rātrau ca bhidyamāno mahāmakhaḥ |
cukrośa ca mahānādān bhidyamāna ivārṇavaḥ || 21 ||
dhanuḥ saśaramādāya pūrvadattaṃ svayaṃbhuvā |
kṛtaṃ kīcakaveṇubhyāṃ samare sumahārathaḥ || 22 ||
pratigṛhya mahādevaḥ sa śaraiḥ samayojayat |
dhanurvigṛhya jānubhyāṃ jaghāna sa mahākratum || 23 ||
sa viddhastena bāṇena khaṃ samutpatitaḥ kratuḥ |
mṛgo bhūtvā nardamāno brahmāṇamupadhāvati || 24 ||
śareṇābhihatastrāṇaṃ na lebhe praśamaṃ bhuvi |
śaraṇārthī hyayaṃ prāptaḥ śareṇāntargatena ca || 25 ||
tamuvāca mṛgaṃ brahmā śubhaṃ sānunayaṃ vacaḥ |
svareṇottamavīryeṇa gambhīreṇa subhāṣiṇā || 26 ||
evaṃrūpo nabhasi tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi mahāmṛgaḥ |
vijitaśca triparveṇa śareṇānataparvaṇā || 27 ||
tiṣṭhan nakṣatraśirasi saha rudreṇa nityaśaḥ |
somena saha saṃyukto hyakṣayeṇāvyayena ca || 28 ||
divi saṃcārabhūto vai tārābhiḥ saha saṃgataḥ |
jyotirbhūto jyotiṣāṃ tvaṃ dhruvaścaiva mahādhruvaḥ || 29 ||
yaccaitad rudhiraṃ divyaṃ kṣatajādabhiniḥsṛtam |
nabhasyutpatitaṃ caiva pravegena pradhāvataḥ || 3.32.30 ||
kṣatajaṃ bahuvarṇaṃ ca kṣetraṃ maṇḍalasaṃjñitam |
nimittabhūtaṃ bhūtānāṃ varṣe varṣapradaṃ tathā || 31 ||
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ darśane sampravartate |
indriyaśravaṇāccaiva nabhasīndrāyudho'bhavat || 32 ||
cakṣuṣī mānuṣe rājan vismayāt samavaikṣata |
adbhutaṃ bahucitraṃ ca manasā samprakalpitam || 33 ||
na tu rātrau pradṛśyeta khe sabrahmaṇi saṃjñitam |
dinasyaiva sadā tvagre mahatkāryaṃ pradṛśyate || 34 ||
bhūmāveva samuttiṣṭhedākāśe tu vilīyate |
śataśaśca samaṃ sarve pradhāvanti pracetasaḥ |
bhayād rudrasya mahato dhanvino bāṇapāṇayaḥ || 35 ||
nandī rudragaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ pinākī samatiṣṭhata |
yugāntakāle jvalito brahmadaṇḍa ivodyataḥ || 36 ||
viṣṇuḥ śṛṅgasamudbhūtaṃ pragṛhya vipulaṃ dhanuḥ |
prātiṣṭhata mahābāhuḥ pāṇinā cakramādadhat || 37 ||
gadāṃ saghaṇṭāmanyena khaḍgamanyena pāṇinā |
pragṛhya so'grato'tiṣṭhad rudrāyodyatapāṇaye || 38 ||
tataḥ śṛṅgāgrasambhūtaṃ pragṛhya vipulaṃ dhanuḥ |
śaṅkhaṃ cāpratimaṃ loke śarāṃścānataparvaṇaḥ || 39 ||
viṣṇuragrasthito bhāti sabalaḥ saṃhatāṅguliḥ |
baddhagodhāṅgulitrāṇaḥ sacandra iva toyadaḥ || 3.32.40 ||
ādityā vasavaścaiva divyaiḥ praharaṇaiḥ saha |
viṣṇumevābhitaḥ sarve tiṣṭhanti jvalanaprabhāḥ || 41 ||
marutaścaiva viśve ca rudramevābhipedire |
gandharvāḥ kinnarāścaiva nāgā yakṣāḥ sapannagāḥ || 42 ||
ṛṣayo nyastadaṇḍāśca ubhayoḥ pakṣayorhitāḥ |
japanti śāntaye nityaṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 43 ||
rudraḥ śareṇābhyahanad viṣṇumevāgraṇī raṇe |
hṛdi sarvāṅgasandhīṣu tīkṣṇāgreṇa suyantriṇā || 44 ||
na cakampe tadā viṣṇuḥ sarvātmā brahmasambhavaḥ |
na ca roṣamanā nityaṃ vṛtaḥ sarvaiḥ ṣaḍindriyaiḥ || 45 ||
viṣṇuśca dhanurānamya śareṇa samayojayat|
jatrudeśe mumocāśu brahmadaṇḍamivodyatam || 46 ||
sa viddhastena bāṇena mahādevo na kampate |
vajreṇa ca mahāsandhirmandarasya na cālyate || 47 ||
tataḥ prasabhamāplutya rudraṃ viṣṇuḥ sanātanam |
kaṇṭhe jagrāha bhagavān nīlakaṇṭhastato'bhavat|| 48||
anādinidhano devo kṣamatāṃ hi bhavānmama |
sarvabhūtāgamācāryamacalatvācca karmaṇām || 49 ||
karmaṇāṃ caiva kartā ca vikartā caiva bhārata |
aśeṣatvācca bhūtānāṃ sarvabhūteṣu cottamaḥ || 3.32.50 ||
svayameva hi yat karma vidhatte karmayoniṣu |
tayoḥ śubhatamo rājan svayameva tathākarot || 51 ||
antarikṣācchubhā vācaḥ śrūyante paramādbhutāḥ |
siddhānāṃ vadanonmuktāḥ sanātana namo'stu te || 52 ||
nandī pinākamudyamya balavān rudrasambhavaḥ |
mūrddhanyabhijaghānājau viṣṇuṃ krodhena mūrchitaḥ || 53 ||
tataḥ prahasito viṣṇurnandīṃ dṛṣṭvā surottamaḥ |
stambhayāmāsa bhagavān sarvabhūtapatirhariḥ || 54 ||
viṣṇurbrahmasamo bhūtvā tejasā prajvalanniva |
kṣamayā ca samāyuktaḥ sthitaḥ sthāṇurivācalaḥ|| 55 ||
acintyaścāprameyaśca hyajeyaścāpyariṃdamaḥ |
yugāntāgnisamo bhūtvā śāntātmā hariravyayaḥ || 56 ||
prasannaḥ kalpayāmāsa bhāgaṃ rudrāya dhīmate |
viṣṇurdharmaparo nityaṃ tyaktakāmaḥ surottamaḥ || 57 ||
viṣṇunā caiva rājendra sa yajñaḥ saṃdhitaḥ punaḥ |
yathāpakṣaṃ ca te sarve gaṇāstvāsan mahīpate |
tasmin yuddhe mahāghore viṣṇū rudrasya caiva ha || 58 ||
yathāpakṣaṃ bhaved yuddhaṃ dakṣayajñavināśane |
vināśaścaiva yajñasya tadā loke pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 59 ||
sarvabhūteṣu rājendra hito yajñaḥ sanātanaḥ |
dakṣo yajñaphalaṃ caiva prāptavān sa prajāpatiḥ || 3.32.60 ||
imāṃ codāhṛtāṃ divyāṃ kathāmiti sa buddhimān |
śrāvayed yastu viprebhyaḥ śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ || 61 ||
adhītya sarvamadhyātmaṃ devaloke mahīyate |
eṣa pauṣkarako nāma prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ || 62 ||
purāṇe pauṣkare caiva mayā dvaipāyaneritaḥ |
yathāvadanupūrveṇa saṃskṛtaḥ paramarṣibhiḥ || 63 ||
yaścainamagryaṃ puruṣaḥ purāṇaṃ sadāpramattaḥ śṛṇuyād yathoktam|
avāpya kāmāniha vītaśokaḥ paratra ca svargaphalāni bhuṅkte || 64 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṣkare dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 32 ||

<3.33>

trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
prādurbhāvaḥ purāṇeṣu viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ |
satāṃ kathayatāṃ vipra vārāha iti naḥ śrutaḥ || 1 ||
na jānate'sya caritaṃ na vidhiṃ naiva vistaram |
na karma guṇavadbhāvaṃ na hetuṃ na manīṣitam || 2 ||
kimātmako varāho'sau kā mūrtiḥ kāsya devatā |
kimācāraḥ kiṃ prabhāvaḥ kiṃ vā tena purā kṛtam|| 3 ||

<3.35>

pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

mahataḥ parvatasyāgre puṣpahāsaṃ nyaveśayat|
śubhāmatirasāṃ caiva ghṛtadhārāmiti śrutiḥ || 37 ||
varāhaḥ saritaṃ puṇyāṃ pratīcyāmakarot prabhuḥ |
pratīcyāṃ saṃvidhiṃ kṛtvā parvatānkāñcanojjvalān |38|
guṇottarānuttarasyāṃ saṃnyaveśayadagrataḥ |
tataḥ saumyagiriṃ saumyamantarikṣapramāṇataḥ || 39 ||
rukmadhātupraticchannamakarod bhāskaropamam|
sa tu deśo visūryo'pi tasya bhāsā prakāśate || 40 ||
tasya lakṣmyadhikaṃ bhāti tapasā raviṇā yathā |
sūkṣmalakṣaṇavijñeyastapatīva divākaraḥ || 41 ||
sahasraśikharaṃ caiva nānātīrthasamākulam |
cakāra ratnasaṃkīrṇaṃ bhūyo'staṃ nāma parvatam || 42 ||
manoharaguṇopetaṃ mandaraṃ cācalottamam |
uddāmapuṣpagandhaṃ ca parvataṃ gandhamādanam || 43 ||
cakāra tasya śṛṅgeṣu suvarṇarasasambhavam
jambūṃ jāmbūnadamayīmanantādbhutadarśanām|| 44 ||
giriṃ triśikharaṃ caiva tathā puṣkaraparvatam|
śubhraṃ pāṇḍurameghābhaṃ kailāsaṃ ca nagottamam || 45 ||
himavantaṃ ca śailendraṃ divyadhātuvibhūṣitam|
niveśayāmāsa harirvārāhīṃ tanumāsthitaḥ || 46
nadīṃ sarvaguṇopetāmuttarasyāṃ diśi prabhuḥ |
madhudhārāṃ sa kṛtavān divyāmṛṣiśatākulām|| 47 ||
sarve caiva kṣitidharāḥ sapakṣāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ |
tadā kṛtā bhagavatā vicitrāḥ parameṣṭhinā || 48 ||
sa kṛtvā pravibhāgaṃ tu pṛthivyā lokabhāvanaḥ |
devāsurāṇāmutpattau kṛtavān buddhimakṣayām || 49 ||
sarvāsu dikṣu kṣatajopamākṣaścakāra śailānvividhābhidhānān |
hitāya lokasya sa lokanāthaḥ puṇyāśca nadyaḥ salilopagūḍhāḥ || 50 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vārāhe pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 35 ||

<3.36>

ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
jagatsraṣṭumanā devaścintayāmāsa pūrvajaḥ |
tasya cintayato vaktrānniḥsṛtaḥ puruṣaḥ kila || 1 ||
tataḥ sa puruṣo devaṃ kiṃ karomītyupasthitaḥ |
pratyuvāca smitaṃ kṛtvā devadevo jagatpatiḥ || 2 ||
vibhajātmānamityuktvā gato'ntardhānamīśvaraḥ |
antarhitasya devasya saśarīrasya bhārata || 3 ||
praśāntasyeva dīpasya gatistasya na vidyate |
tatasteneritāṃ vāṇīṃ so'nvacintayata prabhuḥ || 4 ||
hiraṇyagarbho bhagavān ya eṣa chandasi śrutaḥ |
eṣa prajāpatiḥ pūrvamabhavad bhuvanādhipaḥ || 5 ||
tadā prabhṛti tasyādyo yajñabhāgo vidhīyate |
prajāpatiruvāca
vibhajātmānamityuktastenāsmi sumahātmanā || 6 ||
kathamātmā vibhajyaḥ syāt saṃśayo hyatra me mahān|
iti cintayatastasya omityevotthitaḥ svaraḥ || 7 ||
sa bhūmāvantarikṣe ca nāke ca kṛtavāṃstataḥ |
taṃ caivābhyasatastasya manaḥsāramayaḥ punaḥ || 8 ||
hṛdayād devadevasya vaṣaṭkāraḥ samutthitaḥ |
bhūmyantarikṣakānāṃ ca bhūrbhuvaḥsuvarātmikāḥ |
mahāsmṛtimayāḥ puṇyā mahāvyāhṛtayo'bhavan || 9 ||
chandasāṃ pravarā devī caturviṃśākṣarābhavat |
tatpadaṃ saṃsmaran divyāṃ sāvitrīmakarot prabhuḥ || 3.36.10 ||
ṛksāmātharvayajuṣaścaturo bhagavān prabhuḥ |
cakāra nikhilān vedān brahmayuktena karmaṇā || 11 ||
tatastasyaiva manasaḥ sanaḥ sanaka eva ca |
sanātanaśca bhagavān varadaśca sanandanaḥ || 12 ||
sanatkumāraśca vibhustatra jajñe sanātanaḥ |
mānasāścaiva pūrvādyā ityete ṣaṇmaharṣayaḥ || 13 ||
brahmāṇaṃ kapilaṃ caiva ṣaḍetāṃścaiva yoginaḥ |
yatayo yogatantreṣu yān stuvanti dvijātayaḥ || 14 ||
tato marīcimatriṃ ca pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum |
bhṛgumaṅgirasaṃ caiva manuṃ caiva prajāpatim || 15 ||
pitṝṃśca sarvabhūtānāṃ devatāsurarakṣasām |
maharṣīnasṛjacchambhuraṣṭāvetāṃśca mānasān || 16 ||
ete yugasahasrānte yāścaiṣāmabhavan prajāḥ |
kalpe niḥśeṣamukte tu tato gacchanti nirvṛtim|| 17 ||
bhūyo varṣasahasrānte utpattistu vidhīyate |
eteṣāmeva devānāṃ prajākartṛṣu vai tadā || 18 ||
kiṃ tu karmaviśeṣeṇa devatānāṃ yuge yuge |
nāmajanmaviśeṣāśca tathaiva yugaparyaye || 19 ||
aṅguṣṭhād dakṣiṇād dakṣa utpanno bhagavānṛṣiḥ |
tasyaiva tu punarbhāryā vāmāṅguṣṭhādajāyata || 3.36.20 ||
tasya tatrābhavan kanyā viśrutā lokamātaraḥ |
yābhirvyāptāstrayo lokāḥ prajābhirmanujādhipa || 21 ||
aditiṃ ca ditiṃ kālāṃ danāyuṃ siṃhikāṃ munim |
prādhāṃ krodhāṃ ca surabhiṃ vinatāṃ surasāṃ tathā || 22 ||
danuṃ kadrūṃ ca duhitṝḥ pradadau kaśyapāya tu |
prajāṃ saṃcintya manasā gatijñenāntarātmanā || 23 ||
arundhatīṃ vasuṃ yāmīṃ lambāṃ bhānuṃ marutvatīm |
saṃkalpāṃ ca muhūrtāṃ ca sādhyāṃ viśvāṃ ca bhārata || 24 ||
manave brahmaputrāya kanyā dakṣo dadau daśa |
tataḥ sarvānavadyāṅgyaḥ kanyāḥ kamalalocanāḥ || 25 ||
pūrṇacandrānanā divyā gandhavatyo manoramāḥ |
kīrtiṃ lakṣmīṃ dhṛtiṃ puṣṭiṃ buddhiṃ medhāṃ kṣamāṃ tathā|| 26 ||
matiṃ lajjāṃ vasuṃ caiva dakṣo dharmāya vai dadau |
atrestu tanayo jātastasya toyātmakaḥ śaśī || 27 ||
putro grahāṇāmadhipaḥ sahasrāṃśustamisrahā |
tasmai nakṣatrayoginyaḥ saptaviṃśatiruttamāḥ || 28 ||
rohiṇīpramukhāḥ kanyā dakṣaḥ prācetaso dadau |
etāsāṃ putrapautraṃ ca procyamānaṃ mayā śṛṇu || 29 ||
kaśyapasya manoścaiva dharmasya śaśinastathā |
aryamā varuṇo mitraḥ pūṣā dhātā puraṃdaraḥ || 3.36.30||
tvaṣṭā bhagoṃ'śuḥ savitā parjanyaśceti viśrutāḥ |
adityāṃ jajñire devāḥ kaśyapāllokabhāvanāḥ || 31 ||
dityāḥ putradvayaṃ jajñe kaśyapāditi naḥ śrutam |
hiraṇyakaśipuścaiva hiraṇyākṣaśca vīryavān |
dvāvapyamitavikrāntau tapasā kaśyapopamau || 32 ||
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putrāḥ pañcaiva sumahābalāḥ |
prahrādaścaiva saṃhrādastathānuhrāda eva ca || 33 ||
hradaścaiva tu vikrāntaḥ pañcamo'nuhradastathā
prahrādaḥ pūrvajasteṣāmanuhrādastathā paraḥ || 34 ||
prahrādasya trayaḥ putrā vikrāntāḥ sumahābalāḥ |
virocanaśca jambhaśca sujambhaśceti viśrutāḥ || 35 ||
balirvirocanasuto bāṇa eko baleḥ sutaḥ |
bāṇasya cendradamanaḥ putraḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ || 36 ||
danoḥ putrāstu bahavo vaṃśe khyātā mahāsurāḥ |
vipracittiḥ prathamajasteṣāṃ rājā babhūva ha || 37 ||
gaṇaḥ prajajñe krodhāyāḥ putrapautramanantakam |
raudrāḥ krodhavaśā nāma krūrakarmāṇa eva ca || 38 ||
siṃhikā suṣuve rāhuṃ grahaṃ candrārkamardanam |
grastāraṃ caiva candrasya sūryasya ca vināśanam || 39 ||
kālāyāḥ kālakalpastu gaṇaḥ paramadāruṇaḥ |
abhavad dīptasūryākṣo nīlameghasamaprabhaḥ || 3.36.40 ||
sahasraśīrṣā śeṣaśca vāsukistakṣakastathā |
bahūnāṃ kadruputrāṇāmete prādhānyamāgatāḥ || 41 ||
dharmātmāno vedavidaḥ sadā prāṇihite ratāḥ |
lokatantradharāścaiva varadāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ || 42 ||
tārkṣyaścāriṣṭanemiśca garuḍaśca mahābalaḥ |
aruṇaścāruṇiścaiva vinatāyāḥ sutāḥ smṛtāḥ || 43 ||
imāścāpsarasaḥ puṇyā vividhāḥ puṇyalakṣaṇāḥ |
suṣuve'ṣṭau mahābhāgā prādhā devarṣipūjitā ||44 ||
anavadyāṃ manuṃ vaṃśāmanūnāmaruṇapriyām |
anugāṃ subhagāṃ bhāsīṃ striyaḥ prādhā vyajāyata || 45 ||
alambuṣā miśrakeśī puṇḍarīkā tilottamā |
surūpā lakṣaṇā kṣemā tathā rambhā manoramā || 46 ||
asitā ca subāhuśca suvṛttā sumukhī tathā |
supriyā ca sugandhā ca surasā ca pramāthinī || 47 ||
kāśyā śāradvatī caiva mauneyāpsarasaḥ smṛtāḥ |
viśvā vasurbharaṇyaśca gandharvāścaiva viśrutāḥ || 48 ||
menakā sahajanyā ca parṇikā puñjikasthalā |
ghṛtasthalā ghṛtācī ca viśvācī corvaśī tathā || 49 ||
anumlocetyabhikhyātā pramloceti ca tā daśa |
manovatī cāpi tathā vaidikyo'psarasastathā || 3.36.50 ||
prajāpatestu saṃkalpāt sambhūtā bhuvanapriyāḥ |
amṛtaṃ brāhmaṇā gāvo rudrāśceti catuṣṭayam || 51 ||
surabhyapatyamityetat purāṇe niścayo mahān |
etad vai kaśyapāpatyaṃ manorvaṃśaṃ nibodha me || 52 ||
saṃkṣepeṇaiva tat sarvaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi te'nagha|
viśvedevāstu viśvāyāḥ sādhyā sādhyān vyajāyata||53||
marutvatyāṃ marutvanto vasostu vasavaḥ smṛtāḥ|
bhānostu bhānavastāta muhūrtāśca muhūrtajāḥ||54||
lambā ghoṣaṃ vijajñe'tha nāgavīthī ca jāmijā ||
pṛthivyāṃ viṣamaṃ sarvaṃ marutvatyāmajāyata ||55||
saṃkalpāyāstu kauravya jajñe saṃkalpa eva ca ||
dharmasya putro lakṣmyāstu kāmo jajñe jagatprabhuḥ || 56 ||
yaśo harṣaśca kāmasya ratyāṃ putradvayaṃ smṛtam ||
somasya putro rohiṇyāṃ jajñe varcā mahāprabhaḥ || 57 ||
udayanneva bhagavānvarcasvī yena jāyate ||
purūravāśca bhagavāturvaśī yena yujyate || 58 ||
evaṃ putrasahasrāṇi strīṇāṃ caiva parasparam ||
etāvattu jaganmūlaṃ yatra lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ || 59 ||
prajāpatistu bhagavān guṇataḥ prekṣya dehinaḥ ||
ādhipatyeṣu yukteṣu niyojayati yogavit || 3.36.60 ||
diśo daśa kṣitimṛṣayo'rṇavānnagāndumauṣadhīruragasaritsurāsurān ||
prajāpatirbhuvanasṛjo nabhobhuvaḥ kriyāmakhānatha kṛtavān girīṃśca saḥ || 61 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khileṣu harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 36 ||

<3.37>

vaiśampāyana uvāca ||
trayāṇāmapi lokānāmādityānāṃ ca bhārata ||
cakāra śakraṃ rājānamādityasamatejasam || 1 ||
sa vajrī kavacī viṣṇuradityāmabhijajñivān ||
smṛteḥ sahāyo dyutimānyathā so'dhvaryubhiḥ stutaḥ || 2 ||
jātamātro'tha bhagavānsa kuśairbrāhmaṇairdhṛtaḥ ||
tadāprabhṛti deveśaḥ kauśikatvamupāgataḥ || 3 ||
abhiṣicyādhirājye tu sahasrākṣaṃ puraṃdaram ||
brahmā krameṇa rājyāni vyādeṣṭumupacakrame || 4 ||
yajñānāṃ tapasāṃ caiva grahanakṣatrayostathā ||
dvijānāmoṣadhīnāṃ tu somaṃ rājye'bhyaṣecayat || 5 ||
dakṣaṃ prajāpatīnāṃ tu ambhasāṃ varuṇaṃ patim ||
pitṝṇāṃ sarvanidhanaṃ kālaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ prabhum ||6||
gandhānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ ca śarīriṇām ||
śabdākāśabalānāṃ ca vāyurīśastadā kṛtaḥ || 7 ||
sarvabhūtapiśācānāṃ mṛtyūnāṃ ca gavāṃ tathā ||
utpātagraharogāṇāṃ vyādhīnāṃ tu tathaiva ca || 8 ||
vratānāṃ ceva sarveṣāṃ mahādevaḥ kṛtaḥ prabhuḥ ||
yakṣāṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca guhyakānāṃ dhanasya ca || 9 ||
ratnānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ kṛto vaiśravaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||
sarveṣāṃ daṃṣṭriṇāṃ śeṣo nāgānāmatha vāsukiḥ || 3.37.10 ||
sarīsṛpāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ prabhurvai takṣakaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
sāgarāṇāṃ nadīnāṃ ca meṣānāṃ varṣaṇasya ca ||
ādityānāmavarajaḥ parjanyo'dhipatiḥ kṛtaḥ || 11 ||
gandharvāṇāmadhipatistathā citrarathaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
sarvāpsarogaṇānāṃ ca kāmadevaḥ prabhuḥ kṛtaḥ || 12 ||
catuṣpadānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vāhanānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ||
maheśvaradhvajaḥ śrīmān govṛṣo'dhipatiḥ kṛtaḥ ||13||
daityānāṃ ca mahātejā hiraṇyākṣaḥ prabhuḥ kṛtaḥ ||
hiraṇyakaśipuścaiva yauvarājye'bhiṣecitaḥ || 14 ||
gaṇānāṃ kālakeyānāṃ mahākālaḥ prabhuḥ kṛtaḥ ||
anāyuṣāyāḥ putrāṇāṃ vṛtro rājā tadā kṛtaḥ ||15||
siṃhikātanayo yastu rāhurnāma mahāsuraḥ ||
utpātānāmanekānāmaśubhānāṃ prabhuḥ kṛtaḥ || 16 ||
ṛtūnāmatha sarveṣāṃ yugānāṃ caiva bhārata ||
pakṣāṇāṃ ceva māsānāṃ tathaiva tithiparvaṇām || 17 ||
kalākāṣṭhāmuhūrtānāṃ gaterayanayostataḥ ||
kṛtaḥ saṃvatsaro rājā yogasya gaṇitasya ca || 18 ||
pakṣiṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ cakṣuṣāṃ ca mahābalaḥ ||
suparṇo bhogināṃ caiva garuḍo'dhipatiḥ kṛtaḥ || 19 ||
aruṇo garuḍabhrātā japāpuṣpacayaprabhuḥ ||
yogānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ sādhyānāmadhipaḥ kṛtaḥ || 3.37.20 ||
putro'sya viratho nāma kaśyapasya prajāpateḥ ||
rājā prācyāṃ diśi tathā vāsavenādhipaḥ kṛtaḥ ||21||
ādityasya vibhoḥ putro dharmarājo mahāyaśāḥ ||
dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi yamo mahendreṇaiva satkṛtaḥ || 22 ||
kaśyapasyaurasaḥ putraḥ salilāntargataḥ sadā ||
amburāja iti khyātaḥ pratīcyāṃ diśi pārthivaḥ || 23 ||
pulastyaputro dyutimānmahendrapratimaḥ prabhuḥ ||
ekākṣaḥ piṅgalo nāma saumyāyāṃ diśi pārthivaḥ|| 24 ||
evaṃ vibhajya rājyāni svayaṃbhūrlokabhāvanaḥ ||
lokāṃśca tridive divyānadadatsa pṛthak pṛthak || 25 ||
kasyacitsūryasaṃkāśānkasyacidvahnisannibhān || 
kasyacitsuṣṭhuvidyotānkasyaciccandranirmalān || 26 || 
nānāvarṇānkāmagamānanekaśataśo janān ||
sa tāntsukṛtināṃ lokānpāpaduṣkṛtidurlabhān || 27 ||
yeṣāṃ bhāso vibhāntyagre saumyāstārāgaṇā iva ||
ete sukṛtināṃ lokā ye jātāḥ puṇyakarmiṇaḥ || 28 ||
ye yajanti makhaiḥ puṇyaiḥ samāptavaradakṣiṇaiḥ ||
svadāraniratāḥ kṣāntā ṛjavaḥ satyavādinaḥ || 29 ||
dīnānugrahakartāro brahmaṇyā lobhavarjitāḥ ||
saṃtyaktarajasaḥ santo yānti tatra tapomalāḥ || 3.37.30 ||
evaṃ niyujya tanayāntsvayaṃ lokapitāmahaḥ ||
puṣkaraṃ brahmasadanamāruroha prajāpatiḥ || 31 ||
sarve svayaṃbhudatteṣu pālaneṣu divaukasaḥ ||
remire sveṣu lokeṣu mahendreṇābhipālitāḥ || 32 ||
svayaṃbhuvā śakrapuraḥsarā surāḥ kṛtā yathārhaṃ pratipālaneṣu te ||
yaśo divaṃ ca pratipedire śubhaṃ mudaṃ ca jagmurmakhabhāgabhojinaḥ || 33 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khileṣu harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 37 ||

<3.38>

aṣṭātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
kadācit tu sapakṣāste parvatā dharaṇīdharāḥ |
prasthitā dharaṇīṃ tyaktvā nūnaṃ tasyaiva māyayā || 1 ||
tadāsurāṇāṃ nilayaṃ hiraṇyākṣeṇa pālitam |
diśaṃ pratīcīmāgatya hrade'majjan yathā gajāḥ || 2 ||
tatrāsurebhyaḥ śaṃsanta ādhipatyaṃ surāśrayam |
tacchrutvāthāsurāḥ sarve cakrurudyogamuttamam || 3 ||
krūrāṃ ca buddhimatulāṃ pṛthivīharaṇe ratāḥ |
āyudhāni ca sarvāṇi jagṛhurbhīmavikramāḥ || 4 ||
cakrāśanīṃstathā khaḍgān bhuśuṇḍīśca dhanūṃṣi ca |
prāsānpāśāṃśca śaktīśca musalāni gadāstathā || 5 ||
cakra, aśani, khaṅga, bhuśuṇḍi, dhanuṣa, prāsa, pāśa,
śakti, mūsala aura gadā ādi āyudha le liye || 5 ||
kecit kavacinaḥ sajjā mattanāgāṃstathā pare |
kecidaśvarathānyuktā apare'śvān mahāsurāḥ || 6 ||
keciduṣṭrāṃstathā khaḍgān mahiṣān gardabhānapi |
svabāhubalamāsthāya keciccāpi padātayaḥ || 7 ||
parivārya hiraṇyākṣaṃ talabaddhāḥ kalāpinaḥ |
itaścetaśca niścerurhṛṣṭāḥ sarve yuyutsavaḥ || 8 ||
tato devagaṇāḥ paścāt puraṃdarapurogamāḥ |
daityānāṃ viditodyogāścakrurudyogamuttamam || 9 ||
mahatā caturaṅgeṇa balena susamāhitāḥ |
baddhagodhāṅgulitrāṇāstūṇavantaḥ samārgaṇāḥ || 3.38.10 ||
ugrāyudhadharā devāḥ sveṣvanīkeṣvavasthitāḥ |
airāvatagataṃ śakramanvagacchanta pṛṣṭhataḥ || 11 ||
tatastūryaninādena bherīṇāṃ ca mahāsvanaiḥ |
abhyadravaddhiraṇyākṣo devarājaṃ puraṃdaram || 12 ||
tīkṣṇaiḥ paraśunistriṃśairgadātomaraśaktibhiḥ |
musalaiḥ paṭṭiśaiścaiva chādayāmāsa vāsavam || 13 ||
tato'strabalavegena sārciṣmatyaḥ sudāruṇāḥ |
ghorarūpā mahāvegā nipeturbāṇavṛṣṭayaḥ || 14 ||
śiṣṭāśca daityā balinaḥ sitadhāraiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ |
parighairāyasaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ kṣepaṇīyaiśca mudgaraiḥ || 15 ||
gaṇḍaśailaiśca vividhai raśmibhiścādrisaṃnibhaiḥ |
ghātanībhiśca gurvībhiḥ śataghnībhistathaiva ca || 16 ||
yugairyantraiśca nirmuktairargalaiśca vidāraṇaiḥ |
sarvāndevagaṇāndaityāḥ saṃnijaghnuḥ savāsavān|| 17 ||
dhūmrakeśaṃ hariśmaśruṃ nānāpraharaṇāyudham |
raktasaṃdhyābhrasaṃkāśaṃ kirīṭottamadhāriṇam || 18 ||
nīlapītāmbaradharaṃ śitadaṃṣṭrordhvadhāriṇam |
ājānubāhuṃ haryakṣaṃ baiḍūryābharaṇojjvalam || 19 ||
samudyatāyudhaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve devagaṇāstadā |
te hiraṇyākṣamasuraṃ daityānāmagrataḥ sthitam || 3.38.20 ||
yugāntasamaye bhīmaṃ sthitaṃ mṛtyumivāgrataḥ |
pravivyathuḥ surāḥ sarve tadā śakrapurogamāḥ || 21 ||
dṛṣṭvā''yāntaṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ mahādrimiva jaṅgamam |
devāḥ saṃvignamanasaḥ pragṛhītaśarāsanāḥ |
sahasrākṣaṃ puraskṛtya tasthuḥ saṃgrāmamūrdhani || 22 ||
sā ca daityacamū reje hiraṇyakavacojjvalā |
pravṛddhanakṣatragaṇā śāradī dyaurivāmalā || 23 ||
te'nyonyamapi sampetuḥ pātayantaḥ parasparam |
babhañjurbāhubhirbāhudvandvamanye yuyutsavaḥ || 24 ||
gadānipātairbhagnāṅgā bāṇaiśca vyathitorasaḥ |
vinipetuḥ pṛthak kecittathānye'pi vijaghnire ||25||
babhañjire rathān kecitkecitsammarditā rathaiḥ |
sambādhamanye samprāptā na śekuścalituṃ rathāt || 26 ||
dānavendrabalaṃ tatra devānāṃ ca mahad balam |
anyonyabāṇavarṣeṇa yuddhadurdinamābabhau || 27 ||
hiraṇyākṣastu balavān kruddhaḥ sa ditinandanaḥ |
vyavardhata mahātejāḥ samudra iva parvaṇi || 28 ||
tasya kuddhasya sahasā mukhānniścerurarciṣaḥ |
sāgnidhūmaśca pavano yayau tasya samīpataḥ || 29 ||
śastrajālairbahuvidhairdhanurbhiḥ parighairapi |
sarvamākāśamāvavre parvatairutthitairiva || 3.38.30 ||
bahubhiḥ śastranistriṃśaiśchinnabhinnaśirorasaḥ |
na śekuścalituṃ devā hiraṇyākṣārditā yudhi || 31 ||
sarve vitrāsitā devā hiraṇyākṣeṇa saṃyuge |
na śekuryatnavanto'pi yatnaṃ kartuṃ vicetasaḥ || 32 ||
tena śakraḥ sahasrākṣaḥ stambhito'streṇa dhīmatā |
airāvatagataḥ saṃkhye nāśakaccalituṃ bhayāt || 33 ||
sarvāṃśca devānakhilān sa parājitya dānavaḥ |
stambhayitvā ca deveśamātmasthaṃ manyate jagat || 34 ||
satoyameghapratimograniḥsvanaṃ prabhinnamātaṅgavilāsavigraham |
dhanurvidhunvantamudāravarcasaṃ tadāsurendraṃ dadṛśuḥ surāḥ sthitāḥ || 35 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vārāhe śakrastambhane aṣṭātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 38 ||

<3.39>

ekonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
niṣprayatne surapatau dharṣiteṣu sureṣu ca |
hiraṇyākṣavadhe buddhiṃ cakre cakragadādharaḥ || 1 ||
vārāhaḥ parvato nāma yaḥ pūrvaṃ samudāhṛtaḥ |
sa eva bhūtvā bhagavānājagāmāsurāntakṛt || 2 ||
tataścandrapratīkāśamagṛhṇācchaṅkhamuttamam |
sahasrāraṃ ca taccakraṃ cakraparvatasaṃnibham || 3 ||
mahādevo mahābuddhirmahāyogī maheśvaraḥ |
paṭhyate yo'maraiḥ sarvairguhyairnāmabhiravyayaḥ || 4 ||
sadasaccātmani śreṣṭhaḥ sadbhiryaḥ sevyate sadā |
ijyate yaḥ purāṇaśca triloke lokabhāvanaḥ || 5 ||
yo vaikuṇṭhaḥ surendrāṇāmananto bhogināmapi |
viṣṇuryo yogaviduṣāṃ yo yajño yajñakarmaṇām || 6 ||
makhe yasya prasādena bhuvanasthā divaukasaḥ |
ājyaṃ maharṣibhirdattamaśnuvanti tridhā hutam || 7 ||
yo gatirdevadaityānāṃ yaḥ surāṇāṃ parā gatiḥ |
yaḥ pavitraṃ pavitrāṇāṃ svayambhūravyayo vibhuḥ || 8 ||
yasya cakrapraviṣṭāni dānavānāṃ yuge yuge |
kulānyākulatāṃ yānti yāni dṛptāni vīryataḥ || 9 ||
tato daityadravakaraṃ paurāṇaṃ śaṅkhamuttamam |
dhaman vaktreṇa balavānākṣipad daityajīvitam || 3.39.10 ||
śrutvā śaṅkhasvanaṃ ghoramasurāṇāṃ bhayāvaham |
kṣubhitā dānavāḥ sarve diśo daśa vyalokayan || 11 ||
tataḥ saṃraktanayano hiraṇyākṣo mahāsuraḥ |
ko'yamityabravīd roṣānnārāyaṇamudaikṣata || 12 ||
vārāharūpiṇaṃ devaṃ saṃsthitaṃ puruṣottamam |
śaṅkhacakrodyatakaraṃ devānāmārtināśanam || 13 ||
rarāja śaṅkhacakrābhyāṃ tābhyāmasurasūdanaḥ |
sūryācandramasormadhye yathā nīlapayodharaḥ || 14 ||
tato'suragaṇāḥ sarve hiraṇyākṣapurogamāḥ |
udyatāyudhanistriṃśā dṛptā devamupādravan || 15 ||
pīḍyamāno'tibalibhirdaityaiḥ sarvāyudhodyataiḥ |
na cacāla hariryuddhe'kampyamāna ivācalaḥ || 16 ||
tataḥ prajvalitāṃ śaktiṃ vārāhorasi dānavaḥ |
hiraṇyākṣo mahātejāḥ pātayāmāsa vīryavān || 17 ||
tasyāḥ śaktyāḥ prabhāveṇa brahmā vismayamāgataḥ |
samīpamāgatāṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāśaktiṃ mahābalaḥ || 18 ||
huṃkāreṇaiva nirbhartsya pātayāmāsa bhūtale |
tasyāṃ pratihatāyāṃ tu brahmā sādhviti cābravīt || 19 ||
yaḥ prabhuḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ vārāhastena tāḍitaḥ |
tato bhagavatā cakramāvidhyādityasaṃnibham || 3.39.20 ||
pātitaṃ dānavendrasya śirasyuttamakarmaṇā |
tataḥ sthitasyaiva śirastasya bhūmau papāta ha |
hiraṇmayaṃ vajrahataṃ meruśṛṅgamivottamam || 21 ||
hiraṇyākṣe hate daitye śeṣā ye tatra dānavāḥ |
sarve tasya bhayatrastā jagmurāśu diśo daśa || 22 ||
sa sarvalokāpraticakracakro mahāhaveṣvapratimogracakraḥ |
babhau varāho yudhi cakrapāṇiḥ kālo yugānteṣviva daṇḍapāṇiḥ || 23 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vārāhe ekonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 39 ||

<3.40>

catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
vidrāvya tu raṇe sarvānasurān puruṣottamaḥ |
mumoca tatra baddhāṃstān puraṃdaramukhān surān || 1 ||
tataḥ prakṛtimāpannāḥ sarve devagaṇāstathā |
puraṃdaraṃ puraskṛtya nārāyaṇamupasthitāḥ || 2 ||
devā ūcuḥ
tvatprasādena bhagavaṃstava bāhubalena ca |
jīvāmo'dya mahābāho niṣkrāntāścāntakānanāt|| 3 ||
tvacchāsanāddhi bhagavankiṃ kurvantvaditeḥ sutāḥ |
icchāmaḥ pādaśuśrūṣāṃ tava kartuṃ sanātana || 4 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇaḥ |
uvāca vacanaṃ devān mudāyukto hatadviṣaḥ || 5 ||
śrībhagavānuvāca
yo yasya bhāvato loko mayaiva vihitaḥ purā |
pālyatāṃ sa tu yatnena niyogaśca kvacit kvacit|| 6 ||
aiśvaryaṃ pratipannāḥ svaṃ kratubhāgapuraskṛtam |
mayaiva pūrvaṃ nirdiṣṭo niyogaḥ pratipālyatām || 7 ||
śakraṃ covāca bhagavān vacanaṃ dundubhisvanaḥ |
idaṃ yathāvat kartavyaṃ satsu cāsatsu ca tvayā|| 8 ||
gacchantu tapasā svarge munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ |
tava lokaṃ suraśreṣṭha sarvakāmadughaṃ sadā || 9 ||
yāyajūkāśca ye kecid brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā viśaḥ |
teṣāṃ kāmadughā lokāḥ svargamādimanoharāḥ |
yajñairiṣṭvā yāyajūkāḥ phalaṃ te prāpnuvantu ca || 3.40.10 ||
bhāvaḥ saddharmaśīlānāmabhāvaḥ pāpakarmaṇām |
santaḥ svargajitaḥ santu sarvāśramanivāsinaḥ || 11 ||
satyaśūrā raṇe śūrā dānaśūrāśca ye narāḥ |
te narāḥ svargamaśnantu sadā ye cānasūyavaḥ || 12 ||
aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣāḥ kāmino'rthaparāḥ śaṭhāḥ |
abrahmaṇyā nāstikāśca narakaṃ yāntu mānavāḥ || 13 ||
etāvat kriyatāṃ vākyaṃ mayoktaṃ tridaśeśvarāḥ |
tato mayi sthite sarvān bādhiṣyante na cārayaḥ|| 14 ||
ityuktvāntarhito devaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ |
devatānāṃ ca sarveṣāmabhavad vismayo mahān || 15 ||
etadatyadbhutaṃ dṛṣṭvā vārāhacaritaṃ surāḥ |
namaskṛtya varāhāya nākapṛṣṭhamito gatāḥ || 16 ||
tataḥ svānyādhipatyāni pratipannāni daivataiḥ |
sarvalokādhipatye ca pratiṣṭhāṃ vāsavo gataḥ || 17 ||
vimuktā dānavagaṇaiḥ prakṛtiṃ dharaṇī gatā |
sthairyahetordharaṇyāstu jñātvā cāgaskṛtāngirīn|| 18||
sveṣu sthāneṣu saṃsthāpya parvatānāṃ puraṃdaraḥ |
ciccheda bhagavān pakṣān vajreṇa śataparvaṇā || 19 ||
sarveṣāmeva pakṣā vai chinnāḥ śakreṇa dhīmatā |
ekaḥ sapakṣo mainākaḥ suraistatsamayaḥ kṛtaḥ || 3.40.20 ||
eṣa nārāyaṇasyāyaṃ prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ |
vārāha iti viprendraiḥ purāṇe parikīrtitaḥ || 21 ||
kṛṣṇadvaipāyanamataṃ nānāśrutisamāhitam |
nāśucerna kṛtaghnāya na nṛśaṃsāya kīrtayet || 22 ||
na kṣudrāya na nīcāya na gurudveṣakāriṇe |
nāśiṣyāya tathā rājan na kṛtaghnāya caiva hi || 23 ||
āyuṣkāmairyaśaḥkāmairmahīkāmaiśca mānavaiḥ |
jayaiṣibhiśca śrotavyo devānāmeṣa vai jayaḥ || 24 ||
purāṇavedasambaddhaḥ śivaḥ svastyayano mahān |
pāvanaḥ sarvasattvānāṃ tatkālavijayapradaḥ || 25 ||
eṣa kauravya tattvena kathitastvanupūrvaśaḥ |
vārāhasya nṛpaśreṣṭha prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ || 26 ||
ye yajanti makhaiḥ puṇyairdaivatāni pitṝnapi |
ātmānamātmanā nityaṃ viṣṇumeva yajanti te || 27 ||
lokāyanāya tridaśāyanāya brahmāyanāyātmabhavāyanāya |
nārāyaṇāyātmahitāyanāya mahāvarāhāya namaskuruṣva || 28 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vārāhaprādurbhāve catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 40 ||

<3.41>

ekacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
vārāha eṣa kathito nārasiṃhamataḥ śṛṇu |
yatra bhūtvā mṛgendreṇa hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ || 1 ||
purā kṛtayuge rājan hiraṇyakaśipuḥ prabhuḥ |
daityānāmādipuruṣaścakāra sumahat tapaḥ || 2 ||
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi śatāni daśa pañca ca |
jalavāsī samabhavat sthānamaunavratasthitaḥ || 3 ||
tataḥ śamadamābhyāṃ ca brahmacaryeṇa caiva hi |
brahmā prīto'bhavat tasya tapasā niyamena ca || 4 ||
tataḥ svayambhūrbhagavān svayamāgatya tatra ha |
vimānenārkavarṇena haṃsayuktena bhāsvatā || 5 ||
ādityairvasubhiḥ sādhyairmarudbhirdaivataiḥ saha |
rudrairviśvasahāyaiśca yakṣarākṣasakiṃnaraiḥ || 6 ||

nakṣatraiśca muhūrtaiśca khecaraiśca mahāgrahaiḥ || 7 ||
devairbrahmarṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ siddhaiḥ saptarṣibhistathā |
rājarṣibhiḥ puṇyakṛddhirgandharvairapsarogaṇaiḥ || 8 ||
carācaraguruḥ śrīmān vṛto devagaṇaiḥ saha |

brahmovāca
prīto'smi tava bhaktasya tapasānena suvrata |
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yatheṣṭaṃ kāmamāpnuhi || 3.41.10 ||
tato hiraṇyakaśipuḥ prītātmā dānavottamaḥ |
kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ śrīmān vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 11 ||
hiraṇyakaśipuruvāca
na devāsuragandharvā na yakṣoragarākṣasāḥ |
na mānuṣāḥ piśācāśca nihanyurmāṃ kathaṃcana || 12 ||
ṛṣayo naiva māṃ kruddhāḥ sarvalokapitāmaha |
śapeyustapasā yuktā vara eṣa vṛto mayā || 13 ||
na śastreṇa na cāstreṇa giriṇā pādapena ca |
na śuṣkeṇa na cārdreṇa syānna cānyena me vadhaḥ || 14 ||
na svarge'pyatha pātāle nākāśe nāvanisthale |
na cābhyantararātryahnorna cāpyanyena me vadhaḥ || 15 ||
pāṇiprahāreṇaikena sabhṛtyabalavāhanam |
yo māṃ nāśayituṃ śakyaḥ sa me mṛtyurbhaviṣyati || 16 ||
bhaveyamahamevārkaḥ somo vāyurhutāśanaḥ |
salilaṃ cāntarikṣaṃ ca nakṣatrāṇi diśo daśa || 17 ||
ahaṃ krodhaśca kāmaśca varuṇo vāsavo yamaḥ |
dhanadaśca dhanādhyakṣo yakṣaḥ kiṃpuruṣādhipaḥ || 18 ||
mūrtimanti ca divyāni mamāstrāṇi mahāhave |
upatiṣṭhantu deveśa sarvalokapitāmaha || 19 ||
pitāmaha uvāca
ete divyā varāstāta mayā dattāstavādbhutāḥ |
sarvakāmapradā vatsa durlabhāstvatimānuṣāḥ |
sarvānkāmānalpabhāvāt prāpsyasi tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ||3.41.20||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evamuktvā sa bhagavāñjagāmākāśameva ca |
vairājaṃ brahmasadanaṃ brahmarṣigaṇasevitam || 21 ||

devā ūcuḥ
vareṇānena bhagavan vadhiṣyati sa no'suraḥ |
tatprasīdasva bhagavan vadho'pyasya vicintyatām|| 23 ||
bhavān hi sarvabhūtānāmādikartā svayaṃ prabhuḥ |
sraṣṭā ca havyakavyānāmavyaktaprakṛtirdhruvaḥ || 24 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
sarvalokahitaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā devaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
āśvāsayāmāsa surān suśītairvacanāmbubhiḥ || 25 ||
avaśyaṃ tridaśāstena prāptavyaṃ tapasaḥ phalam |

labdhamātre vare tasmin sarvāḥ so'bādhata prajāḥ|

yadā varamadonmattaścoditaḥ kāladharmaṇā |
yajñiyānakarod daityān daivatānapyayajñiyān || 31 ||
tadādityāśca sādhyāśca viśve ca vasavastathā |

athoṅkārasahāyo'sau bhagavān viṣṇuravyayaḥ || 43 ||

tejasā bhāskarākāraḥ kāntyā candra ivāparaḥ || 44 ||
narasya kṛtvārdhatanuṃ siṃhasyārdhatanuṃ vibhuḥ |
nārasiṃhena vapuṣā pāṇiṃ saṃspṛśya pāṇinā || 45 ||
tato 'paśyat vistīrṇāṃ divyāṃ ramyāṃ manoramām |
sarvakāmayutāṃ śubhrāṃ hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sabhām || 46 ||
vistīrṇo yojanaśataṃ śatamadhyardhamāyatām |
vaihāyasīṃ kāmagamāṃ pañcayojanamucchritām || 47 ||
jarāśokaklamatyaktāṃ niṣprakampāṃ śivāṃ śubhām |
śubhāsanavatīṃ ramyāṃ jvalantīmiva tejasā || 48 ||
antaḥsalilasaṃyuktāṃ vihitāṃ viśvakarmaṇā |
divyaratnamayairvṛkṣaiḥ phalapuṣpapradairyutām || 49 ||
nīlapītāsitaśyāmaiḥ sitairlohitakairapi |
avatānaistathā gulmairmañjarīśatadhāribhiḥ || 3.41.50 ||
sitābhraghanasaṃkāśā plavantīvāpsu dṛśyate |
dhanyāsanavatī ramyā jvalantī iva tejasā || 51 ||
prabhāvatī bhāsvarā ca divyagandhamanoramā |
na sukhā na ca duḥkhā sā na śītā na ca gharmadā || 52 ||
