stambhairmaṇimayairdivyaiḥ śāśvatī cākṣatā ca sā |
aticandraṃ ca sūryaṃ ca pāvakaṃ ca svayamprabhā || 54 ||
dīpyate nākapṛṣṭhasthā bhartsayantīva bhāskaram |
sarve ca kāmāḥ pracurā ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ || 55 ||
rasavantaḥ prabhūtāśca bhakṣyabhojyaṃ tathākṣayam |
puṇyagandhā srajastatra nityapuṣpaphaladrumāḥ || 56 ||
uṣṇe śītāni toyāni śīte coṣṇāni santi vai |
puṣpitāgrān mahāśākhān pravālāṅkuradhāriṇaḥ || 57 ||
latāvitānasaṃcchannān saritsu ca saraḥsu ca |
manoharāṃśca vividhān dadarśa sa tadā prabhuḥ || 58 ||
drumān bahuvidhāṃstatra mṛgendro dadṛśe drutam |
gandhavanti ca puṣpāṇi rasavanti phalāni ca || 59 ||
tāni śītāni toyāni tatra tatra sarāṃsi ca |
apaśyat sarvatīrthāni sabhāyāṃ śataśo vibhuḥ || 3.41.60 ||
nalinaiḥ puṇḍarīkaiśca śatapatraiḥ sugandhibhiḥ |
raktaiḥ kuvalayairnīlaiḥ kumudaiḥ saṃyutāni ca || 61 ||
sakāntairdhārtarāṣṭraiśca rājahaṃsaiḥ surapriyaiḥ |
kādambaiścakravākaiśca sārasaiḥ kurarairapi || 62 ||
vimalasphaṭikābhāni pāṇḍurāṣṭadalāni ca |
kalahaṃsopagītāni sārikābhirutāni ca || 63 ||
gandhavatyaḥ śubhāstatra puṣpamañjaridhāriṇīḥ |
dṛṣṭavān pādapāgreṣu nānāpuṣpadharā latāḥ || 64 ||
ketakāśokasaralāḥ punnāgatilakārjunāḥ |
cūtā nīpā nāgapuṣpāḥ kadambabakulā dhavāḥ || 65 ||
priyaṅgupāṭalīvṛkṣāḥ śālmalyaḥ saharidrakāḥ |
śālāstālāḥ priyālāśca campakāśca manoramāḥ || 66 ||
tathā cānye vyarājanta sabhāyāṃ puṣpitā drumāḥ |
vaidrumāśca drumānīkā dāvāgnijvalitaprabhāḥ || 67 ||
skandhavantaḥ suśākhāśca bahutālasamucchrayāḥ |
añjanāśokavarṇābhā bhānti vañjulakā drumāḥ || 68 ||
varaṇā vatsanābhāśca panasāścandanaiḥ saha |
nīlāḥ sumanasaścaiva pītāmlāśvatthatindukāḥ || 69 ||
prācīnāmalakā lodhrā mallikā bhadradāravaḥ |
āmrātakāstathā jambūlakucāḥ śailavālukāḥ || 3.41.70 ||
sarjārjunāḥ kanduravāḥ pataṅgāḥ kuṭajāstathā |
raktāḥ kurabakāścaiva nīpāścāgarubhiḥ saha || 71 ||
kadambāścaiva bhavyāśca dāḍimībījapūrakāḥ |
kālīyakā dukūlāśca hiṅgavastailaparṇikāḥ || 72 ||
kharjūrā nālikerāśca pūgavṛkṣā harītakī |
madhūkāḥ saptaparṇāśca bilvāḥ pārāvatāstathā || 73 ||
panasāśca tamālāśca nānāgulmalatāvṛtāḥ |
latāśca vividhākārāḥ patrapuṣpaphalopagāḥ || 74 ||
ete cānye ca bahavastatra kānanajā drumāḥ |
nānāpuṣpaphalopetā vyarājanta samantataḥ || 75 ||
cakorāḥ śatapatrāśca mattakokilasārikāḥ |
puṣpitān phalitāgrāṃśca sampatanti mahādrumān|| 76 ||
raktapītāruṇāstatra pādapāgragatā dvijāḥ |
parasparamavaikṣanta prahṛṣṭā jīvajīvakāḥ || 77 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi nārasiṃhe hiraṇyakaśipusabhāvarṇane ekacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||41||

<3.42>

dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tasyāṃ sabhāyāṃ daityendro hiraṇyakaśipuḥ prabhuḥ |
āsīna āsane divye nalvamātre pramāṇataḥ || 1 ||
divākaranibhe ramye divyāstaraṇasambhṛte |
rarāja suciraṃ rājan jvalatkāñcanakuṇḍalaḥ || 2 ||
tasya daityapatermandaṃ virajaskaṃ samantataḥ |
divyagandhavahastatra mārutaḥ sumukho vavau || 3 ||
tatra devāḥ sagandharvā gaṇairapsarasāṃ vṛtāḥ |
divyatālena divyāni jagurgītāni gāyanāḥ || 4 ||
vaho devatā tathā apsarāoṃse ghire hum gandharva gāyaka
banakara divya tālake sātha divya gīta gāte ye || 4 ||
viśvācī sahajanyā ca pramlocetyabhiviśrutā |
divyā ca saurabheyī ca samīcī puñjikasthalā || 5 ||
miśrakeśī ca rambhā ca citrasenā śucismitā |
cārunetrā ghṛtācī ca menakā corvaśī tathā || 6 ||
etāḥ sahasraśaścānyā nṛtyagītaviśāradāḥ |
upatiṣṭhanti rājānaṃ hiraṇyakaśipuṃ tadā || 7 ||
hiraṇyakaśipustatra vicitrābharaṇāmbaraḥ |
strīsahasraiḥ parivṛtastasthau jvalitakuṇḍalaḥ || 8 ||
tatrāsīnaṃ mahābāhuṃ hiraṇyakaśipuṃ prabhum |
upāsanti diteḥ putrāḥ sarve labdhavarāḥ purā || 9||
balirvairocanastatra narakaḥ pṛthivījayaḥ |
prahrādo vipracittiśca gaviṣṭhaśca mahāsuraḥ || 3.42.10 ||
candrahantā krodhahantā sumanāḥ sumatiḥ kharaḥ |
ghaṭodaro mahāpārśvaḥ krathanaḥ piṭharastathā || 11 ||
viśvarūpaśca rūpaśca virūpaśca mahādyutiḥ |
daśagrīvaśca vālī ca meghavāsā mahāravaḥ || 12 ||
kaṭābho vikaṭābhaśca saṃhrādaścendratāpanaḥ |
dainyadānavasaṃghāśca sarve jvalitakuṇḍalāḥ || 13 ||
sragviṇo vāgminaḥ sarve sarve sucaritavratāḥ |
sarve labdhavarāḥ śūrā sarve vigatamṛtyavaḥ || 14 ||
ete cānye ca bahavo hiraṇyakaśipuṃ prabhum |
upāsante mahātmānaṃ sarve divyaparicchadāḥ || 15 ||
vimānairvividhairagryairbhrājamānairivārcibhiḥ |
sragviṇo bhūṣaṇadharā yānti cāyānti helayā || 16 |
vicitrābharaṇopetā vicitravasanāstathā |
vicitraśastrakavacā vicitradhvajavāhanāḥ || 17 ||
mahendracāpasaṃkāśairvicitrairaṅgadairvaraiḥ |
bhūṣitāṅgā diteḥ putrāstamupāsanti nityaśaḥ || 18 ||
tasyāṃ sabhāyāṃ divyāyāmasurāḥ parvatopamāḥ |
hiraṇyamukuṭāḥ sarve divākarasamaprabhāḥ || 19 ||
kanakamaṇivicitravedikāyāmupahitaratnasahasravīthikāyām|
sa dadarśa mṛgādhipaḥ sabhāyāṃ suruciradantagavākṣasaṃvṛtāyām || 3.42.20 ||
kanakavimalahārabhūṣitāṅgaṃ dititanayaṃ sa mṛgādhipo dadarśa |
dinakarakaraprabhaṃ jvalantamasurasahasragaṇairniṣevyamāṇam || 21 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi nārasiṃhe dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 42 ||

<3.43>

tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tato dṛṣṭvā mahābāhuṃ kālacakramivāgatam |
nārasiṃhavapuśchannaṃ bhasmācchannamivānalam || 1 ||
vikuñcitasaṭaṃ tasya nārasiṃhasya bhārata |
rūpaudāryaṃ vabhau tatra sahasraśaśisaṃnibham || 2 ||
aho rūpamidaṃ citraṃ śaṅkhakundendusaṃnibham |
abruvan dānavāḥ sarve hiraṇyakaśipuśca saḥ || 3 ||
evaṃ hi bruvatāṃ teṣāṃ nirdagdhānāṃ mahātmanām |
nārasiṃhena cakṣurbhyāṃ coditāḥ kāladharmaṇā || 4 ||
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putraḥ prahrādo nāma vīryavān |
divyena cakṣuṣā siṃhamapaśyad devamāgatam || 5 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā rukmaśailābhamapūrvāṃ tanumāsthitam |
vismitā dānavāḥ sarve hiraṇyakaśipuśca saḥ || 6 ||
prahlāda uvāca
mahārāja mahābāho daityānāmādisambhava |
na śrutaṃ naiva dṛṣṭaṃ ca nārasiṃhamidaṃ vapuḥ || 7 ||
avyaktaprabhavaṃ divyaṃ kimidaṃ rūpamadbhutam |
daityāntakaraṇaṃ ghoraṃ śaṃsantīva manāṃsi naḥ || 8 ||
asya devāḥ śarīrasthāḥ sāgarā saritastathā |
himavān pāriyātraśca ye cānye kulaparvatāḥ || 9 ||
candramāḥ saha nakṣatrairādityāścāśvinau tathā |
dhanado varuṇaścaiva yamaḥ śakraḥ śacīpatiḥ || 3.43.10 ||
maruto devagandharvā munayaśca tapodhanāḥ |
nāgā yakṣāḥ piśācāśca rākṣasā bhīmavikramāḥ|| 11 ||
brahmadevaḥ paśupatirlalāṭasthā vibhānti vai |
sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni jaṅgamāni tathaiva ca || 12 ||
bhavāṃśca sahito'smābhiḥ sarvairdaityagaṇairvṛtaḥ |
vimānaśatasaṃkīrṇā tathābhyantarajā sabhā || 13 ||
sarvaṃ tribhuvanaṃ rājam̐llokadharmaśca śāśvataḥ |
dṛśyate nārasiṃhe'smin yathendau vimale jagat|| 14 ||
prajāpatiścātra manurmahātmā grahāśca yogāśca mahī nabhaśca |
utpātakālaśca dhṛtiḥ smṛtiśca rajaśca sattvaṃ ca tapo damaśca || 15 ||
sanatkumāraśca mahānubhāvo viśve ca devāpsarasaśca sarvāḥ |
krodhaśca kāmaśca tathaiva harṣo darpaśca mohaḥ pitaraśca sarve || 16 ||
ityevamuktvā sa ca daityarājaṃ hiraṇyanāmānamavismayena |
dadhyau ca daityeśvaraputra ugraṃ mahāmatiḥ kiṃcidadhomukhaḥ prāk || 17 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi nārasiṃhe prahrādavākye tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 43 ||

<3.44>

catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāya
vaiśampāyana uvāca
prahrādasya ca tacchrutvā hiraṇyakaśipurvacaḥ |
uvāca dānavān sarvān sagaṇāṃśca gaṇādhipaḥ || 1 ||
mṛgendro gṛhyatāṃ śīghramapūrvāṃ tanumāsthitaḥ |
yadi vā saṃśayaḥ kaścid vadhyatāṃ vanagocaraḥ || 2 ||
tacchutvā dānavāḥ sarve mṛgendraṃ bhīmavikramam |
parikṣipanto muditāstrāsayāmāsurojasā || 3 ||
siṃhanādaṃ naditvā tu punaḥ siṃho mahābalaḥ |
babhañja tāṃ sabhāṃ ramyāṃ vyāditāsya ivāntakaḥ || 4 ||
sabhāyāṃ bhajyamānāyāṃ hiraṇyakaśipuḥ svayam |
cikṣepāstrāṇi siṃhasya roṣavyākulalocanaḥ || 5 ||
sarvāstrāṇāmatha śreṣṭhaṃ daṇḍamastraṃ subhairavam |
kālacakraṃ tathātyugraṃ viṣṇucakraṃ tathaiva ca || 6 ||
dharmacakraṃ mahaccakramajitaṃ nāma nāmataḥ |
cakramaindraṃ tathā ghoramṛṣicakraṃ tathaiva ca || 7 ||
paitāmahaṃ tathā cakraṃ trailokyamahitasvanam |
vicitramaśanīṃ caiva śuṣkārdraṃ cāśanidvayam || 8 ||
raudraṃ tadugraṃ śūlaṃ ca kaṅkālaṃ musalaṃ tathā |
astraṃ brahmaśiraścaiva brāhmamastraṃ tathaiva ca || 9 ||
aiṣīkamastramaindraṃ ca āgneyaṃ śaiśiraṃ tathā |
vāyavyaṃ mathanaṃ nāma kāpālamatha kiṃkaram || 3.44.10 ||
tathā cāpratimāṃ śaktiṃ krauñcamastraṃ tathaiva ca |
astraṃ hayaśiraścaiva saumyamastraṃ tathaiva ca || 11 ||
paiśācamastramamitaṃ sārpyamastraṃ tathādbhutam |
mohanaṃ śoṣaṇaṃ caiva saṃtāpanavilāpane || 12 ||
jṛmbhaṇaṃ prāpaṇaṃ caiva tvāṣṭraṃ caiva sudāruṇam |
kālamudgaramakṣobhyaṃ kṣobhaṇaṃ tu mahābalam || 13 ||
saṃvartanaṃ mohanaṃ ca tathā māyādharaṃ param |
gāndharvamastraṃ dayitamasiratnaṃ ca nandakam || 14 ||
prasvāpanaṃ pramathanaṃ vāruṇaṃ cāstramuttamam |
astraṃ pāśupataṃ caiva yasyāpratihatā gatiḥ || 15 ||
etānyastrāṇi sarvāṇi hiraṇyakaśipustadā |
cikṣepa nārasiṃhasya dīptasyāgneryathāhutiḥ || 16 ||
astraiḥ prajvalitaiḥ siṃhamāvṛṇodasurādhipaḥ |
vivasvān gharmasamaye himavantamivāṃśubhiḥ || 17 ||
sa hyamarṣānilodbhūto daityānāṃ sainyasāgaraḥ |
kṣaṇenāplāvayat siṃhaṃ mainākamiva sāgaraḥ || 18 ||
prāsaiḥ pāśaistathā śūlairgadābhirmusalaistathā |
vajrairaśanikalpaiśca śilābhiśca mahādrumaiḥ || 19 ||
mudgaraiḥ kūṭapāśaiśca śūlolūkhalaparvataiḥ |
śataghnībhiśca dīptābhirdaṇḍairapi sudāruṇaiḥ || 3.44.20 ||
parivārya samantāt tu nighnannastrairhariṃ tadā |
svalpamapyasya na kṣuṇṇamūrjitasya mahātmanaḥ || 21 ||
te dānavāḥ pāśagṛhītahastā mahendravajrāśanitulyavegāḥ |
samantato'bhyudyatabāhuśastrāḥ sthitāstriśīrṣā iva pannagendrāḥ || 22 ||
suvarṇamālākulabhūṣitāṅgā nānāṅgadābhogapinaddhagātrāḥ |
muktāvalīdāmavibhūṣitāṅgā haṃsā ivābhānti viśālapakṣāḥ || 23 ||
teṣāṃ tu vāyupratimaujasāṃ vai keyūramālāvalayotkaṭāni |
tānyuttamāṅgānyabhito vibhānti prabhātasūryāṃśusamaprabhāṇi || 24 ||
taiḥ prakṣipadbhirjvalitānalopamairmahāstrapūgaiḥ sa samāvṛto babhau |
giriryathā saṃtatavarṣibhirghanaiḥ kṛtāndhakāro'dbhutakandaradrumaḥ || 25 ||
tairhanyamāno'pi mahāstrajālaiḥ sarvaistadā daityagaṇaiḥ sametaiḥ |
nākampatājau bhagavān pratāpavān sthitaḥ prakṛtyā himavānivācalaḥ || 26 ||
saṃtāpitāste narasiṃharūpiṇā diteḥ sutāḥ pāvakadīptatejasā |
bhayād viceluḥ pavanoddhatā yathā mahormayaḥ sāgaravārisambhavāḥ || 27 ||
śatairdhanurbhiḥ sumahātivegā yugāntakālapratimāñcharaughān |
ekāyanasthā mumucurnṛsiṃhe mahāsurāḥ krodhavidīpitāṅgāḥ || 28 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi nārasiṃhe catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 44 ||

<3.45>

pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
daityebhiḥ kṛtānāṃ prahārāṇāṃ racitānāṃ māyānāṃ ca niṣphalatā
vaiśampāyana uvāca
svarāḥ kharamukhāścaiva makarāśīviṣānanāḥ |
īhāmṛgamukhāścānye varāhasadṛśānanāḥ || 1 ||
bālasūryamukhāścaiva dhūmaketumukhāstathā |
candrārdhacandravaktrāśca pradīptāgnimukhāstathā || 2 ||
haṃsakukkuṭavaktrāśca vyāditāsyā bhayāvahāḥ |
pañcāsyā lelihānāśca kākagṛdhramukhāstathā || 3 ||
vidyujjihvāstriśīrṣāśca tatholkāsaṃnibhānanāḥ |
mahāgrāhanibhāścānye dānavā baladarpitāḥ || 4 ||
kailāsavapuṣastasya śarīre śaravṛṣṭayaḥ |
avadhyasya mṛgendrasya na vyathāṃ cakrurāhave || 5 ||
evaṃ bhūyo'parān ghorānasṛjandānavāḥ śarān |
mṛgendrasyorasi kruddhā niḥśvasanta ivoragāḥ || 6 ||
te dānavaśarā ghorā mṛgendrāya samīritāḥ |
vilayaṃ jagmurākāśe khadyotā iva parvate || 7 ||
tataścakrāṇi divyāni daityāḥ krodhasamanvitāḥ |
mṛgendrāyākṣipantyāśu prajvalantīva sarvaśaḥ || 8 ||
tairāsīd gaganaṃ cakraiḥ sampatadbhiḥ samāvṛtam |
yugānte samprakāśadbhiścandrasūryagrahairiva || 9 ||
tāni cakrāṇi vadanaṃ praviśanti vibhānti vai |
meghodaradarīṃ ghorāṃ candrasūryagrahā iva || 3.45.10 ||
tāni cakrāṇi sarvāṇi mṛgendreṇa mahātmanā |
nigīrṇāni pradīptāni pāvakārciḥsamāni vai || 11 ||
hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo bhūyaḥ prāsṛjadūrjitām |
śaktiṃ prajvalitāṃ ghorāṃ hutāśanasamaprabhām || 12 ||
tāmāpatantīṃ samprekṣya mṛgendraḥ śaktimuttamām |
huṃkāreṇaiva raudreṇa babhañja bhagavāṃstadā || 13 ||
rarāja bhagnā sā śaktirmṛgendreṇa mahītale |
savisphuliṅgā jvalitā maholkeva nabhaścyutā|| 14 ||
nārācapaṅaktiḥ siṃhasya sṛṣṭā reje vidūrataḥ |
nīlotpalapalāśānāṃ mālevojjvaladarśanā || 15 ||
garjitvā tu yathākāmaṃ vikramya ca yathāsukham |
tat sainyamutsāritavāṃstṛṇāgrāṇīva mārutaḥ || 16 ||
tato'śmavarṣaṃ daityendrā vyasṛjanta nabhogatāḥ |
nagamātraiḥ śilākhaṇḍairgirikūṭairmahāprabhaiḥ || 17 ||
tadaśmavarṣaṃ siṃhasya gātre nipatitaṃ mahat |
diśo daśa prakīrṇaṃ hi khadyotaprakaro yathā || 18 ||
tadaśmaughairditisutāstadā siṃhamariṃdamam |
prācchādayan yathā meghā dhārābhiriva parvatam || 19 ||
na ca taṃ cālayāmāsurdaityaughā devamāsthitam |
bhīmavegā balaśreṣṭhaṃ samudrā iva parvatam || 3.45.20 ||
tato'śmavarṣe nihate jalavarṣamanantaram |
dhārābhirakṣamātrābhiḥ prādurāsīt samantataḥ || 21 ||
nabhasaḥ pracyutā dhārāstigmavegāḥ sahasraśaḥ |
āvṛṇvan sarvato vyoma diśaścopadiśastathā || 22 ||
dhārāṇāṃ saṃnipātena vāyorvisphūrjitena ca |
vardhatā caiva varṣeṇa na prājñāyata kiṃcana || 23 ||
dhārā divi ca saṃsaktā vasudhāyāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ |
na spṛśanti sma taṃ tatra nipatantyo'niśaṃ bhuvi || 24 ||
bāhyato vavṛṣe varṣaṃ nopariṣṭāt tu toyadaḥ |
mṛgendrapratirūpasya sthitasya yudhi māyayā || 25 ||
hate'śmavarṣe tumule jalavarṣe ca śoṣite |
sasṛjurdānavā māyāmagniṃ vāyuṃ ca sarvaśaḥ || 26 ||
nabhasaḥ pracyutaścaiva tigmavegaḥ samantataḥ |
jvālāmālī mahāraudro dīptatejāḥ samantataḥ || 27 ||
sa sṛṣṭaḥ pāvakastena daityendreṇa mahātmanā |
na śaśāka mahātejā dagdhumapratimaujasam || 28 ||
tamindrastoyadaiḥ sārdhaṃ sahasrākṣo'mitadyutiḥ |
mahatā toyavarṣeṇa śamayāmāsa pāvakam || 29 ||
tasyāṃ pratihatāyāṃ tu māyāyāṃ yudhi dānavāḥ |
sasṛjurghorasaṃkāśaṃ tamastīvraṃ samantataḥ || 3.45.30 ||
tamasā saṃvṛte loke daityeṣvāttāyudheṣu vai |
svatejasā parivṛto divākara ivābabhau || 31 ||
triśikhāṃ bhrukuṭīṃ cāsya dadṛśurdānavā raṇe |
lalāṭasthāṃ trikūṭasthāṃ gaṅgāṃ tripathagāmiva || 32 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi nārasiṃhe pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 45 ||

<3.46>

ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ sarvāsu māyāsu hatāsu ditinandanāḥ |
hiraṇyakaśipuṃ sarve viṣaṇṇāḥ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 1 ||
tataḥ prajvalitaḥ krodhāt pradahanniva tejasā |
hiraṇyakaśipurdaityaścālayāmāsa medinīm || 2 ||
tataḥ prakṣubhitāḥ sarve sāgarāḥ salilākarāḥ |
calitā girayaḥ sarve sakānanavanadrumāḥ || 3 ||
tasmin kruddhe tu daityendre tamobhūtamabhūjjagat |
tamasā samabhūcchannaṃ na prājñāyata kiṃcana || 4 ||
āvahaḥ pravahaścaiva vivahaśca samīraṇaḥ |
parāvahaḥ saṃvahaśca udvahaśca mahābalaḥ || 5 ||
tathā parivahaḥ śrīmān mārutā bhayaśaṃsinaḥ |
ityete kṣubhitāḥ sapta mārutā gaganecarāḥ || 6 ||
ye grahāḥ sarvalokasya kṣaye prādurbhavanti vai |
te grahā gagane hṛṣṭā vicaranti yathāsukham || 7 ||
ayogataścātyacarad yogaṃ divi niśākaraḥ |
sagrahaṃ sahanakṣatraṃ prajajvāla nabho nṛpa || 8 ||
vivarṇatvaṃ ca bhagavān gato divi divākaraḥ |
kṛṣṇaḥ kabandhaśca mahām̐llakṣyate ca nabhastale || 9 ||
amuñcaccāsitāṃ sūryo dhūmavartiṃ bhayāvahām |
gaganasthaśca bhagavānabhīkṣṇaṃ paritapyate || 3.46.10 ||
saptadhūmanibhā ghorāḥ sūryā divi samutthitāḥ |
somasya gaganasthasya grahāstiṣṭhanti śṛṅgagāḥ || 11 ||
vāme ca dakṣiṇe caiva sthitau śukrabṛhaspatī |
śanaiścaro lohitāṅgo lohitārkasamadyutiḥ || 12||
samaṃ samabhirohanti durgāṇi gaganecarāḥ |
śṛṅgāṇi kanakairghorā yugāntāvartakā grahāḥ || 13 ||
candramāḥ saha nakṣatrairgrahaiḥ saptabhirāvṛtaḥ |
carācaravināśārthaṃ rohiṇīṃ nābhyanandata || 14 ||
gṛhīto rāhuṇā candra ulkābhirabhihanyate |
ulkāḥ prajvalitāścandre pracelurghoradarśanāḥ || 15 ||
devānāmapi yo devaḥ so'bhyavarṣata śoṇitam |
apatan gaganādulkā vidyudrūpāḥ saniḥsvanāḥ || 16 ||
akāle pādapāḥ sarve puṣyanti ca phalanti ca |
latāśca saphalāḥ sarvā yāḥ prāhurdaityanāśanam || 17 ||
phale phalānyajāyanta puṣpe puṣpaṃ tathaiva ca |
unmīlanti nimīlanti hasanti ca rudanti ca|| 18 ||
vikrośanti ca gambhīraṃ dhūmayanti jvalanti ca |
pratimāḥ sarvadevānāṃ kathayanti yugakṣayam || 19 ||
āraṇyaiḥ saha saṃsṛṣṭā grāmyāśca mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ |
cukruśurbhairavaṃ tatra mṛgendre samupasthite || 3.46.20 ||
nadyaśca pratilomā hi vahanti kaluṣodakāḥ |
aparāhṇagate sūrye lokānāṃ kṣayakārake || 21 ||
na prakāśanti ca diśo raktareṇusamākulāḥ |
vānaspatyā na pūjyante pūjanārhāḥ kathaṃcana || 22 ||
vāyuvegena hanyante bhidyante praṇudanti ca |
tadā ca sarvabhūtānāṃ chāyā na parivartate || 23 ||
aparāhṇagate sūrye lokānāṃ ca yugakṣaye |
tadā hiraṇyakaśipordaityasyopariveśmanaḥ || 24 ||
bhāṇḍāgārāyudhāgāre niviṣṭamabhavanmadhu |
tathaiva cāyudhāgāre dhūmarājiradṛśyata || 25 ||
sa ca dṛṣṭvā mahotpātān hiraṇyakaśipustadā |
purohitaṃ tadā śukraṃ vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 26 ||
kimarthaṃ bhagavannete mahotpātāḥ samutthitāḥ |
śrotumicchāmi tattvena paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 27 ||
śukra uvāca
śṛṇu rājannavahito vacanaṃ me mahāsura |
yadarthamiha dṛśyante mahotpātā mahābhayāḥ || 28 ||
yasyaite sampradṛśyante rājño rāṣṭre mahāsura |
deśo vā hriyate tasya rājā vā vadhamarhati || 29 ||
ato buddhayā samīkṣasva yathā sarvaṃ praṇaśyati |
vṛhadbhayaṃ hi nacirād bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ|| 3.46.30 ||
etāvaduktvā śukrastu hiraṇyakaśipuṃ tadā |
svastītyuktvā tu dainyendraṃ jagāma svaṃ niveśanam|| 31 ||
tasmingate sa daityendro dhyātavān suciraṃ tadā|
āsāṃcakre sudīnātmā brahmavākyamanusmaran || 32 ||
asurāṇāṃ vināśāya surāṇāṃ vijayāya ca |
dṛśyante vividhotpātā ghorā ghoranidarśanāḥ || 33 ||
ete cānye ca bahavo ghorā hyutpātadarśanāḥ |
daityendrāṇāṃ vināśāya dṛśyante kālanirmitāḥ || 34 ||
tato hiraṇyakaśipurgadāmādāya satvaram |
abhyadravata vegena dharaṇīmanukampayan || 35 ||
hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo padā saspṛṣṭavān mahīm |
saṃdaṣṭauṣṭhapuṭaḥ krodhād varāha iva pūrvajaḥ || 36 ||
medinyāṃ kampyamānāyāṃ daityendreṇa mahātmanā |
mahīdharebhyo nāgendrā nipeturbhayaviklavāḥ || 37 ||
viṣajvālākulairvaktraiviṃmuñcanto hutāśanam |
catuḥśīrṣāḥ pañcaśīrṣāḥ saptaśīrṣāśca pannagāḥ || 38 ||
vāsukistakṣakaścaiva karkoṭakadhanaṃjayau |
elāpatraśca kālīyo mahāpadmaśca vīryavān |
sahasraśīrṣadhṛṅnāgo hematāladhvajaḥ prabhuḥ || 39 ||
śeṣo'nanto mahīpālo duṣprakampaḥ prakampitaḥ |
dīptānyantarjalasthāni pṛthivīdharaṇāni ca || 3.46.40 ||
tadā kruddhena daityena kampitāni samantataḥ |
pātālatalacāriṇyo nāgatejodharāḥ śivāḥ || 41 ||
āpaśca sahasā kruddhā duṣprakampyarasāḥ śubhāḥ |
nadī bhāgīrathī caiva sarayūḥ kauśikī tathā || 42 ||
yamunā caiva kāverī kṛṣṇā veṇā tathaiva ca |
suveṇā ca mahābhāgā nadī godāvarī tathā || 43 ||
carmaṇvatī ca sindhuśca tathā nadanadīpatiḥ |
mekalaprabhavaścaiva śoṇo maṇinibhodakaḥ || 44 ||
susrotā narmadā caiva tathā vetravatī nadī |
gomatī gokulākīrṇā tathāpūrṇā sarasvatī || 45 ||
mahī kālanadī caiva tamasā puṇyavāhinī |
sītā cekṣumatī caiva devikā ca mahānadī || 46 ||
jambūdvīpaṃ ratnavantaṃ sarvaratnopaśobhitam |
suvarṇakūṭakaṃ caiva suvarṇākaramaṇḍitam || 47 ||
mahānadaśca lauhityaḥ śailakānanaśobhitaḥ |
pattanaṃ kauśikāraṇyaṃ draviḍaṃ rajatākaram || 48 ||
māgadhāṃśca mahāgrāmānaṅgān vaṅgāṃstathaiva ca |
suhyān mallān videhāṃśca mālavān kāśikosalān||49||
bhavanaṃ vainateyasya suvarṇasya ca kampitam |
kailāsaśikharākāraṃ yat kṛtaṃ viśvakarmaṇā || 3.46.50 ||
raktatoyo bhīmavego lauhityo nāma sāgaraḥ |
śubhaḥ pāṇḍurameghābhaḥ kṣīrodaścaiva sāgaraḥ || 51 ||
udayaścaiva rājendra ucchritaḥ śatayojanam |
suparṇavedikaḥ śrīmān nāgapakṣiniṣevitaḥ || 52 ||
bhrājamāno'rkasahṛśairjātarūpamayairdumaiḥ |
śālaistālaistamālaiśca karṇikābhiśca puṣpitaiḥ || 53 ||
ayomukhaśca vipulaḥ sarvato dhātumaṇḍitaḥ |
tamālavanagandhaśca parvato malayaḥ śubhaḥ || 54 ||
surāṣṭrāśca subāhlīkāḥ śūrābhīrāstathaiva ca |
bhojāḥ pāṇḍyāśca vaṅgāśca kaliṅgāstāmraliptakāḥ || 55||
tathaivāndhrāśca puṇḍrāśca vāmacūḍāḥ sakeralāḥ |
kṣobhitāstena daityena sadevāḥ sāpsarogaṇāḥ || 56 ||
agastibhuvanaṃ caiva yadagamyaṃ purā kṛtam |
siddhacāraṇasaṅghaiśca sevitaṃ sumanoharam || 57 ||
vicitranāgavihagaṃ supuṣpitalatādrumam |
jātarūpamayaiḥ śṛṅgairapsarogaṇasevitam || 58 ||
giriḥ puṣpitakaścaiva lakṣmīvān priyadarśanaḥ |
utthitaḥ sāgaraṃ bhittvā vayasyaścandrasūryayoḥ || 59 ||
rarāja sumahāśṛṅgairgaganaṃ vilikhanniva |
sūryacandrāṃśusaṃkāśaiḥ sāgarāmbusamāvṛtaḥ || 3.46.60 ||
vidyutvān parvataḥ śrīmānāyataḥ śatayojanam |
vidyutāṃ yatra sampātā nipātyante nagottame || 61 ||
ṛṣabhaḥ parvataścaiva śrīmānṛṣabhasaṃsthitaḥ |
kuñjaraḥ parvataścaiva yatrāgastyagṛhaṃ mahat || 62 ||
viśākharathyā durdharṣā sarpāṇāmālayā purī |
tathā bhogavatī cāpi daityendreṇābhikampitā || 63 ||
mahāmeghagiriścaiva pāriyātraśca parvataḥ |
cakravāṃstu giriḥ śreṣṭho vārāhaścaiva parvataḥ || 64 ||
prāgjyotiṣapuraṃ caiva jātarūpamayaṃ śubham |
yasmin vasati duṣṭātmā narako nāma dānavaḥ || 65 ||
meruśca parvataśreṣṭho meghagambhīraniḥsvanaḥ |
ṣaṣṭiṃ tatra sahasrāṇi parvatānāṃ viśāmpate || 66 ||
taruṇādityasaṃkāśo mahendraśca mahāgiriḥ |
devāvāsaḥ śubhaḥ puṇyo girirājo divaṃ gataḥ || 67 ||
hemaśṛṅgo mahāśailastathā meghasakho giriḥ |
kailāsaścāpi duṣkampo dānavendreṇa kampitaḥ || 68 ||
yakṣarākṣasagandharvairnityaṃ sevitakandaraḥ |
śrīmān mandaraścaiva nityaṃ puṣpitapādapaḥ || 69 ||
hemapuṣkarasaṃchannaṃ tena vaikhānasaṃ saraḥ |
kampitaṃ mānasaṃ caiva rājahaṃsairniṣevitam || 3.46.70 ||
viśṛṅgaḥ parvataścaiva kumārī ca saridvarā |
tuṣāracayasaṃkāśo mandaraścaiva parvataḥ || 71 ||
uśīrabījaśca girī rudropasthastathādrirāṭ |
prajāpateśca nilayastathā puṣkaraparvataḥ || 72 ||
devāvṛt parvataścaiva tathā vai vāluko giriḥ |
krauñcaḥ saptarṣiśailaśca dhūmavarṇaśca parvataḥ || 73 ||
ete cānye ca girayo deśā janapadāstathā |
nadyaśca sāgarāścaiva dānavendreṇa kampitāḥ || 74 ||
kapilaśca mahīputro vyāghrākṣaḥ kṣitikampanaḥ |
khecarāśca niśāputrāḥ pātālatalavāsinaḥ || 75 ||
gaṇastathāparo raudro meghanādo'ṅkuśāyudhaḥ |
ūrdhvago bhīmavegaśca sarva evābhikampitāḥ || 76 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi nārasiṃhe ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 46 ||

<3.47>

saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tatrādityāśca sādhyāśca viśve ca marutastathā |
rudrā devā mahātmāno vasavaśca mahābalāḥ || 1 ||
āgamya te mṛgendrasya sakāśaṃ sūryavarcasaḥ |
ūcuḥ saṃtrastamanaso devā lokakṣayārditāḥ || 2 ||
jahi deva diteḥ putraṃ dānavaṃ lokanāśanam |
durvṛttamasadācāraṃ saha sarvairmahāsuraiḥ || 3 ||
tvaṃ hyeṣāmantakṛnnānyo daityānāṃ daityanāśana |
tannāśaya hitārthāya lokānāṃ svasti vai kuru || 4 ||
tvaṃ guruḥ sarvalokānāṃ tvamindrastvaṃ pitāmahaḥ |
ṛte tvadanyaccharaṇaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 5 ||
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ daivo devānāmādisambhavaḥ |
nanāda sumahānādamatigambhīraniḥsvanam || 6 ||
pāṭitānyasurendrāṇāṃ mṛgendreṇa mahātmanā |
siṃhanādena mahatā hṛdayāni manāṃsi ca || 7 ||
gaṇaḥ krodhavaśo nāma kālakeyastathā paraḥ |
vegaśca vaigaleyaśca saiṃhikeyaśca vīryavān || 8 ||
saṃhrādīyo mahānādo mahāvegastathā paraḥ |
kapilaśca mahīputro vyāghrākṣaḥ kṣitikampanaḥ || 9 ||
khecarāśca niśāputrāḥ pātālatalacāriṇaḥ |
gaṇastathāparo raudro meghanādo'ṅkuśāyudhaḥ || 3.47.10 ||
ūrdhvago bhīmavegaśca bhīmakarmārkalocanaḥ |
vajrī śūlī karālaśca hiraṇyakaśipustataḥ || 11 ||
jīmūtaghanasaṃkāśo jīmūta iva vegavān |
jīmūtaghanasaṃnādo jīmūtasadṛśadyutiḥ || 12 ||
devārirditijo dṛpto nṛsiṃhaṃ samupādravat || 1 3 ||
samutpatya tatastīkṣṇairmṛgendreṇa mahānakhaiḥ |
tatroṅkārasahāyena vidārya nihato yudhi || 14 ||
mahī ca lokaśca śaśī nabhaśca
grahāśca sūryaśca diśaśca sarvāḥ |
nadyaśca śailāśca mahārṇavāśca
gatāḥ prakāśaṃ ditiputranāśāt || 15 ||
tataḥ pramuditā devā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ |
tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotrairādidevaṃ sanātanam || 16 ||
devā ūcuḥ
yat tvayā vihitaṃ deva nārasiṃhamidaṃ vapuḥ |
etadevārcayiṣyanti parāvaravido janāḥ || 17 ||
mṛgendratvaṃ ca lokeṣu sarvasattveṣu vā vibho |
gāyanti tvāṃ ca munayo mṛgendra iti nityaśaḥ |
tvatprasādāt svakaṃ sthānaṃ pratipannāḥ sma vai vibho|| 18 ||
evamukto devasaṃghairnarasiṃho mahāmanāḥ |
brahmā ca paramaprīto viṣṇoḥ stotramudairayat || 19 ||
brahmovāca
bhavānakṣaramavyaktamacintyaṃ guhyamuttamam |
kūṭasthamakṛtaṃ kartṛ sanātanamanāmayam || 3.47.20 ||
sāṃkhyayoge ca yā buddhistattvārthapariniṣṭhitā |
tāṃ bhavānveda vidyātmā puruṣaḥ śāśvato dhruvaḥ|| 21 ||
tvaṃ vyaktaśca tathāvyaktastvattaḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat |
bhavanmayā vayaṃ deva bhavānātmā bhavān prabhuḥ || 22 ||
caturvibhaktamūrtistvaṃ sarvalokavibhurguruḥ |
caturyugasahasreṇa sarvalokāntakāntakaḥ || 23 ||
pratiṣṭhā sarvabhūtānāmanantabalapauruṣaḥ |
kapilaprabhṛtīnāṃ ca yatīnāṃ paramā gatiḥ || 24 ||
anādimadhyanidhanaḥ sarvātmā puruṣottamaḥ |
sraṣṭā tvaṃ tvaṃ ca saṃhartā tvameko lokabhāvanaḥ || 25 ||
bhavān brahmā ca rudraśca mahendro varuṇo yamaḥ |
bhavān kartā vikartā ca lokānāṃ prabhuravyayaḥ || 26 ||
parāṃ ca siddhiṃ paramaṃ ca devaṃ
paraṃ ca mantraṃ paramaṃ manaśca |
paraṃ ca dharmaṃ paramaṃ yaśaśca
tvāmāhuragryaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam || 27 ||
paraṃ ca satyaṃ paramaṃ haviśca
paraṃ pavitraṃ paramaṃ ca mārgam |
paraṃ ca hotraṃ paramaṃ ca yajñaṃ
tvāmāhuragryaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam || 28 ||
paraṃ śarīraṃ paramaṃ ca dhāma
paraṃ ca yogaṃ paramāṃ ca vāṇīm |
paraṃ rahasyaṃ paramāṃ gatiṃ ca
tvāmāhuragryaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam || 29 ||
paraṃ parasyāpi paraṃ ca yat paraṃ
paraṃ parasyāpi paraṃ ca devam |
paraṃ parasyāpi paraṃ prabhuṃ ca
tvāmāhuragryaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam || 3.47.30 ||
paraṃ parasyāpi paraṃ pradhānaṃ
paraṃ parasyāpi paraṃ ca tattvam |
paraṃ parasyāpi paraṃ ca dhātā
tvāmāhuragryaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam || 31 ||
paraṃ parasyāpi paraṃ rahasyaṃ
paraṃ parasyāpi paraṃ paraṃ yat |
paraṃ parasyāpi paraṃ tapo yat
tvāmāhuragryaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam || 32 ||
paraṃ parasyāpi paraṃ parāyaṇaṃ
paraṃ ca guhyaṃ ca paraṃ ca dhāma |
paraṃ ca yogaṃ paramaṃ prabhutvaṃ
tvāmāhuragryaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam || 33 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evamuktvā sa bhagavān sarvalokapitāmahaḥ |
stutvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ brahmalokaṃ gataḥ prabhuḥ || 34 ||
tato nadatsu tūryeṣu nṛtyantīṣvapsaraḥsu ca |
kṣīrodasyottaraṃ kūlaṃ jagāma prabhurīśvaraḥ || 35 ||
nārasiṃhīṃ tanuṃ tyakvā sthāpayitvā ca tad vapuḥ |
paurāṇaṃ rūpamāsthāya yayau sa garuḍadhvajaḥ || 36 ||
aṣṭacakreṇa yānena bhūtiyuktena śobhinā |
avyaktaprakṛtirdevaḥ saṃsthānamagamat prabhuḥ || 37 ||
evaṃ mahātmanā tena nṛsiṃhavapuṣā tathā |
devena nihataḥ pūrvaṃ hiraṇyakaśipuśca saḥ || 38 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi nārasiṃhaprādurbhāve hiraṇyakaśipuvadhakathane saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 47 ||

<3.48>

aṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
nṛsiṃha eṣa kathito bhūyo'yaṃ vāmano'paraḥ |
yatra vāmanamāsthāya rūpaṃ rūpavidāṃ varaḥ || 1 ||
balerbalavato yajñe balinā viṣṇunā purā |
vikramaistribhirākramya trailokyamakhilaṃ hṛtam || 2 ||
samudravasanā corvī nānānagavibhūṣitā |
hṛtvā dattā surendrāya śakrāya prabhaviṣṇunā || 3 ||
janamejaya uvāca
atra me saṃśayo brahānnatra kautūhalaṃ mahat |
kathaṃ nārāyaṇo devo vāmanatvamupāgataḥ || 4 ||
yaḥ purāṇe purāṇātmā bhūtvā nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
padmanābho mahābāhurlokānāṃ prakṛtirdhruvaḥ || 5 ||
anādimadhyanidhanastrailokyādiḥ sanātanaḥ |
devadevaḥ surādhyakṣaḥ kṛṣṇo lokanamaskṛtaḥ || 6 ||
havyakavyavahaḥ śrīmān havyakavyabhugavyayaḥ |
adityā devamātuśca kathaṃ garbhe'bhavat prabhuḥ |
sraṣṭā yo vāsavasyāpi sa kathaṃ vāsavānujaḥ || 7 ||
prasūto devadeveśo viṣṇutvaṃ prāptavān katham |
etadācakṣva me vipra prādurbhāvaṃ mahātmanaḥ || 8 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śṛṇu rājan kathāṃ divyāmarcitāmṛṣipuṅgavaiḥ |
purāṇaiḥ kavibhiḥ proktāṃ brahmoktāṃ brāhmaṇeritām || 9 ||
mārīcasya sureśasya kaśyapasya prajāpateḥ |
adirtirditirdve bhārye bhaginyau janamejaya || 3.48.10 ||
adityāṃ jajñire devāḥ kaśyapasya mahātmanaḥ |
dhātāryamā ca mitraśca varuṇoṃ'śo bhagastathā || 11 ||
indro vivasvān pūṣā ca parjanyo daśamastathā |
tathaikādaśamastvaṣṭā dvādaśo viṣṇurucyate || 12 ||

baleratulavīryasya siṃhāsanagatasya vai || 23 ||

daityā ūcuḥ

amitabalaparākramo'si rājannatiśayase svaguṇaiḥ pitāmahaṃ svam|| 29 ||

savidyutastoyadharā yathaiva |

vīryottamāḥ sūryamarīcivarṇāḥ || 48 ||
yayuḥ sasainyā yudhi durnivāryā balotkaṭāḥ padmasahasramālāḥ |
rathaiḥ suyuktaistapanīyavarṇairvaidūryamuktāmaṇidāmacitraiḥ || 49 ||
nānāvidhākārasamākulāste
pāriplavaiścaiva sitātapatraiḥ |
tejomayaiḥ kāñcanacārucitraiḥ
sunirmalaiḥ pāvakasaṃnibhāste || 3.52.50 ||
soraśchadaiḥ sadhvajakiṅkiṇīkairhayaiśca vāyoḥ samavegavadbhiḥ |
diśāṃ gajaiścaiva mahābalaistaiḥ kailāsaśṛṅgapratimairmahadbhiḥ || 51||
prajagmurugrāyudhacāpahastāścaturyugānte jvalitā ivolkāḥ |
sādhyāśca devāḥ sumahāprabhāvāḥ svādhīnacakrāḥ pratidīptavaktrāḥ || 52 ||
prayānti jāmbūnadabhūṣitāṅgā
gāṅgaughamātrairgaganairbalaughaiḥ |
vidyotayanto vidiśo diśaśca
mahābalāste jayatāṃ variṣṭhāḥ || 53 ||
variṣṭhapuṣṭāṣṭabhujāḥ sudṛptā
vaiśvānarārkapratimaprabhāvāḥ |
te brahmavidbhiśca namasyamānāḥ
sampūjyamānāśca suraiḥ saśakraiḥ || 54 ||
gandharvasaṃghairanugamyamānā vadhāya teṣāmasurādhipānām |
vaidūryavajrasphaṭikāgracitrairdhvajaiḥ suvarṇaiśca pariṣkṛtānām || 55 ||
rūpaṃ babhau cotkaṭabhūṣaṇānāṃ daityendranāśāya vibhūṣitānām |
ātmaprabhābhiśca raṇotkaṭābhirvarmaprabhābhiśca tamonudābhiḥ | 56 ||
dhvajotthabhābhiḥ svaśarorubhābhirmahāprabhābhiśca mahojjvalābhiḥ |
vibhānti te devavarāḥ sasādhyāḥ pradhmātaśaṅkhasvanasiṃhanādāḥ || 57 ||
mahārathasthāstridivaukasaste
mahābalāḥ śatrubalaṃ prayānti |
mahāstrahastā yayurugrakāyā
mahāsurāṇāṃ nidhanāya devāḥ || 58 ||
tathaiva sarve maruto'tivīryā balotkaṭāste samaraṃ pratītāḥ |
yayurmahāmeghasamānavarṇāścakrāyudhāstoyadanādanādāḥ || 59 ||
mahendraketupratimā mahābalāḥ
pragṛhya sarvāsurasūdanāṃ gadām|
raṇotkaṭā lohitacandanāktāḥ
sahemamālyāmbarabhūṣitāṅgāḥ ||3.52.60||
te yuddhaśauṇḍāḥ sabhujāstravīryā
balotkaṭāḥ krodhavilohitākṣāḥ |
yayuḥ sajāmbūnadapadmamālā
yatheṣṭanānāvidhakāmarūpāḥ ||61 ||
khaḍgaprabhāśyāmalitāṃsapīṭhāḥ puraṃdaraṃ vai parivārya devāḥ |
vaidūryacāmīkaracārurūpāṇyābadhya gātreṣu mahāprabhāṇi || 62 ||
varmāṇi daityāstranivāraṇāni prayānti yuddhāya sapatnasāhāḥ |
tairutthitaiḥ kāñcanavedikāḍhyairvaradhvajairbhāskararaśmivarṇaiḥ ||63||
yayau surāṇāṃ pṛtanograbhāsā
samunnadantī yudhi siṃhanādān|
ityevamuktaṃ tridiveśvarasya
sainyaṃ tadāsīt sumahatprabhāvam || 64 ||
yuddhaṃ prayātasya jayāvahasya
vadhāya teṣāmasurādhipānām || 65 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vāmanaprādurbhāve dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 52 ||

<3.53>

tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ pravṛtto'suradevavigrahastadadbhuto bhāti surāsurākulaḥ |
velāmatikramya yugāntakāle mahārṇavānyonyamivāśrayantaḥ || 1 ||
nānāyudhoddyotavidīpitāṅgā mahābalā vyāyatakārmukāste |
raṇotsukā vāraṇahastahastāḥ sudurjayāstoyadanādanādāḥ || 2 ||
visphārayantaḥ sahasā dhanūṃṣi cakrāṇi cādityasamaprabhāṇi |
samutkṣipanto hyaśanīśca ghorān khaḍgāṃśca te vajramukhāśca śaktīḥ || 3 ||
mahāgadāḥ kāñcanapaṭṭanaddhāstathāyasān kārmukamudgarāṃśca |
śūlāṃśca vṛkṣāṃśca vigṛhya dīptān nadanti śūrāḥ śataśo raṇasthāḥ|| 4 ||
etasminnantare teṣāmanyonyamabhinighnatām |
dvandvayuddhānyavartanta devānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha || 5 ||
marutāṃ pañcamo yastu sa bāṇenābhyayudhyata |
mahābalaḥ suravaraḥ sāvitra iti yaṃ viduḥ || 6 ||
danāyuṣāyāḥ putrastu balo nāma mahāsuraḥ |
so'yudhyata raṇe'tyugro dhruveṇa vasunā saha || 7 ||
namuciścāsuraśreṣṭho dhareṇa saha yudhyata |
pravarau viśvakarmāṇau khyātau devāsureśvarau || 8 ||
pulomā tu mahādaityo vāyunā saha yudhyata |
sasainyaḥ parvatākāro raṇe'yudhyata daṃśitaḥ || 9 ||
hayagrīvastu ditijaḥ saha pūṣṇā tvayudhyata |
śūreṇāmitavīryeṇa bhāskarākāravarcasā || 3.53.10 ||
śambarastu mahādaityo mahāmāyo mahāsuraḥ |
bhagenāyudhyata tadā sahito yuddhadurmadaḥ || 11 ||
śarabhaḥ śalabhaścaiva daityānāṃ candrabhāskarau |
prayuddhau saha somena śaiśirāstreṇa dhīmatā || 12 ||
virocanastu balavān balerbalavataḥ pitā |
viṣvaksenena sādhyena devena ca sa yudhyata || 13 ||
kujambhastu mahātejā hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutaḥ |
aṃśenāyudhyata tadā prāsapraharaṇena ve || 14 ||
asilomā tu balinā mārutena samaṃ vibho |
tadāyudhyata dīptāsyo vikṛtaḥ parvatāyudhaḥ || 15 ||
danāyuṣāyāḥ putrastu vṛtro nāma mahāsuraḥ |
aśvibhyāṃ devavaidyābhyāṃ saha yudhyata saṃyuge ||16 ||
ekacakrastu ditijaścakrahasto durāsadaḥ |
sahāyudhyata devena sādhyena ditijāriṇā 17 ||
balastu madhupiṅgākṣo vṛtrabhrātā mahāsuraḥ |
mṛgavyādhena rudreṇa sahāyudhyata vīryavān 18 ||
rāhustu vikṛtākāraḥ śataśīrṣā mahodaraḥ |
ajaikapādena raṇe sahāyudhyata daṃśitaḥ || 19 ||
keśī tu dānavaśreṣṭhaḥ prāvṛṭkālāmbudaprabhaḥ |
dhaneśvareṇa bhīmena sahāyudhyata saṃyuge || 3.53.20 ||
vṛṣaparvā tu balinā pāvanena mahāraṇe |
viśvedevena viśveśaḥ sahāyudhyata vīryavān ||21 ||
prahrādastu mahāvīryo vīraiḥ svaistanayairvṛtaḥ |
yuyudhe saha kālena raṇe kāla ivāparaḥ || 22||
anuhrādaḥ kubereṇa dhanadena mahāraṇe |
gadāhastena yuyudhe kṣobhayan ripuvāhinīm || 23 ||
vipracittistu daiteyo varuṇena mahātmanā |
pravṛtto vai raṇaṃ kartuṃ daityānāṃ nandivardhanaḥ || 24 ||
balistu saha śakreṇa sureśena mahātmanā |
yuyudhe devarājena balinā balavān raṇe || 25 ||
śeṣā devāśca daityāśca jaghnuranyonyamāhave |
vinardanto mahānādān prāsāsiśaraśaktibhiḥ || 26||
adṛśyanta mahotpātā ye proktā jagataḥ kṣaye |
mārutāḥ sapta te kṣubdhā vyaśīryanta mahīdharāḥ || 27 ||
sapta caivotthitāḥ sūryāḥ śoṣayanto mahārṇavān |
bahunābhidyata dharā vāyunā mathitā yathā || 28 ||
vyutthitāśca mahāmeghāḥ śakracāpāṅkitodarāḥ |
praṇeduḥ sarvabhūtāni sarvāḥ satimirā diśaḥ || 29 ||
devānāmajayo ghoro dṛśyate kālanirmitaḥ |
ghorotpātaḥ samudbhūto yugāntasamaye yathā || 3.53.30 ||
na hyantarikṣaṃ na diśo na bhūmirna bhāskaro'dṛśyata reṇujālaiḥ |
vavuśca vātāstumulāḥ sadhūmā diśaśca sarvāstimiropagūḍhāḥ || 31 ||
ete cānye ca bahavo dṛśyante devanirmitāḥ |
bhūmau tathāntarikṣe ca mahotpātāḥ samantataḥ || 32 ||
tad yuddhaṃ devadaityānāṃ bhīmānāṃ bhīmadarśanam |
apaśyata gururbrahmā sarvaireva suraiḥ saha || 33 |||
vedaiścaturbhiḥ sāṅgaiśca vidyābhiśca sanātanaḥ |
padmayonirvṛtaḥ śrīmān siddhaiśca paramarṣibhiḥ ||34||
nānāmaṇistambhasahasracitramāruhya yānaṃ dadṛśe svayambhūḥ |
subhāsvaraṃ bhūtasahasrayuktaṃ pradīpyamāno vapuṣā vareṇa | 35 ||
sutaptajāmbūnadabhakticitramānandabherīśatasampraṇādam |
nakṣatracaṇḍāṃśubhiraṃśumantaṃ vaidūryasomārkavibhūṣitāṅgam || 36||
tamātmajā vai pulahaḥ pulastyastathā marīcirbhṛguraṅgirāśca |
ṛksāmabhiḥ samyagabhiṣṭuvantaḥ sevanti devaṃ varadaṃ vimāne || 37 ||
taṃ pāvakā lokaguruṃ svayaṃbhuvaṃ
sāṅgāśca vedā makhadevatāśca |
sevanti devaṃ bhuvaneśvareśaṃ
bhūtāni cānyāni mahānubhāvam || 38||
ete babhūvuśca maharṣisaṃghā
'vaiśvānarāḥ pāvakayonayaśca |
sarve yayurdevapurohitāśca
yuddhotsukāḥ sarvasurāsurāṇām|| 39 ||
yogeśvarā ṣaṭ ca divākarābhā
vibhūṣaṇairbhūṣitasarvadehāḥ |
antahitā vai dadṛśurnabhaḥsthā
nārāyaṇaścaiva naraśca devāḥ || 3.53.40 ||
vaktraiścaturvedadharaiścaturbhiḥ
sampūrṇacandrapratimaiḥ sukāntaiḥ |
sarvā diśo nistimirāścakāra
navodito'sau śaradīva candraḥ || 41||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi devāsurayuddhe sanakādikāgamanaṃ nāma tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 53 ||

<3.54>

catuṣpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
ubhayoḥ senayo rājan bhūyo yuddhamavartata |
nādena saṃcālayatāṃ trailokyamidamavyayam || 1 ||
gomukhāḍambarāṇāṃ ca bherīṇāṃ murajaiḥ saha |
jhallarīḍiṇḍimānāṃ ca vyabhūyanta mahāsvanāḥ || 2 ||
pravṛtto yuddhayajñastu tumulo lomaharṣaṇaḥ |
raṇamadhye mahānādaḥ svargīyaḥ śūrasammataḥ || 3 ||
yuddhayajñasya netābhūt prahrādo daityasattamaḥ |
virocanastathādhvaryuryuddhayajñapravartakaḥ || 4 ||
hotā caivātra namucirvṛtraḥ stotropakalpakaḥ |
mantrā daityāḥ samākhyātā yajñakarmaṇi tatra vai || 5 ||
anuyātaśca pitaramadhiko vā parākramaiḥ |
yaṣṭā tatrābhavad bāṇa saṃyuge copatiṣṭhate || 6 ||
aindraṃ pāśupataṃ brāhmaṃ sthūṇākarṇaṃ sudurjayam|
mantrāstatrābhyavartanta sādhvanuhrādayojitāḥ || 7 ||
udgātā ca mayaḥ śrīmān sthitaḥ śatrubhayaṃkaraḥ |
vinadan ditijaśreṣṭho devānīkaṃ vyadārayat || 8 ||
balistu rājā dyutimān svayaṃ tatra mahāsuraḥ |
jāpyairhomaiśca saṃyuktā brahmatvamakarotprabhuḥ || 9 ||
raṇāgnirjvalito ghoro vairendhanasamīritaḥ |
hūyate tvasuraistatra devo viṣṇuḥ suraiḥ saha || 3.54.10 ||
śaṅkhaśabdaiḥ sutumulairbherīṇāṃ ca mahāsvanaiḥ |
udghuṣṭaṃ vimalaṃ caiva subrahmaṇyaṃ prayujyate || 11||
balaśca balakaścaiva pulomā ca mahāsuraḥ |
praśastaṃ ca samaṃ kṛtvā satraṃ samyak pracakrire || 12 ||
kalmāṣadaṇḍā vimalā vipulā rathapaṅktayaḥ |
yūpāśca samakalpanta yuddhayajñe mahāphale || 13 ||
karṇinālīkanārācā vatsadantopabṛṃhikāḥ |
tomarāḥ somakalaśā vicitrāṇi dhanūṃṣi ca || 14 ||
asthīnyatra kapālāni puroḍāśāḥ śirāṃsi ca |
ājyaṃ ca raudraṃ rudhiraṃ tasmin yajñe'bhihūyate || 15 ||
idhmāḥ paridhayastatra prastārā vipulā gadāḥ |
hayagrīvo'silomā ca rāhuḥ keśī ca dānavaḥ || 16||
virocanaśca jambhaśca kujambhaśca mahābalaḥ |
sadasyāstatra tu makhe vipracittistu vīryavān || 17 ||
iṣavastu sruvāstatra rathākṣasadṛśāḥ śubhāḥ |
dhanuṣkoṭyā dhanurjyāśca sruvastatra mahāmakhe || 18 ||
pratiprāsthānikaṃ karma vṛṣaparvākarodiha |
dīkṣitastatra tu balistasya patnī mahācamūḥ || 19 ||
śambarastatra śāmitramakarod ditinandanaḥ |
atirātre mahābāhurvitate yajñakarmaṇi ||3.54.20 |
dakṣiṇāstasya yajñasya kālanemirmahāsuraḥ |
vaitāne karmaṇi vibhoryaḥ khyāto havyavāḍiva || 21 ||
tridaśānāṃ tu sainyasya śarīrairgatajīvitaiḥ |
tasmin yajñe tu savanaṃ vardhate daityanirmitam || 22 ||
devānāṃ rudhiraṃ saṃkhye papurugrā diteḥ sutāḥ |
nardamānāḥ pramuditāḥ somapānaṃ raṇādhvare || 23 ||
yadā balirmahādaityo vijetā samare surān |
tadā hyavabhṛtho yajñe bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 24 ||
mahāsurendrapatayo yajvāno bhūridakṣiṇāḥ |
vedavanto vṛttavantaḥ śūrāḥ sarve tanutyajaḥ || 25 ||
trailokyaharaṇe sṛṣṭā yuddhayajñāya dīkṣitāḥ |
baddhakṛṣṇājināḥ sarve vratino muñjadhāriṇaḥ || 26||
ekaniścayakāryāśca trailokyajayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ |
suradānavadaityānāṃ śabdaḥ samabhavanmahān || 27||
nānāyudhavihastānāṃ tvaritānāṃ pradhāvatām |
kṣveḍitotkruṣṭaninadairgajabṛṃhitaniḥsvanaiḥ || 28 ||
rathanemisvanairghoraistumulaḥ sarvato'bhavat |
śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣairhayaheṣitaniḥsvanaiḥ || 29 ||
hayānāṃ heṣamāṇānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca garjatām |
kṣveḍitotkruṣṭaninadaiḥ pāṇipādaravaistathā ||3.54.30 ||
dānavānāṃ pareṣāṃ ca śastravanti mahānti ca |
samare bhīmakarmāṇi sainyāni pracakāśire || 31 ||
tato nāgā rathāścaiva jāmbūnadavibhūṣitāḥ |
bhrājamānā vyarājanta meghā iva savidyutaḥ || 32 ||
ṛṣṭikhaḍgagadāstīkṣṇāḥ śūlaśaktiparaśvadhāḥ |
cāru vibhrājire tatra teṣvanīkeṣu bhāgaśaḥ || 33
rathā bahuvidhākārāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ |
hemapracchannaśikharā jvalanta iva pāvakāḥ || 34 ||
dānavānāṃ surāṇāṃ ca samālokyanta sainikāḥ |
kāñcanaiḥ kavacaiḥ sarve jvalitārkasamaprabhaiḥ || 35 ||
saṃnaddhāḥ samadṛśyanta jyotīṃṣi gagane yathā |
udyatairāyudhaiścitraistalabaddhāḥ kalāpinaḥ || 36 ||
ṛṣabhākṣāḥ suragaṇāścamūmukhagatā babhuḥ |
nānāvarṇāḥ patākāśca dhvajamālāśca saṃyuge || 37||
yuddhyatāṃ raṇaśauṇḍānāmīrayāmāsa mārutaḥ |
dhvajālaṃkāravastrāṇi kavacāni ca raśmibhiḥ ||38 ||
bhāsayāmāsa sarvāṇi raśmivarṇāni raśmivān |
sarveṣāmaprameyāṇāṃ balānāṃ pādacāriṇām || 39 ||
rajaḥ pracchādayāmāsa patrorṇaṃ pāṇḍuraṃ diśaḥ |
divyāyudhadharāḥ sarve dīptāyudhaparicchadāḥ || 3.54.40 ||
pratitastambhire'nyonyamanīkaṃ pratyanīkataḥ |
girikūṭocchrayāḥ sarve tadā te devadānavāḥ || 41 ||
anyonyamabhinighnanto raṇasthāścitrayodhinaḥ |
bāṇaiḥ suruciraistīkṣṇaiḥ patravājairdurāsadaiḥ || 42 ||
mudgarairmusalaiḥ śūlairayastuṇḍairulūkhalaiḥ |
vajrairaśanikalpaiśca khaḍgavṛkṣādibhistathā || 43 ||
tathā pravartite teṣāṃ vimarde'dbhutavikrame |
sāvitrasya vadhaṃ prepsurbāṇo jagrāha kārmukam || 44 ||
śarajālena divyena cchādayānaḥ surottamam |
mantrairhuta ivārciṣmān samprajajvāla tejasā || 45 |
sāgarābhāṃ mahāsenāṃ devānāṃ daityapuṃgavaḥ |
saṃśoṣayati bāṇaughairarkoṃ'śubhirivārṇavam || 46 ||
mārutaḥ sumahāvegaḥ sāvitraḥ śaktimuttamām |
cikṣepa baliputrāya śakro'śanimivādraye || 47 ||
āpatantī ca sā śaktirmaholkā jvalitā iva |
dvidhā chinnā kṣurapreṇa bāṇenādbhutakarmaṇā || 48 ||
hatāyāmatha śaktyāṃ tu sāvitro devasattamaḥ |
viśvakarmakṛtaṃ divyaṃ sutīkṣṇa dānavārdanam || 49 ||
supīnadhāraṃ vimalaṃ vipulaṃ candravarcasam |
agṛhṇanniśitaṃ khaḍgamāśīviṣamivoragam || 3.54.50 ||
taṃ gṛhītvā raṇamukhe prajvalantaṃ mahāprabham |
bāṇābhyāśe mahātejāḥ khaḍgapāṇiravasthitaḥ || 51 ||
sa taṃ sthitamathālakṣya sāvitraṃ balinandanaḥ |
lohitākṣaṃ mahākāyaṃ cikṣepa ca nanāda ca ||52||
tato'rkakiraṇākārānaśanipratimāñchitān |
saṃdadhe cāśu bāṇaughānāśīviṣaśilīmukhān || 53 ||
rukmapuṅkhān pradīptāgrānugravegānalaṃkṛtān |
ākarṇapūrāṃścikṣepa śarānugrān samantataḥ || 54 ||
dṛḍhacāpaprayuktāste śarā vaiśvānaraprabhāḥ |
sāvitraṃ chādayāmāsuḥ kailāsamiva toyadāḥ || 55 ||
saṃchādyamānaḥ śastraughairbāṇena balisūnunā |
parāṅmukhaḥ suravaraḥ prayātaḥ sarathadhvajaḥ || 56||
parājitya sa sāvitraṃ bāṇaḥ paramaharṣitaḥ |
pragṛhya kārmukaṃ ghoraṃ gataḥ śakrarathaṃ prati || 57 ||
balaścāpyasuraśreṣṭhaḥ pragṛhya mahatīṃ gadām |
dhruvāya vasave mūrdhni raudrāṃ cikṣepa dānavaḥ || 58 ||
tasya nirmathitaṃ tvaṃse hemacitraṃ ca varma vai |
gadāvegena bhīmena dhruvasya samare tadā || 59 ||
śeṣāśca vasavaḥ sarve divyāstrairghoradarśanaiḥ |
prācchādayan raṇe daityamādityamiva toyadāḥ || 3.54.60 ||
tataḥ sammardito bāṇairbalo dānavasattamaḥ |
avātarad rathāttasmād gadāmudyamya vegavān|| 61 ||
pātayāmāsa śatrūṇāṃ samāvidhya mahāsuraḥ |
diśaḥ prādrāvayatsarvāṃstridaśānsā mahāgadā|| 62 |
indrāśanirivendreṇa pravṛddhā sumahāsvanā |
tasyāḥ savidyuddhoṣāyāstena śabdena vepitāḥ || 63 ||
vyadravanta paribhraṣṭā rathebhyo rathinastadā |
tadudīrṇe rathānīkaṃ sūryābhaṃ meghaniḥsvanam || 64 ||
devānāṃ śaradhārābhiḥ samantādabhyavarṣata |
kṣuraprairviśikhairbhallairvatsadantaiḥ śilīmukhaiḥ || 65 ||
muhurmuhurmahātejāḥ pratyavidhyanmahāsuraḥ |
balākastu gadāpāṇirvyāditāsya ivāntakaḥ || 66||
taḍidgaṇārkasadṛśo vaiśvānara ivāparaḥ |
pibanniva śaraughāṃstān devacāpasamucchritān || 67 ||
abhyadravata daityendro mahārṇava ivāparaḥ |
avasphūrjan diśaḥ sarvāḥ svena vīryeṇa dānavaḥ|| 68 ||
aruṇattridaśān daityaḥ siṃdhuvegān nagā iva |
samudrastarasā devān vāyurvṛkṣānivaujasā || 69||
damayaṃśca maheṣvāsān vasubhyāṃ samasajjata |
āpaścaivānilaścaiva vavarṣaturariṃdamau || 3.54.70 ||
śaravarṣāṇi dīptāni meghāviva paraṃtapau |
kṣiptāṃstān viśikhān dīptānantarikṣe sa cicchide|71|
amṛṣyamāṇastatkarma dhruvastamabhidudruve |
tau pṛthakcharavarṣābhyāmanyonyamabhijaghnatuḥ || 72 ||
uttamābhijanau śūrau devadaityau yaśaskarau |
tau nakhairiva śārdūlau dantairiva mahādvipau || 73 ||
rathaśaktibhiranyonyaṃ viśikhaiścāpyakṛntatām |
nirbhindantau ca gātrāṇi vilikhantau ca sāyakaiḥ|| 74 ||
stambhayantau ca balinau pratudantau sthitau raṇe |
carantau vividhān mārgānmaṇḍalāni ca bhāgaśaḥ ||75|
mudgarairjaghnatuḥ kruddhāvanyonyamabhimāninau |
asibhyāṃ carmaṇī divye vipule ca śarāsane || 76 ||
nikṛtyācalasaṃkāśau bāhuyuddhaṃ pracakratuḥ |
vyūḍhoraskau dīrghabhujau niyuddhakuśalāvubhau || 77 ||
bāhubhiḥ samasajjetāmāyasaiḥ parighairiva |
tayorāsīd bhujāghātairnigrahaḥ pragrahastathā || 78||
atīva bhīmaḥ saṃhrādo vajraparvatayoriva |
dvipāviva viṣāṇāgraiḥ śṛṅgairiva mahāvṛṣau || 79 ||
anyonyamabhisaṃrabdhau muhūrtaṃ paryakarṣatām || 3.54.80 ||
tataḥ parājito devo balākena tathā dhruvaḥ |
rathaṃ tyaktvā bhayāttasya praṇaṣṭaḥ prāṅmukho vasuḥ|| 81
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vāmanaprādurbhāve devāsurayuddhe catuḥpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 54 ||

<3.55>

pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
punareva tu tatrāsīnmahāyuddhaṃ sudāruṇam |
kruddhasya namuceścaiva dharasya ca mahātmanaḥ || 1 |
saṃrabdhau ca mahābāhū maheṣvāsāvariṃdamau |
parasparamudaikṣetāṃ dahantāviva locanaiḥ || 2||
visphārya ca mahācāpaṃ hemapṛṣṭhaṃ durāsadam |
saṃrambhātsa vasuśreṣṭhastyaktvā prāṇānayudhyata|| 3 ||
sa sāyakamayairjālairdharo daityarathaṃ prati |
bhānumadbhiḥ śilādhautairbhānoḥ prācchādayatprabhām|| 4 ||
tataḥ prahasya namucirdharasya ca śilāśitān |
asṛjatsāyakāndīptānbhīmavegāndurāsadān||5||
mahātejā mahābāhurmahāvego mahārathaḥ |
vivyādhātibalo daityo navabhirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ || 6 ||
sa totrairiva mātaṅgo vāryamāṇaḥ patattribhiḥ |
abhyadhāvacca saṃkruddho namuciṃ vasusattamaḥ || 7 ||
tamāpatantaṃ vegena sarambhānnamucī raṇe |
daityaḥ pratyasarad devaṃ matto mattamiva dvipam || 8||
tataḥ prādhmāpayacchaṅkhaṃ bherīśataninādinam |
vikṣobhya tadbalaṃ harṣādudbhūtārṇavasaprabham || 9 ||
aśvānṛkṣasvavarṇābhān haṃsavarṇaiḥ suvājibhiḥ |
miśrayan samare daityo vasuṃ prācchādayaccharaiḥ || 3.55.10 ||
samāśliṣṭāvathānyonyaṃ vasudānavayo rathau |
dṛṣṭvā prākampata muhustridaśānāṃ mahadbalam || 11 ||
krodhasaṃrambhatāmrākṣau prekṣamāṇau muhurmuhuḥ |
garvantāviva śārdūlau prabhinnāviva vāraṇau || 12 ||
yamarāṣṭropamaṃ raudramāsīdāyodhanaṃ tayoḥ |
rathāśvanarasambādhaṃ mattavāraṇasaṃkulam || 13 ||
samājamiva taṃ dṛṣṭvā prekṣamāṇā mahārathāḥ |
āśaṃsanto jayaṃ tābhyāṃ yodhā naikatrasaṃśrayāḥ || 14 ||
tayoḥ praikṣanta saṃrambhaṃ saṃnikṛṣṭaṃ mahāstrayoḥ |
siddhagandharvamunayo devadānavayostadā || 15 ||
tau cchādayantāvanyonyaṃ samare niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ |
śarajālāvṛtaṃ vyoma cakratuśca mahābalau || 16 ||
tāvanyonyaṃ jighāṃsantau śaraistīkṣṇairmahārathau |
prekṣaṇīyatamāvāstāṃ vṛṣṭimantāvivāmbudau || 17 ||
suvarṇavikṛtān bāṇān pramuñcantāvariṃdamau |
bhāskarābhaṃ tadākāśamulkābhiriva cakratuḥ ||18||
tayoḥ śarāḥ prakāśante devadānavayostadā |
paṅktayaḥ śaradi mattānāṃ sārasānāmivāmbare ||19||
tridaśāśvagajānāṃ hi śarīrairgatajīvitaiḥ |
kṣaṇena saṃvṛtā bhūmirmeghairiva nabhastalam || 3.55.20 ||
tataḥ sudhāraṃ jvalitaṃ sūryamaṇḍalasannibham |
dharāya vasave muktaṃ cakraṃ namucinā raṇe || 21||
patatā tena cakreṇa dharasya syandanottamaḥ |
sadhvajaḥ sāyudhaḥ sāśvo dagdho'rkakiraṇaprabhaḥ|| 22||
sa tyaktvā syandanaṃ devaḥ pradīptaṃ cakratejasā |
bhayāt tasyāsurendrasya gataḥ svagṛhamuttamam || 23||
parājitya suraṃ daityo namucirbalagarvitaḥ |
prayātaḥ svena sainyena bhūyaḥ suracamūṃ prati || 24 ||
yau tau mayaśca tvaṣṭā ca devadaityeṣu viśrutau |
pravarau viśvakarmāṇau māyāśataviśāradau || 25 ||
ghorastayoḥ samprahāraḥ prāvartata sudāruṇaḥ |
anyonyasparddhinostatra cirātprabhṛti saṃyuge || 26 ||
tvaṣṭā tu niśitairbāṇairdaityaṃ tu baladarpitam |
parākrāntaṃ parākramya vivyādha triśataiḥ śaraiḥ || 27 ||
mayastu prativivyādha tvaṣṭāraṃ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ |
sudhātaiḥ suprasannāgraiḥ śātakumbhavibhūṣitaiḥ |
nanāda ditijaśreṣṭho hatastvaṣṭraḥ śarairmayaḥ || 28 |
saṃkruddho daityasainyasya vicinvanniva jīvitam|
śaktiṃ kanakavaidūryacitradaṇḍāṃ mahāprabhām || 29 ||
devo gṛhītvā samare daityendraṃ samapātayat|
bhaīhmāṃ sarvāyasīṃ 7 puraṃdara ivāśanim || 3.55.30 ||
tāṃ tvaṣṭurbhujanirmuktāmarkavaiśvānaraprabhām |
mayaściccheda tīkṣṇāgraiccūrṇaṃ saptabhirāśugaiḥ || 31 ||
tataḥ kṣuṇvanniva prāṇāṃstvaṣṭuḥ kopānmahāsuraḥ |
preṣayāmāsa saṃrambhaḥ śarān barhiṇavāsasaḥ || 32 ||
ciccheda bāṇāṃstvaṣṭā tāñjvalitairnataparvabhiḥ |
daityasya sumahāvegaiḥ suvarṇavikṛtaiḥ śaraiḥ || 33 ||
tau vṛṣāviva nardantau balinau vāsitāntare |

anyonyaṃ pratiyudhyantāvanyonyavadhakāṅkṣiṇau |
anyonyamabhivīkṣantau kruddhāvāśīviṣāviva || 35 ||
mahāgajāvivāsādya viṣāṇāgraiḥ parasparam |
śaraiḥ pūrṇāyatotsṛṣṭairanyonyamabhijaghnatuḥ ||36||
tataḥ suvipulāṃ dīptāṃ mayo rukmāṅgado gadām |
tvaṣṭari prāhiṇot kruddhaḥ sarvaprāṇaharāṃ raṇe ||37||
tayā jaghānātirathastvaṣṭuruttamavājinaḥ |
gadayā dānavaḥ kruddho vajreṇendra ivācalān || 38 ||

dhvajaṃ tvaṣṭuratha cchitvā sūtaṃ ninye yamakṣayam|
mahābalān mahāvegānsadaśvān gadayā hanat|| 3.55.40 ||
dṛṣṭvā tvaṣṭā hataṃ sūtamaśvāṃśca vinipātitān |
hatāśvaṃ rathamutsṛjya sūtaṃ ca patitaṃ bhuvi || 41 ||

mayaḥ kālāntakaprakhyaścāpapāṇiradṛśyata || 43 ||
prādahad devasainyāni dāvāgniriva kānanam |.
tvaṣṭuḥ so'kṣipatātyugrānnārācāṃstigmatejasaḥ||44||
caturdaśaśilādhautān sāyakānvividhākṛtīn|

suparṇavegairvikṛtairjvaladbhiḥ prāṇanāśanaiḥ |

nihatā vāyuvegena tena sapta mahārathāḥ |

saptakiṣkuparīṇāhaṃ dvādaśāratnikārmukam|
cāpaṃ cāśaninirghoṣaṃ dṛḍhajyaṃ bhārasādhanam ||114||
vikṣipannakṣasadṛśānvyasṛjatsāyakān bahūn|
krodhasaṃraktanayanaḥ śambaraḥ sarvayogavit ||115||
tena vitrāsyamānāni devasainyāni sarvaśaḥ |
samakampanta bhītāni sindhoriva mahormayaḥ ||116||
tamāpatantaṃ samprekṣya virūpākṣaṃ vibhīṣaṇam |
bhagaḥ prasphuramāṇauṣṭhastvaramāṇo vyadārayat || 117||
tato bhago maheṣvāso divyaṃ viskārayandhanuḥ |
avākirad daityagaṇāñcharajālena chādayan || 118||
tamabhyagād bhago daityaṃ tūrṇamasyantamantikāt |
mātaṅgamiva mātaṅgo vṛṣaṃ prati vṛṣo yathā || 119||
tau pragṛhya mahāvegau dhanuṣī bhārasādhane |
prācchādayetāmanyonyaṃ takṣamāṇau raṇe śaraiḥ || 3.55.120|||
tayoḥ sutumulaṃ yuddhamāsīd ghoraṃ mahāraṇe |
bhagaśambarayobhīṃmamaprameyaṃ mahātmanoḥ || 121|||
atha pūrṇāyatotsṛṣṭaiḥ śaraiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ |
vyadārayetāmanyonyaṃ kārṣṇe nirbhidya carmaṇī || 122||
tau tu vikṛtasarvāṅgau rudhireṇa samukṣitau |
samprekṣyamāṇau rathināvubhau paramadurmadau |
takṣamāṇau śitairbāṇairna vīkṣitumaśaknutām || 123||
atha vivyādha samare tvaramāṇo'suro bhagam |
nārācaiḥ krodhatāmrākṣaḥ kālāntakayamopamaḥ || 124||
garutmāniva cākāśe pothayāno mahoragam |
nārācā nyapatan dehe tūrṇaṃ śambaracoditāḥ || 125||
tānantarikṣe nārācān bhagaściccheda patribhiḥ |
jvalantamacalaprakhyaṃ vaiśvānarasamaprabham || 126||
tato bhagaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭyā vivyādhāsurasattamaḥ |
śilīmukhairmahāvegairjāmbūnadavibhūṣitaiḥ || 127|
tadā tatsuciraṃ kālaṃ yuddhaṃ samamivābhavat |
śambarasya ca māyābhirnādṛśyata tato'mbaram || 128||
dorbhyāṃ vikṣipataścāpaṃ raṇe viṣṭabhya tiṣṭhataḥ |
śrūyate dhanuṣaḥ śabdo visphūrjitamivāśaneḥ || 129||
sa bhagasya hayān hatvā sārathiṃ ca mahāhave |
abhyavarṣaccharairenaṃ parjanya iva vṛṣṭimān || 3.55.130 ||
na tasyāsīdanirbhinnaṃ gātre dvyaṃgulamantaram |
bhagadevasya daityena śambareṇāstraghātinā ||131||
devasya cādbhutaṃ divyamastramastreṇa vārayan |
māyāyuddhena māyāvī śambarastamayodhayat || 132||
avañcayad bhagaṃ daityo māyābhirlāghavena ca |
bhagastasya rathaṃ sāśvaṃ śaravarṣairavākirat ||133||
sahasramāyo dyutimān devasenāṃ niṣūdayan |
adṛśyata śaraiśchannaḥ śambaraḥ śataśo raṇe ||134||
adṛśyat patito bhūmau gatacetā ivāsuraḥ |
atha sma yudhyate bhūyaḥ śatadhā śailasaṃnibhaḥ ||135||
diśāṃ gajendramārūḍho dṛśyate sa punarbalī |
prādeśamātraśca punaḥ punarbhavati śailavat || 136||
mahāmegha iva śrīmāṃstiryagūrdhvaṃ ca so'bhavat |
punaḥ kṛtvā virūpāṇi vikṛtāni ca sarvaśaḥ ||137||
sarvāṃ bhīṣayate senāṃ devānāṃ bhīmadarśanaḥ |
te bhītāḥ prapalāyante siṃhaṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛgā yathā || 138||
tataḥ so'nyaṃ varaṃ dehaṃ kṛtvā prāṃśutaraṃ punaḥ |
gacchatyūrdhvagatiṃ ghoro diśaḥ śabdena pūrayan ||139||
nabhastalagataścāpi varṣate vāsavo yathā |
saṃvartakāmbudaprakhyaḥ pūrayan pṛthivītalam || 3.55.140||
saṃvartako'nalaścaiva bhūtvā bhīmaparākramaḥ |
śatavartmā śataśikho dadāha ca punaḥ surān || 141||
muhūrtācca mahāśailaḥ śataśīrṣā śatodaraḥ |
adṛśyata divaḥ stambhaḥ śataśṛṅga ivācalaḥ 142||
ye'nye devāśca sādhyāśca ye ca viśve ca devatāḥ |
kṣipantyastrāṇi divyāni tāni so'grasatāsuraḥ || 143||
yuddhyamānaśca samare sarathaḥ so'surottamaḥ |
gandharvanagarākārastatraivāntaradhīyata || 144||
te bhītāḥ samudīkṣanta tridaśā bhīmavikramāḥ |
sahasramāyaṃ samare śambaraṃ citrayodhinam || 145||
sa bhago bhayasaṃtrasto dānavendrasya saṃyuge |
rathaṃ tyaktvā mahābhāgo mahendraṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 146||
parājitya tu taṃ devaṃ dānavendraḥ pratāpavān |
gato yatra mahātejā jātavedā mahāprabhaḥ || 147||
sa vahniṃ vāgbhirugrābhiḥ kruddhastarjayate balī |
bhavāmyeṣa hi te mṛtyurityuktvāntaradhīyata || 148|
vaiśampāyana uvāca
etasminnantare caiva brāhmaṇendro mahābalaḥ |
jaghāna somaḥ śītāstro dānavānāṃ camūṃ raṇe || 149||
kailāsaśikharākāro dyutimadbhirgaṇairvṛtaḥ |
avadhīd dānavān dṛṣṭvā daṇḍapāṇirivāntakaḥ || 3.55.150||
pothayad rathavṛndāni vājivṛndāni vai prabhuḥ |
daityeṣu vicarañchrīmānyugānte kālavadbalī ||151||
so'marṣād rathajālāni uruvegena candramāḥ |
dadāha dānavān sarvāndāvāgniriva coditaḥ || 152||
mṛdnan rathebhyo rathino gajebhyo gajayodhinaḥ |
sādinaścāśvapṛṣṭhebhyo bhūmau cāpi padātinaḥ || 153||
śītena vyadhamatsarvān vāyurvṛkṣānivaujasā |
candramāḥ sumahātejā dānavānāṃ mahācamūm || 154||
tadastramabhavat tasya pradigdhaṃ śatruśoṇitaiḥ |
pinākamiva rudrasya kruddhasyābhighnataḥ paśūn || 155||
yugāntakopamaḥ śrīmān daityeṣu vyacaradbalī |
āvārya mahatīṃ senāṃ prādravantīṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 156||
candraṃ mṛtyumivāyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā yodhā visismiyuḥ|
yato yataḥ prakṣipati śiśirāstraṃ tamonudaḥ ||157||
tatastato vyaśīryanta daityasainyāni saṃyuge |
vyadārayat ca sainyāni svabalenābhisaṃvṛtaḥ || 158||
grasamānamanīkāni vyāditāsyamivāntakam |
taṃ tathā bhīmakarmāṇaṃ gṛhītāstraṃ mahāhave || 159||
dṛṣṭvā śaśāṃkamāyāntaṃ daityābhaṃ candrabhāskarau |
tālamātrāṇi cāpāni karṣamāṇau mahābalau || 3.55.160||
chādayetāṃ śaraiścandraṃ vṛṣṭimantāvivāmbudau |
atha visphāryamāṇānāṃ kārmukāṇāṃ surāsuraiḥ || 161||
abhavat sumahāśabdo diśaḥ saṃnādayanniva |
vinadadbhirmahānāgairhreṣamāṇaiśca vājibhiḥ || 162||
bherīśaṅkhaninādaiśca tumulaṃ sarvato'bhavat|
yuyutsavaste saṃrabdhā jayagṛddhā yaśasvinaḥ ||163||
anyonyamabhigarjanto goṣṭheṣviva mahāvṛṣāḥ |
śirasāṃ pātyamānānāṃ samare niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ||164||
aśmavṛṣṭirivākāśe hyabhavat senayostathā |
kuṇḍaloṣṇīṣadhārīṇi jātarūpasrajāṃsi ca || 165|
patitāni sma dṛśyante śirāṃsi raṇamūrdhani |
viśikhairmathitairgātrairbāhubhiśca sakārmukaiḥ || 166||
sahastābharaṇaiścānyairvicchinnai rudhirokṣitaiḥ |
kavacairāvṛtairgātrairurubhiścandanokṣitaiḥ || 167||
mukhaiśca candrasaṃkāśaistaptakuṇḍalabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
gajavājimanuṣyāṇāṃ sarvagātraiḥ samantataḥ ||168||
āsīt sarvā samākīrṇā muhūrtena vasuṃdharā |
cāpameghāśca vipulāḥ śastravidyutprakāśinaḥ |
vāhanānāṃ ca nirghoṣaḥ stanayitnusamo'bhavat ||169||
sa samprahārastumulaḥ kaṭukaḥ śoṇitodakaḥ |
prāvartata surāṇāṃ ca dānavānāṃ ca saṃyuge || 3.55.170||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vāmanaprādurbhāve devāsurayuddhe pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 55 ||

<3.56>

ṣaṭpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tasmin mahāhave raudre tumule lomaharṣaṇe |
vavarṣuḥ śaravarṣāṇi saṃrabdhā devadānavāḥ || 1 ||
vyākrośanta gajāstatra śaraghātaprapīḍitāḥ |
aśvāśca paryadhāvanta hatārohā diśo daśa || 2 ||
utpatya nipatantyanye śaravarṣaprapīḍitāḥ |
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca gajāśvarathināṃ raṇe || 3 ||
samare tatra śūrāṇāmanyonyamabhidhāvatām |
dhanurjyātalaśabdena na prājñāyata kiṃcana || 4 ||
śaraśaktigadābhiste khaḍgaiścāmitatejasaḥ |
nijaghnurmahatīṃ senāmanyonyasya paraṃtapa || 5 ||
bāhūnāmuttamāṅgānāṃ kārmukāṇāṃ ca saṃyuge |
rāśayastatra dṛśyante devadaityasamāgame || 6 ||
aśvānāṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ ca rathānāṃ ca varūthinām |
nāntaṃ samabhigacchanti nihatānāṃ surāsuraiḥ || 7 ||
gadābhirasibhiḥ prāsairbhallaiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ |
yodhāstatrābhyahanyanta hastyaśvaṃ cāmitaṃ bahu || 8||
prāvartata nadī ghorā śoṇitaughā taraṅgiṇī |
tadā madhye tu sainyānāṃ keśaśaivalaśādvalā || 9 |
hāhākāro mahāśabdo yodhānāmabhavat tadā |
dānavairhanyamānānāṃ tridaśānāṃ mahāraṇe || 3.56.10 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
teṣāṃ tadabhavad yuddhaṃ devānāmasuraiḥ saha |
vibhīṣaṇaṃ mahāraudraṃ vikṛtaṃ bhīmadarśanam || 11 ||
virocanastu tatraiva viṣvaksenaṃ mahāhave |
jaghāna rudhirābhākṣaṃ sādhyaṃ paramadhanvinam || 12 ||
tamāyāntamabhiprekṣya viṣvaksenaḥ surairvṛtaḥ |
ameyātmā suraśreṣṭhaḥ pratyavidhyat stanāntare || 13||
sādhyasya bāṇābhihatastotrārpita iva dvipaḥ |
virocanaḥ prajajvāla krodhenāgnirivādhvare || 14 ||
sa kārmukavinirmuktaiḥ śarairdānavasattamaḥ |
viṣvaksenaṃ bibhedājau dīptaiḥ saptabhirāśugaiḥ || 15||
so'tividdho balavatā dānavena surottamaḥ |
mūrcchāmabhijagāmāśu dhvajaṃ cāpyāśrayatprabhuḥ|| 16 ||
tataḥ sa punarāśvasya sādhyo yuddhe mano dadhe |
visphārya ca mahācāpaṃ daityamadhye vyavasthitaḥ || 17 ||
virocanastu balavānabhyayudhyata sarvaśaḥ |
kṣobhayan surasainyāni samantānniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ| 18 ||
tatastasyāsurendrasya yuddhyamānasya saṃyuge |
śrūyate tumulaḥ śabdo jīmūtasyeva garjataḥ || 19 ||
jagarja ca mahāghoṣo vinighnan devavāhinīm |
caṇḍavegāśmavarṣī ca savidyutstanayitnumān || 3.56.20 ||
diśo vidrāvayāmāsa śaravarṣeṇa dānavaḥ |
sarvasainyāni devānāmudyatāstro mahāhave || 21 ||
te prādravanta vitrastā rathebhyo rathinastadā |
sādinaścāśvapṛṣṭhebhyo bhūmau cāpi padātayaḥ || 22 ||
śrutvā kārmukanirghoṣaṃ visphūrjitamivāśaneḥ |
sarvasainyāni bhītāni nivyalīyanta saṃyuge || 23 ||
virocanabhayatrastā rathebhyo rathinastadā |
padātīnāṃ yayuḥ saṃghā yatra devaḥ śacīpatiḥ || 24 ||
viṣvaksenasya sādhyasya sarvataḥ sumahābalaḥ |
padā rakṣaḥsahasrāṇi nijaghāna caturdaśa || 25 ||
aśvavṛndeṣu nāgeṣu rathānīkeṣu cābhibhūḥ |
padātīnāṃ ca saṃgheṣu vinighnan pratyadṛśyata || 26 ||
vitatya śyenavat pakṣau sarvataḥ sa varūthinīm|
bhittvā chittvā mahābāhuḥ śirāṃsyājau hyakṛntata|| 27 ||
sādinaśca padātāśca hataśeṣā rathāstathā |
viṣvaksenena sahitā virocanamathādravan || 28 ||
te'sicarmagadāśaktiparighaprāsatomaraiḥ |
tamekamabhyadhāvanta siṃhanādaṃ pracakrire || 29 ||
tataḥ so'siṃ samudyamya javamāsthāya dānavaḥ |
vakarta rathināmājau śirāṃsi ca dhanūṃṣi ca || 3.56.30 ||
rathanāgāśvavṛndeṣu balavānarisūdanaḥ |
virocanaścaran mārgān prakārānekaviṃśatim || 31 ||
bhrāntamudbhrāntamāviddhamāplutaṃ viplutaṃ plutam|
sampātaṃ samudīrṇaṃ ca darśayāmāsa dānavaḥ || 32 ||
kecid varāsinā rugṇā dānavena mahātmanā |
vineduśchinnavarmāṇo nipetuśca gatāsavaḥ || 33 ||
chinnapṛṣṭhā hatārohā dānavena mahātmanā |
vidrutāḥ svānyanīkāni jaghnustridaśavāraṇāḥ ||34 ||
nipetururvyāmākāśe nikṛtā dṛḍhadhanvinā |
vividhāstomarāścāpā mahāmātraśirāṃsi ca || 35 ||
pratīpamāharannāgānaśvāṃśca dṛḍhavikramān |
cakarta rathinaḥ kāṃścit parāmṛśya mahābalaḥ |
sūtāṃściccheda khaḍgena rathānapi ca dānavaḥ || 36 ||
muhurutpatato dikṣu dhāvataśca yaśasvinaḥ |
mārgāṃścarati vaicitrān vyasmayanta tato'surāḥ|| 37 ||
nijaghāna padā kāścidākṣipyānyānapothayat |
khaḍgena cānyāṃściccheda nādenānyāṃśca bhīṣayan|| 38 ||
ūrustambhagṛhītāśca nipatantyapare bhuvi |
apare daityamālokya bhayātprāṇānavāsṛjan || 39 ||
tasmiṃstathā vartamāne yuddhe mahati dāruṇe |
rathaughagajapattīnāṃ surāṇāṃ ca mahākṣaye || 3.56.40 ||
kujambho dānavaśreṣṭho hyaṃśamādityamāhave |
yodhayāmāsa samare vṛṣaḥ prativṛṣaṃ yathā 41 ||
jaghānācalasaṃkāśo mattavāraṇavikramaḥ |
sphuradbhirniśitaistīkṣṇaśarairbahubhirāśugaiḥ || 42||
devasainyasahasrāṇi sarathāni mahāhave |
tasya bāṇapathaṃ prāpya nābhyavartanta sarvaśaḥ || 43 ||
praṇeduḥ sarvabhūtāni babhūvustimirā diśaḥ |
devānāmajayaḥ krūraḥ pratyapadyata dāruṇaḥ || 44 ||
aṃśastu dānavendrasya jaghānottamavikramaḥ |
anīkaṃ daśasāhasraṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ tarasvinām || 45 ||
āpatantaṃ gajānīkaṃ kujambho vīkṣya dānavaḥ |
gadāpāṇiravārohad rathopasthādariṃdamaḥ | 46 ||
adrisāramayīṃ gurvīṃ pragṛhya mahatīṃ gadām |
abhyadravad gajānīkaṃ vyāditāsya ivāntakaḥ || 47 ||
sa gajān gadayā nighnan vyacaratsamare balī |
kujambho dānavaśreṣṭho gadāpāṇirbalādhikaḥ || 48 ||
viśīrṇadantāṃśca vadvanbhinnakumbhāmbadāruṇān |
akarod dānavaśreṣṭha uddiśyoddiśya tān balī || 49 ||
viśīrṇadantā bahavo bhinnakumbhāstathā pare |
kujambhenārditā nāgā vyadravanta diśo daśa || 3.56.50 |
kujambhasya ca ye'mātyā dānavā ghoravikramāḥ |
nārācairvividhaistīkṣṇairapāstagajayodhinaḥ || 51 ||
kṣuraiḥ kṣuraprairbhallaiśca pātairañjalikaiḥ śitaiḥ |
ciccheda cottamāṅgāni kujambho dānavottamaḥ || 52 ||
śirobhiḥ prapatadbhistu gaganaṃ pratyapūryata |
aśmavṛṣṭirivākāśe bahubhiśca sahāṅkuśaiḥ || 53 ||
kṛttottamāṅgāḥ skandheṣu gajānāṃ gajayodhinaḥ |
adṛśyanta mahārāja tālā viśiraso yathā ||54 ||
āpatantaṃ mahānāgamaṃśasyāsurasattamaḥ |
jaghānaikeṣuṇā kruddhastataḥ sa vimukho'bhavat ||55 ||
vigāhyaivaṃ gajānīkaṃ kujambho dānavottamaḥ |
vinighnanpravarānsainyāngadayā balināṃ varaḥ || 56 ||
ekaprahārābhihatān kujambhena mahāgajān |
apaśyanta surāḥ sarve parvatāniva pātitān || 57 ||
kujambhasya ca mārgeṣu viśīrṇāste mahāgajāḥ |
vajrāhatā ivendreṇa viśīrṇā iva parvatāḥ || 58 ||
apaśyaṃstridaśāḥ sarve mūrtimantamivāntakam|
gajāstathā vyadīryanta siṃhasyevetare mṛgāḥ || 59 ||
sa babhau tāṃ gadāṃ bibhrat prokṣitāṃ gajaśoṇitaiḥ |
vyāditāsyo'nadatkruddho raudrarūpo bhayānakaḥ || 3.56.60 ||
yathā hi bhagavānkruddhaḥ prajānāṃ saṃkṣaye purā |
vikrīḍamāno gadayā raṇamadhye mahāsuraḥ || 61 ||
gopāla iva daṇḍena kālayansa mahāgajān |
kruddhaṃ kālamivākāle daṇḍamudyamya dānavam |
apaśyanta surāḥ sarve kujambhaṃ bhīmavikramam || 62 ||
hatārohāstu tatrānye prabhinnā vāraṇottamāḥ |
te hanyamānā gadayā bāṇaiśca bhṛśavikṣatāḥ ||63 ||
asahantaḥ kujambhasya gadāvegaṃ mahāhave |
svānyanīkāni mṛdnantaḥ prādravanta mahāgajāḥ || 64 ||
mahāvāta ivābhrāṇi vidhaman gadayā gajān |
atiṣṭhatsamare daityaḥ kālaḥ saṃvartako yathā || 65 |
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vāmanaprādurbhāve devāsurayuddhe kujambhasyotkarṣavarṇane ṣaṭpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||56||

<3.57>

saptapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ sarvāṇi sainyāni devarājasya śāsanāt|
abhyadravanta ditijānnadanto bhairavān ravān || 1 |
taṃ balaughamaparyantaṃ devānāṃ sudurāsadam |
rathanāgāśvakalilaṃ śaṅkhadundubhiniḥsvanam || 2 ||
āpatantaṃ suduṣpāraṃ rajasā sarvatovṛtam |
sainyasāgaramakṣobhyaṃ veleva makarālayam || 3 ||
tadāścaryamapaśyanta aśraddheyamivādbhutam |
udīrṇāṃ pṛtanāṃ sarvāṃ sāśvāṃ sarathakuñjarām || 4 ||
āvārya samare'tiṣṭhat kujambhastarasā balī |
sainyārṇavaṃ devatānāṃ girirmerurivācalaḥ || 5||
anīkinīṃ kujambhastu gadayā sa nyavārayat |
sā tathā vāritā senā vihvalābhūnnirudyamā || 6 ||
tasmiṃstathā vartamāne samprahāre sudāruṇe |
asilomā tu balavān dānavo dānavādhipaḥ || 7 ||
devasainyasya sarvasya dhūmaketurivotthitaḥ |
tapatyarka ivāmoghaḥ surasainyāni saṃyuge || 8 ||
sahasraraśmipratimo dānavasya rathottamaḥ |
śarairmegha ivāvarṣad devānīkaṃ pratāpavān || 9 ||
śaraugharaśmibhirdīptaiḥ pratapto ghoravikramaḥ |

babhūvāyodhanaṃ ghoraṃ piśitāśanasaṃkulam |

anyonyabaddhavairāṇāṃ daityānāṃ jayagṛddhinām |
samprahārastathā yuddhe vartate'tibhayaṃkaraḥ || 74 ||
sainyānāṃ samprayuddhānāṃ śūrāṇāmanivartinām |
ajasya caikapādasya rāhoścaiva mahātmanaḥ || 75 ||
teṣāṃ tu tatra patatāṃ kruddhānāśatiniḥsvanaḥ |
udvarta iva bhūtānāṃ samudrāṇāṃ tu śuśruve || 76 ||
tatraikastu sudhūmrākṣaḥ śrīmān rudro munīśvaraḥ |
bibheda keśinaṃ śaktyā gadāparighaśūlabhṛt || 77 ||
nānāpraharaṇā ghorā bhīmākṣā bhīmavikramāḥ |
niṣpetū rudradayitā mahāpāriṣadāstathā || 78 ||
rathamāsthāya ca śrīmāṃstaptakāñcanakuṇḍalaḥ |
dānavaiḥ saṃvṛtaḥ keśī yudhyate yuddhadurjayaiḥ || 79 ||
tasya saṃgrāmaśauṇḍasya saṃgrāmeṣu yuyutsataḥ |
nipeturugravīryasya jvālā hi prasṛtā mukhāt || 3.58.80 |
sa tu siṃharṣabhaskandhaḥ śārdūlasamavikramaḥ |
mahājaladasaṃkāśo mṛdaṅgadhvaniniḥsvanaḥ || 81 ||
tasya niṣpatamānasya dānavaiḥ saṃvṛtasya ca |
babhūva sumahānādaḥ kṣobhayaṃstridivaṃ yathā || 82 ||
tena śabdena vitrastā tridaśānāṃ mahācamūḥ |
drumaśailapraharaṇā yoddhumevābhyavartata || 83 ||
teṣāṃ ca devadaityānāṃ yuyutsūnāṃ parasparam |
saṃnipātaḥ sutumulo raudro lokabhayāvahaḥ || 84 ||
teṣāṃ yuddhaṃ mahāghoraṃ saṃjajñe lomaharṣaṇam |
devadānavasaṃghānāṃ prāṇāṃstyaktvā mahāhave || 85 ||
sarve hyatibalāḥ śūrā sarve parvatasaṃnibhāḥ |
sarve sarvāstravidvāṃsaḥ sarve sarvāyudhodyatāḥ |
tridaśā dānavāścaiva parasparajighāṃsavaḥ || 86 ||
teṣāṃ vai nadatāṃ śabdaḥ saṃyuge meghaniḥsvanaḥ |
śuśruve'timahāghoraścarasthāvarakampanaḥ || 87 ||
reṇuścāruṇasaṃkāśo bhīmaḥ sa samapadyata |
udbhūto devadaityaughaiḥ saṃrurodha diśo daśa || 88 ||
anyonyaṃ rajasā tena kauśeyāruṇapāṇḍunā |
saṃvṛtā bahurūpeṇa dadṛśurna ca kiṃcana || 89 ||
na dhvajo na patākāśca na varma turago'pi vā |
āyudhaṃ syandano vāpi dṛśyate naiva sārathiḥ || 3.58.90 ||
sa śabdastumulasteṣāmanyonyamabhidhāvatām |
śrūyate tumulaḥ śabdo na rūpāṇi cakāśire || 91 ||
dānavāstatra saṃkruddhā dānavāneva jaghnire |
tridaśāstridaśāścaiva nijaghnustumule tadā ||92 ||
te parāṃśca vinighnantaḥ svāṃśca yuddhe mahāsurān |
rudhirārdrā tathā cakrurmedinīmasurāḥ surāḥ || 93 ||
tatastu rudhiraugheṇa saṃsiktamuditaṃ rajaḥ |
śarīraśatasaṃkīrṇaṃ babhūva dharaṇītalam | 94 ||
śūlaśaktigadākhaḍgaparighaprāsatomaraiḥ |
tridaśā dānavāścaiva jaghnuranyonyamāhave || 95 ||
bāhubhiḥ parighākārairnighnataḥ parighaistathā |
rudrapāriṣadān sarvān sūdayanti sma dānavāḥ || 96 ||
rudrapāriṣadāścaiva mahādrumamahāśmabhiḥ |
vyadārayannatikramya śastraiścādityasaṃnibhaiḥ || 97 |
etasminnantare kruddhaḥ keśī dānavasattamaḥ |
saṃgrāmāmarṣaghoraḥ san svānyanīkāni harṣayan |
teṣāṃ paramasaṃkruddho vajramastramudīrayat || 98 ||
vajreṇāstreṇa divyena śastreṇa ca mahātmanā |
mahāpāriṣadāḥ sarve nihatā yudhi durjayāḥ || 99 ||
vajrāstrapīḍitā bhrāntā rudrapāriṣadā yudhi |
viprakīrṇadrumāḥ petuḥ śailā vajrahatā iva || 3.58.100||
evaṃ sutumulaṃ yuddhamabhavallomaharṣaṇam |
keśinaḥ saha rudreṇa tadadbhutamivābhavat ||101||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vāmanaprādurbhāve devāsurayuddhakeśirudrayuddhakathane aṣṭapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 58 ||

<3.59>

ekonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
vṛṣaparvā tu daityendro viśvamadbhutadarśanam |
niṣkumbhaṃ yodhayāmāsa lohitārkasamadyutim || 1 ||
krodhamūrcchitavaktrastu dhunvan paramakārmukam |
dhanūṃṣi prekṣya śatrūṇāṃ sārathiṃ tvarito'bravīt || 2 ||
atraiva tāvat tvaritaṃ naya me sārathe ratham |
ete devāśca sahitā ghnanti naḥ samare balam || 3 ||
etān nihantumicchāmi samaraślāghino raṇe||
etairhi dānavānīkaṃ kṛtacchidramidaṃ mahat || 4 ||
tataḥ prajavitāśvena rathena rathināṃ varaḥ||
arīnabhyahanat kruddhaḥ śarajālairmahāsuraḥ || 5 ||
na sthātuṃ devatāḥ śaktāḥ kiṃ punaryoddhumāhave||
vṛṣaparveṣunirbhinnāḥ sarva evābhidudruvuḥ || 6 ||
tān mṛtyuvaśamāpannān vaivasvatavaśaṃ gatān ||
samīkṣya nihatāñjñātīnavatasthe mahāsuraḥ || 7 ||
dṛṣṭvā taṃ tatra niṣkumbhaṃ sarve te tridaśottamāḥ |
sametya sahitāḥ sarve drutaṃ taṃ paryavārayan || 8 ||
vyavasthitaṃ tu niṣkumbhaṃ dṛṣṭvā tridaśasattamam |
babhūvurbalavanto vai tasyāstrabalatejasā || 9 ||
vṛṣaparvā tu śailābhaṃ niṣkumbhaṃ samare sthitam |
mahendra iva dhārābhiḥ śaravarṣairavākirat || 3.59.10 ||
acintayitvā tu śarāñcharīre patitān bahūn |
sthitaśca pramukhe śrīmān sasainyaḥ sa mahābalaḥ|| 11 ||
samprahasya mahātejā vṛṣaparvāṇamāhave|
abhidudrāva vegena kampayanniva medinīm || 12
tasya tvādhāvamānasya dīpyamānasya tejasā ||
babhūva rūpaṃ durdharṣaṃ dīptasyeva vibhāvasoḥ || 13||
rathaṃ tyaktvā mahātejāḥ sakrodhaḥ samapadyata ||
vṛkṣamutpāṭayāmāsa mahātālaṃ mahocchrayam || 14 ||
tataścikṣepa taṃ vṛkṣaṃ niṣkumbho vṛṣaparvaṇaḥ |
taṃ gṛhītvā mahāvṛkṣaṃ pāṇinaikena dānavaḥ || 15||
vinadya sumahānādaṃ bhrāmayitvā ca vīryavān ||
sagajān sagajārohān sarathān rathinastathā || 16||
jaghāna dānavastena śākhinā tridaśāṃstadā ||
tamantakamiva kruddhaṃ samare prāṇahāriṇam || 17 ||
vṛṣaparvāṇamāsādya tridaśā vipradudruvuḥ |
tamāpatantaṃ saṃkruddhaṃ tridaśānāṃ bhayāvaham || 18 ||
ālokya dhanvī niṣkumbhaścukrodha ca nanāda ca|
sa tatra niśitairbāṇaistriṃśadbhirmarmabhedibhiḥ || 19||
nirbibheda mahāvīryo niṣkumbho dānavādhipam ||
śaraśaktibhirugrābhidaityānāmadhipo'pyamum || 3.59.20 ||
viddhaḥ sa raṇamadhyastho rudhiraṃ prāsravad bahu ||
udvignā muktakeśāste bhagnadarpāḥ parājitāḥ || 21 ||
śvasanto dudruvuḥ sarve bhayād vai vṛṣaparvaṇaḥ ||
anyonyaṃ pramamanthuste trāsitā vṛṣaparvaṇā || 22||
pṛṣṭhavaktrāḥ susaṃvignāḥ prekṣamāṇā muhurmuhuḥ ||
tyaktapraharaṇāḥ sarve kṛtāste vṛṣaparvaṇā || 23 ||
saṃgrāme yuddhaśauṇḍena tadā niṣkumbhasainikāḥ ||
tatraiva tu mahāvīryaḥ prahlādaḥ kālamāhave || 24 ||
yodhayāmāsa rakākṣo hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutaḥ ||
tasya dānavavīrasya yuddhakāle jayakriyāḥ || 25 ||
cakāra tvarayā yukto bhārgavo vijayāvahāḥ ||
hutāśanaṃ tarpayato brāhmaṇāṃśca namasyataḥ || 26 ||
ājyagandhaprativaho mārutaḥ surabhirvavau ||
srajaśca vividhāścitrā jayārthamabhimantritāḥ || 27 ||
prahlādasya śubhe mūrdhanyābabandhośanāḥ svayam ||
kālena saha saṃgrāme prayuddhasya mahātmanaḥ || 28 ||
prahlādasyātivīryasya śānti cakre sa bhārgavaḥ ||
daśa śiṣyasahasrāṇi bhārgavasya mahātmanaḥ || 29 ||
yāni dānavavīrāṇāṃ jepuḥ śāntimanutamām |
athavaṇamatho divyaṃ brahmasaṃstavacoditam || 3.59.30 ||
tataḥ sarvāstraviduṣaḥ samareṣvanivartinaḥ || 31||
vidyayā tapasā yuktāḥ kṛtasvastyayanakriyāḥ |
dhanurhastāḥ kavacino vegenāplutya dānavāḥ ||
balimabhyarcya rājānaṃ prahlādaṃ paryavārayan || 32||
āsthāya paramaṃ divyaṃ rathaṃ pararathārujam ||
nānāpraharaṇākīrṇaṃ savajramiva parvatam || 33||
tad babhūva muhūrtena kṣveḍitāsphoṭitākulam |
meroḥ śikharamākīrṇaṃ dyaurivāmbudharāgame || 34||
srajaḥ padmapalāśānāmāmucya suvibhūṣitāḥ |
bāndhavān samparityajya nipatanti raṇapriyāḥ || 35||
mahāyudhadharaḥ śrīmāñchubhacarmadharaḥ prabhuḥ ||
satanutraśirastrāṇo dhanvī paramadurjayaḥ || 36||
siṃhaśārdūladarpāṇāṃ gadatāṃ kiṅkiṇīkinām |
daityānāṃ ca sahasrāṇi prayāntyagre mahāraṇe || 37||
sainyapakṣahitāstasya rathāḥ paramadurjayāḥ |
saptatirvai sahasrāṇi gajāstāvanta eva ca || 38 ||
madhye vyūhodarasthastu kālanemirmahāsuraḥ ||
dhanurvisphārayan ghoraṃ nanāda prajahāsa ca || 39 ||
tasmiñchatasahasrāṇi puro yānti mahādyuteḥ ||
dānavānāṃ balavatāṃ śakrapratimatejasām || 3.59.40 ||
sa samaṃ vartamānastu pakṣābhyāṃ vistṛto mahān |
abhavad dānavavyūho durbhedyaḥ sarvadaivataiḥ || 41 ||
ṣaṣṭī rathasahasrāṇi dānavānāṃ dhanurbhṛtām |
nānāpraharaṇānāṃ ca parimāṇaṃ na vidyate || 42 ||
gadāparighanistriśaiḥ śūlamudgarapaṭṭiśaiḥ ||
pragṛhītairvyarājanta dānavāḥ parvatopamāḥ || 43||
garjanto ninadantaśca vikrośantaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||
ayudhyanta mahāvīryāḥ samareṣvanivartinaḥ || 44 ||
tatra tūryasahasrāṇi bherīśaṅkharavāṇi ca |
hayānāṃ ca gajānāṃ ca garjatāmativeginām || 45 ||
dundubhīnāṃ ca nirghoṣaḥ parjanyaninadopamaḥ |
śuśruve śaṅkhaśabdaśca paṭahānāṃ ca niḥsvanaḥ || 46||
tena śaṅkhaninādena bherītūryaraveṇa ca |
nirghoṣeṇa rathānāṃ ca krośatīva nabhastalam || 47 ||
sāgarapratimaughena balena mahatā vṛtaḥ ||
prahlādo'yudhyata raṇe kālāntakayamopamaḥ || 48 ||
tasya nādena raudreṇa ghoreṇāpratimaujasaḥ |
vineduḥ sarvabhūtāni trailokyanikṛtaiḥ svanaiḥ || 49 ||
antarikṣāt papātolkā vāyuśca paruṣo vavau ||
vamantyaḥ pāvakaṃ ghoraṃ śivāścaiva vavāśire || 3.59.50 ||
prahlādastu mahāvīryaḥ prahasan yuddhadurmadaḥ |
uvāca vacanaṃ śrīmāṃstatkālakṣamamuttamam || 51 ||
adyāhaṃ darśayiṣyāmi svabāhubalamūrjitam |
adya madbāṇanihatān devān drakṣyatha saṃyuge || 52||
bāndhavā nihatā yeṣāṃ tridaśairiha saṃyuge ||
adya nirvartayiṣyanti śatrumāṃsāni dānavāḥ || 53||
imamadya samudbhūtaṃ reṇuṃ samaramūrdhani |
ahaṃ tu śamayiṣyāmi śatruśoṇitavisravaiḥ || 54|| |
timiraughahatārkaṃ tu sainyareṇvaruṇīkṛtam|
ākāśaṃ sampatiṣyanti khadyotā iva me śarāḥ || 55 ||
hṛṣṭāḥ samparimodadhvaṃ devebhyastyajyatāṃ bhayam |
adyāhaṃ nihaniṣyāmi kālendraṃ dhanuṣā raṇe || 56 ||
toṣayiṣyāmi rājānaṃ baliṃ balavatāṃ varam |
tridaśān sagaṇān hatvā raṇe cāntakamantikāt||57||
akṣayāḥ santi me tūṇāḥ śarāścāśīviṣopamāḥ ||
sthātuṃ me purataḥ śaktāḥ ke raṇe jīvitepsavaḥ || 58 ||
hatvā ripugaṇāṃstuṣṭiranurāgaśca rājasu ||
hatasya tridive vāso nāsti yuddhasamā gatiḥ || 59||
tad bhayaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā raṇe dānavasattamāḥ ||
nihatyemānarīn sarvān modadhvaṃ nandane vane || 3.59.60 ||
evamuktvā mahatsainyaṃ prahlādo dānavottamaḥ |
kālasainyaṃ mahāraudraṃ tarasāmardatāsuraḥ || 61 ||
sarvāstravidvān vīraśca nityaṃ cāpyaparājitaḥ |
yuddhe hyabhimukho nityaṃ svabāhubaladarpitaḥ || 62 ||
ṣaṣṭiṃ rathasahasrāṇi vividhāyudhadhāriṇīm |
prahlādasyātivīryasya te tasya tanayā nijāḥ || 63||
taistu kratuśatairiṣṭaṃ vipulairāptadakṣiṇaiḥ ||
kṣāntā dharmaparā nityaṃ satyavrataparāyaṇāḥ || 64 ||
dātāraḥ priyavaktāro vaktāraḥ śāstravastuṣu |
svadāraniratā dāntā brahmaṇyāḥ satyasaṅgarāḥ ||65||
yaṣṭāraḥ kratubhirnityaṃ nityaṃ cādhyayane ratāḥ |
iṣvastrakuśalāḥ sarve bahuśo dṛḍhavikramāḥ || 66||
mattavāraṇavikrāntāḥ śatrusainyapramardakāḥ |
dārayantaḥ padākṣepaiḥ sughorān vātarecakān || 67 ||
yuddhotsukadhiyā nityaṃ krodharañjitalocanāḥ ||
saṃdaṣṭauṣṭhapuṭā daityā vinedurbhīmavikramāḥ |
kṣveḍitāsphoṭitaravairanyonyaṃ samaharṣayan || 68 ||
veṇuśaṅkharavaiścaiva siṃhanādaiśca puṣkalaiḥ |
āplutyāplutya sahasā raṇe vavruranekaśaḥ || 69||
tālamātrāṇi cāpāni vikṛṣya sumahābalāḥ ||
amṛṣyamāṇāḥ sahasā dānavāścāpapāṇayaḥ || 3.59.70 ||
surāsurairapyajitaṃ yodhayanti raṇe'ntakam ||
prataptahemābharaṇāḥ sarve te śvetavāsasaḥ || 71 ||
dānavā māninaḥ sarve sarve svargābhikāṅkṣiṇaḥ |
sarve jayaiṣiṇo vīrāḥ sarve śatruvadhodyatāḥ || 72||
śuśubhe sā camūrdīptā patākādhvajamālinī ||
gajāśvarathasaṃbādhā svargamārgābhikāṅkṣiṇī || 73 ||
tataḥ kālaḥ suniryāto bhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ |
ninadan sumahākāyo vyādhibhirbahubhirvṛtaḥ || 74|| |
dadarśa mahatīṃ senāṃ dānavānāṃ balīyasām ||
abhisaṃjātadarpāṇāṃ kālaṃ samabhigarjatām || 75 ||
tadāyāntaṃ tadānīkaṃ dānavānāṃ tarasvinām |
pratilomaṃ cakārāśu vyādhibhiḥ sahito'ntakaḥ || 76||
praviśya dhvajinīṃ caiṣāṃ pātayāmāsa dānavān |
kālo rudhiraraktākṣaḥ svenānīkena saṃvṛtaḥ || 77 ||
prahlādabalamatyugraṃ prahlādaṃ ca mahābalam |
ājaghāna raṇe kālo daṇḍamudgarapaṭṭiśaiḥ || 78 ||
śaraśaktyṛṣṭikhaḍgāṃśca śūlāni musalāni ca |
gadāśca parighāścaiva vicitrāśca paraśvadhāḥ || 79||
dhanūṃṣi ca vicitrāṇi śataghnīśca sthirāyasīḥ |
pātyante vyādhibhiryuddhe dānavānāṃ camūmukhe || 3.59.80 ||
bahavo vyādhayo yuddhe bahūnasurapuṅgavān |
vyādhīnapi ca daityaughā nijaghnurbahavo bahūn || 81||
śūlaiḥ pramathitāḥ kecit kecicchinnāḥ paraśvadhaiḥ|
parighairāhatāḥ kecit kecicca paramāyudhaiḥ || 82 ||
kecid dvidhā kṛtāḥ khaḍgaiḥ sphurantaḥ patitā bhuvi ||
vyādhayo dānavaireva nānāśastrairvidāritāḥ || 83||
te cāpi vyādhibhiḥ sarve vividhairāyudhottamaiḥ |
khaḍgaiśca musalaistīkṣṇaiḥ prāsatomaramudgaraiḥ|
bhinnāśca dānavāḥ sarve nikṛttāśca paraśvadhaiḥ || 84 ||
mudgaraiḥ paṭṭiśaiścaiva vyādhibhiśca mahābalaiḥ ||
kṛtvā śastrairanekaiśca muṣṭibhiśca hatā bhṛśam || 85 ||
vemuḥ śoṇitamanyonyaṃ viṣṭabdhadaśanekṣaṇāḥ ||
ārtasvaraṃ ca nadatāṃ siṃhanādaṃ ca garjatām || 86||
babhūva tumulaḥ śabdaḥ saṃgrāme lomaharṣaṇe |
muṣṭibhiścottamāṅgāni talairgātrāṇi cāsakṛt || 87 ||
sāditāni mahīṃ jagmustiṣṭhatāmeva saṃyuge |
astraphenā dhvajāvartā cchinnabāhumahoragā || 88 ||
śūlaśaktimahāmatsyā cāpagrāhasamākulā ||
ratheṣopalasambādhā dhvajadumalatāvṛtā || 89 ||
saśabdaghoṣavistārā lohitodābhavannadī|
svadhanuḥśakradhanuṣau kāñcanāṅgadavidyutau || 3.59.90 ||
tau daityakālajaladau śaradhārāṃ vyamuñcatām ||
tau mahāmeghasaṃkāśau rathanāgagatau tadā || 91 ||
babhūvaturabhikruddhau sāmbugarbhāvivāmbudau |
taptakāñcanasaṃnāhau divyahāravibhūṣitau || 92||
tau virejaturāyastau sūryavaiśvānaropamau |
tau mahābalasaṃkāśāvanyonyasya camūmukhe || 93 || śakrāśanisamasparśairbāṇairjaghnaturāhave |
parasparaṃ samāsādya tayoryudhi durāsade || 94 ||
nāśaṃsanta tadā yodhā jīvitānyapi saṃyuge |
śarairvibhinnasarvāṅgā yudhi prakṣīṇabāndhavāḥ ||
nipeturyodhamukhyāstu rudhirokṣitavakṣasaḥ || 95 ||
patitairniṣpatadbhiśca pātyamānaiśca saṃyuge|
babhūva bhūḥ samākīrṇā yodhairudgatajīvitaiḥ || 96||
saṃgṛhṇatoḥ śarān ghorānna ca saṃdadhatostayoḥ |
antaraṃ dadṛśe kaścit prayatnādapi saṃyuge || 97 ||
laghutvācca mahābāhū yuddhaśauṇḍau mahābalau|
maṇḍalībhūtadhanuṣau sakṛdeva babhūvatuḥ || 98||
prahlādasya ca bāṇaughairdudrāvāntakavāhinī ||
uhyamānaṃ balavatā vāyunevābhramaṇḍalam || 99 ||
hatadarpaṃ tu vijñāya prahlādaḥ kālamāhave|
apayātaṃ ca samare dviṣantaṃ sampratarkya tam ||3.59.100||
matvā vaśagataṃ caiva prahlādo yuddhadurmadaḥ |
tatraivānyāṃ camūṃ bhūyaḥ sammamarda mahāsuraḥ ||101||
kālaprahlādayoryuddhamabhavad yādṛśaṃ purā |
tādṛśaṃ sarvalokeṣu na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ||102||
evamadbhutavīryaujā mahāraṇakṛtavraṇaḥ |
prahlādastvatha vṛddho'tra kālastvapasṛto raṇāt ||103||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vāmane devāsurayuddhe kālaprahādayuddhe ekonaṣaṣṭitamodhyāyaḥ || 59 ||

<3.60>

ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
dhanādhyakṣamanuhrādaḥ prahrādasyānujo balī |
sasainyaṃ yodhayāmāsa kṣobhayan yakṣavāhinīm || 1 ||
mahatā ca balaughena tvanuhrādo'surottamaḥ |
ardayāmāsa saṃkruddho dhanādhyakṣaṃ pratāpavān || 2 ||
amṛṣyamāṇastridaśānāhavasthānudāyudhān |
cakāra kadanaṃ ghoraṃ dhanuṣpāṇirmahāsuraḥ || 3 ||
āvarta iva saṃjajñe balasya mahato mahān |
kṣubhitasyāprameyasya sāgarasyeva samplave || 4 ||
tridaśānāṃ śarīraistu dānavānāṃ ca medinī |
babhūva nicitā ghoraiḥ parvatairiva samplave || 5 ||
merupṛṣṭhaṃ tu raktena rañjitaṃ samprakāśate |
sarvato mādhave māsi puṣpitairiva kiṃśukaḥ || 6 ||
hatairvīrairgajairaśvaiḥ prāvartata mahānadī |
śoṇitaughā mahāghorā yamarāṣṭravivardhinī || 7 ||
śakṛnmedomahāpaṅkā samprakīrṇāntraśaivalā |
chinnakāyaśiromīnā aṅgāvayavaśādvalā || 8 ||
gṛdhrahaṃsasamākīrṇā kekisārasanāditā |
vasāphenasamākīrṇā protkruṣṭastanitasvarā || 9 ||
tāṃ kāpuruṣadustārāṃ yuddhabhūmau mahānadīm |
nadīmivātapāpāye haṃsasaṃghopaśobhitām || 3.60.10 ||
tridaśā dānavāścaiva teruste dustarāṃ nadīm |
yathā padmarajodhvastāṃ nalinīṃ gajayūthapāḥ || 11 ||
tataḥ sṛjantaṃ bāṇaughām̐nanuhrādaṃ rathe sthitam |
dadarśa tarasā devo nighnantaṃ yakṣavāhinīm || 12 ||
kruddhastato daityabalaṃ sūdayāmāsa vittapaḥ |
vikṣipanniva khe vāyurmahābhrapaṭalaṃ balāt || 13 ||
samīkṣya tumulaṃ yuddhamanuhrādaśca vīryavān |
rathenādityavarṇena kuberamabhidudruve || 14 ||
sa dhanurdhanvināṃ śreṣṭho vikṛṣya raṇamūrdhani |
utsasarja śitān bāṇānvitteśasya mahātmanaḥ || 15 ||
kuberaṃ prāpya te bāṇā nirbhidya susamāhitāḥ |
aparānpṛṣṭhato jaghnurvyāsaktānyakṣarākṣasān || 16 ||
devaḥ śarairabhihato niśitairjvalanopamaiḥ |
anuhrādaṃ pratyudiyāt saṃkruddhaḥ paramāhave || 17 ||
tato vaiśravaṇo rājā kruddho yakṣagaṇaiḥ saha |
vavarṣa śaravarṣāṇi dānavaṃ prati vīryavān || 18 ||
tadyathā śāradaṃ varṣaṃ govṛṣaḥ śīghramāgatam |
apārayan vārayituṃ pratigṛhṇan nimīlitaḥ || 19 ||
evameva kuberasya śaravarṣaṃ mahāsuraḥ |
nimīlitākṣaḥ sahasā daityaḥ sahati dāruṇam || 3.60.20||
roṣitaḥ śaravarṣeṇa dhanadena mahāsuraḥ |
indraketupratīkāśamabhīto'paśyata drumam || 21 ||
pravṛddhaśākhāviṭapaṃ taruṇāṅkurapallavam |
utpāṭya kupito daityastaruṃ phalasamanvitam 22 ||
nijaghāna hayāñchreṣṭhān kuberasya mahātmanaḥ |
tasya karma mahāghoraṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve mahāsurāḥ || 23 ||
siṃhanādaṃ nadanti sma anuhrādapraharṣitāḥ |
tayostu tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ saṃjajñe devadaityayoḥ || 24 ||
tatastau krodharaktākṣāvanyonyavadhakāṅkṣiṇau |
anyonyaṃ vividhaiḥ śastrairghorairjaghnaturāhave || 25 ||
tridaśā dānavān sarve mathitvā prāṇadaṃstadā |
dānavaistridaśāścāpi kruddhairbhuvi nipātitāḥ || 26 ||
dānavāstvatha saṃkruddhāstridaśān niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ |
vivyadhurvajrasaṃkāśaiḥ kaṅkapatrairajihmagaiḥ || 27 ||
vidāryamāṇā daityaughaistridaśāstu mahābalāḥ |
amarṣitatarāścakruryuddhakarmāṇyabhītavat || 28 ||
tairgadābhiḥ subhīmābhiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ śūlamudgaraiḥ |
parighaiśca sutīkṣṇāgrairdānavāḥ pīḍitāḥ śaraiḥ || 29 ||
śaranirbhinnagātrāśca khaḍgavicchinnavakṣasaḥ |
jagṛhuste śilāścaiva drumāścāsurasattamāḥ || 3.60.30 ||
te bhīmavegā ditijā nardamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
mamanthustridaśān vīryācchataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 31||
tatastu tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ teṣāṃ samabhivartata |
śilābhirvipulābhiśca śataśaścaiva pādapaiḥ || 32 ||
parighaiḥ paṭṭiśairbhallairbhindipālaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ |
kecinnivṛttaśirasaḥ kecicca vidalīkṛtāḥ || 33 ||
kecid vinihatā bhūmau rudhirārdrāḥ surāsurāḥ |
kecid raṇājirānnaṣṭāḥ parasparavadhārditāḥ || 34 ||
vibhinnahṛdayāḥ kecicchinnapādāśca śerate |
vidāritāstriśūlaiśca kecit tatra gatāsavaḥ || 35 ||
tat subhīmaṃ mahadyuddhaṃ devadānavasaṃkulam |
babhūva tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ śilāpādapasaṃkulam || 36 ||
dhanurjyātantrimadhuraṃ hikkātālasamanvitam |
ārtastanitaghoṣāḍhyaṃ yuddhaṃ gāndharvamābabhau || 37 ||
kuberaḥ sa dhanuṣpāṇirdānavān raṇamūrdhani |
diśo vidrāvayāmāsa saṃkruddhaḥ śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ || 38 ||
kubereṇārditaṃ sainyaṃ vidrutaṃ prekṣya dānavaḥ |
amyadravadanuhrādaḥ pragṛhya mahatīṃ śilām || 39 ||
krodhād dviguṇaraktākṣaḥ pitṛtulyaparākramaḥ |
śilāṃ tāṃ pātayāmāsa kuberasya rathottame || 3.60.40 ||
āpatantīṃ śilāṃ dṛṣṭvā gadāpāṇirdhanādhipaḥ |
rathādāplutya vegena vasudhāyāṃ vyatiṣṭhata ||41 ||
sacakrakūbarahayaṃ sadhvajaṃ saśarāsanam |
bhaṅktvā rathottamaṃ tasya nipapāta śilā bhuvi || 42 ||
vimathya tu kuberasya prahrādasyānujo ratham |
śūrāṇāṃ kadanaṃ cakre saskandhaviṭapairdrumaiḥ || 43 ||
nirbhinnaśiraso bhagnāstridaśāḥ śoṇitokṣitāḥ |
drumapravyathitāṅgāśca nipeturdharaṇītale || 44 ||
vidrāvya vipulaṃ sainyamanuhrādo mahāsuraḥ |
giriśṛṅgaṃ gṛhītvā tu kuberamabhidudruve || 45 ||
tamāpatantaṃ dhanado gadāmudyamya vīryavān |
vinaditvā''hvayāmāsa dānavendraṃ mahābalam || 46 ||
tasya daityasya saṃkruddho gadāṃ tāṃ bahukaṇṭakām |
nyapātayata vitteśo dānavasyorasi prabho || 47 ||
daityaḥ sakrodhatāmrākṣastaṃ prahāramacintayan |
