vitteśasyopari tadā giriśṛṅagamapātayat || 48 ||
sa vihvalitasarvāṅgo giriśṛṅgeṇa tāḍitaḥ |
papāta sahasā bhūmau viśīrṇa iva parvataḥ || 49 ||
vitteśaṃ vihvalaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve te yakṣarākṣasāḥ |
parivārya mahātmānaṃ rarakṣurbhīmavikramāḥ || 3.60.50 ||
muhūrtaṃ vihvalo bhūtvā punarviśravasaḥ sutaḥ |
upatasthe ca sahasā dhanadaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ || 51 ||
sa nanāda mahānādaṃ trailokyamabhinādayan |
janayanniva nirghoṣaṃ vidhamanniva parvatān || 52 ||
tamavadhyaṃ tu vijñāya nihantuṃ punarutthitam |
prekṣya piṅgākṣamāyāntaṃ dānavā vipradudruvuḥ || 53 ||
tāṃstu vidravato dṛṣṭvānuhrādo hyasuro'bravīt|
kālanemiṃ dānavaṃ ca vīryadarpasamanvitam || 54 ||
ātmānaṃ caiva vīryaṃ ca vismṛtyābhijanaṃ tathā |
kva gacchatha bhayatrastāḥ prākṛtā iva dānavāḥ || 55 ||
nivartadhvaṃ mahāvīryāḥ kiṃ prāṇān parirakṣatha |
nālaṃ yuddhāya yakṣo'yaṃ mahatīyaṃ vibhīṣikā || 56 ||
etāṃ vibhīṣikāmadya dānavānāṃ samutthitām |
vikramya vidhamiṣyāmi nivartadhvaṃ mahāsurāḥ || 57 ||
te'surāḥ saṃnivṛttāśca samadā iva kuñjarāḥ |
nijaghnuḥ paramakruddhā devasainyaṃ mahāsurāḥ || 58 ||
kṣīṇapraharaṇāḥ kecinmahāmeghanibhasvanāḥ |
darpotkaṭā bhujaireva samprahāraṃ pracakrire || 59 ||
prāṃśubhiścaiva kāṣṭhaiśca śilābhiśca mahābalāḥ |
bāhubhiśca tathānyonyamākṣipanti sma vegitāḥ || 3.60.60 ||
muṣṭibhiśca talaiścaiva nakhapātairmahābalāḥ |
pādapaiśca mahāśākhairayudhyanta raṇājire || 61 ||
anuhrādastu saṃkruddho devatānāṃ mahācamūm|
mamantha paramāyatto vanānyagnirivotthitaḥ || 62 ||
rudhirārdrāstu bahavaḥ śerate yodhasattamāḥ |
vikṛtāḥ patitā bhūmau tāmrapuṣpā iva drumāḥ || 63 ||
anuhrādasya vikrānto devastvāśīviṣopamān |
yudhyamānasya samare vyasṛjanniśitāñcharān || 64 ||
dhanādhipena viddhasya anuhrādasya saṃyuge |
aṅgāramiśrāḥ kruddhasya mukhānniścerurarciṣaḥ || 65 ||
atha bāṇasahasreṇa vitteśaṃ dānavottamaḥ |
vivyādha sa śaraiḥ kruddho daṇḍapāṇirivāntakaḥ || 66 ||
kuberastu śarairbhinnaḥ samantātkṣatajokṣitaḥ |
rudhiraṃ parisusrāva giriḥ prasravaṇairiva || 67 ||
labdhvā sa tu punaḥ saṃjñāṃ roṣaraktekṣaṇaḥ suraḥ |
gadāmatha samāsādya bhīmāṃ bhīmaparākramaḥ |
cikṣepa daityamuddiśya balātkrodhena mūrchitaḥ || 68 ||
aprāptāmantare so'tha tāṃ gadāṃ gadayāsuraḥ |
babhañja vinadan kruddhastadāścaryamabhūt tadā || 69 ||
pragṛhya tu gadāṃ bhūyo hyabhidudrāva dānavam|
tamāpatantaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva anuhrādo mahābalaḥ || 3.60.70 ||
giriśṛṅgamivotpāṭya kailāsācalasaṃnibham |
dhanādhipaṃ pradudrāva vyāditāsya ivāntakaḥ || 71 ||
tamantakamivāyāntamajeyaṃ sakalaiḥ suraiḥ |
grasantamiva taṃ daityaṃ trailokyamakhilaṃ ruṣā || 72 ||
tamālokya tathā bhūtaṃ dhanādhyakṣo raṇaṃ bhayāt |
apahāya yayau tatra yatra śakraḥ surādhipaḥ || 73 ||
tasya cāpi mahat karma dṛṣṭvā vittapatistadā |
jagāma bhayasaṃtrasto yatra devaḥ śacīpatiḥ || 74 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vāmanaprādurbhāve devāsurayuddha anuhrādakuberayuddhavarṇane ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 60 ||

<3.61>

ekaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
vipracittistu varuṇaṃ daityānāmādiravyayam |
jaghāneṣugaṇaiḥ kruddho dīptairiva mahoragaiḥ || 1 ||
sa dahyamāno daityena dīptaiḥ śaragabhastibhiḥ |
nābhyajānata kartavyaṃ saṃgrāme sa jaleśvaraḥ || 2 ||
sarvalokeśvarasyeva parameṣṭhī prajāpatiḥ |
na śaknotyagrataḥ sthātuṃ vipracitterjalādhipaḥ || 3 ||
vajro nāma mahāvyūho nirbhayaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ |
taṃ vyūhya pratyayudhyanta dānavā devavāhinīm || 4 ||
vahnijvālāsamaṃ tatra ravimaṇḍalasaṃnibham|
mukhamābhāti daityasya vipracittermahātmanaḥ || 5 ||
varuṇastu mahātejā vipracittiṃ mahāsuram |
pradahanniva tejobhirjigīṣuḥ pratyavaikṣata || 6 ||
sragdāmamālābharaṇaḥ keyūrāṅgadabhūṣaṇaḥ |
jagrāha parighaṃ daityaḥ kailāsaśikharopamam || 7 ||
pinaddhaṃ kāñcanaiḥ paṭṭairhemamālinamāyasam |
yamadaṇḍopamaṃ ghoraṃ daityānāṃ bhayanāśanam || 8 ||
bhrāmayāmāsa saṃkruddho mahāśakradhvajopamam |
vinanāda vivṛttāsyo vipracittirmahāsuraḥ || 9 ||
sa kaṇṭhasthena niṣkeṇa bhujasthairapi cāṅgadaiḥ |
kuṇḍalābhyāṃ vicitrābhyāṃ bhrājate kāñcanasrajā || 3.61.10 ||
dānavo bhūṣaṇairbhāti parigheṇāyasena ca |
yathendradhanuṣā meghaḥ savidyutstanayitnumān || 11 ||
prasphuran parighāstreṇa vātaskandhānmahāsvanaḥ |
jajvāla ca sadhūmārciḥ sāṅkarṣaṇa ivānalaḥ || 12 ||
vidyādharagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ gandharvanagarairapi |
saha caivāmarāvatyā siddhalokaistathā saha || 13 ||
grahanakṣatrasahitaṃ sārkacandravibhūṣitam |
daityendraparighoddhūtaṃ bhramatīva nabhastalam || 14 ||
durāsadaḥ susaṃjajñe parighābharaṇakṣamaḥ |
surendhano'surendrāgniryugāntāgnirivotthitaḥ || 15 ||
tridaśā varuṇaścaiva na śekuḥ spandituṃ bhayāt |
tatrāsīnnirbhayastvekaḥ kauśiko vāsavaḥ prabhuḥ || 16 ||
bhāskarapratimaṃ ghoraṃ parighaṃ raudradarśanam |
pātayāmāsa senāyāṃ jaleśasya sa dānavaḥ || 17 ||
patatā tena saṃgrāme jaleśasya mahātmanaḥ |
bhūtānāṃ śatasāhasraṃ parigheṇa samāhatam |
teṣāṃ gātrāṇi cāsādya vyaśīryanta sahasraśaḥ ||18 ||
viśīryamāṇaṃ vibabhāvulkāśatamivāmbare |
bhūyaścainaṃ tadā''bhrāmya varuṇāya nyapātayat || 19 ||
pātyamāne tadā tasmiñcharīre vāruṇe tadā |
sa bhinnaḥ parigho ghoro devagātre vyaśīryata || 3.61.20 ||
śīryamāṇasya cūrṇāni khadyotā iva cāmbare |
sa tu tena prahāreṇa na cacāla jalādhipaḥ || 21 ||
parigheṇa hataḥ saṃkhye yathā vajrahato'calaḥ |
svasainyeṣvapi bhagneṣu bhinnadeheṣu cāhave || 22 ||
muhūrtamagamat kṣobhamapāmpatiramarṣaṇaḥ |
so'marṣaṃ ca samāpanno varuṇo'mitavikramaḥ || 23 ||
sarvasaṃhāramakarot svapakṣasyārimardanaḥ |
sa sāgaraiścaturbhiśca vṛto dīptaiśca pannagaiḥ || 24 ||
śaṅkhamuktāmaṇicito bibhrattoyamayaṃ vapuḥ |
pāṇḍurodbhūtavasano nānāratnavibhūṣitaḥ || 25 ||
varuṇaḥ pāśadhṛkchrīmān kūrmamīnasamākulaḥ |
varuṇastu tadā kruddhastānnirīkṣya svasainikān || 26 ||
uvāca dṛṣṭvā yudhyadhvaṃ dānavānāṃ jighāṃsayā |
ahamenaṃ haniṣyāmi bhayaṃ muktvā tu yudhyata || 27 ||
tataste pannagāḥ sarve mahārṇavajalāśrayāḥ |
jaghnurdaityān raṇamukhe nadanto jayagṛddhinaḥ || 28 ||
te tu nālīkanārācairgadābhirmusalaistathā |
abhyaghnan dānavān hṛṣṭā muditā varuṇānugāḥ || 29 ||
vipracittistu saṃkruddho mahābalaparākramaḥ |
pannagānāṃ śarīrāṇi vyadhamad yuddhadurmadaḥ || 3.61.30 ||
garuḍenāpi cāstreṇa pannagān dānavottamaḥ |
samare ghātayāmāsa garuḍaiḥ pannagāśanaiḥ || 31 ||
sa śaraiḥ sūryasaṃkāśaiḥ śātakumbhavibhūṣitaiḥ |
pannagān samare vīraḥ pramamātha sudurjayān || 32 ||
samare bhinnagātrāste pannagāḥ śarapīḍitāḥ |
peturmathitasarvāṅgā gajā iva mahāgajaiḥ || 33 ||
tapantaṃ tamivādityaṃ dīptairbāṇagabhastibhiḥ |
abhyadhāvata saṃkruddhaḥ samare varuṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 34 ||
tatastu dānavāstatra bhinnadehāḥ sahasraśaḥ |
vyathitā vidravanti sma diśo daśa vicetasaḥ || 35 ||
indrasyārthe parākramya varuṇastyaktajīvitaḥ |
vinardamāno yuyudhe samare pāśabhṛdvaraḥ || 36 ||
varuṇaḥ pannagāścaiva muṣṭibhiḥ samarotkaṭāḥ |
abhyavartanta samare vipracittiṃ mahāsuram || 37 ||
tato'straiśca śilābhiśca prāharat sa balotkaṭaḥ |
vyapohata mahātejā vipracittirmahāsuraḥ || 38 ||
tataḥ pāvakasaṃkāśaiḥ sa muktaiḥ śīghragāmibhiḥ |
varuṇasya mahāvegān bibheda samare hayān || 39 ||
karmaṇā tena mahatā vipracittermahātmanaḥ |
agnerājyāhutasyeva tejaḥ samabhivardhata || 3.61.40 ||
sa śaraiḥ sūryasaṃkāśaiḥ sumuktaiḥ śīghragāmibhiḥ |
vāruṇīṃ tāṃ mahāsenāṃ nirmamantha mahābalaḥ || 41 ||
kṣīṇāstrāṃ sāyakākrāntāṃ śarajālena mohitām |
śūlaśaktyṛṣṭibhinnāṃ ca cakāra rudhirokṣitām || 42 ||
sa śerairvahnisaṃkāśaiḥ sumuktairnataparvabhiḥ |
varuṇasya mahāvegān bibheda samare hayān || 43 ||
abhidruto'tha daityena sasainyaḥ salilādhipaḥ |
mahendraṃ śaraṇaṃ prāpto vipracitterbhayārditaḥ || 44||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vāmane varuṇavipracittiyuddhe ekaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 61 ||

<3.62>

dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
parājayaṃ tu devānāṃ dṛṣṭvāgnirdevasattamaḥ |
cakāra buddhiṃ daityānāṃ vadhe brahmarṣibhiḥ stutaḥ || 1 ||
svayaṃprabhāyāḥ śāṇḍilyā yaḥ putro havyavāhanaḥ |
hiraṇyaretāḥ piṅgākṣo devahūto hutāśanaḥ || 2 ||
rohito lohitagrīvo hartā dātā haviḥ kaviḥ |
pāvako viśvabhug devaḥ sarvadevānanaḥ prabhuḥ || 3 ||
subrahmātmā suvarcaskaḥ sahasrārcirvibhāvasuḥ |
kṛṣṇavartmā citrabhānurdevānāmapi devarāṭ || 4 ||
lokasākṣī dvijahutaḥ sadarciṣmān vaṣaṭkṛtaḥ |
havyabhakṣaḥ śamīgarbhasvayoniḥ sarvakarmakṛt || 5 ||
pāvanaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tridaśānāṃ taponidhiḥ |
śamanaḥ sarvapāpānāṃ lelihānastapomayaḥ || 6 ||
pradakṣiṇāvartaśikhaḥ śuciromā makhākṛtiḥ |
havyabhug bhūtabhavyeśo yajñabhāgaharo hariḥ || 7 ||
somapaḥ sumahātejā bhūteśaḥ sumahātapāḥ |
adhṛṣyaḥ pāvako bhūtirbhūtātmā vai svadhādhipaḥ || 8 ||
svāhāpatiḥ sāmagītaḥ somapūtāśano'dridhṛk |
devadevo mahākrodho rudrātmā brahmasambhavaḥ || 9 ||
lohitāśvaṃ vāyucakraṃ rathamāsthāya bhūtadhṛk |
dhūmaketurdhūmaśikho nīlavāsāḥ surottamaḥ || 3.62.10 ||
udyamya divyamāgneyaṃ śastraṃ devo raṇe mahān |
dānavānāṃ sahasrāṇi prayutānyarbudāni ca || 11 ||
dadāha bhagavān vahniḥ saṃkruddhaḥ pralaye yathā |
prāṇo yaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dehe tiṣṭhati pañcadhā || 12 ||
yantā yaśca hutāśasya sakhā ca prabhurīśvaraḥ |
prabhañjano yo lokānāṃ yugānte sarvanāśanaḥ || 13 ||
saptasvaragatā yasya yonirgīrbhirudīryate |
yo hyākāśamayo devo dūragaḥ sarvasambhavaḥ || 14 ||
yaśca kartā vikartā ca gatirgatimatāṃ prabhuḥ |
vedakartā samo loke brahmaṇā yaḥ sanātanaḥ || 15 ||
amūrtimantaṃ yaṃ prāhurmahābhūtaṃ mahattaram |
so'gniṃ samīrayāmāsa śamīgarbhaṃ samīraṇaḥ || 16 ||
tridivārohibhirjvālairjambhamāṇo diśo daśa |
dānavānāmabhāvāya yugāntāgnirivotthitaḥ || 17 ||
medomajjāmahāpaṅkāṃ keśaśaivalaśālinīm |
yodhaśīrṣopalavahāṃ mṛtadvipataṭotkaṭām || 18 ||
śoṇitodāṃ raṇe dṛṣṭvā saṃgrāmasaritaṃ vibhuḥ |
vahniḥ praskandayāmāsa daityānāṃ bhayavardhanaḥ || 19 ||
tato'gnirditijān sarvān prahrādapramukhāṃstathā |
parājayānaḥ sa vibhuḥ krośamāno mahāmṛdhe || 3.62.20 ||
kecit pradīptairmukuṭaiḥ kecid dīptaiḥ śiroruhaiḥ |
kecit pradīptavasanaiḥ kecid dīptairbhujānanaiḥ || 21 ||
kecit pradīptairurubhiḥ kecicchatrairdhvajai rathaiḥ |
asurāstatra dṛśyante pradīptenāgninā vṛtāḥ || 22 ||
tyaktvā''yudhāni sarvāṇi sadhvajāṃśca rathottamān|
prayānti samare bhītāḥ pāvakena parājitāḥ ||23||
na ca paśyanti te vahniṃ pradīptaṃ dhvajinīmukhe |
diśaḥ khaḍgāṃśca meghāṃśca dīptān paśyanti dānavāḥ ||24||
dhruvaḥ svayambhuvā sṛṣṭo yugāntastoyayoninā |
ityevaṃ dānavāḥ sarve menire trastacetasaḥ || 25 ||
mayaśca śambaraścaiva mahāmāyādharau tadā |
pārjanyavāruṇī mayi sṛjatāṃ vārivikṣare || 26 ||
tābhyāṃ vahniḥ sa māyābhyāṃ sicyamānaḥ samantataḥ |
toyaughaiḥ parvatanibhairmṛdvarcirabhavad raṇe || 27||
śamyamāne tu samare pāvake daityanāśini |
bṛhatkīrtirbṛhattejā vahnimāha bṛhaspatiḥ || 28 ||
gururuvāca
hiraṇyaretaḥ sumukha jvalanāhvaya sarvabhuk |
saptajihvānana kṣāma lelihāna mahābala || 29 ||
ātmā vāyustava vibho śarīraṃ sarvavīrudhaḥ |
yonirāpaśca te proktā yonistvamasi cāmbhasaḥ|| 3.62.30 ||
ūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca gacchanti saṃcaranti ca pārśvataḥ |
arciṣaste mahābhāga sarvataḥ prabhavanti ca ||31||
tvamevāgne sarvamasi tvayi sarvamidaṃ jagat |
tvaṃ dhārayasi bhūtāni bhuvanaṃ tvaṃ bibharṣi ca || 32 ||
tvamagne havyavāḍekastvameva paramaṃ haviḥ |
yajanti ca sadā santastvāmeva paramādhvare || 33 ||
tvamannaṃ prāṇināṃ bhuṅkṣe jagattrātāsi tvaṃ prabho |
tvayi pravṛtto vijayastvayi lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ || 34 ||
sarvāṃllokāṃstrīnimān havyavāha prāpte kāle tvaṃ pacasyeva dīptaḥ |
tvamevaikastapase jātavedo nānyastvatto vidyate goṣu deva ||35 ||
vṛṣākapiḥ sindhupatistvamagne mahāmakheṣvagryaharastvameva |
viśvasya bhūmnastvamasi prasūtistvaṃ ca pratiṣṭhā bhagavan prajānām || 36 ||
sṛjasyapo raśmibhirjātavedastathauṣadhīroṣadhīnāṃ rasāṃśca |
viśvaṃ tvamādāya yugāntakāle sraṣṭā bhavasyānala sargakāle || 37 ||
tvamagne sarvabhūtānāṃ yonirvedeṣu gīyase |
tvayā devahitārthāya nihatā dānavā raṇe || 38||
svayoniste mahātejastoyaṃ makhaśatārcita |
tāṃ svayoniṃ samāsādya kiṃ viṣīdasi pāvaka || 39 ||
trāyasva samare devān daityebhyaḥ surasattama |
piṅgākṣa lohitagrīva kṛṣṇavartman hutāśana || 3.62.40||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vāmane'gnistave dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 62 ||

<3.63>

triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
bṛhaspatestu vacanaṃ śrutvā satyaṃ samīritam |
bhūyaḥ prajajvāla raṇe haviṣeva mahāmakhe || 1 ||
hatāstu māyā daityānāṃ pradīptenāgninā raṇe |
hatamāyā hatabalā baliṃ te samupasthitāḥ || 2 ||
parājiteṣu daityeṣu vahninādbhutakarmaṇā |
prahrādastūttaraṃ vākyamāha daityapatiṃ balim || 3 ||
bhavānagniśca vāyuśca bhāskaraḥ salilaṃ śaśī |
nakṣatrāṇi diśo vyoma bhūśca dānavasattama || 4 ||
bhaviṣyaṃ caiva bhūtaṃ ca bhavaccāsurasattama |
dattaṃ caitad bhāgavatā varadena svayaṃbhuvā || 5 ||
indratvaṃ cāmaratvaṃ ca yuddhe cāpyaparājayaḥ |
īśitvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca balaṃ caivāmitaṃ śubham || 6 ||
sarvabhūteśvaratvaṃ ca daityarāja sadā tava |
mahāyogīśvaratvaṃ ca śūratvaṃ ca mahāmṛdhe || 7 ||
aṇimā laghimā caiva ye cānye sāttvikā guṇāḥ |
tatparājitya daityendra devān sarvāṃśca sānugān || 8 ||
yathoktaṃ brahmaṇā rājaṃstattathā na tadanyathā |
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā prahrādasya mahātmanaḥ |
baliḥ paramasaṃhṛṣṭaḥ prāyācchakrarathaṃ prati || 9 ||
tataḥ prayāntaṃ tridaśendrasaṃnidhau mahāsurendraṃ balimuttamaśriyam |
tamañjasā jagmurabhipradakṣiṇaṃ dvijāśca puṇyāḥ paśavaśca sattamāḥ || 3.63.10 ||
mahājaṭābhāradharāstapasvinastadā tamāhurvidhimantramaṅgalaiḥ |
abhiṣṭuvantaḥ kavayaḥ svalaṃkṛtaṃ baliṃ prayāntaṃ raṇamūrdhani sthitāḥ || 11 ||
prataptajāmbūnadacitrabhūṣaṇairdivyaiśca ratnairvividhairalaṃkṛtaḥ |
virājamānaḥ parameṇa varcasā raṇe vibhātyagniśikheva dānavaḥ || 12 ||
sa vai tadā śatrubalārditaṃ balaṃ balirdadarśottamasattvavīryavān |
jalāgame śrīmadivābhramaṇḍalaṃ viśīryamāṇaṃ nabhasīva vāyunā || 13 ||
tato dadarśātha balāni sarvato raṇe praguptāni hutāśanena vai |
samucchritānyugratarāṇi tatra vai samudravegāniva parvasaṃdhiṣu || 14 ||
saśūlaśaktyṛṣṭigadāsisāyakān kṣipan ripūṇāṃ samare mahātmanām |
nanāda siṃharṣabhamattanāgavajjalāgame toyadavacca vīryavān || 15 ||
divyāstradhūmaḥ subhujogravāyurmahābalaḥ pauruṣavikramendhanaḥ |
prajā didhakṣanniva kālavahniḥ sughorarūpo vibabhau raṇe baliḥ || 16 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vāmanaprādurbhāve triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 63 ||

<3.64>

catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
balinā tu surāḥ sarve varjayitvā surādhipam |
raṇe śaraśatairbhinnāḥ sasainyā vai parājitāḥ || 1 ||
vimukhā yāti daityendrairvadhyamānā mahācamūḥ |
jitāstu balinā devāḥ śakramāhurmahābalam || 2 ||
devā ūcuḥ
bhavānindraśca dhātā ca lokānāṃ prabhuravyayaḥ |
tvamapratimakarmā ca tathaivānupamadyutiḥ || 3 ||
vidrutānīha sainyāni sahāsmābhiḥ sureśvara |
rathacakradhvajākṣāṇi vibhinnāni mahāsuraiḥ || 4 ||
rathahastyaśvayodhāśca padātāśca sahasraśaḥ |
bhinnacchinnāśca śataśo gadāmuśalapaṭṭiśaiḥ||5||
mahābhairavarūpaṃ hi daityendreṇa kṛtaṃ raṇe |
kimupekṣasi daityendrairhanyamānā mahācamūm || 6 ||
trāyasva tridaśaśreṣṭha śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāgatān |
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ teṣāṃ devānāmamarādhipaḥ || 7 ||
saṃvartāgnisamakruddhaḥ sarvān dahati dānavān |
divākarakarākāraṃ kirīṭaṃ dhārayan prabhuḥ || 8 ||
vaidūryavarṇasaṃkāśo nānāratnacitāṅgadaḥ |
mayūraromā raktākṣaḥ śatabāhuḥ sahasradṛk || 9 ||
harireko hariśmaśrurnānāketurmahābalaḥ |
vajrapraharaṇaḥ śrīmān yogī śataśirodharaḥ || 3.64.10 ||
sadhanurbaddhasannāhaḥ śatādityasamaprabhaḥ |
devagandharvayakṣaughairanuyātaḥ sahasraśaḥ || 11 ||
sāmagaiśca jayaiścāpi stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ |
śataparvaṃ mahāraudraṃ sphoṭanaṃ sarvatomukham || 12 ||
pragṛhya ruciraṃ vajraṃ dīptaṃ raudrāṭṭahāsanam |
daityānayodhayat sarvān mahendraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ || 13 ||
adhṛṣyaḥ sarvabhūtānāmadityā dayitaḥ sutaḥ |
tataḥ pravṛttaḥ saṃgrāmo balivāsavayostadā || 14 ||
ubhābhyāṃ devadaityābhyāmacirānmahadadbhutaḥ |
ativīryabalodagrastumulo lomaharṣaṇaḥ || 15 ||
prahlādena stutiśataiḥ karmabhirjayasammataiḥ |
prabodhito daityapatiragniriddha ivābabhau || 16 ||
surāsurendrayordṛṣṭvā saṃgrāmaṃ lomaharṣaṇam |
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca bhūyo yuddhamabhūt tadā || 17 ||
tato'vidhyanmahendrastaṃ balimastrairmahābalam |
tānyastrāṇi mahābāhuściccheda śatadhā raṇe || 18 ||
tataḥ kruddhaḥ punastatra nijaghne dānavaṃ mahat |
āgneyamatha śatrughnaṃ cikṣependro mahābalaḥ || 19 ||
taddṛṣṭvā khe samāgacchat pralayānalasaṃnibham |
pātayāmāsa taccaindraṃ vāruṇāstreṇa dānavaḥ || 3.64.20 ||
saṃkruddho maghavā vajramagṛhṇāt parvatopamam |
hantukāmo raṇaślāghī baliṃ daityādhipaṃ raṇe || 21 ||
tataḥ śuśrāva devendraḥ kauśiko harivāhanaḥ |
aśarīrāṃ śubhāṃ vāṇīṃ tasmin mahati vaiśase || 22 ||
nivartasva mahābāho surāṇāṃ nandivardhana |
puraṃdara suraśreṣṭha na jeṣyasi raṇe balim || 23 |
tapasātyuttamo daityo varadānena cādhikaḥ |
svayaṃbhūparitoṣācca satyadharmācca vāsava || 24 ||
naiṣa śakyastvayā jetuṃ tridaśairvā sureśvara |
yo hyasya jetā bhagavāṃstaṃ śṛṇuṣva samāhitaḥ || 25 ||
brahmaṇaḥ sa hi sarvasvaṃ devānāṃ caiva sā gatiḥ |
paraṃ rahasyaṃ dharmasya parasya ca parā gatiḥ || 26 ||
parātparataraḥ śrīmān parāvaragatiḥ prabhuḥ |
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt || 27 ||
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ pītavāsāḥ surārihā |
jetā jeyo jayaḥ śrīmānso'sya jetā bhaviṣyati|| 28 ||
śrutvā divyāṃ tu madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ tāmaśarīriṇīm |
apayāto raṇācchakraḥ sārdhaṃ sarvaiḥ surottamaiḥ || 29 ||
apayāte tu devendre kauśike harivāhane |
siṃhanādo mahānāsīd dānavānāṃ mahāmṛdhe || 3.64.30 ||
tataḥ kilakilāśabdaḥ kṣveḍitāsphoṭitasvanaḥ |
śaṅkhānāṃ ninadaścātra yodhānāṃ valgitasvanaḥ || 31 ||
vāditrāṇāṃ ca nirghoṣastumulaścābhavattadā |
jayaśabdaravāścaiva devānāṃ tu parājaye || 32 ||
sasainyo daityarājastu stūyamānaḥ suhṛdgaṇaiḥ |
balīndro vibabhau daityo hiraṇyakaśipuryathā || 33 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vāmane devāsurasaṃgrāme śakrāpayāne catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 64 ||

<3.65>

pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
niṣprayatneṣu deveṣu trailokye daityapālite |
jaye balerbalavato mayaśambarayostathā || 1 ||
sudhāsu dikṣu sarvāsu pravṛtte dharmakarmaṇi |
apāvṛtte dharmapathe ayanasthe divākare || 2 ||
prahrādaśambaramayairanuhrādena caiva hi |
dikṣu sarvāsu guptāsu gagane daityapālite || 3 ||
daityeṣu makhaśobhāśca svargārthaṃ darśayatsu ca |
prakṛtisthe tadā loke vartamāne ca satpathe || 4 ||
abhāve sarvapāpānāṃ bhāve caiva tathā sthite |
bhāve tapasi siddhānāṃ sarvatrāśramarakṣiṣu || 5 ||
catuṣpāde sthite dharme adharme pādavigrahe |
prajāpālanayukteṣu bhrājamāneṣu rājasu || 6 ||
svadharmasamprayukteṣu sarvāśramanivāsiṣu |
abhiṣikto'suraiḥ sarvairdaityarājo balistadā || 7 ||
hṛṣṭeṣvasurasaṃgheṣu nadatsu muditeṣu ca |
athābhyupagatā lakṣmīrbaliṃ padmāsane sthitā || 8 ||
padmodyatakarā devī varadā suramohinī |
śrīruvāca
bale balavatāṃ śreṣṭha mahārāja mahādyute || 9 ||
prītāsmi tava bhadraṃ te devatānāṃ parājaye |
yastvayā yudhi vikramya devarājaḥ parājitaḥ || 3.65.10 ||
dṛṣṭvā te paramaṃ sattvaṃ tato'haṃ svayamāgatā |
nāścaryaṃ dānavaśreṣṭha hiraṇyakaśipoḥ kule || 11 ||
prasūtasyāsurendrasya tava karmedamīdṛśam |
viśeṣitastvayā rājan daityendraḥ prapitāmahaḥ || 12 ||
yena bhuktaṃ hi nikhilaṃ trailokyamidamavyayam |
viśeṣatastava vibho sarve dharmapathe sthitāḥ || 13 ||
tena trailokyamukhyena bhokṣyasyamitavikrama |
evamuktvā hi sā devī lakṣmīrdaityapatiṃ balim || 14 ||
praviṣṭā varadā saumyā sarvabhūtamanoramā |
śiṣṭāśca devyaḥ pravarā hrīḥ kīrtirdyutireva ca || 15 ||
prabhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā bhūtirnītirvidyādayā smṛtiḥ |
kṛtirlajjā tathā medhā lakṣmīrīhā gatistathā || 16 ||
śrutiḥ prītirilā kīrtiḥ śāntiḥ puṣṭiḥ kriyāstathā |
sarvāścāpsaraso divyā nṛtyagītaviśāradāḥ || 17 ||
patiṃ prāptāḥ sudaiteyaṃ trailokye sacarācare |
prāptamaiśvaryamamitaṃ balinā brahmavādinā || 18 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṇyaparvaṇi vāmanaprādurbhāve pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 65 ||

<3.66>

ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
parājitāḥ surā daityaiḥ kimakurvata vai mune |
kathaṃ ca tridivaṃ labdhaṃ bhūyo devairdvijottama || 1 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śrutvā vāṇīṃ tu tāṃ divyāṃ saha devaiḥ surādhipaḥ |
prāgdiśaṃ prasthitaḥ śrīmānadityālayamuttamam || 2 ||
aditiruvāca
yadyevaṃ putra yuṣmābhirna śakyo hantumāhave |
balirvirocanasutaḥ sarvaiścaiva marudgaṇaiḥ || 4 ||
sahasraśirasā hantuṃ kevalaṃ śakyate'suraḥ |
tenaikena sahasrākṣa na hyanyena śatakrato || 5 ||
tad vaḥ pṛcchasva pitaraṃ kaśyapaṃ satyavādinam |
parājayārthaṃ daityasya balestasya mahātmanaḥ || 6 ||
tato'dityā saha surāḥ samprāptāḥ kaśyapāntikam |
apaśyan kaśyapaṃ tatra muniṃ divyataponidhim || 7 ||
ādyaṃ devaṃ guruṃ divyaṃ klinnaṃ triṣavaṇāmbubhiḥ |
tejasā bhāskarākāraṃ gauramagniśikhāprabham || 8 ||
nyastadaṇḍaṃ tapoyuktaṃ baddhakṛṣṇājinottaram |
valkalājinasaṃvītaṃ pradīptaṃ brahmavarcasā || 9 ||
hutāśamiva dīpyantamājyamantrapuraskṛtam |
svādhyāyanirataṃ śāntaṃ vapuṣmantamivānalam || 3.66.10 ||
taṃ brahmavādināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ surāsuraguruṃ prabhum |
pratapantamivādityaṃ mārīcaṃ dīptatejasam || 11 ||
yaḥ sraṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ prajānāṃ patiruttamaḥ |
ātmabhāvaviśeṣeṇa tṛtīyo yaḥ prajāpatiḥ || 12 ||
tataḥ praṇamya te vīrāḥ sahādityā surarṣabhāḥ |
ūcuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve brahmāṇamiva mānasāḥ || 13 ||
yacchrutaṃ yudhi śakreṇa sarasvatyā samīritam |
ajeyastridaśaiḥ sarvairbalirdānavasattamaḥ || 14 ||
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ teṣāṃ putrāṇāṃ kaśyapastadā |
cakāra gamane buddhiṃ brahmalokāya lokakṛt || 15 ||
kaśyapa uvāca
gacchāma brahmasadanaṃ brahmaghoṣanināditam |
yathāśrutaṃ ca tatraiva brahmaṇe vadatānaghāḥ || 16 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tato'dityā saha surā yāntaṃ kaśyapamanvayuḥ |
prasthitaṃ brahmasadanaṃ devarṣigaṇasevitam || 17 ||
te muhūrtena samprāptā brahmalokaṃ divaukasaḥ |
divyaiḥ kāmagamairyānairmahārhaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ || 18 ||
didṛkṣavaste brahmāṇaṃ tapaso rāśimavyayam |
abhyagacchanta vistīrṇāṃ brahmaṇaḥ paramāṃ sabhām|| 19 ||
ṣaṭpadodgītaninadāṃ sāmagītavimiśritām |
śreyaskarīmamitraghnīṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃjahṛṣurmudā || 3.66.20 ||
brāhmaṇaiśca mahābhāgairvedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ |
ṛco bahvṛcamukhyaiśca śikṣāvidbhistathā dvijaiḥ||21||
śabdanirvacanārthaṃ ca preryamāṇapadākṣarāḥ |
śuśruvuste'maravyāghrā vitateṣu ca karmasu || 22 ||
yajñavedāṅgaviduṣāṃ padakramavidāṃ tathā |
ghoṣeṇa paramarṣīṇāṃ sā babhūva nināditā || 23 ||
yajñasaṃstavavidbhiśca śikṣāvidbhistathā dvijaiḥ |
śabdanirvacanārthajñaiḥ sarvavidyāviśāradaiḥ || 24 ||
mīmāṃsāhitavākyajñaiḥ sarvavādaviśāradaiḥ |
hṛṣṭapuṣṭasvaraistatra dvijendrairvalguvādibhiḥ |
nāditaṃ brahmasadanaṃ pravaraṃ devasadmavat || 25 ||
te tatra samanuprāpya śṛṇvanto vai dhvaniṃ surāḥ |
pūtānyātmaśarīrāṇi menire tu na saṃśayaḥ || 26||
tūṣṇīṃbhūtā ekacittā brahmaṇyāgatamānasāḥ |
vismayotphullanayanā nirīkṣantaḥ parasparam || 27 ||
namaskurvanti ca punarguruṃ lokaguruṃ prabhum |
manasaiva suraśreṣṭhāḥ puraskṛtya tu kaśyapam || 28 ||
punaḥ sampūjya paramaṃ vedoccāraṇaniḥsvanam |
gambhīrodāramadhuraṃ susvaraṃ haṃsagadgadam || 29 ||
aikyanānātvasaṃyogasamavāyaviśāradaiḥ |
lokāyatikamukhyaiśca śuśruvuḥ svanamīritam || 3.66.30
tatra tatra ca viprendrān niyatān saṃśitavratān|
japahomaparān mukhyān dadṛśuḥ kaśyapātmajāḥ || 31 ||
tasyāṃ sabhāyāmāste sma brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
surāsuraguruḥ śrīmān vidhivad devamāyayā || 32 ||
upāsate ca tatrainaṃ prajānāṃ patayaḥ prabhum |
dakṣaḥ pracetāḥ pulaho marīciśca dvijottamaḥ || 33 ||
bhṛguratrirvasiṣṭhaśca gautamo nāradastathā |
manurdyaurantarikṣaṃ ca vāyustejo jalaṃ mahī || 34 ||
śabdasparśau ca rūpaṃ ca rasau gandhastathaiva ca |
prakṛtiśca vikārāśca yaccānyat kāraṇaṃ mahat || 35 ||
sāṅgopāṅgāścaturvedāḥ sarahasyapadakramāḥ |
kriyāśca kratavaścaiva saṃkalpaḥ prāṇa eva ca || 36 ||
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ svayambhuvamupasthitāḥ |
artho dharmaśca kāmaśca dveṣo darpaśca nityadā || 37 ||
śakro bṛhaspatiścaiva saṃvarto budha eva ca |
śanaiścaro'tha rāhuśca grahāḥ sarve hyaśeṣataḥ || 38 ||
maruto viśvakarmā ca nakṣatrāṇi ca bhārata |
divākaraśca somaśca brahmāṇaṃ samupāsate || 39 ||
sāvitrī durgataraṇī vāṇī saptavidhā tathā |
sarvāṇi śrutiśāstrāṇi gāthāśca niyamāstathā || 3.66.40 ||
bhāṣyāṇi sarvaśāstrāṇi dehavanti viśāmpate |
kṣaṇā lavā muhūrtāśca divā rātriśca bhārata || 41 ||
ardhamāsāśca māsāśca ṛtavaḥ ṣaṭ tathaiva ca |
saṃvatsarāścaturyugaṃ māsā rātriścaturvidhā || 42 ||
kālacakraṃ ca yad divyamanityaṃ dhruvamavyayam |
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ svayambhuvamupasthitāḥ || 43 ||
te praviṣṭāḥ sabhāṃ divyāṃ brahmaṇaḥ sarvakāmadām |
kaśyapastridaśaiḥ sārdhaṃ putrairdharmaviśāradaiḥ || 44 ||
sarvatejomayīṃ divyāṃ brahmarṣigaṇasevitām |
brāhmyā śriyā dīpyamānamacintyaṃ vigataklamam || 45 ||
brahmāṇaṃ vīkṣya te sarve āsīnaṃ paramāsane |
jagmurmūrdhnā śubhau pādau brahmaṇaste divaukasaḥ || 46 ||
śirobhiḥ spṛśya caraṇau tasya te parameṣṭhinaḥ |
vimuktāḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ śāntā vigatakalmaṣāḥ || 47 ||
dṛṣṭvā tu tānsurānsarvānkaśyapena sahāgatān|
āha brahmā mahātejā devānāṃ prabhurīśvaraḥ || 48 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vāmanaprādurbhāve brahmalokagamane ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 66 ||

<3.67>

saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
brahmovāca
yadarthamiha samprāptā bhavantaḥ sarva eva hi |
vijānāmyahamavyagra etat sarvaṃ mahābalāḥ || 1 ||
bhaviṣyati ca vaḥ so'rthaḥ kāṅkṣito yaḥ surottamāḥ |
balerdānavamukhyasya yo vijetā bhaviṣyati || 2 ||
na khalvasurasaṃghānāmeko jetā sa viśvakṛt |
trailokyasyāpi jetāsau devānāmapi cottamaḥ || 3 ||
dhātā caiva hi lokānāṃ viśvayoniḥ sanātanaḥ |
pūrvaṃ devaṃ sadā prāhurhemagarbhanidarśanam || 4 ||
ātmā devena vibhunā kṛto'jeyo mahātmanaḥ |
balerasuramukhyasya viśvasya jagatastathā || 5 ||
prabhavaḥ sa hi sarveṣāmasmākamapi pūrvajaḥ |
acintyaḥ sa hi viśvātmā yogayuktaḥ paraṃtapaḥ|| 6 ||
taṃ devāpi mahātmānaṃ na viduḥ ko'pyasāviti |
vedātmānaṃ ca viśvaṃ ca sa devaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 7 ||
tasyaiva tu prasādena pravakṣye'haṃ parāṃ gatim |
yatra yogaṃ samāsthāya tapaścarati duścaram || 8 ||
kṣīrodasyottare kūle udīcyāṃ diśi devatāḥ |
amṛtaṃ nāma paramaṃ sthānamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ || 9 ||
bhavantastatra vai gatvā tapasā saṃśitavratāḥ |
amṛtaṃ sthānamāsādya tapaścarata duścaram || 3.67.10 ||
tatra śroṣyatha vispaṣṭāṃ snigdhagambhīraniḥsvanām|
uṣṇage toyapūrṇasya toyadasya samasvanām || 11 ||
yuktākṣarapadasnigdhāṃ ramyāmabhayadāṃ śivām |
vāṇīṃ paramasaṃskārāṃ varadāṃ brahmavādinīm || 12 ||
divyāṃ sarasvatīṃ satyāṃ sarvakilbiṣanāśinīm |
sarvadevādhidevasya bhāṣitāṃ bhāvitātmanaḥ || 13 ||
tasya vratasamāptau tu yāvad vratavisarjanam |
amoghasya tu devasya viśvedevā mahātmanaḥ || 14 ||
svāgataṃ vaḥ suraśreṣṭhā matsakāśe vyavasthitāḥ |
kasya kiṃ vā varaṃ devā dadāmi varadaḥ sthitaḥ || 15 ||
taṃ kaśyapo'ditiścaiva varaṃ gṛhṇīta vai tataḥ |
praṇamya śirasā pādau tasmai yogātmane tadā || 16 ||
bhavāneva ca naḥ putro bhavatviti na saṃśayaḥ |
uktaśca parayā bhaktyā tathāstviti sa vakṣyati || 17 ||
devā bruvantu taṃ sarve bhrātā nastvaṃ bhaveti ha |
tathāstviti ca sa śrīmān vakṣyate sarvalokakṛt|| 18 ||
tasmādevaṃ gṛhītvā tu varaṃ tridaśasattamāḥ |
kṛtakṛtyāḥ punaḥ sarve gacchadhvaṃ svaṃ svamālayam|| 19 ||
tathāstviti surāḥ sarve kaśyapo'ditireva ca |
vanditvā brahmacaraṇau gatāḥ saumyāṃ diśaṃ prati|| 3.67.20 ||
te'cireṇaiva samprāptāḥ kṣīrodasyottaraṃ taṭam |
yathoddiṣṭaṃ bhagavatā brahmaṇā brahmavādinā || 21 ||
te'tītya sāgarān sarvānparvatāṃśca bahūnkṣaṇāt|
nadyaśca vividhā divyāḥ pṛthivyāṃ surasattamāḥ || 22 ||
paśyanti ca sughorāṃ vai sarvasattvavivarjitām |
abhāskarāmamaryādāṃ tamasā saṃvṛtāṃ diśam || 23 ||
amṛtaṃ sthānamāsādya kaśyapena surāḥ saha |
dīkṣitāḥ kāmadaṃ divyaṃ vrataṃ varṣasahasrakam || 24||
prasādārthaṃ sureśāya tasmai yogāya dhīmate |
nārāyaṇāya devāya saddasrākṣāya dhīmate || 25 ||
brahmacaryeṇa maunena sthānavīrāsanena ca |
damena ca surāḥ sarve tapo duścaramāsthitāḥ || 26 ||
kaśyapastatra bhagavān prasādārthaṃ mahātmanaḥ |
udīrayati vedoktaṃ yamāhuḥ paramaṃ stavam || 27 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vāmanaprādurbhābe saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 67 ||

<3.68>

aṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
kaśyapa uvāca
namo'stu devadeveśa ekaśṛṅga varāha vṛṣārciṣa vṛṣasindho vṛṣākape suravṛṣabha suranirmita anirmita bhadrakapila viṣvaksena dhruva dharma dharmarāja vaikuṇṭha tretāvarta anādimadhyanidhana dhanaṃjaya śuciśravaḥ agnija vṛṣṇija aja ajayāmṛteśaya sanātana vidhātastrikāma tridhāma trikakut kakudmin dundubhe mahānābha lokanābha padmanābha viriñce variṣṭha bahurūpa virūpa viśvarūpākṣayākṣara satyākṣara haṃsākṣara havyabhuk khaṇḍaparaśo śukra muñjakeśa haṃsa mahāhaṃsa mahadakṣara hṛṣīkeśa sūkṣma parasūkṣma turāṣāḍ viśvamūrte surāgraja nīla
nistamo virajastamorajaḥsattvadhāma sarvalokapratiṣṭha śipiviṣṭa sutapastapo'gra agra
agraja dharmanābha gabhastinābha dharmaneme satyadhāma satyākṣara gabhastineme vipāpman candraratha tvameva samudravāsāḥ ajaikapāt sahasraśīrṣaṃ sahasrasammita mahāśīrṣa sahasradṛk sahasrapāt adhomukha mahāmukha mahāpuruṣa puruṣottama sahasrabāho sahasramūrte sahasrāsya sahasrākṣa sahasrabhuja sahasrabhava sahasraśastvāmāhurvedāḥ || 1 ||
viśvedeva viśvasambhava sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ saubhaga ādau gatiḥ viśvaṃ tvamāpyāyanaḥ
viśvaṃ tvāmāhuḥ puṣpahāsa paramavaradastvameva vauṣaṭ oṃkāra vaṣaṭkāra tvāmekamāhuragryaṃ
makhabhāgaprāśinam || 2 ||
śatadhāra sahasradhāra bhūrda bhuvarda svarda bhūrbhuvaḥ svarda tvameva bhūtaṃ bhuvanaṃ tvaṃ svadhā tvameva brahmasakha brahmamaya brahmādistvameva || 3 ||
dyaurasi pṛthivyasi pūṣāsi mātariśvāsi dharmo'si maghavāsi hotā potā netā hantā mantā homyahotā parātparastvaṃ homyastvameva || 4 ||
āpo'si viśvavāg dhātrā parameṇa dhāmnaḥ tvameva digbhyaḥ sruk srugbhāṇḍastvaṃ gaṇa iṣṭo'si ijyo'si īḍyo'si tvaṣṭā tvamasi samiddhastvameva gatirgatimatāmasi mokṣo'si yogo'si guhyo'si siddho'si dhanyo'si dhātāsi paramo'si yajño'si somo'si yūpo'si dakṣiṇāsi dīkṣāsi viśvamasi || 5 ||
sthaviṣṭha sthavira viśva turāṣāḍ hiraṇyagarbha hiraṇyanābha hiraṇyanārāyaṇa nārāyaṇāntara nṛṇāmayana ādityavarṇa ādityatejaḥ mahāpuruṣa surottama ādideva padmanābha padmeśaya padmākṣa padmagarbha hiraṇyāgrakeśa śukla viśvadeva viśvatomukha viśvākṣa viśvasambhava viśvabhuktvameva || 6 ||
bhūrivikrama cakrakrama tribhuvana suvikrama svavikrama svarvikrama babhruḥ suvibhuḥ prabhākaraḥ śambhuḥ svayambhūśca bhūtādirbhūtātman mahābhūta viśvabhuk tvameva viśvagoptāsi viśvambhara pavitramasi havirviṃśārada haviḥkarmā amṛtendhana surāsuraguro mahādideva nṛdeva
ūrdhvakarman pūtātman amṛteśa divaḥspṛg viśvasyapate ghṛtācyasi anantakarman druhiṇavaṃśa svavaṃśa viśvapāstvaṃ tvameva viśvaṃ bibhaṣiṃ varārthino nastrāyasveti || 7 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vāmanaprādurbhāve mahāpuruṣastave aṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 68 ||

<3.69>

ekonasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
nārāyaṇastu bhagavāñchrutvaitat paramaṃ stavam |
brahmajñena dvijendreṇa kaśyapena samīritam || 1 ||
snigdhagambhīranirghoṣajīmūtasvananiḥsvanam |
manasā prītiyuktena vibudhānāṃ mahātmanām || 2 ||
uvāca vacanaṃ samyag hṛṣṭapuṣṭapadākṣaram |
ākāśācchuśruve śabdo darśanaṃ nopalabhyate |
śrīmān prītamanā devaḥ provāca prabhurīśvaraḥ || 3 ||
viṣṇuruvāca
prīto'smi vaḥ suraśreṣṭhāḥ sarve matto viniścayam |
varaṃ vṛṇuta bhadraṃ vo varado'smi surottamāḥ || 4 ||
kaśyapa uvāca
yadaiva bhagavān prītaḥ sarveṣāmamarottamaḥ |
tadaiva kṛtakṛtyāḥ sma tvaṃ hi naḥ paramā gatiḥ || 5 ||
yadi prasanno bhagavān dātavyo vā varo yadi |
vāsavasyānujo bhrātā jñātīnāṃ nandivardhanaḥ |
adityāṃ vāmanaḥ śrīmān bhagavānastu vai sutaḥ || 6 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
aditirdevamātā ca etamevārthamuttamam |
putrārthe varadaṃ prāha bhagavantaṃ varārthinī || 7 ||
aditiruvāca
yāce tvāṃ putrakāmā vai bhavān putro bhavatviti |
niḥśreyasāya sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ hi mahātmanām || 8 ||
devā ūcuḥ
bhrātā bhartā ca dātā ca śaraṇaṃ ca bhavasva naḥ |
adityāḥ putratāṃ yāte tvayi devāḥ savāsavāḥ |
devaśabdaṃ vahiṣyanti kaśyapasyātmajo bhava || 9 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tatastānabravīd viṣṇurdevān kaśyapameva ca |
evaṃ bhavatu bhadraṃ vo yatheṣṭaṃ kāmamāpnuta || 3.69.10 ||
sarveṣāmeva yuṣmākaṃ ye bhaviṣyanti śatravaḥ |
muhūrtamapi te sarve na sthāsyanti mamāgrataḥ || 11 ||
hatvāsuragaṇān sarvān ye cānye devaśatravaḥ |
kariṣye devatāḥ sarvā yajñabhāgāgrabhojinaḥ || 12 ||
havyādāṃśca surān sarvān kavyādāṃśca pitṝnapi |
kariṣye vibudhaśreṣṭhāḥ pārameṣṭhyena karmaṇā || 13 ||
yathāgatena mārgeṇa nivartadhvaṃ surottamāḥ |
devamātustathādityāḥ kaśyapasyāmitātmanaḥ |
yathāmanīṣitaṃ kartā gacchadhvaṃ svaṃ svamālayam || 14 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evamukte tu vacane viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā |
devāḥ prahṛṣṭamanasaḥ pūjayanti sma sarvaśaḥ || 15 ||
viśvedevā mahātmānaḥ kaśyapo'ditireva ca |
sādhyā marudgaṇāścaiva śakraścaiva mahābalaḥ || 16||
namaskṛtya sureśāya tasmai devāya raṃhase |
prayātāḥ prāgdiśaṃ divyaṃ vipulaṃ kaśyapāśramam || 17 |
gatvā te āśramaṃ tatra brahmarṣigaṇasevitam |
ceruḥ svādhyāyaniyatā adityā garbhamīpsavaḥ || 18 ||
aditirdevamātā ca garbhe dadhre'titejasam |
bhūtātmānaṃ mahātmānaṃ divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam || 19 ||
pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu prasūtā garbhamuttamam |
surāṇāṃ śaraṇaṃ devamasurāṇāṃ vināśanam || 3.69.20 ||
garbhasthena tu devena paritrātāḥ surāstadā |
ādadānena tejāṃsi trailokyasya mahātmanā || 21||
tasmiñjāte tu deveśe trailokyasya sukhāvahe |
bhayade daityasaṃghānāṃ surāṇāṃ nandivardhane || 22 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vāmanaprādurbhāve ekonasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 69 ||

<3.70>

saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
prajānāṃ patayaḥ sapta sapta caiva maharṣayaḥ |
tasya devasya jātasya namaskāraṃ pracakrire || 1 ||
bharadvājaḥ kaśyapo gautamaśca viśvāmitro jamadagnirvasiṣṭhaḥ |
yaścodito bhāskare sampraṇaṣṭe so'pyatrātrirbhagavānājagāma || 2 ||
marīciraṅgirāścaiva pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ |
dakṣaprajāpatiścaiva namaskāraṃ pracakrire || 3 ||
aurvo vasiṣṭhaputraśca stambaḥ kāśyapa eva ca |
kapīvānakapīvāṃśca datto niścyavanastathā || 4 ||
vasiṣṭhaputrāḥ saptāsan vāsiṣṭhā iti viśrutāḥ |
hiraṇyagarbhasya sutāḥ pūrvajātāḥ sutejasaḥ || 5 ||
gārgyaḥ pṛthustathaivānyo janyo vāmana eva ca |
devabāhuryadudhraśca parjanyaścaiva somajaḥ || 6 ||
hiraṇyaromā vedaśirāḥ saptanetrastathaiva ca |
viśvo'tiviśvaścyavanaḥ sudhāmā virajāstathā || 7 ||
atināmā sahiṣṇuśca namaskāramakurvata |
uddayotamānā vapuṣā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 8 ||
upanṛtyanti deveśaṃ viṣṇumapsarasāṃ varāḥ |
tato gandharvatūryeṣu praṇadatsu vihāyasi || 9 ||
bahubhiḥ saha gandharvaiḥ prāgāyata ca tumburuḥ |
mahāśrutiścitraśirā ūrṇāyuranaghastathā || 3.70.10 ||
gomāyuḥ sūryavarcāśca somavarcāśca saptamaḥ |
yugapastṛṇapaḥ kārṣṇirnandiśca triśirāstathā || 11 ||
trayodaśaḥ śāliśirāḥ parjanyaśca caturdaśaḥ |
kaliḥ pañcadaśaścātra tatraiva tu mahīpate || 12 ||
daśa pañca tvime proktā nāradaścaiva ṣoḍaśaḥ |
hāhā hūhūśca gandharvau haṃsaścaiva mahādyutiḥ || 13 ||
sarve te devagandharvā upagāyanti keśavam |
tathaivāpsaraso hṛṣṭāḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ || 14||
vapuṣmantaḥ sujaghanāḥ sarvāṅgaśubhadarśanāḥ |
nanṛtuśca mahābhāgā jaguścāyatalocanāḥ || 15||
sumadhyāścārumadhyāśca priyamukhyo varānanāḥ |
anūkātha tathā jāmī miśrakeśī tvalambuṣā || 16||
marīciḥ śucikā caiva vidyutpūrṇā tilottamā |
adrikā lakṣaṇā caiva rambhā tadvanmanoramā || 17 ||
asitā ca subāhuśca supriyā subhagā tathā |
urvaśī citralekhā ca sugrīvā ca sulocanā || 18||
puṇḍarīkā sugandhā ca surathā ca pramāthinī |
nandā śāradvatī caiva tathānyāstatra saṃghaśaḥ || 19||
menakā sahajanyā ca parṇikā puñjikasthalā |
etāścāpsaraso'nyāśca pranṛtyanti sahasraśaḥ ||3.70.20||
dhātāryamā ca mitraśca varuṇoṃ'śo bhagastathā |
indro vivasvānpūṣā ca tvaṣṭā ca savitā tathā ||21||
kathito viṣṇurityevaṃ kāśyapeyo gaṇastathā |
ityete dvādaśādityā jvalantaḥ sūryavarcasaḥ ||22||
cakrustasya sureśasya namaskāraṃ mahātmanaḥ |
mṛgavyādhaśca sarpaśca nirṛtiśca mahābalaḥ ||23||
ajaikapādahirbudhnyaḥ pinākī cāparājitaḥ |
dahano'theśvaraścaiva kapālī ca viśāmpate ||24||
sthāṇurbhargaśca bhagavān rudrāstatrāvatasthire |
prajānātha mṛgavyādhaḥ sarpa, mahābalī niṣkṛtiḥ
aśvinau vasavaścāṣṭau marutaśca mahābalāḥ ||25||
viśvedevāśca sādhyāśca tasya prāñjalayaḥ sthitāḥ |
śeṣānujā mahābhāgā vāsukipramukhāstathā ||26||
kacchapaścāpahartā ca takṣakaśca mahābalaḥ |
adhṛṣṭāstejasā yuktā mahākrodhā mahābalāḥ ||27||
ete nāgā mahātmānastasmai prāñjalayaḥ sthitāḥ |
tārkṣyaścāriṣṭanemiśca garuḍaśca mahābalaḥ ||28||
aruṇaścāruṇiścaiva vainateyā hyupasthitāḥ |
pitāmahaśca bhagavān svayamāgamya lokakṛt |
prāha caivaṃ guruḥ śrīmān saha sarvairmahātmabhiḥ ||29||
brahmovāca
yasmāt prasūyate lokaḥ prabhaviṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ |
tasmāllokeśvaraḥ śrīmān viṣṇureva bhavatvayam ||3.70.30||
evamuktvā tu bhagavān sārdhaṃ devarṣibhiḥ prabhuḥ |
namaskṛtvā sureśāya jagāma tridivaṃ punaḥ ||31||
sa tu jātaḥ sureśānaḥ kaśyapasyātmajaḥ prabhuḥ |
navadurdinameghābho raktākṣo vāmanākṛtiḥ ||32||
śrīvatsenorasi śrīmān romajātena rājatā |
utphullalocanāḥ sarvāḥ paśyantyapsarasastadā ||33 ||
divi sūryasahasrasya bhaved yugapadutthitā |
yadi bhāḥ sadṛśī sā syād bhāsā tasya mahātmanaḥ||34||
surarṣipratimaḥ śrīmān bhūrbhuvarbhūtabhāvanaḥ |
śuciromā mahāskandhaḥ sarvatejomayaḥ prabhuḥ ||35||
yā gatiḥ puṇyakīrtīnāmagatiḥ pāpakarmaṇām |
yogasiddhā mahātmāno yaṃ viduryogamuttamam |36|
yasyāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryaṃ yamāhurdevasattamam |
yaṃ prāpya śāśvataṃ viprā niyatā mokṣakāṅakṣiṇaḥ ||37|
janmano maraṇāccaiva mucyante bhavabhīravaḥ |
yadetattapa ityāhuḥ sarvāśramanivāsinaḥ ||38|
sevante yaṃ yatāhārā duścaraṃ vratamāsthitāḥ |
yo'nanta iti nāgeṣu sevyate sarvabhogibhiḥ ||39||
sahasramūrdhā raktākṣaḥ śeṣādibhiranuttamaiḥ |
yo yajña iti viprendrairijyate svargalipsubhiḥ ||3.70.40|
nānāsthānagataḥ śrīmānekaḥ kaviranuttamaḥ |
yaṃ devā yānti vettāraṃ yajñabhāgapradāyinam ||41||
vṛṣārciścandrasūryākṣaṃ devamākāśavigraham |
sa prāha tridaśān sarvān vācā vai parayā vibhuḥ ||42||
jānannapi mahātejā gato yogena bālatām |
kiṃ karomi suraśreṣṭhāḥ kaṃ varaṃ ca dadāmi vaḥ ||43||
yatkāṅkṣitaṃ vai sarveṣāṃ tadvai brūta mudā yutāḥ |
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā vāmanasya mahātmanaḥ ||44||
sarve te hṛṣṭamanaso devāḥ kaśyapanandanam |
ūcuḥ prāñjalayo viṣṇuṃ surāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ ||45||
brahmaṇo varadānena hṛtaṃ no nikhilaṃ jagat |
tapasā mahatā caiva vikrameṇa damena ca ||46
balinā daityamukhyena sarvajñena mahātmanā |
avadhyaḥ kila so'smākaṃ sarveṣāṃ devasattama ||47
bhavān prabhavate tasya nānyaḥ kaścana suvrata |
tat prapadyāmahe sarve bhavantaṃ śaraṇārthinaḥ |
śaraṇyaṃ varadaṃ devaṃ sarvadevabhayāpaham ||48
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca hitārthāya lokānāṃ ca sureśvara |
priyārthaṃ ca tathādityāḥ kaśyapasya tathaiva ca ||49|
kavyaṃ pitṝṇāmucitaṃ surāṇāṃ havyamuttamam |
pravarteta mahābāho yathāpūrvaṃ surottama ||3.70.50|
ānṛṇyārthaṃ sureśasya vāsavasya mahātmanaḥ |
pratyānaya mahendrasya trailokyamidamavyayam ||51 ||
kratunā vājimedhena yajate sa hi dānavaḥ |
yat pratyānayane yuktaṃ lokānāṃ tad vicintaya ||52||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evamuktastadā devairviṣṇurvāmanarūpadhṛk |
praharṣayannuvācātha sarvān devānidaṃ vacaḥ ||53||
tasya yajñasakāśaṃ māṃ maharṣirvedapāragaḥ |
bṛhaspatirmahātejā nayatvaṅgirasaḥ sutaḥ ||54||
tasyāhaṃ samanuprāpto yajñavāṭaṃ surottamāḥ |
vicariṣye yathāyuktaṃ trailokyaharaṇāya vai ||55||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tato bṛhaspatirdhīmānanayad vāmanaṃ prabhum |
yajñavāṭaṃ mahātejā dānavendrasya dhīmataḥ ||56||
mauñjī yajñopavītī ca chatrī daṇḍī dhvajī tathā |
vāmano dhūmraraktākṣo bhagavān bālarūpadhṛk ||57||
taṃ gatvā yatravāṭaṃ ca brahmarṣigaṇasaṃkulam |
ātmanā caiva bhagavān varṇayāmāsa taṃ kratum ||58||
lokeśvareśvaraḥ śrīmān surairvrahmapurogamaiḥ |
adhyāsyamāno bhagavānavṛddho'pyatha vṛddhavat ||59|
dānavādhipatestasya balervairocanasya ca |
yajñavāṭamacintyātmā jagāma surasattamaḥ ||3.70.60||
pālito'pi hi daiteyaḥ sāṃgrāmikaparicchadaiḥ |
dvāre dānavasambādhe sahasaiva viveśa ha ||61 ||
ṛṣibhiścaiva mantrādyaiḥ sarvataḥ parivāritam |
daityadānavarājendramupatasthe baliṃ balī ||62|
varṇayitvā yathānyāyaṃ yajñaṃ yajñaḥ sanātanaḥ |
vistareṇa naraśreṣṭha prayogairvividhaistathā ||63||
śukrādīnṛtvijaścāpi yajñakarmavicakṣaṇān |
sarvāneva nijagrāha cakāra ca niruttarān ||64||
ārādatha balestasya ṛtvijāmabhitastathā |
yajñamātmānamevāsau hetubhiḥ kāraṇaṃ vibhuḥ ||65||
vaidikairaprakāśaiśca punarapyatha bhārata |
pratyakṣamṛṣisaṃghānāṃ varṇayāmāsa citraguḥ ||66||
tato niruttarān dṛṣṭvā sopādhyāyānṛṣīṃśca tān |
avṛddhenāpi vṛddhāṃstān vāmanena mahaujasā || 67 ||
adbhutaṃ cāpi mene sa virocanasuto balī |
mūrdhnā kṛtāñjaliścedamabravīd vismito vacaḥ ||68||
kutastvaṃ ko'si kasyāsi kiṃ tehāsti prayojanam |
naivaṃvidhaḥ parijñāto dṛṣṭapūrvo mayā dvijaḥ ||69||
bālo matimatāṃ śreṣṭho jñānavijñānakovidaḥ |
śiṣṭavāgrūpasampanno manojñaḥ priyadarśanaḥ ||3.70.70 ||
nedṛśāḥ santi devānāmṛṣīṇāmapi sūnavaḥ |
na nāgānāṃ na yakṣāṇāṃ nāsurāṇāṃ na rakṣasām ||71||
na pitṝṇāṃ na siddhānāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ tathaiva ca |
yo'si so'si namaste'stu brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
ukta evaṃ hyacintyātmā balinā vāmanastadā |
provācopāyatattvajñaḥ smitapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ ||73||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vāmanaprādrurbhāve saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 70 ||

<3.71>

ekasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
viṣṇuruvāca ||
aho yajño'sureśasya bahubhakṣaḥ susaṃskṛtaḥ ||
pitāmahasyeva purā yajataḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || 1 ||
sureśasya ca śakrasya yamasya varuṇasya ca ||
viśeṣitastvayā yajño dānavendra mahābala || 2 ||
yajatā vājimedhena kratūnāṃ pravareṇa tu ||
sarvapāpavināśāya tvayā svargapradarśi'nā || 3 ||
sarvakāmamayo hyeṣa saṃmato brahmavādinām ||
kratūnāṃ pravaraḥ śrīmānaśvamedha iti śrutiḥ || 4 ||
suvarṇaśṛṅgo hi mahānubhāvo lohakṣuro vāyujavo mahārayaḥ ||
svargekṣaṇaḥ kāñcanagarbhagauraḥ sa viśvayoniḥ paramo hi medhyaḥ || 5 ||
āsthāya vai vājinamaśvamedhamiṣṭvā narā duṣkṛtamuttaranti ||
āhuśca yaṃ vedavido dvijendrā vaiśvānaraṃ vājinamaśvamedham || 6 ||
yathāśramāṇāṃ pravaro gṛhāśramo yathā narāṇāṃ pravarā dvijātayaḥ ||
yathā'surāṇāṃ pravaro bhavāniha tathā kratūnāṃ pravaro'śvamedhaḥ || 7 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca ||
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ vāmanena samīritam ||
mudā paramayā yuktaḥ prāha daityapatirbaliḥ || 8 ||
baliruvāca ||
kasyāsi brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha kimicchasi dadāmi te ||
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yatheṣṭaṃ kāmamāpnuhi || 9 ||
vāmana uvāca ||
na rājyaṃ na ca yānāni na ratnāni na ca striyaḥ ||
kāmaye yadi tuṣṭo'si dharme ca yadi te matiḥ || 10 ||
gurvarthaṃ me prayacchasva padāni trīṇi dānava ||
tvamagniśaraṇārthāya eṣa me pravaro varaḥ ||
vāmanasya vacaḥ śrutvā prāha daityapatirbaliḥ || 11 ||
baliruvāca ||
tribhiḥ kiṃ tavaṃ viprendra padaiḥ pravadatāṃ vara ||
śataṃ śatasahasrāṇāṃ padānāṃ mārgatāṃ bhavān || 12 ||
śukra uvāca ||
mā dadasva mahābāho na tvaṃ vetsi mahāsura ||
eṣa māyāpraticchanno bhagavānpravaro hariḥ || 13 ||
vāmanaṃ rūpamāsthāya śakrapriyahitepsayā ||
tvāṃ vañcayitumāyāto bahurūpadharo vibhuḥ || 14 ||
evamuktaḥ sa śukreṇa ciraṃ saṃcintya vai baliḥ ||
praharṣeṇa samāyuktaḥ kimataḥ pātramiṣyate || 15 ||
pragṛhya haste saṃbhrānto bhṛṅgāraṃ kanakodbhavam ||
baliruvāca ||
viprendra prāṅmukhastiṣṭha sthito'smi kamalekṣaṇa ||16 ||
pratīccha dehi kiṃ bhūmiṃ kā (kiṃ) mātrā bhoḥ padatrayam ||
dattaṃ ca pātaya jalaṃ naiva mithyā bhavedguruḥ || 17 ||
śukra uvāca ||
bho na deyaṃ kuto daitya vijñāto'yaṃ mayā dhruvam ||
ko'yaṃ viṣṇuraho prītirvañcitastvaṃ na vañcitaḥ || 18 ||
baliruvāca ||
kathaṃ sa nātho'yaṃ viṣṇuryajñe svayamupasthitaḥ ||
dāsyāmi devadevāya yadyadicchatyayaṃ vibhuḥ || 19 ||
ko vānyaḥ pātrabhūto'smādviṣṇoḥ parataro bhavet ||
evamuktvā baliḥ śīghraṃ pātayāmāsa vai jalam ||20 ||
vāmana uvāca ||
padāni trīṇi daityendra paryāptāni mamānagha ||
yanmayā pūrvamuktaṃ hi tattathā na tadanyathā || 21 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca.||
ityetadvacanaṃ śrutvā vāmanasya mahaujasaḥ ||
kṛṣṇājinottarīyaṃ sa kṛtvā vairocanistadā || 22 ||
evamastviti daityeśo vākyamuktvārisūdanaḥ ||
tato vārisamāpūrṇaṃ bhṛṅgāraṃ sa parāmṛśat || 23 ||
vāmano hyasu rendrasya cikīrṣuḥ kadanaṃ mahat ||
kṣipraṃ prasārayāmāsa daityakṣayakaraṃ karam || 24 ||
prāṅmukhaścāpi detyeśastasmai sumanasā jalam ||
dātukāmaḥ kare yāvattāvattaṃ pratyaṣedhayat|| 25 ||
tasya tadrūpamālokya hyacintyaṃ ca mahātmanaḥ ||
abhūtapūrvaṃ ca harerjihīrṣoḥ śriyamāsurīm || 26 ||
iṅgitajño'grataḥ sthitvā prahrādastvabravīdvacaḥ ||
prahlāda uvāca ||
mā dadasva jalaṃ haste baṭorvāmanarūpiṇaḥ || 27 ||
sa tvasau yena te pūrvaṃ nihataḥ prapitāmahaḥ ||
viṣṇureṣa mahāprājñastvāṃ vañcayitumāgataḥ || 28 ||
baliruvāca ||
hanta tasmai pradāsyāmi devāyemaṃ pratigraham ||
anugrahakaraṃ devamīdṛśaṃ jagataḥ prabhum || 29 ||
brahmaṇo'pi garīyāṃsaṃ pātraṃ lapsyāmahe vayam ||
avaśyaṃ cāsuraśreṣṭha dātavyaṃ dīkṣitena vai|| 30 ||
ityuktvāsurasaṃghānāṃ madhye vairocanistadā||
devāya pradadau tasmai padāni trīṇi viṣṇave || 31 ||
prahlāda uvāca ||
dānaveśvara mā dāstvaṃ viprāyāsmai pratigraham ||
nemaṃ vipraśiśuṃ manye nedṛśo bhavati dvijaḥ || 32 ||
rūpeṇānena daityendra satyamevaṃ bravīmi te ||
nārasiṃhamahaṃ manye tamevaṃ punarāgatam || 33 ||
evamuktastadā tena prahlādenāmitaujasā ||
prahrādamabravīdvākyamidaṃ nirbhartsayanniva || 34 ||
baliruvāca ||
dehīti yācate yo hi pratyākhyāti ca yo'sura ||
ubhayorapyalakṣmyā ve bhāgastaṃ viśate naram || 35 ||
pratijñāya tu yo vipre na dadāti pratigraham ||
sa yāti narakaṃ pāpī mitragotrasamanvitaḥ || 36 ||
alakṣmībhayabhīto'haṃ dadāmyasmai vasundharām ||
pratigrahītā cāpyanyaḥ kaścidasmāddvijo'tha vai || 37 ||
nādhiko vidyate yasmāttaddadāmi vasuṃdharām ||
hṛdayasya ca me tuṣṭiḥ parā bhavati dānava || 38 ||
dṛṣṭvā vāmanarūpeṇa yācantaṃ dvijapuṅgavam ||
eṣa tasmātpradāsyāmi na sthāsyāmi nivāritaḥ || 39 ||
bhūyaśca prābravīdeva vāmanaṃ viprarūpiṇam ||
svalpe svalpamate kiṃ te padaistribhiranuttamam || 40 ||
kṛtsnāṃ dadāmi te vipra pṛthivīṃ sāgarairvṛtām ||
vāmana uvāca ||
na pṛthvīṃ kāmaye kṛtsnāṃ saṃtuṣṭo'smi padaistribhiḥ ||
eṣa eva ruciṣyo me varo dānavasattama || 41 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca ||
tathāstviti baliḥ procya sparśayāmāsa dānavaḥ ||
padāni trīṇi devāya viṣṇave'mitatejase || 42 ||
toye tu patite haste vāmano'bhūdavāmanaḥ ||
sarvadevamayaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa vai vibhuḥ || 43||
bhūḥ pādau dyauḥ śiraścāsya candrādityau ca cakṣuṣī ||
pādāṅgulyaḥ piśācāśca hastāṅgulyaśca guhyakāḥ || 44 ||
viśvedevāśca jānusthā jaṅghe sādhyāḥ surottamāḥ ||
yakṣā nakheṣu saṃbhūtā lekhāścāpsarasastathā ||45||
taḍidvṛṣṭiḥ suvipulā keśāḥ sūryāṃśavastathā ||
tārakā romakūpāṇi romāṇi ca maharṣayaḥ||46||
bāhavo vidiśaścāsya diśaḥ śrotre tathaiva ca ||
aśvinau śravaṇau cāsya nāsā vāyurmahābalaḥ || 47 ||
prasādaścandramāścaiva mano dharmastathaiva ca ||
satyamasyābhavadvāṇī jihvā devī sarasvatī || 48||
grīvāditirmahādevī tāluḥ sūryaśca dīptimān ||
dvāraṃ svargasya nābhirvai mitrastvaṣṭā ca vai bhruvau || 49 ||
mukhaṃ vaiśvānaraścāsya vṛṣaṇau tu prajāpatiḥ ||
hadayaṃ bhagavānbrahmā puṃstvaṃ vai viśvatomuniḥ || 50 ||
pṛṣṭhe'sya vasavo devā marutaḥ pādasaṃdhiṣu ||
sarvacchandāsi daśanā jyotīṃṣi vimalāḥ prabhāḥ || 51 ||
ūrū rudro mahādevo dhairyaṃ cāsya mahārṇavaḥ ||
udare cāsya gandharvā bhujagāśca mahābalāḥ || 52 ||
lakṣmīrmedhā dhṛtiḥ kāntiḥ sarvavidyā ca vai kaṭiḥ ||
lalāṭamasya paramaṃ sthānaṃ ca paramātmanaḥ|| 53 ||
sarvajyotīṃṣi yānīha tapaḥ śakrastu devarāṭ ||
tasya devādhidevasya tejo hyāhurmahātmanaḥ || 54 ||
stanau kakṣau ca vedāśca oṣṭhau cāsya makhāḥ sthitāḥ ||
iṣṭayaḥ paśubandhāśca dvijānāṃ ceṣṭitāni ca || 55 ||
tasya devamayaṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇormahāsurāḥ ||
abhyasarpanta saṃkuddhāḥ pataṅgā iva pāvakam || 56 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khileṣu harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vāmanaprādurbhāve ekasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||71||

<3.72>

dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śṛṇu nāmāni sarveṣāṃ rūpāṇyabhijanāni ca |
āyudhāni ca mukhyāni dānavānāṃ mahātmanām || 1 ||
vipracittiḥ śibiḥ śaṅkurayaḥ śaṅkustathaiva ca |
ayaḥśirā aśvaśirā hayagrīvaśca vīryavān || 2 ||
vegavān ketumānugraḥ sogravyagro mahāsuraḥ |
puṣkaraḥ puṣkalaścaiva sāśvo'śvapatireva ca || 3 ||
prahādo'śvaśirāḥ kumbhaḥ saṃhrādo gaganapriyaḥ |
anuhrādo hariharau vārāhaḥ saṃharo rujaḥ || 4 ||
vṛṣaparvā virūpākṣo aticandraḥ sulocanaḥ |
niṣprabhaḥ suprabhaḥ śrīmāṃstathaiva ca nirūdaraḥ || 5 ||
ekavaktro mahāvaktro dvivaktraḥ kālasaṃnibhaḥ |
śarabhaḥ śalabhaścaiva kuṇapaḥ kulapaḥ krathaḥ || 6 ||
bṛhatkīrtirmahāgarbhaḥ śaṅkukarṇo mahādhvaniḥ |
dīrghajihvo'rkavadano mṛdubāhurmṛdupriyaḥ || 7 ||
vāyurgaviṣṭho namuciḥ śambaro vikṣaro mahān |
candrahantā krodhahantā krodhavardhana eva ca || 8 ||
kālakaḥ kālakākṣaśca vṛtraḥ krodho vimokṣaṇaḥ |
gaviṣṭhaśca haviṣṭhaśca pralambo narakaḥ pṛthuḥ || 9 ||
candratāpanavātāpī ketumān baladarpitaḥ |
asilomā pulomā ca bāṣkalaḥ pramado madaḥ || 3.72.10||
śṛgālavadanaścaiva karālaḥ keśireva ca |
ekākṣaścaikabāhuśca tuhuṇḍaḥ sṛmalaḥ sṛpaḥ || 11||
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ kramamāṇaṃ trivikramam |
upatasthurmahātmānaṃ viṣṇuṃ daityagaṇāstadā || 12||
prāsodyatakarāḥ kecid vyāditāsyāḥ kharasvanāḥ |
śataghnīcakrahastāśca vajrahastāstathā pare || 13||
khaḍgapaṭṭiśahastāśca paraśvadhadharāḥ pare |
prāsamudgarahastāśca tathā parighapāṇayaḥ || 14||
mahāśanivyagrakarā mauśalāstu mahābalāḥ |
mahāvṛkṣodyatakarāstathaiva ca dhanurdharāḥ || 15||
gadābhuśuṇḍihastāśca vajrahastāstathā pare |
mahāpaṭṭiśahastāśca tathā parighapāṇayaḥ ||16||
asikampanahastāśca dānavā yuddhadurmadāḥ |
nānāpraharaṇā ghorā nānāveṣā mahābalāḥ ||17|
kūrmakukkuṭavaktrāśca hastivaktrāstathā pare |
kharoṣṭravadanāścaiva varāhavadanāstathā ||18||
bhīmā makaravaktrāśca śiśumāramukhāstathā |
mārjāraśukavaktrāśca dīrghavaktrāśca dānavāḥ ||19||
garuḍānanāḥ khaḍgamukhā mayūravadanāstathā |
aśvavaktrā vabhruvaktrā ghorā mṛgamukhāstathā ||3.72.20||
uṣṭraśalyakavaktrāśca dīrghavaktrāśca dānavāḥ |
nakulasyeva vaktrāśca pārāvatamukhāstathā |21||
cakravākamukhāścaiva godhavaktrāstathā pare |
tathā mṛgānanāḥ śūrā go'jādimahiṣānanāḥ ||22||
kṛkalāsamukhāścaiva vyāghravaktrāstathā pare |
ṛkṣaśārdūlavaktrāśca siṃhavaktrāstathā pare ||23|
gajendracarmavasanāstathā kṛṣṇājināmbarāḥ |
cīrasaṃvṛtagātrāśca tathā phalakavāsasaḥ ||24||
uṣṇīṣiṇo mukuṭinastathā kuṇḍalino'surāḥ |
kirīṭino lambaśikhāḥ kambugrīvāḥ suvarcasaḥ ||25||
nānāveṣadharā daityā nānāmālyānulepanāḥ |
svānyāyudhāni dīptāni pragṛhyāsurasattamāḥ ||26||
kramamāṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśamupātiṣṭhanta dānavāḥ |
pramathya sarvān daiteyān pādahastatalaiḥ prabhuḥ ||27||
rūpaṃ kṛtvā mahākāyaṃ jahārāśu sa medinīm |
trailokyaṃ kramamāṇasya dyutirādityasambhavā ||28||
tasya vikramato bhūmiṃ candrādityau stanāntare |
nabhaḥ prakramamāṇasya sakthideśe vyavasthitau ||29||
paraṃ vikramamāṇasya jānudeśe vyavasthitau |
viṣṇoramitavīryasya vadantyevaṃ dvijātayaḥ || 3.72.30||
jitvā lokatrayaṃ kṛtsnaṃ hatvā cāsurapuṅgavān |
dadau śakrāya vasudhāṃ harirlokanamaskṛtaḥ ||31||
sutalaṃ nāma pātālamadhastād vasudhātale |
balerdattaṃ bhagavatā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ||32||
tadavāpyāsuraśreṣṭhaścakāra matimuttamām |
rasātalatale vāsamakarodasurādhipaḥ ||33||
tatrasthaśca mahātejā dhyānaṃ paramamāsthitaḥ |
uvāca vacanaṃ dhīmān viṣṇuṃ lokanamaskṛtam||34||
kiṃ mayā deva kartavyaṃ brūhi sarvamaśeṣataḥ |
tato daityādhipaṃ prāha devo viṣṇuḥ surottamaḥ ||35||
viṣṇuruvāca
dadāmi te mahābhāga parituṣṭo'smi te'sura |
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yatheṣṭaṃ kāmamāpnuhi ||36||
mā ca śukrasya vacanaṃ pratihāsīḥ kathaṃcana |
ahamājñāpayāmi tvāṃ śreyaścaivamavāpsyasi ||37||
atha daityādhipaṃ prāha viṣṇurdevādhipānujaḥ |
vācā paramayā devo vareṇyaḥ prabhurīśvaraḥ ||38||
yat tvayā salilaṃ dattaṃ gṛhītaṃ pāṇinā mayā |
tasmāt te daitya devebhyo nāsti jātu bhayaṃ kvacit||39||
sutalaṃ nāma pātālaṃ tatra tvaṃ sānugo vasa |
sarvadaityagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ matprasādānmahāsura ||3.72.40||
na ca te devadevasya śakrasyāmitatejasaḥ |
śāsanaṃ pratihantavyaṃ smaratā śāsanaṃ mama ||41||
devatāścāpi te sarvāḥ pūjyā eva mahāsura |
bhogāṃśca vividhān samyagyajñāṃśca sahadakṣiṇān||42||
prāpsyase ca mahābhāga divyānkāmānyathepsitān |
iha cāmutra cākṣayyānvividhāṃśca paricchadān||43||
daityādhipatyaṃ ca sadā matprasādādavāpsyasi |
yadā ca tāṃ mayā proktāṃ maryādāṃ cālayiṣyasi ||44||
vadhiṣyanti tadā hi tvāṃ nāgapāśairmahābalāḥ |
namaskāryāśca te nityaṃ mahendrādyā divaukasaḥ ||45||
mama jyeṣṭhaḥ suraśreṣṭhaḥ śāsanaṃ pratigṛhyatām |
baliruvāca
devadeva mahābhāga śaṅkhacakragadādhara ||46||
surāsuraguro śreṣṭha sarvalokamaheśvara |
tatrāsato me pātāle bhāgaṃ brūhi surottama ||47||
mamānnamaśanaṃ deva prāśanārthamariṃdama |
tad vadasva suraśreṣṭha tṛptiryena mamākṣayā ||48 ||
śrībhagavānuvāca
aśrotriyaṃ śrāddhamadhītamavratamadakṣiṇaṃ yajñamanartvijā hutam |
aśraddhayā dattamasaṃskṛtaṃ havirete pradattāstava daitya bhāgāḥ ||49||
puṇyaṃ maddveṣiṇāṃ yacca madbhaktadveṣiṇāṃ tathā |
krayavikrayasaktānāṃ puṇyaṃ yaccāgnihotriṇām ||3.72.50||
aśraddhayā ca yad dānaṃ dadatāṃ yajatāṃ tathā |
tatsarvaṃ tava daityendra matprasādād bhaviṣyati ||51||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ balirviṣṇormahātmanaḥ |
evamastviti taṃ proktvā pātālamasurottamaḥ |
praviveśa mahānādo devājñāṃ pratipālayan ||52||
etasminnantare cāpi viṣṇustridaśapūjitaḥ |
bhagavānapi rājyānāṃ pravibhāgāṃścakāra ha ||53||
dadau pūrvāṃ diśaṃ caindrīṃ śakrāyāmitatejase |
yāmyāṃ yamāya devāya pitṛrājñe mahātmane ||54||
paścimāṃ tu diśaṃ prādād varuṇāya mahātmane |
uttarāṃ ca kuberāya yakṣādhipataye diśam ||55||
adhaḥsthāṃ nāgarājāya somāyordhvāṃ diśaṃ dadau |
evaṃ vibhajya trailokyaṃ viṣṇurbalavatāṃ varaḥ ||56||
jagāma tridivaṃ devaḥ pūjyamāno maharṣibhiḥ |
vāmanaḥ sarvabhūteśaḥ pratiṣṭhāpya ca vāsavam ||57||
tasmin prayāte durdharṣe vāmane'mitatejasi |
sarve mumudire devāḥ puraskṛtya śatakratum ||58||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
gate tu tridivaṃ kṛṣṇe baddhvā vairocaniṃ balim |
nāgaiḥ saptaśirobhiśca kambalāśvatarādibhiḥ ||59||
nāgabandhanaduḥkhārtaṃ baliṃ vairocaniṃ tataḥ |
yadṛcchayāsau devarṣirnāradaḥ pratyapadyata ||3.72.60||
sa taṃ kṛcchragataṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛpayābhipariplutaḥ |
uvāca dānavaśreṣṭhaṃ mokṣopāyaṃ dadāmi te ||6 1 ||
stavaṃ devādhidevasya vāsudevasya dhīmataḥ |
anādinidhanasyāsya akṣayasyāvyayasya ca ||62||
tamadhīṣvātha daityendra viśuddhenāntarātmanā |
tadgatastanmanā bhūtvā drutaṃ mokṣamavāpsyasi ||63||
tato virocanasutaḥ prayataḥ prāñjaliḥ śuciḥ |
mokṣaviṃśakamavyagro nāradāt samadhītavān ||64||
tamadhītya stavaṃ divyaṃ nāradena samīritam |
pṛthivī coddhṛtā yena taṃ jajāpa mahāsuraḥ ||65||
oṃnamo'stvanantapataye akṣayāya mahātmane |
jaleśayāya devāya padmanābhāya viṣṇave ||66||
saptasūryavapuḥ kṛtvā trīṃllokān krāntavānasi |
bhagavan kālakālastvaṃ tena satyena mokṣaya ||67||
naṣṭacandrārkagagane kṣīṇayajñatapaḥkriye |
punaścintayase lokāṃstena satyena mokṣaya ||68||
brahmarudrendravāyvagnisaridbhujagaparvatāḥ |
tvatsthā dṛṣṭā dvijendreṇa tena satyena mokṣaya |65|
mārkaṇḍena purā kalpe praviśya jaṭharaṃ tava |
carācaragataṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tena satyena mokṣaya || 3.72.70 ||
eko vidyāsahāyastvaṃ yogī yogamupāgataḥ |
punastrailokyamutsṛjya tena satyena mokṣaya || 71 ||
jalaśayyāmupāsīno yoganidrāmupāgataḥ |
lokāṃścintayase bhūyastena satyena mokṣaya || 72 ||
vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāya vedayajñapuraskṛtam |
dharā jaloddhṛtā yena tena satyena mokṣaya || 73||
uddhṛtya daṃṣṭrayā yajñāṃstrīnpiṇḍānkṛtavānasi |
tvaṃ pitṝṇāmapi hare tena satyena mokṣaya || 74 ||
pradudruvuḥ surāḥ sarve hiraṇyākṣabhayārditāḥ |
paritrātāstvayā deva tena satyena mokṣaya || 75 ||
dīrghavaktreṇa rūpeṇa hiraṇyākṣasya saṃyuge |
śiro jahāra cakreṇa tena satyena mokṣaya || 76 ||
bhagnamūrdhāsthimastiṣko hiraṇyakaśipuḥ purā |
huṃkāreṇa hato daityastena satyena mokṣaya || 77 ||
dānavābhyāṃ hṛtā vedā brahmaṇaḥ paśyataḥ purā |
paritrātāstvayā deva tena satyena mokṣaya || 78 ||
kṛtvā hayaśirorūpaṃ hatvā tu madhukaiṭabhau |
brahmaṇe te'rpitā vedāstena satyena mokṣaya || 79 ||
devadānavagandharvā yakṣasiddhamahoragāḥ |
antaṃ tava na paśyanti tena satyena mokṣaya || 3.72.80 ||
apāntaratamā nāma jāto devasya vai sutaḥ |
kṛtāśca tena vedārthāstena satyena mokṣaya || 81 ||
vedayajñāgnihotrāṇi pitṛyajñahavīṃṣi ca |
rahasyaṃ tava devasya tena satyena mokṣaya || 82 ||
ṛṣirdīrghatamā nāma jātyandho guruśāpataḥ |
tvatprasādācca cakṣuṣmāṃstena satyena mokṣaya || 83 ||
grāhagrastaṃ gajendraṃ ca dīnaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ gatam |
bhaktaṃ mokṣitavāṃstvaṃ hi tena satyena mokṣaya || 84 ||
akṣayaścāvyayaśca tvaṃ brahmaṇyo bhaktavatsalaḥ |
ucchritānāṃ niyantāsi tena satyena mokṣaya || 85 ||
śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ śārṅgaṃ garuḍameva ca |
prasādayāmi śirasā te bandhānmokṣayantu mām|| 86 ||
śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadā padmaṃ śārṅgaṃ ca garuḍādayaḥ |
hariṃ prasādayāmāsurbaliṃ mokṣaya bandhanāt || 87 ||
tataḥ prasanno bhagavānādideśa khageśvaram |
garuḍaṃ nāgahantāraṃ baliṃ mokṣaya bandhanāt || 88 ||
tato vikṣipya garuḍaḥ pakṣāvatulavikramaḥ |
jagāma vasudhāmūlaṃ yatrāste saṃyato baliḥ || 89 ||
āgamaṃ tasya vijñāya nāgā muktvā mahāsuram |
yayuḥ purīṃ bhogavatīṃ vainateyabhayārditāḥ || 3.72.90 ||
muktaṃ kṛṣṇaprasādena cintayānamadhomukham |
bhraṣṭaśriyamuvācedaṃ garutmān pannagāśanaḥ || 91 ||
garuḍa uvāca
dānavendra mahābāho viṣṇustvāmabravīt prabhuḥ |
mukto nivasa pātāle saputrajanabāndhavaḥ || 92 ||
itastvayā na gantavyaṃ gavyūtimapi dānava |
samayaṃ yadi bhindyāstvaṃ mūrdhā te śatadhā bhavet|| 93 ||
pakṣendravacanaṃ śrutvā dānavendro bravīdidam|
sthito'smi samaye tasya anantasya mahātmanaḥ || 94 ||
jīvyopāyaṃ tu bhagavānmama kiṃcitkarotu saḥ |
ihastho'haṃ sukhāsīno yenāpyāye khageśvara || 95 ||
balestu vacanaṃ śrutvā garutmānidamabravīt |
pūrvameva kṛtastena jīvyopāyo mahātmanā || 96 ||
vartayiṣyanti ye yajñān vidhihīnāmaṛtvijaḥ |
prāyaścittamajānanto yajñabhāgastatastava || 97 ||
na teṣāṃ yajñabhāgaṃ vai pratigṛhṇanti devatāḥ |
anenāpyāyitabalaḥ sukhamātraṃ nivatsyasi || 98 ||
saṃdeśametaṃ bhagavān dattavān kaśyapātmajaḥ |
dānavendra mahābāho viṣṇustrailokyabhāvanaḥ || 99 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
imaṃ stavamanantasya sarvapāpapramocanam |
yaḥ paṭheta naro bhaktyā tasya naśyati kilbiṣam|| 3.72.100|
gohatyāyāḥ pramucyeta brahmaghno brahmahatyayā |
aputro labhate putraṃ kanyā caivepsitaṃ patim ||101||
sadyo garbhātpramucyeta garbhiṇī janayetsutam |
ye ca mokṣaiṣiṇo loke yoginaḥ sāṃkhyakāpilā|| 102||
stavenānena gacchanti śvetadvīpamakalmaṣāḥ |
sarvakāmaprado hyeṣa stavo'nantasya kīrtyate || 103||
yaḥ paṭhet prātarutthāya śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ |
sarvān kāmānavāpnoti mānavo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 104||
eṣa vai vāmano nāma prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ |
vedavidbhirdvijairevaṃ paṭhyate vaiṣṇavaṃ yaśaḥ || 105||
yastvimaṃ vāmanaṃ divyaṃ prādurbhāvaṃ mahātmanaḥ |
śṛṇuyānniyato bhaktyā sadā parvasu parvasu ||106||
parān vijayate rājā yathā viṣṇurmahābalaḥ |
yaśo vimalamāpnoti vipulaṃ cāpnute vasu || 107||
priyo bhavati bhūtānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vāmano yathā |
putrapautrāśca vardhante ārogyaṃ guṇasampadaḥ || 108||
prīyate paṭhataścāsya devadevo janārdanaḥ |
sarvakāmayutaścaiva kṛṣṇadvaipāyano'bravīt || 109||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vāmanaprādurbhāve dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 72 ||

<3.73>

trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
kimarthaṃ bhagavān viṣṇurdevadevo janārdanaḥ |
gataḥ kailāsaśikharamālayaṃ śaṃkarasya ca || 1 ||
nāradādyaistapovṛddhairmunibhistattvadarśibhiḥ |
tatra dṛṣṭo mahādevaḥ śaṃkaro nīlalohitaḥ || 2 ||
keśavena purā vipra kurvatā tapa uttamam |
arcito devadevena śaṃkaraśceti naḥ śrutam || 3 ||
devau tatra jagannāthau dṛṣṭavantau purātanau |
arcayāṃcakrire devā indrādyāḥ śaṃkaraṃ harim || 4 ||
tau hi devau mahādevāvekībhūtau dvidhā kṛtau |
ekātmānau jagadyonī sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakau || 5 ||
parasparasamāveśājjagataḥ pālane sthitau |
tayostatra yathāvṛttaṃ kailāse parvatottame || 6 ||
ṛṣayaḥ kimaceṣṭanta dṛṣṭvā tau puruṣottamau |
etat sarvamaśeṣeṇa vaktumarhasi sattama || 7 ||
yathā gato harirviṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇo jiṣṇuḥ purātanaḥ |
yathā ca śaṃkaraḥ sākṣātkṛtavānnāgabhūṣaṇaḥ |
etat sarvaṃ vipravarya brūhi tattvena yatnataḥ || 8 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājan yathā kṛṣṇo gato nagam |
yathā ca dṛṣṭo deveśaḥ śaṃkaro vṛṣavāhanaḥ || 9 ||
yathā cacāra sa tapo yathā te munayo gatāḥ |
evaṃ tayoryathāvṛttaṃ tathā śṛṇu narottama || 3.73.10 ||
dvaipāyano'tha bhagavān yathā provāca māṃ tathā |
namaskṛtya pravakṣyāmi keśavaṃ khagavāhanam || 11 ||
yathāśakti yathāprajñaṃ śṛṇu yatnena suvrata |
na cāśuśrūṣave vācyaṃ nṛśaṃsāyātapasvine || 12||
nānadhītāya vaktavyaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyavatā sadā |
svargyaṃ yaśasyaṃ dhanyaṃ ca buddhiśuddhikaraṃ sadā ||13||
dhyeyaṃ puṇyātmanāṃ nityamidaṃ vedārthaniścitam |
anekāraṇyasaṃyuktaṃ sevante nityamīdṛśam ||14||
munayo vedaniratā nāradādyāstapodhanāḥ |
atyadbhutaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ vṛttaṃ kailāsaparvate ||15||
śivayordevayostatra hareścaiva bhavasya ha |
hateṣvasurasaṃgheṣu narakādiṣu bhūmipa ||16|
hateṣvatha nṛpeṣvevaṃ kiṃcicchiṣṭeṣu śatruṣu |
śāsati sma sadā viṣṇuḥ pṛthivīṃ puruṣottamaḥ || 17||
dvāravatyāṃ jagannātho vasan vṛṣṇibhirīśvaraḥ |
rukmiṇyā saṃgato devo vasaṃstatra pure hariḥ || 18||
kadācicca tayā sārdhaṃ śete rātrau jagatpatiḥ |
viharaṃśca yathāyogaṃ prītaḥ prītiyujā tayā ||19||
athovāca tadā devī rukmiṇī rukmabhūṣaṇā |
putramicchāmi deveśa tvatto mādhava nandanam ||3.73.20||
balinaṃ rūpasampannaṃ tvayaiva sadṛśaṃ prabho |
vṛṣṇīnāmapi netāraṃ vīryavantaṃ taponidhim ||21||
sarvaśāstrārthakuśalaṃ rājavidyāpuraskṛtam |
evamādiguṇairyuktaṃ dātumarhasi sattama ||22||
tvayi sarvasya dātṛtvaṃ nityameva pratiṣṭhitam |
tvaṃ hi sarvasya kartā ca dātā bhoktā jagatpatiḥ ||23||
viśeṣatastu bhṛtyānāṃ śuśrūṣāniyatātmanām |
vaktavyaṃ kimu deveśa yadi bhaktāsmi keśava ||24||
anugraho yadi syānme devadeva jagatpate |
dātumarhasi putraṃ tvaṃ vīryavantaṃ janārdana ||25||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
ityukto devadeveśaḥ priyayā prīyamāṇayā |
tayā mahiṣyā rukmiṇyā rukmiśatruryadūdvahaḥ ||26||
provāca vacanaṃ kāle rukmiṇīṃ yādaveśvaraḥ |
dātāsmi tādṛśaṃ putraṃ yaṃ tvamicchasi bhāmini ||27||
nityaṃ bhaktāsi me devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
avaśyaṃ tava dāsyāmi putraṃ śatrunibarhaṇam ||28||
putreṇa lokāñjayati satāṃ kāmadughā hi ye |
narakaṃ puditi khyātaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca narakaṃ viduḥ ||29||
pudastrāṇāt tataḥ putramihecchati paratra ca |
anantāḥ putriṇo lokāḥ puruṣasya priye śubhāḥ ||3.73.30||
patirjāyāṃ praviśati garbho bhūtvā sa mātaram |
tasyāṃ punarnavo bhūtvā daśame māsi jāyate ||31||
putravantaṃ bibhetīndraḥ kiṃ nu tenāśitaṃ bhavet |
nāputro vindate lokān kuputrād vandhyatā varā ||32||
kuputro narake yasmāt suputrāt svarga eva hi |
tasmād vinītaṃ satputraṃ śrutavantaṃ dayāparam ||33||
vidyayā vinayo yasmād vidyāyuktaṃ sudhārmikam |
icchet putraṃ putrakāmaḥ puruṣo yatnavān budhaḥ ||34||
tasmād dāsyāmi te putraṃ vidyāvantaṃ sudhārmikam |
eṣa gacchāmi putrārthaṃ kailāsaṃ parvatottamam ||35||
tatropāsya mahādevaṃ śaṃkaraṃ nīlalohitam |
tato labdhāsmi putraṃ te bhavād bhūtahite ratāt ||36||
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa bhavaṃ śaṃkaramavyayam |
toṣayitvā virūpākṣamādidevamajaṃ vibhum ||37||
gamiṣyāmyahamadyaiva draṣṭuṃ śaṃkaramavyayam |
sa ca me dāsyate putraṃ toṣitastapasā mayā ||38||
tatra gatvā mahādevaṃ namaskṛtya sahomayā |
praviśya badarīṃ puṇyāṃ munijuṣṭāṃ tapomayīm ||39||
agnihotrākulāṃ divyāṃ gaṅgāmbuplāvitāṃ sadā |
mṛgapakṣisamāyuktāṃ siṃhadvīpiśatākulām ||3.73.40||
badarīphalasampūrṇā vānarakṣobhitadrumām |
vetrārūḍhamahāvṛkṣāṃ kadalīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitām ||41|
munibhirvedatattvārthavicāranipuṇaiḥ sadā |
vedaniścitatattvārthaiḥ pramāṇakuśalairyutām ||42||
idamekamidaṃ tattvamiti niścitamānasaiḥ |
upāsyamānāmanyatra siddhaiḥ siddhārthatatparaiḥ ||43||
itihāsapurāṇajñaiḥ sevyamānāṃ maharṣibhiḥ |
gacchadbhiḥ svarganilayaṃ parityajya kalevaram ||44|
prasiddhāṃ mahatīṃ devīṃ yāsyāmi sukṛtālayām |
ityuktvā virarāmaiva devadevo janārdanaḥ |||45|
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kailāsayātrāyāṃ trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 73 ||

<3.74>

catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ gantumaicchajjanārdanaḥ |
hutāgniḥ kṛtakalyāṇaḥ samāptavaradakṣiṇaḥ || 1 ||
gāśca dattvātha viprebhyo namaskṛtya dvijottamān |
āsthānamaṇḍapaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ praviveśa jagatpatiḥ || 2 ||
āsanaṃ mahadāsthāya vṛṣṇīnāhūya sarvaśaḥ |
balabhadraṃ śineḥ pautraṃ hārdikyaṃ śukasāraṇau || 3 |
ugrasenaṃ mahābuddhimuddhavaṃ nītimattaram |
yasya buddhiṃ samāśritya jīvante yādavāḥ sukham || 4 ||
netā ca yaduvṛṣṇīnāṃ sa tu dharmaparaḥ sadā |
yasya bibhyati devāśca nītestasya mahātmanaḥ || 5 ||
yasya buddhibalād viṣṇuḥ śaśāsa pṛthivīṃ sadā |
taṃ ca vṛṣṇivaraṃ vīramuddhavaṃ devasuprabham || 6 ||
anyānapi yadūn sarvānuvāca bhagavān hariḥ |
śṛṇvantu mama vākyāni yādavāḥ sarva eva hi |
śṛṇu cāpi vaco mahyaṃ pituruddhava me sakhe || 7 ||
bālyātprabhṛti yo yatno mama duṣṭanibarhaṇe |
pratyakṣaṃ bhavatā dṛṣṭaṃ pūtanānidhanaṃ nṛpa || 8 ||
keśī ca nihato bālye mayā bālena yādavāḥ |
govardhano dhṛtaḥ śailo gāvaśca paripālitāḥ || 9 ||
abhiṣikto'smi śakreṇa devānāmagrataḥ sthitaḥ |
kaṃso'pi nidhanaṃ nīto mayā cāṇūramuṣṭikau || 3.74.10||
ugraseno'bhiṣiktaśca kṛtā dvāravatī mayā |
anye cāpi nṛpā rājan balino nihatā mayā || 11||
yo'pi vīro jarāsaṃdho nigṛhīto balānmayā |
bhīmena balinā rājannayane mama yādavāḥ || 12||
śṛgālo nihataḥ saṃkhye gomantād gacchatā mayā |
yo'pi vīro durātmāsau dānavo narako hataḥ ||13||
niṣkaṇṭakamimaṃ lokaṃ kṛtavān rājasattamāḥ |
kiṃ tu vīro nṛpo jajñe sakhā bhaumasya yādavāḥ || 14||
pauṇḍro vīryavatāṃ netā dveṣṭā cāsau sadā mama |
śiṣyo droṇasya rājendro balī brahmāstravitkṛtī || 15|
śāstrajño nītimānsākṣānnetā sarvasya yatnavān |
yoddhā yuddhapriyo rājā jāmadagnya ivāparaḥ ||16||
ekāntaśatrurasmākaṃ chidrānveṣī sadā mama |
bādhiṣyate purīṃ yoddhācchidraṃ yadi labheta saḥ || 17||
na hyalpasādhyo balavān puṇḍrasyeśo nṛpottamāḥ |
yattā bhavantastiṣṭhantu pragṛhītaśarāsanāḥ || 18||
yathā na bādhate rājā purīṃ yadukulāśrayām |
ahaṃ tu yāsye kailāsaṃ kutaścitkāraṇānnṛpāḥ || 19||
śaṅkaraṃ draṣṭukāmo'smi bhūtabhāvanabhāvanam |
yāvadāgamanaṃ mahyaṃ tāvad yattā bhavantviha || 3.74.20||
mayā virahitāṃ cemāṃ yadi jānāti puṇḍrakaḥ |
āgamiṣyati rājendro yotsyate ca purīmimām ||21 ||
imāṃ niryādavīṃ kartuṃ śaknotīti ca me matiḥ |
yattā bhavata rājendrāḥ khaḍgaiḥ pāśaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ ||22||
pāṣāṇaiḥ karṣaṇīyaiśca sannaddhā bhavata svakaiḥ |
pidhāya ca kapāṭāni mahādvārāṇi yatnataḥ ||23||
eka eva mahādvāro gamanāgamane sadā |
mudrayā saha gacchantu rājño ye gantumīpsavaḥ ||24||
na cāmudraḥ praveṣṭavyo dvārapālasya paśyataḥ |
yāvadāgamanaṃ mahyaṃ tāvadevaṃ bhaviṣyati ||25||
mṛgayā nātra kartavyā na ca krīḍā bahiḥ purāt |
jñātavyāśca pare sve ca gamanāgamane sadā ||26||
evamādikriyā kāryā yāvadāgamanaṃ mama |
ityuktvā yādavānsarvānsātyakiṃ punarāha ca ||27||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kailāsayātrāyāṃ catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 74 ||

<3.75>

pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
śrībhagavānuvāca
sātyake śṛṇu madvākyaṃ yatto bhava yudhāṃ vara |
tvaṃ tu khaḍgī gadī bhūtvā cāpapāṇistanutravān || 1 ||
tiṣṭha yatnena rakṣasva purīṃ bahunṛpāśrayām |
na ca nidrā tvayā kāryā rātrau yaduvṛṣa prabho || 2 ||
na ca vyākhyā tvayā kāryā śāstrāṇāṃ śāstratatpara |
na ca vādastvayā kāryo vādibhiḥ saha vṛṣṇipa || 3 ||
tvaṃ hi yoddhā balī jñātā dhanurvedākhyavedavit |
tathā kuru yathā vīra nopahāsyā bhavediyam || 4 ||
sātyakiruvāca
kariṣyāmi vacastubhyaṃ yathāśakti janārdana |
ājñā tava jagannātha dhāryā yatnena me sadā || 5 ||
bhṛtyavat pracariṣyāmi kāmapālasya mādhava |
yāvadāgamanaṃ tubhyaṃ tāvatsthāsyāmi yatnataḥ || 6 ||
prasādastava govinda yadi syānmayi mādhava |
kiṃ nāma me ca duḥsādhyaṃ śatrūṇāṃ nigrahe raṇe || 7 ||
yadi śakraṃ yamaṃ vāpi kuberamapi pāśinam |
sarvānetānvijeṣyāmi kimu pauṇḍraṃ nṛpottamam || 8 ||
gaccha kārya kuruṣvedaṃ yatto'haṃ satataṃ hare |
uddhavaṃ punarāhedaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ padmanibhekṣaṇaḥ || 9 ||
śṛṇūddhava tvaṃ vākyaṃ me kuryāstvetatprayatnavān |
rakṣyā nayena rājendra purī dvāravatī tvayā || 3.75.10||
yatto bhava sadā tāta kuru sāhayyamatra naḥ |
lajjā mama samutpannā vadatastava sāmpratam || 11||
tvaṃ hi netā samastasya vidyāpārasya sarvataḥ |
ko nu śakṣyati medhāvī vaktuṃ vidyāvataḥ puraḥ ||12||
yat kāryaṃ tadbhavān vetti hyakāryaṃ vāpi sarvataḥ |
ato'haṃ virame tāta vaktuṃ samprati vṛṣṇipa || 13||
uddhava uvāca
kimidaṃ tava govinda vartate māṃ prati prabho |
aho prasannatā mahyaṃ kiṃtu prītiriyaṃ tava || 14||
jānāmyahaṃ jagannātha prasādasyaiṣa vistaraḥ |
yasya prasanno bhavati tasya kiṃ nāsti keśava ||15||
tvaṃ hi sarvasya jagataḥ kartā hartā pradhānataḥ |
prabhavaḥ sarvakāryāṇāṃ vaktā śrotā pramāṇavit ||16||
dhyātā dhyānamayo dhyeya iti brahmavido viduḥ |
jetā devaripūṇāṃ ca goptā nākasadāṃ bhavān || 17||
tvannāthā vayameveti jīvāmo nihatadviṣaḥ |
iyaṃ nītirahaṃ manye netā nīteryato bhavān || 18||
ko nu nāma nayo veda tvāṃ vinā sāmprataṃ vada |
nītistvaṃ sarvakāryāṇāmiti me niścitā matiḥ || 19||
durgāḍho nayamārgo'yamityāhustadvido janāḥ |
caturdhā procyate nītiḥ sāmadāne janārdana ||3.75.20||
daṇḍo bhedo manuṣyāṇāṃ nigrāhāvagrahe sadā |
daṇḍyeṣu daṇḍamicchanti samānyaṃ tu naye hare ||21 ||
balavatsvatha dānaṃ tu trayāṇāmapyagocare |
prayoktavyo mahābheda iti nītimatāṃ matam ||22||
teṣu teṣvatha sarveṣu pramāṇaṃ tvāṃ vidurbudhāḥ |
kimatra bahunoktena sarvaṃ tvayi samarpitam ||23||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
ityuktvā virarāmaiva uddhavo nītimattaraḥ |
tataḥ sa bhagavān viṣṇurevameva nṛpottama ||24||
kāmapālaṃ mahābāhumuvāca yadusaṃsadi |
ugrasenaṃ nṛpaṃ rājaṃstathā hārdikyameva ca ||25||
kāmapālaṃ punarviṣṇuridaṃ provāca tattvavit |
na pramādastvayā kāryaḥ sarvadā yatnavān bhava ||26||
sthite tvayi mahābāho kā pīḍā jagato bhavet |
gadī bhava sadā tvārya na krīḍā sarvadā bhavet ||27||
rakṣa tvaṃ sarvadā yatnāt purīṃ dvāravatīṃ prabho |
nopahāsyā yathā syāma tathā kuru gadī bhava ||28||
utsāhaḥ sarvadā kāryo nirutsāho na yatnataḥ |
bāḍhamityabravīd rāmaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vṛṣṇikulodbhavam ||29||
vṛṣṇayaḥ sarva evaite svaṃ svaṃ sadma samāyayuḥ |
gantumaicchajjagannāthaḥ kailāsaṃ parvatottamam ||3.75.30||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kailāsayātrāyāṃ pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 75 ||

<3.76>

ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ saṃcintayāmāsa garuḍaṃ pakṣipuṅgavam |
āgaccha tvaritaṃ tārkṣya iti viṣṇurjagatpatiḥ || 1 ||
tataḥ sa bhagavāṃstārkṣyo vedarāśiriti smṛtaḥ |
balavān vikramī yogī śāstranetā kurūdvaha || 2 ||
yajñamūrtiḥ purāṇātmā sāmamūrddhā ca pāvanaḥ |
ṛgvedapakṣavān pakṣī piṅgalo jaṭilākṛtiḥ || 3 ||
tāmratuṇḍaḥ somaharaḥ śakrajetā mahāśirāḥ |
pannagāriḥ padmanetraḥ sākṣād viṣṇurivāparaḥ || 4 ||
vāhanaṃ devadevasya dānavīgarbhakṛntanaḥ |
rākṣasāsurasaṃghānāṃ jetā pakṣabalena yaḥ || 5 ||
prādurāsīnmahāvīryaḥ keśavasyāgratastadā |
jānubhyāmapatad bhūmau namo viṣṇo jagatpate || 6 ||
namaste devadeveśa hare svāminniti bruvan |
pasparśa pāṇinā kṛṣṇaḥ svāgataṃ tārkṣyapuṅgavam || 7 ||
ityuvāca tadā tārkṣyaṃ yāsye kailāsaparvatam |
śūlinaṃ draṣṭumicchāmi śaṅkaraṃ śāśvataṃ śivam|| 8 ||
bāḍhamityabravīt tārkṣya āruhyainaṃ janārdanaḥ |
tiṣṭhadhvamiti hovāca yādavān pārśvavartinaḥ || 9 ||
tato yayau jagannātho diśaṃ prāguttarāṃ hariḥ |
raveṇa mahatā tārkṣyastrailokyaṃ samakampayat || 3.76.10 ||
sāgaraṃ kṣobhayāmāsa padbhyāṃ pakṣī vrajaṃstadā |
pakṣeṇa parvatān sarvān vahan devaṃ janārdanam || 11 ||
tato devāḥ sagandharvā ākāśe'dhiṣṭhitāstadā
tuṣṭuvuḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ vāgbhiriṣṭābhirīśvaram|| 12 ||
jaya deva jagannātha jaya viṣṇo jagatpate |
jayājeya namo deva bhūtabhāvanabhāvana || 13 ||
namaḥ paramasiṃhāya daityadānavanāśana |
jayājeya hare deva yogidhyeya parāgata || 14 ||
nārāyaṇa namo deva kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa hare hare |
ādikartaḥ purāṇātman brahmayone sanātana || 15 ||
namaste sakaleśāya nirguṇāya guṇātmane |
bhaktipriyāya bhaktāya namo dānavanāśana || 16 ||
acintyamūrtaye tubhyaṃ namaste sakaleśvara |
ityādibhistadā devaṃ vāgbhirīśānamavyayam || 17 ||
tuṣṭuvurdevagandharvā ṛṣayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ |
śṛṇvannevaṃ jagannāthaḥ stutivākyāni tāni ca|| 18 ||
yayau sārdhaṃ suragaṇairmunibhirvedapāragaiḥ |
yatra pūrvaṃ svayaṃ viṣṇustapastepe sudāruṇam || 19 ||
lokavṛddhikaraḥ śrīmām̐llokānāṃ hitakāmyayā |
varṣāyutaṃ tapastaptaṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || 3.76.20 ||
yatra viṣṇurjagannāthastapastaptvā sudāruṇam |
dvidhākarot svamātmānaṃ naranārāyaṇākhyayā || 21 ||
gaṅgā yatra saricchreṣṭhā madhye dhāvati pāvanī |
yatra śakraḥ svayaṃ hatvā vṛtraṃ vedārthatattvagam || 22 ||
brahmahatyāvināśārthaṃ tapo varṣāyutaṃ carat |
yatra siddhāśca siddhāḥ syurdhyātvā devaṃ janārdanam|| 23 ||
yatra hatvā raṇe rāmo rāvaṇaṃ lokarāvaṇam |
etacchāsanamicchaṃśca tapo ghoramatapyata || 24 ||
devāśca munayaścaiva siddhiṃ yānti śucivratāḥ |
yatra nityaṃ jagannāthaḥ sākṣād vasati keśavaḥ || 25 ||
yatra yajñāḥ pravartante nityaṃ munigaṇaiḥ saha |
yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa naraḥ svargaṃ gamiṣyati || 26 ||
svargasopānamicchanti yāṃ puṇyāṃ munisattamāḥ |
śatravo mitratāṃ yānti yatra nityaṃ nṛpottama || 27 ||
yāmāhuḥ puṇyaśīlānāṃ sthānamuttamadharmiṇām |
yatra viṣṇuṃ samārādhya devāḥ svargaṃ samāyayuḥ || 28 ||
siddhakṣetramidaṃ prāhurṛṣayo vītamatsarāḥ |
viśālāṃ badarīṃ viṣṇustāṃ draṣṭuṃ sakaleśvaraḥ || 29 ||
sāyāhne cāmaragaṇairmunibhistattvadarśibhiḥ |
praviveśa mahāpuṇyamṛṣijuṣṭaṃ tapovanam || 3.76.30 ||
agnihotrākule kāle pakṣivyāhārasaṃkule |
nīḍastheṣu vihaṅgeṣu duhyamānāsu goṣu ca || 31 ||
ṛṣiṣvapyatha tiṣṭhatsu munivīreṣu sarvataḥ |
samādhistheṣu siddheṣu cintayatsu janārdanam || 32 ||
adhiśriteṣu haviṣu jvālyamāneṣu cāgniṣu |
hūyamāneṣu tatraiva pāvakeṣu samantataḥ || 33 ||
atithau pūjyamāne ca saṃdhyāviṣṭe jaganmaṇau |
sa tasyāmatha velāyāṃ devaiḥ saha janārdanaḥ || 34 ||
viveśa badarīṃ viṣṇurmunijuṣṭāṃ tapomayīm |
āśramasyātha madhyaṃ tu praviśya harirīśvaraḥ || 35 ||.
garuḍādavaruhyātha dīpikādīpite tadā |
pradeśe puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ sthitastāvat sahāmaraiḥ || 36 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kailāsayātrāyāṃ ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 76 ||

<3.77>

saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tato munigaṇā dṛṣṭvā devadevamupasthitam |
samāpya cāgnihotrāṇi sampūjyātithisattamān|| 1 ||
munayo dīrghatapasaḥ samādhau kṛtaniścayāḥ |
jaṭino muṇḍinaḥ kecicchirādhamanisaṃtatāḥ || 2 ||
nirmajjā nīrasāḥ kecid vetālā iva kecana |
aśmakuṭṭāśanaparāḥ parṇabhakṣāstathā pare || 3 ||
vedavidyāvratasnātā nirāhārā mahātapāḥ |
smarantaḥ sarvadā viṣṇuṃ tadbhaktāstatparāyaṇāḥ || 4 ||
āsannamuktayaḥ kecit keciddhyānaikatatparāḥ |
dhyānena manasā viṣṇuṃ dṛṣṭavantastapodhanāḥ || 5 ||
saṃvatsarāśinaḥ kecit kecijjalavicāriṇaḥ |
śakrasya bhayadātāraḥ śrutismṛtiparāyaṇāḥ || 6 ||
vasiṣṭho vāmadevaśca raibhyo dhūmrastathaiva ca |
jābāliḥ kaśyapaḥ kaṇvo bharadvājo'tha gautamaḥ || 7 ||
atriraśvaśirā bhadraḥ śaṅkhaḥ śaṅkhanidhiḥ kuṇiḥ |
pārāśaryaḥ pavitrākṣo yājñavalkyo mahāmanāḥ || 8 ||
kakṣīvānaṅgirāścaiva munirdīptatapāstathā |
asito devalastāta vālmīkiśca mahātapāḥ || 9 ||
ete cānye ca munayo draṣṭumīśvaramavyayam |
ādāyārghyaṃ yathāyogamuṭajātsvātsamāyayuḥ|| 3.77.10 ||
te ca gatvā hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ viṣṇumīśaṃ janārdanam |
bhaktinamrāstadā devaṃ praṇemurbhaktavatsalam || 11 ||
namo'stu kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti devadeveti keśavam |
praṇavātmañjagannātha natāḥ sma śirasā hare || 12 ||
kṛṣṇa viṣṇo hṛṣīkeśa keśaveti ca sarvadā |
praṇāmapravaṇā viprāḥ prāhuritthaṃ jagatpatim || 13 ||
idamarghyamidaṃ pādyamidaṃ viṣṭarameva ca |
kṛtārthāḥ sarvadā deva prasanno no jagatpatiḥ || 14 ||
kiṃ kurmaḥ kiṃ nu naḥ kṛtyaṃ kaścid doṣaḥ prabho hare |
iti prāñjalayaḥ sarve prāhurdevasya paśyataḥ || 15 ||
kṛṣṇo'pi tad yathāyogamupayujya sahāmaraiḥ |
kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ munivarā vardhatāṃ tapa uttamam || 16 ||
iti bruvan purāṇātmā prītastena garutmatā |
āsanaṃ lambhayāmāsa rātrau devo janārdanaḥ || 17 ||
kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭavān bhūyo munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām |
agnihotreṣu tapasi tathā bhṛtyeṣu sarvataḥ || 18 ||
evamādi jagannāthaḥ pṛṣṭavānīśvarastadā |
sarvatra kuśalaṃ te'tra brūyuḥ kṛṣṇasya sarvataḥ || 19 ||
ātithyaṃ cakrire te tu nīvāraiḥ phalamūlakaiḥ |
devānāmatha sarveṣāṃ viṣṇoḥ kṛṣṇasya yatnataḥ|
ātithyamupayuñjānastataḥ prīto'bhavaddhariḥ || 3.77.20 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kailāsayātrāyāṃ saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 77 ||

<3.78>

aṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ sa bhagavān viṣṇurdurvijñeyagatiḥ prabhuḥ |
yatra pūrvama tapastaptamātmanā yādaveśvaraḥ || 1 ||
gaṅgāyāścottare tīre deśaṃ draṣṭumupāgataḥ |
svayameva hariḥ sākṣāt praviveśa tapovanam || 2 ||
praviśya suciraṃ deśaṃ dadarśa ca manoramam |
niṣasāda tatastasminnāśrame puṇyavardhanaḥ || 3 ||
samādhau yojayāmāsa manaḥ padmanibhekṣaṇaḥ |
kimapyeṣa jagannātho dhyātvā deveśvaraḥ sthitaḥ || 4 ||
sthite devagurau tatra samādhau dīpavaddharau |
tatra śabda mahāgheraḥ prādurāsīt samantataḥ || 5 ||
khāda khādata modeta yāta yāta mṛgānimān |
preṣayeha punaḥ sarvān prasādācchārṅgadhanvanaḥ || 6 ||
eṣa viṣṇurayaṃ kṛṣṇo harirīśa ito'cyutaḥ |
namo'stu viṣṇo deveśa svāminmādhava keśava|| 7 ||
ityādiśabdaḥ sumahānāvirāsīt tadā niśi |
tataśca sumahānādaḥ siṃhānāṃ mṛgavidviṣām || 8 ||
dhāvatāṃ ca śunāṃ rājan mṛgānanu vinardatām |
mṛgāṇāṃ bhītiyuktānāmṛkṣāṇāṃ dvīpināṃ tathā || 9 ||
gajānāṃ nadatāṃ rājan bṛṃhitaṃ ca tatastataḥ |
mahāvātasamuddhūtakṣubhitasyeva vāridheḥ || 3.78.10 ||
nādastrailokyavitrāsaḥ prādurāsīttadā niśi |
śrutvā śabdaṃ harirdevastādṛśaṃ tatra dhiṣṭhitaḥ || 11 ||
samādhikṣobhamāsādya viśvasya ca jagatpatiḥ |
tataḥ saṃcintayāmāsa ko'yameṣa mahāsvanaḥ || 12 ||
kasyāyamīdṛśaḥ śabdaḥ stutiyukto mama tviti |
aho'sminmṛgayāśabdaḥ śunāṃ saṃcaratāṃ vane || 13 ||
mṛgāṇāmatha sarveṣāṃ nādaśca sumahānayam |
vyāmiśrastutiyuktābhirvāgbhirmama samantataḥ || 14 ||
iti saṃcintya manasā diśo viprekṣya sarvataḥ |
tata āste haristatra jñātuṃ tasya samudbhavam || 15 ||
tato mṛgāḥ samādhāvan yatra tiṣṭhati keśavaḥ |
tāṃścaivānucaro rājan śvagaṇaḥ samapadyata || 16 ||
atha vai dīpikā rājañchataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ |
tatastamo'pi vyanaśad diveva samapadyata || 17 ||
tato nu bhūtasaṅghāśca samadṛśyanta tatra ha |
piśācāśca mahāghorā nadanto bahu visvanam || 18 ||
bhakṣayanto'tha piśitaṃ pibanto rudhiraṃ bahu |
prādurāsanmahāghorāḥ piśācā vikṛtānanāḥ || 19 ||
hanyamānā hatā rājan patantaḥ patitā mṛgāḥ |
itaścetaśca dhāvanto bāṇairviddhā mṛgā dvipāḥ || 3.78.20 ||
tato mṛgasahasrāṇi samudīrṇāni bhārata |
yatrāsau tiṣṭhate devastatra yātā nirantaram || 21 ||
antarīkṛtya deveśaṃ sthitānītyanuśuśruma |
piśācyo vikṛtākārāḥ karālā romaharṣaṇāḥ || 22 ||
putravatyaḥ samāpeturyatra tiṣṭhati keśavaḥ |
śvagaṇastatra rājendra caratyevaṃ tatastataḥ || 23 ||
tataḥ sa bhagavān viṣṇuḥ sarvamālokya veṣṭitaḥ |
vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatvā paśyannāste sma keśavaḥ || 24 ||
kasyaiṣa vistṛto nādaḥ kasya vāyaṃ jano'patat |
ko nu māṃ stauti bhaktyā vai bhaviṣye prītimānaham|| 25||
kasya muktiḥ samāyātā prīte mayi sudurlabhā |
iti saṃcintya bhagavānāste prākṛtavaddhariḥ || 26 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kailāsayātrāyāṃ aṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 78 ||

<3.79>

ekonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
teṣāmanu mahāghorau piśācau vikṛtānanau |
prāṃśū piṅgalaromāṇau dīrghajihvau mahāhanū || 1 ||
lambakeśau virūpākṣau hī hī hā heti vādinau |
khādantau māṃsapiṭakaṃ pibantau rudhiraṃ bahu || 2 ||
antraveṣṭitasarvāṅgau dīrghau kṛśakṛtodarau |
lambamānamahāprāntaśūlaprotaśirodharau || 3 ||
karṣantau śavayūthāni bāhubhyāṃ tatra tatra ha |
hasantau vividhaṃ hāsaṃ svajātisadṛśaṃ nṛpa || 4 ||
vadantau bahurūpāṇi vacāṃsi prākṛtāni ca |
kampayantau mahāvṛkṣānūrupādapraghaṭṭanaiḥ || 5 ||
sṛkkiṇīṃ lelihantau ca dantānkaṭakaṭāyinau |
asthisnāyusamākīrṇau dhamanīrajjusaṃtatau || 6 ||
vadantau kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti mādhaveti ca saṃtatam |
kadā nu drakṣyate viṣṇuḥ sa idānīṃ kva tiṣṭhati || 7 ||
svāminaḥ kutra vasatiḥ kuto draṣṭuṃ yatāmahe |
atra vā kutra deveśaḥ kuto nu sthāsyate hariḥ || 8 ||
kutaḥ padmapalāśākṣaḥ sākṣādindrānujo hariḥ |
yamāhuḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ brahma brahmavido janāḥ || 9 ||
tamajaṃ puruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ draṣṭumabhyudyatā vayam |
antakāle jagannāthaṃ praviveśa jagattrayam || 3.79.10 ||
tamajaṃ viśvakartāraṃ kuto drakṣyāma sāmpratam|
yasya vistāra evaiṣa lokaḥ prāṇinivāsinaḥ || 11 ||
taṃ draṣṭuṃ devamīśānaṃ yatāmaḥ sāmprataṃ harim |
daśā ghoratamā loke vidviṣṭā sarvajantubhiḥ || 12 ||
paiśācīyaṃ samutpannā kathaṃ nau prāviśadbalāt|
naramāṃsāsthikaluṣā sarvabhītipradāyinī || 13 ||
aho nau duṣkṛtaṃ karma prāktane karmasaṃcaye |
atraiva mahatī prītirvartate sarvadā tathā || 14 ||
yāvannau duṣkṛtaṃ karma tāvatsthāsyati tādṛśī |
daśā sā sarvavidviṣṭā prāṇipīḍanakāriṇī || 15 ||
sarvathā duṣkṛtaṃ karma bahubhirjanmasaṃcayaiḥ |
tathā hi tatphalaṃ ghoramadyāpi na nivartate || 16 ||
yatāḥ sma prāṇino hantuṃ śvagaṇaiḥ saha sāmpratam |
tathā hi prāṇino loke bālyamādau samāsthitāḥ || 17 ||
ajñānāvṛtacittāśca kṛtyākṛtyaṃ na jānate |
