tathā yauvanino bhrāntā viṣayairbahulīkṛtāḥ || 18 ||
yatante śreyase naiva tato viṣayasaṃsthitāḥ |
viṣayāviṣṭacittā hi manuṣyā na vijānate || 19 ||
tathā ca vṛddhabhāve tu vyādhibhirbahubhirvṛtāḥ |
jvarādibhirmahāghorairnānāduḥkhavidhāyibhiḥ || 3.79.20 ||
yatante na hi vai śreyo vinaṣṭendriyagocarāḥ |
tato mṛtā garbhavāse vasanti satataṃ narāḥ || 21 ||
viṇmūtrakalile ghore duḥkhairbahubhirācitāḥ |
cyavante tu tato ghorādgarbhātsaṃsāramaṇḍale || 22 ||
parasparaṃ vihiṃsantaḥ kurvantaḥ karmasaṃcayam |
mahatyevaṃ sadā ghore saṃsāre duḥkhasaṃkule || 23 ||
pāpāni bahurūpāṇi kurvate'jñānatastadā |
saṃsārasyaiṣa mahimā vistṛtaḥ sarvajantuṣu || 24 ||
acchedyaḥ śastrasampātairupāyairbahubhiḥ sadā |
etasmānna nivartante martyāḥ prākṛtabuddhayaḥ || 25 ||
imaṃ hatvā manuṣyendramidamasmāddharāmyaham |
corayitvā dhanamidaṃ hariṣyāmyādadāmyaham || 26 ||
nirbhartsyainamimaṃ śāntaṃ hariṣyāmi dhanaṃ balī |
ityādivyākulā mūrkhā yatante prāṇipīḍanam || 27 ||
asyaiva duḥkhamūlasya saṃsārasya sadā hariḥ |
bheṣajaṃ sarvathā devaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ |
ādidevaḥ purāṇātmā ātmā brahmavidāṃ sadā || 28 ||
te vayaṃ sarvayatnena drakṣyāmaḥ sarvathā harim |
itthaṃ piśācau bhāṣantau prādurāstāṃ hareḥ puraḥ || 29 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi
kailāsayātrāyāmekonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 79 ||

<3.80>

aśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ sa bhagavān viṣṇuḥ piśācau māṃsabhakṣakau |
dadarśātha mahāghorau dīpikādhāriṇau hariḥ || 1 ||
vilokayāṃcakratustau piśācau devakīsutam |
sthitaṃ sukhāsane viṣṇuṃ dṛṣṭvā lokeśvareśvaram || 2 ||
tau ca gatvā samuddeśaṃ piśācau keśavasya ha |
tatastāvūcaturviṣṇumantarīkṛtya keśavam || 3 ||
kau bhavān kasya vā martya kutaścāgamyate tvayā |
kimarthamiha samprāpto vane ghore mṛgākule || 4 ||
nirmanuṣye dvīpivṛte piśācagaṇasevite |
śvāpadaiḥ sevyamāne ca vipine vyāghrasaṃkule || 5 ||
sukumāro'navadyāṅgaḥ sākṣād viṣṇurivāparaḥ |
padmapatrekṣaṇaḥ śyāmaḥ padmābhaḥ śrīpatiḥ svayam || 6 ||
asmatprītikaraḥ sākṣāt prāpto viṣṇurivāparaḥ |
devo vā yadi vā yakṣo gandharvaḥ kinnaro'pi vā || 7 ||
indro vā dhanado vāpi yamo'tha varuṇo'pi vā |
ekākī vipine ghore dhyānārpitamanā iva || 8 ||
brūhi martya yathātattvaṃ jñātumicchāmi mānada |
evaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ piśācābhyāmāha viṣṇururukramaḥ || 9 ||
kṣatriyo'smīti māmāhurmānuṣyāḥ prakṛtisthitāḥ |
yaduvaṃśe samutpannaḥ kṣātraṃ vṛttamanuṣṭhitaḥ || 3.80.10 ||
lokānāmatha pātāsmi śāstā duṣṭasya sarvadā |
kailāsaṃ gantukāmo'smi draṣṭuṃ devamumāpatim || 11 ||
ityevaṃ mama vṛttāntaḥ kathyatāṃ kau yuvāmiti |
yuvāmiha samāyātau kimarthaṃ brāhmaṇāśramam || 12 ||
eṣā hi mahatī puṇyā nānāvipraniṣevitā |
badarīyaṃ samākhyātā na kṣudrairāśritā kvacit || 13 ||
tapasvibhistapoyuktairjuṣṭā siddhaniṣevitā |
śvagaṇā nātra dṛśyante piśācā māṃsabhojanāḥ || 14 ||
na hantavyā mṛgāścātra mṛgayā nātra vartate |
na tu kṣudraiḥ praveṣṭavyā na kṛtaghnairna nāstikaiḥ || 15 ||
ahamasya tu deśasya rakṣitā nātra saṃśayaḥ |
vyatikramo yadi bhavettasya śāstāsmi yatnataḥ || 16 ||
kau bhavantau kva nu yuvāṃ kasyeyaṃ mahatī camūḥ |
nātaḥ paraṃ praveṣṭavyamṛṣayastvatra saṃsthitāḥ || 17 ||
vighnastatra pravarteta tapaḥsu ca tapasvinām |
ihaiva sthīyatāṃ tāvad vaktavyaṃ ca tataḥ sukham || 18 ||
anyathāhaṃ niṣeddhā syāṃ balādvākyaistathaiva ca |
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evaṃ pṛṣṭau piśācau tu vaktumevopacakratuḥ || 19 ||
tayoreko mahāghoraḥ piśāco dīrghabāhukaḥ |
uvāca vacanaṃ tatra yathā hṛdi samarpitam || 3.80.20 ||
piśāca uvāca
śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi samātitamanā bhava |
namaskṛtya jagannāthaṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ jagatpatim || 21 ||
ādidevamajaṃ viṣṇuṃ vareṇyamanaghaṃ śucim |
vakṣyāmi sakalaṃ yadvattathā śṛṇu yadīcchasi || 22 ||
ghaṇṭākarṇo'smi nāmnāhaṃ piśāco ghoradarśanaḥ |
māṃsādo vikṛto ghoraḥ sākṣānmṛtyurivāparaḥ || 23 ||
dhanadasyānugantāhaṃ sākṣād rudrasakhasya ca |

mṛgayeyaṃ sumahatī viṣṇoḥ pūjārthamityuta |

āgato'haṃ mahāśailāt kailāsād bhūtasevitāt|

satataṃ dūṣayan viṣṇuṃ ghaṇṭāmābadhya karṇayoḥ |
mama na praviśennāma viṣṇoriti vicintayan || 27 ||
ahaṃ kailāsanilayamāsādya vṛṣabhadhvajam |
ārādhya taṃ mahādevamastuvaṃ satataṃ śivam || 28 ||
tataḥ prasanno māmāha vṛṇīṣveti varaṃ haraḥ |
tato muktirmayā tatra prārthitā devasaṃnidhau || 29 ||
muktiṃ prārthayamānaṃ māṃ punarāha trilocanaḥ |
muktipradātā sarveṣāṃ viṣṇureva na saṃśayaḥ || 3.80.30 ||
tasmād gatvā ca badarīṃ tatrārādhya janārdanam |
muktiṃ prāpnuhi govindānnaranārāyaṇāśrame || 31 ||

tameva paramaṃ matvā govindaṃ garuḍadhvajam || 32 ||

anyacca śṛṇu me kāryaṃ yadi kautūhalaṃ tava || 33 ||
purī dvāravatī nāma paścimasyodadhestaṭe |

drakṣyāma nityaṃ bhuvaneśvaraṃ hariṃ purāṇamādyaṃ prabhaviṣṇumavyayam || 41
ajasya kartā bhuvanasya goptā bhuvaśca kartā harireka eva |

janmāspadaṃ lokaguroryadāsīdvistāri padmaṃ jagadādisṛṣṭau || 46 ||

yaṃ prāhurīḍyaṃ varadaṃ vareṇyamekāntatattvaṃ munayaḥ purātanāḥ |

dṛḍhaṃ baddhvā''tmanaḥ kāyamāntrapāśena māṃsapaḥ || 83 ||

praṇavaṃ vācakaṃ matvā vācyaṃ brahmeti niścitaḥ |
ekāgraṃ satataṃ kṛtvā cittaṃ viṣṇau samarpitam || 87 ||
vikalparahitaṃ cittaṃ hṛdi madhye nyaveśayat |
puṇḍarīke śubhadale samāveśya jagatpatim || 88 ||
āste sukhaṃ mahāyogī piśitāśastadā mahān |
tridhāmānaṃ japaṃstatra smaran viṣṇuṃ sanātanam || 89 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kailāsayātrāyāṃ
ghaṇṭākarṇacittasamādhāvaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 80 ||

<3.81>

ekāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ sa bhagavān viṣṇuḥ piśācaṃ dṛṣṭavāṃstadā |
cintayatta svamātmānaṃ śuddhabuddhisamanvitam || 1 ||
ātmanyavasthitaṃ sākṣāt paṭhantaṃ praṇavaṃ sakṛt |
prārthayantaṃ svamātmānamekānte niyataṃ hariḥ || 2 ||
acintayajjagannāthaḥ kāraṇaṃ puṇyasaṃcaye |
dhyātvā tu suciraṃ viṣṇuḥ kāraṇaṃ puṇyakarmaṇaḥ || 3 ||
dhanadasyopadeśena paṭhan subahuśaḥ kṣitau |
vāsudeveti kṛṣṇeti mādhaveti ca māṃ sadā || 4 ||
janārdana hare viṣṇo bhūtabhāvanabhāvana |
narākāra jagannātha nārāyaṇa parāyaṇa || 5 ||
iti māṃ nāmabhirnityaṃ paṭhatyeva divāniśam |
svapañjāgraṃstathā tiṣṭhanbhuñjangacchaṃstathā vadan|| 6 ||
bhakṣayan māṃsapiṭakaṃ pibañcchoṇitameva vā |
bādhamānaśca suciraṃ hatvā cāpi mṛgān bahūn || 7 ||
hanane bhojane caiṣa jāgratsvapne tathaiva ca |
sarveṣvapi ca kāryeṣu kartāhamiti manyate || 8 ||
etasya karmaṇaḥ pāka eṣa ghorasya karmaṇaḥ |
niścityaivaṃ jagannāthaḥ prītastasya babhūva ha || 9 ||
adarśayat svamātmānamananyasya jagatpatiḥ |
śuddhe'ntaḥkaraṇe tasya piśācasyāpi bhūmipa || 3.81.10 ||
sa ca ghoraḥ piśāco'pi dadarśātmani keśavam |
pītakauśeyavasanaṃ padmākṣaṃ śyāmalaṃ harim || 11 ||
śaṅkhinaṃ cakriṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ sragviṇaṃ gadinaṃ vibhum |
kirīṭinaṃ kaustubhinaṃ śrīvatsācchāditorasam|| 12 ||
nīlameghanibhaṃ kāntaṃ garuḍasthaṃ prabhañjanam |
caturbhujaṃ śubhagiraṃ niścalaṃ sarvagaṃ śivam || 13 ||
anādinidhanaṃ nityaṃ māyāvinamamāyinam |
satyayuktaṃ sadā śuddhaṃ buddhigamyaṃ sadāmalam || 14 ||
manasyevaṃ jagannāthaṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇumanekadhā |
anunmīlyaiva nayane kṛtārtho'smītyamanyata || 15 ||
atha dṛṣṭo harirviṣṇuḥ sākṣāt sarvatragaḥ śubhaḥ |
prasanno hi harirmahyaṃ tenāhaṃ dṛṣṭavān harim || 16 ||
siddhaṃ me janmanaḥ kṛtyaṃ kimataḥ kṛtyamasti me |
granthayo mama nirbhinnā vaśyānyevendriyāṇi me || 17 ||
prāyeṇa jitamityeva mano manye smṛte harau |
eṣaṇāśca nirastā me prasanno'haṃ tathābhavam || 18 ||
etebhyo'pi piśācebhyo nirmuktaḥ sāmprataṃ tathā |
yo'sau mamānujaḥ sākṣātsa ca bhaktastathā harau|| 19 ||
kālena caiva nirmukto viṣṇoḥ sāyujyamāpnuyāt|
ityevaṃ cintayitvā sa āntrapāśaṃ vibhidya ca || 3.81.20 ||
krameṇa prāṇānunmucya vilokya ca diśastathā |
śarīraṃ sugamaṃ kṛtvā prāviśat sa sukhena ha || 21 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kailāsayātrāyāṃ
piśācasya viṣṇusākṣātkāre ekāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 81 ||

<3.82>

dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
piśitāśo jagannāthaṃ dadarśātha jagadgurum |
samādhau ca yathā dṛṣṭaṃ bhūmau cāpi tathā harim|| 1 ||
ayaṃ viṣṇurayaṃ viṣṇurityūce piśitāśanaḥ |
samādhau ca yathā dṛṣṭaḥ so'yamatrāpi dṛśyate |
ityuktvā ca punarbrūte nṛtyanniva hasanniva || 2 ||
ayaṃ sa cakrī śaraśārṅgadhanvā gadī rathī sadhvajatūṇapāṇiḥ |
sahasramūrdhā sakalāmareśo jagatprasūtirjagatāṃ nivāsaḥ || 3 ||
viṣṇurjiṣṇurjagannāthaḥ purāṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
viśvātmā viśvakartā yaḥ so'yameṣa sanātanaḥ|| 4 ||
asyaiva devasya hareḥ stanāntare virājate kaustubharatnadīpaḥ |
yasya prasādājjagadetadādau virājate candramaseva rātriḥ || 5 ||
yo'sau pṛthvīṃ dadhārāśu daṃṣṭrayā jalasaṃcayāt |
yo'yameva hariḥ sākṣād vārāhaṃ vapurāsthitaḥ || 6 ||
baddhvā tathā dānavamugrapauruṣaṃ dadau ca śakrāya tato'nurājyam |
baliṃ balādeva hariḥ sa vāmanaḥ stutaśca bhaktyā munibhiḥ purātanaiḥ || 7 ||
daṃṣṭrākarālaḥ sumahān hatvā yo dānavān raṇe |
niḥśokamakhilaṃ lokaṃ cakārāsau janārdanaḥ || 8 ||
ādau dadhāraikabhujena mandaraṃ nirjitya sarvānasurān mahārṇave |
dadau ca śakrāya sudhāmayaṃ mahān sa eṣa sākṣādiha māmavasthitaḥ || 9 ||
yaḥ śete jaladhau nāge devyā lakṣmyā sukhāvahe |
hatvā tau dānavau ghorau madhukaiṭabhasaṃjñitau || 3.82.10 ||
yamāhurādya vibudhā jagatpatiṃ sarvasya dhātāramajaṃ janitram |
aṇoraṇīyāṃsamatipramāṇaṃ sthūlātsthaviṣṭhaṃ harimeva viṣṇum|| 11 ||
yatra sthitamidaṃ sarvaṃ prāpte lokasya nāśane |
ādau yasmātsamutpannaṃ so'yaṃ viṣṇuriti sthitaḥ|| 1 2||
yasyecchayā sarvamidaṃ pravṛttaṃ pravartate cāpi janārdanasya |
ayaṃ sa viṣṇuḥ puruṣottamaḥ śivaḥ pravartate māmiha yādaveśvaraḥ || 13 ||
bhṛgorvaṃśe samutpanno jāmadagnya iti śrutaḥ |
śiṣyatvaṃ samavāpyaiva mṛgavyādhasya yaḥ sthitaḥ || 14 ||
jaghāna vīryād balinaṃ mahāraṇe kuṭhāraśastreṇa girīśaśiṣyaḥ |
sahasrabāhuṃ kṛtavīryasambhavaṃ hayairgajaiścaiva rathaiśca nirgatam || 15 ||
kurukṣetraṃ samāsādya yaścakāra pitṛkriyām |
niḥkṣatriyamimaṃ lokaṃ kṛtavānekaviṃśatiḥ || 16 ||
raghoratha kule jāto rāmo nāma janārdanaḥ |
sītayā ca śriyā yukto lakṣmaṇānucaraḥ kṛtī || 17 ||
kṛtvā ca setuṃ jaladhau janārdano hatvā ca rakṣaḥpatimāśugaiḥ śaraiḥ |
dattvā ca rājyaṃ sa vibhīṣaṇāya daśāśvamedhairayajacca yo'sau || 18 ||
vasudevakule jāto vāsudeveti śabditaḥ |
gokule krīḍate yo'sau saṃkarṣaṇasahāyavān || 19 ||
uttānaśāyī śiśurūpadhārī pītvā stanaṃ pūtanikāpradattam |
vyasuṃ cakārāśu janārdanastadā danoḥ sutāṃ tāmavasat sukhaṃ hariḥ|| 3.82.20 ||
payaḥpānaṃ tathā kurvan bhakṣayan dadhipiṇḍakam |
dāmnā baddhodaro viṣṇurmātrā ruṣitayā dṛḍham || 21 ||
tataśca dāmnā sudṛḍhena baddho jaghāna yo'sau yamalārjunau ca |
krīḍan harirgokulavāsavāsī gopībhirāsvādya mukhaṃ stanaṃ ca || 22 ||
vṛndāvane vasan viṣṇurgopairgokulavāsibhiḥ |
tatra hatvā hayaṃ rājan virarājāṃśumāniva || 23 ||
yaḥ krīḍate nāgaphaṇau janārdano niṣevyamāṇaḥ saha gopadārakaiḥ |
mahāhrade nāgapatiṃ jagatpatirmamarda vīryātiśayaṃ pradarśayan || 24 ||
yo dhenukaṃ tālavane tatphalaiḥ samamacchinat |
hatvā dānavamugraṃ taṃ gopān vismāpayatyasau || 25 ||
dadhāra yo godharamugrapauruṣān mahāmatirmeghasamāgame sati |
viḍambayañchakrabalaṃ pramodayan gopāṃśca gopīśca sa gokulaṃ hariḥ|| 26 ||
gopīnāṃ stanamadhye tu krīḍate kāmamīśvaraḥ |
yo'sau pibaṃstadadharaṃ māyāmānuṣadehavān || 27 ||
gopībhirāsvādya mukhaṃ vivikte śete sma rātrau sukhameva keśavaḥ |
stanāntareṣveva tadā ca tāsāṃ kāmīva kāntādharapallavaṃ piban || 28 ||
akrūreṇa samāhūtastena gacchan hi yāmune |
jale yo hyarcitastena nāgaloke sa eva hi || 29 ||
tataśca gacchanbalavājjanārdano hatvā tamugraṃ rajakaṃ balātpathi |
hṛtvā ca vastrāṇi yatheṣṭamīśvaro yayau sarāmo mathurāṃ purīṃ hariḥ || 3.82.30 ||
labdhvā ca dāmāni bahūni kāmado dattvā varaṃ mālyakṛte mahāntam |
labdhvānulepaṃ surabhiṃ ca yādavaḥ kubjāṃ cakārāśu mahārharūpām || 31 ||
yo'sau cāpaṃ samādāya madhye chittvā mahaddhanuḥ |
siṃhanādaṃ mahāṃścakre kalpānte jalado yathā || 32 ||
hatvā gajaṃ ghoramudagrarūpaṃ viṣāṇamādāya tato'nu keśavaḥ |
nanarta raṅge bahurūpamīśvaraḥ kaṃsasya dattvā bhayamugravīryaḥ || 33 ||
yo'sau hatvā mahāmallaṃ cāṇūraṃ nihatadviṣam |
yādavebhyo dadau prītiṃ kaṃsasyaiva tu paśyataḥ || 34 ||
jaghāna kaṃsaṃ ripupakṣaghātinaṃ pitṛdviṣaṃ yādavanāmadheyam |
saṃsthāpya rājye harirugrasenaṃ sāndīpanaṃ kāśyamupāgato yaḥ || 35 ||
vidyāmavāpya sakalāṃ dattvā putraṃ mahāmuneḥ |
sāgrajo'tha jagāmāśu mathurāṃ yādavīṃ purīm || 36 ||
hatvā niśumbhaṃ narakaṃ mahāmatiḥ kṛtvā sa ghoraṃ kadanaṃ janārdanaḥ |
rarakṣa viprān munivīrasaṃghān devāṃśca sarvāñjagato jagatpatiḥ || 37 ||
sa eṣa bhagavān viṣṇuradya dṛṣṭo janārdanaḥ |
kṛtakṛtyo'smi saṃjātaḥ sāyujyaṃ prāptavānaham|| 38 ||
yena dṛṣṭo hariḥ sākṣāttasya muktiḥ kare sthitā |
so'yameṣa hariḥ sākṣāt pratyakṣamiha vartate || 39 ||
nūnaṃ janmāntare pūrvaṃ dharmaḥ saṃcita eva me |
yasya pākaḥ samutpannau yenāsau dṛśyate mayā || 3.82.40 ||
sarvathā puṇyavānasmi naṣṭasaṃsārabandhanaḥ |
kimasmai dīyate vastu kiṃ nu vakṣyāmi sāmpratam |
kariṣye kimahaṃ viṣṇo vadasvādya yathepsitam || 41 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
ityuktvā vistaraṃ nādaṃ nanarda bahuśastadā |
jahāsa vikṛtaṃ bhūyo nanarta piśitāśanaḥ || 42 ||
namo namo hare kṛṣṇa yādaveśvara keśava |
pratyakṣaṃ ca harestatra nanarta vividhaṃ nṛpa || 43 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kailāsayātrāyāṃ ghaṇṭākarṇastutau dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 82 ||

<3.83>

tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
vihasya vikṛtaṃ bhūyaḥ pranṛtya ca yathābalam |
brāhmaṇasya hatasyātha śavamādāya satvaraḥ || 1 ||
dvidhākṛtya mahāghoraṃ piśitaṃ keśaśāḍvalam |
tataḥ khaṇḍaṃ samādāya adbhirabhyukṣya yatnataḥ || 2 ||
vidhāya pātre suśubhe namaskṛtya janārdanam |
idaṃ provāca deveśaṃ prāñjaliḥ praṇataḥ sthitaḥ || 3 ||
gṛhāṇa me jagannātha bhakṣyaṃ yogyaṃ tava prabho |
bhavādṛśairjagannātha grāhyaṃ sarvātmanā hare || 4 ||
bhaktinamrā vayaṃ viṣṇo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
dattaṃ yad bhaktinamreṇa grāhyaṃ tat svāminā hare || 5 ||
navaṃ susaṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣyaṃ brahmaṇyaṃ śavamuttamam |
asmākaṃ piśitāśānāṃ śāstre niyatameva hi || 6 ||
tasmād gṛhāṇa bhagavan yadi doṣo na vidyate |
ityuktvā vikṛtaṃ bhūyo vihasya sa tu kāmataḥ || 7 ||
dātumaicchat tadā khaṇḍamaspṛśyaṃ tu śavasya ha |
tataḥ prīto'bhavat tasmai manasā pūjayacca tam|| 8 ||
aho'sya snehakāruṇyaṃ mayi sarvatra vartate |
iti saṃcintya manasā provāca yadupuṅgavaḥ || 9 ||
alametena sarvatra piśāca piśitāśana |
aspṛśya mādṛśairetad brāhmaṇyaṃ śavamuttamam || 3.83.10 ||
brāhmaṇaḥ sarvathā pūjyo jantubhirdharmakāṅkṣibhiḥ |
piśācā ghorakarmāṇo yatante brahmahiṃsane || 11 ||
na hantavyāḥ sadā viprāstaddhiṃsā narakāvahā |
tasmādaspṛśyamasmābhirnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 12 ||
bhaktyā prīto'smi bhadraṃ te mano nirmalametayā |
manaḥśuddhyai kṛto yatnastataḥ prīto'smi māṃsapa|| 13 ||
asmatsaṃkīrtanācchaśvacchuddhaṃ hi karaṇaṃ tava |
atīva manasā prīta ityuktvā bhagavānhariḥ || 14 ||
pasparśāṅgaṃ tadā viṣṇuḥ piśācasyātha sarvataḥ |
kareṇa mṛdunā devaḥ pāpānnirmocayaddhariḥ || 15 ||
tatastasyābhavad rūpaṃ kāmarūpasamaprabham |
dīrghakuñcitakeśāḍhyo dīrghabāhuḥ sulocanaḥ || 16 ||
samāṅguliḥ samanakhaḥ samavaktraḥ samunnasaḥ |
padmākṣaḥ padmavarṇābhaḥ padmakeśarabhūṣaṇaḥ || 17 ||
keyūrī cāṅgadī caiva kauśeyavasanastadā |
jñānavānsattvasampannaḥ sākṣādindra ivāparaḥ || 18 ||
gandharva iva gāyaṃstu siddhaḥ siddha iva svayam |
sākṣātspṛṣṭaṃ tadā viṣṇoḥ kareṇa mṛdupūrvakam|| 19 ||
na nūnaṃ tādṛśaṃ rūpamāsīt kālāntareṣvapi |
adyāpi naiva munayo labhante tādṛśaṃ vapuḥ || 3.83.20 ||
kṛtvā subahuśo ghoraṃ tapaḥ paramadāruṇam |
yacca labdhaṃ tadā tena piśācena nṛpottama || 21 ||
ko nu nāma jagannāthamāśritaḥ sīdate nṛpa |
sa hi sarvatra kalyāṇo yo hi nityaṃ janārdanam|| 22 ||
dhyāyan paṭhañjapanvāpi tasya kiṃ nāsti bhūpate |
tataḥ provāca bhagavān sthitaṃ kāmamivāparam || 23 ||
akṣayaḥ svargavāsaste yāvadindro vasiṣyati |
tāvat svargī bhavānastu śāsanānmama nānyataḥ || 24 ||
naṣṭe śakre tataḥ svargātsāyujyaṃ mama gacchatu |
yo'yaṃ bhrātā tava svargī yāvadindro bhavettadā|| 25 ||
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yaste manasi vartate |
dātāsmi sarvaṃ sarvatra nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||26 ||
ghaṇṭākarṇa uvāca
yaścemaṃ saṃgamaṃ deva saṃsmarenniyatātmavān |
bhaktistasyācalā deva tvayi bhūyājjanārdana || 27 ||
manaḥśuddhirbhavettasya mā bhūt kaluṣatā hare |
kāluṣyaṃ manasastasya mā bhūdeṣa varo mama || 28 ||
evamastviti deveśaḥ svargaṃ gaccheti keśavaḥ |
indrātithirbhavānastu tvāṃ pratīkṣya hariḥ sthitaḥ|| 29 ||
ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇa utthāpya brāhmaṇaṃ tadā |
tena stuto jagannāthaḥ pūjayitvā ca taṃ dvijam|| 3.83.30 ||
tato visṛjya govindastasmād deśādupāgamat |
yatra te munayaḥ siddhā agnihotrasamanvitāḥ || 31 ||
sa ca svargī gataḥ svargamājñayā keśavasya ha |
tasmātpaṭha sadā rājanmanaḥśuddhiṃ yadīcchasi|
manaśca śuddhaṃ bhavati paṭhataste jagatpate || 32 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi ghaṇṭākarṇamuktipradāne tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 83 ||

<3.84>

caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ sa bhagavānviṣṇurmunibhyastattvamāditaḥ |
kathayāmāsa yad vṛttaṃ piśācasya mahātmanaḥ || 1 ||
tacchrutvā munayaḥ sarve vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ |
aho'sya karmaṇaḥ pākastava saṃdarśanāttata || 2 ||
arcito munibhiḥ sarvaiḥ prītaḥ prītimatāṃ priyaḥ |
tataḥ prabhāte vimale sūrye cābhyudite sati || 3 ||
āruhya garuḍaṃ viṣṇuryayau kailāsamuttamam |
bhavadbhistatra gantavyamityuktvā munisattamān|| 4 ||
yatra viśveśvarāḥ siddhāstapasyanti yatavratāḥ |
yatra vaiśravaṇaḥ sākṣādupāste śaṃkaraṃ sadā || 5 ||
yaśca tanmānasaṃ nāma saro haṃsālayaṃ mahat |
yatra bhṛṅgīriṭirdevamupāste śaṃkaraṃ śivam || 6 ||
gāṇapatyamavāpyātha harapārśvacaraḥ sadā |
yatra siṃhā varāhāśca dvipadvīpimṛgaiḥ saha || 7 ||
krīḍanti vanyaratayaḥ parasparahite ratāḥ |
yatra nadyaḥ samutpannā gaṅgādyāḥ sāgaraṃgamāḥ || 8 ||
yatra viśveśvaraḥ śambhuracchinad brahmaṇaḥ śiraḥ |
yatrotpannā mahāvetrā bhūtānāṃ daṇḍatāṃ yayuḥ || 9 ||
umayā yatra sahitaḥ śaṃkaro nīlalohitaḥ |
ṛṣibhiḥ prārthitaḥ pūrvaṃ dadau yatra giriḥ sutām || 3.84.10 ||
śaṃkarāya jagaddhātre śivāya jagatīpate |
yatra lebhe hariścakramupāsya bahubhirdinaiḥ || 11 |
puṣkaraiḥ śatapatraiśca netreṇa ca jagatpatim |
guhāṃ yatra samāśritya krīḍante siddhakinnarāḥ || 12 |
priyābhiḥ saha modante pibante madhu cottamam |
yamuddhṛtya bhujaiḥ sarvaiḥ paulastyo virarāma ha || 13 |
tamāruhya mahāśailaṃ devakīnandano hariḥ |
mānasasyottaraṃ tīraṃ jagāma yadunandanaḥ || 14 |
tapaścartuṃ kila harirviṣṇuḥ sarveśvaraḥ śivaḥ |
jaṭī cīrī jagannātho mānuṣaṃ vapurāsthitaḥ || 15 ||
tapase dhṛtacittastu śucau bhūmāvupāviśat |
avaruhya tato yānād garuḍādvedasammitāt || 16 ||
dvādaśābdaṃ tapaścartuṃ mano dadhre tato hariḥ |
phālgunena tu māsena samārebhe jagatpatiḥ || 17 ||
śākabhakṣaḥ kṛtajapo vedādhyayanatatparaḥ |
kimuddiśya jagantāthastapaścarati mānavaḥ || 18 ||
taṃ na vidmo yathākāmaṃ durjñeyeśvaracintanā |
tapasyati tadā viṣṇau parvate bhūtasevite || 19 ||
garuḍaḥ kaśyapasuta indhanāni samācinot |
homārthaṃ vāsudevasya caratastapa uttamam || 3.84.20 ||
cakrarājo'tha puṣpāṇi saṃcinoti tadā hareḥ |
dikṣu sarvāsu sarvatra rarakṣa jalajastadā || 21 ||
khaḍga āhṛtya yatnena kuśān subahuśastadā |
gadā kaumodakī caiva paricaryā cakāra ha || 22 ||
dhanuḥpravaramatyugraṃ śārṅga dānavabhīṣaṇam |
sthitaṃ hi puratastasya yatheṣṭaṃ bhṛtyavat svayam ||23||
juhoti bhagavān viṣṇuredhobhirbahubhiḥ sadā |
ājyādibhistadā havyairagniṃ sampūjya mādhavaḥ ||24||
saptārciṣaḥ samāptiṃ ca samastavyastataḥ kṛtī |
ekasminnekadā māse bhuñjāno niyatātmavān ||25|
dvitīye tvatha paryāye bhuñjannekena keśavaḥ |
ekasmin vatsare bhuñjaṃstathaivaikena kenacit ||26||
samāpya tat tapaḥ sarvamevameva jagatpatiḥ |
dvādaśābde tathā pūrṇe ūnamāse jagatpatiḥ ||27||
juhvannagniṃ samāsthāya paṭhan mantraṃ janārdanaḥ |
āraṇyakaṃ paṭhan viṣṇuḥ sākṣāt sarveśvaro hariḥ |
āste dhyānaparastatra paṭhan praṇavamuttamam ||28||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kailāsayātrāyāṃ kṛṣṇatapovarṇane caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 84 ||

<3.85>

pañcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tata indraḥ svayaṃ tatra āruhya gajamuttamam |
draṣṭuṃ sarveśvaraṃ viṣṇuṃ tapasyantaṃ samāyayau || 1 ||
tato yamastu bhagavānāruhya mahiṣaṃ varam |
kiṃkaraiśca svayaṃ sākṣādāyayau nagamuttamam || 2 ||
pracetā haṃsamāruhya vāruṇaiśca samanvitaḥ |
śvetacchatrasamāyuktaḥ śvetavyajanavījitaḥ || 3 ||
yayau kailāsaśikharaṃ draṣṭuṃ keśavamañjasā |
anye cāpi tathā devā ādityā vasavastathā || 4 ||
rudrāścaiva tathā rājan draṣṭuṃ keśavamāyayuḥ |
siddhāśca munayaścaiva gandharvā yakṣakinnarāḥ || 5 ||
sarvāścāpsaraso rājan nṛtyagītaviśāradāḥ |
tato devagaṇaḥ sarvaḥ kailāsaṃ samapadyata || 6 ||
parvato nāradaścaiva tathānye munisattamāḥ |
vismayasthitalolākṣāḥ sarvadevagaṇāstathā || 7 ||
āścaryaṃ khalu paśyadhvaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati |
yogidhyeyaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo yattapyati guruḥ svayam |
ko nvatra samayo bhūyāditi te menire gaṇāḥ || 8 ||
tataḥ samāpte sakale jagatpatervrate samūle sakaleśvaraḥ śivaḥ |
draṣṭuṃ hariṃ lokahitaiṣiṇaṃ prabhuṃ yayau bhavānyā saha bhūtasaṃghaiḥ || 9 ||
sārdhaṃ kubereṇa saguhyakena sakhyā priyeṇa prabhurīśvaraḥ śivaḥ |
svayaṃ jaṭī bhūtapiśācasaṃvṛtaḥ śarī ca khaḍgī śaśikhaṇḍaśekharaḥ || 3.85.10 ||
kareṇa bibhratsahadarbhakuṇḍikāṃ kareṇa sākṣādapareṇa dīpikām |
anyena vibhranmahatīṃ sa ḍiṇḍimāṃ śūlaṃ ca bibhrannapareṇa bāhunā || 11 ||
guṇān sa rudrākṣakṛtān samudvahañjaṭābhirāpiṅgalatāmramūrtiḥ |
virājamānaḥ prabhurinduśekharo vṛṣeṇa yuktaḥ sa sitena śaṃkaraḥ || 12||
umāstanadvandvasamarpitānanastathā samāśliṣya nipīḍitādharaḥ |
gaṅgāmbuvikṣālitacandraśekharastāṃ cāpi vīkṣan bahuśastadā śivaḥ || 13||
bhasmāṅgarāgairanulepitānano mahoragairbaddhajaṭaḥ sanātanaḥ |
śiraḥkapālaiḥ pariśobhitastadā draṣṭuṃ hariṃ keśavamabhyayācchivaḥ ||14||
yamāhuragryaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntaṃ purātanaṃ sāṃkhyanibaddhadṛṣṭayaḥ |
yasyāpi devasya guṇān samagrāṃstattvāṃścaturviṃśatimāhureke || 15||
yamāhurekaṃ puruṣaṃ purātanaṃ kaṇādanāmānamajaṃ maheśvaram |
dakṣasya yajñaṃ vinihatya yo vai vināśya devānasurān sanātanaḥ || 16||
yaṃ vidurbhūtatattvajñaṃ bhūteśaṃ bhūtabhāvanam |
vāmadevaṃ virūpākṣamāhustattvavido janāḥ || 17||
mahādevaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ kālamūrtiṃ caturbhujam |
rudraṃ rodananāmānamāhurviśveśvaraṃ śivam ||18||
aprameyamanādhāramāhurmāheśvarā janāḥ |
nagnaṃ nagnaparītaṃ tu nāginaṃ tvagnivarcasam || 19||
āhurviśveśvaraṃ śāntaṃ śivamādiṃ sanātanam |
tasya mūrtirimāḥ sarvā dharādyāḥ sakalā nṛpa ||3.85.20||
bhūmirāpo'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ sūryaśca tathā śaśī |
agniśca yajamānaśca prakṛtiścaivamaṣṭadhā ||21 ||
mahādevo mahāyogī girīśo nīlalohitaḥ |
ādikartā mahābhartā śūlapāṇirumāpatiḥ |
draṣṭuṃ viśveśvaraṃ viṣṇuṃ bhūtasaṃghaiḥ samāyayau ||22||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kailāsayātrāyāṃ śivāgamanakathane pañcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 85||

<3.86>

ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tasyāgre samapadyanta bhūtasaṃghāḥ sahasraśaḥ |
ghaṇṭākarṇo virūpākṣaḥ kuṇḍadhāra kumudvahaḥ || 1 ||

urunetraḥ śatamukhaḥ śatagrīvaḥ śatodaraḥ || 2 ||

pārśvavaktraḥ siṃhamukha unnatāṃso mahāhanuḥ || 3 ||
tribāhuḥ pañcabāhuśca vyāghravaktraḥ sitānanaḥ |
ete cānye ca bahavo dīrghāsyā dīrghalocanāḥ || 4 ||
nṛtyantaḥ prahasantaśca sphoṭayantaḥ parasparam |
tathānye ghorarūpāśca tathānye vikṛtānanāḥ || 5 ||
pretabhakṣāḥ pretavāhā māṃsaśoṇitabhojanāḥ |
śavāni subahūnyāśu bhakṣayantastatastataḥ || 6 ||
pibanto rudhiraṃ ghoraṃ khaṇḍayantaḥ śavān bahūn |
karālā vitatā dīrghā dhamanisnāyusaṃtatāḥ || 7 ||

śiromālāvṛtāḥ kecidāntrapāśāvapāśitāḥ || 8 ||
ḍiṇḍimairaṭṭahāsaiśca nādayanto vasundharām |
kapālino bhairavāśca jaṭilā muṇḍinastathā || 9 ||
evaṃ bahuvidhā ghorāḥ piśācā vikṛtānanāḥ |
tathānye munivīrāśca dhyāyantaḥ parameśvaram || 3.86.10 ||
paṭhanto vedavākyāni sāṅgāni vividhāni ca |
kuṇḍikāsthakarāḥ kecitkecitkuśavicāriṇaḥ|| 1 1||
kaupīnavasanāḥ kecit kecit kārpāsasaṃvṛtāḥ |
stuvantaḥ śaṃkaraṃ bhaktyā stotrairmāheśvaraistathā || 12||
ekatra te munigaṇā aparatra gaṇāstathā |
anyatra siddhagandharvāḥ priyābhiḥ saha saṃgatāḥ || 13||
nṛtyanti nṛtyakuśalā gāyanti sma ca kanyakāḥ |
vidyādharāstathānyatra stuvantaḥ śaṃkaraṃ śivam || 14||
nanṛtustasya purato gacchanto'psarasāṃ gaṇāḥ |
evametairmahāghoraiḥ piśācairbhūtakinnaraiḥ || 15||
munibhiścaiva pramathaiḥ samaṃ śarvaḥ samāyayau |
yatra viśveśvaro viṣṇustapastepe sudāruṇam || 16 ||
yatra te lokapālāśca tiṣṭhanti sma didṛkṣayā |
umayā lokabhāvinyā gaṅgayā candraśekharaḥ || 17||
sa sarvalokaprabhavo bhavo vibhurjaṭī ca sākṣāt praṇavātmakaḥ kṛtī |
draṣṭuṃ hariṃ viṣṇumudāravikramo yayau yatheṣṭaṃ piśitāśanairvṛtaḥ || |8 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kailāsayātrāyāṃ mahādevāgamane ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 86 ||

<3.87>

saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evaṃ bahuvidhairbhūtaiḥ piśācairuragaiḥ saha |
āgatya bhagavān rudraḥ śaṃkaro vṛṣavāhanaḥ || 1 ||
dadarśa viṣṇuṃ deveśaṃ tapantaṃ tapa uttamam |
juhvānamagniṃ vidhivad dravyairmedhyairjagatpatim || 2 ||
garuḍāhṛtakāṣṭhaṃ tu jaṭilaṃ cīravāsasam |
cakreṇānītakusumaṃ khaḍgānītakuśaṃ tathā || 3 ||
gadākṛtasamācāraṃ devadevaṃ janārdanam |
indrādyairdevasaṃghaiśca vṛtaṃ munigaṇaiḥ saha || 4 ||
acintyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dhyāyantaṃ kimapi prabhum |
avaruhya vṛṣāccharvo bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ || 5 ||
tataḥ prītaḥ prasannātmā lalāṭākṣa umāpatiḥ |
tato bhūtapiśācāśca rākṣasā guhyakāstathā || 6 ||
munayo vipravaryāśca jayaśabdaṃ pracakrire |
jaya deva jagannātha jaya rudra janārdana || 7 ||

ādideva jagannātha jaya śaṃkara bhāvana |
jaya kaustubhadīptāṅga jaya bhasmavirājita || 9 ||
jaya cakragadāpāṇe jaya śūliṃstrilocana |
jaya mauktikadīptāṅga jaya nāgavibhūṣaṇa || 3.87.10 ||
iti te munayaḥ sarve praṇāmaṃ cakrire harim |
tata utthāya bhagavān dṛṣṭvā devamavasthitam || 11 ||

śrībhagavānuvāca
namaste śitikaṇṭhāya nīlagrīvāya vedhase |
namaste śociṣe astu namaste upavāsine || 13 ||
namaste mīḍhuṣe astu namaste gadine hara |
namaste viśvatanave vṛṣāya vṛṣarūpiṇe || 14 ||
amūrtāya ca devāya namante'stu pinākine |
namaḥ kubjāya kūpāya śivāya śivarūpiṇe || 15 ||
namastuṣṭāya tuṇḍāya namastuṭituṭāya ca |
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya giriśāya ca te namaḥ|| 16 ||

namo'ghorāya ghorāya ghorāghorapriyāya ca || 17 ||
namo'ghaṇṭāya ghaṇṭāya namo ghaṭighaṭāya ca |
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya giriśāya ca te namaḥ || 18 ||
namo virūparūpāya purāya purahāriṇe |
nama ādyāya bījāya śucaye'ṣṭasvarūpiṇe || 19 ||
namaḥ pinākahastāya namaḥ śūlāsidhāriṇe |
namaḥ khaṭvāṅgahastāya namaste kṛttivāsase || 3.87.20 ||
namaste devadevāya nama ākāśamūrtaye |
harāya harirūpāya namaste tigmatejase || 21 ||
bhaktapriyāya bhaktāya bhaktānāṃ varadāyine |
namo'bhramūrtaye deva jaganmūrtidharāya ca || 22 ||
namaścandrāya devāya sūryāya ca namo namaḥ | |
namaḥ pradhānadevāya bhūtānāṃ pataye namaḥ || 23 ||
karālāya ca muṇḍāya vikṛtāya kapardine |
ajāya ca namastubhyaṃ bhūtabhāvanabhāvana || 24 ||
namo'stu harikeśāya piṃgalāya namo namaḥ |
namaste'bhīṣuhastāya bhīrubhīruharāya ca || 25 ||
harāya bhītirūpāya ghorāṇāṃ bhītidāyine | |
namo dakṣamakhaghnāya bhaganetrāpahāriṇe || 26 ||
umāpate namastubhyaṃ kailāsanilayāya ca |
ādidevāya devāya bhavāya bhavarūpiṇe || 27 ||
namaḥ kapālahastāya namo'jamathanāya ca |
tryambakāya namastubhyaṃ tryakṣāya ca śivāya ca|| 28 ||

namaste śaktiyuktāya nāgapāśapriyāya ca |
virūpāya surūpāya bhadrapānapriyāya ca || 3.87.30 ||
śmaśānarataye nityaṃ jayaśabdapriyāya ca |
svarapriyāya kharvāya kharāya khararūpiṇe || 31 ||
bhadrapriyāya bhadrāya bhadrarūpadharāya ca |
virūpāya surūpāya mahāghorāya te namaḥ || 32 ||
ghaṇṭāya ghaṇṭabhūṣāya ghaṇṭabhūṣaṇabhūṣiṇe |
tīvrāya tīvrarūpāya tīvrarūpapriyāya ca || 33 ||
nagnāya nagnarūpāya nagnarūpapriyāya ca |

kā nu vākstutirūpā te ko nu stotuṃ praśaknuyāt|

kṣamasva bhagavan deva bhakto'haṃ trāhi māṃ hara |

iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kailāsayātrāyāṃ viṣṇukṛteśvarastutau saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 87 ||

<3.88>

aṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tato vṛṣadhvajo devaḥ śūlī sākṣādumāpatiḥ |
karaṃ kareṇa saṃspṛśya viṣṇoścakradharasya ha || 1 ||
provāca bhagavān rudraḥ keśavaṃ garuḍadhvajam |
śṛṇvatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām|| 2 ||
kimidaṃ devadeveśa cakrapāṇe janārdana |
tapaścaryā kimarthaṃ te prārthanā tava kā vibho || 3 ||
svayaṃ viṣṇurbhavānnityastapastvaṃ tapasāṃ hare |
putrārthaṃ yadi te deva tapaścaryā janārdana || 4 ||
putro datto mayā deva pūrvameva jagatpate |
śṛṇu tatrāpi bhagavan kāraṇaṃ kāraṇātmaka || 5 ||
tapaścartuṃ pravṛtto'haṃ kutaścit kāraṇāddhare |
varṣāyutaṃ mahāghoraṃ purā kṛtayuge tadā || 6 ||
bhavānī tatra me deva paricartuṃ tadābhavat |
pitrā niyuktā deveśa umaiṣā varavarṇinī || 7 ||
bhīta indrastadā deva māraṃ māṃ praiṣayattadā |

tataḥ kruddho'hamabhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā māraṃ tathāvidham |
kruddhyato mama deveśa netrādagniḥ papāta ha || 3.88.10 ||
so'yamagnistadā māraṃ bhasmasātkṛtavān hare |
acintayaṃ tadā viṣṇo śakrasyaitaccikīrṣitam || 11 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti deveśa dayā taṃ prati vartate |
brahmaṇā ca niyukto'smi prītastatra janārdana || 12 ||
niyuktaḥ putrarūpeṇa sa te deva jagatpate |
jyeṣṭhastava suto deva pradyumnetyabhiviśrutaḥ || 13 |
smaraṃ taṃ viddhi deveśa nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
ityuktvā punarāhedaṃ yāthātmyaṃ darśayanniva || 14||
munīnāṃ śrotukāmānāṃ yāthātmyaṃ tatra sattamaḥ |
añjaliṃ sampuṭaṃ kṛtvā viṣṇumuddiśya śaṃkaraḥ|| 15 ||
umayā sārdhamīśāno yāthātmyaṃ vaktumaihata |
hare kurvati tatraivamañjaliṃ kurusattama || 16 ||

maheśvara uvāca
yattatkāraṇamāhustatsāṃkhyāḥ prakṛtisaṃjñakam|

sattvaṃ rajastamo viṣṇo jagadaṇḍaṃ janārdana || 19 ||
tasya kāraṇamāhustvāṃ sāṃkhyaprakṛtisaṃjñakam|
tadrūpeṇa bhavān viṣṇo pariṇamyādhitiṣṭhati|| 3.88.20 ||
tasmāttu mahato ghorādahaṃkāro mahānabhūt |
sa tvamādau jagannātha pariṇāmastathā hi saḥ || 21 ||
ahaṃkārāt prabho deva karaṇāni mahānti ca |
tanmātrāṇi tathā pañca bhūtāni prabhavantyuta || 22 ||
tāni tvāmāhurīśānaṃ bhūtānīha jagatpate |
pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam || 23 ||
cakṣurghrāṇaṃ tathā sparśo rasanaṃ śrotrameva ca |
manaḥ ṣaṣṭhaṃ tathā deva prerakaṃ tatra tatra ha || 24 ||
karmendriyāṇi cānyāni vāgādīni janārdana |
tvameva tāni sarvāṇi karoṣi niyatātmavān || 25 ||
sveṣu sveṣu jagannātha viṣayeṣu tathā hare |

yadāca sattvayukto'si tadā pātā jagattrayam|| 27 ||
yadā tvaṃ tamasā''kṛṣṭastadā saṃharase jagat |

tasmāt sarvatra bhūteṣu vartate sarvabhogavān || 3.88.30 ||

bhūmirāpo'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca |

sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt |

bhūmiṃ sarvāmimāṃ prāpya saptadvīpāṃ sasāgarām |

prādurāsītpurāṇātman ṣaṭkarmanirataḥ sadā || 36 ||
rājanyastu tathā bāhvorāsīt saṃrakṣaṇe rataḥ |
ūrvorvaiśyastathā viṣṇo pādācchūdra udāhṛtaḥ || 37 ||
evaṃ varṇā jagannātha tava dehājjanārdana |
manasastava deveśa candramāḥ samapadyata || 38 ||
sukhakṛt sarvabhūtānāṃ śītāṃśuramitaprabhaḥ |
akṣṇoḥ sūryaḥ samutpannaḥ sarvaprāṇivilocanaḥ|| 39 ||
yasya bhāsā jagat sarvaṃ bhāsate bhānumānasau |
mukhādindraśca agniśca prāṇād vāyurajāyata || 3.88.40 ||
nābherabhūdantarikṣaṃ tava deva janārdana |
dyaurāsīt tu mahāghorā śirasastava gopate || 41 ||
padbhyāṃ bhūmiḥ samutpannā diśaḥ śrotrājjagatpate |
eva sṛṣṭvā jagatsarvaṃ vyāpya sarvaṃ vyavasthitaḥ || 42 ||
vyāpya sarvānimām̐llokān sthitaḥ sarvatra keśava |
tataśca viṣṇunāmāsi dhātorvyāpteśca darśanāt || 43 ||
nārā āpaḥ samākhyātāstāsāmayanamāditaḥ |
yatastvaṃ bhūtabhavyeśa tannārāyaṇaśabditaḥ || 44 ||
harasi prāṇino deva tato haririti smṛtaḥ |
śaṃkaro'si sadā deva tataḥ śaṃkaratāṃ gataḥ || 45 ||
bṛhattvād bṛṃhaṇatvācca tasmād brahmeti śabditaḥ |
madhurindriyanāmeti tato madhuniṣūdanaḥ || 46 ||
hṛṣīkāṇīndriyāṇyāhusteṣāmīśo yato bhavān|
hṛṣīkeśastato viṣṇo khyāto deveṣu keśava || 47 ||
ka iti brahmaṇo nāma īśo'haṃ sarvadehinām |
āvāṃ tavāṅgasambhūtau tasmātkeśavanāmavān || 48 ||
mā vidyā ca hare proktā tasyā īśo yato bhavān |
tasmānmādhavanāmāsi dhavaḥ svāmītibditaḥ || 49 ||
gaureṣā tu yato vāṇī tāṃ ca veda yato bhavān |
govindastu tato deva munibhiḥ kathyate bhavān || 3.88.50 ||
trirityeva trayo vedāḥ kīrtitā munisattamaiḥ |
kramate tāṃstathā sarvāṃstrivikrama iti śrutaḥ || 51 ||
aṇurvāmananāmāsi yatastvaṃ vāmanākhyayā |
mananānmunirevāsi yamanād yatirucyase || 52 ||
tapaścarasi yasmāttvaṃ tapasvīti ca śabditaḥ |
vasanti tvayi bhūtāni bhūtāvāsastato hare || 53 ||
īśastvaṃ sarvabhūtānāmīśvaro'si tato hare |
praṇavaḥ sarvavedānāṃ gāyatrī chandasāṃ prabho || 54 ||
akṣarāṇāmakārastvaṃ sphoṭastvaṃ varṇasaṃśrayaḥ |
rudrāṇāmahamevāsi vasūnāṃ pāvako bhavān || 55 ||
aśvattho vṛkṣajātīnāṃ brahmā lokagururbhavān |
merustvaṃ parvatendrāṇāṃ devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ || 56 ||
dānavānāṃ bhavān daityaḥ prahrādo bhaktavatsalaḥ |
sarpāṇāmeva sarveṣāṃ bhavān vāsukisaṃjñitaḥ || 57 ||
guhyakānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ bhavān dhanada eva ca |
varuṇo yādasāṃ rājā gaṅgā tripathabhāg bhavān || 58 ||
ādistvaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ madhyamantastathā bhavān |
tvattaḥ samabhavad viśvaṃ tvayi sarvaṃ pralīyate || 59 ||
ahaṃ tvaṃ sarvago deva tvamevāhaṃ janārdana |
āvayorantaraṃ nāsti śabdairarthairjagatpate || 3.88.60 ||
nāmāni tava govinda yāni loke mahānti ca |
tānyeva mama nāmāni nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 61 ||
tvadupāsā jagannātha saivāsti mama gopate |
yaśca tvāṃ dveṣṭi deveśa sa māṃ dveṣṭi na saṃśayaḥ || 62 ||
tvadvistāro yato deva ahaṃ bhūtapatistataḥ |
na tadasti vinā deva yat te virahitaṃ hare || 63 ||
yadāsīd vartate yacca yacca bhāvi jagatpate |
sarve tvameva deveśa vinā kiṃcittvayā na hi || 64 ||
stuvanti devāḥ satataṃ bhavantaṃ svairguṇaiḥ prabho |
ṛkca tvaṃ yajurevāsi sāmāsi satataṃ prabho || 65 ||
kimucyate mayā deva sarvaṃ tvaṃ bhūtabhāvana |
namaḥ sarvātmanā deva viṣṇo mādhava keśava || 66 ||
namaskaromi sarvātman namaste'stu sadā hare |
namaḥ puṣkaranābhāya vande tvāmahamīśbara || 67 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kailāsayātrāyāṃ śivakṛtaviṣṇustutau aṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 88 ||

<3.89>

ekonanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
ityuktvā devadeveśaṃ munīnāha punaḥ śivaḥ |
evaṃ jānīta he viprā ye bhaktā draṣṭumāgatāḥ || 1 ||
etadeva paraṃ vastu naitasmāt paramasti vaḥ |
etadeva vijānīdhvametad vaḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ || 2 ||
etadeva sadā viprā dhyeyaṃ satatamānasaiḥ |
etad vaḥ paramaṃ śreya etad vaḥ paramaṃ dhanam || 3 ||
etad vo janmanaḥ kṛtyametad vastapasaḥ phalam |
eṣa vaḥ puṇyanilaya eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || 4 ||
eṣa vo mokṣadātā ca eṣa mārga udāhṛtaḥ |
eṣa puṇyapradaḥ sākṣādetat ca karmaṇaḥ phalam || 5 ||
etadeva praśaṃsanti vidvāṃso brahmavādinaḥ |
eṣa trayīgatirviprāḥ prārthyo brahmavidāṃ sadā || 6 ||
etadeva praśaṃsanti sāṃkhyayogasamāśritāḥ |
eṣa brahmavidāṃ mārgaḥ kathito vedavādibhiḥ || 7 ||
evameva vijānīta nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
harirekaḥ sadā dhyeyo bhavadbhiḥ sattvamāsthitaiḥ || 8 ||
nānyo jagati devo'sti viṣṇornārāyaṇātparaḥ|
omityevaṃ sadā viprāḥ paṭhata dhyāta keśavam || 9 || |
tato niḥśreyasaprāptirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ |
evaṃ dhyāto hariḥ sākṣātprasanno vo bhaviṣyati|| 3.89.10 ||
bhavanāśamayaṃ devaḥ kariṣyati dṛḍhaṃ hariḥ |
sadā dhyāta hariṃ viprā yadīccha prāptumacyutam || 11 ||
eṣa saṃsāravibhavaṃ vināśayati vo guruḥ |
smaradhvaṃ satataṃ viṣṇuṃ paṭhadhvaṃ triśarīriṇam || 12 ||
manaḥsaṃyamanaṃ viprāḥ kurudhvaṃ yatnataḥ sadā |
śuddhe'ntaḥkaraṇe viṣṇuḥ prasīdati tapodhanāḥ || 13 ||
dhyātvā māṃ sarvayatnena tato jānīta keśavam |
upāsyo'haṃ sadā viprā upāsye'smin harī smṛtaḥ|| 14||
upāyo'yaṃ mayā prokto nātra saṃdeha ityapi |
ayaṃ māyī sadā viprā yatadhvamaghanāśane || 15 ||
yathā vo buddhirakhilā śuddhā bhavati yatnataḥ |
tathā kuruta viprendrā yathā devaḥ prasīdati || 16 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evamuktāstataḥ sarve munayaḥ puṇyaśīlinaḥ |
yathāvadupagṛhṇānā nirasan saṃśayaṃ nṛpa || 17 ||
evameveti taṃ viprāḥ prāhuḥ prāñjalayo haram |
chinno naḥ saṃśayaḥ sarvo gṛhīto'rthaḥ sa tādṛśaḥ|| 18 ||
etadarthaṃ samāyātā vayamadya tavālayam |
saṃgamād yuvayoḥ sarvo naṣṭo moho mahāniha || 19 ||
yathā vadasi deveśa tathā naḥ śreyase param |
yathā''ha bhagavān rudro yatāmaḥ satataṃ harau |
iti te munayaḥ prītāḥ praṇemuḥ keśavaṃ harim || 3.89.20 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi ṛṣyupadeśe ekonanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 89 ||

<3.90>

navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ sa bhagavānrudraḥ sarvānvismāpayanniva |
stutyā pracakrame stotuṃ viṣṇuṃ viśveśvaraṃ harim |
arthyābhistu tadā vāgbhirmunīnāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tathā|| 1 ||
maheśvara uvāca
namo bhagavate tubhyaṃ vāsudevāya dhīmate |
yasya bhāsā jagat sarvaṃ bhāsate nityamacyuta || 2 ||
namo bhagavate deva nityaṃ sūryātmane namaḥ |
yaḥ śītayati śītāṃśurlokān sarvānimān vibhuḥ|| 3 ||
namaste viṣṇave deva nityaṃ somātmane namaḥ |
yaḥ prajāḥ prīṇayatyeko viśvātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ || 4 ||
namaḥ sarvātmane deva namo vāgātmane hare |
yo dadhāra kareṇāsau kuśacīrādi yat sadā || 5 ||
dadhāra vedān sarvāṃśca tubhyaṃ brahmātmane namaḥ |
sarvān saṃharate yastu saṃhāre viśvadṛk sadā || 6 ||
krodhātmāsi virūpo'si tubhyaṃ rudrātmane namaḥ |
sṛṣṭau sraṣṭā samastānāṃ prāṇināṃ prāṇadāyine || 7 ||
ajāya viṣṇave tubhyaṃ sraṣṭre viśvasṛje namaḥ |
ādau prakṛtimūlāya bhūtānāṃ prabhavāya ca || 8 ||
namaste devadeveśa pradhānāya namo namaḥ |
pṛthivyāṃ gandharūpeṇa saṃsthitaḥ prāṇināṃ hare || 9 ||
dṛḍhāya dṛḍharūpāya tubhyaṃ gandhātmane namaḥ |
apāṃ rasāya sarvatra prāṇināṃ sukhahetave || 3.90.10 ||
namaste viśvarūpāya rasāya ca namo namaḥ |
tejasā bhāskaro yastu ghṛṇirjantuhitaḥ sadā || 11 ||
tasmai deva jagannātha namo bhāskararūpiṇe |
vāyoḥ sparśaguṇo yatra śītoṣṇasukhaduḥkhadaḥ || 12 ||
namaste vāyurūpāya namaḥ sparśātmane hare |
ākāśe'vasthitaḥ śabdaḥ sarvaśrotraniveśanaḥ || 13 ||
yo dadhāra jagat sarvaṃ māyāmānuṣadehavān || 14 ||
namastubhyaṃ jagannātha māyine'māyadāyine |
nama ādyāya bījāya nirguṇāya guṇātmane || 15 ||
acintyāya sucintyāya tasmai cintyātmane namaḥ|
harāya harirūpāya brahmaṇe brahmadāyine || 16 ||
namo brahmavide tubhyaṃ brahmabrahmātmane namaḥ |
namaḥ sahasraśirase sahasrakiraṇāya ca || 17 ||
namaḥ sahasravaktrāya sahasranayanāya ca |
viśvāya viśvarūpāya viśvakartre namo namaḥ || 18 ||
viśvavaktre namo nityaṃ bhūtāvāsa namo namaḥ |
indriyāyendrarūpāya viṣayāya sadā hare || 19 ||
namo'śvaśirase tubhyaṃ vedābharaṇarūpiṇe |
agnaye'gnipate tubhyaṃ jyotiṣāṃ pataye namaḥ || 3.90.20 ||
sūryāya sūryaputrāya tejasāṃ pataye namaḥ |
namaḥ somāya saumyāya namaḥ śītātmane hare || 21 ||
namo vaṣaṭkṛte tubhyaṃ svāhāsvadhāsvarūpiṇe |
namo yajñāya ijyāya haviṣe havyasaṃskṛte |
namaḥ sruvāya pātrāya yajñāṅgāya parāya ca || 22 ||
namaḥ praṇavadehāya kṣarāyāpyakṣarāya ca |
vedāya vedarūpāya śastriṇe śastrarūpiṇe || 23 ||
gadine khaḍgine tubhyaṃ śaṅkhine cakriṇe namaḥ |
śūline carmiṇe nitya varadāya namo namaḥ || 24 ||
buddhipriyāya buddhāya prabuddhāya sukhāya ca |
haraye viṣṇave tubhyaṃ namaḥ sarvātmane guro|| 25 ||
namaste sarvalokeśa sarvakartre namo namaḥ |
nabhaḥ svabhāvaśuddhāya namaste yajñasūkara || 26 ||
namo viṣṇo namo viṣṇo namo viṣṇo namo hare |
namaste vāsudevāya vāsudevāya dhīmate || 27 ||
namaḥ kṛṣṇāya kṛṣṇāya sarvāvāsa namo namaḥ |
namo bhūyo namaste'stu pāhi lokān janārdana|| 28 ||
iti stutvā jagannāthamuvāca munisattamān |
idaṃ stotramadhīyānā nityaṃ vrajata keśavam || 29 ||
śaraṇyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tatra śreyo vidhāsyati |
ye cemaṃ dhārayiṣyanti stavaṃ pāpavimocanam || 3.90.30 ||
teṣāṃ prītaḥ prasannātmā paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ hariḥ |
śreyo dāsyati dharmātmā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā|| 31 ||
avaśyaṃ manasā dhyāta keśavaṃ bhaktavatsalam |
śreyaḥ prāptuṃ yadīcchanti bhavantaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ || 32 ||
ityuktvā bhagavān rudrastatraivāntaradhīyata |
sagaṇaḥ śaṃkaraḥ sākṣādumayā bhūtabhāvanaḥ || 33 ||
nemustaṃ munayaḥ sarve parāṃ nirvṛtimāyayuḥ |
tameva paramaṃ tattvaṃ matvā nārāyaṇaṃ harim |
vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatvā menire svakṛtārthatām || 34 ||
lokapālāstadā viṣṇuṃ namaskṛtya hariṃ mudā |
jagmuḥ svānyatha veśmāni gaṇaiḥ sarvairnṛpottama || 35 ||
āruhya bhagavān viṣṇurgaruḍaṃ pakṣipuṅgavam |
śaṅkhī cakrī gadī khaḍgī śārṅgī tūṇī tanutravān || 36 ||
yathāgataṃ jagannātho yayau badarikāmanu |
sāyāhne puṇḍarīkākṣo nityaṃ muniniṣevitām || 37 ||
tatra gatvā yathāyogaṃ vinamya harirīśvaraḥ |
arcito munibhiḥ sarvairniṣasāda sukhāsane || 38 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kailāsayātrāyāṃ kṛṣṇapratyāgamane navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 90 ||

<3.91>

ekanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
etasminneva kāle tu pauṇḍro nṛpavarottamaḥ |
balavān sattvasampanno yoddhā vipulavikramaḥ || 1 ||
vṛṣṇiśatrustadā rājā kṛṣṇadveṣī balāt tadā |
nṛpān sarvān samāhūya provāca nṛpasaṃsadi || 2 ||
jitā ca pṛthivī sarvā jitāśca nṛpasattamāḥ |
vṛṣṇayaste balonmattāḥ kṛṣṇamāśritya garvitāḥ || 3 ||
dāsyanti me karaṃ sarve na hi te kṛṣṇasaṃśrayāt |
sa tu kṛṣṇaścakrabalānmāmavajñāya tiṣṭhati || 4 ||
ahaṃ cakrīti garvo'bhūttasya gopasya sarvadā |
śaṅkhī cakrī gadī śārṅgī śarī tūṇī sahāyavān || 5 ||
evamādirmahāgarvastasya samprati vartate |
loke ca mama yannāma vāsudeveti viśrutam || 6 ||
agṛhṇānmama tannāma gopo madabalānvitaḥ |
tasya cakrasya yaccakraṃ mamāpi niśitaṃ mahat || 7 ||
garvahantṛ sadā tasya nāmnā cāpi sudarśanam |
sahasrāraṃ mahāghoraṃ tasya cakrasya nāśanam || 8 ||
anekamahataṃ cakraṃ gopajasya nṛpottamāḥ |
mamāpyetad dhanurdivyaṃ śārṅgaṃ nāma mahāravam || 9 ||
gadā kaumodakī nāma mameyaṃ bṛhatī dṛḍhā |
kālāyasasahasrasya bhāreṇa sukṛtā mayā || 3.91.10 ||
khaḍgo nandakanāmāsau mamāyaṃ vipulo dṛḍhaḥ |
antakasyāntako ghorastasya khaḍgasya nāśakaḥ || 11 ||
tatrāhaṃ ca gadī khaḍgī śaṅkhī cakrī tanutravān |
yudhi jetā ca kṛṣṇasya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 12 ||
māṃ ca brūta nṛpāścaiva gadinaṃ cakriṇaṃ tathā |
śaṅkhinaṃ śārṅgiṇaṃ vīraṃ brūta nityaṃ nṛpottamāḥ || 13 ||
vāsudeveti māṃ brūta na tu gopaṃ yadūttamam |
eko'haṃ vāsudevo hi hatvā taṃ gopadārakam || 14 ||
sakhyurmama balāddhantā narakasya mahātmanaḥ |
māṃ tathā yadi na brūta daṇḍyā bhāraśataiḥ śatam|| 15 ||
suvarṇasya ca niṣkasya dhānyasya bahuśastadā |
tathā bruvati rājendre manasā dussahaṃ yathā || 16 ||
kecillajjāsamāyuktā āsaṃste balavattarāḥ |
rasajñā balavīryasya rājānaste sadā nṛpa || 17 ||
apare tu nṛpā rājannevameveti cukruśuḥ |
anye balamadotsiktā jeṣyāmaḥ keśavaṃ raṇe || 18 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṇḍrakoktau ekanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 91 ||

<3.92>

dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ kailāsaśikharānnirgato munisattamaḥ |
nāradaḥ sarvalokajñaḥ pauṇḍrasya nagaraṃ prati || 1 ||
avatīrya nabhobhāgāt pratyāgamya narottamam |
dvāḥsthena ca samājñaptaḥ praviveśa gṛhottamam || 2 ||
arghyādisamudācāraṃ nṛpāllabdhvā mahāmuniḥ |
niṣasādāsane śubhre hyāstṛte śubhavāsasā || 3 ||
kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭavānbhūyo nṛpaḥ sa munisattamam |
uvāca nāradaṃ bhūyaḥ pauṇḍrako balagarvitaḥ || 4 ||
bhavān sarvatra kuśalaḥ sarvakāryeṣu paṇḍitaḥ |
prathito devasiddheṣu gandharveṣu mahātmasu || 5 ||
sarvatrago nirābādho gatvā sarvatra sarvadā |
agamyaṃ tava viprendra brahmāṇḍe na hi kiṃcana |
nāradedaṃ vada tvaṃ hi yatra yatra gato bhavān || 6 ||
tatra tatra tapaḥsiddho loke prathitavīryavān |
pauṇḍra eva ca vikhyāto vāsudeveti śabditaḥ || 7 ||
śaṅkhī cakrī gadī śārṅgī khaḍgī tūṇī tanutravān |
vijetā rājasiṃhānāṃ dātā sarvasya sarvadā || 8 ||
bhoktā rājyasya sarvasya śāstā rājā balād balī |
ajeyaḥ śatrusainyānāṃ rakṣitā svajanasya ca || 9 ||
yo'dya gopakanāmāsau vāsudeveti śabditaḥ |
tasya vīryabale na sto nāmno'sya mama dhāraṇe || 3.92.10 ||
sa hi gopo vṛthā bālyāddhārayatyeva nāma me |
idaṃ niścinu viprendra eka eva bhavāmyaham || 11 ||
vāsudevo jagatyasmin nirjitya balinaṃ yadum |
vṛṣṇīnsarvān balāt kṣiptvā nihaniṣye ca tāṃ purīm ||
dvārakāṃ viṣṇunilayāṃ yoddhā cāhaṃ mahāmate |
ete ca balinaḥ sarve nṛpā mama samāgatāḥ || 13 ||
aśvāśca veginaḥ santi rathā vāyujavā mama |
uṣṭrā mattāḥ sahasraṃ ca gajā niyutameva ca || 14 ||
etenāhaṃ balenājau haniṣye keśavaṃ raṇe |
tasmādevaṃ sadā vipra vada brahman pure mama || 15 ||
indrasyāpi sadā vipra vada nārada sāmpratam |
prārthanaiṣā mama vibho namasye tvāṃ tapodhana || 16 ||
nārada uvāca
sarvatragaḥ sadā cāsmi yāvad brahmāṇḍasaṃsthitiḥ |
ācāryaḥ sarvakāryeṣu gamane kenacinnṛpa || 17 ||
kiṃ nu vaktuṃ tathā rājannutsahe nṛpasattama |
mahīṃ śāsati deveśe cakrapāṇau janārdane || 18 ||
viṣṇau sarvatrage deve duṣṭān hatvā sabāndhavān |
vāsudeveti ko nāma tiṣṭhatyasmin harāviti || 19 ||
ko nāma vaktumevedaṃ kṛṣṇe śāsati gomatī |
ajñānād vaktumevaṃ ca samarthāḥ prākṛtā janāḥ || 3.92.20 ||
hariḥ sarvatrago viṣṇurdarpaṃ te vyapaneṣyati |
acintyavibhavo viṣṇuḥ śārṅgadhanvā gadādharaḥ || 21
ādidevaḥ purāṇātmā darpa te vyapaneṣyati |
hāsyametanmahārāja yacca vai tatra saṃsthitam || 22 ||
śārṅga khaḍgaṃ tathā rājan mahāghoraṃ na dāpyate |
atīva hrāsakālo'yaṃ tava samprati vartate || 23 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṇḍrakanāradasaṃvāde dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 92 ||

<3.93>

trinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ kruddhau mahārāja pauṇḍro madabalānvitaḥ |
nāradaṃ vipravaryaṃ taṃ provāca nṛpasaṃsadi || 1 ||
kimidaṃ prāha viprarṣe rājāhaṃ ca dvijaiḥ saha |
gaccha tvaṃ kāmamatha vā mune śāpapradaḥ sadā || 2 ||
bhītastvatto mahābuddhe gaccha tvaṃ kāmamadya hi |
ityukto nṛpavaryeṇa tūṣṇīmeva sa nāradaḥ || 3 ||
jagāmākāśagamano yatra tiṣṭhati keśavaḥ |
sa gatvā viṣṇusaṃkāśaṃ viṣṇoḥ sarvaṃ śaśaṃsa ha || 4 ||
tacchrutvā bhagavān viṣṇuryatheṣṭaṃ vadatāmiti |
darpa tasyāpaneṣyāmi śvobhūte dvijasattama || 5 ||
ityuktvā virarāmaiva tasmin badarikāśrame |
tataḥ pauṇḍro mahābāhurbalairbahubhirīśvaraḥ || 6 ||
aśvairanekasāhasrairgajairbahubhiranvitaḥ |
astrakoṭisamāyuktaḥ sa rājā satyasaṃgaraḥ || 7 ||
anekaśatasāhasraiḥ pattibhiśca samanvitaḥ |
ekalavyaprabhṛtibhī rājabhiśca samantataḥ || 8 ||
aṣṭau rathasahasrāṇi nāgānāmayutaṃ tathā |
arbudaṃ pattisaṃghānāṃ tadbalaṃ samapadyata || 9 ||
etena ca balenājau prasphuran nṛpasattamaḥ |
virarāja mahārāja udayastho mahāraviḥ || 3.93.10 ||
sa yayau madhyarātreṇa nagarīṃ dvārakāmanu |
pattayo dīpikāhastā rātrau tamasi dāruṇe || 11 ||
yayurvividhaśūstraughāḥ sampatanto mahābalāḥ |
dvārakāṃ vīryasampannāṃ mahāghorāṃ nṛpottamāḥ || 12 ||
rathaṃ mahāntamāruhya śastraughaiśca samāvṛtam |
paṭṭiśāsisamākīrṇaṃ gadāparighasaṃkulam || 13 ||
śaktitomarasaṃkīrṇaṃ dhvajamālāsamācitam |
kiṅkiṇījālasaṃyuktaṃ śarāsiprāsasaṃyutam || 14 ||
mahāghoraṃ mahāraudraṃ yugāntajaladopamam |
dhanurgadāsamākīrṇaṃ mahāvādyopamaṃ mahat || 15 ||
agnyarkasadṛśākāraṃ yayau dvāravatīmanu |
gṛhītadīpiko rājā vīryavān balavān nṛpa || 16 ||
hantumaicchajjagannāthaṃ vṛṣṇīṃścaiva samantataḥ |
ākarṣan balamukhyāṃstān rājñaḥ sarvānmahādyutiḥ| 17|
puradvāraṃ samāsādya balaṃ saṃsthāpya yatnataḥ |
idaṃ provāca rājā tu nṛpān sarvānavasthitān || 18 ||
tāḍyatāmatra bherī tu nāma viśrāvya māmakam |
yudhyatāṃ yudhyatāmatra deyaṃ vā pratidīyatām || 19 ||
āgataḥ pauṇḍrako rājā yuddhārthī vīryavattaraḥ |
hantukāmaḥ samagrān vaḥ kṛṣṇabāhubalāśrayān || 3.93.20 ||
iti te preṣitāḥ sarve samīyuḥ sūcakān bahūn |
dīpikāśca pradīpyante bahvyaḥ śatasahasraśaḥ || 21 ||
itaścetaśca rājāno yudhyante yuddhalālasāḥ |
purīṃ te puratastatra kṣatriyāḥ śastriṇastadā || 22 ||
siṃhanādaṃ prakurvantaḥ śastradhārāsamākulāḥ |
kuto'yaṃ vṛṣṇipravaraḥ kuto rājā jagatpatiḥ || 23 ||
kuto'yaṃ sātyakirvīraḥ kuto hārdikya eva ca |
kuto nu balabhadraśca sarvayādavasattamaḥ |
ityevaṃ kathayanto vai rājānaḥ sarva eva te || 24 ||
ādāya śastrāṇi bahūni sarvataḥ śarāṃśca cāpāni bahūni sarve |
yuddhāya sannāhanibaddhaśo yayurhareḥ purīṃ dvāravatīṃ nṛpottamāḥ || 25 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṇḍrakasya dvārakāgamane trinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 93 ||

<3.94>

caturnavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataśca yādavāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā sainikasaṃcayam |
rātrau va vyasanaṃ prāptaṃ mahāśastrasamākulam || 1 ||
mahāvātasamudbhūtaṃ kalpānte sāgaropamam |
saṃnaddhāḥ samapadyanta śastriṇo yuddhalālasāḥ || 2 ||
gṛhītadīpikāḥ sarve yādavāḥ śastrayodhinaḥ |
sātyakirbalabhadraśca hārdikyo niśaṭhastathā || 3 ||
uddhavo'tha mahābuddhirugraseno mahābalaḥ |
anye ca yādavāḥ sarve kavacapragrahe ratāḥ || 4 ||
samastayuddhakuśalā rātrau sannāhayodhinaḥ |
śastriṇaḥ khaḍginaścaiva sarve śastrasamākulāḥ || '5 ||
yuddhāya samapadyanta bahavo bāhuśālinaḥ |
rathino gajinaścaiva sādinaḥ sāyudhāstathā || 6 ||
nityayuktā mahātmāno dhanvinaḥ puruṣottamāḥ |
niryayurnagarāt tūrṇaṃ dīpikābhiḥ samantataḥ || 7 ||
kutaḥ pauṇḍraka ityevaṃ vadantaḥ sarvasātvatāḥ |
dīpikādīpito deśo nistamāḥ samapadyata || 8 ||
tato vitimiro deśaḥ samantāt pratyapadyata |
yuddhaṃ samabhavad ghoraṃ vṛṣṇibhiḥ śatrubhiḥ saha || 9 ||
tato mahān samabhavat saṃnādo romaharṣaṇaḥ |
hayā hayaiḥ samāyuktāḥ gajāśca gajayūthapaiḥ || 3.94.10 ||
rathā rathaiḥ samāyuktāḥ sādibhiḥ sādinastathā |
khaḍginaḥ khaḍgibhiḥ sārdhaṃ gadibhirgadinastathā || 11 ||
parasparavyatīkāro raṇa āsīt sudāruṇaḥ |
mahāpralayasaṃkṣobhaḥ śabdasteṣāṃ mahātmanām || 12 ||
dhāvantaḥ praharantyetān ghnantyetān sarvato nṛpān|
ayameṣa mahābāhuḥ khaḍgī patati vīryavān || 13 ||
ayameṣa śaro ghoro vartate'tisudāruṇaḥ |
gadī cāyaṃ mahāvīryaḥ sarvān no bādhate nṛpaḥ || 14 ||
ayaṃ rathī śarī cāpī gadī tūṇī tanutravān|
paṭṭiśī sarvato yāti kuntapāṇirayaṃ balī || 15 ||
ayamatra mahāśūlī saṃśritaḥ sarvato diśam |
gajo'yaṃ saviṣāṇāgro vartate sarvataḥ prati || 16 ||
atisarvatragaḥ śūro vegavān vātasaṃnibhaḥ |
śarāñccharaiḥ samāhanti daṇḍān daṇḍairjagatpate || 17 ||
kuntān kuntaiḥ samājaghnurgadābhiśca gadāstathā|
parighān parighaiḥ sārdhaṃ śūlāñcchūlaiḥ samantataḥ || 18 ||
evaṃ teṣāṃ mahārāja kurvatāṃ raṇamuttamam |
saṃgrāmaḥ sumahānāsīcchabdaścāpi mahānabhūt || 19 ||
bhūtāni subahūnyājau śabdavanti mahānti ca |
prādurāsan sahasrāṇi śaṅkhānāṃ bhīmaniḥsvanaḥ || 3.94.20 ||
rātrau prādurabhūcchabdaḥ saṃgrāme romaharṣaṇaḥ |
vartamāne mahāyuddhe vṛṣṇīnāṃ caiva taiḥ saha || 21 ||
kecid grastāḥ samāpetuḥ pṛthivyāṃ pṛthivīkṣitaḥ|
kecicca patitāḥ kliṣṭāḥ viprakīrṇaśiroruhāḥ || 22 ||
petururvyāṃ mahāvīryā rājānaḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ |
kecit tu bhinnavarmāṇaḥ samāpetuḥ sahasradhā || 23 ||
parasparaṃ samāśritya parasparavadhaiṣiṇaḥ |
nyastaśastrā mahātmānaḥ samantāt kṣatavigrahāḥ || 24 ||
peturgatāsavaḥ kecid yamarāṣṭravivardhanāḥ |
evaṃ te nihatā rājan yodhitāḥ sarva eva tu || 25 ||
etasminnantare śūra ekalavyo niṣādapaḥ |
dhanurgṛhya mahāghoraṃ kālāntakayamopamaḥ || 26 ||
śarairanekasāhasrairardayāmāsa yādavān |
paraḥśataiḥ śarāṇāṃ tu niśitairmarmabhedibhiḥ || 27 || |
vṛṣṇīnāṃ ca balaṃ sarvaṃ pothayāmāsa sarvataḥ |
yuddhyataḥ śastrapāṇīṃśca kṣatriyān vīryavattarān|| 28 ||
niśaṭhaṃ pañcaviṃśatyā śarāṇāṃ nataparvaṇām |
sāraṇaṃ daśabhirviddhvā hārdikyaṃ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ || 29 ||
ugrasenaṃ navatyāśu vasudevaṃ ca saptabhiḥ |
uddhavaṃ daśabhiścaiva hyakrūraṃ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ || 3.94.30 ||
evamekaikaśaḥ sarve nihatā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ |
vidrāvya yādavīṃ senāṃ nāma viśrāvya vīryavān|| 31 ||
ekalavyo yaduvṛṣān vīryavān balavānaham |
idānīṃ sātyakirvīraḥ kva yāsyati mahābalaḥ || 32 ||
madamatto halī sākṣāt kva yātīha gadādharaḥ |
ityāha siṃhanādena siṃhān vismāpayanniva || 33 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṇḍrakavadhe rātriyuddhe caturnavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 94 ||

<3.95>

pañcanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
nivṛtteṣvatha sainyeṣu vṛṣṇivīreṣu caiva hi |
bhīteṣvatha mahārāja hateṣu yudhi sarvataḥ || 1 ||
dīpikāsu praśāntāsu niḥśabde sati sarvataḥ |
jitamityeva yanmatvā vṛṣṇīnāṃ balamuttamam || 2 ||
tataḥ pauṇḍro mahāvīryo babhāṣe sainikān svakān|
śīghraṃ gacchata rājendrāṣṭaṅkaiḥ kuntaiḥ purīmimām || 3 ||
kuṭhāraiḥ kuntalaiścaiva pāṣāṇaiḥ sarvatodiśam |
karṣaṇasthaiḥ supāṣāṇaiḥ sarvato yāta bhūmipāḥ || 4 ||
bhidyantāṃ prākāracayāḥ prāsādāśca samantataḥ |
gṛhyantāṃ kanyakāḥ sarvā dāsyaścaiva samantataḥ|| 5 ||
gṛhyantāṃ vasumukhyāni dhanāni subahūnyatha |
te tatheti mahātmāno rājānaḥ sarva eva tu || 6 ||
kuṭhāraiḥ sarvataścaiva cicchiduḥ pauṇḍrakājñayā |
prākārāṃścaiva sarvatra prāsādān narasaṃcayān || 7 ||
atha tatra mahāśabdaḥ prādurāsīt samantataḥ |
ṭaṅkeṣu pātyamāneṣu prākāreṣu mahābalaiḥ || 8 ||
pūrvadvāre mahārāja bhinnāḥ prākārasaṃcayāḥ |
śrutvā śabdaṃ mahāghoraṃ sātyakiḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ|| 9 ||
mayi sarvaṃ samāropya keśavo yādaveśvaraḥ |
gataḥ kailāsaśikharaṃ draṣṭuṃ śaṃkaramavyayam || 3.95.10 ||
avaśyaṃ hi mayā rakṣyā purī dvāravatī tviyam |
iti saṃcintya manasā dhanurādāya satvaram || 11 ||
rathaṃ mahāntamāruhya dārukasya mahātmanaḥ |
putreṇa saṃskṛtaṃ ghoraṃ yantā ca svayameva hi || 12 ||
dhanurmahat tadādāya śarāṃścāśīviṣopamān |
āmucya kavacaṃ ghoraṃ śastrasampātaduḥsaham || 13 ||
aṅgadī kuṇḍalī tūṇī śarī cāpī gadāsimān |
yayau yuddhāya śaineyaḥ saṃsmaran kaiśavaṃ vacaḥ || 14 ||
dīpikādīpite deśe yayau sātyakiruttamaḥ |
tathaiva baladevo'pi rathamāruhya bhāsvaram || 15 ||
gadī śarī mahāvīryaḥ prāyād raṇacikīrṣayā |
siṃhanādaṃ prakurvanto muñcanto bhairavaṃ ravam || 16 ||
uddhavo'pi balī sākṣād gajamāruhya satvaram |
mattaṃ mahāravaṃ ghoraṃ saṃgrāme nītimattaraḥ || 17 ||
yayau nītiṃ vicinvānaḥ parāṃ prītiṃ mahābalaḥ |
anye ca vṛṣṇayaḥ sarve yayuḥ saṃgrāmalālasāḥ || 18 ||
rathāngajānsamāruhya hārdikyapramukhāstathā |
dīpikābhiśca sarvatra purovṛttābhirīśvarāḥ || 19 ||
siṃhanādaṃ prakurvantaḥ smarantaḥ kaiśavaṃ vacaḥ |
pūrvadvāraṃ samāgamya vṛṣṇayo yuddhalālasāḥ || 3.95.20 ||
te sametya yathāyogaṃ sthitāstatra mahābalāḥ |
sthite sainye mahāghore dīpikādīpite pathi || 21 ||
śinirvīraḥ śarī cāpī gadī tūṇīravānvibho |
vāyavyāstraṃ samādāya yojayitvā mahāśaram || 22 ||
ākarṇaṃ tūrṇamākṛṣya dhanuḥpravaramuttamam |
mumoca parasainyeṣu śinirvīraḥ pratāpavān || 23 ||
vāyavyāstreṇa te sarve tatrasthā narasattamāḥ |
vijitā hyastravīryeṇa yatra tiṣṭhati pauṇḍrakaḥ || 24 ||
tatra gatvā sthitāḥ sarve nirdhūtā vātaraṃhasā |
yatra pūrvaṃ sthitāḥ sarve vidrutā rājasattamāḥ || 25 ||
tatra sthitvā ca śaineyaḥ śaramādāya satvaram |
niśitaṃ sarpabhogābhaṃ babhāṣe sātyakistadā || 26 ||
kva idānīṃ mahābuddhiḥ pauṇḍrako rājasattamaḥ |
sthito'smi vyavasāyena śarī cāpī mahābalaḥ|| 27 ||
yadi draṣṭā durātmānaṃ tato hantā nṛpādhamam |
bhṛtyo'smi keśavasyāhaṃ jighāṃsuḥ pauṇḍrakaṃ sthitaḥ ||28||
chittvā śirastu tasyāsya sarvakṣatrasya paśyataḥ |
baliṃ dāsyāmi gṛdhrebhyaḥ śvabhyaścaiva durātmanaḥ || 29 ||
ko nāma īdṛśaṃ karma cauravacca samācaret |
supteṣu niśi sarvatra yādaveṣu mahātmasu || 3.95.30 ||
cauro'yaṃ sarvathā rājā na hi rājā balānvitaḥ |
yadi śakto na kuryācca cauryamevaṃ nṛpādhamaḥ || 31 ||
aho'sya balino rājñaścaurakāryaṃ prakurvataḥ |
sarvathā''gamanaṃ tasya na hi paśyāmi sāmpratam || 32 ||
ityuktvā sātyakirvīraḥ prajahāsa mahābalaḥ |
visphārya sudṛḍhaṃ cāpaṃ saṃdadhe kārmuke śaram || 33 ||
ākarṇya vacanaṃ vīraḥ sātyakestasya dhīmataḥ |
kva nu kṛṣṇaḥ kva gopālaḥ kutaḥ so'tha pravartate || 34 ||
strīhantā paśuhantā ca kva ca svāmīti sevitaḥ |
sa idānīṃ kva varteta gṛhītvā mama nāma tat || 35 ||
hantā sakhyurmahāvīryo narakasya mahātmanaḥ |
mamaiva tāta yuddhe'sminhate tasmindurātmani || 36 ||
gaccha tvaṃ kāmato vīra yoddhuṃ na kṣamate bhavān |
athavā tiṣṭha kiṃcittu tato draṣṭāsi me balam| 37 ||
śiraste pātayiṣyāmi śarairghorairdurāsadaiḥ |
hatasya tava vīreha bhūmiḥ pāsyati śoṇitam || 38 ||
śroṣyate sa tathā gopo hataḥ sātyakirityapi |
yo garvastasya gopasya sarvadā vartate mahān || 39 ||
vinaśyati sa tu kṣipraṃ hate tvayi yadūttama |
tvayi rakṣāṃ samādiśya gopaḥ kailāsaparvatam || 3.95.40 ||
gata ityevamasmābhiḥ śrutaṃ pūrvaṃ mahāmate |
śaraṃ gṛhāṇa niśitaṃ yadi śakto'si sātyake |
ityuktvā bāṇamādāya yayau yoddhaṃ vyavasthitaḥ|| 41 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe sātyakipauṇḍrakabhāṣaṇe pañcanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 95||

<3.96>

ṣaṇṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ kruddho mahārāja sātyakirvṛṣṇipuṅgavaḥ |
uvāca vacanaṃ rājan vāsudevaṃ smaranniva || 1 ||
avocadīdṛśaṃ vākyaṃ vāsudevaṃ nṛpādhamaḥ |
ko nāma jagatāṃ nāthamitthaṃ brūyājjijīviṣuḥ || 2 ||
mṛtyustvāṃ sarvathā yāti vadantaṃ tādṛśaṃ vacaḥ |
jihvā te śatadhā dīryād vadatastādṛśaṃ vacaḥ || 3 ||
eṣa te pātayiṣyāmi śiraḥ kāyācca pauṇḍraka |
yannāma vāsudeveti tava samprati vartate || 4 ||
yāvat patati kāyātte śirastāvatpravartate |
sa eva śvo na bhagavān vāsudevo bhaviṣyasi || 5 ||
eka eva jagannāthaḥ kartā sarvasya sarvagaḥ |
durātman sarvathā devo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 6 ||
eṣa te'haṃ śiraḥ kāyāt pātayiṣyāmi rājaka |
yadasau bhagavān viṣṇurnāgamiṣyati sāmpratam|| 7 ||
astravīryaṃ balaṃ caiva sarvaṃ darśaya sāmpratam |
nātaḥ parataraṃ rājan vīryaṃ ca tava vartate || 8 ||
sarvaṃ darśaya yatnena sthito'smi vyavasāyavān |
śarī cāpī gadī khaḍgī sarvathāhamupasthitaḥ || 9 ||
naitannagaramāyāsīḥ satyametad bravīmyaham |
sarvathā kṛtakṛtyo'smi dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ vāsudevakam || 3.96.10 ||
tavāṅgaṃ tilaśaḥ kṛtvā śvabhyo dāsyāmi rājaka |
ityuktvā bāṇamādāya vāsudevaṃ mahābalaḥ || 11 ||
ākarṇapūrṇamākṛṣya vivyādha niśitaṃ śaram |
sa tena viddho yadunā vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān || 12 ||
vamañchoṇitamatyuṣṇamaṅgānnetrānnṛpottama |
tataścukrodha nṛpatirvāsudevaḥ pratāpavān || 13 ||
navabhirdaśabhiścaiva śaraiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ |
vivyādha sātyakiṃ rājā nadaṃśca bahudhā kila || 14 ||
tato nārācamādāya niśitaṃ yamasaṃnibham |
dhanurākṛṣya bhagavān vāsudevo nṛpottama || 15 ||
vivyādha sātyakiṃ bhūyo niśi prahrādayan svakān |
nārācena samāviddhaḥ sātyakiḥ satyasaṅgaraḥ || 16 ||
lalāṭe sudṛḍhaṃ vīro vṛṣṇīnāmagraṇīstadā |
niṣasāda rathopasthe niśceṣṭa iva sattamaḥ || 17||
tataḥ sa pauṇḍrako rājā viddhvā daśabhirāśugaiḥ |
sārathiṃ pañcaviṃśatyā hayāṃśca caturo nṛpa || 18 ||
te hayā rudhirāktāṅgāḥ sārathiśca samantataḥ |
vihvalāḥ samapadyanta vāsudevasya paśyataḥ || 19 ||
vāsudevo rathe cāpi siṃhanādaṃ samādade |
tena nādena tatrābhūd vibuddhaḥ sātyakirnṛpa || 3.96.20 ||
viddhān hayāṃstathā dṛṣṭvā sārathiṃ ca tathāgatam |
śaineyo'tha mahāvīryo ruṣito nṛpasattama || 21 ||
alaṃ drakṣyāmi te vīryamityuktvā bāṇamādade |
vivyādha tena bāṇena vakṣasyenaṃ mahābalaḥ || 22 ||
tataścacāla tenājau vāsudevaḥ śareṇa ha |
susrāva rudhiraṃ ghoramatyuṣṇaṃ vakṣaso nṛpa || 23 ||
rathopasthe papātāśu niḥśvasannurago yathā |
kṛtyaṃ cāpi na jānāti kevalaṃ niṣasāda ha || 24 |||
sātyakistu rathaṃ viddhvā daśabhiḥ sāyakaistathā |
dhvajaṃ ciccheda bhallena vāsudevasya vṛṣṇipaḥ || 25 ||
hayāṃśca caturo hatvā bāṇaiḥ sārathimeva ca |
yuyudhāno'tha rājendra pauṇḍrakasya ca paśyataḥ || 26 ||
sāratheśca śiraḥ kāyādaharat sa rathāt tadā |
rathagranthiṃ ca ciccheda hayāśca vyasavo'bhavan || 27 ||
cakraṃ ca tilaśaḥ kṛtvā bāṇairdaśabhirañjasā |
jahāsa vipulaṃ rājan vāsudevaṃ mahābalaḥ || 28 ||
tataḥ paraṃ mahatprāyaṃ sātyakirvṛṣṇinandanaḥ |
śabdaṃ kṛtvā balī sākṣāt sarvakṣatrasya paśyataḥ || 29 ||
śaraiḥ saptatisaṃkhyākairardayāmāsa satvaram |
te śarāḥ śalabhākārā nipetuḥ sarvaśastadā || 3.96.30 ||
śirastaḥ pārśvataścaiva pṛṣṭhataḥ puratastathā |
kevalaṃ dhairyanicayastṛṣārtaḥ śaravān yathā || 31 ||
yathā manasvī riktaśca tathā tiṣṭhati pauṇḍrakaḥ |
tataścukrodha balavān vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān || 32 ||
ardhacandraṃ samādāya vivyādha yudhi sātyakim |
viddhvā saptabhirāyāntaṃ krodhena prasphuranniva || 33 ||
viddho'tha sātyakistena śaraiḥ pañcabhirāśugaiḥ |
cāpaṃ ciccheda pauṇḍrasya siṃhanādaṃ vyanīnadat || 34 ||
vāsudevo gadāṃ gṛhya bhrāmayitvā padātpadam |
tvaritaṃ pātayāmāsa sātyakervakṣasi prabho || 35 ||
savyena tāṃ samākṛṣya kareṇa yadunandanaḥ |
śaraṃ pragṛhya vivyādha sātyakiryudhi pauṇḍrakam || 36 ||
tamantare gṛhītvāśu vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān |
śaktibhirdaśabhiścaiva sātyakiṃ nijaghāna ha || 37 |
tābhirviddho raṇe vīraḥ sātyakiḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ |
apāsya dhanuranyat tad dhanurādāya satvaram |
ājaghāna tadā vīro vṛṣṇīnāmagraṇīrnṛpa || 38 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kailāsayātrāyāṃ pauṇḍrakasātyakiyuddhe ṣaṇṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 96 ||

<3.97>

saptanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ kruddho gadāpāṇiḥ sātyakirvṛṣṇinandanaḥ |
vāsudevaṃ jaghānāśu gadayā tīkṣṇayā nṛpa || 1 ||
sātyakiṃ vāsudevastu gadayābhyahanad balī |
tāvudyatagadau vīrau śuśubhāte sudāruṇau || 2 ||
dṛptau vane yathā siṃhau parasparavadhaiṣiṇau |
tataḥ sa sātyakiḥ kruddhaḥ savyaṃ maṇḍalamāgamat || 3 ||
dakṣiṇaṃ vāsudevastu taṃ jaghāna stanāntare |
yuyudhāno'tha vīrastu bāhvormadhyamatāḍayat || 4 ||
dṛḍhaṃ sa tāḍito vīro jānubhyāmapatad bhuvi |
tata utthāya vīrastu lalāṭe'bhyahanad gadām || 5 ||
viṣaṇṇaḥ kiṃcidāsthāya tata utthāya satvaram |
gadayābhyahanad vīraḥ sātyakiḥ pauṇḍrasattamam || 6 ||
vāsudevo balī vīraḥ sākṣānmṛtyurivāparaḥ |
jaghāna gadayā vṛṣṇiṃ nirdahanniva cakṣuṣā || 7 ||
sa tayā tāḍito vṛṣṇirgadayā bāhumuktayā |
ālambya bhūmiṃ sahasā mṛtyoraṅkagato yathā || 8 ||
saṃjñāṃ punaḥ samālambya pāṇibhyāṃ dṛḍhameva ca |
gadāṃ tasya mahārāja gṛhītvā pragraheṇa ha || 9 ||
dvidhā kṛtvā mahāgurvīṃ gadāṃ kālāyasīṃ śubhām |
utsṛjya sahasā vīraḥ siṃhanādaṃ vyanīnadat || 3.97.10 ||
tata utsṛjya rājā tu vāsudevo mahābalaḥ |
savyena sātyakiṃ gṛhya dakṣiṇena kareṇa ha || 11 ||
muṣṭiṃ kṛtvā mahāghorāṃ vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān |
tāḍayāmāsa madhye tu stanayoḥ sātyakernṛpa || 12 ||
śaineyo vṛṣṇivīrastu gadāmutsṛjya satvaram |
talenābhyahanad vīro vāsudevaṃ raṇājire || 13 ||
talena vāsudevo'pi sātyakiṃ satyasaṃgaram |
tayorevaṃ mahāghoraṃ talayuddhaṃ pravartata || 14 ||
jānubhyāṃ muṣṭibhiścaiva bāhubhyāṃ śirasā tadā |
urasoraḥ samāhatya jānubhyāṃ jānunī tathā || 15 ||
karābhyāṃ karamāhatya tau yuddhaṃ sampracakratuḥ |
tālayostatra rājendra vṛkṣayoḥ saṃnikarṣayoḥ || 16 ||
vane yathā nirutpannastathaivābhūnmahāsvanaḥ |
tāvājau prathitau vīrāvubhau pauṇḍrakasātyakī || 17 ||
niśi stimitamūkāyāṃ śastraṃ tyaktvā mahābalau |
yuyudhāte mahāraṅge mallau dvāviva viśrutau || 18 ||
ubhe sene mahārājñoḥ saṃśayaṃ jagmatustadā |
kiṃ nu syāt sātyakirvīro hatastena bhaviṣyati || 19 ||
āhosvid vāsudevastu hatastena mahātmanā |
adya vai tau mahāvīrau parasparavadhaiṣiṇau || 3.97.20 ||
yudhyamānau mahāvīrau tadā svargaṃ gamiṣyataḥ |
anyathā noparamyetāṃ yuddhād vīrau suniścitau || 21 ||
aho vīryamaho dhairyametayorbalaśālinoḥ |
etau mahābalau loke etau prakṛtisattamau || 22 ||
naivaṃ yuddhaṃ mahāghoramāsīd devāsureṣvapi |
na śruto na ca vā dṛṣṭaḥ saṃgrāmo'yaṃ kadācana || 23 ||
ete vai sainikā brūyuḥ senayorubhayorapi |
rātrau niśīthe meghaughe dṛṣṭvā yuddhaṃ sudāruṇam || 24 ||
atha tau bāhubhirvīrau sanipetaturañjasā |
daśabhirmuṣṭibhirjaghne sātyakiḥ pauṇḍrakaṃ tadā || 25 ||
pañcabhiḥ sātyakiṃ pauṇḍraḥ samājaghne mahābalaḥ |
tayoścaṭacaṭāśabdo brahmāṇḍakṣobhaṇo mahān |
prādurāsīt tu sarvatra sarvān vismāpayanniva || 26 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṇḍrakasātyakiyuddhe saptanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 97 ||

<3.98>

aṣṭanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
etasminnantare kruddha ekalavyo niṣādapaḥ |
balabhadramabhi kṣipraṃ dhanurādāya satvaram || 1 ||
nārācairdaśabhirviddhvā bāṇaiśca daśabhiḥ paraiḥ |
ciccheda dhanurardhaṃ tat sarvakṣatrasya paśyataḥ || 2 ||
sūtaṃ daśabhirāhatya rathaṃ triṃśadbhireva ca |
dhvajaṃ ciccheda bhallena niṣādasya jagatpatiḥ || 3 ||
tataḥ paraṃ mahaccāpaṃ niṣādo vīryasammataḥ |
dṛḍhamaurvyā samāyuktaṃ daśatālapramāṇataḥ || 4 ||
kāmapālaṃ śareṇāśu jaghāna janamadhyataḥ |
baladevo mahāvīryaḥ sarpaḥ śeṣa iva śvasan || 5 ||
daśabhistaddhanurdivyaṃ śaraiḥ sarpasamairbalaḥ |
ciccheda muṣṭideśe tu mādhavo mādhavāgrajaḥ || 6 ||
ekalavyo niṣādeśaḥ khaḍgamādāya satvaraḥ |
prāhiṇod balamādāya niśitaṃ ghoravigraham || 7 ||
tamantare paṭurvīro vṛṣṇivīraḥ pratāpavān |
tilaśaḥ pañcabhirbāṇaiścakāra yadunandanaḥ || 8 ||
tato'paraṃ mahat khaḍgaṃ sarvakālāyasaṃ śubham |
prāhiṇot sāratheḥ kāyamālokyātha niṣādajaḥ || 9 ||
taṃ cāpi daśabhirvīro mādhavo yadunandanaḥ |
bāhvorantarayoścaiva nirbibheda mahāraṇe || 3.98.10 ||
tataḥ śaktiṃ samādāya ghaṇṭāmālākulāṃ nṛpaḥ |
niṣādo baladevāya preṣayitvā mahābalaḥ || 11 ||
siṃhanādaṃ mahāghoramakarot sa niṣādapaḥ |
sā śaktiḥ sarvakalyāṇī baladevamupāgamat || 12 ||
utpatantīṃ mahāghorāṃ balabhadraḥ pratāpavān |
ādāyātha niṣādeśaṃ sarvān vismāpayanniva || 13 ||
tayaiva taṃ jaghānāśu vakṣodeśe ca mādhavaḥ |
sa tayā tāḍito vīraḥ svaśaktyātha niṣādapaḥ || 14 ||
vihvalaḥ sarvagātreṣu nipapāta mahītale |
prāṇasaṃśayamāpanno niṣādo rāmatāḍitaḥ || 15 ||
niṣādāstasya rājendra śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ |
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi niṣādāstasya yodhinaḥ || 16 ||
gadinaḥ khaḍginaścaiva maheṣvāsā mahābalāḥ |
śarairanekasāhasraiḥ śaktibhiśca paraśvadhaiḥ || 17 ||
gadābhiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ śūlaiḥ parighaiḥ prāsatomaraiḥ |
kuntairatha kuṭhāraiśca yādavānāṃ mahaujasām || 18 ||
śalabhā iva rājendra dīpyamānaṃ hutāśanam |
te śaraiḥ pātayāṃcakrū rāmaṃ rāmamivāparam || 19 ||
kecit kuṭhārairājaghnuḥ kecit kuntaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ |
gadābhiḥ kecidāghnanti śaktibhiśca tathā pare || 3.98.20 ||
nijaghnuḥ sahasā rāmaṃ sphurantaṃ pāvakaṃ yathā |
tataḥ kruddho halī sākṣāddhalamudyamya satvaram || 21 ||
sarvānākarṣayāmāsa musalena hi pīḍayan |
te hanyamānā rājendra niṣādāḥ parvatāśrayāḥ || 22 ||
nipeturdharaṇīpṛṣṭhe śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ |
kṣaṇena tanmahārāja hatvā sarvān mahābalān || 23 ||
siṃhavad vyanadaṃstatra tasthau rāmo mahābalaḥ |
tato rātrau mahāghorāḥ piśācāḥ piśitāśanāḥ|| 24 ||
ākṛṣya māṃsayūthāni bhakṣayantaḥ samāsate |
pibantaḥ śoṇitaṃ koṣṭhāt saṃchidya ca śavaṃ bahu || 25 ||
iti śrībhahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi ekalavyasainyavadhe aṣṭanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 98 ||

<3.99>

navanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
kravyādāḥ sarva evāśu bhakṣayantastadā śavam |
hasanto vividhaṃ ghoraṃ nādayanto vasuṃdharām || 1 ||
rākṣasāśca piśācāśca pibantaḥ śoṇitaṃ bahu |
āśikhaṃ bhuñjate rājañchavasya piśitāśanāḥ || 2 ||
nṛtyanti sma tadā rājan nagaryāṃ raṇatoṣitāḥ |
kākā balākā gṛdhrāśca śyenā gomāyavastathā|| 3 ||
bhakṣayantaḥ pravartante rākṣasāścaiva dāruṇāḥ |
etasminnantare vīro niṣādo labdhasaṃjñakaḥ || 4 ||
hatān sarvān samālokya niṣādān nagacāriṇaḥ|
gadāmādāya kupito rāmameva jagāma ha || 5 ||
jaghāna gadayā rājañjatrudeśe niṣādapaḥ |
tato rāmo gadī rājan niṣādaṃ bāhuśālinam || 6 ||
ājaghne gadayā krūraṃ madamatto halāyudhaḥ |
tayośca tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ gadābhyāṃ samavartata || 7 ||
ākāśe śabda āsīt tu tayoryuddhe mahābhuja |
samudrāṇāṃ yathā ghoṣaḥ sarveṣāṃ saṃnigacchatām|| 8 |
kalpakṣaye mahārāja śabdaḥ sutumulo'bhavat |
kṣobhito nāgarājaśca nāgāḥ kṣobhaṃ samāyayuḥ || 9 ||
pṛthivī cāntarikṣaṃ ca sarvaṃ śabdamayaṃ babhau |
tataḥ sa pauṇḍrako rājā sātyakiṃ vṛṣṇinandanam|| 3.99.10 ||
gadayaiva jaghānāśu satvaraṃ raṇakovidaḥ |
yuyudhāno balī rājan vāsudevaṃ jaghāna ha || 11 ||
tayośca tumulaḥ śabdaḥ prādurāsīnmahāraṇe |
caturṇāṃ yudhyatāṃ rājan parasparavadhaiṣiṇām || 12 ||
brahmāṇḍakṣobhaṇo rājañchabda āsīt sudāruṇaḥ|
tato rajaḥ prādurabhūt tasmin saṃgrāmamūrdhani || 13 ||
tārakā niṣprabhā rājaṃstamasyevaṃ kṣayaṃ gate |
uṣasi pratibuddhāyāṃ tato niḥśeṣatāṃ yayau || 14 ||
udito bhagavān sūryaścandraśca kṣayamāyayau |
teṣāṃ yuddhaṃ prādurabhūccaturṇāṃ bāhuśālinām |
devāsurasamaṃ rājannudite bhāskare mahat || 15 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi pauṇḍrakayuddhe navanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 99 ||

<3.100>

śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ prabhāte vimale bhagavān devakīsutaḥ |
gantumaicchajjagannāthaḥ puraṃ badarikāśramāt || 1 ||
namaskṛtya munīn sarvān yayau dvāravatīṃ nṛpa |
āruhya garuḍaṃ viṣṇurvegena mahatā prabhuḥ || 2 ||
sumahāñchuśruve śabdasteṣāṃ yuddhaṃ prakurvatām |
gacchatā devadevena purīṃ dvāravatīṃ nṛpa || 3 ||
acintayajjagannāthaḥ ko nvayaṃ śabda utthitaḥ |
saṃgrāmasambhavo ghora āryaśaineyasaṃyutaḥ || 4 ||
vyaktamāgatavān pauṇḍro nagarīṃ dvārakāmanu |
tena yuddhaṃ samabhavat pauṇḍrakeṇa durātmanā || 5 ||
yadūnāṃ vṛṣṇivīrāṇāṃ yuddhyatāmitaretaram |
śabdo'yaṃ sumahān vyakto nātra kāryā vicāraṇā|| 6 ||
ityevaṃ cintayitvā tu dadhmau śaṅkhaṃ mahāravam |
pāñcajanyaṃ hariḥ sākṣāt prīṇayan vṛṣṇipuṅgavān||7 ||
rodasī pūrayāmāsa tena śabdena keśavaḥ |
yādavā vṛṣṇayaścaiva śrutvā śaṅkhasya te ravam || 8 ||
vyaktamāyāti bhagavān pāñcajanyaravo hyayam |
iti te menire rājan vṛṣṇayo yādavāstathā || 9 ||
nirbhayāḥ samapadyanta vṛṣṇayo yādavāśca te |
tasminneva kṣaṇe dṛṣṭastārkṣyaśca patatāṃ varaḥ || 3.100.10 ||
tataśca devakīsūnurdṛṣṭastairyādaveśvaraḥ |
sūtāśca māgadhāścaiva puro yānti jagatpateḥ || 11 ||
stutyā stutaṃ hariṃ viṣṇumīśvaraṃ kamalekṣaṇam |
gatāśca yādavāḥ sarve parivavrurjanārdanam || 12 ||
kṛṣṇastu garuḍaṃ bhūyo gaccha tvaṃ nākamuttamam |
ityuktvā garuḍaṃ viṣṇurvisṛjya yadunandanaḥ || 13 ||
dārukaṃ punarāhedaṃ rathamānaya me prabho |
sa tatheti pratijñāya rathamādāya satvaram || 14 ||
ratho'yaṃ bhagavan deva kimataḥ kṛtyamasti me |
ityuktvā rathamādāya praṇamyāgre sthito hareḥ || 15 ||
gate'tha garuḍe viṣṇū rathamāruhya satvaram |
yatra yuddhaṃ samabhavat tatra yāti sma keśavaḥ || 16 ||
tatra gatvā mahārāja yudhyatāṃ ca mahātmanām |
pāñcajanyaṃ mahāśastraṃ dadhmau yaduvṛṣottamaḥ || 17 ||
pauṇḍro'tha vāsudevastu kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā raṇotsukam |
sātyakiṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā vāsudevamupāgamat || 18 ||
kruddho'tha sātyakī rājan vārayāmāsa pauṇḍrakam|
na gantavyamito rājannaiṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || 19 ||
jitvā māṃ gaccha rājendra paraṃ yoddhuṃ mahāraṇe |
kṣatriyo'si mahāvīra sthite mayi raṇotsuke || 3.100.20 ||
eṣa te garvamakhilaṃ nāśayiṣyāmi saṃyuge |
ityuktvā cāgratastasthau gacchato yādaveśvaraḥ || 21 ||
pauṇḍrasya śininaptā tu paśyataḥ keśavasya ha |
avajñāya śineḥ pautraṃ kṛṣṇameva jagāma ha || 22 ||
nirbhartsya sahasā bhūyaḥ sātyakiḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ |
gadayā prāharat pauṇḍraṃ vāsudevasya paśyataḥ || 23 ||
yathāprāṇaṃ yathāyogaṃ sātyakiḥ satyavikramaḥ |
dṛṣṭvātha bhagavānevaṃ sātyakiṃ praśaśaṃsa ha || 24 ||
nivārya sātyakiṃ kṛṣṇo yatheṣṭaṃ kriyatāmasau |
upāramad yathāyogaṃ sātyakiḥ kṛṣṇavāritaḥ || 25 ||
sa tataḥ pauṇḍrako rājā vāsudevamuvāca ha |
bho bho yādava gopāla idānīṃ kva gato bhavān || 26 ||
tvāṃ draṣṭumatha samprāpto vāsudevo'smi sāmpratam |
hatvā tvāṃ sabalaṃ kṛṣṇa balairbahubhiranvitaḥ || 27 ||
ahameko bhaviṣyāmi vāsudevo mahītale |
yaccakaṃ tava govinda prathitaṃ suprabhaṃ mahat || 28 ||
anena mama cakreṇa pīḍito'smi ca tadraṇe |
cakramastīti tadvīryaṃ tava mādhava sāmpratam || 29 ||
nāśayiṣyāmi tat sarvaṃ sarvakṣatrasya paśyataḥ |
śārṅgīti māṃ vijānīhi na tvaṃ śārṅgīti śiṣyase || 3.100.30||
śaṅkhamastīti tadvīryaṃ tava mādhava sāmpratam |
śaṅkhī cāhaṃ gadī cāhaṃ cakrī cāhaṃ janārdana || 31 ||
māmeva hi sadā brūyurjānanto vīryaśālinaḥ |
ādau tvaṃ balavad vṛddhānhatvā strībālakānbahūna||32||
gāśca hatvā mahāgarvastava samprati vartate |
tat te'haṃ vyapaneṣyāmi yadi tiṣṭhasi matpuraḥ || 33 ||
śastraṃ gṛhāṇa goccindra yadi yoddhuṃ vyavasthitaḥ |
ityuktvā bāṇamādāya tasthau pārśvaṃ jagatpateḥ || 34 ||
etad vacanamākarṇya vāsudevena bhāṣitam |
smitaṃ kṛtvā hariḥ kṛṣṇo babhāṣe pauṇḍrakaṃ nṛpam ||35||
kāmaṃ vada nṛpa tvaṃ hi pātakyasmi sadā nṛpa |
goghātī bālaghātī ca strīhantā sarvathā nṛpa || 36 ||
cakrī bhava gadī rājañchārṅgī ca satataṃ bhava |
nāmadheyaṃ vṛthā mahyaṃ vāsudeveti ca prabho || 37 ||
śārṅgī cakrī gadī śaṅkhītyevamādi vṛthā mama |
kiṃ tu vakṣyāmi kiṃcittu śṛṇuṣva yadi manyase |38|
kṣatriyā balino ye tu sthite mayi jagatpatau |
tathānubruvate tvāṃ hi jīvatyeva mayi prabho || 39 ||
yanme cakraṃ mahāghoramasurāntakaraṃ mahat|
tattulyaṃ tava cakraṃ tu vṛttato na tu vīryataḥ |
āyudheṣvatha sarvatra śabdasādṛśyamasti te || 3.100.40 ||
gopo'haṃ sarvadā rājan prāṇināṃ prāṇadaḥ sadā |
goptā sarveṣu lokeṣu śāstā duṣṭasya sarvadā || 41 ||
katthanaṃ sarvakāryaṃ hi jitvā śatrūn nṛpādhama |
ajitvā kiṃ bhavān brūte sthite mayi ca śastriṇi || 42 ||
hatvā māṃ brūhi rājendra yadi śakto'si pauṇḍraka |
sthito'haṃ cakramāśritya rathī cāpī gadāsimān|| 43 ||
rathamāruhya yuddhāya sannaddho bhava mānada |
ityuktvā bhagavān viṣṇuḥ siṃhanādaṃ vyanīnadat|| 44 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kṛṣṇapauṇḍrakayuddhe śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 100 ||

<3.101>

ekādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ śaraṃ samādāya vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān |
pauṇḍraṃ jaghāna sahasā niśitena śareṇa ha || 1 ||
pauṇḍro'tha vāsudevastu śarairdaśabhirāśugaiḥ |
vāsudevaṃ jaghānāśu vārṣṇeyaṃ vṛṣṇinandanam || 2 ||
dārukaṃ pañcaviṃśatyā hayān daśabhireva ca |
saptatyā vāsudevaṃ tu yādavaṃ vāsudevakaḥ || 3 ||
tataḥ prahasya suciraṃ keśavaḥ keśisūdanaḥ |
dhṛṣṭo'sāviti manasā sampūjya yadunandanaḥ || 4 ||
ākṛṣya śārṅgaṃ balavān saṃdhāya ripusūdanaḥ |
nārācena sutīkṣṇena dhvajaṃ ciccheda keśavaḥ || 5 ||
sāratheśca śiraḥ kāyādāhṛtya yadunandanaḥ |
aśvāṃśca caturo hatvā caturbhiḥ sāyakottamaiḥ || 6 ||
rathaṃ rājñaḥ samāhatya tadobhau pārṣṇisārathī |
cakre ca tilaśaḥ kṛtvā hasan kiṃcidiva sthitaḥ || 7 ||
pauṇḍrako vāsudevastu rathādutplutya satvaraḥ |
ādāya niśitaṃ khaṅgaṃ prāhiṇot keśavāya saḥ || 8 ||
sa khaṅgaṃ śatadhā kṛtvā tūṣṇomāsīcca keśavaḥ |
tataḥ paraṃ mahāghoraṃ parighaṃ kālasammitam || 9 ||
gṛhītvā vāsudevāya vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān |
prāhiṇod vṛṣṇivīrāya sarvakṣatrasya paśyataḥ || 3.101.10 ||
tad dvidhā jagatāṃ nāthaścakāra yadunandanaḥ |
tataścakraṃ mahāghoraṃ sahasrāraṃ mahāprabham || 11 ||
triṃśadbhārasamāyuktamāyasākhyamamitrahā |
ādāyātha mahārāja keśavaṃ vākyamabravīt || 12 ||
paśyedaṃ niśitaṃ ghoraṃ tava cakravināśanam |
anena tava govinda darpaṃ darpavatāṃ vara || 13 ||
apaneṣyāmi vārṣṇeya sarvakṣatrasya paśyataḥ |
tvāmuddiśya mahāghoraṃ kṛtamanyad durāsadam || 14 ||
yadi śakto hare kṛṣṇa dārayedaṃ mahāspadam |
ityuktvā tacchataguṇaṃ bhrāmayitvā mahābalaḥ || 15 ||
cikṣepātha mahāvīryaḥ pauṇḍrako nṛpasattamaḥ |
avaplutya tato deśāt tadutsṛjya mahābalaḥ || 16 ||
siṃhanādaṃ mahāghoraṃ vyanadad vīryavāṃstadā |
tato vismayamāpanno bhagavān devakīsutaḥ || 27 ||
aho vīryamaho dhairyamasya pauṇḍrasya duḥsaham |
iti matvā jagannātha utthitaśca rathottamāt || 18 ||
tataḥ śilāṃ samādāya preṣayāmāsa keśavam |
tāṃ śilāṃ preṣayāmāsa tasmai yadukulodvahaḥ || 19 ||
pauṇḍreṇa suciraṃ kālaṃ vikrīḍya bhagavān hariḥ |
tataścakraṃ samādāya niśitaṃ raktabhojanam || 3.101.20 ||
daityamāṃsapradigdhāṅgaṃ nārīgarbhavimocanam |
śātakumbhamayaṃ ghoraṃ daityadānavanāśanam || 21 || |
sahasrāraṃ śatāraṃ tadadbhutaṃ daityabhīṣaṇam |
aiśvaryavarma paramaṃ nityaṃ suragaṇārcitam || 22 ||
viṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇastathā śārṅgī nityayuktaḥ sadā hariḥ |
jaghāna tena govindaḥ pauṇḍrakaṃ nṛpasattamam || 23 ||
tasya dehaṃ vidāryāśu cakraṃ piśitabhojanam |
kṛṣṇasyātha karaṃ bhūyaḥ prāpa sarveśvarasya ha || 24 ||
tataḥ sa pauṇḍrako rājā gatāsuḥ prāpatad bhuvi |
nihatya bhagavān viṣṇurdurvijñeyagatiḥ prabhuḥ |
pratipede sudharmāṃ tu yādavaiḥ pūjito hariḥ || 25 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kailāsayātrāyāṃ pauṇḍrakavāsudevavadha ekādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 101 ||

<3.102>

dvyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
niṣādeśaṃ tato rāmaḥ śaktyā vīryavatāṃ varaḥ |
ājaghāna stanadvandve siṃhanādaṃ vyanīnadat || 1 ||
tataḥ kruddho niṣādeśo rāmaṃ mattaṃ mahābalam |
gadayā lokavikhyāto jaghāna stanavakṣasi || 2 ||
āhataḥ sa tu tenāśu balabhadro mahābalaḥ |
ubhābhyāṃ caiva rāmastu karābhyāṃ vṛṣṇipuṅgavaḥ || 3 ||
gadāṃ gṛhya mahāghorāmāyāntīṃ prāṇahāriṇīm |
dudrāvātha niṣādeśaḥ samudraṃ makarālayam || 4 ||
dhāvatyevaṃ tadā rājñi ekalavye niṣādape |
dhāvatyevaṃ ca rāmo'pi yatra yāto niṣādapaḥ || 5 ||
sāgaraṃ sa praviśyāśu gatvā yojanapañcakam |
bhīta eva tadā rājannekalavyo niṣādapaḥ || 6 ||
kaṃcid dvīpāntaraṃ rājan praviśya nyavasat tadā |
itthaṃ rāmo niṣādeśaṃ jigāya yadunandanaḥ || 7 ||
tāṃ sabhāṃ maṇiratnāḍhyāṃ praviveśa halāyudhaḥ |
sātyakiryuddhasaṃsaktastāṃ sabhāṃ praviveśa ha || 8 ||
anye ca yādavā rājan yathāyogamupasthitāḥ |
āsīneṣu ca sarveṣu vṛṣṇivīreṣu sarvataḥ || 9 ||
abhivādya yathāyogaṃ vṛṣṇīn sarvāṃśca keśavaḥ |
uvāca vacanaṃ kāle bhagavān devakīsutaḥ || 3.102.10 ||
dṛṣṭaṃ kailāsaśikharaṃ śaṃkaro nīlalohitaḥ |
sa tu mahyaṃ yaduvarāḥ prītimāṃśca dadau varam || 11 ||
tatra devāḥ samāyātā munayaśca tapodhanāḥ |
dṛṣṭvā māṃ śaṃkaraścaiva prītaḥ stutvā samāyayau || 12 ||
atyadbhutaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ rātrau yādavasattamāḥ |
piśācau dvau mahāghorau vadantau māmikāṃ kathām || 13 ||
mṛgayāṃ cakratustau tu cintayantau tu māṃ sadā |
dṛṣṭvā māṃ tau tu rājendrāḥ prītimantau tapasvinau || 14 ||
bhaktinamrau mahātmānau praṇāmaṃ cakratustadā |
tato'haṃ sarvathā prītastau nītau svargamuttamam || 15 ||
toṣayitvā mahādevaṃ mayā cādya samāgatam |
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataste vṛṣṇayaḥ sarve devadevaṃ śaśaṃsire || 16
sarvathā kṛtakṛtyāste vṛṣṣayaḥ keśavāśrayāḥ |
yādavāḥ sarva evaite svaṃ svaṃ jagmuryathālayam || 17 ||
abhyantare jagannāthaḥ praviśya harirīśvaraḥ |
rukmiṇīsatyabhāmābhyāmācacakṣe yathābhavat || 18 ||
te prīte prītiyuktena keśavena samanvite |
etat te sarvamākhyātaṃ keśavasya viceṣṭitam || 19 ||
śaśāsa pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ duṣṭān hatvā mahābalān |
narakaṃ ghorakarmāṇaṃ pauṇḍrakaṃ nṛpasattamam || 3.102.20 ||
hayagrīvaṃ niśumbhaṃ ca tathā sundopasundakau
rarakṣa viprān deveśo munīn munivarārcitaḥ || 21 ||
viprebhyaśca dadau vittaṃ gāśca dattvā sa keśavaḥ |
agnihotraṃ prayuñjāno brāhmaṇāṃśca sutaparyan || 22 ||
munīṃśca brahmacaryeṇa devān yajñairanekadhā |
svadhayā ca pitṝn sarvān prīṇayanneva sarvadā || 23 ||
tasmiñchāsati deveśe rājyaṃ niṣkaṇṭakaṃ prabho |
sukhameva prajāḥ sarvā jīvanti brāhmaṇādayaḥ ||24 ||
iti śromahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi kailāsayātrāyāṃ pauṇḍrakavadhasamāptau dvyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 102 ||

<3.103>

tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
bhūya eva dvijaśreṣṭha śaṅkhacakragadābhṛtaḥ |
caritaṃ śrotumicchāmi vistareṇa tapodhana || 1 ||
na hi me tṛptirastīha śṛṇvataḥ kaiśavīṃ kathām |
ko nu nāma harerviṣṇordevadevasya cakriṇaḥ || 2 ||
śṛṇvaṃstathā raman vāpi tṛptiṃ yāti divāniśam |
puruṣārtho'yamevaiko yatkathāśravaṇaṃ hareḥ || 3 ||
kathamāsījjagaddhetorhaṃsasya ḍimbhakasya ca |
samitiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sadā vismayadāyinī || 4 ||
vicakrasya kathaṃ yuddhaṃ dānavasya mahātmanaḥ |
sa tayormitratāṃ yāta ityevamanuśuśruma || 5 ||
tau sutau vīryasampannau śiṣyau bhṛgusutasya ha |
sarvāstrakuśalau vīrau harāllabdhavarau kila || 6 ||
saṃgrāmaḥ sumahānāsīdityuktaṃ bhavatā purā |
tayośca nṛpayorvipra keśavasya jagatpateḥ || 7 ||
kasya putrau samutpannau yathābhūd vigraho mahān |
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi dānavānāṃ tarasvinām || 8 ||
balānyatha vicakrasya śitaśūladharāṇi ca |
āsan yuddhe mahārāja dānavasya jayaiṣiṇaḥ || 9 ||
yadūnāmantaraṃ prepsuryadūnāṃ yuddhakāṅkṣayā |
devāsure mahāyuddhe devāñjayati durdharaḥ |
tadvadhārthaṃ sadā yatnamakaroccaiva keśavaḥ || 3.103.10 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne janamejayavākye tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||1 03||

<3.104>

caturadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
āsīcchālveṣu rājendra brahmadatto nṛpottamaḥ |
nāmnā rājan sa pūtātmā sarvabhūtadayāparaḥ || 1 ||
pañcayajñaparo nityaṃ jitātmā vijitendriyaḥ |
brahmavid vedaviccaiva sadā yajñamayaḥ śivaḥ || 2 ||
tasya bhārye mahīpāla rūpaudāryaguṇānvite |
babhūvatuḥ susampanne anapatye nṛpottama || 3 ||
sa tābhyāṃ mumude rājā śacyā śakra ivāmbare |
nāmnā mitrasaho nāma sakhā cāsīd dvijottamaḥ|| 4 ||
tasya rājño mahāyogī vedavedāntatatparaḥ |
anapatyaḥ sa viprendro yathā rājā babhūva ha || 5 ||
sa rājā sahitastābhyāmarcayāmāsa śaṃkaram |
putrārthaṃ śūlinaṃ śarvaṃ daśa varṣāṇyananyadhīḥ || 6 ||
sa vipro vaiṣṇavaṃ satraṃ putrārthe samayojayat |
arcitastena rājendra śaṃkaro nīlalohitaḥ || 7 ||
ātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa svapne rājānamabravīt |
prīto'smi tava bhadraṃ te varaṃ varaya suvrata || 8 ||
atha rājā jagannāthamuvācedaṃ smayanniva |
putrau mama bhavetāṃ hi tathetyuktvā vṛṣadhvajaḥ || 9 ||
antardhānaṃ gataḥ śambhuḥ pratibuddhastato nṛpaḥ |
so'pi mitrasaho vidvān devaṃ keśavamavyayam || 3.104.10 ||
pañcavarṣaṃ jagannāthamarcayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ |
vidvān mitrasahane bhī avināśī jagadīśvara bhagavān
keśavakī pīca varṣotaka bade bhaktimāvase ārādhanākī||1 03||
arcitastena vipreṇa devadevo janārdanaḥ || 11 ||
putramekaṃ dadau tasmai svātmanā sadṛśaṃ hariḥ |
te bhārye garbhamādhattāṃ tejasā śaṃkarasya ha || 12 ||
viprabhāryā mahārāja vaiṣṇavaṃ teja ādadhat |
mahiṣyau te mahāvīryau putrau śaṃkaranirmitau || 13 ||
asūyetāṃ mahīpāla krameṇaiva nṛpasya ha |
sa tayośca mahārāja nāmakarmādikāḥ kriyāḥ || 14 ||
cakāra vidhivatsarvā viprebhyo'dānmahaddhanam |
sa ca vipro vinītātmā putramekaṃ hi labdhavān|| 15 ||
sākṣādiva jagannāthaṃ sthitaṃ putrātmanā nṛpa |
jātakarmādikaṃ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ sa cakāra ha || 16 ||
tau kumārāvayaṃ caiva trayaḥ savayaso'bhavan |
vedānadhītya te sarvāñchrutvā cānvīkṣikīṃ tathā || 17 ||
dhanurvede tathā'stre ca nipuṇāste'bhavaṃstadā |
haṃso jyeṣṭho nṛpasuto ḍimbhako'nantaro'bhavat|| 18 ||
