sa ca viprasuto rājan janārdana iti smṛtaḥ | |
anyonyaṃ mitratāṃ yātāḥ sarve caiva kumārakāḥ|| 19 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakotpattau caturadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 104 ||

<3.105>

pañcādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
haṃsaśca ḍimbhakaścaivaṃ tapaścartuṃ mahāmatī |
manaścakraturātmāṃśau śaṃkarasya nṛpottama || 1 ||
gatvā tu himavatpārśvaṃ tapaścakraturañjasā |
uddiśya śaṃkaraṃ śarvaṃ nīlagrīvamumāpatim || 2 ||
vīryāstre caiva nau syātāmityādhāya tu mānase |
ekāgrau prayatau bhūtvā vāyvambuprāśinau nṛpa || 3 ||
namaste devadeveti śaṃkareti divāniśam |
hara śarva śivānanda nīlagrīva umāpate || 4 ||
vṛṣadhvaja virūpākṣa haryakṣa jagatāṃ pate |
bhaktapriya girīśeśa vāsudeva śivācyuta || 5 ||
sadyojāta mahādeva devadeva guhāśaya |
bhūtabhāvana deveśa praṇavātman sadāśiva || 6 ||
ityādināmabhirnityaṃ stuvantau śaṃkaraṃ bhavam |
hṛdi kṛtvā virūpākṣaṃ tapastepaturañjasā || 7 ||
nirmamau nirahaṃkārau maunavratasamāsthitau |
varṣāṇīha tadā rājan pañca cakraturojasā || 8 ||
tataḥ prīto'bhavaccharvastābhyāṃ saṃyamanena ca |
sa dadau darśanaṃ naijaṃ vyāghracarmāmbaro haraḥ || 9 ||
triyakṣaḥ śaṃkaraḥ śarvaḥ śūlapāṇirumāpatiḥ |
agrataḥ saṃsthitaṃ śarvaṃ candrārdhakṛtaśekharam |
tau dṛṣṭvā prītamanasau namaścakraturañjasā || 3.105.10 ||
śrībhagavānuvāca
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ vāṃ yathecchā vāṃ tathāstu vai |
tāvūcatustadā rājan prītastvaṃ bhagavan yadi || 11 ||
devāsuracamūmukhyairyakṣagandharvadānavaiḥ |
āvāmajayyau sarvātmanneṣa nau prathamo varaḥ || 12 ||
dvitīyo nau virūpākṣa raudrāstrāṇāṃ ca saṃgrahaḥ |
māheśvaraṃ tathā raudramastraṃ brahmaśiro mahat || 13 ||
abhedyaṃ kavacaṃ divyamacchedyaṃ cāpi kārmukam |
paraśuṃ ca tathā śarva sadā rakṣārthameva ca || 14 ||
sahāyau dvau mahādeva bhūtau yuddhe hi gacchatām |
evamastviti deveśa āha bhṛṅgiriṭī haraḥ || 15 ||
kuṇḍodaraṃ virūpākṣaṃ sarvaprāṇihite ratam |
yuvāmatha ca bhūteśau sahāyau satataṃ raṇe || 16 ||
saṃgrāmaṃ gacchatāṃ ghorametayorbalaśālinoḥ |
ityuktvā bhagavāñcharvastatraivāntaradhīyata || 17 ||
tatastau vīryasampannau haṃso ḍimbhaka eva ca |
kṛtāstrau śastrasampannau cāpinau vīryavattarau || 18 ||
āmuktakavacau vīrāvajayyau devadānavaiḥ |
atyantabhaktau deveśe śaṃkare nīlalohite || 19 ||
nityotsavakarau deve bhasmoddhūlanaśobhinau |
kṛtatripuṇḍrakau nityaṃ jaṭāyuktaśirodharau || 3.105.20 ||
rudrākṣārpitasarvāṅgau vyāghracarmāmbarāvṛtau |
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya mahādevāya dhīmate || 21 ||
ityādibhirmahādevaṃ stuvantau nāmabhiḥ śivam |
sākṣādiva mahādevau rejaturjaladhāriṇau || 22 ||
tataḥ svabhavanaṃ gatvā pituḥ pādāvagṛhyatām |
pituśca sakhyurbalinau mātuśca caraṇau tadā || 23 ||
janārdano'pi dharmātmā kālena mahatā nṛpa |
vidyāpāraṃ mahābuddhiryuktenāsāvupeyivān || 24 ||
sa ca viṣṇuṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ pītakauśeyavāsasam |
brahmatattvaparo nityamupāste vijitendriyaḥ || 25 ||
haṃsaśca ḍimbhakaścaiva kṛtadāro babhūvatuḥ |
janārdano'pi dharmātmā kṛtadāro babhūva ha || 26 ||
sarve te yajñaniratāḥ pañcayajñaparāstathā |
svadāraniratāḥ sarve guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ |
dharma eva paraṃ śreya iti te menire nṛpa || 27 |
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne pañcādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 105 ||

<3.106>

ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ kadācit tau vīrau mṛgayāmāṭatuḥ kila |
janārdanena sahitau rathairaśvairgajairapi || 1 ||
vanaṃ gatvā tu tau vīrau siṃhavyāghrāṃśca jaghnatuḥ |
śitairbāṇairmahārāja varāhānatha sarvaśaḥ || 2 ||
vyālānanyān mṛgān hiṃsrāñchvabhiśca sahitau nṛpa |
eṣa āyāti vipulo varāho dīrghalocanaḥ || 3 ||
enaṃ vāṇena saṃchindhi yāti cāyaṃ mṛgādhipaḥ |
ayamanyo'tha mahiṣaḥ śṛṅgaprotasarīsṛpaḥ || 4 ||
ete khalu mṛgāḥ sārdhaṃ śāvairbādhanti sarvaśaḥ |
etad bhramati sarvatra bhītaṃ śaśakulaṃ mahat || 5 ||
śāvaṃ stanaṃ pibatsādhu na hantavyamidaṃ śubham |
grahītavyamidaṃ sarvaṃ nirudhya śvagaṇairiha || 6 ||
ityādiśabdaḥ sumahān mṛgayāṃ kurvatāṃ nṛpa |
kṣatriyāṇāṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha vyādhānāṃ caiva dhāvatām || 7 ||
hatvā mṛgān subahuśo vyāghrān siṃhān nṛpottamau |
śramaṃ ca jagmaturvīrau madhyaṃ yāte divākare || 8 ||
alaṃ hi mṛgayāsmākaṃ śramaḥ samupajāyate |
ityūcaturmahārāja puṣkaraṃ jagmatuḥ saraḥ || 9 ||
saraḥsamīpamāgamya munisiddhaniṣevitam |
vījan mārutasānūpaṃ śramāt tatra sukhasthitau || 3.106.10 ||
tato janāḥ saraḥ sarve vigāhya śramakarṣitāḥ |
bisān pravālān padmānāṃ bhakṣayāmāsurārtavat|| 11 ||
janārdanena sahitau haṃso ḍimbhaka eva ca |
saraḥ kvacit samāśritya śramaṃ saṃtyajya tiṣṭhataḥ || 12 ||
viśramya sarasastīre tadā''sāte sukhaṃ nṛpau |
aśṛṇvātāṃ paraṃ brahma munimukhyaiḥ samīritam || 13 ||
madhyaṃdinaṃ tathā sarvaiḥ savanaṃ sasvaraṃ nṛpau |
tataḥ prītau nṛpau bhūtvā śrutvā vedadhvaniṃ tadā || 14 ||
aicchetāṃ tau tadā draṣṭuṃ yajñaṃ munikṛtaṃ tadā |
sthāpayitvā tataḥ senāṃ sarvāṃ mṛgasamanvitām|| 15 ||
ādāya ca mahācāpe śarān katicideva ca |
janārdanastadā vīrau haṃso ḍimbhaka eva ca || 16 ||
padātinau mahārāja jagmatuścāśramaṃ kila |
maharṣeḥ kāśyapasyātha satraṃ vaiṣṇavasaṃjñakam |
yajato munibhiḥ sārdhaṃ japahomaparāyaṇaiḥ || 17 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne mṛgayāvarṇane ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 106 ||

<3.107>

saptādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
janārdanaśca dharmātmā haṃso ḍimbhaka eva ca |
sadaḥ praviśya satrasya namaścakrurmunīśvarān || 1 ||
tānāgatān mahātmāno munayaḥ śiṣyasaṃyutāḥ |
arghyapādyāsanādīni cakruḥ pūjāṃ prayatnataḥ || 2 ||
tau nṛpau sa ca viprendraḥ saparyāṃ pratigṛhya ca |
prītātmāno mahātmāna āsate sasukhaṃ nṛpa || 3 ||
tato haṃso babhāṣe tān munīn saṃyatavāṅnṛpa |
pitā hi nau muniśreṣṭhā yaṣṭumaicchat sasādhanam || 4 ||
gantavyaṃ tatra yuṣmābhiḥ satrānte munisattamāḥ |
rājasūyena yajñena kṛtvā digvijayaṃ vayam | 5 ||
yājapiṣyāmahe viprāḥ pitaraṃ dhārmikaṃ nṛpam |
āyāntu tatra viprendrāḥ saśiṣyāḥ saparicchadāḥ|| 6 ||
vayamadyaiva sahitau diśo jeṣyāmahe vayam |
śaktā vayamihaivaitat kartuṃ sainikasaṃcayaiḥ || 7 ||
āvayoḥ purataḥ sthātuṃ na śaktā devadānavāḥ |
kailāsanilayād devād varaṃ labdhāḥ sma yatnataḥ || 8 ||
ajayyau śatrusaṃghānāmastrāṇi vividhāni ca |
ityuktvā virarāmaiva haṃso madabalānvitaḥ || 9 ||
munaya ūcuḥ
yadi syāt tatra gacchāmo vayaṃ śiṣyairnṛpottama |
āsmahe vānyathā rājannityūcuḥ kila tāpasāḥ || 3.107.10 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tato deśān mahārāja gantuṃ niścitamānasau |
puṣkarasyottaraṃ tīraṃ durvāsā yatra tiṣṭhati || 11 ||
yatayo niyatā bhūtvā mantrabrahmaniṣeviṇaḥ |
brahmasūtrapade saktāstadarthālokatatparāḥ || 12 ||
nirmamā nirahaṃkārāḥ kaupīnācchādanavratāḥ |
tamātmānaṃ jagadyoniṃ viṣṇuṃ viśveśvaraṃ vibhum || 13 ||
brahmarūpaṃ śubhaṃ śāntamakṣaraṃ sarvatomukham |
vedāntamūrtimavyaktamanantaṃ śāśvataṃ śivam || 14 ||
nityayuktaṃ virūpākṣaṃ bhūtādhāramanāmayam |
dhyāyantaḥ sarvadā devaṃ manasā sarvatomukham || 15 ||
durvāsasā sadopāsyaṃ vedāntaikarasaṃ gurum |
tarkaniścitatattvārthā jñānanirmalacetasaḥ || 16 ||
haṃsāḥ paramahaṃsāśca śiṣyā durvāsasaḥ prabho |
gatvā tatra mahātmānau tau dṛṣṭvā tūrdhvaretasam || 17 ||
durvāsasaṃ mahābuddhiṃ vicinvānaṃ paraṃ padam |
kruddho yadi sa durvāsā dagdhuṃ lokānimān kṣamaḥ|| 18 ||
devā api ca yaṃ draṣṭuṃ kruddhaṃ vai na kṣamāḥ sadā |
roṣamūrtiḥ sadā yastu rudrātmā viśvarūpadhṛk || 19 ||
raktakaupīnavasano haṃsaḥ parama eva ca |
dṛṣṭvainaṃ ca tayorevaṃ buddhirāsīnmahāmate || 3.107.20 ||
ko nāmāsau mahābhūtaḥ kāṣāyī varṇavittamaḥ |
kaścāyamāśramo nāma vihāya ca gṛhāśramam || 21 ||
gṛhastha eva dharmātmā gṛhastho dharmavittamaḥ |
gṛhastho dharmarūpastu gṛhastho varṇa eva ca || 22 ||
gṛhasthaśca sadā mātā prāṇināṃ jīvanaṃ khadā |
taṃ vinānyena rūpeṇa vartate yo'timūrkhavat || 23 ||
unmatto'yaṃ virūpo'yamathavā mūrkha eva ca |
dhyāyanniva sadā cāyamāste vañcayitāpi vā || 24 ||
kimete prākṛtajñānā dhyāyanta iti kiṃcana |
vayametān durārohānāśramāntarakalpakān || 25 ||
sthāpayiṣyāmahe sarvān mandabuddhīnimān gṛhe |
balādeva dvijānetān mūḍhavijñānatatparān || 26 ||
asadgrāhagṛhītāśca bāliśān durmatīnimān |
eṣāṃ śāstā ca ko mūḍho na vipro vayamatra ha || 27 ||
dharmye vartmani saṃsthāpya punaryāsyāva nirvṛtau |
iti saṃcintya tau vīrau vipreṇa sahitau nṛpa || 28 ||
janārdanena rājānau mohād bhāgyakṣayānnṛpa |
samīpaṃ tasya rājendra yateḥ saṃyatacetasaḥ || 29 ||
gatvā ca procaturubhau durvāsasamatīndriyam |
yatīṃśca niyatān kruddhau rājānau rājasattama || 3.107.30 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne saptādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 107||

<3.108>

aṣṭādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
haṃsaḍimbhakāvūcatuḥ
jñānaleśādvihīnātmankiṃ te vyavasitaṃ dvija |
kaścāyamāśramo vipra bhavatā yaḥ samāśritaḥ || 1 ||
gṛhamedhaṃ parityajya kiṃ tvayā sādhitaṃ padam |
dambha eva bhavān vyaktaṃ śaṅke nāstyatra kāraṇam|| 2 ||
lokāṃścemānsadā mūḍha nāśayiṣyasi nirvṛtaḥ |
etān sarvān vinetāsi narake pātayiṣyasi|| 3 ||
svayaṃ naṣṭaḥ parān mūrkha nāśayiṣyasi yatnataḥ |
aho śāntā kathaṃ nāsti tava mandamaterdvija || 4 ||
sarvathā tvadvinetā ca pāpo nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ |
tyaktvemamāśramaṃ vipra gṛhī bhava yatātmavān || 5 ||
pañca yajñān sadā vipra kuru yatnaparo bhava |
tataḥ svargaṃ paraṃ gatvā svarge hi sumahatsukham|| 6 ||
eṣa śreyaḥ patho vipra jīvite cet spṛhā tava |
ityuktavantau dharmātmā śrutvā vipro janārdanaḥ || 7 ||
uvāca ca yatiṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamyāsau sunītavat |
mā brūtāmīdṛśaṃ vākyaṃ rājānau mandatejasau || 8 ||
aśrāvyamīdṛśaṃ ghoraṃ lokayorubhayorapi |
ko vaktumīśo mandātmā yadi jīvet sabāndhavaḥ|| 9 ||
sarvathā kāla evāyaṃ yuvayormandacetasoḥ |
samāpta āyuṣaḥ śeṣo brahmadaṇḍahatau yuvām || 3.108.10 ||
ete hi yatayaḥ śuddhā jñānadīpitacetasaḥ |
jñānāgnidagdhakarmāṇaḥ prāṇān prāṇeṣu juhvati || 11 ||
ṛte vāmīdṛśaṃ vākyaṃ kaḥ samartho hyanubruvan |
sarvathā jñātamasmābhiḥ samāptamiha jīvitam || 12 ||
catvāra āśramāḥ pūrvamṛṣibhirvihitā nṛpau |
brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprasthaśca bhikṣukaḥ || 13 ||
teṣāmagraścaturtho'yamāśramo bhikṣukaḥ smṛtaḥ |
āste tasminmahābuddhiḥ sa hi puṇyataraḥ smṛtaḥ || 14||
nopāsitā bhavadbhyāṃ ca vṛddhāḥ samyag vinītavat|
jñānaṃ nāptaṃ tapasvibhyastathā caivaṃ vadeta kaḥ || 15 ||
aśrāvyamīdṛśaṃ ghoraṃ mayā prāṇabhṛtā nṛpa |
kiṃ kariṣyāmi mandātmanmitratvād bhavato nṛpa|| 16 ||
jñānaṃ yadāptaṃ bhavatā gurubhyastadatra duḥkhāya hi kevalaṃ nṛpa |
jñānaṃ hi dharmaprabhavaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ valāddhi pāpasya vidhātṛrūpam || 17 ||
yuvāṃ vihāya yāsye vā pateyaṃ vā śilātalam|
pibeyaṃ vā viṣaṃ ghoraṃ pateyaṃ vā mahormiṣu || 18 ||
ātmānaṃ vātra saṃtyakṣye paśyatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ punaḥ |
ityuktvā vilalāpaivaṃ mā brūtamiti tau vadan || 19 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne aṣṭādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 108 ||

<3.109>

navādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ kruddho'tha durvāsā dhakṣyanniva tayorasūn |
ekenākṣṇātha durvāsā raudreṇāgniyujā sadā || 1 ||
paśyaṃstau ca durātmānau roṣavyākulitendriyaḥ |
kurvanniva tadā lokān bhasmabhūtānimān nṛpa || 2 ||
brāhmaṇaṃ cakṣuṣā paśyan saumyenānyena kevalam |
uvāca vacanaṃ rājan dhvaṃsata dhvaṃsatetarān || 3 ||
ito gacchata rājānau kiṃ vilambata mā ciram |
na vāṃ vacanasambhūtaṃ roṣaṃ dhārayituṃ kṣame || 4 ||
anyathā vo mahīpālānsarvān dagdhumahaṃ kṣamaḥ |
kimataḥ sāhasaṃ vaktuṃ kaśca śaknoti matparaḥ || 5 ||
darpaṃ vāṃ lokavikhyātaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ |
vyapaneṣyati mandajñau kiṃ vāṃ vakṣyāmi sāmpratam || 6 ||
tata utthāya dharmātmā gantumaicchad yatīśvaraḥ |
tato niṣeddhuṃ haṃsastaṃ yatate sma yatīśvaram || 7 ||
tasya bāhuṃ samādāya haṃso nṛpavarottama |
kaupīnaṃ cicchide krūraḥ kṛtānta iva sattama || 8 ||
yatayo'nye palāyanti diśo daśa vicetasaḥ |
kaṣṭaṃ heti vadan vipro mitrabhāvājjanārdanaḥ || 9 ||
nyavārayad yathāśakti kimidaṃ sāhasaṃ tviti |
durvāsāḥ satyadharmastu hantumīśo'pi taṃ tataḥ || 3.109.10 ||
mandaṃ mandamuvācedaṃ haṃsaṃ ḍimbhakameva ca |
śāpenāhaṃ samartho'pi hantuṃ rājakulādhamau || 11 ||
tathāpi na karomyantaṃ yatayo hyatra te vayam |
yo di devo jagannāthaḥ keśavo yādaveśvaraḥ || 12 ||
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇirgarvaṃ vāṃ vyapaneṣyati |
loke tasmin yaduśreṣṭhe rakṣatyevaṃ jagatpatau || 13 ||
yuvayoḥ sarvathā jīvaḥ sajjīva iti me matiḥ |
jarāsaṃdho'pi vāṃ bandhuḥ sa ca vaktuṃ na cecchati|| 14 ||
īdṛśaṃ lokavidviṣṭaṃ sa hi dharmapathe sadā |
etāvatā sa vāṃ bandhurna hi bhūyo bhaviṣyati || 15 ||
vidveṣo hyastu vāṃ tasya māgadhasya mahīpateḥ |
śrutvedaṃ ghorarūpaṃ tu sa hi bandhuḥ saheta cet || 16 ||
dharmanāśo bhavet tasya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
ityuktvā gaccha gaccheti haṃsaṃ prāha punaḥ punaḥ || 17 ||
janārdanamuvācedaṃ durvāsā yatisattamaḥ |
svastyastu tava viprendra bhaktirastu janārdane || 18 ||
saṃsṛtistava tasyāstu śaṅkhacakragadābhṛtaḥ |
adya śvo vā paraśvo vā sādhureva sadā bhavān || 19 ||
na hi sādhorvināśo'sti lokayorubhayorapi |
gaccha sarvaṃ piturbrūhi jñātvā vṛttaṃ yathākhilam || 3.109.20
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne durvāsobhāṣaṇe navādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 109 ||

<3.110>

daśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tatastau haṃsaḍimbhakau kruddhau kālena coditau |
śikyaṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ caiva dvidalaṃ dārumeva ca || 1 ||
daṇḍān pātraviśeṣāṃśca chittvā bhittvā ca sarvaśaḥ|
tasmin deśe mahārāja vyādhairmāṃsānyadīdahan || 2 ||
bhakṣayitvā tato deśāt svapurīṃ tau prajagmatuḥ |
janārdanaśca dharmātmā snehādanuyayau tayoḥ || 3 ||
naṣṭāvimāviti tadā sa mene duḥkhitaḥ param |
gateṣu teṣu sarveṣu durvāsā yatisattamaḥ || 4 ||
palāyanaparān sarvānidaṃ prāha yatīśvarān |
ito deśādvinirgatya puṣkarātpuṇyasaṃyutāt || 5 ||
mandaṃ mandaṃ samāśvasya viśramya ca tatastataḥ |
praviśya dvārakāṃ devaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam || 6 ||
dṛṣṭvā ca tasmai prabhave vakṣyāmo yatisattamāḥ |
sa hi rakṣañjagadidaṃ dharmavartmani saṃsthitaḥ || 7 ||
ādyo lokagururviṣṇuryatātmā tattvavitpriyaḥ |
uddhṛtya kaṇṭakān sarvāñchaśāsa pṛthivīmimām|| 8 ||
sa ca pāpān mahāghorān sarvān pāpakṛtān prabhuḥ |
rakṣennaḥ sakalān sarvāñjñāneṣu niyatātmanaḥ || 9 ||
idamadya kṣamaṃ viprā yānamadya vidhīyatām |
sāhasaṃ yatkṛtaṃ tābhyāṃ pātrabhedādi sattamāḥ || 3.110.10 |
etat sarvamaśeṣeṇa darśayāma janārdanam |
tatheti te pratijñāya yatayo jñānacakṣuṣaḥ || 11
chinnaṃ tābhyāṃ samādāya śikyaṃ dārumayaṃ tathā |
dvidalaṃ karpaṭaṃ caiva kaupīnamatha valkalam || 12 ||
kamaṇḍaluṃ tathā rājannardhaprotakapālakam |
etānanyān samādāya draṣṭuṃ keśavamāyayuḥ || 13 ||
pañca caiva sahasrāṇi puraskṛtya mahāmunim |
durvāsasaṃ tapoyonimīśvarasyātmasambhavam || 14 ||
ahorātreṇa te sarve dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇapālitām |
yayurdāntā mahātmāno lomaśāḥ keśavarjitāḥ || 15 ||
prātaḥ praviśya rājendra vāpikāyāṃ yatīśvarāḥ |
snātvopaspṛśya te sarve yatnena mahatā tadā || 16 ||
draṣṭumabhyudyatā viṣṇuṃ kaṇṭakoddhṛtitatparam |
ekarūpaṃ samāsthāya sudharmāyāmavasthitam || 17 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne yatīnāṃ dvārakāgamane daśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 110 ||

<3.111>

ekādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
atha sarveśvaro viṣṇuḥ padmakiṃjalkalocanaḥ |
śyāmaḥ pītāmbaraḥ śrīmān pralambāmbarabhūṣaṇaḥ || 1 ||
kirīṭī śrīpatiḥ kṛṣṇo nīlakuñcitamūrdhajaḥ |
avyaktaḥ śāśvato devaḥ sakalo niṣkalaḥ śivaḥ || 2 ||
krīḍāvihāropagataḥ kadācidabhavaddhariḥ |
kumārairaparaiḥ sārdhaṃ sātyakipramukhairnṛpa || 3 ||
golakrīḍāṃ sudharmāyā madhye yādavasattamaḥ |
cakāra priyakṛt kṛṣṇo yuyudhānena keśavaḥ || 4 ||
mamāyaṃ prathamo golastava paścād bhaviṣyati |
iti bruvaṃstadā viṣṇuḥ sātyakiṃ kamalekṣaṇaḥ || 5 ||
pārśvasthā yādavāstasya vasudevapurogamāḥ |
uddhavapramukhā rājannāseduḥ kvacidatra vai || 6 ||
anyavyāpārarahito bhūtātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ |
vijahāra yathā rāmaḥ sugrīveṇa purā nṛpa || 7 ||
madhyaṃdine mahāviṣṇuḥ śaineyena sahācyutaḥ |
vikrīḍya suciraṃ kṛṣṇa upāraṃsīt sa yādavaḥ || 8 ||
dvāḥsthena vāritāḥ pūrvaṃ dvāryeva ca samāsthitāḥ |
idamantaramityeva viviśustāṃ sabhāṃ nṛpa || 9 ||
yatayo dīrghatapasaḥ puraskṛtya tapodhanam |
durvāsasaṃ sumanaso dadṛśuryādaveśvaram || 3.111.10 ||
golakrīḍāsamāsaktaṃ karasaṃsthitagolakam |
padmapatraviśālākṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ taṃ sātyakiṃ harim || 11 ||
ekenākṣṇā hlādayantaṃ pareṇānyena golakam |
yatayaśca mahārāja pratyadṛśyanta tatpuraḥ || 12 ||
vṛṣṇipaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ sātyakirbalabhadrakaḥ |
vasudevastathākrūraḥ ugrasenastathā nṛpa || 13 ||
anye ca yādavāḥ sarve sambhramaṃ pratipedire |
idaṃ kimidamityevaṃ vyāśaṅkamanaso'bhavan || 14 ||
pṛṣṭhato'pyanugacchanti didhakṣantaṃ jagattrayam |
ardhakaupīnavasanaṃ smarantaṃ kamapi dvijam || 15 ||
antastāpasamāyuktaṃ chinnadaṇḍadharaṃ yatim |
antarjvalantaṃ roṣeṇa haṃsāsāditakalmaṣam || 16 ||
netrotthitamahāvahniṃ prekṣantaṃ yādaveśvaram |
durvāsasaṃ te dadṛśurbhītā yādavasattamāḥ || 17 ||
kiṃ kariṣyatyasau kruddhaḥ ki vā vakṣyati naḥ prabhuḥ |
iti prāñjalayaḥ sarve yādavāḥ pratipedire || 18 ||
idamāsanamityevaṃ kiṃcidūcuśca vṛṣṇayaḥ |
tataḥ kṛṣṇo hṛṣīkeśaḥ kiṃcidutplutya tatpuraḥ || 19 ||
idamāsanamityevaṃ sthīyatāmiha nirvṛtaḥ |
ahamadya sthito vipra kiṃkaro'smīti cāvravīt || 3.111.20 ||
tataḥ kiṃcidivāsīna āsane yativigrahaḥ |
āsane saṃsthite tasmin yatayo vītamatsarāḥ || 21 ||
āsanāni yathāyogaṃ bhejire nirvṛtāḥ kila |
arghyādisamudācāraṃ cakre kṛṣṇaḥ kirīṭabhṛt || 22 ||
āha bhūyo hṛṣīkeśo yatiṃ durvāsasaṃ prabhum |
kimarthaṃ brūhi viprendra asmin pratyāgamo hi vaḥ || 23 ||
dṛṣṭaṃ vā hyathavā kiṃcit kāraṇaṃ cāsti vo mahat |
saṃnyāsino dvijaśreṣṭhā yūyaṃ vigatakalmaṣāḥ || 24 ||
niḥspṛhāśca sadā yūyamasmatto dvijapuṅgavāḥ |
prārthyaṃ nāma na caivāsti spṛhā naivāsti vo yataḥ|| 25 ||
spṛhāpreritakarmāṇaḥ kṣatriyān yānti suvratāḥ |
nirūpyamāṇamasmābhirvipra kiṃcinna dṛśyate || 26 ||
na jāne kāraṇaṃ brahman yuṣmadāgamanaṃ prati |
etāvatā cānumeyaṃ kicitkāraṇamasti vai || 27 ||
tad brūhi yadi vidyeta tvatto jñāsyāmahe vayam |
ityuktavati deveśe cakrapāṇau janārdane || 28 ||
tasyāpi rājanviprasya bhūyaḥ kopo mahānabhūt |
tasmādabhyadhikaḥ pūrvāt kopaḥ saṃjāyate mahān ||29 ||
didhakṣanniva lokāṃstrīn bhakṣayanniva paśyataḥ |
roṣaraktekṣaṇaḥ kruddho hasanniva dahanniva || 3.111.30 ||
uvāca vacanaṃ viṣṇuṃ durvāsā krodhamūrcchitaḥ |
na jāne iti kasmāt tvaṃ brūṣe no yādaveśvara || 31 ||
jānāmi tvāṃ mahādevaṃ vañcayanniva bhāṣase |
purātanā vayaṃ viṣṇo pūrvavṛttāntavedinaḥ || 32 ||
yathā hi devadevo'si māyāmānuṣadehavān |
nigūhase prabhurataḥ kasmānno jagatīpate || 33 ||
so'si brahmavidāṃ mūrtistavaitat paramaṃ padam |
yadabhyarcya purā brahmā yacca jñānā vayaṃ purā || 34 ||
yato viśvamidaṃ bhūtaṃ tadetat paramaṃ padam |
yacca sthūlaṃ vijānanti purā tattvena cetasā || 35 ||
purāvido'tha viśveśa yadetat paramaṃ vapuḥ |
karmaṇā prāpyate yattu yatsmṛtvā nirvṛtā vayam || 36 ||
pratyakṣamapi yadrūpaṃ naiva jānanti mānuṣāḥ |
na hi mūḍhadhiyo deva na vayaṃ tādṛśā hare || 37 ||
na jāne iti yad brūṣe kimataḥ sāhasaṃ vacaḥ |
ye hi mūlaṃ vijānanti teṣāṃ tu pravivecanam || 38 ||
kurvataḥ kiṃ phalaṃ deva tava keśiniṣūdana |
vedānte prathitaṃ tejastava cedaṃ vicāryate || 39 ||
ye ca vijñānatṛptāstu yogino vītakalmaṣāḥ |
paśyanti hṛtsaroje'pi tadevedaṃ vapuḥ prabho || 3.111.40 ||
vedairyad gīyate tejo brahmeti pratipādya vai |
tadevedaṃ vijāne'haṃ rūpamaiśvarameva ca || 41 ||
vaiṣṇavaṃ paramaṃ teja iti vedeṣu paṭhyate |
avagacchāmyahaṃ viṣṇo tadevedaṃ vapustava || 42 ||
ya omityucyate śabdo yasya vāgiti gīyate |
sa evāsi prabho viṣṇo na jāne iti mā vada || 43 ||
parokṣaṃ yadi kiṃcit syāt tava vaktuṃ prayujyate |
na jāne iti govinda mā vādīḥ sāhasaṃ hare || 44 ||
viśvaṃ yataḥ prādurāsīd yasmim̐llīna kṣaye sati |
idaṃ tadaiśvaraṃ tejastvavagacchāghi keśava || 45 ||
kartā tvaṃ bhūtabhavyeśa pratibhāsi sadā hṛdi |
yad yad rūpaṃ smare nityaṃ tat tadevāsi me hṛdi || 46 ||
vāyureva yadā viṣṇuriti me dhīyate matiḥ |
tadā tadrūpa evāsi hṛnmadhye saṃsthito vibho || 47 ||
ākāśo viṣṇurityeva kadāciddhīyate matiḥ |
tadā tadrūpa evāsi hṛnmadhye saṃsthito vibho || 48 ||
pṛthivī viṣṇurityetat kadāciddhīyate matiḥ |
tadā pārthivarūpastvaṃ pratibhāsi sadā mama || 49 ||
raso'yaṃ deva ityeva kadāciccintyate mayā |
tadā rasātmanā viṣṇo hṛnmadhyesaṃsthitovibho || 3.111.50 ||
yadā tvāṃ teja ityevaṃ smartā syāṃ puruṣottama |
tadā tadrūpasampannaḥ pratibhāsi sadā hṛdi || 51 ||
candramā harirityevaṃ tadā cāndramasaṃ vapuḥ |
nirīkṣya cakṣuṣā deva tataḥ prīto'smi keśava || 52 ||
yadā sauraṃ vapuriti smartā syāṃ jagatīpate |
tadā tadbhāvanāyogāt sūrya eva virājase || 53 ||
tasmāt sarvaṃ tvamevāsi niścitā matirīdṛśī |
ato na jāne'hamiti vaktuṃ neśo janārdana || 54 ||
ityarthaṃ saṃsthito viṣṇo pīḍāṃ no naiva cintyase |
atyantaduḥkhitā viṣṇo vayaṃ tvāmanusaṃsthitāḥ || 55 ||
īdṛśīyamavasthā no naitāṃ smarasi keśava |
etat punarbhāgyamato naṣṭamityeva cintaye || 56 ||
mandabhāgyā vayaṃ viṣṇo yato no na smareḥ prabho |
kaucit kṣatriyadāyādau girīśavaragarvitau || 57 ||
nāmnā ca haṃsaḍimbhakau bādhete no janārdana |
gārhasthyaṃ hi sadā śreyo vadantāviti keśava || 58 ||
itastataśca dhāvantau vadantau bahu kilbiṣam |
ayuktaṃ bahu bhāṣantau dharṣayantau ca naḥ sadā || 59 ||
idamanyat kṛtaṃ deva asahyaṃ pāpamucyate |
paśyedaṃ bahudhā deva bhinnaṃ bhinnaṃ sahasraśaḥ || 3.111.60 ||
śakyaṃ ca dāravaṃ pātraṃ dvidalān veṇukān bahūn |
idamapyaparaṃ paśya tayoḥ sāhasaceṣṭitam || 61 ||
kaupīnaṃ bahudhā chinnaṃ tadasmākaṃ mahaddhanam |
kṛtaṃ kapālamātreṇa kamaṇḍalu jagatprabho || 62 ||
tvaṃ tu no rakṣase nityaṃ kṣātraṃ vai vratamāsthitaḥ |
citraṃ citramidaṃ deva rakṣasyasi sadāniśam || 63 ||
kiṃ kariṣyāmi mandātmā mandabhogyā vayaṃ vibho |
kiṃ naḥ śaraṇamadyaiva tad brūhi jagatāṃ pate || 64 ||
jīvantau tau yadi syātāṃ naṣṭā lokā ime trayaḥ |
na viprā na ca rājāno na vaiśyā na ca pādajāḥ || 65 ||
atyantabalinau mattau tīkṣṇadaṇḍadharau nṛpa |
na tayoḥ purataḥ sthātuṃ śaktā devāḥ savāsavāḥ || 66 ||
na ca bhīṣmo na vā rājā vāhlīko bhīmavikramaḥ |
yo hi vīro jarāsaṃdhaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ bhayaṃkaraḥ || 67 ||
naiva ca prāyaśaḥ sthātuṃ girīśavaradarpiṇoḥ |
tayoḥ kṛṣṇa hare śakto nityamapratisaṅginoḥ || 68 ||
tasmāt tvaṃ jahi tau vīrau rakṣa lokānimān prabho |
anyathā rakṣasītyevaṃ vyarthaḥ śabdo'tra jāyate ||69||
bahunātra kimuktena rakṣa rakṣa janattrayam |
ityuktvā virarāmaiva durvāsāḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ || 3.111.70 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhabiṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne durvāsaḥ samāgame ekādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 111 ||

<3.112>

dvādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
yatervacanamākarṇya mandamucchvasya keśavaḥ |
durvāsasaṃ samālokya babhāṣe yādaveśvaraḥ || 1 ||
kṣantavyaṃ bhavatā sarvaṃ doṣa eṣa mamaiva hi |
śṛṇu vākyaṃ mamaitat tu śrutvā śāntiparo bhava || 2 ||
jeṣyāmi tau raṇe vipra haṃsaṃ ḍimbhakameva ca |
girīśo vā varaṃ dadyācchakro vā dhanado'pi vā || 3 ||
yamo vā varuṇo vāpi brahmā vātha caturmukhaḥ |
sabalau sānujau hatvā punardāsyāmi vo ratim || 4 ||
satyenaiva śapāmyadya mā roṣavaśago bhava |
rakṣāṃ vo'haṃ kariṣyāmi hatvā tau ca nṛpādhamau || 5 ||
jānāmi tau durātmānau yuṣmaddoṣakarau hi tau |
śrutaṃ ca pūrvamasmābhistīkṣṇadaṇḍadharāviti || 6 ||
atyantabalinau mattau girīśavaradarpitau |
nālpaprayatnasaṃsādhyau jarāsaṃdhahitaiṣiṇau || 7 ||
prāṇānapi tayo rājā dāsyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ |
jarāsaṃdho na bhūpālo vinā tau jayate mahīm || 8 ||
jaye tayorvipravarya tatra śreyo bhavet tataḥ |
yatra yatra tu tau gatvā sthitāvityanuśuśruma || 9 ||
tatra tatra ca hantāhaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
gacchadhvaṃ yatayaḥ svairaṃ nijakāryaparāyaṇāḥ || 3.112.10 ||
acireṇaiva kālena jeṣyāmi raṇapuṅgavau |
tataḥ prītaḥ prasannātmā yādaveśvaramāha saḥ || 11 ||
svastyastu bhavate kṛṣṇa jagatāṃ svasti kurvate |
kiṃ nu nāma jagannātha duḥsādhyaṃ tava keśava || 12 ||
trilokeśa tridhāmāsi sarvasaṃhārakārakaḥ |
devānāmapi deveśaḥ sarvatra samadarśanaḥ || 13 ||
viṣṇo deva hare kṛṣṇa namaste cakrapāṇaye |
namaḥ svabhāvaśuddhāya śuddhāya niyatāya ca || 14 ||
śabdagocara deveśa namaste bhaktavatsala |
ajñānādathavā jñānād yanmayoktaṃ kṣamasva tat || 15 ||
tvamevāhaṃ jagannātha nāvayorantaraṃ pṛthak |
ataḥ kṣamasva bhagavan kṣamāsārā hi sādhavaḥ || 16 ||
śrībhagavānuvāca
kṣantavyaṃ bhavatā vipra kṣamāsārā vayaṃ sadā |
saṃnyāsinaḥ kṣamāsārāḥ kṣamā teṣāṃ paraṃ balam || 17 ||
kṣamā mokṣakarī nityaṃ tattvajñānamiva dvija |
kṣamā dharmaḥ kṣamā satyaṃ kṣamā dānaṃ kṣamā yaśaḥ || 18 ||
kṣamā svargasya sopānamiti vedavido viduḥ |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kṣamāṃ pālayata svakām || 19 ||
pratyakṣajñānasaṃyuktā yūyaṃ sarve yatīśvarāḥ |
ya ete yatayo viprāḥ pūjanīyā mayādya vai || 3.112.20 ||
bhoktavyā yatayo viprā bhikṣukāḥ sarva eva hi |
tatheti te pratijñāya bhoktumaicchan harergṛhe || 21 ||
tataḥ svabhavanaṃ viṣṇuḥ praviśya harirīśvaraḥ |
caturvidhaṃ tathā''hāraṃ kārayitvā yathāvidhi ||22||
bhojayāmāsa tān sarvānyatīnyativarārcitaḥ |
chittvā chittvā ca deveśo dukūlāni mṛdūni saḥ || 23 ||
dadau tebhyastadā viṣṇuḥ sarvebhyo janamejaya |
te ca prītā yathāyogaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ tato gatāḥ || 24 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne yatibhojane dvādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 112 ||

<3.113>

trayodaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
durvāsāstvatha tatraiva nāradena mahātmanā |
cintayan brahmaṇastattvaṃ vijahāra yathāsukham || 1 ||
bhagavānapi govindastayorvāsamamanyata |
tatastau haṃsaḍimbhakau tasminkāle mahīpatim || 2 ||
brahmadattaṃ mahīpālaṃ pitaraṃ vīryaśālinam |
prāvocatāmidaṃ vākyaṃ samantājjanasaṃsadi || 3 ||
rājasūyaṃ mahāyajñaṃ pitaḥ kuru suyatnataḥ |
asmin māsi nṛpaśreṣṭha yatāvo yajñasiddhaye || 4 ||
āvāṃ te'dya mahārāja diśāṃ vijayatatparau |
yatiṣyāvo balaiḥ sārdhaṃ gajairaśvai rathairapi || 5 ||
sambhārā yajñasiddhyarthamānetavyā nṛpottama |
tatheti sa mahāvāho brahmadatto'bravīt tadā || 6 ||
janārdanastu viprendro dṛṣṭvā sāhasatatparau |
aśakyamiti manvāno vayasyaṃ haṃsamabravīt || 7 ||
śṛṇu haṃsa vaco mahyaṃ śrutvā niścitya vīryavān |
āyuṣman sāhasaṃ kartumudyato'si nṛpottama || 8 ||
sthite bhīṣme jarāsaṃdhe bāhlīke ca nṛpottame |
kiṃ ca vīreṣu sarveṣu yādaveṣu nṛpottama || 9 ||
bhīṣmo hi balavān vṛddhaḥ satyasaṃdho jitendriyaḥ||
triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivīṃ yo jigāya bhṛgūttamaḥ || 3.113.10 ||
taṃ yuddhe jitavān bhīṣmaḥ sarvakṣatrasya paśyataḥ |
jarāsaṃdhasya yad vīryaṃ tad bhavānvetti saṃyuge || 11 ||
vṛṣṇivīrāstu te sarve kṛtāstrā yuddhadurmadāḥ |
tatra kṛṣṇo hṛṣīkeśo jitaśatruḥ kṛtī sadā || 12 ||
jarāsaṃdhena sahitaḥ sadā yuddhe jitaśramaḥ |
pramukhe tasya na sthātuṃ śakto jīvan nṛpottamaḥ || 13 ||
balabhadrastathā mattaḥ kruddho yadi bhaved balī ||
lokānimān samāhartuṃ śaknotīti matirmama || 14 ||
tathā ca sātyakirvīraḥ śakto jetuṃ raṇe ripūn |
tathānye yādavāḥ sarve kṛṣṇamāśritya daṃśitāḥ || 15 ||
asmābhiśca kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ virodho yatibhiḥ saha |
durvāsā yatibhiḥ sārdhaṃ gato draṣṭuṃ sa keśavam || 16 ||
iti śrutaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha brāhmaṇād bhoktumāgatāt |
tathā sati yathā siddhyettathā cintyaṃ ca mantribhiḥ||17||
tataḥ pat vidhāsyāmo rājasūyaṃ mahākratum |
haṃsa uvāca
ko nāma bhīṣmo mandātmā vṛddho hīnabalaḥ sadā || 18 ||
āvayoḥ purataḥ sthātuṃ śaktaḥ sa kila vṛddhakaḥ |
yādavā iti citraṃ naḥ śaktāḥ sthātuṃ raṇe dvija || 19 ||
kaśca kṛṣṇaḥ puraḥ sthātuṃ baladevaśca mattakaḥ |
śaineyaścāpi viprendra sthātuṃ na iti cintaya || 3.113.20 ||
jarāsaṃdhastu dharmātmā bandhureva sadā mama |
gaccha priya yaduśreṣṭhaṃ brūhi madvacanāt tvaran || 21 ||
dīyatāṃ karasarvasvaṃ yajñārthaṃ sundaraṃ bahu |
lavaṇāni bahūnyadya gṛhya keśava mā ciram || 22 ||
āgaccha tvaritaṃ kṛṣṇa na te kāryaṃ vilambanam |
iti brūhi yaduśreṣṭhaṃ yāhi tvaritavikramaḥ || 23 ||
na brūyāścottaraṃ vipra śapeyaṃ tvāṃ priyo'si me |
mitrabhāvādidaṃ brūhi paśyāmi tvāṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 24 ||
iti saṃcodito vipro nottaraṃ pratyabhāṣata |
mitrabhāvāt tathā rājan snehācca janamejaya || 25 ||
janārdanastu dharmātmā nityaṃ gantuṃ samudyataḥ |
adya śvo vā paraśvo vā gacchāmīti yateta saḥ || 26||
devaṃ draṣṭuṃ jagadyoniṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam |
eka eva ca dharmātmā hayamāruhya satvaram || 27 ||
prātareva jagāmāśu draṣṭuṃ dvāravatīṃ dvijaḥ |
hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ manasā saṃsmaran dvijaḥ || 28 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne trayodaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 113 ||

<3.114>

caturdaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ prāyāddhariṃ viṣṇuṃ brāhmaṇo brahmavittamaḥ |
hayenaikena rājendra tvaritaṃ sa yayau nṛpa || 1 ||
yathā nidāghasamaye sūryāṃśuparipīḍitaḥ |
pāntho yāti jalaṃ dṛṣṭvā tvaritaṃ tatpipāsayā || 2 ||
dhāvatyeva tathā vipro hariṃ draṣṭuṃ janārdanaḥ |
gacchansa cintayāmāsa codayanhayamuttamam|| 3 ||
haṃsa eva priyo mahyaṃ kuryāt priyahitaṃ mama |
tathā hi preṣitastena hariṃ paśyāmyahaṃ prabhum || 4 ||
ahameva sadā dhanyo matto hyabhyadhiko na hi |
yato drakṣyāmyahaṃ viṣṇuṃ vasantaṃ dvārakāpure || 5 ||
sā hi me jananī dhanyā hariṃ dṛṣṭvā punargatam |
kṛtārthaṃ sarvadā devī drakṣyatyeṣā manasvinī || 6 ||
mukhamunnidrahemābjakiñjalkasadṛśaprabham |
drakṣyāmi devadevasya cakriṇaḥ śārṅgadhanvanaḥ || 7 ||
'maiṃ śārṅga dhanuṣa dhāraṇa karanebāle devādhideva śrīkṛṣṇake
uśca mukhakā darśana karūm̐gā3 jo vikasita suvarṇamaya kamalake
kesarakīnhī kāntise prakāśita hotā haiṃ || 7 ||
vapurdrakṣyāmyahaṃ viṣṇornīlotpaladalacchavi |
śaṅkhacakragadāśārṅgavanamālāvibhūṣitam || 8 ||
netre te devadevasya padmakiñjalkasaprabhe |
paśyāmyahamadīnātmā naṣṭaduḥkho'smi nirvṛtaḥ || 9 ||
api drakṣyati yogātmā saumyenaiva svacakṣuṣā |
api vā matpriyaṃ brūyāt svasti ceti ca vā vadet|| 3.114.10||
drakṣyāmi cakriṇo varṣma tatastrailokyasaṃnibham |
pādābjaṃ cakriṇo draṣṭuṃ tvaratyeva ca me manaḥ || 11 ||
vakṣaḥsthalaṃ sadā viṣṇoḥ sphuradratnaprabhāyutam |
paśyanniva ca gacchāmi smaraścāniśamīśvaram || 12 ||
pītakauśeyavasanaṃ lambahāravibhūṣitam |
īṣatsmitādharaṃ viṣṇuṃ paśyāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ || 13 ||
smarataśca hare rūpaṃ romaharṣo'yamīdṛśaḥ |
gacchataśca puro bhāti śaṅkhacakragadāsimān || 14 ||
yātīva ca puro bhāti mahyaṃ devā jagadguruḥ |
eṣo'yamiti me vaktuṃ jihvā prasphuratīva tam || 15 ||
idaṃ duḥkhataraṃ manye karaṃ dehīti madvacaḥ |
idaṃ tatsāhasaṃ manye tadvacastasya bhūpateḥ || 16 ||
haṃsasya karado viṣṇustadājñāparicārakaḥ |
tasya sarvaṃ puro gatvā vaktāhaṃ kila nirdayaḥ || 17 ||
mūḍhānāmagraṇīrasmi nirlajjaśca tathā vadan |
karaṃ dehi hare viṣṇo haṃsasya yadupuṅgava || 18 ||
lavaṇāni bahūnyāśu dātavyāni karātmanā |
iti vaktuṃ na me yuktaṃ puratastasya śārṅgiṇaḥ || 19 ||
tathāpi mitrabhāvāt tu vaktavyaṃ ghoramīdṛśam |
kaṣṭo hyayaṃ mitrabhāvo manuṣyāṇāṃ kṛtātmanām|| 3.114.20 ||
athavā sarvavid viṣṇuḥ sarvasya hṛdi saṃsthitam|
jānātyeva sadā bhāvaṃ prāṇināṃ śobhane rataḥ || 21 ||
tathā sati na me doṣo mitrabhāvo yato hyayam |
sarvathā rakṣatāṃ viṣṇurghoraṃ vaktuṃ yatasya me || 22 ||
drakṣyāmyahaṃ jagannāthaṃ nīlakuñcitamūrdhajam |
kambugrīvadharaṃ viṣṇuṃ śrīvatsācchāditorasam || 23 ||
sphuratpadmamahābāhuṃ ratnacchāyāvirājitam |
drakṣyāmi keśavaṃ viṣṇuṃ cakriṇaṃ yādaveśvaram || 24 ||
acintyavibhavaṃ devaṃ bhūtabhavyabhavatprabhum |
ātmecchayā jagadrakṣaṃ drakṣyāmi jalaśāyinam || 25 ||
kṛtārthaḥ sarvathā cāhaṃ bhavāmi vigatajvaraḥ |
adya me saphalaṃ janma sākṣād dṛṣṭavato harim || 26 ||
adya me saphalā yajñāḥ sākṣātkṛtavato harim |
netre me saphale viṣṇuṃ paśyataśca jaganmayam || 27 ||
prītimānastu me viṣṇurvakturghorasya karmaṇaḥ |
unmiṣannetrayugmena drakṣyāmi sakṛdīśvaram || 28 ||
āmūlamasakṛd viṣṇuṃ paśyāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ |
pibāmi netrayugmena vapuḥ kṛṣṇasya kevalam || 29 ||
dhārayiṣyāmyahaṃ pāṃsuṃ tatpādaprabhavaṃ śivam |
tataḥ kṛtārthatāṃ yāsye svargamārgo hi tadrajaḥ || 3.114.30 ||
meghagambhīranirghoṣaṃ śroṣyāmi ca hareḥ svaram |
pādābjaṃ cakriṇo viṣṇoḥ paśyāmi ca jagatpateḥ || 31 ||
paśyāmi ca harervaktraṃ pūrṇendusadṛśaprabham |
hareridaṃ jagad rūpaṃ paśyāmīva ca sarvataḥ || 32 ||
prasīdatu sadā viṣṇurayuktaṃ vaktumicchataḥ |
ālolakuṇḍalayutaṃ haricandanacarcitam || 33 ||
sphuratkeyūraratnārcirbāhudvayavirājitam |
savye dyotanmahāśaṅkhaṃ raśmijālavirājitam || 34 ||
prodyadbhāskaravarṇābhaṃ cakrajvālāvirājitam |
projjvalatkaṅkaṇayutaṃ taptajāmbūnadāṅgadam || 35 ||
pītakauśeyavasanaṃ vistīrṇoraskamacyutam |
kadā drakṣyāmi deveśamidānīmathavānyadā || 36 ||
sarvathā kṛtakṛtyo'haṃ yadvapurdraṣṭumudyataḥ |
namo mahyaṃ namo mahyaṃ yato draṣṭumahaṃ harim || 37 ||
udyato'smi jagannāthaṃ balabhadrakṛtāspadam |
drakṣyāmyavaśyamadyaiva jiṣṇuṃ viṣṇuṃ jagadgurum || 38 ||
śrīkaustubhodbhavaruci sphuritoruvakṣaḥ pītāmbaraṃ makarakuṇḍalapaṅkajākṣam |
kṛṣṇaṃ kirīṭavaracakragadordhvahastaṃ tejomayaṃ mama harervapurastu bhūtyai || 39 ||
vedodadhau viśadaśāstramahāhiyoge niṣṇātaśuddhamatimandaramathyamāne |
udyotamānamamarairaniśaṃ niṣevyaṃ nārāyaṇākhyamamṛtaṃ prapibāmi vādya || 3.114.40 ||
dhyeyaṃ mumukṣubhirameyamanādyanantaṃ sthūlaṃ susūkṣmataramekamanekamādyam |
jyotistrilokajanakaṃ tridaśaikavandyamakṣṇormamāstu satataṃ hṛdaye'cyutākhyam ||41||
cintayanniti viprendro yayau dvāravatīṃ purīm |
matvā kṛtārthamātmānaṃ vāhayan hayamuttamam || 42 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne viprasya dvāravatīgamane caturdaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 114 ||

<3.115>

pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
sa niveditasarvasvo dvāḥsthena hi janārdanaḥ |
atha praviśya dharmātmā sudharmāṃ vai dvijottamaḥ || 1 ||
apaśyad devadeveśaṃ sudharmākṛtisaṃsthitam |
balabhadreṇa saṃyuktamadhyāsitamahāsanam || 2 ||
agrataḥ sthitaśaineyaṃ pārśvataḥ sthitanāradam |
durvāsasā kṛtakathamugrasenapuraskṛtam || 3 ||
gāyadgandharvamukhyaiśca nṛtyadapsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ |
sevyamānaṃ mahārāja sūtamāgadhabandibhiḥ || 4 ||
udgīyamānayaśasaṃ mādhavaṃ madhusūdanam |
udgīyamānaṃ vipraiśca sāmabhiḥ sāmagairharim || 5 ||
dṛṣṭvā prītamanā viṣṇuṃ prodbhūtapulakacchaviḥ |
nāmnā janārdano'smīti nanāma caraṇau hareḥ |
balabhadraṃ tato devaṃ vavande śirasā dvija || 6 ||
dūto'smi devadeveśa haṃsasya ḍimbhakasya ca |
iti bruvāṇaṃ viprendramidamāha sa mādhavaḥ || 7 ||
āssvaidaṃ viṣṭaraṃ pūrvaṃ paścād brūhi prayojanam |
tatheti cābravīd vipro mahadāsanamāsthitaḥ || 8 ||
vācā sampūjya viprendramapṛcchatkuśalaṃ hariḥ |
brahmadattasya rājendra haṃsasya ḍimbhakasya ca || 9 ||
śrutaṃ cāpi tayorvīryaṃ prayojanamato dvija |
api vā kuśalaṃ vipra pitustava janārdana || 3.115.10 ||
janārdana uvāca
kuśalaṃ brahmadattasya pituśca mama keśava |
tayoreva jagannātha haṃsasya ḍimbhakasya ca ||11 ||
śrībhagavānuvāca
kimāhaturmahīpālau tau haṃsaḍimbhakau nṛpau |
brūhi sarvamaśeṣeṇa nātra śaṅkā dvijottama || 12 ||
vācyaṃ vāpyathavāvācyaṃ kartavyamatha cetarat |
śrutvā tasya vidhāsyāmo yuktarūpaṃ dvijottama || 13 ||
dūto'si sarvathā vipra na vācyāvācyakalpanā |
yat karmakāranirdiṣṭaṃ tad vācyaṃ dūtajanmanā || 14 ||
nātra śaṅkā tvayā kāryā vaktavyasyetarasya ca |
ato vada yathā proktaṃ tābhyāmiha janārdana || 15 ||
keśavenaivamuktastu provāca sa janārdanaḥ |
ajānanniva kiṃ brūṣe sarvaṃ pratyakṣadarśivān || 16 ||
na cāsti te parokṣaṃ tu jagadvṛttāntamacyuta |
sarvaṃ hi manasā paśyan kiṃ tvamāttha vadeti mām || 17 ||
vidvadbhirgīyase viṣṇustvameva jagatīpate |
icchayā sarvamāpnoṣi dṛṣṭādṛṣṭavivecanam || 18 ||
tvamevedaṃ jagat sarvaṃ jagacca tvayi tiṣṭhati |
na tvayā rahito hyekaḥ padārthaḥ sacarācaraḥ || 19 ||
nāsti kiṃcidavedyaṃ te sarvago'si jagatpate |
tvamindraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ rudraḥ saṃhārakarmakṛt || 3.115.20 ||
rakṣitāsi sadā viṣṇuḥ sarvalokasya mādhava |
saṃsārasya bhavānsraṣṭā kiṃ tvamāttha vadeti māma 21 ||
vidvadbhirgīyase nityaṃ jñānātmeti ca mādhava |
prāṇaṃ prāṇavidaḥ prāhustvāmeva puruṣottama || 22 ||
śabdaṃ śabdavidaḥ prāhustvāmeva puruṣottama |
tathā sati hṛṣīkeśa kiṃ tvamāttha vadeti mām || 23 ||
tathāpi śṛṇu deveśa codito'smi yatastvayā |
vadetyasakṛdevaitat tasmād vakṣyāmi mādhava || 24 ||
rājasūyena yajñena brahmadatto'dya yakṣyate |
tadarthaṃ preṣitastābhyāṃ haṃsena ḍimbhakena ca || 25 ||
karārthaṃ yadumukhyebhyastava cāmantraṇāya hi |
lavaṇaṃ bahu deyaṃ te yajñārthaṃ tasya keśava || 26 ||
ityarthaṃ preṣitastābhyāṃ karaṃ dehi tadājñayā |
idaṃ tvamaparaṃ tābhyāmuktaṃ śṛṇu jagatpate || 27 ||
lavaṇāni bahūnyāśu pragṛhya tvaritaṃ bhavān |
āgacchatu tayo rājñoḥ seyaṃ keśava vāg vibho || 28 ||
ityuktavati viprendre dūte tatra tayornṛpa |
prahasya suciraṃ kṛṣṇo babhāṣe dūtamīśvaraḥ || 29 ||
śṛṇu dūta vaco mahyaṃ yuktamuktaṃ dvijottama |
karaṃ dadāmi tābhyāṃ tu karado'smi yato nṛpaḥ || 3.115.30 ||
dhārṣṭyametat tayorvipra matto yastu karagrahaḥ |
aho dhārṣṭyamaho dhārṣṭyaṃ tayoḥ kṣatriyabījayoḥ || 31 ||
idamaśrutapūrvaṃ me matto yastu karagrahaḥ |
ityuktvā keśavo dūtamidamāha sma yādavān || 32 ||
hāsyametad yaduśreṣṭhā matto yastu karagrahaḥ |
yaṣṭāsau rājasūyasya brahmadatto mahīpatiḥ || 33 ||
tau tu yājayitārau hi haṃso ḍimbhaka eva ca |
voḍhā kila yaduśreṣṭho lavaṇasya durātmanaḥ || 34 ||
karado vāsudevo hi jito'smi yadusattamāḥ |
hāsyaṃ hāsyamidaṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ yādavā vacaḥ || 35 ||
ityuktavati deveśe balabhadrapurogamāḥ |
yādavāḥ sarva evaite hāsāya samavasthitāḥ || 36 ||
karadaḥ kṛṣṇa ityevaṃ bruvantaḥ sarvasātvatāḥ |
hāsaṃ mumucuratyarthaṃ talaṃ dattvā parasparam || 37 ||
talaśabdo hāsaśabdo rodasī paryapūrayat |
sa ca vipro nṛpaśreṣṭha nindayan mitramātmanaḥ || 38 ||
aho kaṣṭamaho kaṣṭaṃ dautyaṃ yat kṛtavānaham |
iti lajjāsamāviṣṭastūṣṇīmāsīdavāṅmukhaḥ || 39 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne
vāsudevavākye pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 115 ||

<3.116>

ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
hāsaṃ kurvatsu teṣvevaṃ keśavaḥ keśisūdanaḥ |
uvāca vacanaṃ dūtaṃ gaccha madvacanād dvija || 1 ||
tāvitthaṃ haṃsaḍimbhakau brūhi tvaritavikramaḥ |
bāṇairdāsyāmi niśitaiḥ śārṅgamuktaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ || 2 ||
asinā vātha dāsyāmi niśitena mahātmanoḥ |
śiro vā chetsyate cakraṃ matkaraprahitaṃ balim || 3 ||
yo varaṃ dattavān rudro yuvayordhārṣṭyakāraṇam |
sa eva rakṣitā vāṃ syāttaṃ jitvā vāṃ nihanmyaham || 4 ||
deśo'yaṃ saṃvidhātavyo yatra naḥ saṃgatirbhavet|
tatra gantā tathā cāsmi sabalaḥ sahavāhanaḥ||5||
bhavantau nirbhayau bhūtvā gacchetāṃ sabalau nṛpau |
puṣkare vā prayāge vā mathurāyāmathāpi vā || 6 ||
tatrāhaṃ sabalo yātā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
athavā mitrabhāvācca vaktumevaṃ na te kṣamam || 7 ||
na śakyaṃ yat tvayā vaktuṃ tacca vakṣyati sātyakiḥ |
tvayā saha tato gatvā sākṣibhūto bhava dvija || 8 ||
idaṃ ca jāne viprendra sneho mayi sadā tava |
tena tvaṃ vijayī bhūtvā saṃsāre duḥkhasaṃkule |
matkathāparamo nityaṃ sadā bhava janārdana || 9 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||116 ||

<3.117>

saptadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
ityuktvā brāhmaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sātyakiṃ punarāha saḥ |
gatvā śaineya vipreṇa brūhi madvacanāt tayoḥ || 1 ||
yanmayoktamaśeṣeṇa vada gatvā tayoḥ puraḥ |
yathā naḥ saṃgatiryuddhe tathā vada balāt tadā || 2 ||
dhanurādāya gaccha tvaṃ baddhagodhāṅgulitravān |
ekenāśvena gaccha tvamasahāyo yadūttama || 3 ||
sātyakistaṃ tathetyuktvā hayamāruhya śīghragam |
gantumaicchat tato rājannasahāyaḥ sa sātyakiḥ || 4 ||
janārdanaṃ visṛjyāśu dūtaṃ taṃ yādaveśvaraḥ |
aho dhārṣṭyamaho dhārṣṭyamityuvāca janārdanaḥ || 5 ||
namaskṛtya tadā dūto mādhavaṃ mādhaveśvaram |
sa yayau śālvanagaraṃ śaineyena samanvitaḥ || 6 ||
tataḥ praviśya dharmātmā brāhmaṇo brahmavittamaḥ |
āsanaṃ mahadāsthāya visṛjya yādave punaḥ || 7 ||
āste sukhaṃ yadā vipraḥ śaineyena samanvitaḥ |
atha taṃ haṃsaḍimbhayordarśayāmāsa sātyakim || 8 ||
dūto'yaṃ sātyakiḥ prāptaḥ savyo bāhurayaṃ hareḥ |
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā haṃsaḥ prāha vacastadā || 9 ||
śrutaḥ samāgamaḥ pūrvamadya dṛṣṭo mayā tvasau |
dhanurvede ca vede ca śāstre śastre tathaiva ca || 3.117.10 ||
nipuṇo'yaṃ sadā dhīra ityevamanuśuśruma |
atho dṛṣṭipathaṃ prāptaḥ prītiṃ nau vidadhātyasau || 11 ||
kuśalaṃ vāsudevasya balabhadrasya vā punaḥ |
kuśalāḥ sātvatāḥ sarve ugrasenapurogamāḥ || 12 ||
tatheti sātyakiḥ prāha mandamunmathitānanaḥ |
tato janārdanaṃ prāha haṃso vākyaviśāradaḥ || 13 ||
api dṛṣṭastvayā cakrī siddhaṃ naḥ kāryamīhitam |
vada sarvamaśeṣeṇa mā vṛthā kālamatyagāḥ || 14 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne haṃsavākye saptadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 117 ||

<3.118>

aṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
ityuktavati haṃse ca dharmātmātha janārdanaḥ |
uvāca prahasan vīraḥ stuvan nārāyaṇaṃ sadā || 1 ||
adrākṣamadrākṣamahaṃ janārdanaṃ hastasthaśaṅkhaṃ varacakradhāriṇam |
ātaptajāmbūnadabhūṣitāṅgadaṃ sphuratprabhādyotitaratnadhāriṇam || 2 ||
adrākṣamenaṃ yadubhiḥ purātanaḥ saṃsevyamānaṃ munivṛndamukhyaiḥ |
saṃstūyamānaṃ prabhubhiḥ samāgadhaiḥ smitapravālādharapallavāruṇam || 3 ||
adrākṣamenaṃ kavibhiḥ purātanairvivicya vedyaṃ vidhivatsahāmaraiḥ |
praphullanīlotpalaśobhitaṃ śriyā vinidrahemābjavirājitodaram || 4 ||
bhūyo'hamadrākṣamajaṃ jagadguruṃ pramodayantaṃ vacanena yādavān |
nirūpayantaṃ vidhivanmunīśvaraiḥ pravṛttavedārthavidhiṃ purātanaiḥ || 5 ||
adrākṣamadrākṣamahaṃ punaḥ punaḥ samastalokaikahitaiṣiṇaṃ harim |
vasantamasmiñjagato hitāya jaganmayaṃ tān paribhūya śatrūn || 6 ||
bhūyo'pyapaśyaṃ saha yādaveśvarairvikrīḍamānaṃ ca vihārakāle |
ramantamīḍyaṃ ramayantamīśvarān yadūttamān yādavamukhyamīśvaram || 7 ||
bhūyo'pyapaśyaṃ sarasīruhekṣaṇaṃ sametayā bhīṣmatanūjayā harim |
vasantamambhonidhiśāyinaṃ vibhuṃ bhaktapriyaṃ bhaktajanāspadaṃ śivam || 8 ||
adrākṣamadrākṣamahaṃ sunirvṛtaḥ piban pibaṃstasya vapuḥ purātanam |
netreṇa mīladvivareṇa kevalaṃ dhanyo'hamasmīti tadā vyacintayam|| 9 ||
adrākṣamambhojayugaṃ dadhānaṃ prabhuṃ vibhuṃ bhūtamayaṃ vibhāvanam |
ādyaṃ kakudmānamuruṃ vibhāvasuṃ saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya tameva nirvṛtaḥ || 3.118.10 ||
adrākṣaṃ jagatāmīśaṃ vakṣorājitakaustubham |
vījyamānaṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ cāmarāṇāṃ śataiḥ sadā || 11 ||
yuvāṃ vidveṣayuktena cetasā yādaveśvaram |
smarantaṃ sarvadā viṣṇuṃ kva caivaṃ kva ca vetti kaḥ || 12 ||
kva ca drakṣyāmi tau mandau kuto vā matpurogatau |
dhyāyantamitthaṃ deveśaṃ kare śaṅkhavahaṃ sadā || 13 ||
hasantamenamadrākṣaṃ karadaṃ hāsyatatparam |
vadantaṃ nārade vācaṃ durvāsasi yatīśvare || 14 ||
brahmasūtrapadāṃ vāṇīṃ dāpayantaṃ munīśvaram |
dṛṣṭvāhaṃ taṃ hariṃ devaṃ punaḥ punaracintayam || 15 ||
asādhyamidamārabdhaṃ tābhyāmiti nṛpottama |
nārabdhavyamidaṃ kāryamitaḥprabhṛti bhūmipa || 16 ||
nivṛttā sā kathā haṃsācintayad grahaṇaṃ tava |
tad vṛttamakhilaṃ sarvaṃ vadiṣyati hi sātyakiḥ |
etad vacanamākarṇya haṃsaḥ kuddho'bravīd vacaḥ || 17 ||
haṃsa uvāca
are brāhmaṇadāyāda kā nāma tava vāgiyam |
āvayoḥ purato vaktuṃ trailokyaṃ jetumicchatoḥ || 18 ||
māyayā tvāṃ bhrāmayati kṛṣṇo līlāvidhānavit |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhrama evaiṣa tava saṃjāyate mahān || 19 ||
śaṅkhacakragadāśārṅgavanamālāvibhūṣitam |
vṛṣṇivīraṃ samāvekṣya samucchritayaśodharam || 3.118.20 ||
sūtamāgadhasaṃstāvaprakaṭadbāhuvīryakam |
atyadbhutayaśorāśiṃ vikramāllokamaṇḍanam || 21 ||
caturbhujaṃ balākrāntaṃ vṛṣṇiyādavasammatam|
aho'dya bhrama evaiṣa darśanāt tasya cakriṇaḥ || 22 ||
idānīṃ ca mahārāja bhrāmayatyeva durmatiḥ |
tvāmeva vipra mandātmannindrajālikatā hi yā || 23 ||
cāpalyamidamaivaitat tava vipra bhramodbhavam |
aho hi khalu sādṛśyaṃ vaktavyaṃ bhavatā mama || 24 ||
ahameva tvayā vipra marṣaye proditaṃ vacaḥ |
sakhibhāvād dvijaśreṣṭha anyathā kaḥ sahedidam || 25 ||
gaccha mandamate vipra yatheṣṭaṃ sāmprataṃ tava |
dvija gaccha yatheṣṭaṃ tvaṃ pṛthivīṃ pṛthivī tava || 26 ||
jitvā gopāladāyādaṃ hatvā yādavakān bahūn |
eṣa naḥ prathamaḥ kalpo jeṣyāma iti yādavān || 27 ||
gaccha gaccheti vipra tvaṃ dhṛṣṭaṃ paruṣavādinam |
śatrupakṣastutiparaṃ saha yuktvā sadā mayā || 28 ||
na me vipravadhaḥ kāryaḥ kaṣṭādapi hi sarvataḥ |
ityuktvā brāhmaṇaṃ bhūyo haṃsaḥ sātyakimabravīt ||29||
bho bho yādavadāyāda kimarthaṃ prāptavāniha |
kimabravīnnandasutaḥ kiṃ vāsau me'diśat karam ||3.118.30||
sātyakiruvāca
idaṃ satyaṃ vaco haṃsa śaṅkhacakragadābhṛtaḥ |
śarairniśitadhārāgraiḥ śārṅgamuktaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ || 31 ||
dāsyāmi karasarvasvamasinā niśitena te |
śiraśchetsyāmi te haṃsa karadānasya saṃgraham || 32 ||
dhārṣṭyaṃ hi tava mandātmankimato'pi nṛpādhama |
devadevājjagannāthāt karamicchati yo nṛpaḥ || 33 ||
tasyaiṣa karasaṃkṣepo jihvācchedo narādhama |
tasya śārṅgaravaṃ śrutvā śaṅkhasya ca hareḥ punaḥ || 34 ||
ko nāma jīvitaṃ kāṅkṣet tiṣṭhedānīṃ tvamadya vai |
girīśavaradarpeṇa ko brūyādīdṛśaṃ vacaḥ || 35 ||
sahāyā vayamevaite balabhadrapurogamāḥ |
prathamo balabhadro'sau dvitīyo'haṃ ca sātyakiḥ ||36||
kṛtavarmā tṛtīyastu caturtho niśaṭho balī |
pañcamo'tha ca babhrustu ṣaṣṭhaścaivotkalaḥ smṛtaḥ || 37 ||
saptamastāraṇo dhīmānastraśastraviśāradaḥ |
aṣṭamastvatha sāraṅgo navamo vipṛthustathā || 38 ||
daśamaścoddhavo dhīmān vayamete balānvitāḥ |
ta ete purato goptuḥ śaṅkhacakragadābhṛtaḥ || 39 ||
devadevasya yuddheṣu tiṣṭhantyeva divāniśam |
yau hi vīrau sutau tasya nāsatyasadṛśau bale || 3.118.40 ||
tāveva vāṃ kṣamau yuddhe hantuṃ balamadānvitau |
yo girīśo girāṃ devo varaṃ dattvā sa tiṣṭhati || 41 ||
yuvāṃ hi kiṃbalau yuddhe tiṣṭhataḥ saśaraṃ dhanuḥ |
gṛhītvā śatrubhiḥ sārdhaṃ yuddhaṃ kartuṃ samudyatau || 42 ||
īdṛśeṣvatha bhṛtyeṣu yuddhaṃ kurvatsu śatrubhiḥ |
trailokyaṃ rakṣatastasmātkaramicchan vrajeta kaḥ || 43 ||
haniṣyatyeva vāṃ yuddhe trailokyaṃ yo hi rakṣati |
śareṇa niśitenājau śārṅgamuktena kevalam || 44 ||
kva naḥ saṃgrāma ityevaṃ punarāha jagatpatiḥ |
puṣkare puṇyade nityamuta govardhane girau || 45 ||
mathurāyāṃ prayāge vā darśayanto balāni me |
śaṅkhacakradhare deve jagatpālanatatpare || 46 ||
rājasūyaṃ mahāyajñaṃ kartumicchati kaḥ svayam |
vadanvā svastimānmartyastvāṃ vinā ko vrajet sukham||47||
idamicchasi cenmūḍha hāsyatāṃ yāsi bhūtale |
ityuktvā sātyakirvīro hasanniva bhuvi sthitaḥ ||48||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne sātyakivākye aṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 118 ||

<3.119>

ekonaviṃśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
tataḥ kruddhau mahārāja haṃso ḍimbhaka eva |ca |
idaṃ vai procaturvāktyaṃ roṣavyākulitekṣaṇau || 1 ||
didhakṣantau diśaḥ sarvāḥ sarvān vīkṣya nṛpottamān |
kareṇa niṣpīḍya karaṃ smarantau tadvaco mahat || 2 ||
kva nu kva vā nandasūnuḥ kva vā rāmo balotkaṭaḥ |
iti bruvāṇau sākṣepau sātyakiṃ satyasaṃgaram || 3 ||
are yādavadāyāda kiṃ brūṣe naḥ puro gataḥ |
ito nirgaccha mandātmandūtastvamasi sāmpratam || 4 ||
anyathā vadhya eva tvaṃ pralapan paruṣaṃ vacaḥ |
satyaṃ nirlajja evāsi yad brūyā īdṛśaṃ vacaḥ || 5 ||
āvāmidaṃ jagat sarvaṃ śāsituṃ saṃyatau nṛpau |
ko nāma mānuṣe loke karado naiva jīvati || 6 ||
hatvā gopālakān sarvān baddhvā yādavakān bahūn |
gṛhṇīmaḥ karasarvasvaṃ tato gaccha narādhama || 7 ||
avadhyo dūtatāṃ prāpto bahvabaddhaṃ prabhāṣase |
īśvaro nau varaṃ dātā hyastrāṇāmapi ca prabhuḥ || 8 ||
rakṣitārau mahābhūtau saṃgrāmaṃ gacchatośca nau |
pitaraṃ yājayiṣyāvo jitvā gopālakaṃ raṇe || 9 ||
ete proktā bhṛśaṃ yuddhe kātarāḥ sarva eva te |
hatvā tānsabalān yuddhe punarjeṣyāmi keśavam || 3.119.10||
saṃhartavyā mahāsenā pragṛhītaśarāsanā |
gṛhītaprāsamuśalā gṛhītakavacā sadā || 11 ||
ārūḍharathasāhasrā gadāparighasaṃkulā |
suprabhūtendhanavatī prabhūtabalasādhanā || 12 ||
cālyatāṃ vāhinī ghorā balādhyakṣāḥ samantataḥ |
avadhya eva gaccha tvaṃ na te maraṇato bhayam || 13 ||
saṃgrāmaḥ puṣkare'smākaṃ śvaḥ paraśvo'pi vā nṛpa |
tato jñāsyāmahe vīryaṃ keśavasya valasya ca |
ye tvayoktā nṛpāḥ saṃkhye teṣāmapi ca yad balam|| 14||
sātyakiruvāca
haṃsāgacchāmi vāṃ hantuṃ śvaḥ paraśvo'pi vā nṛpa |
adyaiva hi mayā vadhyau na ced dūto bhavāmyaham ||15||
na hi śvo vā paraśvo vā yuvāṃ kaṭukabhāṣiṇau |
dautye hi duḥkhamatulaṃ vahāmyeva sadā nṛṇām || 16 ||
anyathāhaṃ yuvāṃ hatvā tato yāsyāmi nirvṛtim |
svavīryaṃ bāhudarpaṃ ca darśayan vāṃ nṛpādhamau || 17 ||
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ śārṅdhanvā kirīṭabhṛt |
nīlakuñcitakeśāḍhyo lambabāhuḥ śriyā vṛtaḥ || 18 ||
sa sarvalokaprabhavo viśvarūpaḥ surūpavān |
daityadānavahantāsau yogidhyeyaḥ purātanaḥ || 19 ||
padmakiñjalkanayanaḥ śyāmalaḥ siṃhavikramaḥ |
sṛṣṭisthitilayeṣvekaḥ kartā trijagato guruḥ || 3.119.20 ||
śareṇa niśitenājau darpaṃ vāṃ vyapaneṣyati |
ityuktvā rathamāruhya prayayau sātyakiḥ kila || 21 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne sātyakipratiprayāṇe ekonaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 119 ||

<3.120>

viṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
praviśya sa puraṃ viṣṇoḥ sātyakiḥ śinipuṅgavaḥ |
ācacakṣe'tha kṛṣṇāya yathā vṛttaṃ tayostathā || 1 ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale keśavaḥ keśisūdanaḥ |
balādhyakṣānuvācedaṃ cakrapāṇirgadādharaḥ || 2 ||
saṃnahyatāṃ balaṃ sarvaṃ rathakuñjaravājimat |
anekabherīpaṇavaṃ prāsāsiparighākulam || 3 ||
sadhvajaṃ sapatākaṃ ca sālaṃkāraparicchadam |
te tatheti pratijñāya sarvaṃ cakruradhīnagāḥ || 4 ||
ādāya sudṛḍhaṃ cāpaṃ rathamāruhya daṃśitāḥ |
agrato jagmuratyarthaṃ senāyāḥ puruṣottamāḥ || 5 ||
sātyakiśca tathā rājan pragṛhītaśarāsanaḥ |
babhau krodhasamāyukto jagāmāgre mahābalaḥ || 6 ||
anye ca yādavāḥ śūrā pragṛhītamahāyudhāḥ |
siṃhanādaṃ prakurvanto jagmuratyarthamuttamāḥ || 7 ||
haristu rathamāruhya saṃskṛtaṃ dārukeṇa ha |
śārṅgaṃ bhārasahaṃ ghoraṃ gṛhītvā saśaraṃ dhanuḥ || 8 ||
cakrapāṇistadā śaṅkhī gadāśaravarāsimān |
baddhagodhāṅgulitrāṇaḥ pītavāsā janārdanaḥ || 9 ||
padmamālāvṛtorasko navajīmūtasaṃnibhaḥ |
yayau rathagato vipraiḥ stūyamāno mudānvitaiḥ || 3.120.10 ||
sūtairmāgadhaputraiśca gīyamānastatastataḥ |
ānīya senāṃ sakalāṃ yayau kāṣṭhāmathottarām || 11 ||
pāñcajanyaṃ mukhe nyasya sarvaprāṇena keśavaḥ |
dadhmau mahāravaṃ kurvañchatrūṇāṃ bhayavardhanam || 12 ||
ādhmātastena hariṇā sa cakre śaṅkharāṭ dhruvam|
ravaḥ sa rodasī rājan pūrayāmāsa sarvataḥ || 13 ||
tasmiñchaṅkhe tathā''dhmāte dadhmuḥ śaṅkhānsahasraśaḥ |
bheryaścāpi samādhmātā mṛdaṅgā bahavo nṛpa || 14 ||
neduratyarthamatulaṃ gharmānte jaladā yathā |
athāyayurmahārāja puṣkaraṃ puṇyavardhanam || 15 ||
sarasastasya rājendra puṣkarasya nṛpottamāḥ |
pratīkṣya haṃsaḍimbhakau yuddhāya samavasthitāḥ || 16 ||
niveśaṃ kārayāmāsuryādavāḥ sarva eva hi |
svaṃ svaṃ yayuḥ sukhaṃ rājan pragṛhītakuṭīmaṭham || 17 ||
bhagavānapi govindaḥ saro dṛṣṭvā suśobhanam |
upaspṛśya jale tasmin praṇamya yatipuṅgavān || 18 ||
tayorāgamanaṃ lipsurāste tīre yathāsukham |
śṛṇvan vedadhvaniṃ viṣṇurbrāhmaṇānāṃ samantataḥ || 19 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne kṛṣṇapuṣkarapraveśe viṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 120 ||

<3.121>

ekaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
atha tau haṃsaḍimbhakau jagmatuḥ puṣkaraṃ prati |
pragṛhītamahācāpau sarathau sadhvajau nṛpa || 1 ||
puraḥsaramahābhūtau saṃharantāvivolbaṇau |
prakurvantau siṃharavaṃ bhasmanā parilepitau || 2 ||
tripuṇḍrakalalāṭāntau rudrākṣapariśobhitau |
anyau dvāviva rudrau tau lokasaṃhārakārakau || 3 ||
tato'nujagmuḥ śataśaḥ sainyāni nṛpasattama |
akṣauhiṇyo daśaivāsaṃstayoratha samāgatāḥ || 4 ||
vicakrastu mahārāja dānavo nagasaṃnibhaḥ |
tayoreva sakhā pūrvamāsīcca balaśālinoḥ || 5 ||
śakro yasya puraḥsaraḥ sthātuṃ śakto na vajrabhṛt|
yo hi vīro mahārāja devadaityasamāgame || 6 ||
devān nighnaṃstathā rājan devendramajayanmahān |
akarocca purā yuddhaṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || 7 ||
yo hi dvāravatīṃ prāpya babādhe yadupuṅgavān |
sa tadānīṃ mahārāja śrutvā yuddhamupasthitam || 8 ||
anekaśatasāhasrairdānavaiḥ parighāyudhaiḥ |
vṛtaḥ samabhavad daityo vṛṣṇidveṣān nṛpottama || 9||
haṃsasya ḍimbhakasyātha sāhāyyaṃ kartumudyataḥ |
vicakrasyātha daityasya hiḍimbo rākṣaseśvaraḥ || 3.121.10 ||
atīva mitratāṃ yāto dadyāt prāṇāṃśca saṃyati |
rākṣasairaparaiḥ sārdhaṃ śilāśūlāsipāṇibhiḥ || 11 ||
yayau tasya sahāyārthaṃ hiḍimbaḥ puruṣādapaḥ |
aṣṭāśīti sahasrāṇi rākṣasāstasya cābhavan || 12 ||
anuyātā mahārāja śilāparighabāhavaḥ |
tayostatra mahāsainyaṃ gacchatoḥ keśavaṃ prati || 13 ||
miśritaṃ daityasaṃghaiśca rākṣasaiśca samantataḥ |
atyadbhutaṃ mahāraudraṃ trailaukyabhayadāyakam || 14 ||
daityena sahitau tau hi jagmatuḥ puṣkaraṃ prati |
tāvetau haṃsaḍimbhakau hantuṃ keśavamañjasā || 15 ||
tataḥ śrutvā jarāsaṃdho vigrahaṃ yadubhiḥ saha |
nākaronnṛpasāhāyyaṃ pāpaṃ me bhaviteti ha || 16 ||
gacchatoḥ samitiṃ rājanhaṃsasya ḍimbhakasya ca |
atitvaritavikrāntāste yayuḥ puṣkaraṃ prati || 17 ||
siṃhanādaṃ vimuñcantaḥ kathayantaḥ parasparam |
ahameva nṛpā yuddhaṃ karomi prathamaṃ hareḥ || 18 ||
ityabruvan nṛpā rājañchataśaḥ keśavaṃ prati |
samprāptāste nṛpaśreṣṭhāḥ puṣkaraṃ puṇyavardhanam || 19 ||
munijuṣṭaṃ tapovṛddhairṛṣibhiśca niṣevitam |
atyantabhadraṃ lokeṣu puṣkaraṃ prathamaṃ nṛpa || 3.121.20 ||
puṣkaraṃ puṇḍarīkākṣo dvāveva jagatīpate |
darśanāt sparśanāccaiva kilviṣacchedinau nṛpa ||21||
puṣkaraṃ puṇḍarīkākṣo dvāveva nṛpasattama |
sevyamānau muniśreṣṭhairamaraughairmahātmabhiḥ || 22 ||
dvāveva hi nṛpaśreṣṭha sarvapāpapraṇāśakau |
tāvubhau yatra sahitau tatra te saṃsthitā nṛpāḥ || 23 ||
dṛṣṭavanto hariṃ viṣṇuṃ viṣṭaraśravasaṃ param |
puṣkaraṃ puṇyanilayaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmaniṣevitam || 24 ||
tābhyāṃ kuru namaskāraṃ manasā nṛpasattama |
aho niḥśeṣamabhavat tatra bhūyo na saṃśayaḥ || 25 ||
sainyaṃ tatra ca samprāptaṃ daityarakṣaḥsamākulam |
anekabherīpaṇavajharjharīḍiṇḍimākulam || 26 ||
nānāpaṇavasammiśraṃ rakṣonādavināditam |
praviśya sarasastīraṃ puṣkarasya viśāmpate |
darśayāmāsa deveśaṃ yuddhāya samupasthitam || 27 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne yuddhārthaṃ haṃsaḍimbhakasainyānāṃ puṣkarāgamane ekaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 121 ||

<3.122>

dvāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
dve sene saṃgate rājan sadhvaje saparicchade |
mahāparighasaṃkīrṇe gadāśaktisamākule || 1 ||
bherījharjharasampūrṇe ḍiṇḍimārāvasaṃkule |
pragṛhītamahāśastraśūlāsivarakārmuke || 2 ||
parasparakṛtotsāhe cakrāte yuddhamulbaṇam |
te śarāḥ kārmukotsṛṣṭā nirbhidyātha śarīriṇām || 3||
śarīrāṇi mahārāja jagmurdūraṃ sahasraśaḥ |
bhaṭabāhuvinirmuktāḥ khaḍgā nirbhidya vakṣasi || 4 ||
sphurantaśca tathā rājañchirāṃsyāhṛtya khaṃ yayuḥ |
parighāśca tathā rājñāṃ bāhubhiḥ paricoditāḥ || 5 ||
tilaśaścakruratulaṃ śarīraṃ nṛparakṣasām |
daityānāṃ kurvatāṃ nādamanyonyavadhakāṅkṣiṇām || 6 ||
daityā rakṣāṃsi rājendra rājānaśca samantataḥ |
anyonyaṃ parighairjaghnuścāpamuktaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ || 7 ||
śaraiśca bhogibhogābhaistīkṣṇamanye mahābalāḥ |
rākṣasā dānavāścānye mattamātaṅgavikramāḥ || 8 ||
anyonyaṃ jaghnire rājaṃścāpamuktairmahāśaraiḥ |
nāgā nāgairmahārāja hayā aśvaiḥ samantataḥ || 9 ||
rathā rathaiḥ samājagmuḥ sādinaḥ sādibhistathā |
paṭṭiśāsiśaravrātaiḥ kuntaiḥ sāyakakarṣaṇaiḥ || 3.122.10 ||
saśaktiparighapāsaparaśvadhasamākulaiḥ |
bhindipālairmahāraudrairjaghnuranyonyamāhave || 11 ||
anyonyaṃ jaghnire rājaṃścāpamuktaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ |
rākṣasā dānavā rājan kṣatriyāśca samantataḥ |
itaścetaśca dhāvantaḥ kurvanto visvaraṃ ravam || 12 ||
hatāḥ kecinmahārāja petururvyāṃ mahāsibhiḥ |
kecinmathitamastiṣkā gadābhirvīryavattamāḥ || 13 ||
bhinnagrīvā mahārāja parighaiḥ parighāyudhaiḥ |
yamarāṣdraṃ gatāḥ kecit kecit svargaṃ samāyayuḥ ||14|
apsarobhiḥ samāseduḥ paśyantaḥ svaṃ kalevaram |
kecitsvāṃśca parāṃścaiva hatvā bhrāntā ivābhavan || 15||
etasminnantare rājañchaṅkhā bheryaḥ sahasraśaḥ |
sasvanuḥ sarvataḥ sainye mṛdaṅgā bahavastathā || 16 ||
madhyaṃdinagate sūrye tāpaṃ dadhati ghoravat |
tataḥ piśācā vikṛtāḥ karālavitatodarāḥ || 17 ||
rākṣasāśca mahāghorāḥ piśitaṃ keśaśādbalam |
muditā bhakṣayāmāsuḥ pibantaḥ śoṇitaṃ vahu || 18 ||
saṃcitāni śavānyāsan kabandhāḥ khaḍgapātitāḥ |
vibhajya deśaṃ bahuśo yuddhabhūmau śavāśinaḥ || 19||
atha śyenā mṛgāścaiva kaṅkā gṛdhrāstathā pare |
tuṇḍaiḥ śavān viniṣkṛṣya bhakṣayanti tatastataḥ ||3.122.20 ||
saptāśītisahasrāṇi hatā nāgā nṛpottama |
triṃśatsahasramayutaṃ nihatā hayasattamāḥ || 21 ||
hataṃ lakṣaṃ mahārāja rathānāṃ rathibhiḥ saha |
triṃśatkoṭyo hatāstatra sādinaḥ sāyudhā bhṛśam ||22|
madhyaṃdinagate sūrye hatāḥ kecana nirgatāḥ |
kecicca tṛṣitā rājan viviśuḥ puṣkaraṃ saraḥ || 23
kecid bhūmiṃ samāliṅgya bhītā ityabruvan raṇe |
muktakeśāḥ patanti sma rathān saṃtyajya kecana ||24||
saṃdaṣṭauṣṭhapuṭāḥ kecit sādinaḥ purato hatāḥ |
atyadbhutaṃ mahāyuddhamāsīt puṣkaratīrthake |
yathā devāsuraṃ yuddhamāsīt pūrvaṃ nṛpottama || 25 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne saṃkula yuddhe dvāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 122 ||

<3.123>

trayoviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
etasminnantare rājan dvandvayuddhamavartata |
vicakraṃ yodhayāmāsa śārṅgadhanvā gadādharaḥ || 1 ||
balabhadro'tha haṃsena ḍimbhakena ca sātyakiḥ |
vasudevograsenābhyāṃ hiḍimbaḥ puruṣādakaḥ || 2 ||
śeṣāśca śeṣai rājendra cakuryuddhamadīnagāḥ |
vāsudevastrisaptatyā daityaṃ vakṣasyatāḍayat || 3 ||
śarairniśitadhārātrairvismayaṃ darśayan raṇe |
dānavo devadeveśaṃ dṛḍhena niśitena ca || 4 ||
śareṇākarṇamākṛṣya dhanuḥpravaramīśvaram |
jaghāna stanamadhye ca paśyatastu śacīpateḥ || 5 |
tena viddho'tha bhagavān vakṣodeśe janārdanaḥ |
avamacchoṇitaṃ viṣṇurādikāle yathā prajāḥ || 6 ||
tataḥ kruddho hṛṣīkeśaḥ kṣurapreṇāhanad dhvajam |
aśvāṃśca caturo hatvā sārathiṃ ca śaraistribhiḥ || 7 ||
tato dadhmau mahāśaṅkhaṃ yathā tārāmaye raṇe |
rathādutplutya sahasā dānavaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ || 8 ||
gadāṃ gṛhya mahāghorāṃ duḥsahāṃ vīryaśālinīm |
tayā jaghāna daityendraḥ kirīṭe keśavasya ha || 9 ||
lalāṭe ca punarviṣṇuṃ siṃhanādaṃ vyanīnadat |
tataḥ śilāṃ ca mahatīṃ pragṛhya danujaḥ kila || 10 ||
bhrāmayitvā daśaguṇaṃ prāharat keśavorasi |
tāmāpatantīṃ samprekṣya hastenādāya keśavaḥ || 11 ||
jaghāna ca tayā daityaṃ sa papātārditaḥ kṣitau |
gatāsuriva saṃjajñe śvasanniva papāta ha || 12 ||
prāpya saṃjñāṃ tato daityaḥ krodhād dviguṇamābabhau |
ādāya parighaṃ ghoramidamāha janārdanam || 13 ||
anena tava govinda darpajātaṃ nihanmyaham |
vikramajñastadā cāsi mama devāsure raṇe || 14 ||
tāveva vipulau bāhū sa evāsmi janārdana |
tathāpi yudhyase vīra jñātvā tvaṃ māmakaṃ balam || 15 ||
vārayainaṃ mahābāho parighaṃ bāhuniḥsṛtam |
ityuktvā devadeveśaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam |
cikṣepa daityo lokeśaṃ sarvalokasya paśyataḥ || 16 ||
taṃ gṛhya bāhunā kṛṣṇo hato'sīti vadan hariḥ |
khaṇḍaśaḥ kārayāmāsa khaṅgena niśitena ha || 17 ||
utpāṭya vṛkṣaṃ daityeśaḥ śataśākhaṃ mahāśikham |
tena sampothayāmāsa viṣṭaraśravasaṃ vibhum || 18 ||
chittvā taṃ cāpi khaḍgena tilaśaśca cakāra ha |
vikrīḍya suciraṃ viṣṇustena daityena mādhavaḥ || 19 ||
hantumaicchat tadā daityamādāya niśitaṃ śaram |
āgneyāstreṇa saṃyojya jaghānainaṃ mahān hariḥ || 20 ||
saṃdahya sa śaro daityaṃ sarvalokasya paśyataḥ |
yathāpūrvaṃ jagāmāśu karaṃ bhagavataḥ punaḥ || 21 ||
hataśiṣṭāstato daityāḥ palāyanto diśo daśa |
adyāpi na nivartante gacchanto vai mahodadhim || 22 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne kṛṣṇasyotkarṣe trayoviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 123 ||

<3.124>

caturviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
baladevastu dharmātmā dhanurādāya satvaram
jaghāna haṃsaṃ daśabhirbāṇairbāṇabhṛtāṃ vara ||
taṃ pratyavidhyannārācairhaṃsaḥ pañcabhirāśugaiḥ
tānantare halī chittvā nārācairdaśabhiḥ punaḥ |
nārācenāśu vivyādha lalāṭe haṃsamojasā || 2 ||
dṛḍhaṃ patan sa nārācastasya saṃjñāṃ samādade |
rathopasthe ciraṃ sthitvā tūṇād bāṇaṃ samādade || 3 ||
labdhvā haṃsaḥ sa saṃjñāṃ tu viddhvā tena yadūttamam|
siṃhavad vyanadaddhaṃso devān vismāpayan raṇe || 4 ||
tataḥ kruddho halī viddhastena bāṇena mādhavaḥ |
vamañchoṇitamatyuṣṇaṃ niḥśvasaṃśca raṇājire || 5 ||
lohitāviṣṭagātrastu kuṃkumārdra ivābhavat |
nārācaiḥ śatasāhasrairardayāmāsa mādhavaḥ || 6 ||
haṃsaṃ haṃsagatiṃ vīraṃ nīlavāsā halāyudhaḥ |
te muktā niśitā ghorā nārācāśca suvājinaḥ || 7 ||
rathe dhvaje tathā cāpe cakre tūṇīdvaye nṛpa |
patitāḥ sarvato rājan vyathāṃ caiva tathā daduḥ || 8 ||
tataḥ kruddho mahārāja haṃso vīryamadānvitaḥ |
śareṇa halinaṃ viddhvā dhvajaṃ ciccheda kālavit || 9 ||
śaraiścaturbhiraśvāṃśca sūtaṃ pretādhipe dadau |
tataḥ kruddho halī tasmai gadāṃ gṛhya mahāraṇe || 3.124.10 ||
āpapāta mahābāhurhaṃsaṃ śeṣa iva śvasan |
tayā rathaṃ dhvajaṃ cakramaśvān sūtaṃ halāyudhaḥ |
babhañja tilaśaḥ sarvaṃ nanāda ca punaḥ punaḥ || 11 ||
bhūyaśca gadayā haṃsaṃ cikṣepa ca balī kila |
so'pi haṃso gadāṃ gṛhya rathāttasmādavāpatat || 12 ||
tatastau haṃsahalinau yuyudhāte mahāraṇe |
mahārathau mahābāhū loke prathitatejasau || 13 ||
atyadbhutaṃ suvikrāntau parasparavadhaiṣiṇau |
kṛtaśramau mahāyuddhe haṃsavikrāntagāminau || 14 ||
yathā devāsure yuddhe śakravṛtrau purāmbare |
ubhau saṃsiktasarvāṅgau śoṇitena mahāraṇe || 15 ||
atyantakhedinau yuddhe parasparabalena ha |
tataśca dakṣiṇaṃ mārgaṃ balabhadro'nvagacchata || 16 ||
savyaṃ tu haṃso rājendra vyagṛhṇāt svayameva hi |
pothayāñcakraturyuddhe gadābhyāṃ gajavikramau || 17 ||
yathāprāṇaṃ mahābāhū jaghnaturmaraṇāya tau |
atipravṛddhaṃ saṃgrāmaṃ devāsuraraṇopamam || 18 ||
vidadhāte mahāraṅge paśyatāṃ tridivaukasām |
devāśca munayaścaiva vismayaṃ parijagmire || 19 ||
aho khalvīdṛśaṃ yuddhaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ pūrvaṃ na ca śrutam |
ityūcurvismayavaśād devagandharvakinnarāḥ || 3.124.20 ||
parasparakṛtotsāhau cakraturyuddhamuttamam |
atha haṃso mahāraṅge dakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇottamaḥ |
vyacaranmārgamatyarthaṃ savyaṃ tu balavān balaḥ || 21 ||
nikuñcya jānunī pūrvaṃ cakraturgadayā bhṛśam |
raṇe raṇavidāṃ śreṣṭhau paśyatāṃ tridivaukasām || 22 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne haṃsabalabhadrayuddhe caturviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 124 ||

<3.125>

pañcaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
yuddhaṃ cakraturatyarthaṃ tato ḍimbhakasātyakī |
tāvubhau balinau vīrau vikhyātau kṣatriyeṣu ca || 1 ||
kṛtaśramau mahāyuddhe satataṃ vṛddhasevinau |
sātyakirdaśabhirvīro ḍimbhakaṃ vedapāragam || 2 ||
avidhyanniśitairbāṇaiḥ stane vaktre tathorasi |
sa tena viddho balinā ḍimbhakaḥ kṣatriyottamaḥ || 3 ||
nārācaiḥ pañcasāhasrairvivyādha yudhi garvitaḥ |
tānantare vṛṣṇivīro niṣiddhan ninadan bruvan || 4 ||
atha kruddho nṛpavaro viddhaḥ saptabhirāśugaiḥ |
punaḥ śatasahasreṇa pratyavidhyata sātyakim || 5 ||
sātyakistvatha vikrānto dhanuściccheda tasya tat|
ardhacandreṇa tīkṣṇena ḍimbhakasya sa yādavaḥ || 6 ||
ājaghne ḍimbhako vīraścāpamādāya cāparam |
kṣurapreṇātha raudreṇa tailadhautena vikramī || 7 ||
sa tena viddho bāṇena vamañchoṇitakaṃ nṛpa |
atīva śuśubhe rājan vasante kiṃśuko yathā || 8 ||
dhanuściccheda bhūyastu gṛhītaṃ yatpunarmahat|
tato'nyad dhanurādāya ḍimbhako yādaveśvaram || 9 ||
jaghāna niśitairbāṇaiḥ sarvakṣatrasya paśyataḥ |
sa dhanuḥ punaratyugraṃ ciccheda yudhi sātyakiḥ || 3.125.10 ||
śareṇa tīkṣṇapuṅkhena ḍimbhakasya durātmanaḥ |
tato'nyad dhanurādāya satvaraṃ sa nṛpottamaḥ || 11 ||
dhanuṣā tena rājendra sātyakiṃ vivyadhe punaḥ |
evaṃ dhanūṃṣi rājendra śataṃ pañca ca pañca ca || 12 ||
chittvā nanāda śaineyaḥ sarvakṣatrasya paśyataḥ |
dhanuṣī tau parityajya vīrau ḍimbhakasātyakī || 13 ||
khaḍgau pragṛhya cātyugrau yuddhāya samupasthitau |
tau hi khaṅgavidāṃ śreṣṭhau vīrau ḍimbhakasātyakī || 14 ||
dauḥśāsanirmahābhāgaḥ saumadattistathaiva ca |
abhimanyuśca vikrānto nakulaśca tathaiva ca || 15 ||
ete khaṅgavidāṃ śreṣṭhāḥ kīrtitā yudhi sattamāḥ |
eteṣvetau nṛpaśreṣṭhau ṣaṭsu vai nṛpasattama || 16 ||
tāvetāvasinā yuddhaṃ cakraturyuddhalālasau |
bhrāntamudbhrāntamāviddhaṃ praviddhaṃ bāhuniḥsṛtam || 17 ||
ākaraṃ vikaraṃ bhinnaṃ nirmaryādamamānuṣam |
saṃkocitaṃ kulacitaṃ savyajānu vijānu ca || 18 ||
āhikaṃ citrakaṃ kṣiptaṃ kusumbaṃ lambanaṃ dhṛtam |
sarvabāhu vinirbāhu savyetaramathottaram || 19 ||
tribāhu tuṅgabāhutvaṃ savyonnatamudāsi ca |
paṭṭikaṃ mauṣṭikaṃ caiva yaudhikaṃ prathitaṃ tathā || 3.125.20 ||
iti prakārān dvātriṃśaccakratuḥ khaḍgayodhinau |
punaḥ punaḥ praharantau na ca śramamupeyatuḥ || 21 ||
puṣkarasthau mahārāja yuddhāya kṛtaniścayau |
tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ || 22 ||
tuṣṭuvustau mahārāja jaye kṛtapariśramau |
aho vīryamaho dhairyamanayorbāhuśālinoḥ || 23 ||
etāveva raṇe śaktau khaḍge dhanuṣi pāragau |
ekaḥ śiṣyo girīśasya droṇasyānyo hi dhīmataḥ || 24 ||
arjunaḥ sātyakiścaiva vāsudevo jagatpatiḥ |
traya ete mahāvīrāḥ prathitāḥ saṅgare sadā || 25 ||
ḍimbhakaḥ śaktibhṛccharvastraya ete mahārathāḥ |
prasiddhāḥ sarva evaite vīryeṣu ca baleṣu ca || 26 ||
iti te devagandharvāḥ siddhā yakṣā mahoragāḥ |
divisthitāḥ samaṃ brūyuryuddhadarśanalālasāḥ || 27 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne sātyakiḍimbhakayuddhe pañcaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 125 ||

<3.126>

ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
vasudevograsenau ca vṛddhau yuddhe sunirvṛtau |
jarājaritasarvāṅgau palitāṅgaśiroruhau || 1 ||
jñānavijñānasampannau rājamārgaviśāradau |
yuyudhāte mahāraṅge rākṣasena durātmanā || 2 ||
śarairanekasāhasrairardayāmāsatū raṇe |
rākṣasendraṃ durātmānaṃ hiḍimbaṃ puruṣādakam || 3 ||
hiḍimbo rākṣasendrastu bhakṣayansarvato narān |
atipravṛddho duṣṭātmā lambabāhurmahāhanuḥ || 4 ||
lambodaro virūpākṣaḥ piṅgakeśo vilocanaḥ |
śyenanāso mahāraudra ūrdhvaromā mahābhujaḥ || 5 ||
parvatākāravarṣmā ca dīrghadaṃṣṭraḥ śivānanaḥ |
lambodaro dīrghadanto jagadgrāsaparastathā || 6 ||
uttuṅgāṃso mahorasko dīrghagrīvo gajopamaḥ |
bhakṣayan māṃsapiṭakaṃ pibañśoṇitasaṃcayam || 7 ||
gajān nāgaiḥ samāhatya hayairaśvān nṛpottama |
rathān rathaiḥ samāhṛtya sādinaḥ sādibhistathā || 8 ||
manuṣyān sa puro dṛṣṭvā nāsyagrāsaṃ cakāra saḥ |
kāṃściddhatvā mahārāja vṛṣṇipālānsamantataḥ || 9 ||
bhakṣayāmāsa sahasā hiḍimbaḥ puruṣādakaḥ |
yān paśyan purato rakṣastāñjaghāna virūpadhṛk || 3.126.10 ||
bhakṣayannaparān vṛṣṇīnyādavānrākṣaseśvaraḥ |
cikṣepa sahasā kāṃściddhiḍimbaḥ puruṣādakaḥ || 11 ||
antakāle yathā kruddho rudraḥ prāṇabhṛto nṛpa |
kṣaṇenaikena sarvāṃstān bhakṣayāmāsa rākṣasaḥ || 12 ||
kecid bhītā diśaḥ prāpurvṛṣṇayo vīryaśālinaḥ |
kecit tu bhakṣitāstena rakṣasā vṛṣṇipuṅgavāḥ || 13 ||
kumbhakarṇo yathā rājan bhakṣayāmāsa vānarān |
niḥśeṣaṃ vṛṣṇisainyaṃ tu cakāra puruṣādakaḥ || 14 ||
etasminnantare kruddhau vṛddhau yādavapuṅgavau |
dhanurgṛhya mahāghoraṃ rākṣasasya puraḥ sthitau || 15 ||
yathā kruddhasya siṃhasya mṛgau vṛddhatamāviva |
vyādāyāsyaṃ mahārakṣastau vṛddhāvabhyadhāvata || 16 ||
cikhādiṣurvirūpākṣaḥ pātālatalasaṃnibhaḥ |
tato rakṣaḥ paryadhāvat khādat khādatkalevaram || 17 ||
pūrayāmāsaturvīrau śarairyaduvṛṣau nṛpa |
hiḍimbasya mahāghoraṃ vyāditāsyamivāntakam || 18 ||
sarvāṃstān vārayāmāsa devaśatrurvirūpadhṛk |
dhāvati sma tato rakṣo vyāditāsyaṃ bhayānakam || 19 ||
tayorgṛhītvā dhanuṣī babhañja yudhi satvaram |
bāhū prasārya duṣṭātmā rākṣaso vikṛtānanaḥ || 3.126.20 ||
vasudevaṃ mahīpālaṃ rājānaṃ vṛddhasevinam |
grahītuṃ rākṣasaśreṣṭho yatate nṛpasaṃsadi || 21 ||
hiḍimba uvāca
eṣa vāṃ bhakṣayiṣyāmi vasudevaṃ tvayā saha |
ugrasena kimartha tvaṃ tiṣṭhase matpurogamaḥ || 22 ||
āgaccha praviśāsyaṃ me grāsabhūtau tu vāṃ mama |
vidhinā nirmito vṛddho vasudevo hareḥ pitā || 23 ||
bubhukṣitaḥ śramārtaśca yuddhe tvaritavikramaḥ |
manmukhānnaiva gacchetāṃ praviśetāṃ tvarānvitau || 24 ||
yuvayoḥ śoṇitaṃ pītvā tṛptiṃ yāsyāmi nirvṛtaḥ |
khādāmi ca punarmāṃsaṃ vṛddhayoryuvayoḥ sukham || 25 ||
iti bruvaṃstathā rakṣo vyāditāsyo mahāhanuḥ |
dhāvati sma tadā kṣipraṃ hiḍimbo rākṣaseśvaraḥ || 26 ||
vasudevograsenau ca bhītau viprekṣya sarvataḥ |
diśo'bhyabhajatāṃ rājanniḥśastrau vṛṣṇipuṅgavau || 27|
etasminnantare dṛṣṭvā balabhadraḥ pratāpavān |
dṛṣṭvā ca tau tathābhūtau vasudevograsenakau || 28 ||
vāsudeve samādiśya haṃsaṃ yudhyantamīśvare |
nirgatya cāntaraṃ tasya rākṣasasya durātmanaḥ || 29 ||
mā kṛthāḥ sāhasaṃ rakṣo muñcaitau rājasattamau |
sthito'smi yudhyatāṃ rakṣo mayā śatrūñjighāṃsatā ||3.126.30||
ahameva haniṣye tvāṃ kā ceyaṃ tava bhīṣikā |
iti bruvāṇaṃ halinaṃ tau visṛjya mahāraṇe || 31 ||
mahānayamasau duṣṭo bhakṣayāmyenamagrataḥ |
vidārya pūrvavad vaktraṃ balabhadramupādravat || 32 ||
visṛjya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ rākṣasasya puraḥ sthitaḥ |
muṣṭiṃ pragṛhya balavānsphoṭayan bāhumuttamam || 33 ||
hiḍimbastvatha duṣṭātmā muṣṭiṃ kṛtvā bhayānakam|
jaghāna vakṣo rāmasya vyāditāsya ivāntakaḥ || 34 ||
kuddho'tha balabhadrastu muṣṭinā tena tāḍitaḥ |
jaghāna muṣṭinā tena rākṣaseśamaninditaḥ || 35 ||
muṣṭiyuddhaṃ samabhavannararākṣasavīrayoḥ |
yuddhyatoryuddharaṅge'tha nararākṣasasiṃhayoḥ || 36 ||
tayoścaṭacaṭāśabdaḥ prādurāsīd bhayānakaḥ |
atha rākṣasarājastu muṣṭinā rāmamāhave || 37 ||
jaghāna vakṣodeśe tu vajreṇeva puraṃdaraḥ |
atha rāmo balī sākṣānmuṣṭiṃ saṃvartya yatnataḥ || 38 ||
hiḍimbaṃ tāḍayāmāsa vakṣasyamaravidviṣam |
talābhyāmatha rāmastu vaktre hatvā sa rākṣasam || 39 ||
āhatastalaghātena hiḍimbo rākṣaseśvaraḥ |
jānubhyāmapatad bhūmau gatāsurvīrarākṣasaḥ || 3.126.40 ||
tata utpatya rāmastu dorbhyāṃ saṃgṛhya rākṣasam |
ādāya bahuvegena bhrāmayitvā padātpadam || 41 ||
vyāvidhyat suciraṃ rāmo darśayannātmano balam |
utkṣipya rākṣasendraṃ taṃ sarvalokasya paśyataḥ || 42||
gavyūtimātraṃ cikṣepa tato deśāddhalāyudhaḥ |
gatāsū rākṣasaśreṣṭhastato deśānnirākramat || 43 ||
ye kecid rākṣasāstatra hataśeṣā mahāraṇe |
balabhadrāt tato bhītā jagmuścaivaṃ diśo daśa || 44 ||
athāṃśumālī bhagavān dineśaḥ saṃhṛtya tejāṃsi sahasraraśmiḥ |
astaṃ yayau cakṣurapi prajānāmīṣattamaścāpi samāviveśa ||45 ||
tasmin praviṣṭe'tha samudratoyaṃ prajāpatau viśvamukhe jagadgurau |
nakṣatranāthaḥ samupājagāma saṃdhyātamo'pi vyanaśannṛpottama || 46 ||
prabhātakāle nṛpa sattamo raṇo govardhane kinnaragītanādite |
iti bruvanto nṛpasattamāstadā vyupāramaṃstatra raṇotsave nṛpa || 47 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne hiḍimbaparābhave ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 126 ||

<3.127>

saptaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
ubhau tau haṃsaḍimbhakau rātrāveva mahāgirim |
jagmatuḥ sahitau rājan govardhanamatho nṛpa || 1 ||
atha prabhāte vimale sūrye cābhyudite sati |
govardhanaṃ jagāmāśu keśavaḥ keśisūdanaḥ || 2 ||
śaineyo balabhadraśca yādavāḥ sāraṇādayaḥ |
gandharvairapsarobhiśca nāditaṃ bahudhā girim || 3 ||
jagmuste sahitā rājan govardhanamatho girim |
godhanairatha sainyaiśca nāditaṃ vahudhā girim || 4 ||
tasyottaraṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha pārśvaṃ samprāpya yādavāḥ |
nikaṣā yamunāṃ rājaṃstato yuddhamavartata || 5 ||
vivyādha haṃsaḍimbhakau vasudevaśca saptabhiḥ |
sāraṇaḥ pañcaviṃśatyā daśabhiḥ kaṅka eva ca || 6 ||
haṃsena ḍimbhakenātha yādavaiśca samantataḥ |
ugrasenastrisaptatyā śarāṇāṃ nataparvaṇām || 7 ||
virāṭastriṃśatā rājan sātyakiścāpi saptabhiḥ |
aśītyā vipṛthū rājannuddhavo daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ || 8 ||
pradyumnastriṃśatā rājansāmbaścāpi ca saptabhiḥ |
anādhṛṣṭistvekaṣaṣṭyā śarāṇāṃ nataparvaṇām || 9 ||
evaṃ te sahitā rājaṃścakruryuddhamadīnavat|
atyadbhutaṃ mahāghoraṃ yādavāḥ sarva eva hi || 3.127.10 ||
cakrustābhyāṃ mahāyuddhaṃ vāsudevasya paśyataḥ |
sarvānapi mahārāja yādavān baladarpitān || 11 ||
tāvubhau haṃsaḍimbhakau nṛpāṃstān pratyavidhyatām |
pratyekaṃ daśabhirviddhvā bāṇairniśitanirmalaiḥ || 12||
jaghnatuśca śaraistīkṣṇairatyarthaṃ yādaveśvarān |
vyathitāḥ sarva evaite vamantaḥ śoṇitaṃ bahu || 13 ||
mādhave kiṃśukā rājan puṣpitā iva te babhuḥ |
bhītāśca yādavā rājan palāyanaparāyaṇāḥ || 14 ||
etasminnantare rājan vasudevātmajo nṛpa |
vāsudevo halī yuddhe pramukhe dhanvinau tayoḥ || 15 ||
cakraturyuddhamatulaṃ skandaśakrāvivāmbare |
tayoreva sagandharvāḥ siddhā yakṣā maharṣayaḥ || 16 ||
vimānasthāśca dadṛśuryuddhaṃ devāsuropamam |
tataḥ prādurabhūtāṃ tau dūtau bhūteśvarau nṛpa || 17
śūlinā preṣitau yuddhe rakṣārthaṃ balinostayoḥ |
haṃso'tha vāsudevaśca yuddhaṃ cakraturīśvarau || 18 ||
rāmaśca ḍimbhakaścaiva saṃyuktau yuddhakāṅkṣayā |
vikrāntāḥ sarva evaite hyastre śastre tathā bale || 19 ||
śaṅkhān dadhmuḥ pṛthagghrādaṃ sve sve sarve rathe sthitāḥ |
atha kṛṣṇo hṛṣīkeśaḥ pāñcajanyaṃ mahāravam ||3.127.20||
dadhmau padmapalāśākṣaḥ sarvān vismāpayanniva |
atha bhūtau mahāghorau lambodaraśarīriṇau || 21 ||
dudruvaturmahārāja śūlamādāya keśavam |
śūlena pothayāṃ rājañcakraturyādaveśvaram || 22 ||
tābhyāṃ samāhato viṣṇurdevagandharvasaṃnidhau |
īṣatsmitādharo devaḥ kiṃcidutplutya satvaram || 23 ||
rathād rathivaraśreṣṭhastau pragṛhya janārdanaḥ |
bhrāmayitvā śataguṇamalātamiva keśavaḥ || 24 ||
kailāsaṃ ca samuddiśya pracikṣepa tato hariḥ |
tāvupetya gireḥ śṛṅgaṃ kailāsasya mahāmate || 25 ||
dṛṣṭvā tatkarma devasya vismayaṃ jagmatuḥ param |
haṃsaśca dṛṣṭvā tatkarma roṣatāmrāyatekṣaṇaḥ || 26 ||
uvāca vacanaṃ haṃsaḥ śṛṇvatāṃ tridivaukasām |
kimarthaṃ rājasūyasya vighnaṃ carasi keśava || 27 ||
brahmadatto mahīpālo yaṣṭā tasya mahākratoḥ |
karaṃ diśa yathāyogaṃ yadi prāṇān hi rakṣasi || 28||
athavā tvaṃ kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭha tato jñātvā paraṃ bahu |
dadāsi tvaṃ nandaputra tato yaṣṭā sa me guruḥ || 29 ||
īśvaro'haṃ sadā rājñāṃ devānāmiva śūlabhṛt |
eṣa te vīryamatulaṃ nāśayiṣyāmi saṃyuge || 3.127.30 ||
ityuktvā saśaraṃ cāpaṃ śālatālopamaṃ nṛpa |
ākṛṣya ca yathāprāṇaṃ nārācena ca keśavam || 31 ||
lalāṭe cikṣipe haṃso lalāma iva so'bhavat |
uvāca sātyakiṃ kṛṣṇo rathaṃ vāhaya me prabho || 32 ||
dārukaṃ pṛṣṭhavāhaṃ taṃ kṛtvā deśaṃ tamīśvaraḥ |
atha tena samādiṣṭaḥ sātyakirvāhayan ratham || 33 ||
maṇḍalāni bahūnyājau darśayāmāsa satvaram |
atha viddho dṛḍhaṃ tena śareṇa harirīśvaraḥ || 34 ||
āgneyamastraṃ saṃyojya śare kasmiṃścidavyayaḥ |
uvāca haṃsaṃ rājendra sātyakiṃ prerayan raṇe || 35 ||
anena tvāṃ dahe pāpa yadi śakto'si vāraya |
alaṃ te bahvabaddhena kṣatriyo'si sadā śaṭha || 36 ||
mattaścet karamicchestvaṃ darśayādya parākramam |
yatayo bādhitā haṃsa puṣkare saṃsthitāstvayā || 37 ||
śāstā tvaṃ khalu viprāṇāṃ sthite mayi narādhama |
sthite mayi jagannāthe hatvā kṣatriyakaṇṭakān || 38 ||
śāstāsmyatho satāṃ loke duṣṭānāṃ brahmavidviṣām |
śāpena yatimukhyānāṃ hata eva narādhama ||39||
mṛtyave tvāṃ nivedyādya rakṣitā brāhmaṇānaham |
iti bruvaṃstadastraṃ tu mumoca yudhi keśavaḥ || 3.127.40 ||
tadastraṃ vāruṇenātha haṃso'pi pratyaṣedhayat |
vāyavyamatha govindo mumoca yudhi haṃsake || 41 ||
tadastraṃ vārayāmāsa māhendreṇa nṛpottamaḥ |
atha māheśvaraṃ kṛṣṇo mumocātyugramāhave || 42 ||
raudreṇa tat tato haṃso vārayāmāsa tatkṣaṇāt |
gāndharvaṃ rākṣasaṃ caiva paiśācamatha keśavaḥ || 43 ||
brahmāstramatha kauberamāsuraṃ yāmyameva ca |
catvāryetāni haṃsastu mumoca yudhi satvaram || 44 ||
vāraṇārthaṃ tadastrāṇāṃ caturṇāṃ mādhavasya ha |
atha brahmaśiro nāma ghoramastraṃ vināśakam || 41 ||
mumoca haṃsamuddiśya devadevo janārdanaḥ |
yojayāmāsa taddhaṃse mahāghoraparākramam || 46 ||
atha bhīto mahāraudramastraṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛpottamaḥ |
haṃso'pi tena rājendra vārayāmāsa taṃ śaram || 47 ||
yamunāpa upaspṛśya devadevo janārdanaḥ |
astraṃ vaiṣṇavamādāya śare sa niśite hariḥ || 48 ||
yojayāmāsa bhūtātmā bhūtabhāvanabhāvanaḥ |
yena devā raṇe hatvā rājyamāpuḥ purāsurān |
tadastraṃ yojayāmāsa vadhārthaṃ tasya bhūpateḥ || 49 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne haṃsakeśavayuddhe saptaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||127||

<3.128>

aṣṭāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
atha bhīto mahāraudramastraṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛpottama |
haṃso rājā mahārāja niśceṣṭa iva sambabhau || 1 ||
utplutya sa rathāttasmād yamunāmabhyadhāvata |
yatra kṛṣṇo hṛṣīkeśaḥ kāliyāhiṃ mamarda ha || 2 ||
mahāhradaṃ mahāraudraṃ yāvatpātālasaṃsthitam |
tāvaddīrghaṃ mahānīlaṃ kālāñjananibhaṃ hi yat || 3 ||
tasmin hrade mahāghore papātātha sa haṃsakaḥ |
haṃse patati tasmiṃstu mahān rāvo babhūva ha || 4 ||
girīṇāṃ pātyamānānāṃ samudra iva vajriṇā |
rathādutplutya kṛṣṇo'pi tasyopari papāta ha || 5 ||
devadevo jagannātho jagad vismāpayanniva |
prāharan taṃ mahābāhuḥ pādābhyāmatha keśavaḥ || 6 ||
pādakṣepaṃ nṛpastasmāllabdhvā haṃso nṛpottama|
mamāra ca nṛpaśreṣṭha kecidevaṃ vadanti hi || 7 ||
anye pātālamāyāto bhakṣitaḥ pannagairiti |
adyāpi naiva rājendra dṛṣṭa ityanuśuśruma || 8 ||
yathāpūrvaṃ jagannātho rathaṃ samupajagmivān |
hate tasmin mahārāja dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || 9 ||
akarot rājasūyaṃ ca tava pūrvapitāmahaḥ |
yadi jīvedasau haṃsaḥ ko namasyati taṃ kratum || 3.128.10 ||
sa ca sarvāstravinnityaṃ rudrāllabdhavaraḥ prabho |
kṣaṇādeva mahārāja vārteyaṃ gāmagāhata || 11 ||
hato haṃso hato haṃsaḥ kṛṣṇena ripumardinā |
jagurgandharvapatayo devaloke divāniśam || 12 ||
kṛṣṇena lokanāthena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā |
yamunāyā hrade ghore haṃso nihata ityapi || 13 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi haṃsaḍimbhakopākhyāne haṃsavadha aṣṭāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 128 ||

<3.129>

ekonatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śrutvā nihatamatyugraṃ bhrātaraṃ vīryaśālinam |
baladevaṃ parityajya yudhyamānaṃ mahāraṇe || 1 ||
ḍimbhako vīryasampanno yamunāmanujagmivān |
tamanvadhāvad vegena balabhadro halāyudhaḥ || 2 ||
haṃso hi yatra patitastatrāsau nipapāta ha |
yamunāyāṃ mahārāja viloḍya jalasaṃcayam || 3 ||
athaṃ kruddhaḥ sa ḍimbhako bhrāmayitvā jalaṃ bahu |
unmajjyonmajjya sahasā nimajjya ca punaḥ punaḥ 4||
na dadarśa tadā rājan bhrātaraṃ vīryaśālinam |
unmajjyātha mahābāhurvāsudevaṃ vilokya ca || 5 ||
uvāca vacanaṃ rājan ḍimbhako vīryavattamaḥ |
are gopakadāyāda kvāsau haṃsa iti sthitaḥ || 6 ||
vāsudevo'pi dharmātmā yamunāṃ pṛccha rājaka |
ityabravīt prasannātmā vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān || 7 ||
tacchrutvā yamunāṃ bhūyaḥ praviśya ḍimbhakaḥ kila |
bahuprakāramudvīkṣya bhrātaraṃ bhrātṛvatsalaḥ || 8 ||
vilalāpa tato rājā ḍimbhako bhrāntamānasaḥ |
kva nu gacchasi rājendra vihāyainamabāndhavam || 9 ||
kuto bhrātarito gaccheḥ parityajyaiva māmiha |
vilapyaivaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha ḍimbhako bhrātṛvatsalaḥ || 3.129.10 ||
ātmatyāge manaḥ kurvan yamunāyā mahāhrade ||
nimajyonmajya sahasā maraṇe kṛtaniścayaḥ || 11 ||
hastena jihvāmākṛṣya bhūyo bhūyo vilapya ca |
tataḥ samūlāmākṛṣya jihvāṃ sāhasakṛt svayam || 12 ||
mamārāntarjale rājan ḍimbhako narakāya vai |
evaṃ tu nihate haṃse ḍimbhake vīryaśālini || 13 ||
āgamatpuṇḍarīkākṣo bhūtānvismāpayanniva |
tataḥ prītaḥ prasannātmā vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān || 14||
govardhane'tha viśramya balabhadrasahāyavān |
kaṃcit kālaṃ mahārāja pūrvabhuktamuvāsa ha || 15 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi ḍimbhakamaraṇe ekonatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 129 ||

<3.130>

triṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
yaśodā nandagopaśca kṛṣṇadarśanalālasau |
govardhanagataṃ śrutvā vāsudevaṃ sahāgrajam || 1 ||
navanītaṃ ca dadhi ca pāyasaṃ kṛsaraṃ tathā |
vanyaṃ puṣpaṃ mahārāja mayūrāṅgadameva ca || 2 ||
ballavairaparaiḥ sārdhaṃ gopibhiśca samantataḥ |
jagmatuḥ sahasā prītau govardhanamatho nṛpa || 3 ||
kvacid vṛkṣe samāsaktaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇamṛgekṣaṇam |
dadarśaturmahābāhuṃ vāsudevaṃ sahāgrajam || 4 ||
praṇematuḥ susaṃhṛṣṭau tatra dṛṣṭvā mahābalau |
darśayāmāsaturdevau pāyasāni mahānti ca || 5 ||
tāta mātarvraje goṣṭhe kuśalaṃ vā svagodhanam |
api gāvaḥ kṣīravatyo vatsā vatsatarāḥ pitaḥ || 6 ||
api vā suśubhaṃ kṣīramapi gāvaḥ suśobhanāḥ |
api vā dārakā mātarvatsapālāḥ pibanti ca || 7 ||
bahūni cāpi dāmāni kīlakā api vā bahu |
tṛṇāni bahurūpāṇi kiṃ vā santi pitaḥ sadā || 8 ||
śakaṭāni sugandhīni kiṃ vā santi pitardhruvam |
api gopyaḥ putravatyo dārakānkimajījanan || 9 ||
ghaṭāḥ kiṃ bahavo mātarabhinnāḥ sarvato vraje |
kiṃ gāvaḥ kṣīramatulaṃ sravantyaharahaḥ pitaḥ || 3.130.10 ||
haiyaṅgavīnaṃ kṣīrāṇi dadhi vā kimajījanan |
godhanaṃ sarvamevedaṃ nīrogaṃ pratipadyate || 11 ||
nanda uvāca
sarvametad yaduśreṣṭha nīrogaṃ bahuśaḥ prabho |
kuśalaṃ godhanasyaiva sarvakāleṣu keśava || 12 ||
rakṣaṇāt tava deveśa sadā kuśalino vayam |
sagodhanāḥ savatsāśca nīrogā iva keśava || 13 ||
ekameva sadā duḥkhaṃ na tvāṃ drakṣyāmi keśava |
yadetat kevalaṃ duḥkhamiti dhīḥ śīryate sadā || 14 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evamādi vilapyantaṃ gacchetyāha sa keśavaḥ |
yaśodāṃ punarāhedaṃ mātargaccha gṛhaṃ prati || 15 ||
ye ca tvāṃ kīrtayiṣyanti te ca svargamavāpnuyuḥ |
ye kecit tvāṃ namasyanti te me priyatarāḥ sadā || 16 ||
madbhaktāḥ sarvadā santu gacchetyāha ca tāṃ hariḥ |
ityuktvā pitarau devo vāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ || 17 ||
gāḍhamāliṅgya tau prītau preṣayāmāsa keśavaḥ |
yaśodā nandagopaśca jagmatuḥ svagṛhaṃ prati || 18 ||
tataḥ kṛṣṇo hṛṣīkeśo yādavaiḥ saha vṛṣṇibhiḥ |
gantumaicchattadā viṣṇuḥ purīṃ dvāravatīṃ kila || 19 ||
ya etacchṛṇuyānnityaṃ paṭhed vāpi samāhitaḥ |
putravān dhanavāṃścaiva ante mokṣaṃ ca gacchati || 3.130.20||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi
yaśodānandagopabalabhadrakṛṣṇasamāgame triṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 130 ||

<3.131>

ekatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
