gacchannatha mahāvipṇuḥ puṣkaraṃ prāpya yādavaiḥ |
apaśyanmunimukhyāṃstu puskarasthān nṛpottama || 1 ||
te sametya mahādevamṛṣayo vītamatsarāḥ |
arghyādisamudācāraṃ kṛtvainaṃ yādavottamam || 2 ||
procurviśveśvaraṃ viṣṇuṃ bhūtabhavyabhavatprabhum |
atyadbhutamidaṃ viṣṇo tava vīryaṃ janārdana || 3 ||
yena tau nihatau yuddhe haṃso ḍimbhaka eva ca |
yo vicakro durādharṣo devairapi suduḥsahaḥ || 4 ||
saṃgare nihato deva duḥsādhya iti no matiḥ |
kṣemo naḥ sarvakāryeṣu caratāṃ tapa uttamam || 5 ||
niṣkalmaṣā bhaviṣyāmastava saṃsmaraṇāddhare |
tvaṃ hi sarvasya duḥkhasya hartā tvāṃ dhyāyatāṃ sadā || 6 ||
tvadanusmaraṇaṃ jantoḥ sadā puṇyapradaṃ prabho |
tvaṃ hi naḥ satataṃ dhātā vidhātā tapaso hare || 7 ||
tvamoṃkāro vaṣaṭkārastvaṃ yajñastvaṃ pitāmahaḥ |
tvaṃ jyotirbrahmaṇo mūrtitvaṃ brahmā rudra eva ca || 8 ||
prāṇastvaṃ sarvabhūtānāmantarātmeti kathyate |
upāsyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yajñairdānairjagatpate || 9 ||
namo viśvasṛje deva namaste viśvamūrtaye |
pāhi lokamimaṃ deva hatvā brahmadviṣaḥ sadā || 3.131.10 ||
sa tatheti harirviṣṇuryayau dvāravatīṃ purīm |
avasadvṛṣṇibhiḥ sārdha stūyamānaḥ samāgadhaiḥ || 11 ||
iyaṃ ca devadevasya ceṣṭā hi janamejaya |
proktā te pṛcchate rājankimanyacchrotumicchasi || 12||
iti śromahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi dvārakāyāṃ kṛṣṇasya pratyāgamane ekatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 131 ||

<3.132>

dvātriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
bhagavan kena vidhinā śrotavyaṃ bhārataṃ budhaiḥ |
phalaṃ kiṃ ke ca devāśca pūjyā vai pāraṇeṣviha || 1 ||
deyaṃ samāpte bhagavan kiṃ ca parvaṇi parvaṇi |
vācakaḥ kīdṛśaścātra yaṣṭavyastad bravīhi me || 2 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śṛṇu rājan vidhimimaṃ phalaṃ yaccāpi bhāratāt|
śrutād bhavati rājendra yat tvaṃ māmanupṛcchasi || 3 ||
divi devā mahīpāla krīḍārthamavaniṃ gatāḥ |
kṛtvā kāryamidaṃ caiva tataśca divamāgatāḥ || 4 ||
hanta yat te pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva samāhitaḥ |
ṛṣīṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca sambhavaṃ vasudhātale || 5 ||
atra rudrāstathā sādhyā viśvedevāśca śāśvatāḥ |
ādityāścāśvinau devau lokapālā maharṣayaḥ || 6 ||
guhyakāśca sagandharvā nāgā vidyādharāstathā |
siddhā dharmaḥ svayambhūśca muniḥ kātyāyano varaḥ || 7 ||
girayaḥ sāgarā nadyastathaivāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ |
grahāḥ saṃvatsarāścaiva ayanānyṛtavastathā || 8 ||
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva jagat sarvaṃ surāsuram |
bhārate bharataśreṣṭha ekasthamiha dṛśyate || 9 ||
teṣāṃ śrutipratiṣṭhānāṃ nāmakarmānukīrtanāt |
kṛtvāpi pātakaṃ ghoraṃ sadyo mucyeta mānavaḥ || 3.132.10 ||
itihāsamimaṃ śrutvā yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ |
saṃyatātmā śucirbhūtvā pāraṃ gatvā ca bhārate || 11 ||
teṣāṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ śrāddhāni śrutvā bhārata bhāratam |
brāhmaṇebhyo yathāśaktyā bhaktyā ca bharatarṣabha || 12 ||
mahādānāni deyāni ratnāni vividhāni ca |
gāvaḥ kāṃsyopadohāśca kanyāścaiva svalaṃkṛtāḥ || 13 ||
sarvakāmaguṇopetā yānāni vividhāni ca |
bhājanāni vicitrāṇi bhūmirvāsāṃsi kāñcanam || 14 ||
vāhanāni ca deyāni hayā mattāśca vāraṇāḥ |
śayanaṃ śibikāścaiva syandanāśca svalaṃkṛtāḥ || 15 ||
yad yad gṛhe varaṃ kiṃcid yad yadasti mahadvasu |
tat tad deyaṃ dvijātibhya ātmā dārāśca sūnavaḥ || 16||
śraddhayā parayā dadyāt kramaśastasya pāragaḥ |
śaktitaḥ sumanā hṛṣṭaḥ śuśrūṣuravikampanaḥ || 17 ||
satyārjavarato yattaḥ śuciḥ śaucaparāyaṇaḥ |
śraddadhāno jitakrodho yathā siddhyati tacchrṛṇu || 18 ||
śuciḥ śīlānvitācāraḥ śuklavāsā jitendriyaḥ |
saṃskṛtaḥ sarvaśāstrajñaḥ śraddadhāno'nasūyakaḥ || 19 ||
rūpavān subhago dāntaḥ satyavādī jitendriyaḥ |
dānamānagrahītā ca kāryo bhavati vācakaḥ || 3.132.20 ||
avilambamanāyastamadrutaṃ ghoramūrjitam |
asaṃsaktākṣarapadaṃ na ca bhāvasamanvitam || 21 ||
triṣaṣṭivarṇasaṃyuktamaṣṭasthānasamīritam |
vācayed vācakaḥ svasthaḥ svādhīnaḥ susamāhitaḥ |22||
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam |
devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet || 23 ||
īdṛśādvācakādrājañcchrutvā bhārata bhāratam |
niyamasthaḥ śuciḥ śrotā śṛṇvansa phalamaśnute|24||
pāraṇaṃ prathamaṃ prāpya dvijān kāmaiśca tarpayet |
agniṣṭomasya yāgasya phalaṃ vai labhate naraḥ || 25 ||
apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ vimānaṃ labhate mahat |
prahṛṣṭaḥ sa tu devaiśca divaṃ yāti samāhitaḥ ||26 |
dvitīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ prāpya atirātraphalaṃ labhet |
sarvaratnamayaṃ divyaṃ vimānamadhirohati || 27 ||
divyamālyāmbaradharo divyagandhavibhūṣitaḥ |
divyāṅgadadharo nityaṃ devaloke mahīyate || 28||
tṛtīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ prāpya dvādaśāhaphalaṃ labhet |
vasatyamarasaṃkāśo varṣāṇyayutaśo divi || 29 ||
caturthaṃ vājapeyasya pañcame dviguṇaṃ phalam |
uditādityasaṃkāśaṃ jvalantamanalopamam ||3.132.30 |
vimānaṃ vibudhaiḥ sārdhamāruhya divi gacchati |
varṣāyutāni bhavane śakrasya divi modate | 31||
ṣaṣṭhe dviguṇamastīti saptame triguṇaṃ phalam |
kailāsaśikharākāraṃ vaidūryamaṇivedikam || 32 ||
parikṣiptaṃ ca bahudhā maṇividrumabhūṣitam |
vimānaṃ samadhiṣṭhāya kāmagaṃ sāpsarogaṇam || 33 ||
sarvāṃllokān vicarate dvitīya iva bhāskaraḥ |
aṣṭame rājasūyasya pāraṇe labhate phalam || 34 ||
candrodayanibhaṃ ramyaṃ vimānamadhirohati |
candraraśmipratīkāśairhayairyuktaṃ manojavaiḥ || 35 ||
sevyamāno varastrīṇāṃ candrakāntatarairmukhaiḥ |
mekhalānāṃ ninādena nūpurāṇāṃ ca niḥsvanaiḥ || 36 ||
aṅke paramanārīṇāṃ sukhaṃ supto vibudhyate |
navamaṃ kraturājasya vājimedhasya bhārata || 37 ||
kāñcanastambhanirvyūhaṃ vaidūryakṛtavedikam |
jāmbūnadamayairdivyairgavākṣaiḥ sarvato vṛtam || 38 ||
sevitaṃ cāpsarasaṃghairgandharvairdivicāribhiḥ |
vimānaṃ samadhiṣṭhāya śriyā paramayā jvalan || 39 ||
divyamālyāmbaradharo divyacandanabhūṣitaḥ |
modate daivataiḥ sārdhaṃ divi deva ivāpara || 3.132.40 ||
daśamaṃ pāraṇaṃ prāpya dvijātīnabhivandya ca |
kiṅkiṇījālanirghoṣaṃ patākādhvajaśobhitam || 41 ||
ratnavedikasaṃkāśaṃ vaidūryamaṇitoraṇam |
hemajālaparikṣiptaṃ pravālavalabhīmukham || 42 ||
gandharvairgītakuśalairapsarobhirniṣevitam |
vimānaṃ sukṛtāvāsaṃ sukhenaivopapadyate ||43 ||
mukuṭenārkavarṇena jāmbūnadavibhūṣaṇaḥ |
divyacandanadigdhāṅgo divyamālyavibhūṣitaḥ || 44 ||
divyām̐llokān pracarati divyairbhogaiḥ samanvitaḥ |
vibudhānāṃ prasādena śriyā paramayā yutaḥ || 45 ||
atha varṣagaṇānevaṃ svargaloke mahīyate |
tato gandharvasahitaḥ sahasrāṇyekaviṃśatiḥ || 46 ||
puraṃdarapure ramye śakreṇa saha modate |
divyayānavimāneṣu lokeṣu vividheṣu ca || 47 ||
divyanārīgaṇākīrṇo nivasatyamaro yathā |
tataḥ sūryasya bhavane candrasya bhavane tathā || 48 ||
śivasya bhavane rājan viṣṇoryāti salokatām|
evametanmahārāja nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||49||
śraddadhānena vai bhāvyamevamāha gururmama |
vācakasya tu dātavyaṃ manasā yad yadicchati || 3.132.50 ||
hastyaśvarathayānādi vāhanaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
kaṭake kuṇḍale caiva brahmasūtraṃ tathāparam || 51 ||
vastraṃ caiva vicitraṃ ca gandhaṃ caivaṃ viśeṣataḥ |
devavat pūjayettaṃ tu viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt || 52 ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yāni deyāni bhārate |
vācyamāne'tha viprebhyo rājan parvaṇi parvaṇi || 53 ||
jātiṃ deśaṃ ca satyaṃ ca māhātmyaṃ bharatarṣabha |
dharmavṛttiṃ ca vijñāya brāhmaṇānāṃ narādhipa || 54 ||
svasti vācyaṃ dvijairādau tataḥ kāryaṃ pravartayet |
samāptaparvaṇi tataḥ svaśaktyā tarpayed dvijān || 55 ||
ādau tu vācakaṃ caiva vastragandhasamanvitam |
vidhivad bhojayed rājan madhupāyasasaṃyutam || 56
tato mūlaphalaprāyaṃ pāyasaṃ madhusarpiṣā |
āstīke bhojayed rājan dadyāccaiva guḍaudanam ||57||
apūpaiścaiva pūpaiśca modakaiśca samanvitam |
sabhāparvaṇi rājendra haviṣyaṃ bhojayed dvijān || 58 ||
āraṇyake mūlaphalaistarpayecca dvijottamān |
araṇīparva āsādya jalakumbhān pradāpayet || 59 ||
tarpaṇāni ca mukhyāni vanyamūlaphalāni ca |
sarvakāmaguṇopetaṃ viprebhyo'nnaṃ pradāpayet || 3.132.60 ||
virāṭaparvaṇi tathā vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca |
udyoge bharataśreṣṭha sarvakāmaguṇānvitam || 61 ||

catustriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
harivaṃśe varṇitānāṃ vṛttāntānāṃ saṃgrahaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
harivaṃśe'tra vṛttāntāḥ prakīrtyante kramoditāḥ |
tatrādāvādisargastu bhūtasargastataḥ paraḥ || 1 ||

vaivasvatakulotpattirdhundhumārakathā tathā || 2||
gālavotpattirikṣvākuvaṃśasyāpyanukīrtanam |
pitṛkalpastathotpattiḥ somasya ca budhasya ca || 3 ||
amāvasoranvayasya kīrtanaṃ kīrtivardhanam |
cyutiṃpratiṣṭhe śakrasya prasavaḥ kṣatravṛddhajaḥ || 4 ||
divodāsapratiṣṭhā ca triśaṅkoḥ kṣatriyasya ca |
yayāticaritaṃ caiva pūruvaṃśasya kīrtanam || 5 ||
phira divodāsakī pratiṣṭhā, rājā triśaṅkukī kathā,
yayātikā caritra aura pūruvaśakā varṇana ha || 5 ||
kīrtanaṃ kṛṣṇasambhūteḥ syamantakamaṇestathā |
saṃkṣepātkīrtitā viṣṇoḥ prādurbhāvāstataḥ param ||6||
tārakāmayayuddhaṃ ca brahmalokasya varṇanam |
yoganidrāsamutthānaṃ viṣṇorvākyaṃ ca vedhasaḥ || 7 ||
pṛthvīvākyaṃ ca devānāmaṃśāvataraṇaṃ tathā |
tato nāradavākyaṃ ca svapnagarbhavidhistathā || 8 ||
āryāstavaḥ punaḥ kṛṣṇasamutpattiḥ prapañcataḥ |
govraje gamanaṃ viṣṇoḥ śakaṭasya nivartanam || 9 ||
pūtanāyā vadho bhaṅgo yamalārjunayorapi |
vṛkasaṃdarśānaṃ caiva bṛndāvananiveśanam || 3.134.10 ||
prāvṛṣo varṇanaṃ cāpi yamunāhradadarśanam |
kāliyasyāpi damanaṃ dhenukasya ca bhañjanam || 11 ||
pralambanidhanaṃ caiva śaradvarṇanameva ca |
giriyajñapravṛttiśca govardhanavidhāraṇam || 12 ||
govindasyābhiṣekaṃ ca gopīsaṃkrīḍanaṃ tathā |
riṣṭāsurasya nidhanamakūrapreṣaṇaṃ tathā || 13 ||
andhakasya ca vākyāni keśino nidhanaṃ tathā |
akrūrāgamanaṃ caiva nāgalokasya darśanam || 14 ||
dhanurbhaṅgasya kathanaṃ kaṃsavākyamataḥ param |
kuvalayāpīḍavadhaścāṇūrāndhravadhastathā || 15 ||
kaṃsasya nidhanaṃ cāpi vilāpaḥ kaṃsayoṣitām |
ugrasenābhiṣekaśca yādavāśvāsanaṃ tathā || 16 ||
pratyāgatirgurukulādathoktā rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ |
mathurāyāścoparodho jarāsaṃdhanivartanam || 17 ||
vikadruvākyaṃ rāmasya darśanaṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ tathā |
gomantārohaṇaṃ cāpi jarāsaṃdhagatistathā || 18 ||
gomantasya girerdāhaḥ karavīrapure gatiḥ |
śṛgālasya vadhastatra mathurāgamanaṃ tataḥ || 19 ||
yamunākarṣaṇaṃ caiva mathurāpakramastathā |
upāyena vadhaḥ kālayavanasya prakīrtitaḥ || 3.134.20||
nirmāṇaṃ dvāravatyāstu rukmiṇīharaṇaṃ tathā |
vivāhaścaiva rukmiṇyā rukmiṇo nidhanaṃ tathā || 21 ||
baladevāhnikaṃ puṇyaṃ balamāhātmyameva ca |
narakasya vadhaḥ pārijātasya haraṇaṃ tathā || 22 ||
dvāravatyā viśeṣeṇa punarnirmāṇakīrtanam |
dvārakāyāṃ praveśaśca sabhāyāṃ ca praveśanam || 23 ||
nāradasya ca vākyāni vṛṣṇivaṃśānukīrtanam |
ṣaṭpurasya vadhākhyānamandhakasya nibarhaṇam || 24 ||
samudrayātrā kṛṣṇasya jalakrīḍākutūhalam |
tathā bhaimapravīrāṇāṃ madhupānapravartakam || 25 ||
tataśchālikyagāndharvasamudāharaṇaṃ hareḥ |
bhānośca duhiturbhānumatyā haraṇakīrtanam || 26 ||
śambarasya vathaścaiva dhanyopākhyānameva ca |
vāsudevasya māhātmyaṃ bāṇayuddhaṃ prapañcitam || 27 ||
bhaviṣyaṃ puṣkaraṃ caiva prapañcenaiva kīrtitam |
vārāhaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ ca vāmanaṃ bahuvistaram || 28 ||
kailāsayātrā kṛṣṇasya pauṇḍrakasya vadhastataḥ |
haṃsasya ḍimbhakasyaiva vadhaścaiva prakīrtitaḥ || 29 ||
puratrayasya saṃhāra iti vṛttāntasaṃgrahaḥ |
kathito nṛpaśārdūla sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ || 3.134.30 ||
vṛttāntaṃ śṛṇuyādyastu sāyaṃprātaḥ samāhitaḥ |
sa yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma labdhakāmaḥ kurūdvaha |
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam || 31 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi vṛttāntasaṃgrahe catuṣtriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 134 ||

<3.135>

pañcatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
harivaṃśe purāṇe tu śrute munivarottama |
kiṃ phalaṃ kiṃ ca deyaṃ vai tad brūhi tvaṃ mamāgrataḥ || 1 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
harivaṃśe purāṇe tu śrute ca bharatottama |
kāyikaṃ vācikaṃ caiva manasā samupārjitam || 2 ||
tat sarvaṃ nāśamāyāti tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā |
aṣṭādaśapurāṇānāṃ śravaṇād yatphalaṃ bhavet || 3 ||
tat phalaṃ samavāpnoti vaiṣṇavo nātra saṃśayaḥ |
ślokārdhaṃ ślokapādaṃ vā harivaṃśasamudbhavam || 4 ||
śṛṇvanti śraddhayā yuktā vaiṣṇavaṃ padamāpnuyuḥ |
jambūdvīpaṃ samāśritya śrotāro durlabhāḥ kalau || 5 ||
bhaviṣyanti narā rājan satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham |
strībhiśca putrakāmābhiḥ śrotavyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yaśaḥ || 6 ||
dakṣiṇā cātra deyā vai niṣkatrayasuvarṇakam |
vācakāya yathāśaktyā yathoktaṃ phalamicchatā || 7 ||
svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ ca kapilāṃ savatsāṃ vastrasaṃyutām |
vācakāya pradadyād vai ātmanaḥ śreyakāṅkṣayā || 8 ||
alaṃkāraṃ pradadyācca pāṇyorvai bharatarṣabha |
karṇasyābharaṇaṃ dadyād yānaṃ ca saviśeṣataḥ || 9 ||
bhūmidānaṃ samādadyād brāhmaṇāya narādhipa |
bhūmidānasamaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 3.135.10 ||
śṛṇoti śrāvayed vāpi harivaṃśaṃ tu yo naraḥ |
sarvathā pāpanirmukto vaiṣṇavaṃ padamāpnuyāt || 11 ||
pitṝnuddharate sarvānekādaśasamudbhavān |
ātmānaṃ sasutaṃ caiva striyaṃ ca bharatarṣabha || 12 ||
daśāṃśaścātra homo vai kāryaḥ śrotrā narādhipa |
idaṃ mayā tavāgre ca sarvaṃ proktaṃ nararṣabha || 13 ||
yasya smaraṇamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
aputraḥ putramāpnoti adhano dhanamāpnuyāt || 14 ||
naramedhāśvamedhābhyāṃ yat phalaṃ prāpyate naraiḥ |
tat phalaṃ labhate nūnaṃ purāṇaśravaṇāddhareḥ || 15 ||
brahmahā bhrūṇahā goghnaḥ surāpo gurutalpagaḥ |
sakṛtpurāṇaśravaṇāt pūto bhavati nānyathā || 16 ||
idaṃ mayā te parikīrtitaṃ mahacchrīkṛṣṇamāhātmyamapāramadbhutam |
śṛṇvan paṭhannāśu samāpnuyātphalaṃ yaccāpi lokeṣu sudurlabhaṃ mahat || 17 ||
iti śrīmahābhārate śatasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ vaiyāsikyāṃ khilabhāge harivaṃśe bhaviṣyaparvaṇi śravaṇaphalakathane pañcatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 135 ||
|| harivaṃśaparva sampūrṇa ||

<4>

śrīparamātmane namaḥ
śrīharivaṃśamāhātmyam

<4.1>

prathamo'dhyāyaḥ
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam |
devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet || 1 ||
jayati parāśarasūnuḥ satyavatīhṛdayanandano vyāsaḥ |
yasyāsyakamalagalitaṃ vāṅmayamamṛtaṃ jagat pibati ||2||
ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāñjanaśalākayā |
cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 3 ||
akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaram |
tat padaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 4 ||
janamejaya uvāca
tvayā me bhagavan prokto bhārataśravaṇe vidhiḥ |
śravaṇe harivaṃśasya viśeṣād vada me vidhim || 5
vaiśampāyana uvāca
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ harivaṃśaṃ jagurvapuḥ |
śabdabrahmamayaṃ viddhi harivaṃśaṃ sanātanam || 6 ||
śābde brahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ parabrahmādhigacchati |
harivaṃśapurāṇe tu śrute vai rājasattama || 7 ||
kāyikaṃ vācikaṃ pāpaṃ manasā samupārjitam |
tat sarvaṃ nāśamāyāti tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā || 8 ||
aṣṭādaśapurāṇānāṃ śravaṇād yat phalaṃ labhet |
tat phalaṃ samavāpnoti vaiṣṇavo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 9 ||
striyaśca puruṣāścaiva vaiṣṇavaṃ padamāpnuyuḥ |
jambūdvīpaṃ samāśritya śrotāro durlabhāḥ kalau || 1.10 ||
bhaviṣyanti narā rājan satyaṃsatyaṃ vadāmyaham|
strībhiśca putrakāmābhiḥ śrotavyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yaśaḥ || 11 ||
bālaghātī ca puruṣo mṛtavatsaḥ prajāyate |
śravaṇaṃ harivaṃśasya kartavyaṃ ca yathāvidhi || 12 ||
gurucandrāgnisūryāṇāṃ sammukhe mehate ca yaḥ |
bījamusṛjyate tena tyaktaretā naro bhavet || 13 ||
yoṣitpuṣpaphalānāṃ ca bālānāṃ ghātinī tathā |
phalānāṃ kartanakarī mātāpitṛviyoginī || 14 ||
srāviṇī paragarbhāṇāṃ tat tat prāyopajoṣiṇī |
īdṛgvidhā bhaviṣyanti pañcadoṣayutāḥ striyaḥ || 15 ||
apuṣpā mṛtavatsāśca kākavandhyāstathaiva ca |
kanyāprajātvaṃ ca tathā srāvayuktāḥ svapātakaiḥ || 16 ||
tāsāṃ doṣāpahārārthaṃ harivaṃśo'bhigarjati |
madīyaśravaṇātsadyo doṣā naśyanti satvaram || 17 ||
naraḥ suvarṇaṃ sarpiśca padadānaiḥ samanvitam |
daśāvṛttīḥ śṛṇotyevaṃ bījasāphalyamāpnuyāt || 18 ||
daśāvṛttīrapuṣpārthaṃ mṛtavatsā tu sapta vai |
pañcāvṛttīḥ sravadgarbhā kākavandhyā trayaṃ tathā || 19 ||
kanyāprasūścaikāvṛttiṃ śrutvā putramavāpnuyāt |
jīvitāvadhikaṃ śrāvyaṃ sarvadoṣopaśāntaye || 1.20 ||
bhaviṣyaṃ janmasamprāpya na bhavet tādṛśī punaḥ |
uttamaṃ sārthapāṭhaṃ ca madhyamaṃ ca nirarthakam || 21 ||
vinārthaṃ śuddhapāṭhaśceduttamena samo bhavet |
navāhamuttamaṃ proktamekaviṃśāha madhyamam || 22 ||
nikṛṣṭamekatriṃśāhaṃ sukhasādhyaṃ samācaret |
bahubhirdivasai rājan sādhyānāṃ sādhanaṃ kalau || 23||
tena pārāyaṇaṃ sādhyaṃ proktaṃ nārāyaṇātmanā |
navāho garjati kalau caikaviṃśāhikastathā || 24 ||
ekatriṃśāhiko yajño vandhyādoṣavināśakaḥ |
govrataṃ tu striyā kāryaṃ pāraṇaṃ puruṣeṇa ca || 25 ||
śravaṇārambhaṇe rājan yathāvat kathayāmi te |
avasāyāntaparyantaṃ kāryaṃ māsavrataṃ śubham || 26 ||
caturthyāṃ prātarutthāya striyā hṛṣṭena cetasā |
govrataṃ niyataṃ kāryaṃ nirāhāraṃ nirūdakam || 27 ||
sṛryāstakālaparyantaṃ yāvadgrāmāgamo bhavet |
āgatāṃ ca savatsāṃ hi pūjayitvā yathāvidhi || 28 ||
yavasaṃ puṣkalaṃ dattvā yavānnaṃ kurute svayam |
evaṃ māse caturthyāṃ sā śuklāyāṃ vratamācaret || 29 ||
strīvrataṃ kathitaṃ rājan puruṣasya tathaiva ca |
evaṃ māsavrataṃ kṛtvā suputraṃ labhate dhruvam || 1.30 ||
iti śrīpadmapurāṇe harivaṃśamāhātmye śravaṇādividhikathanaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ||1 ||

<4.2>

dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
atha te sampravakṣyāmi navāhaśravaṇe vidhim |
sahāyairbahubhiścaiva prāyaḥ sādhyo vidhistvayam || 1 ||
daivajñaṃ tu samāhūya muhūrtaṃ pṛcchya yatnataḥ |
vivāhe yādṛśaṃ vittaṃ tādṛśaṃ parikalpya ca || 2 ||
nabhasyaścāśvinorjau ca mārgaśīrṣaḥ śucirnabhaḥ |
ete māsāḥ kathārambhe śrotṝṇāṃ kāmasūcakāḥ || 3 ||
sahāyāśca ta evātra kartavyāḥ sodyamāśca ye |
deśe deśe tathā seyaṃ vārtā procyā prayatnataḥ || 4 ||
bhaviṣyati kathā cātra āgantavyaṃ kuṭumbibhiḥ |
deśe deśe viraktā ye vaiṣṇavāḥ kīrtanotsukāḥ || 5 ||
teṣveva patraṃ preṣyaṃ ca tallekhanamitīritam |
satāṃ samājo bhavitā navarātraṃ sudurlabhaḥ || 6 ||
āgantukānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vāsasthānāni kalpayet |
tīrthe vāpi vane vāpi gṛhe vā śravaṇaṃ smṛtam || 7 ||
viśālā vasudhā yatra kartavyaṃ tatkathāsthalam |
śodhanaṃ mārjanaṃ bhūmerlepanaṃ dhātumaṇḍanam || 8 |
gṛhopaskaramuddhṛtya gṛhakoṇe niveśayet |
kartavyo maṇḍapaḥ proccaiḥ kadalīstambhamaṇḍitaḥ || 9 ||
phalapuṣpadalairviṣvagvitānena virājitaḥ |
caturdikṣu dhvajāropastoraṇena virājitaḥ || 2.10 ||
ūrdhvaṃ saptaiva lokāśca saptādhaḥ parikalpayet |
teṣu viprā viraktāśca sthāpanīyāḥ prabodhya vai || 11 ||
pūrvaṃ teṣāmāsanāni kartavyāni yathottaram |
vaktuścāpi tathā divyamāsanaṃ parikalpayet| 12 ||
udaṅmukho bhaved vaktā śrotā vai prāṅmukhastathā |
prāṅmukho'tha bhaved vaktā śrotā codaṅamukhastathā ||
virakto vaiṣṇavo vipro vedaśāstraviśāradaḥ |
dṛṣṭāntakuśalo dhīro vaktā kāryo dayānvitaḥ || 14 ||
vedavedāntatattvajñairgurubhirbrahmavādibhiḥ |
nṛṇāṃ kṛtopadeśānāṃ sadyaḥ siddhirhi jāyate || 15 ||
athānyajanasāmānyairgurubhirnītikovidaiḥ |
nṛṇāṃ kṛtopadeśānāṃ siddhirbhavati kīdṛśī || 16||
anekadharmavibhrāntāḥ straiṇāḥ pākhaṇḍavādinaḥ |
dharmaśāstrakathoccāre tyājyāste yadi paṇḍitāḥ || 17 ||
vaktuḥ pārśve sahāyārthamanyaḥ sthāpyastathāvidhaḥ |
paṇḍitaḥ saṃśayacchettā lokabodhanatatparaḥ || 18 ||
vaktrā kṣauraṃ prakartavyaṃ dinādarvāg vratāptaye |
vaktuḥ śrotuścandraśuddhau dampatyoḥ śubhatārake || 19 ||
aruṇodaye vinirvartya śaucaṃ snānaṃ samācaret |
nityaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ kṛtvā saṃdhyādyaṃ prayatastataḥ || 2.20 ||
sukṣālitapāṇipādaḥ svastivācanapūrvakam|
gomayopaliptadeśe sarvatobhadrakalpanam || 21 ||
svīyaśaktyanusāreṇa pūjanaṃ sarvamācaret |
kathāvighnavināśāya gaṇanāthaṃ prapūjayet || 22 ||
salakṣmīputrasahitaṃ gopālaṃ sthāpayet tataḥ |
nirvighnenaiva siddhyarthaṃ devapūjanapūrvakam ||23||
saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt
adyehetyādideśakālau smṛtvā amukagotrasyāmukapravarasyāmukaśarmaṇaḥ sapatnīkasya mama janmani janmani saṃcitamahāpātakapaṭalanāśapūrvakaṃ tena pāpasaṃcayena kṛtasaṃtānabādhakatāvināśapūrvakamiha janmani saṃtānotpattihetave tasya saṃtānasya śaradāṃ śatamāyuṣo vṛddhyarthamātmanaśca sakalasukhāptihetave iha śarīraśuddhayarthaṃ paratra cendrādilokātikramaṇapūrvakaśrīmadviṣṇubhaktyudrekajanitakalpāvadhitallokagamana tatra vāsapūrvaka tatsvarūpāvāptihetave āvāṃ dampatī śrīmaddharivaṃśapurāṇaśravaṇaṃ kartṛkatayā kariṣyāvahe |
anyatarakartṛtve kariṣye ityeva saṃkalpaḥ |
iti kṛtvā tu saṃkalpaṃ vaktāraṃ vṛṇuyāttataḥ |
śrutādhyayanasampannaṃ pūjayitvā yathāvidhi || 24 ||
suvarṇamudrikāṃ gṛhya kuṇḍale ca viśeṣataḥ |
dhautavastraṃ sottarīyaṃ coṣṇīṣeṇa samanvitam || 25 ||
suvarṇaṣoḍaśapalaṃ puṣpatāmbūlasaṃyutam |
pūgīphalaṃ cākṣatān vai gṛhītvā śuddhamānasaḥ || 26 ||
saṃkalpaḥ—
adyehetyādi amukagotramamukaśarmāṇaṃ brāhmaṇamebhiścandanatāmbūlasuvarṇavastrādibhirharivaṃśaśravaṇe vācakatvenāvāṃ dampatī tvāṃ vṛṇīvahe |
vṛto'smīti tenokte—
vratena dīkṣāmāpnoti iti mantreṇa vakturdakṣiṇakaramūle rakṣābandhanaṃ kāryam | brāhmaṇena śrotṝṇāṃ rakṣābandhanaṃ kāryam |
vratena dīkṣāmāpnoti dīkṣayāpnoti dakṣiṇām|
dakṣiṇā śraddhāmāpnoti śraddhayā satyamāpyate||
candanādyupacāraistu vastrapuṣpākṣataistathā |
hemālaṃkaraṇaiḥ pūgaiḥ phalairṛtusamudbhavaiḥ || 27 ||
purāṇapūjanaṃ proktaṃ vidhinā ṣoḍaśena tu |
pūjayitvā dvijaśreṣṭhāñśravaṇaṃ phaladaṃ smṛtam 28 ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena śrotavyaṃ vidhipūrvakam |
atha vyāsaṃ namaskuryurmantrametamudīrayet || 29 ||
namaste bhagavan vyāsa sarvaśāstrārthakovida |
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānamūrte satyavatīsuta || 2.30 ||
iti vyāsaṃ namaskṛtya śubhadeśe kuśāsane |
upaviśya pratidinamullasatprītamānasaḥ || 31 ||
bālo yuvātha vṛddho vā daridro durbalo'pi vā |
purāṇajñaḥ sadā vandyaḥ pūjyaśca sukṛtārthibhiḥ || 32 ||
nīcabuddhiṃ na kurvīta purāṇajñe kadācana |
yasya vaktrodgatā vāṇī kāmadhenuḥ śarīriṇām|| 33 ||
guravaḥ santi lokasya janmato guṇataśca ye |
teṣāmapi ca sarveṣāṃ purāṇajñaḥ paro guruḥ || 34 ||
bhavakoṭisahasreṣu bhūtvā bhūtvā ca sīdate |
yo dadāti puṇyavṛttiṃ ko'nyastasmātparo guruḥ ||35 ||
purāṇajñaḥ śucirdāntaḥ śānto'pi jitamatsaraḥ |
sādhuḥ kāruṇyavānvāgmī vadetpuṇyakathāṃ sudhīḥ||36||
vyāsāsanasamārūḍho yadā paurāṇiko dvijaḥ |
ā samāpteḥ prasaṃgasya namaskuryānna kasyacit || 37
ye dhūrtā ye ca durvṛttā ye cānye vijigīṣavaḥ |
teṣāṃ kuṭilavṛttīnāmagre naiva vadetkathām || 38 ||
na durjanasamākīrṇe na śūdraśvāpadāvṛte |
deśe nāpūtasadane vadet puṇyakathāṃ sudhīḥ || 39 ||
sadgrāme sujanākīrṇe sukṣetre devatālaye |
puṇye nadanadītare vadet puṇyakathāṃ sudhīḥ || 2.40 ||
īdṛśād vācakād rājañchrutvā phalamavāpnuyāt|
aihikāmuṣmikaṃ śarma puṇyaṃ putrādisiddhidam || 41 ||
mahāpāpādiśamanaṃ purāṇaṃ harivaṃśakam |
yojyaṃ putrādisiddhyarthaṃ harivaṃśaṃ jitendriyaiḥ || 42 ||
śṛṇuyāt sarvabhāvena puṇyaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || 43 ||
iti śrīpadmapurāṇe harivaṃśamāhātmye śravaṇādividhikathanaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||

<4.3>

tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāpa
japāddhi śravaṇaṃ proktaṃ harivaṃśasya sūribhiḥ |
pitṝn saṃtarpya śuddhyarthaṃ prāyaścittaṃ samācaret || 1||
sumaṇḍapaṃ ca kartavyaṃ tatra sthāpyo haristathā |
kṛṣṇamuddiśya mantreṇa caretpūjāvidhiṃ kramāt || 2 ||
pradakṣiṇānamaskārān pūjānte stutimācaret|
saṃsārasāgare magnaṃ dīnaṃ māṃ karuṇānidhe || 3 ||
karmagrāhagṛhīto'haṃ māmuddhara bhavārṇavāt |
tataḥ śrīharivaṃśasya pūjā kāryā prayatnataḥ || 4 ||
vidhinā ṣoḍaśenaiva dhūpadīpasamanvitā |
tatastu śrīphalaṃ dhṛtvā namaskāraṃ samācaret || 5 ||
stutiḥ prasannacittena kartavyā kevalaṃ tadā |
svīkṛto'si mayā nātha putrārthaṃ bhavasāgare || 6 ||
manoratho madīyo'yaṃ saphalaḥ sarvathā tvayā |
nirvighnenaiva kartavyo dāso'haṃ tava keśava || 7 ||
evaṃ dīnavacaḥ proktvā vaktāraṃ cātha pūjayet |
sambhūṣya vastrabhūṣābhiḥ pūjānte taṃ ca saṃstavet|| 8 ||
vyāsarūpa prabodhajña sarvaśāstraviśārada |
etatkathāprakāśena madajñānaṃ vināśaya || 9 ||
tadagre niyamaḥ paścāt kartavyaḥ śreyase mudā |
navarātraṃ yathāśaktyā dhāraṇīyaḥ sa eva hi || 3.10 ||
varaṇaṃ pañcaviprāṇāṃ kathābhaṅganivṛttaye |
kartavyaṃ tairharerjāpyaṃ dvādaśākṣaravidyayā || 11 ||
saṃtānagopālamantro mahārudrajapastathā |
pūjanaṃ pārthivasyaiva gaṇanāthamanorjapaḥ || 12 ||
brāhmaṇān vaiṣṇavāṃścānyāṃstathā kīrtanakāriṇaḥ |
natvā sampūjya dattājñaḥ svayamāsanamāviśet || 13 ||
lokavittadhanāgārasarvacintā vyudasya ca |
kathācittaḥ śuddhamatiḥ sa labhetphalamuttamam || 14 ||
dampatī śuddhamanasau śraddhābhaktisamanvitau |
śraddhaiva sarvadharmāṇāṃ māteva hitakāriṇī || 15 ||
śraddhayaiva nṛṇāṃ siddhirjāyate lokayordvayoḥ |
śraddhayā bhajataḥ puṃsaḥ śilāpi phaladāyinī || 16 ||
mūrkho'pi pūjito bhaktyā gururbhavati jñānadaḥ |
śraddhayā bhajato mantrastvasad yo'pi phalapradaḥ || 17 ||
śraddhayā pūjito devo nīcasyāpi varapradaḥ |
aśraddhayā kṛtā pūjā dānaṃ yajñastapo vratam || 18 ||
sarvaṃ niṣphalatāṃ yāti puṣpaṃ bandhutaroriva |
sarvatra saṃśayāviṣṭaḥ bhaddhāhīno'ticañcalaḥ || 19 ||
paramārthāt paribhraṣṭaḥ saṃsṛterna hi mucyate |
mantre tīrthe dvije deve daivajñe bheṣaje gurau || 3.20 ||
yādaśī bhāvanā yasya siddhirbhavati tādṛśī |
ato bhāvamayaṃ viśvaṃ puṇyapāpaṃ ca bhāvataḥ || 21 ||
te ubhe bhāvahīnasya na bhavetāṃ kadācana |
tasmātsarvātmanā rājañchraddhābhaktī samāśrayet|| 22 ||
ā sūryodayamārabhya sārdhaṃ tripraharārdhakam |
vācanīyā kathā samyag dhīrakaṇṭhaṃ sudhīmatā || 23 ||
kathāvirāmaḥ kartavyo madhyāhne ghaṭikādvayam |
tat kathāmanu kāryaṃ vai kīrtanaṃ vaiṣṇavaistadā || 24 ||
evaṃ śrutvā vidhānena sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt|| 25 ||
iti śrīpadmapurāṇe harivaṃśamāhātmye śravaṇādividhikathanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||3||

<4.4>

caturtho'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
navāhavratināṃ puṃsāṃ niyamāñchṛṇu sattama |
ekakālāśanaścaiva adhaḥśāyī bhavennaraḥ || 1 ||
sthātavyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa yāvad granthaḥ samāpyate |
harivaṃśe tathā rājan pāyasaṃ carubhojanam || 2 ||
pāraṇe pāraṇe yātaṃ yathāvad bharatarṣabha |
malamūtrajayārthaṃ hi laghvāhāraḥ sukhāvahaḥ || 3 ||
haviṣyānnena kartavyamekavāraṃ kathārthinā |
upoṣya navarātraṃ vā śaktiścecchṛṇuyāttadā || 4 ||
ghṛtapānaṃ payaḥpānaṃ kṛtvā vā śṛṇuyātsukham|
phalāhāreṇa vā bhāvyamekabhuktena vā punaḥ || 5 ||
sukhasādhyaṃ bhaved yattu kartavyaṃ śravaṇāya tat|
bhojanaṃ tu varaṃ manye kathāśravaṇakārakam || 6 ||
nopavāso varaḥ prokto kathāvighnakaro yadi |
śṛṇuyādyaḥ śucistiṣṭhannekacittatayā sadā || 7||
prātaḥsnānādikaṃ kṛtvā putradārasamanvitaḥ |
purāṇaśravaṇaṃ kuryāt kṛṣṇapūjanapūrvakam || 8 ||
puṣpadhūpaphalaiḥ samyaṅ naivedyaiḥ śraddhayoddhṛtaiḥ |
guroḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ tena kartavyaṃ phalakāṅkṣiṇā || 9 ||
śrutvā yathecchayā śaucaṃ kāryaṃ puṇyena vartmanā |
sāyaṃkāle guruśreṣṭhaṃ toṣayitvā sabāndhavaḥ || 4.10 ||
svaparigrahasaṅgena sukhaṃ svapiti vai tadā |
niyamādi prakartavyaṃ pāpānāṃ vinivartane || 11 ||
yathāsukhaṃ vyavaharennityaṃ viṣṇuparāyaṇaḥ |
śuciḥśuddhamanāstiṣṭhan patrāvalyāṃ ca bhojanam| 12 ||
kathāsamāptau bhuktiṃ ca kuryānnityaṃ kathāvratī |
dvidalaṃ madhu tailaṃ ca gariṣṭhānnaṃ tathaiva ca || 13 ||
bhāvaduṣṭaṃ paryuṣitaṃ jahyānnityaṃ kathāvratī |
vṛntākaṃ ca kaliṅgaṃ ca dagdhamannaṃ masūrikām || 14 ||
niṣpāvānāmiṣādyaṃ ca varjayecca kathāvratī |
palāṇḍuṃ laśunaṃ hiṃguṃ mūlakaṃ gṛñjanaṃ tathā || 15 ||
nālikāmūlakūṣmāṇḍaṃ naivādyācca kathāvratī |
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ madaṃ mānaṃ matsaraṃ lobhameva ca || 16||
dambhaṃ mohaṃ tathā dveṣaṃ dūrayecca kathāvratī |
vedavaiṣṇavaviprāṇāṃ gurugovratināṃ tathā || 17 ||
strīrājamahatāṃ nindāṃ varjayecca kathāvratī |
rajasvalāntyajamlecchapatitavrātyakaiḥ saha || 18 ||
dvijadviḍvedabāhyaiśca na vadecca kathāvratī |
satyaṃ śaucaṃ dayā maunamārjavaṃ vinayaṃ tathā || 19 ||
udāraṃ mānasaṃ tadvat kuryādeva kathāvratī |
śraddhābhaktisamāyuktā nānyakāryeṣu lālasā || 4.20 ||
vāgyatāḥ śucayo'vyagrāḥ śrotāraḥ puṇyabhāginaḥ |
abhaktyā ye kathāṃ puṇyāṃ śṛṇvanti manujādhamāḥ ||21||
teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ nāsti duḥkhaṃ syājjanmajanmani |
purāṇaṃ ye tu sampūjya tāmbūlādyairupāyanaiḥ || 22
śṛṇvanti ca kathāṃ bhaktyā daridrāḥ syurna pāpinaḥ |
kathāyāṃ kīrtyamānāyāṃ ye gacchantyanyato narāḥ || 23 ||
bhogāntare praṇaśyanti teṣāṃ dārāśca sampadaḥ |
soṣṇīṣamastakā ye ca kathāṃ śṛṇvanti pāvanīm||24||
te balākā prajāyante pāpino manujādhamāḥ |
tāmbūlaṃ bhakṣayanto ye kathāṃ śṛṇvanti pāvanīm|| 25 ||
svaviṣṭhāṃ khādayantyetānnarake yamakiṅkarāḥ |
nāryā rajasvalāyāśca yonitulyaṃ mukhaṃ bhavet || 26 ||
ye tuṅgāsanārūḍhāḥ kathāṃ śṛṇvanti dāmbhikāḥ |
akṣayyānnarakān bhuktvā te bhavantyeva vāyasāḥ ||27||
ye ca vīrāsanārūḍhā ye ca śayyāsanasthitāḥ |
śṛṇvanti tatkathāṃ te vai bhavantyarjunapādapāḥ || 28 ||
asampraṇamya śṛṇvanto viṣavṛkṣā bhavanti te |
tathā śayānāḥ śṛṇvanto bhavantyajagarā narāḥ || 29 ||
yaḥ śṛṇoti kathāṃ vakraḥ samānāsanamāsthitaḥ |
gurutalpasamaṃ pāpaṃ samprāpya narakaṃ vrajet || 4.30 ||
ye nindanti purāṇajñān kathāṃ vā pāpahāriṇīm |
te vai janmaśataṃ martyāḥ śunakāḥ sambhavanti ca || 31||
kathāyāṃ vartamānāyāṃ ye vadanti duruttaram |
te gardabhāḥ prajāyante kṛkalāsāstataḥ param ||32 ||
kadācidapi ye puṇyāṃ na śṛṇvanti kathāṃ narāḥ |
te bhuktvā narakān ghorān bhavanti vanaśūkarāḥ ||33||
kathāyāṃ kīrtyamānāyāṃ vighnaṃ kurvanti ye śaṭhāḥ |
koṭyabdānnarakānbhuktvā bhavanti grāmasūkarāḥ|34||
madhye vārtāṃ na kurvīta cet kuryānnirayaṃ vrajet |
kathāyāṃ śrūyamāṇāyāṃ na kuryācchiśulālanam || 35 ||
narmavādān vadennaiva striyā sambhāṣaṇaṃ tathā |
na kartavyaṃ prayatnena kathāvicchedakāraṇam || 36 ||
vicchedena kathāyāstu brahmahatyāsamaṃ tvagham |
prāpnoti nṛpaśārdūla kathāvicchedakaḥ pumān || 37 ||
na kuryāttu kathāmadhye tvanyavārtāḥ prayatnataḥ |
nārī vā puruṣo vāpi kuryānnirayamāpnuyāt || 38 ||
itihāsaṃ vadāmyatra śṛṇuṣvaikaṃ hi mānada |
yaṃ śrutvā na vaded vārtāṃ kathāmadhye kadācana || 39 ||
janasthāne purā kaścid brāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ |
dharmaśāstre'tinipuṇaḥ sadācāraparāyaṇaḥ || 4.40 ||
gaṅgāsnānaṃ vidhāyādau kṛtvā mādhyāhnikaṃ tathā |
kṛtvā devārcanaṃ caiva śravaṇe tatparo'bhavat || 41 ||
tasya bhāryātiduṣṭā ca karkaśā kalahapriyā |
asatyālāpanipuṇā paradveṣaparāyaṇā || 42 ||
hṛtvā cakre dhanasyāpi saṃgrahaṃ pāpaniścayā |
dadhi dugdhaṃ samānīya śarkarāguḍameva ca || 43 ||
ghṛtaṃ ca navanītaṃ ca svayamānīya sarvadā |
ekānte bhakṣaṇaṃ cakre bhartaryannaṃ praśuṣkakam || 44 ||
durāgrahā duṣṭamanāḥ patinindāparāyaṇā |
bahupāpaprakartrī ca paraveśmopaveśinī || 45 ||
subhāṣaṇaṃ vadennaiva dviṣaḥ kṣemavidhāyinī |
paṃktibhedaṃ prakurvāṇā sadā niṣṭhurabhāṣiṇī || 46 ||
atithiṣu sadā vairakāriṇī dharmanāśinī |
sajjano'pi guṇī saumyastasyā bhartā supūjitaḥ 47 ||
yadā bhartā purāṇasya śravaṇāya hi saṃsthitaḥ |
pratyahaṃ tatra gatvā tu tasya nindāṃ cakāra ha || 48 ||
saṃnyāsivat kathaṃ hyatra śravaṇe vyāsavat kṛtaḥ |
samutpannanirudyoga kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā vada || 49 ||
śiśavo māṃ pīḍayanti bhakṣaṇāya dine dine |
kiṃ teṣāṃ va prakartavyaṃ bhakṣaṇārthaṃ mayā vada || 4.50 ||
nāstyevānnaṃ gṛhe kiñcid vastraṃ vāpyathavā dhanam |
kiṃ mayā ca prakartavyaṃ kutra gantavyameva ca || 51 ||
kathaṃ vilikhitaṃ diṣṭaṃ dhātrā pāpena me purā |
mūrkhaścālasyasaṃyukto daridro niṣṭhurastathā || 52 ||
snehahīnaḥ kuṭumbe ca kathāyāḥ śravaṇe rataḥ |
etādṛśaḥ patirmahyaṃ dhātrā datto durātmanā || 53 ||
pṛthivyāṃ durbhagaikāhaṃ daridragṛhamāgatā |
udarāpūrtimātraṃ hi nānnaṃ me bhakṣitaṃ kadā || 54 ||
saubhāgyāstāḥ striyo loke yāsāmudyogaśālinaḥ |
patayo dhanadhānyādisamṛddhipariśobhitāḥ || 55 ||
te vai strīṇāṃ vākyakarāḥ śiśupālanatatparāḥ |
nityaṃ gṛheṣu tiṣṭhanti strīṇāṃ saṃtoṣakārakāḥ || 56 ||
sadannabhakṣaṇāt puṣṭā bhāryājñāparipālakāḥ |
vyavasāyaṃ ca bhāryāṇāṃ kurvanti buddhiśālinaḥ || 57 ||
ayaṃ mūrkhaśca jaḍadhīrupekṣāṃ kurute gṛhe |
adya tailaṃ gṛhe nāsti cendhanaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā || 58 ||
śākaśca mama nāstyeva dhānyaleśo na madgṛhe |
kiṃ mayā tu prakartavyaṃ patiretādṛśo mama || 59 ||
kathāyāṃ śrūyamāṇāyāṃ patyā sanmārgamūrtiṃnā |
dhānyādau vidyamāne'pi mithyābhāṣaṇatatparā || 4.60 ||
kathāvighnaṃ cakārāsau karkaśā sā dine dine |
tataḥ kālena maraṇaṃ prāptā sā duṣṭamānasā || 61 ||
yamadūtaistu baddhā sā nītā ca yamamandire |
tato yamājñayā taistu narake pātitā ciram || 62 ||
paścāt sā rākṣasī jātā bhairave jalavarjite |
araṇye kṣuttṛṣāyuktā pūrvapāpaprabhāvataḥ || 63 ||
tasmād vighnaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhāryayā puruṣeṇa vā |
śrīhareḥ satkathāyāstu tava satyaṃ vadāmyaham || 64 ||
mīnālino mahiṣahaṃsabakasvabhāvā mārjārakākavṛkakaṃkajalaukatulyāḥ |
sacchidrakumbhajalasindhuśilopamāśca te śrāvakāśca sucaturdaśadhā bhavanti || 65||
daridraśca kṣayī rogī nirbhāgyaḥ pāpakarmavān |
anapatyo mokṣakāmaḥ śṛṇuyāt sa kathāmimām ||66||
apuṣpā kākavandhyā ca vandhyā yā ca mṛtārbhakā |
sravadgarbhā ca yā nārī tayā śrāvyā prayatnataḥ || 67 ||
suputraṃ labhate rājan vyāsasya vacanaṃ yathā |
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti kathāṃ śrutvā harerimām ||68||
iti śrīpadmapurāṇe harivaṃśamāhātmye śravaṇādividhikathanaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||

<4.5>

pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ
vaiśampāyana uvāca
evaṃ kṛtvā vratavidhimudyāpanamathācaret |
janmāṣṭamīvratamiva kartavyaṃ phalakāṅkṣibhiḥ || 1 ||
akiñcaneṣu bhakteṣu prāyo nodyāpanagrahaḥ |
śravaṇenaiva pūtāste niṣkāmā vaiṣṇavā yataḥ || 2 ||
evaṃ navāhayajñe'smin samāpte śrotṛbhistadā |
pustakasya ca vaktuśca pūjā kāryātibhaktitaḥ || 3 ||
prasādatulasīmālā śrotṛbhyaścātha dīyatām |
mṛdaṅgatālalalitaṃ kīrtanaṃ kīrtyatāṃ tataḥ || 4 ||
jayaśabdo namaḥśabdaḥ śaṅkhaśabdaśca gīyatām |
viprebhyo yācakebhyaśca vittamannaṃ ca dīyatām || 5 ||
śravaṇānte harermūrtiḥ saśrīkasya pradīyatām |
suvarṇasya kṛtā samyaglakṣmyaṅkā palamānataḥ || 6 ||
samāptau vidhivad vastraṃ kṣaumaṃ dadyācca vācake |
viśeṣo'yaṃ samuddiṣṭo munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ || 7 ||
samāpya sarvaṃ prayataḥ saṃhitāśāstrakovidaḥ |
śubhe dine niveśyātha kṣaumavastrābhisaṃvṛtaḥ || 8 ||
śuklāmbaradharastatra śucirbhūtvā svalaṃkṛtaḥ |
arcayattu yathānyāyaṃ gandhamālyaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 9 ||
sahitāpustakaṃ tatra prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ |
bhakṣyairbhojyaiścāpūpaiśca kautukairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 5.10 ||
hiraṇyamanyad dravyaṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ tatra dāpayet |
ye śrāvayanti manujānpuṇyāṃ paurāṇikīṃ kathām || 11 ||
kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ yānti te brahmaṇaḥ pade |
āsanārthaṃ prayacchanti purāṇajñasya ye narāḥ || 12 ||
kambalājinavāsāṃsi mañcāphalakameva ca |
svargalokaṃ samāsādya bhuktvā bhogānyathepsitān|| 13||
sthitvā brahmādilokeṣu padaṃ yānti nirāmayam |
purāṇasya prayacchanti ye sūtravasanaṃ navam || 14 ||
bhogino jñānasampannāste bhavanti bhave bhave |
ye mahāpātakairyuktā upapātakinaśca ye || 15 ||
purāṇaśravaṇādeva te yānti paramaṃ padam |
harivaṃśaṃ likhitvā yo vācakāya pradāpayet || 16 ||
yatphalaṃ bhūmidānasya tat phalaṃ labhate hi saḥ |
rājasūyena teneṣṭamaśvamedhena vai nṛpa || 17 ||
dattāni sarvadānāni harivaṃśe śrute'khile |
rājasūyāśvamedhādyā yajñāścaiva yuge yuge || 18 ||
śravaṇaṃ harivaṃśasya kalau yajñaphalapradam |
śraddhāvānāstiko dānto harivaṃśaṃ yadārabhet || 19 ||
pātakāni prakampante pratyūhāni jvalanti ca |
samārabhya nayet pāraṃ harivaṃśaṃ ya āditaḥ || 5.20 ||
sparśanād darśanāttasya viṣṇurdṛṣṭo bhavennṛpa |
janmatrayasya nikaṣaḥ pātakasya kṣayo dhuvam || 21 ||
phalāptiśca samāptau ca harivaṃśasya buddhyate |
śroturbhārata vijñeyaṃ pūrvaṃ sukṛtilakṣaṇam || 22 ||
yena saṃjāyate buddhirharivaṃśāvadhāraṇe |
sarvāṇi ca purāṇāni vedāśca smṛtayastathā || 23 ||
harivaṃśena baddhārthā vyāsena ca maharṣiṇā |
śrutismṛtipurāṇānāṃ nindakebhyaḥ kathaṃcana || 24 ||
pāpibhyaśca mahārāja śrāvayennaiva vācakaḥ |
śrutyā tuṣṭena manasā vācakaṃ paripūjayet ||25 ||
dāntaṃ yaśasvinaṃ kāntaṃ śuciṃ spaṣṭākṣarabruvam |
triśuklamācāraparamakrodhanamavādinam || 26 ||
grāmaṃ dadyātsuvasitaṃ kuṇḍaloṣṇīṣamālikām |
pādukopānahau chatraṃ savitānaṃ masūrikām || 27 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā tu vidhivad vācakāya pradāpayet |
yānaṃ bārṣaṃ hayagajau kṣaumaṃ maṇimayāsanam || 28 ||
pañca bhāṇḍāni tāmrasya tāmrasyaivāmbubhājanam|
sakuṭumbaṃ ca sastrīkaṃ vācakaṃ parayā mudā || 29 ||
vibhūṣaṇairalaṃkṛtya paridhāyya suvāsasī |
kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ dhyāyan namaskurvīta bhāvataḥ || 5.30 ||
vācake parituṣṭe tu tuṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ |
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kartavyaṃ harivaṃśaphalepsubhiḥ || 31 ||
pradeyā gauḥ śubhā caikā savatsā hemapūritā |
palena ca palārdhena tadardhaṃ vātha vā punaḥ || 32 ||
vācakaṃ yena kenāpi toṣayet susamāhitaḥ |
tuṣṭe tu vācake rājaṃstuṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ || 33 ||
tuṣṭeṣu sarvadeveṣu kāryaṃ tu saphalaṃ bhavet |
harivaṃśe samāpte tu vācake paripūjite || 34 ||
ṛṇatrayeṇa muktāḥ syuste narā janamejaya |
modante pitarasteṣāṃ lokān prāpyākṣayānnṛpa ||35 ||
harivaṃśasya prārambhe samāptau caiva taiḥ saha |
sarvān kāmānavāpnoti vipāpmā jāyate naraḥ || 36 ||
evaṃ kṛte vidhāne tu prajāṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
dhanamārogyamāyuṣyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ guṇagauravam || 37 ||
prāpnoti manujaḥ samyaṅnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 38 ||
iti śrīpadmapurāṇe harivaṃśamāhātmye śravaṇādividhikathanaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||

<4.6>

ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ
janamejaya uvāca
prārambhastu kathaṃ kāryaḥ kathaṃ pūjāvidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
kathaṃ visarjayedvyāsaṃ kathaṃ samyakphalaṃ labhet || 1 ||
vaiśampāyana uvāca
śṛṇu rājan yathāvandhyā saṃtatiṃ labhate dhruvam || 2 ||
vaiśākhe māgha ūrje ca anyasmiñchubhamāsake |
śuklapakṣe tithau pūrṇā nandā bhadrā jayāsu ca || 3 ||
vāre gurau tathā śukre candre candrātmaje tathā |
nakṣatre śravaṇe haste puṣye mūle punarvasau || 4 ||
vāsave tuhināṃśau ca pauṣṇe ca hayatārake |
saubhāgyādiṣu yogeṣu karaṇe viṣṭivarjite || 5 ||
śrotu'ścāthāpi vaktuśca candre ca balaśālini |
pūrvāhṇe cāpi madhyāhne prārambhaḥ kriyate budhaiḥ || 6 ||
ādau lambodaraḥ pūjyaḥ kalaśastu tataḥ param |
śrīkhaṇḍāgurukarpūrakuṅkumāmodalepanaiḥ || 7 ||
paṅkajaiścampakairanyairjātīpuṣpaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ |
tulasībilvadhātrīṇāṃ patrairanyairnavāṅkuraiḥ || 8 ||
dhūpairdīpaiśca vividhairnārikelaphalādibhiḥ |
tāmbūlairmukhavāsaiścākhaṇḍitaiḥ śuklataṇḍulaiḥ || 9 ||
cāmarairvyajanaiścaiva ghaṇṭāvādyādibhistathā |
pratyahaṃ pūjayed devaṃ yāvad granthaḥ samāpyate || 6.10 ||
lattādidoṣarahite vāre ca śubhasaṃjñake |
samarpayet purāṇaṃ tu tataḥ pūjāṃ samācaret || 11 ||
prārambhe ca yathā pūjā tathā kāryā visarjane |
candanāgurukarpūrakuṅkumairgandhakādibhiḥ || 12 ||
gītavāditranṛtyaiśca rājan kāryo mahotsavaḥ |
tataḥ purāṇapūjāyāṃ yathā dānaṃ tathā śṛṇu || 13 ||
aṣṭādaśaśataṃ dānaṃ purāṇāya samarpayet |
abhāve dvādaśaśataṃ pūjā vai janamejaya || 14 ||
tadabhāve'pi rājendra ṣaṭśataṃ parikīrtitam |
uttamaṃ madhyamaṃ dānamadhamaṃ ca prakīrtitam || 15 ||
sapatnīkaṃ tato vyāsaṃ dukūlairaṃśukairnavaiḥ |
pūjayet sarvabhāvena sa samyak phalamaśnute || 16 ||
paridheyāni deyāni kuṇḍalāni śubhāni ca |
mukuṭādyairalaṃkṛtya keyūrāṅgadabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 17 ||
gāvastu kapilā deyāḥ savatsā garbhasaṃyutāḥ |
yānamaśvādikaṃ rājandāsīdāsān samarpayet || 18 ||
āsanaṃ puruṣavyāghra dhūpadīpādi bhājanam |
śayyā tūlādikaṃ sarvaṃ sopadhānaṃ salaḍḍukam || 19 ||
sthālī pīṭhādikaṃ rājañjalapātraṃ tathaiva ca |
annaṃ ca bahu dātavyaṃ lavaṇaṃ janamejaya || 6.20 ||
ghṛtatailādikaṃ rājan yāvad varṣaṃ samāpyate |
etat sarvaṃ dvijendrāya vyāsāsanagatāya ca || 21 ||
mano'bhīṣṭaṃ varaṃ labdhvā tataḥ kuryātpradakṣiṇām |
pāraṇānte tu rājendra dvijendraṃ rudrajāpinam || 22 ||
vastrādibhiralaṃkṛtya mudrikābhistathaiva ca |
navīnaṃ kambalaṃ śubhraṃ tāmrapātraṃ tathaiva ca || 23 ||
dvijaṃ dvijaṃ samuddiśya dātavyā dakṣiṇā bahu |
tato'bhiṣekasaṃyuktaṃ guḍaṃ caiva purodhasam || 24 ||
vastrādibhiralaṃkṛtya dakṣiṇābhiśca toṣayet |
tato'nyānbrāhmaṇānsarvāndakṣiṇābhiḥ samarcayet||25|
havanaṃ ca tathā rājan kartavyaṃ karmaśāntaye |
pratiślokaṃ ca juhuyād daśāṃśenaiva vā punaḥ || 26 ||
pāyasaṃ makṣu sarpiśca tilānnādikasaṃyutam |
athavā havanaṃ kuryād gāyatryā susamāhitaḥ || 27 ||
tanmayatyātpurāṇasya paramasyāsya tattvataḥ |
homāśaktau budho hema dadyāt tatphalasiddhaye || 28 ||
nānācchidranirodhārthaṃ nyūnatādhikatākhyayoḥ |
doṣayoḥ praśamārthaṃ ca paṭhennāmasahasrakam || 29 ||
tena syāt saphalaṃ sarvaṃ nāstyasmādadhikaṃ yataḥ |
bhojayenmithunānyeva caturviṃśatimādarāt || 6.30 ||
tato gandhaiśca mālyaiśca svalaṃkṛtya dvijottamān |
toṣayed dakṣiṇāhemairdhānyai ratnādibhistathā || 31 ||
bhuktavatsu ca vipreṣu yathāvatsamayā ca tān |
vācakaṃ bharataśreṣṭha bhojayitvā svalaṃkṛtam || 32 ||
sapatnīkaṃ ca saṃtoṣya vastrālaṅkaraṇādibhiḥ |
brāhmaṇeṣu prasanneṣu prasannāstasya devatāḥ || 33 ||
vācake parituṣṭe tu śubhā prītiranuttamā |
dadyāt suvarṇaṃ dhenuṃ ca vratapūrṇatvasiddhaye || 34 ||
śaktau palatrayamitaṃ svarṇasiṃhaṃ vidhāya ca |
tatrāsya pustakaṃ sthāpya likhitaṃ lalitākṣaram || 35 ||
sampūjyāvāhanādyaiśca upacāraiḥ sadakṣiṇaiḥ |
vastrabhūṣaṇagandhādyaiḥ pūjitāya mahātmane || 36 ||
ācāryāya sudhīrdattvā muktaḥ syādbhavabandhanaiḥ |
evaṃ kṛte vidhāne ca sarvapāpanivāraṇe || 37 ||
phaladaṃ syāt purāṇaṃ tu sarvakāmārthasiddhidam |
anena vidhinā rājan yaḥ purāṇaṃ samāpayet || 38 ||
tasya strī labhate garbhaṃ māsenaikena bhārata |
anena vidhinā rājanvyāsaṃ yastu samarcayet || 39 ||
pūjayed dānamānābhyāṃ tasya strī garbhiṇī bhavet |
yanmayā vividhaṃ proktaṃ bhaktipūjādikaṃ punaḥ || 6.40 ||
tat kṛtvā labhate nārī putraṃ bhāskaratejasam |
tathā vandhyā labhedgarbhaṃ vyāsasya vacanaṃ yathā || 41 ||
vipraratnāpahārī ca so'napatyaḥ prajāyate |
tena kāyaviśuddhyarthaṃ mahārudrajapādikam || 42 ||
atha pārīkṣito rājā śraddhāyuktena cetasā |
bhāvataḥ sattvayuktena caikāgramanasā tathā || 43 ||
śrutvānte niścayaṃ kṛtvā dambhaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ |
śrutvemaṃ harivaṃśaṃ vai vyāsaṃ sampūjya bhaktitaḥ || 44||
dānaṃ ca bahulaṃ kṛtvā vyāsāśīrgṛhya bhārataḥ |
prasannavadano bhūtvā ramate ramaṇīyutaḥ || 45||
prāgjanmajanite pāpe kṣīṇe vai janamejaya |
ṛtāvādye tu saṃdhatte garbhaṃ tasya kulāṅganā || 46 ||
dvitīye vā tṛtīye vā caturthe māsi vai punaḥ |
pañcame vāpi ṣaṣṭhe vā saptame aṣṭame'pi vā || 47 ||
navame daśame māsi dohadaṃ niścayaṃ bhavet|
vyāsenoktamidaṃ puṇyaṃ vandhyāgarbhasya lakṣaṇam || 48 ||
pitṝnuddharate sarvān daśa pūrvān daśāparān |
harivaṃśaṃ naraḥ śrutvā setihāsaṃ purātanam || 49 ||
idaṃ mayā tavāgre ca sarvaṃ proktaṃ nararṣabha |
yasya śravaṇamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 6.50 ||
aputraḥ putramāpnoti hyadhano dhanamāpnuyāt |
naramedhāśvamedhābhyāṃ yat phalaṃ prāpyate naraiḥ || 51 ||
tatphalaṃ labhyate sarvaṃ purāṇaśravaṇāddhareḥ |
brahmahā bhrūṇahā goghnaḥ surāpo gurutalpagaḥ |
sakṛt purāṇaśravaṇātpūto bhavati nānyathā || 52 ||
idaṃ mayā te parikīrtitaṃ mahacchrīkṛṣṇamāhātmyamapāramadbhutam |
śṛṇvan paṭhannāśu samāpnuyāt phalaṃ yaccāpi lokeṣu sudurlabhaṃ mahat|| 53 ||
iti śrīpadmapurāṇe harivaṃśamāhātmye śravaṇavidhau dānavidhānakathanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 ||
|| savidhi harivaṃśamāhātmya sampūrṇa ||

<5.1>

saṃtānagopālamantravidhiḥ
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ |
asya śrīsaṃtānagopālamantrasya śrīnārada ṛṣiḥ, anuṣṭup chandaḥ, śrīkṛṣṇo devatā, glauṃ bījam, namaḥ śaktiḥ, putrārthe jape viniyogaḥ |
aṅganyām
dvadevakīsuta govinda' hṛdayāya namaḥ|
vāsudeva jagatpate śirase svāhā |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa śikhāyai vaṣaṭ |
tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ |
oṃ namaḥ astrāya phaṭ |
dhyānam —
vaikuṇṭhādāgataṃ kṛṣṇaṃ rathasthaṃ karuṇānidhim |
kirīṭisārathiṃ putramānayantaṃ parātparam || 1 ||
ādāya taṃ jalasthaṃ ca gurave vaidikāya ca |
arpayantaṃ mahābhāgaṃ dhyāyet putrārthamacyutam || 2 ||
mūla mantram —
oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ glauṃ devakīsuta govinda vāsudeva jagatpate |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||

<5.2>

saṃtānagopālamantraḥ
viniyogaḥ —
asya śrīsaṃtānagopālamantrasya brahmā ṛṣirgāyatrīcchandaḥ, śrīkṛṣṇo devatā, klīṃ bījam, namaḥ śaktiḥ putrārthe jape viniyogaḥ |
aṅganyāsaḥ
glauṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ | klīṃ śirase svāhā | hrīṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | śrīṃ kavacāya hum | oṃ astrāya phaṭ
dhyānam —
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmaṃ dadhānaṃ sūtikāgṛhe |
aṅke śayānaṃ devakyāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vande vimuktaye ||
mūlamantram —
oṃ namo bhagavate jagadātmasūtaye namaḥ |
viniyogaḥ —
oṃ asya śrīsaṃtānagopālamantrasya śrīnārada ṛṣiḥ, anuṣṭup chandaḥ, śrīkṛṣṇo devatā, glauṃ bījam, namaḥ śaktiḥ, putrārthe jape viniyogaḥ |
aṅganyāsam —
devakīsuta govinda hṛdayāya namaḥ |
vāsudeva jagatpate' śirase svāhā |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa śikhāyai vaṣaṭ |
tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ' kavacāya hum |
devakīsuta govinda vāsudeva jagatpate |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || astrāya phaṭ |
dhyānam —
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmaṃ dhārayantaṃ janārdanam |
aṅke śayānaṃ devakyāḥ sūtikāmandire śubhe ||
evaṃ rūpaṃ sadā kṛṣṇa sutārthaṃ bhāvayet sudhīḥ ||
mantram —
oṃ devakīsuta govinda vāsudeva jagatpate |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||
saṃtānagopālastotram
śrīśaṃ kamalapatrākṣaṃ devakīnandanaṃ harim |
sutasamprāptaye kṛṣṇaṃ namāmi madhusūdanam || 1 ||
namāmyahaṃ vāsudevaṃ sutasamprāptaye harim |
yaśodāṅkagataṃ bālaṃ gopālaṃ nandanandanam || 2 ||
asmākaṃ putralābhāya govindaṃ munivanditam |
namāmyahaṃ vāsudevaṃ devakīnandanaṃ sadā || 3 ||
gopālaṃ ḍimbhakaṃ vande kamalāpatimacyutam |
putrasamprāptaye kṛṣṇaṃ namāmi yadupuṅgavam || 4 ||
putrakāmeṣṭiphaladaṃ kañjākṣaṃ kamalāpatim |
devakīnandanaṃ vande sutasamprāptaye mama || 5 ||
padmāpate padmanetra padmanābha janārdana |
dehi me tanayaṃ śrīśa vāsudeva jagatpate || 6 ||
yaśodāṅkagataṃ bālaṃ govindaṃ munivanditam |
asmākaṃ putralābhāya namāmi śrīśamacyutam || 7 ||
śrīpate devadeveśa dīnārtiharaṇācyuta |
govinda me sutaṃ dehi namāmi tvāṃ janārdana || 8 ||
bhaktakāmada govinda bhaktaṃ rakṣa śubhapradaṃ |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa rukmiṇīvallabha prabho || 9 ||
rukmiṇīnātha sarveśa dehi me tanayaṃ sadā |
bhaktamandāra padmākṣa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 10 ||
devakīsuta govinda vāsudeva jagatpate |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 11 ||
vāsudeva jagadvandya śrīpate puruṣottama |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 12 ||
kañjākṣa kamalānātha parakāruṇikottama |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 13 ||
lakṣmīpate padmanābha mukunda munivandita |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 14 ||
kāryakāraṇarūpāya vāsudevāya te sadā |
namāmi putralābhārthaṃ sukhadāya budhāya te || 15 ||
rājīvanetra śrīrāma rāvaṇāre hare kave |
tubhyaṃ namāmi deveśa tanayaṃ dehi me hare || 16 ||
asmākaṃ putralābhāya bhajāmi tvāṃ jagatpate |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa vāsudeva ramāpate || 17 ||
śrīmāninīmānacora gopīvastrāpahāraka |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa vāsudeva jagatpate || 18 |
asmākaṃ putrasamprāptiṃ kuruṣva yadunandana |
ramāpate vāsudeva mukunda munivandita || 19 ||
vāsudeva sutaṃ dehi tanayaṃ dehi mādhava |
putraṃ me dehi śrīkṛṣṇa vatsaṃ dehi mahāprabho || 20 ||
ḍimbhakaṃ dehi śrīkṛṣṇa ātmajaṃ dehi rāghava |
bhaktamandāra me dehi tanayaṃ nandanandana || 21 ||
nandanaṃ dehi me kṛṣṇa vāsudeva jagatpate |
kamalānātha govinda mukunda munivandita || 22 ||
anyathā śaraṇaṃ nāsti tvameva śaraṇaṃ mama |
sutaṃ dehi śriyaṃ dehi śriyaṃ putraṃ pradehi me || 23 ||
yaśodāstanyapānajñaṃ pibantaṃ yadunandanam |
vande'haṃ putralābhārthaṃ kapilākṣaṃ hariṃ sadā || 24 ||
nandanandana deveśa nandanaṃ dehi me prabho |
ramāpate vāsudeva śriyaṃ putraṃ jagatpate || 25 ||
putraṃ śriyaṃ śriyaṃ putraṃ putraṃ me dehi mādhava |
asmākaṃ dīnavākyasya avadhāraya śrīpate || 26 ||
gopālaḍimbha govinda vāsudeva ramāpate |
asmākaṃ ḍimbhakaṃ dehi śriyaṃ dehi jagatpate || 27 ||
madvāñchitaphalaṃ dehi devakīnandanācyuta |
mama putrārthitaṃ dhanyaṃ .kuruṣva yadunandana ||28 ||
yāce'haṃ tvāṃ śriyaṃ putraṃ dehi me putrasampadam |
bhaktacintāmaṇe rāma kalpavṛkṣa mahāprabho || 29 ||
ātmajaṃ nandanaṃ putraṃ kumāraṃ ḍimbhakaṃ sutam |
arbhakaṃ tanayaṃ dehi sadā me raghunandana || 30 ||
vande saṃtānagopālaṃ mādhavaṃ bhaktakāmadam |
asmākaṃ putrasaṃprāptyai sadā govindamacyutam || 31 ||
oṃkārayuktaṃ gopālaṃ śrīyuktaṃ yadunandanam |
klīṃyuktaṃ devakīputraṃ namāmi yadunāyakam || 32 ||
vāsudeva mukundeśa govinda mādhavācyuta |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa ramānātha mahāprabho || 33 ||
rājīvanetra govinda kapilākṣa hare prabho |
samastakāmyavarada dehi me tanayaṃ sadā || 34 ||
abjapadmanibhaṃ padmavṛndarūpa jagatpate |
dehi me varasatputraṃ ramānāyaka mādhava || 35 ||
nandapāla dharāpāla govinda yadunandana |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa rukmiṇīvallabha prabho || 36 ||
dāsamandāra govinda mukunda mādhavācyuta |
gopāla puṇḍarīkākṣa dehi me tanayaṃ śriyam || 37 ||
yadunāyaka padmeśa nandagopavadhūsuta |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa śrīdharaḥ prāṇanāyaka || 38 ||
asmākaṃ vāñchitaṃ dehi dehi putraṃ ramāpate |
bhagavan kṛṣṇa sarveśa vāsudeva jagatpate || 39 ||
ramāhṛdayasambhāra satyabhāmāmanaḥpriya |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa rukmiṇīvallabha prabho || 40 ||
candrasūryākṣa govinda puṇḍarīkākṣa mādhava |
asmākaṃ bhāgyasatputraṃ dehi deva jagatpate || 41 ||
kāruṇyarūpa padmākṣa padmanābhasamarcita |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa devakīnandanandana || 42 ||
devakīsuta śrīnātha vāsudeva jagatpate |
samastakāmaphalada dehi me tanayaṃ sadā || 43 ||
bhaktamandāra gambhīra śaṅkarācyuta mādhava |
dehi me tanayaṃ gopabālavatsala śrīpate || 44 ||
śrīpate vāsudeveśa devakīpriyanandana |
bhaktamandāra me dehi tanayaṃ jagatāṃ prabho || 45 ||
jagannātha ramānātha bhūminātha dayānidhe |
vāsudeveśa sarveśa dehi me tanayaṃ prabho || 46 ||
śrīnātha kamalapatrākṣa vāsudeva jagatpate |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 47 ||
dāsamandāra govinda bhaktacintāmaṇe prabho |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 48 ||
govinda puṇḍarīkākṣa ramānātha mahāprabho |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 49 ||
śrīnātha kamalapatrākṣa govinda madhusūdana |
matputraphalasiddhayarthaṃ bhajāmi tvāṃ janārdana || 50 ||
stanyaṃ pibantaṃ jananīmukhāmbujaṃ vilokya mandasmitamujjvalāṅgam |
spṛśantamanyastanamaṅgulībhirvande yaśodāṅkagataṃ mukundam || 51 ||
yāce'haṃ putrasaṃtānaṃ bhavantaṃ padmalocana |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 52 ||
asmākaṃ putrasampatteścintayāmi jagatpate |
śīghraṃ me dehi dātavyaṃ bhavatā munivandita || 53 ||
vāsudeva jagannātha śrīpate puruṣottama|
kuruṃ māṃ putradattaṃ ca kṛṣṇa devendrapūjita||54||
kuru māṃ putradattaṃ ca yaśodāpriyanandana |
mahyaṃ ca putrasaṃtānaṃ dātavyaṃ bhavatā hare || 55 ||
vāsudeva jagannātha govinda devakīsuta |
dehi me tanayaṃ rāma kausalyāpriyanandana || 56 ||
padmapatrākṣa govinda viṣṇo vāmana mādhava |
dehi me tanayaṃ sītāprāṇanāyaka rāghava || 57 ||
kañjākṣa kṛṣṇa devendramaṇḍita munivandita |
lakṣmaṇāgraja śrīrāma dehi me tanayaṃ sadā || 58 ||
dehi me tanayaṃ rāma daśarathapriyanandana |
sītānāyaka kañjākṣa mucukundavaraprada || 59 ||
vibhīṣaṇasya yā laṅkā pradattā bhavatā purā |
asmākaṃ tatprakāreṇa tanayaṃ dehi mādhava || 60 ||
bhavadīyapadāmbhoje cintayāmi nirantaram |
dehi me tanayaṃ sītāprāṇavallabha rāghava || 61 ||
rāma matkāmyavarada putrotpattiphalaprada |
dehi me tanayaṃ śrīśa kamalāsanavandita || 62 ||
rāma rāghava sīteśa lakṣmaṇānuja dehi me |
bhāgyavatputrasaṃtānaṃ daśarathātmaja śrīpate || 63 ||
devakīgarbhasaṃjāta yaśodāpriyanandana |
dehi me tanayaṃ rāma kṛṣṇa gopāla mādhava || 64 ||
kṛṣṇa mādhava govinda vāmanācyuta śaṅkara |
dehi me tanayaṃ śrīśa gopabālakanāyaka ||65 ||
gopabāla mahādhanya govindācyuta mādhava |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa vāsudeva jagatpate || 66 ||
diśatu diśatu putraṃ devakīnandano'yaṃ
diśatu diśatu śīghraṃ bhāgyavatputralābham |
diśatu diśatu śrīśo rāghavo rāmacandro
diśatu diśatu putraṃ vaṃśavistārahetoḥ || 67 ||
dīyatāṃ vāsudevena tanayo matpriyaḥ sutaḥ |
kumāro nandanaḥ sītānāyakena sadā mama || 68 ||
rāma rāghava govinda devakīsuta mādhava |
dehi me tanayaṃ śrīśa gopabālakanāyaka || 69 ||
rāghava govinda devakīputra mādhava śrīpate
gopabālakanāyaka śrīkṛṣṇa mupte putra dījiye || 69 ||
vaṃśavistārakaṃ putraṃ dehi me madhusūdana |
sutaṃ dehi sutaṃ dehi tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 70 ||
mamābhīṣṭasutaṃ dehi kaṃsāre mādhavācyuta |
sutaṃ dehi sutaṃ dehi tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 71 ||
candrārkakalpaparyantaṃ tanayaṃ dehi mādhava |
sutaṃ dehi sutaṃ dehi tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 72 ||
vidyāvantaṃ buddhimantaṃ śrīmantaṃ tanayaṃ sadā |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa devakīnandana prabho || 73 ||
namāmi tvāṃ padmanetra sutalābhāya kāmadam |
mukundaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ govindaṃ madhusūdanam || 74 || 
bhagavan kṛṣṇa govinda sarvakāmaphalaprada |
dehi me tanayaṃ svāmiṃstvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 75 ||
svāmiṃstvaṃ bhagavan rāma kṛṣṇa mādhava kāmada |
dehi me tanayaṃ nityaṃ tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 76 ||
tanayaṃ dehi govinda kañjākṣa kamalāpate |
sutaṃ dehi sutaṃ dehi tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 77 ||
padmāpate padmanetra pradyumnajanaka prabho |
sutaṃ dehi sutaṃ dehi tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 78 ||
śaṅkhacakragadākhaḍgaśārṅgapāṇe ramāpate |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 79 ||
nārāyaṇa ramānātha rājīvapatralocana |
sutaṃ me dehi deveśa padmapadmānuvandita || 80 ||
rāma rāghava govinda devakīvaranandana |
rukmiṇīnātha sarveśa nāradādisurārcita || 81 ||
devakīsuta govinda vāsudeva jagatpate |
dehi me tanayaṃ śrīśa gopabālakanāyaka || 82 ||
munivandita govinda rukmiṇīvallabha prabho |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 83 ||
gopikārjitapaṅkejamakarandāsaktamānasa |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 84 ||
ramāhṛdayapaṅkejalola mādhava kāmada |
mamābhīṣṭasutaṃ dehi tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 85 ||
vāsudeva ramānātha dāsānāṃ maṅgalaprada |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 86 ||
kalyāṇaprada govinda murāre munivandita |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 87 ||
putraprada mukundeśa rukmiṇīvallabha prabho |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 88 ||
puṇḍarīkākṣa govinda vāsudeva jagatpate |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 89 ||
dayānidhe vāsudeva mukunda munivandita |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 90 ||
putrasampatpradātāraṃ govindaṃ devapūjitam |
vandāmahe sadā kṛṣṇaṃ putralābhapradāyinam || 91 ||
kāruṇyanidhaye gopīvallabhāya murāraye |
namaste putralābhārthaṃ dehi me tanayaṃ vibho || 92 ||
namastasmai rameśāya rukmiṇīvallabhāya te |
dehi me tanayaṃ śrīśa gopabālakanāyaka || 93 ||
namaste vāsudevāya nityaśrīkāmukāya ca |
putradāya ca sarpendraśāyine raṅgaśāyine || 94 ||
raṅgaśāyin ramānātha maṅgalaprada mādhava |
dehi me tanayaṃ śrīśa gopabālakanāyaka || 95 ||
dāsasya me sutaṃ dehi dīnamandāra rāghava |
sutaṃ dehi sutaṃ dehi putraṃ dehi ramāpate || 96 ||
yaśodātanayābhīṣṭaputradānarataḥ sadā |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||97 ||
madiṣṭadeva govinda vāsudeva janārdana |
dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 98 ||
nītimān dhanavān putro vidyāvāṃśca prajāyate |
bhagavaṃstvatkṛpāyāśca vāsudevendrapūjita || 99 ||
yaḥ paṭhet putraśatakaṃ so'pi satputravān bhavet|
śrīvāsudevakathitaṃ stotraratnaṃ sukhāya ca || 100||
japakāle paṭhennityaṃ putralābhaṃ dhanaṃ śriyam |
aiśvaryaṃ rājasammānaṃ sadyo yāti na saṃśayaḥ ||101||
|| iti śrīsaṃtānagopālastotraṃ sampūrṇaṃ ||
